LevelPlay_147000001_HandInItemsDesc_147_:
Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Generosity endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his valiant struggle to protect the land from TDs, emptied his own coffers and called upon the people to donate. The gathered wealth was displayed in the <color=Highlight>cottage by the windmill</color> and used to fortify defenses which, at only a modest cost, repelled the TD assault.
In giving, one finds reward.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Wisdom endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon", in his time, devoted himself to the study of the knightly path in <color=Highlight>Silver Moon Grove</color>. Over the years, he wrote volumes on what he learned, so that future knights might follow his teachings.
To the wise, fate serves; to the foolish, fate rules.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Courage endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his youth, singlehandedly fought a victorious battle against an entire pack of ferocious TDs near <color=Highlight>the great tree to the northwest of Egla Town</color>.
Courage is the knight's final weapon.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Mercy endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once stood vigil to <color=Highlight>the west of Mistveil Bay</color>, guarding the merchants who passed through. There, he drove away the fierce TDs and vanquished the ruthless Alari family.
To show mercy to the innocent, one must be merciless to the wicked.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Honor endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once dueled on <color=Highlight>the bridge leading to the Thorncrown Rises near Egla Town</color>, where he bested a hundred challengers.
Honor is a fine blade tempered in the fires of challenge.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Decay of Time.
Decay of Time: The Lifer gains 200% Glacio, Fusion, Electro, Aero, Spectro, and Havoc Resistance. Its Max HP is increased by 25%.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Desire for Escape.
Desire for Escape: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 25%. Additionally, DMG dealt by the Lifer is increased by an additional 25% every 20s.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Growing Loneliness.
Growing Loneliness: The Lifer recovers 10% of its Max HP every second after not being attacked for over 2s.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Impending Stalemate.
Impending Stalemate: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 20% each time it deals DMG, stacking up to 4 times. If the Lifer deals no DMG within 6s, all stacks will be cleared.

I engage only in profitable ventures. To stand in the arena, you must prove your worth.
I have three trials for you. Survive them, and we may speak further, brave young lady.
ReignsCard_700014_CardTitle: Epic of the Blazing Sun - Chapter II
ReignsCard_700017_CardDesc: A wise choice. Rest assured, beauty, I'll put in a good word for you with my master...

You were deceived by nobility and left with nothing.
An incorrect choice led to the story's end...

ReignsCard_700019_CardDesc:
Tempted by the offer, you sign the contract, only to find it's all a lie. No job, no money, nothing.
You recall the noble's mockery... In their eyes, you are but a circus clown.
ReignsCard_700020_CardDesc:
It is this insurmountable challenge that stirs the thirst for victory in your blood.
You accept the third trial: to confront the guardian of Septimont, Arsinosa.
ReignsCard_700021_CardDesc: Chapter III - The Impossible Trial, completed...
ReignsCard_700021_CardTitle: Epic of the Blazing Sun - Chapter III
ReignsCard_700023_CardDesc:
Your Forte never stands out among Resonators.
But its seemingly insignificant power is enough to be stronger than the forge fire and hammer swings.
ReignsCard_700024_CardDesc:
Exhaustion takes over. You have given everything, but still cannot defeat Arsinosa.
She doesn't spare you another look before turning away. You fall at the center of the arena alone.
ReignsCard_700025_CardDesc: Unable to bear the bone-shattering pain, you fight and stagger, until, at last, you fall on your knees before Arsinosa.
ReignsCard_700026_CardDesc:
You tried everything but were unable to do better.
An incorrect choice led to the story's end...
ReignsCard_700026_CardTitle: Epic of the Blazing Sun - Chapter IV
ReignsCard_700028_CardDesc: The spectators cheer you on, and the story concludes with a happy ending.
ReignsCard_700028_CardTitle: Epic of the Blazing Sun - Chapter IV
ReignsCard_700039_CardDesc:
Adorning yourself like this... Hah, you're just wearing a fake crown to cover your cowerdice.
What else wouldn't you abandon if you can toss away your home and your name!
Please, leave, now!
ReignsCard_700040_CardDesc:
Your will crumbles. There you stand, gazing up at that towering peak men call "Strength," frozen at the hill's very foot.
Perhaps a simple life is your best choice.
ReignsCard_700041_CardDesc:
You stand frozen in doubt, and then fear.
Without waiting any longer, Cato shakes his head and walks away.

Term260001_Desc: An institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong, with the highest official titled "Chief Commander." Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators.
Term260002_Desc: A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in Mingting, it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by an Intendant. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting.
Term260003_Desc: A unique Resonance Ability of Qiuyuan. By perceiving the nature and differences of surrounding frequencies, he can discern an enemy's location and even state of mind. In extreme cases, this perception can be amplified through Sonoro Spheres, bringing to life the mental imagery of his enemies—or even his own.
Term260004_Desc: A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."
Term260005_Desc:
A Tidespawn created by Leviathan. It is a fusion of the frequencies of three powerful Tacet Discords: the great lion "Nemea," the ancestral goat "Pan," and the slippery serpent "Python." Once Leviathan's "first offspring," it now "resides" within Galbrena after merging with her frequency.
Within this fused being, the lion's brutal nature dominates Chimera's will, while the goat tempers its violence by feeding on human compassion. The serpent, sly and independent, appears loyal to Galbrena but secretly undermines her frequency.
Term260006_Desc: The past name of "Murmurstown." Devastated sixteen years ago by the outbreak of the Dark Tide, it is now a lost Gladiator town in the Wastelands.
Term260007_Desc:
The Tacet Fields that exist in isolated dimensions. 
"Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.
Term260008_Desc: As the highest official in Huanglong's Ministry of War, the Minister oversees all military affairs for the six cities in Huanglong. The honorific title "Grand Marshal" is used to signify the rank and authority of this position.
Term260009_Desc: The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.
Term260010_Desc: The Ministry of War is Huanglong's supreme military command, headquartered in Mingting with branches in all six cities. Its leader, the Minister of War, holds supreme command over all military affairs. Authority is delegated to a General in each city, who manages local forces. While Mingting usually appoints these Generals, local Sentinels have the authority to do so in certain special cities.
Term260011_Desc: One of Huanglong's three judicial bodies. It holds the authority to jointly try major cases and wields significant supervisory power, a duty summarized as "to probe evil and maintain discipline." Its officials are generally titled Censors, while those stationed or assigned temporarily in the six cities are called Investigating Censors.
Term260012_Desc: Just as the name enjoyed by Napoli the Second, it is a title Primus Fenrico should have rightfully possessed. However, due to unknown reasons, Fenrico forbade Acolytes from referring to him as such, until he met his end at the bottom of the sea. In the history of the Order of the Deep, he is the only one who bears the name "Fenrico."
Term270001_Desc: A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.
Term700004_Desc: An amalgamated horror that often emerges alongside Void Storms. During lulls between Storms, it primarily inhabits the highly concentrated Voidmatter environment of the Mawburrow Desert. The Voidmatter Regulators on its head serve as both its power source and its weakness.
Term700005_Desc:
Officially the "Resonator Nursing Unit," the infirmary is a clinical-research hybrid facility overseen by Rabelle College.
Managed by Academy physician Luuk Herssen, it utilizes Frequency Therapeutics to provide comprehensive healthcare for the students and faculty of Startorch Academy.
Term700006_Desc:
An identity authentication device issued by the Spacetrek Collective, serving as mandatory safety gear for navigating Lahai-Roi.
All first-year students must complete the Cassette's burning and registration under faculty supervision at the Research Institute before venturing beyond the Academy's protected zones.
Term700007_Desc:
A standardized Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members, designed to hold the Rabelle Cassette.
Its casing is constructed from a special composite that mimics the Exostrider's engineering, granting partial resistance to Void Storms.
Term700008_Desc:
A colossal mech of alien origin, now dormant in the Roya Frostlands. Startorch Academy was founded to train Synchronists capable of establishing Augmented Resonance with it.
In the Roya's Trine Myth, it is revered as Baldur, the earthly incarnation of the sun deity Sol. Legend claims it once held up the earth's collapsing crust with its greatsword, saving the Roya from annihilation. Predictions foretell it will awaken from its slumber to confront the ruinous Hvedrungr in a final, apocalyptic battle.
Term700009_Desc:
Candidates selected from across Solaris who can link their consciousness to the giant Exostrider mech via an external mechanical interface.
These Synchronists can achieve a degree of control over the Exostrider through Augmented Resonance. To identify and train these rare pilots, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College.
Term700010_Desc:
The Exostrider's power core and Lahai-Roi's underground "sun."
Royan records say this energy entity was removed from the Exostrider and placed underground to sustain the haven. However, monitoring data confirms a gradual but steady decline in its energy output. Both the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective are now formulating emergency contingencies in response.
Term700011_Desc:
A colossal vertical transport system built along the Exostrider's greatsword, connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands.
Its structure resembles a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it connects the deep cavern to the surface and serves as Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.
Term700012_Desc:
The Exostrider's remaining weapon. The blade is buried deep within Sundermere, while its hilt supports the very ceiling of the cavern, forming a structural pillar through the heart of Lahai-Roi.
In the Roya's Trine Myth, it is predicted that Baldur will draw this sword in the final battle against the ruinous entity Hvedrungr.
Term700013_Desc:
A monitoring instrument installed on the surface of Sundermere by the Spacetrek Collective to oversee and maintain the Reactor Drive.
At its core is a replica of the Exostrider's calibration module, enabling a dedicated data link with the Drive to transmit real-time correction parameters. Hyvatia plays a vital role in ensuring the Reactor Drive's continuous and stable operation.
Term700014_Desc:
Specialized protective infrastructure developed by Startorch Academy, using reverse-engineered materials inspired by the Exostrider's surface fibers and coatings. It provides a degree of resistance against Voidmatter contamination.
It is now deployed as a standard protective measure in Spacetrek Collective camps, research outposts, and transit hubs. The largest installation is the Antivoid Canopy surrounding Startorch Academy.
Term700015_Desc:
The indigenous inhabitants of Lahai-Roi. They have lived in the underground cavern long before the Spacetrek Collective's arrival. They now maintain a cooperative relationship with it.
By observing the Reactor Drive's operational cycles, the Roya devised their own calendar. They guide the growth and migration of the Exoswarm, a sacred duty they regard as their tribe's calling.
Term700016_Desc:
A Spacetrek Collective project decades in the making to replace the Reactor Drive in the sky with Helios, an artificial sun engineered by the Research Institute.
Its ultimate goal is to retrieve the Drive as a power source to awaken the Exostrider slumbering in the frostlands, all while keeping Lahai-Roi's ecosystem stable.
Term700017_Desc:
The artificial sun crafted by the Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute to replace the Reactor Drive in the New Solar Ceremony.
For successful operation, it requires environmental data from Hyvatia and raw observational data on the Reactor Drive provided by the Heliogyre.
Term700018_Desc:
The sacred ground of the Roya and the dwelling of the Heliodic Six. It safeguards Exostrider parts and serves as the central archive for all Royan records.
With each operational cycle of the Reactor Drive, the Solisylum calculates its stability, tracks the birth and growth of the Exoswarm, and monitors their eventual return to the Exostrider.
Term700019_Desc:
An artifact used exclusively by the Heliodic Six to observe the Reactor Drive.
During the New Solar Ceremony, it provides Helios with raw observational data on the Reactor Drive.
Term700020_Desc:
Roya elders such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair in the Six is entrusted with the roles of observation, archival, and extrapolation.
They reside within the Solisylum, tracing the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecasting Void Storms.
Term700021_Desc: The forest where the Soliskin dwell. Bathed in the light of the Reactor Drive, the woods remain untouched by the ravages of Void Storms.
Term700022_Desc: Biomechanical creatures formed from the Exostrider's cellular remnants. By mimicking herds and other lifeforms, they helped rebuild Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.
Term700023_Desc: Materials harvested from Exoswarm. Though still essentially parts of the Exostrider, they are widely utilized in engineering Lahai-Roi's various constructs.
Term700024_Desc: Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become Shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjartr Woods and keep them safe.
Term700025_Desc: Individuals gifted in calendrical calculation and a degree of resonance with the Exostrider and Soliskin are permitted into the Solisylum. There, they serve the Heliodic Six as aides and the tribe as healers and teachers, all while being groomed as the Six's eventual successors.
Term700026_Desc: A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.
Term700027_Desc: Towering constructs widespread in Bjartr Woods, forming a vast, floating forest. Their roots permeate Lahai-Roi, relaying information directly to the Heliogyre.
Term700028_Desc:
A ceremony held by the Roya for the Soliskin. During the rite, the Soliskin transform into ethereal energy forms. Guided by Shepherds, they enter the Solistrees and disperse into luminescence as they rise.
The Roya believe this marks the Soliskin's return to the Exostrider.
Term700029_Desc: A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Lahai-Roi, erupting when Voidmatter concentrations reach a critical threshold. It indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range, causing widespread devastation. Before it strikes, an atmospheric light known as the Shimmer typically appears, serving as an early warning.
Term700030_Desc: A warm, humid underground haven deep beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift that made Lahai-Roi Solaris's new pole, the changing climate drove the surface-dwelling Roya to migrate below. Long isolated, it became a refuge for extinct prehistoric life, which has since evolved into a unique and remarkably independent ecosystem.
Term700031_Desc: Officially titled the Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, this borderless academic metropolis trains Synchronists and spearheads research into the giant mech known as the Exostrider. Its name embodies its core ethos: "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Here, seekers of knowledge from across the world gather, knowledge flows freely, and cultures meet in harmony.
Term750001_Desc:
An operation conducted by Septimont's Gladiators to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus.
The Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area, a remnant of the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita. Consequently, the region has become a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked.
As the confrontation with the Dark Tide stretched on, the Septimontians discovered a strategy to effectively curb the Dark Tide's advance: luring its creations toward the Earthrend Wedge and hunting them near its base. Since then, the "hunt" gradually evolved into an institutionalized tradition deeply woven into Septimont's culture.
Term750002_Desc: A type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.
Term750003_Desc: A colossal wedge-shaped structure located in the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus. It descended from the high heavens alongside Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator, who had full control over it. When the first Dark Tide outbreak struck Rinascita, the Earthrend Wedge was activated. Its energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus.
Term750004_Desc: Located on the outskirts of the city of Septimont, it's the "air terminal" where Gladiators cross the canyons and make their trip to and from the Sanguis Plateaus.
Term750005_Desc: The living quarters of Priestesses, where fate is observed and prophecies are documented. Commonly referred to as the "Temple."
Term750006_Desc: The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.
Term750007_Desc: A Common Echo in the form of a large horn. Hornett's high-pitched and lengthy blare is used to signal the beginning or the conclusion of large-scale hunting operations.
Term750008_Desc: The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.
Term750009_Desc:
A unique flame produced by igniting specific minerals. Its appearance resembles sunlight more than ordinary fire. The precise types and proportions of minerals used to create this flame are a closely guarded secret, passed down exclusively through generations of Priestesses.
While the Sacred Flame offers no special power, Priestesses channel their Resonance power through it, using its light to glimpse the future and deliver prophecies.
Yet to the Priestesses, the Sacred Flame is more than just a medium for divination. They view it as "celestial light descended to the mortal world," often referring to it as "the flames."
Term750010_Desc:
The ruins of a bygone civilization, said to be hidden deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Its entrance is located in the Wastelands. Long ago, it was visited by the three Heroes of Heroes from Septimont.
Legend has it that those who manage to set foot in Manes Deep can hear the whispers of the Heroes of Heroes and thereby gain powers rivaling their own. Some also hold that since the Heroes of Heroes walked this place, the journey to Manes Deep has become an inescapable trial for any who would claim that title.
Term750011_Desc: A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.
Term750012_Desc:
Native to the Septimont region, Griffrexes once coexisted with the ancestors of Septimont who sought refuge in Rinascita.
However, the outbreak of the first Dark Tide devastated the Border Mountains, the Griffrexes' habitat, driving most of the species to extinction. Since then, Griffrexes exist mostly as Common Echoes, which are generated at a fixed frequency from Resonance Beacons.
Over time, Septimontians became aware that these Griffrex Echoes still retained their instincts of hunting and sensing external frequencies. As a result, they were trained as Common Echoes for hunting purposes to track and attack Dark Tide creations.
Term750013_Desc:
A type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge. It provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.
During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.
Term750014_Desc:
An installation that can be field-deployed to amplify the frequency produced by Anchor Stones. Once the Anchor Stone is inserted, it can generate an energy field to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.
During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.
Term750015_Desc: A field nestled deep within Maroonwood. At an elevation approaching Earthrend Wedge and situated in the lower middle level of the Sanguis Plateaus, it serves as the primary battleground where Gladiators engage in deadly combat with the Dark Tide and its creatures.
Term750016_Desc: A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.
Term750017_Desc: The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.
Term750018_Desc: A legendary plant said to grow in Manes Deep. It can survive for years in environments tainted by the Dark Tide, giving it a natural resistance to corruption. When used in medicine, it can slow the Dark Tide's corruption effect on the human body and help restore consciousness.
Term750019_Desc: Victims of Dark Tide corruption who have lost all self-awareness. Their bodies usually resemble stone statues while retaining their original size. Such individuals constantly murmur and recite incomprehensible words and "hymns praising the Dark Tide." The voices from the Hollow Figures have been confirmed to be mentally debilitating, capable of influencing the cognition and mental stability of ordinary people to some extent.
Term750020_Desc: Objects that look like giant stone statues. They are often found near heavily traveled routes or high vantage points, serving as navigational markers for passersby. Some argue that these Waystones are a special type of Echo, formed from the fervent emotional frequencies of Gladiators who traveled through these areas. This theory, however, remains controversial in academic circles.
Term750021_Desc: This type includes Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic, Hologram Echo: Junrock, Hologram Echo: Drake, Hologram Echo: Hoartoise, and Hologram Echo: Puff.
Term750022_Desc: This type includes Tacetite Spikes with Optional Module II, Glacio Beacon, Hologram Echo: Junrock with Optional Module I, Frost Spout, Hologram Echo: Puff, and Freeze Jet
Term750023_Desc: This type includes: Tacetite Barrage with Optional Module I, Hologram Echo: Drake, Hologram Echo: Hoartoise with Optional Module II, Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic, and Burst Launcher
Term750024_Desc: This type includes Repulsor Spout, Vortex Generator, Whirlpool Device.
Term750025_Desc: This type includes Stun Emitter, Tacetite Spikes with Optional Module I, Thunder Lance, and Shock Inductor.
Term750026_Desc: Nimbus Wraith and Tacet Discords defeated by Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic may drop this item.
Term750027_Desc: KU-Money's Shop appears after certain waves, where you can consume Sim Credits to purchase Tactics and items.
Term750028_Desc: A Tactic Set that generates Chain Lightnings bouncing between targets, which is triggered by inflicting Paralysis on the targets.
Term750029_Desc: A Tactic Set that improves resource acquisition efficiency and converts surplus resources into offensive power.
Term750030_Desc: A Tactic Set focused on fire suppression by boosting Attack Speed and Control effects.
Term750031_Desc: The highly recommended core tactics of a Tactic Set.
Term750032_Desc: This type of Tactic increases ATK, Crit. Rate, and DMG of certain Attributes, and reduces Tacet Discords' RES, improving the attack efficiency.
Term750033_Desc: This type of Tactic enhances nearby Combat Machines within a certain range when active.
Term750034_Desc: This type of Tactic enhances debuffs like Paralysis, Slow, Frozen, and Burning.
Term750035_Desc: A planet-wide phenomenon born from an anomalous Lament event. It now blankets Solaris's sky. Research suggests it is composed of extremely high-density Remnant Energy. Since its appearance, all of Solaris's space exploration has been brought to a complete standstill.
Term750036_Desc: The entry point formed when the Exostrider and the Threnodian Aleph-1 entered Solaris. Researchers in Lahai-Roi widely believe it leads to outer space. The overlying Soliskin root network holds Aleph-1's power at bay, the "sealed doors" of the Stridergate.
Term750037_Desc: A phenomenon unique to the surface of the Roya Frostlands. Scholars theorize that this anomaly emerged when the Threnodian's power there attempted to devour the Exostrider, triggering abnormal Voidmatter transformations. Affected objects enter a state of unstable "existence," becoming impossible to observe directly.
Term750038_Desc: A specialized device developed by the Spacetrek Collective for research operations in the Roya Frostlands. It forces entities with fluctuating Voidmatter levels back into the observable state for practical use. In areas with stable signal coverage, the device can be deployed directly to the user's location.
Term750039_Desc: A Court of Savantae space station launched into near-Solaris orbit before the Etheric Sea fully enveloped the planet. Its primary mission was the study of Etheric Sea Droplets, research intended to pave the way for further space exploration.
Term750040_Desc: A high-dimensional domain embedded deep within high-density Voidmatter, existing "inside" Aleph-1. The fundamental laws of time and space descend into total chaos here. Any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.
Term750041_Desc: A species of seal native to the Roya Frostlands, named for its snowball-like, round, white body. Docile in nature, Snowfluff Seals show little reaction to people or their surroundings, spending most of their time either eating or lying still. Only when facing extreme danger will they rear up and bare their fangs as a deterrent. If intimidation fails, they will promptly retreat to a safer area.
Term750042_Desc: A special pharmaceutical substance developed for extremely rare diseases. However, its severe side effects make it intolerable for most, keeping it under ongoing research and validation. In its natural form, Ichor is a volatile golden liquid that radiates intense heat at room temperature. In rare cases, it can be controlled and stabilized into a solid form.
Term750043_Desc: A pharmaceutical corporation based in the New Federation. Its core technology originates from the development of Ichor, a groundbreaking medical advancement shadowed by perpetual controversy.
Term750044_Desc:
In the wake of the Tacet Discord Outbreak in Norfall Barrens, hordes of Tacet Discords were diverted and imprisoned in Censure Courts of varying sizes across the Land of Xuanfang. They now serve as sites for the regular purging of Tacet Discords.
Each Tacet Discord is held in its own Censure Cage, and these Cages also serve to transport newly forged Autopuppets from the Skyworks to where they are needed.
Term750045_Desc:
In the wake of the Tacet Discord Outbreak in Norfall Barrens, hordes of Tacet Discords were diverted and imprisoned in Censure Courts of varying sizes across the Land of Xuanfang. They now serve as sites for the regular purging of Tacet Discords.
Each Tacet Discord is held in its own Censure Cage, and these Cages also serve to transport newly forged Autopuppets from the Skyworks to where they are needed.
Term750046_Desc: A special unit formed by the Xuanfang Wardens, composed of three elite Wardens. Members of this unit are also known as Xuan Watchers. The Xuan Triad is tasked with handling incidents beyond the capabilities of standard Xuanfang Wardens.
Term750047_Desc: The members of Xuan Triad are also known as Xuan Watchers.
Term750048_Desc: An administrative bureau based in Shaftpost Yard. Inspection Officers are responsible for recording and verifying goods and commodities entering the Hold, while Constables handle identity checks for entrants and oversee security operations throughout the region.
Term750049_Desc: The soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens.
Term750050_Desc:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
It comprises the Thousandfold Foundry, which produces Autopuppets ceaselessly, and the Myriad Snare, which suppresses and exterminates powerful Tacet Discords. The Skyworks runs day and night in service to  Xuanfang Hold.
Term750051_Desc:
After Xuanling Birds went extinct, the people of Xuanfang crafted mechanical birds in their image and named them Rafter Kites.
In the past, Rafter Kites served as the primary means of communication across the Land of Xuanfang, carrying messages where their living predecessors once did. But with the widespread adoption of Terminals, their role as messengers has faded, becoming more ceremonial than essential.
Term750052_Desc: Prior to the founding of Xuanfang Hold, Yuan Fortress, a mechanized fortress, was built through collaboration between Zhuojun Atelier and the Ministry of Development. It was designed to defend against the Tacet Discord Outbreak originating from the Norfall Barrens.
Term750053_Desc:
A large-scale war that broke out simultaneously in the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress, aimed at preventing the spread of the Tacet Discord Outbreak from the Norfall Barrens into Huanglong via the Land of Xuanfang. 
Following this war, Jinzhou was formally established. 
Yuan Fortress was ultimately destroyed during the war, and Xuanfang Hold was later constructed upon its ruins.
Term750054_Desc: A Remnant Creature said to carry human feelings and messages once lived in the Land of Xuanfang. It went extinct during the Fortress and Gorges War. To honor it, Artisans later built a mechanical imitation, the Rafter Kite.
Term750055_Desc: Since Yangyang Awakened her Forte at a young age, she became capable of sensing and interpreting a unique form of "streams," which carry various kinds of information, including voices and emotions.
Term750056_Desc: A title addressed by a mysterious existence to Yangyang. It refers to one who offers to the voice.
Term750057_Desc: A criminal organization that was once active in Jinzhou. It recruited a large number of members by promising the ability to reunite them with their deceased loved ones. With the intervention of you and Yinlin, the organization has since been dismantled.
Term750058_Desc: The leader of the Séance Society, formerly a disciple under Yinlin's parents.
Term750059_Desc: A token created from Hsin the Moon Fox's own frequency. It contains part of the Sentinel's authority.
Term800001_Desc: Once a reputable poets society in Ragunna, consisting of three members: Faroll, Selena, and Rimbaud. They composed numerous anthems and poems glorifying the Sentinel and the Order, but were later accused of blasphemy by the Order and sent on a Pilgrim's Sail. They vanished thereafter without a trace, and mentioning of their names is now forbidden in Ragunna.
Term800002_Desc: A large cake dedicated to the 1st anniversary of the launch of the Second Coming of Solaris Beta, as well as the control hub for its simulator. When asked about the hub's cake-shaped design, lead designer Encore replied, "What's a birthday without cake! Happy Anniversary!"
Term800003_Desc: A virtual simulation game developed by the Pioneer Association. Despite many setbacks during development, thanks to Rover's trust and support, the game is steadily evolving towards its ideal form.
Term800004_Desc: Officially known as "Remnant Cubes," these advanced artificial intelligences were created for the Second Coming of Solaris using Encore's abilities and Tethys's microprocessing support. Please note: Remnant Cubes are experimental simulations, automatically generated by the system. Their personalities and actions in the game do not reflect those of real individuals.
Term800005_Desc: The Order's executive arm. Unlike Order Penitentiary, which trials the heretics and maintains faith, the Chamber of Discipline deals with secular cases, and enforces law and order, while also overseeing Ragunna's defenses against Tacet Discords. Its enforcers are often referred to as "Inquisitors."
Term800006_Desc: Sonoro Sphere is a space of dense Remnant Energy capable of preserving transdimensional information. In Huanglong culture, such ethereal realms—neither tangible nor illusory—are often referred to as "mirages."
Term800007_Desc: A signal transmission pathway. During its simulation, the Second Coming of Solaris briefly linked with the Tethys System, creating a temporary channel between them.
Term800008_Desc: A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.
Term800009_Desc: An ancient epic poem of Rinascita. It pioneered blending various regional folkfore with the tales of the Sentinel, including the first accounts of the Carnevale's origins.
Term800010_Desc: A shore where Rinascitan poets and musicians bury their retired instruments.
Term800011_Desc: The autumn night's brightest constellation, shrouded in legends. A poet of Golden Anthem once wrote, "I am a night hawk of wings aflame, soaring towards the Celestial Steed, whose praises I sing and whose true form I behold." Such imagery always evokes Rinascita's Sentinel. But why soar towards it and behold its true form? Maybe the poem was intended to convey some message.
Term800012_Desc: Music is composed of frequency, as is everything. Thus, everything hums its own melody. Ciaccona's Forte allows her to perceive these melodies; by retuning them, she crafts a Sonoro Sphere in her hands where stories and memories carried in music replay themselves. The deeper her understanding of the melodies, the richer the stories she can summon.
Term800013_Desc: Deals Glacio DMG to enemies around the point of impact.
Term800014_Desc: Deals Aero DMG to enemies along its trajectory.
Term800015_Desc: Slices the enemies at close range to deal DMG. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.
Term800016_Desc: Pierces through enemies along its trajectory, dealing multiple instances of damage to enemies at intersections.
Term800017_Desc: Greatly increase range and DMG Multiplier.
Term800018_Desc:
Deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies equal to 100% of Rover's ATK. Then increase Movement Speed by 48%, which gradually decreases to 0% over 4s. Each 1% Movement Speed gained during this time grants 0.8% DMG Bonus.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 5</color>
Movement Speed bonus increases to 64%, and the damage conversion rate rises to 1%.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 10</color>
Movement Speed bonus increases to 80%, and the damage conversion rate rises to 1.2%.
Term800019_Desc:
Deal Fusion DMG to surrounding enemies equal to 100% of Galbrena's ATK. Then increase Attack Speed by 30% for 5s. Each damage dealt during this time increases the Weapon's Crit. Rate by 1% for 5s, stacking up to 20 times.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 5</color>
Attack Speed bonus increases to 40%, and the Crit. Rate bonus now stacks up to 30 times.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 10</color>
Attack Speed bonus increases to 50%, and the Crit. Rate bonus now stacks up to 40 times.
Term800020_Desc:
Deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies equal to 40% of Iuno's Max HP. Then lose 30% of the current HP to increase ATK by 40% of her Max HP for 4s. Hitting an enemy during this time restores 1.5% of her Max HP.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 5</color>
ATK conversion rate increases to 60%, and duration extends to 5s.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 10</color>
ATK conversion rate increases to 80%, and duration extends to 6s.
Term800021_Desc:
Summon a Harmonic Note that deals Aero DMG to surrounding enemies equal to 10% of Ciaccona's ATK every 0.5s for 10s. Enemies damaged by this skill have their DMG taken increased by 3% and their Movement Speed reduced by 1% for 5s, stacking up to 20 times.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 5</color>
Enemies' DMG taken is increased by 4%, and Movement Speed is reduced by 2%.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 10</color>
Enemies' DMG taken is increased by 5%, and Movement Speed is reduced by 3%.
Term800022_Desc: Randomly launches a star to fall upon enemies, dealing Fusion DMG.
Term800023_Desc: Continuously sprays fire forward, dealing Havoc DMG. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.
Term800024_Desc: A summoned Feilian Beringal that stays in one place to deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.
Term800025_Desc: Randomly flips a trap that detonates after a while or upon touching an enemy, dealing AoE Fusion DMG.
Term800026_Desc: Weapons that fire ballistic impact projectiles, such as Isomer Bolt and Blazing Star.
Term800027_Desc: Weapons that can summon Echo projections, such as Feilian Shock and Sanguine Wheel.
Term800028_Desc: Weapons that shoot energy beams, such as Zenith Windblade and Glittering Ray.
Term800029_Desc: Weapons with special effects, such as Rampant Fire and Explosive Omen.
Term800030_Desc: Some weapons can be absorbed to evolve another weapon into its Ultimate Form. The evolution requirements differ depending on the Weapon. The evolved Weapons inherit all buff effects of the absorbed weapon.
Term800031_Desc:
The Exostrider poured forth light and heat from its Reactor Drive, sheltering life from the killing frost. Grateful for this gift, the Roya revered the Reactor Drive as their sun. They took it upon themselves to gather the Exostrider's "cells," making this quiet labor the duty of their tribe.
Now, their ancient vow is complete. As the new sun rises, they hold the New Solar Celebration, both to mark the renewal and to remind their kin of the purpose that set them on this path.
Term800032_Desc: A Sonoro born of nature. Now a shadowy reflection of the Academy, shifting with the collective psyche of its students and teachers.
Term800033_Desc: Shadows of students' emotions in the Dark Side, which mirror the hidden feelings within the students' hearts.
Term800034_Desc: Each year, a treasure hunt organized by a mysterious host takes place at Startorch Academy. Participants take home a wide range of rewards, and a single wish is granted for the biggest winner. Though those wishes are always granted in delightfully peculiar ways, this eccentricity only fuels the students' rivalry as they strive to outwit their invisible mastermind.
Term800035_Desc: If the Dark Side is a vortex of anxiety and sorrow. At the heart of the raging storm is the force that sets it all in motion—the vortex's eye.
Term800036_Desc: Triggers a special effect when HP is no less than 60%.
Term800037_Desc: Triggers a special effect when HP is no more than 50%.
Term800038_Desc: ATK is increased by 1.5% for 10s, stacking up to 20 times.
Term800039_Desc: Triggers a special effect when defeating an enemy.
Term800040_Desc: Briefly reduces DMG taken right before receiving an instance of DMG.
Term800041_Desc: Briefly Morph into or summon the Resonator of the Resonance Factor and cast their special skills. DMG taken is reduced by 50% while Morphed.
Term800042_Desc: For each stack of Affliction: Spectro Frazzle, the target takes DMG equal to 4% of Rover's ATK per second, stacking up to 20 times. This effect lasts 10s.
Term800043_Desc: Includes Affliction: Spectro Frazzle, Affliction: Laceration, and Affliction: Exposed.
Term800044_Desc: A special DMG type that can be enhanced by some Resonance Factors.
Term800045_Desc: Triggers a special effect when taking a hit.
Term800046_Desc: When Affliction: Laceration on the target reaches 20 stacks, the next time it takes damage removes all Laceration stacks, each dealing DMG equal to 50% of Rover's ATK.
Term800047_Desc: Target DEF is reduced by 2% for 10s, stacking up to 20 times.
Term800048_Desc: The docking platforms and wharves where the Shuttles of Xuanfang Hold board passengers and load cargo. They are typically situated at the starting and ending points of transport routes.
Term800049_Desc:
A mechanical defensive barrier activated only when Xuanfang Hold enters a state of emergency. It is vast enough to enshroud the entire Hold. 
It served as a crucial line of protection during the earlier siege by the Autopuppets.
Term800050_Desc:
An anomalous fog mixed with Reverberations. A mutated form of Disorienting Fog, it appears to disrupt the normal operation of machinery. 
Prolonged exposure destabilizes a Resonator's Resonance Ability and can induce Overclocking.
Term800051_Desc:
A data space within the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold, storing vast amounts of the Land of Xuanfang's historical data. 
It is structured into multiple levels representing distinct data zones: namely the Ren Realm, the Di Realm, and the Tian Realm.
Term800052_Desc:
An inner world that only a small number of cultivators can enter during deep meditation, where every blade of grass and every tree is a projection of the mind. 
This mirage realm is also known by the more common name "Mindscape."
Term800053_Desc: A precious item kept by the Sentinel, containing vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization.
