The core area in the Fabricatorium of the Deep for developing Common Echoes. Endless arrays of Echo Brooders line the space, cradling Echoes awaiting rebirth.
As the foundation of the Common Echo system, this site commands heavy investment of security and research resources by the Order.
LoadingTipsText_200703_TipsText:
The energy storage and distribution center of the Fabricatorium.
The recycled energy from the Fallen Grave converges here, waiting to be distributed to other areas as needed. All energy is reserved in liquid media. Frequencies born of the tides once again dissolve in water.
LoadingTipsText_200704_TipsText:
A praying ground dedicated to the Acolytes dwelling under the sea, the only sanctuary of the Order's undersea expanse that remains untouched by the Fractsidus.
These broken Acolytes are the willing victims of the Order's experiments to free Ragunna's consciousness from the Dark Tide. The countless failed trials shattered their minds, yet still they cling to their fervent memories of faith. Fenrico placed them beneath the waves to live peacefully, away from the prying eyes of the world.
LoadingTipsText_200705_TipsText:
The central tower of the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where the Lost Beyond is created.
As the control hub of the entire Fabricatorium, the tower regulates the activities in all other areas within the facility. Deep in the tower keeps the lantern of the first Primus, the first gift bestowed upon the Order by Sentinel Imperator.
LoadingTipsText_200801_TipsText: A natural pass of solid bedrock, marked by jagged cliffs and towering stone pillars. As the gateway to the Sanguis Plateaus, it has stood witness for generations as Gladiators embarked on their sacred hunt, all under the silent watch of the stone colossus of Atilius, the Hero of Heroes.
LoadingTipsText_200802_TipsText: A sprawling encampment near Atilius Canyon. This well-equipped base offers rest and recovery to battle-worn Gladiators. Supported by skilled personnel and Echoes, the camp ensures every Gladiator returns to the hunt at their best, ready to face the Dark Tide creatures once more.
LoadingTipsText_200803_TipsText: The primary hunting grounds for Septimontians for generations. Legend has it that the forest's eternal crimson hue comes from blood spilled in battle. Gladiators drive the Dark Tide's creations into the woods, using traps, tactics, and brute strength to stem the Dark Tide.
LoadingTipsText_200804_TipsText: A plateau blooming with Asphodels, where spring winds never quite manage to carry the blossoms out to sea. Here, "spirits" linger where they sought glory while alive, and where death cut their dreams short.
LoadingTipsText_200805_TipsText: A town wiped out by the Dark Tide. All that remains are the Threnodian Leviathan's whispers and thoughts. People call this place Murmurstown in a desperate attempt to bury an agony too great to bear.
LoadingTipsText_200806_TipsText: The highest peak in the Sanguis Plateaus, named for both its unique summit and the three Heroes of Heroes who once stood there. To Gladiators, it is sacred ground. Legend says that each Hero of Heroes faced their final trial there, and only then would they conquer fate and be cloaked in glory.
LoadingTipsText_200901_TipsText: A quiet, deserted quarter, where the city's busiest crossroads once bustled with life. Rows of commercial towers and shops line the street, and at the corner stands the famous Shashou Cafe.
LoadingTipsText_201001_TipsText: Built under the City Hall's initiative, this once-grand football arena has long fallen into neglect. In its prime, however, the annual "Harukaze Cup" drew school teams from across the region and filled the stands with cheering crowds.
LoadingTipsText_201002_TipsText: Nestled in the city's center, this park was once a beloved retreat, its gardens draped in cascades of wisteria. The fish windsocks floating above the park used to be a popular sight, but now, for some reason, they all seem to be slowly drifting toward a single spot...
LoadingTipsText_201003_TipsText: A cultural passage beneath the city, famed for its flower trees and the celebrated Seisen Garden. It was once the city's hub for film festivals and photography exhibitions.
LoadingTipsText_201004_TipsText: Once Honami's business center, this area is now a graveyard of empty skyscrapers, collapsed passages, and abandoned convention centers. The giant cherry blossom trees rising from the ruins have become its new landmark.
LoadingTipsText_201005_TipsText: This area was once known as "Honami's most beautiful living quarter," where homes and cherry blossoms stood in perfect harmony. Though the houses now lie hollow and lifeless, the cherry blossoms only flourish more vibrantly…
LoadingTipsText_201101_TipsText: Named after the colossal Exostrider greatsword that holds up the underground dome, its dark waters feel like a gateway to another world. As one of the few regions shielded from Void Storms, it became the foundation for the Spacetrek Collective's Starward Riseway, a lift that scales the greatsword's spine to link this subterranean oasis with the Roya Frostlands.
LoadingTipsText_201102_TipsText: A sacred homeland of the Roya and the habitat of the Soliskin. Bathed in the radiance of the Reactor Drive, its towering trees reach hungrily toward the light, their deep, interwoven roots returning that energy to the earth.
LoadingTipsText_201103_TipsText: A vast waterfall often visited by Jetrays. When they leap in unison, their silver wings form a shimmering curtain, hence the name. They travel in flocks for mutual protection, and Roya herders are often seen being carried by their wings, crossing the skies together in serene harmony.
LoadingTipsText_201104_TipsText: A grand observational array established by Startorch Academy. Unlike the Cassettes, which record humanity, this system was built to record Lahai-Roi. It continuously tracks terrain shifts, ecological cycles, and celestial disturbances wrought by Void Storms and the Threnodian, like a giant eye observing the turning of the ages.
LoadingTipsText_201105_TipsText: Officially Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, it stands as a borderless scientific community dedicated to the pure pursuit of knowledge. Its name reflects its ethos, "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Within this vast academic city, knowledge flows freely and cultures meet in harmony.
LoadingTipsText_201106_TipsText: A terrifying creature born from the Threnodian's influence, found primarily in the hinterland of Lahai-Roi known as the "Mawburrow Desert." Its source of power and its fatal weakness are the Voidmatter Regulators on its head. Wherever it passes, life is extinguished, leaving only the void in its wake.
LoadingTipsText_201107_TipsText: A lightweight, all-terrain vehicle co-developed by the Department of Exostrider Engineering and the Department of Voidmatters at Startorch Academy. Indispensable for field expeditions, the Academy has created specialized driving courses and multiple training tracks around the campus to cater to the adventurous spirit of its students and faculty.
LoadingTipsText_201108_TipsText: A colossal lift linking Lahai-Roi to the Roya Frostlands, its structure resembling a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it plummets and ascends through the deep cavern, serving as one of Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.
LoadingTipsText_201109_TipsText: A warm, humid haven beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift, this region became the new Solaris pole, prompting the Roya to migrate below ground. Here, the Spacetrek Collective established Startorch Academy. Today, this borderless academic city has become a cradle for countless rising scholars.
LoadingTipsText_605901_TipsText:
The music persists, and the crimson curtain rises once more.
In this endless drama, you have no choice but to accompany her, one dance after the other.
LoadingTipsText_606001_TipsText: An artificial Sonoro built by Phrolova in the Fabricatorium, a manifestation of her life's dreams and aspirations. It is so vast that it defies conventional measurement.
LoadingTipsText_606101_TipsText:
A shifting realm between life and death, existence and nothingness. It is not a place in the physical sense, but a convergence of infinite possibilities that includes all of Iuno's emotions, memories, and connections. 
Here, her specter wanders, stuck reliving her past… until enough fragments of hers are captured and anchored. Only then can the girl erased by the world reclaim her future.
LoadingTipsText_606201_TipsText:
A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. 
Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.
LoadingTipsText_606301_TipsText:
A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. 
Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.
LoadingTipsText_606401_TipsText:
A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. 
Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.
LoadingTipsText_606501_TipsText:
A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. 
Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.
LoadingTipsText_606601_TipsText:
A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. 
Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.
LoadingTipsText_606701_TipsText:
A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. 
Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.
LoadingTipsText_606801_TipsText:
A type of highly difficult test in Tidal Defense Simulator.
In Deathtrap Mode, participants must rely on Overwatch Protocols and enhanced logistical support to withstand evolved waves of Tacet Discords.
LoadingTipsText_606901_TipsText: An ancient marvel built by master artisans, the Ephor's Palace stands solemnly as a silent witness to the shifts of Septimont through the ages. As the administrative center of Septimont, it upholds the city's order and cohesion. Here, Septimont's leaders convene daily with the Ephor to chart the course of the land's future.
LoadingTipsText_607301_TipsText: Leviathan's avatar rises with the boundless Dark Tide, seeking to "unify" the world in eternal darkness. Stand against the end, and fight for the faintest hope of dawn.
LoadingTipsText_607401_TipsText: Amidst the bamboo grove verdant, a killing edge lies hidden.
LoadingTipsText_607501_TipsText:
The Lament's lingering power gathers here, replaying the battles of the past.
Those unfulfilled dreams, unresolved obsessions… They are no myth.
LoadingTipsText_607601_TipsText: Founded with the core mission to nurture "Synchronists" capable of Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College. Its research is built upon three domains: Exostrider studies, Void Storms, and Reactor Drive energy, giving rise to the Departments of Exostrider Engineering, Voidmatters Science, and Light Energy Sciences. Within the latter, the Division of Ecology Conservation, closely tied to the work of the Exo Genesis Labs, is affectionately nicknamed the "Agronomy Wing."
LoadingTipsText_607701_TipsText: A live-fire facility for testing tactical weaponry and mechanized constructs, operated by the Division of Tactical Development under the Department of Exostrider Engineering. This site supports full-scale weapon validations and equipment trials, and its grounds are open to all Academy faculty and students.
LoadingTipsText_607801_TipsText: Bathed in the constant radiance of the Reactor Drive, this plain teems with life. Flora, fauna, and Exoswarm creatures convert light and heat into diverse energy forms, channeling them through intricate ecological cycles. Every being contributes to this self-sustaining web of life.
LoadingTipsText_607901_TipsText: A vast valley stretching between the Starward Riseway and the Etching Plains. Its name, translated from Royan itself, refers to the jagged square cliffs and stone spires that jut from the valley like the serrated teeth of a giant, forever studded into a scar upon the earth.
LoadingTipsText_608001_TipsText: An arched region that collapsed many years ago during a subterranean Void Storm eruption. As the land gave way, buried cable grids and mechanical spinal frameworks were laid bare like the sinew and bone of the earth itself.
LoadingTipsText_608101_TipsText: The Roya elders are organized into the Six—three pairs holding roles such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair is entrusted with a core function: observation, archival, and extrapolation. They dwell within the Solisylum, linking their consciousness to the Heliogyre to trace the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecast Void Storms. To maximize efficiency, only one of the Six remains awake during each cycle to oversee daily affairs. At the close of each season, Shepherds from all settlements gather in Bjartr Woods to deliver their recorded data, which the Six then deliberate upon to chart the future.
LoadingTipsText_608201_TipsText: Officially Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute, it stands as part of the same borderless research initiative—the Spacetrek Collective—as Startorch Academy. Its mission is to extract and apply advanced technologies. Linked directly to the Starward Riseway, the Institute rests above the greatsword's tip like a guarding Stargram, watching over Lahai-Roi from above.
LoadingTipsText_608301_TipsText: The sun of Lahai-Roi, the source of its life, the cornerstone of the Royas' sacred duty, and the heart of the Spacetrek Collective's Helios Project. But now, the Exostrider's heart is corrupted by the Threnodian's frequencies, teetering on the brink of collapse. Should it fall, an eternal night will engulf the world.
LoadingTipsText_900301_TipsText:
The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions.
In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?
LoadingTipsText_900401_TipsText:
As the hunt begins, horns blare and fearless roars tear through the skies. Beneath the blazing sun, Gladiators gather, blades aflame with valor, swearing to protect Septimont. 
When the Dark Tide surges once more, the foretold hero shall rise to conquer the abyss and defy fate.
LoadingTipsText_900401_Title: By Sun's Scourge, By Moon's Revelation
LoadingTipsText_900501_TipsText: Everything you've done, the world will forever remember.
LoadingTipsText_900601_TipsText:
When the forsaken city crumbles, neon hues twist and devour the past. Between loops of ruin and rebirth, only the unfulfilled longings linger. In this stagnant season, the warm, simple bonds shall become blades to sever the chains.
Last night's stars still burn. The dawn of tomorrow will arrive.
LoadingTipsText_900601_Title: To the City Set in Amber
LoadingTipsText_900701_TipsText: Beneath the Startorch, we pledge to carry its flame forward, to stand beside kindred minds, and to push back the frontiers of knowledge. Let every quest for truth be a spark against the long night until it fades. Together, we build a dawn that is ours.
LoadingTipsText_920101_TipsText:
The Priestesses have forgotten. Augusta has forgotten... Even though the world has forgotten, you remember Iuno. After all, you see her once again.
With her bracelet and the moonlight to guide you, you walk on. You don't know where the path leads, only that you must keep going, until the moonlight finally falls.
LoadingTipsText_920201_TipsText: Humble and unadorned, this place offers a transitory respite in the looping Lament.
LoadingTipsText_920301_TipsText: Here, infinite loops pile atop each other, and people's cries become sustenance for the Lament. In the ruins of chaos, only the Tower shows its true face...
LoadingTipsText_920401_TipsText:
Inside Neon Tower, she fell into the cage of her own making.
Perhaps the girl never truly left her hometown, just as she never escaped her past…
LoadingTipsText_920501_TipsText: Never in memory has Honami been this quiet…. Chisa, where are you?
LoadingTipsText_920601_TipsText:
The unfamiliar city teeters on the verge of collapse.
From the depths of your memory comes a faint, painful whisper... This is the Lament.
LoadingTipsText_920701_TipsText: A ruined city, like amber trapped in the Sonoro. Once-bustling streets lie overgrown with wild grass, low roads swallowed by seawater. The Lament repeats endlessly, and time and space are fractured, but this view seems frozen, stopped in a silent eternity.
LoadingTipsText_920801_TipsText: This soaring communication tower once embodied people's ambition to connect through radio waves. But eventually, it was here that the Lament began. Now, within its disordered heart, it recreates glimpses of familiar pasts, as if luring others to step deeper inside…
LoadingTipsText_920901_TipsText:
The past, the reality, the Lament... Such is the view from atop Neon Tower. See them. Face them. Confront them.
Step into tomorrow. Nothing can stand in your way.
LoadingTipsText_922001_TipsText: When Voidmatter density reaches a critical threshold, the Shimmer descends from the skies and the earth quakes beneath it—the Void Storm follows, Lahai-Roi's most devastating catastrophe. All matter dissolves into nothingness, while infected Exoswarm mutate into massive Voidworms, casting devouring shadows across the land.
LoadingTipsText_UGC01_TipsText: When a Resonator's mental strength and Forte are pushed beyond their limits for an extended period, it can lead to a rare state called "Overclocking." While this condition can be managed, there's no permanent cure. In extreme cases, the Tacet Mark can expand uncontrollably, devouring everything around it, with the Overclocked Resonators ultimately becoming a Tacet Discord of the Tacet Field.
LoadingTipsText_UGC02_TipsText: Formed from Tacetite and hidden in the Stormy Sea, this archipelago is a sanctuary for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, it has fostered extensive partnerships across Solaris-3. While its advanced technologies are shared with the outside world, their origins remain a mystery, even to its members.
LoadingTipsText_UGC03_TipsText:
Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.
At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator."
LoadingTipsText_UGC04_TipsText: Memories converge into frequencies at the fingertip, where sound and form unite—the authority you were born with. Formless echoes coalesce through your power, as you continuously weave a deeper resonance with the world.
LoadingTipsText_UGC05_TipsText: The Sentinel of Rinascita, the one who guided the settlers to this promised land to escape from the Lament. In the faith of the Order of the Deep, They are often depicted as a being with the upper body of a horse and the lower body of a fish. Though Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the world, They often deliver Oracles through the Laureate of Carnevale.
LoadingTipsText_UGC06_TipsText: A Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It gathers in the sky above and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field. According to the Order of the Deep, the two significant Dark Tides that occurred in history were stopped by Napoli the Second and the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys respectively.
LoadingTipsText_UGC07_TipsText: Thanks to the Genesis Nexus, Rinascita's Echoes can exist without Reserved Terminals. The people of Ragunna revere Common Echoes as divine gifts from Sentinel Imperator and treat them as friends and trusted allies. Managed by the Order of the Deep, Common Echoes are incorporated into every aspect of daily life, which is the very symbol that has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."
LoadingTipsText_UGC08_TipsText: Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty. Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.
LoadingTipsText_922201_TipsText: The sighs of that person still linger here. O you who are bound in chains, to whom could you ever confide such endless sorrow?
LoadingTipsText_922301_TipsText: Due to the special nature of this celebration and the Roya Culture Exhibition joining this year's festivities, the Student Council secured the first two floors of Rabelle College with the help of certain talented coordinators. Once tightly restricted classrooms have been transformed into vibrant club showcase spaces.
LoadingTipsText_922401_TipsText:
Every year, the break after final exams marks the season for Startorch Academy's club exhibitions—the perfect outlet for students to burn off their pent-up energy.
With the Reactor Core restored and the New Solar Ceremony a success, the Academy's Executive Committee has announced that this year's showcase will be co-hosted with the Roya. Under the theme "New Solar Celebration," the event aims to deepen the bonds between both peoples.
LoadingTipsText_922501_TipsText: Time to blast off on an interstellar adventure!
LoadingTipsText_922601_TipsText: Use this time to totally let loose!
LoadingTipsText_922701_TipsText: Catch the cosmic beat and set sail!
LoadingTipsText_922801_TipsText:
When the Spacetrek Collective dared to build a facility atop a Threnodian, they had planned for the worst.
When Voidmatter broke loose, some left bearing hope. Others stayed, resolve burning in their chests.
LoadingTipsText_922901_TipsText:
A future that was never hers. One she would never reach.
A dream as fragile as a bubble, bound to pop. Still, isn't there always a sweetness in wanting what you cannot hold?
LoadingTipsText_923001_TipsText:
Within the cage of consciousness, flowing memory data has materialized into shadows of the past. 
At the end of the path, that one special person is waiting.
LoadingTipsText_923101_TipsText: The venue commonly used for major academic summits. Access is restricted to faculty and students of Rabelle College.
LoadingTipsText_923201_TipsText:
An area Lucilla remodeled and sealed off using her abilities; a fragment of her "Memory Palace." 
For the secrets kept within are too cruel for students, and too childish for adults.
LoadingTipsText_923501_Title: Gorges of Spirits of Your Memories
LoadingTipsText_923301_TipsText: A basin located between the Western Fang Peaks and the Eastern Xuan Peaks, where the ruins of Yuan Fortress still remain. Once destroyed by war, the Fortress has long since faded from memory. Yet amid erosion and moss, the outline of its former grandeur can still be discerned.
LoadingTipsText_923401_TipsText: Once allies, now the greatest foes. This is the final line of defense. Take up your weapon. In this moment of despair, hope is forged only in the crucible of desperation.
LoadingTipsText_923501_TipsText:
The place where it all began. The place where your story unfolded.
From this moment on, a roving life starts.
LoadingTipsText_923601_TipsText:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
It comprises the Thousandfold Foundry, which produces Autopuppets ceaselessly, and the Myriad Snare, which suppresses and exterminates powerful Tacet Discords. The Skyworks runs day and night in service to  Xuanfang Hold.
LoadingTipsText_923701_TipsText: A foyer within Fogveil Pagoda, lavishly adorned yet retaining an air of refined elegance. Shadows and light dance across painted screens, solemn and dreamlike. Yet behind the screen at the foyer's end lies a secret unknown to all...
LoadingTipsText_923801_TipsText: A suspended City of Mechanisms under Mengzhou's jurisdiction, built to hold the hordes of Tacet Discords diverted from the Norfall Barrens outbreak. Its intricate construction reroutes and traps incoming hordes through a vast array of mechanisms. Its form shifts at will, deploying Autopuppets to rotate defenses and purge or suppress the Tacet Discords held within.
LoadingTipsText_923901_TipsText: In the Academy, across the frostlands, in the shadows—wherever he is needed.
LoadingTipsText_924001_TipsText: The scent of mint lingers in the air… A summer that can never be forgotten.
LoadingTipsText_924101_TipsText: A forest east of Shaftpost Yard. Legend has it Xuanling Birds once nested here, their legacy turning every leaf to perennial gold. Though their songs have long since fallen silent, the autumn they left behind never fades. And on certain winds, one might still hear a melodious chirping among the boughs...
LoadingTipsText_924201_TipsText:
Denia. She is denied both a past and future.
Aleph-1 looks upon her. And upon you. What lies before you is absurdity, nihilism, collapse... A puzzle with no solution.
But still, she waits for your answer.
LoadingTipsText_924301_TipsText: This area was once known as "Honami's most beautiful living quarter," where homes and cherry blossoms stood in perfect harmony. Though the houses now lie hollow and lifeless, the cherry blossoms only flourish more vibrantly…
LoadingTipsText_924401_TipsText: In the space between past and future, perhaps, snow once fell in Honami.
LoadingTipsText_924601_TipsText:
Mountains and rivers unfold like a painting. White clouds drift by like a fleeting dream. 
The Cloud Shuttles that sail these skies seem destined never to rest.
LoadingTipsText_924701_TipsText: At this very moment, things within the real Xuanfang Hold seem to have changed...
LoadingTipsText_924801_TipsText:
Dark clouds gather. A heavy fog blankets the land. 
The higher one climbs toward the heavens, the deeper one plunges into the abyss.
LoadingTipsText_924901_TipsText: Amid the mist, within the secluded pagoda, anomalies spread. The Moon Fox leaves only mysteries in Her wake.
LoadingTipsText_925001_TipsText:
A data space within the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold—a "world within the Capsule." 
Here, historical data has reconstructed Xuanfang as it appeared two centuries ago.
LoadingTipsText_925101_TipsText: Meanwhile, on the other side of Xuanfang Hold...
LoadingTipsText_925201_TipsText:
The Waking Moon Festival draws near.
Amid the clamor of the streets, whispers begin to stir, and unease takes root.
LoadingTipsText_925301_TipsText: A Nexus of ordered design, the pivot on which all turns.
LoadingTipsText_925401_TipsText:
The streets are silent. The lanterns unlit.
From where voices are faint, a strand of gold comes to light the night.
LoadingTipsText_925501_TipsText:
Lanterns guide wayfarers home through the long night, together.
At last, the Waking Moon Festival returns, just as it promised.
LoadingTipsText_925601_TipsText:
Mengzhou's Xuanfang landscapes are painted in lantern light and the quiet hum of passing crowds. All of it, held close by Hsin.
Here, every hidden feeling is laid bare.
LoadingTipsText_925701_TipsText:
Snow settles on buried blades. Old cities stir beneath the frost.
Obsessions never untangled, doubts never laid to rest—all held in frozen stillness.
LoadingTipsText_925801_TipsText:
Since the Fox Shadow's true face stays hidden, let it think it guides.
When the old bonds finally break, Suoming sees what is...
MoonLabel_01_Desc01: Fate fears no temptation. It follows the path once sworn.
MoonLabel_01_Desc02: Integrity is the key that leads to truth.
MoonLabel_02_Desc01: Fate fears no peril. It confronts the surging calamity head-on.
MoonLabel_02_Desc02: Valor is the ram that crushes the undertow.
MoonLabel_03_Desc01: Fate fears no falsehood. It navigates the uncharted wilds.
MoonLabel_03_Desc02: Curiosity is the lamp that endures the endless night.
MoonLabel_04_Desc01: Fate fears no sacrifice. It preserves the fractured memories.
MoonLabel_04_Desc02: Dedication is the blade that cuts through all illusion.
MoonLabel_05_Desc01: Fate fears no indifference. It dyes the pale thorns.
MoonLabel_05_Desc02: Passion is the spark that warms life.
MoonLabel_06_Desc01: Fate fears no disdain. It bridles the thought of vanity.
MoonLabel_06_Desc02: Humility is the gauge that marks what is lacking.
MoonLabel_07_Desc01: Fate fears no cruelty. It mends the wounds of mistakes.
MoonLabel_07_Desc02: Compassion is the will to heal the broken world.
MoonLabel_08_Desc01: Fate fears no mockery. It grinds the false karma.
MoonLabel_08_Desc02: Tenacity is the rock that stands tall against all.
MoonLabel_09_Desc01: Fate fears no enmity. It sings the glory of peace.
MoonLabel_09_Desc02: Kindness is the breeze that brings thaw.
MoonLabel_10_Desc01: Fate fears no ignorance. It proclaims the break of dawn.
MoonLabel_10_Desc02: Wisdom is the dawn that stirs the sleeping mind.
MoonLabel_11_Desc01: Fate fears no fickleness. It inscribes every trace left in ages.
MoonLabel_11_Desc02: Commitment is the haven in fleeting lives.
MoonLabel_12_Desc01: Fate fears no profanity. It defies the endless cycle of tragedy.
MoonLabel_12_Desc02: Responsibility is the scale that weighs the value of life.
MoonLabel_13_Desc01: Fate fears no shadow. It seeks the glimmer of truth.
MoonLabel_13_Desc02: Sincerity is the bookmark whose color never fades with time.
MoonLabel_14_Desc01: Fate fears no arrogance. It yearns for the hope to move on.
MoonLabel_14_Desc02: Discipline is the staff for walking alone in the darkness of night.
MoonLabel_15_Desc01: Fate fears no coldness. It gives shape to the fading dusk.
MoonLabel_15_Desc02: Empathy is the bridge that passes over pain and sorrow.
MoonLabel_16_Desc01: Fate fears no instability. It rebels against veering paths.
MoonLabel_16_Desc02: Composure is the laurel that stays green throughout every season.
MoonLabel_17_Desc01: Fate fears no doubt. It dissolves primal chaos.
MoonLabel_17_Desc02: Tolerance is the spring that mends a fractured earth.
MoonLabel_18_Desc01: Fate fears no deceit. It gathers scattered resolve.
MoonLabel_18_Desc02: Introspection is the mirror untouched by storms.
MoonLabel_19_Desc01: Fate fears no curse. It pens the stars that illuminate solitude.
MoonLabel_19_Desc02: Clarity is the solace in a life adrift.
MoonLabel_20_Desc01: Fate fears no slander. It shatters unfounded suspicion.
MoonLabel_20_Desc02: Pragmatism is the mind that can manage the world.
MoonPhase_01_Buff: Increases Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team by 50% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_01_Desc:
New Moon, where light finds its fresh start.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. The New Moon heralds the dawn of the lunar cycle, with its surface veiled entirely in shadow.
The New Moon symbolizes rebirth and a new beginning:
After its long journey through the heavens, the moon circles back to its starting point, renewed and ready to begin anew.
MoonPhase_01_Talk01: The shadow drinks the moon. The world stirs anew.
MoonPhase_01_Talk02: The future remains unwritten, yet already, it stirs toward change.
MoonPhase_01_Talk03:
Hard to observe? But it's just right to me.
Isn't everything born from emptiness, after all?
MoonPhase_02_Buff: Increases Crit. DMG of all Resonators in the team by 60% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_02_Desc:
Crescent Moon, where light begins its spread.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. Following the New Moon, shadows start to retreat, and a sliver of light graces the sky.
The Crescent Moon symbolizes growth and hope:
The delicate arc of light grows fuller night by night in the eyes of those who gaze upward.
MoonPhase_02_Talk01: The crescent glows in silver. A song hums you forward.
MoonPhase_02_Talk02: The idealist's flame shall not grow dim tonight.
MoonPhase_02_Talk03:
Night after night, it just wants to be more complete.
That's the happiest a moon ever gets, don't you think?
MoonPhase_03_Buff: Reduces the STA cost of Wall Dash and Swimming for all Resonators in the team by 50% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_03_Desc:
First Quarter, where a bow of light is drawn against the veil.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. It is a half-lit moon, bright on the right, where light and shadow evenly divide the lunar surface.
The First Quarter symbolizes action and challenge:
After a long wait, the time to step toward the full light has finally come.
MoonPhase_03_Talk01: The darkness thins. The moonlight blooms.
MoonPhase_03_Talk02: This is the hour when light and shadow entwine, the hour of trial.
MoonPhase_03_Talk03:
Walk the fine line where light meets shadow.
Past on one side, future on the other.
MoonPhase_04_Buff: Reduces Flight STA cost for all Resonators in the team by 30% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_04_Desc:
Waxing Gibbous, where ascent awaits.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. It is the time when the Full Moon is near, shadows are almost gone, and moonlight brightens the night.
The Waxing Gibbous symbolizes adjustment and preparation:
The restless edge of transformation calls for self-adjustment that leads to a breakthrough.
MoonPhase_04_Talk01: Waxing moon gilds the river. Waning night bathes in gold.
MoonPhase_04_Talk02: Even the stillness of waiting will one day become the past.
MoonPhase_04_Talk03:
Will it rain tomorrow night? Will the moon shine brighter?
Something about the gibbous phase always stretches the night.
MoonPhase_05_Buff: Increases Crit. Rate of all Resonators in the team by 30% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_05_Desc:
Full Moon, where clarity rules.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. The moon reaches its brightest, wholly unshadowed and facing the world in full.
The Full Moon symbolizes wholeness and release:
The flawless silver mirror reflects the purest dreams held in every heart.
MoonPhase_05_Talk01: The night unveils in perfect glow. The moon ascends with flawless hope.
MoonPhase_05_Talk02: All the beauties and ideals, ripened at the right time, have already fused with life itself.
MoonPhase_05_Talk03:
This is the Lunar Phase said to symbolize perfection and fullness.
They say that's when people remember their brightest moments.
MoonPhase_06_Buff: Increases Shell Credit drop by 50% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_06_Desc:
Waning Gibbous, where brightness dims yet lingers.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. After the Full Moon, darkness returns, and the light begins its quiet retreat.
The Waning Gibbous symbolizes reflection and sharing:
All things wax and wane, so joy and sorrow are intertwined by nature's design.
MoonPhase_06_Talk01: Each gleaming pearl bears different marks. All waning moons share the same path.
MoonPhase_06_Talk02: The clamoring aftersound, too, will become a beacon towards tomorrow.
MoonPhase_06_Talk03: The more people cling to yesterday, the easier they forget that tomorrow's already on its way.
MoonPhase_07_Buff: Increases Echo drop rate by 50% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_07_Desc:
Last Quarter, where darkness reclaims its share.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. It is a half-lit moon, bright on the left, where light and shadow evenly divide the lunar surface.
The Last Quarter symbolizes release and decision:
In the shifting tides, seasoned sailors know when to let go.
MoonPhase_07_Talk01: The half-moon comes as it must. The radiance hides as it should.
MoonPhase_07_Talk02: Those who reflect themselves in darkness will find their way to peace and clarity.
MoonPhase_07_Talk03:
Bid the time. Stay hidden. Assess the situation.
Hah, definitely not my kind of moon.
MoonPhase_08_Buff: Increases material drop rate from enemies in the overworld by 50% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_08_Desc:
Waning Crescent, where only a glimmer remains.
One of Septimont's divinatory Lunar Phases. The final stage of the cycle, with only a faint shimmer clinging to the edge of shadow.
The Waning Crescent symbolizes rest and settlement:
Even the grandest journey calls for a pause to gather breath.
MoonPhase_08_Talk01: A final sliver remains. The world sleeps in fatigue.
MoonPhase_08_Talk02: Wisdom, gathered and stored, accumulates in silent hope.
MoonPhase_08_Talk03:
Even a waning crescent can light up the sky.
Those saying the moon's almost gone... Did they even ask the moon?
MoonPhase_09_Buff: Increases Echo drop rate by 50% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_09_Desc:
Twin Moons, where two lives intertwine. 
A unique and unpredictable Lunar Phase in Septimont. Two crescent moons rise back to back in silent symmetry.
The Twin Moons symbolize trust and friendship:
With a steadfast ally by your side, even the longest night loses its terror.
MoonPhase_09_Talk01: Hope leans close. Faint light endures.
MoonPhase_09_Talk02: Even the faintest glows can endure an endless night by sticking together.
MoonPhase_09_Talk03:
I've always been the one and only moon in this world.
No one else could make it this far anyway.
MoonPhase_10_Buff: Increases material drop rate from enemies in the overworld by 50% for 3h. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
MoonPhase_10_Desc:
Rippled Moon, where changes return to one.
A unique and unpredictable Lunar Phase in Septimont. The Rippled Moon shimmers with layered, wave-like brilliance that flows across its surface.
The Rippled Moon symbolizes eternity and flux:
In this world, only the whirl of ceaseless change endures forever.
MoonPhase_10_Talk01: Nothing goes without destiny. Everything moves as one.
MoonPhase_10_Talk02: The ever-shifting whirl is, in itself, an eternal instant.
MoonPhase_10_Talk03:
Chasing some fixed eternity... What a foolish thing.
If fate won't hand it over, go fetch it yourself.
MoonPhase_Normol_Talk01: Wax and wane etch the bough. Light and shadow skim the dew.
MoonPhase_Normol_Talk02: The moon bestows revelation and blessings upon you.
Morale_KeepLevel_1: During the current phase, each level increases ATK and Max HP by 3.2% and DEF by 0.25%.
Morale_flagdesc_map_1:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676> A humanoid Tacet Discord with a body assembled from shattered stained glass. Glittering lights beam from its body with each move. It exudes a resilient beauty born of rebirth through destruction.
The stained glasses that form the Vitreum Dancers are varied and unique, making each Vitreum Dancer a unique existence.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_10:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade and extraordinary might existing only in legends.
Said to be the lost souls of fallen heroes, it was once witnessed slaying other Tacet Discords to protect villagers. Yet such acts were driven purely by an instinctual hunger for battle.
Though it has lost its heart, it stubbornly clings to the vestiges of past honor, wandering the world in solitary defiance.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_11:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Gehinom deals Fusion DMG equal to 4% of the targets' Max HP per second to the surrounding targets.
When Gehinom hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#767676>A dragon-like Tacet Discord that haunts the peak of Penitent's End for an unknown reason, devouring all frequencies indiscriminately. Twisted by the frequencies of decay and death it consumes, it now appears as a dreadful, skeletal beast.
Once a sacred place, this island is now a grave of sorrow, and anyone who comes for redemption must face its fire of judgment.
Such is Gehinom, the Dragon of Dirge, whose flames burn to the bone, whose pain echoes, yearning for a final release.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_12:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Galecrest Gladiators follow the will of freedom. Bound by neither rule nor glory, they become the blade that severs all chains.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_13:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>A stone statue TD that embodies deconstruction and reconstruction. Though sluggish and clumsy, its punches are devastating.
It hurls rocks and other rock-mimic Tacet Discords as a means of attack.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_14:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the pale glow of the moon.
Said to be the lingering shadows of heroes in the old days, their kind retains a chivalrous demeanor even as they decay into TDs.
Glorious knights who have long forgotten their titles. Protectors with nothing to defend, bound by their relentless obsession with honor.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_15:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>Lumiscale Constructs are composed of Jué's defensive modules, commonly known as "Loong's Scales."
They are found throughout the Court of Savantae ruins in Mt. Firmament, tasked with eliminating intruders and potential threats to Jué.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_16:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
When inflicted with Spectro Frazzle, Lorelei takes 100% more damage.
When Lorelei hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#767676>Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.
Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the "Queen of the Night," seeking to cloak the Sanctum in endless darkness to clear all sins.
With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within the atrium, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_17:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Flamecrest Gladiators embody a warrior's undying passion. Wounds become fire, hardship their forge. Battle after battle, they chase a blood-lit path to their truest form.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_18:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the radiance of the sun.
Said to be the lost souls of fallen heroes, it retains an air of commanding dignity, even as a Tacet Discord.
Once a knight who has long forgotten the title they once bore, it has lost all it was sworn to protect. Now, only an unyielding obsession with honor remains.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_19:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>An enormous feline-mimic TD, only sighted in Mt. Firmament in Huanglong.
According to the Hongzhen Chronicle, it is a solitary TD with four claws and a scaly back. It is called "Lightcrusher" because of the glowing tracks left in its wake.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_2:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>Kerasaurs are fierce, amphibious Tacet Discords mimicking Saurosuchus. They gain their name from the spiky scales covering their bodies. Kerasaurs are not indigenous to Septimont. They were introduced as gladiatorial opponents in matches for their distinct appearance and aggressive behavior.
Their pronounced territorial instincts also make them the ideal Echoes to serve in the city's defense force once tamed.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_20:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
When Arsinosa hits a target, the target's STA is reduced by 100%, triggered once every 10s.
Upon entering the battle, Arsinosa gains a Shield equal to 20% of her Max HP. If she hasn't taken damage for over 10s, she gains a Shield equal to 20% of her Max HP.
When Arsinosa hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#767676>She guards the City of Glory, a valiant lioness of the arena.
Built with the pristine white stones that Gryphons are carved out of and tempered in the echoes of battle cries and the laughter of heroes.
This is Arsinosa, ever steadfast, watching over Septimont’s glory for all time.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_3:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
When Lampylumen Myriad deals damage, it inflicts 3 stacks of Glacio Chafe on the target, triggered once every 6s.

<color=#767676>An ensnarer that slumbers in a freezing mine pit, obsessed with collecting and imitating sounds. It can imitate human speech through a vibrating hum.
Lampylumen Myriad uses sound as bait to lure its prey, which will be frozen in the deep cold. The loss of warmth and the illusion before dying will cause human beings to pour out their last words, which contain great emotional fluctuations.
For Lampylumen Myriad, this is the frequency of the supreme taste.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_4:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Lightcrest Gladiators uphold the ideal of justice. They bow to no tyrant, yield to no shadow. If justice has rotted, they shall forge it anew in light.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_5:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Frostcrest Gladiators bear unyielding resolve. Their fortitude is impervious to frost and bitter cold. Though blades may shatter, their creed endures.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_6:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Hitting Kelpie with Counterattack further reduces its Vibration Strength by 50%.
When Kelpie is not Immobilized, its all Attribute RES is increased by 200%.
When Kelpie hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#767676>A humanoid TD born from the deep sea. Commonly found in all types of waters, it's known for its aggression and ferocity.
It attacks with sharp claws laced with paralytic toxins, then rips its prey apart and swallows them whole.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_7:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>A ferocious bear-mimic TD with Tacetite spikes on its head, neck, and shoulders. Its swings strike like a hurricane.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_8:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Thundercrest Gladiators wield stormborne might. Unmoved by favor and unbowed by power. Beneath the thunder’s judgment, right and wrong divide.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_map_9:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#767676>It holds the authority to command other Echoes of the Order, carrying out the Order's will to eliminate any transgressors.
Just as the Order's authority is inviolable, so too is the power of the Echo.</color>

PhantomBattleChallengeDes_3001: Italo is an exchange student from Ragunna. Despite having seen the technological wonders of Lahai-Roi, he still believes that nothing is stronger than an Echo.
PhantomBattleChallengeDes_3002: Andrius is the technician and logistics coordinator for his research expedition team. However, people who know him say he's not particularly reliable.
PhantomBattleChallengeDes_3003: Luanquan realized that she had left a crucial item behind on the way to the frostlands. This mistake cast a shadow over her scientific expedition.
PhantomBattleChallengeDes_3004: As a Roya, Lana is particularly interested in Startorch Academy's expedition motorbikes. A certain rumor led her to come up with a rather crazy idea…
PhantomBattleChallengeDes_3005: Joanna is currently responsible for data collection in the Roya Frostlands. The job is monotonous, and she desperately needs a strong opponent to kill time.
PhantomBattleChallengeDes_3006: Ursula ventured into the harsh Roya Frostlands in search of a strong opponent. Perhaps here, she will find honor and joy.
PhantomBattleChallengeDes_3007: The Roya believe that the best food is only found in the harshest environments. Bream is no exception.

RecallActivity_Area_09_Desc:
A hidden facility at the depths of the sea. It serves as the distribution center for the Common Echoes. Few truly understand its full purpose.
Beneath the calm lies madness, and at the end of the madness is a collection of unfulfilled, lingering desires.
RecallActivity_Area_10_Desc:
The Sanguis Plateaus serve as both Septimontians' hunting grounds and the first line of defense against the Dark Tide. On these magnificent yet bleak highlands, the Blightcloud hovering above stirs relentlessly.

Here, power and glory reach their peak, then give way to bloodshed and death.
RecallActivity_Area_11_Desc: A ruined city, like amber trapped in the Sonoro. Once-bustling streets lie overgrown with wild grass, low roads swallowed by seawater. The Lament repeats endlessly, and time and space are fractured, but this view seems frozen, stopped in a silent eternity.
RecallActivity_Story_06_Desc:
After the Great Agon, Cartethyia once again felt the lingering power of the Threnodian. You journey to the sea in search of answers, but are met with resistance from Fenrico, the Primus of the Order, who desires for you to sink forever in the deep. But Phrolova saves you from the raging waves.
The unknown ocean depths, enemies with unforeseen actions, and a gem coveted by many... everything swirls like a current, pulling you into its grasp. Where will this underwater adventure lead?
RecallActivity_Story_07_Desc:
As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival. To recover the lost relic of Sentinel Imperator and halt the Dark Tide before it devours Rinascita once more, you and the Gladiators of Septimont set out for the expedition...

But in the unforgiving wilds of the Sanguis Plateaus, the boundary between the hunter and hunted is perilously thin. Who truly holds the reins of fate? And who shall rise to wear the crown of glory? Only the victor has the right to answer.
RecallActivity_Story_08_Desc:
Following the defeat of the False Sovereign, Rinascita enjoys a brief period of tranquility. To open the Civilization Capsule left by Imperator, you and Abby prep for Ragunna to find Cartethyia, only to discover that the people of Ragunna are being plagued by nightmares. Meanwhile, inside the Inverted Tower, Avinoleum, the returning Discord Slayer fires her pistol at the once Blessed Maiden...
With Cartethyia's "death," the Fractsidus's "story" in Rinascita approaches its final chapter. Leviathan has been reborn from the Gem, and the prophesied Journeying Paradise makes its descent. Even though no Divinity remains on this land, familiar faces have begun to take action to prevent Rinascita's doom. Bearing everyone's will, you are determined to step into the Dark Tide...
RecallActivity_Story_09_Desc: With events in Rinascita finally over, you return once more to the Black Shores to find them investigating abnormal frequencies in nearby waters. During the investigation, you are pulled into the rift and soon awaken in a ruined, restless city. And as the situation grows dire, a mysterious black-haired girl appears before you… At this point, where time is frozen, sever the endless loop and embrace the dawn of the future.
RecallActivity_Story_10_Desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

Activity_101_Desc: The Second Coming of Solaris, written by Karl from the New Federation, has gained widespread popularity and continues to sell exceptionally well across the globe. The book is not only highly imaginative but also provides valuable insights into geography and history, offering a rigorous worldview. The Pioneer Association has recently obtained the game adaptation rights of The Second Coming of Solaris, but they appear to be facing challenges and are seeking your aid.
Activity_104700001_Desc: Victory does not come easily. A Cube's got to sweat a little to win the race! Join the Cubes in training, complete practice rounds to earn some exciting rewards!
Activity_105400001_Desc: With the intricate terrain of Septimont’s Old District revealed after recent drainage efforts, the city has announced a thrilling new event—a simulated Tacet Discord Hunt. Brave Gladiators, step forward! Join the hunt and carve out your own path to glory and victory!
Activity_120000001_Desc: A mysterious gateway emerges in the Whining Aix's Mire, providing access to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris...

CookLevel_1_AttributesDescription: A title awarded to those who pick up the kitchen knife and start the journey as a cook. A symbol of every cook's original wish.
CookLevel_2_AttributesDescription: A title awarded to those chefs who mastered the basic cooking skills. Proof of a strider on the long path of cookery.
CookLevel_3_AttributesDescription: A title awarded to those chefs who can already work without instructions. Many only make it here.
CookLevel_4_AttributesDescription: A title awarded to master chefs who deserve their place in the hall of fame for both their art and their character.
CookLevel_5_AttributesDescription: A rare title awarded to limited chefs only, whose works reflect not only the best of flavors, but the feelings of life.
CookProcessMsg_10_Description: To make Tofu elastic, grind 2 servings of beans and then add 2 servings of salt for coagulation.
CookProcessMsg_10_Introduce: To make Tofu elastic, grind 2 servings of beans and then add 2 servings of salt for coagulation.
CookProcessMsg_1_Description: It is said that Panhua of Jinzhou is an excellent cook. Maybe she is willing to share about how to make Clear Soup.
CookProcessMsg_1_Introduce: Panhua says, 2 servings of Salt are needed to clear the impurities in the Clear Soup.
CookProcessMsg_2_Description: Mahe of Jinzhou is believed to have a unique understanding of making Clear Soup. Why not ask him about it?
CookProcessMsg_2_Introduce: Mahe says, 2 servings of Edodes are indispensable ingredients for Clear Soup.
CookProcessMsg_3_Description: Uncle Li of Jinzhou is believed to have a unique understanding of making Clear Soup. Why not ask him about it?
CookProcessMsg_3_Introduce: Uncle Li says, 1 serving of Sugar can add extra flavor to the Clear Soup.
CookProcessMsg_4_Description: Koko of Jinzhou is believed to have a unique understanding of making Clear Soup. Why not ask her about it?
CookProcessMsg_4_Introduce: Koko believes that the main seasoning for the Clear Soup is 1 serving of Fowl Meat.
CookProcessMsg_5_Description: Uncle Wei in Jinzhou is believed to have a unique understanding of making Braising Sauce. Why not ask him about it?
CookProcessMsg_5_Introduce: Uncle Wei says, Braising Sauce is made by stewing Fowl Meat. Therefore, 1 serving of Fowl Meat is indispensable.
CookProcessMsg_6_Description: Ganxue of Jinzhou is believed to have a unique understanding of making Braising Sauce. Why not ask her about it?
CookProcessMsg_6_Introduce: Ganxue recommends adding 2 servings of Sugar to give the Braising Sauce an appetizing color.
CookProcessMsg_7_Description: Chenpi of Jinzhou is believed to have a unique understanding of making Braising Sauce. Why not ask him about it?
CookProcessMsg_7_Introduce: Chenpi says, adding 1 serving of Salt is necessary to give extra flavor to the Braising Sauce.
CookProcessMsg_8_Description: Panhua says she has a trick for making the Hot Pot Base: 2 Oil, 2 Chili Pepper, 1 Salt, and 1 Fowl Meat to increase the flavor.
CookProcessMsg_8_Introduce: Panhua says she has a trick for making the Hot Pot Base: 2 Oil, 2 Chili Pepper, 1 Salt, and 1 Fowl Meat to increase the flavor.

LoadingTipsText_200501_TipsText:
Beneath the shadowed trench, an empty yet defiant gaze hungrily covets the legacy of the heavens.
Once a sacred land, only a faint shadow of Avinoleum's glory remains. Those destined to fall still live, while those meant to survive lie buried, transformed into divine oracles no one hears. Their lips remain sealed, and Their ears are bound by words They never spoke.
LoadingTipsText_200601_TipsText: The capital city of Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states. Perched atop Capitoline Hill, it boasts towering stone structures that form the grand "Gryphon's Fortress." After fleeing the threat of the Dark Tide, the bold and battle-loving Septimontians have devoted their lives to chasing the heights of glory. With travelers from distant seas, they gather in this City of Glory built upon the legends of heroes.
LoadingTipsText_200602_TipsText: The heart of the Great Agon, where Gladiators and Echoes fight side by side. With state-of-the-art facilities, the arena hosts electrifying tournaments of all sizes, broadcast live across Solaris. Here, the air is thick with the crowd's roaring cheers, shattering the silence of the night year-round. It's a place where your blood ignites as you witness the blood, sweat, and tears of Gladiators battling for glory.
LoadingTipsText_200603_TipsText: An area at the base of Capitoline Hill, near the Borderline Fort. Herds graze in peace throughout lush pastures, and scattered villages nestle among ancient ruins. Yet even in such tranquility, small arenas remain a vital part of life.
LoadingTipsText_200604_TipsText: A vast plain framed by mountain ranges. Named for the giant boulder clusters left by ancient lava flows, it was here that Septimontian civilization first took root centuries ago. Now, only scattered old villages remain, where wayfaring outlanders often rest before crossing into the Septimont highlands.
LoadingTipsText_200605_TipsText: A precipitous mountain range that marks the border of Septimont. The craggy peaks form a natural barrier between Septimont and the outside world. During the first outbreak of the Dark Tide, the Border Mountains bore the brunt, leaving them forever scarred by ashen traces and Tidal Blight calcification.
LoadingTipsText_200606_TipsText: The remains of a coast eroded by the Dark Tide. Temples and sacred statues once erected by Ragunnesi Acolytes now lie in ruin. Their silent halls, devoid of worshippers, are spread across the canyon floor, transformed into haunted dwellings of Tacet Discords.
LoadingTipsText_200607_TipsText: A dragon of yore once perished in the Border Mountains, attracting numerous dissonant frequencies. Over the years, the area became plagued by Tacet Discords and ferocious creatures. Founding Septimontians saw it as a testing ground for warriors to prove their mettle, leaving behind countless tales of glory. This continued until the first Dark Tide swept through, laying waste to this sanctum of trials and burying its honor beneath Tidal Blight.
LoadingTipsText_604001_TipsText:
Officially known as "Remnant Cubes," these advanced artificial intelligences were created for the Second Coming of Solaris using Encore's abilities and Tethys's microprocessing support.
The Remnant Cubes differ from their originals in subtle to outright obvious ways. The cause of these variations remains unclear. Is it the user acting as the anchor point, Tethys's scanning and data support, or Encore's artistic leeway as the master artisan?
LoadingTipsText_604101_TipsText:
Ciaccona's Sonoro Sphere, created through her perception of melodies and echoes.
Memories and stories carried by the melodies manifest here as still, frozen images.
But through Ciaccona's tuning, these stories and memories come together as notes on a music sheet.
As the notes play, the images begin to move and unfold.
LoadingTipsText_605001_TipsText: What will become of this twisted tale? What awaits at the end of this path, beyond the heroes' triumph...?
LoadingTipsText_900101_TipsText:
In broad daylight, Daemons once devoured in a great fire whisper through the streets of Ragunna. They wield beloved poetry and music as weapons of their curse. A confrontation, wrapped in the language of art, begins to unfold on the stage of Rinascita.
Remnants of past sins resurge. From deep beneath the earth, they scheme and plot. When the flames that once ripped through the night return, a silent war will begin.
LoadingTipsText_900201_TipsText:
The brighter the glory, the deeper the shadow. Amid the arena's deafening roar, tales of joy distort and drown in the icy embrace of the deep.
A champion's path is fraught with peril. When glory itself is burnt to ash by its own flames, none can say who will reach the end victorious.

RecallActivity_Area_07_Desc:
Divine ruins that hang upside down in the sky. Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds.

It once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets.
RecallActivity_Area_08_Desc:
“All for glory, fear no death." Like Ragunna, Septimont is a city-state of Rinascita, though its people revere not Divinity, but heroes of flesh and blood.
Famed for its Gladiators, this City of Glory is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years.”
RecallActivity_Story_04: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
RecallActivity_Story_04_Desc:
In search of Sentinel Imperator, you follow Their guidance and uncover a crucial clue: "Seek the ruins suspended above the wasteland."

As you journey toward the hidden ruins among the clouds, Cantarella, the head of the Fisalias, unveils a long-buried history. Along the way, you also cross paths once again with the mysterious girl, Cartethyia.

Ascending the stairs, the truth is finally within your grasp. However, what awaits beyond is far more unexpected...
RecallActivity_Story_05_Desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita’s city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

Preheating_Desc_01:
Huanglong consists of a capital and six cities, renowned for its vast lands and rich history...
(Clipped to the page is a landscape painting of Ragunna brought by Alannah.)
Preheating_Desc_02:
For Jinzhou citizens, buying everyday essentials on Gourmet Street makes up a big part of their living expenses...
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the interior of a Ragunna bank.)
Preheating_Desc_03:
While Terminals are crucial tools for Resonators, things seem quite different in Rinascita...
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing a Ragunna Terminal.)
Preheating_Desc_04:
Jinzhou has an extensive road network for easy transport, while Rinascita runs a unique transport system....
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing Ragunna's unique transport.)
Preheating_Desc_05:
In Jinzhou, Tacet Discords are often linked to catastrophes and suffering...
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing a special Echo in the Ragunna city.)
Preheating_Desc_06:
In Jinzhou, leisure activities center around watching plays in theaters and socializing in teahouses...
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the streets of the Ragunna city.)
Preheating_Desc_07: A vague figure flashed through the sea of clouds...
Preheating_Epilogue:
The melody will guide you to this place...
(To be continued)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_01:
Huanglong consists of a capital and six cities, renowned for its vast lands and rich history, whereas Rinascita is known for its archipelagos embraced by the sea.
(Clipped to the page is a landscape painting of Ragunna brought by Alannah.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_02:
For Jinzhou citizens, buying everyday essentials on Gourmet Street makes up a big part of their living expenses... When it comes to personal finances in Ragunna, most people handle their money through the wealthy Montelli family's prominent bank service.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the interior of a Ragunna bank.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_03:
While Terminals are crutial tools for Resonators, Reserved Terminals are a rare sight in Ragunna.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing a Ragunna Terminal.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_04:
In contrast to Jinzhou citizens, who are accustomed to manmade vehicles and vessels, transportation in Rinascita is mostly Echoes.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the special transport Echo Gondola in Ragunna.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_05:
Echoes can be found throughout the city of Ragunna.
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing a special Echo in the Ragunna city.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_06:
The leisure activities of Jinzhou people revolve around watching plays in theaters and chatting in teahouses, while in Ragunna, there is a longstanding tradition of celebrating Carnevale...
(Clipped to the page is a photo brought by Alannah, showing the streets of the Ragunna city.)
Preheating_Finish_Desc_07: A vague figure flashed across the sea of clouds, leaving behind a mellow melody...
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_01: It seems the Ragunnesi prefer art galleries over photos to enjoy their landscapes...
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_02: I once interviewed an artist from Ragunna who said, "Money is meant to be earned, not saved."
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_03: In Rinascita, people use Common Terminals, while owning a private Terminal requires registration.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_04: Gondola tours are a favorite pastime in Ragunna, enjoyed by people from all walks of life.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_05: In Ragunna, children buy Echo toys. There are even octopus Echoes that strike the bells in bell towers.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_06: During the Carnevale, Ragunnesi wear traditional clothing and masks with designs that represent their ancestry.
Preheating_Npc_Viewpoin_07: This nightmare... How long was I trapped in it?
Preheating_Question_01: Do you prefer the land in "Huanglong from Above" or the archipelago of Rinascita?
Preheating_Question_02: If you suddenly obtained a large sum of Shell Credits, what would you do?
Preheating_Question_03: Do you think Resonators should be allowed to use their own Terminals freely?
Preheating_Question_04: Which kind of transportation would you prefer to travel with?
Preheating_Question_05: Do you believe humans and Tacet Discords can coexist peacefully?
Preheating_Question_06: How would you like to spend an afternoon when visiting an unfamiliar city?
Preheating_Task_Desc_01: Alannah invites you to Jinzhou's summits to take photos for the "Huanglong from Above" merch.
Preheating_Task_Desc_02: Alannah invites you to Gourmet Street to interview the reportedly richest person in Jinzhou.
Preheating_Task_Desc_03: Alannah wants to discuss if Terminals and Beacons would make good model merchandise.
Preheating_Task_Desc_04: Alannah invites you to Lollo Logistics to find the ideal vehicle for model merchandise.
Preheating_Task_Desc_05: Alannah seems to have run into some trouble while seeking inspiration in the wild...
Preheating_Task_Desc_06: Alannah invites you to talk with Jinzhou citizens to learn about their culture and daily life.
Preheating_Viewpoin_01: "Huanglong from Above" was well received in Jinzhou, but it fell flat in Ragunna. Guess we'll need to tailor it to their tastes.
Preheating_Viewpoin_01_L: The land with a vast expanse.
Preheating_Viewpoin_01_R: The archipelago caressed by sea breezes.
Preheating_Viewpoin_02: Sounds like he's just trying to justify not managing his money properly...
Preheating_Viewpoin_02_R: Deposit it at a safe place.
Preheating_Viewpoin_03: I see... but I feel like most Resonators would rather have their own personal Terminal.
Preheating_Viewpoin_03_L: Terminals are a necessity for Resonators and should be allowed.
Preheating_Viewpoin_03_R: Abuse of Terminals brings many risks, and they should be regulated.
Preheating_Viewpoin_04: Fishing while sitting on a "fish"? That sounds like such a fun idea!
Preheating_Viewpoin_04_R: Echo Gondolas that cut through the wuthering waves.
Preheating_Viewpoin_05: Echoes seem to be an integral part of Ragunnesi's life.
Preheating_Viewpoin_05_L: No, they can't. Tacet Discords have an instinct to destroy and devour.
Preheating_Viewpoin_05_R: Yes, they can, after being converted into Echoes.
Preheating_Viewpoin_06: So that's how they pay tribute to their homelands and loved ones lost in the Lament...
Preheating_Viewpoin_06_L: Enjoy the local plays at a theater.
Preheating_Viewpoin_06_R: Experience the local festivals with the crowd.
RecallActivity_Area_04_Desc: Scattered islands give rise to united civilizations. Their bonds are woven through bloodlines, their purpose driven by the welfare of their families. What changes might a roving warrior bring to their shores?
RecallActivity_Area_05_Desc: A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...
RecallActivity_Area_06_Desc: A facility holding collections of works of art and rare Echoes from across the world, even including artifacts that have survived the Lament and Echoes from ancient times. The ensemble of the dazzling array of collections forms the construct of “art” itself.
RecallActivity_Story_03_Desc: A masquerade that never ends, with music that never sleeps... During the Carnevale, people cast off the chains of society and reveal their truest selves. But now, the city is drowned in silence. Will your arrival lift the veil of quiet, and bring back the joy and song to the streets?
RecallActivity_Story_11_Desc: After the New Solar Ceremony, your campus life kicks off. In class, you cross paths with a "ghost girl," Aemeath, a Synchronist presumed dead more than a decade ago. Why is she lingering at the Academy? What's her connection with you? To uncover the truth about her and the root cause of your fading frequency, you and Aemeath set out for the Roya Frostlands, where the Exostrider slumbers.
RecallActivity_Story_12_Desc: As the New Solar Celebration kicks off, the air of Startorch Academy is filled with festivity. Yet beneath the surface, abnormal frequencies fester within the Academy's Dark Side, a subconscious dimension birthed from students' emotions. At President Lucilla's request, you take a dive into this psychic realm, where you encounter Sigrika—a spirited honor student hailed as a future successor to the Heliodic Six. As you venture forth, it soon becomes clear that the riddles and murmurs haunting the Dark Side harbor a far more sinister intent...
RecallActivity_Story_13_Desc: With the Academy's Dark Side incident resolved, your pursuit of the Fractsidus brings you briefly face-to-face with an aloof white-haired miko who wields a blade. But before the Exostrider can awaken, the Threnodian in the underground Dimmr Plains begin flaring with alarming frequency, forcing the Spacetrek Collective to consider an emergency evacuation of Lahai-Roi. To keep the Exostrider plan alive, you move into action. And as the Void Storm spreads, Aemeath's ever-silent "shell" seems to be whispering to herself...
RecallActivity_Story_14_Desc: A strange gate appears out of nowhere at Startorch Academy. Behind it, reality-invading frequencies leak through. To investigate the crisis, you step through the threshold and into the Somnoire, where you encounter Lucy and Rebecca as they battle a swarm of Nightmare Tacet Discords. But as you explore further, you uncover an unlikely truth…

DungeonDetection_20010001_AttributesDesc: Sonoro Sphere is similar to Tacet Field, but with more obvious traits. It's composed by overclocked Resonators. This Sonoro Sphere locates in a city ruin of Port City of Guixu. Frequency analysis indicates it generated in the time of Threnodian War by a military general. Considering the time and identification, this Sonoro Sphere preserves high risks inside.

Frequency analysis indicates that its owner is one Huanglong general sacrificed in battle. The yearning for war composed this Sonoro Sphere. Due to the general's ability to conjure fire, one could find burned down city ruins inside this Sonoro Sphere. Materials are well forged with the general's unyielding wills, and are rare for weapon... To put it simply? Apologize, This one is just mimitating the way of speech of Huanglong.
DungeonDetection_20010002_AttributesDesc: Sonoro Sphere is similar to Tacet Field, but with more obvious traits. It's composed by overclocked Resonators. This Sphere was hidden in Dim Forest. It's said that it belongs to a Resonator well-versed in healing. But still, analysis indicates high risks inside.

Different from most Sphere. It preserves fine greenery inside, vividly and lively. The scenery should be related to its owner's healing ability and gentle personality. According to the record. The owner was betrayed by the people she used to protect, and died due to healing ability abuse. This sphere then generated from her despair and hatred. So it's predictable that danger lurks behind all the lively greenery.

Influence_1_Introduction:
The Pioneer Association, originally known as the Universal Geography Association, is a scientific and educational organization established before the Lament.

After the Ebb Tide, the Association collaborated with scientists, photographers, and journalists to continue exploring the mysterious world after the disaster, and shared the discoveries with the public through magazines, maps, books, on-site entertainment experience projects, and interactive media, attracting a large fan base in the six regions.
Influence_2_Introduction: Lollo Logistics is a widely respected global transportation company, known for successfully handling high-risk transportation assignments. Their philosophy of "harmony brings wealth" guides their team in choosing peaceful resolutions to any challenges they may face.
Influence_3_Introduction: The Cruising Drake, a group of inventors and enthusiasts scattered throughout Huanglong, set up shop in the bustling Jiaolong Repair Shop. They are known for their love of gang culture and their ability to raise funds for their ventures. Their specialties include causing mischief and creating innovative inventions.
Influence_4_Introduction: Exiles is the general term for groups of people who wander outside the city and live by crime and scavenging. The Exiles do not have a unified organizational structure, and the strongest person in each camp will act as the leader to give orders. In the Huanglong area, they are mainly concentrated in the Wuming Bay. Due to the large number of people and different ideas, two gangs have been formed. The "Boar Gang", for some reasons, seems to be not so repulsive to outsiders.
Influence_998_Introduction: A clandestine organization with an extreme obsession with power and progress that borders on macabre. The Fractsidus members are rumored to possess an unusual appearance, but further details are still being uncovered through ongoing investigations.
Influence_999_Introduction: The Black Shores are a mysterious organization dedicated to saving the world from destruction. They travel to the most perilous places, recruiting brave allies and never losing their idealistic passion. Those who join or are invited to their island will don the emblem of a Blake Bloom as a symbol of their membership.
