LoadingTipsText_1001_TipsText: Sol-III, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.
LoadingTipsText_1002_TipsText: The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."
LoadingTipsText_1003_TipsText: The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.
LoadingTipsText_1004_TipsText: The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.
LoadingTipsText_1005_TipsText: Individuals with the ability to resonate with certain objects and manipulate their frequencies are known as "Resonators." These individuals exhibit unique "Resonance Abilities," also known as their "Fortes," through the "Tacet Mark" on their bodies. According to experts, a Resonator's abilities are often influenced by their past experiences and subconscious mind.
LoadingTipsText_1006_TipsText: Tacet Discords, created by the Waveworn Phenomena, are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms. They possess "Tacet Cores" and feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.
LoadingTipsText_1007_TipsText:
A type of special frequency that can be captured by the Terminal to reproduce Tacet Discords' abilities.
Tacet Discords may leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.
LoadingTipsText_1008_TipsText: Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and guides. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As we embark on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain our record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.
LoadingTipsText_1009_TipsText: Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.
LoadingTipsText_1010_TipsText: Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.
LoadingTipsText_1011_TipsText: The Waveworn Phenomena is believed to alter matter, information, and energy by converting them into vibrating "frequencies" referred to as "Reverberations." This process has been observed through experimental evidence in the academic community.
LoadingTipsText_1012_TipsText:
A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.
In their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite"—a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords. Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.
LoadingTipsText_1101_TipsText: The Black Shores, an archipelago enshrouded in mysteries and turmoil, remains sealed away from the world in thick digital fog. It remains uncertain when or who will lift its veil, allowing it to once more shoulder the task of connecting the world.
LoadingTipsText_1102_TipsText: The Black Shores, an archipelago enshrouded in mysteries and turmoil, remains sealed away from the world in thick digital fog. It remains uncertain when or who will lift its veil, allowing it to once more shoulder the task of connecting the world.
LoadingTipsText_1103_TipsText: The Black Shores, an archipelago enshrouded in mysteries and turmoil, remains sealed away from the world in thick digital fog. It remains uncertain when or who will lift its veil, allowing it to once more shoulder the task of connecting the world.
LoadingTipsText_1104_TipsText: Shrouded in dense sea fog, the Black Shores is a haven for countless Consultants and Bloom Bearers wandering Solaris. Without an invitation from its members, no one has ever been able to locate this floating sanctuary that unites the world across the vast ocean...
LoadingTipsText_1105_TipsText: Shrouded in dense sea fog, the Black Shores is a haven for countless Consultants and Bloom Bearers wandering Solaris. Without an invitation from its members, no one has ever been able to locate this floating sanctuary that unites the world across the vast ocean...
LoadingTipsText_1106_TipsText: As an untuned melody drifts across the night sky, the torchlights that once illuminated the stars now instead devour them in crimson blaze. Listen to the true cries concealed within the Lament, and face them with unwavering courage. Hope will be born anew.
LoadingTipsText_1107_TipsText: As an untuned melody drifts across the night sky, the torchlights that once illuminated the stars now instead devour them in crimson blaze. Listen to the true cries concealed within the Lament, and face them with unwavering courage. Hope will be born anew.
LoadingTipsText_1108_TipsText: The upper and lower realms of the Black Shores are distinct yet interconnected, much like day and night. Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...

Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...
LoadingTipsText_1111_TipsText: The garden, nestled within the depths of the subterranean galaxy, serves as both the lens to observe its great expanse and the Shorekeeper's dwelling during her confinement by the Tethys System. It is said that the garden existed well before the founding of the Black Shores, functioning as the eye that gazes upon the stars. However, what the eye perceives may remain unknown to the heart. What truths lie behind these supreme concepts?
LoadingTipsText_1401_TipsText:
An ancient, secluded town nestles within the tranquil embrace of Mt. Firmament. Elegant structures, scattered among the crimson leaves and tipped with pure white snow, create a scene of serene beauty. 
For centuries, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, as their god, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. Despite the year-round snowfall blanketing Mt. Firmament, the warm springs flowing from the mountains and the vibrant life of the townsfolk make the cold no more a concern.
LoadingTipsText_1402_TipsText:
A sanctuary in the southeastern seas of Jinzhou, sealed away beyond the reach of common folks in thick fogs.
According to ancient records, Mt. Firmament is the ancestral home of Jinzhou's earliest settlers. Sentinel Jué once descended upon this land, using the power of Temporal Mandate to protect it from Tacet Discords. Consequently, the flow of time within Mt. Firmament diverges from that of the outside world. 
In earlier times, scholars from the Court of Savantae were fortunate enough to uncover the mountain's hidden mysteries, leaving behind research facilities and invaluable records before vanishing without a trace.

Sentinel Jué once descended upon this land, using the power of Temporal Mandate to protect it from Tacet Discords. Consequently, the flow of time within Mt. Firmament diverges from that of the outside world. 
In earlier times, scholars from the Court of Savantae were fortunate enough to uncover the mountain's hidden mysteries, leaving behind research facilities and invaluable records before vanishing without a trace.
LoadingTipsText_1404_TipsText:
The capsule that descended with the Sentinel upon Mt. Firmament now lies concealed in the depths of Loong's Rest, known to the people of Hongzhen as the Mianloong Chamber. 
The townsfolk believe that Sentinel Jué may hail from a distant star, and that the Mianloong Chamber served as its hibernation capsule. This site marks the end of the pilgrimage and the gateway to Jinzhou's true future.
LoadingTipsText_1405_TipsText:

The townsfolk believe that Sentinel Jué may hail from a distant star, and that the Mianloong Chamber served as its hibernation capsule. This site marks the end of the pilgrimage and the gateway to Jinzhou's true future.
LoadingTipsText_150601_TipsText:
A future beyond this System lies beyond sight.
Its fall shall usher forth the world's inevitable ruin.
Frozen, torn asunder, consumed by flame... So be it, gaze now upon the world's end.
LoadingTipsText_151001_TipsText: The land is engulfed in flames, while the Necrostar swallows the sky. The black hole at the pinnacle of the Port City of Guixu marks the beginning and the end of destruction. It also holds the key to salvation... Or perhaps, merely a lie.
LoadingTipsText_151201_TipsText:
On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future.
The tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end.
Yet, the guardian of this final destination, like yourself, is but a remnant of that very future.
LoadingTipsText_200001_TipsText:
A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 
The Rinascitan people, with their unique "Common Echoes," have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."
LoadingTipsText_200002_TipsText:
Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. Magnificent sculptures and paintings grace the city at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life.
LoadingTipsText_200003_TipsText: The Order of the Deep worships Sentinel Imperator and holds de facto rule over Ragunna. According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word. Under the leadership of the current Primus, Fenrico, a series of laws were enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.
LoadingTipsText_200004_TipsText: At the farthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven lies an island where a labyrinth of woods and ruins surrounds a central lake. It is spoken of in knight's tales, said to be the destination of their quests. To this day, the restless spirits of those who sought it wander the ancient paths of the grove.
LoadingTipsText_200005_TipsText: The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum.
LoadingTipsText_200006_TipsText: Built by the Montelli family, Averardo Vault stands like a heavily guarded fortress on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures, including precious metals, artworks, and rare Echoes. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.
LoadingTipsText_200007_TipsText: This peninsula thick with oak trees was once where Rinascita's rulers gathered for secret councils. The Oracles carved into the stone and trees have withstood the passage of time, though their messages are now nearly impossible to distinguish.
LoadingTipsText_200008_TipsText: The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread.
LoadingTipsText_200009_TipsText: The Fool's Troupe travels across all of Rinascita, but their base sits in a vast cavern on Penitent's End. Their creed is freedom, their treasure is laughter, and their gift to every city they visit is a new tale.
LoadingTipsText_200010_TipsText: This forsaken island, shrouded in dense sea mist, is dominated by steep cliffs with giant ringed structures. Ships caught in the currents often end up stranded on the island's treacherous shores. For those lucky enough to survive the wreck, even greater horrors await...
LoadingTipsText_200101_TipsText:
Averardo Bank utilizes an Echo train system to move clients' collections and staff to and from Averardo Vault.
Once the Echo trains reach the underground station of Averardo Vault, the collections within will undergo a second sorting process before being moved to specialized storage facilities.
LoadingTipsText_200102_TipsText: A facility holding collections of works of art and rare Echoes from across the world, even including artifacts that have survived the Lament and Echoes from ancient times.
LoadingTipsText_200103_TipsText:
Collections housed in this area are often referred to as "vessels of creativity and ingenuity."
For artists and inventors laboring under the patronage of a wealthy family, all their creations, tangible or intangible, are considered assets of the patrons.
The act of creation becomes a measure of worth, by which these creators' value is defined.
LoadingTipsText_200104_TipsText: Located within the depths of Averardo Vault, off Echo train network, this tower is known to few. What dark secrets does the place hide?
LoadingTipsText_200201_TipsText: A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...
LoadingTipsText_200301_TipsText: Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds. It once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets.
LoadingTipsText_200302_TipsText: A seminary faintly visible through a thin veil of clouds. Suspended upside down in the sky, it stands solemn and silent, as though carrying the weight of the Blessed Maiden's life.
LoadingTipsText_200303_TipsText:
"The mortal world is a vast and mysterious ocean, wherein all souls are doomed to drown and sink to the depths. Those who refuse to be swallowed must learn to rise, climbing upward until their heads break the surface. Only then shall they glimpse the realm of the divine."
This proverb, written by the Order, is preserved within the tower.
LoadingTipsText_200304_TipsText: Majestic and serene, ancient yet still sacred. This is the coronation platform prepared for the Blessed Maiden, though an aura of control lingers above. When the heavy weight of "divine right" falls upon one's head, it feels as if all choices have already been made.
LoadingTipsText_200305_TipsText:
Once the dwelling of dragons, this place witnessed those ancient, mighty beings soaring through the sky.
Now, wild vines and flowers steadily consume the garden's former glory while the buried history of dragons slumbers in cursed lairs.
LoadingTipsText_200401_TipsText:
An ancient, mysterious castle perched on the edge of a cliff in the outskirts.
Surrounded by lush flora reminiscent of deep-sea creatures, its interior houses similarly strange and wondrous treasures. Enticing yet bizarre, it pulls the curious in like a whirlpool, drawing them to step inside.
LoadingTipsText_600001_TipsText: Simulation Training takes place in an artificial Sonoro Sphere dedicated to combat training. Clear the challenges within for various resources.
LoadingTipsText_600101_TipsText: A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
LoadingTipsText_600201_TipsText: A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
LoadingTipsText_600301_TipsText: There are a range of artificial Sonoro Spheres on this land set up to meet various demands.
LoadingTipsText_600401_TipsText: There are a range of artificial Sonoro Spheres on this land set up to meet various demands.
LoadingTipsText_600501_TipsText:
An artificial Sonoro Sphere-based combat simulation program in development in Huanglong. 
This facility is repurposed from an abandoned experiment site once owned by the Court of Savantae.
LoadingTipsText_600601_TipsText:
An ember with smoldering flames. A domain of lingering memories.
If you step foot in this domain once more, you'll relive the memories of disasters and the "blade of destructions".
LoadingTipsText_600701_TipsText: Those who are ignorant hinder progress, while the innocent suffer from the challenges imposed upon them. The embers of a fire, sparked by memories of a distant night and fueled by present circumstances, ignite the pain of Scar's past and the rebirth of new ideas, ultimately leading to the downfall of the old world order.
LoadingTipsText_600801_TipsText: In the ruins, chaotic nightmares lurk in the shadows...
LoadingTipsText_600802_TipsText: As you step into the train carriage, a journey through a tangled web of dreams unfolds before you.
LoadingTipsText_600901_TipsText: In the lake, whispers of restless dreams drift gently to your ears...
LoadingTipsText_601001_TipsText: Simulation Training takes place in an artificial Sonoro Sphere dedicated to combat training. Clear the challenges within for various resources.
LoadingTipsText_601101_TipsText: A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
LoadingTipsText_601201_TipsText: A unique variant of the Sonoro Sphere that captures a moment of time. Within its depths, you'll discover byproducts of the Waveworn that can enhance both Resonators and weapons.
LoadingTipsText_601301_TipsText:
The music persists, and the crimson curtains are set to rise once more.
Will you share another dance with her in this long, unfolding drama?
LoadingTipsText_601401_TipsText: It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
LoadingTipsText_601501_TipsText: It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
LoadingTipsText_601601_TipsText: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
LoadingTipsText_601701_TipsText: It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.
LoadingTipsText_601801_TipsText:
The Sonoro Sphere of Phrolova.
Amid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.
LoadingTipsText_601901_TipsText: The vault, controlled by the Montelli family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
LoadingTipsText_602001_TipsText:
A hall set for a banquet, grand enough to dazzle, yet secret enough to conceal.
At this very moment, a trade initiated by one Montelli is being undone by another.
LoadingTipsText_602101_TipsText: Behind the mirror lies a realm where the illusions of the past intertwine with reality, yet the path ahead leads to an completely different destiny.
LoadingTipsText_602101_Title: Realm of Ego: Mirrors in the Mirror
LoadingTipsText_602201_TipsText: A prison built of power and fear is strong enough to chain the mind—but it cannot silence the song that rises from within people's hearts.
LoadingTipsText_602301_TipsText: The deepest point of the Averardo Vault. Lower ranking staff might not even be aware of its existence. Legend say an intruder would meet their end at the hands of the Echo guard, descending from a height to deliver their fate.
LoadingTipsText_602501_TipsText: A desolate field of ruins that sits near the Strand. As fog cloaks the sea, distant whispers emanate from within, enchanting the weary sailors. Little do they notice, they're lured into a howling vortex and a realm of death.
LoadingTipsText_603001_TipsText:
Time and space collapse into chaos here, and all things dissolve into nothingness. When the storm heralds a new world, the crown of thorns will finally settle upon her head.
Thereafter, Divinity descends.
LoadingTipsText_603101_TipsText: Ancient, enigmatic spirits slumber in the lake's depths. Their eyes once summoned stars, leaving trails of fleeting, radiant light across the night sky. As you glide across the lake, another vast world seems to stir in its reflection, just within reach.
LoadingTipsText_603201_TipsText:
An annual festival in Egla Town to honor those who have passed.
When night falls, the townspeople don masks and dress as ghosts to attend the commemorative event. Legend has it that on the Night of Remembrance, vengeful spirits return to the mortal realm. Who's to say whether the person reveling beside you is human, or something else...
LoadingTipsText_80020101_TipsText: A mysterious gateway has appeared, leading to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris...

MonsterDetection_10010051_AttributesDesc: A powerful Tacet Discord that appears in the Sonoro at Desorock Highlands. Capable of using Electro powers.

<color=#9656d8>[Electro]</color>
This enemy has <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#9656d8>Electro DMG</color>. 

Thundering Mephis resembles a fusion of a human and a lizard. It can use Wutherons within the Tacet Field for high-speed maneuvers. Preliminary studies suggest that it results from the natural evolution of Tacet Discords. Rumor has it in Huanglong that it devoured a couple who had been together for life, tasted their sorrow and will to fight, and ultimately transformed into its current form during a thunderstorm.
MonsterDetection_10010052_AttributesDesc: A powerful Tacet Discord located in the Port City of Guixu, According to witnesses, its movement is different from other Tacet Discords, more information to be further researched.

<color=#e15226>[Fusion]</color> 
This enemy has <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#e15226>Fusion DMG</color>. 

Tacet Discords usually do not require a "vehicle" for movement, but the appearance of the Inferno Rider resembles a rider on a motorcycle. Presumably this form is derived from a poor imitation of human behavior. The Tacet Discord's crazy rampage in the "vehicle" is unofficially known as "Flames of Fury" in Huanglong. However, Huanglong people would also say "Even the flames of fury will one day go extinct." Guess Huanglong can always get people's hope up.
MonsterDetection_10010053_AttributesDesc: A powerful Tacet Discord that resides in the deep shafts of the Tiger's Maw. There is very few available sighting reports, and the only ones claim that they resemble insects.

<color=#1891e7>[Glacio]</color> 
This enemy has <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Glacio DMG</color>.

The Lampylumen Myriad is a collection of small insect-like Tacet Discords called "Glowflies" that are highly sensitive to different sound frequencies. It can either determine the location of its prey by sound, or absorb and imitate their frequency. Oh by the way, this device can mimic their sounds.
MonsterDetection_10010054_AttributesDesc: A formidable Mutant Organism that appears in the deep of Dim Forest. Leader of the Hoochiefs.

<color=#46c3d4>[Aero]</color> 
This enemy has <color=#46c3d4>higher RES</color> against <color=#46c3d4>Aero DMG</color>.  

Once an entertainment for humans, later a target of human offensive and finally a nuisance for humans, Felilian Beringal is imprisoned in the forest. However, It managed to use the pillar that binds it as its weapon and become the ruler of Hoochiefs. Now, it does what is done to it by human onto the human captured by the apes. So... Who's the one in cage actually?
MonsterDetection_10010056_AttributesDesc: A Tacet Discord observed in the Central Plains. There has been only sighting report for this Tacet Discord from Rover. There is no detailed record of its full appearance, and it is judged to be extremely dangerous according to its energy level.

<color=#7e1f57>[Havoc]</color>
 This enemy has <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#7e1f57>Havoc DMG</color>. 

 A copy of the Threnodian "Crownless". It resembles a white-armored knight in appearance, and when risen in power, it extends its blood-red wings, presumably made by its brief manipulation of the structure of Wutherons in its body, instantly increasing its mobility and attack power. Recently, it has also been observed that it can produce a body structure that mimics human "weapons". It is not known how far it can keep mutating, though one certain thing is that it is of Havoc, quite the opposite to its looks. "Don't judge a Tacet Discord by its cover", adapted from Huanglong's idioms.
MonsterDetection_10010057_AttributesDesc: Large Mutant Organism that hides itself in the depths of the Gorges of Spirits. It is only reasonable to decide that it is of extreme danger as of now, since now detailed record exist that depicts the whole appearance of it.

<color=#1891e7>[Glacio]</color> 
This enemy has <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Glacio DMG</color>.  

The ancient bell on the back of the Geochelone hides its Tacetreite core. When struck, the bell resonates with the core, exploding into a sound wave of Glacio energy. Please note that this sound wave can deal permanent damage to broca area in human brains and cause permanent aphasia. Good thing that with current medical technology, we have 0.04% chance to reverse the damage.
MonsterInfo_310000010_DiscoveredDes:
A TD constructed with fragmented rocks. It has poor eyesight and a preference for rampaging. 

The clinks and clacks of its rock skin colliding with other objects help Vanguard Junrock identify its circumstances.
MonsterInfo_310000010_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD inhabiting mountainous areas. Often overlooked due to its rock-like appearance.
MonsterInfo_310000020_DiscoveredDes:
A TD constructed with fragmented rocks. Commonly found in the company of Vanguard Junrock. 

Different from the latter, Fission Junrock has a more active and unstable energy and easily explodes under impact. Records show that it is sometimes used as a throwing weapon by other Tacet Discords.
MonsterInfo_310000020_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD inhabiting mountainous areas. Often overlooked due to its lava-like shape.
MonsterInfo_310000030_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. 

A humanoid Tacet Discord wielding hunting gear that fires lightning arrows. 

Electro Predators' string pulls are as fast as lightning strikes in the first of spring. The wastelands are its hunting ground, and it takes delight in the pursuit of prey.
MonsterInfo_310000030_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is capable of pulling bowstrings like humans and shooting lightning as arrows.
MonsterInfo_310000040_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. 

A humanoid Tacet Discord wielding ice-tipped hunting gear. 

Glacio Predators' spears are as precise as lightning that slices the wind. The wastelands are its hunting ground, and it takes delight in the pursuit of prey.
MonsterInfo_310000040_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class WhisperinTD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is able to gather Glacio energy to form a "projectile" and hurl it like humans.
MonsterInfo_310000050_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

A humanoid TD wielding boomerangs of storm as hunting gear. 

Aero Predators' boomerangs are an unpredictable vortex morphing around the seas. The wastelands are its hunting ground, and it takes delight in the pursuit of prey.
MonsterInfo_310000050_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is able to gather wind as boomerangs to toss and attack like humans.
MonsterInfo_310000060_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

A humanoid Tacet Discord with blades grown from its arms. 

Yearning for powerful opponents, it burns with a fighting spirit as surging as the blades at the end of its limbs.
MonsterInfo_310000060_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD commonly found in the wild. Records show that a sharp blade is grown from its arm.
MonsterInfo_310000070_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A humanoid Tacet Discord with scythes grown from its arms. 

It favors less powerful opponents, for only the weak are at the mercy of its trials and sentences.
MonsterInfo_310000070_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class WhisperinTD commonly found in the wild. Records show that a giant scythe is grown from its arm.
MonsterInfo_310000080_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

An immature humanoid Tacet Discord that exudes small amounts of magma, as though they are on the verge of boiling point. 

When they battle, the magma on their body erupts with sparks and emits a crackling sound similar to "snip-snapping."
MonsterInfo_310000080_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Fusion energy for attacks.
MonsterInfo_310000090_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

An immature humanoid Tacet Discord that often emits a "zig zag" sound when they focus and release light rays.
MonsterInfo_310000090_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Spectro energy for attacks.
MonsterInfo_310000100_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

An immature humanoid TD, hovering in the air with the help of winds. It is able to alter its movement speed through the simple absorption of gases. 

When it exhales air backwards and accelerates, it often emits a sound akin to "whoosh."
MonsterInfo_310000100_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Aero energy for attacks.
MonsterInfo_310000110_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

An immature humanoid Tacet Discord. Maybe imitating the clacking of teeth of human laughter, they always make sounds of "tick tack" whenever they encounter humans.
MonsterInfo_310000110_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Havoc energy for attacks.
MonsterInfo_310000120_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

Fish-like animals widely found in bodies of water. Gulpuffs often hide underwater with only the lotus leaf-like structure on their head breaking the surface. 

When threatened, these creatures swallow a large amount of water before inflating themselves and emitting gulping sounds to frighten enemies.
MonsterInfo_310000120_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD active in water. It excels at disguising and sneaking attacks on nearby enemies.
MonsterInfo_310000130_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

Widely distributed riparian fish-like animals with a special algal flower structure on the crown of their skull and capable of drifting in the wind. 
When threatened, Chirpuff will rapidly puff air and make a warning chirp.
MonsterInfo_310000130_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD widely distributed in water areas. Its size is relatively small.
MonsterInfo_310000140_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins. The crystals embedded in its rock body reflect a cold light. 

Although its combat capability is relatively feeble, when it is destroyed, the energy it releases enhances the Tacet Discords in its vicinity.
MonsterInfo_310000140_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a frost ore.
MonsterInfo_310000150_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins. Under its rock body, blazing magma is contained. 

Although its combat capability is relatively feeble, when it is destroyed, the energy it releases enhances the Tacet Discords in its vicinity.
MonsterInfo_310000150_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a lava rock.
MonsterInfo_310000160_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins. Its rock body emits a blinding, brilliant glow. 

Although its combat capability is relatively feeble, when it is destroyed, the energy it releases enhances the Tacet Discords in its vicinity.
MonsterInfo_310000160_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a golden stone.
MonsterInfo_310000170_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins. Its rock body is haunted with black and profound powers. 

Although its combat capability is relatively feeble, when it is destroyed, the energy it releases enhances the Tacet Discords in its vicinity.
MonsterInfo_310000170_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD often found gathering in the wild. Its shape resembles a pitch-dark lode.
MonsterInfo_310000180_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

Mayfly-like animals with a light body. They have wings like those of butterflies. Good at circling their enemies with flexible moves.
MonsterInfo_310000180_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD often found floating in the wild. Its power is puny.
MonsterInfo_310000190_DiscoveredDes:
Boar-like animals commonly found in forests, with a sensitive and irritable nature. 

Sharp tusks are the solution to every problem a Sabyr Boar encounters – it will always charge towards anything that intrudes its territory unrelentingly. 

A Huanglong idiom also compares "Sabyr Boar's charge" to reckless people.
MonsterInfo_310000190_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD that frequents the wild. It charges at incredible speeds.
MonsterInfo_310000200_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

Mole-like animals with excellent burrowing capabilities. They are able to excavate even concrete and steel. 

With their complicated underground passage system, Excarats can easily hide their traces and confuse their enemies.
MonsterInfo_310000200_UndiscoveredDes: A common Class, terrestrial, Howler TD. Its size dictates its limited power.
MonsterInfo_310000210_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

Large amphibian-like creatures mostly found in forests. Their tough skin emits heat. 

Research has found that the toughness of Viridblaze Saurian's skin is positively correlated to its body temperature.
MonsterInfo_310000210_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD often sighted in mountainous areas. It usually follows and works in concert with Tacet Discords of larger sizes.
MonsterInfo_310000220_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

Roseshrooms are fungus-like TDs inhabiting wetlands, whose caps are like the petals of a rose when fully bloomed, hence the name. 

While they are stationary, the core on their caps can gather and release light rays to attack passing creatures.
MonsterInfo_310000220_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Tranquilite TD distributed in damp areas. Usually sighted beside maturer individuals.
MonsterInfo_310000230_DiscoveredDes:
Non-Resonators of Exile groups. They engage in a series of ordinary tasks such as combat, patrol, and item gathering for the team.

Though they often bow to opponents more powerful than themselves, they are experts at dealing with other Exile groups.

This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

Gibbon-like lifeforms primarily gathered in deep woodlands. Hoochiefs tend to show off their supremacy by stealing human belongings.

They are TDs within Huanglong borders found to manifest relatively sophisticated cognitive abilities, capable of emulating humans in the use of certain rudimentary weapons and tools. In this case, flinging rocks.
MonsterInfo_310000250_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD living nomadically across Dim Forest. Individuals live in packs and follow a leader. Able to imitate the way human use simple tools.
MonsterInfo_310000260_DiscoveredDes: Scorpion-like animals found mostly in dim areas. Their thick, hard crystal claws are deadly weapons against enemies.
MonsterInfo_310000260_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD living in obscured environments. Records show that it possesses an impressive counterattack ability.
MonsterInfo_310000270_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

Tortoise-like amphibious creatures mostly found along riverbanks. The shells on their backs are embedded with pieces of frost crystals. These creatures favor cold environments for naps. 

A warmer surrounding will wake up a Hoartoise, as well as kindle its hot-tempered nature.
MonsterInfo_310000270_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Howler TD often sighted in shallow waters. Judging from the records of charging humans on its own initiative, it might have a rather irritable temper.
MonsterInfo_310000280_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

A fiery "biker" born in the Port City of Guixu. It sets forth trials of courage with its unyielding flame for those who dare to trespass.

Throughout the long years, the truth of history gradually burns to ashes, and the knight who once sang boldly toward death becomes a harbinger of fear in the word of mouth among humanity.
"That is the rider who turns fear into fuel and brings calamity."

However, amidst the idle talk of the indigenous people in the Port City of Guixu, another version quietly spreads.
"When you face that mighty rider, set aside your fear and respond with your utmost reverence. Prove to him your courage to be the last one standing."

"Foolish left, wicked right. Center head's the greatest blight," so goes the Jinzhou rhymes.

An ensnarer that slumbers in a freezing mine pit, obsessed with collecting and imitating sounds. It can imitate human speech through a vibrating hum. 

Lampylumen Myriad uses sound as bait to lure its prey, which will be frozen in the deep cold. The loss of warmth and the illusion before dying will cause human beings to pour out their last words, which contain great emotional fluctuations. 

For Lampylumen Myriad, this is the frequency of the supreme taste.

To avoid unexpected confrontation with it, the Midnight Rangers and the Huaxu Academy once collaborated in a special operation to tag the Feilian Beringal with a tracking bracelet, enabling the tracking of its movements within the forest.
MonsterInfo_330000050_UndiscoveredDes: An Overlord Class Howler TD in Dim Forest. With a giant size, it boasts the sovereign of this land.

A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song. 

Legend has it that this bird once had a partner and that their chorus was a beautiful sound. Their names were not passed down, but their hymns were recorded and preserved by human beings. 

Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix. 

In the loss of a lover, the bird became oppressive and violent, allowing no one to step into its nest of lost love. It only lingers in the heavens while singing the eulogy, in pursuit of an illusion that is no longer there among the clouds.

Crownless is a Whisperin Tacet Discord born outside the Gorges of Spirits along with the eruption of the strange Tacet Field. A vast mixture of human frequencies is detected within its physical form. For instance, the exhilaration and thirst for victory, the fear and resentment of loss... Humanity's long-suppressed barbarism is reified in Crownless and inflected against itself.

This creature is a pawn dispatched by the enemy in disguise, as well as a harbinger of the scourge of war.

When it awakens, a drawn-out toll will echo throughout the Gorges of Spirits.

Between the surging tidal waves, a lonely whalesong is heard, attracting curious voyagers who cheered and chimed in search of this "Ocean Composer."

Upon discovering traces of human frequencies, it became fixated on achieving perfection and grew larger as it improved its composition. 

A haunting symbol of humanity's relentless pursuit of scientific advancement, its presence serves as a subtle reminder of our obsession and descent into madness.

Its very presence is an ominous reminder of the devastating war that once ravaged this land. Born from the residual energies of battle, it continues to evolve and has become the most feared weapon in the Threnodian's arsenal. With merciless destruction, it reawakens humanity's primal fear of warfare. And now, it greets its ruler, ready to unleash chaos upon the world.

A humanoid mimic molded of sludge, a false sovereign, the Dark Tide's will made manifest.

Born from the utopia of Unity envisioned by the Threnodian, it is a shapeless mass of black sludge given form, a vessel created solely to devour. All things are to unite within the False Sovereign's body and be reborn as servants and children of Leviathan.

It does not think. It does not feel. Only the rippling sludge murmurs its false hymns, eternally glorifying the power of Leviathan.

Now, her creator has claimed this failed vessel, lying in wait beneath the waves to devour the entire world.

A member of Ragunna's underground gang.

During a chaotic period in Ragunna's history, many Ragunnesi were forced to gang activities. Some out of survival, others for protection. Masks that once symbolized revelry and celebration were used as tools of concealment, hiding their faces as they carried out acts of violence.

Even today, the few remaining members still cling to the tradition, as though it may help certain people recall the bygone age—the so-called "golden era" when they reveled in lawlessness, and roamed free without fear of consequence.

When the Ironhoof is under Tune Rupture - Shifting and hit by Tune Break, it takes 30% more total DMG for 15s.

After scanning the data of past animals in Lahai-Roi, the Exostrider used its own parts to grow and proliferate mechanical muskox. Due to the Ironhoof's tough armor, which allows it to survive frigid temperatures on long journeys, the Roya often use them to transport heavy loads.
MonsterInfo_320000530_UndiscoveredDes: A mechanical muskox, grown from the Exostrider's own parts. They often help the Roya in transporting loads.
MonsterInfo_320000540_DiscoveredDes:

The Spacetrek Explorer has sturdy armor and exceptional mobility. It is equipped with an electromagnetic gun and has a shield generator that can extend protection to allies.

Hitting Spacetrek Explorer with Tune Break disables its shield generator, removing its active Shield and preventing new ones from generating.

In the face of the vast unknown lands in Lahai-Roi, the Spacetrek Collective developed the multi-purpose Spacetrek Explorer to serve in transport, storage, and defense roles. Its wheeled legs and heavy-duty tires allow it to race along vertical surfaces, making it suitable for both urban and off-road terrain. The onboard storage compartments are designed to support long-term scientific expeditions.
MonsterInfo_320000540_UndiscoveredDes: A large, fast-moving mech developed by the Spacetrek Collective for both transport and defense.
MonsterInfo_320000550_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

When Sabercat Reaver is under Tune Rupture - Shifting and hit by Tune Break, it takes additional DMG equal to 25% of its Max HP, triggered only once.

This predatory machine has a single purpose: to shred everything in its path. It prowls the wilderness of Lahai-Roi, hunting any sign of movement. With the relentless buzz of its tail-mounted chainsaw, it seeks to execute its targets with cruel efficiency.
MonsterInfo_320000550_UndiscoveredDes: A highly aggressive predatory machine that prowls the wilderness of Lahai-Roi, hunting any sign of movement.
MonsterInfo_320000560_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

When Sabercat Prowler is in a state of Invisibility, its all All-Attribute RES is increased by 30%.

Hitting Sabercat Prowler with Tune Break forces it out of Invisibility.

When Sabercat Prowler is under Tune Rupture - Shifting and hit by Tune Break, it takes additional DMG equal to 25% of its Max HP, triggered only once.

A machine capable of camouflage, its parts are badly corrupted by Voidmatter, causing severe degradation to its vision and hearing. Yet this also heightens its other sensory perceptions. It tracks enemy movements by using the detector on its tail to sense changes in frequency.
MonsterInfo_320000560_UndiscoveredDes: A machine capable of camouflage. It possesses heightened senses and uses the detector on its tail to track enemy movements.
MonsterInfo_320000570_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

Frostbite Coleoid is immune to Glacio Chafe, but takes 80% more total DMG taken from other Negative Statuses and Echo Skill.

A parasitic creature that lives inside Whisperin Tacet Discords, using the host's body as a cocoon and feeds on its frequency. Infection by Frostbite Coleoids causes combative behavior and a compulsion to feed on the frequencies of other Tacet Discords. After an incubation period, the Frostbite Coleoid abandons its host by breaking free from the host's back.
MonsterInfo_320000570_UndiscoveredDes: A parasitic creature that lives inside Whisperin Tacet Discords. It uses the host's body as a cocoon and feeds on its frequency.
MonsterInfo_320000580_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG </color>.

The Windlash Coleoid is immune to Aero Erosion, but takes 80% more total DMG taken from other Negative Statuses and Echo Skill.

A parasitic creature that lives inside Whisperin Tacet Discords, using the host's body as a cocoon and feeds on its frequency. Infection by Windlash Coleoids causes combative behavior and a compulsion to feed on the frequencies of other Tacet Discords. After an incubation period, the Windlash Coleoid abandons its host by breaking free from the host's back.
MonsterInfo_320000580_UndiscoveredDes: A parasitic creature that lives inside Whisperin Tacet Discords. It uses the host's body as a cocoon and feeds on its frequency.
MonsterInfo_320000670_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

The Fog Lionarch is capable of separating its head from the body, enabling it to fight with high flexibility.
When Fog Lionarch is Immobilized, its head will separate to protect the body.
When its head is defeated, its body will remain combative.
However, when its body is destroyed, its head will lose its mobility without a Kernel to drive it.

Fog Lionarch takes 60% more total Echo Skill DMG.

A beastly Autopuppet designed to utilize Disorienting Fog to hunt down Tacet Discords at large.
Taking the form of an evil-repelling beast, it has cavities all over its body to release Disorienting Fog. When it moves, it looks as if it's traveling among clouds.
MonsterInfo_320000670_UndiscoveredDes: An Autopuppet bearing the form of a beast shrouded in fog. Like the legendary beast that fends off evil, it roams with the fog, awaiting its chance to strike.
MonsterInfo_320000680_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

When enemies nearby obtain a shield, Forbidden Bastion takes 10% more total DMG for 6s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, stacking up to 4 times.

Every brick and tile in the Censure Court is made of modular parts. It is both an elegant garden and a prison for holding and purging Tacet Discords.
Within the Censure Court, the Forbidden Bastion is one of the most formidable Autopuppets. The columns and ridges within the Court form its towering build.
The ultimate defense that safeguards the grounds, Forbidden Bastion spends year after year purging the Tacet Discords left behind within these walls, maintaining peace within Xuanfang.
MonsterInfo_320000680_UndiscoveredDes: Within the Censure Court lies an Autopuppet hailed as the Censure Court's Apparatus." Legends tell it bears an enormous form and is especially formidable in strength.
MonsterInfo_320000690_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Areo DMG</color>.
The total Negative Status DMG taken by this enemy is increased by 100%.

A type of Autopuppet developed by the Court of Savantae in Mengzhou to counter airborne Tacet Discords. Its exceptional mobility is designed for rapid deployment, enabling it to provide emergency support to Censure Courts across the region.

Its design draws inspiration from the Xuanling Bird. The propulsion units mounted on either side employ the same levitation technology used in the Skywatch Ring.

Unfortunately, before the Skywatch Lancer could enter large-scale production at Skyworks, the manufacturing lines were destroyed by Tacet Discords during the Fortress and Gorges War.
MonsterInfo_320000690_UndiscoveredDes: Clad in steel feather armor, wielding a lance. It excels at proving covering firing from the sky. But its existence seems to only be found in the historical records of the Land of Xuanfang.
MonsterInfo_320000700_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

Having seized part of Hsin's authority, Suhsin the Inevitable replicated Hsin's method for making Kernel Puppets and built one solely for war, the Formrender.

They tear into Autopuppets and raid repair workshops again and again, cutting down the Celestials' Artisan Autopuppets to stall the Civilization Capsule's restoration.

To enhance their capabilities even further, Suhsin the Inevitable poured in the fervor and rage that saturate the Heart of Flames. The Formrenders became more powerful but steadily slid into chaos and frenzy, until even their Kernels were twisted along with them.
MonsterInfo_320000700_UndiscoveredDes: An Autopuppet forged by Suhsin the Inevitable, vicious as a curse.
MonsterInfo_320000710_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. 

Having seized part of Hsin's authority, Suhsin the Inevitable replicated Hsin's method for making Kernel Puppets and built one solely for war, the Soulfrayer.

Slender with a sleek design, it wanders the Heart of Frost to no purpose, a graceful figure receding into snowfall, seemingly indifferent to the world. But let one cross paths with an Autopuppet of Hsin's making, or a Celestial at work rebuilding the Civilization Capsule, and it will let loose arrows drawn from stagnant anomalies.

Contrast to the Formrender's violent design, though, the Soulfrayer is silent and sluggish. The two have never fought well together, a rift not even Suhsin the Inevitable has managed to close.
MonsterInfo_320000710_UndiscoveredDes: An Autopuppet forged by Suhsin the Inevitable, silent as the abyss.
MonsterInfo_330000100_DiscoveredDes: This enemy has a higher RES to Fusion DMG while in human form. When enraged, he transforms into a grim goat reaper with a higher RES to Spectro DMG and Havoc DMG. One of the Fractsidus Overseers. A rebel who revels in Overclocking, disregarding the ideas of beauty and order. He enjoys destruction and chaos, delighting in the suffering of others. He disregards rules and fame, using any means to reach his goals. With an introspective sobriety driving him, he seeks you out to witness the birth of a new world, still in its infancy. "New life blooms from scorched earth, rising through the ashes."
MonsterInfo_330000100_UndiscoveredDes: One of the Fractsidus Overseers. His blazing inferno engulfs all order and rules, leaving chaos in its wake.
MonsterInfo_340000190_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A special Tacet Discord summoned by Phrolova from a Sonoro Sphere where all decaying frequencies converge, known as the "Beyond." It manifests as a three-faced Witch of the Underworld.

Mortals are nothing more than captives of fate, their struggles mere fleeting illusions. As the phases of the moon wax and wane, only death and oblivion remain unchanged.

On a stage woven from crimson Lycorises, she performs in harmony with Phrolova's orchestration, together crafting a "perfect" symphony of despair.
MonsterInfo_340000190_UndiscoveredDes: A special Tacet Discord summoned by Phrolova from a Sonoro Sphere where all decaying frequencies converge, known as the "Beyond." It manifests as a three-faced Witch of the Underworld.
MonsterInfo_340000200_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

The "divinity" who wields the power to merge. A Threnodian rooted in the civilization of Rinascita.
Its frequency, once bound by the Sentinel's shackles, was reborn through the Gem. Taking the form of the once Blessed Maiden, Fleurdelys, It made Itself a vessel anew.
Born of the yearning for life and sustained by the eternal dread that haunts all living beings, It gazes unceasingly, silent as the abyss.
All heretics and non-believers shall stand before Its judgment.
MonsterInfo_340000200_UndiscoveredDes:
The multitudes chant Its name as one; countless voices hail the gospel of the end.
It and Its kingdom are fated to descend.
MonsterInfo_340000210_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG </color>.

When Hyvatia opens its Eye of Prediction, it observes and records Resonators' Dodges and Counterattacks. After the Eye closes, Hyvatia's next attack cannot be Dodged or Counterattacked.

Hyvatia takes 100% more total Tune Rupture DMG. When it's under Tune Rupture - Shifting and hit by Tune Break, it takes 15% more total DMG for 15s.

Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

The Research Institute implanted the Exostrider's space-time error correction module runtime into Hyvatia's core, allowing Hyvatia to adjust the Exostrider's orbit and detect hidden spaceborne threats with high precision. Therefore, Hyvatia possesses sufficient computational power to predict the Reactor Drive's rotation.

Hyvatia's core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.
MonsterInfo_340000210_UndiscoveredDes: The Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.
MonsterInfo_340000220_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

Reactor Husk's special ranged attack, Cinder Cut, can be deflected back, dealing damage to the Reactor Husk in return and reducing its Vibration Strength.

After attacking or taking Counterattacks several times, a Vulnerable Core will be exposed on Reactor Husk's left arm. Attacking the exposed core will destroy Reactor Husk's armor, rendering it unable to attack.

Inflicting Negative Statuses on Reactor Husk immediately exposes the Vulnerable Core. If Reactor Husk's armor is destroyed while it is inflicted with Negative Statuses, then it takes 100% more total DMG from Negative Statuses for 30s. During this effect's period, the core will no longer be exposed.

After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activities of Aleph-1. 

When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.
MonsterInfo_340000220_UndiscoveredDes: A Reactor Drive component. When the Drive's immune response is triggered, its battle logic will activate to eliminate all intruders.
MonsterInfo_340000240_DiscoveredDes: A higher-dimensional being originated from Aleph-1, which shaped its body with Exoswarm devoured by the Void Storm and forged its spine with the Exostrider's remnants. To the inhabitants of Lahai-Roi, Voidworm and Void Storm are equally terrifying. Both are unpredictable natural disasters that devour everything in their paths.
MonsterInfo_340000240_UndiscoveredDes:
A shadow looming in the sand and storm.
An abomination woven from tens of thousands of Exoswarm.
Listen—the void-star hums, and it is near.
MonsterInfo_310000830_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

Draped in a flowing skirt of ice, this humanoid Tacet Discord moves with airy grace. The razor-sharp blades beneath its feet trace frozen arcs that mimic figure skating but deliver only demise. It senses every tremor across the ice and reads the world through the frozen mirror. From the reflections, it learned elegance, then turned that elegance into a weapon. What was once a noble art has, in its hands, become a quiet choreography of death.
MonsterInfo_310000830_UndiscoveredDes: A graceful humanoid TD dressed in ice.
MonsterInfo_310000840_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A faceless humanoid Tacet Discord with a body that flows, splits, and coalesces like a living shadow. By splintering its own frequency, it can generate a pocket of shadow realm to lie in wait. When its prey draws near, it will erupt from the darkness to strike from impossible angles.
MonsterInfo_310000840_UndiscoveredDes: A faceless humanoid Tacet Discord with a body that flows, splits, and coalesces like a living shadow.
MonsterInfo_320000590_DiscoveredDes:

This enemy has the Rage Feather ability and three weaknesses.

After remaining in combat for a period of time, Kronablight enters the Rage Feather state, greatly enhancing its ATK.
Weakness I: A successful Counterattack can damage its crest and wings, weakening its attacks and reducing the number of ranged projectiles.
Weakness II: Tune Break can remove its Rage Feather state and reduce its ranged projectiles.
Special Weakness: When Kronablight is under Tune Rupture - Shifting, hitting it with Tune Break will greatly reduce its All-Attribute RES.

A powerful raptor-like Exoswarm, mimicking an ancient predator known as Kronaclaw.
In the distant past, these raptors once circled the skies of Lahai-Roi, their dominion unchallenged since the First Epoch.
Legend holds that the Kronaclaw was a creation of Sol, sharing the divine sight of the Eye of Sol and beholding all that lay above and below Lahai-Roi.
But as magnetic poles shifted and the landscape was reshaped, the Kronaclaw species had faded into near extinction. Their place was eventually taken by Kronablight, an Exoswarm born of the Exostrider.
MonsterInfo_320000590_UndiscoveredDes: A mysterious raptor-shaped Exoswarm that seems to mimic an extinct ancient animal.
MonsterInfo_320000600_DiscoveredDes:

Weakness I: A successful Counterattack can damage its crest and wings, weakening its attacks and reducing the number of ranged projectiles.
Weakness II: Tune Break can remove its Rage Feather state and reduce its ranged projectiles.
Special Weakness: When Kronaclaw is under Tune Rupture - Shifting, hitting it with Tune Break will greatly reduce its All-Attribute RES.

An extinct ancient raptor reproduced through the Upphaf Life Chamber.
In the distant past, these raptors once circled the skies of Lahai-Roi, their dominion unchallenged since the First Epoch.
Legend holds that the Kronaclaw was a creation of Sol, sharing the divine sight of the Eye of Sol and beholding all that lay above and below Lahai-Roi.
But as magnetic poles shifted and the landscape was reshaped, the Kronaclaw species had faded into near extinction. Their place was eventually taken by Kronablight, an Exoswarm born of the Exostrider.
MonsterInfo_320000600_UndiscoveredDes: A powerful raptor believed to be extinct, now appearing within the Upphaf Life Chamber.
MonsterInfo_320000610_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
While in combat, Glommoth gains Frost Armor, which increases its All-Attribute RES.
The Frost Armor is removed when the Fusion Burst on it reaches 3 stacks.

Weakness: Breaking Glommoth's left tusk causes it to lose part of its skill set.

Among the Exoswarm, none stand taller nor command greater reverence than these towering figures. Shaped in the likeness of the long-extinct mammoth, they are seen as reliable guides in leading their kin back to the Exostrider.
Glommoth, the male, advances with ferocity, often carving paths through frozen earth with its long, jagged tusks.
While Glommotha, the female, moves with care, guiding and healing the Exoswarm with its trunk as they return along the paths to the Exostrider.
MonsterInfo_320000610_UndiscoveredDes: Among the Exoswarm, none stand taller nor command greater reverence than these towering figures. They are seen as reliable guides in leading their kin back to the Exostrider.
MonsterInfo_340000250_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
When hit by an Echo Skill, Sigillum gains 1 stack of Off Course, up to 5 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
Each stack of Off Course makes it take 10% more total DMG. At 5 stacks, Sigillum takes an additional 30% total DMG.

Rage and tears. Suffering and joy. Sorrow and pain. All are condensed, along with her sigh, into a single golden frequency.
It gazes at the sky, lost in memories worn thin by the ages. The lost voyager is still searching for the way home.
MonsterInfo_340000250_UndiscoveredDes: A wordless black mech, lost and longing to return home.
MonsterInfo_340000260_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

Resonators can inflict up to 2 additional stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the Nameless Explorer.
When the Nameless Explorer is under Tune Strain - Interfered and hit by Tune Break, it gains 1 additional stack of Tune Strain - Interfered.
Each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered makes it take 4% more total DMG.

The station fell like a dying star, burying the dream of its era beneath ice and soil.
The Explorer was one of those who dreamed, who once walked among the stars.
But now he hides in the dark, corrupted by the Void.
Before reason and strength slipped entirely from his grasp, he sealed himself away in the cabin.
MonsterInfo_340000260_UndiscoveredDes: An ancient remnant entombed under the permafrost, a prisoner by its own hand.
MonsterInfo_310000850_DiscoveredDes:
A prized creation of the Fractsidus.

Using New Federation technology, they have fused a set of vicious claws with the essence of a Tacet Discord, creating a weapon of cruelty capable of strangling its prey before slicing them apart.

Yet, all transcendence comes at a price. Those who embraced this creation have become thralls to their own design, leaving behind nothing but hollow shells.
MonsterInfo_310000850_UndiscoveredDes: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a set of vicious claws with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.
MonsterInfo_310000860_DiscoveredDes:
A prized creation of the Fractsidus.

Using New Federation technology, they have fused a pair of flowing sleeves with the essence of a Tacet Discord, creating billowing maws capable of devouring the very frequencies of their prey.

Yet, all transcendence comes at a price. Those who embraced this creation have become thralls to their own design, leaving behind nothing but hollow shells.
MonsterInfo_310000860_UndiscoveredDes: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a pair of flowing sleeves with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.
MonsterInfo_320000620_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A prized creation of the Fractsidus.

Using New Federation technologies, they have fused a picture hat with the essence of a Tacet Discord, forging a chainsaw horror capable of rending steel and grinding prey to dust.

Yet, all transcendence comes at a price. Those who embraced this creation have become thralls to their own design, leaving behind nothing but hollow shells.
MonsterInfo_320000620_UndiscoveredDes: A prized creation of the Fractsidus, fusing a picture hat with the essence of a Tacet Discord with New Federation technologies.
MonsterInfo_320000630_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.

Joy and sorrow, laughing and weeping... All emotions will eventually find their graves somewhere, etching their scars in the dark.

How does one escape their own shadow? How do they confront what they've become?

Some run. Some shriek. Some laugh it off.
MonsterInfo_320000630_UndiscoveredDes: A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.
MonsterInfo_320000640_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.

Joy and sorrow, laughing and weeping... All emotions will eventually find their graves somewhere, etching their scars in the dark.

At the crash site of ecstasy, you can no longer tell laughter from weeping.
MonsterInfo_320000640_UndiscoveredDes: A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.
MonsterInfo_320000650_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.

Joy and sorrow, laughing and weeping... All emotions will eventually find their graves somewhere, etching their scars in the dark.

But sorrow can never reach its finish line, not while the shadow of fate looms so close behind.
MonsterInfo_320000650_UndiscoveredDes: A creation of the Fractsidus. A defective failure abandoned to the shadows.
MonsterInfo_320000660_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
When the Voidwing Moth recovers from Immobilization, it cycles between the Wings Spread, Wings Folded, and Curled Up states.
While in the Wings Spread state, its Vibration Strength reduces faster.
While in the Wings Folded State, it takes less Vibration Strength reduction, and 30% less total DMG.
While in the Curled Up state, it takes 50% more total DMG.

A unique TD endemic to the Dimmr Plains, often seen in areas heavily contaminated by Voidmatter. It assumes a moth-like form with wings that shed Voidmatter particles.
Moving with instinct under the influence of Voidmatter, these creatures were once the vanguard of Aleph-1's incursion.
Though naturally passive, it will stop at nothing to annihilate its target once aggravated.
MonsterInfo_320000660_UndiscoveredDes: A unique, moth-like TD endemic to the Dimmr Plains, often seen in areas heavily contaminated by Voidmatter.
MonsterInfo_340000270_DiscoveredDes:
A watcher from beyond the Stridergate, born of Aleph-1's design.
Before those who seek answers, Aleph-1 projects the very boundary of the knowable: that which once opened the way to the future has now become something dark and dreadful beyond recognition.
At the scale of the cosmos, life and hope are only trivialities, devoid of meaning.
Everything is but a beginning without an end. Everything is but a pursuit in vain.
MonsterInfo_340000270_UndiscoveredDes: At the scale of the cosmos, life and hope are only trivialities, devoid of meaning.
MonsterInfo_340000280_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Denia takes 25% more DMG from all Negative Statuses.
She takes 30% more total DMG for 15s under Frostbind.

"A Department of Voidmatters student at Startorch Academy. Also, a professional slacker who has mastered the art of dozing through courses. Still, she hardly misses any campus event, always there to flash her 'gentle' smile to one and all."
And yet her name, her identity, her Resonance Ability, even the ties she claimed to others... all of it was a lie.
Between you and the Keystone stands nothing more but a puppet who came into existence only because of Aleph-1.
MonsterInfo_340000280_UndiscoveredDes: "A Department of Voidmatters student at Startorch Academy. Always there to flash her 'gentle' smile to one and all."
MonsterInfo_340000290_DiscoveredDes:
When inflicted with Hack - Shifting, Nightmare: Adam Smasher deals 20% more Total DMG for 15s. He takes 60% more Total Hack DMG.

A nightmare born of Lucy's deepest fears, taking form as the legendary mercenary Adam Smasher. 

As Arasaka's most notorious hit-man, Adam Smasher has replaced much of his biological human side with cyberware, giving him strength far surpassing any ordinary merc. Now, as a Nightmare, he guards the gateway to the Dreamscape, barring all entry to the deepest reaches of the Somnoire.
MonsterInfo_340000290_UndiscoveredDes: A Nightmare Tacet Discord that is hunting Lucy down. The data torrent that envelopes its body scrambles sensors and offers immunity to most attacks from Resonators.
MonsterInfo_340000300_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- When Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis is affected by Havoc Bane, it takes 5% more total DMG for 30s, stacking up to 5 times.
- When the Havoc Bane affecting Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis is consumed, it takes 20% more total DMG for 30s.

Deep within the Skyworks, the Myriad Snare serves as a living prison for Tacet Discords, capable of transforming into a formidable Autopuppet to wipe them out.
However, as the Skyworks fell into unknown chaos, all maintenance work came to a halt. Structures of the Myriad Snare damaged in fierce battle have all plunged into the abyss.
To this day, even with only a shattered body remaining, it still carries out its purge without rest.
MonsterInfo_340000300_UndiscoveredDes: A ruined giant shadow lurking within the Skyworks. It has nearly been forgotten, yet still clings to the directive to wipe out the Tacet Discords to the bitter end.
MonsterInfo_340000310_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, and a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

The Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Screen Armor, Left Arm, and Head can be broken.
 - Breaking the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Screen Armor increases its Vibration Strength Reduction Rate.
 - Breaking the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Left Arm temporarily reduces its damage dealt.
 - Breaking the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Head greatly increases its Off-Tune Level.

The Thousand-Puppet Pavilion has a higher Off-Tune Level gauge. When the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion is hit by Tune Break while affected by Tune Strain - Shifting, it gains 2 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered. When its Tune Strain - Interfered reaches 3 stacks, its total DMG taken is increased by 25%.
The max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on Thousand-Puppet Pavilion is increased by 2.

Built by Muyu, a former Artisan of Zhuojun Atelier, this giant Autopuppet has absorbed structures of Censure Courts and morphed into a formidable engine of destruction powered by Reverberations of the departed. Souls bound by the battlefields of old, longing for release, have had their obsessions twisted and manipulated, now swinging their blades of resentment at the spiteful enemies before them.
MonsterInfo_340000310_UndiscoveredDes: A massive Autopuppet formed by absorbing the buildings of the Censure Court, bound by the battlefields of old, and bringing down merciless blades upon the enemies before it.
MonsterInfo_340000320_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
The total DMG taken by this enemy is increased by 20% for 6s when affected by a Negative Status.
This enemy takes 100% more total Electro Flare DMG.

He cast his consciousness into a mechanical vessel, fueled by the Reverberations of lost souls, all for the obsession to become a "perfect Celestial." Though the mechanist arts beyond mortal comprehension could emulate heavenly might, it could never transcend its own shackles.

It walked to the end of its road, and this forged body became a calamity unto itself.
MonsterInfo_340000320_UndiscoveredDes: A mystic Autopuppet that strolls in the sky. An epitome of mechanist arts at their peak.
MonsterInfo_340000330_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. 

When a nearby Resonator triggers Union Response, Suhsin the Inevitable gains 1 stack of Paradox, stacking up to 2 times:
Each stack of Paradox makes Suhsin the Inevitable take 15% more total DMG, up to 30%.
At 2 stacks of Paradox, Suhsin the Inevitable's RES to all Attributes is reduced to 0.

It began as the underlying logic that ensured Xuanfang Hold would collapse according to schedule. When Hsin moved to overwrite that logic, it fought back and broke free, and the data it tore from the Civilization Capsule's lowest strata gave it a form close to the Sentinel as Hsin remembered. That likeness made Hsin waver, and in the deadlock that ensued, Hsin gave ground step by step. In the end it broke the last of Hsin's hold, and Suhsin the Inevitable descended into the world.

The Wheel of Prediction turns about it, the Kernel set deep in its chest, and its form is meant to be the flawless Sentinel Mengzhou has prayed for—every flicker of expression, every gesture, enough to shake heaven and earth.
MonsterInfo_340000330_UndiscoveredDes: Reckoner of fate, revealer of one true path. The fox shadow at the deepest reach of the Civilization Capsule.
