MonsterInfo_310000340_UndiscoveredDes: A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. Its small body is as fragile as ice.
MonsterInfo_310000340_DiscoveredDes:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. 

An immature humanoid TD. Small amounts of ice crystals are left on its body. It uses them to imitate the crisp sound of “clang bang” of ice colliding.
Activity_100700001_Desc: Recently, Simulation Training Grounds are offering Resonator richer training rewards. Use Waveplates to claim more rewards from Simulation Challenges!
Activity_100700002_Desc: The Sonoro Spheres are undergoing an accelerating collapse due to the Waveworn Phenomenon. However, this is also intensifying the energy within, resulting in more valuable materials. Use the Waveplates to maximize your rewards from the Remnant Crystals.
Activity_100700003_Desc: The Tacet Fields are experiencing a surge in energy due to the Waveworn Phenomenon. Use the Waveplates to maximize your rewards from the Tacetite Blooms!
Activity_101000001_Desc:
As the clouds of fear and sorrow lift from the sky of Jinzhou after the Battle of Norfall Barrens, talk of the long-awaited Riverside Games resurfaces. 
Amidst the joyous celebrations, with laughter and cheers ringing out, stands the general, seemingly alone in a sea of people. 
And perhaps, there is a story untold, hidden within his gaze...
Activity_101000002_Desc: A mysterious letter arrives from an enigmatic organization known as the Séance Society, claiming to possess the ability to summon departed loved ones. However, this wondrous dream may also be the sweetest poison.
Activity_101000003_Desc:
Time continues to flow on 
Mt. Firmament.
You met an unexpected listener while strolling through the lively yet peaceful Hongzhen and listening to interesting stories about Mt. Firmament.
This gentle but mysterious Wayfinder extends a rather special invitation to you...
Activity_101000004_Desc: What does it really mean to create? Will this artist find the courage to confront her past missteps and face old accusations once more? Can she reconnect with her innermost emotions and talents to breathe new life into her paintings?
Activity_100900001_Desc: A new Resonator has entered the Simulation Training. Make use of their powers to complete the challenge and gather relevant data for rewards.
SameVisionNoCountValue: Same Echoes will not be counted towards the Sonata effect
SilentArea_rewardinfo: Rewards are determined by your Data Bank level and SOL3 Phase
Activity_100800001_Desc:
Shilang has been conducting research on optimizing alloy properties.
A unique Sonoro Sphere has emerged recently, and Shilang discovers that the alloys he has forged possess exceptional abilities in this domain.

Role_1503_ShareDesc: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!
Role_1203_ShareDesc: Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from the Black Shores! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?
Role_1301_ShareDesc: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.
Role_1405_ShareDesc: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?
Role_1104_ShareDesc: You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember me as how I look, without the lion head!
Role_1404_ShareDesc: Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.
Role_1302_ShareDesc: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.
Role_1304_ShareDesc: As the Sentinel said, we will meet here.
Role_1205_ShareDesc: It is truly my fortune to find a worthy opponent like you in this vast world...
Role_1105_ShareDesc: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!
Role_1305_ShareDesc: My name is Xiangli Yao, a researcher at the Huaxu Academy. Rover, your rare resonance frequencies raise an intriguing question: are you a unique beacon of insight in our quest for truth? Or do you already hold the ultimate truth in your hand?
Role_1505_ShareDesc: "The Shorekeeper"... This name suits me well enough. It aligns with my purpose and drive: they only exist because of you.
Role_1603_ShareDesc: Camellya, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores. Happy to see you again! My beloved... seed of fate.
Role_1107_ShareDesc: Fate has led you to me, and considering the terms I'm offering… You wouldn't refuse me, would you?
Role_1606_ShareDesc: All the world's a stage, and we are mere players.
Role_1506_ShareDesc: I'm Phoebe, an acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.
Role_1206_ShareDesc: Brant's the name, captain of the Fool's Troupe! A pleasure to meet you. Enough with introductions now—let's hand the stage over to everlasting joy and boundless liberty!
Role_1607_ShareDesc: The current head of Fisalia, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know.
Role_1407_ShareDesc: I am Ciaccona, a wandering bard from Rinascita. Should you harbor any unspoken thoughts or deep emotions, why not convey them into poetry? When you pour your heart into words and music, you speak directly to people's hearts.
Role_1507_ShareDesc: Name's Zani, Averardo Vault employee. You're my client, huh? If so, I'm your sword and shield. Just say the word. If you leave me a good review when we're done, it'll be much appreciated.
Role_1409_ShareDesc: Cartethyia, now a wandering knight. The Threnodian's malicious creation, the Order's unsuspecting Laureate, the defier lost in the tides of fate... These titles, once portrayed in poems and books, have long since slipped from my grasp. As for what lies ahead... let's explore it together, "Swordbearer."
Role_1207_ShareDesc: Lupa, Gladiator of Septimont. Just ignore the attention, Warrior. This victory is ours to savor!
Role_1608_ShareDesc: Do not fear the Fractsidus Overseer. Settle your mind. Quiet the clamor of thought. Only then can you stay and truly appreciate the perfect melody echoing through the Lycoris sea... and the true paradise that is soon to arrive.
Role_1306_ShareDesc: I am Augusta, Ephor of Septimont. Etch this name into your memory—it belongs to the one who stands above, and whose mark will never fade. Whether we meet as foes or friends, my sword and I await the fierce fight between us.
Role_1410_ShareDesc: Beyond myself. Beyond every written start and end of the story. Till we rewrite our fate.
Role_1208_ShareDesc: Galbrena. The Fiend of Ever-burning Flame. The Discord Slayer. Call me what you want. Just point me to the monsters.
Role_1411_ShareDesc: Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.
Role_1508_ShareDesc: Kuchiba Chisa. Tactical Development Program, Department of Engineering, Startorch Academy. Forte Specialization: structural dissection... Apologies, this might not be the time for formalities.
Role_1509_ShareDesc: Outlaw Blue, Apollo Orange, Hazard Yellow, Acid Green... Wanna guess what color is my next pick?
Role_1209_ShareDesc: I am Mornye, Research Institute engineer and professor at Startorch Academy. Please, let me know when my expertise can be of service.
Role_1210_ShareDesc: Aemeath, Synchronist of the Exostrider from Rabelle College. That was me back when I was alive. Now? I'm a digital ghost!
Role_1510_ShareDesc: Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk.
Role_1311_ShareDesc: I have tasted every longing beneath the heavens, and at last... I know where my heart belongs.
Role_1312_ShareDesc: Suoming, Seal Master of the Ten Seals Covenant, and Intendant of Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. Any enemy of Mengzhou is an enemy of mine.
PhantomCollectTaskDesc_2_Desc: Despite his advanced age, Grandpa Jingzhu insists on capturing Echoes. What could be his reason? Go find out from Chixia and lend a helping hand!

RoleSkin_81011304_BgDescription:
Dance in the moonlight, sing to the blooms. It is a dance to commemorate your first meeting, the many journeys you'll share, and the companionship forged along the way.
"Now that spring returns, who will share it with me?
The peach blossom's beauty longs for eyes that see."
RoleSkin_81011102_BgDescription: Silver hair, piercing red eyes, monochromatic garments... A ferocious mask conceals her face, while a gleaming blade rests in her hand. Her voice rings out in a powerful chant, driving away evil spirits and banishing malicious souls.
RoleSkin_81011205_BgDescription: In the warm mist of the indoor hot spring, behind the fluttering chiffon veils, the laurel-crowned nymph casts her gentle gaze—a signal of invitation to a long-awaited, carefree holiday.
RoleSkin_81011107_BgDescription: Soft satin smoothly flows down from her body. The droplets on her glisten like luxurious gems. As they dip into the water, ripples spread across the pool into you and the girl's heart.
RoleSkin_81001402_BgDescription: An outfit soft to the touch, like feathers, but also highly durable. Feathers fill with wind, lifting the lark to the sky, and a song sounds as it flies.
RoleSkin_81001202_BgDescription: A featherlight outfit favored by Jinzhou Speedster Chixia, perfect for her need to rush to the side of whoever calls out her name.
RoleSkin_81001503_BgDescription: An outfit Verina wears when doing fieldwork. Every word from each unfurling bud, Verina engraves in her heart.
RoleSkin_81001501_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001102_BgDescription: A somber-colored lightweight outfit, worn by the City Hall guard Sanhua. She moves swiftly, a sharp blade in hand, ready to defend peace.
RoleSkin_81001601_BgDescription: An outfit Taoqi wears at work, matching the Peachy Turtle in color. She always forgets to wear her uniform. Her everyday clothes have now become a uniform, in a manner of speaking.
RoleSkin_81001502_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001103_BgDescription: A well-fitted uniform that provides great freedom of movement, perfect for fieldwork. Truths are elusive, accessible only to the most indefatigable seekers.
RoleSkin_81001203_BgDescription: A custom-made outfit gifted to Encore by her fellow Black Shores members. Cosmos and Cloudy, reporting for duty! One, two... three! Great, everyone is here. Let the treasure hunt begin!
RoleSkin_81001602_BgDescription: Jade, clear and pure, assumes rosy hues after long exposure to crimson dye... at least that's what they say in the novels.
RoleSkin_81001403_BgDescription: What's my trump card? It's... right here. Yes, the brain. It's all about how to squeeze every ounce of advantage from an information asymmetry.
RoleSkin_81001404_BgDescription: A uniform bestowed by Jué when Jiyan was appointed general. Its design is based on the standard uniform of the Midnight Rangers. The turquoise coat billows when the wind rises, like a flag that rallies his fellow soldiers. Made of tough materials, it's resistant to wear and tear, much like the enduring mountains of Jinzhou.
RoleSkin_81001204_BgDescription: An outfit worn by Huaxu Academy researchers. The fire inside the Red Dragon is burning as fierce as ever, but he has found his anchor, something he intends to devote his life to.
RoleSkin_81001207_BgDescription: This custom Septimont Gladiator suit has evolved through many revisions to match Lupa's unique fighting style. It bears silent witness to her countless solitary days and nights, as well as the thunderous cheers that followed her every triumph.
RoleSkin_81001603_BgDescription: Red is passionate and wild; white is serene and pure. Camellya dances at the junction of two opposing forces.
RoleSkin_81001301_BgDescription: A Huanglong-style combat uniform custom-made for Calcharo, designed for ease of movement in the region. Lightweight yet durable, it is a no-frills outfit tailored to his needs, with an emphasis on concealment.
RoleSkin_81001302_BgDescription: An outfit Yinlin commissioned her favorite qipao shop to make. Flamboyant, extravagant... Adjectives that aren't normally used on secret agents describe the real Yinlin behind her many masks.
RoleSkin_81001104_BgDescription: A neat outfit Lingyang wears when performing liondances. It is adorned with a traditional pattern said to bring good luck, and the pattern is as vibrant as Lingyang's youthful energy.
RoleSkin_81001303_BgDescription: A tailored suit over a form-fitting set of boxing attire, accentuating Yuanwu's long-limbed and powerful physique.
RoleSkin_81001408_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001604_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001605_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001405_BgDescription: A uniform Jianxin received from her sect. This outfit, whenever she wears it, always brings to mind the wise counsel of her master. Move like a shadow; stay as composed as a steady breath.
RoleSkin_81001304_BgDescription: An outfit adorned with two diaphanous ribbons that seem to glow a faint blue, a perfect match for Jinhsi's complexion. The weight of the whole Jinzhou has been put on her shoulders, but she bears it with grace and dignity.
RoleSkin_81001305_BgDescription: A simple, practical outfit, specifically designed for use on long-distance expeditions. A truth seeker is drawn to the truth, undeterred by any obstacle in their path.
RoleSkin_81001205_BgDescription:
Changli's usual outfit. It includes an Enflamement-infused gown, styled on Huanglong-style court attire. After many journeys and through terrain of all kinds, however, the texture of the gown no longer differs from that of ordinary fabric.
Of life's many highs and lows, I've known, yet joy stirs my soul when I behold grasses grow.
RoleSkin_81001105_BgDescription: A picturesque outfit that puts one in mind of an exquisite painting. Landscapes abound, waiting to be recaptured on canvas.
RoleSkin_81001106_BgDescription: Youhu's heart is as pure as a snowflake, filled with a great love for the stories behind antiques.
RoleSkin_81001505_BgDescription: She manifested in human-like form in response to the one who awakened her, marking the beginning you bestowed upon her. It was the starting point of a new life. It was not the first time, nor would it be the last.
RoleSkin_81001504_BgDescription: A lightweight yet sturdy outfit, worn by Lollo Logistics Navigator Lumi. It has survived many arduous deliveries.
RoleSkin_81001606_BgDescription: A unique outfit Roccia wears when doing improv comedy. Made out of various scraps, this product of love is decorated with odds and ends that Roccia has accumulated.
RoleSkin_81001107_BgDescription: A boldly designed one-piece dress. Red is Carlotta's color. She wears it even on secret missions, in the dead of night, when stealth is crucial. She is a nonconformist and trendsetter.
RoleSkin_81001206_BgDescription: A costume the captain wears on his grand voyages. Its design inspires the garments of the Troupe of Fools. It captures the hues of sea and sky, bringing their grandeur back to Ragunna.
RoleSkin_81001506_BgDescription: Phoebe's memories are always tinged with a shade of blue. The bird that soared from her childhood bedtime stories, the robes of the Acolytes who offered her sanctuary, and the gentle breeze that carried her out of her darkest dreams.
RoleSkin_81001406_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001607_BgDescription:
The dress worn by Cantarella the Bane is awash in flowing, vibrant colors.
These iridescent hues change and refract, shifting with the light, like a deadly creature lurking deep in the ocean, beautiful, dangerous, and hypnotic.
RoleSkin_81001407_BgDescription: An attire that is light but lacks no elegance. A gentle breeze passes by as Ciaccona plays her instrument, the rustling of the fabric of her clothes sometimes becomes the accompaniment.
RoleSkin_81001507_BgDescription: A custom-made uniform, primarily of simple black and white color schemes. No matter how heavy the work load, one must maintain an impeccable appearance.
RoleSkin_81001409_BgDescription: The dress Cartethyia wore during her coronation as the Blessed Maiden. These thorns accompanied her through storms of solitude, and they serve to engrave the responsibilities of "salvation" deep into her heart.

FlySkinConfig_84000001_BgDescription: Once, a Laureate used a Cloudcaster to create golden-pink rain over Ragunna City as a way of protest. The Laureate has long since vanished, yet his yearning for freedom has condensed into these pair of wings, waiting silently for the next person that claims the crown.

HelpText_347_Content:
[Phantasma Dreamland]
In this event, each Stage contains multiple Phases, each with its own revenue targets. To enter the next Phase, you must collect enough Dreamland Coupons to meet the current goal. Clear all goals across all Phases to complete the Stage.

[Dream Boon]
1. Clearing a Dreamland Stage for the first time grants you Lost Mirror Pieces, which can be used to unlock Dream Boon buffs.

2. Each Dream Boon has its own unlock conditions. You need to unlock prerequisite nodes before progressing further.

[Phantasma Blessing]
1. Phantasma Blessings provide various buffs to help Phrolova achieve the revenue targets.

2. Only one Blessing can be equipped at a time. It must be activated manually and has a limited number of uses.

3. Some blessings must be unlocked by clearing specific Stages.

[Dreamland Gallery]
1. Dreamland Gallery displays all unlocked Dreamland Members and Props.

2. Selecting an unlocked Member or Prop will show detailed information. For locked entries, you can view the conditions required to unlock them.

WeaponSkinConf_80080009_AttributesDescri: A projection device that allows you to change the weapon's appearance.
WeaponSkinConf_80080009_BgDescription:
A projection that reshapes the sword.
The silhouette of this sword clearly echoes ancient Huanglong craftsmanship, yet its creator gave it a radical redesign: swapping the traditional metallic edge for an ultra-fine energy jet.
Much like other entities from the Endstate Matrix, a familiar weapon has been digitally warped into something entirely unprecedented.
MenuConfig_60210_Desc: Activates the Adaptive Triggers on your controller when enabled. Please note that this function is only available in certain parts of the game.
PrefabTextItem_4294734977_Text: All photo objectives completed. You may exit the challenge.
RoleSkin_81001208_BgDescription:
The daily outfit of the "Discord Slayer"—light and enduring, unscathed by weathers and unfliched before hellfire.

She once donned this garb through trials of life and death, crossing shadows and inferno, treading the boundary between good and evil. She returns still, to search, to pursue, and to hunt—without rest, without end.
RoleSkin_81001411_BgDescription: From Chongzhou to Mingting, across the six states of Huanglong, his worn attire bears the weight of travel, tracing the swordsman's solitary path.
LoadingTipsText_921201_TipsText: Bright and radiant is the flame that shines on every corner of Black Alley, leaving no shadow to hide in.
LoadingTipsText_921301_TipsText: At the sound of thunder, winter snow retreats at the fleeting light.
LoadingTipsText_921401_TipsText: The one returning from the abyss shall purge this world of filth with hellfire.
LoadingTipsText_921501_TipsText: When the world falls into chaos, a wind rises and howls, weaving itself into a banner that never falls.
LoadingTipsText_921601_TipsText:
The music has yet to conclude. The crimson curtain is about to rise once more.
On this lasting stage, why not give her another dance?
LoadingTipsText_201201_TipsText: One of the near-orbit space stations humanity built before the Etheric Sea sealed off Solaris. Magnetic disturbances from the Lament sent it crashing down, but it remained largely whole. Its ruins once sheltered the Roya from the cold and served as an exploration outpost.
LoadingTipsText_201202_TipsText: This sector houses SkyArk's most significant pre-Lament research achievement—a prototype Mass Relay Device powered by Etheric Sea Droplets.
LoadingTipsText_201203_TipsText: Located within the research base zone, the Icebreak Port is the only regular access point into the Roya Frostlands. Upon arrival, personnel and supplies may be transferred via the Starward Riseway to the underground haven of Lahai-Roi, or routed deeper into the frostlands through the inter-outpost roads.
LoadingTipsText_201204_TipsText: Once a forest-thick fjordland in the frigid zone, this region was home to the nomadic Roya. Then came Lahai-Roi's first recorded Lament that triggered a geomagnetic pole shift. The land was transformed into the new polar extremity of Solaris, buried beneath endless snow and ice. The violent shift also dragged near-orbit satellites and space stations from the sky. Their wreckage still litters the frostlands to this day.
LoadingTipsText_201205_TipsText:
Formally known as the Spacetrek Collective: Frostlands Polar Research Outpost, this facility is a joint project between the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya people. Built around the Exostrider's greatsword embedded in the ice, it serves as a vital logistics hub.
Here, researchers work to salvage pre-Lament data from fallen satellites and space stations, run non-invasive diagnostics on the Exostrider to monitor its restoration, and survey the ecosystem to revive the long-frozen flora and fauna of the ancient world.
LoadingTipsText_201206_TipsText:
During the second Lament recorded in Lahai-Roi, the Exostrider, a colossal mech from an unknown civilization, emerged through the Stridergate. It fought a fierce battle against the Threnodian to seal the catastrophe from the other side, a clash that shattered the very bedrock of the frostlands.
As the Roya faced annihilation, the Exostrider channeled its remaining power and drove the greatsword deep into the earth to brace the collapsing land. Its Reactor Drive transformed into a subterranean sun, casting warmth into the depths. Its scattered fragments reassembled into the Exoswarm that mimic the local lifeforms, guiding the Roya toward a new homeland. Since then, the Exostrider fell dormant upon the surface, awaiting the day of its awakening.
LoadingTipsText_608401_TipsText: Vast, boundless space erodes all sense of time, where endlessly repeating moments hold equal weight. The long voyage has yet to reach its end, and the coordinates of the starting point have long since worn away. Infinite possibilities collapse into a single next instant—still a miracle by any name, with no need to return.
LoadingTipsText_608501_TipsText: The public auditorium in Startorch Academy that serves as the primary venue for large-scale indoor events. It is available for student activities. To host an event here, student societies or fan clubs must submit a proposal and application to the Student Council at least three working days in advance. Upon approval, the event will be officially registered and circulated.
LoadingTipsText_608701_TipsText: There lies a forever festival that one day shall end.
LoadingTipsText_900801_Title: For You Who Walk in Snow
LoadingTipsText_900801_TipsText: Fine snow drifts gently to the ground, carrying with it the entwined fates of those who walk upon the snow.
LoadingTipsText_608801_TipsText: Here, fading voices and hidden trails are woven into a web, and the rationale of liquid gold is patiently unraveled…
LoadingTipsText_609001_TipsText:
Named after Scott Rabelle, the founder of Resonance Curve Theory and inventor of the Rabelle's Curve, this college—also known as the Synchronist Department—identifies and trains Synchronists through uncompromisingly rigorous, data-driven methods. 
Access to Rabelle College requires special authorization and is ordinarily closed to students from other departments.
LoadingTipsText_609101_TipsText:
A collective Sonoro that manifested naturally in Lahai-Roi. The exact cause of its formation remains unconfirmed.
Influenced by the subconscious minds and residual frequencies of the Resonators at Startorch Academy, it gradually evolved into a mirrored projection of the Academy, becoming a unique phenomenon existing within its grounds.
LoadingTipsText_609201_TipsText:
Ambition, passion, anxiety, sorrow… the Academy's Dark Side absorbs them all without distinction, reflecting the students' rawest and most unguarded thoughts.
If left unchanneled, these accumulated negative emotions gather within the domain, eventually spilling into reality.
LoadingTipsText_609301_TipsText:
The Research Institute sealed the Dark Side within riddles, rendering it harmless and turning it into an annual game students eagerly await.
By solving these riddles, students confront their doubts directly, releasing and dispelling the negative energy accumulated in the Dark Side.
LoadingTipsText_609401_TipsText:
If the Dark Side is a vortex, then anxiety and sorrow form its very eye.
Interfered with by the Fractsidus, these negative emotions are now manifesting as aggressive Tacet Discords.
LoadingTipsText_609501_TipsText:
Every student who enters Startorch Academy does so with a sincere heart.
Such hearts are treasures that must never be allowed to be tainted.
LoadingTipsText_609601_TipsText:
The rabbit guides those who venture into the Academy's Dark Side, leading them to confront the fears and truths they usually avoid.
Even after Sigrika's incident, some students and professors continue to face their own dilemmas within the Dark Side.
LoadingTipsText_900901_TipsText:
People's expectations are like gold, both a blessing and a heavy weight. Even amid the New Solar Celebration's laughter, doubt and emptiness can take root.
When truth stands on the scales, the lurking shadows ask their final, piercing question: Does the pursuit of discovery truly have meaning?
LoadingTipsText_201301_TipsText: The true destination of the Soliskin after they return to the Solistrees. They become warm sunlight, flowing down the roots and converging as sparks within the Solvein Heartwood to keep the encroaching Voidmatter at bay.
LoadingTipsText_201302_TipsText:
The first Helios prototype was swallowed by a Voidstorm, ending up here where it drew the Soliskin's attention.
Twilight marks the hour after sunset. In the Dimmr Plains, this is the Soliskin's final gathering place before they return to the Solistrees.
LoadingTipsText_201303_TipsText:
To stop a past Voidmatter breach, Hiyuki drew upon her Futures' Tithe and channeled a portion of her power to create a seal over the rift.
The miko gave everything she had. She always did.
LoadingTipsText_201304_TipsText: A precipice in the depths of Lahai-Roi touched by Voidmatter. Here, sound itself is consumed.
LoadingTipsText_201306_TipsText:
Here, Voidmatter's power swells to its peak. Beyond this point lies the Stridergate, a passage to a universe now beyond your reach.
Beyond the Stridergate lies the sea of stars you long for, and the darkness that fills you with dread.
LoadingTipsText_610001_TipsText: For reasons unknown, the dreams of the Left Behind in Honami have manifested in a corner of Lahai-Roi. Anchored to a Somnoire gate, fantasy and reality overlap here in chaotic disorder.
LoadingTipsText_610101_TipsText:
—Scrawled across a message board in uneven strokes—
"Do not forget the regret that brought you here."
LoadingTipsText_610201_TipsText: Here, past and present converge, and time and space unravel into chaos.
LoadingTipsText_610301_TipsText:
It devours everything. Thought, feeling, hope, all reduced to dust and nothingness.
It is the Void.
LoadingTipsText_610401_TipsText:
An anchor set over the Stridergate long ago with the Exostrider's arrival. It is essential to opening the gateway.
One day, it will be flung open, even if it was meant to keep the danger out.
LoadingTipsText_610501_TipsText:
To prove they can endure the extreme neural load of connecting to the Exostrider, Synchronists must pass a synchronization test.
All for the torch of humanity.
LoadingTipsText_610601_TipsText:
Denia. She is denied both a past and future.
Aleph-1 looks upon her. And upon you. What lies before you is absurdity, nihilism, collapse... A puzzle with no solution.
But still, she waits for your answer.
LoadingTipsText_901001_Title: Reverbs From the End of Galaxies
LoadingTipsText_901001_TipsText:
You know all too well that this world has no all-knowing, all-powerful savior.
The steps of countless others have become the path beneath your feet. So take one more step forward. What echoes behind you are the voices from beyond the sea of stars itself.
LoadingTipsText_609901_TipsText:
Outfitted with a range of gaming devices, this club draws inspiration from exposure therapy, helping Synchronists cope with stress by simulating diverse environments.
While the current generation of consoles has its limits, developers compensate with retro charm and a campus-wide online leaderboard.
"Competition is human nature. It's the same everywhere."
LoadingTipsText_611001_TipsText: The gate opens, and two worlds collide. A lingering nightmare stalks the runners who can't afford to slow down. To plunge into the illusions or to stare down reality? Beyond this gate, she must make a choice.
LoadingTipsText_611101_TipsText: The gate opens, and two worlds collide. A lingering nightmare stalks the runners who can't afford to slow down. To plunge into the illusions or to stare down reality? Beyond this gate, she must make a choice.
LoadingTipsText_611201_TipsText: Warped by inexplicable frequencies, the Somnoire has devolved into a chaotic fever dream. Strange Nightmare TDs now prowl within, seeking to imprison all those who enter this labyrinth of entangled delusions.
LoadingTipsText_611301_TipsText:
The arcade's newest holographic shooter doubles as an immersive training sim for Startorch students, touting a difficulty level reserved for those with the most exceptional skills and biggest guts. But for Rebecca—who has spent her life on the razor's edge—it's just a trip down memory lane.
"So these goofs are all pulled straight from my head, huh? Then, let 'em choke on my muzzle."
LoadingTipsText_611401_TipsText:
Born of a fevered hallucination, this bustling concrete jungle is shrouded in eternal night, revealing a completely different cityscape. 
A cage forged from sorrow and despair. A graveyard of unfinished dreams and a time long gone.
LoadingTipsText_611501_TipsText:
In the deepest reaches of a dream lie our strongest longings. Here, reality is no longer the tether.
So we shall meet here—in that land of a promise.
LoadingTipsText_611601_TipsText:
The students and staff in the Research institute have been evacuated.
Some staff members stay behind to search for a way to contain the aberrant frequencies. But the source of the crisis remains unknown.
LoadingTipsText_611701_TipsText:
Reacting to Lucilla's mental fluctuations, the sealed Old Research Institute has undergone chaos.
Memories that can neither be forgotten nor braved come surging back like a tide.
LoadingTipsText_611801_TipsText:
A reading room repurposed into a secret workshop by Synchronist students. 
Genius ideas get their start here, like seedlings cracking through concrete, stretching toward the sky.
LoadingTipsText_901101_TipsText: The gate opens, and two worlds collide. A lingering nightmare stalks the runners who can't afford to slow down. To plunge into the illusions or to stare down reality? Beyond this gate, she must make a choice.
LoadingTipsText_901201_Title: Blade of Past Resounds, Lingering Dream Hymns
LoadingTipsText_201401_TipsText: A way station in the Land of Xuanfang's Southern Yuan Hills. Every shipment, commodity, and traveler entering the territory must first submit to inspection by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
LoadingTipsText_201402_TipsText: A pagoda of mechanisms in the Land of Xuanfang's Eastern Xuan Peaks. Its complex structure spills a ceaseless Disorienting Fog made up of frequencies that confound Tacet Discords, luring them into traps from which there is no escape.
LoadingTipsText_201403_TipsText: A scarred battlefield from the Fortress and Gorges War, one ignited over two centuries ago by Ovathrax. Countless soldiers gave their lives here, laying down everything to defend the home they held dear.
LoadingTipsText_201404_TipsText: A suspended City of Mechanisms under Mengzhou's jurisdiction, built to hold the hordes of Tacet Discords diverted from the Norfall Barrens outbreak. Its intricate construction reroutes and traps incoming hordes through a vast array of mechanisms. Its form shifts at will, deploying Autopuppets to rotate defenses and purge or suppress the Tacet Discords held within.
LoadingTipsText_201405_TipsText: A forest east of Shaftpost Yard. Legend has it Xuanling Birds once nested here, their legacy turning every leaf to perennial gold. Though their songs have long since fallen silent, the autumn they left behind never fades. And on certain winds, one might still hear a melodious chirping among the boughs...
LoadingTipsText_201406_TipsText: A unique region nestled between Jinzhou and Mengzhou. Though under Mengzhou's jurisdiction, time has shaped it into a land with its own regional character. Its people once lived alongside Xuanling Birds, rare Remnant Creatures revered as the land's spiritual totem for generations.
LoadingTipsText_201501_TipsText: A foyer within Fogveil Pagoda, lavishly adorned yet retaining an air of refined elegance. Shadows and light dance across painted screens, solemn and dreamlike. Yet behind the screen at the foyer's end lies a secret unknown to all...
LoadingTipsText_201502_TipsText: Deep beneath Xuanfang lies a vast underground complex, a labyrinth of jagged cliffs, thundering waterfalls, and ancient pavilions all woven into one impossible structure. Here, Tacet Discords are contained and purged, and the Hold's arcane Automata Mechanics are tested and deployed.
LoadingTipsText_201601_TipsText:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
The Thousandfold Foundry within it produces Autopuppets for Xuanfang ceaselessly, while the Myriad Snare disposes of powerful Tacet Discords too terrible for Censure Courts to hold.
LoadingTipsText_201602_TipsText: The hub where the Skyworks' assembly lines converge. Here, components are fused to form Autopuppets of all kinds. At the far end of this vast mechanical network lies the core of the Myriad Snare—the Snare Platform.
LoadingTipsText_612001_TipsText: Through fog and veiled halls, the dawnlight breaks the riddle's thrall.
LoadingTipsText_612101_TipsText: The innermost depths of the Censure Court—where madness and chaos first took root.
LoadingTipsText_612201_TipsText: A mysterious realm you entered after resonating with the core of the Myriad Snare. A faint, incomprehensible murmur echoes endlessly within.
LoadingTipsText_612301_TipsText: An old house in Xianling Village, a witness to generations of life and legacy. Now... it appears to have been long since abandoned.
LoadingTipsText_612401_TipsText: In an alternate future, Xuanfang Hold's floating isles transformed into massive Cloud Shuttles, sailing through the firmament to wage war against the Lament—only to crash into the chasm below. There, thorned vines bind their ruins, and rogue Autopuppets nest within their hollowed frames. A seething hive of anomalies, poised to erupt with countless rogue Autopuppets and scour the remaining structures from the world above.
LoadingTipsText_612501_TipsText:
A simulated training ground within the Ministry of War in Xuanfang Hold, designed for the combat drills of Xuanfang Wardens. 
Clear the challenges for various resources.
LoadingTipsText_612601_TipsText: A Sonoro Sphere built by the Black Shores, designed to recreate the frequencies recorded throughout your journey. Clear the challenges for various resources.
LoadingTipsText_612701_TipsText: A Sonoro Sphere built by the Black Shores, designed to recreate the frequencies recorded throughout your journey. Clear the challenges for various resources.
LoadingTipsText_612801_TipsText: A Sonoro Sphere built by the Black Shores, designed to recreate the frequencies recorded throughout your journey. Face the powerful foes of your past and hone your skills!
LoadingTipsText_612901_TipsText: A Sonoro Sphere built by the Black Shores, designed to recreate the frequencies recorded throughout your journey. Face the powerful foes of your past and hone your skills!
LoadingTipsText_613001_TipsText: A Sonoro Sphere built by the Black Shores, designed to recreate the frequencies recorded throughout your journey. Clear the challenges for various resources.
LoadingTipsText_613101_TipsText: To help Solaris prepare for future crises, the Black Shores and Spacetrek Collective have launched a new hologram simulation project. At Yhoran’s invitation, you and your companions step up to take part, ready to fight for humanity's survival in a simulated doomsday.
LoadingTipsText_901201_TipsText:
As mechanisms shift, echoes persist without end. The wind carries new tidings, and with them, a long-awaited reunion.
When the blade falls, the skylark sheds its first feather. Guided by song, the girl steps through her dreams, toward a destiny no longer at a standstill.
LoadingTipsText_201305_TipsText: The shifting, auroral hues are ethereal, quietly concealing the long forgotten secrets of old.
LoadingTipsText_901301_Title: Lamplight in Mirage, Sword's Resolve in Heart
LoadingTipsText_613201_TipsText:
The skies darken, and storms rage. 
Malfunctioning mechanical components fill the entire space. All before your eyes is spiraling into chaos and disorder...
LoadingTipsText_613301_TipsText:
A bright moon hangs in the clear night sky. Shadows dance amid a lingering fragrance. The beloved is by my side.
Her heartscape is now laid bare before you.
LoadingTipsText_613401_TipsText: Within the Sanctum, the mist swirls. The signs were there all along...
LoadingTipsText_613501_TipsText:
The mountain gate towers into the heavens, vanishing among the clouds. Every brick and tile is shaped by human hands. 
In those days, Yuan Fortress stood astride the major routes of Xuanfang, a vital frontier stronghold that kept Tacet Discords from reaching the heartland of Mengzhou.
LoadingTipsText_613601_TipsText:
Sword shadows fade, yet the heartstrings remain entangled.
Lingering attachments left unsevered, unfinished ties of fate—these have already become shackles.
LoadingTipsText_901301_TipsText:
Mist and cloud stretch far. The vast sky races past.
Amid the looming mirages, a Fire of Life shines into dark and light alike, and burns delusion away. Down the long road of transcendence, a jade blade carries the light of the mortal world, and proves a heart set on the Way.
Heaven keeps its indifferent course, and the mortal world is small and fragile. But if this heart does not waver, the flame may yet be passed down a hundred generations, unending.
LoadingTipsText_201901_TipsText:
Mist shrouds bamboo footpaths. Mechanisms cast crooked shadows.
Where tangled memories flicker and fade, the way forward is lost. Only the weaving Fox Shadow looms.
LoadingTipsText_201902_TipsText:
A broken shuttle, long silent. But the warmth of old ties remains.
Unfinished wishes and paths never taken all rest here, beside the Cloud Shuttle.
LoadingTipsText_201903_TipsText:
Green fills courtyards. Blooms follow footsteps.
What was once cherished and what the heart refused to release may linger here, for a time.
LoadingTipsText_201904_TipsText:
Passing light turns across jade. Flickering shadows become stars.
The Waking Moon's old glory endures in memory. But now, laughter and strange visions run entwined together.
LoadingTipsText_201905_TipsText:
Snow settles on buried blades. Old cities stir beneath the frost.
Obsessions never untangled, doubts never laid to rest—all held in frozen stillness.
LoadingTipsText_201906_TipsText: A vale of dreams shaped by mountains and rivers. Celestials move through it, guiding the land by the Sanctum's quiet law, where the real and the imagined barely part.
LoadingTipsText_201907_TipsText:
A Nexus of ordered design, the pivot on which all turns. 
Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe—the Manifold Sanctum. Here, all things are simulated and released, sustaining the Hold's ceaseless workings.
LoadingTipsText_613701_TipsText:
Born of the cosmic order, bound to its appointed track.
It emerged from immutable principle—to execute the Sentinel's will, correcting all that deviates.
Whatever strays from the ordained path must be set right.
LoadingTipsText_613901_TipsText: On this stage, the Cubie Warriors will make use of magical items to wage a fierce battle!
LoadingTipsText_614001_TipsText: Deep within the Heart Realms, the heart finds peace.
LoadingTipsText_901401_TipsText:
The Prism unveils countless forms. Dreams reflect the mortal world.
Old covenants endure, and beneath the umbrella, shadows of the past still follow.
The Waking Moon arrives in its appointed hour, and in her palm, a city is held aloft, never to fall.
The Fox Shadow drifts through the rise and fall of all things, through endless simulations, seeking the road yet unseen.
LoadingTipsText_921801_TipsText: Here, her specter wanders, stuck reliving her past… until enough fragments of hers are captured and anchored. Only then can the girl erased by the world reclaim her future.

NpcSystemBackground_10132_Title: Lahai-Roi: Tape of Last Words Collector
RoleSkin_81011507_BgDescription:
She leans casually against the railing, her sweater soft against the light, appearing equally elegant as she is relaxed. Changing up the style every now and then isn't so bad.

Turning slightly, Zani looks down at the city stretching beneath her. The afternoon sunlight spills over the buildings, their outlines shimmering in the glow. She gazes quietly, letting the city's clamor become the backdrop to this moment of ease.
RoleSkin_81001508_BgDescription:
An old Startorch Academy uniform, rarely seen these days, but Chisa still wears it out of habit.

This uniform has witnessed her sever countless threads, and up until now, its collar is still crisp and pleats still neat, quietly accompanying her toward a morning that will no longer repeat.
RoleSkin_81001307_BgDescription: An outfit in Mengzhou's style, adorned with shiny trinkets and jingling bells—perfect for its carefree, spirited wearer.
ExploreTools_1030_CurrentSkillInfo: The next-generation vehicle developed by Startorch Academy based on their studies on the Exoswarm.
RoleSkin_81001509_BgDescription: The Startorch Academy's prep uniform, "slightly modified" for Lynae's taste, tailored to minimize drag at high speeds. And yes, the splashes of color are a crucial part of the design!
RoleSkin_81001209_BgDescription:
A standard uniform of the Spacetrek Collective Research Institute.
Wearing it, the petite girl moves among data streams, machinery, and shifting currents. Beneath the silent gaze of the stars, humanity's drive to explore never ceases.
FunctionCondition_10098_Desc: A lightweight, all-terrain vehicle co-developed by the Department of Exostrider Engineering and the Department of Voidmatters at Startorch Academy. Indispensable for field expeditions, the Academy has created specialized driving courses and multiple training tracks around the campus to cater to the adventurous spirit of its students and faculty.
PhantomDisplay_SpecialDesc_310000790: Geospiders S4 in Lahai-Roi gravitate towards places bathed in Lumiglow where they perform <color=Light>Lumiglow Revelation</color>. Once the revelation is complete, the Lumiglow fades, revealing the hidden objects inside.
PhantomDisplay_SpecialDesc_310000820: In Lahai-Roi, Zip Zaps can sense any nearby immobilized Spacetrek Explorer and release an <color=Thunder>Electric Shock</color> to restore the Explorer to normal operating status. Additionally, Zip Zaps can detect defective power lines in their immediate surroundings, and can release an <color=Thunder>Electric Shock</color> to re-energize the line.
PhantomDisplay_SpecialDesc_320000520: In Lahai-Roi, Mining Reindeer can sense nearby Soliskin sealed inside special Luxites. The reindeer can fire a sustained <color=Thunder>laser beam</color> to break the rock's outer shell, allowing you to free the trapped Soliskin.
PhantomDisplay_SpecialDesc_320000610: In the frostlands, Glommoths can sense and shatter massive ice formations. Shattering the ice reveals paths and objects once sealed by the cold. Glommoths can also interact with Soliskin hiding within caves. Look for glimmering caves where the Soliskin hide, then use the Glommoth Projection to uncover the secrets they conceal.
PhantomDisplay_SpecialDesc_320000660: Around the Dimmr Plains, Voidwing Moth uses its wings to scatter the Soliskin Puffs unique to the Dimmr Plains, within which hidden treasures may be found. Additionally, in certain areas with residual Voidmatter contamination, Voidwing Moth's power may be utilized to disperse the residual Voidmatter that shrouds what's hidden within.

PhotoMemory_11101_Desc: "From the steel once embraced by the earth, we shall forge the first step towards the sky. One day, we will carry the greetings to the stars from down below."
PhotoMemory_11102_Desc: "Countless rivers of information converge at this nexus to be assessed and redistributed. It was the first thought in humanity's blueprint for deep space, and it will become the beating heart that brings the blueprint to life."
PhotoMemory_11103_Desc: "The forest is immersed in a long dream of evolution."
PhotoMemory_11104_Desc: "Warm firelight, the still waters of the timeless deep, and every fragment of memory that we once called home."
PhotoMemory_11105_Desc: "Hammered by the weight of ages, the unyielding ice and snow were forged into a boundless plain. Humanity would later name it the Frostlands."
PhotoMemory_11106_Desc: "Torch bearers, welcome to the origin of truth."

CharacAlbum_GuideDesc_Lynae: You run into <color=Highlight>Lynae</color> in the <color=Highlight>Screening Room</color>. Did she… skip classes again? Maybe you should ask her yourself. (Unlocks after talking to Lumi in the Quest "The Answer Is Where a River of Stars Falls")
CharacAlbum_GuideDesc_Jiyan: Rarely one for festivities, <color=Highlight>Jiyan</color> now stands before a displayed Echo, quietly gazing at it. Go find him in the <color=Highlight>Lobby</color> and say hello.
CharacAlbum_GuideDesc_Cantarella: <color=Highlight>Cantarella</color> is reviewing the dishes. Has her sense of taste finally returned? Go chat with her at the <color=Highlight>Bar</color>.
CharacAlbum_GuideDesc_Zani: <color=Highlight>Zani</color> is enjoying a rare vacation, but she doesn't quite seem used to it. Go talk to her in the <color=Highlight>Outdoor Lounge</color>.
CharacAlbum_GuideDesc_Yinlin: <color=Highlight>Yinlin</color> is spotted on the <color=Highlight>second-floor balcony</color>. What identity is she wearing this time? Go find out for yourself.
CharacAlbum_GuideDesc_Firework:
Bring the party to its climax and witness the most breathtaking fireworks that exist only for this very moment.
(Unlocks after completing the Quest "The Answer Is Where a River of Stars Falls")
CharacAlbum_UnlockDesc_Lynae: A life sparked by impulse may yet lead to the brightest future.
CharacAlbum_UnlockDesc_Jiyan: Even when duty weighs heavy, who could turn down a grand festivity?
CharacAlbum_UnlockDesc_Cantarella: Good food and travel always go hand in hand. May she set off on a journey filled with joy.
CharacAlbum_UnlockDesc_Zani: Even doing nothing at all can be meaningful. That, too, is what a vacation is for.
CharacAlbum_UnlockDesc_Yinlin: There are moments when you can cast aside every disguise. After all, we're here for a great time.
CharacAlbum_UnlockDesc_Firework: When the stars come cascading down, they will light the radiant path ahead of you.
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_Motor: Since your <color=Highlight>motorbike</color> is going on display, now's the time to swap in a different livery. Visit the <color=Highlight>Screening Room's stand</color> and see what works for you!
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_EchoPresent: Those majestic <color=Highlight>Echoes</color> displayed in the <color=Highlight>Lobby</color> elevate the festival to a whole new level. Go take a closer look and admire their unique beauty.
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_WeaponPresent: A wide array of <color=Highlight>weapons</color> is showcased in the <color=Highlight>Collection Gallery</color>. But remember, in a land of peace, they are for display only.
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_Swing: Lollo Logistics has repaired the <color=Highlight>swing</color> by the shore. Head to the <color=Highlight>seaside</color> and try it out for yourself. (Unlocks at Vibe Level 7)
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_Fireworks: A <color=Highlight>firework launcher</color> has been set up in the <color=Highlight>Garden</color>. Give it a try and paint the night sky with brilliant colors (Complete Quest "The Answer Is Where a River of Stars Falls" to unlock).
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_Phonograph: No celebration is complete without music. Visit the <color=Highlight>phonograph</color> in the <color=Highlight>Lobby</color> and enjoy the melodies it has prepared.
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_Screen: Lollo Logistics has installed a <color=Highlight>screen</color> in the <color=Highlight>Screening Room</color>, allowing you to switch between different channels.
MechaAlbum_GuideDesc_StarObserve: A <color=Highlight>telescope</color> awaits on the <color=Highlight>second-floor balcony</color> for stargazing. Be sure to give it a look. (Unlocks at Vibe Level 6)
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_Motor: Visitors admire your motorbike as though they could see the long, winding road you traveled.
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_EchoPresent: Gazing upon these Echoes, perhaps you can hear the breath of this world itself.
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_WeaponPresent: Brilliance is the dream of the young; brilliance is the glory of those returning home.
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_Swing: Seated on the swing by the sea, you can almost feel the rhythm of the tides.
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_Fireworks: Though it cannot light up every corner of the night, it leaves behind a fleeting spark across the sky.
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_Phonograph: Time may never turn back, but music always carries the power to resonate across eras.
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_Screen: The screen set up by Lollo Logistics and Startorch Academy occasionally remind you of matters beyond the party.
MechaAlbum_UnlockDesc_StarObserve: We look into the darkness from afar just to seek the stars.

CoopActivity_Text1_101:
Amid the lively bustle of the New Solar Celebration, students are busy pairing up for the festivities.
Lynae—the very first schoolmate you met here—reaches out with an invitation of her own! Don't miss the chance to share a festive lunch and celebrate the once-in-a-lifetime event together.
CoopActivity_Text2_101_1:
Lynae catches you up on her life lately. Her schedule has been jam-packed with a flurry of tedious volunteer tasks, but these ordinary duties can't satisfy her restless spirit.
Where is something "unordinary"? Just as she's voicing her boredom, an "unordinary" request for help arrives on her Terminal.

<color=#c49e55>Lynae senses that you're just as bored as she is. Well... Just how much longer are these lifeless days going to drag on? Come on. Let's spice things up!</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_101_2:
Lynae catches you up on her life lately. Her schedule has been jam-packed with a flurry of tedious volunteer tasks, but these ordinary duties can't satisfy her restless spirit.
Where is something "unordinary"? Just as she's voicing her boredom, an "unordinary" request for help arrives on her Terminal.

<color=#c49e55>Lynae senses that you're just as hungry for a thrill as she is. Well then, let's get out there and gather some more Echoes!</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_101_3:
Lynae catches you up on her life lately. Her schedule has been jam-packed with a flurry of tedious volunteer tasks, but these ordinary duties can't satisfy her restless spirit.
Where is something "unordinary"? Just as she's voicing her boredom, an "unordinary" request for help arrives on her Terminal.

<color=#c49e55>Lynae senses that you're just as swamped as she is. What will she invite you to do next time you're free? She's already got plenty of plans!</color>
CoopActivity_Upgrade_101: Ding-dong! Lynae here! There's a brand-new event waiting for you! Wink-wink!
CoopActivity_Text1_102:
An unmistakably "unordinary" emergency request arrives! An unstable prototype patrol mech has vanished without a trace! Concerned for campus safety, Lynae asks you to help track it down. Once again, the merry duo of the Voidworm Knight sets out on a new adventure!
Head to the square with Lynae and speak with the student who lost the patrol mech.
CoopActivity_Text2_102:
It turns out that what's missing isn't just the unstable patrol mech, but also the student's cherished family photo. In a state of great distress, the young student is unable to offer any useful clues.
However, the mech's last known trail provides the first lead. Determined to uncover more, Lynae takes charge and decides on her next move...
CoopActivity_Upgrade_102: Time to roll! Let's go check out this latest incident!
CoopActivity_Title_103: If You Catch Up to It...
CoopActivity_Text1_103:
A new lead emerges. To recover the missing patrol mech, Lynae invites you to investigate the lab together. One unusual trace after another points toward something far from ordinary. Is a real threat waiting ahead? Or just a false alarm?
Work with Lynae to uncover the truth.
CoopActivity_Text2_103:
Deep scratches on the wall. Flimsy debris. Weapon fragments that cannot be ignored… The prototype patrol mech proves far more dangerous than anticipated.
Seeing a reflection of her own past in the crisis, Lynae chooses to focus on locating the rogue mech and gives the student a chance to confront his own fears. All signs suggest the trail leads beyond the Celebration site.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_103: Uh-oh… I've got a bad feeling about this. We need to hurry.
CoopActivity_Text1_104:
Lynae finally pins down the mech's signal. It has already left the Academy. Why did the student install unauthorized modifications? Where is the patrol mech heading? And what truth awaits at the end of this pursuit?
Head to the Academy's main entrance and meet Lynae.
CoopActivity_Text2_104:
The truth behind the dangerous rogue mech finally surfaces. Its aggression was born of a desperate desire to protect. After losing his family, the student built the mech as a fragile yet desperate shield. But just as the dust begins to settle, the disabled mech suddenly jolts to life and bolts toward an unknown destination.
Turns out it's a move to save its creator from the contaminated Exoswarm. With the chaos behind you and everyone safe, you and Lynae return to the Academy, letting out a long-overdue sigh of relief.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_104: A long-awaited full throttle! Feels like we’re getting close to the truth.
CoopActivity_Text1_105:
The emergency has been resolved. After the Celebration, life at the Academy has settled back into its familiar rhythm. As your days find their balance between calm and chaos, Lynae's message pops up on your Terminal as usual. She wants to catch up and fill you in on what happened after the incident.
Meet Lynae by the fountain in the square.
CoopActivity_Text2_105:
The student received a just punishment for his actions, but also the support his talent deserved. Life at the Academy continues on, unchanged. For Lynae, however, the incident has sparked a question about her own path forward within. Enjoying the campus life here is no longer just a fragile dream. It's her everyday reality now. So what comes next?
Under the vast blue sky, she cracks open a soda and begins to share her new wishes with you...
CoopActivity_Upgrade_105: Before we decide where to go next, why not stay with me until I finish this soda? It's on me.
CoopActivity_Text1_201:
While the students immerse themselves fully in the Celebration, the faculty are run ragged keeping the gears turning. Even with thirteen different projects juggling for her attention, Mornye still finds a spare second to send a message checking in on you.
To return the favor and help the ever-restless Mornye finally catch her breath, bring her the specific food she requested.
CoopActivity_Text2_201:
You deliver the Agronomy Wing's latest energy supplement to Mornye. While you are left reeling from its "impactful" aftertaste, Mornye casually mentions her newest project: "Sylph." An unfamiliar yet intriguing name.
Thanks to your support, she seems to have a stronger drive for her research now...
CoopActivity_Upgrade_201: A new flavor of energy supplement... Preliminary feedback from the trial team remains within expected parameters.
CoopActivity_Text1_202:
Not long after your brief encounter at the library, Mornye sends you another invitation. The message is a word-for-word replica of her last one. It seems she is attempting to recreate your previous meeting to validate a specific theory.
Head to the library to meet Mornye and assist with her experiment.
CoopActivity_Text2_202:
Same hour, same place, and yet, the feelings are not the same. To Mornye's perplexity, the replicated environment failed to produce the same positive outcome as before.
If solid data alone cannot explain this, where does the answer hide? As Mornye grapples with the logic of her results, you suggest a different approach: meeting somewhere entirely new next time.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_202: Replicating the environment is a critical step... Thank you for your cooperation, Mentor.
CoopActivity_Text1_203:
Mornye has sent you another invitation. Unlike your previous meetings, she has carefully selected a location designed for relaxation: "Lush vegetation and an open view." Can she obtain the experimental results she seeks in this new environment?
Head to the Golden Spiral and meet Mornye.
CoopActivity_Text2_203_1:
You and Mornye share a peaceful moment at the Golden Spiral. Before returning to her mountain of work, she shows you "Sylph"—the blueprint for her newly designed mech. A beautiful memory can act as a source of courage even in the most dire situations. Mornye hopes to construct a mathematical model capable of quantifying a user's psychological state, but since this lies outside her field of expertise, you offer to lend a hand.

<color=#c49e55>Mornye has taken note of your preferences. Bright light, fresh air, and open views... Someday, she hopes to visit places like that with you again.</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_203_2:
You and Mornye share a peaceful moment at the Golden Spiral. Before returning to her mountain of work, she shows you "Sylph"—the blueprint for her newly designed mech. A beautiful memory can act as a source of courage even in the most dire situations. Mornye hopes to construct a mathematical model capable of quantifying a user's psychological state, but since this lies outside her field of expertise, you offer to lend a hand.

<color=#c49e55>Mornye holds your hopes close to her heart. Mustering her courage, she finally finds the words to voice her feelings to you. She promises to do even better in the future.</color>
CoopActivity_Upgrade_203: The breeze feels wonderful. A stroll with you like this... It feels quite nice.
CoopActivity_Text1_204:
After some careful preparation, it is your turn to send an invitation to Mornye. Upon receiving it, she seems a bit nervous—she doesn't have much experience simply "hanging out" with others. As her Mentor, this is your moment to lead the way.
Head to the screening room with Mornye to watch the film you specially selected for her.
CoopActivity_Text2_204_1:
You and Mornye finish watching a time-travel film together. Though she can't help but point out the gaps in its logic and world-building, she is clearly moved by the story.
The time spent together, the echoes of the plot, the deep discussion that followed, and the inspiration from your last meeting have all clicked into place... She finally has her answer.

<color=#c49e55>Mornye holds your feelings close to her heart. The melancholy of facing a world where everything changes... Can she truly come to sympathize with it, too?</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_204_2:
You and Mornye finish watching a time-travel film together. Though she can't help but point out the gaps in its logic and world-building, she is clearly moved by the story.
The time spent together, the echoes of the plot, the deep discussion that followed, and the inspiration from your last meeting have all clicked into place... She finally has her answer.

<color=#c49e55>Mornye holds your feelings close to her heart. The pain of what cannot be undone… has she endured it more than once?</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_204_3:
You and Mornye finish watching a time-travel film together. Though she can't help but point out the gaps in its logic and world-building, she is clearly moved by the story.
The time spent together, the echoes of the plot, the deep discussion that followed, and the inspiration from your last meeting have all clicked into place... She finally has her answer.

<color=#c49e55>Mornye holds your feelings close to her heart. That quiet, heartfelt warmth once belonged to her, too.</color>
CoopActivity_Upgrade_204: This film... I have made a note of the title. I'll be sure to watch it again later.
CoopActivity_Text1_205:
Mornye has sent word that her research is finally complete. After several twists and turns, the prototype of "Sylph" has finally been unveiled. Her brief message barely hides her excitement. She wants you to be the very first person to see it. 
Head to the Research Institute and share the joy of Mornye's hard-won success.
CoopActivity_Text2_205:
"Sylph," a device capable of recreating one's most precious memories. However, the study is ultimately deemed an infringement on scientific ethics, and the design fails its final review.
Mornye gives you the only existing prototype, inviting you to record your own most cherished memory. However, she forgot to wipe her own data first. After a brief flicker of a black screen, the memory plays, and you hear the sound of your own voice...
CoopActivity_Upgrade_205: To me, the most beautiful memory is...
CoopActivity_Text1_301:
To match the warmth and wonder of the New Solar Celebration, Luuk Herssen has baked a fresh batch of waffles. A message arrives at your Terminal riding a beam of sunlight—an invitation as soft as a waffle and as rich as a latte.
It's such a sunny day. While you have a moment, head to the infirmary to try Luuk Herssen's latest creation.
CoopActivity_Text2_301:
Luuk Herssen has put a new tweak on his recipe, and you're the first to get a taste. The infirmary is rarely this quiet. Usually, the endless stream of injured or sick students during the Celebration keeps the staff running off their feet.
While you and Luuk Herssen exchange recent campus anecdotes, an emergency at the venue cuts your peaceful tea time short. With a hurried "Until next time," your time together comes to an abrupt end.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_301: Remember to take breaks when you can. A little afternoon tea goes a long way.
CoopActivity_Text1_302:
Based on your feedback, Luuk Herssen has refined his waffle recipe once more. Yet, the fresh batch vanished mysteriously just two minutes after he left! What kind of being could act so fast? To recover the stolen treats, Luuk Herssen has sent you a "commission." 
Head to the infirmary and begin your investigation into this Case of the Missing Waffles.
CoopActivity_Text2_302_1:
The infirmary is a revolving door of people, and the clues are a tangled mess. But within the detective game Luuk Herssen has so meticulously crafted, you peel back the layers of the mystery and lock onto the prime suspect: the calico cat that frequents the infirmary.
When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth. Now, it's time to hunt down the suspect...

<color=#c49e55>Luuk Herssen recalls your habits. Making an offer the other party can't refuse—that, too, is his tactic.</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_302_2:
The infirmary is a revolving door of people, and the clues are a tangled mess. But within the detective game Luuk Herssen has so meticulously crafted, you peel back the layers of the mystery and lock onto the prime suspect: the calico cat that frequents the infirmary.

<color=#c49e55>Luuk Herssen recalls your habits. Sometimes, the most efficient way forward is to act alone. Not that he truly agrees with your action, but he would've done the same nonetheless.</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_302_3:

<color=#c49e55>Luuk Herssen recalls your habits. You have asked for his thoughts and sought out his wishes so many times. Now he wants to fulfill your wish in return.</color>
CoopActivity_Upgrade_302: How about a little detective work for a change? I promise to be a very loyal assistant.
CoopActivity_Text1_303:
In the final stage of your detective game, you have deduced the identity of the thief who made off with the waffles in under two minutes, but the important waffles remain gone. Where would a tiny feline suspect hide its spoils? 
"A place not far from here, quiet, undisturbed."
Following this lead, head to the preparation team's warehouse with Luuk Herssen.
CoopActivity_Text2_303_1:
Among the piles of clutter in the warehouse, you find the suspect and the "remains" of the waffles. With the cat safely in custody, you and Luuk Herssen weigh your next move.
You lay out your final theory. The tea time in the middle of a busy day and the impromptu detective game were Luuk Herssen's way of helping you unwind. Your "assistant" surrenders at your sharp deduction, admitting his ruse and promising to go out and truly enjoy the celebration with you.

<color=#c49e55>Luuk Herssen senses your lingering pout. He has no intention of mending his ways just yet, though. After all, not every grumpy mood needs smoothing over. It might just become the spark that starts your next conversation.</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_303_2:
Among the piles of clutter in the warehouse, you find the suspect and the "remains" of the waffles. With the cat safely in custody, you and Luuk Herssen weigh your next move.
You lay out your final theory. The tea time in the middle of a busy day and the impromptu detective game were Luuk Herssen's way of helping you unwind. Your "assistant" surrenders at your sharp deduction, admitting his ruse and promising to go out and truly enjoy the celebration with you.

<color=#c49e55>Luuk Herssen senses your trust. Thus, he decides to go all out. He can't help but wonder how you'll react when you discover what he's done. And he's really looking forward to it.</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_303_3:
Among the piles of clutter in the warehouse, you find the suspect and the "remains" of the waffles. With the cat safely in custody, you and Luuk Herssen weigh your next move.
You lay out your final theory. The tea time in the middle of a busy day and the impromptu detective game were Luuk Herssen's way of helping you unwind. Your "assistant" surrenders at your sharp deduction, admitting his ruse and promising to go out and truly enjoy the celebration with you.

<color=#c49e55>Luuk Herssen senses your concern. Perhaps the two of you are exactly the same when it comes to making others worry. He doesn't plan on changing that, and he knows you won't either.</color>
CoopActivity_Upgrade_303: The suspect cat has been apprehended. Detective, it's time for the wrap-up.
CoopActivity_Text1_304:
Luuk Herssen messages you that while he was relaxing at the celebration and scouting for potential adopters, the kitten got spooked and slipped out of its cage. 
A "criminal" like this cannot be allowed to roam free! For the safety of waffles everywhere, head to the teaching building, track down this fluffy fugitive, and bring it back to the infirmary.
CoopActivity_Text2_304:
After bringing the calico back to the infirmary, you and Luuk Herssen discuss the kitten's future. You suggest that he adopt the cat himself, an idea he readily accepts.
Welcoming a new life into a doctor's limited personal space comes with a mountain of chores, but regardless, the two of you have found a new path for a once-stray soul.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_304: Well, seems like a day made for taking a friend's advice, don't you think?
CoopActivity_Text1_305:
With the New Solar Celebration concluded, Luuk Herssen has stayed true to his word and taken a well-earned vacation. To mark the start of his break, he has prepared a fresh batch of waffles and invited you over.
How will the new waffles taste, and is the doctor getting along with his new feline roommate? Head to the Infirmary to catch up with Luuk Herssen.
CoopActivity_Text2_305:
Accustomed to the wild, the kitten struggled to adapt to life in a small room. It was born free-spirited. Yet even a soul like that needs a place to rest, and Luuk Herssen has become a quiet harbor where it can occasionally drop anchor. For him, this seems to be the most satisfying outcome.
Under the warm sunlight, you and Luuk Herssen finish your afternoon tea, marking the peaceful beginning of his holiday.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_305: Life is short. We must cherish every encounter.
CoopActivity_Text2_401: Like a solitary boat, moored between you and the vast sea of people.
CoopActivity_Text1_501:
Sigrika returns to her room. 
Her moments of vulnerability in the Academy's Dark Side replay on a loop in her mind. Her cheeks burn with embarrassment. Even hugging her favorite plushie can't stop the blushing.
(This is so humiliating... No, Sigrika! You have to apologize to Senior and the others who were worried about you.) 
With that thought, she opens your chat window on WavesLine.
CoopActivity_Text2_501:
Your meeting leaves Sigrika in high spirits. You accept her gift—an origami black cat she painstakingly made following a tutorial—and that brings her a great sense of relief.
(Great job, Sigrika! Now, keep that momentum going...)
She pats her cooling cheeks and runs toward the training grounds, leaving a trail of lighthearted notes in her wake.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_501: Folding a black cat out of paper... So difficult...
CoopActivity_Text1_502:
Sigrika is practicing tirelessly at the training grounds, striving to sketch every rune with absolute precision. 
The weight of everyone's expectations propels her forward, but her nerves have stretched thin, tense as a bowstring pushed past its limit. Even so, she presses on, unaware that her stubborn determination is pushing her toward a suffocating mire...
CoopActivity_Text2_502:
After her training ends, Sigrika sends you an invitation. She has decided to take you to a place she's always kept to herself—her "secret base."
A seemingly ordinary rooftop is her sanctuary for wandering thoughts and her haven within the Academy. Now, she shares this sacred space with you, hoping you will share this moment with her.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_502: Training is tough, but it's worth it! I'll keep doing my best!
CoopActivity_Text1_503: Sigrika leads you to a certain rooftop within the Academy. To any passerby, it looks completely ordinary. But only she knows just how many "spirits of freedom" love to pause and rest on this unassuming place. Every bird visiting the area carries its own character, but their size makes them easy to miss. Spotting them takes a sharp eye. She has one, undoubtedly. And so do you.
CoopActivity_Text2_503:
You and Sigrika spend the time photographing the birds together. It's something she loves to do, though she admits she usually misses the moment they face the camera. Fortunately, she has you this time. You capture several perfect shots and gift one to her.
Carrying Sigrika's quiet hopes for freedom, the birds lift into the horizon and disappear into the endless blue.
CoopActivity_Text1_504:
Sigrika sits in silence on the rooftop. 
The wind, which once brought her endless inspiration, now only brushes past her, stealing her warmth. Her heart of gold has grown heavy, each beat a soft whimper.
Please, stop crying out, she prays, but it is to no avail. 
Just then, Sigrika hears the sound of your footsteps.
CoopActivity_Text2_504:
Catching a moment when you aren’t looking, Sigrika's eyes drift to the hem of your sleeve.
She has always told herself she can't run away—because of everyone's expectations, because of her own pride… Yet you never say those words. You simply tell her she's allowed to step back. To rest.
Slowly, the tension starts to ebb, and her heart stops its soft whimpering.
The wind quiets down, and a bird lands gently at your side.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_504: Senior, can you stay with me a little longer?
CoopActivity_Text1_505:
With the Dark Side crisis resolved, Sigrika is in higher spirits than ever before. After rushing to share her joy with you, she heads back to her sanctuary, her heart still racing with excitement. 
This place has witnessed her expectations, her fragility, and her confusion. Now, it finally holds her happiness. As she tells the birds and the horizon the story of your journey together, she makes a silent vow to cherish these memories forever.
CoopActivity_Text2_505:
Sigrika returns to her room.
Her brilliant adventure in the Academy's Dark Side replays on a loop in her mind. Her cheeks burn with heat. Even after running several laps around her room, she can't get the temperature to drop.
(I'm so, so happy. Sigrika, you did it!)
With that thought, she opens the photo of the two of you. Her heart of gold, light once more, continues to dance with joy.
CoopActivity_Upgrade_505: I'll treasure our photo! I'll keep it right beside my other most precious ones.
CoopActivity_Text1_601:
The New Solar Celebration belongs to the students, not the faculty keeping order, and certainly not the president overseeing it all. You've grown used to Lucilla's packed schedule. That one movie you watched together seemed to be the only leisure she could steal. But today, just outside the venue, you spot her looking remarkably relaxed...
"How's that for a teaser?"
CoopActivity_Text2_601:
As the Academy President, Lucilla is well aware of the sources of her students' stress, and this stroll is a moment of respite stolen from her own hectic schedule. After a brief chat, she returns to her duties, leaving only a promise to watch a movie together next time.
Will she truly be able to find the time to keep the promise?
"Treat it as a plot hook, one to be revealed when you meet again in the next 'scene.'"
CoopActivity_Upgrade_601: "Take time out for those things that really make you happy, like watching a movie..."
CoopActivity_Text1_602:
On a day that started out like any other, you receive an unexpected message. The mere fact that the ever-busy Lucilla reached out at all is a rarity in itself. She brings two pieces of bad news: one concerns you, and the other... well, that concerns you, too.
"If a movie trailer were written this way, I'd accuse the PR department of being lazy. Then again, some of the best films start exactly the same way."
CoopActivity_Text2_602:
While helping Lucilla retrieve a repaired projector, you catch a glimpse of her life beyond the role of president—her side as a teacher. A top scholar of the Pioneer Association, a mentor to her students... Lucilla spins gracefully between her various roles, executing every footwork of the dance perfectly. 
"Alright, you, stop daydreaming. Let's move on to the next episode."
CoopActivity_Upgrade_602: (A silent, elegant, and precise rhythm, as if it is dancing.)
CoopActivity_Text1_603:
Even with her schedule packed to the brim, Lucilla still made time to point you toward the Academy's finest view.
Gardens are often where stories unfold—be they horror or romance—but on this campus, the faculty ensures they remain strictly for relaxation. Head to the garden and admire the greenery so meticulously tended to by the support staff. 
"Awaiting my message? I'm afraid I really am swamped this time."
CoopActivity_Text2_603_1:
During a brief respite following a student consultation, Lucilla confides in you about the dilemma the girl is facing. A confusion of memory is much like the chaos of life. In this aimless voyage, Lucilla can steady the ship for her student, but she cannot choose the direction for her. This somewhat heavy story has now become a secret shared between the two of you.
"What choice will Laurene make? Telling you now would be a spoiler. Come, let's move on to the next episode."

<color=#c49e55>Lucilla notices your fortitude. The courage to live is found in the countless times you rise from the fall again.</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_603_2:
During a brief respite following a student consultation, Lucilla confides in you about the dilemma the girl is facing. A confusion of memory is much like the chaos of life. In this aimless voyage, Lucilla can steady the ship for her student, but she cannot choose the direction for her. This somewhat heavy story has now become a secret shared between the two of you.

<color=#c49e55>Lucilla notices your restraint. People will make their own choices. Sometimes, all that is needed is to watch over them in silence.</color>
CoopActivity_Text2_603_3:
During a brief respite following a student consultation, Lucilla confides in you about the dilemma the girl is facing. A confusion of memory is much like the chaos of life. In this aimless voyage, Lucilla can steady the ship for her student, but she cannot choose the direction for her. This somewhat heavy story has now become a secret shared between the two of you.
