<color=#c49e55>Lucilla notices your hesitation. She was once hesitant, much like you are now. She once made a choice, much like you always have.</color>
CoopActivity_Upgrade_603: "Fear is life's only true opponent. Only fear can defeat life."
CoopActivity_Text1_604:
Lucilla has hit a snag trying to pick the right film. She invites you to help her navigate the "vast sea of movies" to find the perfect one.
Head to the library and pick out a film that catches your eye. 
"The movies we love are always connected to us in some way. Sometimes the link sparks an instant memory. Other times, it's like dust on a film reel, hidden in shadows the naked eye can barely perceive."
CoopActivity_Text2_604:
You and Lucilla sift through film after film, synopsis by synopsis. She offers a few personal favorites. But for one reason or another, none of them quite make the cut. In the end, both of you agree to watch the tape repaired by the Department of Engineering the next time you meet.
"To have not a single film worth watching... That is truly the audience's darkest hour."
CoopActivity_Upgrade_604: "We, and I say we because I consider you such, must remain lucid to the bitter end."
CoopActivity_Text1_605:
After a long period of relentless work, Lucilla has finally carved out a good stretch of time off. Before the next busy season sweeps in, she seizes the chance to fulfill her old promise: watching that long-delayed film with you.
"Time waits for no one. The final screening begins now!"
CoopActivity_Text2_605:
You and Lucilla meet in the auditorium. But before the first frame can flicker to life, the projector—Lucilla's faithful companion for years—breathes its last and refuses to play. During the idle chat that follows, you bring up Laurene. After much hesitation, it seems she has finally made her choice. How many times does one really get to choose in a lifetime? Those who have not yet reached the end can never know. All they can do is hold onto hope.
"Please stay tuned for the next story."

KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810001:
A dairy product that's been sitting around for who knows how long. Surprisingly, you can still drink it.
"The trick is to ignore the use-by date and try to bypass your tongue. If all goes well, you may still fool your bowel."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810002:
A hardy herb that somehow survived the End Times. Can be used to stop bleeding in a pinch.
"Chew it up, slap it on the wound. Good enough."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810003:
This little talon used to be a good luck charm. When the End Times came, even the slightest stroke of luck became a lifeline for survivors.
"If I could go back in time, I'd definitely use this thing to pray for a windfall. But now? What good's a mountain of Shell Credits?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810004:
A small pendant shaped like a Goldcrest Scarab. Maybe it'll bring you some fortune.
"Fortune...? Or, put it more plainly, a better chance of finding supplies. Well, you can always sell it for some food on your worst days. So—you taking it or not?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810005:
Leaftail Foxes have a habit of stashing Oaknuts around their dens. For survivors, that little quirk makes Oaknuts a good sign that supplies might be nearby.
"They're not bad as a snack, you know."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810006:
A stray KU-Roro that lost contact with the Black Shores and has been wandering alone ever since. Once it finds out who you are, it decides to lend you a hand.
"KU-Roro unit, at your service!"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810007:
You can't tell what model this mech is, but you can tell it's stuffed with explosives, ready to blow itself up the moment it detects a threat.
"It's got legs, but we've forgotten how to make 'em work... Eh, whatever. It'll still come in handy."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_810008:
An oven Echo from Rinascita. Even in this post-apocalyptic world, it's still doing what it does best—cooking up all kinds of delicious treats.
"Yummy yummy. That's the Bakie I know."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820001:
No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.
"Looks pretty spicy. You think we can use it for hotpot?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820002:
No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.
"Smells refreshing, at least... But more like detergent than a drink, don't you think?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820003:
An encased explosive crystal that can be detonated multiple times.
"Pick it up carefully, then throw it fast. Easy, right? Huh? What's this under my foot..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820004:
An energy shield that still works well enough to provide the most basic protection to its user.
"If TDs can level an entire city, why would anyone think they're perfectly safe behind a busted shield?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820005:
It is said that this kind of ore was once used by swindlers as fake gold. When the End Times came, weapons and tools made from it became more popular than real gold.
"You can even just chuck it at your enemies. Feels better than a plain old rock."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820006:
A type of edible mushroom. To survive sudden environmental changes, they evolved the ability to release a massive cloud of spores upon impact. Easy to grow and tough as nails, they've become a staple food for survivors.
"Today's special: Stir-fried Mushrooms with Mushrooms, Mushroom Stew with Mushrooms, and a Mushroom Salad topped with Mushrooms..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820007:
This butterfly is a symbol of luck. According to some legends, a mysterious world-saving organization would always show up on its wings to help survivors face the crisis.
"It can be a sign, sure... Just don't go making a religion out of it..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820008:
A KU-Roro equipped with a flamethrower. Used to be the barbecue enthusiast of the KU-Roro squad. Maybe.
"Cremator sounds way more badass. And honestly, it fits what it's been up to these days... Anyway, by fire be purged, TDs!"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820009:
You can't tell what model this mech is, but you can tell it's more powerful than the usual Bomb Mechs.
"Time to teach 'em some lessons!"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820010:
For some reason, Bakie has grown to a much larger size. Now it can pump out food even faster.
"A bigger Bakie means more tasty food, I guess..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820011:
The destiny it reveals is chaotic, but at least not hopeless.
"I'm actually super good at these cubes, y'know. First we do this, then this... oops..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820012:
A nut you found from an abandoned factory. It seems to be made of some unknown high-density metal.
"I mean, what can this thing do? It's just a heavy nut. That's it."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820013:
A recorder that captured the status of automated assembly lines. And just like the lines it used to record, the tape inside keeps looping forever.
"That tape never seems to end. Wait… how many times have we watched this already?
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820014:
A highly portable compass. A must-have for exploring the city ruins.
"Heard the poles shifted before. But until that happens again, this thing's still pretty handy."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_820015:
Simulation: formidable abominations flood everything like a dark tide. You have no choice left but to make your final stand.
Warning: Activating this protocol will significantly increase the difficulty of the drill.
"Just wanna give a try, you know..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830001:
No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.
"Looks pretty spicy. You think we can use it for hotpot?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830002:
No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.
"It won't dye my tongue purple, right?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830003:
Most survivors have forgotten its real name and original use. All they know is that it boosts the body and eases the pain.
"Well, it is what it is. Want some candy?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830004:
Most survivors have forgotten its real name and original use. All they know is that it boosts the body and eases the pain.
"It tastes better than it looks. But honestly? Mid."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830005:
A type of Tacitite Bloom packed with highly volatile energy. The energy it emits can enhance weapons, but it might also pose a risk to whoever carries it.
"Keep hauling that live hazard around, and we're gonna have to politely ask you to leave the squad. Just drop it. For our sake, alright?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830006:
A pair of goggles with a built-in aiming assist system. But since they're a bit damaged, they could be slow at locking onto nearby targets.
"Look over there. Look over here. Over there. Over here... Wait, my head's spinning..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830007:
A spring that stores the force applied to it. Inside, the pressure builds and releases.
"Might've been a kid's toy back in the day. But these days... just look at this thing go..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830008:
A pair of high-tech gauntlets with a protective energy field that can also help you deliver a heavier punch in addition to shielding you.
"Both a spear and a shield. Looks sci-fi enough... Now that's the good stuff."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830009:
Purple coral with a faint fluorescent glow. Its fractures are razor-sharp, making it a great material for barriers.
"A recipe from some forgotten age says it's edible. I tried it. Let's just say my teeth weren't on board."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830010:
A golden-colored frog. Legends say it was a symbol of wealth in the past.
"They jump fast. Traps are your best bet."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830011:
A piece of petrified remains from some unknown beast.
"Good enough as a weapon."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830012:
KU-Roro units designed for rescue operations. Compared to stray KU-Roros, they are packed with more powerful arms and a whole lot more ammo.
"KU-Roro units, ready for battle!"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830013:
A data chip containing an emergency override that rewrites the preprogrammed routines of all KU-Roros. Once activated, they'll stop active firing and start hauling explosives to defend key positions. The command cannot be reversed.
"Order received! Time to blow those TDs to bits!"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830014:
This trinket is so precious that even in this post-apocalyptic age—when money means nothing—some are still willing to give everything to get their hands on it.
"Trade it for some cans and treat yourself to a decent meal, alright?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830015:
A crystal that enhances Resonance Ability. No one knows where it came from.
"You see, everything's got its use. Food, weapon, or trade goods. But this thing? No clue what to do with it."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830016:
A fragile plant, as fleeting as a passing moment. Survivors make wishes with it, hoping the wind will carry its seeds, and their hopes, somewhere far away.
"Just blow on it."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830017:
A type of small shrimp capable of warp-leaping for a short distance. Fragile as they are, they always manage to blink their way out of danger.
"Shrimp! They'll make one hell of a meal!"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830018:
When smashed, this type of snail shell attracts TDs. Some veteran survivors use it to lure the TDs away while they raid the ruins for supplies.
"Just never throw it directly at a TD. It won't do a thing. Just makes 'em angry."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_830019:
Sliced butter blocks perfect for quick energy replenishment.
"Have it with something else, or it might kill your appetite."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840001:
No one remembers what this spray was originally for anymore. These days, people just use it however they see fit, giving it all kinds of new purposes.
"The previous owner told me it could make people invisible. Clearly, it didn't do the trick... which is why it's in my hand now."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840002:
Most survivors have forgotten its real name and original use. All they know is that it boosts the body and eases the pain.
"The candy looks like a grape, smells like a grape, but tastes like orange... isn't it a bit weird?"
"...Maybe it's simply out of date."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840003:
A large, sturdy shield. All the walls crumbled when the cataclysm struck. But humans have become the last bulwark of their own civilization.
"I am not surrendering our future to you."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840004:
A censer loaded with explosives, so now it's literally a bomb.
"Who the hell packed this thing with explosives..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840005:
A rare type of slough. It symbolizes the chance to trade everything you have for a new kind of power.
"This is insect slough.. Do we have to eat it?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840006:
A prosthetic hand with a built-in set of weapons. The complex design makes it to use alongside other weapons.
"Okay. So I press this button for 'Monoblade,' this one for 'Storm Drill.' Press them together for 'Cuttin' My Own Fingers Off'... Cool. I've memorized 'em all."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840007:
A survival knife that looks pretty ordinary, but seems to carry some kind of peculiar power.
"Great for outdoor survival and fighting off TDs. As long as you've got enough whetstones on you, that is."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840008:
Wings issued to mech soldiers. They provide a moderate boost to both movement speed and defense.
"I can fly! Hahaha, look, I'm flying—"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840009:
An automatic injector loaded with cardiotonics. Sure, a heavy dose of heart stimulants is never a good idea, but it beats facing TDs without a boost and getting torn apart.
"This is no boxing ring. You'd better bounce right back the second you hit the ground. No referee's there to count to ten for you."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840010:
A book filled with delirious heresies. The overflowing obsession with immortality in the text could easily get hold of the readers, turning them into predators who devour others' frequencies.
"Just don't read it. And tell me at once if you've already read it... I'll figure something out."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840011:
A very heavy slammer. It smashes TDs like driving nails.
"What's that saying again? When all you've got is a hammer..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840012:
Sing with me—Sing with me at the End Times!
"—One, no, two octaves higher!"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840013:
An iron whistle that produces a sound so piercing it can even rattle the frequencies of TDs.
"Cover your ears before blowing it."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840014:
A long scroll with exemption clauses and disclaimers scribbled across it. You have absolutely zero interest in reading the whole thing.
"Let's see, item one, item two... annnnd..."
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840015:
An amulet carved from a branch of Jade Wood. People wear it in the hope that they can survive this calamity, just like the ancient woods once did.
"...But even the forest died, turned to cold, lifeless stone. What chance do we have?"
KurotatoItem_Bgdesc_840016:
A crimson butterfly. In legends, it is a symbol of disaster.
"Those lunatics in red always show up wherever the Crimson Butterflies go. Better steer clear the moment you spot one."

KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1001: A pair of broken standard-issue gauntlets, maybe just a few hits or blocks away from falling apart completely. Still, they're better than nothing. Better than your bare fists.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1002: A spear found among the ruins. The survivors still have a faint memory of a man holding back waves of Tacet Discords with it. But no one ever found him afterward.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1003: A throwing weapon made from a circular saw. Someone got the idea from the hunting tools of a long-gone tribe. In this post-apocalyptic world, you'll find plenty of weapons crafted from scraps and old tools.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1004: A weapon you found stashed away in a forgotten depot. No telling how long it had been buried there, but one thing's for sure—it's sharp enough to cut through the enemies ahead.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1005: A sword corrupted by abnormal frequencies. It cuts both the enemies and the wielder.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1006: The Ragunnesi believe that the Order of the Deep secretly forged this cursed weapon in the depths of the sea. It bears the power of a Threnodian, hungering for any frequency it can consume. One day, it will lay its grip upon the soul of its wielder. But against the crisis you face, you have no other choice.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1007: You found this deck of cards in a ravaged wasteland. Apparently, its owner's spiraling madness eventually consumed him on the doomsday.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1008: A short-barreled musket with an antique look and design. Still capable of firing a barrage of Tacitite shots.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1009: A sturdy, reliable standard-issue gun. It has enough firepower to handle most ordinary threats.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1010: A heavy weapon retrieved from the wreckage of a military robot. Powerful, but a bit bulky.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1011: An old pistol you found on a battlefield. Despite all the wear and scratches it bears, it's still as precise as ever.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1012: A flamethrower made from scraps, but still sturdy enough to unleash a continuous stream of fire.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1013: An electromagnetic cannon made from scraps, but still sturdy enough to accelerate bullets to incredible speeds, piercing through anything in its path.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1014: An electric arc cannon made from scraps, but still sturdy enough to fire penetrating eletric arcs.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1015: A component you salvaged from a downed mech. Most of its functions are disabled, but it still makes for a solid weapon.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1016: A DIY weapon that fires incendiary rounds. The special fuel packed into each bullet ensures the target keeps burning for a good while.

PhotoMemory_11301_Desc: "Beyond the cliffs, a sky path reaches the four chimes."
PhotoMemory_11302_Desc: "Through fog and veiled halls, the dawnlight breaks the riddle's thrall."
PhotoMemory_11303_Desc: "A prison for Tacet Discords, a cradle of wondrous machines. Through a thousand turns twisted by ambition, old allies meet once more."
PhotoMemory_11304_Desc: "Because of you, this song has never fallen silent."
PhotoMemory_11305_Desc: "Through a thousand workings, all calamity is swept clean. The heavenly array forms, and the city is reborn."
PhotoMemory_11306_Desc: "Honor the past, and press onward, even in the face of death."
KurotatoWeaponGroup_desc_1017: A pistol with normal firepower and firing rate.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_desc_1018: Deal a blow to enemies in close range and spawn a KU-Roro at the start of each wave.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_desc_1019: Deal DMG to enemies in a linear range and spawn a Bomb Mech periodically.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_desc_1020: Swing the lute to attack the target, generating ricocheting notes on hit.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_desc_1021: Swing the hammer to attack the target. Defeating an enemy permanently increases its DMG.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_desc_1022: Deal DMG to enemies in a linear range and spawn an oven Echo at the start of each wave.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1017: A common pistol that was easy to come by before the disaster.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1018: The frying pan carried by KU-Roros. It's a reliable cooking tool, as well as a sturdy weapon. Somehow, you can sense its connection to KU-Roros.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1019: A knife with various tools attached. It can also be used for simple mech repairs.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1020: An ordinary lute, a common sight before the End Times. Nobody remembers how to play the thing anymore, but it still makes for a handy weapon.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1021: A heavy melee weapon of unknown origin. It seems to contain vast computing power and fragments of data.
KurotatoWeaponGroup_Bgdesc_1022: A pizza spatula once used by a restaurant owner. The deep bond between her and her Echo has given this spatula some rather peculiar power.

[Tarnished Dredge]: When a Resonator successfully triggers a Counterattack, Resonators in the team gain 1 stack of Occultation for 8s, stacking up to 5 times.

[Occultation]: The Resonator's total DMG is increased by 5%, and their Vibration Strength Reduction Rate is increased.

[Dream of Annihilation]: A successful Dodge recovers 3% of the Resonator's Max HP, and grants Resonators in the team 1 stack of Phantom Froth for 8s, stacking up to 5 times.

[Phantom Froth]: The Resonator takes 5% less damage.

[To the Void]: 3 minutes after the battle begins, Resonators deal 10% more Total DMG every 10s, up to 100%. Resonators take 10% more Total DMG every 10s, up to 100%.

RoleSkin_81011310_BgDescription: Rover's uniform from a past life at Startorch Academy. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.
RoleSkin_81011309_BgDescription: Rover's uniform from a past life at Startorch Academy. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.
RoleSkin_81001310_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001309_BgDescription: Rover's usual outfit. This is what he wore at the beginning of his journey and what he will be wearing for the rest of it.
RoleSkin_81001610_BgDescription:
Her attire as the "Votary of the Voice," worn after deepening her bond with the Streams.
The bird has shed its down and rides the wind toward the heights. From here on, too, she will stride forward, toward everything she believes in.
RoleSkin_81001110_BgDescription: Suisui's go-to attire when business calls—a qipao of striking gold and jade-green, its feathered hems swaying like sunlight on rippling water. In this dress, she has crossed hills and rivers to trace the breadth of a splendid, vast world.
RoleSkin_81011508_BgDescription: The sky's colors melt into the sea. Splashing waves sparkle in the brilliant summer sun. A bird glides across the boundless blue overhead. A slice of watermelon and a perfectly chilled peach parfait. Just another slow summer day for her.
RoleSkin_81001212_BgDescription:
The outfit Jingran wears most often as a Nethermancer. Tailored for ease of movement, it is well suited for traversing wilderness and forgotten ruins. A fire-striker, a mechanism grappling cord, and other travel essentials hang at his waist and sleeves.
Mountains, rivers, and Mirage Realms alike lie open to him; he comes and goes between the mortal world and the nether as he pleases. Lantern in hand, he walks the boundary where truth and illusion intertwine, carrying long-forgotten stories back into the light of the living world.
RoleSkin_81001413_BgDescription: Qingxiao's everyday attire in the Land of Xuanfang. Moonlight seems to spill across its surface, mist and cloud drift through its folds, and the faint glint of sword-light shimmers in the weave. When she rides her blade through the sky, the fabric ripples and streams behind her, sweeping over mountains and rivers as she chases the Way of the Sword far above the azure.
RoleSkin_81001311_BgDescription:
This is the attire Hsin wears most often, the form She takes when walking among mortals—crimson clouds drift lightly amid moonlight, gold patterns trace ancient motifs, and hanging pendants hold quiet joy.
All forms are Hers to take, but this is the one She chose for Herself.
RoleSkin_81001312_BgDescription:
Born of Huating's relentless wind and rain, this black attire was worn when Suoming first stood before the Sentinel. Its sharp silhouette is trimmed with the gilded insignia of Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.

Black carries the weight of her homeland, gold reflects the duty of her calling. Where she came from and the oath she swore are both sewn into every thread of this garment.
RoleSkin_81011509_BgDescription:
Endless sunshine, golden sand beaches, and vibrant hues bursting everywhere—summer's here! Lynae's favorite season, hands down! Hm? The heatwave sapped your energy? Why not pop open another ice-cold soda?
(∩^o^)⊃━☆ﾟ.*･
KurotatoMonsterDesc16:
A High-Risk Target who poses a major threat at long range
Lash of Pain: Lash out on a large area up front.
Crimson Dance: Spin on the spot and spray out energy missiles.
Wheel of Punishment: Throw out serrated wheels, which launch energy missiles in all directions continuously.
KurotatoMonsterDesc17:
A High-Risk Target who poses a major threat at close range.
Melting Corona: Shoot out 3 energy lances straight ahead.
Scorching Charge: Charge forward and shoot out energy missiles from both sides along the path.
Fusing Chamber: Spawn auras of energy missiles near the Resonator.
KurotatoMonsterDesc18:
A High-Risk Target who poses a major threat at all ranges.
Claw of Demise: Slam the ground and shoot out energy missiles along 3 lines up front.
Sacred Flame's Afterglow: Shoot out energy lances continuously in a spinning cross pattern. During this skill, spawn energy missiles on random spots.
Terror Assault: Charge forward and shoot out energy missiles from both sides along the path.

<color=#c49e55>Through the mist's old shadows, behold the heart's true form.</color>
Obtainable after proceeding with Side Quest "Past Dreams, Traced Seals"
PhotoMemory_11402_Tips:
<color=#c49e55>Through the embers' faint glow, a city shines with lasting joy.</color>
Obtainable after proceeding with Side Quest "Past Dreams, Traced Seals"
PhotoMemory_11403_Tips:
<color=#c49e55>Through desolate snow and sunken blades, to walls raised by countless hands.</color>
Obtainable after proceeding with Side Quest "Past Dreams, Traced Seals"
PhotoMemory_11404_Tips:
<color=#c49e55>Through deep green serenity, embrace a garden brimming with life.</color>
Obtainable after proceeding with Side Quest "Past Dreams, Traced Seals"
PhotoMemory_11405_Tips:
<color=#c49e55>Through the broken shuttle's path, bear the timeless vow to the clouds.</color>
Obtainable after proceeding with Side Quest "Past Dreams, Traced Seals"
PhotoMemory_11406_Tips:
<color=#c49e55>Through the lingering echoes of streams and hills, where the mortal realm is never far.</color>

PhotoMemory_11401_Desc: "Old relics whisper memories past. Seek them, and the fog shall part.... Returning to where it all began, I find myself in a tangle of endless thoughts, yet I refuse to part with any."
PhotoMemory_11402_Desc: "Moonlit lanterns greet the moon, flutes echo in the wind. Light dawns anew at the Heart Ring Pagoda, again the dragon-fish dance through the night."
PhotoMemory_11403_Desc: "Only countless hands passing the work onward, wings raised and blades drawn, as a hundred ramparts rise at once."
PhotoMemory_11404_Desc: "The clear breeze and bright moon have no price. The near waters and distant hills alike hold their own affection."
PhotoMemory_11405_Desc: "At last the moonlike heart conforms to mortal desires, and this feeling now rests within the azure sky."
PhotoMemory_11406_Desc: "With nowhere to turn for past obsessions, thus a realm of streams and mountains is left behind, where every lingering thought may find rest."
PlayerHead_82000017_Description: A loyal heart pierces the night, shattering the clouds. Long sword sweeps away the filth of evil like a clear wind. Having walked through both the light and shadow of this life, the shadows of the past dissolve into the winds of a new dawn.

DangoBrawlBuff_Des_01: Each stack increases Crit. Rate by 0.5% and Crit DMG by 1%. Crit. DMG is considered as <te href=853715>Weapon DMG</te>. Effect only applies to Weapons.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_02: Each stack increases Weapon Attack Interval Restoration Speed by 1%, up to 100 stacks.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_03: Each stack restores HP equal to 1% of <te href=853715>Weapon DMG</te> dealt, up to 100 stacks.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_04: When taking a Weapon attack from the enemy, each stack deals 1 <te href=853714>Effect DMG</te> to the enemy.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_05: At the end of the Round, earn 1 Wooly Coin for every stack of Luck.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_06: The bearer takes <te href=853714>Effect DMG</te> equal to this effect's stack count ×5.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_07: The bearer takes additional <te href=853714>Effect DMG</te> eqaul to this effect's stack count x1 when taking hits.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_08: Lose 25% stacks and take <te href=853714>Effect DMG</te> equal to 100% of the lost stack count every 2s.
DangoBrawlBuff_Des_09: Checked once per second on the enemy: each stack has a 10% chance to trigger, guaranteed at 10 or more stacks. Triggering clears all stacks, pauses the Attack Interval Restoration Time of one random Weapon the enemy has for 1s, and deals <te href=853714>Effect DMG</te> equal to 2 times the current stack count.

InstanceDungeon_1501_DungeonDesc: Those who are ignorant hinder progress, while the innocent suffer from the challenges imposed upon them. The embers of a fire, sparked by memories of a distant night and fueled by present circumstances, ignite the pain of Scar's past and the rebirth of new ideas, ultimately leading to the downfall of the old world order.
InstanceDungeon_1503_DungeonDesc:
Jinzhou is home to one of Huanglong's unique database centers, managed by the Sentinel and controlled by the Jinzhou Magistrate. It uses time as an index and precisely records information related to the city's establishment, making it a comprehensive and objective resource. The class books of Jinzhou, stored in City Hall, hold important data collected since ancient times. This vast database holds answers to any question one may have about Huanglong's history.
Recommended Character Level: Level 40

InstanceDungeon_8151_MonsterTips:
Breath Alloy:
Concerto Energy of <color=Wind>Aero</color> and <color=Light>Spectro</color> Resonators is automatically restored
When <color=Wind>Aero</color> Resonators cast Intro Skills, a whirlwind will be summoned.
When <color=Light>Spectro</color> Resonators cast Intro Skills, deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to and mark the enemies within a certain range. An explosion will be triggered when the marked enemies take damage, dealing additional damage.
InstanceDungeon_8152_MonsterTips:
Freezing Alloy:
Concerto Energy of <color=Ice>Glacio</color> and <color=Dark>Havoc</color> Resonators is automatically restored.
When <color=Ice>Glacio</color> Resonators release Intro Skill, freeze and mark all enemies within an area. When the marked enemies take damage, deals additional <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
When <color=Dark>Havoc</color> Resonators release Intro Skill, explosions will be triggered 6 times around them, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
InstanceDungeon_8153_MonsterTips:
Scorching Alloy:
Concerto Energy of <color=Fire>Fusion</color> and <color=Thunder>Electro</color> Resonators is automatically restored.
When <color=Fire>Fusion</color> Resonators cast Intro Skills, a lava pillar will be raised at the enemy's feet, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
When <color=Thunder>Electro</color> Resonators cast Intro Skill, 3 lightning bolts will be summoned around them, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
InstanceDungeon_8154_MonsterTips:
Rapido Alloy:
Resonators' <color=highlight>Concert Energy</color> regeneration rate is increased. After Resonators cast Intro Skills, <color=highlight>Resonance Energy</color> will be fully restored and <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color> will be increased by 225%.
InstanceDungeon_8155_MonsterTips:
Striking Alloy:
Resonators' <color=highlight>Concerto Energy</color> regeneration rate is increased. After Resonators cast <color=highlight>Intro Skills</color>, their <color=highlight>Crit. Rate</color> is increased by 100% and <color=highlight>Crit. DMG</color> is increased by 30%. The effect of Crit. DMG boost can stack up to 15 times.
InstanceDungeon_8156_MonsterTips:
Intimidating Alloy:
<color=highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color> is increased by 20% every time <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> is cast. This effect can stack up to 15 times. The CD of <color=highlight>Echo Skills</color> cast within 8s after a <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is reduced by 100%.
InstanceDungeon_8157_MonsterTips:
Deafening Alloy:
<color=highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color> and <color=highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> are increased by 20% when <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> is cast. This effect stacks up to 15 times. <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> CD is reduced by 50% after Resonators perform <color=highlight>Heavy Attacks</color>.
InstanceDungeon_8158_MonsterTips:
Furious Alloy:
Echo Skill CD is reduced by 50%. The <color=highlight>Crit. Rate</color> and <color=highlight>Crit. DMG</color> of <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=highlight>Heavy Attack</color> are increased by 100% and 30% respectively after Resonators cast an <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>. The effect of Crit. DMG boost can stack up to 15 times.
InstanceDungeon_8159_MonsterTips:
Ethereal Alloy:
Echo Skill CD is reduced by 50%. After Resonators release <color=highlight>Echo Skills</color>, a wind field will be generated to continuously pull in enemies. When the wind field disperses, <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> will be dealt 1 time.
InstanceDungeon_8160_MonsterTips:
Everlasting Alloy:
Casting <color=highlight>Intro Skills</color> reduces <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> CD by 100% for 5s. <color=highlight>Defeating an enemy</color> increases Resonators' DMG by 10%, stacking up to 25 times.
InstanceDungeon_8161_MonsterTips:
Rupture Alloy:
Casting <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color> reduces Resonance Liberation Cooldown and regenerates Resonance Energy.
Casting <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> reduces all party members' Resonance Skill Cooldown, increases their Resonance Skill Crit. Rate for 3s, and boosts their Resonance Skill Crit. DMG. This effect can be stacked.
InstanceDungeon_8162_MonsterTips:
Empyrean Alloy:
While the active Resonator is <color=highlight>in mid-air</color>, increase their Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG each second. Whenever a Mid-air Attack hits the target, it triggers an additional attack that deals Resonance Liberation DMG.
The additional attack increases the Resonator's <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>. This effect can be stacked.
InstanceDungeon_8163_MonsterTips:
Aftersound Alloy:
Increase inactive Resonators' DMG when <color=highlight>Coordinated Attack</color> hits the target. This effect can be stacked.
All party members gain extra Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy when <color=highlight>Coordinated Attack</color> hits the target.
Increase all party members' Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG for 8s when <color=highlight>Intro Skill</color> hits the target.
InstanceDungeon_8164_MonsterTips:
Fervor Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> Cooldown.
Defeating an enemy regenerates extra Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.
Defeating an enemy also increases the Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of all party members' <color=highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>. This effect can be stacked.
InstanceDungeon_8165_MonsterTips:
Crescent Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> Cooldown. At the beginning and end of an <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>, cast a Crescent Slash beside the active Echo, dealing Echo Skill DMG to the enemy.
Defeating an enemy increases all party members' Attack DMG and Echo Skill DMG.
InstanceDungeon_8166_MonsterTips:
Stagnation Alloy:
Reduce <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> Cooldown. <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color> inflicts a Stagnation effect on the enemy and marks it. Every marked enemy takes extra DMG.
InstanceDungeon_8167_MonsterTips:
Devouring Alloy:
Increase the Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG of Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting <color=highlight>Echo Skill</color>. This effect can be stacked.
Defeating an enemy with <color=highlight>Resonance Skill</color> reduces the Resonator's Echo Skill Cooldown and Resonance Skill Cooldown and regenerates a certain amount of Concerto Energy.

InstanceDungeonEntrance_1501_Description: Reality and destiny fades; Constructions and laws collapsed. Chaos consumed all in the blazing flame, only pain and agony remain.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1504_Description: A mysterious space in the Crownless Statue's heart, where chaotic flames of war are born.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_16_Description: A grand construction located in the central axis of Jinzhou. Not only it reserves the functions of important reception and discussion of major issues, but also sets itself as the symbol of hope for the people of Huanglong.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2031_Description: A mysterious space in the Crownless Statue's heart, where chaotic flames of war are born.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_201000_Descripti: Maiden's tear was caged within the whispering forest. Her soul was forever detained and was tormented by scarlet thorns, which were nurtured by endless malice.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_202000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere preserves the moonlit forest as it was before the Tacet Field consumed it. That same light also created the terrifying nightmare on the second night.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2021_Description:
Laws and orders have crumbled, uprooting reality and destiny.
Please heed our words. One more step closer, and you shall break free.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_203000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere captures the sunlight shed upon the forest. When day and night collide, it condenses into an eternal crystal of flame.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_301000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere captures the never-ending din of countless engines, a constant soundtrack to the bustling metropolis that was once drenched in molten metal.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_302000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere captures the essence of dawn and dusk, as a fiery crystal sparks through the forest, illuminating its surroundings in a blaze of light.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4_Description: A grand construction located in the central axis of Jinzhou. It holds records of all important events that have ever happened since Jinzhou's foundation.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4006_Description: The wise man knows that everything is false, but the wise man will substitute the false for the true, and will learn the lessons of the real battle from the virtual scenarios.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4021_Description: As you stand on the earth of SOL-3, you are surrounded by tales and myths of its past, while its future stretches out beneath your feet. In this endless light, infinite possibilities await. If you choose to take part, you may discover the ultimate answer. But it is not a solution found from the outside; rather, it lies within the depths of the past, the boundless potential of the future, and your very own heart.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4041_Description: A Simulated Training Ground for combat trainings. Clear the challenges for various resources.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4901_Description: Here concentrate the spotlight of the world, and beneath the light are the truths await uncovered by the brave. Or maybe the answer is always in your heart.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_5001_Description: The clever consider all to be fake, while the wise turns falsity into veracity. The same applies to virtual training.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_6001_Description: A mysterious domain from nowhere. Search the narrow paths to find the destination where treasures lie.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_6002_Description: A mysterious domain from nowhere. Search the narrow paths to find the destination where treasures lie.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_8001_Description: A mysterious gateway emerges in the Whining Aix's Mire, providing access to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_89_Description: A large underground research center built before the Lament, featuring a well plunging to depths that reach the Moho discontinuity. At the well's bottom, mysteries await unraveling.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_97_Description: Amidst a cacophony of voices at the gateway to the enigmatic world, faint pleas for aid could be discerned, struggling to be heard amidst the chaos.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_98_Description: At the edge of the Dim Forest, a narrow cave beckoned with a low rumble and whistling wind.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_99_Description: Hidden in the depths of an abandoned structure, a converted factory churns out eerie and enigmatic puppets endlessly.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_8150_Description:
Shilang has been conducting research on optimizing alloy properties.
A unique Sonoro Sphere has emerged recently, and Shilang discovers that the alloys he has forged possess exceptional abilities in this domain.

The Loong Dance is the grand finale of the Moonlit Fair, often led by the Magistrate to wish for peace and prosperity in the coming year.

MapMark_152001_MarkDesc: Familiar scenes now lie faded, stripped of the colors they once held. A picture book awaits your touch to bring its hues back to life.
MapMark_301205_MarkDesc: Beneath the iceberg of thought's deepest layers, all dreams are interconnected. Those neglected in the deep sea accumulate over time, merging and entangling in the abyss.
MapMark_3033_MarkDesc: A Supply Station set up for Acolytes living in the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Butler, the store's Steward, is running low on Sacred Salt, and he's willing to trade.
MapMark_3040_MarkDesc: One of the comprehensive journal databases that requires the highest level of access clearance in Solaris. It serves as the portal to the academic resources of the Spacetrek Collective and Startorch Academy. The archive is managed by the Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System, known as I.R.I.S.
MapMark_3041_MarkDesc: Resonator Nursing Unit is the Academy's infirmary, operating as an affiliate of Rabelle College. It is renowned for its specialization in Frequency Therapeutics. The facility is led by Head Physician Luuk Herssen, with the assistance of N.A.N.A., the Nightingale Autonomous Nursing Assistant.
MapMark_3042_MarkDesc: An open-air trading hub between Startorch Academy and the Roya. During designated hours, Royan merchants arrive with local ingredients and wares, allowing students and faculty to obtain unique Lahai-Roi specialties.
MapMark_3043_MarkDesc: This station is located within Exo Genesis Labs, an experimental field that uses lunar soil samples to create a microgravity environment. Here, prehistoric plants are induced to undergo mutation, enhancing their nutritional value and functional traits. The resulting ingredients are processed at this station to produce convenient "space food" designed to boost intellect, stamina, and Forte, suitable for consumption in any environment.
MapMark_3044_MarkDesc: The Synth Armament crafting facility under the Division of Tactical Development. It integrates Exoswarm biomorphic traits into Tacetite weapons, allowing automatic frequency adaptation and progressive performance improvement through repeated use.
MapMark_3047_MarkDesc: A parking lot for Academy students and faculty to station their Motorbikes. Mr. S.I.G.M.A., its administrator and traffic overseer, is committed to providing upgrades and maintenance services for every rider, perfectly safe and by the book.
MapMark_381022_MarkDesc: The hottest restaurant in Septimont City. Here, you can order a hearty Glory Set, sip on a glass of wheat juice, or even get up and dance while watching a match broadcast. At Solis, there's always a place for you.
MapMark_381023_MarkDesc: A general store run by Madam Danvers, a retired Gladiator. She sees it as her duty to help others with affordable medicines and reliable gear.
MapMark_381024_MarkDesc:
A member of the Plushies Gang on a mission to restore the power of the morph painting. She trades the items she discovers for Sonance Caskets.
"The day will come when every wandering Echo finds their own home."
MapMark_3_MarkDesc:
The Pioneer Association, founded before the Lament, is a prestigious organization in science and education. 
The Pioneer Association continues to collaborate with scientists, photographers, and journalists to explore and document the world's wonders after the Ebb Tide. Their hard work leads to groundbreaking discoveries that captivate global audiences through mediums like magazines, maps, books, entertainment, and interactive media.

Be hold—the stage now belongs to the combination reaction.
MapMark_3005_MarkDesc: Scattered throughout the region, these Wood-textured Shards attract curious merchants from all nations. They'd be happy to pay you with their various "souvenirs."
MapMark_3010_MarkDesc: Jinzhou's Panhua restaurant boasts open stoves and a bustling kitchen, making it the city's premier dining destination. With a steady stream of satisfied patrons, this establishment has earned a reputation as the culinary god of Jinzhou, representing its unique Huanglong food culture. Foodies flock here for delectable dishes and to immerse themselves in local gastronomy.
MapMark_3011_MarkDesc: A store selling a variety of pharmaceuticals, various daily medicinal drugs you need can be found here.
MapMark_3012_MarkDesc: Located in Huanglong's bustling city of Jinzhou, Mahe runs an honest grocery store. Despite being a practical worker, his insistence on using the best ingredients for tasty dishes has caused a rift with his wife. The couple now lives apart, their marriage strained by his unwavering dedication to quality.
MapMark_301203_MarkDesc: The Huaxu Academy's experimental project offers generous rewards. Conquer the tower's challenges for great prizes.
MapMark_3014_MarkDesc: Exchange offices found in major cities, where you can use Interferences to exchange for rare supplies.
MapMark_3015_MarkDesc: A bustling ore trading hub in Tiger's Maw Mine, providing ore purchase and recycling services.
MapMark_3016_MarkDesc: A food stall in Tiger's Maw Mine, providing a variety of common food.
MapMark_3017_MarkDesc: This shop offers a variety of potions and essential medicines for daily needs.
MapMark_3018_MarkDesc:
"The wind whispers, the water gurgles, the birds chirp. Each sound, a delicate note in the symphony of memories past."
Collecting Windchimers and delivering them to Xian'ge will be rewarded with various gifts.
Gather the scattered Windchimers and let the melody resonate again.
MapMark_3022_MarkDesc: An exchange run by KU-Money, one of the Black Shores' administrator droids. It offers high-quality services to Black Shores members and also helps to build the organization's wealth from around the world.
MapMark_3023_MarkDesc: The Gondola Market drifts along the canals, laden with flowers, fruits, and ingredients, native and exotic. The gondalas arrive with goods and depart with stacks of Shell Credits. With each fair trade, they sing warm, cheerful tunes. Yet when deals turn sour, they weep and wail.
MapMark_3024_MarkDesc: In Ragunna, the old Monnaies have long been replaced by Shell Credits. At Averardo Bank, the dedicated teller Mercurio is always on the lookout to recover any remaining pieces of this historic currency.
MapMark_3025_MarkDesc: Rosemary's Apothecary is known for its artful blending of medicine and poison. The owner, Rosemary, is a skilled Fisalia pharmacist, yet whispers surrounding the Fisalia family have kept many Ragunnesi wary, leaving her shop particularly lack of customers.
MapMark_3026_MarkDesc: A beloved restaurant in the heart of Ragunna whose offerings nourishes both body and soul. Margherita, the chef and owner, is famed for her mastery of the Echo Cooker, and no guest leaves without feeling well-fed and content—satisfaction is practically a rule here, after all.
MapMark_3027_MarkDesc: In the quiet corners of Egla Town lies Vida's Stillwind Grocery. Once a traveling merchant known around Ragunna, Vida now lives simply but still keeps a special price list for trusted patrons, filled with rare, hard-to-find treasures...
MapMark_3028_MarkDesc: For a taste of classic Ragunna, this century-old bakery in Egla Town is undoubtedly the best choice. Loyal to tradition, it serves Ragunna's most beloved recipes. Just be sure to respect the local culinary culture when you meet the owner...
MapMark_3029_MarkDesc: Remember, darling, that costumes and masks are mere florid facades. Beneath their elegance and beauty lie not refined ladies and gentlemen, but seductive and deadly perils.
MapMark_3030_MarkDesc:
A member of the Plushies Gang on a mission to restore the power of the morph painting. She trades the items she discovers for Sonance Caskets.

"The day will come when every wandering Echo finds their own home."
MapMark_3031_MarkDesc:
The Pioneer Association’s Ragunna branch is run by the Wutherium Film Studio, a division focused on visual documentation, aiming to reveal both the devastation and transformations brought by disaster.
Wutherium Film Studio captures these endless changes through the lens, encouraging humanity to look anew at the world around them.
MapMark_3032_MarkDesc: A remarkable Common Echo with an innate talent for melody and rhythm, capable of conducting Notepoles to perform any composition as long as it has a score to follow.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4042_Description: A Combat Training Simulation. Clear the challenges for various resources.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4043_Description: An underground space used to test and evaluate various types of Synth Armaments. A modding workshop right outside the testing area allows testers to adjust and calibrate armament performance in real time.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_4044_Description:
A simulated training ground within the Ministry of War in Xuanfang Hold, designed for the combat drills of Xuanfang Wardens. 
Clear the challenges for various resources.
MapMark_3034_MarkDesc: Now, let us shine a spotlight on this unique chemical reaction!

MapMark_4027_MarkDesc: A simulator cockpit embedded with the Exostrider's neurons, designed for training Synchronists in Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider. Through its neural-interface system, Synchronists can safely simulate the synchronization process, establishing stable links in both frequency and consciousness. During this process, Synchronists can measure and record their resonance stress to assess adaptation levels and neural-load thresholds.

People have reported sightings of a large feline Tacet Discord on Mt. Firmament in Huanglong.
According to the Hongzhen Chronicle: ...It is solitary by nature and lives alone... with four claws and a back covered with scales... As its footstep marks glow, the mountain people call it the Lightcrusher.
MapMark_7518_MarkDesc: Collect the Windchimers scattered all over Mt. Firmament and let the sound of the guqin fill the air once more.

MapMark_7535_MarkDesc: The afterglow graces the mountain pass, while floating rocks knock on heaven's gate.

Before the festival begins, whispers of the Moontree Lodge, where wishes are granted, find their way to you. Intrigued, you decide to...

The collapsing morph painting constantly devours and absorbs frequencies and energy from its surroundings to sustain itself. Stones, plants, and even animals stripped of their frequencies are left in a silent, frozen state, as if drained of all life and color.

The stolen colors manifest as chaotic color blocks within the painting. Remove the incorrect color blocks to release these trapped colors, restoring the scenery to its original splendor.

The fractured but connected rooms lead the trespassers to the starting point of the memory, where the first raving is heard...

InstanceDungeonEntrance_8170_Name: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?
InstanceDungeonEntrance_8170_Description:
You found Cosmos, Encore's wooly companion, by a mysterious gateway. Some kind of test seems to be running behind the gate and it needs your assistance.
During the test, Cosmos will provide Echoids to significantly boost Resonators' combat power.
You can complete the task with your friends.
InstanceDungeon_8171_Description:
A gate leading to the world of dreams, where lambs can be seen jumping over a fence one after another, making you feel drowsy.
Please protect the experimental device and help Cosmos complete the test.
InstanceDungeon_8172_Description:
Even with your eyes closed, you can still hear the sounds around you. This might be what people call neurasthenia.
Please protect the experimental device and help Cosmos complete the test.
InstanceDungeon_8173_Description:
As time slows down, the light waves are stretched out—perhaps therein lies the ultimate answer to the universe.
Please protect the experimental device and help Cosmos complete the test.
InstanceDungeon_8174_Description:
In the darkness, someone exclaims, "People don't understand destiny, and that's why I have made myself destiny."
Please protect the experimental device and help Cosmos complete the test.
InstanceDungeon_8175_Description:
"I saw attack ships on fire off the shoulder of Orion. I watched C-beams glitter in the dark near the Tannhäuser Gate." His voice has conjured a shimmering mirage before you.
Please protect the experimental device and help Cosmos complete the test.
InstanceDungeon_8176_Description:
There's no need to fear lies, as the world is built upon them.
Please protect the experimental device and help Cosmos complete the test.

InstanceDungeon_8613_Name: Pilgrim in the Sea of Fog
InstanceDungeon_8180_Description:
"Great adventures in stories have a way of starting off with a sudden gust of wind out of nowhere."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8181_Description:
"Embark on a dream-seeking journey. May you find your true self in this clearer world."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8182_Description:
"Courage is just a consumable by nature, it gets more expensive as you get older."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8183_Description:
"I'm just practicing how to tell you the truth about those fairy tales."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8184_Description:
"The sun rises over the village houses. I wonder if tomorrow will be a brand new day?"
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeon_8185_Description:
"The time to say goodbye has come. This is where I will leave behind my weak self of the past."
Help Dorothy defeat the monsters behind the gate.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_8180_Description:
Beside a mysterious gateway stands a girl who has accidentally wandered through it—Dorothy. She seeks your help to defeat the monsters lurking behind the gate.
In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.

InstanceDungeon_8610_Description:
Painted on a bright summer morning, this piece captures a Lottie Lost strolling under her parasol, the breeze flowing gently around her. 
"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?"
InstanceDungeon_8611_Description:
In the absence of the Carnevale, restless dreams drift through Ragunna's starry night.
"Starry, starry night. Paint your palette blue and gray."
InstanceDungeon_8612_Description:
A portrait hailed as the pinnacle of Ragunna's artistry, yet the Divine Envoy's smile on the canvas remains an enigma.
"I'm not good at photography, for it holds no value to a painter."
InstanceDungeon_8613_Description:
Through the pilgrim's eyes, the turbulent sea is the very embodiment of virtue and passion.
"Try to imagine something you've never seen and let your hand flow across the canvas."
InstanceDungeon_8614_Description:
Adorned with pearl earrings, the acolyte on the canvas casts her eternal gaze upon the painter, her silence echoing.
"Was it my golden youth that vainly gave me the roses?"
InstanceDungeon_8615_Description:
In times of peril, the people of Ragunna rally under her banner to resist the invaders. 
"Praise be to Imperator!"
InstanceDungeon_8616_Description:
The Fisalias do not know of Sentinel Imperator's origins, but in their dreams, there is no higher authority.
"Silent above the wastelands and the mountains, They command the sea to dash upon the cliffs."
InstanceDungeonEntrance_8610_Description:
Beside a mysterious morph painting, you find a painter named Claudia, trapped in her nightmares. 
Claudia asks you to investigate the world within the painting and gives you a protective talisman. Within the painted world, the talisman transforms into various Echoes to assist you.
You can complete the task with your friends.

MapMark_130001_MarkDesc:
Unique Tacet Discord. A Gulpuff born from anomalous data, this creature possesses an enormous size and terrifying destructive power. 

While Gulpuffs are usually Common Class Tacet Discords, this one has acquired exceptional combat ability and a violent temper due to the influence of anomalous data. Maintaining a safe distance is advised.
MapMark_130002_MarkDesc:
Unique Tacet Discord. A Fusion Warrior born from anomalous data, possessing combat skills beyond imagination.

Its dual-wielded blades, replacing its arms, appear almost sentient, exploiting every weakness in an opponent's stance.

The specific frequency it mimicked to achieve such mastery in swordsmanship remains a mystery.
MapMark_130003_MarkDesc:
Unique cluster of Tacet Discords. A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

While individual Cruisewings are weak, their combined forces can create a powerful storm.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.
MapMark_130004_MarkDesc:
Unique group of Tacet Discords. Two Tambourinists fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss—so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.
MapMark_130005_MarkDesc:
Unique Tacet Discord. A Rocksteady Guardian formed from anomalous data, capable of smashing through multiple rock layers with a single blow. 

Despite its slow movement, its devastating force is more than enough to make up for it.

Brute force, pure and simple.
MapMark_130006_MarkDesc: Though tiny, the game cartridges carry so many sounds, scenes, stories, and hopes... To relive the stories from the bygone civilization, KU-Cass needs your help to recover its lost cartridges.
MapMark_131001_MarkDesc:

Complete specific challenges and defeat the targets to obtain additional rewards prepared by Yhoran.
"When you're prepared, the Reaper will not come."

MowTower_leveldescription_1:
The team gains a stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. Upon reaching 30 stacks, all Marks are cleared to unleash a small-scale Impact.

Team I Buff: Casting Resonance Skill grants the team a stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. This effect lasts for 4s.

Team II Buff: Triggering Impact increases all team members' ATK by 30% for 30s.
MowTower_leveldescription_2:
The team gains a stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. Upon reaching 30 stacks, all Marks are cleared to unleash a small-scale Impact.

Team I Buff: Casting Resonance Skill grants the team a stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. This effect lasts for 4s.

Team II Buff: Triggering Impact increases all team members' ATK by 30% for 30s.
MowTower_leveldescription_3:
The team gains a stack of Momentum Mark when dealing Basic Attack DMG. Upon reaching 30 stacks, all Marks are cleared to unleash 1 large-scale Impact.

Team I Buff: Casting Resonance Skill grants the team a stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. This effect lasts for 4s.

Team II Buff: Triggering Impact increases all team members' ATK by 30% for 30s.
MowTower_leveldescription_4:
The team gains a stack of Momentum Mark when dealing Basic Attack DMG. Upon reaching 30 stacks, all Marks are cleared to unleash 2 large-scale Impacts.

Team I Buff: Casting Resonance Skill grants the team a stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. This effect lasts for 4s.

Team II Buff: Triggering Impact increases all team members' ATK by 30% for 30s.
MowTower_leveldescription_5:
The team gains a stack of Momentum Mark for 2s when dealing Basic Attack DMG. Upon reaching 30 stacks, all Marks are cleared to unleash 2 small-scale Impacts.

Team I Buff: Casting Resonance Skill grants the team a stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. This effect lasts for 4s.

Team II Buff: Triggering Impact increases all team members' ATK by 30% for 30s.
MowTower_leveldescription_6:
The team gains a stack of Thunder Mark when hitting a target with any attack. Hitting the same target grants only 1 stack every 3 seconds.

Thunder Mark: The team can hold up to 30 stacks of Thunder Mark. Upon reaching 30 stacks, all Marks are cleared to summon a Lightning to strike.

Team I Buff: The team gains 2 extra stacks of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Electro DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Team II Buff: The team gains an extra stack of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Coordinated Attack DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Team I Buff: The team gains 2 extra stacks of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Electro DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Team II Buff: The team gains an extra stack of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Coordinated Attack DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.

InstanceDungeon_2505_DungeonDesc:
Head to the tower...
The Fisalia descendant leaves only his retreating silhouette behind. He will fulfill his mission.
InstanceDungeon_2507_DungeonDesc:
As twilight falls, all things return home.
Something tells you that an indescribable presence awaits.... anticipating the arrival of ships, people, and the setting sun. It is waiting for a world where light fades and silence reigns. It will step into the darkness, swallowing all in its wake.
InstanceDungeon_2508_DungeonDesc:
Where do schools of fish swim? 
Above the towers, into the silent night sky...
InstanceDungeonEntrance_8700_Name: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men
InstanceDungeonEntrance_8700_Description:
John Wicktorio, a retired acolyte and accountant of the Order, found his cherished Echo brutally killed by some thugs.
Determined to settle the score and avenge his old friend, he's stepping back into the game to make the culprits pay.
InstanceDungeon_8701_DungeonDesc: "What's with all the Montellis named 'Leonardo'? Is there a naming convention I missed?"
InstanceDungeon_8702_DungeonDesc:
"You won't believe what they put on their pizza instead of tomato sauce..."
"What?"
"Mayonnaise!" 
"Ugh, that's heresy!"
InstanceDungeon_8703_MapName: Once Upon a Time in Rinascita
InstanceDungeon_8703_DungeonDesc: "We're better than fate. We decide who lives the good life, and who faces a harsher hand."
InstanceDungeon_8704_DungeonDesc: "The Fisalias and the Montellis may falter, but the Order cannot."
InstanceDungeon_8705_DungeonDesc: "To be a true noble, it's not enough to have a gun. You must have vision."
InstanceDungeon_8706_DungeonDesc: "What is the one thing that bothers you most about Ragunna?"

Activity_1100_Description: Casting Intro Skill summons a Shockwave that pulls enemies in and deals Havoc DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1101_Description: The Shockwave causes an Explosion shortly after, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 600% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1102_Description: Defeating a target with Shockwave or Explosion recovers 20 Concerto Energy for the caster.
Activity_1103_Description: Performing 2 Coordinated Attacks or 5 Basic Attacks grants a stack of Electric Spark. Stacks from each type are counted separately. When either reaches 2 stacks, attacks will consume all the stacks to summon 2 Lightning Bolts that strike the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1104_Description: Lightning Bolts deal an additional Electro DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK within 3s of hitting the target.
Activity_1105_Description: Lightning Bolts trigger a Magnetic Storm, dealing Electro DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1106_Description: Performing Mid-air Attack summons a Meteorite, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
Activity_1107_Description: All team members' Crit. DMG is increased by 10% every second while in mid-air, stacking up to 10 times.
Activity_1108_Description: The Meteorite explodes on hit, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK and creating a flaming zone that deals Fusion DMG equal to 380% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1109_Description: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 2 times increases the active Resonator's Crit. DMG by 5% (triggered once every 0.1s), stacking up to 20 times.
Activity_1110_Description: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 5 times generates an Iceblast (triggered once every 0.1s), dealing Glacio DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1111_Description: Increase the Crit. Rate of Heavy Attack by 50%.
Activity_1112_Description: Dodge Counter DMG is increased by 500%
Activity_1113_Description: Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG by 10%, stacking up to 10 times.
Activity_1114_Description: The DMG of Dodge Counter is increased by 100%. Performing Dodge Counter summons a Swirl Burst that deals Aero DMG equal to 600% of the Resonator's ATK.
Activity_1115_Description: Successful Dodge increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% for 10s, stacking up to 10 times.
Activity_1116_Description: All team members' Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. Taking DMG reduces Crit. DMG by 100% for 3s.
Activity_1117_Description: Attacking the target again within 2s of the last attack increases the Resonator's ATK by 3% for 5s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
Activity_1118_Description: All team members gain 20 Concerto Energy every 2s and will not be downed during the challenge. Casting Intro Skill increases the ATK of all team members by 15%, stacking up to 10 times.
Activity_1119_Description: All team members have their Basic Attack DMG increased by 60% and will not be downed during the challenge.
Activity_1120_Description: All team members have their ATK increased by 50% while in mid-air and will not be downed during the challenge.
Activity_1121_Description: All team members have their Heavy Attack DMG increased by 50% and will not be downed during the challenge. Hitting a target with Heavy Attack recovers 10 Concerto Energy.
Activity_1122_Description: Successful Dodge summons a Swirl, dealing Aero DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK. All team members will not be downed during the challenge.
Activity_1123_Description: Taking no DMG for 5s grants increases the Resonator's Crit. DMG by 50%, stacking up to 5 times. Lose 1 stack each time taking DMG.
InstanceDungeon_8701_Tips:
Gunshot in the Motel
Default Buff: All team members gain 20 Concerto Energy every 2s and cannot be downed during the challenge. Casting Intro Skill increases the ATK of all team members by 15%, stacking up to 10 times.
Primary Buff: Casting Intro Skill summons a Shockwave that pulls enemies in and deals Havoc DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Enhanced Buff: The Shockwave causes an Explosion shortly after, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 600% of the Resonator's ATK.
Ultimate Buff: Defeating a target with Shockwave or Explosion recovers 20 Concerto Energy for the Resonator.
InstanceDungeon_8702_Tips:
Justice to be Served
Default Buff: All team members' Basic Attack DMG is increased by 60% and they cannot be downed during the challenge.
Primary Buff: Performing 2 Coordinated Attacks or 5 Basic Attacks grants a stack of Electric Spark. Stacks from each type and each Resonator are counted separately. When either reaches 2 stacks, attacks will consume all stacks to summon 2 Lightning Bolts that strike the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK.
Enhanced Buff: Lightning Bolts deal an additional Electro DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK within 3s of hitting the target.
Ultimate Buff: Lightning Bolts trigger a Magnetic Storm, dealing Electro DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
InstanceDungeon_8703_Tips:
Crash and Burn
Default Buff: All team members' ATK is increased by 50% while in mid-air and they cannot be downed during the challenge.
Primary Buff: Performing Mid-air Attack summons a Meteorite, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 300% of the Resonator's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
Enhanced Buff: All team members' Crit. DMG is increased by 10% every second while in mid-air, stacking up to 10 times.
Ultimate Buff: The Meteorite explodes on hit, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 200% of the Resonator's ATK and creating a flaming zone that deals Fusion DMG equal to 380% of the Resonator's ATK.
InstanceDungeon_8704_Tips:
Smash 'Em All
Default Buff: All team members' Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 50% and they cannot be downed during the challenge. Hitting a target with Heavy Attack recovers 10 Concerto Energy.
Primary Buff: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 2 times increases the Resonator's Crit. DMG by 5% (triggered once every 0.1s), stacking up to 20 times.
Enhanced Buff: Dealing Heavy Attack DMG 5 times generates an Iceblast (triggered once every 0.1s), dealing Glacio DMG equal to 400% of the Resonator's ATK.
Ultimate Buff: The Crit. Rate of Heavy Attack is increased by 50%.
InstanceDungeon_8705_Tips:
Right of Self-Defense

InstanceDungeonEntrance_313000_Descripti: Deep in the chasm lies the fallen Cloud Shuttle, choked by thorny vines. A seething hive of anomalies, poised to erupt with countless rogue Autopuppets and scour the remaining structures from the world above.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1511_Description: The vault houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Upholding the principle of "Inviolability of Property," it is the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1514_Description:
Phrolova's Sonoro Sphere. 
Amid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1003_Description:
A mysterious stained-glass mirror made of energy crystals.
Come closer. Gaze into me, fix your eyes upon me, until your soul is laid bare—not to the "mirror," but to me.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_1004_Description: At the end of the labyrinth lies a bizarre cave, seemingly the source of the mist. In the pitch darkness, twisted shadows flicker, accompanied by low, unsettling growls...
InstanceDungeonEntrance_6003_Description: An institution where the Order sealed all forbidden books and records, now lost beneath the depths of the lake during the Dark Tide.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2510_Description: A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2051_Description:
Lingering frequencies left by a fierce clash between two formidable forces, now shaped by your memories and taking the form of Lycrosis.
The singer from beyond still awaits on the stage.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_303000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere manifests the wishes of those who drowned in the Lament's abyss. In a darkness untouched by day or night, can a single glimmer of light deliver what the heart yearns for?
InstanceDungeonEntrance_304000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere manifests the wishes of those who drowned in the Lament's abyss. They spread saintly wings, like the tender embrace of a lover's arms.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_305000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere manifests the wishes of those who drowned in the Lament's abyss. It is not a surrender to the Order's authority, but a confession of the world's suffering.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_306000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere records an ancient ceremony eroded by the Lament. At the end of suffering, may all transgressions be forgiven.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_307000_Descripti: This Sonoro Sphere records an ancient ceremony eroded by the Lament. The harbor draws near, the bell rings clear. O captain, have you heard the people's cheers?
InstanceDungeonEntrance_308000_Descripti: The bells still toll in a world consumed by the Shimmer, but the lesson never reached its conclusion. In the dying glow of the evening, a chalk trail comes to an abrupt halt on the blackboard. This is Lahai-Roi's final lesson.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_309000_Descripti: It reveals the Academy's final moments, where Void Storms creep in like a black fog, smothering everything in the dead of night. In this deathly stillness, the Academy stands as a grim testament to the prophecy for civilizations—All that is known shall eventually be erased by the unknown.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_310000_Descripti: In the wake of the Void Storm, the Academy lies in ruins. Desks and instruments drift like ghosts on a dead tide. Silence reigns. When will the next roll call sound? Perhaps no one is left to know.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_311000_Descripti: The dome is shattered, and what light remains illuminates overgrown ruins. Amidst thick weeds, the dying Reactor Drive holds onto a mere memory that it once was the sun.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_312000_Descripti: The Heliogyre, corrupted by Voidmatter, becomes a twisted core of energy that unleashes a calamity of "light." Where light touches, people and Exoswarm are reduced to nothingness, as if they had never existed.
InstanceDungeon_1511_DungeonDesc:
The vault, controlled by the Montelli Family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork.  Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
Inside, the vault features numerous depositories guarded by a formidable array of Echo Guards and advanced security devices, making it the safest and most impregnable place in Rinascita. It defies any ordinary means of intrusion.
InstanceDungeon_1514_DungeonDesc:
The final stage, constructed from Lycorises, is stained with deep crimson sap that seeps into every corner. The singer from beyond has long waited here.
Join her in this endless play, and use your humble strength to defy the raging current of fate!
InstanceDungeon_1003_DungeonDesc: Behind the mirror lies a realm where past illusions blend with reality, yet the path ahead leads to an entirely different destiny. Step toward the light to embrace long-awaited perfection... or raise your gun at it.
InstanceDungeon_1004_DungeonDesc: At the end of the labyrinth lies a bizarre cave, seemingly the source of the mist. In the pitch darkness, twisted shadows flicker, accompanied by low, unsettling growls...
InstanceDungeon_6003_DungeonDesc: A prison built of power and fear can chain the mind—but it cannot silence the song that rises from the heart. Just as the barren desert cannot bury the spring of life, and the darkest night cannot smother the stars.
InstanceDungeon_2510_DungeonDesc:
A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue. It also serves as the seat of the Order of the Deep.
The upper water chapel connects to the sea that flows through Ragunna City, with its waters rising and falling with the tides as if breathing in time with the Sentinel. Thus, it is known as the Tidal Sanctuary.
InstanceDungeon_2051_DungeonDesc:
The music persists, and the crimson curtain rises once more.
Will you dance again with her in this endless drama?
