MapMark_390200_MarkDesc:
In Oakheart Highcourt, tree roots intertwine with every stone wall. Legend has it that the first divine oracle was etched here, and from that sacred wound, the very first green branch grew.
Yet, within this sacred highcourt, a faint, almost imperceptible sound lingers. Perhaps, beyond the oracle, something else lies imprisoned deep within the highcourt.
MapMark_390201_MarkDesc: A ruthless knight who wreaks havoc in the east of Mistveil Bay, feared for its mercilessness toward foes. But who stands beside this savage figure?
MapMark_390202_MarkDesc: A mysterious knight often spotted near the cabin by the windmill, driven by a desire to hoard every treasure in the world in its hidden chest.
MapMark_390203_MarkDesc: A proud knight, standing tall on the bridge. Yet, despite its triumph, true admiration seems forever out of its reach.
MapMark_390204_MarkDesc: A timid knight, hiding in the northeast of Egla Town, constantly trembling with fear—so much so, it forgets everything, even the instinct to flee.
MapMark_390205_MarkDesc: A lost knight wandering the Silver Moon Grove. It seems to have found the answer, yet has long forgotten the question that led it here...
MapMark_390206_MarkDesc: Venture to the Mirror Lake in the grove to uncover the legendary knights' traces and retrieve the five lost swords. Stay until the sun sets and the moon rises.
MapMark_390207_MarkDesc: A special Echo challenge located in Thessaleo Fells. Some report dreaming while participating, while others dismiss it as mere hallucinations.
MapMark_390210_MarkDesc:
Legend has it that, the fate of the descendants of Fisalia is deeply intertwined with the Thorncrown Rises—this tower is one among them.
As twilight falls, all things seek their return.
Something tells you that an indescribable being is waiting ahead, anticipating the arrival of ships, people, and the sun's descent upon the shore. It is waiting for a world where light fades and silence reigns. And then, it will step into the darkness, swallowing all in its path.
MapMark_390211_MarkDesc:
Legend has it that, the fate of the descendants of Fisalia is deeply intertwined with the Thorncrown Rises—this tower is one among them.
Where do the schools of fish swim?  Over the towers, into the silent night sky above...
MapMark_390212_MarkDesc:
Legend has it that, the fate of the descendants of Fisalia is deeply intertwined with the Thorncrown Rises—this tower is one among them.
Go to the tower... The descendants of Fisalia turn around and leave their resolute figures behind—they will fulfill their destined purpose.
MapMark_390213_MarkDesc: "The unfortuante knight left the expedition. Five knights remained."
MapMark_390214_MarkDesc: "The cowardly knight lost his sanity. Four knights remained."
MapMark_390215_MarkDesc: "The righteous knight fulfilled their justice. Three knights remained."
MapMark_390216_MarkDesc: "The greedy knight uncovered the truth. And then, there were no knights left."
MapMark_390217_MarkDesc: Debris of a long-destroyed Lumiscale Construct. A closer inspection might reveal some hidden clues.
MapMark_390218_MarkDesc: Altars scattered across the Shores of Last Breath. Activating all of them might unlock a gateway to an unknown destination.
MapMark_390219_MarkDesc: Legend tells of Sentinel Imperator's descent upon this site, vanishing into the clouds. Now, another presence claims dominion over this place...
MapMark_5033_MarkDesc:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

A dragon-like Remnant creature haunts the peak of Penitent's End for an unknown reason, devouring all frequencies indiscriminately. Twisted by the frequencies of decay and death it consumes, it now appears as a dreadful, skeletal beast.

Once a sacred place, this island is now a grave of sorrow, and any who come for redemption must face its fire of judgment.

Such is Gehinom, the Dragon of Dirge, whose flames burn to the bone, whose pain echoes, yearning for a final release.
MapMark_5034_MarkDesc:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

Once a creature born of Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through the Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.

Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the “Queen of Night,” seeking to cloak the Nimbus in endless darkness to clear all sins.

With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within her garden, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.
MapMark_5035_MarkDesc:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>

Refitted with special technology, this Echo has transformed into a precise and powerful battle machine, carrying out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

Any trace of its original form has faded, leaving only finely honed combat instincts within its frequencies. An unyielding guardian, it adapts seamlessly to all types of combat, and when needed, unlocks a unique component to enhance mobility or unleashes all its energy in a devastating blast.

The Montelli Family, voyaging from distant shores, has seen a wider world—and they are willing to pay any price to gain the strength needed to revive their homeland.
MapMark_5036_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

She guards the City of Glory, a valiant lioness of the arena.

Her body, hewn from the same white marble that formed the Gryphons. Her spirit, forged from the echoes of battle cries and the laughter of heroes.

This is Arsinosa, ever steadfast, watching over Septimont's glory for all time.
MapMark_5037_MarkDesc:
This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
A despair devotee, a fallen soul devoured by an illusory paradise.
When the mask of Dark Tide was dropped, he found clarity at the end of his path—hope and redemption traded with a perished form.
He will forever sleep at the bottom of the dark sea, for there too lies the way home.
MapMark_5038_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A humanoid molded of sludge. The False Sovereign, the Dark Tide's will made manifest.

Born from the utopia of Unity envisioned by the Threnodian, it is a shapeless mass of black sludge given form, a vessel created solely to devour. All things are to unite within the False Sovereign's body and be reborn as servants and children of Leviathan.

It does not think. It does not feel. Only the rippling sludge murmurs its false hymns, eternally glorifying the power of Leviathan.
MapMark_5039_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

A fallen one adrift in the frigid currents, a ruptured remnant in which Threnodian's residual energy resides.

She pierced her own heart and fell into the ocean. But fate, relentless as the whirlpools below, dragged her even deeper.

Now, her creator has claimed this failed vessel, lying in wait beneath the waves to devour the entire world.
MapMark_5040_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

Its core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.
MapMark_5041_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activity of Aleph-1. When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Till its body collapses, till the last speck of starlight goes dark.
MapMark_5043_MarkDesc:
When inflicted with Hack - Shifting, Nightmare: Adam Smasher takes 20% more Total DMG for 15s and 60% more Total Hack DMG.

A nightmare born of Lucy's deepest fears, taking form as the legendary mercenary Adam Smasher. 

As Arasaka's most notorious hit-man, Adam Smasher has replaced much of his biological human side with cyberware, giving him strength far surpassing any ordinary merc. Now, as a Nightmare, he guards the gateway to the Dreamscape, barring all entry to the deepest reaches of the Somnoire.
bossrush2_101_desc: Gain {0}% Fusion DMG Bonus. Resonance Skill DMG is increased by {1}% for all team members for {2}s, stackable up to {3} times. At {4} stacks, ATK is increased by {5}% for all team members.
MapMark_150001_MarkDesc: Among the prized treasures of the Montelli family is a morph painting depicting Hadrian, the legendary gladiator, with his blade drawn. In Ragunna, these paintings have the special power to pull anyone who touches them into the sphere within, allowing them to experience it as though it were real.
MapMark_150002_MarkDesc: At the heart of Trattoria Margherita is an oven Echo known as Bakie, tirelessly fueling Ragunna with its roaring flames and delicious aromas.
MapMark_150003_MarkDesc: To be a true performer, one must first learn how to listen. Give your records, sheet music, or any musical medium to the Aria Mummer. Don't be alarmed when it swallows and chews these items—it's simply its way of "listening" to the music.
MapMark_150004_MarkDesc:
Passersby are often drawn to the delicate hands reaching out from the Averardo Bank. These hands are perfectly adorned, always gesturing with elegance and grace...
Though their owner is just an Echo teller.
MapMark_150005_MarkDesc: Once a lonely Echo drifting through the seas, Lario has spent years without a companion until it joined the Troupe of Fools. All people know about it is its genus—Pliosaurus Somnii. Though the troupe has sailed across many waters near Rinascita, they have yet to encounter another like it.
MapMark_150006_MarkDesc: C-MOSS, the camera Echo owned by the Pioneer Association's Ragunna branch, acts with all the fine manners of an old gentleman. He captures moments in time with care, often sipping a cup of developer solution between shots.
MapMark_150007_MarkDesc: Before they fall into slumber, the Farceur's Faces of the Masked Reverie fill Ragunna's days and nights with their playful banter. As the shop's iconic mascots, they've garnered their fair share of noise complaints.
MapMark_150008_MarkDesc: An Echo boat that quietly glides through Ragunna's canals, offering a safe and silent voyage to all who hop on it, often known as the Water Bus.
MapMark_150009_MarkDesc: Once, when the Dark Tide ravaged the city and Tacet Fields spread like a plague, Signor Octopus's duty was to sound the alarms. Those days are like a distant dream now, yet he still announces the hour with a gentle horn, guarding the city's peace with quiet dedication.
MapMark_150010_MarkDesc: An Echo lantern that belongs to the Order of the Deep, serving as the Order's watchful eyes to monitor the people of Ragunna.
MapMark_150011_MarkDesc: Originally transformed from discarded dolls, these plushie Echoes have evolved to feel delicate human emotions. For them, these emotions are delicious frequencies to be savored with relish.
MapMark_150012_MarkDesc: Spotted throughout Ragunna's streets, the Tubpups are lively Echoes that serve as faithful companions. Whether they are playing with children, carrying art supplies, or working as handy baskets, they bring joy and energy wherever they go.

MapMark_302001_MarkDesc:
Mist rises over the sea, carrying echoes from all directions—songs, the creak of windmills, and the bustling noise of city streets. For sailors weary from the monotony of life at sea, these sounds become an irresistible siren call. Entranced, they steer their ships toward the heart of the mist, unaware they are sailing straight into the Tacet Discord's trap…
But as in every tale where despair festers, a glimmer of hope is bound to emerge. Even in these treacherous waters, someone will break the storm and waves and bring light to all.

InstanceDungeonEntrance_9000_Description:
[About]

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls—why wait? Dive into the adventure now!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22 and unlock Utility: Flight.

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you can invite other players to join the Overdash Challenge in Co-op Mode. The first to finish is the winner.

2. Once the first player finishes, the challenge enters a 20-second final sprint phase. After the sprint phase ends, results will be finalized.

3. Combat is disabled during the challenge. Players must follow the markers to finish the challenge.

4. The final points consist of two parts: Course Completion Points and Ranking Points:

I. Course Completion Points are earned by reaching designated checkpoints along the track.

II. Ranking Points are earned based on the order in which players finish.

[Reminder]

Resonators of different heights run at different speeds.
MapMark_7560_MarkDesc: A weathered sea chest, left in the ruins, seemingly holding treasures inside.
InstanceDungeon_1101002_DungeonDesc:
A precise and powerful battle machine that has been refitted with special technology. It carries out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

Any trace of its original form has faded, leaving only finely honed combat instincts within its frequencies. As an unyielding guardian, it adapts seamlessly to all types of combat. When needed, it activates a unique component to enhance mobility or unleashes all its energy in a devastating blast.
InstanceDungeon_1101003_DungeonDesc:
Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.

Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the "Queen of the Night," seeking to cloak the Sanctum in endless darkness to clear all sins. With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within the atrium, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.
InstanceDungeon_1101004_DungeonDesc:
A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song. 

Legend has it that this bird once had a partner and that their chorus was a beautiful sound. Their names were not passed down, but their hymns were recorded and preserved by human beings. 

Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix.

InstanceDungeonEntrance_1010_Description:

Dango_Broadcast_Jinxi_GroupStage_1: Jinhsi has earned widespread praise for her achievements as Magistrate. What kind of performance will she bring as a contender?
Dango_Broadcast_Jinxi_GroupStage_2: Jinhsi says every contender has their own strengths. A few races aren't enough to call it just yet!
Dango_Broadcast_Jinxi_FinalStage_1: Jinhsi shares her winning secret: "The key is to maintain your pace and breathing. Master the rhythm, and you'll master the race."
Dango_Broadcast_Jinxi_FinalStage_2: Jinhsi is grateful for the luck that got her to the finals. Now she's ready to team up with the other Resonators and bring it all home!
Dango_Broadcast_Jinxi_Win: Congratulations to Jinhsi for taking first place! She says everyone's support gave her the strength to win.
Dango_Broadcast_Changli_GroupStage_1: In a pre-race interview, Changli admits she isn't particularly skilled at racing, but she's joining in for the experience.
Dango_Broadcast_Changli_GroupStage_2: Changli regrets seeing some strong competitors get knocked out and hopes for a rematch in the future!
Dango_Broadcast_Changli_FinalStage_1: Changli says she competes to make new friends, share ideas, and keep pushing herself to grow.
Dango_Broadcast_Changli_FinalStage_2: Changli is honored to compete with such great contenders and will give her all in the upcoming matches.
Dango_Broadcast_Changli_Win: Congratulations to Changli for taking first place! She humbly credits her win to luck.
Dango_Broadcast_Shouanren_GroupStage_1: Shorekeeper says everyone adapts to the Cube form differently. It's not that she has better physical abilities than those eliminated. She's just better at being a Cube.
Dango_Broadcast_Shouanren_GroupStage_2: KU-Lolo mentions the last time Shorekeeper prepared this much was to welcome Rover to the Black Shores. Let's all look forward to her performance in the race!
Dango_Broadcast_Shouanren_FinalStage_1: Shorekeeper explains that since Cubes are mostly starch, too much sweat can make them break down. The trick to winning is keeping your body temperature and shape steady.
Dango_Broadcast_Shouanren_FinalStage_2: Based on race data, Shorekeeper suggests thrill seekers bet on the more explosive contenders, while those who play it safe might want to back endurance racers like herself.
Dango_Broadcast_Shouanren_Win: Shorekeeper says she enjoys racing alongside others on an uncertain track more than knowing the outcome ahead of time.
Dango_Broadcast_Chun_GroupStage_1: Camellya declined our pre-race interview, stating that only winners have the right to speak.
Dango_Broadcast_Chun_GroupStage_2: Camellya states there are no secrets to victory. Strength is the only way.
Dango_Broadcast_Chun_FinalStage_1: Camellya says that the contenders are so boring that she's almost falling asleep!
Dango_Broadcast_Chun_FinalStage_2: Camellya declares that now that she's reached the final round, she will no longer hold back and will tear it up!
Dango_Broadcast_Chun_Win: Congratulations to Camellya for taking first place! She says she had a blast and can't wait for the next race to begin!
Dango_Broadcast_Luokeke_GroupStage_1: As a contender known for using power-up items, what kind of surprises will Roccia bring to the race this time?
Dango_Broadcast_Luokeke_GroupStage_2: Roccia encourages the eliminated contenders not to feel down and to cheer on the ones still racing!
Dango_Broadcast_Luokeke_FinalStage_1: Roccia reveals that her secret to victory is keeping Pero's belly full.
Dango_Broadcast_Luokeke_FinalStage_2: Roccia says Pero is hungry! Spectators, feel free to toss anything you don't need her way!
Dango_Broadcast_Luokeke_Win: Congratulations to Roccia for taking first place! We now have her partner, Pero, on camera: "Pero. Pero, Pero!"
Dango_Broadcast_Bulante_GroupStage_1: Brant says that the finest sailors are just as comfortable on land as fish in water, and don't forget to keep supporting the Troupe of Fools, savvy?
Dango_Broadcast_Bulante_GroupStage_2: Brant suggests adding a little extra prize money to make the competition more exciting.
Dango_Broadcast_Bulante_FinalStage_1: Brant thanks the audience for their support and invites you all to stay tuned for more dazzling performances from the Troupe of Fools!
Dango_Broadcast_Bulante_FinalStage_2: Brant promises to pull out all the stops in the final, so be ready for a show you won't forget!
Dango_Broadcast_Bulante_Win: Congratulations to Brant for taking first place! He hopes his performance left you grinning, and of course, keep supporting the Troupe of Fools!
Dango_Broadcast_Feibi_GroupStage_1: We now bring you Phoebe's blessings: she hopes everyone enjoys the race and does their best!
Dango_Broadcast_Feibi_GroupStage_2: Phoebe wishes the eliminated contenders all the best for their next chance to shine!
Dango_Broadcast_Feibi_FinalStage_1: Phoebe shares her secret to victory: "T-T-There's really no secret!"
Dango_Broadcast_Feibi_FinalStage_2: Phoebe was so shocked to make it to the final that she froze right in the middle of the interview. How adorable!
Dango_Broadcast_Feibi_Win: Congratulations to Phoebe for taking first place! She attributes her success to the blessing of the Sentinel.
Dango_Broadcast_Zanni_GroupStage_1: Zani hopes there will be more paid competitions like this in the future.
Dango_Broadcast_Zanni_GroupStage_2: Zani suggests adding a requalification round for eliminated contenders.
Dango_Broadcast_Zanni_FinalStage_1: Zani states that she won't stop as long as paid competitions continue to exist.
Dango_Broadcast_Zanni_FinalStage_2: Zani feels bittersweet about the competition ending: "Good times never last..."
Dango_Broadcast_Zanni_Win: Congratulations to Zani for taking first place! Unfortunately, she declined our interview to enjoy the last few moments of her vacation.
Dango_Broadcast_Kanteleila_GroupStage_1: Cantarella wishes everyone a wonderful time and reminds them to stay safe during the race.
Dango_Broadcast_Kanteleila_GroupStage_2: Cantarella offers an elixir that promises to bring championship-winning dreams to those eliminated… and it has virtually no side effects!
Dango_Broadcast_Kanteleila_FinalStage_1: Cantarella shares a list of "nutritious" foods to boost race performance... but, uh, are these really what you'd call "nutritious"?
Dango_Broadcast_Kanteleila_FinalStage_2: Cantarella warns that any contender who made it to the final should not be underestimated, so she plans to up the dosage accordingly… Wait, what dosage?!
Dango_Broadcast_Kanteleila_Win: Congratulations to Cantarella for taking first place! She says it was truly an enjoyable experience, and it was never about winning or losing.
Dango_Broadcast_Katixiya_GroupStage_1: Cartethyia says that she's fully prepared and promises to put on an exciting show for the audience with her fellow contenders!
Dango_Broadcast_Katixiya_GroupStage_2: Cartethyia says she's happy to have a friendly match with any eliminated contenders who didn't get to enjoy the race to the fullest!
Dango_Broadcast_Katixiya_FinalStage_1: After her victory in the last round, Cartethyia shares her secret: "Just run, run, and keep running. Don't let anyone pass you!"
Dango_Broadcast_Katixiya_FinalStage_2: Cartethyia declined our interview, saying she needs to fully focus on preparing for the final!
Dango_Broadcast_Katixiya_Win: Congratulations to Cartethyia for taking first place! But it looks like she wasn't done running. Our camera crew couldn't keep up with her!
Dango_Broadcast_Kelaita_GroupStage_1: Carlotta wishes for a smooth commencement of the race, and the event organizers extend their gratitude for her generous sponsorship of the competition.
Dango_Broadcast_Kelaita_GroupStage_2: Carlotta looks forward to seeing each contender's performance, believing every one of them has untapped potential!
Dango_Broadcast_Kelaita_FinalStage_1: Carlotta shares that her secret to victory lies in maintaining passion and thirst for glory.
Dango_Broadcast_Kelaita_FinalStage_2: Carlotta feels fortunate to have made it to the final and announces that, regardless of the final ranking, the Montelli family will be offering commemorative gifts to all contenders.
Dango_Broadcast_Kelaita_Win: Congratulations to Carlotta for taking first place! And special thanks for the gifts. Keep up the great work, Carlotta!
Dango_Broadcast_Kakaluo_GroupStage_1: Unfortunately, Calcharo declined our interview. We wish him the best of luck in the competition!
Dango_Broadcast_Kakaluo_GroupStage_2: Calcharo declines to comment on the eliminated contenders.
Dango_Broadcast_Kakaluo_FinalStage_1: Calcharo states that those obsessed with "secrets to victory" don't tend to live long.
Dango_Broadcast_Kakaluo_FinalStage_2: Calcharo says he will not be making any special preparations for the final, as he gives his all in every race.
Dango_Broadcast_Kakaluo_Win: Congratulations to Calcharo for taking first place! Sadly, our crew couldn't track him down after the race. Truly a mysterious competitor.

InfoDisplay_161000001_Text:
(The inscription shows signs of being deliberately defaced.)
 
The little ones are crying. Their whimpers get swallowed up in the Kerasaur's roars. Thea was right… That damn beast's heading straight for us. Guess it figured out ████.

We can still run. We've got just enough strength left to make it. But the children? They can't even get past the trenches. Once the walls fall, there's no question what happens to them.

…We were scum once. Sold our souls for money. But we bought them back along the way. ██ is interesting. Who'd have thought it? Us old outlaws, ██ for decades, picking up weapons again to guard Septimont.

Myzel's back is more bent than the sword he's gripping. Beccan's lance—the same one that carried him through a dozen wars—is just a walking stick now. I'm no exception. My vision's blurry. Don't know if I can still hit the target dead on like I once did as a ██. We were all ████ once. Time really doesn't pull its punches.

Before we left, we picked one of the older kids to come with us. If we ████ there, he's gotta make it back. Raise the alarm. Buy the others a chance to get out.

The ██'s close now. Well then, my old rivals… it's time. Time to meet ██ on the field.

I wish you, me, and everyone happy hunting.
InfoDisplay_161000002_Text:
(The inscription shows signs of being deliberately defaced.)
 
"Damn it… I told you we never should've let the young face the Blightcloud. And now, just us. A bunch of useless ████ left standing. How the hell are we supposed to stop the Kerasaurs?"

"Doesn't matter. If they weren't shorthanded, we'd still be rotting in our ██."

"We've lived our lives. No regrets if we fall here. But those children… they are Septimont's future. They deserve the chance to grow up."

"Save the speeches. What do we actually do? Try to get them out? With ██ closing in, there's nowhere safer than here."

"Then we deal with this the way ████ do. Been a long time since we held weapons. You haven't forgotten how to fight, huh?"

"Heh. Don't go underestimating me! Once I'm done skewering the Kerasaurs, I'll give you a taste of my lance!"

"Your lance? You can't even talk without wheezing, you old bastard!"

"Tch… shut up. So long as I can breathe, I can fight. And while I can fight, those things haven't won yet."

"Damn right. If we're going down… Maybe next time they talk about us, they'll call us something other than ████..."
InfoDisplay_161000003_Text:
(Though some parts of the sword tomb have been weathered, the inscription remains clear.)
 
To the twelve valiant souls who laid down their lives to shield Septimont from disaster.
 
Were it not for your courage in the face of the Kerasaurs' threat, we would have perished beneath their claws.
 
Out of reverence for your will, we have shrouded your names and identities, erecting this sword tomb to ensure your sacrifice is never lost to the ages.
 
We shall forever remember you. And so, we who were saved by your valor make this vow:
 
Should the Kerasaur rise again to threaten Septimont, we, or our descendants, shall rise to meet it. We shall defend this land as you once did, carrying forth your spirit.
 
This oath shall endure, untarnished by time.
InfoDisplay_161000004_Text:
Gryphon's Fortress, Gryphon's Fortress, I feel thee near,
In winds that stir the banners gold, their song I hear.
The shining banners lift and dance, and sing of battles won,
Across the ink-dark tides, through rivers red as blood, and me on the ground.
With them comes the golden triumph, and my mother's call,
With banners high, let winds arise, and bear me far from all.

Gryphon's Fortress, Gryphon's Fortress, I clasp thee tight,
From waters deep, from the lake asleep in the hush of night,
From the streams that flowed through my mother's braids
From the blood-stained water dripping from my brother's blade,
Those waters rise to meet me now, and they will stay, your steadfast aid.

Gryphon's Fortress, Gryphon's Fortress, I will shield thee well,
With lake and sea and blood of mine, a sacred, binding spell.
The dark tides shall never touch thy breast,
The dark tides shall never wash over my mother's hair,
The dark tides shall never bring thy end!
Gryphon's Fortress, O Gryphon's Fortress, in the unsetting sun you gleam,
Forever kissed by whispering breeze, like an eternal dream.

InfoDisplay_161000006_Text:
Log Time: ████

"You're not Archid. Excuse me, sir, you are…?"
"His friend. Archid entrusted me with the tower's master key and his Blake Bloom before he died." 
"…What happened to him?"
"A TD Outbreak. He saved the people of a village, but didn't have time to save himself. I was all too late."
"On behalf of the Black Shores, I offer our deepest respect and condolences to this Consultant."
"The Black Shores… Archid spoke of you people often. I'd like to take his place, to keep watch over this observation tower in his stead."
"May I have your name?"
"Flavio. From Septimont. Once a Gladiator of the Colosseum."
"You wish to take on his duties?"
"I witnessed Archid's final moment—he passed in glory, without a regret. If I stay here, might I one day come to understand this glory?"
"…We cannot promise that. The Black Shores does not advocate action plans premised on sacrifices."
"I don't care."
"…Sir?"
"I'll stay here. For someone like me, a Gladiator who's lost everything, a glorious death is the best I could ask for."

InfoDisplay_186700018_Text:
Would you be willing to let me use this song here?
It will become damp, heavy, filled with twisted desires.
Let's face the changes and witness them together in the future.
InfoDisplay_186700019_Text:
The emotions of that moment are strikingly similar to the visions of the people who are present.
People's desires differ, yet through anticipation, they may produce similar emotions.
Such a melody should evoke a powerful resonance.
InfoDisplay_186700020_Text:
Intense emotions and rhythms affect the deep sea and the Beyond, plunging all life into an uncontrollable turbulence.
All right, all right...
Calm down, and think carefully: Which kind of music possesses the power to guide and soothe everything?
InfoDisplay_186700021_Text:
They always watch me Orchestrate the melodies, seemingly trying to understand their mysteries.
They wish to seize this power, unaware that the songs in their ears are the whispers of death they so desperately try to avoid.
If they were to ask, to demand, would I give them what they want? Would they accept?
InfoDisplay_186700022_Text:
An illusory beauty conceals the fragile reality.
Does this perfectly matched song, which establishes its tone here, also foretell a future?

InfoDisplay_21010003_Title: Annals of Past Primuses (Volume One, Excerpts)
InfoDisplay_21010003_Text:
The Founding Primus, Napoli the Second

Being the first leader chosen by the Sentinel to bear the Orchestrate carrying Their power, Napoli the Second was the commander who brought an end to the War of Faith, restoring both unified belief and territory to the people of Rinascita.
His ten-year reign brought legal reforms that standardized Rinascita's confused patchwork of laws. Furthermore, by the Sentinel's will, he also oversaw the propagation of the "Common Echoes," designed to shepherd the people back towards a life of normalcy. Under his watch, the Council of Ten was established to balance and legislate between the interests of nobility and common folk.
However, the exhaustive task of laying Rinascita's very foundations ultimately claimed this remarkable Primus. He did not live to see Rinascita grow to its full potential (a point of contention to this day).

The Gilded Primus, Clement

Clement, the sole Primus to hail from the Fisalia bloodline, led the formal codification of the Order's doctrines with the help of the Fisalias. Backed by his family's immense wealth, he elevated the Order's reach and influence to new heights. However, his mental stability deteriorated in later years, leading to erratic attempts to alter the fundamental doctrines—until his unexpected death.
Official historiography attributes his demise to undisclosed and secretive Fisalia rituals. Yet, whether his fractured mind was a consequence of these rituals or the influence of other dark forces remains a compelling subject of discussion.

The Technocrat Primus, Vester the First

A visionary who placed great faith in scientific progress, Primus Vester the First spearheaded the continuous development of Common Echo technology.
His most enduring achievement was the refinement of frequency editing, which lowered the time necessary to bridge the residual frequencies of Tacet Discords and solidified the Order's control over the long-range aggregation technology. For the first time, all Order-operated Common Echoes within Rinascita were able to maintain a state of perpetual frequency aggregation.
This achievement rendered the routine recall and destruction of Echoes obsolete, except in special circumstances. It was a major leap in overcoming the spatiotemporal constraints on Common Echoes and greatly enhanced their stability.

The Carnevale Primus, Pettini

A ruler of extraordinary openness and tolerance, Pettini ushered in an era of unprecedented prosperity. Society flourished, marked by remarkable advancements in technology and philosophy. Yet, as the constraints of tradition fell away, the people plunged into recklessness. With their faith eroded, they started to question the Divinity. What began as enlightenment devolved into dissension.
Thus, Pettini became the architect of ruinous revelry. Over time, the reformists rose in opposition and stripped him of the Primus Seat.
Shortly before his death, Pettini uttered these heretical words: "The Order of the Deep is already a swamp. The statutes, the deeds, the words—they are all twisted. We are beyond salvation... so why not just laugh?"

The Reformist Primus, Podolisk

Primus Podolisk personally executed his predecessor, whose reign had descended into grotesque decadence. Through this bold action, Podolisk averted the fragmentation of Rinascita and guided the people back to the path of unity. He restructured the Council of Ten into the Order Tribunal and tasked it with mediating civil disputes, prosecuting political crimes, and overseeing public affairs.
In his twilight years, Podolisk enacted sweeping theological reforms that would forever alter some of the Order's doctrine. Where previous teachings had maintained that Sentinel Imperator held a high position among many divine beings, Podolisk declared Imperator to be the one true Divinity. As a result, He issued a decree forbidding Acolytes from venerating any other deities.
InfoDisplay_21010004_Text:
The two great families diverged on the question of whether a formal faith should be established for the Sentinel.

The Fisalias argued that Rinascita must not retread the fate of the fallen archipelagos and could no longer endure fragmented governance. They advocated for a unifying faith to guide its people, with the Sentinel as the ideal deity. In their view, establishing this faith would also serve as Rinascita's expression of gratitude toward the Sentinel.

Contrasting sharply with this view, the Abrogati warriors held that the Sentinel was a rare and unrepeatable miracle that could not be summoned at will. To place one's hope in a Divinity whose presence is uncertain, they argued, was both foolish and cowardly. The Sentinel had already demonstrated immense benevolence by guiding the people of Rinascita to new lands. To continue praying for further intervention was inapropriate. Instead, they insisted that people must strive to become warriors worthy of standing alongside such a divine being, facing calamity not through supplication, but through strength.

The difference between the two forces steep in historical tensions eventually erupted into large-scale conflict. It was only when Tacet Discords attacked Rinascita that both sides realized their new land was far from a place where they could rest easy.

In the aftermath of the Tacet Discord Crisis and following lengthy negotiations, the Abrogati and their supporters moved westward into the wilds, where they founded Septimont. Meanwhile, the Fisalias led those who remained in establishing what would become Ragunna.
InfoDisplay_21010005_Text:
After the Fisalia family established the Sentinel faith and positioned themselves at the core of the religious structure, an increasing number of people in Ragunna began to dream of a fish imbued with divine presence. This phenomenon was especially common among the fishing communities who often went out to sea. When fishermen prayed to this fish in their dreams, their prayers were answered—sometimes with a more bountiful catch, other times by safely avoiding an approaching storm...

These accumulating small miracles over time gave rise to a new faith. While practitioners maintained their devotion to the Sentinel, they increasingly directed prayers to the dreamt fish, drawn by its tangible blessings.

Fearing crackdowns from the Fisalia family, followers of this new faith dared only to spread their belief within a limited circle among the lower classes. Yet as more discovered their shared worship of the same divine fish, a new clandestine group arose.
InfoDisplay_21010006_Text:
On the same fateful day, both leaders of the Order, Napoli the First and Napoli the Second, received divine revelations. After deliberation, they agreed that Napoli the Second would embark on a pilgrimage befitting the revelations, while Napoli the First would remain behind to lead the faithful.

In the third year of Napoli the Second's departure, Napoli the First suddenly fell ill and died, leaving the Order leaderless. When the Fisalia family caught wind, a war over authority to interpret the faith was inevitable.

Many believed this conflict would continue indefinitely, but a Dark Tide broke the stalemate. Inexorable in its advance, the Dark Tide indiscriminately overran the homes of all Rinascitans. The Tacet Discords, which surged from the Tides, were so relentless that both warring sides found themselves exhausted and forced into retreat. As each side prepared for a desperate final battle, Napoli the Second returned from his pilgrimage with a sacred lantern-shaped relic which a flood of Divine Envoys emerged, turning the tide of battle.

Following this event, Napoli the Second's prestige soared. Recognizing that their situation was untenable, the Fisalia family initiated peace talks with The Order. The precise details of the negotiation have been lost to time, as only a handful were present when Napoli the Second entered the gate of Fisalia castle, bearing a tightly bound sword.

Following these talks, Napoli the Second's coronation as Primus proceeded without opposition, and governance of Ragunna transitioned to The Order of the Deep.
InfoDisplay_21010007_Title: An Acolyte's Diary from the Avenolium Theological Seminary
InfoDisplay_21010007_Text:
<s>Fenrico's devotion, wisdom, and determination are sufficient for him to become a second significant Priest in Avenolium.</s>

<s>Unfortunately, compared to the other one, he seems to lack spiritual insight and flexibility…</s>

Impossible, impossible! So long as I study hard and practice what we preach, I WILL stand before the Divinity someday.

Is it not right to take the sacred Codex in its most literal form and apply these truths to every aspect of society?

These teachings are the only authoritative truth. I must still be lacking the full comprehension. But once my understanding is clear enough to uphold these truths, They will surely understand. They will surely see me.
InfoDisplay_21010008_Text:
The Divinity is gone with the Blessed Maiden.
Rinascita must have its Divinity.
This... is my chance.
I will sit on that chair.
I will console the flocks.
I will deliver the Divinity's Oracle.
As it should have been my right.
InfoDisplay_21010009_Text:
The Carnevale must be canceled to safeguard the authority of our Order and to strengthen the foundation of our faith.

Only then will the Blessed Maiden be gone forever. Without her meddling, I shall lead Ragunna to a better future.

Merely delivering the Oracle is simply insufficient to earn people's trust. I must step back, foment a disaster, and perform an act of salvation.

When this year's liner is sunk by the behemoth monster of the sea, and the tide washes up horrific casualties, they will understand the punishment I speak of. Only then will I call upon divine power to halt the disaster. As the curtain falls on this spectacle, they will see the truth with their own eyes, and in that moment, all will trust me unreservedly. The masses will instead cheer as I cancel the Carnevale.

InstanceDungeonEntrance_2516_Description: The Spacetrek Collective Research Institute is a borderless research facility, where scientists from around the world study the Exostrider and the Stridergate. It also serves as the R&D center of the artificial sun, Helios. Standing at the highest point in Lahai-Roi, the Institute is built on an orbit track alongside the Starward Riseway, continuously monitoring the Exostrider's great sword. Over the years, countless researchers have devoted their lives and wisdom here, all in the hope that humanity's torch of exploration will forever burn bright.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2520_Description: Startorch Academy offers every student a private dorm room to relax and recharge. Every space in the building is thoughtfully designed to meet a variety of needs. The resting area creates a calming environment that helps even insomniacs drift off with ease. Soundproofed walls minimize noise complaints, ensuring peace of mind.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2517_Description:
The sacred ground of the Roya and the dwelling of the Heliodic Six. It safeguards Exostrider parts and serves as the central archive for all Royan records.
With each operational cycle of the Reactor Drive, the Solisylum calculates its stability, tracks the birth and growth of the Exoswarm, and monitors their eventual return to the Exostrider.

InfoDisplay_30010008_Text: "...Given the recent increase in hazardous weather events across the Etching Plains, the traditional manual operation required for infrastructure repair poses imminent safety concerns. As such, a fully-automated smart operation protocol is being initiated..."
MapMark_3051041_MarkDesc: The abnormal Voidworm activity has been contained, and the Academy's crisis has passed. While the Voidworm has returned to its normal route, lingering Voidmatter disturbances have yet to fully dissipate. Continued monitoring is required.
MapMark_3052001_MarkDesc: Use the Route Constructor to generate a skill-based race track. Pass through all Score Rings to complete the challenge and claim your reward.
MapMark_3053001_MarkDesc:
Minna has just bought her very first Terminal, but she doesn't seem to have the faintest idea how to use it...
Find her in Bjartr Woods and lend a hand before she accidentally breaks it.
MapMark_3053002_MarkDesc: You've caught the attention of a particularly perceptive Terminal assistant. He claims there exists a race track where no one has ever crossed the finish line...
MapMark_3053003_MarkDesc:
A melody, once scattered to the winds, is now sought by Soliskin who yearn to hear it whole again. 
Follow them to a place heavy with memory. Work with the Soliskin to restore the lost "music sheet." If the music returns, the story it holds may finally awaken.
MapMark_3054001_MarkDesc: Mechascout: Transition is equipped with a customized giant mech arm, powerful enough to send anyone flying a remarkable distance with a single throw.
MapMark_318051_MarkDesc:
Certain areas in Lahai-Roi are rich with Supply Chests.
Use your Sensor and the Owlwatch Scanner on your expedition motorbike to locate them.
MapMark_3051050_MarkDesc: In Solaris's data space, invisible offenses and defenses occur every day. Before the malice inside the matrix annihilates everything, find it... and put an end to it.
MapMark_318110_MarkDesc:
Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander Lahai-Roi.
Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Soliseed Plains. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.
MapMark_390601_MarkDesc:
The nexus of an ecological information network designed based on the principles of Wutherium Science. Typically situated in medium and large towns, it detects and models energy fluctuations, activities of Tacet Discords, and other abnormal signals to provide early warnings of Waveworn Phenomena.

In the Roya Frostlands and Lahai-Roi, the Resonance Nexus is known as the Solis Lens Array. These lenses concentrate and convert the glow of the Reactor Drive into usable power for local facilities.

EncircleLevelDesc_1: The traces left behind on the frostlands are the most crucial clues. Be sure to observe them carefully.
EncircleLevelDesc_2: Startled Exoswarm are much like kittens. You'll need a little patience to approach them.
EncircleLevelDesc_3: "White sheep like silver starlight, green hills bathed in golden sunset." Shepherds' songs are more than just catchy melodies. They also soothe the unsettled Exoswarm.
EncircleLevelDesc_4: To the Exoswarm, Shepherd's Staffs are like sheepdogs, guiding them back to where they belong.
EncircleLevelDesc_5: The frostlands are plagued by unpredictable weather. Every minute counts.
EncircleLevelDesc_6: One... two... The Exoswarm's numbers are recovering, and the herd's order is returning.
EncircleLevelDesc_7: The Exoswarm have always been part of the Exostrider. For them, migration is also their final journey.

The Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Screen Armor, Left Arm, and Head can be broken.
 - Breaking the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Screen Armor increases its Vibration Strength Reduction Rate.
 - Breaking the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Left Arm temporarily reduces its damage dealt.
 - Breaking the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Head greatly increases its Off-Tune Level.

The Thousand-Puppet Pavilion has a higher Off-Tune Level gauge. When the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion is hit by Tune Break while affected by Tune Strain - Shifting, it gains 2 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered. When its Tune Strain - Interfered reaches 3 stacks, its total DMG taken is increased by 25%.

InstanceDungeonEntrance_2081_Description:
In the depths of the stars' memories, a mech waits in silence for the moment of its return. 
Listen once more to the sighs of hope, pain, concern, and grief, then cleave the eternal shackles.
InstanceDungeon_2081_DungeonDesc:
Rage and tears. Suffering and joy. Sorrow and pain. All are condensed, along with her sigh, into a single golden frequency.
It gazes at the sky, lost in memories worn thin by the ages. The lost voyager is still searching for the way home.
DungeonDetection_2081_Name: Weekly Challenge: Gate of the Lost Star
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2091_Description:
A shadow from the past, born when the "truth" touched nothingness, drifting endlessly in this boundless ocean of void.
Go to her. Call out her name. Do not let her be alone.
InstanceDungeon_2091_DungeonDesc:
A being who exists only because of Aleph-1. Even that gentle smile of hers has been taken away.
Her name, her identity, her Forte, even her bonds with others… all of it a lie.
Yet, the world will not sink into boundless darkness. The end of the path she walks must not be eternal emptiness.
DungeonDetection_2091_Name: Weekly Challenge: Seed of Illusory Origin
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2111_Description:
Deep within the proliferating Censure Courts, massive shadows formed by twisted minds loom in the dark.
Hear their true voices and deliver peace to these long-fallen souls.
InstanceDungeon_2111_DungeonDesc: A giant Autopuppet that has absorbed structures of Censure Courts. The strong obsessions that bind it can be felt by those who confront it.
DungeonDetection_2111_Name: Weekly Challenge: Court of Shackled Souls
MapMark_5044_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- When Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis is affected by Havoc Bane, it takes 5% more total DMG for 30s, stacking up to 5 times.
- When the Havoc Bane affecting Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis is consumed, it takes 20% more total DMG for 30s.

Deep within the Skyworks, the Myriad Snare serves as a living prison for Tacet Discords, capable of transforming into a formidable Autopuppet to wipe them out.
However, as the Skyworks fell into unknown chaos, all maintenance work came to a halt. Structures of the Myriad Snare damaged in fierce battle have all plunged into the abyss.
To this day, even with only a shattered body remaining, it still carries out its purge without rest.
MapMark_5045_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
The total DMG taken by this enemy is increased by 20% for 6s when affected by a Negative Status.
This enemy takes 100% more total Electro Flare DMG.

He cast his consciousness into a mechanical vessel, fueled by the Reverberations of lost souls, all for the obsession to become a "perfect Celestial." Though the mechanist arts beyond mortal comprehension could emulate heavenly might, it could never transcend its own shackles.

It walked to the end of its road, and this forged body became a calamity unto itself.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2121_Description:
All things unfold by prediction, and all laws return to one.
Where it walks, the world shudders. Where it looks back, the laws remake themselves.
Forms beyond number manifest, all calculated between its fingers.
InstanceDungeon_2121_DungeonDesc: It began as the underlying logic that ensured Xuanfang Hold would collapse according to schedule. When Hsin moved to overwrite that logic, it fought back and broke free, and the data it tore from the Civilization Capsule's lowest strata gave it a form close to the Sentinel as Hsin remembered. That likeness made Hsin waver, and in the deadlock that ensued, Hsin gave ground step by step. In the end it broke the last of Hsin's hold, and Suhsin the Inevitable descended into the world.
DungeonDetection_2121_Name: Weekly Challenge: Ordinance of the Inevitable
WeeklyBossInfo_Desc_10:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
When a nearby Resonator triggers Unison Response, Suhsin the Inevitable gains 1 stack of Paradox, stacking up to 2 times:
Each stack of Paradox makes Suhsin the Inevitable take 15% more total DMG, up to 30%.
At 2 stacks of Paradox, Suhsin the Inevitable's RES to all Attributes is reduced to 0.

MapMark_318210_MarkDesc:
Void Storms across the frostlands are corrupting the Soliskin…
Guide the Soliskin to the corrupted Giant Soliskin and help cleanse them.
MapMark_3051101_MarkDesc:
A series of small printing machines installed by the Academy. When a Void Storm causes severe disruption, they deploy Cube Blockers to protect their core components.
After the Void Storm passes, any heavily affected machines require manual reset. Operators must disable the Cube Blockers to restore normal operation.
MapMark_3152001_MarkDesc:
Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Frostlands Surface.
Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in the Upphaf Life Chamber.
MapMark_5042_MarkDesc:
This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

The station fell like a dying star, burying the dream of its era beneath ice and soil.
The Explorer was one of those who dreamed, who once walked among the stars.
But now he hides in the dark, corrupted by the Void.
Before reason and strength slipped entirely from his grasp, he sealed himself away in the cabin.
MapMark_7013_MarkTitle: Southern Yuan Hills Tacet Discord Nest
MapMark_7013_MarkDesc: This area generates a fixed number of Tacet Discords daily, which may drop the corresponding Echo set after being defeated.
MapMark_3240005_MarkTitle: A Soliskin and Its Mysterious Friend
MapMark_3240001_MarkDesc: Your usual meeting place with Platya. With the Black Shores–Spacetrek Collective exchange program underway, she passes through here every time she comes to the Academy.
MapMark_3240002_MarkDesc: After hearing that the "Lady Miko" might have ties to the Special Response Force, she asks you to consult I.R.I.S. while she continues to gather intel around campus.
MapMark_3240003_MarkDesc: Rumor has it, a few expedition researchers owe their lives to a mysterious "Lady Miko." Platya passes you the coordinates of one camp, and you head there to see what clues might be waiting.
MapMark_3240004_MarkDesc: You catch wind of a “Film-Loving Ghost Miko” urban legend in the Academy's group chat. You decide to head to the screening room to check it out.
MapMark_3240005_MarkDesc: A Soliskin has made a mysterious new friend. Platya suspects it might be the "Lady Miko" herself, and since the Soliskin trusts you, she asks you to follow it and find out if her hunch is right...
MapMark_3240006_MarkDesc: It seems the "Lady Miko" is intentionally keeping her distance, and Platya starts to notice. But even if they never meet, she still wants to give her a gift. You suggest asking others from Honami for insight. Chisa comes to mind...
MapMark_3240007_MarkDesc: With Platya's gift finally finished, you think of the one person in contact with the "Lady Miko," Lucilla. You decide to ask her to deliver it on Platya's behalf.
MapMark_7012_MarkDesc: This area generates a fixed number of Tacet Discords daily, which may drop the corresponding Echo set after being defeated.
MapMark_3170001_MarkDesc: A cavern in Starblind Crashsite, standing solemnly in the biting wind and snow of the frostlands.
MapMark_3170002_MarkDesc: A long, narrow cave inside the Exostrider Observation Station, marked by complex geological formations.
MapMark_3170003_MarkDesc: Even upon the pale land, warm hues still flow. This path leads onward to Ginnungamere.
MapMark_3170004_MarkDesc: Turbulent Voidmatter lies sealed behind the door, entombing with it the dreams of those who fell.
MapMark_3170006_MarkTitle: The Song of Ice and Steel
MapMark_3170005_MarkDesc: Though buried deep beneath the snow, the rusted iron bird still longs to sing.
MapMark_3170006_MarkDesc: Hope is not found in spring, but in deep winter, when life first begins to sprout.
MapMark_3370001_MarkDesc: An underground cavern beneath the Twilight Woodlands. Over the years, the leaking energy of the sunken Helios prototype has crystallized, forming a giant crystal there.
MapMark_3370002_MarkDesc: The battlefield where the Exostrider once confronted Aleph-1. It is now a graveyard of buried Exostrider components. Weathered by time, it has come to be known as Rustbound Hillside.
MapMark_3370003_MarkDesc: A secret research facility hidden deep within the Silent Crag. It is concealed by unique terrain and a high density of Voidmatter.
MapMark_3370004_MarkDesc: A rift torn open by Hiyuki's slash. A gateway that beckons you back into the crushing depths of the void.
MapMark_3370005_MarkDesc: Startorch Academy's old dormitory swallowed whole by Void Storms. The structures remain, forever lifeless.

MapMark_3340011_MarkDesc: The Void Storm Zone I in Solisia Landing. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
MapMark_3340012_MarkDesc: The Void Storm Zone II in the Silent Crag. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
MapMark_3340013_MarkDesc: The Void Storm Zone III in the Sealed Fissure. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...

MapMark_3340002_MarkDesc: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Sealed Fissure is protected by Hiyuki's Resonance Ability. Though not severely contaminated by Voidmatter, the tree is frozen under thick ice.
MapMark_3340003_MarkDesc: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Dimmr Deep sits right at the site of the decisive battle. As a result, the tree's root system is buried under rubble.
MapMark_3340004_MarkDesc: The Voidbane Eldertree in Solisia Landing is severely contaminated by Voidmatter. Fortunately, Exostrider components scattered across the area can be used to help restore it.
MapMark_3340005_MarkDesc: A scientific research outpost jointly built by Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe. This base camp provides full logistical and operational support for field expeditions. With facilities for observation, sampling, experimentation, communication, energy storage, and life support, it stands as a haven to help researchers work safely and steadily during the long-term operations in the Dimmr Plains.
MapMark_3340100_MarkDesc: The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, and deep within the Dream Abode, a crisis brews...
MapMark_3310001_MarkDesc: Seek out the lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to Solisia Landing. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.

MapMark_3350701_MarkDesc: Upon an ancient yet vibrant isle of ruins, follow the feathers that shimmer like auroras. Witness the reawakening of a story that has slumbered for ages...

Use Drift to slide under barriers or Bounce Jump to leap over obstacles. You may also use Drift to swing out the motorbike through certain spots to grab more points.
MapMark_3350901_MarkDesc: A motorbike challenge track themed around stunt performance. Collect enough points to clear the challenge.
AvoidBlock_MainTitle_02: Score as many points as possible
MapMark_3350702_MarkDesc: In the Twilight Woodlands of the Dimmr Plains, the Helios prototype—once lost to a Void Storm—now lies here in a silent slumber. It accompanied generations of Soliskin through their journeys and bore witness to the pure intentions of the first researchers.
MapMark_3350301_MarkDesc: Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Dimmr Plains. Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in Solisia Landing.
MapMark_3330003_MarkDesc:
An anchor was placed here long ago, when the Exostrider first arrived. It is the key to unlocking the gateway.
One day, we will push this gate open ourselves, even if it was meant to keep the danger out.

(You can relive the very battle fought among the stars here.)
KurotatoLevel_35011_desc: A camp established by survivors has attracted the Tacet Discords wandering around. Help them defend their camp.
KurotatoLevel_35012_desc: From the intel you gathered, some supplies are still buried under nearby ruins. Retrieve them, but don't risk your life.

"The End Times have no fixed form. But their harbinger is plain for all to see."
<color=Highlight>Warning: High-difficulty simulation.</color>

The survivors thought they had fully prepared for every single kind of disaster. When the time came, they realized just how wrong they were.
<color=Highlight>Warning: High-difficulty simulation.</color>

ItemInspection_pingzi_2: There appears to be unusual rust on the base of the bottle.
MapMark_4028_MarkDesc: A secret drill ground built by T-G0NG inside the Fogveil Pagoda, accessible via the Battle Shade Shroud. The simulations of Tacet Discords deployed within are of extreme power and are often used to test the combat limits of top-of-the-line Autopuppets. Occasionally, capable Resonators will also arrive to challenge them at T-G0NG’s request, ensuring the drills pose a challenge within a reasonable range.
MapMark_7780_MarkDesc: Enter Somnoire: Night City through the anomalous gateway at Startorch Academy and complete the event objectives. (Replay access to Somnoire: Night City unlocks after completing the Episodic Quest "At Dream's Edge")
MapMark_3510003_MarkDesc:
Rafter Kites carry letters, and each Unclaimed Rafter Kite holds a message undelivered for over a century. 
Deliver these to Qiuhong or Chiwen, and they will use them to learn more about Xuanfang Hold's past and better plan how to protect its future.
KClawIntro_Desc:
Scattered across Xuanfang Hold, Auto Caskets can be used to obtain Automatons.
To restore the Auto Empire to its former glory, retrieve them all!
KClawRule_Desc:
Upon entering the game, all items inside the Auto Casket will continuously cycle along the carousel.

You can control the Deft Grabber to position it within the Auto Casket. After predicting an item's movement path and timing the moment correctly, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Grab button to release the Deft Grabber. It will descend and perform a grab as it approaches the platform. Once an item is successfully captured, you need to move the Deft Grabber again to align it above the prize box. Release the item, and if it lands in the prize box, the grab is considered successful.

Each Auto Casket challenge is time-limited. When the countdown reaches zero, no further actions can be taken. During the challenge, you can extend the timer by using the Deft Grabber to interact with the Time Dial inside the Casket.

Challenges are divided into Standard Mode and Endless Mode: In Standard Mode, successfully grabbing items directly grants rewards. Once all items in the Casket are collected, the machine will automatically shut down. In Endless Mode, items and Time Dials continuously respawn. The machine remains active, allowing free play until the timer expires. Items in this mode do not grant direct rewards; instead, they are converted into Challenge Points. Reaching specific point milestones unlocks valuable rewards such as Astrites.
MapMark_15_MarkDesc:
Interact with Unclaimed Rafter Kites to collect or use, or use Grapple to pull them close.
Rafter Kites carry letters, and each Unclaimed Rafter Kite holds a message undelivered for over a century. Deliver these to Qiuhong or Chiwen, and they will use them to learn more about Xuanfang Hold's past and better plan how to protect its future.
MapMark_3520001_MarkDesc:
The nexus of an ecological information network designed based on the principles of Wutherium Science. Typically situated in medium and large towns, it detects and models energy fluctuations, activities of Tacet Discords, and other abnormal signals to provide early warnings of Waveworn Phenomena.
The Resonance Nexus of the Land of Xuanfang is also known as the Lexicon Axis. Serving as the registration hub for visitors, its structure resembles a mechanical scroll forged from countless modular parts.
MapMark_3550101_MarkDesc:
Control a Kernel Puppet, defeat Sparring Echoes along your path, and reach the endpoint to complete Squarefield Sparring and earn rewards.
Before Xuanfang Hold became operational, the Court of Savantae and the Ministry of Development built several testing grounds to verify the Hold's Autopuppets' ability to eliminate Tacet Discords. Once the Hold went into service, the trial Squarefields were abandoned, left to gather dust over the years.
MapMark_3550201_MarkDesc:
Large mechanism boxes containing Automatons.
Obtained Automatons can be handed to King Auto or stored in the Automaton Collection Cabinet.
Censure Courts often require repairs or replacement parts for their Autopuppets. To train Artisans before they officially take up their posts, "Auto Caskets" have been placed across the Land of Xuanfang. Only after achieving satisfactory results within these Caskets may an Artisan assume their duties.
MapMark_3550301_MarkDesc: Throughout the Land of Xuanfang lie occupied Supply Chests and Tidal Heritages. Defeat the enemies surrounding them to claim the riches within.
MapMark_3550401_MarkDesc: Scattered throughout the Land of Xuanfang are customized Cloud Ride challenge courses. Cross Score Rings to complete the challenges and claim your rewards.
MapMark_3550501_MarkDesc: A scenic rest spot offering breathtaking views. Rest here to capture moments worth remembering.
MapMark_3550601_MarkDesc:
Use the Elseway Shroud to travel to specific Chambers within Fogveil Pagoda.
The Elseway Shroud releases a Disorienting Fog that disrupts Tacet Discords' perception and lures them into the Shroud. Once inside, they are rerouted and confined within Fogveil Pagoda.
MapMark_3550701_MarkDesc:
Use Q-L1NG to rapidly traverse the Fogveil Pagoda.
Q-L1NG can manipulate the pagoda's shifting layout, allowing you to seamlessly weave through the environment and even manifest directly on walls or ceilings.
MapMark_3550602_MarkDesc: A pagoda of mechanisms in the Land of Xuanfang's Eastern Xuan Peaks. Its complex structure spills a ceaseless Disorienting Fog made up of frequencies that confound Tacet Discords, luring them into traps from which there is no escape.
MapMark_3550702_MarkDesc: A massive Autopuppet known as T-G0NG, who has stood vigil over the Sunken Warren for over a century.
MapMark_3550801_MarkDesc:
Unlike the unmanned, autonomous Autopuppets, the myriad transformations of the Fogveil Pagoda seem to have always been supported by some unnamed existence in the shadows...
As to who is controlling this dwelling, and for what purpose have they persisted in its maintenance for over a century remains a mystery till this day.
MapMark_3550802_MarkDesc: You encounter Suyu, an injured Midnight Ranger, in Xuanfang. She tells you that she is here on a mission as an Oversight Officer, accompanying a unique Resonator. Seizing the chance, you join this Resonator in investigating a crisis unfolding in the Skyworks, and along the way, uncover the burdens she carries in her heart...
MapMark_3550803_MarkDesc: A Constable named Weining requests your assistance in investigating suspicious incidents occurring throughout the Hold.
MapMark_3550901_MarkDesc:
The Four Chime Shaftpost is a mechanism structure designed to report potential hazards within the Land of Xuanfang.
Through its Mingshen System, one can investigate the locations of past incidents and collect evidence at any time.
MapMark_3551001_MarkDesc:
Before Xuanfang Hold became operational, the Court of Savantae and the Ministry of Development built several testing grounds to verify the Hold's Autopuppets' ability to eliminate Tacet Discords. Once the Hold went into service, the trial Squarefields were abandoned, left to gather dust over the years.
Lately, however, you've been hearing recordings from the past in the area.
MapMark_3551002_MarkDesc: To revive the Auto Empire, King Auto has a favor to ask of you.
MapMark_3551003_MarkDesc: The Sunken Warren was originally built as a prison to contain Tds, yet human voices are now echoing from its deepest| depths...
MapMark_3551004_MarkDesc: Wenchang is currently preparing the first live-action interactive tourism project in the Land of Xuanfang. If you're interested, head on over and experience it firsthand.
MapMark_3551005_MarkDesc:
The Super Cloud Ride Challenge is now open, designed specifically to push the driving skills of the Xuanfang Wardens to the next level.
Sprint, drift, and overtake—feel the absolute limit roar past your ears on the racetrack!
MapMark_3551006_MarkDesc:
There's no shortage of people in the Land of Xuanfang who are fascinated by mechanisms, and Xubai is one of them. But no matter how hard he tries, he just can't get the hang of it.
To pass the assessment, he's turned to you for help.
MapMark_3551007_MarkDesc: A film crew from the Pioneer Association is currently gathering footage for a documentary, and they need your assistance.
MapMark_3551008_MarkDesc: Legends told across the Land of Xuanfang speak of a eerie tale called “A Street Lighter's Night Walk.” On foggy nights, the Street Lighters tending to the lanterns around the Skyworks often vanish without a trace...
MapMark_3551009_MarkDesc: A squad in the Land of Xuanfang has repeatedly failed its combat qualification, and the Autopuppet leading it wants your guidance.
MapMark_3551010_MarkDesc:
An Autopuppet sent by Skyworks for repairs has developed a glitch after some components were put back in the wrong place. Now it can only move backward.
To make matters worse, the malfunctioning Autopuppet has somehow gone missing...
MapMark_3551011_MarkDesc: Yusu, a Huaxu Academy Researcher, is currently testing the performance of a new Terminal. She needs your assistance to train Puff Projector Echoes.
MapMark_3551012_MarkDesc: Ain was tasked with guarding the film crew's spare supplies, but they have somehow sustained severe damage...
MapMark_3551013_MarkDesc: To film her documentary, Mo needs your help to reconstruct a folk custom known as “Smeltguard's Feast of Fortune.”
MapMark_3551014_MarkDesc: Weiyang and Changwen want to film the Ding Puppets and their stories. Maybe you can give them a hand.
MapMark_3551015_MarkDesc: Using the Mountainpin Stake as a blueprint, an Artisan named Suoxi has developed a new anti-TD mechanism called the "Anti-TD Kinetic Stake." He is currently recruiting testers.

MapMark_3056_MarkTitle: Fake Merchant Stage 2 Map Marker Title
MapMark_3510005_MarkDesc: The pharmacists here give personalized medical advice and dispense prescriptions to the locals.
MapMark_3510002_MarkDesc: A small grocery shop run by Zouma. Day in and day out, streams of Jade Steed Haulers travel between the Shaftpost Yard and Xuanfang Hold, bringing curiosities and goods from both inside and outside of the Land of Xuanfang to sell in the city.
MapMark_3510001_MarkDesc: The Xuanfang Hold branch of the renowned restaurant "Yuan's Flavors." The owner of the place is the Fillet Fairmaiden.
MapMark_3510004_MarkDesc:
The ruler of the Automaton Empire.
Help King Auto reclaim and resurrect the empire, and you shall be handsomely rewarded.

MapMark_3580002_MarkDesc: A cavern connecting Jinzhou and the Land of Xuanfang. Go through the Dreaming Cavern via the north side of the Clouded Cliffs, and you'll find yourself before the Gate of Xuanfang.
MapMark_3570001_MarkDesc: Legend tells of this hidden sanctuary hand-built by Hsin the Moon Fox, where azure waters, moonlit lanterns, lush green trees, and elegant pavilions complement one another in perfect harmony.
MapMark_3570002_MarkDesc: The heart of the Skyworks, now home to the Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis. The isolated platform retains none of its former majesty.
MapMark_3570003_MarkDesc: Built into the side of a colossal cavern, the Central Workshop is where a brand-new Myriad Snare is slowly taking shape.

Enenmies left uncontained by the Censure Cages continue to roam the wild...
Purge these threats to restore peace to the Land of Xuanfang.

KClaw_LuckyBag_Large_Desc:
When claimed, there is a chance to obtain one of the following rewards:
FF Autopuppet Kernel x1, HF Autopuppet Kernel x2, Shell Credit x15000, Advanced Resonance Potion x1, Advanced Energy Core x1.

KClaw_MechDoll_Lion_Desc:
According to King Auto, the Shielder Automaton serves as the shield-bearer of the Auto Legion, always standing at the very front lines to protect its fellow Automatons.
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.
KClaw_MechDoll_Dragon_Desc:
According to King Auto, the Swordsman Automaton is known for weaving through enemy lines, taking the heads of the enemy commanders in the blink of an eye.
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.
KClaw_MechDoll_Ox_Desc:
According to King Auto, Scholar Automaton is the brain of the Auto Legion. Its groundbreaking invention, "Oldton's Three Laws," profoundly altered the very landscape of warfare.
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.
KClaw_MechDoll_Fox_Desc:
According to King Auto, the Angler Automaton usually maintains a low profile, but it is actually a hidden grand master within the Auto Legion. 
It is famous for the motto: "The automaton casts its line. Only those who wish to be caught will take the bait."
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.
KClaw_MechDoll_Lion_Silver_Desc:
According to King Auto, despite its fiercely powerful appearance, the Lionarch Automaton is actually the mascot of the Auto Legion. It is traditionally stationed on either side of the barracks gates to ward off evil.
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.
KClaw_MechDoll_Dragon_Silver_Desc:
According to King Auto, the Rusher Automaton is the swiftest warrior in the Auto Legion. The mobile unit under its command is capable of executing rapid forced marches across any terrain.
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.
KClaw_MechDoll_Ox_Plush_Desc:
According to King Auto, the Wrestler Automaton is the most combative soldier in the Auto Legion and stands as one of its top fighters. Constantly priming itself for the next bout, any ground beneath its feet becomes an eternal arena.
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.
KClaw_MechDoll_Fox_Gold_Desc:
According to King Auto, the Teamaster Automaton acts as the drillmaster of the Auto Legion. It possesses the incredible composure to calmly savor its tea even in the heat of battle—a level of focus that every automaton would do well to emulate.
Collect all three parts and deliver them to King Auto to receive rewards.

InstanceDungeon_8900_Description:
The dream sinks into the deep sea. The reflection wakes before the true self does. Between the real and the unreal, the sharp-clawed phantom slips through the cracks of sleep and never leaves.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"
InstanceDungeon_8901_Description:
The dream sinks into the deep sea. The reflection wakes before the true self does. Between the real and the unreal, the sharp-clawed phantom slips through the cracks of sleep and never leaves.
"Careful, meow! The deeper you go, the stronger the Nightmares get!"
InstanceDungeon_8902_Description:
Carved in white stone are the names of heroes, every echo a remnant of former glory. Sleep now, brave ones, here in the dream, alongside this guardian of honor.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"
InstanceDungeon_8903_Description:
Carved in white stone are the names of heroes, every echo a remnant of former glory. Sleep now, brave ones, here in the dream, alongside this guardian of honor.

It never listens, nor does it need to watch. All it devours is reborn in its belly, sinking into a dream of the divine kingdom.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"
InstanceDungeon_8905_Description:
It never listens, nor does it need to watch. All it devours is reborn in its belly, sinking into a dream of the divine kingdom.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"

In a dream spun by the Divinity she slumbered, until the thorns of fate finally snapped. Only then did she realize: death is just the final, lingering dream before waking into life anew.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"

He still dreams of stars hanging beyond the window, yet the beacon to guide him home is gone forever. All that remains are the echoes of endless struggle in the long, frozen dream.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"

The light that once hung high in the sky has long since fallen. All that remains is an ever-burning husk, roaming the earth like a nightmare without end...
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"
InstanceDungeon_8911_Description:
The light that once hung high in the sky has long since fallen. All that remains is an ever-burning husk, roaming the earth like a nightmare without end...
"Careful, meow! The deeper you go, the stronger the Nightmares get!"

It still dreams of the stars answering its gaze, unaware that past the edge of the dream, a deeper darkness watches.
"This is still the Surface Layer of the Somnoire, meow! Good luck!"

InstanceDungeon_8914_Description:
Here, the final Nightmares gather. Layer upon layer, the dreams run without end. But you have reached the journey's end, and by your hand, every nightmare shall end.
"That gate is already shut! But the most terrifying Nightmares are all gathered here. Time to wipe them all out!"
