MapMark_3651001_MarkDesc:
"Will and sword as one, that the edge follows your heart."
Sword Flight Windpaths can be found throughout the Land of Xuanfang. Head to the start of the Sword Flight Windpath to fly on your sword.
InstanceDungeon_2528_DungeonDesc: A hidden realm sealed away long ago, once the dwelling place of a certain Nethermancer.
InstanceDungeonEntrance_2528_Description: A hidden realm sealed away long ago, once the dwelling place of a certain Nethermancer.
MapMark_3630001_MarkDesc: To trace the anomaly to its source, you and Qingxiao ventured into the Manifold Sanctum, only to find that Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe had been eroded by Reverberations. As the Sanctum, and then all of Xuanfang Hold, took to the air, the two of you fell into a deep valley...
MapMark_3740011_MarkDesc: This is where the Nexus Fox Shadow keeps its silent watch. Here, you can offer the Thousandfold Petals you have gathered from the Heart Realms and interact with it in certain ways.
MapMark_361000_MarkDesc: Nestled amidst the towering ranges of the Eastern Xuan Peaks lies a nameless, solitary summit. Now and then, the ethereal notes of a guqin drift from its peak, piercing the clouds and lingering far into the distance. Legends throughout the Land of Xuanfang speak of a Transcendent who watches over this realm. And this lonely peak, as it happens, is where that Transcendent dwells.
MapMark_3630002_MarkDesc:
A data space within the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold—a "world within the Capsule."
Here, historical data has reconstructed Xuanfang as it appeared two centuries ago.
MapMark_7014_MarkDesc: This area generates a fixed number of Tacet Discords daily, which may drop the corresponding Echo set after being defeated.
MapMark_3750001_MarkDesc: Enemies left uncontained by the Censure Cages continue to roam the wild... Purge these threats to restore peace to the Simulacrum Nexus.
MapMark_3750004_MarkTitle: Censure Lock Crisis: When the Heartbeat Returns
MapMark_3750004_MarkDesc:
Listen. Can you hear it "thinking"?
After all this time, it is still waiting for another round of sparring.
MapMark_3750031_MarkDesc: A cave hidden behind a waterfall in the Heart of Bloom, shrouded in mysterious and ancient atmosphere, as if harboring a seal concealed within.
MapMark_3750032_MarkDesc: A cave hidden in a valley of the Heart of Bloom, suffused with the vibrant breath of life.
MapMark_3750033_MarkDesc: A hidden cave linking the Heart of Ruin to the outside world, where an ancient aura has seeped deep into the bedrock.
MapMark_3750034_MarkDesc: A deep cave linking the Heart of Stillness to the Heart of Frost.
MapMark_3750035_MarkDesc: A cave hidden in a valley of the Heart of Frost, shrouded in a desolate and frigid atmosphere.
MapMark_3750036_MarkDesc: A cave hidden in a valley of the Heart of Flames, suffused with a stifling and suffocating atmosphere.
MapMark_3760001_MarkDesc: The larger and more far-reaching anomalies of the Heart of Flames are all sealed inside an Inner Threshold, and their repair progress is recorded by a broken Dream Fox Statue. Take the Heart of Flames Key from the statue to enter the matching Inner Threshold. Once the anomaly has been repaired, set the Realm Key back in place and the Dream Fox Statue will be reconstructed and restored to what it was.
MapMark_3760002_MarkDesc: The larger and more far-reaching anomalies of the Heart of Frost are all sealed inside an Inner Threshold, and their repair progress is recorded by a fallen Dream Kernel Puppet. Take the Heart of Frost Key from the puppet to enter the matching Inner Threshold. Once the anomaly has been repaired, set the Realm Key back in place and the Dream Kernel Puppet will be mended and move once again.
MapMark_3760003_MarkDesc: The larger and more far-reaching anomalies of the Heart of Bloom are all sealed inside an Inner Threshold, and their repair progress is recorded by a withered Dream Jade Rootstone. Take the Heart of Bloom Key from the rootstone to enter the matching Inner Threshold. Once the anomaly has been repaired, set the Realm Key back in place and the Dream Jade Rootstone will proliferate with it and grow into a Dream Jade Tree.
MapMark_3760004_MarkDesc: Some areas contain more than one anomaly, with Reconstruction, Stasis, and Proliferation Anomalies blending into one another. Only Rover, who bears the Prism of Fate, can repair such anomalies using different types of Realm Keys.
MapMark_3760005_MarkDesc: Smaller anomalies whose spread has already been contained are scattered throughout the Simulacrum Nexus. You can repair them with the matching Realm Key or with the help of the Nexus Fox Shadow via the Shadow Binder.
MapMark_3760006_MarkDesc: At Chenghuai's request, you travel to the Heart of Flames to investigate an anomalous disturbance. Along the way, you become acquainted with a dancer named Mashan and, together with him, step into a strange, uncanny "Waking Moon Festival." There, the two of you rescue several of Mashan's junior sisters, yet the anomaly is far from resolved. At last, within the Lantern Carriage, you grasp the key to the anomaly and break through the delusion buried deep in the human heart...
MapMark_3760007_MarkTitle: Tales from the Capsule: Ashen Fox
MapMark_3760007_MarkDesc:
Guided by Youfang, you recover an unusual Kernel from the wreckage of an Autopuppet in the Heart of Frost, and it seems able to open a separate, secret space.
Everything that unfolds inside feels strangely familiar, and yet has nothing at all to do with the real world. Whatever it may be, all it holds is only a phantom of some distant past.
MapMark_3760008_MarkDesc:
A mysterious girl named Xuanqing asks for your help collecting the Feeling Capsule shards scattered by the Tuntun.
As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.
LevelPlay_686750045_QuestScheduleMainTit: Command the Forbidden Bastion to attack the Echoes

Uncle Fu says that he has a magical item.
It's said that this item is shaped like a scale and has a magical power called Chrono Trace that can make people relive moments from their past...
Activity_101700001_Desc:
"Have you heard? Beneath the Wishing Tree, there's a place dreams take flight. They call it the Moontree Lodge."
As the moon waxes full, Jinzhou hums with excitement in preparation for the Moon-Chasing Festival. It is a beloved tradition where friends and family gather to wish upon the moonlit sky. Before the festival begins, whispers of the Moontree Lodge, where wishes are granted, find their way to you. Intrigued, you decide to...
Activity_101700002_Desc:
"Have you heard? Beneath the Wishing Tree, there's a place dreams take flight. They call it the Moontree Lodge."

Before the festival begins, whispers of the Moontree Lodge, where wishes are granted, find their way to you. Intrigued, you decide to...
Activity_100105523_Title: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?
Activity_100105523_Desc:
You found Cosmos, Encore's wooly companion, by a mysterious gateway. Some kind of test seems to be running behind the gate and it needs your assistance.
During the test, Cosmos will provide Echoids to significantly boost Resonators' combat power.
You can complete the task with your friends.
Activity_100300002_Desc: The new trial phase has begun, and the Hazard Zone in the Tower of Adversity has reopened...

Activity_101600002_Desc:
KU-Cass, a merchant of the Black Shores, holds a piece of mysterious intel.
Scattered across the Black Shores are traces of ancient memories, and whoever finds them may reclaim the lost treasures of the Black Shores' founder...
Activity_102500001_Desc:
Beneath the starry sky, the Black Shores keeps its endless vigil, calculating the arrival of the Lament.
But fear not the unknown—we are born of the stars.
Activity_101000005_Desc:
While in Jinzhou, you run into Encore on vacation. She extends a special invitation to you—
The adventure is about to begin! As her closest friend, will you join the Wooly Warrior on this exciting journey?
Activity_102400001_Desc:
Arno, a special agent of the Black Shores, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on the Lament with the promise of generous rewards.

The difficult landscape requires sharp reflexes and great grappling skills. If this sounds like your kind of mission, seek him out for more details.
Activity_102300013_Desc: Following the Battle of the Norfall Barrens, the Black Shores and the Huaxu Academy collaborated to develop the Infinite Battle Simulation, a simulation training system designed to address the potential threats posed by the residual frequencies of the Threnodian.
Activity_101500002_Desc: Fresh from the Lollo Logistics Headquarters, your old friend Maji decides to relaunch the Lollo Campaign. Looks like your help is needed once again.
Activity_101500004_Desc: Maji, your entrepreneurial friend, has made his way across the sea to Ragunna. It seems he's stumbled upon a golden opportunity, and he's eager to get you on board.
Activity_101900001_Desc:
Beside a mysterious gateway stands a girl who has accidentally wandered through it—Dorothy. She seeks your help to defeat the monsters lurking behind the gate.
In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.
You can complete the task with your Friends.
Activity_102600001_Desc:
A train crashes from the dreamscape into reality, ripping open a gateway to the realm of illusions.
A looming shadow greets you with a grim prophecy: the world will succumb to this nightmare, and night will reign eternal.
You struggle to awaken, desperately clinging to the shreds of reality left in the shattered dreams.
Thankfully, a white cat appears to guide you back on track, helping you find your lost allies. Together, you battle against the darkest terrors lurking in this chaotic labyrinth.
Activity_102800001_Desc: The Ragunna branch of the Pioneer Association is preparing to release a fresh line of merchandise. To hit the sales target set by her supervisor, Alannah is seeking a reliable advisor to assist with the task...
Activity_101300002_Desc:
Complete the Pioneer Project to earn awesome rewards.
After the official update, rewards claimed in the Pioneer Project will be sent to your account on the live server within 14 business days.
Activity_102700001_Desc: To encourage the Pioneers to further share their Jinzhou explorations, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs to the Lollo courier truck to get various Adventure Packages!
Activity_101000006_Desc: The flowers in the Black Shores' Greenhouse sway silently. Camellya stands among them, sharing the silence. The sea of stars holds infinite timelines that intertwine and diverge at each moment. Though there are millions of possibilities, she knows all paths lead to the same destiny.
Activity_101300003_Desc:
Starlight streams through your fingers as you mount the expedition into the depths of the universe.
The gentle twinkles silently chant a song of gratitude, a tribute to the treasured gifts you once bestowed upon them.
Activity_101500003_Desc: Maji, your good old friend, is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan." As always, your support is greatly appreciated.
Activity_101900002_Desc:
Beside a mysterious morph painting, you find a painter named Claudia, trapped in her nightmares. 
Claudia asks you to investigate the world within the painting and gives you a protective talisman. Within the painted world, the talisman transforms into various Echoes to assist you.
You can complete the task with your friends.
Activity_101600003_Desc:
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos...
Activity_103000003_Desc: O Rover guided by the tides, you have banished the shadows of war in Jinzhou and crossed the boundaries of time on Mt. Firmament. When you stood upon the secluded shores, did you hear the gospel carried on the tempest winds, echoing across the stormy sea? Did you glimpse the unparalleled splendor that lies within the fabled land of the Echoes? Now, steel your heart and embark on a journey into the unknown, brave the storm, and carve a path to Rinascita.
Activity_103300001_Title: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men
Activity_103300001_Desc:
John Wicktorio, a retired Acolyte and accountant of the Order, found his cherished Echo brutally killed by some thugs.
Determined to settle the scores and avenge his old pal, he's stepping back into the game to make the culprits pay.
Activity_103200001_Desc:
After braving the perilous sea mists and tumultuous waves, you've finally arrived in Rinascita, the Land of Echoes.
Radiant lights stretch across the horizon, while cheerful melodies echo through the bays and blooms.
The Carnevale is around the corner. May your journey be one to remember.
Activity_103400001_Desc: "Honored guest from afar, please pardon my intrusion, but we desperately need your help. You're the only one who can subdue that evil-infested Terminal..." Somewhere far from Ragunna City, a shadow stirs, murmuring danger. The innocent's pleas weigh heavy on your heart, and you cannot stand idle...
Activity_101000007_Title: If On a Rainy Night a Family
Activity_101000007_Desc: The bitter night lingers for the restless. An invitation from the Montelli family pulls you into its past, where new and old, balance and change collide. In the freest place of Ragunna, the host of the invitation awaits your arrival.
Activity_101000008_Desc: What do the exiled "pilgrims" truly need? Food? Shelter? And perhaps, a ray of starry light, a symbol of hope? Now, with Roccia by your side, the time has come to seek out that light...
Activity_101000009_Desc: What would the Captain of the Fool's Troupe normally do? Impromptu performance? A great adventure? Why not hear it straight from Brant himself? A captivating journey surely awaits!
Activity_103100001_Desc: As spring draws near, a group of visitors from Rinascita have visited the Jinzhou Theater. Before a brand-new stage setting, you enjoy "The Tale of Demon-Banishing Asura," a new Hero Play together. A familiar figure takes the spotlight as the Asura and performs a mesmerizing dance of blessings, offering warm wishes for the coming year with her ice-cold blade.
Mail_400010_Content:
Dear Rover,

Dances For Spring's Return is about to end. Don't hesitate to join in and claim your event rewards. Thank you for your support! 

Please note that Sanhua's Outfit "Exorcistic Adjuration," currently claimable as part of the event rewards, will be sold at its original price in the Outfit Store after the next version update.
Activity_103700001_Desc: To the north of Ragunna City lies Rinascita's largest fishing ground: the Riccioli Islands, an enticing destination for an intriguing adventure. Ready your sails and prepare for the vast blue waters, Captain!
Activity_102700003_Desc: Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to bring you the exciting campaign: Beyond the Waves! Just upload your Adventure Logs at the courier truck and you'll receive an "Adventure Package" filled with surprises at each location!
Activity_102700002_Desc: Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign: Beyond the Waves! Just upload your Adventure Logs to this courier truck, and you'll receive an "Adventure Package" for the corresponding location filled with surprises!
Activity_100390001_Desc: Born of evil tides, swarms of Tacet Discords weave a deadly web, luring every passing soul... Once again, it falls to you to cleanse these treacherous waters.
Activity_103800001_Desc:
After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls! Dive into the adventure now!
Activity_101600004_Desc:
In the eyes of the Ragunnesi, Avinoleum Theological Seminary represents a lost era. Those glorious days have been forgotten with time. Perhaps one day, no one will remember the origins of that expanse of shadows hanging in the sky.

An elderly hermit is writing his memoirs by the seminary ruins. He needs some images of Avinoleum...
Activity_104000001_Desc: The Black Shores has developed a special training program that can simulate dangerous trials in Solaris by using Tethys system data. The program is a good measure of the challenger's combat capabilities under adverse conditions.
Activity_103600001_Desc:
A familiar gateway to the Somnoire has appeared in Rinascita. Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

<color=yellow>(New Weekly Combat Challenge Available. Try It Out!)</color>
Activity_101900003_Title: If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams
Activity_104300001_Desc:
Your journey through uncharted lands is chronicled within these pages.
And now, you have reached the forsaken halls of Avinoleum Theological Seminary, where secrets of the past wait for the right hands to bring them to light.
Activity_Map_Reward: Explore this new area to claim Astrites.
Activity_104300002_Desc:
Your journey through uncharted lands is chronicled within these pages.
And now, you have reached the City of Glory—Septimont, where secrets of the past wait for the right hands to bring them to light.
Activity_104300003_Desc:
Your journey through uncharted lands is chronicled within these pages.
And now, you have ventured beyond the walls of Septimont City and reached the Sanguis Plateaus, where secrets of the past wait for the right hands to bring them to light.
Activity_105900001_Desc:
From the creators of the Second Coming of Solaris, a masterwork reimagined! Step into a world of wonder like you've never seen before!
Dive into the Second Coming of Solaris and witness wit-wit-ness... ssssssss...

<color=#ffd12f>To ensure the best possible game experience, some stories in this event cannot be skipped.</color>
Activity_105900001_Lock: The test server is currently unavailable. Players participating in the beta may access the content once the maintenance concludes.
Activity_101900003_Desc:
A girl called Dorothy appears next to a mysterious gate. She claims a sudden crisis is taking place inside.

In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.

You can complete the task with your Friends.
Activity_101900003_0: If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams
Mail_400011_Title: Dances For Spring's Return - Unclaimed Rewards
Mail_400011_Content:
Dear Rover, 

The Dances For Spring's Return event has concluded. Your unclaimed event reward—Sanhua's Outfit "Exorcistic Adjuration"—has been automatically added to your account. You can view it on the Resonator page.
Activity_104500001_Desc:
<color=HighLight>The Dreaming Deep event offers limited-time rewards. Make sure to claim them after completion.</color>

Beneath the iceberg of thought's deepest layers, all dreams are interconnected. Those neglected in the deep sea accumulate over time, merging and entangling in the abyss.

Now, the door to the Somnoire's depths has been opened—In this quiet place absent of wind or light, a mysterious person sends you an invitation to a film festival.
Activity_102400002_Desc:
KU-Ryan, a Black Shores robot, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on Waveworn Phenomena in Ragunna.
 
The difficult landscape requires sharp reflexes and great grappling skills. If this sounds like your kind of mission, seek him out for more details.
Activity_101300007_Desc:
Suspended in the sky, Avinoleum Theological Seminary has become a shattered reflection of a glorious bygone era in Ragunna.
Step into this forsaken and forbidden land to search for the truth behind faith.
Activity_104200001_Desc:
[Support Period]
2025-05-4 08:00 to 2025-05-23 19:00 (server time)
[Ranking Settlement Period]
2025-05-23 19:30 to 2025-05-26 03:59 (server time)
The first Cube Games hosted by the Pioneer Association are officially up and running! Twelve Cube stars are set to showcase their skills on the track, setting aside their standings and identities, as they fully commit to compete for the title of fastest Cube!
For those who cannot participate in the race, no worries! We've got you covered! You can support potential winners through our official channels! Plus, the Pioneer Association will offer full live event coverage, and everyone is welcome to tune in and cheer for their favorite contestants!
(This program is brought to you by the Montelli Second Coming of Solaris Branch, in partnership with the New Black Shores.)
Activity_101000010_Desc:
A mysterious letter gently lifts a corner of the veil that shrouds the nights gone by. 

A faint whisper from the depths of the abyss waits for your reply.
Activity_104600001_Desc:
The celebration is about to begin. Invite your friends back to join the fun in Rinascita. Complete tasks together to earn Astrites and other rewards!
<color=yellow>(Go to the event page to see the invitation code)</color>
Activity_101600005_Desc:
KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvenirs in the Second Coming of Solaris!
 
<color=#ffd12f>Complete Event Quest "Cube, Cubic n Cubie" for the best experience.</color>
Activity_106300001_Desc: To help prevent another Waveworn Phenomenon on the scale of a Dark Tide, the Black Shores and Rinascita have come together on a joint project: to conduct simulations using a hologram device in regions vulnerable to the Threnodian's power. Thus, you and your reliable companions have been invited to help test this unique device.
Activity_106400001_Desc:
Behold! Wutherium Film Studio Special Feature: Resonators in Combat Edition has officially launched!
Capture Resonators' exhilarating moments during combat, then submit the photos to Fulmine and C-MOSS to earn plenty of rewards!
Activity_104400001_Desc: The Second Coming of Solaris's Anniversary is approaching, but trouble has struck the Cube World! The mysterious demon king Abbowser has captured all Cubes and challenged the legendary Black Cat Warrior. "Step into the unknown, face my minions, rescue your lost friends, and face me in a big showdown! Come on, it's going to be a blast!"
Activity_104800001_Desc: A rumor about Daemons is spreading through the streets of Ragunna, with an article pointing to the former Poets Society—Golden Anthem. As you dig deeper, you uncover a tragic story deliberately concealed by the Order.
Activity_101000011_Desc:
A case unfolds at midnight, an echo of Ragunna's turbulent past. 
 
Now, the city is once again shrouded in its shadows. Only a blaze of light can banish the encroaching darkness.
Activity_105200001_Title: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige
Activity_105200001_Desc:
A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called "Peaks of Prestige." It's said that countless challengers have set out on a journey to claim the legendary title of "Apex Duelist."

"Countless Echoes. Limitless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"
keyActivity_105100001_Desc: Complete Spindrift Tasks to earn Spindrifts, which can be exchanged for various rewards.
Activity_101600006_Desc:
The clouds above bear witness to echoing battle cries, the wild lands remember the footsteps of warriors, and rushing currents carry the fiery passion of the brave. Here, every corner holds shining tributes to a glorious history. The towering cities, spires, and mighty walls forged by the people of the Septimont stand as enduring proof of their strength and resolve.

At the harbor, you meet a quarreling father and daughter. This unexpected encounter sets you on a journey to uncover the rich history of Septimont...
Activity_105300002_Desc:
"Hi, Rover, welcome to the Solaris Photo Show!"
How will your journey unfold in this brand new world? The scenery you dream of, the companions you wish to encounter, and the stories you are about to write... memories will unravel in full color, starting right here, with you.
TaskOccupyGeneralDes_1001: Quest impacted by environment. Cannot continue.
TaskOccupyGeneralDes_1005: You are in Co-op Mode. Quest occupied. Cannot continue.
Activity_104000002_Desc: Tethys's crisis simulation program is getting an upgrade. With newly gathered data from the Black Shores and Rinascita, even harsher scenarios now await those who dare to face the challenge…
Activity_101300009_Desc:
The streets of Septimont are teeming with life. Travelers from near and far have gathered in their finest for the Great Agon.
Explore Septimont in this time of celebration, taste the bitterness of defeat and joy of triumph in the competition, and experience the glory of the arena amidst stunning landscapes.
Activity_101300012_Desc: On the crimson earth of the Sanguis Plateaus, the scorched front of Septimont's war against the Dark Tide, generations of Gladiators have carved their legends into the land with their blood. Now, it's time to walk their path, fight beside the heroes' spirits, and forge an immortal name in the fires of glory.
GlobalFliterOpenTips: Available only while characters are in idle state.
Activity_102000003_Desc: Contents claimable after specific time points
Activity_105600001_Desc: Familiar scenes now lie faded, stripped of the colors they once held. A picture book awaits your touch to bring its hues back to life.
Activity_101600007_Desc: The Fabricatorium of the Deep has stirred beneath the waves, its unrest quietly noted by the nobles and the Order. To prevent further disruption to the lives of the people of Ragunna and to avoid unnecessary panic, both sides held a rare private meeting. In an unprecedented move, they reached a consensus: a full re-survey of the facility must be conducted to inform joint discussions on the fate of the Fabricatorium and the Common Echoes it holds. As the only one to return from that place unscathed, you are undoubtedly the best person to lead this expedition.
Activity_105500001_Desc: A strange gate to the Somnoire appears, beyond which a forsaken Dreamland lies. As Phrolova stumbles into this realm, she finds a host of peculiar Echoes have gathered here, serving as the staff of this lost wonderland. The Conductor chooses to linger to help restore its former glory, while silently awaiting the unfolding of this dream...
Activity_101600008_Desc:
To Septimontians, the Sanguis Plateaus represents the very pinnacle of glory. Generations of Gladiators have stepped onto this crimson land with unwavering passion. Beneath the gaze of the colossal statues of the Heroes of Heroes, they fell enemies with blades swift and hearts ablaze, their blood painting the red forests. Countless legends were forged here, yet few know the shadows buried beneath its grandeur.
At an old lady's request, you track a fallen hero's spirit, retracing memories of a forgotten past...
Activity_104600002_Desc:
The "Back to Solaris" web event is now live! Participate to earn up to 530 Astrites and other rewards.
Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts!
Activity_105800002_Desc: The Huaxu Academy has recently made a breakthrough in Utility tech. Researcher Lanyan now requests your help testing a new tool near the Academy.
Activity_106000001_Desc:
At Iuno's invitation, you ascend to the top of Tetragon Temple to gaze upon the starlit sky alongside her.
Amidst drifting starlight where fate entwines with the constellations, she unveils the revelations and blessings hidden within Septimont's lunar phases…
"You're from Huanglong, right? Hehe, worry not. I can give you Huanglong-style moon readings."
Activity_106100001_Desc: You receive a new message from the Hunter's Den: Please examine the traces left by TDs and track them down.
Activity_103600006_Desc: A familiar gateway emerges in the land of Rinascita, connecting to a realm known as the Somnoire. Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.
Activity_106500001_Desc:
Maji, the idea king, is back with yet another new campaign—
This time, he's riding the tech wave and trying to create his very own smart assistant, Lollo Genie.
Interact with adorable Echoes and submit their behavioural data to Maji to collect Lollo Stamps and participate in the thrilling lottery!
Activity_101500007_Desc:
Who will take care of those poor audiences with thirsty throats from all the cheering and shouting inside the Septimont Arena? It's only up to you and Maji!
This time, focusing on traditional delivery services, Maji is gearing up to provide immediate ice-cold beverage delivery to all spectators. Help Maji deliver drinks to the hands of every cheering fan before the ice melts!
Activity_101600009_Desc:
Beneath the azure sky, amidst towering buildings and bustling streets, powdery snow swirls, while colorful koi streamers drift in the wind. People stroll through the city markets, unaware that they are but whispers of waves—fleeting illusions in a vanishing dream.
A stranger arrives at the cafe and asks for your help to retrieve the memories hidden within the Irideglow...
Activity_102400003_Desc: KU-Ryan, a Black Shores robot, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on Waveworn Phenomena in Septimont. The difficult landscape requires sharp reflexes and great grappling skills. If this sounds like your kind of mission, seek him out for more details.

Activity_106200001_Desc:
After the end of Honami's City looping crisis, Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your and Chisa's help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City.

Activity_106700001_Title: Search for It! Bits of Lahai-Roi
Activity_107300001_Desc: A WavesLine message full of garbled letters suddenly popped up. This seems to be more than just a system glitch. What information does this message contain? Where did it come from? Who's sending them out? What could the sender be going through...?
HelpText_417_Content:
[About]
A window suddenly blinks open, choking messages filled with garbled letters from unknown signals.
Who's sending the messages? What's this noise trying to say? Perhaps by untangling these cryptic messages, you could get a clearer picture of the sender.

[Eligibility] Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
One WavesLine message to be deciphered will be sent daily at 04:00 server time.
There are a total of 7 WavesLine messages that need to be deciphered in order.
Deciphering an unknown Wavesline message will reveal its true message and earn you rewards.
Activity_104600003_Desc:
The "Back to Solaris" web event is now live! Participate to earn up to 530 Astrites.
Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts!

Just upload your Adventure Logs to this courier truck, and you'll receive an "Adventure Package" for the corresponding location filled with surprises!

The two moderators of "Everything Startorch" can't agree on their next feature. 
They want to produce a freshman guide to Lahai-Roi's iconic landscapes. But with the "Voidworm Rider" dominating the charts, could this trending topic be the key to making their feature explode?

Activity_107600001_Desc: A strange land with new Ecoacoustics. Together, we step into the unknown.
Activity_107900001_Desc: Invited by Lumi, you attend a party hosted by Lollo Logistics, only to find yourself drawn into a never-ending festival. Join the revelry beneath a river of stars, and uncover the secrets hidden within their glow.
Activity_100770001_Desc:
<color=Highlight>High-Difficulty Challenge</color>
In the Spacetrek Collective's database, invisible offenses and defenses occur every day. Locate the malice deep inside the matrix, and delete it.
Activity_103000004_Desc: As the people's wishes converge to pierce through the false beliefs, Rinascita greets a dawn unwritten by any Divinity. After you journey through Honami, a city forever trapped within the embers of time, the ancient land of Lahai-Roi, flourishing with new life, awaits your arrival.
Activity_103400009_Desc: A simulator cockpit embedded with the Exostrider's neurons, designed for training Synchronists in Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider. Through its neural-interface system, Synchronists can safely simulate the synchronization process, establishing stable links in both frequency and consciousness. During this process, Synchronists can measure and record their resonance stress to assess adaptation levels and neural-load thresholds.
Activity_108000001_Desc: <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/Activity30/BeginnerSupport/GuideMain/T_BeginnerTxtArrow.T_BeginnerTxtArrow/> During the event, you may recruit Support Resonators and unlock bountiful rewards as your <color=#f6de91>SOL3 Phase</color> increases.
Activity_108200001_Desc: The new Startorch Racing Season is officially underway! Give it up for on-track thrills, roaring crowds, and enticing prizes! Hop on your beloved motorbike and sign up for the race now!
Activity_107800001_Desc:
Kinova, a Biomatic Club inventor, loaded too much student data when training one of her inventions—the Heuristic Expedition Robotic Motorbike - Embedded Sentience, Mark II, or H.E.R.M.E.S. Due to the overwhelming influx of data, H.E.R.M.E.S went wild and refused to be ridden.
The project has since been shelved. In desperation, Kinova seeks the help of the legendary rider in the Academy, Rover the Voidworm Rider.
Activity_107500002_Desc:
Lahai-Roi feels both foreign and familiar.
Through the Academy, you walk in uniform, among the grand dreams of gifted minds. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.
Activity_107900002_Desc: A team of Royan herders has run into trouble while guiding their Exoswarm across the frostlands. Now, they need your help to track down the strays.
Activity_101500008_Desc:
In the world of academia, time is everything! Researchers are waiting on pins and needles for data that never seems to arrive. Who will step up and lend a hand? It's time for you and Maji to shine once again!
Help Maji devise a stable pipeline for the efficient transport of research materials.
Activity_103300003_Desc: Around a Sonoro Sphere, you run across a troubled researcher, who seems to have an important job to do...
Activity_108400001_Desc:
A sudden catastrophe trapped the lush vegetation beneath a thick layer of ice, but the people here, through their collective wisdom, constructed a range of research facilities to bring life back to this icy land...
However, low temperatures have caused damage and breakage to the lines that power the facilities.
You decide to do what you can to help repair these power lines, so that the research here can carry on uninterrupted.
Activity_107100001_Desc:
Green and hazy as they may feel, school days always shine like gems in the river of memory. Those stories drift among the stars, your constant companions through every quiet night.
As the New Solar Celebration unfolds, fresh little tales begin to blossom between you and your friends...
Activity_101300018_Desc: The frostlands of Lahai-Roi beckon the curious. Many find their eyes fixed upon the endless white expanses. Truth seekers walk this polar region, one step at a time, chasing but echoes of truth in this land of snow where silence reigns. Now, join them in their exploration of the frostlands and go where no one has ever been before.
Activity_108700001_Desc: Lately, "Stellar Orbit Beats" has been taking the Mind Dive Arcade by storm! It's officially the go-to game for everyone to unwind and have fun here at the Academy. Got a free minute between classes? Grab your friends and let the rhythm carry you on a trip through the stars!

Dive into the celebration and claim your bounty of rewards!
Activity_109600001_Desc:
For the couriers of Lollo Logistics, no hardship is too great, no obstacle too steep. Their resolve to deliver never wavers. As the collab season between Second Coming of Solaris and Lollo Logistics takes flight, their most demanding rush has begun...
Complete the assigned tasks and claim your delivery rewards!
Activity_102700006_Desc: Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign: Beyond the Waves! Upload the Adventure Logs obtained by completing daily tasks, and you'll receive an "Adventure Package" for the corresponding location filled with surprises!
Activity_109400001_Desc:
Guided by the orbit, led by luck, and fueled by romanticism.
This is the great adventure—a vibrant trek across the galaxy.
Time to let the sea of stars bounce in rhythm with your heart!
Mail_400039_Content: Dear Rover, the limited-time reward period for the {0} event is coming to a close. Don't hesitate to join in and claim your event rewards. Thank you for the support!

Activity_110100002_Desc: "PRAGMATA," "Riders Republic," and "HAIKYU!!" (anime) Collab Event. Complete tasks in the Collab Event to obtain the corresponding Collab Livery and various leveling Materials.
Activity_109900001_Desc: As frequencies spill forth from the Somnoire, Lucy seeks your assistance in breaching the dreamscape to contain the problem.
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_1: Sure, simple lines of code are capable of simulating Night City's basest joys: power, influence, fat paychecks, sprawling villas, floor-to-ceiling windows, the list goes on. But no matrix, no algorithm, no matter how complex, can model the human heart. Gotta ask yourself a simple question: Would you rather live in peace as a nobody, or go down for all times in a blaze of glory?
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_2: Gonks who might mistake this place as an oasis, as some escape from their troubles, will learn the hard way. There's no such thing as a "fresh start." Toss aside your past life all you want, but old debts will always come due.
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_3: Sit down, close your eyes, get your eddies at the ready, and witness your wildest fantasies turn to reality in an instant. How long will it last, you ask? Depends how many BDs you can pony up for.
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_4: Between the restlessness of a neon-soaked city and the peace of a distant moon, what would you choose? A girl already accustomed to the grime of those streets looked up to moon one day and made her choice. She eventually reached her goal, but the price proved far more costly than she could've imagined.
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_5: Money and the luxuries it provides don't extend into this barren land of nightmares. But maybe life on the road isn't so bad. Riding a motorcycle, chromatic rock blasting at max volume – sounds preem, no doubt. Just don't let any ghouls hiding in roadside ditches leave you with a flat.
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_6: Dismantled, reassembled, redundancies removed – only acid rain and the relics of industry remain. Above shimmers a digital paradise in a sea of stars. While, below, a hellscape of concrete and steel burns and scars.
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_7: Filter out the noise, peel back the layers. Might be surprised to discover no one cares about the truth. Out there, the toxic fumes of desire rise like a haze from the streets. Either you choose to keep running, or sin and suffering will catch up to you.
IntrusionProtocolActivity_LevelDesc_8: In this city, even the digital can dream. Data, whether stored on a server or in a meat brain, inevitably tries to carve a path for itself forward. How and why does this always happen? Does code have a soul?
Activity_110500001_Desc:
Every fragment of Xuanfang Hold stands as a witness, recording the city's every smallest collapse, bearing testament to how solemnly it marches toward ruin.
Gather these fragments and piece together the image of Xuanfang Hold, its past, its present, and its future.
Activity_110500002_Desc: The Black Shores has developed a special training program that can simulate dangerous trials in Solaris by using Tethys system data. The program is a good measure of the challenger's combat capabilities under adverse conditions.
Activity_111100001_Desc: Complete Main Quests and Companion Stories to advance the progress and claim rewards
Activity_108400003_Desc:
Journey deep into the silent cave and help guide the Jadeplume Eagle out of danger and back to its nest. And win Astrites in the process!
Complete event tasks to win Advanced Sealed Tubes and more.
Activity_103400010_Desc: A secret drill ground built by T-G0NG inside the Fogveil Pagoda, accessible via the Battle Shade Shroud. The simulations of Tacet Discords deployed within are of extreme power and are often used to test the combat limits of top-of-the-line Autopuppets. Occasionally, capable Resonators will also arrive to challenge them at T-G0NG’s request, ensuring the drills pose a challenge within a reasonable range.
Activity_101500009_Desc: Although a work reassignment has kept him from traveling to Xuanfang for now, Maji of Lollo Logistics has still prepared a new campaign for his old friends.
Activity_106400002_Desc:
Behold! Wutherium Film Studio Special Feature: Resonators in Combat Edition is back for a limited time!
Capture Resonators' exhilarating moments during combat, then submit the photos to Fulmine and C-MOSS to earn plenty of rewards!
Activity_111200001_Desc: This is an open-ended test of ability diversity, a simulated experiment that keeps iterating under layer upon layer of interference. The Tethys System continuously supplies interference sources of every kind, free for participants to tap into and combine as they explore ever richer structures of ability. Every type of ability you bring online opens up new possibilities for the whole.
Activity_111300001_Desc: With Encore's help, the Second Coming of Solaris has built a Wooly Stage for the Cubie Wars. On this stage, the Cubie Warriors will make use of magical items to wage a fierce battle!
HelpText_652_Content:
[About]
With Encore's help, the Second Coming of Solaris has built a Wooly Stage for the Cubie Wars. On this stage, the Cubie Warriors will make use of magical items to wage a fierce battle!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14

[Event Rules]
1. Once the event begins, access the event page, then head to the Second Coming of Solaris to embark on an adventure.
2. You can unlock various Cubie Warriors by progressing through levels and challenging different foes.
3. If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.

[Instructions]
1. Rule Summary: Each Round has two phases: Store and Battle. Build your Storybook by buying, placing, and synthesizing Items, and win as many battles as you can before you run out of Retries.
2. Store: During the Store Phase, use Coins to buy Items, refresh the Store, and lock or sell Items. You receive Coins each round. Buy Items, then drag them onto the Book Page and adjust their position. Items must be fully placed on the Book Page.
3. Storage Box: Purchased Items you don't want to equip can go in the Storage Box. Items there won't be used in battle.
4. Synthesis: Some Items can be synthesized. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} an Item to view its synthesis recipe. Once the conditions are met, you can manually synthesize it into a higher-quality Item.
5. Star Effect: Some Items have a Star mark. Placing the right type of Item in a slot marked by Star triggers its bonus effect.
6. Cost: Weapon Items each have a cost, and the cost limit rises as Rounds progress. If your Weapons' total cost exceeds the limit, you can't enter the match.
7. Auto Battle: Once battle begins, you can't control your character manually — Items in your Storybook attack, defend, heal, or apply status effects automatically based on their cooldowns and trigger conditions. After the battle, review the damage sources and Item triggers, then refine your build by buying, selling, and synthesizing Items.
8. Victory Condition: In each battle, whoever depletes the opponent's HP first wins, earning 1 Trophy. Reach the Trophy count required for the current Stage to win the challenge. Losing costs you 1 Retry, and running out of Retries ends the challenge in defeat.
HelpText_682_Content:
Cubie Wars Collection
1. Unlocking Items: The first time you synthesize a locked Item in a match, that Item is unlocked and added to the Collection.
2. Role Filter: You can filter the list by Adventure Roles to find Items for a specific Role.
3. Role Guide: The Role Guide page shows recommended builds, core Items, and endgame lineups for each Role.
Activity_101300025_Desc:
Here Mengzhou's mountains and rivers, its woods and wilds, meet its pavilions and towers, the very place the people of Mengzhou, bound to one another across time, make their homes and live out their lives. Peace and quiet, ardor and flame, despondency and sorrow, every feeling there is settles into a Heart Realm of its own, continuing without end. In this small world, the Court of Savantae and Hsin are shaping the face of Mengzhou anew.
This is the Simulacrum Nexus.
Activity_108400004_Desc:
The "Waking Moon Fishing" web event is live now! Participate to win Astrites and more!
The Waking Moon Festival begins right on schedule, its lanterns bright as day. Before you stands a mysterious stall...
Participate in the fishing challenge and unlock entries in the Fishing Index to win Astrites! And complete event tasks to win Advanced Sealed Tubes and more.
HelpText_654_Content:
[About]
The Imitative Sonic Device left by the Court of Savantae can simulate powerful enemies. The Data Set obtained in this battle can be exchanged for various rewards in the Simulation Training Store.

[How to Unclock]
Unlocking any difficulty level in Tactical Hologram: Calamity will automatically unlock all other challenges up to that same level. Successfully clearing a difficulty level will also grant all first-time completion rewards for the lower difficulty tiers beneath it.
Activity_101900004_Desc:
The Ivory Gatekeeper has sent you an SOS over WavesLine! The gate in the depths of the Somnoire—the one that should never be opened, the one you once shut—has somehow come open again. Now, terrifying Nightmares are once again running rampant in the Somnoire...
In this challenge, you can choose "Support Echoes" to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.
This event can be completed in Co-Op Mode.
Activity_102700007_Title: Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang
Activity_102700007_Desc: Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign, Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang! Upload Adventure Logs obtained by completing daily tasks, and you'll receive an "Adventure Package" for the corresponding location filled with surprises!
Activity_111800001_Desc:
Looming over the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, the Nexus Fox Shadow watches the realm with cold detachment. Everything within the Heart Realms is born of Hsin's heart, and shifts as it does. This towering shadow, a manifestation of the heart, is bound up in that same interplay, shaping and shaped by the Heart Realms in turn.
However, a conversation with a Celestial from the Court of Savantae has revealed something new: the Fox Shadow reacts to a specific token within the Simulacrum Nexus...
Activity_105900002_Title: Second Coming of Solaris: Coded Deception
Activity_105900002_Desc: A brand-new version of Second Coming of Solaris like you've never seen is coming soon! What are you waiting for? Come give it a try!
Activity_105900002_Lock: The test server is currently unavailable. Players participating in the beta may access the content once the maintenance concludes.
Activity_101000012_Desc: Following the resolution of anomalies of the Simulacrum Nexus, a mysterious girl sends you a WavesLine message, claiming she "has a favor to ask." As the matter unfolds, a story about Hsin the Moon Fox, the past Sentinel, comes to light.
DangoBrwal_PreOpenTips: You can skip the event tutorial quest and jump straight into the event.
DangoBrwal_QuestTips: Complete Tutorial Quest "Cubie Wars" for the best experience
Flow_31000154_3: I'm Shui, an honorary member of the Overdash Club.
Flow_31000154_4: Actions speak louder than words. Let's get you Overdashing right away to feel the thrill!
Flow_31000154_5: Just to confirm, you're here because of our ad, right?
Flow_31000154_7: It's no surprise you're drawn to such an exciting event.
Flow_31000154_8: Hmm, looks like we need to ramp up our promotions...
Flow_31000154_9: But hey, now that you're here, why not give it a shot? It's free, after all!
Flow_31000154_10: I wish you'd put it a bit more tactfully...
Flow_31000154_11: Alright, let me run you through the event rules!
Flow_31000154_12: Overdash is all about racing through the air using Grapples to show off your skills.
Flow_31000154_14: Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Flow_31000154_16: Hold on. Let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development.
Flow_31000154_17: Fantastic! By the way, let me show you the official documents from the Ministry of Development. We've got the green light!
Flow_31000154_21: A-Anyway, trust me! We've got all the permits!
Flow_31000154_22: As long as we stick to the designated area, we are good to go.
Flow_31000154_23: This time, we're racing on an "Easy" track on the outskirts of Jinzhou, perfect for beginners like you!
Flow_31000154_24: Normally, I'd guide newbies through their first Overdash, but I need to track down those documents, you know...
Flow_31000154_25: So, here's a trick instead. Pay attention, and stay safe, okay?
Flow_31000154_51: Step 1: Assess your surroundings. Step 2: Get your hook ready. Step 3: Warm up. Step 4: Let's go! Always keep an eye out for the next Grapple Point.
Flow_31000154_52: If you can't spot it, use your Glider for a better view. And remember, don't retract it mid-air or you'll fall straight down!
Flow_31000154_53: Even though it's a race, safety is priority number one. Got it?
Flow_31000154_54: It's normal to feel dizzy at first. I've got some antiemetics just in case. Hopefully, you won't need them...
Flow_31000154_56: Alright, get ready for your first Overdash! Meet me at the outskirts. Don't stand me up!
Flow_31000154_66: Can't be more familiar. Shall we start now?
Flow_31000154_69: Alright, here we are at the starting line. Feeling those butterflies fluttering?
Flow_31000154_70: Haha, every time I'm about to kick off an Overdash challenge, those nerves hit me like a wave!

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_120_2: {PlayerName}, we need to keep an eye out for anything unusual.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_125_1: This vase on the stone table seems rather peculiar.

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_4: Relax, they're our honored guests. No need to be tense.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_5: In a single day, we've greeted both the Magistrate of Jinzhou and her trusted Counselor in Hongzhen. I can only assume something significant happened.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_7: I heard you stepped down from your position and moved to the countryside.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_8: And now here we are, meeting again after all this time, in such unfortunate circumstances...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_9: For years I lived secluded, no longer concerning myself with the matters beyond Hongzhen.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_10: But the current situation in Jinzhou is volatile. It has reunited us in an unpredictable moment.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_11: And you, young {Male=sir;Female=lady}... What shall I call you?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_14: My name is Xinyi. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_15: Please follow me this way. It's not safe to talk here.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_1: ...Please pardon my rudeness earlier. I... I didn't know you  were here to help Madam Magistrate.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_3: You were just doing your job.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_5: First the Temporal Disruption, and now the Fractsidus. When will we ever get a break? If trouble finds us again, our people won't stand a chance.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_6: Anyway, I still want to make it up to you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_141_7: Just give me a call if you need anything at Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_1: How are you feeling, Xiangping? Are you hurt? I'll call for help.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_4: Don't worry, my dear. No need to trouble the young ones.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_5: We were in a hurry and accidents happen. I'll be fine. I can handle it myself.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_6: But... Are you sure? You've been feeling unwell for years, and now...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_7: Well, we're alive at least. Can't complain. A few scrapes and bruises are nothing compared to what could've happened.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_8: Goodness, that kind young lady saved our lives from the Disruption. If it weren't for her, I wouldn't still be breathing today.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_9: A kind young lady? You mean...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_10: Oh, come on. That's not just any young lady. She's the Magistrate of Jinzhou!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_142_11: ...Oh, my, so she is our Magistrate? She looked so young...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_1: You there, young {Male=man;Female=lady}. I bet you have more important things to do. Don't let an old man like me hold you back. Go and accomplish your tasks with purpose.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_3: My eyes may be old and blurry, but my mind is sharp as ever.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_4: I've lived my whole life in Mt. Firmament, but people are all the same no matter where you go. Our actions reveal our true character.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_5: And now, at this crucial turning point for Mt. Firmament, your arrival... Yes... It is no mere coincidence.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_143_6: In these troubled times, you may hold the key to bring about much-needed change.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_1: I believe you are here for Magistrate Jinhsi?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_2: The Magistrate left Hongzhen about fifteen minutes ago. She should be at the Truthseeker's Pass now.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_4: That's what they call it in Hongzhen. You might know it better as the ruins of a Court of Savantae facility.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_9: How's the situation? Have we evacuated all the civilians?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_10: Yes. Remaining civilians have been counted and escorted to safety.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_11: Good. These hidden chambers should provide some much-needed shelter for them to rest a little...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_12: Despite being the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, I haven’t been able to sense its presence for some time now…
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_13: I can feel my Resonance Ability waning, and I get my power from the Sentinel. This can only mean one thing: the Sentinel's condition is getting worse.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_14: Lady Xinyi, I need to know where the Sentinel was last seen.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_15: I can only fix the Temporal Disruption within a confined radius. It's already pushing my limits to keep this small pocket of space secure.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_16: Mt. Firmament is in serious trouble, and we can't waste any more time. We need our Sentinel to stabilize the time flow.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_17: The Sentinel was last seen flying towards Mianloong Chamber, where it would normally rest. The Fractsidus likely swarmed it soon after.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_18: But little did they know, we had a defense system in place, built with the help of the Court of Savantae. It was reactivated as soon as our Sentinel made it back inside.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_19: This mechanism has allowed us to locate their troops, and we've already eliminated some of them outside the Mianloong Chamber.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_20: To get inside Mianloong Chamber, we have to find the Cipher Key in Truthseeker's Pass and unseal it with the Keyforge.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_21: Understood. I will go bring back the Cipher Key.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_22: You are injured. Please rest and leave it to me.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_24: The Fractsidus will most likely attack this place once I leave. You must stay here and guard it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_25: I implore you, Xinyi. Help me keep our people safe.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_27: Before I headed to Mt. Firmament, the Fractsidus revealed a prophecy from our Sentinel: a fateful clash between the Sentinel and myself that would shape the fate of our city.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_28: I never intended to believe their baseless claims, but I was not surprised to hear it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_29: The Sentinel had told me long ago that there would come a day when I surpass it in power. A day when the humans of Jinzhou take control of their own destiny.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_30: Once we save the Sentinel from danger, I intend to have a serious conversation with it about this prophecy.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_32: There's still one thing that doesn't add up—How did the Fractsidus kidnap our Sentinel?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_33: The Mianloong Chamber was once renovated by the Court of Savantae. Do you think their research could be involved somehow?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_34: I'll look into what you said, but once we have the Cipher Key, the Mianloong Chamber will be left vulnerable to the Fractsidus' potential retaliation.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_35: We must keep them at bay...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_36: {PlayerName} and I are headed to the Truthseeker's Pass to meet up with Jinhsi. We'll distract the Fractsidus main forces, giving you an opportunity to stage your ambush.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_37: And the locals will handle the rest.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_38: I will send some men to open up the side exit for you. Head south and keep walking a couple of minutes, and you will see the Truthseeker's Pass downstream.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_39: Thank you, Lady Xinyi. Please leave it to us.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_40: In this place she was born, and in this place she returns. Our Magistrate's fate is bound to Mt. Firmament...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_2: What can I help you with today?

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_4: I regret to inform you that Madam Magistrate is not in the City Hall. She has left for Mt. Firmament.

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_12: In order to investigate the Sentinel's whereabouts, Madam Magistrate has left for Mt. Firmament, its last recorded location.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_13: Did Jinhsi bring anyone with her? Bodyguards? Can you get in touch with them?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_14: Madam Magistrate traveled to Mt. Firmament alone.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_15: The looming threat of the Threnodian discouraged any additional divertion of human resources. Furthermore, when it comes to the Sentinel, force is not a viable solution.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_16: I need to go to Mt. Firmament to meet with the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_17: Jinhsi might be in trouble, and I want to help.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_18: Madam Magistrate trusts you. It is beyond my authorization to meddle in your decisions.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_19: However, the landscape around Mt. Firmament is complex. One must be accompanied by a special "Wayfinder" to navigate safely. That's all I know.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_20: Where can I find this Wayfinder, then?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_21: Currently, she's likely at the ferry terminal in Whining Aix's Mire. I'll reach out to her.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_22: To learn more about Mt. Firmament, you can meet her at the ferry. I lack the same level of understanding of the situation there as she does.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_24: I trust Madam Magistrate's decisions. I will do my utmost to handle the public matters on her behalf while she is away.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_25: I just... This worry about her safety won't leave me.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_26: In her last video message, I could tell she seemed weaker than usual, despite her efforts to maintain composure.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_27: Madam Magistrate's situation might not be optimistic...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_28: {PlayerName}, Mt. Firmament is a dangerous place. Please take care.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_29: I have sent the coordinates to your Terminal. Thank you for your kind help. I pray you will both return safely.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_34: Hey, did you notice how the mountain has a strangely pleasant smell? It doesn't look edible though...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_36: I'm suddenly unsure whether I can count on you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_37: Go get some rest. I can handle it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_38: Not that I'm hungry or anything. I just tend to doze off easily. Feels like my body can only process what I consume while sleeping.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_39: Well of course I'm reliable! Even if I do happen to fall asleep and can't hear you...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_40: Of course you can! When I'm already so cool, you must be pretty amazing too!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_41: And don't worry, if there's any danger coming your way, I'll wake up like clockwork, just like last time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_42: Well, unless there's nothing that can even remotely challenge you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_43: In that case, I probably won't... wake... up...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_6: (Ask about the lifespan cost of leaving.)
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_9: People were going about their day as usual, but then chaos erupted without warning. They didn't even have the time to escape.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_10: Our town is made up of ordinary individuals, and we had no way to defend ourselves against the Temporal Disruptions.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_11: Thanks to Magistrate Jinhsi, we didn't get too many casualties.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_12: The Sentinel caused this disaster by trying to protect people...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_13: We understand our Sentinel is not to blame for what has transpired.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_14: Jinzhou stands thanks to the Sentinel's never-faltering protection. It saved our ancestors from the Tacet Discords. Without the Sentinel, this land would be uninhabitable.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_15: The current situation could be much worse without the Sentinel's aid. We are grateful for its help and can't expect anything more from it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_16: ...As our Sentinel once protected the people of Mt. Firmament from Tacet Discords, it seems we'll need to rely on Magistrate Jinhsi this time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_17: Many outsiders are unaware, but in ancient times, a colossal vehicle descended upon Mt. Firmament alongside our Sentinel. This became the Mianloong Chamber as we know it today.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_18: People in Hongzhen believe our Sentinel came from a faraway star and the chamber serves as its hibernation pod.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_19: But with our limited technology, we still struggle to comprehend its workings.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_20: Speaking of which... Our Sentinel's health is worsening. Lately, it has been spending longer periods of time in the Mianloong Chamber, essentially going back to "sleep" more frequently.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_21: We've tried asking about it, but no response.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_22: The defense mechanisms outside Mianloong Chamber were built by the Court of Savantae.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_23: Back in the day, researchers from the Court of Savantae would often come to Mt. Firmament to study the strange time fluctuations. This caused tension with the locals.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_24: Local people believed it was disrespectful to the Sentinel, especially when they tried to enter Mianloong Chamber.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_25: After some deliberation, local people understood that the Court of Savantae posed no threat to the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_26: A deal was struck: the locals would refrain from disrupting their research, and in return, they would build defense mechanisms to keep outsiders from interrupting the Sentinel's rest.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_27: The Sentinel was believed to have agreed to this compromise by remaining silent during negotiations.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_28: Activating the Cipher Key is a complex process, and we've stored the Mianloong Chamber's controller separately.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_29: It's an extra safeguard. By splitting the key and its control panel, it'll be harder for malicious individuals to access them.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_30: Long ago, the Sentinel protected people of Hongzhen from Tacet Discords, and it also revealed a harsh truth—
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_31: Leaving Mt. Firmament shortened one's lifespan exponentially. The longer someone has lived inside the Temporal Barrier, the less likely they can make it out alive.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_32: Later, a group of brave young people who could afford the aging left Mt. Firmament, and they eventually built Jinzhou city.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_33: Others stayed and worshiped the Sentinel as their god, vowing to protect it for generations and carving its likeness into the mountain.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_150_35: I pray for your safe return. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have other responsibilities to attend to.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_1: How did it go for you?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_2: I saved as many people as possible and directed them to safety. But there were others... I did what I could.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_3: Don't beat yourself up, we acted quickly and saved a lot of lives.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_4: *sigh* It's all thanks to Lady Xinyi...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_5: I was so overwhelmed, my mind went blank. If she hadn't been there to give orders, I wouldn't have even made it out alive, let alone save anyone.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_6: It's rare to hear that from you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_7: I remember how much you opposed Uncle Fu's decision to let her take the reins back in the day.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_8: ...Well... I thought she knew nothing about our town as an outsider...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_9: But it was too late, the decision had been made based on the support she received. In the end, I just accepted the inevitable.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_11: Uh... Have you never heard about Uncle Fu?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_12: ...{Male=He;Female=She} must be the esteemed guest from Jinzhou Lady Xinyi mentioned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_14: That man in the white shirt is Uncle Fu, former leader of Hongzhen. Despite having stepped down from his position, he still commands respect from the townsfolk.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_15: He's said to be over a hundred years old, making him the oldest person in town.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_156_16: Sigh... It must be tough for him, enduring all this chaos at his age...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_1: Have you seen the Magistrate of Jinzhou... She looks familiar...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_2: She looks like the baby our Sentinel brought back all those years ago...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_3: ...She appears to be 16 or 17 years old though. It doesn't make sense...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_157_4: Time works differently here in Mt. Firmament, remember? Good luck figuring out the math.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_1: Nothing I've tried so far is working.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_2: The Nexus is completely out of commission...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_3: Can't tell if it's the Temporal Disruption or the Fractsidus' doing.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_158_4: So we can't use our Terminals to locate those missing people?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_160_3: Don't worry, I'm here with you...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_160_4: Hang in there. I'll have you patched up in no time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_161_2: Sorry, ma'am. You must stay here. It's too dangerous.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_161_3: My child... She's been... the Temporal Disruption...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_161_4: I'm begging you, please... I need to go save her...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_1: Did Xinyi and Jinhsi know each other?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_2: Jinhsi was chosen as a baby for her Resonance Ability, and raised in City Hall to become the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_3: All the government workers there helped care for and teach her at some point, including Lady Xinyi.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_4: She grew up with immense responsibilities, forced to suppress her true nature from a young age. Thinking back, Jinhsi was only a teenage girl when she became the Magistrate...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_163_5: She has been burdened with unimaginable weight that most cannot fathom.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_1: I assume this is the Truthseeker's Pass Xinyi mentioned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_3: This should be another Chronosorter. It should work in similar ways with the one we saw near the Luminous Shore.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_4: The entrance is built on that cliff, and it's been blocked...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_5: We will need to break the three Photonvaults with ranged attacks first.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_8: Nothing. I was wondering, how did the Court of Savantae create such an advanced mechanism using the Sentinel's power? Mortals aren't supposed to be able to comprehend it.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_9: I've never heard of any human civilization having the ability to manipulate time.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_10: Unless the Sentinel willingly taught them... But why?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_11: We need to focus on items related to the Court of Savantae in Truthseeker's Pass. Maybe we can find some clues there.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_2: {PlayerName}, take good care of the Cipher Key.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_3: I'm leaving the rest to you and Jinhsi.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_5: Please don't forget: I am your Wayfinder. I journeyed with you into the mountains to ensure you meet up with Jinhsi.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_6: From this point onward, I will be counting on you both to go and confront the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_7: This is all I can do for you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_8: I'm here to guide, not intervene. The path is yours to choose.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_9: Not to mention... the Fractsidus has been pestering us non-stop.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_10: You'll need someone to keep them at bay.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_11: The Fractsidus are here for me.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_12: Yes, they've been constantly watching you, interested in your every move. They can never seem to take their eyes off of you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_13: By all means, please carry on without me. As for myself...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_245_14: I have a more fitting location to make my contributions from.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_25_2: Hmm... Mt. Firmament. Our Wayfinder should have plenty information to share.

Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_250_2: Allow me to demonstrate the proper etiquette.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_255_2: Those Artificers are nothing to worry about. {PlayerName}, don't worry. Changli has her plans.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_255_3: I don't believe we will run into more ambushes on the way.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_265_2: I must go tell Lady Xinyi!
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_267_1: Lady Xinyi, Madam Magistrate has returned.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_269_1: Honored to be in your presence, Magistrate Jinhsi.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_1: The Mianloong Chamber is open now. You can proceed inside.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_2: Before you go, there's something important I need to tell you.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_3: About how the Fractsidus imprisoned your Sentinel?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_4: Changli was right. They used the Court of Savantae's research to trap our Sentinel in its resting chamber.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_7: Our captured Artificer revealed that the Fractsidus sent a death squad to invade Mt. Firmament. They had a two-fold plan…
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_8: First, to place the Chronosorter in the Mianloong Chamber while it was still operational; and second, to lure the Sentinel back to Mt. Firmament.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_9: Although their death squad was no match for the Sentinel, by forcing its hand, the powerful Resonance Ability of the Sentinel would clash with the energy of the Chronosorter. This would ultimately cause harm to itself.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_10: Would that really make any difference?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_11: How could some Chronosorters trap the Sentinel?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_12: What if the Fractsidus modified those Chronosorters?
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_13: A whole bunch of them, pushed to their limits, all working together to deliver one massive blow.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_14: But not even that was enough to take down the Sentinel.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_15: After the first hit, they set up modified Flare Crests in the Mianloong Chamber to form a special force field along with those Chronosorters.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_16: It prevented the Sentinel from replenishing energy and eventually restricted its movement and perception.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_17: So... We must free the Sentinel from that force field first.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_18: ...It would be a task more complicated than it sounds.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_19: The people of Hongzhen have lived with the Sentinel for generations. We can usually tell if it's in good shape or not.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_20: But now, the Fractsidus want to capture the Sentinel... They won't just stop at Mt. Firmament. Madam Magistrate, I'm sure you didn't come here just for the Sentinel...
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_21: Please tell us what you know, Madam Magistrate.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_22: Yes, I will tell you everything.
Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_23: Jinhsi updates Xinyi on her findings at Truthseeker's Pass and shares her theory about the situation. She then outlines her current plans.
