Side_CFYW_2_14: Oh, by the way, he lives just around the corner. Go ask him yourself if you think I'm pulling your leg.
Side_CFYW_2_15: With that, the resident shrugs and strolls off.
Side_CFYW_2_16: Well, it's good to have a witness at least.
Side_CFYW_2_18: Yes, that's me. And you must be the Rover, the hero Madam Xinyi spoke of from Jinzhou and Hongzhen?
Side_CFYW_2_21: Don't be modest. Your heroic deeds are already recorded in the Hongzhen Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_2_22: I'm just a newbie intern, so I don't get to write those epic tales... yet.
Side_CFYW_2_23: But that's fine, I have my own mission. I'm investigating the two Mt. Firmament incidents. Once I piece it all together, it'll go into the Hongzhen Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_2_25: Yes, one is the sighting of a huge monster, as the gentleman mentioned.
Side_CFYW_2_26: The other comes from a hunter who found animals and Tacet Discords frozen solid in a valley.
Side_CFYW_2_27: Sounds like someone is up to something.
Side_CFYW_2_28: Indeed. I've read through the Hongzhen Chronicle, and it says the Sentinel's barrier keeps out Tacet Discords, even Elite Class ones.
Side_CFYW_2_29: The rare Elite Class Tacet Discords are only spotted in far-off places. In the Chronicle, they're dubbed "beasts," "scourges," or even "blessings."
Side_CFYW_2_31: Yeah, probably because Elite Class Tacet Discords are super rare, they're almost mythical, seen as omens of good or bad luck.
Side_CFYW_2_32: Anyway, based on these witness accounts, I think there's a link between this monster and the "beast" in the Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_2_33: Rumors have been flying around, getting all exaggerated, but I’m still unclear on where these incidents actually happened.
Side_CFYW_2_34: But here's the kicker—I've tracked down the rumor spreaders.
Side_CFYW_2_36: Yep, one's a herb collector from Hongzhen, and the other's a hunter. Makes sense, given their line of work.
Side_CFYW_2_39: Well, I do think Tacet Discords are behind all this, but still I can't help but wonder... do ghosts really exist?
Side_CFYW_2_43: I-I suspected as much. I've studied Remnant Ecoacoustics, so I know it's just a natural phenomenon caused by Reverberations!
Side_CFYW_2_44: For real? Have you seen a ghost before, Rover?
Side_CFYW_2_45: Y-yeah, just a natural phenomenon. Nothing to be scared of!
Side_CFYW_2_47: This is excitement, not fear! Exploring the unknown is my jam!
Side_CFYW_2_48: Let's go, Rover! It's time to uncover the truth!
Side_CFYW_20_1: Alright, I think I've probably got things figured out.
Side_CFYW_20_3: The Fractsidus calls this place "Site 2" and ran experiments with the "Photonvault" created by the Court of Savantae.
Side_CFYW_20_4: Those frozen animals? They must be the device's test subjects caught in time.
Side_CFYW_20_5: And the monsters at Loong's Crest must've been captured with it, too.
Side_CFYW_20_6: But what's their plan? The memo from Site 1 mentioned a frequency suppressor… What’s that for?
Side_CFYW_20_7: To suppress the Tacet Discords' innate frequencies?
Side_CFYW_20_8: Yes… So they can control them, like in the diary.
Side_CFYW_20_11: It is their style, after all.
Side_CFYW_20_12: Are they all mad? Why would they do this?
Side_CFYW_20_16: For power? Is it really worth all this?
Side_CFYW_20_17: For dreams? I doubt these killers know anything about dreams.
Side_CFYW_20_18: But cities like Jinzhou or Hongzhen offer protection. Folks can go about their daily lives, so why go looking for this kind of trouble?
Side_CFYW_20_19: I just... can't wrap my head around it. There's no excuse for this.
Side_CFYW_20_20: We have more important matters to attend to.
Side_CFYW_20_21: You're right. We have to stop the Fractsidus. We can't let them get away with this.
Side_CFYW_21_1: We've arrived, Rover, it's right over there!
Side_CFYW_21_3: Don't bother going over. It's too late…
Side_CFYW_22_1: Boss, all systems are go. We’re ready to roll with the next experiment whenever you give the word.
Side_CFYW_22_4: Who else? You want to live, right? You want power, don’t you? That’s exactly what the Fractsidus is all about.
Side_CFYW_22_5: We turn the weak into the mighty, the nobodies into somebodies, and mere mortals into… gods.
Side_CFYW_22_7: Relax, it’s just another tweak. Like the upgrade you had before—only this makes you stronger and less constrained.
Side_CFYW_22_8: Look at this beast—gorgeous, isn’t it? Strong, too. Those sharp claws, that glossy fur, those bulging muscles…
Side_CFYW_22_9: Listen, Tacet Discords are not curses, they’re miracles. And now, you get the honor of harnessing that miracle. Don’t let me down.
Side_CFYW_22_11: Of course, Ogo. The Fractsidus isn’t pouring money into this just for kicks.
Side_CFYW_22_12: Just fire up that machine over there, and you’ll be... transformed. No one will be able to touch you, much less take you down.
Side_CFYW_22_13: I'll take it upstairs. Once you get stronger, you'll move up the ladder too. Say goodbye to grunt work.
Side_CFYW_22_15: Ogo trembles as he approaches the machine. With no other option, he entrusts his fate to this experiment he neither understands nor cares about.
Side_CFYW_22_16: Initiating frequency suppressor injection… triple unit. Ogo's frequency detected, causing effective interference with the Tacet Discord's frequency. Synchronization rate: 95.27%.
Side_CFYW_22_17: HAHAHA! We did it! Such a genius move, using human frequencies to take down Tacet Discord’s!
Side_CFYW_22_18: As long as Tacet Discords understand our language, we can boss them around however we want!
Side_CFYW_22_19: Shut down the Photonvault and release our new friend… I mean, old friend! Even that Rover won't stand a chance!
Side_CFYW_22_20: The Artificers turn off the Photonvault.
Side_CFYW_22_22: Ogo? Can you hear me? How’s your new body feeling? I get it, four legs might be a challenge at first. Take your time.
Side_CFYW_22_23: Hold on, boss. Ogo's frequencies… they're gone.
Side_CFYW_22_24: What? Don’t be stupid. We combined his with the Tacet Discord’s frequencies. Of course you can’t see his, moron!
Side_CFYW_22_25: No… the Tacet Discord’s frequencies are unchanged. His were completely devoured.
Side_CFYW_22_26: This isn’t funny! Ogo, wake up! Now isn’t the time for a nap… No, no… Stay back! STAY BACK!
Side_CFYW_22_27: In those final moments, Ogo's response was neither what he hoped for nor expected.
Side_CFYW_23_1: What did the Fractsidus do…? He was one of their own…
Side_CFYW_23_2: Take cover somewhere safe. I'll handle this.
Side_CFYW_24_1: Is it… is it over? Is Ogo…
Side_CFYW_24_4: I see… That's okay. We did… we did everything we could.
Side_CFYW_24_5: I read his diary. All he wanted to do was survive, but… he's not as lucky as we are.
Side_CFYW_24_6: He didn't have a safe place to call home or the means to protect himself.
Side_CFYW_24_7: I used to think justice was everywhere in Huanglong, just like in Jinzhou.
Side_CFYW_24_8: We have the Midnight Rangers guarding us and the Patrollers keeping order. Everyone lives in peace.
Side_CFYW_24_9: To me, Tacet Discords and Tacet Fields were just distant stories, less real than the monsters in fairytales.
Side_CFYW_24_10: But today, I realized that… they're right here.
Side_CFYW_24_13: Ha… I’m not blaming myself. I just feel… like I’ve been slacking off all this time.
Side_CFYW_24_15: I'm still the little girl who once looked at the Midnight Rangers believing they could solve every single problem…
Side_CFYW_24_16: I never thought about who needed help, let alone took action. Looking back, I feel ashamed…
Side_CFYW_24_18: But first, I gotta figure out what my heart wants.
Side_CFYW_24_19: Anyway, I have all the details recorded. When I get back to Hongzhen, I'll write them in the Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_24_20: Next up... I might just join the Pioneer Association and travel the world. I want to see what lies beyond Jinzhou's walls with my own eyes.
Side_CFYW_24_21: Taking that first step is key.
Side_CFYW_24_22: You're right. I've got to take that first step.
Side_CFYW_24_23: Thank you, Rover. Let's head back to Hongzhen.
Side_CFYW_25_1: Your efforts seem to have borne fruit. What conclusions have you drawn about the incidents, Rover?
Side_CFYW_25_2: You tell Xinyi about what happened.
Side_CFYW_25_3: So, it was the Fractsidus behind these disturbances, all to push their disgraceful goal. How despicable.
Side_CFYW_25_4: Thank you for bringing this vital information to light. I shall ensure that patrols around Mt. Firmament are intensified to prevent any further attempts by these miscreants.
Side_CFYW_25_5: Oh yes, and Qianyue seems to have found her footing since she returned.
Side_CFYW_25_6: This journey did make her grow.
Side_CFYW_25_7: There is no better teacher than experience itself. I hold high hopes for her future contributions.
Side_CFYW_25_8: Once again, Rover, I'm grateful for your assistance in this matter.
Side_CFYW_26_2: I have a request to make... Hongzhen is in danger. I need your assistance.
Side_CFYW_26_3: Let's discuss in person. The coordinates have been sent to your Terminal. I'll wait for you there.
Side_CFYW_3_4: Story…? It's not a story! It really happened to me!
Side_CFYW_3_5: I was almost killed on that mountain! Just the thought of it sends shivers down my spine, like it's still lurking out there, watching...
Side_CFYW_3_6: Look behind me, you don't see anything, do ya?
Side_CFYW_3_8: That's a relief. With so many people in Hongzhen, I bet that thing wouldn't dare show its face. But that place… I wouldn't set foot there again.
Side_CFYW_3_9: What do you mean by that place? Where is it?
Side_CFYW_3_10: Curiosity killed the cat, they say. Getting mixed up with that monster will only spell disaster. I must've lost my mind insisting on checking it out…
Side_CFYW_3_12: We're gathering tales for the Hongzhen Chronicle.
Side_CFYW_3_13: Madam Xinyi…? So, she heard the rumor too? Not surprising, she always takes everything here seriously.
Side_CFYW_3_14: Gathering tales…? I've heard those pages are filled with countless regional folktales, so it’s only natural you’d want to add this.
Side_CFYW_3_15: Alright, if you're here to listen, I'll tell you exactly what happened.
Side_CFYW_3_16: Hold on! Let me start the recording first… Alright, please go on.
Side_CFYW_3_17: It all began three days ago. I was deep in the mountains hunting for a rare herb and lost track of time.
Side_CFYW_3_18: By the time I stumbled upon the herb, night had fallen. Fearful of beasts prowling after dark, I decided to take a shortcut back to Hongzhen.
Side_CFYW_3_19: When I reached Loong's Crest, I heard some... strange noises coming from the darkness. They sounded like metal clashing and scraping, mixed with eerie cries.
Side_CFYW_3_20: I thought it was just a poor Scarefrost Deer caught in a trap, so I pressed on. But the deeper I went, the creepier it got.
Side_CFYW_3_22: Hard to describe. Whimpers? Howls? Whatever it was, it wasn't human, and it sure as hell wasn't any beast I'd ever crossed paths with.
Side_CFYW_3_23: More like a twisted combination of both.
Side_CFYW_3_24: The noises gave me goosebumps. Then I remembered the story my grandmother once told me.
Side_CFYW_3_25: Long ago, the Sentinel and the Court of Savantae worked together, using their bizzare creations to seal some real vicious monsters.
Side_CFYW_3_26: Their bodies crumbled to dust over the years, but their evil souls hung around, craving revenge on the Sentinel.
Side_CFYW_3_27: Revenge on the Sentinel? That's wild!
Side_CFYW_3_28: Ahem, I'm talking here, young lady. Interrupt again and I won't say another word.
Side_CFYW_3_30: Where was I? Ah, yes, the evil souls. I was in a dilemma, you know. Terrified as I was, curiosity gnawed at me, urging me forward…
Side_CFYW_3_31: Suddenly, out of nowhere, two lanterns appeared in front of me. It happened so fast, I didn't even realize it was impossible to have lanterns out in the wilderness like that.
Side_CFYW_3_32: The lanterns seemed to float, barely visible. They flickered once, then a few seconds later, flickered again.
Side_CFYW_3_33: It wasn't until then that I realized they weren't lanterns at all, but eyes! Eyes as big as lanterns. How big would its head be?
Side_CFYW_3_34: I turned and ran, and that monster kept howling behind me. Believe me, I've never heard anything so bone-chilling.
Side_CFYW_3_35: I didn't dare look back, just ran for my life. I lost track of time, but eventually, I saw the lights of Hongzhen and knew I was safe.
Side_CFYW_3_36: I heard you passed out at Hongzhen's entrance, right? Thank goodness the night patrol found you. Otherwise…
Side_CFYW_3_37: Non-nonsense! I didn't pass out! Just… a bit tired from the running! Yeah, I was tired!
Side_CFYW_3_38: Anyway, whatever was chasing me must be the souls of those monsters! One wrong step, and I'd have been its next meal!
Side_CFYW_3_39: Alright, that's all been recorded. What's your take, Rover?
Side_CFYW_3_40: I doubt it's some evil ghost.
Side_CFYW_3_41: Yes, I agree. I've heard nerves can make you see things that aren't real. Maybe it was just a Scarefrost Deer... or a passing Tacet Discord?
Side_CFYW_3_44: If you're really curious, go see the monster for yourself. I spotted it near Loong's Crest. Just remember, I did warn you.
Side_CFYW_4_2: Yes? You are…? Oh, I see. You folks are here for the snow monster too?
Side_CFYW_4_4: Imagine a tank-sized ape, with the power to freeze everything around it into ice sculptures.
Side_CFYW_4_5: I saw it once as a kid, just a glimpse of its back while tagging along with my dad in the mountains.
Side_CFYW_4_6: (Sounds like a Tacet Discord with freezing abilities.)
Side_CFYW_4_7: So, how do you intend to find the snow monster this time?
Side_CFYW_4_8: This time? I never actually encountered it. If I had, I wouldn't have lived to tell the tale!
Side_CFYW_4_9: But, I did come across… evidence of its hunting.
Side_CFYW_4_11: Okay, long story short.  I went hunting in the mountains and found some strange contraptions at the base of Loong’s Ridge.
Side_CFYW_4_12: I thought they were left by the Court of Savantae. No idea what they were for. You know, I haven't found anything related to the Court of Savantae there before.
Side_CFYW_4_13: Maybe they have a secret vault nearby?
Side_CFYW_4_14: That's what I thought. So I followed the contraptions trying to find it.
Side_CFYW_4_16: Of course not. This is a tale about running into a snow monster,  not about a thief hitting the jackpot with a vault!
Side_CFYW_4_17: I trekked up the mountain and saw some... animals. Oh, not just any animals, there were Tacet Discords too.
Side_CFYW_4_18: Tacet Discords? They didn't attack you?
Side_CFYW_4_19: Nope. When I found them, they were all frozen solid.
Side_CFYW_4_20: Birds, deer, even the Tacet Discords—every one of them frozen stiff. You could see every hair crystal clear.
Side_CFYW_4_21: Can you believe it? Even the snowflakes around them were frozen. Gave me the creeps, I tell you.
Side_CFYW_4_22: So you think the snow monster did all this?
Side_CFYW_4_23: Who else would it be? What else could turn living creatures into those… terrifying ice sculptures?
Side_CFYW_4_24: I totally forgot about the vault and ran like the wind, terrified that the snow monster would jump out from nowhere and turn me into a popsicle like the rest of them.
Side_CFYW_4_25: The snow monster and the Court of Savantae…
Side_CFYW_4_27: Yes, why didn't I think of it sooner... The Court of Savantae must've sealed that monster with one of their contraptions, and someone let it out by mistake!
Side_CFYW_4_28: That explains everything! No wonder it's been centuries since the last time people saw the snow monster…
Side_CFYW_4_29: Hold up, didn't you say you saw it as a kid?
Side_CFYW_4_30: Did I? Ha… Hahaha, well, yes, besides ME, it's been centuries since anyone saw the snow monster!
Side_CFYW_4_31: Uh, wait! And my father! He saw it too.
Side_CFYW_4_32: Qianyue doesn't ask more questions, but the skeptical look on her face suffices to show her opinion.
Side_CFYW_4_33: Ahem, well, thank you for your help.
Side_CFYW_4_35: By the way, if you're planning to hunt the snow monster, why not grab some of my poison arrows? They're made to take down wild beasts quickly.
Side_CFYW_4_38: Think about it. You'll be out there, staring down that snow monster, wishing you had something to defend yourself with. Trust me, you'll regret not taking these.
Side_CFYW_4_39: Smart move. Here. It took me years to craft these beauties.
Side_CFYW_4_40: But… they look just like regular arrows?
Side_CFYW_4_41: Hey, open your eyes! These are no ordinary arrows. The tips are poisoned. The one I used is colorless, odorless, safe for humans, but deadly to beasts!
Side_CFYW_4_42: …Well, maybe keep them to yourself for now.
Side_CFYW_4_43: Fine, your call. Just don’t say I didn’t warn you when the time comes.
Side_CFYW_4_44: Anyway, you're not the only ones curious about that snow monster. Excuse me, got another customer… adventurer to attend to.
Side_CFYW_4_45: The hunter leaves in a hurry, taking his deadly, invisible, and odorless poison arrows with him.
Side_CFYW_4_46: Well, I've got all that recorded. I'll sort through it later.
Side_CFYW_4_47: I can't help but feel… these two incidents aren't quite what I had pictured.
Side_CFYW_4_49: The herb collector didn't even get a clear look. From his description, sounds more like a rare Tacet Discord than a monster.
Side_CFYW_4_50: But the whimpering or howling he mentioned does pique my interest. If it was a Tacet Discord or a monster… why didn't it attack him?
Side_CFYW_4_52: It might be friendly to humans.
Side_CFYW_4_53: That makes sense. Maybe a Tacet Discord got stuck in a trap or wedged in a crevice?
Side_CFYW_4_54: That makes sense. I've heard some Tacet Discords are friendly towards humans.
Side_CFYW_4_55: Hmm, now that could be the real story behind this "evil ghost."
Side_CFYW_4_56: As for the hunter, he gave a really detailed account.
Side_CFYW_4_57: If he were making it up, he wouldn't have included verifiable details like the creations of the Court of Savantae.
Side_CFYW_4_58: Which means the frozen animals are real. The Court of Savantae creations are real, but…
Side_CFYW_4_59: The snow monster might be a lie.
Side_CFYW_4_60: That's right! No snow monster, just a ruse to sell those poison arrows.
Side_CFYW_4_61: He did see the frozen animals, but he didn't know who did it and how.
Side_CFYW_4_62: Spreading rumors about the snow monster was just a way to lure in hunters.
Side_CFYW_4_63: Now, there's only one question left.
Side_CFYW_4_64: Yeah, who froze those animals? Tacet Discords? Doesn't quite add up.
Side_CFYW_4_65: Something's off about these two sightings. Maybe we need to visit the locations for answers.
Side_CFYW_5_1: H-here we are... This should be the location mentioned by the herb collector.
Side_CFYW_5_2: Let's investigate the surroundings. Look, I've got a camera. I'll make sure to take pictures of anything unusual!
Side_CFYW_6_1: Are those… cages? Who would put cages out here?!
Side_CFYW_6_2: Seems like they were used to lock something up. Good news is, it wasn't a person, judging from these claw marks.
Side_CFYW_6_3: Let's take some pictures, just in case.
Side_CFYW_7_1: This cage must be for the really big one.
Side_CFYW_7_2: But it looks brand new. I don't think it's been used.
Side_CFYW_8_2: Looks like they were used to store equipment.
Side_CFYW_9_2: There's a memo attached to it, but it seems to be stained with ink.
Side_CFYW_9_4: So, someone was experimenting on animals and Tacet Discords here…?

Side_CFYW_18_2:
I've always known I'm useless… and beyond redemption.  When that monstrosity wreaked havoc in the camp, I was the first to flee. Was I ashamed? No, who wouldn't run if they were in my shoes?
Overseers talk about grand plans all the time, like human evolution and a new era. I guess it works well for other Artificers, because that's what they all chase. But not me. I'm a coward afraid of any sacrifice, much less sacrifice for intangible ideals. But I do agree with one thing they say: the world is doomed, and only the powerful will survive.
I've heard of Exiles vanishing during Tacet Discord onslaughts, like candles in the wind. Survivors speak of the horrors they saw in Tacet Fields. I don't want to be like them. Struggling to live out there like rats, surviving on scraps, fearful of being killed at any moment. 
Luckily, there's good news from the boss. He said the experiment was a success. If we can control Tacet Discord, we'll be valued by the Overseers. Maybe even promoted! Maybe... finally some peace and stability.
I want power. I want to be strong. If it's the Tacet Discord's power, I'll take it. If it's an Echo's, I'll take it, no matter what. If getting dirty keeps me alive, I'll do it without hesitation.
I won't be the prey. I won't let this world swallow me whole. I won't.
Side_HZBJT_1_1: Ah, you must be the Rover!

Side_HZBJT_1_6: Haha... Sorry, occupational habit. Ahem, speaking of which, I'm in the middle of a career crisis.
Side_HZBJT_1_8: Well, um... our magazine's cooking up something special about Hongzhen's cultural scene.
Side_HZBJT_1_9: Unfortunately, we're staring down the barrel of the deadline, and we're missing a few crucial snaps in our stack...
Side_HZBJT_1_10: If I mess this up, the editor-in-chief will have my head!
Side_HZBJT_1_11: I hate to admit it, but I'm not exactly a pro with a camera, despite running the photography column.
Side_HZBJT_1_12: And it's too late to call in a photographer from Jinzhou now. Say, you've got a knack for photography too, don't you?
Side_HZBJT_1_15: Ha! You're just as modest as they say you are.
Side_HZBJT_1_17: In that case, if you have time... Could you take a few photos for me? Just three, four shots.
Side_HZBJT_1_19: Thank you! You'll be doing me a great service.
Side_HZBJT_1_20: Oh, right, mind if I accompany you? I could use a bit of a wander myself, you know, just in case a bolt of inspiration decides to pay me a visit!
Side_HZBJT_10_1: That about does it. I can't thank you enough for these wonderful pictures!
Side_HZBJT_10_4: Yes, yes, I will arrange payment as soon as I can!
Side_HZBJT_10_5: But I practically dragged you all over Hongzhen for these photos, didn't I?

Side_HZBJT_10_7: ...Just thinking about all that work makes me depressed.

Side_HZBJT_10_9: I'm tempted to quit and move to Hongzhen myself...
Side_HZBJT_10_11: Maybe things aren't as good as they look.

Side_HZBJT_2_1: Hongzhen is famous for its Sagaci Springs. Let's go take some photos of the hot springs.
Side_HZBJT_3_1: Here we are! Let's look for the perfect spot...
Side_HZBJT_3_2: Oh, look at that ancient tree! Such a picturesque sight! Come, let's capture it!
Side_HZBJT_4_1: A quaint hot spring, nestled under the shade of an ancient tree... The setting is perfect!
Side_HZBJT_4_2: While the world changes around us, Hongzhen's timeless traditions live on.
Side_HZBJT_4_3: Here, people soak in the same springs their ancestors did, washing away their worries with the same clear waters.
Side_HZBJT_4_5: Now, back to business... I spotted some peculiar rings on the mountains across the gate. Let's capture them.
Side_HZBJT_5_1: Wow... quite the spectacle. I wonder what these massive rings are for. Could they be... ancient ceremonial sites of Hongzhen's forebears?
Side_HZBJT_5_2: No... they might be relics from the Pre-Lament era. Hmm... Perhaps colossal colliders or planetary engines? Anyway, let's snap a picture.
Side_HZBJT_6_1: Let me have a look... Hm, this turned out pretty good. Maybe we'll feature it in an "Explore Hongzhen" column. Already got the headline: "The Mountain Town's Unsolved Riddle."
Side_HZBJT_6_2: But let's include the peaks flanking the rings in our shot. That'll give a sense of how enormous and awe-inspiring they are.
Side_HZBJT_7_1: Oh, perfect! That's the angle we want! This shot will be a winner.
Side_HZBJT_7_2: Stand over here to take it!
Side_HZBJT_8_1: Hmm... Can we get a panoramic view of the whole of Hongzhen from here?
Side_HZBJT_8_2: Right! Let's snap an overhead shot of Hongzhen. Our special edition still needs a cover photo, and this will give readers a wonderful perspective of the town.
Side_HZBJT_8_3: Because you know, to most folks, Hongzhen is still an enigmatic, secluded place.
Side_HZBJT_9_1: From up here, every part of the town is visible. Ancient relics and market stalls dot the landscape, connected by winding footpaths.
Side_HZBJT_9_2: What's surprising is, despite the ancient lore painting Hongzhen as an isolated paradise, what I see is a vibrant, bustling community.
Side_WQDMX_1_2: It appears you've been busy lately.
Side_WQDMX_1_3: You're right. With Hongzhen back to normal, we've been swamped here at the gate... I never thought life here could get this busy.
Side_WQDMX_1_4: So, {PlayerName}, have you come to help us?
Side_WQDMX_1_5: Is there something I can help with?
Side_WQDMX_1_6: Of course! In fact, there’s a job that would be just right for you.
Side_WQDMX_1_7: There are a few hot springs around Hongzhen. Ordinarily, we monitor the water periodically to check for contamination from Tacet Discords or the like.
Side_WQDMX_1_8: But as you can see, we've been short on manpower lately. Inspections were due days ago, but we haven't had anyone available to send...
Side_WQDMX_1_10: Equipment? No, no, no, we don't bother with that sort of thing here. Here in Hongzhen, we rely on the Pavo Plums by the hot springs to check the water, just as our ancestors did.
Side_WQDMX_1_12: How... how do you use them?
Side_WQDMX_1_13: The Pavo Plum plant is highly sensitive to its environment. It absorbs harmful substances from its surroundings, leading to slight changes in its appearance.
Side_WQDMX_1_14: Basically, I just give the Pavo Plum a good whiff, check its hue, and give it a quick lick. That’ll tell me all I need to know about the water's quality.
Side_WQDMX_1_16: Hey, don't give me that look!
Side_WQDMX_1_17: I'm as local as it gets! Ever since I—no, ever since my Grandpa was a baby, we've always done it this way.
Side_WQDMX_1_18: Now, there are three hot springs needing inspection, and they're just a stone's throw away. I'm counting on you, {PlayerName}!
Side_WQDMX_2_1: Fish... There are fish in the hot spring!
Side_WQDMX_2_2: The water is so hot. Wouldn't it cook the fish?
Side_WQDMX_2_3: Oh! I get it! They are jumping out of the water because it's too hot!
Side_WQDMX_2_4: Hey, do you know what's happening here?
Side_WQDMX_2_5: These fish are Airsailers. They can handle the heat.
Side_WQDMX_2_6: Uh... I guess... what you said is right!
Side_WQDMX_2_7: Oh... so that's the reason. Awesome! Thanks for teaching me this!
Side_WQDMX_2_8: Ha! So the teacher was right! When in doubt, think it out.
Side_WQDMX_2_9: These fish... Oh, I just know the teacher will be thrilled if I write about them! Yep, it’s diary time!
Side_WQDMX_2_10: Hongzhen is full of fun things to do... Where should I go next?
Side_WQDMX_3_1: This is my analysis. Hmm... It lacks adequate theoretical support and empirical validation, but I am resolved to... maintain my stance.
Side_WQDMX_3_2: Save it, please. This is art. Creation. It defies the cold logic of mere numbers!
Side_WQDMX_3_8: Ah... it's {PlayerName}! You have perfect timing. We were just discussing which foods taste better when cooked in hot spring water.
Side_WQDMX_3_9: Trust me, I've been around. When it comes to cooking things in a hot spring, your first thought would be an egg, right?
Side_WQDMX_3_10: I beg to differ. An egg has a shell! Boiling it in a hot spring is no different than boiling it in regular water.
Side_WQDMX_3_11: Corn, however, can really absorb all the good stuff from the hot spring. But eggs? ZERO ABSORPTION!
Side_WQDMX_3_12: ...Like I said, cuisine is an art, not a science!
Side_WQDMX_3_13: Who likes plain old boiled eggs anyway?!
Side_WQDMX_3_14: This is what you're arguing about?
Side_WQDMX_3_15: We're at a stalemate here, so it's up to you—yes, you! Which food do you think tastes better when cooked in a hot spring?
Side_WQDMX_3_18: Look, even {PlayerName} agrees. Eggs boiled in hot springs are the best! That's what I call art!
Side_WQDMX_3_19: Hmph, just as I expected. {PlayerName} always makes judgments with wisdom and reason.
Side_WQDMX_3_20: At this moment, an elderly man shuffles over unsteadily.
Side_WQDMX_3_21: I could hear you quarreling from a mile away... Cough, none of you are from Hongzhen, are you?
Side_WQDMX_3_22: This spring's barely warmer than body heat. It's not even good for a hot bath, let alone boiling food in it.
Side_WQDMX_3_24: How embarrassing... We should have inspected the hot spring first before our discussion...
Side_WQDMX_3_25: If it's spring fare you're after, make your way to Spring's Taste.
Side_WQDMX_3_26: They've got a spring nearly boiling over—perfect for cooking up local specialties. It's a well-known delight in Hongzhen.
Side_WQDMX_3_27: That water’s hot enough to perfectly steam a chicken, let alone eggs or corn.
Side_WQDMX_3_29: My mouth is already beginning to water!
Side_WQDMX_3_30: In that case, should we go take a look later?
Side_WQDMX_4_1: Look at that! Finally, an unguarded hot spring!
Side_WQDMX_4_2: We traveled so far and endured so much, all... all for this moment.
Side_WQDMX_4_4: You feel it, don't you? Our hard work paid off! Ah, and that faint scent of sulfur... Just standing here is already washing away all the exhaustion.
Side_WQDMX_4_5: Um... It's not that. Boss, I'm trying to say...
Side_WQDMX_4_7: Does that person over there... look familiar?
Side_WQDMX_4_8: Ah... it's that... What were they calling {Male=him;Female=her}?
Side_WQDMX_4_10: Yes! They were with that little monk outside Jinzhou! How did {Male=he;Female=she} manage to follow us here... Oh no, did they find out what we did in Jinzhou...
Side_WQDMX_4_11: That seems a bit much, doesn't it? Just lifted a few fish... from the cages, no less! And we did replace them with worms later, didn't we?
Side_WQDMX_4_12: Wait, that monk... She isn't here, right?
Side_WQDMX_4_13: I don’t see her. Looks like the Rover is alone.
Side_WQDMX_4_15: This is our chance. Grab your weapon, boy! Time for revenge.
Side_WQDMX_5_1: Spare us, please! We surrender, we surrender!
Side_WQDMX_5_2: How was that even possible? We had the numbers...
Side_WQDMX_5_3: Are you here for the hot springs?
Side_WQDMX_5_4: Of course. We pulled off a mission just days ago, now today we need to—
Side_WQDMX_5_5: —That's right! We heard that the hot springs in Hongzhen were the best, so we left Jinzhou looking for them. We've been behaving ourselves perfectly all the way, I swear!
Side_WQDMX_5_6: Forgive us, we didn't know you were in charge of this hot spring. It's just, we weren't allowed in Hongzhen, so we had to—

Side_WQDMX_5_10: Really. Ever since the day when you and that monk showed us a better way, we've been reforming our ways. We even helped Lollo Logistics to deliver goods the other day!
Side_WQDMX_5_11: Ha... Well, this was all just a misunderstanding. Let's skedaddle, shall we?
Side_WQDMX_5_12: Don't let me catch you a third time.
Side_WQDMX_5_13: You got it. From here on out, we'll be model citizens, contributing positively to society.
Side_WQDMX_5_14: The exiles leave in a hurry.
Side_WQDMX_6_1: Good, I've gathered all the Pavo Plums Bing'ge requested.
Side_WQDMX_6_2: I'll head back to town now to deliver them.
Side_WQDMX_7_1: Oh, you're back. Did everything go well?
Side_WQDMX_7_2: Time for a little inspection... Hmm, color checks out. And the smell... all good.
Side_WQDMX_7_3: Now, onto the taste... Mmm... Yup, spot on.
Side_WQDMX_7_4: The zesty bitterness hits the spot. Seems like these hot springs are clean. Whew, I can finally breathe easy.
Side_WQDMX_7_5: By the way, happen to see anything interesting along the way?
Side_WQDMX_7_6: Flying fish in a hot spring?
Side_WQDMX_7_7: Two people arguing about eggs and corn?
Side_WQDMX_7_9: What in the world... Ha, that's got to be one heck of a story!
Side_WQDMX_7_11: But I'm on duty now. Ugh, should've skipped work to see it myself. This endless grind is driving me crazy!
Side_WQDMX_7_12: Anyway, thanks for the help, {PlayerName}. Until next time!
Daily_BWGJ_1_3: My stomach hurts... I got food poisoning from accidentally eating the wrong herb to be more precise.
Daily_BWGJ_1_4: Should I take you to a clinic?
Daily_BWGJ_1_5: No need, I'm a doctor myself. I've checked my pulse and it's nothing too serious.
Daily_BWGJ_1_6: I just didn't expect this herb to be poisonous. It was supposed to be safe. I should've been more careful.
Daily_BWGJ_1_7: What herb did you take exactly?
Daily_BWGJ_1_8: According to the Supplement to Great Pharmacopoeia, it's a herb called the Loong's Pearl.
Daily_BWGJ_1_9: The pharmacopoeia says that it isn't poisonous—on the contrary, it can dissolve toxins from plants, wood, metal, and stones.
Daily_BWGJ_1_10: I suspect there might be some errors in the pharmacopoeia, or maybe I mixed up two similar herbs.
Daily_BWGJ_1_11: May I take a look at it?
Daily_BWGJ_1_12: Uh... sure. I've got it with me. Here.
Daily_BWGJ_1_14: What is it? Did you find anything?
Daily_BWGJ_1_15: There's a note in the appendix in fine script.
Daily_BWGJ_1_16: Really? Let me see... "The Loong's Pearl is a fine medicine, but where fine medicine grows, poison also flourishes. Neighboring the Loong's Pearl there usually grows a poisonous herb known as the Yunjiao Gall, which causes unending stomach pain when consumed."
Daily_BWGJ_1_17: "It resembles the Loong's Pearl, so be careful not to mix them up."
Daily_BWGJ_1_18: I see... Sorry, I should have read more carefully.
Daily_BWGJ_1_19: Wait, there's more. It also mentions an antidote: "Loong's Pearl can counteract the poison. The most potent ones thrive under waterfalls and have a strong fragrance."
Daily_BWGJ_1_21: An antidote growing near poisonous herbs... It aligns with the pharmacological theories. Looks like this isn't a mistake.
Daily_BWGJ_1_22: Could you help me find a Loong's Pearl beneath the waterfall? I'd go myself, but I really can't walk now.
Daily_BWGJ_2_1: You... you're back... Did you find the herb?
Daily_BWGJ_2_3: Hmm... the slight blue hue, the faint glow, and the aromatic scent. Yes, it matches the description in the pharmacopoeia.
Daily_BWGJ_2_4: According to the records, it can be consumed directly if in an emergency, although it might be more effective after processed.
Daily_BWGJ_2_6: You might not have time to wait that long.
Daily_BWGJ_2_7: Shinong puts the Loong's Pearl in his mouth and begins chewing. His pain visibly eases.
Daily_BWGJ_2_8: Phew... Much better. It looks like the pharmacopoeia's description of the Loong's Pearl was accurate. Thank you.
Daily_BWGJ_2_9: Why did you eat the herb in the first place anyway?
Daily_BWGJ_2_10: Ah, that's a long story. Allow me to formally introduce myself. I'm Shinong, a doctor from Jinzhou.
Daily_BWGJ_2_11: I've been studying ancient pharmacopoeias and medical books from all over Huanglong.
Daily_BWGJ_2_12: While the medical practices of Huanglong share the same roots, many ancient texts have been lost over time.
Daily_BWGJ_2_13: Luckily, Hongzhen has managed to preserve some texts that may have been lost elsewhere.
Daily_BWGJ_2_14: But over the years, as supplements are made, all pharmacopoeias and medical books inevitably suffer from confusions and omissions.
Daily_BWGJ_2_15: They even include some superstitions that are completely unrelated to medicine.
Daily_BWGJ_2_17: For example, there's a remedy that involves holding a rooster at exactly noon, jumping three times under the eaves, and then spinning around three times. It's said that if the rooster crows at that moment, it will drive away any plague.
Daily_BWGJ_2_20: While it might be a fun folklore activity, in practice it doesn't do anything to treat any illnesses.
Daily_BWGJ_2_21: That's why I wanted to revise these pharmacopoeias—to remove the unnecessary parts and correct the errors.
Daily_BWGJ_2_22: And the best way to do this is to try each herb personally and observe any reactions.
Daily_BWGJ_2_23: This way, I can determine their effects and uncover any side effects not mentioned in the texts.
Daily_BWGJ_2_25: Don't worry. After generations of supplements and revisions, I'm certain any herb that poses significant health risks are all highlighted in these pages.
Daily_BWGJ_2_26: Worst-case scenario, it would just be minor mishaps, like what happened earlier. Such risks are predictable and entirely manageable.
Daily_BWGJ_2_27: Oh, as a token of gratitude, here's some tonic that I brewed.
Daily_BWGJ_2_29: Don't worry. I brewed it using my proven recipe.
Daily_BWGJ_2_30: Until we meet again, friend. I wish you good health.
Daily_BWGJ_3_2: You didn't eat any odd herbs today, did you?
Daily_BWGJ_3_4: I read an anecdote in Hongzhen Chronicles about a young man from a few hundred years ago who discovered that Pavo Plums has temporary memory-enhance effects.
Daily_BWGJ_3_5: He memorized all the texts of Hongzhen with the help of Pavo Plum's incredible effects, earning him the nickname "the Walking Bookshelf."
Daily_BWGJ_3_6: So... you know. I want to try it.
Daily_BWGJ_3_8: You sure something like that exists?
Daily_BWGJ_3_9: I agree that the story might be fictional. But there might be some truth behind it.
Daily_BWGJ_3_10: I've always been gathering Pavo Plums from around this area. But according to Hongzhen Chronicles, only those "found near the hot spring and that can slightly heat up" has medical effects.
Daily_BWGJ_3_11: But I've searched everywhere near the hot spring and haven't found any Pavo Plums like the ones described.
Daily_BWGJ_3_12: I could give you a hand with it.
Daily_BWGJ_4_1: {PlayerName}, did you find any heated Pavo Plums?
Daily_BWGJ_4_2: Exactly as the chronicles described... I didn't expect it to exist. Interesting... But it could be a mutation.
Daily_BWGJ_4_5: H-haha. Don't be upset. Presumption is the first step toward truth.
Daily_BWGJ_4_6: I suspect that the surrounding heat might have induced some changes in these Pavo Plums... potentially altering their medicinal effects.
Daily_BWGJ_4_7: Now, {PlayerName}, could you please say something after I eat the Pavo Plum?
Daily_BWGJ_4_8: Sure, what would you like me to say?
Daily_BWGJ_4_9: Anything will do, preferably something long and complicated. I want to test if it truly helps improve memory.
Daily_BWGJ_4_10: As soon as Shinong finishes the Pavo Plum, his face twists into a peculiar expression.
Daily_BWGJ_4_12: What is it? Is it poisonous?
Daily_BWGJ_4_13: It's so SPICY! I've tasted countless herbs, but I've never tasted anything this SPICY before!
Daily_BWGJ_4_14: Wait, I think it's working... Say something, Rover. Anything!
Daily_BWGJ_4_15: How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if—
Daily_BWGJ_4_16: Oh, my lord, I beg your forgiveness—
Daily_BWGJ_4_17: You effortlessly recite a passage from a tongue twister.
Daily_BWGJ_4_18: You passionately perform a monologue from a movie film.
Daily_BWGJ_4_20: Did you catch all of that?
Daily_BWGJ_4_22: Whole thing sounded like a bust from the get-go.
Daily_BWGJ_4_23: That doesn't mean all myths are false.
Daily_BWGJ_4_24: After all, it's just a fictional anecdote that can't be taken too seriously. But you never know unless you give it a try.
Daily_BWGJ_4_25: Perhaps. If I've learned anything from revising these pharmacopoeias, it's never to underestimate the wisdom of those who came before us.
Daily_BWGJ_4_26: Anyway, these Pavo Plums don't show any special effects, even though they can absorbe heat... and are extremely spicy. Well, that's a small discovery, at least.
Daily_BWGJ_4_27: Thank you, {PlayerName}. There are still quite a few herbs from the pharmacopoeia that I haven't tried yet. I'll go and search for them now.
Daily_BWGJ_5_3: I fell off the hill by accident. Luckily I got away with only a swollen leg.
Daily_BWGJ_5_4: According to the pharmacopoeia, a herb called Elderflower grows on the hilltop, which is far more effective for treating external injuries than other herbs.
Daily_BWGJ_5_5: However, it appears I overestimated my athletic abilities.
Daily_BWGJ_5_6: Anyway... Ahem, I'll need your help again, {PlayerName}. Could you go to the hilltop and pick some Elderflowers for me?
Daily_BWGJ_5_7: Elderflowers grow at the top of that hill, so please be careful. But given your abilities, I'm sure it will be a piece of cake.
Daily_BWGJ_6_2: According to the pharmacopoeia, simply grind them into paste and apply it to the injury. It takes effect almost immediately.
Daily_BWGJ_6_3: Shinong applies the paste to his leg, wincing at the sharp sting it causes.
Daily_BWGJ_6_4: Ah... All right, this should do it now.
Daily_BWGJ_6_6: Much better... I should be back on my feet after a bit of rest.
Daily_BWGJ_6_7: You must find it strange, {PlayerName}. Why am I out here risking my life instead of treating others back at the clinic in Jinzhou?
Daily_BWGJ_6_8: Many believe that I'm doing this for fame and attention.
Daily_BWGJ_6_9: For minor ailments that could easily be treated with injections or pills, using herbs involves a lot of effort, including collecting, concocting, and refining the herbs.
Daily_BWGJ_6_10: ...They think it's meaningless, just a form of performative art and self-satisfaction. What do you think, {PlayerName}?
Daily_BWGJ_6_11: It's about carrying on the tradition.
Daily_BWGJ_6_12: Plus, many people still rely on it.
Daily_BWGJ_6_13: Exactly. These pharmacopoeias are the legacy of our ancestors' wisdom. Yet, nowadays, few are willing to put in the time to revise them.
Daily_BWGJ_6_14: As a result, the errors in these pharmacopoeias keep piling up, making them less and less trustworthy. Many people who could have been cured end up having their conditions worsen or prolonged due to incorrect treatments.
Daily_BWGJ_6_15: I'm not doing this for fame. I just want to preserve our ancestors' tradition and help more people avoid suffering.
Daily_BWGJ_6_17: ...No, it's just a simple wish. The wish of a doctor.
Daily_BWGJ_6_18: Maybe I'm just a humble doctor, but at least I have the courage to see it through.
Daily_BWGJ_6_19: I wish you all the best!
Daily_BWGJ_6_20: Thank you for your help, {PlayerName}. Don't worry, I'll get back in town soon.

Daily_BWGJ_8_17: I've made a lot of progress recently and have finished revising the  pharmacopoeias in Hongzhen.
Daily_BWGJ_8_18: I'll send them to the clinics. Hopefully, what I'm doing can benefit more people.
Daily_BWGJ_8_20: Next? There's a long journey ahead. The world is vast, and there are countless pharmacopoeias to rectify. I'm not sure how many I can complete.

Character_Encore_64_1: Hmm... How do we solve this one...?
Character_Encore_66_1: Feeling stuck? Why don't we search around for clues?
Character_Encore_69_1: No worries. We can use that platform down there to fly across!
Character_Encore_7_1: You must be new to this place! Are you also searching for the Gateway of Wishes?
Character_Encore_7_2: (Gateway of Wishes? Looks like I'm inside Encore's story somehow...)
Character_Encore_7_4: I just want to find my way back.
Character_Encore_7_5: That's great! How about we team up? I have a wish I want to make, too!
Character_Encore_7_6: Then we'll be going in the same direction! If we reach the end of this journey and find out about the Gateway of Wishes, we'll be back to the real world in no time!
Character_Encore_7_7: Since it's your first time here, everything must feel strange to you, huh?
Character_Encore_7_8: This is the Wooly Kingdom, a land filled with lots and lots of woolies. Look, even the clouds are shaped like them!
Character_Encore_7_9: You're in luck, I know this place like the back of my hand. I can be your tour guide!
Character_Encore_7_11: I want to look around on my own.
Character_Encore_7_13: Oh. Okay then... I mean, we're heading in the same direction anyway. You can look at your part and I'll look at mine.
Character_Encore_7_14: Fairy Cloudy told me that as long as we walk along this path, we'll get there eventually!
Character_Encore_7_15: Once we're there, I gotta make her tell us where all the treasure is hidden...
Character_Encore_7_16:
As you open your eyes, you find yourself within the world of the story. Soon, you cross paths with Encore, who is searching for the legendary Gateway of Wishes. She explains that you're in the Wooly Kingdom and that a way out lies at the end of the road.
You decide to journey together.
Character_Encore_8_1: Please don't hurt me. Baa... I'm just an ordinary box. Baa...

Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_8: At the Moon-Chasing Festival, we worked together on a painting commission. Her brushwork was so exquisite and expressive.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_9: Oh, right! She helped out at the fan drawing stall during the festival. Her artwork was so popular, I couldn't get one myself.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_10: Now that you mention it, she seems perfect for this job! If she takes it, the client will be very pleased.
Character_ZheZhiBuChong_1_11: Thanks for bringing this up! We will make sure to contact her.

Flow_226750000_13: Is it just me, or is the light bulb on my tail brighter than before?
Flow_226750000_14: You'tan and I will ensure your safety.

Event_WWDH_1_1: What's up, old friend? Long time no see. Looks like you didn't die from boredom while I was gone.
Event_WWDH_1_3: Well, if it isn't good old Maji...
Event_WWDH_1_4: Hahaha. All thanks to you, the "Lollo Entrepreneur Incubator Project" last time went down as smooth as butter. Even though it's not being adopted for the time being...
Event_WWDH_1_5: But visiting the headquarters and diving into some other projects was really an eye-opener for me, and so I've come up with a brand new idea.
Event_WWDH_1_7: A lot of the service pilots we prepped before operated on "independent tracks." I was thinking maybe we could consolidate them into a single "track."
Event_WWDH_1_8: To do so, we connect different services and functionalities to a certain main body, so that the former act as accessories that exist to perfect the latter.
Event_WWDH_1_9: Kinda like... the Utility module that you Resonators use. A single unit equipped with various tools for exploration.
Event_WWDH_1_14: So, are you interested in joining the trial run for the "Lollo Navigator," {PlayerName}?
Event_WWDH_1_16: We've been in this together for how long now?
Event_WWDH_1_18: Outstanding. I'll let you know as soon as I get a new update for the "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_10_1: Oh. You're such a great help. The speed, this quality... I didn't expect "Lollo Navigator" actually meant it when it said, "Apply user experience as a closed-loop evaluation standard."
Event_WWDH_10_2: Feels like I've heard of this one before.
Event_WWDH_10_3: This guy never changes, all right.
Event_WWDH_10_4: Thank you so much. I should get back to work. Once I finish this batch of orders, I'll be sure to give you a five-star rating!
Event_WWDH_11_1: We're temporarily suspending all trial runs for today, {PlayerName}. We need to do some maintenance on "Lollo Navigator"!
Event_WWDH_11_4: Well... in a way, yes, but it's only temporary. We need to recalibrate the dynamic map info of "Lollo Navigator" after its long trial run.
Event_WWDH_11_5: No, no, no. We just need to recalibrate the dynamic map info of "Lollo Navigator" after its long trial run.
Event_WWDH_11_6: We need to ensure everything's accurate and on time. Now that you're here, why not help me find a few things as references for the information?
Event_WWDH_11_8: You know, besides road conditions, things like plants, animals, minerals, their growth cycles, and their environments are also key references for dynamic information.
Event_WWDH_11_9: The objects I need are sent to your Terminal. Good luck out there!
Event_WWDH_12_1: Really appreciate the hard work. These reference objects will definitely come in handy. Here's your pay for today, you earned it.
Event_WWDH_13_1: The rain from last night finally stopped, {PlayerName}. And the trial run of our program is finally drawing to a close.
Event_WWDH_13_3: Let me see if "Lollo Navigator" has received any... Wait a sec, someone actually used the expedite feature.
Event_WWDH_13_4: It's from a courier near Taoyuan Vale. Looks like that heavy rain last night did a number on the shipping labels.
Event_WWDH_13_5: Now they can't make out the goods and need help from the "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_13_6: Can shipping labels also be recorded?
Event_WWDH_13_7: Of course not, it would count as a violation of the user's privacy. But don't forget that the map is updated live.
Event_WWDH_13_8: It can't record the user's information, but it can record and track their transportation routes on the map.
Event_WWDH_13_9: Each goods use different routes, so we can make a rough estimate based on this information, and then use the logistics system to verify.
Event_WWDH_13_10: Let's go, {PlayerName}. Gotta save that perfect score on the last day of the trial run!
Event_WWDH_14_1: After some hard work, you and Maji used the data recorded by "Lollo Navigator" to help the couriers verify their goods. In the end, all the couriers gave you a thumbs-up.
Event_WWDH_15_1: Phew... I'm so beat. Even with "Lollo Navigator," it took a helluva longer than I expected.
Event_WWDH_15_2: But it was worth the good reviews.
Event_WWDH_15_3: You're right. "Lollo Navigator" did its job well, and thank you for testing out all of the many features during its trial run.
Event_WWDH_15_4: I'll sort out all this data and fix any potential problems. Here's hoping that "Lollo Navigator" can officially go live and be promoted for mass use someday…
Event_WWDH_15_5: See this, I left a spot right next to the developer's credits...
Event_WWDH_15_7: Yup. Wait for my good news. Goodbye, {PlayerName}.
Event_WWDH_16_2: I don't remember Maji ever mentioning them...
Event_WWDH_17_1: For this trial run, {PlayerName}. I plan to merge the users as one group. A group I know best, the Lollo Logistics.
Event_WWDH_17_2: For them, the map is king. As long as...
Event_WWDH_17_3: Just as Maji is about to explain the details to you, the applet on the "Lollo Navigator" starts chiming…
Event_WWDH_17_4: See that? That's a call for action for "Lollo Navigator." I'm sending you the coordinates I just received.
Event_WWDH_17_5: To get familiarized with all the features, it's better to go and see for yourself.
Event_WWDH_2_1: The program shows the color on this part of the map has changed. You did it, {PlayerName}.
Event_WWDH_2_3: Remember "Lollo Hitman" from last time? I've loaded some of its features into this new program. The trips out in the wild can be tough, and emergencies can pop up any time.
Event_WWDH_2_4: If "Lollo Hitman" was a response measure for emergencies, then the new program acts as an early warning system.
Event_WWDH_2_5: Couriers can provide real-time feedback on road conditions to the "Lollo Navigator," which means the map is constantly being updated.
Event_WWDH_2_8: So your plan is to combine the map with the various services mentioned earlier?
Event_WWDH_2_9: Exactly. We also have other new services currently running in their trial phases. You've done a great job today. Let's try out the rest of the features some other time.
Event_WWDH_3_1: Detected: An item in need of repairs in the Lollo Warehouse vicinity. Timely repairs are advised...
Event_WWDH_3_2: Timely repairs are advised. Timely repairs are advised. Timely repairs are advised...
Event_WWDH_3_3: Okay, Okay. Stop, stop it already. Sheesh. Weird, I don't remember installing a repeat function for reminders...
Event_WWDH_3_5: Looks like they've given it the new "Lollo Fixit" DLC.
Event_WWDH_3_6: Here you are, {PlayerName}. Just a sec. I need to turn off this annoying reminder.
Event_WWDH_3_7: Hehe. You're as sharp as a tack per usual, {PlayerName}.
Event_WWDH_3_8: Introducing, the new "Lollo Fixit." A fixer on the go!
Event_WWDH_3_9: The live map now can not only record road conditions but also keep tabs on the status of equipment.
Event_WWDH_3_10: If the system fails to receive regular data reports from the equipment after a certain period of time, "Lollo Navigator" will log its map coordinates, and the duration shall reflect the likelihood of a malfunction.
Event_WWDH_3_12: As you saw earlier, the Sound Emulator at the Lollo Warehouse hasn't reported back in a long time, likely due to a malfunction. I'll leave the repairs to you.
Event_WWDH_4_1: Finally, it's stopped repeating itself. Looks like your work is done over there.
Event_WWDH_4_2: Thanks for the hard work. Did you get today's payment? I might need your help again with improving the other features later.
Event_WWDH_5_1: You come just in time, {PlayerName}. No time to explain. Quick, I need you to connect to "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_5_2: It's been crammed with too much data lately, and the system can't handle it, so some of the data's being corrupted.
Event_WWDH_5_3: If this thing crashes and sends out wrong information to the users, we'd be in a world of trouble.
Event_WWDH_6_1: Phew. Close one. "Lollo Navigator" would've gone haywire if you hadn't given us a hand.
Event_WWDH_6_4: This little crisis exposed a bit of a problem in the program... It's got a limited capacity for storing map information. Well, better late than never, right?
Event_WWDH_6_5: Couldn't have done it without you, {PlayerName}. How about we call it a day? I need to go sort this thing out, pronto.
Event_WWDH_7_1: This area of the map turned red, {PlayerName}. There's also an increase in reports from the couriers.
Event_WWDH_7_2: There might be some kind of threat brewing in the area. I'll leave the investigation to you.
Event_WWDH_7_3: Once you're done, you can also try sending live information to "Lollo Navigator" remotely.
Event_WWDH_8_1: I remember Maji taught me how to transmit data. Let's see here...
Event_WWDH_8_2: There... This should do the trick... I think.
Event_WWDH_8_3: I'm back where I started. And the other statues are gone... I should record this anomaly.
Event_WWDH_9_1: Gloves, boots, spare crates, and emergency rations... All that's left is...
Event_WWDH_9_2: Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}. Just in time to show you another feature of "Lollo Navigator."
Event_WWDH_9_3: Lollo Navigator can give couriers info on supply wear and consumption along the route based on real-time geographical and road conditions.
Event_WWDH_9_4: And whenever they need a resupply, they can just request it through the app. This batch of orders is still missing some items.
Event_WWDH_9_6: It feels like I've done this before.
Event_WWDH_9_7: Would you mind helping me prepare a few <color=Highlight>Basic Nutrient Blocks</color> and then give them to the recipient couriers?
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_3: Here, the story both ends and begins anew.
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_4: I am pleased to see you back on these shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_5: Wherever you venture, be it Huanglong or Rinascita, I will always be here, waiting.
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_6: No matter how far you wander, you will always find me here... on these black shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_10_7: As you traverse the Sonoro Sphere, you finally arrive at your true beginnings. Yet, the person who waits here remains beyond your grasp…
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_4: Is it really you? No, no, don't let this be a dream… At last! You've come to me, to the Black Shores!
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_7: We need to hurry. Time is one luxury we do not have. Let's save the rest for the road.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_8: Phew, finally out of the cave.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_9: But why is the fog still so thick? I can't even see you!
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_11: Because you're at Veiled Rock, your vision is veiled. Now, how about explaining what brings you here, uninvited guests?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_12: Wait, what? This is the Black Shores?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_14: But how did you manage to get here?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_15: You recount to Aalto the events that led to your arrival here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_16: I see… Tsk, the situation doesn't look good.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_17: That Hoda might not be one of us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_18: Ahem... Anyway, let's not get carried away. We should head to the Greenhouse. The abnormal frequency you collected needs to be uploaded to the Tethys System as soon as possible in order to avoid another Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_22: As for the information you're after—
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_24: But I'm curious... could I have a look at that item the antique dealer gave you?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_25: You hand the antique Youhu gave you over to Aalto.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_26: Huh, didn't expect to see it outside Mt. Firmament…
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_28: A monitoring register. We, Black Shores members, place these around the world to keep an eye on the Sentinels. If anything happens to them, we'll know immediately.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_29: Looks like it was also used to record abnormal frequencies in the Port City of Guixu…
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_35: But why was I teleported here?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_36: Maybe the Tethys System has a soft spot for you? But without more details, I can't say for sure.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_37: Since your arrival, has anything unusual caught your eye?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_38: You tell Aalto about the person you met on the beach…
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_39: A person in light blue… Could it be the Shorekeeper?
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_41: Yes, the elusive guardian of the Black Shores, who is said to be always watching our true leader, shielding us from danger. It seems you've had quite the encounter.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_42: In times of great adversity, the Shorekeeper will reveal herself and support our true leader, who, at the destined moment, will rise to save and guide the Black Shores. Fantastical or not, that's all we've got to go on.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_43: There must be a reason she went to such lengths for you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_44: Given that we've already lost enough of our own to it, we need more Bloom Bearers to handle this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_45: Seems like the Tethys malfunction is getting worse.
Heihaian_main_1_3_12_46: Passing through the mist, you encounter Aalto on patrol. After you recount your recent experience, he speculates that the blue figure you just saw might be the Shorekeeper from the Black Shores. However, the immediate priority is to upload the abnormal frequency to the Tethys System for analysis. Meanwhile, the Black Shores seem to be grappling with certain anomalies...
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_1: Hey! Can you hear me! Is that you, Rover? Are you okay?!
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_2: We couldn't reach you for so long! Yangyang was freaking out!
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_4: Someone must have teleported us away from the Port City of Guixu when things went south.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_5: You know, in the blink of an eye, we were back in Jinzhou.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_6: Hey, is that the sea behind you?
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_8: Comm's dead? Don't worry. It happens a lot around here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_9: The Black Shores sits atop a massive Tacetite, wreaking havoc on standard communications.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_11: Once we reach the Greenhouse, you can patch them in near our beacon.
Heihaian_main_1_3_14_12: Only our beacons can cut through the Tacetite's interference.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1401_1: The island is quiet and serene.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1401_2: It appears these islands have deliberately formed a circle, leaving a void in the center.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_1: Aalto, there you are. And this is…?
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_2: The Rover just arrived. {Male=He;Female=She} is the one we invited earlier—the mysterious Resonator who appeared in Jinzhou.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_3: So you're the Resonator who confronted the Threnodian? I honestly didn't expect to meet you in person!
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_5: I was supposed to show you around, but things are quite hectic right now. My apologies.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_6: You heard about what happened in Guixu, right?
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_8: Exactly. We need Tethys functioning normally to fully resolve this.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_11: Hoda? No, I don't recall any Bloom Bearer by that name. Why do you ask?
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_12: You tell Monica what happened in the Port City of Guixu…
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_32: But retrieving the abnormal frequency was a significant step forward.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_33: Ahem, sorry, I got a bit carried away. My name's Monica, the chief administrator—or "housekeeper" around here.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_34: Those Bloom Bearers didn't sacrifice themselves in vain…
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_36: Efforts to stabilize the Tethys System are underway.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_37: Good to hear. By the way, since you deal with all our contacts, does the name "Hoda" ring any bells? She claims to be a Bloom Bearer.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_38: Yes, we received word from Jinzhou's City Hall about their actions. We also alerted them to the Tethys System's likely warning of a potential Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_40: The data you brought back has been uploaded to the system, but as you know, Tethys has been unstable.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_41: It could have been much worse if they hadn't risked their lives to transmit the coordinates back to Niya. And thank you for risking your life to retrieve the data.
Heihaian_main_1_3_15_43: You meet Monica, the chief administrator of the Black Shores, and discover that the Tethys System has been experiencing instability. You then brief her on the recent events in the Port City of Guixu.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_13: So, this is related to that abnormal frequency…
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_15: That theory doesn't hold water. Not only are traitors incredibly rare in our history, they are all documented.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_16: And there's no record of her in the system. Was she trying to mislead us?
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_19: Well, looks like she's made herself at home in Tethys.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_20: I'll check with KU-Money to assess the current situation underground. We need to do everything in our power to protect Tethys from any harm.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_21: {PlayerName}, could you please accompany Aalto to the Greenhouse? We need you to find the KU-Water robots.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_22: Also, ensure the Modulation Device in the Greenhouse remains secure.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_28: …I'm sorry. You were meant to have a pleasant time here…
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_29: When the dust clears, I'd like to formally welcome you to join us.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_43: She told me I was once part of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_44: Hmm, that's strange, because we just added you to the recruitment list recently.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_45: She's quite the mystery... Monica, can you try to gather more info about this Hoda for us?
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_46: Of course. If it concerns the security of the Black Shores, it's my job.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_47: If this... "person" was truly residing in that abnormal frequency, "she" could be responsible for those deaths.
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_49: If she was residing in that abnormal frequency…
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_50: —Damn it, we've been tricked. We just fed it back into Tethys!
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_52: Did we just upload it to…?
Heihaian_main_1_3_1501_53: Even Monica, the chief administrator of the Black Shores, has never heard of the name Hoda. Right after your discussion, another quake shakes the Black Shores, echoing the disaster in the Port City of Guixu. To safeguard the Tethys System, Monica instructs you to inspect the Modulation Device in the Greenhouse.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_2: Aalto? I've told you before, when it comes to the classic games on the TR-1200, you don't stand a chance against me. Not in the slightest!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_5: Well, in a sense, yes. They're directly linked to the Tethys System, their voice frequencies are encoded into languages we could understand. If you think about it, they could be considered a unique living race of their own.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_6: Anyway... let me introduce you to KU-Money. They manage the cash flow and keep tabs on robot terminals across the region. They're the shrewd profiteer of the Black Shores.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_7: Yo, hold up! You can't call me that! Every move I make is about stacking those chips for the Black Shores!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_21: I haven't heard of anyone with such an ability either.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_22: Gravity control? Sounds farfetched. I'd sooner believe in someone minting Shell Credits.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_23: Unlikely that exists in any universe.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_24: Keep me posted if you find one.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_25: Well, it's a big world, after all. Since we already know someone who can resonate with the Sentinel… you never know.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_27: Sure thing! We can split the Shell Credits they generate, 30-70. I'll take the 70, you take the 30. That's the deal!
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_29: As for Hoda... If she's a Bloom Bearer, there should be a record of her in the system. And if such a Resonator existed, the Black Shores would definitely know.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_31: She's not from the Black Shores?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_32: Yeah, that's one possibility. Not to worry, if the machine route doesn't work, there's another way...
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_33: Let's go to the Greenhouse. Most of us like to gather there, and Monica, our chief administrator, is stationed there as well.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_35: Easy there. Let's get back to business.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_36: The recent quake's stirred up Tacetite's interference. How's your underground connection holding?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_37: Rock solid. As long as Tethys is up, we're wired tight.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_38: That's comforting. Hey {PlayerName}, you can give the abnormal frequency to KU-Money. They'll handle the upload.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_39: You hand over the card Youhu gave you to the peculiar robot.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_40: This a new rookie? You've got skills if you snagged that abnormal frequency from Port City of Guixu. Better not underestimate you.
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_45: How's the upload? Already sent the data back to Tethys?
Heihaian_main_1_3_17_48: Since you're linked to the Tethys' data bank, can you check if there's a Bloom Bearer named Hoda registered?

Event_SLLSQXQY_1_1: Hello! I'm Arno, a special agent from the Black Shores. What should I call you?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_3: Hello, {PlayerName}! I ran into some issue with the periodical data collection work I'm tasked with, and I'm looking for some help. Are you interested?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_7: Thank you! I'll give you a quick rundown of what we do first.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_8: This is a key part of our project. Let me give you a quick rundown of the work first. You can decide if you want to be involved based on your circumstances.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_9: The Black Shores always reward generously for facilitators, of course. Let me give you a quick rundown of the work first. You can decide if you want to be involved based on your circumstances.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_11: You should have heard about the Lament and how it happens, I think. How much do you know about the whole Lament forecasting process?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_12: The Black Shores serves as a weather station, gathering data to enhance Lament predictions like meteorologists do with weather forecasts.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_13: As a special agent, I periodically travel all around the world to collect data from various locations to improve our prediction models.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_14: The data collection for this cycle is almost done, but I suspect I'm still missing accurate data in a few spots.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_15: So now I'm hoping to recruit some people to help me collect better data samples.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_16: What do I need to do, exactly?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_17: Currently, we need a special detection device to collect the Lament surveilance data.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_18: The device detects and marks datasets that fit the criteria. Just walk near them to collect automatically.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_19: But it <color=Highlight>cannot run continuously</color> due to high energy consumption. If you fail to gather enough data in a set time, it will shut down automatically.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_20: Please help us collect <color=Highlight>as many datasets as possible</color> to yield an accurate result.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_21: Oh yes, we have also set up temporary mechanisms at the target locations. They'll activate along with the detection device.
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_22: How did it go? Wasn't hard for you, right? Would you like to help me collect more data?
Event_SLLSQXQY_1_24: Thanks. My assistant KU-Ryan will guide you through it.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_2: The surveillance data you collected has been analyzed and sent back to the Black Shores.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_3: The data is top-notch—maybe enough for us to add a new variable in our forcast model.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_4: Hopefully, we'll be able to provide even better predictions soon.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_6: You're being too kind. We couldn't have done this without you...
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_7: KU-Ryan and I are not exactly the athletic type. It would’ve been nearly impossible to gather sufficient data in such a short time.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_8: And will that new variable improve your predictions a lot?
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_9: It may not have a huge impact. Maybe just a few seconds or milliseconds of difference.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_10: But who knows what situations we'll face in the future? Our new model might be the key to unlocking any loopholes in the old one.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_11: Many people may not understand why I collect data in such a tedious way.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_12: But like they say in Huanglong, a minuscule error could lead to major consequences.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_13: "If only the forecast was one second closer..." "If only the projected spot was ten centimeters more precise..."
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_14: ...But by then, it would be too tardy for regrets.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_15: A few seconds or centimeters could mean life and death. I could've saved more lives with a more precise prediction—
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_16: The thought of that makes me unable to accept any error in the data I handle.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_17: Oops. Sorry, I got ahead of myself.
Event_SLLSQXQY_10_19: I look forward to working with you again!
