Event_WGZM_25_5: If you let your mind wander for a second, you never know what might jump out at you.
Event_WGZM_25_6: So, are you here to help?
Event_WGZM_25_7: Of course, darling. We share the same goal, after all.
Event_WGZM_25_8: By the way, I found this nearby. Here, take it.
Event_WGZM_25_9: Let's finish up here quickly, and in return for my little gift... Promise me you'll save some time for me in the real world, okay?
Event_WGZM_26_1: Well, well, I didn't think we could have this kind of fun here.
Event_WGZM_26_2: Do whatever you want—let's make it more intense, more fiery, more electrifying than the real world…
Event_WGZM_26_4: You're next once I've handled things here.
Event_WGZM_26_5: Are you going to keep me waiting again? Why can't we fight right now?
Event_WGZM_26_6: Because I have something urgent to take care of.
Event_WGZM_26_7: Fine… I'll behave. There's still plenty of time for us, hehe.
Event_WGZM_26_8: I can feel it... Those chaotic energies are gathering somewhere. Looks like there's a big surprise in store for you.
Event_WGZM_26_10: Hehe, take this little cutie with you and hurry back, my seed of fate.
Event_WGZM_27_1: {PlayerName}, I was musing about their relationship.
Event_WGZM_27_2: Do you mean the dynamics between the Ebony and Ivory Gatekeepers?
Event_WGZM_27_3: Yes, the Somnoire's guardians. Are they rivals or allies?
Event_WGZM_27_4: I think it's a bit of both.
Event_WGZM_27_5: Sometimes they work together, and other times they clash.
Event_WGZM_27_6: Hmm… They're like two sides of the same coin—interdependent yet counterbalancing. The Somnoire reflects that balance.
Event_WGZM_27_7: The recent disturbances were the result of a series of actions that tipped the scales, rather than the fault of one side going off track.
Event_WGZM_27_8: So, we need to restore the balance.
Event_WGZM_27_9: Are you suggesting I shouldn't favor the Ivory Gatekeeper?
Event_WGZM_27_10: Just my humble opinion. No need to dwell on it. Here, take this pouch. It may prove useful on your journey.
Event_WGZM_27_11: By the way, I'd love to hear about your adventures when you're back, if you have time.
Event_WGZM_3_4: It's Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain.
Event_WGZM_3_5: Why can't I be here? Are you worried that I might be someone else?
Event_WGZM_3_6: There are still lots of messes to clean up, and besides, the dream's not over yet.
Event_WGZM_3_7: You remember what happened before, right?
Event_WGZM_3_8: Of course! We teamed up and took down that big cat, right?
Event_WGZM_3_9: Don't ya know dreams can pick up where they left off? Must be thanks to that Ivory Gatekeeper, huh?
Event_WGZM_3_11: He helped a lot, didn't he?
Event_WGZM_3_12: Anyway, now that we're back, let's shake things up! No regrets when we wake up!
Event_WGZM_3_13: Oh, by the way, I ran into this quiet lady on my way here. She asked me to deliver this package to you.
Event_WGZM_3_15: Yep! Just sign here, and—another satisfied customer!
Event_DSJDYCF_1_1: {PlayerName}... I-I think I just saw someone else's dream.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_2: It was in a small, dim room. A child, with her parents watching so warmly, blew out the candles on a tiny cake... and smiled.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_4: Yes... It was such a simple, ordinary moment, but it felt so full of happiness.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_5: Maybe I had moments like that when I was little too.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_6: But I can't remember anymore... I've gotten so used to being alone. And in my dreams, my parents always seem so... stern, so far away.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_9: N-no... I'm not strong... but if that's how you see me, I-I'll try to live up to your expectations.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_10: Um... t-thank you... It makes me really happy to hear that, b-but... I don't know how to respond...
Event_DSJDYCF_1_11: I've probably taken up too much of your time. Please, take this painting with you.
Event_DSJDYCF_1_12: Even if it was just a dream, it holds a lot of my feelings... a-and I want to share them with you.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_1: Ah, you're here. Speaking of which, I've stumbled upon quite a few... intriguing nightmares lately.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_3: Yes. I encountered different dreamers, but they all feared the same figure—though her appearance varied from one dream to the next.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_4: Sometimes she appeared as a stern office worker, sometimes a lowlife street thug, and other times... a lone Exile wandering the wilds.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_5: Ah, I see. That person... it was you, wasn't it?
Event_DSJDYCF_2_6: Those were criminals' nightmares about you, right?
Event_DSJDYCF_2_7: Well, I rarely reveal myself during a mission, but it's amusing when the "lucky few" get a glimpse.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_8: If they're haunted by a little... trauma, it might make them hesitate the next time they think of causing trouble.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_11: Hehe, trying to console me, are you, darling? Playing these sinister roles is simply part of the game. It's only natural that I appear in their nightmares.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_12: But I see the real you—not the masks you wear.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_13: I always see you as who you are.
Event_DSJDYCF_2_14: You certainly know what to say, don't you?
Event_DSJDYCF_2_15: Then come closer. I want to reward you with... a memory that tingles just right.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_1: So, it really is you. I owe you my gratitude.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_4: I was trapped in yet another endless dream, fighting Tacet Discords alone. No matter how many I vanquished, they continued to rise.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_5: The voices of the fallen cursed my every step, assailing my spirit. Yet, amidst the chaos, a radiant, golden light broke through the darkness.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_6: It was fleeting, but soon after, you appeared.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_8: You're the one who endured to the end.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_9: Before, such dreams felt eternal, persisting until I awoke.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_10: Yet, ever since we've crossed paths, I haven't been haunted by them again.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_11: That dream will never become reality.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_12: If you ever falter, I'll stand beside you and support you.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_13: Thank you... If you're heading to somewhere perilous, take this lance.
Event_DSJDYCF_4_14: May it grant you safe passage through every trial, and may it help you prevail the lasting night.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_1: I didn't expect to cross paths with you here, {PlayerName}.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_2: This place... it's quite amazing. As I walked through, I felt as if I was drifting between past memories and, at times, into the fantasies of others.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_4: I see. That would explain a lot.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_6: Dreams always stir mixed emotions in me. For a long time, I was plagued by nightmares.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_7: Sleepless nights filled with images of my people displaced, shivering in the cold, and facing hunger. We were all so small before the might of the Lament.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_8: Yet, those nightmares serve as a constant reminder of the complex challenges our people face, the burdens I bear as the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_9: It's okay to take a rest sometimes.
Event_DSJDYCF_3_10: Let go of your responsibilities! You're in a dream!
Event_DSJDYCF_3_11: But aren't you working just as hard to protect what you hold dear?
Event_DSJDYCF_3_12: This ear of millet... it holds deep meaning for me, but now, I'd like you to have it. May everything go smoothly for you on your journey.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_3: I just had a dream from my past.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_4: Simple dishes—plain noodles and soft steamed buns—but even in the dream, they appeared irresistible.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_7: Surprised? In my childhood, I wandered the streets, often plagued by hunger. Each time I passed a restaurant or a food stall, my steps felt heavier.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_8: Back then, all I longed for was a decent meal—so much so that it echoed even in my dreams.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_9: That must have been tough for you.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_10: It's behind me now. Look at me, healthy and well, am I not?
Event_DSJDYCF_5_11: When peace is finally enjoyed across the land, no one will have to starve as I once did.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_12: When we wake, let's go grab a meal together.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_13: I'll treat you to a feast in reality.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_14: Hehe, I won't say no to that. Then, it's a promise.
Event_DSJDYCF_5_15: Here, take this journal. It contains some recommendations. I hope you find it useful.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_5: You faintly hear the sounds of waves crashing against the shore—they seem distant, yet stirring emotions within you.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_6: Those sounds always take me back to the moments we shared—bathed in soft moonlight, with fine sand beneath us, and the rhythm of your breath and heartbeat filling the air.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_7: You really cherish those memories, don't you?
Event_DSJDYCF_6_8: ...It reassured me that I have indeed kept our memories for you.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_9: We'll create even more memories together.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_10: Let's explore more of the world together.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_11: Indeed, our connection will only grow stronger.
Event_DSJDYCF_6_12: Let these bright stars guide you on your journey.
Event_WGZM_8_1: As expected, our paths shall always cross, even in dreams.
Event_WGZM_8_3: I'm surprised that you also dream.
Event_WGZM_8_4: Yes. Your arrival provided an opening for me to enter this realm.
Event_WGZM_8_5: Yes, and in the few dreams I have, your presence is always there.
Event_WGZM_8_6: You have probably noticed that this place looks similar to the Black Shores.
Event_WGZM_8_7: Will the Black Shores be affected in reality?
Event_WGZM_8_8: Not at this moment, but this dreamscape is on the brink of collapsing.
Event_WGZM_8_9: Dreams of the Black Shores are gathering, mingling with those from other realms.
Event_WGZM_8_10: I sense those wishes, memories, and obsessions are turning into something familiar yet dangerous.
Event_WGZM_8_12: The existing data isn't enough to provide a clear answer...
Event_WGZM_8_13: In the worst case, this dreamscape could collapse under their impact.
Event_WGZM_8_14: But don't worry. I will use my power to stabilize this realm, and I will stay by your side until the end of your journey.
Event_WGZM_8_16: Our goal is to resolve this crisis, right?
Event_WGZM_8_17: Yes. {PlayerName}, if you ever lose your way, call my name.
Event_WGZM_8_18: Remember, I am always here, right by your side.
Event_WGZM_12_1: So this is how it is... I see...
Event_WGZM_12_4: The dreams of the Black Shores act like a gravitational center, pulling in other dreams to form entities of extreme density.
Event_WGZM_12_5: Those perished members of the Black Shores… Their thoughts linger and evolve within the dreams.
Event_WGZM_12_6: Their unshakable longings and aspirations lie deep within layers of volatile frequencies.
Event_WGZM_12_7: But why are they trying to destroy the Somnoire?
Event_WGZM_12_8: No, it's not destruction they want. They're trying to break free.
Event_WGZM_12_9: They are trying to escape from this space and return to the real world they once strove to save.
Event_WGZM_12_11: It's futile to try to bridge the gap between dreams and reality.
Event_WGZM_12_12: …But they dove headfirst into the Lament, fully knowing they were likely to fail. Maybe it was that same determination that drove them to take this path.
Event_WGZM_12_15: This is the only thing we can do for them.
Event_WGZM_13_1: We are not here to prove that resistance is futile, but to mark that… we don't go down without a fight…
Event_WGZM_14_1: When those who follow see our gravestones, they will understand… humanity never surrenders…
Event_WGZM_15_1: We won't retreat… ██. This is our final task… Not everyone is lucky enough to bear this responsibility…
Event_WGZM_16_1: We're so close to getting the accurate modeling of ██… Just give me a bit more time, as long as it's before the Lament strikes…
Event_WGZM_17_1: Gravity... is the only pre-Lament law of physics that still holds true today…
Event_WGZM_18_1: {PlayerName}, you've helped them break free from their hopeless quest to return home.
Event_WGZM_18_3: Those scattered dreams will still wander this realm, but they won't be burdened by those overwhelming desires anymore.
Event_WGZM_18_4: Do you regret putting an end to those longings and obsessions?
Event_WGZM_18_6: They will live on in our memories, won't they?
Event_WGZM_18_7: You are right. The time has come.
Event_WGZM_18_9: The Black Shores in a dream is not where I truly belong… I must go.
Event_WGZM_18_10: With the help of those two Gatekeepers, you will surely surely help to restore this place back to normal.
Event_WGZM_18_13: It's just… who knows when we'll meet again in our dreams.
Event_WGZM_18_14: Let's meet one day when we wake up.
Event_WGZM_18_15: Yes, when we wake up... tomorrow.
Event_WGZM_19_1: You sorted out those dream masses. Well done.
Event_WGZM_19_4: He's trying to contain those scattered dream fragments.
Event_WGZM_19_5: But it's not an easy job to retrieve them all in such a vast realm as the Somnoire.
Event_WGZM_19_6: You're not to blame for that.
Event_WGZM_19_7: Don't worry, I'll come up with a plan...
Event_WGZM_19_8: Never stop exploring, Dreamwalker. Only in dreams will we find the answers we need.
Event_WGZM_10_1: Impressive work, Dreamwalker. That was quite a formidable foe, but it was still no match for you.
Event_WGZM_10_2: Looks like that's not all of it.
Event_WGZM_10_3: Yes, many more dream masses are lurking in the depths of the Somnoire...
Event_WGZM_10_4: They're getting stronger as we speak, targeting the Somnoire's weak points. It's almost as if they have a mind of their own.
Event_WGZM_10_6: Keep exploring, Dreamwalker. You will find the truth in a dream.
Event_WGZM_11_1: The frequencies I sensed earlier are still there. "They" are hiding in the depths of all of these dreams.
Event_WGZM_11_2: So, that's what a dream mass looks like?
Event_WGZM_11_4: It's likely reflecting a form we're already familiar with, or maybe... it resembles a certain "something" inside the mass.
Event_WGZM_11_5: There are things I need to see for myself. This is the duty you have entrusted to me.
Event_WGZM_11_8: Rest assured, I will not put myself in danger again.
Event_WGZM_11_9: See you soon. You have my word.
Event_WGZM_4_1: Sigh, you must have noticed the Ebony Gatekeeper by now, right? I finally found him.
Event_WGZM_4_2: We were supposed to keep the balance in the Somnoire together… but now, things have spiraled out of control.
Event_WGZM_4_3: There are dream masses just up ahead.
Event_WGZM_4_4: Dreamwalker, please stay vigilant. I wish you the best of luck.
Event_WGZM_5_2: Don't you have anything to say?
Event_WGZM_5_3: These masses are devouring other dreams, threatening the stability of the entire Somnoire…
Event_WGZM_5_4: With what power I have left in me, I'm afraid I can no longer rein them in. I need your help.
Event_WGZM_5_5: You don't sound like you're asking for help.
Event_WGZM_5_6: I know I made a few missteps in trying to save more dreams. I don't expect you to forgive me.
Event_WGZM_5_7: But I am as devastated as anyone to see the Somnoire collapse. You have to believe me.
Event_WGZM_5_8: I'm… sincerely begging for your help.
Event_WGZM_5_9: Alright, but I'm not doing this for you.
Event_WGZM_5_10: Meow three times, and I'll think about it.
Event_WGZM_6_1: Impressive work. These dream masses are disintegrating.
Event_WGZM_6_3: Well, they're breaking down into dream fragments now. In time, they might form something new. I'll track them down, but...
Event_WGZM_6_5: You really need to finish your sentences.
Event_WGZM_6_6: Our actions had unexpected repercussions. More dream masses are escaping the Somnoire. The boundary between reality and dreams is rapidly deteriorating.
Event_WGZM_6_7: I cannot predict what will happen next.
Event_WGZM_6_9: Don't worry. I can handle whatever comes.
Event_WGZM_6_10: That's reassuring. Please do keep exploring the Somnoire.
Event_WGZM_7_1: Abandoned buildings and platforms… I didn't see anything like this before.
Event_WGZM_7_2: Looks like things are shifting again inside the Somnoire…
Event_WGZM_9_1: An entity like this shouldn't exist in a dream… But now that I'm here, let me be of use to you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_1: Three days ago, the delivery van reached Waving Battlefield near Whining Aix's Mire!
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_2: Journeying from the New Federation to Jinzhou, it braved countless trials to arrive at its destination, but alas...
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_3: Enough. Explain it in five words.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_5: You're the one who's in charge of this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_7: Whatever you do, do it right and do it clean. That's the Cruising Drake's principle. Finish what you started.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_8: Ah, Lollo Logistics! How despicable! Utterly insufferable!
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_9: I shall reclaim the package myself, that much is clear!
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_10: The Exile grunts and storms toward the delivery station.
Event_AYKXBRZM_1_11: You unexpectedly overhear two Exiles discussing a lost package during transit, with one of them intent on confronting Lollo Logistics about it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_1: If I really have the chance to kill you...
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_2: Why are you so obsessed with it?
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_4: Well, because it's all about you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_5: Taking your life won't be easy, not with all the strong foes you've defeated.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_6: Unless, of course, you step willingly on to my blade.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_7: Anyway, it doesn't matter. I'd never force you into anything. No fun in that.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_8: Your potential, your desires, your ambitions... They're what truly excite me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_9: But you know what's the icing on the cake? It's how you look into my eyes when you talk about these things...
Event_AYKXBRZM_100_10: Perhaps one day I'll whisk you away to a hidden land, where you'll be mine, and mine alone.
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_3: Did you regain all your power?
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_5: I and all those you helped in the Somnoire are prepared for the final battle.
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_6: Once you're set, we'll be ready to face the one responsible for all this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_101_7: Let's repair the Somnoire and shut down his mischief for good!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_1: All set... It's time to fight!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_2: Here we come, Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_3: I'll give this show a grand finale.
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_4: If I can help then, I'll... I'll do my best!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_5: It's time to end this charade.
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_6: Oh, to dance alongside you in battle... I can't wait any longer.
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_7: Now, give me your battle cry!
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_9: Not that one. It should be "Let's go save the world again!"
Event_AYKXBRZM_102_10: You have rescued all the Resonators trapped in their dreams, and the white cat has largely regained its clearance. You and your companions are now ready to challenge the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_2: Has that black cat vanished for good?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_3: No, he's just lost some control over the Somnoire. It won't be long before he tries to take it back.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_6: Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on him.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_7: Hmm... If things get serious, I can call on you again, can't I?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_8: By the way, did you have something you wanted to ask?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_10: Why did I experience other people's dreams?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_12: Its creation may not be the work of one person. At any rate, I can't say much more about it right now.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_14: Because you, or maybe your past self, told me to keep it hush-hush.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_15: If I were to tell you why, well... that's already saying too much!
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_16: What I can tell you is, you're the Dreamwalker, the only one who can come and go in Somnoire as you please.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_17: You've got control over me, this gateway, and that sneaky black cat.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_18: Basically, you're the only one who can see this gateway and all the anomalies it causes...
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_19: This is what happens when Somnoire expands into reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_20: The black cat turned off Somnoire's filters, so it started copying every dream in Solaris.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_21: To store all those dreams, he opened more gateways that started to leech into reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_22: The dreams you just went through are from folks who got stuck in Somnoire by accident.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_23: But since you control these gateways, you can help them escape.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_24: When they wake up, all they'll have is a vague feeling of what happened.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_25: Just like a real dream, mmm?
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_26: I can finally go back through the gateway I came from, and you... It's time for you to wake up, meow.
Event_AYKXBRZM_106_27: Back on the train, the white cat reveals why you are the only one that can help those trapped in dreams—you hold the highest control over the Somnoire. It also informs you that those you rescue will forget everything that happened in the Somnoire once they wake up.
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_1: Anything else you want to know?
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_5: Of course, silly! You didn't think that was all, did you?
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_6: The black cat might be nursing his boo-boos now, but he's not out of the game yet.
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_7: I'll find you if I need help, Dreamwalker.
Event_AYKXBRZM_107_13: Alright then. See you next time, Dreamwalker!
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_1: If this is a dream, then what happened here isn't real...
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_3: Maybe a bit, but you know what? My team always has my back, dream or not.
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_4: Even in a dream, the friendship felt so real.
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_8: Oh yeah, I've already met you in real life!
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_9: It was your support that kept me going.
Event_AYKXBRZM_108_10: So come find me in reality! I'll be waitin' for you!
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_3: The crisis is over. Why are you still hanging around?
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_4: Outside, more dirt's getting swept under the rug.
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_5: I'm ready to get back. But there is still one thing that's nagging at me...
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_6: You. When I screwed up, you... had my back.
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_7: But hey, dream talk. Who's to say what's real. Not like I screw up in real life.
Event_AYKXBRZM_109_9: Heh, is that right? Prove it to me in the real world, then.
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_1: This is the end of our adventure!
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_4: In this story, the ten warriors defeated the Black Cat Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_5: But there were only six of us.
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_6: Not true! Cosmos, Cloudy, and the white cat were also part of our team...
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_8: Of course they count! We are all brave warriors!
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_9: And the Grape Kingdom is where the next adventure begins...
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_10: Make sure to tell me this story when you wake up.
Event_AYKXBRZM_110_12: Maybe the white cat can be the bad guy next time...
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_2: I couldn't have finished that draft without you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_4: You finished that same painting in reality.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_5: I still find myself swayed by my doubts.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_6: Painting, for me, isn't just in the finished piece. It's the only place I can let my emotions out.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_7: When I worked on that Xiehua Village piece, I felt like I was capturing the very essence of life around me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_8: Thanks to you, I felt bold enough to capture those fleeting moments.
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_9: I really need to be truer to myself...
Event_AYKXBRZM_111_10: Hey, could you visit me when you wake up? I want to show you my painting.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_1: Mmm, what do you think a dream is?
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_2: It's a reflection of the past.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_3: It's a glimpse into the future.
Event_AYKXBRZM_112_5: I realized this was a dream through careful observation. It's often that same keen observation that reveals the deepest truths.

Event_AYKXBRZM_4202_2: I know who I am. I have my own path to walk.

Event_AYKXBRZM_10200_2: I need more space to store these precious dreams and memories.

Event_AYKXBRZM_10306_1: Only by keeping them here can the dreams live on forever!
Event_AYKXBRZM_10400_1: This power... I can feel everyone's support!
Event_AYKXBRZM_105_1: Foolish... You're doing this for nothing!
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_1: What do you want to do?

Event_AYKXBRZM_203_3: I need more space to store these precious dreams and memories.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_4: That's why you're expanding the Somnoire to break into reality itself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_5: Are you planning to expand Somnoire to encompass all of Solaris?

Event_AYKXBRZM_203_8: Just think of it! They will be forever saved and remembered!
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_9: Not every dream holds the key to saving the world... Most are personal, trivial, even selfish.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_10: But still, they should not be erased.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_12: They live on in people's memories.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_13: People may eventually forget them, but Somnoire won't!
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_14: You saw that girl and how deeply she felt about her dream. It holds significance.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_15: That doesn't justify what you're doing.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_17: Tell me, have you ever erased another's dreams? Their memories?
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_18: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_19: For millennia, I've been doing this tirelessly.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_20: Those dreams and I are no different in nature, yet I've done nothing but extinguish them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_21: I don't expect you to understand me. We're not in the same position.
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_22: Just know that even the great Rover cannot stop me now!
Event_AYKXBRZM_203_23: To preserve every dream within the Somnoire, the Ebony Gatekeeper resolves to use the real world—the entire Solaris—as a new vessel for dreams. He opens numerous gateways throughout Solaris, allowing dreams to invade and consume reality itself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_46_1: A long, long time ago, there was a brave warrior in the Magical Kingdom. Her name was Encore.
Event_AYKXBRZM_46_2: One day, she met her good friend, Cloudy.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4600_2: Cloudy said she was a princess from a wonderful play. Everyone loved her performance.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4601_1: But then, out of nowhere... a Big Bad Demon appeared!
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_1: The Big Bad Demon sent its minions to attack the Magical Kingdom.
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_2: Everyone hid at home, and the stage was empty and quiet.
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_4: But then, Warrior Encore stood up and said she would fight the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_47_5: To bring the crowd back, Cloudy the great performer also joined Encore's team!
Event_AYKXBRZM_48_1: But not everyone in the Magical Kingdom was very nice...
Event_AYKXBRZM_48_2: One day, Warrior Encore met Cosmos.
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_1: I used to live in the Magical Kingdom, but I went on a big adventure far away.
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_2: When I came back, no one knew me, and they wouldn't play with me...
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_3: If you're not Cosmos's friend, I'll just go join the Big Bad Demon and cause trouble!
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_4: But I want to be your friend.
Event_AYKXBRZM_49_6: Really? That's so nice of you! Sob, sob...
Event_AYKXBRZM_4900_1: Sad little adventurer Cosmos was so moved by these words.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4900_2: This special friendship made him join Encore's team.
Event_AYKXBRZM_4900_3: With his brave heart, Cosmos decided to fight the Big Bad Demon and save the Magical Kingdom with Encore!
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_1: Warrior Encore and her friends marched to find the Big Bad Demon.
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_2: The sly Demon sent its monster squad to try to stop them!
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_3: But they were not afraid! Ha, ha! Princess Cloudy and Adventurer Cosmos used all their skills to support Warrior Encore.
Event_AYKXBRZM_50_4: In the end, Encore's super team took care of the monsters! But the Woolies got hurt...
Event_AYKXBRZM_51_1: To help them feel better, Warrior Encore climbed all the hills and swimmed all the rivers.
Event_AYKXBRZM_51_2: She walked a long way and finally found the magic Golden Sprout!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5100_1: She picked it up carefully, and ta-da! She made medicine that healed the Woolies!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5100_2: Then, the super team marched on their way to fight the Big Bad Demon.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_1: The Big Bad Demon sent more monsters to stop Encore.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_2: But every one of them was defeated by her super team!
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_3: Their amazing feats made lots of people in the Magical Kingdom excited.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_4: More and more people wanted to join Encore's team.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_5: After careful picking by Warrior Encore, they chose the Candlestick Fairy, who breathes fire.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_6: Encore also picked Gray Ear the Rabbit, who can slice bread into 100 pieces, and the Stool Spirit, who likes to zoom around on four legs.
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_7: Then came Miss Clover, Uncle Broom, and Grandpa Coal...
Event_AYKXBRZM_52_8: With more friends joining, Encore's team got bigger and stronger, becoming the super-duper awesome team!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5200_1: At last, it was time to fight the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5200_2: Gray Ear the Rabbit made yummy bread for everyone so they wouldn't fight on empty stomachs.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5200_3: Cloudy put on a show about a brave princess the night before to cheer everyone up.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5201_1: As the curtain rises, Rover takes {Male=his;Female=her} seat among the audience.
Event_AYKXBRZM_53_4: On the big battle day, Adventurer Cosmos led the super-duper awesome team to dodge traps and face the Big Bad Demon.
Event_AYKXBRZM_53_6: Miss Clover blew wind, Grandpa Coal and the Candlestick Fairy made fire.
Event_AYKXBRZM_53_7: Gray Ear the Rabbit held Uncle Broom and rode the Stool Spirit to charge at the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5300_1: Finally, Warrior Encore and the Woolies teamed up for the final blow!
Event_AYKXBRZM_5301_1: They defeated the Big Bad Demon! Encore's team stopped his evil plan and brought peace back to the Magical Kingdom.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_1: Hmm... Huh... You beat me today, but there'll always be more demons in this kingdom...
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_2: Someone's gotta be the Big Bad Demon!
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_3: But why did you have to pick this path?
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_4: Before I was big and bad, nobody paid any attention to me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_6: But you could be a hero like me!
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_8: I don't have your bravery. More importantly, I don't have any friends...
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_10: Being a hero isn't just about fighting or going on adventures.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_11: Uncle Broom keeps the castle spotless. Candlestick Fairy keeps things bright.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_12: They don't need to be on my team to be heroic warriors. They already are.
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_13: Just do your best at everything and have fun! That's how heroes do lots of cool stuff!
Event_AYKXBRZM_54_14: Don't worry. You can do it too!
Event_AYKXBRZM_55_1: Okay, the Magical Kingdom is now called the Warriors' Kingdom!
Event_AYKXBRZM_55_4: Now it's time for a new adventure.
Event_AYKXBRZM_55_5: Hooray! I'll tell a new story next time!
Event_AYKXBRZM_56_1: Didn't I just leave the Somnoire... Why am I still here?
Event_AYKXBRZM_56_2: Encore's not here. Did she leave already? Let me see if I can find another gateway.
Event_AYKXBRZM_57_1: The Gatekeeper? Who's the one beside him?
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_1: Excuse me, sir. Is this all real? Are you the god of this realm?
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_3: I don't know... I was supposed to be at my Grandma's funeral.
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_4: I was watching over her and lost track of time.
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_5: The next moment, I was here... Maybe I fell asleep?
Event_AYKXBRZM_58_6: You believe you've left the Somnoire, only to discover yourself in a new dream. Here, you witness the Ebony Gatekeeper conversing with a young girl.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_6: A part of your consciousness entered Somnoire when you fell asleep.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_7: Somnoire? What's that? Some kind of Sonoro?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_8: No, but you can think of it that way.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_9: Well... just now, I met a girl around my age. She had the same name as Grandma.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_10: She lived in the same town, had a group of friends, and liked to catch dragonflies in the mountains.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_11: The only difference is, the temple that should be demolished by monsters was still there, east of the town...
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_12: Grandma used to say that people would pay tribute to their ancestors in that temple every year. The ceremony would be as grand as the Moon-Chasing Festival.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_13: As much as she loved that town, she never stopped wanting to explore the world outside it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_14: Um, I heard the Sonoro Sphere can keep memories of people or even a place's history. Is that true?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_15: What I saw just now, is it real? Is that girl my Grandma?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_16: My apologies, but I cannot answer that.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5800_19: What happens when I wake up? Will this place and my memory of it disappear?
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_20: Everything you saw here will be erased, except your memory. That I have no control over.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_21: That's a relief... Thank you, kind sir. That's given me some hope.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_22: In my memories, Grandma always took care of everyone in the family.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_23: She raised her children and they left home, then her grandchildren, repeating this cycle her entire life in that old house.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_24: I always wanted to travel, but I couldn't bear to leave Grandma alone.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_25: This dream showed me a different side of her. She was once a young girl with dreams... just like me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_26: She dreamed of traveling, meeting new people, and starting a family.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_27: Now I feel grateful to be part of such a family. And even more grateful to have this side of Grandma live on in my memories.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_28: I used to think she was old and lonely, but she really glowed with her hopes and dreams.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_29: Thank you, sir. Thank you for showing me this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_5801_31: In the dream, the girl encounters her grandmother in her youth, gaining a deeper understanding of her. This heartfelt experience brings her solace, easing the sorrow of her grandmother's passing.
Event_AYKXBRZM_59_1: That happened in the past... I was looking at their Illusias.
Event_AYKXBRZM_59_2: The Gatekeeper showed this to me... What is he trying to tell me?
Event_AYKXBRZM_59_3: Please leave the Somnoire. Data from the last phase will be deleted. Repeat, data from the last phase will be deleted.
Event_AYKXBRZM_60_1: It's about to collapse... Better leave now.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_1: It has been some time, hasn't it {PlayerName}?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_2: So, it was you who did this.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_3: Why are you showing me this?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_4: I already told you the first time we met: Somnoire is unstable.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_5: You didn't say it's because of you.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_6: It isn't. It's due to Somnoire's innate design.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_7: Tell me, what do you think Somnoire was created for?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_10: It appears so, but the answer is something more fundamental.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_12: Such a large and complex creation is necessary to save a world torn apart by the Lament.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_13: The dreams it stores contain countless possibilities...
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_14: Millions upon millions of dreams converge in Somnoire... Perhaps within one lies the key to vanquishing the Lament.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_15: It may not be the most efficient or practical strategy, but even as a mere spark of hope... I believe it's worth pursuing with all the power I have.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_17: They're closely connected to you... But that's not important right now.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_18: One day, you'll find out who they are.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_19: Compared to you, who is of immense significance to them, I am just a tool they created to get rid of useless data.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_21: Why are you getting rid of it?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_22: Every day, people dream, but Somnoire's capacity is finite.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_23: Dreams that don't aid in defeating the Lament are deemed worthless.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_24: My duty is to erase them, like a heartless executioner.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_25: By this reasoning, the two dreams you just witnessed should also be erased—they offer no solution to save our world.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_26: What do you think? Are they useless?
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_27: They mean a lot to the ones who dreamed them.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_28: Regardless, every dream has its own meaning.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_29: Indeed... those dreams are truly precious.
Event_AYKXBRZM_61_31: The Ebony Gatekeeper stands before you, revealing that the Somnoire acts as a vessel for storing dreams, and he is on a quest to find a way to confront the Lament. He explains that his role involves clearing the Somnoire by erasing what is deemed "useless dreams." Yet, despite this duty, he struggles with the idea. His conversation with a young girl leads him to the realization that he, too, is just a string of data, and that these so-called "useless dreams" hold the power to inspire and motivate people. Determined to change his course, he resolves to preserve every dream within the Somnoire.
Event_AYKXBRZM_62_1: This realm is about to collapse...
Event_AYKXBRZM_62_2: I need to wrap this up quickly and get out of here.

Event_AYKXBRZM_4003_1: Perhaps I'm nothing more than a tool for copying paintings.
Event_AYKXBRZM_401_1: In their eyes... am I only capable of copying my old work?
Event_AYKXBRZM_402_1: Can I really call myself an artist then?

Event_AYKXBRZM_66_3: If you don't paint, you can't earn! You don't wanna end up broke, do ya?
Event_AYKXBRZM_66_4: What about painting... what was it called? Ah, Winter's Serenade in Bloom?
Event_AYKXBRZM_66_6: I-I want to try something different.

Event_AYKXBRZM_66_8: Don't worry, Master Zhezhi! I handpicked your clients and know them like the back of my hand.
Event_AYKXBRZM_66_9: That painting was outstandingly popular, I would know.
Event_AYKXBRZM_66_10: Trust me. This will be another best-seller!
Event_AYKXBRZM_66_12: Of course. Take your time, Master Zhezhi. Let me know when you've decided.

Event_AYKXBRZM_67_1: Ha... I need a walk now. Maybe I'll find some new inspiration.
Event_AYKXBRZM_68_2: It's all so beautiful... I have to capture it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_68_3: Let me find the perfect spot to stop and paint.

Event_AYKXBRZM_69_2: Hmm... They do complete the scene I had in mind.
Event_AYKXBRZM_70_1: The landscape looks great from this side. It's perfect for planning my painting.

Event_AYKXBRZM_70_3: The composition looks fine, but something's still missing...
Event_AYKXBRZM_70_4: Maybe I should get closer to see the tiny details of the trees and rocks.
Event_AYKXBRZM_71_1: That place should be close enough.
Event_AYKXBRZM_71_2: Waterlamp, Dewvetch, Pearl Leaf, and Bittberry...
Event_AYKXBRZM_71_3: These vibrant plants harmonize exquisitely with the cold stones.
Event_AYKXBRZM_72_1: The details of the stones and trees... I got it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_72_2: I can show this draft to my manager.
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_4: Okay, Master Zhezhi! About the painting I mentioned last time...
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_12: Zhezhi, you're a true master! Would a master present a client with a half-finished piece?
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_13: Your last painting sold for the highest price at auction! Give the people what they want, that's what I always say.
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_14: You just need to paint it again, and I'll make sure it sells well.
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_16: With all due respect, Master Zhezhi, not everyone will buy whatever you paint.
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_17: I've worked so hard to find a few clients who love your style. How can I sell your paintings if you can't cater to their needs?
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_18: Please focus on recre—I mean, creating tonight! I won't disturb you. I'll come and pick it up tomorrow.
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_19: No more indulging your every creative whim. All I'm asking for is another Winter's Serenade in Bloom. I'm counting on you, Master Zhezhi!
Event_AYKXBRZM_73_20: Zhezhi presents her latest work to the manager, but he insists that she should only replicate her earlier piece, which has already garnered widespread acclaim.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_1: What do you really want to paint?

Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_3: Yes. I saw flowers blooming in the middle of winter, and birds were circling around...
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_4: You worked really hard on it.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7500_5: And... that hard work should be noticed.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7501_1: Believe in your judgment, your brush, and yourself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_7502_1: (Zhezhi musters her courage and continues to work on the unfinished draft.)
Event_AYKXBRZM_7502_2: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away, the painted world fades, forgotten today...
Event_AYKXBRZM_76_1: This giant bird... It's... it's the one from Winter's Serenade in Bloom!
Event_AYKXBRZM_76_2: I keep telling you, your clients only want that one painting!
Event_AYKXBRZM_76_3: Don't be so stubborn, Zhezhi! A painting that doesn't sell well is meaningless!
Event_AYKXBRZM_76_4: I'm the artist, not just the brush.
Event_AYKXBRZM_76_5: It's the soul I put into my paintings that makes people appreciate them!
Event_AYKXBRZM_88_1: Is this real or just another dream?
Event_AYKXBRZM_88_2: Hehe... If it's a dream, it better be juicy!
Event_AYKXBRZM_89_2: Wait for me to catch you, {PlayerName}.
Event_AYKXBRZM_90_1: Oh, you wanna play hide and seek?
Event_AYKXBRZM_90_2: The tastiest meal is always the one you've worked hardest to catch.
Event_AYKXBRZM_91_2: Quit the running and come play with me. Let's not waste our precious time.
Event_AYKXBRZM_92_2: Why does the Black Shores keep dumping these dull missions on me?
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_1: I live for a good thrill.
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_2: But it's so hard to find one that meets my standards.
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_3: Some have potential, but they're still too dull.
Event_AYKXBRZM_94_4: Only you can really get my heart racing, {PlayerName}.
Event_AYKXBRZM_95_1: You swing your final strike at the struggling enemy, but your blade cuts through nothing but air.
Event_AYKXBRZM_96_3: I remember the way you fought—your blade's strong enough to sever the air itself.
Event_AYKXBRZM_96_5: Ah... My head... It hurts. No, that's not you!
Event_AYKXBRZM_97_1: Is that... Camellya? She needs help.
Event_AYKXBRZM_97_2: I need to go to her, quick.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_5: That thing couldn't be you. You always... exceed my expectations.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_8: ...I know. After all, you're the one I've chosen, my beloved seed.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_9: While I crave your sweet words, a part of me craves the thrill of hunting you down.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_10: We can do this after we get out.
Event_AYKXBRZM_99_12: Oh, is that an invitation? You do know how to please me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_11_6: These dreams... I no longer wish to have them, to remember anything.
Event_AYKXBRZM_11_7: But I do remember things about you...
Event_AYKXBRZM_12_1: You're the only one who can restore everything to its rightful place. That's what he said to me.
Event_AYKXBRZM_12_2: Farewell, Dreamwalker. May your thoughts remain unclouded.
Event_AYKXBRZM_13_1: What is this? I've never seen this in the Somnoire before.
Event_AYKXBRZM_13_2: I should look around for more information.

Event_AYKXBRZM_14_2: (The rest is smudged. Someone must have lost it here.)

Event_AYKXBRZM_15_2: (This is probably where Fulei lost the package, but where is it now...)
Event_AYKXBRZM_16_1: (Is that... Lumi? The Tacet Discords are after her!)

ZXZTC_1_1: As the tides receded, a new world and an unexplored adventure awaited you.
ZXZTC_1_2: Yangyang and Chixia found you unconscious at the Gorges of Spirits. Together, you decided to head to Huanglong's Jinzhou City, marking the beginning of your journey.
ZXZTC_1_3: Jinzhou, a border city in Huanglong, had long been a battleground against the Threnodian Ovathrax. The Midnight Rangers, led by General Jiyan, fought tirelessly against the waves of Tacet Discords—nightmarish entities created by the Threnodian—near the Norfall Barrens...
ZXZTC_1_4: Meanwhile, a mysterious organization known as the Fractsidus operated covertly within Jinzhou. They were aiming to resurrect the Threnodian. Somehow, they seemed especially interested in you, going so far as to extend an invitation...
ZXZTC_1_5: You met Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou. She explained the double threats Jinzhou was facing: external attacks from the resurgent Threnodian, and internal turmoil caused by the mysterious disappearance of Jinzhou's Sentinel.
ZXZTC_1_6: As the Magistrate and the Sentinel's Resonator, Jinhsi resolved to travel to Mt. Firmament and uncover the truth about Jinzhou's missing Sentinel, Jué. A confrontation seemed unavoidable...
ZXZTC_1_7: The rise of the TD Outbreak unleashed Ovathrax's latest creation: the Dreamless, an incomplete entity. With Jinzhou City under siege, you joined the battle, eventually defeating the Dreamless and absorbing it with your bare hands.
ZXZTC_1_8: Jinzhou's immediate crisis was averted, but Magistrate Jinhsi was nowhere to be found...
ZXZTC_1_9: You sought guidance from Sanhua, who directed you to a ferry near Mt. Firmament. There, you encountered Changli, your "Wayfinder" into the mountain.
ZXZTC_1_10: This secret realm, where the flow of time warped and twisted, required a price for entry. However, you seemed curiously unaffected by the temporal distortion, while Changli seemed unbothered by its effects...
ZXZTC_1_11: Within Mt. Firmament's Hongzhen settlement, you discovered that many animals and residents had been frozen in time, trapped by the erratic temporal flows. The Fractsidus had also infiltrated the area.
ZXZTC_1_12: Xinyi, the mayor of Hongzhen, informed you that Jinhsi had only recently departed for Mt. Firmament's peak, in search of the Sentinel. Due to the temporal distortions, what had been days to you was merely moments inside the mountain.
ZXZTC_1_13: Deep within the Mianloong Chamber, you finally found Jinhsi. Together, you faced the Sentinel, Jué. Jué explained its dilemma: to keep its power from spiraling out of control, it had chosen to remain confined within Mt. Firmament.
ZXZTC_1_14: If the situation continued, its only recourse would have been to freeze time across all of Jinzhou, hoping future generations could find a solution to undo the damage...
ZXZTC_1_15: At the mountain's peak, you stood by Jinhsi as she endured Jué's trial, proving the strength of human will. With your help, she stabilized and inherited the Sentinel's power, finally bringing an end to the temporal chaos on Mt. Firmament...
ZXZTC_1_16: Jué revealed the truth: You were none other than its Arbiter, the founder of Jinzhou.
ZXZTC_1_17: Jinhsi's unyielding resolve, coupled with the Temporal Mandate granted by Jué with your approval, allowed her to make it through the impossible trial.
ZXZTC_1_18: Following Jué’s guidance, you set out on a new path, seeking answers to the mysteries of your origins. Your next destination is the base of an enigmatic organization known as the Black Shores.
ZXZTC_1_19: You confronted a crisis in the Port City of Guixu alongside Yangyang. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper guided you to the Black Shores, a place shrouded in mystery. The Tethys System of the Black Shores had suffered a catastrophic failure, unleashing data-based pollution that corroded everything it touched.
ZXZTC_1_20: Once again guided by the Shorekeeper, you delved deeper into the Black Shores, determined not only to save this ravaged place but also to recover memories of your past...
ZXZTC_1_21: The Shorekeeper revealed that you were once the leader and founder of the Black Shores, an ancient organization spanning ages, with her serving as your loyal assistant.
ZXZTC_1_22: The current crisis, it seemed, was intricately tied to your forgotten past, and the Lament recorded by the Tethys System during the disaster in Port City of Guixu held crucial secrets...
ZXZTC_1_23: To resolve the chaos caused by the Tethys System, you and the Shorekeeper entered a simulation it had created, reliving the final hour before the Lament struck Port City of Guixu.
ZXZTC_1_24: As the disaster drew near, the Tethys System tried to absorb you as its new core. In a desperate bid to protect you, the Shorekeeper was sucked into a black hole...
ZXZTC_1_25: You reclaimed the mantle of leadership, steering the Black Shores toward redemption. You broke free from the mistakes of the past, liberated the innocent trapped in endless suffering, and rescued the Shorekeeper from the Tethys System's grasp.
ZXZTC_1_26: Now free from the burden of her mission, the Shorekeeper revealed another clue. She suggested that the key to understanding your connection with Abby—and Abby's recent strange symptoms—might lie within Rinascita.
ZXZTC_1_27: Rinascita is a nation to the southeast of the Black Shores, making the Black Shores archipelago the perfect starting point for your journey...
ZXZTC_1_28: O Rover guided by the tides, you have banished the shadows of war in Jinzhou and crossed the boundaries of time on Mt. Firmament. When you stood upon the secluded shores, did you hear the gospel carried on the tempest winds, echoing across the stormy sea? Did you glimpse the unparalleled splendor that lies within the fabled land of the Echoes? Now, steel your heart and embark on a journey into the unknown, brave the storm, and carve a path to Rinascita.

Event_XFLX_9_2: What is this Flight Module you mentioned?
Event_XFLX_9_3: I'm sure you're very familiar with the Glider?
Event_XFLX_9_4: To put it simply, the Flight Module shares a similar mechanic—it also revolves around the wings of an Echo.
Event_XFLX_9_5: But unlike the Glider, it offers a faster flight and more rapid maneuvers.
Event_XFLX_9_6: This technology originated from Rinascita and cannot be deployed outside of that region, including Jinzhou, due to certain limitations.
Event_XFLX_9_7: That is, until recently, we've made it functional here with some adjustments. Now, we just need to test its stability and safety.
Event_XFLX_9_8: That's why we'd like your help in collecting some flight data, so that we can make further improvements to it.
Event_XFLX_9_9: What do I need to do then?
Event_XFLX_9_10: Simple. Just follow the flight paths we've marked for you and reach the designated locations on the map using the module.
Event_XFLX_9_11: I've sensors set up across Jinzhou City. They'll automatically record data as you fly past.
Event_XFLX_9_12: Data such as lift force, maximum speed, time of flight, flying position, etc.
Event_XFLX_9_13: We'll compare these to the ones collected in Rinascita to evaluate its performance.
Event_XFLX_9_14: No problem. Leave it to me.
Event_XFLX_9_16: I've remotely upgraded your Flight Module, and the user manual has been uploaded to your Terminal. You can check it anytime.
Event_XFLX_9_17: Very well. Just be sure to stay safe. I'll stay in touch during the test.
Event_XFLX_9_18: That's okay. You're welcome to come back when you're free.
Event_XFLX_9_15: I have other matters to attend to.

Event_TCTL4_1_2: Take out your Terminal—your trusty wish-granter!

Event_TCTL4_1_21: Anyway, I'll be counting on you to join the event, my friend. Wishing you all the best on your adventures!

STNPC_SYPXJTCD_1_1: What is the meaning of this affront to the Deep Dwellers' altar...?
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_10_1: The phantom vanishes the moment your hand comes close to it.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_10_2: What is this... Hmm? What's that sound around?
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_11_1: This altar wasn't here earlier... Did it just appear out of thin air?
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_12_1: The offerings to the altars are incomplete. The ritual cannot be invoked...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_13_1: Thou hast arrived, Appellant from Bonape...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_13_4: I am the Ancient One. Thou mayest also call me the King in Armor. Lord of Bonape. Master of the Deep Dwellers...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_13_5: And Bonape is my abode, the sunken city now lying at the seabed...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_13_6: Appellant, prove unto me that thou hast the resolve to see this ritual to its end.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_1: I never expected you'd take part in the ritual! The Deep Dwellers will surely be grateful for your noble deed, friend!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_3: The Deep Dwellers are residents of the city of Bonape, a city far beneath the depths of the sea, beyond even the reach of the Dark Tide...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_4: So long as we offer our most sincere worship to the Deep Dwellers and protect their offspring, they respond to our callings.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_9: Most certainly. It's all documented in the tome of The King in Armor.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_10: From a tome called The King in Armor.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_11: According to this esoteric book, once we set up six altars and offer sufficient offspring, the Bell Crabs...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_12: The underwater city of Bonape will rise from the sea, and the Ancient One shall awaken from his slumber and personally reward us for our noble deeds!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_14_13: I can wait no longer, friend!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_15_1: Appellant of Bonape... Twelve more offspring of the Deep Dwellers art required to bring this ritual to fruition.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_15_2: Show unto me that thou dost bear the resolve…
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_15_3: I have it here with me.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_16_5: They're all accounted for... Good work. Good work, indeed!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_16_6: The Ancient One begins laughing hysterically, a sound you've never heard before.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_16_7: There're enough Bell Crabs here they'll last us the entire season. Mwahaha—
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_16_8: Like being cut off on the telephone, the Ancient One's voice disappeared just like that. In the meantime, you hear yelling noises in the distance.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_17_2: I know you're upset, but just calm down...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_1: You cheating bastard! How dare you lie to me? You claimed this was a tome from a foreign land, but it's all completely fabricated!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_2: It's just something I wrote during my free time. All I wanted was to share it with you...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_3: How was I supposed to know you were gonna take it so seriously? That's why I...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_4: That's why you took advantage of it and sold it to me, and even had me go over all this "ritual" nonsense!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_5: If I hadn't found those hidden speakers on the statue and traced them back to you hiding in the corner, who knows how long you would've kept me fooled!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_6: It's just a few Bell Crabs, for crying out loud. You can have 'em back...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_7: I bought an entire fishing gear set from you just to catch those Crabs, plus the shrimps to feed them!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_8: I want my money back. The fishing gear. The shrimp. The King in Armor. All those Shell Credits you swiped from me!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_9: The two argue on, pushing and pulling each other as they walk away.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_10: (Well, that explains everything... Wait, why's there still noise coming from the statue?)
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_11: You hear a sound, as if from the depths of the sea, emanating from the direction of the statue.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_18_12: Iä... Iä... In his house at Bonape, our dead king waits, dreaming...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_19_1: The stone statue stands still, as though nothing ever happened...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_2_4: Oh... I just have a love for Bell Crabs, that's all. I'm giving them something to snack on.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_2_5: If you ever come across statues like this in the future, put Bell Crabs on them, and I'll come offer them food.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_2_6: The ritual... I mean, the feeding is quite tightly scheduled. I must proceed to the next statue. Farewell, friend.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_2_7: As you still wonder about Phillips's words, he rushes off in a hurry.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_2_8: (A Supply Chest? Did Phillips leave this here as a thank you, or...?)
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_20_1: You get nothing from the stone statue, as though nothing ever happened...
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_4_1: My dear friend! Could you please help me find something?
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_4_3: The Deep Dwellers'... I mean, the Bell Crabs' favorite: shrimp.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_4_4: I must have dropped it somewhere on the way here... Please, help me, my friend. It's important to me. I'll repay you for your kindness!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_5_1: This must be the shrimp Phillips was talking about. Let's bring it back to him.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_6_1: Yes, yes! It's exactly what I was looking for... Thank you so much, friend!
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_6_3: Of course, it is crucial for the ritual... No, I mean it's crucial that I keep the Bell Crabs well fed.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_6_4: Anyway, thank you for returning this to me... Here's a little token of my appreciation, friend.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_6_5: Phillips turns away, but instead of feeding the Bell Crabs, he places the shrimp on top of the statue and leaves.
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_7_1: Did the altar just... wobble? Like it's finally broken free from restraints... Or was I seeing things?
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_8_1: This altar wasn't here earlier... Did it just appear out of thin air?
STNPC_SYPXJTCD_9_1: The phantom vanishes the moment your hand comes close to it.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_1: Analysing data... Progress at 93.75%. The Rinascita data bundle has been fully recovered.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_2: Initiating regional TD ecosystem data import into the artificial Sonoro Sphere. Requesting computing assistance from the Tethys System. Estimated completion time: 366 seconds.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_4: What are you doing here, Valentina?
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_5: Nice to see you, {PlayerName}. As you can see, we're collecting data associated with the TD Outbreak for the Tidal Defense Simulator project.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_7: Yep. One of the many assignments as a Black Shores field agent is to assist local authorities in evacuating citizens in the event of Waveworn catastrophes or large-scale TD Outbreaks.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_8: But due to the high risks that often come with the tasks, many Bloom Bearers gave their lives while performing their duties, just like... Niya and Hoda did in the previous Port City of Guixu incident.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_10: No need to feel sad, {PlayerName}. Their sacrifices are a testament to their dreams and oaths to protect others.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_11: Every Black Shores member knew what they signed up for. That includes both of us, isn't that right?
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_12: To provide additional safety measures for our agents out on the field, the R&D department has developed a few autonomous Combat Machines by combining technologies of simulated Echoes and Tacetite weapons.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_13: The design purpose is to have them replace field personnel in delaying TD Outbreak attacks, buying time for evacuation. However, there are still some rough edges to be ironed out before they can be fully deployed.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_14: So to set us on the correct course for improvements, we're collecting TD Outbreak data to create a simulated environment for testing these devices. This is where the Tidal Defense Simulator project comes into play.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_15: On top of that, we hope to find more efficient deployment strategies through repeated simulations.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_16: To get the results we're looking for, I'd like to invite you to participate in the simulator project. With what you've achieved in multiple previous crisis trials, you'll certainly help us develop a flawless strategy.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_20: I'd like to point out that to verify the machines' combat efficiency, please refrain from using direct attack methods while in the Tidal Defense Simulator.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_21: Let's be honest, normal TDs are a cake walk for you, and if you get too involved, there won't be much left for the machines to do their thing.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_22: So, as an alternative, I'll have KU-Uigon and its offensive loadouts serve as your tactical support, which should simulate the combat capabilities of the average Bloom Bearer.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_23: Glad to have you with me, KU-Uigon.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_24: Sure, I'll try my best to be gentle.
Event_CSCSGSYD_1_25: Right, then KU-Uigon and I'll go get the Sonoro Sphere up and running. Good luck to you, {PlayerName}.
Event_CSCSGSYD_2_4: {PlayerName}'s test results have been archived. Based on the data, Bloom Bearer {PlayerName} has demonstrated extraordinary tactical capabilities.
Event_CSCSGSYD_2_5: Machines set up by {PlayerName} produced a combat efficiency 52.63% higher than the Black Shores average.
Event_CSCSGSYD_2_6: 52.63%... That's a number you don't see very often. Then again, it means that none of the previous tests truly captured the Combat Machines' full potential.
Event_CSCSGSYD_2_7: I'll file an application to develop the tactical guidelines on the Combat Machines based on your test results.
Event_CSCSGSYD_2_9: And, of course, your efforts were of considerable help to us. With these test data, the devices are one step closer to field deployment.
Event_CSCSGSYD_2_11: We'll be staying here until we've finished analyzing the additional TD Outbreak data.
Event_CSCSGSYD_2_12: If you wish to conduct further testing in the Tidal Defense Simulator under even more challenging environments, you are welcome to come here anytime.
Event_CSCSGSYD_6_2: Awaiting further data input. Please stand by, Valentina.
