GNNPC_SYSTCDS_10_1:
Of the Three Heroes' Crest, beyond the legendary exploits of its Heroes of Heroes, there is another story seldom told.

A young Gladiator once climbed the summit alone after a hunt under the cover of night. When he returned to camp, his fellows were astonished, for this "Dragon Slayer" bore upon his body more than a hundred wounds, great and small. He had clearly endured a harrowing battle, a trial beyond imagining.

The Gladiator smiled wryly, admitting his defeat. Many would remember it as the "Flawless Hero's" first failure. His second, the tragedy of Fabianum, would follow not long after.

That Gladiator was Magno, the former Ephor of Septimont.
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_2_1: Warrior who ascends this peak, we shall grant you a trial—
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_2_2: Hearken to your heart's rhythm, hold fast your sword, and stand before us… until you rise above us.
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_3_1: The die is cast. Our conquest shall not cease...
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_3_3: Show me to whom shall victory kneel!
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_4_1: Go now, warrior, to the memorial shrine. You have earned this honor...
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_5_1: O brave, peerless warrior... regrets we still bear.
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_5_2: Has Septimont cast off the shadow of its own glory? Has it withstood the calamity fate ordained?
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_5_3: ...And Rinascita... has it found unity at last?
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_6_1: Fabius, who bore the "Expedition Banner"—led the people across raging seas to the highlands. There he laid the bedrock of Septimont.
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_7_1: Atilius the Monument—stood firm against the Dark Tide's onslaught, the unbroken bulwark against calamity.
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_8_1: Valeria the Untarnished Blade—slew city-felling monsters in an endless hunt, etching naught but victory in her wake.
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_9_1: ...Mighty Heroes who slumber here, grant us your guidance once more...
GNNPC_SYSTCDS_9_2: If fate withholds its omens, who then shall deliver Septimont from ruin?
Event_BMQB_1_1: Oh, I'm finally patched through. Hello? {PlayerName}... Can you hear me?
Event_BMQB_1_2: Aha, good to hear your voice. I'm Yhoran. We met back at the Black Shores.
Event_BMQB_1_4: Do you still remember the Tactical Trial you took part in before? We're currently running a similar project, and we could use your assistance again.
Event_BMQB_1_5: I suppose you're still in Rinascita?
Event_BMQB_1_6: You can find me in Ragunna City and I'll brief you on the details in person when you have the time.
Event_BMQB_2_1: Long time no see, {PlayerName}. Stories of your adventures in Ragunna are all over the streets!
Event_BMQB_2_2: Jokes aside. The Tethys System has always kept a close watch on Rinascita, and our emergency response team just received new data linked to Dark Tide activity.
Event_BMQB_2_3: To help prevent another Waveworn Phenomenon on the scale of a Dark Tide, we've been working with local authorities to conduct simulations using a hologram device in regions vulnerable to the Threnodian's power.
Event_BMQB_2_4: I can feel the crisis already.
Event_BMQB_2_5: Exactly. It utilizes a similar technology, but the scenarios you'll experience are only extreme predictions simulated by Tethys, so nothing to worry about, {PlayerName}.
Event_BMQB_2_6: After all, Tethys is in charge of preparing us for every possible scenario. As they like to say… hmm, what was it again?
Event_BMQB_2_7: Ah, right: "The grim reaper won't come when you're ready for him."
Event_BMQB_2_8: It's worth mentioning that unlike our usual training, which revolves around skirmishes, this time Tethys wants to focus on scenarios concerning the deployment of individual Resonators.
Event_BMQB_2_9: To put it simply, in the event of a TD outbreak triggered by the Lament, elite Resonators will be deployed across weak points behind enemy lines to create diversions or take out high-value targets.
Event_BMQB_2_10: Sounds like something straight out of an action movie, doesn't it?
Event_BMQB_2_11: KU-Cass even came up with a cool name for it—Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier. Said the name was inspired by some of its retro video games.
Event_BMQB_2_12: Anyway, we're counting on you to give the holograms a run. And as always, we'll make it worth your while.
Event_BMQB_2_13: And if possible, feel free to call over some friends to take a spin on the simulation. The more data we can get our hands on, the better.
Event_BMQB_2_14: Well, {PlayerName}, I'll be looking forward to your performance!
Event_ZDPZ_1_2: Savior from a foreign land, the dark thunderbolt streaking across the world… Every time I see you, I feel an urge to capture this extraordinary moment!
Event_ZDPZ_1_3: That's too much. Cut it out.
Event_ZDPZ_1_5: Hahaha, forgive me. I just get carried away whenever I see your majestic figure…
Event_ZDPZ_1_6: Right, right. I actually have a favor to ask.
Event_ZDPZ_1_7: Ever since I saw your valor in battle, my fascination with combat-type Resonators has only grown.
Event_ZDPZ_1_8: Every time I think of your fierce roundhouse kick, that unyielding stance… and then, the reels in my hair start growing wildly—
Event_ZDPZ_1_11: Exactly. As the head of Wutherium Film Studio, I'm tied to my duties every day. I can't leave Ragunna.
Event_ZDPZ_1_12: And in this city, there's no real stage for battle, making it impossible to admire the graceful battle postures of Resonators.
Event_ZDPZ_1_13: So all I can do is let my imagination run wild, until it turns into empty reels, tangled with my hair...
Event_ZDPZ_1_14: So please! I need you to breathe life into them!
Event_ZDPZ_1_15: I doubt I can do it alone…
Event_ZDPZ_1_17: No, no, no, you misunderstand! I'm not asking you to fill every reel yourself.
Event_ZDPZ_1_18: Behold! The Wutherium Film Studio Special Feature: Resonators in Combat Edition!
Event_ZDPZ_1_19: Capture the breathtaking moments of Resonators in battle!
Event_ZDPZ_1_20: Whether it's the undying hunter who walks the underworld…
Event_ZDPZ_1_21: Or the mysterious swordsman wrapped in shadows…
Event_ZDPZ_1_22: Seek them out with your steps, seize them with your gaze, and preserve them with your lens!
Event_ZDPZ_1_23: Help my reels regain their rightful brilliance.
Event_ZDPZ_1_24: C-MOSS and I will be forever grateful for your help.
Event_SBGYWY_1_2: So, Chisa, Passenger {PlayerName}, I asked you here today for a little investigation. There have been unexplainable events popping up around Honami City lately.
Event_SBGYWY_1_3: What kind of unexplainable events are we talking about?
Event_SBGYWY_1_4: Mmm, rumor among the Left Behind is... the events all seem to follow a certain pattern, always leaving people in... Well, a strange situation.
Event_SBGYWY_1_5: Like the "Mysterious Scissorswoman," "The Haunted Apartment", and "The Moonlit Weretiger"—
Event_SBGYWY_1_7: Stop, you're starting to scare me!
Event_SBGYWY_1_8: Does this have something to do with the Lament?
Event_SBGYWY_1_9: Oh, that one has really become an urban legend lately. They say a cold, mysterious girl with a giant pair of scissors patrols Honami's streets, hunting any powerful Tacet Discord she finds.
Event_SBGYWY_1_11: Again with that sense of humor, Passenger! The memory of you saving this city is still so clear in my mind.
Event_SBGYWY_1_12: Steel gleams in the street. Flowers dance in time's swift flow. The Lament is gone.
Event_SBGYWY_1_14: Hmm, Passenger? Why do you make such a funny face every time I recite a haiku?
Event_SBGYWY_1_15: It might be, but it's hard to tell. That's why I wanted to ask you to investigate with me.
Event_SBGYWY_1_16: One thing bothers me, though... The Lament's lingering power in Honami's districts shouldn't be strong enough to cause this. Not on its own, at least.
Event_SBGYWY_1_17: Unless it's being manipulated or being purposefully triggered?
Event_SBGYWY_1_18: Mhm, just like how a Dango needs its sweet filling to become a delicacy... But oh, these are all just theories. We'll know more after we see things for ourselves.
Event_SBGYWY_1_21: Are there ever any other staff here?
Event_SBGYWY_1_22: Wonderful. Glad to have you both on board.
Event_SBGYWY_1_23: Hmm... Not in my time, no. But this cafe has been here long before the Lament. So, in the distant past... I guess there must have been...
Event_SBGYWY_1_24: By the way, if we're going to investigate areas in the city, we can't be too careful. Most of Honami is still crystallized.
Event_SBGYWY_1_25: I've set up little base stations for you guys. They have all the nice features that'll make your investigation twice as easy.
Event_SBGYWY_1_26: And if you happen to find any Rice Dangos out there, be sure to bring them back. I can use them to upgrade the cafe's facilities and offer you even better support.
Event_SBGYWY_1_28: Because they are Honami's signature delicacy! Soft, sweet, and loved by all. You should try some, Passenger.
Event_SBGYWY_1_29: Anyway, once you're all set, let's give the nearest station a whirl. I'll tell you more later.
Event_SBGYWY_1_30: I agree, this is something we should look into. It sort of feels like those urban mysteries I've heard in the past…
Event_SBGYWY_10_1: We meet again. Your actions have already helped stabilize the lingering Lament power in the Residential District. Good to see Kirine has been freed from it, too.
Event_SBGYWY_10_3: Impressive. You've accomplished something even the Aces of Honami could not.
Event_SBGYWY_10_4: To investigate certain matters of interest.
Event_SBGYWY_10_6: Anyway, these unexplainable events feel targeted. It's less like random acts of the Lament and more like a string of targeted crimes against specific people.
Event_SBGYWY_10_7: We need to figure out what all these victims have in common...
Event_SBGYWY_10_9: Just a few folks who don't know how to sit still, that's all...
Event_SBGYWY_11_1: Oh... Passenger, look… is that someone there?
Event_SBGYWY_11_2: Hello... Welcome... Thank you, and come again...
Event_SBGYWY_11_3: It's so dangerous out here. Why is she not seeking shelter?
Event_SBGYWY_11_4: She doesn't seem aware of what's going on around her.
Event_SBGYWY_12_1: Two Rice Dangos, okay... Will that be cash or credit…?
Event_SBGYWY_12_2: Ugh, I feel really dizzy. Where's the cash register…? What's going on? Wasn't I just in an overtime shift?
Event_SBGYWY_12_3: You don't need to keep doing this...
Event_SBGYWY_12_4: You got caught up in an unexplainable event.
Event_SBGYWY_12_5: Huh? But... No, I want to keep working! After all this time... this is the first job that's ever made me feel... happy...
Event_SBGYWY_12_7: You briefly explain the situation to her.
Event_SBGYWY_12_8: Waaah! I thought I'd finally found the perfect job... Great pay, all the extra hours I could want... and you're telling me it's all just a dream?
Event_SBGYWY_12_10: It's okay to enjoy your work, but you should also get plenty of rest... If you'd like, why not come to our cafe and sit for a bit?
Event_SBGYWY_12_11: We're looking into the recent unexplainable events happening in Honami. What you went through could be a key clue to solving this.
Event_SBGYWY_12_12: Huh? A talking capybara... Wait, aren't you the mascot, Namipon? Did you just say... cafe?
Event_SBGYWY_12_13: I'd love to visit your cafe, but I don't have any money. Nothing at all... Blub blub blub...
Event_SBGYWY_12_14: Don't you worry. Cuz today, coffee, desserts—everything is on the house. Consider it Shashou Cafe's little gift.
Event_SBGYWY_12_15: After all, our motto is, "Your smile is our specialty."
Event_SBGYWY_13_1: Oh, hey. I found this lying near that unusual TD earlier. I'll find a nice spot for it…
Event_SBGYWY_14_1: This coffee is so nostalgic. It's completely different from the instant stuff I usually drink, and the cake is so sweet. Thank you.
Event_SBGYWY_14_2: That's right, Namipon. You said you've been investigating the unexplainable events?
Event_SBGYWY_14_4: Irideglow... You mean the stuff that looks like iridescent cellophane? Hmm... I think I started working overtime after seeing something like that...
Event_SBGYWY_14_6: I don't really remember... But I'm pretty sure I was at work. And I think... I ran into someone from the old cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_14_7: Ms. Kirine said something very similar.
Event_SBGYWY_14_8: Kirine? You mean the short-haired girl who gets sick all the time? You've met her?
Event_SBGYWY_14_9: You tell her about the previous unexplainable event.
Event_SBGYWY_14_10: So it really was her! I wonder how she's doing... We haven't seen each other in so long, not since the old cafe shut down...
Event_SBGYWY_14_12: (Inquire about the person Aomame came across)
Event_SBGYWY_14_13: (Aomame also mentioned that old cafe... We should look into it.)
Event_SBGYWY_14_14: Could you tell me more about that cafe?
Event_SBGYWY_14_15: Oh, it's just a place I used to work. It was a tiny, run-down little spot. Nothing like this place. But if I had to compare...
Event_SBGYWY_14_16: The owner at the time adopted a lot of capybaras. She gave them names like "New Honami Line" or "Sakanan Line," though none of them could talk.
Event_SBGYWY_14_17: What happened to that shop afterward?
Event_SBGYWY_14_19: After that, everyone just... drifted apart. I heard someone later wanted to rebuild it, but... what's gone is gone, you know? You can't ever really go back.
Event_SBGYWY_14_20: Do you remember anything or have any information about that person?
Event_SBGYWY_14_21: Um... I'm sorry. With the Hanakage Underground Street being so busy, it's all a blur.
Event_SBGYWY_14_22: But if you're investigating these unexplainable events, you might have some luck finding the "Aces of Honami." Their names are Shouta and Firi.
Event_SBGYWY_14_23: They were detectives who used to stay at that cafe. Knowing them, they've probably already started poking their noses into this. They might be able to help you.
Event_SBGYWY_14_24: I've heard of them before... Thank you, Ms. Aomame, for the information.
Event_SBGYWY_14_25: After saying goodbye to Aomame, you and Namipon sort out the information you've gathered so far.
Event_SBGYWY_14_26: Ms. Aomame always wanted a high-paying job... and the unexplainable event trapped her in an endless shift. Her wish came true in a way, I guess?
Event_SBGYWY_14_27: Wishes aside, I'm more curious about the person both victims reported seeing.
Event_SBGYWY_14_28: And both incidents also involved Irideglow… While it may not be the direct cause, I'm certain there's a connection.
Event_SBGYWY_14_29: These are more actionable leads than the victims' psychological states... Apologies. I got caught up in thinking aloud.
Event_SBGYWY_14_30: Don't worry, you're making perfect sense, Chisa. Let's follow up on this.
Event_SBGYWY_14_31: Okay. We need to watch for anyone else investigating this, and identify those present at the scenes before the unexplainabe events occurred.
Event_SBGYWY_14_32: The Namipon shuttle lines to the Central and Commercial Districts have been cleared. We're free to search the city for clues now.
Event_SBGYWY_14_33: But before we leave, Passenger, we should go find Sales Champ first. It seems to have some good news for you.
Event_SBGYWY_15_1: Passenger, starting from today, the Shashou Cafe's special supply line is officially open.
Event_SBGYWY_15_2: Feel free to exchange materials or equipment with me using Rice Dangos whenever you like.
Event_SBGYWY_15_3: With each purchase, new supplies will require a certain amount of time to resupply.
Event_SBGYWY_15_4: Remember to check for special supplies in the cafe before your next trip to the urban areas!
Event_SBGYWY_16_1: You're the one behind all of this, aren't you?
Event_SBGYWY_16_2: It's time we count your crimes.
Event_SBGYWY_16_3: Passenger, look. Is that a talking tiger over there?
Event_SBGYWY_17_1: Tch... My head is spinning. Is the case closed, Firi?
Event_SBGYWY_17_2: You explain the situation to Shouta.
Event_SBGYWY_17_3: You're saying I turned into some kind of tiger? A literal TIGER?
Event_SBGYWY_17_4: Oh, brilliant. I say I have a heart of a tiger and it gives me the fur. The customer service for these unexplainable events is terrible.
Event_SBGYWY_17_5: Whatever. Thanks for the help... Never thought I'd get caught up in the thing I was investigating.
Event_SBGYWY_17_6: Sir, this isn't the best place to talk. Why don't you come with us back to Shashou Cafe? We can pick up from there.
Event_SBGYWY_17_8: I see. The name's Shouta. I'm a detective. Looks like we'll be working together.
Event_SBGYWY_17_9: Are you one of the "Aces of Honami" that Aomame talked about?
Event_SBGYWY_17_10: Well, what do you think…? Suits me pretty well, doesn't it?
Event_SBGYWY_18_1: Oh, hey. I found this lying near that unusual TD earlier. I'll find a nice spot for it…
Event_SBGYWY_18_2: The craft you discovered has been placed on a shelf inside the cafe...
Event_SBGYWY_19_1: After returning to Shashou Cafe, you find a green-haired man waiting in the lobby.
Event_SBGYWY_19_2: Firi? Still in one piece, are you?
Event_SBGYWY_19_3: You're the person at all the scenes…
Event_SBGYWY_19_5: We meet again, friends from Shashou Cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_19_6: Haha, I think it's up to me to do the explaining.
Event_SBGYWY_19_7: I'm Firi. Shouta's my partner. We've been investigating what's been happening across the city.
Event_SBGYWY_19_8: We split up to cover more ground and lost contact. When I heard that victims were recovering, I followed the trail from Ms. Kirine straight here.
Event_SBGYWY_19_9: What made you choose to investigate in the first place?
Event_SBGYWY_19_10: Call it a detective's instinct, if you like. But more importantly, we wanted to use these unexplainable events to learn the truth about the disaster that destroyed Honami.
Event_SBGYWY_19_11: Do you know about the Lament in Honami?
Event_SBGYWY_19_13: Yes, it's a strange feeling... akin to a cognitive blind spot. All the signs of something being wrong are there, but I just... ignored them.
Event_SBGYWY_19_14: The TDs in the districts, the state of the residents, and the Irideglow's bizarre effects... It's all evidence that the Lament occurred. Which means Honami has already been destroyed, right?
Event_SBGYWY_19_15: Hmm, I didn't expect the Left Behind to be able to hold onto their existence after realizing that...
Event_SBGYWY_19_16: The Lament that damaged Honami to this scale is an indiscriminate force of nature. Yet these unexplainable events have yet to actively harm a single citizen.
Event_SBGYWY_19_17: That's right. Everyone caught up in them so far has had a wish granted, just in a distorted way. They aren't being hurt by the Lament itself.
Event_SBGYWY_19_18: You mentioned wishes. What am I missing?
Event_SBGYWY_19_19: Oh, I see. We're all working with different pieces of the puzzle. Let's get on the same page first.
Event_SBGYWY_19_20: Namipon brings everyone coffee, and you exchange what you've gathered so far with Shouta and Firi.
Event_SBGYWY_19_21: So, these unexplainable events do have a source, and taking out the nearby TDs can stop them.
Event_SBGYWY_19_22: And if you look at the events we've seen so far, they all share a common theme.
Event_SBGYWY_19_23: They're all related to the cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_19_24: Everyone involved originally met through that old cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_19_25: Correct. While other Left Behind have been affected, only those three have been sucked into these unexplainable events triggered by the Lament's residual power.
Event_SBGYWY_19_26: True. Guess we need to check out the area around that old cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_19_27: In that case, you'll need us. We know the streets around Honami Central Park like the back of our hands. Who knows? You might be surprised what we can find.
Event_SBGYWY_2_1: Thank you for choosing NamiZoom! How can I help you?
Event_SBGYWY_2_4: I'm the one who handles the transportation! You can also call me the Platform Guardian.
Event_SBGYWY_2_5: Here in Honami, no matter how far away, I'll come rolling up the moment you need it!
Event_SBGYWY_2_6: But remember, Passenger. Drive slow and enjoy the scenery. Drive fast and you might join the scenery.
Event_SBGYWY_2_7: So when you're out exploring, drive safe, and be safe.
Event_SBGYWY_20_1: By the look of those TDs, the lingering Lament power in Honami City is stirring again.
Event_SBGYWY_20_2: Doubt we're going to find the source of these events in this area.
Event_SBGYWY_20_3: Mhm. I wonder what Shouta and Firi might have found around the old cafe...
Event_SBGYWY_20_4: Ask about Namipon's thoughts on the cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_20_6: Namipon, you seem kind of hung up on that old cafe?
Event_SBGYWY_20_7: I've just been thinking what the source of these strange events could be.
Event_SBGYWY_20_8: A cafe should be a place that holds all Passengers' happiest memories. That's why "Your smile is our specialty" is the Shashou Cafe's motto.
Event_SBGYWY_20_9: If these unexplainable events are trying to grant the wishes of that old cafe's customers... what if it's the cafe's owner that's behind everything?
Event_SBGYWY_20_10: I have a feeling we're about to find the truth.
Event_SBGYWY_21_1: Hey, come take a look at this.
Event_SBGYWY_21_2: Shouta and Firi hand you a notebook.
Event_SBGYWY_21_3: A notebook? There's a sticky note on the cover... Miki? Is that who this notebook belongs to?
Event_SBGYWY_21_4: There are frequency traces... similar to the Lament power on this notebook.
Event_SBGYWY_21_5: Miki was the owner of that cafe. The one Aomame mentioned, who adopted capybaras.
Event_SBGYWY_21_7: Does this mean Namipon is actually…
Event_SBGYWY_21_8: Yes, it was part of the aesthetic of the cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_21_9: Not quite. Those were just ordinary, non-talking capybaras. Namipon is more of a... mascot. A symbol of Honami itself.
Event_SBGYWY_21_10: As for what's inside this notebook, you should see for yourselves.
Event_SBGYWY_21_11: It looks like a guestbook left by a customer. It's filled with stories from the old cafe...
Event_SBGYWY_21_13: (Analyze the source of the unexplainable events)
Event_SBGYWY_21_14: (Kirine, Aomame, and Shouta all left messages inside. Everyone caught in an unexplainable event, too.)
Event_SBGYWY_21_15: (Flying, work, and... Hmm... a tiger. The events are all tied to the wishes they wrote down in this book.)
Event_SBGYWY_21_17: So the records in this old guestbook became the blueprint for granting their wishes... In that case, do you think it could have been...?
Event_SBGYWY_21_18: But no one can manipulate the Lament's power. Especially not a Left Behind.
Event_SBGYWY_21_19: What if they aren't manipulating it? What if they were devoured by it and became a part of it?
Event_SBGYWY_21_20: Oh…! I know, it's the <te href=851067>Longings</te>! Remember the Longings we collected before?
Event_SBGYWY_21_21: So, if Longings are strong enough to affect the Lament's residual power in Honami...
Event_SBGYWY_21_22: Then it must be located where the Lament first began...
Event_SBGYWY_21_23: Yup. Where we had that great battle.
Event_SBGYWY_21_24: Longings are frequencies that persist within the Lament! They don't disappear even if they're devoured by the Lament again.
Event_SBGYWY_21_27: Okay! The route to Neon Tower is set. This time, we can go straight to the top!
Event_SBGYWY_23_1: Is this... a pocket Sonoro Sphere formed by Lament power?
Event_SBGYWY_23_2: It seems to be recreating the scene from the last time we were here...
Event_SBGYWY_23_3: I'm sorry... Miki... I've failed you as a father...
Event_SBGYWY_24_1: I will carry on your dream...
Event_SBGYWY_24_3: This is the last thing I can do for you...
Event_SBGYWY_24_4: Passenger, more TDs coming our way!
Event_SBGYWY_25_2: Keep everyone in the cafe. Forever...
Event_SBGYWY_25_3: Just like you always told me you wanted...
Event_SBGYWY_25_4: His frequency has been completely devoured by the Lament...!
Event_SBGYWY_26_1: You are... from Shashou Cafe... I see...
Event_SBGYWY_26_3: I entrust Shashou Cafe to you now...
Event_SBGYWY_26_4: The voice then goes silent forever.
Event_SBGYWY_26_5: I'm not picking up on the Lament here anymore.
Event_SBGYWY_26_7: But, Ms. Miki's father... He mentioned Shashou Cafe, didn't he? How did he know that name?
Event_SBGYWY_26_8: Both Kirine and Ms. Aomame mentioned seeing someone they know. But Miki's father was always in the tower. Which means…
Event_SBGYWY_26_10: Some mysteries aren't meant to be solved until the very end.
Event_SBGYWY_27_1: Welcome back. You two must be exhausted!
Event_SBGYWY_27_3: We heard everything from Shouta... So, what happened? Did you find out the truth behind the unexplainable events?
Event_SBGYWY_27_4: You share everything that happened inside the tower with the group.
Event_SBGYWY_27_5: A brilliant piece of work. It seems everything is out in the open now... Shouta, don't you think it's time you came clean?
Event_SBGYWY_27_6: It must've been you that Kirine and Aomame saw.
Event_SBGYWY_27_7: Yes, and for that I owe you all an apology. The truth is, I'd been inside Neon Tower once before we ever met.
Event_SBGYWY_27_8: Of course, I didn't expect to get caught up in one of those events myself.
Event_SBGYWY_27_11: Haha, sorry about that. It's because during my investigation, I started piecing things together about Shashou Cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_27_12: If my hunch was right, then the ones who saved this city from the Lament, long before these events started... was you, wasn't it?
Event_SBGYWY_27_14: It's long overdue... but thank you. Thank you for saving our city.
Event_SBGYWY_27_15: Actually, the place Miki's father wanted to rebuild the cafe is exactly where Shashou Cafe is standing today. We just never got the chance to start…
Event_SBGYWY_27_16: After you rescued me, I struggled with whether to tell you the whole truth. After all, Namipon had a right to know.
Event_SBGYWY_27_17: But I wanted you to see it through yourselves. It was the only way for Miki's father's wish to be truly fulfilled.
Event_SBGYWY_27_18: Inheriting a cafe isn't just about the building, the coffee beans, or the dessert recipes... It's about inheriting the stories and the life that fills it.
Event_SBGYWY_27_19: Of course, it has been. Honami Crossing, this cafe, and even Honami City now have wonderful new guardians.
Event_SBGYWY_27_20: And that guestbook, full of stories from the past... can finally start collecting new ones.
Event_SBGYWY_27_22: I never thought I'd get the chance to talk to you like this. Namipon... or should I say, the spirit of Honami? But I think I'll stick with Namipon.
Event_SBGYWY_27_23: Thank you for everything. Our story ends here. The rest of it... is yours to tell.
Event_SBGYWY_27_24: With their wishes fulfilled, the Left Behind gradually fade from sight.
Event_SBGYWY_27_25: A little while later, Namipon tidies the tables and prepares a fresh cup of coffee for everyone.
Event_SBGYWY_27_26: Good work, Passenger. It seems these unexplainable events have finally reached their end.
Event_SBGYWY_27_28: Miki used to name all the capybaras in her cafe after railway lines... but the name she chose for the cafe itself was <ano=Train Conductor>Shashou</ano>.
Event_SBGYWY_27_29: I think... I'm finally starting to understand why.
Event_SBGYWY_27_30: The people in this city are all connected, like a vast railway network. Tracks crossing and intertwining.
Event_SBGYWY_27_31: Lives that were never meant to meet all found a connection in the cafe. And slowly, this place became the central station for it all.
Event_SBGYWY_27_32: Maybe… that is why you, the symbol of Honami, appeared here in the first place.
Event_SBGYWY_27_33: Beats me. At the very least, this cafe is proof that the Honami of the past existed.
Event_SBGYWY_27_34: Then, as the Shashou, you have to take good care of it, Namipon.
Event_SBGYWY_27_35: Don't you worry. The story of Shashou Cafe is just getting started.
Event_SBGYWY_27_36: Next time you get the chance, remember to bring more of your friends over to visit, {PlayerName}, Chisa.
Event_SBGYWY_3_1: Looks like you've gotten a general idea of the situation in Honami City.
Event_SBGYWY_3_2: It's time we investigate the first unexplainable event. Hmm, the one closest to us is... "The Haunted Apartment." A fine place to start.

Event_SBGYWY_32_1: Unusual cases always bring the freshest clues. It's the mundane ones that are truly unsolvable.
Event_SBGYWY_32_2: I wonder if there is more to this series of events in Honami than meets the eye...

Event_SBGYWY_32_6: But don't get me wrong, I'm not some brooding protagonist from a popular work of fiction. I don't have time for emotional baggage, psychological hand-holding, or spinning fancy theories from a total lack of data...
Event_SBGYWY_32_7: I simply enjoy the meticulous architecture of logic. Each time I enter my mind palace, I feel a sense of transcendence. It is my instinct.
Event_SBGYWY_32_8: In other words, I enjoy cases and crimes.
Event_SBGYWY_32_9: Perhaps Honami would be more interesting with a Moriartypon...

Event_SBGYWY_5_5: Let them come, they're no match for us.
Event_SBGYWY_5_6: That's quite the confidence in your abilities. How nice.
Event_SBGYWY_5_7: I'd like to help, but in my current state, I'd be useless in a fight. The best I can do is share what I know.

Event_SBGYWY_5_9: I'm not sure how she got caught up in this unexplainable event, but I don't think she deserves your suspicion.
Event_SBGYWY_6_1: Now that those unusual TDs are gone, the Lament power around here seems to have stabilized... Oh, Passenger, look! Our ghostly lady is waking up.
Event_SBGYWY_6_2: Ugh, my head... Are you… Namipon the Mascot? What happened?
Event_SBGYWY_6_3: You briefly explain the situation to her.

Event_SBGYWY_6_5: We haven't found any other lingering traces of Lament power here. I believe that is the case.
Event_SBGYWY_6_6: How incredible. Thank you for saving me. I'm Kirine, a Honami local.
Event_SBGYWY_6_7: I'm curious, what exactly is this Lament power you mentioned?
Event_SBGYWY_6_8: Hmm... to keep it simple, Honami's Lament power manifests as a unique phenomenon we call "Irideglow."
Event_SBGYWY_6_9: Irideglow? You mean those rainbow-colored, sparkling things? I think I saw something like that right before all this happened...
Event_SBGYWY_6_10: This area isn't fully secure yet. Let's head back to the cafe. We'll be able to talk in peace there.
Event_SBGYWY_6_11: Couldn't agree more! We'll have delicious coffee and desserts waiting, our treat. Your help in investigating these unexplainable events will be really appreciated, Kirine.
Event_SBGYWY_6_12: Sure, I do love a nice cafe. Please, lead the way.
Event_SBGYWY_7_1: Oh, hey. I found this lying near that unusual TD earlier. I'll find a nice spot for it…
Event_SBGYWY_8_1: I'm surprised. This cafe looks so different from the one I remember. That one wasn't this spacious, and the location wasn't nearly as nice…
Event_SBGYWY_8_2: Oh, what was it you wanted to ask about?
Event_SBGYWY_8_4: (Ask how she first saw the Irideglow)
Event_SBGYWY_8_5: (I need to figure out what connects the victims of these unexplainable events. Since they're all Left Behind, it must be some kind of strong attachment keeping them in Honami.)
Event_SBGYWY_8_6: You mentioned you're a Honami local, Ms. Kirine... Can you tell us a bit about yourself?
Event_SBGYWY_8_7: I'm just an ordinary high school girl. What's special about me...? Well, I've been sickly since I was a child. I couldn't go out much, and hospital visits were a regular part of my life.
Event_SBGYWY_8_8: Actually, to think I was flying during this unexplainable event... is actually kind of nice.
Event_SBGYWY_8_9: Let's see... My memories are still kind of fuzzy. I was probably on my way to the hospital for a check-up that day. I can't really say how I saw the Irideglow.
Event_SBGYWY_8_10: Did you notice anything particular that day? Anything that stood out?
Event_SBGYWY_8_11: Well... I think I met someone I know... then there was the familiar smell of coffee. Sorry. I can't remember who it was exactly.
Event_SBGYWY_8_12: Can you recall the street where you met them?
Event_SBGYWY_8_13: You obtain details of the location from Kirine.
Event_SBGYWY_8_14: So you're investigating the unexplainable events happening in Honami? That reminds me of two detectives who used to stay in the old cafe.
Event_SBGYWY_8_15: Maybe they're looking into it, too. I wonder what the truth behind all this really is...
Event_SBGYWY_8_16: Some time later, after saying goodbye to Kirine, you and Namipon sort through the information you've gathered so far.
Event_SBGYWY_8_17: We still haven't figured out what's causing these unexplainable events. But judging from Ms. Kirine's situation, they might be triggered by the lingering attachments of the Left Behind.
Event_SBGYWY_8_18: Ms. Kirine was always sick and stuck inside, so it turned her into a flying ghost. It's like her wish to be free was granted... but in a twisted way?
Event_SBGYWY_8_19: It's too soon to jump to conclusions. But the Meishin Passageway she mentioned is highly suspect… Has anyone reported strange happenings there, Namipon?
Event_SBGYWY_8_20: I did hear a few stories… How about we head to the Commercial District next? The trail might be cold, but it's better than just chasing rumors.
Event_SBGYWY_8_23: Namipon... How come the Left Behind can perceive these Lament phenomena now? Before, they didn't even realize they were all already dead.
Event_SBGYWY_8_24: Oh, that... Well, after you and Chisa stopped the looping Lament in the city, the <te href=850080>Waveworn Phenomena</te> affecting the Left Behind was weakened.
Event_SBGYWY_8_25: They still linger in Honami because of their attachments, but now they can think more clearly, almost like they did in life, until those attachments finally fade.
Event_SBGYWY_8_26: I see... So that's why they're becoming self-aware.
Event_SBGYWY_8_27: Mhm! By the way, we've gathered enough materials from our exploring to fix up a few facilities. Be sure to take a look when you get a moment, Passenger.
Event_SBGYWY_8_28: Before we head out again, you should go talk to Polmes. I think it needs your help with some of the other Namipons scattered around the city.
Event_SBGYWY_9_1: Long time no see. I'm impressed you found one of our <ano=Missing Namipons>Little Namipons</ano> so quickly, Passenger.
Event_SBGYWY_9_3: There are still other Little Namipons lost in the city. If you happen to find any, please help bring them back to me.
Event_SBGYWY_9_5: I've put together a list with all their details.
Event_SBGYWY_9_8: Of course, there'll be rewards for completing this Namipon rescue mission. Come find me anytime to check the list or collect rewards.
Event_SBGYWY_3_6: If you need a lift, just give Transport Namipon a shout.

Event_SBGYWYZZ_18_2: Phew, nothing to worry about now.

Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_1: The Tethys System recently expanded its frequency feature library and detected a previously unknown, special frequency. In response, the Black Shores dispatched Bloom Bearers to investigate. Valentina informs you that Shorekeeper is now analyzing the abnormal frequency and suggests you meet her for more information.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_2: Group A, begin data preprocessing. Group B, deploy ground interference neutralizers... Oh, {PlayerName}, you're here.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_3: Why is there such a large gathering today?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_4: The Black Shores recovered the Threnodian's Gem not long ago... I mean, Leviathan's essence. The Tethys System ran a deep analysis and expanded its frequency feature library. This enhancement allows us to detect previously unidentifiable special frequencies.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_7: Bloom Bearers not assigned to critical duties have been dispatched to investigate. The Shorekeeper is also dedicating part of her computations to tracking it. The Black Shores has classified this as a high-priority operation and is committing additional resources to track and replicate the signal.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_9: Exactly. None of us can identify this abnormal frequency, so it might lead to new discoveries.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_10: The Shorekeeper is in the Error Cell. You can go there to speak with her.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_11: Fortunately, not all these frequencies are Leviathan-related, so there's no immediate risk of Its revival. That said, the closest anomaly is right offshore.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_10_2: You... you're the one from before.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_10_3: This area isn't safe. When the Tacet Discords become crystallized, they become harder to handle... Get down!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1001_8: The Lament is looping. We need to get out of here first.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1002_4: You said the Lament is "looping"...? So this has happened before?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1002_5: Yes. It's like a pair of scissors... slicing Honami City into hopeless, broken pieces.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1003_11: They've overlapped from the distortion. Stay close.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_11_1: As minutes pass, the Lament continues to devastate the city. Tacet Discords run rampant, and the city crumbles around you. With no time to spare, you and the mysterious scissor-wielding girl retreat toward a safe zone.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_11_4: Drop the supplies and follow it!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_11_5: The next Slice is almost here. I know you have a lot of questions, but hold onto them for now. Just follow me.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_111_7: My apologies. I just had to be sure you hadn't turned into one of them.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_111_8: The safe house is just ahead. Come with me.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_111_9: (Steady breathing... No signs of Irideglow crystallization. I can rule out the possibility {Male=he;Female=she}'s one of the Left Behind.)
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_111_10: (She's the one who came at me when I first dropped into this Sonoro.)
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_111_11: (So why did she save me this time? And even...)
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_111_12: Hm? It's fine. Just scratches. That won't slow me down.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_111_13: In the safe zone, you and the girl catch your breath. You lean against a wall to steady yourself while she watches you in silence. You meet her gaze, yet her eyes seem to focus just off to the side, leaving you uncertain what she's looking at.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_1: We've arrived. The brawl has ended. Breeze slips through the shutters. Coffee stain dries slow.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_5: You're welcome. Like I said, I'm sure you have a lot of questions. But first, please allow us to introduce ourselves.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_6: Ah Chisa, so formal, as usual. I think {Male=he;Female=she} looks like a good person.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_8: Greetings, Passenger. My name is Namipon, the <ano=Mascot>guardian</ano> of Honami. I'm also the one who showed you the way... Mmm, I can tell you're a good soul.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_9: Hello, Namipon. You're a cute one!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_11: Hehe, new friends knock like a spring breeze... Oh, I mean, I'm happy you find me cute.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_12: No, no. I'm not the kind of animal you think I am. I am this city's <ano=Mascot>guardian</ano>.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_13: So of course I have a name. It was given by all who live here.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_14: And this is Chisa. A strong, mysterious...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_16: Sorry again. Things were chaotic when we first met, and I couldn't tell whether or not you were one of the Left Behind... I didn't have time to explain.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_17: But now, I'm sure. You're just another person pulled into this.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_19: Can I ask how you ended up here?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_22: A rift opened up. A hand came out of it and dragged me in.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_24: A hand from a rift? But why didn't that person escape themselves? Why pull you in instead?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_52: Before we go any further, I need to know where we really are.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12_53: You enter a coffeehouse, finally meeting the "mysterious capybara"—Namipon. It proudly declares itself the city's <ano=Mascot>guardian</ano> and, with great enthusiasm, introduces the girl as Chisa, "A strong, mysterious… ordinary student."
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_1: What is it? Do you have any questions for me?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_2: Why did you choose this coffeehouse as a base?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_4: How can I leave this Sonoro?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_5: I have nothing else to ask.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_6: Because of its location. It's well-placed, with passageways on both sides. Ideal for monitoring movement.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_7: When I first found it, the inside was a cluttered mess. I spent the last two months clearing it out. It's still far from tidy, but it's good enough for rest and shelter.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_8: Has it always just been you and Namipon here?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_9: Yes. It's always just been the two of us.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_10: But there are still... people in the city. I call them the <ano=Human Reverberations>Left Behind</ano>. They don't realize they're already dead. Still go about their lives, heading to school, waiting for buses, replying to messages... But once they begin to notice something's wrong, their consciousness begins to crumble. Seconds later, they're gone.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_11: That's why I don't say anything. I pretend they're just ordinary citizens. They never remember me, anyway. Sometimes I help them fix a jammed vending machine or tidy up a messy stall... not for any reason. Just because I'm there.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_12: I don't like watching them disappear like that. It's... unsettling. Like they were never real to begin with.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_15: After I first found this place and began setting it up, I went out to gather supplies. Then, Namipon appeared.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_16: It knows the city's layout and transport better than anyone. It helped me a lot. But all I could offer in return were a few cups of coffee and some desserts.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_17: Seems like Namipon is easy to please.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_18: Didn't expect Namipon to know so much.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_21: And I think it's even more attached to Honami than I am.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_23: If that interests you, talk to it. I'm sure Namipon would be happy to chat. It was practically humming the whole time on its way to pick you up.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_25: I've been looking for an opening. Based on what I've observed, Neon Tower in the center of the city is most likely the key. The frequency there is highly unstable, and it shows the Lament's most severe spatial fracturing. Could be the source... or maybe the endpoint.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_26: But I can't get close. The space in Honami is twisted and overlapping. I've tried every method I could think of, but I always end up looping back to the same spot.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_27: ...Now it's just me. And things don't always go the way I want them to.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_29: I have nothing else to ask.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_30: Why not walk around the coffeehouse and relax a bit? We've still got time before the next Lament hits.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_31: Has the coffeehouse always had this much stuff in it?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_32: No, not at first. I brought most of it in myself over the past two months.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_33: I didn't focus on decorations. Durable and low power, that's what mattered. Like that coffee machine over there. It was half broken, but the inner heating pipe still worked. I modified it. Good for a cup of coffee now, at least.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_34: Also rearranged the power grid. Added voltage regulator stabilizers. It may be cobbled together... but it's stronger. Should be able to handle a sudden blackout now.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_35: ...Oh, sorry. Rambled on there. You might not be interested in such things.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_36: It wasn't always like this. There used to be someone else. They caught the misaligned pieces, pointed out the right routes. I made sense of it all... because I had another mind with me.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12001_37: Do you have any other questions?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12002_1: This sofa has seen some years, but somebody's taken good care of it.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12002_2: That little dip on the left side. Hmm... kinda looks like a capybara butt.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12002_3: I guess Namipon really likes this spot.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12003_1: The plastic casing's gone a bit yellow. Some scratches here and there, but the drip tray's spotless.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12003_2: The "Espresso" button is too worn to read, but the milk frother knob still looks new. Looks like someone's got a clear taste preference.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12004_2: Good afternoon, everyone. You're listening to the city radio, drifting gently beneath the early summer sun. Now for your daily dose of happiness—
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12004_3: A hundred blind picnic baskets have been scattered across the lush lawns of Central Park by City Hall! Each one holds a surprise: maybe a hand-brewed coffee kit paired with a poetry book, or a handcrafted picnic bag for two sweethearts.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12004_4: A friendly cleaner even let slip that someone found open-air concert tickets tucked in a flowerbed this morning!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12004_5: Meanwhile, the Geiei Gallery Summer Exhibit is in full swing at Hanakage Underground Street. Rare vintage video tapes are on display, inviting you to take a slow stroll through the long river of history.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12004_7: And don't forget: today's bus stop announcements are hiding snippets of the song "Melody in the Rainbow." The passenger who finds the most will win this month's city tram pass!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12004_8: Keep your heart tuned to joy, and may your day in Honami be a beautiful one.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_2: No rush. You can finish your Rice Dango first.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_4: Is there anything I can help you with, Passenger?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_5: I want to learn about this city.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_6: I want to learn about you.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_7: Ah, Honami City... It's a good place.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_8: I like it here. Flowers drift by the riverside. A tunnel glows with rainbow light. Even though some of it has changed, I...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_9: I'm still... fond of it. It's like every time I open my eyes, I already know what the view will be.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_10: Hmm... I don't remember how I "woke up." One day, I just knew this city like the lines of my paw.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_11: Perhaps they created me? All those people in this city, they built things, opened shops, and lived their lives... In the end, all those little pieces came together. And out came me.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_12: If you think of it that way, maybe I'm just a strange dream they all had together. Or maybe even... a ghost? Hehe.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_14: Me? I'm Namipon! A little critter wandering the city, patching things up here and there. I can help you find your way, too.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_15: I know every alley and corner of Honami like the back of my paw. I'll be a good travel buddy. All I ask for is a cup of coffee or a Rice Dango. Well... it's also okay if you don't have anything.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_16: I'll still help. Because helping you means helping everyone in Honami.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_17: Say, Passenger... will you bring us a new story? Chisa's been stuck in this loop for two whole months. You're the only change we've seen.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_18: That's why... I feel like you might open a new path.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_19: Ah, but don't worry. If I am a ghost, I'm a nice one. After all, the people who once lived in Honami loved it dearly. Whatever they left behind... must be gentle, too.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12005_20: I'm really looking forward to our journey ahead.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12006_1: Greetings, <ano=Master>Goshujin-sama</ano>. Is there anything I can do to make your day brighter?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12006_7: Here you go! Careful, it's hot. If the sweetness isn't just right, just let me know, okay?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12006_9: That's because I am a Namipon! We're all the same Namipon you know. Just shaped a little differently by people's wishes. But deep down, we're all one and the same.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12006_10: So, how about a hot cup of our freshly brewed house special?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12006_11: Yes! I manage everything in <ano=Train Conductor>Shashou</ano> Cafe! Would you care for a hot cup of our freshly brewed house special?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12007_1: Greetings, Passenger! You're just in time! Ta-da! Take this, your very own Namipon Badge!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12007_3: Why are you giving this to me?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12007_4: It's something special. Since you're new here, it's only right I lend a hand. Whether you're in trouble or just need to rest your feet, come find me anytime, alright?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12007_5: So, what do you say? Want to hear more about this badge?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_33: But don't worry. You're safe here.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_34: This <ano=Shashou Cafe>coffeehouse</ano> is a safe zone I created using my "clipping" Forte. The location is ideal and the space stable, so I made it our base of operations.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_36: Everything has a structure. And with these, I can see how it all fits together.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_37: When I was in the center of the city right before the Lament hit?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_38: For the past two months, I've lived through countless repeats of the Lament. Time and space keep getting sliced up and rearranged. What you see now—that chaos—is the result.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_39: It's like the whole city's trapped in amber. The people here are caught in one moment, reliving the same day over and over.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_40: I suspect they're no longer truly alive. Just... residual Reverberations. I call them the <te href=851065>Left Behind</te>.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_41: How long has this been going on?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_42: I wish I knew. Like you, I'm not from here. I was pulled in by the Lament and trapped in this unfamiliar city.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_43: By objective measurement, I've been trapped in Honami for two months. But even when I first arrived, this endless loop was already underway.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_44: So you've only tracked the last two months. To get the full picture, I'll need to talk to someone who's been here longer...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_45: You're barking up the wrong capybara, Passenger. It's true I'm the guardian of Honami... but by the time I woke up, the city was already like this.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_46: That's right. I asked Namipon before. It doesn't know more about this than us.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_47: But here's what we do know: After the Lament, Namipon gained a physical form and a will of its own. And as Honami's mascot, it knows the city like the back of its paw. The layout, the pathways. I believe that makes it a pretty reliable partner.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_48: And apparently... it's made itself right at home.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_49: Mind if I take a look around?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_51: Inside this Sonoro, time and space are brittle. With enough Resonance Energy, I can trace their "threads" and cut through them.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_53: You're in Honami. A city that was destroyed decades ago. You'll still see its name on bus stop signs, in street ads, and in local textbooks for kids.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_54: Remember that tall tower? The one in the center of the city? That was <te href=851064>Neon Tower</te>, Honami's tallest communication facility. I once saw a billboard for a radio show there: "Voices in the Morning, broadcast citywide from Neon Tower."
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_55: But its last broadcast wasn't a morning greeting. It was the Lament. Records show that on the day of the disaster, it came pouring out of Neon Tower, wiping Honami off Solaris entirely... and sealing it inside this Sonoro.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_56: That's what I did earlier. I cut through the gaps in space to bring you close to the base.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_12008_57: Chisa and Namipon share with you the history of Honami City. Though the Lament reduced it to ruins decades ago, its lingering aftereffects also sealed the city within a Sonoro Sphere. Time here remains frozen around when the Lament struck, trapping the city in a repeating loop of its final moments. The coffeehouse where you now stand is a safe zone Chisa created using her "clipping" Forte.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_1: An old clock... its hands are still ticking.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_2: Someone I knew left it here. She believed time flowed strangely in this Sonoro. Used timing devices to find a loophole. So I brought it to the base.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_3: Someone you knew? Was she... also from the outside and got pulled into this Sonoro?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_4: You could say that. I don't know who she is exactly, but she understood this place far better than I do.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_5: She suspected the Sonoro doesn't just loop. It also has a different inner time flow than the outside world. To test her theory, she took apart countless clocks and logged everything. Even her wristwatch was...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_10: Whoever pulled me into this Sonoro wore a watch like that.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_11: ...Could it have been her? But why? If she reached you, she found a way to contact the outside. So she did figure it out... Then why didn't she leave? She was always careful. Never acted without calculating the odds.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_12: Unless... she knew that was as far as she could go.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_13: You said she knew a lot. Where is she now?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_16: She once told me she suspected the only way to break this loop and reconnect with the real world was through the Lament's source, Neon Tower. The closer you get, the more spatial fractures you see.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_17: ...And the more dangerous it gets. But she went alone. Left only a message. Said she'd use the Tower to find others to help, and I should wait here.

Shixifeidu_main_2_8_13_55:
Inside the coffeehouse, you notice an old clock. Chisa explains that it once belonged to "someone she knew" who was obsessed with studying the Sonoro's time patterns. As the conversation unfolds, you learn that this person used to wear a moss-covered watch, the very one on the wrist of the hand that pulled you into this place. But you learn she was last heard heading to Honami City's Neon Tower, in search of an escape. She still hasn't returned.

Within Honami City, space is repeatedly sliced apart by the Lament. According to Chisa and Namipon, the only way to navigate this fragmented maze and reach Neon Tower is to rely on the "Longings" of Honami's Left Behind. Namipon produces a bottle filled with these lingering obsessions, explaining they can resonate with the Tower and guide you closer to the truth.
