Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_1: Ah, my dear friend, we meet again!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_4: Haha, indeed, fate has its way of bringing people together.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_5: Ah, of course not. If my pocket was too full, a bank would suffice.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_6: I'm here for a bit of inspiration, that's all.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_8: Why not? Given that the Carnevale performances always revolve around Order lore, perhaps… a touch of secular themes might be refreshing?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_9: Maybe, a tale of a shrewd moneylender, undone by a trite legal technicality?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_12: True, but that's why where some inspiration could be useful.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_13: Is it really why you are here?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_14: Well, I suppose I can't hide it from you. I'm here for the auction, hoping to acquire some rare, ancient manuscripts.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_15: Oh, speaking of scripts! Did you have the chance to read mine? The one with the maiden? Please, I'd love to hear your thoughts.…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_16: The martyrdom of the maiden is quite moving.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_17: There's something more behind the tale.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_19: It's the climax of the play. Ha, I'm glad you enjoyed it!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_20: Indeed? You have a discerning eye. My research did unearth some… intriguing rumors, but they didn't find their way into the script.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_21: You see, those stories might be too much for the Carnevale crowd.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_22: Ah... I see. So my script wasn't quite up to par.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_23: Anyway, I appreciate your thoughts... Let's hope I outdo myself with the next one.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_59_24: Until the Carnevale, traveler from afar.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_1: Good day! Are you here for the Ducat Auction? I'm afraid we've closed entries for today's session. We would be delighted to see you at our next auction though.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_3: The Ducat Auction is held regularly in the Auction Hall.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_4: Here at Averardo Vault, we pride ourselves on our transparent and fair auctions where only bids matter. We welcome all lawful Ragunna citizens to make their offers. Any item appraised by our agents is eligible for auction.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_5: Be it selling collections or hunting for prized possessions, this is the place to be.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_6: Here's the catalog for our next auction. Please take a look.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_60_7: If you cannot attend in person, simply use our Terminal service, and our Averardo professionals will handle all your bidding and selling needs.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_1: I'm sorry, Lady Carlotta. I've just confirmed with the office that Mr. Capollo is not in the vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_3: That's quite alright. Please inform me the moment he returns.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_6: Oh, {PlayerName}. I'm afraid we've hit a slight snag.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_7: I just learned that Uncle Capollo was called away on pressing matters, so we won't be able to see him at the moment.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_8: This does alter our plans, but worry not. I already have some other surprises up my sleeve.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_9: Please come with me. We need more privacy.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_11: The noble from the Fisalia family?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_12: Yes, thanks to you and Ms. Zani, he could not escape and is now in our custody.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_13: The family gave him a rather… spirited "welcome." As it happens, his bravado crumbled quite quickly. Once he saw the Niumbus Sanctum restored, he sang like a canary.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_14: Your quick action has secured us vital intelligence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_15: To put it simply, Gilberto revealed that we have traitors in our family.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_16: Which is not entirely surprising. Our family has always had its cracks. Given the right incentives or pressures, human weaknesses are all too easily exploited.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_17: I'd actually begun to look into this matter before your arrival at the vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_18: And now it's confirmed that the traitors are in the vault's <ano=Frequency Modification>tuning</ano> room, doing what they believe to be secretive with the help of the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_19: Now they probably won't even notice us with their attention fixed on the property room.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_20: I guess that they are desperately destroying any evidence against the Fisalia family and the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_22: Thank you. Right, as for the next move, I have a plan.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_23: There's an alternate passage into the vault leading straight to where they are. We can surprise them when they least expect it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_24: But I can't manage this alone... I could really use your help.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_26: Your plan is bold, but practical.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_27: I'm glad I have you with me, {PlayerName}. Please take a moment to prepare, and I'll see you at the entrance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_62_28:
After waiting for Carlotta for a long time, you search for her and discover she's in trouble—Capollo has vanished. 
In private, she reveals information from Gilberto's interrogation: there are traitors in the family who have been bribed by Fractsidus.
Carlotta requests your help to reach the traitors' hideout deep within the vault via an alternate passage. She hopes to capture and interrogate them to gain more information.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_1: ...Everything has been taken care of, Lady Carlotta. Here is the "jewelry" and "perfume" you requested.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_3: But I have one more task for you, one of utmost importance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_4: I need you to guard the property room and stop anyone who attempts to break in, whatever it takes—by force if necessary.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_8: Leave it to me. I'll make sure no one touches the evidence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_9: {PlayerName}, we've implemented a two-tier security system. Once inside, please hold your position until I signal. I'll clear the path for you from above.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_10: Then, you may need to use the Terminal to unlock the path on my side.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_11: Two-tier security system? Could it be…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_12: …Sadly yes, our family built this vault with the foresight of possible betrayal.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_13: Most family members only know how to pass one of the two layers. And alliances forged amid all these locks tend to breed treachery and mistrust.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_14: To enter the vault without being trapped to death, two people must have absolute trust in each other. So... do you trust me, {PlayerName}?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_15: Not really, but we have the same goals.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_17: We are already in the same boat, after all.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_19: Oh, I appreciate your trust. It will not be abused.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_20: Ha, very good. I can work with that.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_63_22:
Before you enter the alternate passage, Carlotta assigns Zani to create a diversion by drawing attention of the traitors' helpers in the property room. 
With everything in place, you and Carlotta prepare to venture into the depths of Averardo Vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_64_3: Just a moment, I need to access the upper control room to unlock the door on your end.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_1: So, can you figure it out?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_2: Let's try again. The frequency of the Tacet Discords… What a genius idea, but I can't reverse-engineer the frequency it's using.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_3: Seems like the key is not these flowers, but their creator. She must be an insanely powerful Resonator to be able to… shatter and recontruct these frequencies.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_4: Then we'd better speed up. Once their plan succeeds, there won't be another chance like this!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_6: It's me. Most likely by mistake. I apologize for interrupting your work.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_7: La…Lady Carlotta? How… what brings you here?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_8: Oh, nothing, just curious what you are working on, locked away in this tuning room…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_9: The flowers. No doubt they're from the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_10: Care to defend yourselves? While you still have the chance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_11: Lady Carlotta, we… we're just following orders.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_12: Following orders, you say? Do you recall the very first "oath" we all took upon joining the family?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_13: None… shall h-harm the family's interests.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_17: You've appropriated family assets and turned these Echoes into… ticking time bombs.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_18: Once they detonate, the countless efforts and fortunes spent on the Carnevale will all vanish instantly, taking the Montelli's name and future with them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_19: Lady Carlotta, p-please, we can explain...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_20: What's going on here? Oh, Lady Carlotta…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_21: Just in time. I've found some family traitors. But hold on, I have a few more questions for them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_22: I will only ask once. Who are you taking orders from?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_23: I only know he's one of the top brass in the family… always using encrypted channels and ordering us to pick up flowers from masked strangers.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_24: How many of these Echoes have you made?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_25: …A lot. The first shipment reached the venue as early as a week ago. They look so identical to regular ones that even we can hardly tell them apart.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_27: Take them away and scrutinize all their recent transactions, including the source of every last credit. Then handle them as per the family rules.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_30: I knew those <ano=Frequency Specialist>tuners</ano> wouldn't dare do this alone. Someone far more dangerous is pulling the strings.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_31: Using Echoes to disrupt the Carnevale, having family weakness on a silver platter… enemies within are far more deadly than those without.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_32: Their schemes won't prevail. I will not sit idly by and watch them ruin the long-awaited Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_33: We're done here. Let the guards take care of the rest. So, Ms. Zani mentioned you heard the Sentinel's oracle when you met the Vitreum Dancer?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_34: Yes. Not directly, but close enough.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_35: The seasoned artisans in our family restored the Vitreum Dancer you retrieved and discovered something fascinating in its records.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_36: Come with me. This might answer your questions.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_65_37:
You and Carlotta reach the tuning room in the depths of the vault and catch the <ano=Frequency Specialist>tuners</ano> tampering with the family's Echoes using Lycoris. 
Intimidated by Carlotta, they confess their betrayal: they altered the Echoes and sent them to the rehearsal venue. 
While the traitors are taken away, Carlotta suspects an even more dangerous traitor is involved. 
To thank you, she offers to take you to the family's Echo Collection Room, where you might uncover connections between the Sentinel and the Vitreum Dancers.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_1: Here we are. The true splendors of Montelli's heritage.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_2: Are these all Echoes in the cases?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_3: Yes, and no. They are Echoes but also the promise of Rinascita's future—and, above all, freedom.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_4: Rinascita may be a fledgling country, but it boasts centuries of history. Its foray into the wider world, however, only began a few years ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_5: Don't you find it peculiar? Rinascita, the Land of Echoes… leads the world in Echo technology, yet stands so insular and unadventurous.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_6: What do you suppose is behind all this?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_8: Sharp as always. Rinascita's Common Echoes are bound to Genesis Nexus, making seafaring with them almost impossible.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_9: But their power is essential for dealing with Tacet Discords and other threats at sea. You could say the reliance on Common Echoes has shackled our ambitions to venture beyond our borders.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_10: To break these shackles, the Montelli family has invested in Reserved Terminals. It's not about short-term benefits, but the future for the whole of Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_11: The Order has monopolized the use of Common Echoes and kept a tight leash on Reserved Terminals, claiming that individual ownership would sully the sanctity of the Echoes they so fervently preach about.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_12: But you see their real objective, don't you? To keep Rinascita isolated so they can shape its entire narrative.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_13: And the Fisalia family has covertly aligned with the Order, aiming to crush our efforts and therefore the prospect of Reserved Terminals. They've even gone so far as to seek Fractsidus' aid.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_14: Such is the reality of the Land of Echoes—whoever controls the Echoes controls Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_15: My forebears began collecting these Echoes long before the Vault existed, when the Montelli family was nothing more than a third-rate house ridiculed for its adventurous spirit.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_16: They ventured out to sea for trades and got their hands on Terminals of the most basic model. From there, they've been tirelessly collecting Echoes and advancing the technology. Brick by brick, they built this enterprise that you see today.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_17: You are probably wondering, how does this relates to the Vitreum Dancer? Well, the one that came to you at the Carnevale rehearsal is among our family's earliest Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_18: As both the first Vitreum Dancer and the prototype for the frequency tuning of all subsequent models, its value is truly unparalleled.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_19: It was never meant to be deployed and should have been preserved here in a case forever. But somehow, it found its way to the Carnevale… just to meet you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_21: This is no coincidence. I can only assume it was the design of Sentinel Imperator.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_22: Here are some files about the Vitreum Dancer. Perhaps they can offer you some insights.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_66_23:
In the Echo Collection Room, Carlotta proudly presents the family's treasured collection of Echoes, symbols of freedom and the Montelli commitment to developing Reserved Terminals for exploration beyond Rinascita. Common Echoes rely heavily on beacons and can't be used at sea, limiting exploration outside Rinascita.
Here, you find the first Vitreum Dancer, the prototype for all other Vitreum Dancers—the same one that had empathy with you in the city. 
Carlotta suggests this is no coincidence. The Sentinel may be using this Vitreum Dancer to send a message. 
You decide to delve into the archives on Vitreum Dancers for further insight.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_1: I trust you've read the files. The original Tacet Discord for the Vitreum Dancer emerged from the frequencies of shattered stained glass in the tower ruins, a place forbidden by decree of the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_2: Before the Codex era, those stained-glass windows were used to depict the tales of the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_3: Out of all of the Echoes, they chose the Vitreum Dancer to deliver Their message because—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_4: It will lead me to the Order's hidden truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_5: It will lead me to the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_6: Hmm... my thoughts exactly. The Order's secrets must somehow be connected to the Sentinel's fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_7: How do you know all this?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_8: The Montellis have long pursued the buried secrets of Rinascita—the Order's tampering with the Codex, and the mysterious erasure of the "Age of Ignorance" and the "Age of Conflict" from our history.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_9: If anything can break the chains around Rinascita and grant freedom to all, it must be the truth.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_10: And the quest for this truth is also part of our endeavor to restore connection with the wider world.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_11: Well, that's all I have to offer. Did you want to visit the ruins? Though I'm not sure what there is to uncover.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_14: In that case, I'll accompany you. The family will take care of everything else.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_68_15:
The archives reveal that the original Tacet Discord for the Vitreum Dancer emerged from the frequencies of shattered stained glass in the tower ruins, a place forbidden by decree of the Order. The stained-glass windows were used to depict the tales of the Sentinel.
Carlotta is also intrigued by the Sentinel's message, which seems to be guiding you to hidden truths about the Order and the Sentinel's location.
Together, you prepare to venture to the tower ruins.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_1: Oh, you're back. I've done everything you asked, Lady Carlotta. All the thugs trying to storm the room were handled.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_2: So, they walked straight into the trap.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_3: Yes, we set a bait the traitors could never refuse. You aren't injured, are you, Ms. Zani?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_4: Of course not. I saw a squad of security guards charging into the vault. Did anything happen in there?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_5: Wait… no, never mind. Best I don't know. Whatever's going on in the vault must be family business.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_6: Anyway, it's all sorted now, yes?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_7: Yes, now you can take a break. I've spoken with Mr. Alberto, and he's agreed to grant you a very generous vacation.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_8: Oh, I don't really mind. My pay already came through… but vacation is always a bonus.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_9: Thank you. These adventures beat office life by a mile.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_10: What? Is that... the central alarm of the vault?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_11: Could be a backup plan from the traitors.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_12: Shall we see what delights they've cooked up for us?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_69_13:
Passing through the Averardo Vault lobby, you see that Zani has completed her task. 
However, the vault suddenly shifts into full lockdown—perhaps a backup plan from the traitors.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_1: Lady Carlotta, we have a situation. The guardian Echoes deployed outside the main entrance... have gone rogue for unknown reasons.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_2: We've initiated Security Protocol Four, evacuating civilians and non-combat staff. Our security teams nearby are trying to suppress the Echoes. But…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_3: We are short-handed. Even the bank staff have been whisked away to the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_4: Y-yes, ma'am. If possible, could you authorize access to the vault's Echo Collection…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_5: That won't be necessary. I'll address this personally.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_7: Don't worry. I've got her back. I'm with the bank's security team, and I've handled my fair share of these emergencies.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_9: I'm also up for some action.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_10: Thank you both… Now, let the show begin.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_70_11:
At the reception desk, you learn that the Echo guards outside the main entrance have lost control. With most staff reassigned for the upcoming Carnevale, Carlotta decides to handle the situation personally.
You volunteer to help her deal with the emergency.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_94_1: Cameras here. Good thing I came prepared. Recall the "jewelry" I asked for?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_94_2: In family parlance, it's this handy little tool that generates crystals to cover these cameras and blind them for a while.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_95_1: Done, but it won't last long. I have to keep moving.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_96_2: Luckily, they can be trapped with the crystals as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_97_2: But I must be careful, the security level ahead will increase.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_98_1: So, if "jewelry set" means this gadget... what about "perfume"?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_98_2: Just another weapon… For my family, many things must be kept discreet.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_98_3: And it's not always verbal. Sometimes a glance or a gesture can speak volumes, which, of course, demands a deep mutual understanding.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_99_1: I'm seeing some scatter prisms here. Ornaments, that's what they were designed to be.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_99_2: But they can also amplify my Resonance power… Might be useful at some point.
Side_LGNPZ_1_1: Here you are! Actually, I've come to ask you for a favor today...
Side_LGNPZ_1_2: The deadline for the new issue of Wutherium Film Studio's publication is approaching, and this time, we plan to capitalize on a trending topic.
Side_LGNPZ_1_5: Oh! No need to be modest, of course it's about you—the latest Laureate in Ragunna!
Side_LGNPZ_1_6: Of course, you are the latest Laureate in Ragunna after all!
Side_LGNPZ_1_7: As you know, publishing is tough these days, and if sales keep lagging, headquarters will probably cut our budget again.
Side_LGNPZ_1_8: We've been following your work in Ragunna and thought if you, the Laureate, photographed a travelogue of Ragunna, it would surely be a hit!
Side_LGNPZ_1_9: So we'd like to commission you to take a series of photos for this issue to help boost sales.
Side_LGNPZ_1_10: Any profit from this will go entirely to you. Please, we're counting on you!
Side_LGNPZ_1_12: All you have to do is ask.
Side_LGNPZ_1_13: Thank you so much! We've already set the coordinates for some of Ragunna's landmarks. I'll send them to you now!
Side_LGNPZ_2_4: What a perfect shot! Brilliant composition, exquisite colors!
Side_LGNPZ_2_5: Please, don't limit yourself to photography. What I mean is, your aesthetic should not be confined by the camera!
Side_LGNPZ_2_6: This is where my good partner comes in! Mr. C-MOSS! With your permission, it can capture the scenery you envision. Please, roam Ragunna freely and collect the scenes that speak to you.
Side_LGNPZ_2_7: Have you taken the first photo yet? Let me take a look!
Side_LGNPZ_3_1: Forward, the knight's mission is to move ahead... I understand.
Side_LGNPZ_3_2: But the knight's attire has been with me for half my life. Now, who can give meaning to the knight's path forward?
Side_LGNPZ_4_1: This land is no longer where I belong. If the art I seek is truly a sin beyond redemption, then... where should I go?
Side_LGNPZ_5_1: This is the final location for the last photo. Thank goodness you agreed to help — this issue will surely be the most brilliant since the magazine's inception!
Side_LGNPZ_5_2: But your story with Ragunna is still unfolding, and I truly look forward to witnessing more of your legacy here.
Side_LGNPZ_6_1: Oh, I didn't expect to run into you here. Here, take a commemorative postcard from the exclusive Ragunna performance.
Side_LGNPZ_6_3: This performance marks the reunion of Ragunna and theatrical arts after many years apart. When we first set sail from here, we promised ourselves we'd return to the stage one day."
Side_LGNPZ_6_4: Now we've come back, not to prove our greatness, but to show everyone that the things we lost will be reclaimed!
Side_LGNPZ_6_5: You must come to the next performance, too!
Side_LGNPZ_7_1: "According to Montelli customs and requirements, this is a promissory note with no expiration, no designated beneficiary, and no specified amount."
Side_LGNPZ_7_2: "This note is a link to the Montelli."
Side_LGNPZ_7_3: "Stranger, when you find yourself in trouble, show them this note."
Side_LGNPZ_7_4: "As long as it still bears the Montelli seal, it will serve as a voucher for a grand reward in your future."
Side_LGNPZ_7_6: "But their will also present you with an offer you cannot refuse."
Side_LGNPZ_7_7: (The seal is worn out, it seems the note is no longer valid...)
Side_LGNPZ_8_1: (The Nimbus Wraith looks around, making helpless sounds, seemingly searching for its companions.)
Side_LGNPZ_9_1: (The Nimbus Wraith reunites with its companions, making joyful sounds as if thanking you, the kind-hearted Rover, and inviting you to join in their celebration.)
POI_QSMG_1_1: With humility, justice, and bravery... I vow never to use force against women, children, or the defenseless. I will stand against injustice until my last breath.
POI_QSMG_1_3: How's that, Mr. Cosimo? I didn't miss a word. Can we start the knighting ceremony now?
POI_QSMG_1_4: Well, you recited it perfectly, but... I'm no longer part of the Order. What you have before you now is only a simple innkeeper. I'm afraid... I've no right to knight you.
POI_QSMG_1_5: I do have some old friends still in the Order. If you can wait a bit longer I can...
POI_QSMG_1_6: No right? I can't wait any longer! Every time we get this far, Mr. Cosimo, you always come up with one excuse after the other to delay the ceremony.
POI_QSMG_1_8: Watch your words, Carlow! Accusations like that betray everything you just swore to uphold. And to say such things in front of an outlander?
POI_QSMG_1_10: I... forgive me. But... Mr. Cosimo, tell me the truth. You don't really believe I saw a knight when I was a child, do you?
POI_QSMG_12_1: My sword stands ready! The gods blessed it, so it will always be sharp. By the knight's code, I hereby challenge you to a duel!
POI_QSMG_12_2: ...No, no! That sounded weak. Let me try again!
POI_QSMG_12_4: A black armor, a well-crafted sword in hand... and a flying servant. Are you the foreign knight and the sword spirit passing through Egla Town?
POI_QSMG_12_9: Ah, say no more. If you want to prove you mean no harm, we must duel! A duel settles everything!
POI_QSMG_12_10: The boy playing knight seems to have nothing but dueling on his mind. You have no choice but to walk away.
POI_QSMG_13_1: Greetings, honorable chevalier from afar. I presume you wish Egla Town to be your starting point to distant horizons?

Event_JSZZV_1_1: Alright, time for a coin toss again...
Event_JSZZV_1_3: So, that settles it. Praise be to Imperator... I shall punish the wicked and fulfill the divine will.
Event_JSZZV_2_1: Ahem… Apologies, friends from afar. Didn't realize you were watching.
Event_JSZZV_2_3: Just a pain in the neck… When you get old, trouble finds you everywhere.
Event_JSZZV_2_4: Last night, some thugs broke into my house looking for documents. Daisy caught them in the act...
Event_JSZZV_2_5: She rang the alarm and tried to wake me up, but they were armed. Tried to cover their tracks… Daisy didn't make it.
Event_JSZZV_2_7: That's awful! How could they?! Jerks!
Event_JSZZV_2_8: Daisy's been with me for twenty years... twenty whole years. If someone told me back then that people would harm the Order's Echo, I'd simply call them crazy.
Event_JSZZV_2_9: So Daisy was an Echo? Wait, I'm an Echo too! How dare they hurt a poor little Echo!
Event_JSZZV_2_10: I lost everything after my wife passed away twenty years ago—until Daisy showed up at my doorstep. She was my wife's last gift to me… and now she's taken away too.
Event_JSZZV_2_14: I'm old now, but in my younger days, the Primus always told me: "Wicktorio, there is no need for extreme measures."
Event_JSZZV_2_15: "As an accountant of the Order, you must act professional and decent..."
Event_JSZZV_2_17: Do it long enough, and you'll understand. It's all about the numbers. As long as the books balance, anything's fair game.
Event_JSZZV_2_18: After I retired, my buddy Cosimo once told me I couldn't just "shoot" my problems away.
Event_JSZZV_2_19: But when the problems kept piling up, I thought: why not deal with the people who created those problems?
Event_JSZZV_2_20: I get the logic… but it's a stretch...
Event_JSZZV_2_21: Anyway, my friends... how about joining me for a little adventure? I can tell you've got potential. And don't worry, my savings will make it worth your while.
Event_JSZZV_2_22: Nothing complicated, just some debt collecting.
Event_JSZZV_2_24: Good. I'll show you where they're hiding. You can handle them however you like. The reward will be worth it.
Event_JSZZV_3_4: Well, we've both had a busy day. Time for a drink, don't you think?
Event_JSZZV_3_5: So, care to share what you found inside?
Event_JSZZV_3_7: The gold coins they hoarded were old currency that was meant to be issued but abandoned after a currency swap.
Event_JSZZV_3_8: Given Ragunna's trade history over the past two decades, they probably planned to exploit the information gap and run cons overseas. That's why they needed those documents.
Event_JSZZV_3_10: What did you do to those people?
Event_JSZZV_3_11: They made too many. Way more than the market could handle.
Event_JSZZV_3_12: People always believe more money is better, but there's a limit. Once it's breached, everything spirals—a chain reaction.
Event_JSZZV_3_13: As you can see, Ragunna eventually adopted Shell Credit as its stable currency.
Event_JSZZV_3_14: Them? Heh. Let's just say I hope the coins I placed on their eyes cover their fare to the underworld.
Event_JSZZV_3_15: Sentinel above, forgive the violence. But for those blinded by greed, it was the only fitting end.
Event_JSZZV_3_16: Wow… like a scene straight out of that Ragunnesi play.
Event_JSZZV_3_17: By the way, here's the reward I promised. As for the extra Shell Credits, consider them a handling fee for converting that outdated currency.
Event_JSZZV_3_18: In life, you either handle the people or settle the score. Peace doesn't come easy, even after retirement.
Event_JSZZV_3_19: Anyway, this old man's heading back now. Stop by Egla Town anytime. You're always welcome.
Guide_LSJ_1_1: Oh... my soulmate, my king of inspiration... what has happened to you...

Guide_LSJ_3_2: Could you share them with Melody? This might ease its "symptoms"...

Rinascita, known as the Land of Echoes, is famed for its advanced Echo technologies and is home to many Echoes like Abby. This region may also hold vital clues as to Abby's origins.
Shorekeeper gives you an invitation letter from the Montelli family, which allows you to enter Rinascita through the port city of Ragunna.
Even as the Threnodian's revival spreads chaos across other regions, Rinascita remains strangely unaffected and is gearing up to celebrate the Carnevale grand festival. This unusual calm belies what could be a rough journey.

Your smooth sailing meets a sudden disruption as you come under attack from Cetus the Tidebreaker. Just when things seemed most dire, Brant, the leader of a traveling troupe, comes to your rescue and brings you aboard his liner.

Brant tells you he and his troupe will take part in the upcoming Carnevale, where the Sentinel Imperator will make a rare appearance to crown the festival's finest performer with the Laurel, an honor that grants the Laureate the privilege of hearing the Sentinel's voice.

As you converse, a Waveworn Phenomenon rises as a mist over Rinascita's seas. Hidden within are many TDs, ready to attack any passing ship. To survive this mist, you fight alongside the troupe.

Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_5: Though their origins were different, they followed the same ocean currents to a hidden sea.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_6: They prayed for paradise but were met with a nightmare filled with Tacet Discords. The sky darkened, the sea roared, and towering waves threatened to engulf them.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_7: At that moment, a radiant light pierced the clouds, and a voice resounded from the sky—
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_8: "Make the waters your second home, like seabirds nesting along the coast. Build your shelters hither and thither, like stars in the night sky."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_9: "Your fortress is fragile, made only of wickers and planks, but fear not, for it is strong enough to withstand the wuthering waves."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_10: Heeding the heavenly voice, the displaced united. A gentle breeze guided their ships, filling their sails with wind.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_11: Through the storm, they glimpsed a bright light from an unnamed island. This was the light of the Genesis Nexus.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_12: The Nexus granted them knowledge of Echoes and sent them to help build their cities. The people named the island Rinascita and built sanctuaries with inscriptions, honoring the voice that guided them to paradise.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_13: The voice did indeed reveal itself. The faithful saw the true form of their savior, who declared its sacred name—Imperator.

Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_16: This legend is known widely among the Ragunnesi, though the true beginnings of Rinascita remain shrouded in lost history. Scholars of the Order have never stopped their quest to uncover it.

Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_1: Is there anything else you'd like to know about Ragunna? I'll do my best to answer your questions.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_6: Our Sentinel embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. They are the lord of the sky and seas, protector of the land.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_7: They freed us from division and conflict, treating all equally and uniting us as one.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_8: Legends say the Sentinel's breath becomes a gentle breeze, blessing Ragunna's ships and guiding them safely to their destinations.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_9: Their radiant gaze pierces the darkness, illuminating the way forward. In reverence, people built lighthouses across the island.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_10: The Sentinel never boasts of Their deeds but bestows miracles in subtle ways, as it is written.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_11: "I am the gentle breeze that caresses you in green meadows. I am the unseen guardian as you walk in the valley of shadows."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_12: "I am with you, steadfast and unwavering, from the past, through the present, and beyond the future."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_13: The Order of the Deep is Ragunna's de facto authority, handling everything from city management and disputes to diplomacy.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_14: We revere our Sentinel and act on Their behalf, overseeing all Common Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_15: The La Guardia, the armed Echoes you saw before you entered the city, are part of the Order, working alongside us to keep Ragunna safe and orderly.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_16: By the Sentinel's will, all citizens of Ragunna can use Common Echoes by simply registering their information with the Nexus.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_17: If you face any issues during your stay, please report them to the Order. We are here to ensure your stay is comfortable.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_18: The Carnevale is Rinascita's grandest annual festival, lasting seven days. Its theme is said to be "transcend the flesh to the divine realm."
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_19: The outer seas of Rinascita were once plagued by Tacet Discords and Lament occurrences, making sea travel impossible. Isolated on the island, the Ragunnesi found solace in the epics recited by limping poets and ballads sung by blind singers.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_20: Stories from many lands were shared, forming a cradle of culture and art. The people mingled, dreaming of the world beyond, envisioning a different life for themselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_21: These dreams came to life during the spring rite in honor of the Sentinel. People dressed in costumes, setting aside their positions and prejudices to come together for a grand parade—this is the origin of today's Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_24: A stage will be set on the first day of the Carnevale. Wear a mask, and you can be part of the show.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_25: The masks set people free, allowing everyone to shed their usual roles and revel in the celebration. We haven't had a Carnevale in many years, so this one is poised to be pretty special.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_27: The streets will be alive with spectacular performances. Vendors from far and wide will showcase unique items.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_28: Even without a mask, you can still take in the atmosphere and pick up some souvenirs.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_29: In Rinascita, anyone can summon Common Echoes from the Nexus, whether they're a Resonator or not.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_30: It has been modified by our Sentinel to allow Echoes to appear in physical forms.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_31: However, not all Common Echoes are available for personal use. For example, La Guardia are armed guards managed exclusively by the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_32: Echoes affiliated with the Order are identified by their halo and respond only to its members, so please be aware of this.
Main_Linaxita_2_1_11_34: If you have any further questions, please feel free to ask. It's our duty as Acolytes to assist every visitor.

After battling through swarms of Tacet Discords in the mist, you reunite with Brant, who saved a survivor named Andreas from the Pilgrim's Sail.
Brant and Roccia reveal the grim truth of the pilgrimage: it's a banishment in disguise, and all exiles are marked as "The Fool" by The Order. Brant, Roccia, and their troupe are among those given this title, having been cast out as "The Fools."
Unfortunately, the Order's lies run deep. Andreas tells you in despair that some pilgrims have been misled, believing they will find salvation by reaching the Sacrificial Arena at the island's peak. But that arena is actually the lair of the Dragon of Dirge, a TD that answers not to prayers but devours all frequencies without mercy. 
Determined to save those deceived by The Order and to settle your own score with the Dragon, you all set out for the Sacrificial Arena.

Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_5: Of course! You think that lil' lizard could take me down? I just took a nap after eating its frequency. Hic...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_6: Uh, seriously? You think that lil' lizard could take me down? I just took a nap after eating its frequency. Hic.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_7: Thanks, but no thanks. You think that lil' lizard could take me down? I just took a nap after eating its frequency. Hic.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_8: But seriously, that was close! The fire it breathed almost singed your hair! Good thing I was here to back you up!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_9: As soon as I realized it was a Tacet Discord, I went for it and ate its frequency. Piece of cake! But I gotta say, it was a pretty hefty bite.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_10: I swear I chewed it up, but it was hard to swallow. It wasn't the taste, you know. More like my digestion's been a mess lately. Hic.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_11: Is it because of your condition?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_12: Your condition is definitely getting worse.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_13: Exercising more might help with that.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_14: That's not the point! The real deal is, I found something crazy in its frequency.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_15: You said you somehow experienced empathy with a Tacet Discord back in Jinzhou, right? How about trying that again with this guy?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_16: Trust me! This could be our big break!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_28_17:
After a hard-fought battle, you defeat the Dragon of Dirge. Just as you're about to finish it, Abby emerges from within you again. Abby quickly explains that it tried to absorb the Dragon's frequency earlier but something was wrong with its absorption ability—a sign that Abby's condition may be worsening.
Still, Abby says that's not the main issue. During the absorption, it sensed something unusual in the Dragon's frequency. Abby urges you to empathize with the Dragon before its frequency fades.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_1: Gehinnom, a wretched soul, mourned by none...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_2: You are reborn to fulfill our sacred rite... Illuminate the path of salvation...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_3: Become the fiery hand of judgment, purging all transgressions...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_4: Cleanse every soul ensnared by their own indulgence...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_5: Those who cannot withstand the trial by fire... shall forever be barred from our pure land...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_29_6: As you tap into the Dragon of Dirge's memories, a vision unfolds: a man in The Order's uniform places a halo on the Dragon, commanding it to deliver a final judgment to all who approach.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_2: The Order found a way to control the dragon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_3: Tacet Discords' frequencies are perpetually fading, inching toward their end.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_4: Their only way to maintain their existence is to consume other frequencies as food.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_5: The Dark Tide and mist enveloping this isle have drawn in countless Tacet Discords. Their frequencies should have been enough to feed the dragon.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_6: If what you saw is true, then...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_7: The Order must've used some trick to control the dragon, making its frequency fade away faster than it should.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_8: That means they could be responsible for why the dragon began attacking all living beings, including humans...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_9: In time, it ended up becoming a harbinger of death.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_10: I found this during the previous battle.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_11: It seems the Fractsidus had their hand in this case as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_15: Mm? So you know them too. Seems we have much to discuss.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_16: Our troupe usually earns a living by performing on the nearby islands. Sometimes, we take on escort missions for merchant ships as well. That's how we first got acquainted with the Fractsidus.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_17: At first, they were just lurking about, raiding ships. But as the Carnevale drew near, their actions grew suspicious. We noticed them lingering around a certain sea.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_18: Remember Cetus the Tidebreaker, the creature that attacked you when we first met?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_19: After we parted ways, we went searching for it to find out what had gone wrong.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_20: This is what we found on its tail... another Lycoris.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_21: Alas, the Tidebreaker slipped away into the deep, beyond our reach. Still, this bloom leaves no doubt. The Fractsidus is behind its strange behavior.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_22: We saw what they did to the dragon. The Cetus's violent outburst must be their doing as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_23: They could wreak havoc at the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_24: What if their true target is the Sentinel?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_25: They say the Carnevale is a ceremony to resonate with the Sentinel. Those who claim the Laurel may be graced with a miracle—a direct communion with the divine.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_26: At first, we thought you were merely a curious traveler, intrigued by the Carnevale and our Sentinel. But now, seeing how far you've come, there's more to your quest, isn't there?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_27: Our troupe has always sought the Laurel, and we won't sit back while others threaten the Carnevale. If they're your foes, then our paths align!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_28: Remember I mentioned one of ours who once claimed the Laurel?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_29: He wasn't with us when we first met. But once we reach our base, you can speak with him about the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_30: It won't be long now. After such an adventure, a well-earned rest awaits.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_30_32:
You share your vision with Brant and Roccia. They theorize that the Dragon of Dirge was once a simple Tacet Discord that fed on frequencies. But now it becomes a harbinger of death under The Order's control and attacks anything in its path. During the battle, Brant also found a Lycoris on the ground, suggesting that Fractsidus is again behind this.
Brant explains that his troupe has faced Fractsidus at sea before. After they parted ways with you, they kept tracking Cetus the Tidebreaker and found a Lycoris on its tail as well. You suspect Fractsidus's plans may involve the Carnevale and the Sentinel of Rinascita. Since Brant's troupe is here for the Carnevale, they are determined to confront Fractsidus with you.
Brant also mentions that a member of their troupe once won the Laurel of Carnevale. He might know about the connections between the Carnevale, the Laurel, and the Sentinel. You decide to seek him out for answers.
Then, you head to the troupe's base together for a brief respite.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_1: Here we are, ladies and gentlemen. Allow me to present to you our sanctuary, a haven for all the surviving Fools at the edge of the world.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_4: It is, my friend. We built this base from the ground up, and I dare say it's a triumph worthy of the ages.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_5: They say the most dangerous places are the safest. Penitent's End has always been forsaken, and now, cloaked in the sea of mist, even the Order's envoys wouldn't dare set foot here. It's the perfect refuge for us.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_6: The mist does shield us from the Order, but it brings its own set of problems.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_7: Precisely why we must tackle its effects without delay.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_8: By the way, if you'd like to speak with Mr. Bardolino, our Laureate, you'll find his tent deep within the base.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_9: Feel free to talk to the others while we handle our tasks. We'll catch up once we're done.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_10: The troupe's base is, surprisingly, hidden in a cavern beneath Penitent's End. The thick mist provides a natural cover, but it remains a perilous environment. Brant and Roccia tell you how to find Bardolino, the former Laureate, and then set off to handle the lingering impact of the mist. They'll meet you again once their tasks are done.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_1: First Mate! What should we do with these stage props?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_2: Load the light boxes on the heavy suitcases. Place the lights on top and secure them with chains. Keep the fireworks well away from the curtains.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_3: And don't forget to check the freshwater reserves and all cabin doors.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_5: The first mate has quite the workload.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_6: I'm starting to wonder who's really running the ship.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_7: Usually, the crew handles these jobs themselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_8: But since we're prepping for the Carnevale and working on stage setups, it's fair they ask for my advice.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_9: Here, the role of captain is best suited to someone who can ease the newcomers' fears and worries.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_10: Brant is a natural. As for me, I'm more comfortable managing these kinds of tasks.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_12: The frequencies mixed in the mist are unsettling Lario. I'm trying to calm it down so the crew can board.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_13: Wanna give it a try? Just place your hand on its forehead and channel your Resonance Energy, like this...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_16: You really are special... The Echoes here are naturally drawn to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_17: Echoes can sense and respond to human frequencies. They reflect how we treat them, for better or worse.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_18: They're like reflections of who we each are.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_19: I've heard Lario's scientific name is Pliosaurus Somnii, an incredible creature first seen in the dream of its discoverer.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_20: It used to escort our ships across the seas, and then, of its own accord, became our stage. It has braved countless storms with us.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_21: Throughout our many travels, we've never found another like it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_22: It must've been lonely, after so many years alone, drifting... That's why it chose to sail with us.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_24: When I was young, much younger than I am now, I performed in a play that was banned by the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_25: And... that was it. I was sent here with all the other performers.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_26: The play was about freedom, love, and hope. How could something so beautiful be considered taboo? I... I don't understand.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_1: Welcome back, Brant! I... I heard a lot of voices coming from the mist. It's scary...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_2: Don't be afraid, Morrias. They're all friends from the troupe, people we've sailed with.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_3: You said you want to be a captain, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_4: Sailing has its own trials—sea monsters, storms, whirlpools, undercurrents, you name it. When such challenges arise, you've got to trust your helm and your crew.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_5: They'll stand by you through thick and thin, and your job is to guide them safely through it all, till you reach the journey's end.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_6: I understand... Everyone has been so good to me, always looking out for me. When I grow up, I'll be a great captain and take care of them too!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_7: That's the spirit, kiddo! You've already got the heart of a captain, and that's no small feat. You're the captain of your own ship!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_8: Bravery like that deserves rewards. Here, take this.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_9: Wow, Captain Sparrow's Legends! Thanks, Brant!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_10: And... can I maybe have a sip of the stuff you like to drink? The Troupe Strength?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_11: Ah, well... Ahem! That's a special brew for captains who've faced the fiercest storms. When you're ready, your own glass of Troupe Strength will be waiting.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_14: Kids here really seem to trust you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_15: About the Reverberations in the sea mist...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_16: It's a drink made of Waterlamps, fermented, distilled, and aged to perfection. Not for young ones, of course.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_17: We brew it ourselves, each of us with our preferred strength. It's not worth much, but it's one of the few pleasures we can have here…
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_18: As the captain, it's my duty to be the crew's compass. This face must not show any fear or sorrow.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_19: This isle is fraught with hidden threats. Many who were banished never made it to join us, claimed by the Tacet Discords. Their Reverberations became part of the mist...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_20: Those who did make it have their own dreams to chase.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_21: Some will eventually leave to follow the call of their hearts, their silhouettes forever etched into the mist.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_22: We hope they find their promised lands. The troupe may be a safe harbor, but it's certainly not the final destination of their journey.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_23: We honor their names and stories in our plays, passing their legacy down through the crew.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_24: Beriarti the Fire Eater, Toscanini the Night Watcher, Fernando the Fish Killer... Their stories remain vivid in my memory. One day, I'll compile them into a book. Mark my words.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_25: Over the years, we've bid farewell to many and welcomed countless new faces... It seems this cycle will never end.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_27: When I was a boy, I saw the Sentinel's statue in the Cathedral of Mercury. Curiosity led me to point at the statue and ask, "How can you say it's the Sentinel when no one has ever laid eyes on it?" I didn't know the consequences that would follow.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_28: That question earned me a pilgrimage. At the time, I thought it was some grand adventure.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_29: On the Pilgrim's Sail, I was cared for by other Fools who shared what little they had and shielded me from the grim reality with their kindness and smiles.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_30: But all I could do was watch... as they passed away, one by one. From that day forward, I swore to wipe away the tears of the innocent.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_31: Every adventurer needs a rest, and every ship must find a port. For us, that meant finding a sanctuary.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_32: When we finally reached this forsaken isle, the destination of our pilgrimage, we fought the Tacet Discords to claim our territory and scavenged what we could from the ship's wreckage. From that, we built all this...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_35: Though the night may be long, the dawn always follows! That, my friend, is what we should set our sights on.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_1: C'mon, fish. Come to my net.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_4: Did you borrow some of the Cloudcaster's parts?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_5: Me? Just prepping dinner. The storm's passed, so it's the perfect time for fishing!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_6: The captain once told me a secret: the fiercer the storm, the more fish it brings. Sometimes we even see fish swept up by the wind, raining down from the sky!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_8: Uh, are you sure this is legal?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_9: Usually, yeah. But when we dock on an island, the captain and first mate will buy some other food from the locals.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_10: Legal? Ha, who cares! We're not even a legitimate troupe according to the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_11: Back in Ragunna, I was just a fledgling fisherman when I accidentally caught an Orastie.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_12: Turns out it's a sacred fish, only meant as an offering to the Sentinel. Mortals aren't allowed to catch it… but it swam right into my net! Not really my fault, was it?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_13: Though, the Order didn't see it that way. They banished me here, like tossing a fish onto dry land.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_14: Luckily, the troupe found me. I can still fish like I used to. Otherwise, I'd probably be dead or living as a pirate.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_15: Though, to be honest, life here ain't too different from a pirate's, except we're not hunting for treasure but for smiles and cheers from our punters!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_16: Yeah. I borrowed the reel for my fishing rod.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_17: We scavenge all sorts of stuff from the beach and fix them up as needed. Nothing goes to waste! Don't be fooled by appearances, this stuff can be pretty versatile!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_35_18: After talking to the troupe member, you managed to retrieve one of the Cloudcaster's parts.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_5: Who are you? A new recruit? Can't you see we're trying to have a fistfighting contest here? Back in the day, a brawl like this was the pride of the streets!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_6: People from every district used to gather on a certain bridge over the river. And first one to toss their opponent into the water got the bridge and the bragging rights.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_7: The victors were hailed as champions, their names sung in the streets. They earned titles and glory beyond measure.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_8: It's a shame the Order banned it. What was their excuse again? Oh, right—"breaking solidarity among citizens."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_9: It's madness! A good brawl was a way to blow off steam and ease some of the hostility between the people before it grew into something dangerous.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_10: And look where we are now. No more epic matches, just a simmering pot of trouble. Can't make sense of it...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_12: I got caught smacking someone with a stick in the street.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_13: Yeah, I gave him that stick.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_15: Eh... that's the reason you were all banished?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_16: You all seem to get along well now.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_17: Whether it was for a good reason or not, as soon as you break the Order's doctrines—fraternity, Ragunna's "unity," or whatever—you're sent off on pilgrimage.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_18: Once on board the Pilgrim's Sail, we only had each other to rely on. Out here, sticking together is the only way to survive.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_19: Speaking of which, we never did settle who won that fight, did we?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_20: Hmm, now that you mention it, we didn't.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_21: Then let's do it now! C'mon! Let's go!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_24: Haha, don't worry, they've been at this a hundred times before! How about a wager? I'll put up my lucky half-coin!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_36_25: Then again... neither of them ever actually wins, do they? Betting might be a waste... Eh, who cares? It's the fun that matters!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_1: Sailors cheer as hearts ignite, soon we'll break these chains so tight. Set the course, embrace the storm, sailing on 'til light is born...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_4: Did you borrow some of the Cloudcaster's parts?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_5: Oh, hello! I'm writing a sea shanty!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_6: Did you know, Ragunna gondolier's songs are usually in 3/4 time. It matches the flow of water perfectly.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_7: When they row, their strokes go "slow dip, quick lift," which fits that rhythm.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_8: But for our troupe, we use a 4/4 signature with strong and weak beats. It's catchy and perfect for sailors to sing along to as we work together to tackle the waves.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_9: Actually... boarding the Pilgrim's Sail was my choice.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_10: I used to compose hymns for the Order. Sounds prestigious, hm?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_11: But the same old rhythm and lyrics started to wear on me. Music should be alive! So I decided to take the pilgrimage, believing I'd find new inspiration from the divinity.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_12: Hmph, you probably already know what the pilgrimage really is. I was foolish to believe the Order's lies, but luckily, the troupe found me and brought me in. Ah, have you seen any of our performances perhaps?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_13: We don't do those lofty soliloquies that give you existential dread. That doesn't mean our plays are shallow—they're just more hopeful and speak directly to the heart.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_14: We do Commedia Improvviso, a style of play that's all about those fleeting, beautiful moments of everyday life.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_15: We sing of love that endures, enemies who become allies in the fight against evil...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_16: The Order may scoff at such stories, but they're real, human stories—full of ambition, dignity, and everything that makes us human.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_17: Traveling with the troupe, I've learned to see the beauty in the small things, and I've met people facing similar and unique life struggles.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_18: Only those who walk in the fields can really see how the crops grow. It's the same with music. You can't truly know it until you've listened.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_19: That's why I'm always chatting with the crew, gathering ideas for my ballads and shanties—the true rhyme of our time.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_20: The Cloudcaster... Oh, I use its base as a desk. Our first mate lent it to me so I could write more comfortably.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_21: Here it is. Careful, it's heavy.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_37_22: After talking to the troupe member, you managed to retrieve one of the Cloudcaster's parts.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_1: Relax, young man. Life's only just unfurling its sails for you. Why sit there like one of those dour statues in the Order's halls? Don't be afraid to show a little spark!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_2: I... I was just thinking about my future. Is Ragunna truly lost to me forever?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_3: Ah, some have found their way back, but under the Order's watchful eye. Is that really what you want? A life without freedom?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_4: Listen, you don't need a grand stage to leave your mark. A true Ragunnesi can turn even a ragged tent into the finest theater. That's what I'm preparing to do.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_5: I might be an old man now, but don't let that fool you. I was once crowned with the Laurel, you know!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_8: Did anything unusual happen to you when you had the Laurel?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_10: As I took my final bow on stage, a bright light pierced through the clouds, shining down from the sky. And then, a radiant Laurel descended upon me. And I heard a voice—it was the Sentinel's voice, ringing in my head.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_11: I asked Them a question that had puzzled me since childhood, the ultimate philosophical riddle—"What should I eat tonight?"
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_12: And They answered, "The body is the temple of the mind. To keep your mind sharp, do consume healthy food, such as the Laurus Salad."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_13: But why Laurus Salad? I was baffled, and the meaning still eludes me to this very day. I've never been quick-witted though, and the Order's doctrines never quite took hold. Acting, however, that is where my true passion lies...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_15: Perhaps that's just the Sentinel's personal favorite...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_16: I must say, your question is rather interesting...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_17: But why did a blessed Laureate like you get banished by the Order?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_18: Back when I won the Laurel, Ragunna was led by the Holy Maiden. She promoted all sorts of grand celebrations during the Carnevale, an unceasing tide of revelry...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_19: Stages sprang up on every corner of the city, performances dancing through the streets, and shops adorned in vibrant hues. Even on rainy nights, you could still hear music playing in the square.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_20: Some performers wove their critiques into their acts. Sharp as she was, the Holy Maiden noticed. She refined city policy with each whisper of dissent.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_21: Ah, those were the golden days, my friend. The Holy Maiden once said that if she were to leave this world, she'd want no majestic tomb or a solemn funeral, but the grandest Carnevale as her final farewell.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_22: And then... she really did leave us. The current Primus took her place, and in the name of "mourning the Holy Maiden," issued all sorts of bans on the Carnevale. But is that really what she would have wanted?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_23: The Order's grip tightened, and the Carnevale performances were reduced to dull, monotonous shadows of their former selves.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_24: One year, I strung a wire from a Gondola to the top of the clock tower in Liberty Square, and another from the tower to the Fisalia's mansion.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_25: Then, I disguised myself as one of the La Guardia to fool the Acolytes and climbed to the roof along the wire...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_26: Midway through the Order's performance, I hopped on a Wingray with a Cloudcaster, showering the entire city with flowers.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_27: Yes, it was a magnificent sight. The Wingray soared higher than the Acolytes could reach. They couldn't do anything but watch golden-pink petals rain from the sky for three whole days.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_28: They struggled to clean up the flowers from the streets, and it took a downpour to wash them all away. That Cloudcaster, adapted from a music van, became the prototype for the one we use on stage today.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_29: Exactly what I'd expect from a Laureate.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_30: No wonder you got banished by the Order...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_31: But that's all in the past! To this day, I'm still not sure what crime they pinned on me. Maybe walking the wire without protection? Ha!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_32: Anyway, I'm just an old relic now. But you lot, you're the main characters of this era, facing down every obstacle with fire in your bellies!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_33: But isn't our fate already sealed? Without the so-called "salvation" the Order preaches, we're doomed to our banishment. Just lost souls, dying in obscurity...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_38_34: Life is short, and we weren't born just to atone. The Order may banish us, but they can't take away our right to sing.

Carlotta tells you that the Montelli family's trouble is temporarily resolved. She and you then piece together recent events. You realize that The Order intends to recreate the crisis that wrecked the Carnevale ten years ago. 
The Order has maintained its power through communication with the Sentinel, but with the Sentinel's absence for ten years, faith in the Order has waned. Also, Primus Fenrico does not match the description of the "Enlightened One." Desperate to restore public trust, the Order has been "forced" to revive the festival. However, if the Carnevale enables direct communication with the Sentinel, The Order's deceptions will be exposed. 
Their plan seems clear now: by causing chaos through Fractsidus, The Order can then intervene as "saviors" and regain the people's trust without undermining their authority. Although you've foiled some of Fractsidus's schemes, threats still loom. The troupe has discovered that Cetus the Tidebreaker is still under their control, and it's likely that a Fractsidus Overseer will make an appearance at the Carnevale. 
To reach the Sentinel, winning the Laurel—which grants a chance to communicate directly with the Sentinel—may be your best option. 
With a shared goal, Carlotta becomes your ally. Now, you just need to decide how to carry out your plan.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_1: Our rehearsals are rather straightforward. No scripts, just pure intuition and our senses guiding us! That's what makes Commedia Improvviso truly come alive!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_2: For our improvised comedy, we start with a theme. From there, we build our lines and act on the fly, responding to the unfolding show and audience reactions.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_4: But with the limitless capacity for human creativity at play, the plot can sometimes veer into the... well, unconventional. To prevent things from spiraling too far, we set an "anchor" for the performance.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_5: Pardon my interruption, but I'm quite curious. What sort of bizarre plots have you encountered?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_6: Well, something like "A humble craftsman from a small town sets sail on a rainy night, stumbles upon ancient ruins, is reincarnated with super powers, and then decides to conquer the galaxy, becoming the Emperor of the Stars..."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_7: So, we draft a basic outline that assigns roles and guides the plot's direction.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_8: And this time, our outline is: "A kingdom is attacked, monsters run rampant, and the Demon King has kidnapped the Holy Maiden. A few brave heroes accept the minister's quest to defeat the Demon King and rescue her."
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_12: This outline holds special meaning. We want to pay tribute to the play once performed by the Blessed Maiden herself, which was also about a hero facing a Demon King.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_13: Good people have their wishes fulfilled, heroes appear in a time of crisis, justice triumphs over evil, and united friends are undefeatable.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_14: This is the tale the Blessed Maiden once told, and it's a universal story we want to portray.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_16: To me, the world is a stage, and performing is much like combat. Coordinated movements, quick thinking, sharp reflexes, and, above all, trust in your allies.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_17: What I'm getting at is that you both are very skilled and capable. We don't have many dos and don'ts, so relax and express yourselves freely on stage!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_18: This rehearsal is to help you get familiar with basic stage movements, techniques, and the troupe's style, and to build good rapport.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_19: Exactly. I'll handle the stage lighting, Brant will narrate, and the rest will take on the role of the audience.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_20: If you're ready, let's begin! Everyone, a big round of applause to welcome the Rover and Ms. Carlotta on stage!

Although the performance is largely unscripted, they've prepared a simple outline—a classic story of "a hero's victory over the Demon King," the very tale that Fleurdelys once performed to win the Laurel. 
The world is your stage, they tell you, so relax and express yourself freely. Actions speak louder than words—now, take the stage!

Main_Linaxita_2_3_201_1: Ragunna, the tempest's jewel, the sapphire that crowns Solaris...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_201_2: The waters of Ragunna serve as a mirror, reflecting the countless faces of this city—much like our own reflections.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_201_3: The people of Ragunna possess a temperament akin to the tides, ever-changing. We like to describe ourselves as drifters of currents.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_201_4: For, to us, drifting is not a negative attribute. It speaks to opportunity, to potential. I find it quite charming, much like your name—Rover—seems to promise.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_201_5: Our founders went with the flow and discovered these islands. Centuries later, the Montellis too drifted with currents, acquiring new technologies from distant lands.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_2: Once, the Blessed Maiden was just a simple peasant girl. During the Sentinel's Gratitude Rite, the young Fleurdelys managed to sneak past the guards and drink the sacramental wine—every drop.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_3: Perhaps it was the intoxicating wine in Egla Town or simply her lack of experience with spirits, but she soon found herself quite drunk.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_4: Swaying on her feet, she ascended the ceremony's grand platform, lifted her threadbare dress, and began a rather ungainly dance.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_5: Seizing the sacred horn, she played a carefree folk tune, dodging the guards and weaving through the crowd with surprising agility.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_6: Remarkably, the crowd, as if drawn by an unseen force, followed her lead, transforming the solemn ceremony into a wild parade of cheers and revelry.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_7: Naturally, the Order was less than pleased. The Pilgrim's Sail did not yet exist, so Fleurdelys faced three days of confinement. During that time, she used her prison walls as a canvas.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_8: That unforgettable day of disordered revelry left a lasting mark on all who witnessed it.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_9: Is it not remarkable? A rebellious girl, chosen by the Sentinel to become the Blessed Maiden.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_10: If the Sentinel indeed permitted such a girl to serve as Their spokesperson, it suggests that all this joyous revelry is not something They disdain.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_204_11: Perhaps They too enjoy poetry, painting, tears, laughter, romantic tales of knights, and dancing amidst crowds—much like ourselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_5: The divine is always beyond our comprehension.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_6: Perhaps, the true intention of the Sentinel isn't to rule their people by faith.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_7: The people of this island came from diverse civilizations now lost to time, but through plays and tradition, they sought to preserve memories of their heritage.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_8: In the past, while the clash of cultures led to conflict, the Ragunnesi united through faith, restoring balance, even if precarious.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_9: To maintain this unity, we have always needed both a Sentinel and a "play" based on a shared legend that gives us roles.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_10: Yet, this play has endured for so long that we have become defined by our roles—noble, commoner, believer, merchant. What was meant to unite us now stifles us.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_13: Now, we yearn for a day when we can truly set aside our titles and positions, express our true selves, and join together in celebration...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_14: So, this is the true purpose of the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_15: Yes, born from hope and idealism, it reminds the Ragunnesi of our initial vision of equality and freedom. It also affirms our true worth.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_16: While the Order's true intentions remain unclear, we are certain their influence has already eroded the very foundations of our society.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_17: People revere the divine figure the Order has constructed, yet they also live in fear of punishment.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_18: Legends become accomplices in fostering ignorance, and faith becomes the loyal executioner of cruel punishment. An invisible cage has trapped us all...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_19: Speaking of freedom within a cage is absurd. Fear and ignorance are our foremost enemies.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_20: This year's Carnevale will spark a flame fierce enough to burn down that cage.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_22: Our future is in our own hands.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_23: I'll stoke the flames even higher.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_24: Rest well, and tomorrow, we shall take the stage together at the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_25: Good night. May your dreams be sweet.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_205_26:
After finishing her tale, Carlotta confides her deeper thoughts: "If the Sentinel indeed permitted such a girl to serve as their spokesperson, it suggests that all this joyous revelry is not something They disdain." 
The Carnevale, she says, is meant to be a celebration of people's true selves. Yet now, it has become a tool for those who use faith to control others. But Carlotta believes that this year's Carnevale can will spark a flame fierce enough to burn down that cage.
Tomorrow, you and Carlotta will take the stage at the Carnevale. Tonight, all you need to do is rest and prepare.

You and your companions defeat Phrolova and free Cetus the Tidebreaker from her control. The gloom that had shrouded the Carnevale lifts, and the crowd erupts into applause for your performance.
As daylight breaks through the clouds, a golden Laurel descends over your head, a reward as promised. The Sentinel's voice then echoes in your mind, directing you to Their location. If you wish to find Them, head to the Inverted Tower suspended in the sky, from where They watch over the world.
You notice a hint of vulnerability in the Sentinel's voice. They leave you with a final clue: a "lost" person, someone connected to Them, is currently among the people enjoying the festival.

Later, Carlotta arrives and remarks that no one else seems to notice Cartethyia. She offers to have her family members search for the girl in Ragunna, but you urge caution. Too many mysteries surrounding the Order and the Sentinel remain unsolved. Hasty moves could draw unwanted attention from the Order and disrupt the Carnevale. Carlotta invites you to the Montelli family's safe house for a celebratory dinner. You and your friends raise a glass and share a rare moment of laughter. During the gathering, Carlotta reveals that Cartethyia is actually Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden. This new information helps you piece together the clues you've uncovered.
Carlotta also shares a shocking revelation from Gilberto regarding the history recorded in the ruins: The Fisalia family actually worships the Threnodian known as the "Leviathan" from the deep sea, a belief that may date back centuries. Rinascita's Sentinel and the Threnodian are connected, and if the situation demands, the Montelli family might seek a conversation with the Fisalia family.
Meanwhile, the Montellis will keep investigating the mysterious Inverted Tower, the other clue left by the Sentinel.
Soon after, you receive an invitation from the Primus, Fenrico, to the Cathedral of Mercury.
