Main_Linaxita_2_3_86_2: Now, they advance towards the Demon King's castle, where peril await at every corner... What trials lie ahead?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_86_3: Phrolova summons a wave of Tacet Discords to block your path, but you and Carlotta manage to break through the obstacle and press on toward her location.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_87_1: No wall can deter these free spirits, even the stars seem to cheer on their bravery!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_88_1: Exercise caution. New enemies have appeared.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_88_2: The Demon King unleashes its minions, long awaiting these audacious intruders...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_88_3: Once again, Phrolova conjures a deadly swarm of Tacet Discords...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_89_1: They launch a fierce assault, intent on crushing the heroes and grinding them to dust...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_91_3: Ah! A sudden twist unbalanced the heroes, then at this crucial moment, a mysterious figure enters the fray!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_91_4: A Divinity-sent emissary? Or a spirit from the shadows perhaps?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_91_5: She seems moved by their passion and righteousness,  see her join the heroes' ranks!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_91_6: Ah, how delightful! I await your challenge with bated breath...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_91_7: It seems the Demon King anticipated the heroes' arrival and has gladly extended an invitation...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_91_8: You and Carlotta are surrounded by TDs, but Roccia arrives in time, diving headfirst into the fight to aid you.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_92_1: With unyielding determination, the heroes accept the challenge!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_92_2: The Demon King reveals itself at last, exposing its hideous visage and sharp fangs. The final showdown is nigh!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_92_3: Facing Phrolova's taunts, you stand firm and accept her challenge, ready to face the powerful Tacet Discords she has summoned.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_94_1: The Demon King summons its foul army, poised for a climactic battle with the heroes... The victor will soon be revealed.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_1: Amidst the clashing swords and the cries of the minions, the heroes face the Demon King—victory belongs to the righteous and the brave!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_2: And now, we await the Holy Maiden's return...
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_3: And so we arrive at the "happily ever after," yes?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_4: But we do not live in a fairy tale. There is no playwright to script a happy ending for us... What lies behind the curtain is but a cruel jest, a dark satire.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_5: Let me reveal the truth behind that idyllic ending. The Holy Maiden has long succumbed to darkness, drawing power from a heretical force and leading her people into depravity.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_6: And the minister, having uncovered this truth, has vowed to root out this corruption himself.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_95_7: At last, you reach Phrolova. It seems like the story should end here, but she has one last surprise. Unleashing her powers, she tears through the fabric of space itself, adding yet another twist to your tale.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_1: Ah, {PlayerName} and Lady Phoebe! I've been capturing the Carnevale's many beautiful moments! What brings you all together here?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_2: Hmm? You took this picture? Look at that composition and lighting! Who knew you had a knack for photography!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_3: Buddy, you look so happy! Whatever the reason, thanks for making this moment special!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_5: It's all thanks to {PlayerName}. {Male=He;Female=She} fulfilled C-MOSS's wish.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_6: Just like us, C-MOSS wants to savor every moment of the Carnevale and leave with no regrets.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_7: You seem excited about the Carnevale too.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_8: Why not join us in the celebration?
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_9: The Sentinel cherishes Their people, and as followers, we find joy in witnessing everyone's happiness.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_10: But we have our duties, ensuring order during the Carnevale. I'm sorry I can't join in the festivities.
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_11: I wish you a wonderful time at the Carnevale!
Main_Linaxita_2_3_96_12:
With C-MOSS's wish granted, Fulmine arrives to thank you for your kindness. Phoebe, however, is bound by her duties to the Order. She needs to maintain order at the festival and can't join you for the rest of the Carnevale. 
You can see the excitement and joy in her eyes, though. With her blessings for you in mind, you decide to help keep the Carnevale safe.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_12_1: (Hmm? There's something on top of that ruin.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_12_3: (Need to find a way up there.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_13_1: (There are Fisalia markings on these crates. What's inside?)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_13_2: (Something's being wrapped in these strange frequencies. I should clear them out first.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_2: How did it go? Any discoveries to share?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_3: You tell Cristoforo and Zani what you found out.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_4: Intriguing. Frequency corrosion, you say? So these missing Echoes appeared out of nowhere and turned hostile?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_5: This is unheard of... Echoes are the Sentinel's gift to Rinascita. They're not supposed to turn on each other, much less humans.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_6: Actually, there was a similar incident with hostile Echoes in Ragunna City recently.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_7: It was more serious, and the Echoes involved almost hurt us. That's why we're investigating.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_8: I presume the Fisalia you seek is entangled in this affair.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_11: I see... Very well. Allow me to offer you my thanks, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_12: The frequency corrosion driving the Echoes mad has been resolved, but we must still caution villagers and their Echoes. They should exercise vigilance and avoid perilous areas.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_13: Cristoforo leaves in a hurry. It looks like he's on his way to warn the nearby villagers and Echoes.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_14: Looks like we're dealing with a repeat of the rehearsal incident here… But if Gilberto was behind this, how did he pull it off?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_15: The petals might have the answers.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_16: Petals? They give off a... strange feeling.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_17: Any ideas of what it might be, Abby?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_18: Alright. Let's give it a try. Huh, tastes kinda weird.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_19: It's not an Echo, or a Tacet Discord… The frequency's coming from a Resonator. A super strong one!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_20: ...Strange. Gilberto's a Resonator, but he doesn't seem… particularly strong.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_22: Yes. Be it the mastermind or another pawn, it's got the Fisalia family written all over it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_23: They staged the accident, endangering civilians, and then used it to frame the Montellis.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_24: What a story. This is definitely headline material. Just think of the leverage the Montelli family could get with this scandal...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_25: Hey, {PlayerName}. Look, over there! That person looks kinda familiar.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_26: It's Phoebe! What's she doing here with all those Echoes?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_28:
Upon reaching the area where Echoes have gone missing, you're attacked by out-of-control Echoes. After quelling them, you notice that they seem to be manipulated, just like the Vitreum Dancers in Ragunna. 
Bidding Cristoforo farewell, you press on and encounter another familiar face—Acolyte Phoebe.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_1510_1: No bosses, no colleagues, no reports... What a good life.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_1511_1: These Echoes are keen to find their friends too. They're not fighters, but they can surely be your guide. Why not take them along?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_1512_1: After we hand Gilberto over to the family, we'll meet up with you as soon as possible.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_1512_2: Please be extra careful, {PlayerName}! May the Sentinel protect you!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_152_1: You can take a Gondola in the harbor, but please be careful.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_1: Livia, Brenno! Any sign of Beppe?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_3: Oh... Cut it out, Brenno! Stop that...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_4: Wait, Brenno's right here. Then who's poking me in the back? Beppe, you better have a good expla—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_8: Hic...! Lame. I was just trynna have some fun with her.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_10: I thought you were at Ragunna City. Didn't expect to meet you here. Oh, uhh... Sorry, I don't think we've met.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_11: Greetings, madam. My name is Zani. Averardo Bank.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_12: I don't think we've met before.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_13: Well... It's probably because I haven't been to church much... Ahem. Please don't stare at me like that. There are more pressing matters.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_14: We're investigating the Echo incident from the Carnevale rehearsal at Whisperwind Haven, as requested by the Montelli family. One of our clues led us here.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_15: The Echo incident... Yes, I've also heard of it. I even heard you were caught right in the middle of it, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_16: Please accept my apologies on behalf of the Order.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_17: It's okay. I didn't get hurt.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_18: By the way, have any of you seen an Echo named Beppe? They're about this tall and usually wander around here, but I can't seem to find them anywhere...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_20: Sorry, we didn't see the Echo you mentioned, but we've found clues on their odd behavior. They all point to a member of the Fisalia family, Gilberto.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_21: He's also caused similar incidents here recently... Echoes went out of control and attacked each other.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_22: The Order has also received reports of missing Echoes in this area. Is it possible that the Fisalia family is involved? I find it really hard to believe.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_23: From what I know, the Fisalia family is deeply respectful of the Divinity. How could they commit such a blasphemous act? The Echoes are gifts from the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_25: A petal? The ritual one? No, wait... this frequency...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_26: Oh, right! I think I saw this flower in the Cathedral of Mercury, and Priest Alessio was wearing it. Wait... Could he be involved with the Fisalia family's plans?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_28: No, we're still lacking key evidence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_29: Imperator granted us Echoes, the skies, lands, oceans, and sustenance. To which we should all be grateful and reverent.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_30: I request to join your investigation, {PlayerName}. As a servant of the Sentinel, I simply cannot turn a blind eye to their unholy acts.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_32: Fine by me. With someone from the Order as a neutral witness, the Fisalias won't be able to accuse us of fabricating evidence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_33: As long as I'm not treated like a heretic and get kicked out of Rinascita later.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_34: I'm okay with it as well.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_35: Great, it seems we've reached an agreement.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_36: Beppe? Thank the Divinity, you're safe! But what happened to you?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_38: Sorry, I got a bit carried away. Echoes don't usually act like this… Something must have startled them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_39: Something feels off. We should go check it out, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_16_40:
Phoebe reveals that she's searching for a missing Echo. You share your findings, and she realizes Gilberto's actions are blasphemy against the Sentinel, which calls for a punishment. With shared goals, Phoebe joins your team. 
Suddenly, the missing Echo appears, fleeing as if being pursued. You decide to catch up to uncover what's behind its panic.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_1: You're saying the Fisalia family was involved in the incident at the Carnevale rehearsal? Do you have solid evidence?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_2: Not yet, Mr. Alberto. But the clues we found all lead to Fisalia family member, Gilberto. We will investigate further.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_3: The Fisalia family... It seems they've run out of patience. This mess has got our honored guest into trouble and given these rats a chance to make their move.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_4: Please pass on my thanks to our guest for the help. If you find yourselves short of hands or funds, do let me know. I'll be discussing this matter with Director Pacino.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_5: I will, sir. There's also another sensitive matter. It appears a Priest from the Cathedral of Mercury is involved, so it's highly possible that the Order is aware of this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_6: The Order... Let me handle them. You just focus on Gilberto for now. Whatever the case, the Carnevale must be secured.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_7: This goes beyond the Montelli family. It's also about the faith and hope of countless Ragunnesi.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_11: It's from Mr. Alberto. He's the head of Averardo Bank. My superior.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_12: Not really. It's from Mr. Alberto. He's the head of Averardo Bank. My superior.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_13: But this doesn't sound like him. He's usually cautious and rarely makes outright promises unless one of the big shots in the family is twisting his arm.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_14: If the top brass are alarmed, it can only mean that the situation may be...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_17: Hmm, maybe I'm overthinking this. Either way, we've finally got a lead.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_18: We should search the area. See where Gilberto went.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_19:
To your surprise, the Order's "confessional" turns out to be a freight elevator. 
After leaving it behind, you arrive at Whisperwind Haven and meet Zani. Together, you set off to trace Gilberto.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_1: Excellent. Everything is in place. Now, all we need is Her Majesty's approval.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_2: O great Imperator. May you raise the tides, deliver your edict to our Queen, and let the clouds cover Ragunna, cleansing it of the wickedness left by the pleasure-seekers of this city of transgression.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_3: Is he praying? I know the Fisalias are extremely devout, but who is this "Queen" he mentioned?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_4: This prayer sounds... odd. It's definitely not from the Order's Codex.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_5: O Divinity in the Abyss, Lord of Tides and Riddles, may you soon be freed. Let all lies melt away under your power. May you grant me strength to overcome all who oppose you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_8: Uh-oh, things just went south. Looks like we've got a fight on our hands.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_9: You must be that outlander, right? The news of your arrival is all over Ragunna...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_10: Since you're here, I guess you've uncovered quite a bit... Though it's insignificant compared to the truth beneath the tides.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_11: As a gesture of goodwill, let me offer a word of advice: Curiosity won't lead you to the truth you seek, but rather closer to—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_13: He just turned Echoes into Tacet Discords. Is it the petals?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_14: You... What have you done to those Echoes!?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_15: Merely the neccessary sacrifices for our one true Divinity.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_20_16:
You finally pin down Gilberto, who is reciting eerie prayers. 
On seeing you, he transforms the nearby Echoes into Tacet Discords with a Lycoris flower. A fierce battle ensues.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_2: How pathetic. You're nothing but a discarded pawn.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_3: ...Which is not unusual with the Fisalia family.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_4: Mr. Gilberto, please explain this "Lord of Tides and Riddles" you mentioned.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_5: I appreciate your passion for the Order, Miss Phoebe, but now is not the time. We need to uncover the real culprit behind the Fisalias.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_7: Do you really think you've won? No, it's already too late... Haha...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_8: I might just be a pawn, insignificant and small, but while you're focusing on me, you've missed something far more important.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_9: He shows no remorse for his crimes. I'll contact Mr. Alberto and have the family send someone to take over.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_10: What? That's the... The Nimbus Sanctum.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_12: These Echoes... are converging towards the sea of clouds. What's happening?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_13: Ha. Muahahaha! Magnificent! Lorelei is now ours for the taking... Just as the prophecy foretold! All shall be cleansed!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_14: Now, let us wait in patience as the sea of clouds descends to engulf that corrupted city. Only the faithful will rise anew from the tides!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_16: According to the Codex, Lorelei is a powerful Remnant creature residing in the Atrium of Reflections at the center of the Nimbus Sanctum.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_17: Legends say the sea of clouds once flooded the Seminary of the Forgotten, reducing it to ruins, before spreading to Ragunna. It was Lorelei who curbed the raging clouds and ended the crisis.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_18: If... if they've really done something to Lorelei, then Mr. Gilberto wasn't just bluffing. The clouds might truly engulf Ragunna, leading to a disaster beyond our imagination.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_19: They are all mad... So this is what they've been planning all along.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_21: You two go ahead. I'll stay here and watch him until the family arrives, just in case he gets any bright ideas.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_22: I'll stay with you. After all, this could provoke outcry from the Fisalia family. If I testify about Gilberto's misdeeds on behalf of the Order, they can't deny the facts or exploit the situation.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_23: I agree. But what about you, {PlayerName}...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_25: Don't worry. I can take care of myself!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_26: All right. There's a port nearby where you can catch a Gondola. It can take you close to the Atrium of Reflections.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_27: After we hand Gilberto over to the family, we'll meet up with you as soon as possible.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_28: Please be extra careful, {PlayerName}! May the Sentinel protect you!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_29:
Despite his defeat, Gilberto continues to preach a dark prophecy: Lorelei will command the sea of clouds to engulf Ragunna, sparing only the faithful. Meanwhile, an anomaly at the Nimbus Sanctum suggests Lorelei might also be influenced by a Lycoris. 
Zani and Phoebe stay behind to watch over Gilberto until the Montelli members arrive. You head to the sea of clouds alone.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_23_1: Welcome, traveler. I am the harbormaster. Where do you wish to go?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_23_3: You intend to navigate the sea of clouds? Surely you've noticed today's weather… I'm afraid it's far from ideal for sailing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_23_4: Is this kind of weather unusual?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_23_5: Yeah, we've seen storms before, but nothing like this. I wonder what's causing it. I suggest you sit it out before departing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_23_8: I see. If that's the case, you can take the Gondola in the harbor, but please be careful.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_23_9:
Upon reaching the port near the sea of clouds, you prepare to board a boat to the Atrium of Reflections, but the port's services are suspended due to the anomaly. Fortunately, the harbormaster lets you take a Gondola yourself.
With no other options, you search the port for an available Gondola.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_1: Aha. Perfect… There's still a Gondola here. I believe your name is… Noah, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_3: It seems fate has brought us together once more. Don't you agree? Kind {Male=sir;Female=lady}.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_5: It seems you do remember me. That's right. We crossed paths at Madame Nyarla's mask shop.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_6: Truth be told, I need to catch the final train in the Nimbus Sanctum today. However, this lone Gondola is all the harbor offers.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_7: So… since we share the same destination, would you mind also sharing this Gondola with me?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_11: Well, then. Without further ado, let's be on our way.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_12:
While searching for an available Gondola, you encounter the noble lady you once met at the Masked Reverie.
She asks to travel with you to catch the train in the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_1: This song... where is it coming from?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_2: That's Lorelei's song, guiding ships through the mist.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_3: But her singing sounds a bit different today. There are hints of... sorrow and agony...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_4: Perhaps it's merely my fancy. Regardless, her melody will guide us through fog and storm to the heart of the Nimbus Sanctum.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_1: The cloud continues to spread. You may be right. This could be Imperator's test, but we must leave.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_2: Do as you please! I'm not leaving. The relic of the Ancient One is here somewhere. I must...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_3: How intriguing. These seem to be Reverberations hidden in the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_4: Perhaps you've heard that this was once the Order's seminary. It appears that even after the clouds consumed it, the Reverberations of its members linger on.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_5: Maybe the anomalies in the sea of clouds are stirring them to life once more.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_6: You seem very knowledgeable about all this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_7: Why yes, I've long been fascinated by Ragunna's history and art. After all, to chart our future, we must first understand our past. Is that not true?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_28_8: We're likely to encounter more Reverberations on our way. They may even contain vital information. You can search for more if you're curious.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_1: It seems we have some time before the train arrives. How about a little chat to pass the time?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_3: Well, then. Where shall we begin?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_4: "The city, an abomination of chaos, claims its first death at birth. Its mortality has become our sustenance, like a whale that slowly sinks into the abyss."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_5: This comment on Ragunna comes from Rosselli, a painter from the past. Tragically, he died in poverty, his work overlooked. Now, ironically, even a mere sketch of his commands over a million Credits.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_6: Now. What is your impression of Ragunna so far?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_8: A profit-driven place full of corruption.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_11: Passionate... Indeed. Passion is a quality the Ragunnesi possess in abundance. It's also why the Carnevale is so eagerly anticipated.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_12: Indeed. Ragunna is not as glamorous as it seems. Beneath the veneer of prosperity, avarice reigns supreme.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_13: Indeed, faith is Ragunna's crown jewel. Our devotion to the Sentinel stands unrivaled throughout Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_14: A most prudent response. Perhaps you're still acquainting yourself with Ragunna, or you simply prefer discretion. Either way, I take no offense.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_15: Ragunna has many facets. Most people only see one side of it, but for me—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_16: It's like two sworn enemies are forcibly bound together. That's Ragunna—a city where tradition and innovation, openness and isolation, ceaselessly wrestle for dominance.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_17: That is why the Montelli and Fisalia families are in a constant clash, as you may have seen.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_18: The Montellis champion innovation, staking all on the Carnevale. Meanwhile, the Fisalias cling to tradition, colluding with the shadows that lurk in Ragunna's depths.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_19: Fortunately, this long struggle behind the curtains will soon come to an end. Not because of the two families, but because of you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_21: Yes, you. The Fated One. Perhaps you're not merely entangled in Ragunna's conflict, but are, in fact, the very eye of the storm. The city's fate may well rest upon your shoulders.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_24: You may have not noticed it yet, but we are... and have been in the same boat for a long time.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_25: Ah. There's the train. It's time to say goodbye now.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_27: I'll tell you next time. As for now, let's keep it a mystery.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_28: Until we meet again, Fated One. May you find your own path in Ragunna.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_29:
You arrive at the Echo train station and wait for its arrival. 
During the wait, the noble lady shares her thoughts on Ragunna City, the Montelli and Fisalia families... and you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_33_1: After the mysterious lady departs, Zani and Phoebe arrive on a Gondola. Together, you set off toward where Lorelei resides.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_1: So this is what's become of the seminary? I never expected this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_3: No, but I've seen paintings of the seminary in the Cathedral. It had an enormous dome and spires that seemed to touch the heavens.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_4: Then the Order was forced to abandon it when the sea of clouds swallowed it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_39_8: You reunite with Zani and Phoebe at the Atrium of Reflections。
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_1: Have you also come to repent and seek forgiveness?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_2: The Sentinel has revealed a path to resist temptation and corruption. We need only devote ourselves wholly... to Lorelei.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_3: We're just here to see Lorelei.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_4: Patience. I see your eagerness for enlightenment, like our new brothers. You've removed your masks, but your hearts… they're still veiled.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_5: Everyone here wears a mask. Everyone in Ragunna. Without exception, never unmasked. This is the source of our suffering. The mask veils our hearts.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_6: Like our new brothers, they wear peculiar masks of madness. Poor souls tormented by evil desires. May they find peace in Lorelei's embrace.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_9: Yes, their masks are filled with madness, but even wrongdoers can seek redemption from Lorelei. The Sentinel granted Lorelei this authority, and no one can take it away.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_10: Follow Lorelei's song and your heart, and you may meet our lady. But if your transgressions are... beyond redemption, you'll be lost in the sea of clouds forever.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_11: So what should we do to see Lorelei?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_12: Do you seek an audience with Lorelei? Sadly, you've come at a bad time. Lorelei is furious, and our mortal bodies can't withstand her wrath. We've sealed the path to her domain.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_13: We appreciate the explanation, but we believe Lorelei is in danger... We're here to help her. Someone's planning to exploit her powers...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_14: The path has been closed. You must leave.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_15: (Sigh) Doesn't look like we'll be talking our way past him. Let's find another way, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_40_16: At the Atrium of Reflections, a masked believer tells you that the path to Lorelei's domain is sealed. Unable to reason with them, you begin investigating the place to find an alternative way forward.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_1: Oh. I have been cleansed of impure thoughts. I can finally escape from my wrongdoings.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_2: Sing, dance! For we have been granted peace and freedom!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_3: Yes, we only need to relish this moment!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_5: Oh! You've also come to rid yourself of your misdeeds? Then join us! Sing! Sing with us!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_6: The door has been shut. Simply sing along and it will open before you!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_41_7: (Just "Sing"? Doesn't look like we'll get more out of them. Let's go check somewhere else.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_1: But most of these are worn out and don't look like modern Rinascita script. Phoebe, can you read any of it?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_2: Let's see... This seems like an ancient holy script dedicated to recording the deeds of Sentinel Imperator. As for its content...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_3: "I shall grant this power to... the Night... Queen. May she... during the day... sea of clouds..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_4: Ugh. Much of this text is illegible. However, the adjacent drawing is mostly intact. It shows Sentinel Imperator speaking to a massive creature.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_5: And the creature slowly shifts from an immense, amorphous form into a humanoid shape.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_6: Could it be Lorelei? After all, no other being that large lives above the sea of clouds....
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_7: Actually, I'm not sure if the other figure is the Sentinel. It looks a little different from the Cathedral statues. Maybe it's just the lack of clarity in the drawing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_8: Anyway, does it mean... Lorelei and the Sentinel are somehow connected to each other?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_9: Nothing about the barrier though. Are there any other clues?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_42_10: These inscriptions and markings on the stela seem to say something.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_43_1: A veil of mist shrouds the Atrium, radiating an aura of resistance. This must be the entrance that the believers refer to as "the path to audience."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_43_3: Small words are carved beside it: "We mourn the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_43_4: Is this some kind of hint?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_4: This is Misteltein. One of the missing Echoes. They probably followed the singing.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_5: Misteltein, do you know how to remove the barrier?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_6: Now how would an Echo know that, Phoebe—
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_8: They say that we just need to sing a specific song.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_10: Y-You can understand what it's saying?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_44_11: A specific song, huh? That's a direct lead. But which one?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_1: I guess "singing" is our only option for clearing that barrier.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_3: The stela we saw mentioned the Sentinel, and we're in the ruins of the seminary.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_4: Meaning it should be a "chorale"? There are also the inscription in front of the barrier: "We mourn the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_5: Any chorales you know ring a bell, Phoebe?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_6: The martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden... Could this be the "Aria of the Blessed Maiden"? It's a chorale rarely used these days. I doubt most Priests even know of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_8: The Blessed Maiden? We met a playwright named Cristoforo earlier. He shared some stories about her.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_9: Phoebe, if you know this chorale, why not give it a try? It might just clear the barrier.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_11: O-okay then. I suppose it's our best option at the moment. I'll give it a try. Ahem...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_12:
Through investigation, you realize that the key to unsealing Lorelei's domain is a "chorale." 
With encouragement from you and Zani, Phoebe gathers the courage and sings the melody. The song unlocks the sealed passage before you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_1: A song of false nature. Masking... A twisted view... Tear it to shreds...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_2: Did you get the chorale wrong?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_3: I'm sure I sang the "Aria of the Blessed Maiden"...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_47_4: Not good... She doesn't seem too pleased with that one.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_1: That flower... looks like the petals we found in Whisperwind Haven.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_6: It's the Fractsidus. I've dealt with them before, and I've seen a flower just like this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_7: How long have I been in slumber... This nightmare... How long was I trapped in it?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_8: Are you also part of the dream?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_9: No, we are not... Might you be Lorelei?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_10: I am. Travelers from afar, I sense… the kindness pulsing in your hearts. You must be the ones who broke the chains of my nightmare.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_11: The oathbreakers, hiding behind their Masks of Madness… They tainted the Nimbus Sanctum with corrupted blooms, drowning me in rage and sorrow. Endless nightmares became my prison.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_12: Masks of Madness... I recall those people at the entrance of the Atrium mentioned it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_13: Had you not freed me from my nightmare, I would never be able to fulfill the Sentinel's task… The tides of the Nimbus Sanctum would have engulfed the whole of Ragunna, just as they once claimed the sacred temple now lying in ruins beneath you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_14: Wait. The Sentinel? Does that mean...?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_15: Yes, the Sentinel molded me from a mindless being to the form you see, and bestowed upon me the most precious gift... A soul.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_16: They commanded me to restrain the clouds and prevent the Remnant Energy within it from... dissipating.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_17: Can you contact Imperator? I need to meet with the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_18: Unfortunately, it lies beyond my power. The Sentinel's link to the mortal realm is severed. Only through collective prayer, and a rite, at the height of the Carnevale, only then can mortals briefly commune with Them.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_19: A rite... You mean the Carnevale?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_20: No, that's impossible! The current Primus, Fenrico the Enlightened One, was given a direct oracle from the Sentinel. The Sentinel has always been with the people!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_21: I'm afraid the Sentinel's current state... transcends mortal understanding. Your Primus is no exception.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_22: Should doubt linger in your mind, I implore you to await the rite's completion. The Sentinel will surely answer the people's call—not your so-called… Enlightened One.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_23: One last thing. Those oathbreakers wearing Masks of Madness you mentioned, do you know who they are?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_24: All that I know is that they are not from Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_25: In the whispers between dreams, I heard them speak of their leader, a woman they called…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_28: It is time I return to my slumber. Their wicked acts have scarred the sea of clouds, and I must mend it… within my dreams.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_29: The song shall guide you out of this domain. Farewell, visitors.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_30:
You defeat the "Queen of the Night," Lorelei's corrupted form under the Lycoris's influence, and restore her to her true self. Besides, you also find the Vitreum Dancer that fled away, but it is damaged while protecting you. Zani keeps it in the Montelli's Terminal.
Lorelei, a remnant creature enlightened by the Sentinel, reveals a shocking truth: the current Primus of the Order is not the legendary <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>. The Sentinel's link to the mortal world has been severed, and only the Laureate of the Carnevale gets a chance to communicate with Them. 
Lorelei also discloses the identity of the one causing Echoes to lose control—the Conductor.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_1: What a wild turn this job's taken… Seeing the legendary Lorelei up close? Almost makes it worth the trouble.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_3: Hmm? Are you all right, Phoebe?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_4: Huh? I-I'm fine. I'm just… processing Lorelei's words. Forgive me, I… I need a moment to reflect.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_5: In any case, we managed to stop their plot in time and found the missing Vitreum Dancer.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_6: Speaking of that Vitreum Dancer… What brought it here? Lorelei's song, or maybe the Sentinel's guidance?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_9: But those wearing the Masks of Madness... The Fractsidus, right? I'm curious about their role in all this. I think they supplied Gilberto with the flowers to turn Echoes into Tacet Discords.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_10: Yeah, the Fractsidus is behind this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_11: Their actions remind me of something...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_14: You're right... Those snakes lurked in the shadows, using Gilberto as their fall guy. We can't expose them just by ourselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_15: Oh, another thing. Since the Fractsidus is conspiring with the Fisalias, that makes them an enemy of the Montelli family.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_16: There happens to be an auction at Averardo Vault today. The top members of the family will be there.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_17: We should tip off the family about the Fractsidus' scheme. The Montellis can't afford to ignore this threat.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_20: I intend to return to the Order first. While I believe Lorelei is truthful, I can't imagine the Primus would deceive our people. He is, after all, the <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_21: According to Lorelei, the Sentinel will deliver an oracle during the Carnevale. That's when the truth will come to light.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_22: Speaking of which, are all Primuses called the <ano=Sentinel's Resonator>Enlightened One</ano>?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_23: No, only Lord Fenrico has ever directly communicated with the Sentinel. Previous Primuses were merely indirect representatives, not the Enlightened One...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_24: Silence and composure are gifts from the great Imperator. I'll keep today's events between us, locked away in my heart.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_25: Then I believe this is where we part ways.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_26: The Codex reminds us, "It is not the lighthouse that guides us through the storm to safety, but our own eyes fixed on the shore."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_27: I'd like to offer these words to you—may your eyes always shine bright with clarity.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_28:
Shaken by Lorelei's revelations, Phoebe decides to return to the Order to seek answers and bids farewell to you.
With Lorelei's information, you are certain that Fractsidus is behind the chaos among Echoes.
You and Zani head to Averardo Vault, the heart of the Montelli family, to seek allies and repair the damaged Vitreum Dancer Echo.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_1: Strange, did Gilberto just vanish into thin air?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_2: I see. A <ano=Flying Echo>Wingray</ano>, that explains it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_4: Yes, it's a type of Echo that can fly. People in Ragunna often use them to travel quickly between locations.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_5: If Gilberto set up this Wingray as an escape route, it should lead us straight to him.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_6: Let's use the Grapple to hitch a ride on the Wingray.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_5_7:
Gilberto's traces end here. Zani speculates that he must have left using a <ano=Flying Echo>Wingray</ano>.
It seems Gilberto never anticipated that you two could also follow his lead and take the Wingray to where he was heading.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_6_2: Welcome to Whisperwind Haven—known for its iconic windmills and flower fields. Legend has it, this was once the home of the Blessed Maiden.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_6_3: Some people are over there. Let's check if they know anything.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_1: Lo! Foul monsters, taste my steel!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_2: "The Blessed Maiden smote the fiends who dared ascend the hallowed stairs. Yet the Dark Tide surged on, as more monsters poured forth from the mist."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_3: "In this fateful moment, the Blessed Maiden beheld her destiny's end. Moved by the Divinity, she chose to yield her life, for the Sentinel's cause and Rinascita's people."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_5: Wait, wait. Your tone sounds a bit off. The Blessed Maiden should be more determined.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_7: "In Imperator's name! Vile monsters! I swear your behinds shall be met with the end of my boots!"
Main_Linaxita_2_2_7_8: I meant determined, not angry... You've got it all wrong!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_1: Ah we meet again, valiant champion of the foreign land.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_2: Our paths intertwine once more. Ha, a result of Imperator's divine intervention, don't you agree?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_3: Hmm, pardon me, but this lady by your side seems rather familiar...?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_4: I am Zani. I work at Averardo Bank.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_5: Ah, yes. You look quite chivalrous, if I may say so. Yet with your weary face, I'm afraid I can only dub you the "Sorrowful Knight."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_6: That's quite fitting. Do I thank you for that?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_7: Ahh, no need for the formalities. Allow me to re-introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a humble playwright grappling with modern trends. Delighted to meet you.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_9: Actually, I've been working on a script about the Blessed Maiden lately. The well-known Martyred Maiden, Fleurdelys.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_10: Her brave sacrifice during the Dark Tide saved Ragunna many years ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_11: That sacred maiden perished just as the curtain fell, lying in the center of the sanctuary where spotlights converged. I've longed to capture that tragic scene in a play.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_12: The script's nearly finished, but something's amiss. With Fleurdelys' home right here before me, I had hoped to find traces of the Blessed Maiden's early life.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_13: Childhood plays a key role in shaping one's personality, you know.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_15: Sadly, no, I confess I've made zero progress. Most legends of the Blessed Maiden are lost to time. I'm forced to rely on imagination…
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_16: Ahem, nevertheless, the script is finished. I've even asked the children over there to help me rehearse it.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_17: Here, have a copy. I'm eager for your thoughts.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_19: I'll take a look when I have time.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_21: Ah, apologies. I started rambling about my play again. Well, then. What brings you here?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_22: We're looking for someone. Did you come across anyone from the Fisalia family?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_23: The Fisalias… Come to think of it, I had noticed a nobly dressed gentleman around here recently... Yes, he bore their crest.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_24: In fact, I even stared a bit. Old habits die hard. The Fisalias rarely venture beyond city walls, you see.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_25: So Gilberto did pass through here... Thank you for the information, sir.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_26: Speaking of that man... Word from the local villagers is that odd occurrences have plagued the area since his arrival.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_28: You've likely noticed the abundance of Echoes here in Whisperwind Haven. One might say it's more their village than ours.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_29: But since that nobleman's arrival, Echoes in the area have been vanishing without a trace.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_30: Like time lost forever, books forgotten by people, and cherished memories faded away in time's current... Oh, pardon me. My playwright's pen is running away again.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_33: Hmm. Echoes started acting strangely when Gilberto showed up, just like what happened in the Carnevale rehearsal... This is no coincidence.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_34: Mr. Cristoforo, do you know where those Echoes were last seen before they disappeared?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_35: I'm in the dark as well. However, they might know a thing or two.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_36: These Echoes are keen to find their friends too. They're not fighters, but they can surely be your guide. Why not take them along?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_37:
You run into Cristoforo, the mysterious playwright, again. He's on a journey for inspiration to finish his script about the Blessed Maiden, "Fleurdelys." 
As for Gilberto, he tells you that a Fisalia member has been frequenting Whisperwind Haven, and Echoes have been mysteriously vanishing. 
Suspecting a connection, you follow the Echoes to investigate further.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_88_1:
Soft twilight hushes the day,
Moonlight dances, shadows sway.
Tranquil whispers fill the night,
Slumber's veil falls in quiet.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_88_2:
Twinkling stars, a celestial choir,
Sing softly to realms ever higher.
O Fair Lorelei, let your sorrow fade away,
May the good night forever stay.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_88_3:
Before the darkness falls, come sail with me,
Find haven in my boat upon the sea.

Main_Linaxita_2_2_89_2: (Looks like someone's pulling their strings, just like at the rehearsal.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_89_3: (Need to find a way to stop them first.)
Main_Linaxita_2_2_133_3: At the site, you're forced to subdue the rampaging Echo guards by force.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_134_1: Apparently, the Order believes the images on the stained glass to be real.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_134_2: They wouldn't even hesitate to break their façade of neutrality, just to ensure we don't take the secrets out alive.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_136_1: This seems to depict the people of Rinascita torn into two warring factions.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_137_1: This one shows a man in Primus attire, wielding a lantern-shaped relic to dispel shadows and the monsters within.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_138_2: The last one seems to depict the moment a girl communes with the Divinity of Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_144_1: The frequencies of these pieces have been reconstructed.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_144_2: Now we only need to assemble them onto the stained glass. The last step to the secrets.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_147_1: Teacher, the Seminary will soon be engulfed. What should we do?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_147_2: We have to leave… but we can't go without the relic. We can't let it be lost to the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_147_3: The Seminary is but stone and tile. It can always be rebuilt. My days are numbered, but until my last breath, I will protect the sage's relic, no matter the cost.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_148_3: Curse those monsters... curse the Dark Tide...
Main_Linaxita_2_2_148_4: I... will carry on... Teacher's wish... to the very end.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_149_1: The explorers have retrieved a sword from the sea of clouds, along with the remains of an Acolyte, likely one lost to the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_149_2: The sword appears to be an artifact passed down by our sages. Judging by its form, it seems crafted not for combat but for Carnevale rituals.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_149_3: I suspect it may have once belonged to a Primus. Regrettably, all records of this sword were lost to the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_150_1: In honor of the Acolyte who once safeguarded this relic, we've decided to place it in a small chapel untouched by the sea of clouds.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_150_2: The chapel stands beneath the cliffside, near the remnants of the broken bridge. It should be easy to find.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_150_3: We've stored the relic in the bell tower, with the hope that future pilgrims will remember and honor its presence here.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_153_1: Please proceed to the main entrance. A staff member will greet you there.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_156_1: Everyone move! Follow the Averardo Vault Emergency Response Plan!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_157_1: Prioritize the clients' safety! Stay calm and be professional!
Main_Linaxita_2_2_158_1: You have bigger things to worry about. Just let me handle this.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_159_1: This seems to depict the people of Rinascita torn into two warring factions.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_160_1: This one shows a man in Primus attire, wielding a lantern-shaped relic to dispel shadows and the monsters within.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_161_1: This one seems to depict the moment a girl communes with the Divinity of Rinascita.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_1: An ancient stone tablet worn by the passage of time. It bears inscriptions in the ancient Rinascita language, faintly legible. A prophecy, perhaps.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_2: "Once whole... the Divinity was rent by warring creeds..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_3: "From Their holy wounds... sprang the curse of Dark Tide..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_4: "Though the woes of Rinascita yet endure... the shattered Divinity hath chosen Their herald..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_5: "On the grandest of days... the maiden, crowned with golden laurel... shall commune with the Divinity..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_6: "Thus she becomes the prophesied 'Enlightened One'... through whom Rinascita's woes shall end..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_7: "Then... the Divinity shall return to its true form..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_162_8: "and Rinascita, under its glory... shall be a paradise free of suffering..."
Main_Linaxita_2_2_50_1: It's the same Echo boat we were on earlier... Was it also attracted by Lorelei's singing?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_50_4: Noah... Well, I can't understand what it's saying, but it's a perfect timing. We can have it take us to Averardo Vault.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_51_1: That's a really big waterfall... Is there no way up?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_51_3: Whoa, really? You can take us upstream?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_52_1: Another waterfall. You sure about this, Noah?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_53_1: Averardo Vault is just up ahead. It seems this is where we part ways, Noah.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_53_3: I'm sure it can find its way back to the harbor. Don't worry. Now, we just need to follow this path to reach the vault. Let's go.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_1: Welcome to Averardo Vault. Do you have an appointment?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_2: My name is Zani. I'm an employee of the bank. Here's my ID.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_4: Ah, this invitation… My apologies. Welcome to Averardo Vault. How may we assist you today?
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_5: We're not here on business. We've come to brief the family on the Echo incident from the recent Carnevale rehearsal.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_6: I'll arrange that immediately. Please proceed to the main entrance. A staff member will greet you there.
Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_1: These Echoes... Are they guarding the vault?

POI_JINKU_9_11: Check the log file with your clearance... There it is, it was taken by "Ash." The name rings a bell...
POI_JINKU_9_12: Yes, the Employee Manual mentions an old employee named Ash who designed most of the vault's security features. But he passed away.
POI_JINKU_9_13: This is only speculation, but what if this "Ash" stole from the vault and took the security module? That would explain why a complete lockdown was triggered.
POI_JINKU_9_14: What's a hidden security module? Is it like a key?
POI_JINKU_9_15: Pretty much. It's the monitoring core that powers this entire depository. If we don't get it back, we'll be stuck here for good.
POI_JINKU_9_16: A vault employee could easily access the module, but nobody would dare steal it. Everyone knows that'll trigger a lockdown of the entire vault.
POI_JINKU_9_17: But what if that's exactly what they want?
POI_JINKU_9_18: Think about it. There's no one in the vault except for us, and all comms are blocked. It's the perfect opportunity for a thief.
POI_JINKU_9_19: Don't tell me they're searching for... Never mind, we need to catch this rat before they cause us more trouble.
POI_JINKU_9_20: It seems this "Ash" also had access to the control room. Could it be... that old woman?
POI_JINKU_9_22: After reviewing all the surveillance footage, you discover that a person named "Ash" might have taken the vault's security module. You'll need to find Ash to leave.
POI_JINKU_90_1: Why are we getting a day off all of a sudden? What about the meeting today?
POI_JINKU_91_1: Woohoo! A day off! I heard Margherita's just put out something new on their menu. Perfect timing!
POI_JINKU_91_2: Great idea. And since we're getting off this early, there won't be a line, right?
POI_JINKU_92_1: Right, I do have some time off now, but there won't be an extension for the deadline, which means I'll have to take the rest of my work home. So...
POI_JINKU_93_1: So... we don't have to work anymore?
POI_JINKU_94_1: Initiating self-diagnosis... Self-diagnosis canceled by default...

Event_HXMC_1_1: Sails of the departed drift on and on, souls above the clouds, hearts claimed by the sea...
Event_HXMC_1_3: Is that one of your new songs?
Event_HXMC_1_4: It is... this one came from a rather unusual experience.
Event_HXMC_1_5: Tell me, {PlayerName}. What do you think of the sea?
Event_HXMC_1_9: Someone once said the sea is a city of the dead. You can hear the endless cries of the wind and waves, but never the voice of anything living.
Event_HXMC_1_10: When you spend days, weeks, maybe even years adrift, loneliness creeps in and twists despair into something monstrous. And yet, when you see a flicker of light out there—something you dare call "hope"…
Event_HXMC_1_11: That's when people stop thinking straight.
Event_HXMC_1_12: Is this from someone from the Fool's Troupe?
Event_HXMC_1_13: No, it was someone who's long gone now.
Event_HXMC_1_14: He died ten years ago in a shipwreck. I wasn't there to see it happen, and his face has almost faded from my memory. But...
Event_HXMC_1_16: On my last voyage, I saw him. He was on another ship. A lively one if I might add. I could hear the laughter and clink of glasses.
Event_HXMC_1_17: Hold on. Didn't you just say it's rare to see anything living on the sea?
Event_HXMC_1_18: Exactly. That's what makes it unusual. When I saw him, he looked just as he was all those years ago, not a single day older. And in that moment, everything I'd forgotten about him came rushing back.
Event_HXMC_1_19: Are you saying… he might still be alive?
Event_HXMC_1_20: Surviving ten years on the sea, without even a scratch? What do you think, {PlayerName}? How likely is that?
Event_HXMC_1_22: Almost impossible, right? My thoughts exactly.
Event_HXMC_1_23: Yet when the light of "hope" is right in front of you, you can't help but chase after it. No matter how violent the waves or impossible the odds, you have to see it for yourself.
Event_HXMC_1_24: Sadly, when we got closer, Battier and Brant reported back the waters were teeming with Tacet Discords.
Event_HXMC_1_25: If another ship were to stumble across that area…
Event_HXMC_1_26: It would end badly. No doubt about it.
Event_HXMC_1_27: That's why I need your help, {PlayerName}.
Event_HXMC_1_28: I'll admit, this seems more of a personal request from my side. But when you're out there dealing with those Tacet Discords or trying to find the man, regardless of the results your safety comes above all else.
Event_HXMC_1_29: What does this man look like?
Event_HXMC_1_30: He had the same blue hair and eyes as me. He used to call it the color of the sea, a blessing from the ocean itself.
Event_HXMC_1_31: After he died, I stopped believing in nonsense like these. Most sailors still prefer to hold onto their superstitions though, as a way to boost their spirits before heading off to sea.
Event_HXMC_1_32: {PlayerName}, I wish you safety... and the best of luck.
Event_HXMC_2_1: {PlayerName}, welcome back. How did it go out there?
Event_HXMC_2_2: The place was overrun with Tacet Discords.
Event_HXMC_2_4: I didn't see the man you mentioned.
Event_HXMC_2_5: Ah, I see... Thank you for trying, {PlayerName}. Can you tell me more about what you saw?
Event_HXMC_2_6: You describe what you saw to Levito.
Event_HXMC_2_7: Sea fog, never-ending tides of TDs, distant voices on the wind... {PlayerName}, it reminds me of an old story I heard as a child.
Event_HXMC_2_8: Sailors, weary and broken after battling storms and endless waves, find their minds playing tricks on them. As I said before, loneliness can evolve into something unbearable.
Event_HXMC_2_9: In those moments, if a door appeared before them. Bright, warm, and inviting. Even if it led straight to death, many would still choose to walk through it. All for a glimpse of happiness that feels so real they'd gladly give everything for it.
Event_HXMC_2_11: So these waters… is a trap. The TDs are luring people in.
Event_HXMC_2_12: I believe so. And the longer those monsters are left unchecked, the more lives they'll claim.
Event_HXMC_2_13: I'd like to ask another favor of you, though I understand you've got plenty of other tasks to tend to...
Event_HXMC_2_14: I do have a lot going on.
Event_HXMC_2_15: But it's not like I can't make time.
Event_HXMC_2_16: I've learnt about your reputation of being quite a busy person. So don't feel pressured in taking on the task. Feel free to come by whenever you have the time to spare. I'll think of other ways to handle it in the meantime.
Event_HXMC_2_17: That said... I do prefer that you make use of that time on some relaxation.
Event_HXMC_2_18: Are you planning on a reward for me?
Event_HXMC_2_19: Of course, if that's what you hope for. I do not want anyone else to have to experience the loss of hope any longer.
Event_HXMC_2_21: Don't worry. I've made my peace with the idea that he did die ten years ago. Maybe that's not such a bad thing after all.
Event_HXMC_2_22: Ten years have passed for me, but for him? He'll stay forever young. I think there's something beautiful about that—it's the kind of ending that belongs in a song.
Event_HXMC_2_23: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I'll leave the rest in your capable hands.
Event_HXMC_2_24: However, if you do lend me a hand, I'll make sure you're rewarded properly.
Event_HXMC_3_1: The TDs have been growing in numbers lately. I'd be grateful if you could lend me hand when you have the time, {PlayerName}.

Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_10_1:
Subject: Averardo Vault Tour Guide (Underground Depository Zone)
 
Welcome to Averardo Vault! We hope you have a wonderful and unforgettable time here.
 
The main areas of the Underground Depository are as follows:
 
1. Precious Metals and Artworks Depository
This section primarily stores valuable metals and rare artworks. Some of the items are displayed to the public on a rotating basis. Below is a partial list of recommended exhibits for this month:

Stern's Ceramic Jar
The beloved ceramic jar of the famous comedian Arthur Stern! After receiving the Laurel, he retired from the stage to focus on the art of pottery. This jar is one of twelve masterpieces he personally painted.
Recommendation Rating: Five Stars!

"Deepening Stars"
The painting of an anonymous artist, depicting the starlight reflected from beneath the abyss. Critics have debated the theme of this piece for years, making it a highly controversial and discussed piece.
Recommendation Rating: Three Stars!
 
2. Echo Depository (Currently Closed)
This section primarily houses Echoes.
Important: The Echo Depository is no longer open to visitors.
 
3. [Data Deleted]
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_11_1:
[Work Log]
 
8:30 AM: Clocked in. Today's task is to perform an inventory check of the artworks inside the depository. Great, let's get to work.
 
12:00 PM: Lunch break. A new guy tried to ask me about the rumors surrounding the "secret cache." It's honestly surprising how long these baseless rumors have managed to stick around. Even if there was some secret cache, it's not like that's something we Level 1 folks are supposed to care about.
 
5:30 PM: Work is wrapping up for the day. On the Echo Train ride back, Jason thought it'd be fun to spook the newbie with one of those corny old ghost stories. Something about a mysterious, unmanned train that only runs at midnight and takes passengers to the Vault's "underworld." There, spirits of the dead rip apart anyone who dares trespass in their domain. I've heard enough of these kinds of stories. If there really were any mysterious trains, I would've seen one by now.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_12_1:
Bad news. A Chest Mimic somehow managed to sneak into the Vault and has hidden itself among the storage chests.
 
I've already alerted the guards. The Chest Mimic doesn't move on its own, so I suggest you stay away from this room until the guards arrive.
 
(Below the note is a hastily scrawled line in a different handwriting)
 
Don't even think about sending an Echo to inspect those storage chests. They'll just get gobbled up by the Chest Mimic... You really don't want to know how I found that out.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_13_1:
[Warning: For Vault Employees with Level 2 or Higher Clearance Only]
 
Due to the security risks posed by Fractsidus activities, the Family has decided to temporarily suspend the Ducat Auction. A date for its resumption will be announced in due course.
 
During this suspension, relevant staff members will be reassigned to other duties. The auction hall will temporarily be repurposed into a banquet hall and ballroom.
 
The official public statement for the suspension will be: "The auction center is undergoing renovations in line with applicable regulations from other regions." Employees are strictly prohibited from disclosing the true reason for the suspension to outsiders. Violators will be considered to have breached confidentiality and will face appropriate penalties.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_14_1:
Specimen Name: ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇

Specimen Description: A sub-species of the Spearback Tacet Discord obtained from the ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ region. Its strength and agility far surpass that of other Spearbacks. After receiving authorization, the expedition team successfully captured this specimen, with plans to use it for further research.

Specimen Status: Active. A dedicated experimental zone has been established for this specimen by the research team.
Experiment Plan: N/A
Experiment Goal: To reconfigure the frequencies that led to the formation of the specimen's abnormal physique, and attempt to apply the findings to other Echoes in order to enhance their performances.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_15_1:
...We successfully isolated the frequency responsible for the mutation in this specimen. When this frequency was tuned to match another Spearback Echo, it exhibited exceptional performance, far surpassing that of other specimens.
 
Unfortunately, the frequency proved too complex to replicate. The research team plans to secure the Echo specimen within the experimental zone for further combat and endurance testing.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_16_1:
We found some storage chests that clearly do not belong to the Echo Depository. They likely were left behind during a previous supply transfer.

There are no records related to these chests in the Vault, so their ownership is unverified. The Precious Metals and Artworks Depository has also refused to accept them.

The Echo Depository has no use for these materials, and they take up space here… but for now, there's no other option but to continue storing them here.

(Below the note, in a different handwriting, a hastily scrawled line reads)

These are not Vault assets. Whoever wants them can take them.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_17_1:
(A stack of papers rests here. They appear to be part of an unfinished novel or essay.)
 
...Ziegler was stranded on his private island, with only a coconut tree for company and the occasional Bell Crab scuttling across the beach.
 
Who was he? Ziegler Senior's son? Ragunna's most successful investor? The poor soul who lost everything in a gamble, with all his wealth and titles now gone? A mad artist? A hermit? The unfortunate fool who got caught in a shipwreck?
 
He gazed at the sea, the soft breeze lifting his graying hair while stirring the waves. In the golden glint of sunlight, he seemed to see countless versions of himself scattered through time, broken and incomplete. He felt a loneliness like never before, yet a strange sense of satisfaction.
 
He had no chance of leaving this island. Maybe tomorrow, or the day after, he would breathe his last breath under the scorching sun.
 
He had exhausted all of his miracles. The thought crossed his mind but quickly vanished without a trace. He decided to take some time to observe his island—to engrave all of its details deep into his mind, to fill his fragmented memories with them, and to hope that the coming darkness would not turn them to nothingness.
 
(The writing ends here.)
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_18_1:
—O Supreme Sentinel, the Great Imperator, I have never questioned you.
 
You led us from the farthest reaches of the sea to this land, teaching us to walk the righteous path and embrace joy.
 
Yet those who claim to be your servants have distorted your teachings. The masses remain silent, while those who stand by the truth are banished here.
 
May you forge our faith into spears, and our suffering into hardened shields. May you… grant us vengeance, or at the very least, a merciful rest.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_19_1:
Malfunction Report: In the event of an Echo Train malfunction or abnormal operation, there is a possibility that staff members and visitors without Level 3 clearance may be mistakenly taken to this restricted area.
 
Course of Action: All Echo Trains will undergo recalibration, which is expected to be completed within 32 working days. Prior to this operation, a temporary set of instructions for boarding the Echo Train will be issued through flyers. 
 
If any anomalies occur during a ride, efforts will be made to guide passengers to the nearest station, where staff with Level 3 clearance will be on standby to evacuate passengers out of the vault.
 
Although passengers will be unable to enter this area due to insufficient clearance, choosing to disembark here due to rumors about the existence of the "secret cache" could lead to unnecessary complications. Therefore, it is essential to direct passengers away from this section.
 
Comment:
What do you say we create a story? Spread rumors about ghost trains with no return or mutated trains. This way, if passengers notice something unusual, they'll be more likely to seek our help immediately.
 
Response:
Approved. We will include this information in the flyers.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_2_1: A crystal that shines with colorful radiance.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_2_2: Known as the Scatter Prism, it is capable of enhancing and refracting certain specific Fortes.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_20_1:
This isolation zone was constructed after the completion of the Vault. Considering that certain research and specimens might pose security risks, the family built this isolation zone on the island to house these projects. The zone is divided as follows:

Underground Floor 1: Echo Experimentation Area
Underground Floor 2: Item Storage Area (Decommissioned)
Warning: Items in the isolation zone are extremely dangerous. Please do not enter without proper authorization.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_21_1:
We ultimately failed to find a way to mass-produce enhanced Echoes. So, this Jagrock Echo may be the only significant result we were able to achieve. What's worse is that our own Echoes are no match for it in combat, so we haven't been able to collect any combat data.
 
The Family has decided to abandon the research and have us return to work at the Vault. However, I can't help but feel that this deserves a better conclusion. So, I've left behind some equipment capable of collecting combat data, which will be automatically saved to the Vault's server.
 
Whoever finds this, I hope you'll try giving it a go with the Echo. This way, we'll be able to obtain crucial data… Perhaps in the future, this data could be applied to practical use within the field of Echo research.
 
I've also left some rewards behind. If you succeed in defeating this Echo, they are yours to claim.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_3_1: A landscape painting depicting the scenery of Ragunna City. Similar artworks can be found throughout the Averardo Vault.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_3_2: They don't appear to be valuable exhibits. Instead, they resemble paintings serving decorative purposes. You speculate that they function as the "windows" of the Vault.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_3_3: Even underground, these paintings create the illusion of being on the streets of Ragunna, helping to ease the natural sense of fear and claustrophobia caused by the confined space.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_4_1: A huge decorative column inlaid with colored glass, gems, and precious metals.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_4_2: There is fence going around it with no further explanation.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_4_3: Perhaps it is a reflection of the Montelli family, a magnificent monument built from an accumulation of immeasurable wealth.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_5_2: This type of collector's piece is capable of land travel at high speeds. However the dangers posed by the original Tacet Discords limit their potential for any practical use.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_6_2: The original Tacet Discord of this collector's piece is found in areas below surface level, with its ecosystem yet to be fully analyzed by scholars till this day.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_7_2: Echo-type collections are often gathered from all over the world, including many Tacet Discords non-native to Rinascita.
Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_8_1:
…

Nobody can carry on after bearing such a heavy fate. The tragedy deep underground fills us with sorrow. Thus, the wings that symbolize a long journey fold, awaiting the day when the departed will finally find release.

Side_AFLDJKXCSPH_9_1:
Subject: Welcome aboard the Echo Train of Averardo Vault!
 
To facilitate your business within the Averardo Vault, we are pleased to offer the Echo Train service. These unique Echoes will swiftly transport you to various areas within the Vault.
 
For your safety, please adhere to the following guidelines:
 
1. The Echo Train is gentle in nature, but please refrain from feeding or attacking it. Doing so may cause it to veer off course or even fall off the tracks if startled.
 
2. During the journey, you may enjoy the view through the train's window. Please do not extend any part of your body out the window. If you find that this rule has already been violated, promptly refer to Rule 6.
 
3. Averardo Vault only contains depositories, storage facilities, and small decorative sculptures. There are no statues or structures with a height of around ▇▇▇, resembling a ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇. If you encounter such a structure during your ride, remind yourself that it is merely an illusion caused by the Vault's enclosed environment and promptly avert your gaze. If you continue to perceive the structure, promptly refer to Rule 6.
 
4. You may call the Echo Train via your Terminal, and it will typically arrive within three minutes. If the train fails to arrive within this time frame, leave the station immediately and report the delay to the Vault staff at the front desk. Do not board any train arriving after the three-minute window.
 
5. The Echo Train within the vault is designed to resemble a fish. It has no limbs, legs, or tentacles. If you notice that the train's appearance deviates from this, do not board it. Instead, call for another Echo Train and wait until the abnormal train has left the platform.
 
6. If you violate any of the above rules, promptly leave the platform and inform the nearest Vault staff. If you have already boarded the train, immediately throw this flyer out the window. The train will proceed to the nearest station, where Vault staff will be waiting to escort you out. Please refrain from engaging in conversation or making eye contact with the staff.
Character_Brant_1_1: So, Captain, how about it? Fancy a wager on who hooks the first fish?
Character_Brant_1_2: A bet to start the day? Oh, Battier, you do know how to charm a man.
Character_Brant_1_4: Is that Brant...? What are those two doing? Better find out.
Character_Brant_10_1: Leave the paperwork to Brant. It's part of his responsibilities.
Character_Brant_11_1: There's still time before dinner! Smiles are all around. Why not wander about and soak it all in?
Character_Brant_11_3: Battier did say the winner would be the captain, but of course, the choice is yours. So, do you want the helm?
Character_Brant_11_4: What does being captain actually involve?
Character_Brant_11_5: Simply put, you chart the course and steer the ship. The crew will be ready to sail on your order at a moment's notice.
Character_Brant_11_6: Might seem easy enough, but there's more to being captain of the Troupe of Fools.
Character_Brant_11_7: These seas are full of thrilling quests and glittering treasures.
Character_Brant_11_8: That's where a true captain shines! Leading their crew to uncover lost legends, revel in the crowd's cheers, and sail boldly through the Stormy Sea toward glory.
Character_Brant_11_11: I feel like there are easier ways to find glory...
Character_Brant_11_12: That's true. But you know the greatest legends are forged in the fiercest storms.
Character_Brant_11_13: True, but every drop of sweat brings laughter, and every adventure leads to a chest full of treasure.
Character_Brant_11_14: But none of this is possible without a captain, and the same goes for every member of the troupe.
Character_Brant_11_15: Take Battier, for example, he's our best fisherman. Tina? She knows every inch of the sea. And Lavito's stories could stretch on to fill a hundred nights.
Character_Brant_11_16: Everyone's unique talents make this troupe what it is. Each soul plays an important role.
Character_Brant_11_17: Ah, but duty calls, Captain. Oh, time to scrub the decks before dinner, as promised.
Character_Brant_11_18: Dinner's at six. Good... there's still time. Until then!
Character_Brant_12_1: Six o'clock, dinner! Six o'clock, dinner!
Character_Brant_12_2: There's still some time before dinner. A little stroll could be a good idea.
Character_Brant_13_1: A bottle of Troupe Strength, just for you! Around these parts, this stuff is as good as gold.
Character_Brant_13_2: Oh, and look what I found while gutting the fish!
Character_Brant_13_5: Odd, right? Found it just like this. It might even be a relic from the old days.
Character_Brant_13_9: Is that a letter? Does it mean anything to you?
Character_Brant_13_10: Hmm, yes. On these seas, there is only one legend about "D."
Character_Brant_13_11: The story of Drake, the Golden Captain.
Character_Brant_13_12: Captain Drake! That adventurer everyone talks about?
Character_Brant_13_13: I thought that was just a fanciful story…
Character_Brant_13_15: What do they say about him?
Character_Brant_13_16: Captain Drake, the famed hero of Rinascita. Legend has it he assembled a crew with naught but a single coin and amassed great riches from the wealthiest of men.
Character_Brant_13_17: He then embarked on a quest to chart a safe passage across the Stormy Sea. A feat worthy of being remembered forever!
Character_Brant_13_18: But there was a price. Only one crew member returned, and he had been driven mad. What happened out there is still a mystery.
Character_Brant_13_19: You seem to know the story well.
Character_Brant_13_20: Such tales were my bedtime stories.
Character_Brant_13_21: Back when I just boarded the Pilgrim's Sail, with no family and nightmares that could raise the dead, Toscanini would share such stories to comfort me.
Character_Brant_13_22: At the time, I swore that if I ever became a captain, every crew member would come back safe. No exceptions.
Character_Brant_13_23: Ah, Toscanini, the Night Watcher. Hahaha. You're one of the few who still remembers him.
Character_Brant_13_24: Did he ever tell you the rest? That mad sailor who raved about his captain's coin, saying it would lead to untold treasures.
Character_Brant_13_25: Perhaps it's the very coin our Captain here is holding.

Character_Cantarella_127_9: After all, we are more than just firewood.

Character_Cantarella_131_1: I've conducted over a hundred visits and interviews, traveling between Thessaleo Fells and Egla Town. Finally, I think I have a theory...
