Main_Linaxita_2_4_59_12: Will do! You can count on me one hundred percent.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_2: To think the head of the Fisalias approached you when I was still in negotiations with her emissaries. Was it meant to be a diversion all along...?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_5: They invited you and you alone. As a Montelli, I'm in no position to intervene.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_6: That being said, if the Fisalias try anything against you, I'll get you out, even if it means storming through their front gates.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_10: In the meantime, I'll keep looking for more information and the person Cartethyia mentioned to you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_6_11: I'll call you as soon as I find anything.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_60_1: I thought I'd slip away quietly and avoid any fuss. But now, here I am, dealing with all of you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_60_2: Since you're all here, how about a morning stroll?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_61_1: They're a lot feistier than before.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_1: Well, this is where our paths must part.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_2: You're here for the Sentinel, why would you leave now?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_3: What I saw yesterday caught my attention. It may be tied to the Sentinel.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_4: And besides, I'd rather not spend the day twiddling my thumbs, seeing as your Gondola only holds two.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_5: Are you sure you want to go alone?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_6: Such concern for me. I do hope to see the fruits of your labor when I return.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_8: Go ahead, it's no use now that it's out of the pedestal... its energy is gone.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_9: It may still come in handy.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_10: ...I'll add you in my Terminal. Call me if you need help.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_11: Hehe... I just might ring you up once things are settled.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_12: You open your Terminal and exchange contact information. Cantarella leaves with Tyrvine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_62_20:
To verify her visions and improve the chances of saving the Sentinel, Cantarella decides to venture into the unknown alone.

After exchanging contact information, she sets off on a separate path with Tyrvine.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_63_1: If only I could still fight...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_63_2: Everyone's doing their part. Don't worry, nobody's perfect.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_65_1: The waterway up ahead is completely blocked.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_65_2: That garden once housed dragon Echoes, now there's nothing left but Tacet Discords.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_1: One moment, please. I shall inform Milady of your arrival.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_3: To keep our honored guest waiting would be… most improper.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_4: Especially when it was I who extended the invitation.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_5: Cantarella Fisalia—36th matriarch of the Fisalia family. I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_6: Honorable Laureate. The new Crown of the Carnevale.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_8: Have you seen my crown, by chance?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_9: Very well. If you insist, I see no reason to refuse.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_10: You may also call me Cantarella.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_11: Hmm... the Laurel is a gift of the Divinity. What claim have I to crown one as distinguished as yourself?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_12: Sorry, that was a bad joke.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_13: I should be the one to apologize for not understanding our guest's attempt at lightening the mood.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_15: Very well. You may also call me Cantarella.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_16: Now. Shall we proceed to my study?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_7_20: The current head of the Fisalia family introduces herself as Cantarella. She seems to be well prepared for your arrival and invites you to her study.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_2: I hope you'll accept this tea as my way of apologizing for the incident with Gilberto.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_3: Members of the family may have troubled you, but there is no stain that can't be washed away. Every sorrow has its own way of fading, don't you think?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_4: You still hold a grudge. Won't you accept my apology?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_7: This tea... Is it from Jinzhou?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_8: I see. Let's set aside such past unpleasantness for the time being.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_9: I invited you here to ask that you might serve as a mediator.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_10: Before we get into that, there's something I want to know.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_11: I imagine it concerns... the Fisalia family's true beliefs?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_12: It would seem Gilberto's mind is beyond saving.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_13: But let's not dwell on that. What is your opinion on the current state of Ragunna, {PlayerName}?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_14: Peaceful, in a way that feels... wrong.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_15: So you've noticed something is amiss. As expected from someone who's felt the weight of a Threnodian invasion firsthand.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_16: And what exactly do you find most unsettling?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_17: Why haven't the Threnodian and the Sentinel ever shown themselves?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_18: Because the Threnodian's invasion of Ragunna... has long since concluded.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_19: The Threnodian, so named Leviathan, possesses the power to merge and assimilate. It uses distorted beliefs to spread a spiritual plague that slowly devours civilizations from within.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_20: Though the previous two attempts were thwarted, the tall mast of the galleon that is Ragunna has already been snapped in half.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_21: Now the blissfully ignorant masses walk hand in hand toward an abyss they cannot see.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_22: Friend or foe? As a newcomer to this land, can you really tell them apart?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_23: Are you implying the Order worships the Threnodian?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_24: You're one to talk, given how strange your family's been acting.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_25: Yes and no. On one hand, there's the truth of the Order's beliefs…
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_26: On the other, there's our family. The Threnodian doesn't take kindly to those who know the truth. We've always been under Its whispers.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_27: Once the soul fractures, the mind will follow until only a puppet remains.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_28: Now that we've come this far, there's nothing for me to hide.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_29: My only hope is that once you learn everything, you will carefully consider my request.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_8_40:
Based on what you previously learned from Gilberto, you confront Cantarella about the Fisalia family's true allegiance to the Threnodian.

Yet Cantarella unveils a more daunting truth. The Threnodian Leviathan is an entity with powers of assimilation, devouring civilizations through the spread of spiritual plague. Its invasion of Ragunna has long since concluded.

Peace is all but an illusion, blinding the Ragunnesi to the abyss they are unknowingly walking toward.

As if everything were unfolding as planned, Cantarella offers to present more evidence to back her claims.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_9_1: Come. The truth you seek lies in the deepest part of the castle.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_1: The way you were when you saw the Plushie Echo... it was... unexpected.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_2: I think "The Martyrdom of Blessed Fleurdelys" needs a rewrite.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_4: A play about you written by Cristoforo the playwright.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_5: Oh, how did he portray me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_6: Ahem... "I would rather hear the joyous songs of the masses than any solemn hymn of remembrance. Perhaps the Sentinel feels the same."
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_8: In the end, no matter what anyone else says...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_9: As long as you stay true to yourself, everything will be alright.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_96_10: Doesn't matter if it's the Threnodian or the Sentinel. They don't get to change who you are.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_98_1: What you said back there... Thank you.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_113_2: He's not who you think he is.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_115_1: Bound by obsession, till relieved of duty.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_116_1: I'm going to break the chains.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_150_1: If the Threnodian created the Dark Tide, maybe Abby can absorb it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_150_2: Abby is still unwell, perhaps we shouldn't burden it further.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_150_3: More Dark Tide remnants... Good thing there isn't much. Leave it to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_150_5: Don't worry. This much I can still handle.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_1: Vines, over there. And that statue...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_2: I can feel strong Remnant Energy coming from it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_3: The Order's Remnant Spark must be inside the statue. Legends speak of how the first Primus used it to purify the first Dark Tide...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_4: ...I see now. The lingering remnants of the Dark Tide must be trapping the Spark.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_5: To release it, we'll need to clear away the remaining remnants binding it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_152_6: Once we have the Remnant Spark, we can use it to burn through the vines.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_153_1: Hurry. We need to purify the other statues before the Dark Tide's corruption returns.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_157_3: Just catching my breath. You go get the Remnant Spark.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_161_2: But we have to remove the shackles.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_164_1: It's coming back faster each time.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_170_1: Does that mean...he's finally been freed?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_171_1: There, now we can smash that statue back in.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_171_2: The morph painting over there should allow us to reach the highest point.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_37_3: That should do it... Why don't you give it a try?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_38_2: Rotate the Gravity Calibrator to change the direction of the gravity's pull.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_38_3: If we use this we should be able to reach areas we previously couldn't.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_46_2: Can you use your ability from somewhere in between to clear them all at once?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_46_3: I might not have that range...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_46_4: But there may be Tacetite devices nearby that can help amplify my Forte. Let's see if we can find one.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_48_2: Sounds like Phaom's getting impatient. Let's head back.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_67_9: Perhaps that stele over there has instructions on what to do?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_67_10: You don't remember from your own exam?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_67_11: As the Blessed Maiden, I was exempt.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_73_2: So soft, so cuddly... Cough... I mean I'm fine.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_75_2: Help me guide the Wingray to the top of the statue.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_75_3: Of course, but what do you have in mind?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_76_3: Saves us the trouble of finding some trigger mechanism.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_79_3: There's a Gravity Calibrator behind the collapsed wall we just passed. We can use it to reorientate ourselves.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_79_4: The Remnant Spark should be able to incinerate the thorns on the left.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_80_10: The waterway is still incomplete. We have to look elsewhere.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_82_1: Sounds like they're talking about one of the three major belief systems, the faith of Unity.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_82_3: Let's give it a try, we still need to rebuild the waterway.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_82_5: Maybe we could find a way to move them?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_82_6: There's no point in finding Hognis if we can't repair the waterway.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_83_2: Same as before, I'll handle it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_88_2: We're still missing an area, but where...
Main_Linaxita_2_4_88_4: That might be too high for the Wingray.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_88_6: Same as before, I'll handle it.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_89_3: It's okay, I'm just doing my part.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_90_2: I'll handle this bit, you rest.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_90_4: You've done well. Let's see if I can get a feel for how strong the gravitational forces are.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_91_1: It's been a long time since I saw this place as it was meant to be.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_91_3: Do you want to stop for a while?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_91_4: No. We have more important things to do.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_91_100: Let's check back on Hognis now.

Main_Linaxita_2_4_92_4: If it's a trap, we stand a better chance together.
Main_Linaxita_2_4_93_2: How does it feel to trust me?
Main_Linaxita_2_4_94_1: Why don't you call Phaom over? Try whistling.

Character_Zani_1001_1: We're old and no use to anyone. And we can't run anymore...
Character_Zani_1001_2: It's not so bad, lying here... easier than getting up and finding help.
Character_Zani_1001_4: If it weren't for Talos, you'd already be long gone from this place.
Character_Zani_1001_5: You passed the Vault's hiring test. It was those thugs that forced you back.
Character_Zani_1001_6: It's always the same. One Talos goes, then another takes its place.
Character_Zani_1001_8: Leave this place... You deserve a stable home.
Character_Zani_1001_11: That's...that's where little Colleen was supposed to go...
Character_Zani_1001_12: Yes. It was Ms. Colleen who reached out to us. That's why we're here.
Character_Zani_1001_13: According to the Employee Manual, Protocol 8, we're obligated to help members with any problems they run into while onboarding.
Character_Zani_1001_14: Since Ms. Colleen passed the assessment, but can't begin her duties because of outside factors...
Character_Zani_1001_15: We're required to activate Protocol 8 and help her solve the issue at hand.
Character_Zani_1001_19: Ms. Zani is incredible... She... she could flip over a Gondola with one finger if she wanted!
Character_Zani_1001_20: She showed us some wild stuff during the assessment.
Character_Zani_1001_21: But Talos's Echo is not something to be taken lightly...
Character_Zani_1001_23: That's right! The Laureate is here too! Hubert, you missed it before!
Character_Zani_1001_24: {Male=He;Female=She} took down Cetus the Tidebreaker singlehandedly! Sent it right back where it belonged! Even stronger than the Blazing Nightwalker!
Character_Zani_1001_25: Thank you... Thank you so much...
Character_Zani_1001_26: Colleen, I'm leaving this in your hands.
Character_Zani_1001_27: Use my Terminal to contact the Montellis and get them here. You'll be able to track their location with it as well.
Character_Zani_1001_28: {PlayerName}, looks like I'll have to go back on what I said.
Character_Zani_1001_29: I was planning to do just enough to get it done...
Character_Zani_1001_30: But now, I've got no choice but to go all in.
Character_Zani_1001_101: Hubert is convinced that Talos is unstoppable: the miserable fate of the Black Alley residents has been sealed, and this place will continue to be a haven for criminals like Talos. On the contrary, Colleen believes that you and Zani hold the key to bringing about change. Determined to avenge its residents and eradicate the criminals dwelling within once and for all, you head out towards the depths of the Black Alley.
Character_Zani_1002_1: You move the injured individuals to higher ground, where Colleen administers emergency aid to them.
Character_Zani_21301_1: Right, let's get this done quickly.
Character_Zani_21303_1: Uh-oh, things just went south. Looks like we've got a fight on our hands.
Character_Zani_30_1: The way ahead should be under the cistern.
Character_Zani_30_3: I think there's a drainage switch in the next room.
Character_Zani_31_2: It's a Sequence Mechanism. You need to hit it hard to get it to work.
Character_Zani_31_3: Vagrants like us aren't much for heavy lifting, so... it's been stuck like this forever.

Character_Zani_32_2: How do we know what's the right direction?
Character_Zani_32_3: Uh… never actually been here before, so…
Character_Zani_32_4: Let me think… I know there must be something that can help.
Character_Zani_33_1: If we've got nothing else, we'll go with gut instinct.
Character_Zani_33_2: Statues are usually meant to be appreciated. Turning them to face a wall? That's just wrong.
Character_Zani_33_3: Let's try pointing them all toward the center.
Character_Zani_34_2: Oh, yeah… After the water lock opened last time, I heard them talking when they left…
Character_Zani_34_3: They said it felt really weird with all those eyes watching them.
Character_Zani_35_1: So all we needed to do was make them face the center... so simple as if it were a joke.
Character_Zani_35_2: Well, looks like we found the way. Let's move.
Character_Zani_36_4: Yeah, thanks. You saved me there.
Character_Zani_36_5: It's been a while since I've been down here... Forgot about that part.
Character_Zani_37_2: One, two, three… four, five, six… seven, eight, nine… so many unfamiliar faces...
Character_Zani_37_3: You win, I give up... No, I didn't see a single thing...
Character_Zani_37_5: So this is who Talos is hiring now?
Character_Zani_37_6: Heh... He's probably one of those who don't actually buy her story. That's why they tossed him out here.
Character_Zani_37_7: Still... this place usually has more than just one person on guard...
Character_Zani_37_9: Yeah, they usually keep a few posted around here.
Character_Zani_37_10: Not just to make sure we don't run, but to search us, check if we're carrying anything valuable.
Character_Zani_37_11: Some got caught with stuff after a few rounds of searching, and... well... let's just say their fingers didn't stay intact.
Character_Zani_37_12: If only we found this place sooner...
Character_Zani_37_13: Don't waste time on what-ifs. Talos has a debt to pay for all of this.

Character_Zani_38_1: This place was supposed to be abandoned. Why's this thing still running?

Character_Zani_38_6: The ones who try always lose to the Echo she transforms herself into.

Character_Zani_38_8: She says it's to "calm them down."
Character_Zani_38_11: Be careful. There might be an ambush waiting for you.

Character_Zani_39_2: Yeah, the switch to stop it is up ahead.
Character_Zani_39_3: Normally there's always someone guarding this. Strange... it's just like earlier...
Character_Zani_39_4: While I didn't exactly expect them to be model employees, I did expect a bit of crisis awareness.

Character_Zani_42_1: Right above is the Black Alley living quarters.

BBTTC_15_2: When we fed your latest combat logs into the sim, it actually triggered a data overflow. The Threnodian and Sentinel's frequencies were just too unique.
BBTTC_15_3: Fortunately, the glitch only occurred within Virtual Crisis and was corrected. No damage to the core system.
BBTTC_15_4: Still, it highlights just how unpredictable these residual frequencies in Avinoleum can be. That's definitely worth a focused simulation.

BBTTC_19_2: These TDs exhibit strong herd instincts and territorial aggression. Even nearby Hoochiefs and Hooscamps have displayed frequency shifts under their influence.
BBTTC_19_3: Having survived in extreme conditions, the Feilian Beringal and its kin are capable of frequency spikes far beyond normal expectations. If their territory expands closer to settlements... the consequences could be devastating.
BBTTC_19_4: In this simulation, we placed them near the outskirts of Ragunna. Try to contain the outbreak, and watch for pack tactics!

Main_Linaxita_2_8_2_164: A girl whose homeland was devastated by the Dark Tide, Augusta, follows Septimont's Gladiators to the city. Her heart yearns to find the power to protect her home, and the crowd's buzz of the Great Agon catches her attention. The girl thinks this path may help her find the strength she is seeking, so she is determined to participate in the Agon. According to the rules, she needs a mentor. With no identity or status, she faces repeated setbacks until she finally finds Cato as her "lifeline." The girl continues to hone her skills, passing the entry trials Cato set for her, and finally makes her first step into the Agon.
Main_Linaxita_2_8_3_1: Fail enough times, and you might eventually succeed. Should we call it resilience, or mere stubbornness?
Main_Linaxita_2_8_3_2: Or perhaps, for a girl who has lost everything, there was never a second option. She had no one to trust but herself, and naught but a blade to hold.

Main_Linaxita_2_7_135_1: (No one here knows about the Gem… I should look elsewhere.)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_138_1: (The attempts recorded here line up with the research notes Phrolova left behind.)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_138_3: (The friend she mentioned meeting at the concert… That person must be very important to her.)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_138_4: (But what does "a new anchor" mean? Who is she using… and who is using her?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_138_5: None shall stop... the final cadenza...
Main_Linaxita_2_7_138_7: (That was her voice, I'm sure of it… But why can't I reach her?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_138_8: (I won't find any more answers here. I should check somewhere else.)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_138_9: Inside Phrolova's home, you find some notes confirming the previous research files were hers. They also mention a "friend" and "anchor" that meant a great deal to her. Before you can figure out who and what they are, your surroundings begin to shift, prompting you to search elsewhere.
Main_Linaxita_2_7_139_1: (Why are there so many Tacet Discords now…?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_139_2: (Where is everyone? Are they hiding in their homes?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_2: RUN! Run... This place will soon be devoured...
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_3: (Tacet Discords that can talk, but don't attack humans?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_8: (Why do these Tacet Discords sound like the people from earlier…?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_9: (Could they… be one and the same?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_10: (It can't be possible... They looked indistinguishable from real people. I didn't notice anything off at all…)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_11: (Wait, Phrolova said there's no divide between humans and Tacet Discords, and their frequencies could merge.)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_14: (She wants to use the Gem to fuse the bodies of Tacet Discords with human consciousness, bringing them back to life. She's trying to fulfill the desire that's always haunted her.)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_16: (Given their unstable nature, these Reverberations have never truly become human again…)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_140_17: The people you just encountered have transformed into TDs, still repeating the same words. You finally realize that Phrolova is attempting to use the Gem to fuse the bodies of Tacet Discords with human consciousness, hoping to bring them back to life and fulfill her seemingly impossible obsession. However, her attempts have yet to succeed, and these Reverberations have never truly become human.
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_3: Of what sorriest thoughts do your companions make, clinging to what should have died with them?
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_4: All life in this world... has already died...
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_5: No, this isn't irreversible. I won't simply succumb to it.
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_6: I searched everywhere… but why can't I find it?
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_7: Tell me... have you found it?
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_11: My ambition. My companion. The most precious Gem among all that I have...
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_12: I can't lose it… But where could it be? It must be waiting for me.
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_15: (Looks like this place isn't entirely under her control…)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_16: (Could that violin be a sign she left behind?)
Main_Linaxita_2_7_141_17: In your search for the Threnodian's residual energy, you meet a mirage of Phrolova. She seems overwhelmed by conflicting emotions but eventually manages to get a grip on herself. She mentions her violin, something that holds special significance to her. It is her ambition, her companion, and the most precious Gem among all she has. You can't help but wonder if her words hold a hidden clue.
Side_AHKC_1_1: {PlayerName}, I've been informed of what happened at the Fabricatorium of the Deep.
Side_AHKC_1_2: I'm afraid I have another favor to ask of you regarding this matter.
Side_AHKC_1_3: Head to these coordinates if you've got time. A friend of mine there will fill you in on the details.
Side_AHKC_1_4: On behalf of the Montellis... No. On behalf of the people of Ragunna, I thank you.
Side_AHKC_10_3: I need some time to prepare.
Side_AHKC_10_5: Don't worry. Someone's already thanked me.
Side_AHKC_10_6: Absolutely. We'll depart whenever you're ready.
Side_AHKC_11_1: Strange. The melody of this place has gone back to normal. The Echoes shouldn't be behaving like this.
Side_AHKC_11_2: ...It seems you haven't reached the deeper truth. This place is more than just a factory for Echoes.
Side_AHKC_11_3: The new research data I gathered indicates the Order has been secretly pushing experiments on Echo consciousness control in the facility.
Side_AHKC_11_4: In other words, if things had gone according to the Order's plans, the Echoes would become mere puppets and watchdogs entirely under their control.
Side_AHKC_11_5: But... we should've led with faith, not attempting control through force.
Side_AHKC_11_6: If all we have is sand slipping through our fingers, no matter how tightly we grasp, nothing would have mattered. Why, Primus Fenrico, why must you do this...
Side_AHKC_11_7: Ah, apologies, I tend to talk to myself sometimes... Let's move on and document this place.
Side_AHKC_14_3: (Did she take this photo before finishing her work?)
Side_AHKC_14_5: It's the end goal of the Sonoro experiment by the Fractsidus Overseer.
Side_AHKC_14_6: I've heard of such an organization... But how are they involved in all of this?
Side_AHKC_14_7: This is where Fenrico collaborated with the Fractsidus.
Side_AHKC_14_8: Collaborate? The Primus understands their kind better than I do. Why would he do such a thing? This Lost Beyond, does it pose a threat to Ragunna...
Side_AHKC_14_9: No, the Lost Beyond has nothing to do with Ragunna.
Side_AHKC_14_10: It's only about someone with an obsession, and a distant, deluded dream.
Side_AHKC_14_12: Quite the opposite. That was likely her final show of weakness.
Side_AHKC_14_13: The Lost Beyond is no longer here. Don't worry, it won't interfere with the Fabricatorium's operations.
Side_AHKC_14_14: Noticing your expression, Luther paused for a moment, then handed you the photo.
Side_AHKC_14_15: Very well, the families placed their trust in you, then I have no reason to doubt. Here, you should take this photo.
Side_AHKC_14_16: If I'm not mistaken, you must know the person related to this photo. It seems more fitting for you to have it.
Side_AHKC_14_18: Hmm... Let me see here. We've completed the data collection, which confirms the Echo experiments we mentioned earlier.
Side_AHKC_14_19: As of now, the energy devices are nearly automated, we just need people to monitor them... Alright, done. Let's move on.
Side_AHKC_15_1: These Echoes have less stable consciousness than ordinary Common Echoes. The experiment here is truly a chore.
Side_AHKC_15_2: It's not wise to hold everything too tightly. Sometimes, letting go brings greater rewards. An experiment that does only harm may not be worth continuing...
Side_AHKC_15_3: As it stands, Ragunna still needs a place where the Echoes can call home...
Side_AHKC_15_4: There's one last thing I need to tell you.
Side_AHKC_15_5: This is the control hub of the entire Fabricatorium, overseeing all of its areas. Each region has a similar device that reacts to every change.
Side_AHKC_15_6: I've noticed and recorded an image of it.
Side_AHKC_15_7: Someone once told me that everything is made of frequencies, melodies can bend the rhythm of existence, and by orchestrating their essence, we reshape their very nature.
Side_AHKC_15_8: The key to Fabricatorium's operations is a melody. Keep this melody, make sure it plays well, and the Fabricatorium will remain stable.
Side_AHKC_15_9: If you want to make a change here, you'll have to adjust the melody. No way around it.
Side_AHKC_15_13: You hum the melody softly, and its tune echoes throughout the tower.
Side_AHKC_16_1: If not for seeing it with my own eyes, I would've never imagined such grandeur was hidden right beneath the land we've been walking on.
Side_AHKC_16_2: The sea nourishes us. In ways we least expect.
Side_AHKC_17_1: A place this intricate is difficult to fully comprehend in such a short time. You seem to know this place like the back of your hand. Have you done some research prior to your last visit?
Side_AHKC_17_2: Not really. A lot of it came from... the person that was with me at the time. She was one of the founders of this place.
Side_AHKC_17_3: I see. One moment, I'll add a few final notes here.
Side_AHKC_17_4: The Fallen Grave relies heavily on frequency decomposers. Only a small number of Echoes maintained their operation, and no personnel appeared during the course of the investigation. Future management may require fewer staff.
Side_AHKC_17_5: Evaluating and handling anomalies in the Common Echoes requires further revision. They should be offered a choice, rather than helplessly be sent on a conveyor belt for disassembly and smelting.
Side_AHKC_18_1: What a beautiful song. As if I can almost hear a story from it.
Side_AHKC_18_2: I have it recorded. Seeing how focused you are, I took the liberty of capturing your image.
Side_AHKC_18_3: It's fine, as long as it helps you.
Side_AHKC_18_4: Your guidance has been essential to my understanding of this place. Trust me, we will make this place better.
Side_AHKC_18_5: The age of lies is behind us now. Now that the shadow over the Order has lifted, I'm sure the brighter days will come.
Side_AHKC_18_6: Hmm? Why are you looking at me like that?
Side_AHKC_18_8: Heh, isn't that good? Ambition, or you might call it, a desire for the better.
Side_AHKC_18_9: The Order of the Deep needs change. Ragunna deserves a better future, but who will lead that change, I'm not sure.
Side_AHKC_18_10: Luther gave you a calm and meaningful smile before bowing deeply in gratitude.
Side_AHKC_19_1: Alright. I've gathered enough information. Shall we move on to the next area?
Side_AHKC_19_4: No problem. I'll be here waiting.
Side_AHKC_2_1: Carlotta's coordinates are outside of the Cathedral of Mercury.
Side_AHKC_2_2: So the Montellis have already talked with the Order about this...
Side_AHKC_20_1: We need to document this place too, right? Let's take some pictures ahead.
Side_AHKC_21_1: Is everything set? Shall we go to the next area?
Side_AHKC_21_4: No problem, I'll be here waiting for you.
Side_AHKC_22_1: Shall we proceed to the next place?
Side_AHKC_22_4: No worries. I'll be right here.
Side_AHKC_3_1: Ah, Righteous One. You must be here for the deep, yes?
Side_AHKC_3_2: Luther, at your service. I've been expecting you.
Side_AHKC_3_3: Does the Order know about the Fabricatorium?
Side_AHKC_3_4: No need to worry, the events that occurred haven't been made public yet, and we've decided to keep it so after thorough discussion.
Side_AHKC_3_6: Not long after you brought the news, a private meeting was held between the Order of the Deep and the Montelli and Fisalia families.
Side_AHKC_3_7: So rarely do these parties find common ground, especially under such circumstances.
Side_AHKC_3_8: An agreement was made to keep the incident under wraps for now, to prevent unnecessary confusion and fear among the citizens. Meanwhile, we'll need a thorough investigation.
Side_AHKC_3_9: Common Echoes have become a vital part of Ragunna, and it would be unrealistic to remove them entirely. Thus, the fate of the Fabricatorium would be decided once we all fully understand it.
Side_AHKC_3_10: The Fisalia's expertise in Echo control, combined with the Montelli's Terminal technologies will aid in the smooth transition of the Fabricatorium's operations.
Side_AHKC_3_11: Once everyone is ready, the truth will be revealed to all of Ragunna.
Side_AHKC_3_13: You are the only person who's been to the Fabricatorium and returned unscathed. We couldn't think of anyone who can lead this investigation than yourself.
Side_AHKC_3_14: I'll be responsible for documenting any findings. It'd be most helpful if you could be my guide and explain along the way so our investigation can be as detailed as possible.
Side_AHKC_3_16: Yes. Since Acolytes mostly station the Fabricatorium, the Order and the families have decided that I am best suited for this task.
Side_AHKC_3_18: I need some time to prepare.
Side_AHKC_3_20: Don't worry. Someone's already thanked me.
Side_AHKC_3_21: Absolutely. We'll depart whenever you're ready.
Side_AHKC_4_3: Are we now inside the Fabricatorium? This area is...
Side_AHKC_4_4: We are in the Fallen Grave.
Side_AHKC_4_5: It's a deeper part of the Fabricatorium.
Side_AHKC_4_6: Coldness and death litter these obscure corners.
Side_AHKC_4_7: Only a few straggler Echoes remain, watching their own kind being fed into the "furnace" one by one.
Side_AHKC_4_8: We've always regarded Common Echoes as gifts from the Sentinel, never caring about their birth or death. But here lies the dissolving and decaying truth behind the miracles.
Side_AHKC_4_9: The frequency will be recycled once broken down.
Side_AHKC_4_10: You're saying frequency energy can be reused? You mean there's a way for these abnormal Echoes to be reborn after meeting their end?
Side_AHKC_4_11: Where does that energy lead? Do the reborn Echoes retain their past consciousness?
Side_AHKC_4_12: Let's keep moving. The depths will answer your questions.
Side_AHKC_4_13: You speak in riddles. I suppose I'll have to take notes more carefully.
Side_AHKC_4_14: (Why am I starting to talk like this too...?)
Side_AHKC_5_1: I noticed something in the files earlier. This is the area where Common Echoes are brought to be incubated, isn't it?
Side_AHKC_5_2: Yes, those devices you see still running are Echo Brooders.
Side_AHKC_5_3: Hundreds, if not thousands, of Echoes are being incubated. That explains why there's heavy security and so many researchers.
Side_AHKC_5_5: The recycled Echoes from the Fallen Grave feed the creation of new ones...
Side_AHKC_5_6: Pieced together from innumerable broken frequencies, these newborns bear no relation to the past.
Side_AHKC_5_8: I used to be a researcher of frequency studies. One look at the readings is enough to know that every trace of the old data is erased...
Side_AHKC_5_10: Years in the lab can numb one's mind. Eventually, you stop seeing the subjects as living individuals.
Side_AHKC_5_11: I keep reminding myself not to go down that path. But here, it feels like everyone sees the Echoes as expendable tools, not living beings.
Side_AHKC_5_12: Is this not a betrayal of our faith?
Side_AHKC_5_13: I've heard it phrased differently before.
Side_AHKC_5_15: Someone once told me, it's vibrancy in the ruin, an opus of eternal life.
Side_AHKC_5_16: You mean, this cycle is the immortal, unbroken unity of life?
Side_AHKC_5_17: No, that is a fallacy. Our "unity" must never be built upon the sacrifice of self-awareness.
Side_AHKC_6_1: The amount of energy stored here is astounding.
Side_AHKC_6_2: Energy Hub serves as the central energy storage.
Side_AHKC_6_3: The data shows two types of energy being stored here.
Side_AHKC_6_4: One of them matches what we found in the Fallen Grave. Recycled Echo frequencies must be stored here before being distributed to the incubation areas.
Side_AHKC_6_5: The other energy source appeared on devices we saw before. It seems to be the power source that supports the Fabricatorium's operations.
Side_AHKC_6_6: But why is it giving a low energy level reading...
Side_AHKC_6_7: Must be because of the explosion.
Side_AHKC_6_9: We had to detonate some of the energy to escape from underground.
Side_AHKC_6_10: So there's an underground section of the facility. And that's where the energy storage area is located?
Side_AHKC_6_11: Yes, but I'm not sure if there's still a way down there.
Side_AHKC_7_1: Looks like the path is sealed. We'll need someone to repair the underground levels first.
Side_AHKC_7_3: Seems like someone managed to salvage some files from below.
Side_AHKC_7_4: They are not entirely about Echoes. And the data seems to be from another era.
Side_AHKC_7_5: No, wait, given the age of these records, the conclusions about the Waveworn Phenomenon were far ahead of their time.
Side_AHKC_7_6: Mind if we look over this again? I want to make sure we don't miss any critical information.
Side_AHKC_8_1: My dear {Male=brothers;Female=brother and sister}, you who have come here will be the strength that shall save Rinascita.
Side_AHKC_8_2: Oh? Thank you. I didn't expect to see so many...
Side_AHKC_8_3: Let us join together to spread light to all, and face the Divine Ordeal in unity.
Side_AHKC_8_4: Divine Ordeal...? I'm not sure I follow.
Side_AHKC_8_5: They can't communicate with you normally.
Side_AHKC_8_7: To save Rinascita and withstand the inevitable "Divine Ordeal" is a road paved by many.
Side_AHKC_8_8: They're victims of the Order's pursuit of salvation, willing martyrs in their attempt.
Side_AHKC_8_10: Might be because Fenrico is keeping the cost of failure in check.
Side_AHKC_8_11: After countless failures, their minds are filled with chaos, unable to live a normal life.
Side_AHKC_8_12: The ones who survived the darkness could only cling to their faith.
Side_AHKC_8_13: This place has nothing to do with production or the experiments. It's just Fenrico's last refuge for them, where they can live peacefully away from the rest of the world.
Side_AHKC_8_14: I understand. Then these people will remain under our care.
Side_AHKC_8_15: But the chaos and darkness you mentioned earlier...
Side_AHKC_8_16: Let's keep moving. You'll soon see the truth for yourself.
Side_AHKC_9_3: I beg of you, tell me everything that's happened.
Side_AHKC_9_4: Do you know about the false Divinity?
Side_AHKC_9_5: Yes. Soon after I was chosen for the Fabricatorium's investigation, I received a letter from the Fisalias revealing the truth about the Sentinel and the Threnodian.
Side_AHKC_9_6: Your place in the Order must be quite significant to be shown secrets like this.
Side_AHKC_9_7: Fenrico must have known about this earlier than we ever expected.
Side_AHKC_9_8: But he forgot, or to be more precise, his thoughts were muddled after being eroded by the Dark Tide.
Side_AHKC_9_9: With the Threnodian rooted in his mind, he had to record fragments of the truth with his last remaining sanity and keep them buried in the depths of the sea.
Side_AHKC_9_10: He and other Acolytes once sought ways to save Ragunna, until he realized that only by attempting it himself could there be hope of success.
Side_AHKC_9_11: But he forgot one important thing: he was the Harbinger of the Dark Tide.
Side_AHKC_9_12: The Threnodian's residual energy almost slipped back into the Dark Tide. Fortunately, the lantern awakened him, and he gave everything to stop the spread of the Dark Tide.
Side_AHKC_9_15: Many years ago, I had a few exchanges with the former Privy Councilor.
Side_AHKC_9_16: He mentioned that back in the Seminary days, Fenrico was a different person before becoming Primus. Even as an old fellow classmate, he felt like a complete stranger.
Side_AHKC_9_17: He never understood why, even when he was sent on the Pilgrim's Sail. I suppose what you've told me is the reason.
Side_AHKC_14_22: No worries. I'll be right here.
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_1: Wait, no... How do I open it...
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_3: I'm collecting Sacred Salt for future needs.
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_4: There is no room for errors in the work of a Steward. I must take great care of the Acolytes' welfare.
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_5: The martyrs sacrificed everything for the cause of saving Ragunna. Even in failure, they are entitled to live out their days in peace...
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_6: So the Sacred Salt is for them?
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_7: Yes. For they hold onto the belief that anything untouched by the Sentinel's grace on this blessed land could be potentially tainted or cursed by the Threnodian.
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_8: That's why I would perform cleansing and consecration rites with Sacred Salt on all provisions before their eyes.
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_9: To lead them into thinking they're taking the Divinity's nurturing meal, drinking holy blood that grants enlightenment. So they have no reason to refuse.
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_10: But lately, we are running short on Sacred Salt. As an Acolyte of the Ministry of Holy Rituals, I...
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_11: (He seems a bit unsettled too... Best not to push him. We should figure out a way to help.)
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_12: Did the Order anticipate this situation?
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_13: Ah, yes. We've set aside some Sacred Salt in the Fabricatorium for times like this. It's kept in the Triptych Chests and other places...
Guide_FSRWZZ_1_14: If you happen upon any, bring it to me. I'll offer you plenty in return. What do you think?
Guide_FSRWZZ_2_1: Thank you for your help and devotion. Please, take a look and see if anything catches your fancy.
Guide_FSRWZZ_3_1: May the Sentinel always bless you.
Guide_FSRWZZ_4_1: Like this? No, that's not it... How...
Side_TLZX_1_2: Orchestrate using the flower she left behind and see what happens.
Side_TLZX_7_1: Is this how the music used to control the sea depths was made?
Side_TLZX_7_2: I wonder what these unused melodies are for. I’ll keep a record of them either way.
Side_STDHYWB_10_1: This... this is the real prayer...
Side_STDHYWB_11_1: Relax, I'm here. You won't forget how the real prayer goes.
Side_STDHYWB_11_2: Look, I've written everything down. We'll put our trust in this book. Do you need this book?
Side_STDHYWB_11_5: Oh-ho, so you trust your memories. Just you wait, the need will arise.
Side_STDHYWB_11_6: Of course, you need it. Everyone needs it here. Now, how will you prove you'd be a worthy owner?
Side_STDHYWB_11_10: I see. You value money above all else. You have strayed far from the path. Take this book and return to the fold.
Side_STDHYWB_11_11: I see. Your prayer lacks finesse. This book will help you remember how best to pray. Here, take it. You're welcome.
Side_STDHYWB_11_12: I see. Your resolve is unshakable and your faith is immovable. This book will let you ascend to greater piousness. Please take it.
Side_STDHYWB_12_1: Over here? Or there? It's going to appear again!
Side_STDHYWB_12_2: No. There is no corruption or blight here.
Side_STDHYWB_13_1: The darkness that swallows all light will creep into every corner. We must be careful at all times!
Side_STDHYWB_13_2: Look! What is that blackness over there? It's coming. It's here!
Side_STDHYWB_13_3: Is it under my feet?! It will swallow me whole. I can't breathe in there!
Side_STDHYWB_13_4: This sacred land is under the protection of the Divinity. No defilement shall come to pass.
Side_STDHYWB_13_5: Cleanse your soul... Let unharmonious words be banished from this place of peace...
Side_STDHYWB_13_6: Those things must be lying in ambush. Help me look over there.
Side_STDHYWB_14_1: We are all connected. Our souls are aligned. We shall become one.
Side_STDHYWB_15_1: Paradise... I long for the Paradise...
Side_STDHYWB_16_1: I venerate Thee. Yea, I do believe. Please guide me upon Thy path.
Side_STDHYWB_17_1: What do I gain... by worshiping here...
Side_STDHYWB_18_2: False light... cold... I won't go... Don't make me go...
Side_STDHYWB_20_1: They're almost in my grasp... I can get them out soon!
Side_STDHYWB_20_2: Just a little more... Help ... is near...
Side_STDHYWB_28_1: A stranger, eh? Now that's a rare sight!
Side_STDHYWB_29_1: Folks don't often find their way to Ostina. You bringing good news, I hope?
Side_STDHYWB_29_3: Yeah. Is Phrolova making any headway with her work? Are we getting back to the real world?
Side_STDHYWB_29_4: Don't reckon I've seen you around. A friend of hers? Or one of them researchers she works with? Sure don't get many like you out here…
Side_STDHYWB_29_7: That so? She must trust you plenty, or she wouldn't have told you about us.
Side_STDHYWB_29_8: Oh, okay... Sorry, I'm being a bit pushy. These things aren't exactly quick and easy, are they?
Side_STDHYWB_29_9: You're the only one besides her who can travel between the two realms. You must be powerful.
Side_STDHYWB_29_10: I hope you can help her... Ah, sorry, that was selfish of me. Spoke without thinking again.
Side_STDHYWB_29_11: Well... truth is, we're all counting on her. She must be worn clean out by now. It'd be good if she had someone to share the load, someone who gets it like she does.
Side_STDHYWB_29_13: Of course. If she says it's possible, then it's possible. I believe her.
Side_STDHYWB_29_14: I don't get all the fancy details, but hey, who doesn't want to live longer?
Side_STDHYWB_31_1: Don't be indifferent. Now listen, a normal welcome-back party is boring. We should throw a surprise party. The youths do like surprises.
Side_STDHYWB_31_2: There's a fine line between surprise and jump scare.
Side_STDHYWB_31_3: Hehe, she's braver than you. Maybe she's into that kind of thing.
Side_STDHYWB_31_5: Oh, it's you. Phrolova is out performing, and we're discussing how to organize a party for her return.
Side_STDHYWB_31_6: You act younger than the youths of today. Try not to overexert yourself. Oh, you seem tired, child. Care for a glass of water?
Side_STDHYWB_31_7: Hey child, do you like my idea? If we throw a surprise party, maybe they'll let me be the main organizer.
Side_STDHYWB_31_9: Why do you care so much?
Side_STDHYWB_31_10: Hahaha, I most certainly know what the youths want. What have you got to say to that, Leah?
Side_STDHYWB_31_12: Uh... haha, we saw them grow up. Those young'uns are like family to us.
Side_STDHYWB_31_13: Besides, I need to be important to them. If they enjoy my company, they won't forget to visit us from time to time.
Side_STDHYWB_31_14: Unlike our own ungrateful brat... He never....
Side_STDHYWB_32_1: Won't you at least consider my suggestion?
Side_STDHYWB_33_1: I have some spare cash on hand. You can borrow my money and pay me back later.
Side_STDHYWB_33_2: Thank you for the offer, but I can't accept this. I've also returned everything Phrolova's given me.
Side_STDHYWB_33_3: It's infuriating. She bought her first violin by herself with savings from her job. Does she think I can't do the same?
Side_STDHYWB_33_4: I'm sure that's not what she meant.
Side_STDHYWB_33_5: But I'm not angry, really. I only want you all to trust me. Even though it'll take a while, I want to buy a new instrument on my own.
Side_STDHYWB_33_7: Then you can accompany me to the city and help me pick out an instrument after I've saved enough.
Side_STDHYWB_34_1: Who was the first to skip the class?!
Side_STDHYWB_35_1: Rote practice is an essential part of studying music. If you do not master the fundamentals, you cannot create great pieces.

Guid_SYZY_9_3: Just promise you'll make it back safe and sound, okay?
Guid_SYZY_9_5: I see... Well then, take this.
Guid_SYZY_9_6: I made these necklaces. One for each of us. Keep it with you, as a talisman. Promise?
Guid_SYZY_9_8: Cheer up now. I'll be waiting for you at the foot of the Three Heroes' Crest.
Guid_SYZY_9_9: The Three Heroes' Crest… where we made our vow?
Guid_SYZY_9_10: Exactly. That's why it matters. So promise me… you'll come back safe.
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_1: {PlayerName}, I've just sensed a Dreamscape Node being restored in the Sanguis Plateaus. And no surprise, it was your doing.
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_2: You describe what happened to the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_3: A dark sword burning in flames, with Nightmares bearing Dark Tide frequencies coming out of it when touched? Could it be...
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_4: It was suppressing the Nightmare Tacet Discords.
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_5: Was it guarding the Dreamscape Node?
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_6: Indeed... That appears to be the case. The question is,  who placed the sword there?
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_7: I cannot say for certain. It might have been placed there solely to suppress the Tacet Discords. But... by whom?
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_8: Was it a unique Resonator who could perceive the Dreamscapes, or could this power originate from the Somnoire itself?
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_9: When that sword disappeared, I felt a warm frequency in the wind.
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_10: How extraordinary... If it's not too much trouble, could you restore the remaining nodes, {PlayerName}? I'll mark their locations for you.
Guide_JCZMQQ_1_11: If my suspicions are correct, the answer to the sword's origin is hidden within the remaining nodes.
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_1: {PlayerName}... Many years ago, I learned a line of a poem... in a dream, from someone in Huanglong.
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_2: It goes... "Their forms did fall, yet souls endure unbound. Valiant in death, as heroes they are crowned."
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_3: Sounds like you've figured out those swords?
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_4: Yes. And it would seem I've made an error of judgment on my part.
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_5: They originated from neither a Resonator nor a Somnoire... There was no need for them to be "unique." They are merely the dreams of the fallen from Septimont, who couldn't reach the Somnoire.
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_7: Indeed. Dreams. No matter how much they burned, the warriors could not eliminate the Nightmares. The best they could do was trap them, biding their time until the arrival of a "hero."
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_8: And that was why the frequencies that constituted those swords ultimately faded, reaching for Septimont...
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_9: They were hoping to return home. The warriors of Septimont would much rather return to their homeland than find eternal peace in Dreamscapes.
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_11: Ah, yes. I've discovered something interesting within the final Node of the Sanguis Plateaus.
Guide_JCZMQQ_2_12: As their long-awaited hero, you should take it.
XJZM_1_1: Maybe I should go look for him, Captain.
XJZM_1_2: Just wait. He usually comes back around this time.

XJZM_1_14: I'll share all the intel we've gathered with you.

XJZM_10_4: Then let's get a closer look!

XJZM_16_4: You don't have to yell, okay? Got it!

XJZM_17_2: I know what you want to ask, but once we get there, you'll understand everything.

XJZM_18_5: Must be a price too heavy for me to take.
XJZM_18_6: But most people lose everything and still gain no strength.
XJZM_19_2: It's most vulnerable when it swings that thing to attack!
XJZM_2_1: Time to run, Gramp! Another one's coming our way!
XJZM_2_2: Quiet! I can see it just fine! Keep shouting and you'll draw even more of them! Got it?
XJZM_20_2: It belonged to Master Cato, Augusta's coach. He once wielded it against the Dark Tide creations here alone. Even now, his valorous frequency lingers on it.
XJZM_20_4: Were you in the Lion Beast hunt?
XJZM_20_5: Not exactly. I never earned Master Cato's recognition. And no, I wasn't part of that hunt. That old hunter aided Augusta while I was back at camp nursing my wounds.
XJZM_20_7: After her hometown was torn apart by the Dark Tide, she trained under Cato, the legendary Gladiator. Then, she slayed the Lion Beast that plagued the Plateaus, defeated a hundred foes in front of all Septimont, and eventually won Arsinosa's blessing.
XJZM_20_8: And me? I was just one of the supporting roles in her legend.
XJZM_20_9: How long are you going to cling to this obsession, Aeolus?
XJZM_20_10: "A man with neither talent nor resolve is unfit to be my student." That was the only thing Cato ever said to you, wasn't it? And you still see him as your mentor?
XJZM_20_11: Always spouting that nonsense—"Your weapon is your second life."
XJZM_20_12: That Augusta girl defeated a hundred Gladiators and took their blades. Do you think someone like her would remember the name of a weak man like you?
XJZM_20_13: Yes, maybe you were close to heroes. But it doesn't make you one.
XJZM_20_14: Just look at yourself. You're old, Aeolus. One swipe of that Kerasaur's tail could snap your bones in half.
XJZM_20_15: I've had enough of hearing how Gladiators die out here chasing empty glory. It's ridiculous.
XJZM_20_16: And it's even worse when it's my friend caught in this madness.
XJZM_20_17: So quit being a Gladiator, Aeolus. Don't you get it? You're aging too fast as a Resonator.
XJZM_20_18: I don't want to dig another grave in this cursed place.
XJZM_20_19: Gren uncorks a bottle of wine and pours it out before Cato's grave. Then he turns and walks away.
XJZM_21_1: I see. So Aeolus eventually decided to join Gren's team. I'll file his withdrawal application then.
XJZM_21_2: Who are Gren and his team, anyway?
XJZM_21_3: Master Gren used to be the teammate of Master Cato, Ephor Augusta's mentor.
XJZM_21_4: When all of Septimont was watching with bated breath the duel between Augusta and Arsinosa, signs of the Dark Tide surfaced again on the Plateaus. Master Cato went alone into the Wastelands to face it, and never returned.
XJZM_21_5: Gren blames Master Cato's death on the ingrained defects of the Plateau's logistics and support system. He traced that failure back to the former Ephor's compromises with the nobles. And so, his entire team withdrew from the Gladiator ranks.
XJZM_21_6: But what does this have to do with Aeolus?
XJZM_21_7: Very few know the truth. That day, Master Cato wasn't the only one who went to the Wastelands. Aeolus followed him.
XJZM_21_8: But to uphold the legend of Cato's solitary last stand, Aeolus's name was left out of the story.
XJZM_21_9: I understand why he chose to join Gren. But still... it's a shame. He was so close to claiming the glory he longed for.
XJZM_21_11: And that glory might have cost him his life.
XJZM_21_12: Such is the fate of a Gladiator, {Male=Sir.;Female=Lady.} {PlayerName}—
XJZM_21_13: Born for glory. Die for glory.
XJZM_22_1: Hey, Champion! Thanks for convincing Aeolus to quit. It's time we headed out too.
XJZM_22_2: His captain felt sorry about his resignation.
XJZM_22_3: Why don't you return to the Gladiators?
XJZM_22_4: Augusta wouldn't let a warrior like you go to waste.

XJZM_22_6: But ever since I set foot back on this land... I've been dreaming. Dreaming of the past. Of Cato. Of the hunts shared with my old friends who fell.

XJZM_22_8: One bloody grave, then another. And another.
XJZM_22_9: Now that I've woken from those dreams... I just don't believe in myself anymore. And I can't buy into that so-called "Gladiator's glory" either.
XJZM_22_10: As for Aeolus... even if he died out here, no one would know. No one pays attention to an old man's last moment.
XJZM_22_11: By the way, did you know he was Augusta's seventh opponent? She beat him in just two strikes. And I used to take him down using only my left hand! Haha!
XJZM_22_13: He's at his temporary camp, packing up his things. I'll send you the coordinates.
XJZM_23_1: Oh, it's you. Good timing. We're just about to leave this hellhole. Tch, this place reeks like fart...
XJZM_23_2: We… we built a grave for that idiot. Right next to another idiot's grave.
XJZM_23_3: Got a minute? Rolla and I are heading over to pay him a visit. You know, the whole "talk to the air and pretend the dead are listening" thing. Haha...

XJZM_23_5: Anyway... I'll just meet you over there. That's the deal.
XJZM_24_1: Traces of a massive Dark Tide creation?

XJZM_25_2: I need to find a way in.
XJZM_26_2: Has he been training here all this time?
XJZM_26_3: So close to the Dark Tide?
XJZM_27_2: Is he planning to blow up the entire cave?
XJZM_28_3: Aim for the ankle on its right leg! That's its weak spot!

XJZM_29_2: This scene is all too familiar. Heartbreakingly so. A "gift" from fate, carefully prepared for those who dare to defy it.
XJZM_29_3: Listen and honor its weight in silence.

XJZM_29_10: Would Master Cato smile... and say he misjudged me?
XJZM_29_11: Heh… just a dream... but this… this isn't so bad either…
XJZM_29_12: To take the Corrosaurus down with me… Ha, who said I didn't have a sense of humor…
XJZM_3_1: Thanks a bunch for the help! Gramp's back has been acting up lately. If it were just the two of us, who knows how long we'd have been stuck out here.
XJZM_3_2: By the way, I'm Rolla. What's your name?
XJZM_3_3: ...You're the Champion of this year's Great Agon, aren't you? Name's {PlayerName}?
XJZM_3_4: Whoa, I never thought I'd run into the Champion in person!
XJZM_3_5: Fighting people and fighting Dark Tide beasts aren't the same, but you've got the skills for both. Born with the gifts, I'd say?

XJZM_31_2: Aeolus... he was truly a great Gladiator. I will make sure his story lives on.
XJZM_31_5: I understand your sorrow for Aeolus. But Septimont doesn't measure one's sacrifice by whether it was "necessary."
XJZM_31_6: If you can't understand Aeolus's choice, then think of it this way:
XJZM_31_7: He was a Gladiator. That's all there is to it.

XJZM_32_4: Aeolus, you old fool... You think I'd find this funny?!
XJZM_32_5: Damn you Gladiators... Damn the Dark Tide... Damn it all!

XJZM_33_6: ...Why did you say that, Gramp? You've always been my hero.

I have received your withdrawal request. It is hereby denied. The glory of Septimont shall forever shine upon you—a true Gladiator.

Also, Master Aeolus, you were the seventh formidable opponent I faced on my path forward. Your swordsmanship and keen battle instincts left a deep impression on me. I will carry your blade, your ideals, and everything you stood for, and lead Septimont forward.

Please, bear witness.

Highest regards,
Ephor Augusta of Septimont

XJZM_7_10: Why, did you carve them on stones along the way?
XJZM_7_12: Pfft, you've got a sense of humor, eh! Didn't expect someone your age to crack better jokes than me. Wait… don't tell me you're actually older than I am?

XJZM_8_2: I promised Gren I'd keep an eye on Rolla.
XJZM_8_3: It won't take long to hunt a Kerasaur.
XJZM_8_4: Oh, come on, Gramp! Why so stubborn today? Let's just go!

POI_FXZX_12_8: Chunkie was a Gladiator worth honoring.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_100_7: "Hear this, O faithless ones of Septimont. The Divinity of the high heavens has grown enraged. Should your monarch once more stand in contempt of Their will, annihilation shall be your fate."
