Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_5: After all, we share the same destination. Your reputation precedes you, honorable {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_6: I am Gladiator Avidius. At your service.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_7: Are you also here for the hunt?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_8: "Gladiating" and "hunting" are the very pillars upon which the glory of Septimont stands. I believe no Gladiator would refuse such an honor if invited.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_9: I, of course, am no exception.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_10: Please, if you'll follow me. Honored guest from afar.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_1: Iuno and Augusta's hunt for the humanoid is thwarted by an unknown, powerful force. The Whispers tell Augusta that to end the Dark Tide, she must return to her hometown of Murmurstown. The hunting party decides to regroup and tend to the wounded at a nearby camp.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_2: What was that about? And that black fog... It was all mushy... I couldn't even finish it...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_3: Hic. Oh boy, did I take a huge bite outta that one. My head's gone all swishy.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_4: Ugh... I need a quick timeout, {PlayerName}.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_8: ...Now you've seen it. {Male=His;Female=Her} tiny little Echo. Silencing the Dark Tide with such ease... Resonance power. Such might. Such perfection.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_9: Confined to this frail human form, you will achieve nothing.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_10: You nearly lost everything... As you once did.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_11: Augusta... do not resist the "Gift of Divinity." Follow our guidance. Return to <te href=750016>Murmurstown</te>...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_15: If, and I say if... Septimont's fate has already been decided.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_18: A ruler assumes their place... by accomplishing the impossible for their subjects.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_19: It isn't safe here. I'll lead a team and escort everyone to a temporary camp not far from here. But before that, I must ensure no one is left behind.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_350_20: You go on ahead, {PlayerName}. I am entrusting Iuno to your care.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_355_5: How are you feeling? Do you want to rest a bit?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_355_6: I appreciate your concern, but I'm not as fragile as you think... This road is nothing I can't handle...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_1:
You arrive at the camp and attend to Iuno, who's weakened from using her Forte. You ask about the strange visions she saw after firing her Moon Arrow. She's surprised you saw the Dark Tide's "illusions," but quickly realizes it's because you carry an "unknowable fate." What you witnessed, she explains, was a glimpse of the future—the fall of Septimont.

To change that fate, Iuno gave up her ability to see fate to gain a Forte capable of resisting the Dark Tide. But using this power comes at a cost. It consumes her very existence. The humanoid you saw was the Dark Tide's incarnate, the False Sovereign, and their true target all along. She and Augusta had planned to use Tyrannos as bait to lure the Sovereign out and use her power to make it vulnerable to attack, but the plan failed.

Now, to recover from the toll of using her Forte, Iuno must remain at the camp. Before parting, she entrusts you with her Lunarum bracelet, sealed with her Resonance Energy, hoping it will help you and Augusta finish the hunt in her absence.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_2: You can set me down here.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_3: Come on... Don't give me that concerned look of yours. It's nothing to worry about.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_4: You could stand to rest more.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_6: Wait. You have questions. Don't pretend you don't.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_7: Well, spit it out. It's only a minor injury, I can manage.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_8: I saw you fall into the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_9: I saw the moment of Augusta's death.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_10: I saw the destruction of Septimont.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_12: So you've managed to "glimpse" that far? Or is there more?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_13: Heh. Just how many more surprises do you have for me? But I suppose only you could manage something like that.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_14: Grandmother Lillibet, the Head Priestess you met at the Temple, once spoke of the "unknowable void" that is your fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_15: I've yet to fully interpret what she meant by that, but one thing is clear. You are the most unique among us all.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_17: They were... as I once perceived through the Sacred Flames... The fate of Septimont...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_18: Just as you saw, the Dark Tide will bring destruction to Septimont, and... the death of Augusta.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_19: I don't know whether Ragunna's predictions are actually true, but fate has given me no response but sorrow.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_20: Though I would deny it to the end, as it is now... I cannot ignore it any longer. The Dark Tide is a force to be reckoned with.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_21: Its terror lies not in the illusions it shows, or the lies it spins. Rather, it uncovers the parts of us we hide the most carefully. The parts of ourselves we least wish to face.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_22: And if the fate you've glimpsed turns out to be false?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_23: Never. My prophecies are never wrong.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_24: How I... loathe this feeling. This helplessness. To know everything, to see everything, and yet be powerless to change a thing...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_25: Since we've come this far, might as well share a secret with you.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_26: The Iuno you see before you can no longer see the threads of fate.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_27: I gave up my ability to peer into fate in "exchange" for the Resonance power to resist the Dark Tide. Why? Because I refused to be fate's obedient puppet, bowing to its whims and letting it dictate my every step.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_28: But in the end... despite all the sacrifice, we still couldn't escape its grasp...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_29: The dark figure we faced in Asphodel Barrens was, in fact, an embodiment of the Dark Tide. We call it the "False Sovereign."
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_30: Unlike other Dark Tide creations, it can devour and reshape the scattered powers of its maker.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_31: I'm unclear how things will unfold, but I'm certain it's the source of evil that will bring about the fall of Septimont, just as the prophecy foretold.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_32: Before this hunt, Augusta and I investigated such Dark Tide irregularities at the Sanguis Plateaus.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_33: We then formed a plan to take advantage of the Sovereign's nature, using the Corrosaurus as bait to lure out its imperfect form...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_34: Maybe this way, we can rewrite Septimont's tragedy before it even begins.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_35: But as you can see, we failed...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_36: Is there really no way to alter fate and the prophecy?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_38: Fate doesn't lie. Perhaps death is the only choice we're given in the end.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_39: But knowing Augusta... I'm sure that fool would fight till the bitter end.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_40: There is one thing... I'm not certain about. For reasons I can't explain, the fate shown to me by the Dark Tide feels different from what I remember.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_43: A side effect of my Resonance power.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_44: The Dark Tide doesn't exactly show up in a stable form. My powers manifest its creations in exchange for a teensy piece of my "existence." That's the price to pay, I suppose.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_45: Ugh. I admit it sounds a bit complicated. In short, just know that a little sleep will relieve these side effects.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_46: Understanding this situation will take time.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_47: Until then, focus on resting and getting better.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_48: A fair point. Once I've recovered my strength, sorting out these questions will be as simple as a flick of a finger.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_49: Oh, by the way, take this.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_51: A Lunarum bracelet containing a small portion of my Resonance power. It was passed down to me by my predecessor when I became a Priestess.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_52: It's quite dear to me, you know, so be sure to take extra good care of it. And don't expect there will be a spare if you lose it.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_53: Rely on it in my absence. Who knows, it may even help fill in for me and help you and Augusta in my place.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_55: Now, why would you say that?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_56: I'll only be taking a short nap! Don't you or Augusta even dare think about leaving me behind, is that clear?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_365_1: I should see how things are with Augusta now.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_1: The situation we're currently facing is more dire than any I've come across. For the sake of Septimont, I must momentarily set aside my quest for power...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_2: (Ask about the events Iuno mentioned at Tetragon Temple.)
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_3: My four expeditions to Manes Deep?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_4: Now may not be the best time to discuss past events, but if you insist...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_5: It dates back to a High Tide four years ago... At the time, we were driven by the fury of the Dark Tide into the lower levels of the hunting grounds, the <te href=750017>Wastelands</te>.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_6: I had no intention of emulating the feats of the three Hero of Heroes in conquering Manes Deep. But with the Dark Tide's blockade, I had to lead repeated expeditions into those underground ruins.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_7: Fortune, however, did not turn its back on us. In that dark and treacherous place, my companions and I managed to carve out a path to survival.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_8: Are those companions of yours also in this hunt?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_9: ...Fate has its ways. Now, only I remain able to face the hunting grounds' trials.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_10: Many of my companions fell to the corruption of the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_11: Those left barely overcame the Dark Tide's influence with the help of a plant unique to Manes Deep, <te href=750018>Mesona</te>.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_12: Even so, they still suffered from the torment it caused and were forced to cut their time as Gladiators short.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_13: This Holmleaf Medal was granted to me by the former Ephor after the crisis.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_367_14: A victory, yes, but one laced with pain. My companions should never have suffered the Dark Tide's disgrace.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_37_1: Augusta spoke of the great surge we are about to face.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_37_3: And... this year's High Tide has come later than usual, which bodes ill.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_37_4: It's a shame even the sharp ears of the Senate could not chisel through the high walls of Tetragon Temple, to hear the whispers beyond...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_37_5: Heh, is this an auspice of calamity, or a prelude to a new legend? Only time will tell...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_1: You contact Consultant Buling of the Black Shores. She reports that the Tethys System has detected the False Sovereign rapidly consuming nearby frequencies and growing stronger. Left unchecked, it could threaten the Earthrend Wedge and trigger a catastrophic collapse. To stop the Dark Tide's spread and intercept the Sovereign, you, Augusta, and the Gladiators set out for Murmurstown, the most frequency-rich area in the hunting grounds.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_2: Messages have been sent to the encampment and all sectors of the main island, and defenses are currently being deployed per your instructions, Your Excellency.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_3: Good. Ensure timely reports on any new developments.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_5: How are things playing out here?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_6: I've made arrangements for the war effort. Strategically, we must always brace ourselves for the worst.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_7: Communications with the Black Shores are also underway.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_8: The Ephor's Palace has previously established a connection with a Consultant in the Rinascita region. We've reached an agreement granting the Black Shores permission to access Septimont's Resonance Nexus. They'll be able to monitor and collect data on the Dark Tide during the hunt.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_9: In return, should any complications arise, the Black Shores are to fulfill their side of the agreement and provide us with the necessary technical support.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_11: That's right. Her name is Buling. An interesting young lady. Left quite an impression on me.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_13: Why don't you let me handle contacting the Black Shores, Augusta?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_14: We... talk from time to time. It'll help make things smoother for us.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_15: Of course. I'll leave it to you then.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_17: Alright, I think I got the whole picture now... Oh {PlayerName}, how do you keep ending up in messes like this? This is one tough cookie, all right.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_19: Let me tell you, the latest data we got from the Resonance Nexus isn't so pretty. Something's really off with the Dark Tide in that Sanguis place. I don't remember it being this crazy before.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_20: Normally, the Dark Tide getting all freaky during High Tide is whatever, right? But now, I don't know what happened, cuz it's... it's turning into a person.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_21: So listen up, I'll give you Tethys's rundown. That humanoid thing, that "Sovereign," is gobbling up frequencies like a maniac!
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_22: It's eating anything with energy. Dark Tide stuff, Tacet Discords, Echoes, you name it. Might even be saving other things for dessert.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_23: Basically, the Sovereign isn't gonna attack Septimont or Ragunna anytime soon. It's too busy getting fat first. Once it's stuffed full of energy, it'll try and smash the Earthrend Wedge in one go.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_24: With the Earthrender gone, POOF—all that Dark Tide under the hunting grounds will explode like a pimple. When that happens, it's game over for Rinascita. Even if you have three heads and six arms, it will be bye-bye.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_25: But smooth moves, team. Cutting through the clutter, I see what you're doing.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_26: This Corrosaurus is just the bait to hook the big fish, isn't it? Your real plan is to stop the Sovereign before it fully forms, nip it in the bud.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_28: You are right on the mark.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_29: Heaven and earth are in harmony... That's my reading, so your plan shouldn't have fallen apart like that.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_30: But then again... smooth sailing isn't always a good thing either. Too much harmony invites trouble. Tethys did pick up a strange frequency midway through the hunt.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_31: Everything was fine until that frequency came out of nowhere, and suddenly the Sovereign took form way ahead of schedule. Talk about flipping the table.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_32: Can you trace the frequency back to its source?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_33: Umm. Well. Let me get another reading... The Chi's all messed up, it's kind of hard to see.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_34: It's like someone clouded the heavenly signs on purpose...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_35: One way or another, we must find the Sovereign and stop it before it absorbs any more frequencies... This might be our only option for now.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_36: That's right. Supernatural powers or not, the Sovereign can't escape good old Tethys. Lemme see... Yep, it's wandering in an area with a whole lot of other frequencies...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_37: Looks like it's east of the Sanguis Plateaus. Yeah, that place has lots of dark energy. Bet many tough people died there.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_39: Understood. I will stop it in its tracks.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_40: If the Sovereign wants to destroy the Earthrender, I can't let that happen.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_41: Under the oath of the hunt, I will fight alongside you to the very end.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_43: With your permission, I wish to accompany you to Murmurstown.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_44: I know this request may seem bold, and I'm aware of the dangers ahead. But as a warrior of Septimont, I cannot simply stand by.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_45: Gladiators, we are united as defenders of Septimont's honor.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_46: I do not claim the right to ask this of you, but in my heart, I believe everyone here has earned the glory we bear. Let our deeds today reflect that greatness.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_49: Well said, young man. Gladiators of Septimont fear no challenge. When the storm approaches, can an eagle soaring in the skies remain content as a fledgling beneath another's wings?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_50: Your Excellency, we will follow you anywhere.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_51: Very well. You have sworn your allegiance to Septimont with your resolve. Your bravery is witnessed not only by me, but by the fallen heroes lying in Capitoline Hill. They take pride in your courage.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_52: If you wish to fight together, then so be it. I will afford your fervor its due respect.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_53: Come. Take up your blades—For Septimont. For the name of heroes eternal.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_55: It is time. Return to where you belong. Fabianum has long awaited your homecoming...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_57: You recall what Iuno once shared with you—the plan she and Augusta devised to hunt down the Sovereign. Though that plan has since failed, you relay the details to Buling, backed by Augusta's permit.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_375_1: Avidius, ready the Anchor Stones. We must set up a defense line around Murmurstown.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_375_2: It shall be done, Your Excellency.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_380_1: Murmurstown sits atop the Wastelands below the hunting grounds. It has since become a forbidden territory after the Dark Tide's corruption sixteen years ago.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_380_2: Follow me, {PlayerName}. The Wingray can give us a lift.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_1: Under Avidius's escort, you arrive at Tempest Cliffs. Once the hunting party is assembled, Augusta gives the order to begin the campaign.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_3: The pleasure of escorting you to the Ephor has been fulfilled. For now, my duty ends here.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_4: From here, we march onward to the hunting grounds, where the Dark Tide's creations may await us. When the time comes, it will be a true pleasure to see your skills in action.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_8: Do we set out from Tempest Cliffs?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_9: Precisely. These cliffs mark the opening of our campaign.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_10: But there's no bridge to the other side.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_11: Wait... Are we using our gliders?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_13: The path to glory will reveal itself under the feet of the brave.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_1: Woo-wee. Sure is a beautiful day.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_2: So any news from the Ephor, {PlayerName}? Or are we still chillin' like we've been for the past few days?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_4: I am Damian, an attendant in service to the Ephor's Palace. By direct command, I have come to deliver you Her Excellency's personal letter.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_5: It concerns a matter of utmost importance.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_8: Hey, what does it say? Scooch up a bit.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_9: It says Augusta has taken care of everything on her end. She's ready to meet us at the Ephor's Palace as agreed.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_10: It's most likely something to do with the <te href=750001>hunt</te>.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_11: We shouldn't keep the Ephor waiting... Time to go, Abby.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_13: Well, I think I'll sit this one out and leave all the heavy stuff to you guys. Hehe.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_5_14: Chat for as long as you like. Just gimme me a holler if you need me.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_50_2: That is a Corrosaurus. An abomination of the Dark Tide...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_55_2: Let it flee. The path it takes leads deeper into the trap we laid
Main_Linaxita_2_9_595_1: Stop dozing off. Just follow me.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_597_1: Tyrannos's whereabouts… Heh, Aquila must have its eyes on it now.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_597_2: This one doesn't even worth a glance.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_60_3: It's signaling we "retire" for the day, that's all.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_62_1: Augusta, time to bring your party back to the Hunter's Den.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_62_3: Your arrow couldn't have come at a better time.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_62_4: Hmph. Seeing that {PlayerName} is here, I'll take that as a compliment.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_1:
The hunting party stops at the Hunter's Den to rest and resupply. There, you meet Iuno, a Priestess of Tetragon Temple whose combat skills rival those of any Gladiator.

Augusta reveals that the beast that attacked earlier is a Corrosaurus known as "Tyrannos," one of the Dark Tide's more fearsome creations and the target of this hunt. She explains that only by slaying it within the Earthrend Wedge's range can its frequency be bound, stopping the Dark Tide's advance.

As Augusta steps away to plan the next phase of the hunt, the dreaded Whispers stir in her ears.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_2: The Hunter's Den. The busiest Gladiator encampment across the Sanguis Plateaus. Nearly every hunter passes through here on their way to the hunting grounds.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_3: We will rest here before setting off for the next hunt.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_4: I must admit, this place is rather magnificent.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_5: I suppose my predecessors forsook the peace they ought to have enjoyed, just to share this hard-earned land with these hunters. Such magnificence is rightly owed to the <te href=750005>Temple</te>.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_6: Heh, the Priestess's words are not without merit. I am well aware that I stand under blessings, and will forever remember the sacrifices of the Temple.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_7: Now if you'll excuse me. I'll be taking my leave.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_9: Though we've already met, I suppose a proper introduction is in order.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_10: I am Iuno. Priestess of the Tetragon Temple.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_11: I've heard about you. The Priestesses get to call the shots.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_12: I've heard about you. The Priestesses have the gift of prophecy.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_13: Well, aren't you caught up on things? What you say is true, though I've long since grown tired of such affairs.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_14: Come now, {PlayerName}. Surely you can find me something more interesting to occupy my time. For instance... the hunt?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_15: Quite frankly, when it comes to dealing with the Dark Tide, none of these Gladiators can hold a candle to me.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_16: Ha. Look at those looks. I've seen them all before.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_17: What can I say? When you're as dazzling as I am, jealousy tends to follow.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_18: I'll be making my way back, Augusta. Lest my shine further sting the eyes of certain people.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_19: If you find yourself with free time later, consider visiting me at Tetragon Temple.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_20: Not every outlander is granted access to its sacred halls. Make the most of it.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_21: It's rare to see Iuno hold back like that. You must be someone... different to her.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_23: Perhaps... We do share some common traits.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_24: Hehe. Don't let her unruly side fool you. She is as dependable as they come.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_27: Avidius was correct. It is a Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_28: What he didn't have the chance to tell you is that it is the deadliest Corrosaurus of them all—we call it "Tyrannos." A vanguard of the Dark Tide that rides its surge to reach our lands.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_29: The Threnodian's attempt to plague Septimont never came to fruition. But do not mistake that for victory. Our enemy will not bow so easily.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_30: The Dark Tide, immortal and indestructible, carries out the will of its creator—the Threnodian Leviathan.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_31: Only the Earthrend Wedge that bears Sentinel Imperator's power can sever the link between the Dark Tide and the Threnodian, burying the calamity deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_32: The "hunt" is how we disrupt the Dark Tide's frequencies by capturing and eliminating its creatures.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_33: However, the Earthrend Wedge's energy range is limited. Our mission is to deliver a true death to our prey.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_34: Meaning we need to hunt and kill the beast near the Earthrender... Is that how we stop the Dark Tide from spreading?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_35: Yes. And it must be done within <te href=750006>Maroonwood</te>.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_36: This confrontation with Tyrannos was expected, but it's not a fight anyone is eager to face...

Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_1: Once consumed by the Dark Tide, the ruins of Murmurstown still bear its scars. In the face of such destruction, the hunting party knows this hunt cannot fail. Avidius offers to lead a team to place Anchor Stones around the town's perimeter, sealing off any escape routes. Meanwhile, you and Augusta will enter the ruins and track the Sovereign's presence.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_3: I never imagined that after four years, I would return to this place under such circumstances...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_4: How did this place get like this…?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_5: This is where the Dark Tide started sixteen years ago. The fact that this empty shell still stands is a miracle in itself.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_6: Does this mean... if we fail to stop the Dark Tide, Septimont too will...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_8: Warriors, do not let fear stand in our way. The untarnished glory of Septimont stands behind us.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_9: The devastation that befell Murmurstown sixteen years ago will never be repeated.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_11: The Sovereign won't make things easy for us. Any rash action before we can confirm its location and status would be unwise.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_12: Your command is our duty, Your Excellency. We will deploy Anchor Stones around Murmurstown, and I'll personally see that the perimeter stays undisturbed.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_13: Yes. This will trap Sovereign inside the town.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_15: Now, then. It falls to us to track down the Sovereign's whereabouts, {PlayerName}. Time is short, so we'll need to split up.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_17: Keep your guard up. Those <te href=750019>Hollow Figures</te>, do not be fooled by their stillness. Those are just the shell. And watch for their songs of corruption.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_19: They were once our own—brave Gladiators, loyal citizens of Septimont.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_20: The Dark Tide not only twisted their minds, it also raised their corpses and turned them into mindless puppets. Not even death could set them free.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_21: Mark my words, it will pay for this malevolence.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_3: This is Murmurstown, only from the past...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_4: It was once called Fabianum—the town of Gladiators, visited by Fabius, the Hero of Heroes. But the Dark Tide claimed it in the end, leaving behind a scar Septimont will never forget.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_6: Are those... lingering frequencies from the past?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_7: Let's follow them. It might lead us to more answers.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_8: Inside the Sonoro Sphere, you see Murmurstown as it once was before the Dark Tide, then known as Fabianum. The glowing frequency of the unyielding Gladiator's spirit appears, guiding you deeper into the Sonoro.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_1: I didn't see you by the Oak Hollow today…
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_2: You promised we'd go explore Manes Deep together. Don't tell me you got roped into errands again.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_4: Otho got hurt, and Uncle Filo's short on help at the shop, so… I volunteered... but I lost track of time…
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_6: But isn't it odd how people always come asking you for help? We're children, after all.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_9: ...I guess it is High Tide season. Uncle Filo must be busy at his forge. Even Ma and Pa are busy preparing for the hunt.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_10: Sigh… If only we could find our way to Manes Deep. Maybe we'd hear the Hero of Heroes' whispers and gain a mighty Resonance, just like in Grandma Rosa's stories.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_11: If I were strong enough to join the hunt, maybe Ma and Pa wouldn't have to work themselves to the bone.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_13: Sometimes I wish I could be as strong as you.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_15: Average? I don't believe that for a second. Come on, let me see your hand.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_18: Hey... why are you hesitating? Show me.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_22: It's not his fault. I was just being careless...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_23: I asked to borrow some of his old rusty swords… and if I worked fast enough, he'd let me.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_24: Grandma Rosa said you need "two lives" to reach Manes Deep. We don't have our swords yet. We're missing a "life." So I thought if I could get us some...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_25: Not this again... You really can be a handful sometimes...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_28: Yes. Sixteen years ago. Right before the Dark Tide hit.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_30: I think it's trying to lead the way for us this time.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_442_32: You find two Phantoms of the past replaying a memory. A girl named Angel scolds her friend for missing their promised trip to Manes Deep. Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_8: ...The grown-ups keep saying how awful this Dark Tide will be...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_9: And my brother's leg... it won't heal. They said he'll never be a Gladiator now...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_10: In that case... why not try your luck in Oak Hollow?

Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_13: You can't reach Manes Deep without your sword...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_14: It's okay. I'll wait till next time.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_15: I'll find a way to get more swords so everyone can have one.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_17: I feel like I've heard it somewhere before…
Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_19: Looks like there's a garden behind that building.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_445_20: We've got no other leads for now. Let's check it out.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_451_21: Mm… But maybe it also means making people smile. If the Dark Tide disappeared, everyone would be happy, right?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_451_22: That sounds too easy to be true...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_451_23: But if that's all it takes, you've done it already, Augusta. But skip Enric, making a louse like him grin shouldn't count!

Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_4: Heh, guess there's no denying it now. I thought I might keep my foolishness as a child from you.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_5: So Murmurstown... I mean, Fabianum, is your hometown?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_6: Yes. It's been a long time. I never imagined I'd see my past like this.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_8: About Manes Deep and the Oak Hollow?

Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_12: Perhaps that's why Hero of Heroes tales always lingered here. The most popular one was the tale of a great journey to Manes Deep, the ruins of an ancient civilization.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_13: It was said that if you brought "two lives"—yourself and your sword—you'd be granted entry. And within, you'd hear the unceasing whispers of the legendary heroes.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_14: Whispers... they say, capable of awakening a Resonance ability as mighty as the heroes' own.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_15: As for the Oak Hollow said to lead to Manes Deep... just children's tales. No one ever knew if it was real.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_16: But Fabianum never found its Hero of Heroes... Ever since then, the name was lost, replaced by Murmurstown, a scar that Septimont refuses to face...

Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_18: Later, I heard from the senior Gladiators that on the very morning Fabianum fell, most of the Senate lords were still sound asleep in their warm beds...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_19: Heh... it wasn't the Dark Tide that doomed my hometown, but those in power who were blinded by greed and failed to act.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_20: Forgive me. I let my emotions get the better of me.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_21: It's okay. I feel like I've discovered another side of you.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_22: It's okay. I can tell you've always been very sincere.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_23: I see. Then perhaps I should spend more time with you. Like Iuno once did.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_25: Why did the Sonoro reveal all this to us?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_26: Maybe it's helping us find that... um, pure Dark Tide frequency? The scent does feel clearer now, less muddled.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_27: Or maybe... it meant to show us something more.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_28: (Tell Augusta about the Unyielding Gladiator's Spirit.)
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_29: A soul who endured the Dark Tide's corruption... and still fights to speak the truth?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_30: Hmm... his spirit deserves to be remembered. I will go to witness that truth with my own eyes.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_453_1: Those Phantoms up ahead... looks like they've lost control.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_455_5: ...Stay with me. I'll get you out of here.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_455_14: Again, we'll fight them outside the Sonoro.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_457_2: Ha, haha... at least I'm not on my knees...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_458_1: Let's return to the Sonoro. There's likely something new to see there.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_460_1: Stay close, Angel. It'll be alright.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_462_2: Don't let go of my hand! We can't stop here!
Main_Linaxita_2_9_465_2: We... We're not gonna make it...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_465_4: Yes, Angel, hide in the Oak Hollow!
Main_Linaxita_2_9_465_6: Are you going to face it alone?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_465_7: No! Don't! Just come with me...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_465_8: I promised I'd get you out of here.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_467_4: I... I'm not scared! Come on, I'm wide open.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_467_6: Don't look away! I'm not someone you can ignore!
Main_Linaxita_2_9_467_8: Not there! Look at me! I said LOOK AT ME!
Main_Linaxita_2_9_467_10: The Dark Tide answers only to strength. Those without it are doomed to be forsaken...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_467_11: Augusta, my brave yet fragile child… Your strength is far too feeble, unfit to sate the hunger of the Dark Tide.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_467_12: You long to become a hero, to reign by might… But tell me... can the throne of glory be claimed by one so weak?
Main_Linaxita_2_9_467_13: Deeper within the Sonoro Sphere, the guiding "light" leads you to Oak Hollow, where Phantoms replay a tragic scene. Angel lies wounded and paralyzed. That is the first time Augusta begins to hear the Whispers. They accuse her of weakness and deny her dream of becoming a Hero of Heroes.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_468_1: It's over by the alley... Let's go this way!

Augusta surprises you by saying you might be more fitting as the prophesied Hero of Heroes. You counter that a true ruler doesn't need prophecy to lead. Suddenly, you feel a shift within Oak Hollow. The pure Dark Tide frequency you've been hunting might be hiding inside.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_3: The Dark Tide paid me no mind. Its target was always Angel.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_4: And the whispers… they were real, but not as the legends promised. What I heard were words of cruelty.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_5: None of it matters now. Those things belong to the past...
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_6: I was a reckless child, a hatchling flailing with a sword I could barely hold.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_7: But you've grown stronger ever since.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_9: True... though, back then, I didn't really have a choice.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_10: This is Septimont, a place where ideals bow to strength.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_11: As a child, I had no desire for power. But in the City of Septimont, if I wished to rise beyond my origin and silence arrogance dressed in fame and fortune, I had no other path.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_12: Now, my strength speaks in my stead, and my blade cuts down every slander.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_15: But their absurd schemes betray only fear—
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_16: Too afraid to face me, they skulk in the shadows, hoping empty prophecies might bring me to my knees.

Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_19: The Dark Tide still haunts Septimont. People live in terror of losing their homeland again, and so they cling to the hope of a Hero of Heroes.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_20: As Septimont's Ephor, I must stay strong and answer their call.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_21: A ruler has no right to falter.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_22: If my Resonance ability raises doubts about my right to rule, then let the true Hero of Heroes step forth and challenge me.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_23: And if none appear... I will decide whether this title is worthy of the weight of a ruler's glory.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_24: One of the prophecies speaks of a Hero of Heroes wielding extraordinary power, rising from the dark tides. As I see it, you, {PlayerName}, fit that image well.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_25: Should it be you... I would gladly accept your challenge.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_26: A person of immense strength is either a nemesis or a kindred spirit, both of which are intriguing to me and my blade.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_27: Me? Honestly, the thought never crossed my mind.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_28: From what I've seen, being a true ruler isn't about having immense strength, whether that's a powerful Resonance ability or sheer might.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_29: I've met people from Huanglong to Rinascita who live with real integrity. Their skills and backgrounds were all different, and... none of them were perfect.
Main_Linaxita_2_9_470_30: But what defines them isn't strength or anything that can be measured. It's the spirit they were born with. Resilient. Unyielding. That can't be stolen.

Main_Linaxita_2_10_3711_21: Light streams from the bracelet. You've learned how to draw out Iuno's memories, and you wait as they reveal more of her hidden past. The girl who should have watched her mother's death unfold instinctively chose to shut her eyes. After losing the chance to change anything, she vowed to see everything from then on, no matter the cost. That vow led her to become a Priestess. But after countless prophecies, she began to question whether "seeing" truly meant understanding. The Lunarum Bough continues to grow, and the Iuno beside you slowly becomes more whole.

While there's clearly more to him than meets the eye, what matters now is that the Bough's growth has strengthened the anchoring of Iuno's memories and connections. Side_LSZZDYW_10_4: What the...? Did this Echo just pat me on the head? How rude!
Side_LSZZDYW_10_5: Sorry. We're just helping it deliver a song to someone who lives here.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_6: A song? Heh, weird. Well, since I'm the only one left in my family, I guess I'll give it a listen.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_7: The Aria Mummer hands the stubborn girl a Melody Box and begins to play a song. She falls silent after the last note fades.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_8: …Did my Ma ask you to bring this here?
Side_LSZZDYW_10_9: Is your mother the master of this Aria Mummer?
Side_LSZZDYW_10_10: No. I've never seen her with an Echo like this before.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_11: This song must be for her. I heard an accordion. Ma used to love playing the accordion.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_13: Did you and your mother not get along?
Side_LSZZDYW_10_15: Not get along? It was worse than that. We had a big argument before she left for the Den.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_16: She barely came home, and whenever she did, she'd yell at me for not living right and for not preserving her glory by becoming a Gladiator.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_17: But this song… she used to play stuff like this for me. Songs that made me want to be a musician.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_18: You did nothing wrong by following your own dreams.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_20: I wish we hadn't had that argument that day… I… I should have wished her "Happy Hunting"…
Side_LSZZDYW_10_22: ...I'm not crying! I just want to know who wrote this song.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_24: There are plenty of Gladiators who enjoy music, but none would carry an Aria Mummer around.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_25: But… I remember Ma once mentioned a musician friend she met at the Hunter's Den. Maybe that's who you're looking for.
Side_LSZZDYW_10_27: Thank you for bringing me this song. I'll... treasure it forever.
Side_LSZZDYW_11_2: They're quite a renowned family in Septimont. Their eldest son, Galba, is a veteran of the Hunter's Den.
Side_LSZZDYW_11_3: I sent them a message to let them know we were coming, but they never replied… Please don't tell me this is going to be like the last two recipients...
Side_LSZZDYW_11_4: You know, that big mouth of yours is gonna get you in trouble sooner or later.
Side_LSZZDYW_11_5: Don't you worry. Journalists move fast and are hard to hit.
Side_LSZZDYW_11_6: Wait, the door's opening. A medic. I'll go talk to her and see what I can find.
Side_LSZZDYW_12_2: Oh... you're here to see him?
Side_LSZZDYW_12_3: Yes. He's an old friend. I came by to visit him.
Side_LSZZDYW_12_4: I'm sure you're aware of the recent unusual High Tide. His team came under devastating attack by Tacet Discords.
Side_LSZZDYW_12_5: Galba was seriously injured, and he barely made it out alive. He's currently in a coma...
Side_LSZZDYW_12_6: That's terrible… May the Sentinel bless... Ahem, may fortune favor him and bring him back to us.
Side_LSZZDYW_12_8: You mean Mr. Cratus? He's probably hunting Tacet Discords outside the city.
Side_LSZZDYW_12_9: Thank you. That's where we'll be going, then.
Side_LSZZDYW_13_1: The Aria Mummer's frequency is fading… We need to find Cratus quickly.
Side_LSZZDYW_13_2: On it… Hold on. Is that a person in the middle of that group of TDs?
Side_LSZZDYW_14_1: Ha... thank you so much for saving me.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_3: May applause greet you! I'm Cratus. You here to hunt TDs as well?
Side_LSZZDYW_14_5: The Aria Mummer hands Cratus a Melody Box and begins to play a song.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_6: The melody is bold. The trombone, bright. This must be a song for my brother.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_7: My brother was like the trombone in this song: proper, forthright, and admired.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_8: Thank you for bringing us this beautiful song. Did you compose this?
Side_LSZZDYW_14_9: I'm just carrying out someone's request.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_10: So far, it seems the recipients are all members of your brother's team…
Side_LSZZDYW_14_11: Could it be Pulkara? I remember she loved playing the accordion.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_12: Based on what we know, the composer is likely a Ragunnesi lady who enjoys singing and has an Aria Mummer companion…
Side_LSZZDYW_14_13: She sent a song to Ms. Pulkara as well.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_14: My brother once mentioned in a letter that his team had a member from Ragunna who loved to sing and dance.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_15: Aha! At last, a clue. Do you know her name? Was it a woman?
Side_LSZZDYW_14_16: A woman, yes. But my brother never mentioned her name.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_17: There was also another survivor on the team besides my brother, called Aleus.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_18: Maybe he knows something about her.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_19: Aleus? Hmm, he's actually the next person on the list.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_20: Thank you. Looks like we're getting closer to the answer.
Side_LSZZDYW_14_21: You're welcome, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} Champion! I still have much to learn, but I'll meet you in a duel in the arena someday!
Side_LSZZDYW_15_2: Haha… other than our comatose Captain, it's just you and me now.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_3: Are you here to reprimand me? I failed Strozzia. If you want to punch me, go ahead. I deserve it.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_5: Seems like we've got our answer, {PlayerName}!
Side_LSZZDYW_15_7: …I was in Galba's team. We were stationed near the Hunter's Den, keeping tabs on TD activity during the High Tide.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_8: We wrapped up a hunt that day and held a celebration feast at camp.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_9: But something was nagging our Captain. After the feast, he ordered us to patrol the camp's perimeter. I had too many drinks, so I stayed behind.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_10: When I heard the alarm go off, I rushed out, only to see waves of TDs rushing toward camp...
Side_LSZZDYW_15_11: I ran to my team as fast as I could... I only found Strozzia, severely wounded and shielding the Captain with her own body…
Side_LSZZDYW_15_12: She said she couldn't make it and told me to get the Captain out.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_13: Why did I drink so much that day? I should've been out there with them… revelling in that glorious last stand.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_15: But if I'd gone with them… maybe… maybe they'd all still be here…
Side_LSZZDYW_15_16: Wait, Strozzia sounds like someone who couldn't fight. Why was she on your team?
Side_LSZZDYW_15_17: She was our support. The Captain approved it himself.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_18: They say she was from Ragunna. Her story was that she couldn't make a name for herself there, so she came to Septimont for inspiration to create songs no Ragunnesi had ever heard before.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_19: She couldn't even play a proper tune when she first got here.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_20: Honestly, I thought she just wanted to act out some romantic story of sacrifice. Typical Ragunnesi.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_21: Hey, watch your... Forget it. Go on.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_22: Over time, Gattuso, the cheery one on the team, started helping her, told her all about Septimont. Even invited her over to his place while off duty and introduced his little brother to her.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_23: Pulkara was all tough at first, but she eventually warmed up to her. I often saw them playing the accordion together, with Grisoni as accompaniment.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_24: Strozzia's music changed. I could tell she's grown to truly love Septimont.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_25: So when she asked to stay on the team as our support, I voted yes. She earned it.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_26: I taught her how to hold a sword and the skills needed to defend herself. She said she wanted to write a song for each of us, not for fame, but to commemorate our time together...
Side_LSZZDYW_15_27: …She must've followed the Captain out of camp in search of inspiration that day.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_28: If you hadn't taught her how to hold a sword, she might not have been able to bring Galba back.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_29: …Is this the song she wrote for me? That clarinet… Such a clear and elegant melody…
Side_LSZZDYW_15_30: Is this how she saw me? Was I ever like that?
Side_LSZZDYW_15_31: I'll be honest with you, brother, drowning yourself in remorse isn't a good look.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_33: There are still things you can do.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_34: Don't let Strozzia's song go to waste.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_35: …You're right. There are things I must do.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_36: I need to recover the weapons of my comrades. I'm the only one left who still recognizes them.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_37: Thank you all. And thank you, Grisoni. The melody of this song will forever be engraved in my heart, as a reminder of the person I am meant to be.
Side_LSZZDYW_15_38: This Aria Mummer... Are you Grisoni?
Side_LSZZDYW_16_2: That makes the final box. Anything else you wanna do? Let us know.
Side_LSZZDYW_16_4: Hmm… It says it wants to go back to its master's home and meet her brother, {PlayerName}.
Side_LSZZDYW_16_5: But its travelled with its master for so long, it's not sure if its master's family moved some place else or not…
Side_LSZZDYW_16_6: Strozzia… Strozzia… Now that we have her name, it makes things easy. I know basically everyone in Ragunna.
Side_LSZZDYW_16_7: You're smarter than you look. Shocker!
Side_LSZZDYW_16_8: Excuse me?! Does this Echo of yours specialize in words that inflict emotional damage, {PlayerName}?
Side_LSZZDYW_16_9: Hey! I'm right here, you know? Show this Echo some respect!
Side_LSZZDYW_16_10: My apologies, I don't usually talk to coffee machines or phonographs.
Side_LSZZDYW_16_11: Give me a second. My colleague in Ragunna just replied! They've found the address of the Strozzia residence. They never moved.
Side_LSZZDYW_16_12: When did you even send that message?!
Side_LSZZDYW_16_13: Journalist's hidden ability. A trade secret. Anyway, let's go visit Ms. Strozzia's family.
Side_LSZZDYW_16_14: If we waste any more time, the Aria Mummer will be sent back to the Resonance Nexus.
Side_LSZZDYW_16_15: (Given Grisoni's current frequency strength, I wouldn't be surprised if it returns to the Nexus right this moment… It's holding on through willpower, like a human.)
Side_LSZZDYW_18_1: Ah, you're the Laureate! What an honor to receive your visit!
Side_LSZZDYW_18_2: Is there something I can help you with?
Side_LSZZDYW_18_5: It's been five or six years since I last saw my sister. I thought she'd eventually come back to the family business after realizing that being a musician was nothing but a pipe dream.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_6: But it seems I underestimated her resolve. Perhaps from the day she left me that letter, she was no longer the little sister who would hide behind me, while our parents scolded us.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_7: No, maybe it was even before that, when she refused to attend the same school as I did.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_8: If I had talked to her sooner, or given her more support, she might not have traveled to Septimont all by herself… I should have reached out to her, asked about her life there…
Side_LSZZDYW_18_9: Sigh... I can't imagine how much she hated me...
Side_LSZZDYW_18_10: Julio starts to cry. At that moment, the Aria Mummer begins playing a song.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_11: This tune… is a Ragunnesi lullaby. It was quite popular twenty years ago.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_12: Ah… this… this is the one I used to sing for her.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_13: I'm ten years older than her, so I pretty much raised her with our parents. Even when she was in middle school, she would come to my room to hide from the storms.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_14: But… how does Grisoni know this lullaby? It wasn't part of our family back then.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_16: Because this was Strozzia's favorite song.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_18: I don't suppose anyone would keep playing a song sung by someone they hate, would they? Your sister never hated you. She just wanted a life of her own.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_19: Strozzia's teammate, Pulkara, has a daughter who wants to be a musician because of her mother's love for the accordion.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_20: I'm sure Grisoni risked everything to come back to Ragunna and tell you that its master became a musician because of her love for her older brother.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_21: Even in her final moments, she was thinking of you.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_23: Grisoni embraces Julio as the beautiful melody echoes from its chest.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_24: I see, I will carry my sister's love in my heart.
Side_LSZZDYW_18_25: If she never hated me, then that's one more reason to live a happy life…
Side_LSZZDYW_18_26: Maybe when the time comes, somewhere out there, our souls will meet again…
Side_LSZZDYW_18_27: In the glow of Julio's tearful smile, Grisoni's body dissolves into countless specks of light, flowing like a river of stars toward the Resonance Nexus.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_1: The Echo wasn't following orders from its master. It acted on its own, traveling from the Hunter's Den to Septimont City to make the deliveries, then back to Ragunna…
Side_LSZZDYW_19_2: It's remarkable. I wonder if Echoes really have feelings of their own.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_3: I can't say for sure, but I can share with you a true story...
Side_LSZZDYW_19_4: (Tell Pierrot the story of Cartethyia and the Echoes.)
Side_LSZZDYW_19_5: (Tell Pierrot the story of the Echoes from the Troupe of Fools.)
Side_LSZZDYW_19_6: Echoes that the Blessed Maiden grew up with still worried about her even after being corrupted by the Dark Tide… Incredible, indeed.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_7: Echoes that thought they had been abandoned by their masters, yet still traveled to the farthest islands to find them… Incredible, indeed.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_8: Well, I'm not saying I don't believe your story. I've even seen a talking Echo with my own eyes, after all.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_9: It's just… I suddenly get this feeling that this vast world I see might only be a tiny corner of an infinite universe.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_10: I'm planning to write an article about Strozzia and her team. And, of course, about her Echo.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_11: It'll take some time, so you'd better not forget the exclusive interview you promised me!
Side_LSZZDYW_19_13: Thought I'd get away with it...
Side_LSZZDYW_19_14: Great. I knew our Laureate wouldn't go back on {Male=his;Female=her} word.
Side_LSZZDYW_19_15: I knew it! Don't you forget about it! I'll come find you once I'm done!
Side_LSZZDYW_19_16: I've got work on this article now. Until next time! Don't forget to fit me into your busy schedule!

Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_11: Little lamb, your hostility pains me. I came to aid you. You wish to Anchor to her? A simple task.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_13: Then we'll just go find them ourselves!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_14: Hehehehe... The Dark Tide mirrors the chaos of the human mind—shifting, twisting. A fleeting thought, and the path ahead may vanish beneath your feet.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_15: Leviathan lurks in the depths of this world, building Its kingdom, bending this place into Its image.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_16: This place is molded by the Journeying Paradise's frequency. A vision of perfection, unmarred by flaw.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_17: But behold, the Dark Tide's true face. A world of hatred, fear, and despair. The world your kind calls... Hell.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_18: Leviathan merged Paradise and Hell with Its power of assimilation, cloaking rot in radiance.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_19: Yet the mask is flawed. The Paradise is incomplete. These twin worlds bleed into one another to create spatial anomalies.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_20: Countless souls caught between light and shadow, adrift without rudder or self... Lured by false hope, they stumble into Its waiting arms.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_22: I will guide you. Walk with me through this wasteland. If you wish to "see" her, then walk her path. Endure what she endured.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_23: You will hear despair's screams. See the dead beg for death. Watch souls willingly burn in cleansing fire… What is it, are you afraid?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_25: Are you trying to deceive me?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_28: Deceive you? No. "I" thirst for true, brutal battle. If I wished you dead, I would not skulk in shadow.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_29: Good... I've seen many enter this realm, valiant, burning with purpose, just like you. But in the end... Heheheh. I hope you endure longer than most.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_30: Her plan is bold. But an unwonted frequency has mingled into the Dark Tide. I know not who it is. This path will prove less smooth than she hoped.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_31: But for now, you have no choice, do you?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_32: Come, little lamb. Open your eyes, sharpen your claws. It's time we journey into the underworld.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_22_33:
You land in another world. It's not the chaos you expected, but something almost holy. Yet beneath its solemn surface lies a sinister, unsettling frequency.

Your first goal is to reunite with Galbrena, but you barely know anything about her and have no memories to Anchor to.

At that moment, Galbrena's companion, a Tacet Discord called Chimera, appears. He reveals the truth of this Dark Tide world and offers to help you Anchor to Galbrena and guide you through this land.

Follow him. The journey into the underworld begins now.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_32_41:
In yet another memory, you witness Galbrena turn the Dark Tide's power against itself to devour Tidespawn. In the end, Chimera appeared and helped her escape.

But even after escaping, Galbrena was relentlessly hunted by the Tidespawn. Fearing she might endanger Rinascita, she chose exile, fleeing her homeland for distant lands. Over time, she learned to track Tacet Discords through the Dark Tide's fluctuations, roaming the wilds to warn others of impending disasters. It was during this exile that she encountered a Flame Demon Tacet Discord named "Galbrena."

What came after, the Dark Tide cannot reveal. Chimera will tell the rest...

At last, she reveals the plan she and Cartethyia devised. Leviathan, revived through the Gem, has merged back into the Dark Tide, like water returning to the sea. To defeat It, Its form must first be Anchored. Cartethyia proposed using the <ano=Threnodian's power>godhood</ano> within her—its frequency now nearly indistinguishable from her humanity—as bait. If Leviathan could be lured into consuming her humanity, it would be Anchored in the process.

Then Galbrena's Dark Tide bullet devoured the frequency of her humanity, sending it into the Dark Tide. But since Leviathan cannot discern truth, only belief, the one closest to Cartethyia had to truly believe she was dead. Only then would Leviathan lower Its guard, letting the deception succeed.
 
You see the unshakable resolve in Galbrena's eyes. In return, you offer her your trust once again.

Though Scar is driven back, his attack was only a diversion. High atop the Three Heroes' Crest, Phrolova's "symphony" is already in motion. A rain of Lycoris corrupts the Anti-Corrosion Wards, and the Dark Tide surges through the breach to swallow the lowlands of Septimont. To reach you, she ignited her own life force, Overclocking her power to tear open the Dark Tide's illusion. Chimera bore part of the cost for her. Meanwhile, when Septimont and your companions were engulfed by the Dark Tide, the Echoes responded to humanity's hope and resolve. They came together in their strongest form to aid. Though the Anchor Stone was destroyed, your companions still followed a different beacon. You, the "Anchor of Hope."

Through the Dark Tide, all of your memories connected. They have learned of Galbrena and Cartethyia's plan too. But Abby can no longer bear the burden of the Gem. Galbrena offers to use her power of devouring to seal the Gem within herself. It is for this very reason that the Fractsidus made her their target.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_50_47:
On the final path leading to the Paradise, Cristoforo once again blocks your path.

He reveals the Fractsidus's goal: to become beings equal to the gods themselves, and to rewrite "humanity's fate."

No matter how noble their reasoning, you cannot condone their methods. Still, Cristoforo extends an offer: to make you the "Quillbearer," granting you the authority to write the fate of humankind.

But humanity's fate belongs to no one but humanity itself. You make your stance known. Cristoforo, however, has already seen through your plan. Because Abby still carries the frequency of the Ovathrax, if it attempts to absorb the Gem, Leviathan may merge with that power and complete Its rebirth.

Your strategy is exposed, but you refuse to abandon hope. Cristoforo steps aside, and in the next instant, Leviathan's wrath descends. Let your free will rise against the divine. Let it prove you worthy to seize the right to write fate with your own hands.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_52_9:

Rest for now. The final act of your story awaits.

The Sentinel reveals the origins of Leviathan and Rinascita. After long contemplation, They entrusted humanity with the right to decide the course of civilization, sacrificing Themself to become a shackle to bind the Threnodian. What followed, you already know well...

After Imperator's voice fades, Galbrena appears. You confront her, but she simply tosses you Cartethyia's pendant. Resonating with it, you confirm it is real, but the message embedded in Cartethyia's frequency only deepens the mystery: everything they have done is for one purpose—to defeat Leviathan.

Galbrena explains that Leviathan is on the verge of rebirth, incubated by the Fractsidus using the Threnodian's Gem. To prevent their plan from falling into the wrong hands, she cannot reveal more. She asks you to accept one truth: the Blessed Maiden is dead, and only by defeating Leviathan can she be "resurrected."

The priority now is finding the new Harbinger of the Dark Tide. Galbrena already suspects Avidius, but you still harbor doubts about the Dark Tide power she carries. She responds by saying that whether you trust her or not, her hunt will go on.
 
As the Sentinel's frequency fades completely and the space begins to collapse, you choose to form a temporary alliance with the Discord Slayer.

Its analysis revealed it to be the Civilization Capsule, likely containing the Sentinel's legacy data. But for reasons unknown, it requires the combined forces of both the Sentinel and the Threnodian to open. With no clear solution, you return once again to Ragunna, hoping to find answers from Cartethyia in the Inverted Tower.

Back in Ragunna, however, the atmosphere is thick with a strange tension. The only splash of color comes from a Troupe of Fools performance. As you and Abby pause to watch, Cristoforo's whisper slips into your ear...

As you ponder this, a Thundering Mephis ambushes from above. A spear knocks it away just in time. It is Avidius, your old comrade from Septimont.

They destroyed the Genesis Nexus, making Common Echoes unusable. The Montelli family, after consulting with the Order, has begun to evacuate civilians to Averardo Vault. Avidius was escorting villagers from Egla Town through this area when he heard rumors about this killer. He, too, once crossed paths with her and sensed the Dark Tide's frequency within her.
