Main_Rinascita_2_11_18_14: The Ragunnesi know not my name, past, nor the prophecy I once carried. Here... I am a completely blank page.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_18_15: During your pursuit of the Thundering Mephis, you learn that Avidius originally came to Ragunna in search of the Quillbearer. But along the way, he discovered something far more meaningful, a chance to be the master of his own destiny…
Main_Rinascita_2_11_181_1: The Anchor Stone is holding strong. Let's push forward.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_2_2: That was Cristoforo's voice just now... Is this another one of his illusions?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_2_3: Buling's bronze mirror isn't responding... Abby?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_2_4: ...No answer. This isn't like what happened in Septimont. Guess I can only keep moving and find out why.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_21_1: Is that an entrance to a Paradimensional Tacet Field?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_21_2: Ragunna's geographical records haven't documented this...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_21_3: Do you feel that? That ominous energy... the Anchor Stone confirms the Thundering Mephis is hiding here.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_21_5: That's our best lead right now.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_21_6: Very well. I stand with you. Whatever comes, you have my sword.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_21_7: Together, you and Avidius follow the trail of the Dark Tide and discover a Paradimensional Tacet Field that shouldn't be there. Seeking the truth, you step boldly into it…
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_1: What happened? Where's Avidius? We crossed inside at the same time.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_4: So you just barrel in without thinking...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_5: That voice... the Discord Slayer? Is this her trap?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_7: Focus. You are in an illusion. It's weaponizing your combat instincts.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_8: Steady your resolve. Do not let its whispers sway you.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_9: The pain and hallucinations are fading... Is she helping me?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_10: Good. See that Cocoon in the center? The Thundering Mephis is just bait. That right there is the core of this domain.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_11: Destroy it. Then the monster and this illusion will unravel together.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_22_17:
Within the Paradimensional Tacet Field, the illusion returns, disrupting your battle with the Thundering Mephis. From the darkness, the Discord Slayer's voice emerges, revealing a way to break free.

After breaking the illusion, you call out to her, but she doesn't seem to be there at all. Still, her words reach you: to prevent an even greater calamity, she too is searching for the Harbinger of the Dark Tide.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_221_2: Who are you?! And what did you do to Cartethyia?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_221_3: ...Now is not the time for stories.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_221_4: But I'll tell you this. I'm here to kill the Harbinger of the Dark Tide. To stop a greater calamity.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_221_5: I can't hear her voice anymore... Time to leave this place.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_1: {PlayerName}! Are you unharmed? You vanished the moment we entered the Tacet Field.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_2: I'm fine... So, it's gone? Avidius, did you see anything after we got separated?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_3: The Thundering Mephis was nowhere in sight. But I did observe a peculiar figure.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_4: I couldn't see his face clearly, but I heard him call himself... Caligula.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_6: Caligula was a tyrant feared throughout Septimont's history. Notorious for his cruelty that defied reason, the world remembers him as the "Mad King."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_7: Legends say he wielded a vile black Resonance energy, and the worst calamities ever stirred by the Dark Tide all began with him.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_8: He didn't fight it. He embraced it. Commanded its abominations. Bent them to his will. In the end, the people rose against him... and struck him down.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_9: But not before he left a curse: "I shall become the very history and memory of Septimont. So long as fear lingers in your hearts, I shall return."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_10: (The power to command the Dark Tide's creations... Only a Harbinger could do that.)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_11: (That Discord Slayer said she's hunting a Harbinger to stop a greater calamity. If that's true, then everything happening across Ragunna might be tied to the Harbinger.)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_12: (She pulled me from the illusion. If she's the cause of this chaos, why help me?)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_13: (This isn't making sense. Harbinger... who are you, really?)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_14: {PlayerName}, traces of the Dark Tide's frequency still linger where the Paradimensional Tacet Field collapsed.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_15: The Anchor Stone is useless now. The signal is blocked by some sort of spatial layer.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_16: Augusta said the Dark Tide spoke to her when it swallowed her whole. Maybe... I can learn something that way.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_17: My telepathic ability should give me a way in.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_18: Telepathy? Your Grace is versed in many arts. I don't doubt your abilities, but this is the Dark Tide. Reckless contact could—
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_19: I don't want to see... another tragedy like what befell Septimont.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_21: It's just a meeting of minds.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_23: We're falling behind. The Discord Slayer knows far more than we do. We need to find her, and fast.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_24: I'm not letting any leads slip past us.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_23_25:
You reunite with Avidius after leaving the Paradimensional Tacet Field.

Though you entered together, what he saw within was the figure of Caligula, a tyrant reviled in Septimont's history, said to have wielded the Harbinger's power and brought calamity to the land. According to the Discord Slayer, the strange anomalies plaguing Ragunna are also tied to the Harbinger.

But who is the true Harbinger? The mystery only deepens. To uncover more clues, you turn to your telepathic skills to seek the Dark Tide's next move...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_2: I can't see anything... I'm only getting jumbled voices.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_3: Focus. I should be able to hear something.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_4: Okay, everybody listen. Don't panic. Take the lift. It will bring you to safety...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_5: The prototype Echoes in the depositories... Activate them all...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_7: They're in Averardo Vault. The Dark Tide creations could be appearing there.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_8: It's currently sheltering a large number of civilians...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_9: Let's not waste time. We leave now.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_10: You attempt to connect telepathically with the Dark Tide's traces. No visions appear, but you hear the voices of Carlotta and Zani, hinting that Dark Tide creations may be appearing in Averardo Vault, where countless civilians have taken refuge.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_2: Eighty percent of Ragunna's residents have been relocated.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_3: But... the Troupe of Fools hit a storm while ferrying people from the Riccioli Islands. Rough seas out there.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_4: Trust them to see it through.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_5: Miss Carlotta! We've cleared the depositories as ordered. Ready to receive incoming supplies.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_6: Good. Rinascita's greatest treasure has always been the people who built it. The next Cloudpuffer Express is due at any moment. Be ready to offload.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_10: If you mean the incident in Ragunna... You've likely already heard. A horde of Tacet Discords has overrun the city, and Common Echoes are out of control...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_11: Evacuation here is still on track. No anomalies detected in Averardo Vault… yet.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_12: Your assistance is appreciated, Sir Avidius. The residents from Egla Town have all been accounted for.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_13: I am simply fulfilling my duty.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_14: (Strange... I clearly sensed the Dark Tide's presence around here. So why does everything seem normal?)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_17: You and Avidius rush there, only to find most civilians already evacuated, with no signs of Dark Tide creations. Just as doubt begins to set in, the sound of familiar gunfire echoes through the Vault...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_1: These Tidespawn... They've evolved fast. Mutation? Or...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_3: Entering a restricted zone armed, without triggering a single alarm...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_4: Be careful. Her abilities... are not normal.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_6: All this in broad daylight? Brazen.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_7: Let's not jump to conclusions just yet.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_8: Fiction and reality are starting to blur. Don't put your faith in appearances.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_9: That... is what they really are.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_10: The Dark Tide can corrupt, and you carry its power. What proof do we have this isn't your doing?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_11: You don't. Believe whatever you want.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_12: By the sacred statues of the Divinity, evil shall know no peace. Only the righteous may taste eternity. Wickedness shall be purged by the blade, and those who consort with calamity shall fall...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_13: Galbrena, demon wrought from ruin! You are not welcome here.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_15: You have slaughtered my flock and ushered in ruin. The Sentinel's wrath is already upon you. I will cast you back into damnation myself before your carnage spreads any further.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_16: You should be howling in the Styx's depths, your soul aflame in the pit's cruelest fire... forever.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_17: If you're offering me a shortcut back to hell, I'd honestly appreciate the favor.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_18: Your heart holds no reverence for the Divine. Only... desecration and scorn.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_19: Demon, your sins are ripe for judgment. By the Highest Will's command, I shall strike down all that you have wrought. Justice shall be done!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_20: (She could've dodged that... but she took the hit to shield a civilian?)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_21: (And Fenrico... he knew innocents were here, but didn't hold back at all...)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_22: Righteous One, I come to cleanse Rinascita of a traitorous demon and avenge the blood debts of my people. Why raise your blade against me?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_23: Rinascita teeters on the edge of collapse. Now, more than ever, we must uphold the tenets of Unity and Salvation.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_24: The path to deliverance lies within the Civilization Capsule. Entrust it to me. By the authority bestowed upon me, I will open... the gates to the divine Paradise.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_26: I never told you about the Civilization Capsule.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_27: They might not know, but I do. You're the Harbinger.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_28: Unless... You're not Fenrico at all. You... Who are you? What do you want?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_29: ...Bloodshed cannot be avoided. Blood must pay for blood. The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_30: My goal is pure. Singular. All I've done, I've done so Rinascita survives the Divine reckoning and rises as a land free from sorrow.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_31: No understanding is needed. Only faith. When all hope seems lost, I... no, we are the beginning and the end. The absolution. And the grace.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_33: ...So the Civilization Capsule is your goal after all. Lost your patience, have you?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_34: Death is the fruit of transgression. To resist it is to defy the will of the Divinity.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_35: You? You and your Divinity cannot end me...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_36: And these Dark Tide shams... Today, you face your reckoning.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_37: I am the Enlightened One, anointed by the Divinity and crowned by Fate itself.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_38: Huh, so you're the "core" of these abominations. Took long enough to hunt you down. Still pretending that mask isn't cracked?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_39: Mocked by fate, whispering poison, a demon reviled by all! You wield the Dark Tide's power, yet you dare judge me?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_40: It's too bad I'm not the one judging. If the Dark Tide's power isn't enough to convince... How about we try this?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_41: "The Envoys declare the guilt, but Imperator is the only true judge…"
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_42: By the Light of Imperator... REPENT!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_44: Looks like the judgment is clear.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_45: These <ano=Tidespawn>hollow existences</ano> don't need your mercy.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_46: Protect the Civilization Capsule. That's what they're really after.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_47:
Following the gunshots, you witness what appears to be the Discord Slayer firing on civilians, only to realize these "civilians" are actually Dark Tide creations, Tidespawn, in disguise. Avidius accuses her of corrupting them with the very Dark Tide power she wields... 

Suddenly, Fenrico, meant to be stationed at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, appears. He calls the woman "Galbrena" and unleashes a devastating assault. Galbrena takes the blow to shield the civilians behind her. When "Fenrico" demands that you give him the Civilization Capsule, you begin to doubt his true intentions.
 
Tensions erupt. Though pierced by Fenrico's sword, Galbrena "rises from death." Dismissing his words, she hurls her lantern-like Terminal into the air, where it detonates, scattering the Light of Genesis. The burst reveals more disguised Tidespawn as battle erupts…
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_1: How were they able to disguise themselves as humans?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_2: I've never heard of any possessing such abilities...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_4: Their fangs are bared now. Don't hesitate. Let's end them all.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_5: The one mimicking the Primus is the heart. Take it down, and the rest will collapse with it.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_6: It's calling in more of them... We'll need to clear the rabble while waiting for our shot.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_7: That which cometh from the sea... Shall walk upon the land...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_8: It shall work great wonders and mark the flesh of Its faithful...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_27_9: All who have ears to hear... Let them hear...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_28_1: Avidius, you have received the blessing of my Master. Serve... your true Divinity.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_3_2: Mistaking rebellion and recklessness for glory, like an inferior gem made precious only by how it glitters. Yes, even the castoffs of lesser branches can earn admiration if they shine bright enough.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_3_3: She couldn't control the monstrous family legacy, so she turned to bravado. An armor crafted to hide her naivety and fear.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_3_4: Fragile. False. But oh, how brilliantly a gem shines... in the instant it shatters.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_1: {PlayerName}! Good... looks like you haven't run into too much trouble.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_3: What happened when I was gone?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_4: It hasn't been long since you disappeared into the rift. Once that thing masquerading as Fenrico was slain, the other Tidespawn didn't last.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_5: That was the last one. With the family's Private Echo arsenal backing us up, we held the line just fine.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_6: Surely you didn't think we'd fall apart without you? We Ragunnesi are made of sterner stuff than that. We handled those creatures just fine.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_7: This Feilian Beringal... When the "core" was destroyed, the other Tidespawn lost their form. For now, the Vault is secure. At least until the next wave spawns.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_8: I'd set up Order Terminals around the perimeter though. They'll detect humanoid mimics and prevent new Tidespawn from forming here.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_13: Sir Avidius made it out of the rift before you.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_14: But... he didn't look great. Kept muttering about needing to "stop the crisis," then off he went, like a man on fire.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_15: We need to track him down.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_16: That one really knows how to pick his moments...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_18: I left a mark on Avidius during our fight earlier. With <ano=the Tacet Discord "Beholder">Balor's</ano> power, I can tap into his sight. We'll find his trail.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_21: No... I'll be damned before I accept a fate like that...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_22: There must be something left I can still do...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_23: I won't let the same tragedy... happen twice...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_25: We've lost contact with Cantarella. The Beacon on her end appears to have been destroyed.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_26: Dark clouds are gathering over Thessaleo Fells... Something is definitely wrong.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_27: The two of us will go reinforce her.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_28: You stay and protect the civilians here.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_29: ...Very well. We'll hold the line. Zani, call in the family's transport Echoes. We'll assist {PlayerName} where we can.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_30: Don't complicate things. Put those Echoes toward supply runs instead.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_31: Stay close. We're taking the sky route.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_32:
Escaping the Civilization Capsule with Galbrena, you learn that the Averardo Vault crisis has passed, but Avidius has vanished.

Using her abilities, Galbrena tracks his location, and together you ride her wind trail toward Thessaleo Fells.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_1: Manipulating the air to form a wind trail... Is that your Resonance Ability?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_2: One of them. I have the Tacet Discord <ano=half-bird half-woman>Harpyia</ano> within me.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_3: Not an Echo, but a Tacet Discord itself... So you can absorb them directly?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_4: You can say that. Balor is one of many.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_5: One of many... Now I'm really curious about you and your abilities.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_6: If we live through this, maybe I'll tell you. But right now...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_7: We need to find the Harbinger. Do you know how we can identify them?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_8: First things first, they'll be corrupted by the Dark Tide. But the signs aren't always so visible.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_9: We'll have to look for associated side effects, and prepare for what they might bring.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_10: We've entered Thessaleo Fells. I can already sense the Tidespawn up ahead...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_35_11: That's... a Fisalia member! We need to help him!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_351_3: Dark Tide creations swarmed without warning. We were overrun before we could—
Main_Rinascita_2_11_3512_1: Thank you! Lady Cantarella is still on the frontlines fighting. Would you please help to reinforce her position?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_1: It's too late, my Lady... My mind... can't be fixed. Save your potions for those who still have hope...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_2: I only beg... don't let me die a monster. Don't let me become Leviathan's puppet...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_3: GhhhaaAAAAGH—! I see it... The End Times... Paradise... descending at last! AHAHAHAHA!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_4: {PlayerName}... She is... Why are you with her?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_6: Let's handle the crisis first, and I'll explain later.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_7: ...The Fisalia bloodline's ties with Leviathan run too deep. Their ancient fears were the first to be awakened.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_8: This is the true horror of the evolved Dark Tide. It feeds on human despair, warping that frequency to form Tidespawn.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_9: Your family's "antidote" can still cure those lightly infected. But for those whose corruption runs deep, like him... Their frequencies cannot be reversed.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_10: All we can offer is the dignity of dying as a human.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_11: My Lady... don't let me burden... those who still have hope...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_12: Matriarch of Fisalia, I understand the cruelty of such a choice. If you cannot strike the final blow... allow me.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_13: ...Fisalia blood must be ended by Fisalia hands.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_14: Thank you... May glory return to the Fisalias...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_17: The dead rest. The living march forward... The Fisalia will never forget its fallen sons and daughters.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_18: Cartethyia remains secure in the Fisalia estate. But the Divinity's statue began whispering in our minds... Then came the Tidespawn soon after.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_19: It was Leviathan's voice. Something has... awakened It.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_20: It's very likely Avidius. Right now, everything is riding on us finding him.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_21: That Septimontian Gladiator... Our scouts saw him advancing into the depths of Thessaleo Fells.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_23: Thessaleo Fells... It's already... Attention! Deploy all Acolytes to set up temporary Resonance Beacons. Scattering the Light of Genesis will hold back the Tidespawn!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_24: Acolyte Phoebe! A cluster of Tidespawn is marching toward the depths of Thessaleo Fells！
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_26: I'll use my Forte to diffuse the family's antidote. It should help to mitigate the Dark Tide's influence.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_27: We'll triage the wounded and fortify this position. The Order's Acolytes will clear a path for you. Please, you have to stop this!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_28: Whether the Sentinel comes or not, we are Their will made flesh! We protect Rinascita!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_29: O Light of Genesis, shield us! As we were at the dawn, so we stand today as the Sentinel's soldiers!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_36_30:
Tidespawn have already swarmed Thessaleo Fells. There, you witness the true horror of the Dark Tide. Facing Gilberto, who is on the verge of becoming a Tidespawn himself, Cantarella makes the painful choice to end his suffering and preserve his humanity in death.

The departed may rest, but the living must carry on. Avidius has already set out toward the depths of the Fells. Meanwhile, the Acolytes of the Order arrive in time to clear a path for you.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_37_1: The Order's Acolytes are holding off the other Tidespawn. This is our chance to go straight for the source.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_2: Forgive me... that you have to see me like this...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_4: Why has Thessaleo Fells become like this?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_5: When the Civilization Capsule opened, I was dragged inside. A black frequency took hold of me. Swallowed me whole.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_6: I saw Rinascita's beginnings, and the memories of... so many of its people.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_7: I saw him too—Caligula. His face was like mine... He was my past, and the future I am meant to inherit...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_8: ...Leviathan used the Dark Tide's frequency to force those memories into him.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_9: You said you'd become the master of your own destiny!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_10: No one gets to decide who you are!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_11: Yes, I once said... that I would write my own story... define my own "existence"...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_12: But after I left that space, I suddenly felt the Tidespawn's movements. They were converging on Thessaleo Fells. I still wanted... to do something, anything, to stop the devastation.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_13: But once again, I stepped blindly into the <ano=Fate>churning river of Chaos</ano>. The Fisalia's oldest memories awoke ahead of time. Because of me...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_14: Countless Tidespawn emerged in my wake. I tried to drive them back, but I... overestimated myself... and was corrupted by them.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_15: My hopes and dreams... all of it was real. So why? Why did it all come to this?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_16: From Septimont to Ragunna, the blame lies with me. Perhaps this is the fate I could never outrun. Caligula's fate... It's calling to me!
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_17: Damn it. His mind is being consumed by Caligula's memories.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_18: This is the role Fate wrote for me. Fate decrees I become the Mad King. So why... why should I reject its crown?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_38_19: I am the one who glimpsed "Fate" itself... And now, I will reveal it to the world...

The girl turns toward him. Before Avidius's eyes, she slowly merges with the image of Galbrena, then fades away.

While only a fragmented memory, it reminds Avidius that even in this war against fate, there is still something he can do...

You and Galbrena make your way back, checking on the wounded along the way.

While comforting a little girl, your Tacet Mark suddenly flares with an ominous glow. The girl transforms into a Tidespawn, and everything around you freezes. A whisper from Cartethyia brushes against your ear, and a vast gate appears in the distance. Galbrena breaks from her stillness and erupts in flames, firing a bullet at the gate while summoning a Tacet Discord named Chimera to strike at you—

You snap awake from the "illusion" to see the terrified and hostile faces of the Fisalias before you.

Cantarella calms them and explains that your emotions resonated with those around you, causing your Tacet Mark to open a "portal" that dragged you into the illusion. This "portal" fed on your presence to spread malice and fear into the real world. But before it could fully take shape, Galbrena broke into the illusion and stopped it.

A chilling realization strikes you. If that "portal" opened because of you, then it can only mean one thing. The Harbinger of the Dark Tide... is you.

Main_Rinascita_2_11_431_49:
Even after drinking the Fisalia's family "antidote," your heart remains unsettled.

Galbrena's words help reveal that it is Abby who has been corrupted by the Dark Tide. Because you share life and energy, the corruption passed to you as well. Now, the only way to reverse it is to defeat Leviathan and destroy Its Paradise.

From the Fisalia's ancient records, you learn that the Dark Tide is the "subconscious ocean of the Rinascitans' shared trauma." You also uncover Leviathan's final plan to bring Its Paradise to the world. Galbrena and Cartethyia have a plan to stop this, but because you bear the Mark of the Dark Tide, Leviathan can read your thoughts. For this reason, they cannot reveal everything to you. Yet throughout this journey, you have felt the trust others have placed in you. You are not just the "Harbinger of Despair," you are also a vessel of Rinascita's hopes. In this war of spirit, only an unshakable resolve can stand against Leviathan.

Galbrena spreads her wings and takes flight. With the Dark Tide in Ragunna contained, it's time for the next step. You prepare to head to Septimont. Everything will come to a head there.

Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_13: I'm preparing to leave for Septimont.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_14: I still have some matters to attend to.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_15: The records say that since the dawn of civilization, Leviathan, under the guise of Imperator, wormed Its way into the Rinascitans' faith and thought.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_16: When discovered by the Sentinel, Leviathan hastily unleashed the first Dark Tide, attempting to harvest the civilization.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_17: In that battle, the Sentinel was assimilated by the Threnodian. But in doing so, Imperator bound Leviathan, entrusting <ano=the "lantern" filled with Their power>the First Relic</ano> to the First Primus.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_18: The calamity was quelled by Napoli the Second, but Leviathan's "poison" left deep scars on Ragunna and Septimont.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_19: Since then, every Primus has upheld the "Oath of Silence" to hide the truth—the people once worshipped the Threnodian.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_20: And yet... even in chains, Leviathan used "twisted faith" to spur conflict. Suffering, turmoil, and struggle that followed all continued to feed It...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_21: The "Dark Tide of this world" was a calamity wrought by Leviathan's hand. But the heads of our family have long suspected that Rinascitans have always harbored a "spiritual Dark Tide."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_22: It takes root in the shadows, deep in the valleys of our fears. When the Threnodian draws forth enough anguish, It may call a Dark Tide into being. And in the terror of calamity... It feasts.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_23: The "whispers" once planted an idea in our minds: the Dark Tide is fate, and Leviathan its keeper. In hindsight... perhaps it was not so far from the truth.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_24: Our collective subconscious flows endlessly through the Dark Tide, by day and by night. Leviathan lies hidden in its depths, weaving unseen changes, delivered to us through our dreams.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_25: When those altered bits of us rise to the surface, they slip into the waking mind. Our choices and actions were then guided by a will without form.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_27: I fear Leviathan has reclaimed full control over the Dark Tide. Our every thought and feeling... may now fall beneath Its gaze… and bend to Its will.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_28: Galbrena and Cartethyia hesitated to reveal their full plan... and perhaps this is why. As she said, only an unshakable will can stand against Leviathan.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_29: The Harbinger of the Dark Tide is chosen by Leviathan, an Anchor of Reality that summons the Tidespawn. A vessel, too, for spreading Its "gospel"… and gathering Its "sustenance."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_30: The Harbinger is condemned to wander the Dark Tide's illusions. And as the corruption seeps deeper, the boundary between dream and reality begins to unravel.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_31: In time, they may mistake the living for monsters… or even strike down those dearest to them in illusion. Tragedies born of confusion...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_32: To others, and even to themselves, they may come to embody "malice and fear" itself. If they surrender to that fate, the Dark Tide will devour them whole... leaving behind nothing but a puppet.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_33: The records speak of Harbingers who resisted until the end. To spare others from greater harm, they each made the same choice... To take their own lives.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_34: {PlayerName}, you... No, there must be another way. We must bring an end to Leviathan.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_35: Cartethyia's condition... can only be described as "death." For now, we must accept that truth.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_36: Galbrena confided in me, though only in veiled strokes, her intentions. In truth, I know no more of her than you do.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_37: I only know she bears the rare ability to move between this world and the Dark Tide's illusions. It was through that gift she was able to pull you back.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_38: What I saw in her eyes... was unwavering focus. The kind of resolve found only in those who have truly stood against the Dark Tide.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_39: But in those depths, I also saw a blackened will... Absolute, heedless of means or cost. I wonder… what crucible of blood and fire shaped it.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_40: Thankfully, those flames are not aimed at us. Her sights are clear. She simply waits for the moment to pull the trigger.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_41: To us, she is an ally worthy of trust. Should danger arise… you may trust her with your back.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_42: I understand Septimont calls for your aid even now.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_43: As Galbrena said, we must gather every last flicker of hope. We will stand with the Montellis and the Order to face the crisis in Ragunna. This front is ours to hold.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_44_44: If your strength wanes... do not overburden yourself. Safe travels, {PlayerName}.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_5_2: Gentleness born of delusion. A beautiful, sorrowful fantasy. She tried to confront an ancient curse with blind devotion and silence...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_5_3: But fear has eaten away at her soul. Illusion stripped her of freedom. And her tears have long since left her nowhere to hide.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_5_4: What she needs is not light, but a long, dreamless sleep.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_501_2: A pure heart blindly devoted to a deity on the verge of extinction...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_501_3: Yet the true eternal Divinity embraces all. It washes away everything, be it joy or sorrow or hope or obsession.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_501_4: She realigned her faltering faith, and in doing so, claimed her "redemption."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_502_2: The phases of the moon wove her luminous gaze, yet she insists on using that light to peer into fate's menacing face.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_502_3: Her eyes were destined to be burned. All who overstep cannot escape its wrath.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_502_4: Now, neither she nor her moon will ever be whole again.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_503_2: A valiant and determined ruler... On the battlefield where life and death collide, a faint ember lingers. Flickering, barely alive.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_503_3: Conquest and slaughter walk hand in hand. Sooner or later, she will be consumed by the very sun that nurtured her.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_503_4: Beyond her throne lies nothing but withered bones. If she cannot endure such loneliness, then she must learn to descend her own steps and enter "their world."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_6_2: Amid the endless cycle of surging tides, she plunges into fate's swirling maelstrom once more.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_6_3: Soon, she will wear a new crown—one ordained by fate, never to be defied.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_6_4: Her fate was written long ago. What remains is but a fleeting moment of stolen peace.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_6_5: What you see before you... is fate itself.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_6_6: And now, with every step you take, you stir the tides into motion.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_6_7: Is it fate that rules over man, or man who commands fate?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_6_8: I await your answer to this question...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_7_1: Cristoforo... He won't sway me. I've got to keep going.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_8_3: Through me, walk the Path of Glorious Ascension... Through me, enter the City of Eternal Bliss... All who enter... must first forsake all Hope.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_8_4: (These Tacet Discords... why aren't they attacking?)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_8_5: Harbinger... Open... The gates of Paradise for us...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_8_6: You'd better leave. This place... isn't leading to any "salvation."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_8_7: Leviathan, I will deliver you... "her death."
Main_Rinascita_2_11_8_8:
Cristoforo's whisper pulls you into unconsciousness. When you awaken, you find yourself in a mysterious realm.

Visions of fallen companions appear along the path as Cristoforo's whisper continues. Fighting the unease, you reach a lake where in the distance a vast "Paradise" hangs above.

As you stand in disbelief, several Tacet Discords emerge behind you, not to attack, but to chant the title "Harbinger." Then, from the darkness, a strange woman steps forward. With a single demonic arm, she unleashes a surge of flame that casts you from the realm. Her final words: "Leviathan, I will deliver you... 'her death.'"
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_6: You're finally awake, {PlayerName}! One second I'm fine, the next my head's spinning and you're face-down on the ground...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_7: I'm fine. What I saw, though…
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_9: Hmm... Sounds like the same thing happening to the people here.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_10: From what I've heard, many Ragunnesi have been having peculiar dreams lately. Even some of our Troupe members too.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_11: The details vary, but they all end the same way... the fall of Rinascita.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_12: And it's not just in dreamland either... {PlayerName}, I'm not sure if you've heard, but there have been strange rumors appearing across Rinascita lately.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_13: Even in Septimont, folks claim they've seen Tacet Discords not of this land in the wilds, or the ghosts of their ancestors.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_14: Thanks to all these oddities, the mood in Ragunna has gone sour.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_15: The Troupe performed today because Brant thought a new play to lighten the mood might give the people some hope.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_16: But here's the odd part. Only Rinascitans seem to be having these dreams. Visitors are spared... the same should be true of you.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_17: Have any of you had similar dreams?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_18: Have you seen other anomalies like this?
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_19: I'll get to the bottom of what's happening.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_20: Well... Not Brant or me. But someone in the Troupe has. They said they dreamed of sinking into an enormous, black ocean...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_21: The Tacet Discords in the Stormy Sea have been more restless lately. And the "siren's" songs? Well, they've started sounding an awful lot like the Order's hymns...
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_22: We'll keep gathering intel on our end. Might be worth asking around the city to see who else has been experiencing this.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_23: Rinascita's tides don't lie. Watch your back, {PlayerName}.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_24: (What were those Tacet Discords whispering about? Gates of Paradise... and the word "Harbinger." Could they mean the "Harbinger of the Dark Tide"?)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_25: (The only "Harbinger of the Dark Tide" is Fenrico. But he should still be sealing the Dark Tide at the Order's Fabricatorium...)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_26: (That figure I saw... and Cartethyia's murder...)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_27: (I came back to find her, so I should look for her first. She might know what's at the root of all this.)
Main_Rinascita_2_11_9_28:
You regain consciousness under the Troupe's care. What happened feels like an "illusion," but the Troupe members tell you that many in Ragunna have suffered similar "symptoms." Meanwhile, across Rinascita, anomalies have begun to appear.

You recall what you saw in the "illusion": the chanting Tacet Discords, the strange woman, and a vision of Cartethyia's murder. Maybe you can search the city for clues... or maybe the answer lies with Cartethyia herself, the very reason you returned to Ragunna.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_91_1: A few of our friends are already in the city. Seems they're digging into these incidents too.
Main_Rinascita_2_11_91_2: I'd suggest having a little chat with them first. We'll gather more intel on our end as well.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_1: Keep moving! Stay in line and follow instructions. No dawdling. I promise... we will return soon.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_2: Well, well. Is that you, Unwritten One? So you did decide to grace us after all. Thought maybe you'd forgotten about us.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_4: Still the same Iuno, I see.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_5: Now's not the time for teasing, Iuno.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_6: Did you come straight from Ragunna?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_7: I did. Has it begun here too? I see you're starting evacuations.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_8: An unannounced High Tide. But that term doesn't even begin to cover it.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_9: No signs. No patterns. The Dark Tide's spawn are surfacing at random... even outside the City of Septimont.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_10: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_11: As for me, I'm helping out here. Someone has to stop the panic from turning into a stampede.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_12: It's not just Septimont. Ragunna has been hit too...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_14: I see, Ragunna too… And Avidius... He never bent the knee, never played by the rules. Why is it that fate always strikes hardest at those who dare to defy it?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_16: You still can't give new prophecies?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_17: I'm just a helpful, ordinary person now, helping the Temple with the evacuation. No more restraints from the Tetragon. No prophecies... I admit, I've never felt freer. It's just...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_18: It's not just me. No Priestess can see Septimont's Auguries anymore. In our visions, it's all gone. Just blank.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_19: The last prophecy ended with, "The Dark Tide will erupt and engulf all of Septimont." After that... nothing. And with this abnormal Dark Tide behavior, people are starting to fear the end is upon us.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_20: But maybe… that doesn't mean the end is near.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_21: A blank future could mean a new beginning.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_22: Nice thought. If only more people shared your hope.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_23: But in the face of something this vast and unknown, fear is only human. We can't blame them for trembling.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_25: …The Dark Tide has been spotted at the Three Heroes' Crest.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_27: Bad. It's the highest point in the Sanguis Plateaus, well beyond the Blightcloud's reach. The Dark Tide has never touched it before.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_28: They call it the Three Heroes' Crest for the three Heroes of Heroes who once stood there. Many believe their blessing has kept it one of the few sacred places the Dark Tide cannot reach.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_29: If even that place isn't safe... We need to see it with our own eyes.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_30: Worry not, Honored One. The Senate will oversee the evacuation. Please, go assist the Ephor.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_31: We may lack your strength, but we will not stand idle. We will do everything we can to hold the line!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_32: We were born in Septimont. Resistance runs in our blood, and we were raised beneath the shining legacy of heroes. You think we'll sit back and let ruin claim us?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_33: We're counting on you, Honored One!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_36: I won't shame the title of Hero of Heroes.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_37: I hate to admit it, but the current Senate's grown a backbone. Cowards wouldn't last long working under Augusta, anyway.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_39: But Septimont still needs us too...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_40:
After parting ways with Cantarella, you set out alone for Septimont City.

By the time you arrive, the city is already preparing for war. At the gates, you encounter Priestess Iuno helping to evacuate civilians. You recount what happened in Ragunna, and she tells you that the Priestesses can no longer deliver new prophecies. Because of this, many people now believe the apocalypse is nigh.

Griffrex "Aquila" brings unprecedented news from the Plateaus: the Dark Tide has erupted near the Three Heroes' Crest. Named after three Heroes of Heroes, the peaks have been one of the few sacred places in Septimont untouched by the Dark Tide. You and Iuno decide to head to the Plateaus to meet Ephor Augusta, while the Senate stays behind to oversee the evacuation. In this time of crisis, everyone is doing everything they can to hold the line.

Now, mount the Griffrex with Iuno and fly toward the battlefield.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_1: Traces of the Dark Tide are everywhere...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_2: The Tidespawn always shows up where we least expect them and never slow down. Our warriors are stretched thin just trying to hold the lines.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_3: Even though the Common Echoes here don't depend on the Genesis Nexus, they're still breaking down due to the Dark Tide's corruption.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_4: Don't wear that face. These are Septimont's warriors. They don't fall easy.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_5: There, the Three Heroes' Crest. Looks like they just finished a battle.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_6: Let's pick up the pace. You fought beside Augusta before, and you once led the battle to defeat the Sovereign. Your presence will rally them.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_10: My fellow warrior! It's been a while.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_12: Feels like just yesterday we were fighting side by side in the Colosseum. And now look at you, "Hero of Heroes" and all. Didn't see that coming!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_14: Oh, let me introduce you. Augusta, this is...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_18: A lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_20: Ahem, never mind that. Didn't I say before? Never underestimate my charm.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_21: It is strange… From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_22: Alright then, Augusta. What's the situation?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_23: Theoretically, the Dark Tide flows here from the Blightcloud above the Plateaus. High Tides have always followed its movements.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_24: But this time, nothing. No Blightcloud anomalies. No frequency fluctuations near the Three Heroes' Crest.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_25: We always knew the Earthrend Wedge was a stopgap as we continued to search for a permanent solution. But this... eruption without warning defies everything we thought we understood.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_26: We repelled the first wave and set up an Anti-Corrosion Ward using Anchor Obelisks.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_28: The Fractsidus is incubating the Threnodian...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_29: The Threnodian is on the verge of rebirth...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_30: The Fractsidus, always scheming in shadow. Its wicked ambitions know no end.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_31: Your Excellency! Another outbreak! Tidespawn heading straight for the camp!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_32: Heh, Leviathan won't spare us any time to breathe.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_33: Let's go. My sword is ready.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_35: It's been too long since we stood shoulder to shoulder in battle.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_36: Warriors! The battle horns sound once again. Let those who defy Septimont tremble at our fury and fall before our valor!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_37: What?! But... I thought the Sovereign's death would sever the root cause of the Paradise's descent. But Leviathan's rebirth… This is a whole new thread of fate...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_2_38:
From high above, you and Iuno witness the Dark Tide's onslaught. Yet the warriors of Septimont stand unbroken. Their unyielding spirit stirs hope in your heart.

The Griffrex dives, bringing you swiftly to the battlefield. There, you reunite with Augusta and your old partner, Lupa. Iuno, once "forgotten," seems to have rekindled her friendship with Augusta as well.

Augusta explains the abnormal Dark Tide surge at the Three Heroes' Crest. To hold it back, they've set up Anti-Corrosion Wards using Anchor Obelisks. You share your own intelligence, but the Tidespawn strike again before more can be said. As Septimont's Hero of Heroes, you leap into the fray without hesitation. Inspired by your resolve, the warriors rally behind you. It's time to show the enemies once more the fury of Septimont.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_2: I heard you ran into a rough storm at sea...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_3: We did right by the trust they placed in us. We got all the folks from the Riccioli Islands to safety.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_4: Compared to what you're about to face, that storm was nothing.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_5: Sailing into the unknown is never easy. Sailing through the Dark Tide? Even worse.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_6: Pero stocked up on gadgets. You can take whatever you like!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_8: Bring me a few more Training Swords!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_9: This is all we can do for you right now… Please come back safe, {PlayerName}.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_11: Oh! Take these Shell Credits too. They're lucky charms, or so the old sailors say. Take as much as you like. A little luck never hurts.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_12: To us, {PlayerName}, you've always been the protagonist. Never forget that.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_13: …It's not being the protagonist that makes you brave. It's your courage that gave you that role to begin with.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_14: We trust you, so trust us. No matter how dark things get, we'll always be here when you need us.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_201_2: It's not a matter of "knowing how to resist" the Dark Tide's corruption, is it? You've already been corrupted.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_201_3: Sorry, but under the circumstances, I think this is the most rational choice.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_201_6: …Whatever the case, I respect your decision. But even so, let me say this one more time—
Main_Rinascita_2_12_201_7: Do not overburden yourself. Do not carry this weight alone. We are here. Always.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_201_8: Take these potions. My people and I will begin crafting the full batch. Once you activate the Anchor Stone, we will follow into the Dark Tide and meet you there.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_201_11: Thank you all for your effort.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_201_12: You, above all, have borne the most. Be safe, {PlayerName}.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_1: Hmm… So this is how Septimont's Common Echoes operate. But I see some similarities with our Sentry Constructs...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_2: How are things holding up at Averardo Vault?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_3: You actually brought this many echoes along…
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_4: Grandfather is overseeing Averardo Vault, and the Black Shores are holding the line there as well. No need for concern. Besides, the Montellis' cache of Echoes is nothing to underestimate.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_5: But really, such "technology" is our family's proudest "asset." Naturally, we brought what we could with us.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_6: Septimont's Common Echoes use a different configuration than Ragunna's, but the underlying logic is compatible. Our tuning technique will still serve us well here.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_8: Just don't forget to take breaks.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_9: Looks like you'll be working late again.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_10: …If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_11: I don't care about overtime in this case... If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_12: Besides, Ms. Carlotta hasn't rested properly in days.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_13: In times like these, we cannot afford even a sliver of carelessness. We must do everything within our power... so that you can focus on what lies ahead in the Dark Tide without distractions.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_14: These items will strengthen your Echoes. Even without us by your side, they'll be reliable allies.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_203_15: ...We won't let you walk this path alone for long.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_204_2: It has. I haven't seen you around lately.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_204_3: As a wandering bard, I couldn't just sit idle while everyone else played their part.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_204_4: So I did what I do best: played the loudest tune Ragunna's ever heard! With it, I called back every last soul still lost out there.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_204_5: But now, just as we reunite… you're setting off again.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_204_6: Music can be a weapon too. So take my song with you!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_204_7: Winds blow, rains weep, but light will always follow. Look up, and you'll see the stars. Their quiet twinkling is proof you'll never be alone.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_204_8: This entire world listens when you sing. Every bold, bright note will follow in your wake... And so will I.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_205_1: Ah... {PlayerName}. I'm sorry, I didn't see you there.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_205_2: Many of these warriors fell under the Dark Tide's corruption in battle. The Sentinel's light can help to purify their wounds… but the scars on their hearts are much harder to heal.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_205_3: I know Septimontians don't believe in the Sentinel, so… I wanted to try, in my own way, to comfort those who've suffered...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_205_5: Your faith shines brighter than ever.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_205_7: The Sentinel's form of Unity is one of shared faith, without stripping away individual freedom. It's nothing like Leviathan's... forced "oneness."
Main_Rinascita_2_12_205_8: I heard you... you're going into the Dark Tide. To lead the way for the others.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_207_7: I believe that "Discord Slayer" is holding Leviathan's moves in check within the Dark Tide. What do you know of her?

Main_Rinascita_2_12_207_9: I only know she's on our side.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_207_11: Regardless, our priority now is to concentrate our forces, hold the line steady, and capitalize on the time she's buying us.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_3: Remember that stretch of Chaos we once crossed?

Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_6: Once inside, find her existence in the Chaos. Reunite with her. She'll guide you forward.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_7: So this time, I need to Anchor to her.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_8: What exactly does that mean? What do I do?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_9: You catch on quickly. I believe you know what to do.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_10: Don't tell me you forgot already? It's about the Anchoring! You've done it before.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_11: Immerse yourself in her rhythm. Feel it. Understand it. Find a trace of her within the chaotic frequencies. And when you find her... don't let her go.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_12: {PlayerName}... Keep your wits about you once you're inside the Dark Tide.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_13: Don't worry! I'll stick with {Male=him;Female=her} every step of the way!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_14: Then I'm counting on you, Abby.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_17: Just remember, you're not going in alone, {PlayerName}. When the time comes, we will be right behind you.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_19: I believe in all of you, as you believe in me.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_23: May the eternal sun light your path. And may each step bring you closer to victory.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_21_24:
The Dark Tide has stabilized. Now is the time to strike.

Before you depart, Iuno advises anchoring to Galbrena once inside. If she dares to hunt the Threnodian, then surely she knows how to navigate the Dark Tide.

With preparations complete, you and Abby leap into the Dark Tide together.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_3_1: Tidespawn, dead ahead! Let's cut 'em down in one clean sweep!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_301_1: Hah! It's always a blast fighting beside you, my fellow warrior!

Main_Rinascita_2_12_301_3: They're heading straight for the Anchor Obelisks!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_4_1: ...Is it just me, or have they slowed down a little?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_4_2: Your Excellency! They're targeting the remaining Anchor Obelisks now!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_4_3: But the Gladiators guarding them... They haven't recovered from the last wave…
Main_Rinascita_2_12_4_5: Good. We'll split up and reinforce the rest. Stay sharp.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_1: Yes, we saw it. The Anchor Stone has been activated. Sooner than expected...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_2: Ground defenses are holding and no major fluctuations in the Dark Tide for now...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_3: Wait... An intense frequency suddenly... It's moving toward the western front!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_4: ...Is this the best the mighty Gladiators of Septimont can offer?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_5: A grand finale deserves grandeur! How can such a dull act satisfy the audience?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_6: Hahaha! Yes! Now this is a scene fit for the final act!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_7: Blades do not discriminate. Leave. This one's mine.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_8: Oh? Has Huanglong fallen so low, they now send a blind man to die?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_9: Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_10: In an epic play such as this, I refuse an early exit.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_11: My orders were to bring you back. Dead or alive.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_12: I never planned on bringing you back alive.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_14: My family's potions are ready, but please, a word...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_15: It's been crafted from the <ano=frequency>Threnodian's venom</ano>. Outside the corruption's reach, it induces hallucinations—warping your senses and clouding judgment.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_17: If you aren't immediately entering the Dark Tide, I advise you all not to drink it.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_18:
You and Galbrena activate the Anchor Stone within the Dark Tide, sending a signal to your companions in the real world.

With the defenses at the Three Heroes' Crest holding steady, Augusta and the others prepare to drink the "antidote" and follow after you. But just then, Iuno senses a powerful frequency moving toward the western front. Scar appears, shattering the Gladiators' defenses in an instant.

Just as all seems lost, Scar's assault is intercepted by Qiuyuan's blade. The very man Qiuyuan was hunting turns out to be none other than this Fractsidus Overseer.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_45_1: You're too late, defender of Huanglong.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_45_2: Beneath the Dark Tide, It stirs once more...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_45_3: ALL HOPE WILL BE SWEPT AWAY!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_46_1: All this time... Your eyes fixed on the tide...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_46_2: Never once did you see the threat in the sky...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_5_3: We've cleared our sector too. Regrouping now.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_1: More Tidespawn at the southwest basepoint!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_2: Ugh. Trying to wear us down one flank at a time, huh?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_3: They're closing in on the Obelisks on our side!

Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_6: T-the north flank... Hold the Obelisks at all costs!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_7: If I release this attack... the whole Obelisk array may fall.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_8: It's testing me. Seeing if I'll trade lives for victory...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_9: It's driving us into a corner.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_10: If only we had more fighters...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_24: We can't be everywhere all at once…
Main_Rinascita_2_12_6_25:
The Dark Tide's assault is relentless, targeting the weakest links of the Obelisk array. You and your companions cannot cover every front, and the situation grows dire...

Then, several familiar teleportation circles light up. The voices of your companions from Ragunna ring across the battlefield, and Galbrena arrives as well. They've come to reinforce the other fronts, helping the warriors reclaim the Anchor Obelisks.

Heroes from distant lands reunite here to face the crisis together. You take heart, and steel yourself for the battle still ahead...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_601_1: —So! This is where we're needed, right? Time to help reclaim those Obelisks!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_601_2: The north flank's ours! Let's give 'em a grand show!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_601_3: The Montellis greet you. We will secure this side.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_601_4: The poison Leviathan leaves behind... Allow the Fisalias to cleanse it.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_601_5: Whew, made it this time! I've got this side covered!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_601_6: By the name of Imperator! We'll protect the Obelisks here!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_602_3: Let's deal with the mess first! Plenty of time to catch up after!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_602_4: One Obelisk remains on the northeast...

Main_Rinascita_2_12_602_7: This battle is not over yet. Let's end this, together!

Main_Rinascita_2_12_7_10: S-she's absorbing the Tidespawn?! What kind of power is that?!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_1: This calamity… ends here. For good.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_3: Now that you have returned safely, I'll continue with my mission.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_4: Scar from the Fractsidus... Did he escape again?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_5: Unfortunately, yes. I see you didn't catch the mastermind either.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_6: That Cristoforo got away… But don't worry, I will hunt him down.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_7: That Fractsidus... The calamity has passed, but our city-states are weakened. We must rebuild. Recover. We cannot join this hunt.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_8: Survivors deserve more attention than criminals who deserve to die.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_9: Rest assured, we're not forgetting this transgression.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_30: That Primus got what he wanted. He fulfilled the fate he desired for Rinascita.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_32: I only played a small part. It was the courage of these warriors that truly held the line.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_73_33:
Together with your companions, you defeat Leviathan. The Gem is devoured and sealed within Galbrena. With the will of Fenrico and all the past Primuses carried in the Lantern of Napoli the Second, you return safely from the Dark Tide, dispersing it once and for all. The Paradise collapses, the endless night fades, and at last, dawn breaks over Rinascita.

Atop the Three Heroes' Crest, Qiuyuan bids you farewell. While you ventured deep into the Dark Tide, he kept his promise and held the line with Septimont's Gladiators. Now, his journey must continue.

With her soul returned to her body, Cartethyia is revived. Through a voice in the sky, she promises to meet you again in Ragunna. You part ways with your companions from Septimont. Both city-states must now rebuild in their own way. But now, each day to come holds more hope than the last.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_731_5: Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, {PlayerName}.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_731_6: Defeating Leviathan was just the start of Rinascita's "new era." There is plenty of cleanup work ahead for everyone.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_731_7: Each day to come holds more hope than the last.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_731_8: Septimont will have many matters demanding our attention. Ragunna will be no different.

Main_Rinascita_2_12_74_9: Alright, crew! Come lend a hand!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_74_10: Pero's got a whole mountain of tools over here... Like this rapid adhesive gun!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_74_11: If you're having trouble restoring the damaged buildings, Mr. Fulmine and I can help using our Fortes!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_74_12: If Imperator were here, They'd be happy to see this...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_74_34:
You return to Ragunna City with your companions. In the aftermath of battle, the Ragunnesi have come to learn that Primus Fenrico gave his life to disperse the Dark Tide, and Sentinel Imperator is gone as well. Though grief and uncertainty are still fresh, many are already taking the first steps to rebuild their future.

Cartethyia arrives at your side, just as she promised. Together, you recall Imperator's words: The path of civilization is never fixed. It shifts with the needs of the present. And that's up to the people of a civilization to decide.

You turn to Phoebe, still caught in quiet confusion, and give her the Civilization Capsule, the Relic Imperator left behind. She quickly understands what you are entrusting to her.

Now, Cartethyia and Phoebe both step forward to help rebuild Ragunna. Naturally, how could you not be part of it too?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_1: Imperator once said: "Let the winds of the past depart. The ships of this new era no longer need their guidance. No longer shall scroll and prophecy bind, but by humanity's will shall a new era be forged."
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_3: I've now truly returned from the "dead."
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_5: Please, just call me Cartethyia. Rinascita's Divinity is no more, and with it, the "Blessed Maiden chosen by the Divine."
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_6: Phoebe, your faith in the Sentinel has never wavered, nor has it been blind. It stems not from obedience, but from a deep belief in Their deeds and ideals.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_7: Imperator once led the displaced to these isles, yet what allowed the Ragunnesi to stand firm upon the sea was not Divine favor, but their own efforts.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_8: The statue in the city was built in Their likeness, but it was the people who gave shape to the faith it stands for.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_9: Faith once united us. It was also what drove us to seek liberation… The path of civilization is never fixed. It shifts with what's being demanded at present.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_10: And it's the people of a civilization who decide what they demand.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_11: ...As it was in the beginning, and ever shall be.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_12: Everyone has their tasks to do now... But in the future...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_13: I want you to have this, Phoebe.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_14: Imperator entrusted me with this relic. Within it is Rinascita's past, and... its future.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_16: Eh... but it's empty. Where is the recorded future?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_17: The future... is already in your hands.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_19: From now on, perhaps I no longer need to hide who I really am.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7401_20: So... I'll join in rebuilding Ragunna too!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_1: Everything's nearly wrapped up on my end, First Mate!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_2: Good work, Brant. And thank you, everyone.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_3: Oh, by the way, while we were deep in the Dark Tide, I caught sight of an old brewing recipe.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_4: It dates all the way back to when Rinascita was founded. The brew was called Rebirth.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_5: Back then, people were fighting the sea just like we are now. They built seawalls, linked the scattered isles… It was only through countless sacrifices that they finally held their ground on this archipelago.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_6: Hmm... what would Rebirth taste like...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_7: Piqued the First Mate's curiosity, eh? Well, I got my hands on Pero's magic tools and gave it a try myself!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_10: But you're a bit too young for this, Roccia. The crew and I will handle the taste test!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_12: As for the meaning it holds... well...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_13: To the fallen, and to tomorrow!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_14: To the fallen, and to tomorrow!

Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_12: Chimera leaving you out to dry, eh？

Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_18: Right away! You helped Rinascita through its darkest hour. Now it's my turn to make sure our heroes eat and drink like royalty!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_19: Here you go! Double the scoop, on the house! Unlimited refills!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_20: I can't manage this on my own. Want to split it?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_21: Wow. Something even you can't handle?
