Main_Rinascita_2_12_104_6: The battle here matters just as much as the one at the Three Heroes' Crest.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_105_1: Marion! Thank goodness, you're still alive!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_106_1: Marion! Thank goodness, you're still alive!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_106_2: Haha, surprised? I didn't think I'd survive that monster siege either… but a Discord Slayer saved me.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_106_3: A Discord Slayer? Where is she now?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_106_4: She's headed for the Plateaus. No one could stop her… I need to report to the Ephor at once.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_106_5: Leave that to me. You should get your wounds treated.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_106_6: No. I'm still on my feet, and that can only mean one thing… my duty isn't finished.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_106_7: I'll fight to my last breath here in Septimont.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_107_2: If only the family had brought more firearms…
Main_Rinascita_2_12_108_1: Facing those monsters with nothing but cold steel is a bit challenging.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_108_2: But you seem used to it, don't you?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_108_3: For years, we've been "hunting" to earn a glorious death today.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_108_4: The only thing I can count on is the touch of striking them down with my spear.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_108_5: And I bet that touch is pretty damn good, huh?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_108_7: But you're not bad yourself. All dressed up, yet you've still got some real fight in you.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_108_8: When you're ready, let's head back and keep fighting side by side.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_110_2: Much better. The dizziness is almost gone, and I can move a lot more easily.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_110_3: This potion feels almost magical… and it even has a kind of fragrance to it?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_110_4: It was supplied by the Fisalia family. It can slow the spread of Dark Tide corruption, or suppress the festering wounds left by Tidespawn.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_110_6: But it hasn't gone through the Order's analysis or approval. Too much, and your whole body could go numb, and you might even start hallucinating.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_110_8: …You're not the first to come asking for more of it.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_112_2: Ever since the reinforcements arrived from Ragunna, we've been seeing a lot of Echoes like this one.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_112_7: If you're dropping off supplies, head to the other side, and you'll find the spot there! I wonder what Ragunna's dishes taste like…
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_1: Fine work, {PlayerName}! With Rinascita safe for now, we've earned a proper breather.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_2: There's still something I'd like to know.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_3: You've worked hard too. Get some rest.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_4: If there's anything you want to know, ask away!
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_9: Ah, the Paradise. A realm created by Threnodian Leviathan and the destination of the Dark Tide...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_10: But judging by its nature, its reach, and the havoc it could bring… its "descent" is nothing less than what we define as the Lament.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_11: Still, without question, your actions, {PlayerName}, kept that from becoming a true Lament.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_12: Rinascita… what a journey it's been. Truly one for the epics...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_13: You mean the missing frequency, right? We've already cross-checked it against Chimera and Cartethyia's frequency samples left here at the Black Shores…
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_14: Not a single one aligned. Not even close.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_15: Which means… we can't dismiss the chance that the missing frequency has already been seized by the Fractsidus.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_16: But don't worry. We've sped up the Gem's analysis. Even if the Fractsidus is scheming, we'll have countermeasures ready.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_17: Abby? It's a curious case. Even in the deepest databanks of the Black Shores, we found no relevant data...
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_18: (But in that battle against the Journeying Paradise… Leviathan spoke Abby's name.)
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_19: (Yet no one else seemed to react. Was it only Abby and I who heard it?)
Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_20: (Abby's true identity… Perhaps I'll only uncover it on the road ahead.)
Main_Rinascita_2_12_114_1: Opposite the Three Heroes' Crests, a towering obelisk rises. One side is inscribed with countless names, meant to endure the passage of time. The other holds a short, but heavy, elegy:
Main_Rinascita_2_12_114_2: They stepped into the relentless shadow, and with their oaths, their blades, their very lives, forged a new path.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_114_3: They drove back the endless night, so that hope, dawn, and the future could shine upon Rinascita.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_114_4: Their names are now etched upon the newborn isles.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_114_5: You need not seek their graves. Look to the starry sky, the soaring birds, and the soothing waves…
Main_Rinascita_2_12_115_1: Greetings, honored warrior. Have you come to pay your respects as well?
Main_Rinascita_2_12_115_2: Yes. I've brought these flowers for them.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_115_3: The Divinity has gone… Now the future of Rinascita rests in our hands.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_115_4: Friend, you know we Septimontians don't place our faith in divinities.
Main_Rinascita_2_12_115_5: But I believe what is carved upon this obelisk is…
SZSTBC_31_1: Oh… This… Huh? Why am I here?

SZSTBC_34_8: Nonsense! We survived the Dark Tide and stand here today because we were granted redemption. It's a divine miracle, beyond any doubt!
SZSTBC_34_9: Only by gathering under the protection of Imperator and the Blessed Maiden, by constantly ascending and unifying, can we find the path to salvation.
SZSTBC_34_10: I understand why you'd hold that view, but —
SZSTBC_34_11: By Imperator! Perhaps I really should send you to the Order Penitentiary immediately. You should be on the Pilgrim's Sail, repenting for your sins!

SZSTBC_46_1: We can finally return to our homeland, where dawn breaks, birds sing, and melodies drift through the air.

SZSTBC_78_9: You've also been granted special clearance. No paperwork required, unlike other envoys.
SZSTBC_78_10: As for your weapons... Oh, I see. You can carry them in the Palace with Her Excellency's personal permission.
SZSTBC_78_11: The only thing I must remind you of is to keep your voice down within the Palace halls.
SZSTBC_78_12: If there's anything else you should be aware of, I'll inform you promptly.
SZSTBC_79_1: Hey, I heard you're heading to Ragunna again?
SZSTBC_79_2: Yeah! The Ragunnesi really believe in the Sentinel, so the atmosphere's going to be totally different this time.
SZSTBC_79_4: Absolutely! Ugh... With everything going on right now, I wonder if we'll still get to see some amazing performances…
SZSTBC_80_1: After the catastrophe, Augusta has truly come into her own.
SZSTBC_80_2: Still no word on Avidius… and that Priestess…
SZSTBC_80_3: She seems cunning… but who exactly is she? Doesn't ring any bells.
SZSTBC_81_2: If you have questions about the Agons, I'm happy to help.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_1_1: (Chisa's been in the Black Shores' care after Honami. I wonder how she's doing.)
Main_Honami_2_8_2_1_2: (I should drop by when I have the time.)
Main_Honami_2_8_2_10_1: I think it got stuck inside...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_10_2: Try and go for another one, maybe?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_10_3: I've seen this before. Just whack it a few times.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_10_4: Do something with your invincible scissors, Chisa.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_10_5: I've got a better way to handle no-good vending machines like this.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_10_7: That may be a little too much. Here, watch this.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_10_8: The vending machine jams and fails to dispense a drink, but Chisa seems to know exactly how to deal with the situation...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_1: Here you go. Simplicity works best.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_3: Didn't have time for this kind of thing before.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_4: Just wondering if it's past its expiration date.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_5: You're right. We were always running from something. Or chasing after something.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_6: Remember that canned fruit we had that one night? It's the same thing. I've never got an upset stomach from it, at least.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_7: Before I transferred to Startorch, I used to hide next to the vending machines behind my high school building all the time.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_8: No one else really went there. It was quiet. The sound of soda cans dropping down would make me feel relaxed.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_10: Where I come from, discrimination and prejudice against Resonators are part of life. School was no exception.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_11: The gossip, the looks, the way people kept their distance... intentional or not, it still got to me.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_12: I tried to stand up for myself. I tried holding it in. Nothing changed. Just when I was close to breaking, I received an acceptance letter.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_13: And so, with my family's blessing, I left home and went to Startorch Academy, far away in the Lahai-Roi region.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_14: Startorch Academy... What was it like?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_15: So it's true, you... No, it's nothing.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_16: It is a multinational school built specifically for Resonators. A metropolis of science and research.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_17: Even for a girl who couldn't face her own problems and chose to run away, they accepted me with a warm welcome. I met people who dreamed of reaching the stars.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_18: This swing... It's just like the one back home.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_20: Would you join me? There is room for one more.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_21: Was it because you're a Resonator?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_11_22: Chisa hands you a drink and begins to share painful memories from her past. As a Resonator, she faced constant discrimination in her hometown, even at school. Just when she felt she couldn't take any more, she received an acceptance letter from Startorch Academy. There, she was treated with kindness by the teachers and her classmates.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_12_4: I hear you. I'm just... enjoying the gentle sway. Especially... when someone's beside me.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_12_5: Everything feels so peaceful all of a sudden.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_12_6: When you're ready to move on, I'll get up.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_13_1: You don't have to wait for me. I think I've been on the swing long enough.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_14_1: Oh, you're back. Do you like sitting on the swing too?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_15_1: I can already see our destination from here. Look at the cherry blossoms... they weren't blooming like this before.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_15_4: They're the same as they were before.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_15_5: Like clouds floating above the water, or like cotton poking through a torn couch... Sorry, I'm using weird analogies again.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_15_6: It could be that my mood is just different now than before.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_15_7: Luckily, a view like this can exist forever within this Sonoro Sphere.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_16_1: That fountain over there... it's been concealed by leftover Irideglow Crystals. Kind of a shame.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_16_2: I'll take care of it. Just like back in Neon Tower.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_2: Let's fish it out and see what it is.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_3: This looks like a cassette tape.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_4: Ah, I know what it is.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_5: Every Startorch Academy student has a frequency storage cassette like this inside their Terminals.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_6: (I remember now. Galbrena once told me about them.)
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_7: I also have one in my Terminal. They were given out during the orientation.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_8: If it's a device unique to Lahai-Roi, what's it doing here?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_9: Random "castaways" often appear inside the Honami Sonoro Sphere. This must be one of those.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_10: I'll take this to Namipon. It should be able to help us find where it came from.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_11: Cherry blossoms... Right in front of us. It's so beautiful.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_12: Let's go over there and take a picture.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_13: This right here is a photo moment.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_17_22: At a fountain, you discover a strange cassette, a device unique to Lahai-Roi. Every Startorch Academy student carries a similar frequency storage cassette in their Terminal. Chisa decides to bring it to Namipon, hoping it can help you locate its origin. With the cherry blossoms so close, the two of you decide to take a picture together.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_18_1: Make sure you look towards the camera.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_1: When I was little, my parents once took me to a park full of cherry blossoms for a picnic. I made kirigami in all kinds of shapes and had them guess what they were.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_2: The kirigami didn't really look like anything, but when I told them, they'd always smile and pretend they understood.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_3: Those cherry blossoms... they looked just like they do now. After being away from home for so long, drifting around... I feel like I'm home again.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_6: This student ID card came into my possession by chance. It was in that Tower that I found—No, that I recognized who it belonged to.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_7: I never found the right moment to return this to you. Here, this belongs to you.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_8: I was a student at Startorch Academy?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_9: They told me about you at the Black Shores. That you've lost some memories.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_10: We never met in person at school, but... I did read the course selection guide you wrote.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_12: It's okay. Honami is where we first met each other.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_13: But I've been talking about myself this whole time. Why don't you tell me about your story so far? I'd like to know more about you.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_14: Rinascita... sounds like quite an adventure. Only someone like you, Senpai, could accomplish so much.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_15: You can stop calling me that for now.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_16: Hold on, that title takes a little getting used to.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_17: Alright. You always seem to find your way forward, no matter how uncertain things are. Like you did in Honami. But I...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_18: What comes next? Should I continue my studies at the Academy? Should I go home? Or should I do something else... I still haven't decided.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_19: No need to rush your decision. You can take your time and stick around here for a while.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_20: At least, you won't have to face the future alone anymore.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_22: I received a precious gift while traveling with you—the courage to face reality and move on.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_23: There's something else I want to give you besides the ID card, {PlayerName}.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_24: I was out of inspiration towards the end, but finally managed to finish it after coming back to Honami and getting some ideas.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_25: So this is what you were working on during recovery.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_26: Yes. It's a pretty tricky piece, so I ended up using a lot of paper. Looks very much like Honami, don't you think?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_27: My hometown was built next to the Tacet Field created by Honami's fall. Even though the Lament still haunts us, some stubborn souls have rebuilt that familiar Tower again.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_28: We still reach for the sky. Still hope radio waves break through the blockade to connect the isolated regions left behind...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_29: The painful memories of home will never fade. But I won't turn away from the beautiful ones, either. Together... they are what make me Kuchiba Chisa.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_30: This is my thank-you gift to you. Something precious to me... A memory of my home.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_32: I just remembered... Namipon always said the cafe needed more life. Maybe now is the time to try?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_33: Like you said, I have time to "stick around" for a while. So would it be alright if I invite your friends from the Black Shores here for a party?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_34: Before I make any decisions on what to do next, I want Shashou Cafe to celebrate a real "opening day."
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_35: Under the cherry blossoms, Chisa returns your old student ID, revealing that you too once attended Startorch Academy in the past. Still, what matters more to her is the you she met in Honami, and she wants to know you better. You tell her stories of your adventures in Rinascita, and she confides her own uncertainties about the future. Your response moves her, and she says she's drawn strength from the journey you've shared. She then gives you a gift: an intricate kirigami of her hometown she made during her recovery in the Black Shores. A piece filled with feeling and memory. Finally, she suggests inviting your Black Shores friends to the cafe to celebrate a real "opening day."
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_36: Pink petals swirl upon the wind like drifting thoughts, gently filling the space between hearts.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_19_37: Why not stay a little longer, in this long season, along the streets we once walked, here in Honami...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_1: Ah, {PlayerName}. Perfect timing. There's something you need to know.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_2: Since we took charge of the Honami Sonoro Sphere, we've been noticing some changes on the inside—
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_3: The link between Honami and the real world is stabilizing, and the city's time flow is almost in sync.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_4: But scans from Tethys indicate that much of the recent frequency exchanges weren't passing through this rift.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_6: Meaning it could either just be a misreading due to overlapping data, or... there's another access point to the Honami Sonoro Sphere.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_7: On top of that, the city's buzzing with unidentified phenomena and unconfirmed hazard zones. We'll continue to monitor them closely and run further analysis.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_8: By the way, how's Chisa doing?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_9: She's just completed her treatment. Everything seems to be all right. Her Rabelle's Curve is within normal parameters, and there are no significant lingering Overclocking symptoms.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_10: That said, I don't recommend repeating what happened in Honami. That level of Resonance strain is unsustainable.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_12: ...Yes. Mm-hmm. Got it. {Male=He;Female=She}'s with me right now.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_13: I just got a call that Chisa submitted an itinerary not long ago and left for Honami alone.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_15: She didn't specify. All she wrote was "I want to go back."
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_16: You can find her guide KU-Roro in the Haven of Sprouts. It may know something.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_17: I'll go check it out. Knowing Chisa, she usually doesn't act without purpose.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_18: Some time later, you return to the Black Shores to visit Chisa. Valentina tells you that the connection between Honami's Sonoro and the real world is stabilizing. Chisa has completed her treatment and shows no serious lingering Overclocking symptoms. However, she recently went back to Honami alone for reasons unknown. Her guide, KU-Shosho, might know more.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_19: With Chisa's treatment over, you once again return to the Black Shores...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_1: So, do you want to hang around a bit longer, or shall we head back? I'll follow your lead.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_2: There's something I want to ask.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_4: It's getting late. Let's head back to the cafe.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_5: Is there something else you'd like to know? We've got plenty of time.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_7: About when I was a student at Startorch Academy...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_10: Are you worried about me? I'm feeling all right for the time being.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_11: Not pretending to be okay, right?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_12: Not when I'm with you. The people at the Black Shores called it a miracle. That someone who was on the verge of Overclocking for so long could recover. But...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_13: When we passed through Honami's rift, I felt a warm frequency flowing toward me. I suspect that's what helped stabilize my Resonance energy.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_15: It was the person who brought you to Honami... In the end, the same person pulled me back from the edge. Again.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_16: I'm sorry. I was only a first-year student in Engineering. I hadn't been around long enough. Everything I heard about you came from what others said.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_17: All I really heard was that you were popular. Always had friends around. If I hadn't been caught in the Honami incident, we probably would've never met.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_18: The ones from Startorch aren't the average cassettes that you normally see. They are specialized equipment used to store frequencies.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_19: One of the instructors described it as a frequency backup storage for the holder. It records the person's very "existence."
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_21: It's one of the Academy's safety precautions against the <te href=850080>Waveworn Phenomenon</te>. That is all that I know.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_20_22: Come on, then. We should spruce the place up a bit to give our friends a warm welcome.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_1: Anything else you'd like to know? As long as it's within my authority, I can answer.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_3: About Chisa's stay at the Black Shores...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_6: After Honami was devastated, energy from the Lament sealed the entire city into a unique Sonoro Sphere like congealed amber. Its time flow was slowed down compared to the rest of the world.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_7: A similar case would be Mt. Firmament. Being on the inside for a day means up to a hundred days might have passed on the outside.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_8: But it's not permanent. As Honami's connection to reality grows stronger, the flow of time begins to restore itself.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_9: You getting sucked into Honami through that rift has got Shorekeeper worried sick, and she's been closely monitoring everything that's going on over there since.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_10: Good thing is, at that point, Honami's time flow was no longer that different from the real world. So to us, you were only gone for just a bit.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_11: While she was recovering, Chisa applied for partial access to the Black Shores database, mainly to learn general knowledge and modern trends.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_12: We also saw her strolling around the living area and taking a look at the facilities occasionally, just like a lot of the New Branches when they first get here.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_13: The KU-Roro responsible for taking care of her can fill you in if you want to know more.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_14: Sumika is a member of the Black Shores who went M.I.A. many years ago. We dispatched a team on a search and rescue, but nothing solid came of it.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_15: The report Chisa submitted to us has detailed Sumika's operations and engagements in Honami.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_16: She was one of the most outstanding researchers of the Error Cell, and an elite Bloom Bearer who made the Black Shores proud.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_3_17: The Stellar Matrix will forever remember her noble pursuit of truth.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_30_2: Come to think of it, this is the first time I'm here at this cafe while wide awake.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_30_3: You sure it's not because you've been putting in more nap hours lately?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_30_4: Says who? I got locked out by the Sonoro Sphere right from the start, remember? I couldn't even get to you. And don't get me started on all the wacky frequencies that I got mixed in with...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_30_5: You did a great job. Welcome to Shashou Cafe, Abby.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_30_6: ...Whoa, why the formality all of a sudden? Ahem. So you asked Shorekeeper to invite the Black Shores gang over for a party. They should be here pretty soon, right?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_30_7: Yep. Let's go check on Chisa and see how the decorating is going.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_30_8: The next day, you and Abby arrive near Shashou Cafe. It is Abby's first time visiting this coffeehouse. You have already asked Shorekeeper to notify your friends in the Black Shores, and they should be arriving soon.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_1: Gotta hand it to ya, I love what you guys did with the place. Feels like a mini festival in here!
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_2: Oh, you're here. Namipon and I are just making finishing touches to the party.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_4: Well, hello there, Chisa. It's nice to see you again. You're all so kind, you know. Say, whatcha got on the menu—
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_5: In the cozy cafe, vibrant lights dance on the walls. Soft chimes whisper. Glad to have you aboard again, Passenger.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_6: Chisa's the Acting Manager today, and she'll be our host for the opening party.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_7: Wait a minute... Something smells funny about this guy!
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_8: This frequency isn't Echo or TD. Feels like it's hiding a whole mixed bag in its fuzzy tummy!
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_10: It's the guardian of Honami City.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_11: You say that, but I don't trust it. Hey, ain't there a whole lot more of you around here too?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_12: Would you like to join us in putting up the decorations, Passenger?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_15: And it's completely ignoring me! Now it even chats up {PlayerName} like they're old buddies or something...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_16: Ah, the place is starting to turn into a party now.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_17: Is something wrong with your friend?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_19: Abby's just a little excited today, that's all.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_20: After being an emergency shelter for so long, it's finally starting to become what it was supposed to be.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_21: I'll let you finish these last few decorations, {PlayerName}.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_31_22: Chisa and Namipon have already decorated the cafe for the opening party. Right away, Abby finds Namipon suspicious and uneasy, seeing how close you and Namipon are. As the two face off, an unaware Chisa asks you to help place the final decorations.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_32_1: Passenger, Chisa was the one who proposed the party. She has put lots of effort into preparations.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_32_2: For this, I'd like to prepare a surprise—a special ornament just for her. Any recommendations?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_32_5: Agreed. It must be something that would let all the Passengers know Chisa is the manager of the day at first glance.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_32_6: Ah, yes. It must be something that Chisa would fall in love with immediately.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_32_7: And just like that, after a little tinkering here and some cuts there, Namipon hands you the ornament it just finished…
Main_Honami_2_8_2_32_8: Namipon privately tells you it wants to surprise Chisa with a special piece of decor. With your input, it finishes the special piece in secret...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_33_4: Oh, it's a standee of the cafe's manager. I made it with the lingering frequencies around.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_33_5: {PlayerName}, do you like... No, what do you think of it?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_33_8: Fits in perfectly with everything around it.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_33_9: You even included my weapon... Let's leave it here then.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_33_10: Did you say... c-cute? Um, I guess just leave it like this, then.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_33_11: If you think it fits, then... alright.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_33_12: When Chisa sees the life-sized cutout of herself placed at the cafe entrance, she falls silent in astonishment. She then turns and asks your opinion of it...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_34_1: Ah, this was left here by Passenger 3.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_34_3: Passenger 1 is Chisa. You're Passenger 2. As for Passenger 3... Ahem...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_34_4: Passenger 3 is the relentless seeker of truth. She never gave up her quest.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_34_5: You see a glistening piece of amber on the bar counter. It reminds you of someone you once met.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_35_1: This appears to be a gallery set up by Chisa. It displays scenes from around Honami, and pictures she took with people she holds dear...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_36_2: Good afternoon, Honami. You're tuned in to your city radio, broadcasting live on a warm summer breeze.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_36_3: As the temps slowly climb, looks like that midsummer heat is comin' in hot. But don't sweat it. Up next, we've got a special announcement.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_36_4: Our meteor trackers are lighting up. Looks like a shower is set to dazzle just after midnight tonight. For anyone up for a little stargazing, grab your friends and family to catch this "Midnight Summer Magic Show."
Main_Honami_2_8_2_36_5: Coming up next, here's a list of the best viewing spots across the city...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_36_6: (So the seasons in Honami that stood still are flowing again...)
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_1: Maintain eye contact... Smile... Greet everyone as they come in...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_4: A little bit. I'm... I'm just reviewing the basics of greeting guests.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_5: I'm listening. I'm just reviewing the basics of greeting guests.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_6: Shashou Cafe is like "home" to me in Honami. Honestly, i-it's been a long time since I hosted anyone at home.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_7: I think the last time was… sometime in high school.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_8: Just greet everyone like you'd greet me.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_9: To me, you're different from everyone else.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_37_10: I-I didn't give it much thought at the time. Anyway... I need to pull myself together. A manager must stay composed.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_38_1: Thank you for lending us a hand with the decorations, Passenger. I'm sure the others will be very pleased.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_2: No, not at all. We're glad you made it, Shorekeeper. Shashou Cafe welcomes you aboard!
Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_5: Oh, say something, Passenger. This awkward silence is killing me...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_6: Sounds like you two already met at the Black Shores.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_7: Yes. Shorekeeper personally oversaw all of the routine checkups during my recovery. She was very helpful.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_8: Chisa remained on the verge of Overlocking for a prolonged period within a distorted temporal flow. Her case required a full evaluation by the Tethys System.

Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_4: With the right tweak, maybe I can track it. Like I did with Neon Tower's—
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_5: It sounded like the Academy's radio talk show... But why did I hear my mother?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_6: Does that mean she's at Startorch? Why is she there? Is she... looking for me?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_8: (Chisa will need some time to process everything.)
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_9: I am detecting a unique frequency from this radio...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_10: It has formed a connection with Lahai-Roi on the other end of the rift.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_11: Once it's all fixed up, I can piggyback on this frequency and plot coordinates from there to Honami.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_12: Understood. With established coordinates, you will be able to navigate your way within the rift.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_13: The Black Shores will also assist with stabilizing the rift to ensure your safety as much as possible.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_14: ...Should you decide to travel to Lahai-Roi. To Startorch Academy.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_15: What do you know about Lahai-Roi?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_16: Lahai-Roi has been mentioned a lot in passing lately.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_17: It is a region once forgotten, covered in snow most of the year and sparsely populated. No Sentinel is there to guide its civilization.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_18: Beneath its ice fields lie Startorch Academy and numerous research facilities, built by a multinational alliance known as the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_19: Startorch Academy enacts a strict access protocol for all personnel. I will have the necessary paperwork in place before your departure.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_20: Looks like I need to make changes to my plans...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_21: I want to go back to Startorch Academy.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_22: My family is there, and so are my instructors and classmates. The future may be uncertain, but I know what I have to do.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_25: We'll return to the Academy we attended.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_30: ...Is this the answer you've been seeking, {PlayerName}?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_31: I hope to make you proud. I hope I haven't let you down...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_70_32:
It turns out to be a Startorch Academy radio program, and the guest is Chisa's mother, who is currently at the Academy. By tracing the signal, Namipon can pinpoint Lahai-Roi's relative coordinates. With support from the Black Shores, securing safe passage through the rift may soon be possible. Since her family is at the Academy, Chisa changes her plan and decides to return there first. You, too, have your own reasons for going. Lahai-Roi is now your next destination.
As you prepare to leave, a mysterious voice suddenly cuts through the radio...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_1: Is something wrong, {PlayerName}? Why did you turn back?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_2: I heard a voice on the radio just now.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_3: I heard someone calling my name.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_4: A voice from the radio? But isn't it broken?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_5: You did? I'm right next to you, but... I don't think I heard anything.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_6: You sure you didn't hear anything strange?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_7: Yes. You must be exhausted. Should we go back to the cafe?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_8: I guess I could use some rest.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_10: (I don't think I was imagining it... that voice.)
Main_Honami_2_8_2_71_11: Strangely, Chisa, standing beside you, doesn't hear it. But you're certain it wasn't your imagination.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_1: Next up... Ehhh, gotta fix this radio.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_2: So you and Chisa can get to school okay, I'm gonna use... a dozen Rice Dangos' worth of effort.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_3: It'll be an investigation. We're not going to school.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_4: That's a strange unit of measurement...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_5: Okay, okay. When you get to Lahai-Roi, take care of each other, alright?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_6: Are you really not coming with us?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_7: Nope. I'm a Namipon from Honami. This is where I stay.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_8: I'll look after the cafe while you're away. It'll always be here when you need to rest.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_9: Oh, man... Why you gotta bring up the emotional talk out of the blue?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_72_10: It means I'm trying really hard.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_73_1: I will be using my powers to stabilize the rift's channel.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_73_2: Did you hear any voices on the radio earlier?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_73_3: No, to my ears the radio has been silent.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_73_4: However, I was able to sense a peculiar frequency for a brief moment.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_73_5: It felt independent from the Honami Sonoro Sphere, as if... it existed beyond a singular dimension.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_74_1: I remember this Crossing. When I was little, my younger sister and I once snuck out to play in the shopping mall. Oh, we had a blast that whole afternoon...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_74_3: Yes, it is. I was on a train leaving Honami when the Lament struck. I, uh... I had a fight with my parents.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_74_6: Oh, don't be. That was years ago.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_74_7: My Resonance ability might not be the strongest out there, but it gives me plenty of time to feel the world.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_74_8: In the real world, all that's left of Honami is this giant Tacet Field. But inside this Sonoro Sphere, it still exists.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_74_9: To me, the things I need to do stay the same. Collect Reverberations, analyze traces of the Lament, and then... search for the truth.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_75_2: Yes, you did. Everyone had a fantastic time last night.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_75_3: After saying goodbye to your friends, you got tired and decided to take a rest in the cafe.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_75_5: (The only thing I remember is what happened right before watching the meteor shower.)
Main_Honami_2_8_2_75_6: What's the matter? Did you not sleep well?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_75_9: Hehe, Chisa woke up before you. She tiptoed out for some fresh air. Said she didn't want to bother you.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_75_10: Namipon explains that you fell asleep after seeing your friends off, though you have no memory of what happened after watching the meteor shower. When you ask about Chisa, you learn that she woke up earlier and went outside for some air.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_76_1: If not mistaken, the sounds will become clearer once you've adjusted it to the right frequency.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_76_5: Hmm, that doesn't seem right. Try the other way.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_76_8: *Static*... Mrs. Kuchiba, would you mind sharing with us why you chose this particular design... *static*... of the Academy's new uniform?
Main_Honami_2_8_2_76_10: The inspiration came from... well, my daughter. She once made a cutout of this pattern from some old fabric at home...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_76_11: ...Very interesting... *static*... It really captures the Academy's spirit...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_76_12: *Static*... If it's this uniform, I thought... my little Chisa would love to wear it...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_76_15: After some tuning, the signal clears. The broadcast is an interview about school uniforms, and Chisa recognizes who the guest speaker is...
Main_Honami_2_8_2_8_1: I've never mentioned it before, but the buildings and infrastructure here... they remind me of the neighborhood I grew up in.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_8_3: Yes. Even just walking around here brings back memories.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_9_1: That vending machine looks like it's still working.
Main_Honami_2_8_2_9_2: I'll buy you some juice as a thank you for the hassle you went through to find me.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_25_1: Space has just been sliced again.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_25_7: The temperature's dropping, but there's no frost or ice anywhere. Could it mean this "Tower" really is absorbing warmth from human bodies, just like Sumika suspected?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2601_5: These Fractsidus operatives... Looks like they're also among the Left Behind.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2601_6: So they've become part of their own experiment... trapped in a loop they can't even recognize.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2601_7: That's why they've been repeating Test No. 20.
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2602_1: Obsesssion... Too lighhhht... too lighhhht! Can't suppressss... the forgetting...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2603_1: No, no... Too heaaaaavy... heaaaavy... heaaavy...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2604_1: Too much... pain... Nooo... not here...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2701_3: Mom, I think I painted the tree crooked again...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2701_4: Not at all, sweetheart. It's beautiful—Wait, GET AWAY FROM THE WINDOW!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2701_5: Oh come on, you're lost again? Wait, what's that...?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2702_3: Quick, hold my hand... HOLD MY HAND! Don't be scared, don't be scared...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2702_4: Wrap your arms around my neck! On three... One, two...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2702_5: No, Daddy! You promised to bring the puppy!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2702_7: It's the helicopter again! Hurry! Wave the sheet... No! They didn't see us!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2703_1: No... there's no time for last words...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2703_2: It's alright... Daddy will be back when you count to one thousand... Haruka... Don't fall asleep... Stay awake...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2703_4: It's okay... I'll find the way back...
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2704_1: Losssst… it hurrrts… but you… you still…
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_28_4: TURN AROUND AND GRAB MY HAND!
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_28_6: Is she inside that space now?
Shixifeidu_main_2_8_2503_6: Sabotage—Damn it, we were so close!
Guid_LMYY_1_1: Membership... Appraisal... Hmm, more fancy words....
Guid_LMYY_1_2: Guess she's not the type to sit back and relax...
Guid_LMYY_10_1: Every single one of these wind chimes carried someone's wish. Their ringing was like a prayer.
Guid_LMYY_10_2: But now, everyone who made those wishes and anyone who might've made them come true... they're all gone.
Guid_LMYY_10_3: The one who can make their wishes come true...
Guid_LMYY_10_5: I… I can't make anyone's wish come true. What can I do?
Guid_LMYY_10_6: Maybe people didn't make wishes here just so someone could fulfill them.
Guid_LMYY_10_7: ...Maybe they did it just to be heard. To share their joy and their sorrow. The wish itself is proof that they were here. A message for anyone who comes after.
Guid_LMYY_10_8: And now... we can hear them too. Isn't that enough?
Guid_LMYY_10_9: ...You're a special soul. You really live up to that "Dark Justice" title, too. Thank you. I... I needed to hear that.
Guid_LMYY_10_12: Afraid not! Naming the hero is a privilege of the people.
Guid_LMYY_10_13: Come on, let's go. We've got more locations to shoot!
Guid_LMYY_11_1: I remember a huge bed of hydrangeas right by this tennis court...
Guid_LMYY_12_1: I was scared me to death. TDs, in the residential area! {PlayerName}, thank goodness you were here!
Guid_LMYY_12_2: Must be that dense Remnant Energy that pulled them in and changed the landscape… But it's not all bad. We got some amazing shots out of it.
Guid_LMYY_12_3: You seem to know a lot...
Guid_LMYY_12_5: Of course I do. I'm part of that past.
Guid_LMYY_12_6: This city, me, and everyone else still wandering here... we were all lost in the disaster. What's left are only remnants of the past.
Guid_LMYY_12_7: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hide it. I just... couldn't find the words.
Guid_LMYY_12_10: You've already figured it out, haven't you? Or... did you know from the start?
Guid_LMYY_12_12: I realized it from the way you spoke and acted.
Guid_LMYY_12_13: The Left Behind in Honami don't see Neon Tower's distortion. They don't remember the Lament that struck either.
Guid_LMYY_12_14: They just... go on, repeating their old lives and memories in this Sonoro city.
Guid_LMYY_12_16: I can't say why exactly... but when the Lament came... I was aware of it. I felt my own end.
Guid_LMYY_12_17: And in that instant, a single, powerful wish was born. I think... that wish is what's keeping me here.
Guid_LMYY_12_18: I won't fade away. Not until I've seen it through. That's my choice.
Guid_LMYY_12_21: ...Yes. And with your help, it's almost within reach.
Guid_LMYY_12_22: Alright, my sweet hero! Just one last place I want to photograph. Let's go.
Guid_LMYY_13_1: This is the last one. Take the picture however feels right to you.
Guid_LMYY_14_1: An ordinary neighborhood. An empty playground…
Guid_LMYY_14_2: It's like everyone just... stepped out for a minute.
Guid_LMYY_15_1: The last photo for the Honami City project is finally complete.
Guid_LMYY_15_2: Could you deliver these to the Pioneer Association for me?
Guid_LMYY_15_3: My application must be years overdue by now. Ah, just saying it out loud is so embarrassing!
Guid_LMYY_15_4: I will. But... are you sure you don't want to be the one to do it?
Guid_LMYY_15_5: I thought you'd want to see it to the end yourself.
Guid_LMYY_15_7: The truth is... I almost quit my appraisal. Halfway through.
Guid_LMYY_15_8: When I joined the Association as an intern and saw what my peers were willing to do, I realized my dream was just a kid's fantasy. A naive admiration.
Guid_LMYY_15_9: I couldn't do what they did. Staking their lives to photograph a dying city. I admired their passion... but I just didn't have it in me.
Guid_LMYY_15_10: Compared to them, my resolve was a joke. So I came back to Honami, buried the project, and tried to forget.
Guid_LMYY_15_13: ...I couldn't bear the thought of Honami being forgotten. I refused to let that happen.
Guid_LMYY_15_14: In that final moment, as I lay dying, I saw Honami's blue sky one last time. Saw the cherry blossoms falling as always...
Guid_LMYY_15_15: Regret washed over me. And from it, a wish was born. Stronger than anything I'd ever felt.
Guid_LMYY_15_16: ...This city that I loved so much, its people, all of it... it didn't deserve to just vanish.
Guid_LMYY_15_17: In that moment, I finally understood. The duty I walked away from... my friends at the Association...
Guid_LMYY_15_18: They must have known this feeling. That's why they walked into danger. To record it all. To save something.
Guid_LMYY_15_21: ...Yes. And completing this "Honami Photo Feature" with you is the last thing I can do for this city.
Guid_LMYY_15_24: Yes. It is. Thank you, Dark Legend of Justice.
Guid_LMYY_15_25: No... thank you, my friend. For helping me see it through.
Guid_LMYY_15_26: You leave Honami City and deliver the photos to the Pioneer Association, along with Eri's membership application…
Guid_LMYY_16_1: Hello again, Passenger! Hm? Where's the other Passenger?
Guid_LMYY_16_4: I see, I see. What a shame. I even had dessert ready for her. More for me, I suppose.
Guid_LMYY_16_5: This is the reward she promised. She left it in my care for you.
Guid_LMYY_16_6: Y'know, when she first wandered in here, she put on a cheerful face. But I could feel the weight on her.
Guid_LMYY_16_7: On your little adventure together, did she get any happier?
Guid_LMYY_16_10: Wonderful! After all, making sure Honami's people are happy is one of my duties, you know!
Guid_LMYY_2_1: Welcome back, Passenger! Perfect timing! Someone came here looking for you. Said it's something important.
Guid_LMYY_2_5: Nope, a new face! Oh, this calls for a celebration!
Guid_LMYY_2_6: Thanks to you and Chisa breaking Honami's loop, Shashou Cafe finally has a new visitor. Who knows, this cafe might just hum with life again.
Guid_LMYY_2_9: She said she's from the Pioneer Association. She seemed... troubled by a "membership appraisal."
Guid_LMYY_2_10: We chatted. She asked about nice spots for pictures. I suggested the fountain.
Guid_LMYY_2_11: The cherry blossoms there are in full bloom. They won the vote for... "Honami Crossing's Most Scenic Spot"!
Guid_LMYY_2_14: Uh-huh. Whenever that came up, things got a bit heavy…
Guid_LMYY_2_15: Too complicated. Not for a capybara like me. It's best you ask her yourself.
Guid_LMYY_2_16: The cafe needs me, so I'll leave you to it, Passenger.
Guid_LMYY_3_1: Maybe if I try a different angle, the photo would look better?
Guid_LMYY_4_1: Hi, I'm Eri from the Pioneer Association. Finally, we meet!
Guid_LMYY_4_2: (A Left Behind, but doesn't seem local. Where did she come from?)
Guid_LMYY_4_3: (...Unusual. Better figure out her intentions first.)
Guid_LMYY_4_5: Namipon said you were looking for me?
Guid_LMYY_4_6: Ah, yes! The "Dark Legend of Justice"! Please, I have a request for you!
Guid_LMYY_4_9: Of course! I recognized you immediately.
Guid_LMYY_4_10: You're the "Mysterious Scissorswoman's" partner. The black-haired hero, Honami's newest urban legend!
Guid_LMYY_4_11: It's not just that you're strong enough to fight the TDs. It's why you do it. People can see you're genuinely trying to protect this city.
Guid_LMYY_4_14: C'mon, legends need cool titles. It's part of the appeal!
Guid_LMYY_4_15: Anyway, the real reason I sought you out is because I need your help with a project. I want to photograph Honami City.
Guid_LMYY_4_16: This isn't just for fun. It's for my membership appraisal. I call myself a member of the Pioneer Association, but I'm technically still pending membership review.
Guid_LMYY_4_19: I've been a huge fan of Wutherium Geographic magazine since I was a kid. Joining the Pioneer Association as an editor? That's the dream.
Guid_LMYY_4_20: But the Editorial Board has a crazy appraisal process. You have to pitch a project that aligns with the Association's mission, pull off a photoshoot, secure approval, and get it published.
Guid_LMYY_4_21: I finally chose my theme, but now the streets are blocked, TDs are popping up everywhere, and my Terminal decided to die on me!
Guid_LMYY_4_22: I was totally out of options until I started hearing about your heroics... Please, you have to help me! This is my one shot!
Guid_LMYY_4_24: And the reward for all this?
Guid_LMYY_4_25: Thank you, Dark Legend of Justice! Don't worry, I won't let you work for free!
Guid_LMYY_4_26: Oh, don't worry. I'm not about to let a legendary hero work for free!
Guid_LMYY_4_27: Let's get started then. Please, take a photo of this fountain at its absolute best.
Guid_LMYY_4_28: This place... it used to be so full of life. You could see tired shoppers stopping by, listening to the water, stealing a moment of peace.
Guid_LMYY_4_29: Just like Shashou Cafe, this fountain became a landmark in Honami Crossing. It's a memory... the feeling of being perfectly content.
Guid_LMYY_5_1: The lighting, the framing, the timing… perfect. Just perfect!
Guid_LMYY_5_2: Seeking out your help couldn't have been more right. Thank you! And of course, I have Namipon to thank for introducing us.
Guid_LMYY_5_3: Honami's mascot always brings luck. Wherever Namipon goes, good things follow.
Guid_LMYY_5_4: So, it's only fitting that our next stop has a whole lot more Namipons!
Guid_LMYY_6_1: Look! The cherry blossoms, and this grand army of Namipon statues. This spot was voted to the top of Honami's "Ten Best Views" list more than once, you know.
Guid_LMYY_6_2: This tree may have grown a bit… wild, but somehow all these Namipons balance it out.
Guid_LMYY_6_3: What do you think? Can you feel the bond between Honami and its favorite capybara?
Guid_LMYY_6_5: And its fascination with voting for random stuff.
Guid_LMYY_6_6: Ha! You got me there. People in Honami get kinda obsessed with the things important to them.
Guid_LMYY_6_7: It's that dopey face, the slow waddle, the fluffy everything... Namipon just has a way of melting stress away.
Guid_LMYY_6_10: People here place their hopes for tomorrow on that little guy. I guess when life feels unpredictable, you hold on to simple, certain things.
Guid_LMYY_6_11: Ah, listen to me ramble on! Sorry, sorry! To make it up to you, you pick the next spot. Your turn to choose a photo op.
Guid_LMYY_6_14: Then I'm counting on you. Honestly, I'm really curious to see what you think is beautiful in this city.
Guid_LMYY_6_15: (Chisa mentioned the cherry blossoms in the Underground Street… That could work.)
Guid_LMYY_7_1: Didn't expect you to pick this place.
Guid_LMYY_7_3: She said it was lovely here.
Guid_LMYY_7_4: Let me guess, was it that mysterious scissor-wielding girl? She's got quite the eye! Hey, maybe she should pick up a camera herself and contribute to the Pioneer Association.
Guid_LMYY_7_7: This is Seisen Garden… I haven't been here in ages.
Guid_LMYY_7_8: This underground street used to be the heart of Honami's art scene. They were always hosting film festivals and photo exhibitions... I even had a few of my own pieces displayed here once.
Guid_LMYY_7_9: Now, it's just the cherry blossoms putting on a show for nobody. No more exhibitions. No more crowds.
Guid_LMYY_7_11: It's more regret than sadness, really. But don't you worry about me, I'm fine.
Guid_LMYY_7_12: ...Right now, I have more important things to do.
Guid_LMYY_7_13: Anyway, we're done here. On to the next spot! Hmm... where to?
Guid_LMYY_7_16: The Summer Arbor walkway in Central Park? The wind chimes are beautiful, but... it's too close to Neon Tower. Could be risky. You sure about that?
Guid_LMYY_7_17: (Most Left Behind instinctively ignore the anomalies around them. It's a coping mechanism.)
Guid_LMYY_7_18: (But Eri notices the Tower's anomalies... She really is different.)
Guid_LMYY_7_21: Just... please be careful. I don't want you going out of your way.
Guid_LMYY_8_1: I never thought I would be able to come back here.
Guid_LMYY_8_2: Listen. Hear the wind chimes in the Summer Arbor?
Guid_LMYY_9_1: That sound... It's just like old times...

GNNPC_SBDTCD_14_1: Are you… a student from the nearby school? Skipping class today?
GNNPC_SBDTCD_14_2: …What about you? Lazing about in the park to skip work?
GNNPC_SBDTCD_14_3: I'm an adult. I have my reasons. Besides, the view here is nice.
GNNPC_SBDTCD_14_4: Adult, you say? You don't look much older than me.
GNNPC_SBDTCD_14_5: You really know how to talk. So, want something to drink?

GNNPC_SBDTCD_16_1: (What's that on the sand? Some special pattern?)
GNNPC_SBDTCD_2_1: Hmm... This cover smells fishy. Should we take a look?
GNNPC_SBDTCD_3_1: (That tennis ball hopper over there... Is that some special frequency on it?)
GNNPC_SBDTCD_4_1: Ugh... What a smell... Somethin' weird must've happened at a table around.

SDLZXXBST_11_1: During the peak dining hours, seat turnover rises by 37%, yet the average meal time falls by 15%. Such herd behavior is worth chronicling.
SDLZXXBST_11_2: Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?
SDLZXXBST_11_3: Greetings, Arbiter from the chronicles. I am Eivind the Chronicler. For your aid in the Solisylum, our deep gratitude you have.
SDLZXXBST_11_4: Since the Spacetrek Collective launched Helios, the Heliogyre is no longer our sole observational tool. From pure computation, we are freed. Our attention may turn to other significant realms.
SDLZXXBST_11_6: Research. For Roya under the new sun, new Lahai-Roi season laws are required. Local diets, their social rhythms... Yes, all precious first-hand data.
SDLZXXBST_11_7: Look at those mingling at shared tables. Their conversations, food preferences, and even body language... they paint a portrait of present society.
SDLZXXBST_11_8: Subtle data, this. For the Heliogyre to quantify, difficult. But important to the drafting of new season laws and their guiding procedures.
SDLZXXBST_11_9: As Chronicler, I will report my thoughts and observations back to the Shaper. Such services can still be of use to him.
SDLZXXBST_12_1: Rinascita... the Carnevale... Gondolas... Gladiator battles...

SDLZXXBST_13_2: Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?

SDLZXXBST_17_18: Aren't these two the perfect Royan specimens?
SDLZXXBST_19_1: Startorch Academy... Sundermere... Nice places, they are. The Spacetrek Collective's public transport is very convenient...
SDLZXXBST_19_2: Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?
SDLZXXBST_19_3: The old Horstvald was indeed the Binder of the Six. But now, a wandering old man I'd rather be.
SDLZXXBST_19_5: Observing this and that, as was my dream. In my youth, a traveler I always wished to be.
SDLZXXBST_19_6: After your Spacetrek Collective launched Helios into the sky, lighter grew the burden in the Solisylum. "No longer stay confined," the Shaper told us. "For the Royan governance and the new season laws, gather knowledge," he said.
SDLZXXBST_19_7: But we knew his true wish. It was for us, who had given our lives to the Solisylum, to finally go out and see the world.

SDLZXXBST_19_9: And what I observe... to the Shaper, I will carry.

SDLZXXBST_20_2: To lay eyes on you once more, Arbiter, is a pleasure.
SDLZXXBST_20_3: The Heliogyre has shown me that the Spacetrek Collective's ceremony was a success. To you and your companions, my congratulations I offer.
SDLZXXBST_20_4: If questions remain for me, or the Heliogyre. I, the Shaper, shall answer.
SDLZXXBST_20_9: Because of your aid, the Heliogyre turns anew. The Solisylum has returned to normality.
SDLZXXBST_20_10: The Helios in the sky now weaves together wisdom from both the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya. Data once seen only by the Heliogyre... now the Hyvatia Detector may also obtain.
SDLZXXBST_20_11: The Heliogyre's operations stand ready to perform primary verification tasks.
SDLZXXBST_20_12: Thus, in the Solisylum, I alone am sufficient.
SDLZXXBST_20_13: After your authorization, the Heliogyre has concentrated all of its computational power within me. No longer do the Six need to bear those immense calculations in parallel, at all times.
SDLZXXBST_20_14: Now, the other Five may devote their energies to managing Royan affairs. Under the new sun, the Roya need new season laws.
SDLZXXBST_20_15: For this, I require them to gather outside knowledge. With this, I will weave into my own computations.
SDLZXXBST_20_16: <ano=The Eye>Iselde's</ano> perception, <ano=the Binder>Horstvald's</ano> foresight, <ano=the Recorder>Laetia's</ano> curiosity, <ano=the Chronicler>Eivind's</ano> discipline, and <ano=the Refiner>Freamir's</ano> empathy...  they are the Heliogyre's senses in the world. And to the Solisylum, they will return their findings.
SDLZXXBST_20_17: Before they entered the Solisylum, the Heliodic Six were but mere mortals.
SDLZXXBST_20_18: Now they enjoy some time to lay down their burden. I hope... their lives will unfold as they wish. At least for the time being.
SDLZXXBST_20_19: If you see them in Lahai-Roi, please, as a witness, offer them your blessing.
SDLZXXBST_20_20: All of the Heliogyre's computational power is now concentrated within me. Wherever the sunlight touches, so too do my thoughts.
SDLZXXBST_20_21: But this is not without cost.
SDLZXXBST_20_23: As you once said... I am now bound to the Heliogyre's will. From the Solisylum, I cannot depart.
SDLZXXBST_20_24: Human flesh and blood were not made to bear such vast quantities of information in so short a span. Should this continue, my body's decay will quicken tenfold until the electricity in my nerves ceases... and a final computation concludes.
SDLZXXBST_20_25: Yet... the Spacetrek Collective already seeks a remedy. Just as the Heliodic Six with mortal strength touched the divine, so too does their technology strive to undo the toll the gods have exacted upon me.
SDLZXXBST_20_26: I believe in them. Just as I have always believed in the Roya.
SDLZXXBST_20_27: In a future where the light shines brighter, we will one day witness together.
SDLZXXBST_20_29: Do not forget that all the knowledge of the Heliogyre is mine to share with you. Should you have need, I will respond.

ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_1: O Rover guided by the tides, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores. You've braved tempests, heard the dual nature of Ragunna's faith, and tasted the glory in the arenas of Septimont. Now, the path to the frozen frontier unfolds in Honami City. It's time to set forth to Lahai-Roi.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_2: As the tides receded, a new world and an unexplored adventure awaited you.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_3: In Jinzhou, you joined hands with Jiyan and the other Resonators to quell the Tacet Discord outbreak in Norfall Barrens. You also met "little Abby." You ultimately triumphed over and absorbed the Dreamless.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_4: Under the guidance of the Wayfinder Changli, you resolved the Temporal Disruption at Mt. Firmament. And Sentinel Jué passed the Temporal Mandate on to Magistrate Jinhsi.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_5: When you sought the truth of your own past, you met Shorekeeper in the Black Shores and reclaimed your duty as the organization's leader.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_6: In search of a solution to Abby's deteriorating condition, you crossed the Stormy Sea and arrived in Ragunna, a port city in Rinascita.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_7: You met Carlotta of the Montelli family, who vouched for your entry into the city. Yet beneath Ragunna's splendor, the Order of the Deep was guarding a grave secret, one tied to the Sentinel of Rinascita, Imperator.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_8: When the Order conspired to sabotage the Carnevale, you and your companions calmed Lorelei's rage, defeated the Dragon of Dirge, and joined forces with the Troupe of Fools to bring the Carnevale to life.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_9: But amid the cheers of the celebration, the Fractsidus's Overseer, Phrolova, appeared. Together with your companions, you defeated her and claimed the Laurel of the Carnevale.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_10: After the Carnevale, the Primus of the Order spoke to you of the Sentinel, the Threnodian, and a Blessed Maiden of legend. All clues pointed toward the Fisalia family, which has long been entwined with both the Sentinel and the Threnodian.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_11: At the invitation of the Fisalia head, Cantarella, you traveled to Porto-Veno Castle. From her, you learned that the Threnodian "Leviathan" commands the power to merge and assimilate.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_12: For generations, the Fisalia family's mission had been to resonate with the Sentinel's true remaining power and find Their Resonator, the Blessed Maiden.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_13: The current Blessed Maiden, Cartethyia, awaited you in the inverted Avinoleum Theological Seminary. With your help, she finally uncovered the truth behind the Sentinel and the Threnodian—that she herself was a creation of the Threnodian Leviathan.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_14: The Sentinel's corrupted body had long been destroyed, and what remained sealed away was a vessel bearing Leviathan's will, "Fleurdelys." Cartethyia wished to end both the corrupted "Divinity" and its vessel.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_15: Eventually, you and Cartethyia defeated the Threnodian's vessel, Fleurdelys. There, you saw the final consciousness of Imperator, who, with the last of Their will, awakened Cartethyia.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_16: With the fall of the Sentinel, Cartethyia, now a wandering knight of Rinascita, chose to live by her own will.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_17: Not long after, you sensed Cartethyia's abrupt departure from Avinoleum and followed her trail to the city of Gladiators, Septimont.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_18: In Septimont, you met the young Gladiator Lupa and teamed up with her in the arena.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_19: As the truth came to light later, you discovered that Lupa's fate had merged with the Threnodian's failed creation, Mya.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_20: But the Threnodian's Gem on Mya's helmet was taken by the Fractsidus Overseer, Phrolova.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_21: To retrieve the Gem, you set sail from Septimont, only to encounter the Order's Primus, Fenrico. He summoned colossal waves that dragged you under. As you sank into the deep, it was Phrolova who came to your rescue.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_22: She revealed that Primus Fenrico had already taken the Gem and that she had been hunted down and gravely wounded by the Order. You agreed to a temporary alliance to reclaim the Gem.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_23: As you pursued Fenrico, you came to understand Phrolova's true target: the power of assimilation hidden within the Threnodian's Gem.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_24: And in her endless waiting, she finally set down her violin.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_25: When you and Phrolova left the Lost Beyond, you confronted Fenrico, only to find that he intended to use the Gem for his own design: to draw the collective subconscious of the Rinascitans out from the Dark Tide, liberating Rinascita once and for all from the Threnodian's control.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_26: But Fenrico himself had long since fallen to the Threnodian's corrupting influence. In his final moment of clarity, he gave his life to stop the Dark Tide's spread, entrusting you with Rinascita's future and with the task of preventing the descent of the Journeying Paradise.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_27: As Fenrico turned to stone, the Gem slipped from his hand. You and Phrolova fought once more, but the Gem was eventually seized by the Fractsidus Overseers. Phrolova, wounded by your blade during the battle, fell into the sea and vanished.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_28: Following the clues Fenrico left behind, you traveled to Septimont. There, the Ephor, Augusta, extended an invitation to you.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_29: In the Sanguis Plateaus, you met Avidius, a rising Hero of Heroes recognized by the Senate. During the final pursuit of the Dark Tide creation known as the Corrosaurus, Augusta prepared to execute her original plan—
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_30: To turn the tide, Iuno sacrificed her very existence to forcibly manifest the Dark Tide, giving you and Augusta one last chance to strike down the False Sovereign. Against all odds, you prevailed.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_31: Guided by the bracelet Iuno left behind, you finally found the girl only you remembered, just before she faded away in a sliver of moonlight.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_32: Determined to bring Iuno back, you traveled to Tetragon Temple in search of clues. Through Avidius's story, you came to understand that existence itself was the sum of memories, feelings, and connections. You decided to Anchor Iuno back into existence through those bonds.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_33: You made yourself the Anchor and held Iuno's spectral hand as you traversed her memories. Piece by piece, you reconnected her memories and emotions, until she was brought back into existence.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_34: After retrieving Imperator's relic from the Earthrend Wedge beneath Septimont, you returned to Ragunna and set off for the Avinoleum Theological Seminary to seek Cartethyia's guidance on unlocking its secrets.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_35: To track down the killer, you joined forces with Avidius, who was pursuing the "Quillbearer." Together, you found the mysterious woman called Galbrena.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_36: After witnessing Avidius's tragic fate, the truth finally emerged: you were the new Harbinger of the Dark Tide chosen by Leviathan. To confront both the Dark Tide and the looming Journeying Paradise, you and Galbrena set out once more for Septimont.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_37: Near the Three Heroes' Crest, you and your companions battled the Dark Tide head-on. To end its corruption and prevent the descent of the Journeying Paradise, you ventured directly into the heart of the Dark Tide.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_38: After crossing the Styx Lake and a fabricated Mindscape, you and your companions manage to shatter the gates of Leviathan's Paradise. Together, you defeated the divine husk Leviathan had reshaped in the image of the Blessed Maiden, Fleurdelys.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_39: With your journey in Rinascita concluded, you returned to the Black Shores. There, a rift near the coast pulled you into a Sonoro Sphere containing the ruins of the once-prosperous Honami City.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_40: To end the Lament's destructive loop, you and Chisa made your way to Neon Tower, the heart of the disturbance. After clearing the last of the Lament, you helped the city residents' Longings find their way home. You and Chisa returned to the Black Shores and Honami City finally saw the light of a new day.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_41: You guided Chisa through her doubts about the future, and together you reopened Shashou Cafe. For a while, you and your friends shared a rare time of peace.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_42: Leviathan has even corrupted and merged with the Sentinel Imperator, and through the long course of history, twisted the faith of both Ragunna and the Order of the Deep.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_43: Soon, you sensed that something was amiss in Septimont. At times, Lupa's figure blurred into that of another Gladiator girl.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_44: In the end, Cartethyia and Lupa joined forces to bring down Cristoforo's scheme. Peace finally returned to Septimont, and Mya was finally able to rest in peace.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_45: With this power, she hoped to merge the souls of those she'd once known—the townsfolk who perished in a great calamity—into the bodies of Tacet Discords, granting them new life in her Sonoro Sphere, the Lost Beyond.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_46: Hoping both to find the relic left behind by Imperator and to suppress the spreading Dark Tide, you accepted the invitation and joined the great hunt.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_47: With the Priestess Iuno's aid, she intended to lure out and destroy the False Sovereign, a humanoid embodiment of the Dark Tide. However, the Fractsidus intervened, and the plan failed.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_48: During the post-hunt celebration, you realized that everyone had forgotten Iuno's existence. Even Augusta believed she was merely a hallucination caused by your exposure to the Dark Tide.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_49: Defying fate's ordained ending, you both returned to the day of the celebration. Iuno once again stood as the blue-haired girl the Priestesses talked about. She had broken the arrow of destiny itself, and you delivered an unwritten future to both her and Septimont.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_50: But at the Seminary, you witnessed a mysterious woman—someone you had seen before in a vision—suddenly break in and shoot Cartethyia before your eyes. Across Rinascita, strange phenomena began to spread.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_51: She claimed she'd been searching for the "Harbinger of the Dark Tide." Yet, in your mind, the Harbinger, Fenrico, had long since perished beneath the sea.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_52: Within the Dark Tide, you saw Galbrena's past struggles against the Tide and came upon a mysterious member of the Fractsidus who stood in your way.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_53: At last, Rinascita welcomed a dawn that belonged solely to its people, an era no longer defined by Divinity.
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_54: As you explored the city, you met a girl named Chisa, who had been fighting ceaselessly within the Lament's time loops. You also encountered a talking capybara named Namipon...
ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_55: But soon, you began to experience a loss in your frequency. According to Shorekeeper, your frequency was being drawn toward the region of Lahai-Roi. To resolve this mystery, you must now set out once again…

XJXYBGSST_16_6: The novel foodstuffs served in the Food, Utilities & Energy Lounge are mostly the result of their research. Always nutritious, but the taste... well, best not to think about that.

XJXYBGSST_16_8: The stuff they come up with tastes ten times worse than the food in <ano=the cafeteria>F.U.E.L.</ano>. I wouldn't steer you wrong, fresher!

XJXYBGSST_16_10: The Department of Voidmatters specializes in studying Waveworn Phenomena and Void Storms to predict and control these disasters. But once they get deep into their research, they often forget to eat and... can start to lose touch with humanity.
XJXYBGSST_16_11: Then there's the Department of Light Energy Sciences, home to the Division of Light Array Engineering, focused on energy conversion. They spend their days buried in blueprints and equations—a stark contrast to the guys over at the Agro Wing.
XJXYBGSST_16_12: In short, each department is unique. Choosing one isn't just about picking an area of study, it's about choosing a lifestyle for the next four years.
XJXYBGSST_16_13: I hope you'll find your passion during your time here at Startorch Academy.

XJXYBC_4_8: Oh? It's rare to see a freshman from outside Engineering interested in this stuff. In that case, I'll give you the full breakdown! I'll skip the algorithms and just talk about the final rules.
XJXYBC_4_9: First, every mech has one Meta‑Protocol: In the absence of any command input, a mech must not perform any action unless that action complies with its principles.
XJXYBC_4_10: Every mech rolls out with pre‑programmed directives. Like genes and instincts in humans, we've given them their own "instincts" based on this protocol. For example…
XJXYBC_4_11: A Mechascout's "instinct" is to keep students safe.
XJXYBC_4_12: A TARD-E Unit's "instinct" is to prod students into getting to class on time.
XJXYBC_4_13: That's right! You're a bit of a smarty pants, freshman!
XJXYBC_4_14: Next up are our "Three Major Protocols"—Protocol Three: A mech must strive to preserve its own survival, so long as this does not violate Protocol One or Protocol Two.
XJXYBC_4_15: Protocol Two: A mech must obey human commands. If a Stargram Link is established, the linked human's commands take priority, unless they conflict with Protocol One.
XJXYBC_4_16: Finally, Protocol One—Protect humanity: A mech must not harm any individual human, nor, through inaction, allow any individual human to come to harm…
XJXYBC_4_19: These protocols are enough to let mechs operate freely and handle most situations.
XJXYBC_4_20: But in practice, new problems always pop up. Someone even wrote a whole collection of short stories about the contradictions these protocols could create!
XJXYBC_4_21: The Academy is considering adding a protocol that a mech must recognize itself as a machine. And one mech once proposed a Protocol Zero: A mech must protect humanity's collective interest from harm…
XJXYBC_4_22: But across all protocol design, one "directive" remains the same: protect humanity.
XJXYBC_4_23: But the question remains... How are we to define "human," exactly?
XJXYBC_4_24: If someone has replaced most of their body with mechanical prosthetics, or displays extensive Tacet Discord traits... and if the very definition of "human" were to change, how are they supposed to judge?
XJXYBC_4_25: It's a long, hard road. And look... Every discussion about mech behavior rules ultimately circles back to us humans in the end...
XJXYBC_4_26: Maybe the very existence of mechs is also a kind of mirror we're holding up to ourselves…
