NPC_XYJS_411_2: Since when did you transfer to Rabelle College?!
NPC_XYJS_411_3: What do you mean? I'm just sitting in on their classes.
NPC_XYJS_411_4: Hate to break it to you, but sitting in on that many lectures isn't gonna turn you into a Synchronist.
NPC_XYJS_411_5: How do you know I won't learn something?!
NPC_XYJS_411_6: Besides, if a Synchronist can handle it, so can I!
NPC_XYJS_42_1: Should I change my research focus...?
NPC_XYJS_42_2: Professor Mornye has pretty much picked Exostrider Transitional Dynamics clean. There's nothing original left to write.
NPC_XYJS_421_1: I-I can't even get a single paper published!
NPC_XYJS_421_2: Maybe... I'll just apply to work with Professor Mornye.
NPC_XYJS_421_3: If I can't publish on my own, I'll just do it under her.
NPC_XYJS_421_4: Yeah, that's it! So now the issue is...
NPC_XYJS_421_5: If I remember right, the requirement to join Professor Mornye's team is to have published a paper on Transitional Dynamics.
NPC_XYJS_43_2: After my Neuroresonance lecture, I have to sprint to the proving grounds for a Weaponry lecture.
NPC_XYJS_43_3: Then after Weaponry, back here again... There's no way I'm going to make it in time. I'm not a boomerang.
NPC_XYJS_43_5: Need to report this to Madam President. They should give us a shuttle bus, at least.
NPC_XYJS_44_1: Have you seen that Skelecanth in the culture chamber?
NPC_XYJS_44_2: It's exactly like the one in the Collins documentary trilogy.
NPC_XYJS_44_3: You've got it backwards. The documentary was filmed based on real animals.
NPC_XYJS_44_4: But I get it. Seeing a fish swim through sand must be strange for anyone who didn't grow up in Lahai-Roi.
NPC_XYJS_44_5: Tell me about it. The deserts outside the New Federation cities don't have fish like that.
NPC_XYJS_44_6: It's crazy how much you miss when you only see something through a screen. You really have to see it in person.
NPC_XYJS_44_7: Being able to actually see them swirl through the sand, like fish in water, must be a wonderful feeling...
NPC_XYJS_45_1: Have you ever heard the sound mushrooms make?
NPC_XYJS_451_3: The Overtonic Society has a frequency extraction device that can capture their voices.
NPC_XYJS_451_4: The mushrooms make really sharp, high-pitched sounds, almost like they're screaming.
NPC_XYJS_451_5: Yeah, they make the same sound when you toss them in a frying pan...
NPC_XYJS_46_1: Want to grab some chow later?
NPC_XYJS_461_1: You've been stuck in the lab all day, and you still have energy for a club?
NPC_XYJS_461_3: I need to clear my head. Even if I don't relax, I might at least get some new ideas.
NPC_XYJS_461_4: Oh, I think we're going over Honeypot baking methods today.
NPC_XYJS_461_5: A baking club? You've been holding out on me! That sounds awesome.
NPC_XYJS_461_6: Count me in. That solves dinner for tonight.
NPC_XYJS_47_3: Students? Who gave you permission to be here in the middle of the night?
NPC_XYJS_47_4: Let me see your student IDs!
NPC_XYJS_47_5: Here you go, sir. They're all here...
NPC_XYJS_47_6: A couple of third-years in Energy Sciences, huh? What's your business here?
NPC_XYJS_47_7: We just wanted to see if we could find the Phantom Diva, sir...
NPC_XYJS_47_8: Yeah! The one that crawls out of screens!
NPC_XYJS_47_9: You mean I.R.I.S.? What do you want with her for?
NPC_XYJS_47_11: Who else would it be? You live in a scientific institute, not some cheap horror flick...
NPC_XYJS_48_3: Precise intel will be delivered prior to decryption...
NPC_XYJS_49_2: Anything to pass this exam. Just this once...
NPC_XYJS_49_4: Whoa! A student? You scared me! I thought you were a teacher from Academic Affairs.
NPC_XYJS_49_5: Look, don't tell anyone, okay? I'm just... putting my specialty to use.
NPC_XYJS_49_6: Using your skills to their full potential doesn't... technically count as changing grades, right?
NPC_XYJS_49_7: Forcing a STEM student to cram all that history is a crime against nature anyway.
NPC_XYJS_5_2: Are you late? Or just sitting in?
NPC_XYJS_5_5: Well, you sure took your time!
NPC_XYJS_5_6: Over here, quick, sit down. This professor is a total hawk about attendance.
NPC_XYJS_5_7: Open your textbook. We're on page 97.
NPC_XYJS_5_8: Act like you've been here this whole time, got it?
NPC_XYJS_50_1: That should be all for today.
NPC_XYJS_50_2: I'd better start organizing today's data...
NPC_XYJS_5011_1: It's... IT'S COMING OUT OF THE SCREEN!
NPC_XYJS_5012_1: Is it really real? How come we still haven't seen anything yet?
NPC_XYJS_5012_3: The Phantom Diva from Startorch's Great Mysteries. They say she crawls out of screens at night.
NPC_XYJS_5012_4: But we've been searching all night and haven't found anything.
NPC_XYJS_5012_9: Well, I'll be an Exostrider's uncle!
NPC_XYJS_5012_10: Oh, I, uh... I just remembered there's something I have to do...
NPC_XYJS_5012_11: And it's not good to be wandering the halls this late! Later!
NPC_XYJS_51_1: Have logistics bring over another half-bag of cement powder.
NPC_XYJS_51_2: Can't believe they managed to blast a hole in it. 3D printing alone won't cut it for a patch job.
NPC_XYJS_51_3: I've seen worse. Last week at the proving grounds was a real mess.
NPC_XYJS_51_4: A student had a Forte freak-out and caused a gravity shift in a lecture hall.
NPC_XYJS_51_5: By the time I got there, everything was just... floating.
NPC_XYJS_51_6: Ah, the new generation outdoes the old. These kids keep getting more powerful. Back in my day—
NPC_XYJS_51_9: Let's wrap this up. They've got lectures tomorrow.
NPC_XYJS_52_1: I got it! I got it!
NPC_XYJS_52_2: I can feel it! The inspiration is flowing!
NPC_XYJS_52_3: Hahahaha! This will work for sure!
NPC_XYJS_52_4: Once this paper is complete, I'll be the greatest archaeologist of all time!
NPC_XYJS_53_2: Why do I get so sleepy the moment I walk into a lecture hall...
NPC_XYJS_6_1: Hmm... Oh, this seat is free. Go for it.
NPC_XYJS_6_2: I'm getting some extra shut-eye. After five 8 a.m. lectures in a row... I'm literally dying right now.
NPC_XYJS_6_3: Just nudge me if the professor does roll call...
NPC_XYJS_7_1: We have five out of twenty-five students here today.
NPC_XYJS_7_2: No need to check attendance. Any student not here will be marked absent.
NPC_XYJS_7_3: Are you here to sit in? Please sit somewhere in the back.
NPC_XYJS_7_4: Sir, aren't there a lot more than just five students present?
NPC_XYJS_7_5: If you are not the person enrolled in this course, you are absent.
NPC_XYJS_7_6: And while we're at it, let's have a quiz at the end of today's lecture.
NPC_XYJS_7_7: It will count towards 30% of your final grade this semester.
NPC_XYJS_8_1: Ugh, what is this professor? How does he remember every single student's face?
NPC_XYJS_8_2: I didn't have any issues standing in for other classes. This is the only one where I got caught.
NPC_XYJS_8_3: Oh. You're standing in for another student?
NPC_XYJS_8_5: I've never taken any Material Science courses before... I'm from the Agronomy Wing.
NPC_XYJS_8_6: I need to find the guy who's supposed to be here. If there's a quiz coming, I'm not facing a test I know nothing about...
NPC_XYJS_9_1: Hey, where did you come from? Are you a transfer student?
NPC_XYJS_9_2: I know you! You're from Rabelle College, aren't you?
NPC_XYJS_91_1: I saw him with Professor Mornye the other day.
NPC_XYJS_91_2: Tell me, how's the food in your cafeteria? Is it like toothpaste?
NPC_XYJS_91_3: Quiet down over there! What are you? A bunch of Fluffguins?
NPC_XYJS_91_4: You always swarm whenever someone new shows up.
NPC_XYJS_91_5: Interrupt my lecture again, and I'll have you standing in the frostlands like real Fluffguins.
StXYHYDX_1_1: Welcome, {PlayerName}. Your information has been processed and temporary access has been granted.  Welcome to Startorch Academy!
StXYHYDX_1_2: The Academy was founded with the core mission of identifying and training Synchronists capable of piloting the Exostrider, while cultivating expertise across all related fields. It functions as an integrated, non-profit base for both education and advanced research.
StXYHYDX_1_3: As the stars of knowledge brighten the sky, let Startorch Academy be the torch that lights the way for every curious mind.
Event_WWPDTYP_15_1: It looks fantastic! Let me take a sip…
Event_WWPDTYP_15_2: Mmm, not bad at all. Thanks for the drink, {PlayerName}!
Event_WWPDTYP_15_5: (Ask how Lupa has been doing lately.)
Event_WWPDTYP_16_2: Augh… I can't feel my tongue… I mean, it's not awful. But this combo might just be a little too… adventurous.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_4: Me? Lollo Logistics invited me as a special guest for the event.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_5: Septimont is looking to deepen its partnership with them.  Broadcast the next Great Agon across Rinascita, sell some merch... You know how it is.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_6: As the current champion, I was asked to attend their briefing, basically just to show the Ephor's support.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_8: Don't worry, I've got this. Just a few fan photos, some autographs, announcing the upcoming match schedule, and striking a few killer poses for the cameras.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_9: My role is simple: do what I do best and take home the win. The real negotiations are for the Ephor's envoy.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_10: Though I'm not here for the party itself, it's a rare chance to kick back a little. Want to join me, {PlayerName}?
Event_WWPDTYP_21_11: Same as always. Chasing glory and racking up victories in the arena. It's what I'm good at, just like most of Septimont's other Gladiators.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_12: After what the Silvas pulled in the last Agon, and how spectacularly it blew up in their faces, nobody dares try dirty tricks like that anymore.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_13: Anyway, life's good. For the first time, I can throw myself into what I truly want.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_14: Oh, speaking of battles, I haven't heard about the fights you had before you came to Septimont. We've got time now, so spill the stories, {PlayerName}!
Event_WWPDTYP_21_15: (Tell her about the fight against the Crownless.)
Event_WWPDTYP_21_16: (Tell her about the fight against the Dreamless.)
Event_WWPDTYP_21_17: (Tell her about the fight during the Carnevale.)
Event_WWPDTYP_21_18: The Crownless… was that your first strong enemy in Huanglong?
Event_WWPDTYP_21_19: Sounds like a nightmare. But against the Laureate? Huh, I bet it didn't stand a chance.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_20: …The incomplete form of the Threnodian of War? So you stopped it from hatching, but its vanguards still gave you and that Jinzhou general a right proper fight, hmm...
Event_WWPDTYP_21_21: Yeah. But without Abby's help, we wouldn't have been able to hold the line and defeat it.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_22: Huh, if I'd been there, I'd have fought alongside you. Threnodian or anything else.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_23: The Carnevale in Ragunna…? I heard you claimed the title of Laureate there, but I never knew the full story.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_24: What the Fractsidus did to Rinascita is unforgivable. One day, they'll pay for that. I'll make sure of it.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_25: What incredible stories! Each of these battles shines with its own glory...
Event_WWPDTYP_21_26: If the chance ever comes, let me stand with you in battle. After all, we are fellow warriors, aren't we?
Event_WWPDTYP_21_27: Hm? Curious why I'm so fond of iced drinks?
Event_WWPDTYP_21_28: Well, picture this: I'm out there every day, swinging my sword and spear thousands of times under the blazing sun. Then there's the strength training, the simulation battles...
Event_WWPDTYP_21_29: Even I am completely wiped by the end of it.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_30: But, hand me a tall, icy glass of fruit tea and let me chug it—
Event_WWPDTYP_21_33: Right? It's the drink for Gladiators. And fun fact: Heartpour only tastes this good because they actually took my advice when they developed it.
Event_WWPDTYP_21_34: Sure, there's a tiny side effect, but it kicks the heat and fatigue right out. Worth it, no?
Event_WWPDTYP_21_35: It looks fantastic! Let me take a sip…
Event_WWPDTYP_21_36: …Oh, this is amazing! So cooling, it hits the spot better than Heartpour! You know, you could go pro with this, Warrior. I'd endorse you for free!
Event_WWPDTYP_36_2: Oh! That's a very unique flavor. Thank you, {PlayerName}.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_7: It's a wonderful party, very lively. It reminds me of Ragunna's Carnevale.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_8: Everyone dropping their work and worries to frolic in the streets. Ah, the singing, the dancing, the masks...
Event_WWPDTYP_36_9: It didn't matter if you were from a rival family, or one of those stern Acolytes.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_10: For that one day, everyone just came together. Sharing art and food you wouldn't see any other time.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_12: Now that Ragunna is in peacetime, I'm sure they'll start hosting the Carnevale again every year.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_13: And in the future, whether it's the Carnevale or a party like this one… would it be alright if I celebrated with you?
Event_WWPDTYP_36_16: Then it's a date. I'll look forward to it!
Event_WWPDTYP_36_17: Lately? I've traveled to many places as a wandering knight.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_18: The Threnodian's shadow no longer hangs over Rinascita, but there's still no shortage of people who need a helping hand.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_19: Children who've lost their kittens, civilians attacked by Tacet Discords, explorers trapped in ancient ruins…
Event_WWPDTYP_36_20: Aiding those in need is a knight's duty, after all.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_21: A very Cartethyia way of looking at things.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_22: Oh yes, and I've seen landscapes and sights I never could've imagined!
Event_WWPDTYP_36_23: Folk songs, fascinating foods, statues in the mountains, and even the giant vortex at the center of the archipelago…
Event_WWPDTYP_36_24: Sounds like you've found meaning in this journey.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_25: I surely have. This is the life I've always dreamed about.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_26: What do I like to drink? Oh, honestly, I'll enjoy almost anything... as long as it has some juicy Viscum Berries in it.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_27: —Well, except for coffee. Its flavor is just too strong. It completely overpowers the Viscum Berries' taste.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_29: I really do! It's nice to try new foods, but Viscum Berries and Laurus will always be my favorites.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_30: Oh, that reminds me… did you know the Nectarwine from Egla Town tastes even better if you infuse it with Laurus leaves and Viscum Berries?
Event_WWPDTYP_36_31: Oh… so that time you were grounded by the Order…
Event_WWPDTYP_36_32: G-grounded? Wait—you mean… No! Please, don't bring up my past embarrassments!
Event_WWPDTYP_36_33: Ahem… Alright, I admit I wasn't exactly... composed at that time. But just so you know, the offering wine that time was pure! I didn't add a thing to it.
Event_WWPDTYP_36_34: And I've never let myself get that carried away ever since!
Event_WWPDTYP_37_1: You're finished? It looks... a bit different than what I expected.
Event_WWPDTYP_37_2: Wow, that's... a strong taste. Is this a new kind of knight's trial? Um, thank you, {PlayerName}.

Event_WWPDTYP_57_3: Is there anything I can help you with, Mentor?
Event_WWPDTYP_57_5: (Ask how Mornye has been doing lately.)
Event_WWPDTYP_57_7: President Lucilla told me Lollo Logistics had found a special Sonoro Sphere. She said its method of anchoring to reality might give valuable insight for my project.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_8: I dropped everything to come here, only to realize that she'd tricked me.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_9: She said over the comms, "You've been running on no sleep for days, haven't you? Consider this a mandatory break. There's a rather fun party happening."
Event_WWPDTYP_57_10: "Just relax and enjoy yourself. When it's time, someone will be along to take you home."
Event_WWPDTYP_57_13: …It's alright, I'm not upset. I'm used to her methods.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_14: So, what do you think of the party?
Event_WWPDTYP_57_15: I'm not really sure of the metrics for evaluating a party's success. But if "fun" is the primary variable... then yes, the data seems positive.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_16: I've only ever read about many of the things here. Seeing them up close is a new kind of experience.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_17: It's just… the atmosphere feels a little too social for my taste.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_19: Parties are supposed to be social.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_21: Try to enjoy your time off, Mornye.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_22: You as well, Mentor. A break will look good on you.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_23: Don't worry about me, Mentor. I'm feeling much better now.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_24: I've even taken on a new research project recently. I've encountered some obstacles, but the work is progressing, bit by bit.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_26: Make sure you get some rest.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_27: President Lucilla told me the same thing. I suppose that's why she went out of her way to trick me into coming to this party.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_28: Still, I'm not convinced that "stepping away from your work for a party will boost your research efficiency."
Event_WWPDTYP_57_29: There are too many unfinished reports and not nearly enough time… Besides, her theory may lack universality. I may be an outlier.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_30: Sounds like you've got the perfect opportunity to test it right now.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_31: …You're right. A theory isn't proven or disproven until it's tested.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_32: Then just enjoy the party while you can.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_34: Sustained research requires a clear mind and a steady supply of sugar to keep your brain fueled.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_35: That's why a good, sweet coffee is always the perfect late-night beverage.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_36: And... it's even better if you add in a bit of concentrated plant milk, or toss in a chocolate marshmallow or two.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_37: Does that really help you stay sharp?
Event_WWPDTYP_57_38: Yes. It increases the drink's nutrient density, leading to a more sustained energy release.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_39: And all that sweetness just… lifts your mood.
Event_WWPDTYP_57_41: Alright, I'll make you a cup a bit later!
Event_WWPDTYP_58_1: Not exactly what I expected, but the parameters are acceptable. I'll take my sip now.
Event_WWPDTYP_58_2: The flavor profile is… similar to the Research Institute's food prototypes…

Side_BYHDSJ_2_1:
3.11 Introduction to Gear 

The standard issue clothing for scientific research expeditioners is lined with thick, insulated composite padding. This design helps maintain body temperature for extended periods under extreme cold conditions and offers protection in the event of an accidental fall. However, falling on ice may still cause injuries to unprotected areas (such as the head). Therefore, anti-slip crampons are recommended when hiking across icy terrain.

Researcher's annotation: Don't worry too much, as long as you practice proper falling techniques, injury is unlikely. The protective properties of these clothes are no joke, but still, make sure to protect your head by using the correct posture. Also, I would like to note that crampons aren't very effective on hard, icy surfaces, and they might lacerate or otherwise injure you if you fall. Wearing them at all times is not recommended.

……

16.2.1 Emergency Procedure: Ice Rescue

Should you become stranded on ice after a slip or fall, do not attempt to stand up on your own, as concentrated ground force may cause the ice to fracture below you, or you may suffer injuries from falling a second time. Instead, remain prone and use your hands and feet to push along the ice, gradually moving your body toward the edge. Only attempt to stand once you have reached the edge.

If others are nearby, have them use a rope to pull you off the ice. Under no circumstances should you venture into a hazard area prior to a careful assessment of the conditions of the ice.

Researcher's annotation: Given the correct posture, you can remain steady even on slippery ice. The key is to keep your center of gravity as low as possible, keep your upper body upright, and use both hands to balance… All right, this might not sound very intuitive, but you'll probably get the hang of it after one or two falls. If you do end up falling, just call me—I'll get you off the ice in no time.

Recent monitoring has detected abnormal Voidmatter readings in the surrounding area. These anomalies may cause communication failures, navigation system interference, and frequent, small-scale Void Storm activity. Side_WWDLDG_8_1:
Official Announcement Regarding the Recovery of Late Researcher Professor Atrod Scott's Legacy Data

Greetings, {PlayerName}.

The Polar Research Outpost hereby issues you this formal notice that we have successfully recovered the legacy data left by the late Professor Atrod Scott during his frostlands expedition. Based on the information recovered from the Cassette, our technical team was able to locate and confirm the abnormal Voidmatter disturbance in the area near the Exostrider Observation Station. Subsequent field investigations confirmed that the phenomenon originated from a severely contaminated satellite component buried beneath the ice. 

Information provided by Professor Scott's initial findings was instrumental to the investigation and positioning effort. For the time being, the anomalous component has been safely recovered and contained. The positioning and communication systems in the affected area have been restored to normal, and the previous small-scale Void Storms have also settled.

Meanwhile, we at the Polar Research Outpost wish to express our profound gratitude. Had you not discovered his Cassette in time, it would likely have been damaged by subsequent Void Storm activities, burying all trace of his work beneath the ice forever. It is thanks to your actions that this explorer continues to live on in another form.

Professor Atrod Scott remained steadfastly dedicated to the Lahai-Roi expedition until his final moments, embodying both unwavering persistence and the highest standards of professionalism. His Cassette has now been transferred to the Research Institute's Cassette Depository, where his academic legacy is preserved for future research and commemoration. We hereby honor all explorers who have devoted themselves to pushing the boundaries of human knowledge. May we sail to our future carrying this respect alongside their discoveries.

To the ice and stars.

Side_LHSCP_15_22: If a person has to bear that stress while still holding onto their empathy, the pain has to go somewhere.
Side_LHSCP_15_23: It can lead to outbursts, lethargy, or even... self-destruction.
Side_LHSCP_15_24: On that rainy night, someone stood by that gravestone waiting for me. Just knowing I didn't have to face everything alone was enough to stop me from falling into the abyss.
Side_LHSCP_15_25: Most of the time, being alone or not might not make much of a difference. But when you're trapped in despair, a little support is like a lamp in a long, dark night.
Side_LHSCP_15_26: So now, it's my turn to be that person for others. That includes you, {PlayerName}.
Side_LHSCP_15_27: I hope that if you're ever feeling too tired, I'll be the first to notice.
Side_LHSCP_15_30: Glad to hear. I'll keep working on it.
Side_LHSCP_15_31: Facing the warm sunlight, he raises his cup to you.
Side_LHSCP_15_32: To the vacation, and to the free little cat.
Side_LHSCP_15_33: To the free, and to a future where all can enjoy freedom.
Side_LHSCP_2_2: Was the campus filled with people on your way here? I heard the Student Council set up a huge balloon arch, then the whole string got blown away by the wind, and the kids chased it halfway across campus. Oh, to be young…
Side_LHSCP_2_3: The infirmary's been busy these past few days as well. I've been seeing a steady stream of patients with collapses, cuts, and bruises. I'd probably skip lunch if I didn't make some snacks this morning.
Side_LHSCP_2_5: I tweaked the recipe to make it a bit more refreshing—a little less sugar and a touch more lemon zest and butter. Care to taste one?
Side_LHSCP_2_6: Luuk Herssen places the waffles and a cup of latte in front of you. You can see the golden grid lines of the waffles slightly gleaming. Powdered sugar slowly melts in the heat along the crispy edges, releasing a faint caramel aroma.
Side_LHSCP_2_8: Feels like... there's room for improvement.
Side_LHSCP_2_9: Is that so? I'm glad to hear that. It seems my little experiment worked out.
Side_LHSCP_2_10: I was quite confident about the lemon juice. After all, that golden shade is the one I know too well. You can tell the balance of sweet and sour at a glance.
Side_LHSCP_2_11: Hmm, maybe I can try this approach with other desserts and dishes. Would you be my official taste tester?
Side_LHSCP_2_13: It seems the low-sugar route isn't really for me. I'll just consider this a fun experiment.
Side_LHSCP_2_14: Next time, I'll try a different approach. If you don't mind being my taste tester again, I'm sure you'll notice a real improvement.
Side_LHSCP_2_16: Don't you still have work to finish?
Side_LHSCP_2_17: Of course. The Academy has been turned upside down with all the celebration preparations. I had a line of students waiting with bumps and bruises that reached the staircase...
Side_LHSCP_2_18: And then there are those who are perfectly fine. They just pop in for a chat, a snack, or a bit of pep talk. So here I am, bandaging patients on one side and gently coaxing the others back to class.
Side_LHSCP_2_19: Even N.A.N.A. has been so busy that her reactions have gotten a little slow. I have to step in and recalibrate her system occasionally. Come to think of it, if I hadn't become a doctor, I might have made a pretty good engineer.
Side_LHSCP_2_20: But being busy like this for a change does make things interesting.
Side_LHSCP_2_21: I've been busy before; the kind of busy where you'd need a formal appointment to even see me. Back when work and chasing the Fractisdus took over every waking hour... That's no longer the case anymore, you know.
Side_LHSCP_2_22: ...After all, I am in your debt. If you hadn't introduced me to Lahai-Roi, I may still be standing outside a sterile operating room, yawning at cold reports.
Side_LHSCP_2_23: What's that look for? Wondering if I've been completely won over by life at the Academy?
Side_LHSCP_2_24: You seem to fit in just perfectly.
Side_LHSCP_2_25: Definitely. Oh, I have to tell you about the student who came by yesterday. He swore he was possessed by a floating spirit, and he could hear someone singing all night long, sometimes distant and sometimes near. He just couldn't escape the sound...
Side_LHSCP_2_26: ...Are there really ghosts in the Academy?
Side_LHSCP_2_28: Who knows? The kid claimed he also heard the song near the broadcast tower outside the dorms. He was too scared to make a sound all night and even came to me seeking an exorcism the next day. Sadly, pills are the only thing I have, not talismans...
Side_LHSCP_2_29: Well, as it turned out, he simply left his bedtime music on, and it had woven its way into his dreams.
Side_LHSCP_2_30: Ah, there it goes again. Can't manage to spook you even for a little. Turned out he simply left his bedtime music on, and it had woven its way into his dreams.
Side_LHSCP_2_31: All right, that's enough ghost stories for today. Anything else you'd like to eat? Steak? Grilled cod? Or a dish from Huanglong perhaps?
Side_LHSCP_2_32: You know, I'd really love to learn more about Huanglong's cooking. Since you spent so much time there, you must be quite familiar with the local cuisine.
Side_LHSCP_2_34: You're turning the infirmary into a restaurant!
Side_LHSCP_2_35: That's perfect. Care to give me some advice? I'm trying to branch out with my cooking. After all, I'd much rather have people visit for a good meal than for a bandage.
Side_LHSCP_2_36: That might not be too bad, actually. I'd rather have everyone come here just for a good meal.
Side_LHSCP_2_37: Anyway, I'll keep improving these waffles. Maybe make them a little sweeter and crispier, then add a drizzle of maple syrup and some freshly diced fruit on top. I have a feeling this would make it better. Next time you can...
Side_LHSCP_2_38: Dr. Herssen! Someone just fainted at the celebration!
Side_LHSCP_2_39: Seems like we'll have to cut our tea time short today. I'm so sorry about that, especially since I was the one who invited you.
Side_LHSCP_2_40: You should take care of the students first.
Side_LHSCP_2_42: Mm-hmm. Then until next time. Once I'm done, I'll treat you to a proper dinner.

Side_LHSCP_3_22: Did they grow legs and run off?

Side_LHSCP_5_1:
Several students carrying fruits and files gather around the sickbed. They chat away about class projects and campus gossip. It feels as if their chuckles have made even the wind outside warmer.
The student on the sickbed gives a cheery smile, seemingly forgetting the pain for the moment.
Side_LHSCP_5_3: Young friendship is so full of passion. Even if you tell them not to visit, they'll always find a way to sneak in.
Side_LHSCP_5_4: Later, I simply set up seats for visitors, so they could sit and chat here.
Side_LHSCP_6_1: A young researcher paces back and forth in front of the counseling room. He raised his hand multiple times but didn't knock. All that can be heard is his rapid breathing in the hallway, as though a string in his mind might snap at any moment.
Side_LHSCP_6_2: …No luck here as well, it seems.
Side_LHSCP_6_3: Indeed. He's probably struggling with himself. If I'd known someone was there at the time, I would've opened the door and offered him some candy at least.
Side_LHSCP_7_1:
The patient stares at the ceiling, her gaze empty but calm. She is interrupted when a calico cat nimbly jumps onto the side of her bed and begins pressing its paws against her.
She turns her head, eyes instantly lighting up.
Side_LHSCP_7_2: This cat looks... familiar. I think I've seen it inside the infirmary before.
Side_LHSCP_7_3: Yes. Come to think of it, this cat could be considered one of the doctors here.
Side_LHSCP_8_1: I started off assuming we were looking for a person, but having thought about it... the culprit might not be a human at all.
Side_LHSCP_8_3: Not a discovery. I just remembered something now. When you were describing the clues, I was suddenly reminded of a few little moments.
Side_LHSCP_8_4: The thought that flashes through the mind in an instant is often the closest thing to the truth.
Side_LHSCP_8_5: When you've eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth. Am I right?
Side_LHSCP_8_7: I'll take that with a grain of salt.
Side_LHSCP_8_8: Why don't we recreate the scene? Think of it as a role-playing game?
Side_LHSCP_8_9: When I was infiltrating the Fractsidus, I had to regularly change identities—priest, doctor, delivery guy, and occasionally dead body.
Side_LHSCP_8_10: You weren't exactly thrilled with my methods back then. But things are much safer now. No one's shooting at me, and we're just looking into some missing waffles. Like I said: you're the detective, and I'm your assistant.
Side_LHSCP_8_11: All right, then... So, commissioned by the Startorch Academy infirmary, I will be the detective investigating this missing waffle case.
Side_LHSCP_8_12: And I'm your assistant, and also the client of this commission. The incident occurred at 7:30 A.M. this morning.
Side_LHSCP_8_13: We've searched through all humans entering and leaving the infirmary around that time and found no notable suspects.
Side_LHSCP_8_14: Meaning, only one possibility remains. What do you reckon?
Side_LHSCP_8_15: If no human committed the crime... then the suspect isn't a "person."
Side_LHSCP_8_16: Could it be that calico cat?
Side_LHSCP_8_17: Nicely deduced. If it's a small campus animal, one that can easily stay out of sight, it's no wonder it avoided the cameras.
Side_LHSCP_8_18: If that cat is the culprit... it couldn't have finished the entire plate on the spot.
Side_LHSCP_8_19: But when I returned to the infirmary, the plate was empty.
Side_LHSCP_8_20: Looks like it packed the rest and left. Question is—where?
Side_LHSCP_8_21: A place not far from here, quiet, undisturbed.
Side_LHSCP_9_1: Speaking of a place nearby with plenty of cover... This might be it.
Side_LHSCP_9_2: All the equipment and materials piled up here have created the perfect little hideouts for small animals.
Side_LHSCP_9_3: But they're quite alert. If we approach without caution, they'll likely make a run for it.
Side_LHSCP_9_6: Witness a master of stealth in action.

Side_LHSCP_9_16: Such a small cat... No wonder it didn't get caught on surveillance.
Side_LHSCP_9_17: Quite the appetite for its size…
Side_LHSCP_9_18: Haha, that means it's still healthy overall.
Side_LHSCP_9_19: When a student is overwhelmed, I sometimes recommend that they adopt a small pet through the Academy. It can really help people unwind. Of course, it does come with duties. A little one like this, for instance, needs a stable home and a lot of patience.

Side_LHSCP_9_21: It pins its ears back. Meow—Ow—
Side_LHSCP_9_22: It's very frightened and may have a stress response.
Side_LHSCP_9_23: Let's take it somewhere quiet first. Then we'll discuss further when it gets better.

Event_CNZXBWJH_2_10: Long story short, it all goes back to our Academy's great and controversial Food, Utilities & Energy Lounge, A.K.A. the cafeteria.
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_11: Honestly, I've never understood the hate. The cafeteria food's nutritionally on point, efficient, even kinda reminds me of home cooking... so why does everyone keep complaining?
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_12: So, after thorough analysis, I've come to a conclusion: it's not the food. It's the whole dining experience. It's flat. It's boring!
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_13: You order, you wait, you eat... rinse and repeat. Every single day. No surprises, no payoff. That's why satisfaction's been sinking.
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_15: The solution is—gamification! I've extracted the core dining process, mixed in some classic game mechanics, a little physical training, and created this F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator.
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_16: I'm using this club showcase event to finalize my research. If the feedback's solid, I'm taking a formal proposal straight to the Student Council to save the cafeteria's reputation!
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_17: And if an Academy legend like you joins the cause, my data's credibility spikes by a guaranteed eight percent! Please, I could really use your help testing this game!
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_18: I'm a professional player. I come with harsh criticisms.
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_19: What if the test results don't meet your expectations…
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_20: Oh, no big deal! This is game development. Failure is part of the game!
Event_CNZXBWJH_2_21: Look, whatever the results are, I can roll with it. Worst case? I'll just tweak it and try again! How about it? Wanna give it a go?

HD_JYZDFY_6_1:
Today, I walked through the valley of the shadow of death. I was surrounded by a swarm of Tacet Discords.
Right when I'd given up hope, I heard a noise. It wasn't the wind, but a crisp, rhythmic "ding... ding..." like a sharp blade tapping against ice.
I forced my eyes open. They were practically sealed shut with the frost.

A figure appeared before me. A girl, I think. White robes. She held a long, straight blade made of ice, transparent and clear. As she moved, the tip would occasionally graze the ground, making that cold "ding-ding" sound.
 She didn't say a word. Just walked toward the swarm. The snow swallowed her fast. I heard the "ding... ding..." of her blade against the ground a few more times before everything fell silent. When I looked again, both she and the Discords were gone.
 
I didn't think. I just ran. When I got back to camp, my colleagues  looked at me like they'd seen a ghost. Turns out I'd been missing for four hours. I told them everything. They said it was a hallucination.
So... was it?
Does a woman with a blade of ice truly walk the frostlands of Lahai-Roi?
Maybe I should go back there tomorrow and take another look.

Event_WRHMJSTM_16_9: Hmm... I guess this breach probably won't be patched anytime soon.
Event_WRHMJSTM_16_10: A frequency not of this world? What does that mean?

Event_WRHMJSTM_16_12: I'm counting on you to solve this case, Great Detective.

Article 1: Core Principles 
All personnel of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs shall adhere to the following principles: rapid response, proper handling, detailed documentation, seamless handover, and strict adherence to duty. 
This code of conduct applies to all members of the Ministry.

... 

CHAPTER II: DUTIES & DISCIPLINE

Article 1: Dress Code & Appearance 
Personnel must maintain a neat and professional appearance. While on duty, the standard-issue uniform must be worn at all times with the staff ID badge displayed.

Article 2: Shift Discipline 
Leaving a post unattended, abandoning duty, or sleeping during a shift is strictly prohibited.
On-duty personnel must verify and log frequency data from the Skywatch Rings every fifteen minutes. Any anomalous frequency data must be reported to the Ministry of War immediately. Engaging in activities unrelated to official duties while on shift is strictly forbidden.

LHLZTC_1_1: O Seeker of the road ahead, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores. You've braved tempests, heard the dual nature of Ragunna's faith, and tasted the glory in the arenas of Septimont. Adventuring through the City Set in Amber, you faced deep space in mysterious Lahai-Roi, meeting the Void with courage. Now the road ahead has again revealed itself. Let us return to Huanglong, and journey on to Mengzhou.
LHLZTC_1_2: In Jinzhou, you joined hands with Jiyan and the other Resonators to quell the Tacet Discord outbreak in Norfall Barrens. You also met "little Abby." You ultimately triumphed over and absorbed the Dreamless.
LHLZTC_1_3: Under the guidance of the Wayfinder Changli, you resolved the Temporal Disruption at Mt. Firmament. And Sentinel Jué passed the Temporal Mandate on to Magistrate Jinhsi.
LHLZTC_1_4: When you sought the truth of your own past, you met Shorekeeper in the Black Shores and reclaimed your duty as the organization's leader.
LHLZTC_1_5: In search of a solution to Abby's deteriorating condition, you crossed the Stormy Sea and arrived in Ragunna, a port city in Rinascita. There, as the Carnevale Laureate, you received a revelation concerning the Sentinel.
LHLZTC_1_6: Following the clues, you reached the Avinoleum Theological Seminary, hanging inverted in the sky, and there you rescued Cartethyia, vessel of the Threnodian, and Resonator of Imperator.
LHLZTC_1_7: Next, you traveled to Septimont, where you helped the Gladiator Lupa and the Blessed Maiden Cartethyia foil the Fractsidus's scheme to overwrite Septimont's reality with their script.
LHLZTC_1_8: In search of the Threnodian's Gem, you came to the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Along the way, you learned of the promise you once made to Phrolova, and the knot it had become in her heart. In the end Fenrico met his end, the Gem fell back into the Fractsidus's hands, and Phrolova sank into the deep, vanishing without a trace.
LHLZTC_1_9: Afterward, at the invitation of Septimont's Ephor Augusta, you traveled with her to the Sanguis Plateaus, where you watched her prove, through her deeds, what it means to be a true sovereign.
LHLZTC_1_10: Amid the celebrations, you sensed that something was wrong, investigated alone, and eventually saved Iuno, whose very existence was being erased.
LHLZTC_1_11: At last, with the support of many companions, you led them to drive back the Threnodian that sought to be reborn. And so Rinascita greeted a dawn with no more divinity, a dawn that belonged to humanity alone.
LHLZTC_1_12: Bidding farewell to Rinascita, you came next to a ruined city within a Sonoro, Honami City. There you met a girl named Chisa, and together you broke the endlessly looping curse that bound the place.
LHLZTC_1_13: Then, to address the sudden onset of your own frequency loss, you arrived in Lahai-Roi and met Lynae, a girl with a troubled past. Together you fought off the Voidworm assaulting Startorch Academy.
LHLZTC_1_14: Next, alongside Mornye, your former junior schoolmate, you averted the crisis of the falling Reactor Drive, and Lahai-Roi saw its "second sunrise."
LHLZTC_1_15: Later, with the help of the mysterious girl Aemeath, you uncovered the truth behind your frequency loss.
LHLZTC_1_16: You were surprised to learn that you had once saved Aemeath, and that the two of you had shared a home together. This strong, brave girl inherited your will and chose to sacrifice herself to save the world.
LHLZTC_1_17: You joined Luuk Herssen in searching for a way to bring Aemeath back, and as you came to know Luuk's past, you also saw through the disguise of the Fractsidus's Grand Architect.
LHLZTC_1_18: To further thwart the Grand Architect's schemes, you ventured into the Academy's Dark Side with Sigrika, helping her overcome her inner demons while resolving the crisis there.
LHLZTC_1_19: With the help of all the explorers, the Exostrider obtained a "human heart" and ascended to become a Sentinel, once again banishing the Threnodian Aleph-1 from Solaris. It also gained a name of its own: Lahai-Roi.
LHLZTC_1_20: In the end, even with the Exostrider gone, you helped Lucilla give the students a new mission—using the technology the Exostrider left behind to break through the Etheric Sea.
LHLZTC_1_21: It is also worth noting that during your time in Lahai-Roi, you unexpectedly met Lucy and Rebecca from Night City. Together, you fought the Nightmare that pursued them and helped Lucy fulfill a wish along the way...
LHLZTC_1_22: As the tides receded, a new world and an unexplored adventure awaited you.

Event_BMXDWYWJ_1_9: Well, I was just repeating everyone's feedback as it was, although... umm, I do admit I added just a tiny bit of artistic expression into it.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_1_12: Ahem... Never mind the details, I was only joking. Now, on to our business.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_1_13: I've collected some feedback from agents and researchers, and made some improvements to the simulator based on it. I might need your help testing it out again.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_1_14: I'll fill you in on the specific updates once we meet. I'll see you at Startorch Academy, {PlayerName}.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_1: Oh, you're here, {PlayerName}. Even from the intel I saw, I still couldn't tell from the pictures just how massive Startorch Academy actually is...
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_2: All the students here look incredibly energetic as well, like they could pull ten all-nighters in a row on their research and still be fine.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_3: And look at me, a couple of sleepless nights, and I'm already checking the drain for hair loss. Ah, to be young again.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_5: Just as I mentioned over WavesLine, we've made adjustments to the previous Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_6: Long story short, this new simulator works much the same as the last one. Both use panoramic holographic technology to recreate scenarios where various locations are hit by "critical crises."
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_7: Basically, it's about dealing with TD Outbreaks, and I'm sure it's nothing new to you at this point.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_8: Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier leaned heavily on strong Resonators and their Resonance Abilities as the deciding factor in combat.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_9: But that doesn't apply to all agents. Some agents are better at working with their environment, using whatever items and tools they can find to deal with Tacet Discords, rather than relying on their Resonance Abilities.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_10: Just like that famous action-movie star from Huanglong did in those old movies KU-Cass collected.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_11: I think I've heard of it.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_12: You mean "Champion in the Machine City"?
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_13: Anyway, this time around, we removed the default offensive Resonance Abilities from the simulator.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_14: Instead, you'll have to rely on your own strategy and whatever you can get your hands on—weapons, handmade tools, even scrap salvaged from ruins—to take on the TDs.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_15: We've also given this project a brand-new codename, Lament Recon: Tacet Crisis.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_16: Now, then... That's all I have for now.
Event_BMXDWYWJ_2_17: Oh, you're gonna need your friends to come along for the testing this time as well. Don't worry, the pay will be good, same as before.

GuidePLJJC_1_1: {PlayerName}, you need clearance before you can boot up the Route Constructor. And you're in luck, the person in charge of the route network is right over there working maintenance on it.
GuidePLJJC_1_2: His name is Chonglin. Go talk to him, he'll update your clearance and show you how to use the Route Constructor.
GuidePLJJC_1_3: Once you've gained access, you can start rebuilding the route network. That'll be a huge help to the Spacetrek Observatory, and it'll make getting around Lahai-Roi much easier for you as well.
GuidePLJJC_10_1: Fantastic work. Oh, no matter how many times I see it, watching the Route Constructor build roads always gets me thrilled.
GuidePLJJC_10_2: Why keep this outdated Route Constructor around?
GuidePLJJC_10_3: Well, how can I put it... rationality and rigor are essential qualities for us researchers, but what often propels us forward is a streak of romantic imagination.
GuidePLJJC_10_4: When this Route Constructor was produced, every researcher present cheered for it. We knew it would become a vital asset for fieldwork in Lahai-Roi.
GuidePLJJC_10_5: Now the newer Route Constructors are everywhere, playing exactly the role we hoped they would.
GuidePLJJC_10_6: But this is our very first unit... We just can't bring ourselves to have it locked up inside a warehouse.
GuidePLJJC_10_7: I mean, it takes a bit of extra effort, but it still works just fine, doesn't it? Haha.
GuidePLJJC_11_1: (This must be the Route Constructor Rakosan was talking about.)
GuidePLJJC_11_2: (I don't see the researcher he mentioned. Hmmm… I'll have a look on the Route Constructor first.)
GuidePLJJC_3_4: Oh? You must be {PlayerName}? Rakosan already told me about you.
GuidePLJJC_3_5: You're a real lifesaver—you gave us the chance to rebuild the Spacetrek Observatory. And honestly, I could really use your help now.
GuidePLJJC_3_7: I actually came fully prepared to teach you how to operate the Route Constructor, but I hit a bit of a snag.
GuidePLJJC_3_8:
You see, to power up a Route Constructor, you need three materials:
Mechanite and Condensed Bedrock as the raw components, plus a Constructor Core as the energy source.
GuidePLJJC_3_9: You might already have some on you, but without clearance, you still can't activate the Route Constructor, can you?
GuidePLJJC_3_10: But this Constructor before us is special. It was the very first Route Constructor ever put into use, so the materials it requires have to be custom-made.
GuidePLJJC_3_11: I was hauling those materials earlier today when a Sabercat Prowler suddenly swooped down on me. You know how they can turn invisible...
GuidePLJJC_3_12: But strangely enough, it didn't come after me. It just flipped my ride, stole the materials, and took off. I hid until it was gone.
GuidePLJJC_3_13: I'm guessing the materials acted like fuel to Exoswarm contaminated by the Threnodian, or maybe the contamination altered their properties somehow.
GuidePLJJC_3_14: That's not my field, though. You'd have to ask the Department of Voidmatters for the details.
GuidePLJJC_3_15: Anyway, I need you to track down that contaminated Sabercat Prowler and get those custom materials back.
GuidePLJJC_3_16: I'm counting on you to retrieve my Purified Mechanite and Refined Compressed Bedrock!
GuidePLJJC_3_17: The Route Constructor can't start due to insufficient materials. Just then, a researcher comes running towards you from the other side of the hill.
GuidePLJJC_4_1: (There it is, the contaminated Sabercat Prowler…)
GuidePLJJC_5_1: (It got the Refined Compressed Bedrock in its mouth… The Purified Mechanite it took should be nearby. I'll have to take a look around.)
GuidePLJJC_6_1: (That shine… this must be the Purified Mechanite.)
GuidePLJJC_6_2: (It's buried between these Rimewisps. I should clear them out and collect everything.)
GuidePLJJC_7_1: I've got both materials. Time to head back and talk to Chonglin.

GuidePLJJC_9_4: I'm fine. Thanks for checking. Here's everything you asked for.
GuidePLJJC_9_5: Oh, this is it! You must've gone through a lot to find these, huh?
GuidePLJJC_9_6: But don't worry, every other Route Constructor is a newer model.
GuidePLJJC_9_7: You'll only need standard Mechanite, Compressed Bedrock, and regular Constructor Cores to activate those.
GuidePLJJC_9_8: Alright, I'm handing this boosted Constructor Core and the rest of the materials to you. You should be the one to activate the Route Constructor!
TWTPOI_1_1: Nice to meet you, {PlayerName}! I'm KU-Raji, and I'll be supporting your work in Lahai-Roi from the Black Shores.
TWTPOI_1_2: Alright! Let's get to it. There's a giant facility built in the mysterious and rather dangerous land of Lahai-Roi—the Spacetrek Observatory.
TWTPOI_1_3: The Spacetrek Collective once used it to observe and record everything happening in the region. But a Void Storm struck years ago and left it in ruins. Repairs have been... slow, to say the least.
TWTPOI_1_4: Since its functions align with those of the Black Shores, and with all the unusual activity of the Threnodian in the region lately, bringing the Observatory back online could really help us handle future crises.
TWTPOI_1_5: So, we'd like you to head over, check on the site, and see how we might assist with the repairs.
TWTPOI_1_6: Oh, and there's one more thing. There's a girl there, using her Forte to keep the place running, all on her own.
TWTPOI_1_7: A lone girl living among the ruins… Hm, she might need a helping hand too, {PlayerName}.
TWTPOI_1_8: It's a little nerve-wracking, honestly… but also exciting to finally work with an elite Bloombearer like you!

Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_15_26: Oh, the Cassette! Every new student gets one burned. It's a... special device used here in Lahai-Roi. Sort of like an ID and safety device all rolled into one.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_15_27: You'll need access to the Research Institute to get one. And, well, that means you've gotta be officially enrolled first.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_15_28: Okay, let's get that done first.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_15_29: Got it! Enrollment is handled at the faculty office. I'll take you there.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_15_30:
Dr. Luuk Herssen reviews your report: your frequency is stable and you're not in immediate danger, but the portion already lost cannot be traced. The Research Institute, he says, has more thorough scanning equipment than the infirmary. He suggests you finish enrolling at the Academy to obtain a "Cassette," a permit and ID needed to enter the Institute.
Curiously, he whispers "Welcome back" as you leave.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_1: Hold on. Let's pause here for a second.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_2: Voidworms have been unusually active lately. We really need to finalize a countermeasure soon. How's the Defense Array holding up?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_3: It took heavy damage in the last major Void Storm. The Department of Engineering is pushing extra manpower to repair the "lure" device.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_4: We need to restore remote control of both the Defense Array and the lure device, and fast. If not, we'll be at a serious disadvantage.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_5: Worst case, we'll have to send a suitable Resonator to handle it manually.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_6: But that area is too close to Voidworm territory. It's too dangerous. Professor, we can't gamble with the safety of our faculty and students.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_7: I know. That's exactly why we must learn the cause of this Void Storm cycle's irregularity. I've only seen readings like this in simulations.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_8: I have a meeting. Please excuse me.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_9: The professor, looking a bit weary, hurries off with an armful of documents.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_10: Looks like they're done talking. Let's head over.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_11: Hm? Do you need something? Ah! Lynae, you skipped your Cultural Studies class again today, didn't you?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_12: Ugh, darn it, I almost forgot... Ah, that's because...
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_13: You're always skirting the minimum attendance requirement. Keep this up, and only perfect scores in every subject will save you.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_14: Understood. Three subjects left. I'll do my best.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_15: That's not the point. Lynae... Never mind. What brings you to the office?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_16: Ms. Voss, I'm here to help {Male=him;Female=her} get enrolled. {Male=He;Female=She}'s new here and still getting familiar with the place...
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_17: Enrollment? At a time like this? May I have your name?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_19: Let me check... Yes, you're on the list of new students who haven't reported yet, and you passed the <te href=700009>Synchronist</te> Test.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_20: Ah, so you're a Black Shores recommendation. That explains how you made it here during Void Storm season.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_21: Alright, identity confirmed. First, you'll need to register your personal information, then take an ID photo for your student card.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_22: If you have any questions, feel free to ask anytime.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_24: Ahem, it's recess right now. I'll take {Male=him;Female=her} through enrollment and give {Male=him;Female=her} a quick campus tour while we're at it.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_25: Ah, you... Fine, if you insist, I'll leave it to you.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_26: Leave it to me! Alright, freshman. Let's get you enrolled.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_16_27: Outside the faculty office, you overhear teachers discussing the unusual Voidworm activity and the Academy's countermeasures. Inside, a teacher named Voss confirms your identity and assigns Lynae to guide you through enrollment procedures: registering your personal information and taking an ID photo.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_17_1: How do we get to the Research Institute?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_17_2: Usually, I'd take the Startorch Express or get my own ride...
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_17_3: Since you're now officially a Startorch student, you get an Academy-issued vehicle. Rare chance, wanna give it a try?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_17_5: Alright, let's go pick up your ride!
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_1701_1: By the way, have you ever been to school before?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_1701_4: I was usually the one teaching.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_1701_5: Ah, one of those "cram it and dump it" types. Got it.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_1701_7: Oh, really? My bad. Guess I underestimated you.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_1: Let's see… all set. Here, keep this safe. Don't lose it.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_2: Would it be a big problem if I did?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_3: Absolutely. That card's your lifeline. It gives you access to gates, the cafeteria, even hot showers. Lose it, and you'll be roughing it.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_4: That said, if you're fine with missing out on these little conveniences while waiting for a replacement, I suppose it's not that bad.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_5: Since you're a Synchronist, it's also the only pass linked to your simulator cockpit.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_7: Our goal with the <te href=700008>Exostrider</te> is to take on the Threnodian causing the Void Storm. You know about it, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_8: The Exostrider... Even after all these years of research, no one knows which civilization built it.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_9: Some think it shares the same origin as the Sentinels, but no Sentinel has ever confirmed that.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_10: (Same origin as the Sentinels? I haven't gotten that feeling. Maybe it's too far away?)
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_12: Not here. But you saw that giant sword, right? That's its weapon, keeping Threnodian "Aleph-1" contained beyond the Stridergate.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_13: We've collected enough Exostrider components to build exclusive simulator cockpits for Synchronists.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_14: With training and fine-tuning, you'll boost your synchronization rate with the Exostrider. That'll be one of your key courses going forward.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_15: Sounds like you're attempting... some sort of artificially induced Resonance?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_16: It's a multinational project. It's inevitable some New Federation methodologies get in the mix.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_17: Don't worry. We've filtered out the extreme techniques. You can trust us.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_18: It's hard to follow the technical part.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_20: When I say you can trust us, I mean...
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_21: It's safe. The whole project passed the Black Shores' safety evaluation. All the nations involved approved it as well.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_22: Besides that, the Exostrider is also linked to the upcoming <te href=700016>New Solar Ceremony</te>...
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_23: Okay, okay. Easy on the lecture.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_24: That's a lot to take in. I need time to process.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_25: Teach, don't you have another class?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_26: I do. And you, young lady, if you know the schedule so well, why aren't you on time for your classes?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_27: Hehe, I suppose I got carried away.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_28: The Academy's Repository is open to all students. If you're curious, feel free to explore. Any pursuit of knowledge is encouraged here.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_29: Well... welcome to Startorch Academy. With your student card, you can now burn your Cassette at the Research Institute.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_30: Miss Lynae, if you have time, take our new student there.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_31:
After everything is complete, Voss hands you a student ID card. You are officially a Startorch Academy student.
She explains that the Academy's goal with the Exostrider is to take on Aleph-1, a Threnodian contained beyond the Stridergate by the Exostrider's giant sword.
With your student card, you can now visit the Research Institute and have your Cassette burned.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_4: Lahai-Roi stands thanks to the proliferated Exostrider components. If it were ordinary bedrock, it would've collapsed long ago.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_5: The lift to the upper frostlands was also built alongside the Exostrider's weapon.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_6: However, these components adapt more to the environment than to the Exostrider's original design. The Roya, natives to Lahai-Roi, believe that's its way of sheltering life. But the Academy suspects the Void Storm disrupts these components' self-regenerative mechanisms.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_7: Their proliferation has limits. Take the <te href=700010>Reactor Drive</te> in the sky, for example. Once it's depleted, it's gone for good.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_8: The New Solar Ceremony will replace Lahai-Roi's "Sun"—the Exostrider's Drive—with one we built ourselves.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_9: We do have the Exostrider's Drive to thank for this underground haven. But to fight the Threnodian, it must be re-integrated with the Exostrider.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_10: That's why we're building an artificial sun. So the Drive can be restored to the Exostrider's mecha.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_11: It's a long-term project. The details are... complicated. So I won't cover them here.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_12: If you're curious, you can ask Professor Mornye. She's our lead designer on it.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_19_15: Still a few things I don't quite get…
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_2: I can go to Lahai-Roi now?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_3: Yes. Thanks to Namipon's efforts, the Black Shores has confirmed <te href=700030>Lahai-Roi's</te> relative coordinates to Honami City and stabilized a one-way tunnel.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_4: You may set out whenever you wish.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_6: This? Chisa taught me how to make this beverage. I find it tastes better with more milk and sugar...
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_7: I just made a cup. Would you... like to try it?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_9: I meant that you look troubled.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_11: (The aroma is rich, but it doesn't taste like coffee at all.)
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_12: Were you worried about something just now?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_14: Your frequency still fluctuates. It's barely detectable, but... enough to concern me.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_15: About Lahai-Roi, the current <te href=700029>Void Storm</te> is lasting longer than usual.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_16: This is an uncommon state, and for now, the Black Shores can glean little else from what lies beyond the rift.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_17: Do you think something's happened there?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_18: Unlike other regions on Solaris, Lahai-Roi has no Sentinel to guide its civilization. Once considered naught but a forsaken frostland, it remained hidden until the <te href=851071>Spacetrek Collective</te>, an international research organization, discovered it.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_19: Yet the Threnodian has always lurked in the shadows of this frostland, causing <te href=850080>Waveworn Phenomena</te> such as the Void Storm.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_20: Exposure to a Void Storm drains human frequencies until they vanish. I suspect that your own frequency loss is linked to this abnormal Storm cycle.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_21: The Spacetrek Collective is at the forefront of frequency-stabilization research. Once there, you will undergo a full examination and receive treatment.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_22: So the source of the problem and its solution can only be found there.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_23: Yes. The way to Lahai-Roi is open. It's time for you to return.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_25: The paperwork for entry into <te href=700031>Startorch Academy</te>. Access to Lahai-Roi requires strict clearance, so the Black Shores arranged for you to enter as a "student."
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_26: This acceptance letter belonged to your past self. It's still valid and will grant you access. Please keep it safe.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_27: Thank you for preparing all this.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_28: So this trip's theme is "Back to School," huh?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_29: Once you enter Lahai-Roi, I won't be able to contact you, but I will be here as always, awaiting your return with new stories to share.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_30: Don't worry. Everything will go fine.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_31: Maybe I'll find a way to teleport back to you.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_33: Hmm...? If only that were true.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_2_36: Shorekeeper briefs you on Lahai-Roi. It's a region without a Sentinel to guide its civilization, and your frequency loss may be tied to a Threnodian-induced Waveworn Phenomenon known as the Void Storm. She explains that the Spacetrek Collective leads the world in frequency-stabilization research, and you might find a solution to your problem there. Before you depart, she hands you an acceptance letter. This time around, you'll be entering Startorch Academy as a student.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_1: Mr. S.I.G.M.A.! I've brought the Ninth Great Mystery to pick up {Male=his;Female=her} vehicle.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_2: Zero tolerance for traffic violations. Zero tolerance for risking lives. Signal Intelligent Guidance & Management Automaton—S.I.G.M.A.—at your service.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_3: Huh? That's it? Pretty underwhelming intro today.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_4: This week's student poll ranked it number one. Miss Lynae, perfect timing. I noticed that your vehicle has...
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_5: AHEM! Mr. S.I.G.M.A., we're here for the new student's ride. We need to get to the Research Institute for Cassette burning. Top priority, you know.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_6: …Confirmed, {PlayerName}. Your vehicle is ready. Please read and memorize the Startorch Traffic Safety Regulations, then tick "I have read carefully" and sign.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_9: Please read carefully. Traffic safety is not a game. Speed is a privilege. Protection is a duty. Rules are law.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_11: Please complete your signature in 5… 4… 3… 2… 1… Confirmed. Safe travels.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_12: ...Confirmed. Thank you for your cooperation. Safe travels.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_14: Please wait. Resuming dialogue. Scans indicate your vehicle has had thirteen speeding incidents within the last twenty days. Drive safely and comply with the Academy's Traffic Safety Rules.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_15: Additionally, your unauthorized modifications fall into a gray area of the Vehicle Management Code. For your own safety, I strongly advise discontinuing all such modifications.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_16: Ahem, Mr. S.I.G.M.A, all I did was add a turbocharger, tweak the suspension, and upgrade the brakes. Hardly a violation, wouldn't you say?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_17: Besides, compared to seniors strapping missiles and anti-gravity wheels on, I'm practically a model student.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_19: Yep. One senior even turned his bike into a light tank for a project. Drove it straight into an active Voidworm zone.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_22: I must note that the student committed major Vehicle Management Code violations and breached dozens of school regulations. Severe disciplinary action was taken.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_23: ...Which was revoked when he brought back critical Voidworm data.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_20_26: Lynae brings you to the loading bay to pick up your ride. The stern Signal Intelligent Guidance & Management Automaton, S.I.G.M.A., insists you read the Safety Regulations before driving it, and scolds Lynae for her speeding and constant bending of modification rules. Lynae argues back while dragging you away.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_208_1: Oh, Lynae! I haven't had the chance to thank you yet. The material you gave me boosted the device's power by 35%! That's amazing!
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_208_2: No big deal… I just got lucky, really.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_209_1: Looking at this device now… maybe we can dig up its production record in the system.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_209_2: Hm, restricted access… Looks like we'll have to take the less polite route.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_1: Found it. It was hiding pretty deep.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_2: Like I thought, the record isn't in the ordinary directory. It's triple-classified, disguised as regular system data.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_3: Which means… someone hijacked the Department's equipment to make this?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_4: Correct. I just scanned the device itself. It looks like a basic calibrator, but the inside is completely different.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_5: Long story short, it stores and amplifies a tiny slice of Void Storm frequency, just enough to make stuff designed from Exostrider tech lose control.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_7: And here's the kicker—whoever made this can control it remotely.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_9: So it can be activated again at any time.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_10: Exactly. It's literally a ticking time bomb.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_11: You're probably wondering why I didn't hand this over to the Academy, right? Before we identify the Fractsidus "contact," I'm not letting it out of my sight.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_12: So first, we've gotta neutralize the threat. With the production records and device data, I can try to overwrite the device's permissions. Get it to only activate if it resonates with me.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_13: It'll reboot during the process, though... and, uh, there might be some noise.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_14: You mean the mechs here will be affected?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_15: Yes. That's why I'll need you to… keep them in check during the process.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_18: Having someone cover my back like this... Hm, not too bad.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_210_19: After examining the mysterious device disguised as a calibrator, Lynae discovers it can store and amplify Void Storm frequencies, triggering malfunctions in any creation connected to the Exostrider. The maker is likely someone inside the Academy, capable of remotely activating it at any moment. Handing it over to the authorities might just return it to the Fractsidus mole. To stop this, Lynae decides to overwrite the device's permissions and take control of it herself.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_2: It's been overwritten. Don't have to worry about it being remotely controlled. Glad we pulled it off in time…
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_5: Hah… You got me. It's been a while since I've done something like this. Gotten a bit rusty.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_6: Stay in your comfort zone too long and you start to slack off without realizing it... Back in the day, I would've handled this in 28 seconds flat.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_9: Because… the longest reboot time for the Auto-Defense Array is 28 seconds.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_11: Ahem... sorry, back to the topic. While digging through the database, I noticed something.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_12: The Academy's mechs and the <te href=700014>Voidmatter Barrier</te> security logs show unusual access. Someone used admin-level protocols.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_13: Also, the device's data has three frequency waveforms. One from Hyvatia. The other two are... unrecognizable.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_14: How do you know that's Hyvatia's waveform?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_15: Um... Heh, just by, uh... browsing the Academy Forum.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_16: Mm, alright, I was once tasked to hack into the Institute's database and tamper with Hyvatia's calibration data.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_17: But I didn't change anything. Just threw in a few emojis and left a note telling them to upgrade their encryption.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_18: That backfired though. Got me flagged.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_20: Back to those waveforms… If one is Hyvatia's, then the other two are likely the targets for the next experiment.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_21: I think you're right. Next, we need to figure out what those waveforms correspond to. Maybe we'll find a clue in the Lahai-Roi ecological studies.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_22: Let's head to the Spacetrek Archive then.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_211_23:
With you providing cover, the overwrite is successful. During the process, she finds evidence of admin-level access to the Academy's mechs and the Voidmatter Barrier security logs. The device contains three frequency waveforms. One belongs to Hyvatia, and the other two are unidentifiable.
You both decide to investigate the source of these waveforms at the Spacetrek Archive.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_1: So it's true. The Dark Thunderbolt has enrolled at Startorch! Can you walk us through that epic battle with the Voidworm?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_4: How did that title catch on so widely?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_5: At any rate, your actions were legendary!
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_7: Sorry, guys. I need to report the Voidworm incident to the Academy first.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_8: Once that's done, I'll tell you everything you want to know. Promise.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_9: You must know why we're here, Miss Lynae.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_10: I do. I'm not a Startorch student anymore. Rules are rules, and I should return to the New Federation.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_13: We've reviewed everything. No matter what happened, the Academy is grateful for your bravery. Truth is, we never should've allowed our students to face danger like this.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_14: Our duty is to keep you safe while you're still learning how to protect yourselves, not throw you into the fire.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_15: Like you said, Miss Lynae, you're not a Startorch student.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_17: So if you want to be a student here, you'll need to pass the entrance exam.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_19: Of course, you'll need to enroll under your real identity this time.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_20: That means... you're coming back to the Academy.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_21: Indeed. But we must conduct another inquiry before admission.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_22: An inquiry? Sure. And the entrance exam? No problem.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_23: Very well, Miss Lynae. Please follow me.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_28: Gosh. Never thought I'd be this happy to take a freaking exam.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_29: The Academy convenience store's specials are really good.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_30: When I become a "freshman" at Startorch, let's go grab a bite together, okay?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_32:
You and Lynae are surrounded by excited students and reporters. Amid the questions, Lynae, normally so unflappable, shows a rare, nervous smile. Just then, an Academy officer approaches. Prepared for expulsion, Lynae is instead met with a decision that fills her with joy: due to her bravery, the Academy will allow her to take the entrance exam under her real identity. Lynae accepts, and you watch her cheerful figure depart. Just then, a faint, familiar voice whispers in your ear: "...Protect the sun."
It seems the crisis is far from over.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_33: Whew… the Academy is safe. Thank goodness.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_1: Ahem, allow me to introduce Miss I.R.I.S. She's—
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_2: One of Startorch's Seven Great Mysteries?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_3: That's right! She's the Archive's administrator, responsible for indexing all the data here. A very reliable senior, you could say.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_4: Hello, I'm I.R.I.S., the retrieval AI of the Spacetrek Archive.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_5: Miss Lynae, and… {PlayerName}, what can I help you with today?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_6: You look beat. Everything okay, Miss I.R.I.S.?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_7: The Archive experienced a data leak recently, so I'm running system maintenance in the background. But don't worry, routine queries are still available.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_8: We want to look up info related to this waveform data.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_9: Searching now. Found 3,281 matching entries. Should I list them all?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_10: That's a lot… Add these keywords: "Void Storm" and "Exoswarm Contamination."
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_14: A big improvement. Let's split up and review them.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_15: Locations for those files are marked. Need anything else? Maybe… some tips on your school life?
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_18: Never call Mr. S.I.G.M.A. "Traffic Illuminator," unless you're up for a 10-minute, non-stop high-speed chase.
Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_213_20: At the Archive, with help from the AI administrator I.R.I.S., you search for information tied to the waveform data. The search eventually narrows to two keywords: Void Storm and Exoswarm Contamination.

Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_38_35:
Back at the Academy, Lynae is questioned by Warren and other faculty. She recounts the Hyvatia malfunction, but you notice she omits any mention of the "liaison." Warren points out that her testimony about the "contaminated Exoswarm" doesn't match the scene investigation or surveillance footage. He questions her motives, especially in light of a recent security breach in the Institute's database. Although you and Voss speak in her defense, Lynae cannot explain the key inconsistencies.
After everyone leaves, you ask her directly why she didn't tell the whole truth. After a pause, she asks to continue the conversation somewhere quieter.

Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_51:
Lynae finally reveals her true identity: she is a former government-hired mercenary from the New Federation's "Lawless Zone." During a mission, she found an admission letter in one of the dead's belongings. Seeing a chance to escape her old life, she took on the dead girl's name and identity to enroll in Startorch Academy.
What she didn't expect was that the dead girl, the real "Lynae," had been a Fractsidus plant, sent to infiltrate the Academy. Wanting to stay in the place she's come to call home, she asks to work with you to uncover the truth and thwart the Fractsidus's plans.
She then takes out the device that caused Hyvatia's malfunction and prepares to investigate its origin in the Department of Engineering.
