MAIN_YHX_8_5: But, as you said, curiosity from the Institute is inevitable—
MAIN_YHX_8_7: My, my. Already caused a stir in the training grounds? Color me impressed.
MAIN_YHX_8_8: I'll have people clean up the aftermath. You can carry on as you see fit.
MAIN_YHX_8_9: You were monitoring my comms with Mornye?
MAIN_YHX_8_10: You're a person of special interest. Of course we keep an eye on your movements.
MAIN_YHX_8_12: Yes, "we." The Spacetrek Collective. Think of us as the annoying adults on campus.
MAIN_YHX_8_13: I'll handle the debate between the Institute and the Academy about the Core. This is a matter of priority. They'll listen to me.
MAIN_YHX_8_14: But when you're done with your business, I'll need you to return the Core to the Exostrider, {PlayerName}.
MAIN_YHX_8_15: Why is the Spacetrek Collective pushing this so hard?
MAIN_YHX_8_16: You should know. You have a past in Lahai-Roi, and you have some kind of connection with the Exostrider.
MAIN_YHX_8_17: The Twilight Epoch, the Unending Winter described in Royan legend... the threat of the Threnodian Aleph-1 is growing. We need the Exostrider awakened. Returning that Reactor Core is the only way.
MAIN_YHX_8_18: We've always trusted you to stand with us in this matter. To stand on the side of humanity.
MAIN_YHX_8_19: You know where to find me if you need anything, {PlayerName}. And my door is always open if you just want to talk.
MAIN_YHX_8_20: You didn't mention it to Mornye, but I suspect... your possession of it traces back to Aemeath, doesn't it?
MAIN_YHX_8_21: President Lucilla, I don't appreciate being interrogated over a tapped line.
MAIN_YHX_8_22: Heh, my apologies. As the one responsible for this Academy, matters related to the Exostrider tend to cloud my judgement.
MAIN_YHX_8_23: Here is a peace offering. I've granted you full clearance: passes for the Starward Riseway, archive access, and use of Academy weaponry and equipment.
MAIN_YHX_8_24: I'll also personally apologize to Professor Mornye for interrupting your comms and ensure her next research grant is... substantially approved.
MAIN_YHX_8_25: How's that, {PlayerName}? More to your liking?
MAIN_YHX_8_27: (Like what happened during our previous encounter, what she's done since becoming a digital ghost, and the real reason why Sigillum stole her power.)
MAIN_YHX_8_28: (After years drifting like this, to still hold onto that spirit... Her will must be strong. Prying answers from her won't be easy.)
MAIN_YHX_8_29: (I'll bide my time. The right moment will come.)
MAIN_YHX_8_30: After the incident with Warren, we upgraded safety protocols on public lines. No more overstepping.
MAIN_YHX_8_31:
Lucilla taps your comms, requesting that you immediately return the Reactor Core to the Exostrider.
Later, as an apology for her heavy-handedness, she grants you full access clearance for your mission.

MAIN_YHX_110_3: I never saw myself as a hitmaker. I was just an amateur, singing what was in my heart.
MAIN_YHX_110_4: But over time, they stopped being just my songs. They became... a melody that connected people.
MAIN_YHX_110_5: If my listeners want a complete song, I'll finish it for them. Or maybe for me, too.
MAIN_YHX_110_6: You really do care about the people of Lahai-Roi, don't you, Aemeath?
MAIN_YHX_110_7: I guess I do now. Wouldn't have said that at the start, though.
MAIN_YHX_110_8: To be honest, I never had some grand passion. Before I became a ghost, I just wanted to live an easy, happy life and try a little bit of everything.
MAIN_YHX_110_9: And my whole "I want to be a savior" thing? Well, that was just me trying to copy you.
MAIN_YHX_110_10: But after I died, I had all this time. Time to notice the people and things in Lahai-Roi I'd overlooked before.
MAIN_YHX_110_11: So many people here dream of becoming stars themselves, but that was never my dream.
MAIN_YHX_110_12: I'd rather be the one who looks up at the stars. The one who watches over them.
MAIN_YHX_110_13: Really? But the way I see it...
MAIN_YHX_110_16: Go on then, Aemeath. I want to hear you sing.
MAIN_YHX_110_17: You'd better! 'Cause you're my most important audience today.

MAIN_YHX_110_19: There! Brand new, just like I remember you wearing. Looks good, right? A new place calls for a new look.

MAIN_YHX_110_23: Alright, that's enough out of you.
MAIN_YHX_110_24: Haha! What, are you blushing? Since when is having charm a bad thing?
MAIN_YHX_110_25: Now, go grab that seat over there. Best view in the house. I scouted it myself back when I used to nap through lectures.

MAIN_YHX_51_5: I thought I just didn't see them around.

MAIN_YHX_51_12: I'm still shaking, but you're already cool as ice. Are all Synchronists from Rabelle College as composed as you?
MAIN_YHX_51_13: If you want to thank her, share your Void Storm research! To the frostlands came our little Aemeath for this curiosity. You should show her that thesis you've been writing for years!

MAIN_YHX_51_15: Hm, I'm not sure… Right now they're just for archiving. Actual transcription feels like a leap.

MAIN_YHX_51_17: Haha! Your thesis or your delicious stew, either works! I'm not picky!
MAIN_YHX_51_18: As for the Void Storm… I'll try all your ideas. The problem is, we don't understand the Void Storm deeply enough.
MAIN_YHX_51_19: Especially in the depths with high Voidmatter concentration. No probe survives the journey, so research is stuck. I can't shake the feeling that...

MAIN_YHX_51_21: So you see? Death hasn't been all bad!
MAIN_YHX_51_22: Once I became a digital ghost, Voidmatter couldn't affect me anymore. Even if the whole world forgets my friends and colleagues, I still get to remember every single one of them.
MAIN_YHX_51_25: You don't always have to smile through everything.
MAIN_YHX_51_27: I'm happy. Really. It's the way I chose to live. You're too serious, always overthinking, hence the long face.
MAIN_YHX_51_28: You wouldn't understand how happy this moment makes me.
MAIN_YHX_51_29: Come on. I'll show you the frostlands' slumbering giant. Lahai-Roi's… Exostrider.
MAIN_YHX_51_30:
You and Aemeath arrive at an abandoned research outpost. Activating the Reactor Core reveals scenes from her past expedition there with other researchers.

MAIN_YHX_53_4: It's all so wonderful. I love hearing these stories.

MAIN_YHX_55_21: Its true form is like... a <color=RedD>black hole</color>.

MAIN_YHX_55_23: So far, I'm the only one who's reached it. Because I'm already dead, and no living soul could withstand a place like that.

MAIN_YHX_55_26: Inside, <color=RedD>time and space aren't linear. Everything is warped.</color>
MAIN_YHX_55_27: Things the Threnodian devoured from different eras can be sitting right next to each other.
MAIN_YHX_55_28: I know you fought many Threnodians, but Aleph-1 is different. It's already won elsewhere....
MAIN_YHX_55_29: Wandering through the <te href=750040>Voidspace</te>, I saw the proof... a graveyard of civilizations it's already ended.
MAIN_YHX_55_31: The Threnodian's presence in Lahai-Roi is only a sliver of its true self. It's been trying to break through the seal on the <te href=750036>Stridergate</te> to devour Solaris.
MAIN_YHX_55_32: So... {PlayerName}, don't go wandering off alone. Not until the Exostrider awakens.
MAIN_YHX_55_33:
Upon arriving at Ginnungamere, Sigillum attacks again. Aemeath is struck and falls into the lake. As you jump in to save her, a sense of déjà vu washes over you.
Back on the surface, Aemeath explains that the high-concentration Voidmatter at the bottom of the lake forms a gateway to Voidspace, the warped, nonlinear spacetime inside the Threnodian. It contains the remnants of civilizations devoured by Aleph-1, a place where no living soul can withstand, and which only one already deceased, like Aemeath, can traverse.

MAIN_YHX_121_3: But now, further along the timeline, the edges of Voidspace are beginning to collapse. I don't know why the Threnodian is changing, but I know there won't be another chance.
MAIN_YHX_121_4: I'm not that child who needed protecting anymore. I have a duty to fulfill. Lahai-Roi is my responsibility.
MAIN_YHX_121_5: So if I can help, I will. I have to.
MAIN_YHX_121_6: But before I go… I want to see {Male=him;Female=her} again. That's my one, selfish wish.
MAIN_YHX_121_7: I want to talk to {Male=him;Female=her}. To know how {Male=he's;Female=she's} really been. I want to spend a little more time with my family.
MAIN_YHX_121_8: I was always afraid that when {Male=he;Female=she} finally discovered the truth about {Male=himself;Female=herself}, {Male=he'd;Female=she'd} feel so alone.
MAIN_YHX_121_10: {Male=He;Female=She} told me about {Male=his;Female=her} journey after losing {Male=his;Female=her} memories. It was… meaningful.
MAIN_YHX_121_11: {Male=He;Female=She} met people. People who care for {Male=him;Female=her}. Who miss {Male=him;Female=her}. People {Male=he;Female=she} formed connections with.
MAIN_YHX_121_12: So even knowing the truth about {Male=his;Female=her} homeland now, {Male=he;Female=she} won't be alone. {Male=He;Female=She} has a reason to keep living.
MAIN_YHX_121_13: That's enough for me. Now, I can finally... let go.
MAIN_YHX_121_15: Aemeath, don't you dare decide this by yourself!
MAIN_YHX_121_16: You're the one who taught me that my pain is no different from anyone else's! I can't turn my back on the responsibility I have.
MAIN_YHX_121_18: I have to make the jump now, during this peak season, while Voidspace is still stable.

MAIN_RGLC_1_1: (Luuk texted me to go over the Exostrider plan at the infirmary. Better get going.)
MAIN_RGLC_10_4: The "Golden Serum" developed by the Novialle Group. But I prefer its other name—<te href=750042>Ichor</te>.
MAIN_RGLC_10_5: My father started it as a medication for rare diseases. But as research progressed, it came to represent something far more ambitious—the "drug of evolution."
MAIN_RGLC_10_6: Evolution? Sounds like something the Fractsidus would like.
MAIN_RGLC_10_7: Well, on paper, it worked. I became its Resonator, so it would be unfair to say it was entirely useless.
MAIN_RGLC_10_8: But I was a rare case who survived. All it cost me was excruciating pain and my color vision. Most test subjects like me didn't make it.
MAIN_RGLC_10_9: It wasn't until I met you that I realized there was more to the story.
MAIN_RGLC_10_10: A vial of "Golden Serum," an "evolutionary drug" developed by the Novialle Regenerative Group, owned by Luuk's adoptive father, which drew the Fractsidus's attention.
MAIN_RGLC_11_5: The entire Lollo Logistics carrier was already blown to smithereens by the time I recovered this page.
MAIN_RGLC_11_6: I managed a quick glimpse before the fire consumed most of the page. Hehe, it is a report from an Overseer.
MAIN_RGLC_11_7: A Fractsidus Overseer's report on its way to the New Federation?
MAIN_RGLC_11_8: Yes, tucked away in a Lollo Logistics delivery box.
MAIN_RGLC_11_9: The recipient is "Eris" in the New Federation.
MAIN_RGLC_11_10: A scorched report from a Fractsidus Overseer, meant to be sent to "Eris" in the New Federation.
MAIN_RGLC_12_4: My brother Rhein drew this picture.
MAIN_RGLC_12_5: We're not related by blood. Father took us both in after his own children passed away from a rare illness long ago.
MAIN_RGLC_12_6: For a while, I tried to be the perfect son Father wanted. It never worked, so eventually I stopped trying.
MAIN_RGLC_12_7: It only got worse from there. What Father tried to do to Rhein was unforgivable. And then came that accident...
MAIN_RGLC_12_8: I thought what my father did was a rather mundane story. A cliché, someone trying to atone for past guilt, only to cause greater harm.
MAIN_RGLC_12_9: Until your hints made me suspect it was someone's staged finale. So I had my father's grave exhumed. It was empty.
MAIN_RGLC_12_10: Rhein never could handle pain, but he was easy to cheer up.  Whenever the grown-ups would give me candy, I'd save it all for him.
MAIN_RGLC_12_11: (So that's why he always has candy with him.)
MAIN_RGLC_12_12: A child's drawing inside a picture frame. A family portrait drawn by Luuk's younger brother, Rhein.
MAIN_RGLC_12161_1: A niche edition of "The Minimalist Approach to Cat Psychology," a magazine that the infirmary has a subscription to.
MAIN_RGLC_12161_2: The subscriber doesn't own a cat. Rumor says he's not even good with them. Others have seen him late at night, holding a copy and staring into space.
MAIN_RGLC_12161_3: It was Rhein, Luuk Herssen's younger brother, who loved this magazine series. The good doctor took over the subscription after him and, even years after leaving home, has never canceled it.
MAIN_RGLC_12162_1: Luuk Herssen gathered this dirt from the "place where he rests."
MAIN_RGLC_12162_2: Few know of its significance, yet Luuk places it in the sunlight every day. No one knows why he studies and measures this frozen mound of dirt that never thaws.
MAIN_RGLC_13_1: Those three items you just showed me... Did the Fractsidus get into <te href=750043>Novialle's</te> work after learning about the <te href=750042>Ichor's</te> potential for "evolution"?
MAIN_RGLC_13_2: They didn't just "get into" our work. They went a step further—replacement.
MAIN_RGLC_13_3: Have you ever met the Fractsidus's Grand Architect?
MAIN_RGLC_13_4: The "thousand-faced survivor." We met near the "Styx Lake" deep within the Dark Tide.
MAIN_RGLC_13_5: Wait... Does this mean your father was...?
MAIN_RGLC_13_6: Yes. My father was just another face the Grand Architect borrowed. Though, looking back now, I can't recall the moment the real him was taken.
MAIN_RGLC_13_7: I think the Grand Architect sees life and death as a game. I wouldn't be surprised if "Father" was even smiling in his coffin as we buried him in that downpour!
MAIN_RGLC_13_8: So, that's your answer. Why did you choose me? Because I have a very personal reason to go after the Fractsidus—hatred.
MAIN_RGLC_13_10: Now, it has become something of a habit.
MAIN_RGLC_13_11: Continue this train of investigation and you'll see for yourself what they are. But before you do, there's something I should share.
MAIN_RGLC_13_12: My friends in the Black Shores told me you've already had a few run-ins with certain Overseers. Is that right?
MAIN_RGLC_13_13: Three: Cristoforo, Phrolova, and Scar. Plus the Grand Architect you mentioned.
MAIN_RGLC_13_14: Ah, those names do ring a bell. Phrolova is codenamed Hecate. Cristoforo? Arachnos. Intriguing, isn't it? The flair they have for their own branding.
MAIN_RGLC_13_15: But it's a telling detail. A codename can reveal its owner's style, personal tastes, and even ambitions.
MAIN_RGLC_13_16: Think about it. A powerful Resonator who causes chaos at random leaves no trail to follow. But give them a preference, a pattern, and we can start to build a profile from the pieces.
MAIN_RGLC_13_17: I've been compiling reports on the Overseers for years. Allow me to share what I've learned so far.
MAIN_RGLC_13_18: Luuk explains that his father's identity was also stolen by the Fractsidus's Grand Architect. Hatred was his initial motivation for pursuing the organization, and the very reason your past self chose him for this task.
MAIN_RGLC_14_1: I've reactivated your access. You'll find the door controls right over there.
MAIN_RGLC_15_1: The Fractsidus is loosely organized. Most of its members have only undergone basic, artificially-induced body modification. They're not terribly difficult to neutralize.
MAIN_RGLC_15_2: But if you encounter Artificers with more... creative modifications,  you're likely looking at the handiwork of "Hydra."
MAIN_RGLC_15_3: Hydra is their leading mind on human evolution and body modifications. Whoever they are, they often work in tandem with "Siren."
MAIN_RGLC_15_4: In other words, if you spot one, be on guard in case the other is lurking close by.
MAIN_RGLC_15_5: Zashiki-warashi won't require much of your attention. This Overseer primarily operates in Ashinohara, a region that's been largely destroyed by the Lament.
MAIN_RGLC_15_6: Ashinohara... I've heard of it somewhere before.
MAIN_RGLC_15_7: The girl we had in the infirmary for a while, Chisa, I remember? The city that trapped her, Honami, is part of Ashinohara.
MAIN_RGLC_15_9: Now, on to two key pieces of the puzzle.
MAIN_RGLC_15_10: I did say the Fractsidus was a loose organization, but even the most scattered cells still need funding to function.
MAIN_RGLC_15_11: Remember that report from earlier? It's only a matter of time before you go to the New Federation. And based on the intel I've gathered...
MAIN_RGLC_15_12: That's their most critical base of operations, and where you'll find "Eris."
MAIN_RGLC_15_13: How critical? Do they operate in the open?
MAIN_RGLC_15_14: Not exactly. But in a place where money talks, they must have members in the highest echelons of government and business. Key members.
MAIN_RGLC_15_15: Their foothold in the New Federation has given them immense leverage. With that endless stream of wealth, the Fractsidus operates with impunity across the planet.
MAIN_RGLC_15_16: Speaking of which, Startorch Academy is also heavily funded by the New Federation. To be blunt, they're the Spacetrek Collective's single largest donor.
MAIN_RGLC_15_17: Eris, huh? Duly noted. I'm assuming the other key piece is the Grand Architect?
MAIN_RGLC_15_18: The Fractsidus Grand Architect. Their true name is unknown. They only appear through borrowed identities: Real people, legendary beings, and even the phantoms of the dead from others' memories.
MAIN_RGLC_15_19: I did brush shoulders with them once. It was a shame I had no idea at the time and missed my shot.
MAIN_RGLC_15_20: This pen was the only thing I brought back from that great fire.
MAIN_RGLC_15_21: I have yet to discipher the lettering, but it shows one thing for sure: the Grand Architect has been around for a very, very long time.
MAIN_RGLC_15_22: It's a pity you called me to Lahai-Roi. Otherwise, I would've continued following that trail. But you always have good reason. Right?
MAIN_RGLC_15_23: You uncovered all this by yourself?
MAIN_RGLC_15_24: More or less. I did have some help along the way.
MAIN_RGLC_15_25: To get your hands on one of the Grand Architect's personal items. You did more than just follow a trail. You infiltrated them.
MAIN_RGLC_15_26: Playing along with them isn't that difficult once you get the hang of it. Like I said, they are a loose organization.
MAIN_RGLC_15_27: Knowing the Fractsidus, stealing all that intel on the Overseers is risky, no matter how loose they are. Each infiltration will only be more dangerous than the last.
MAIN_RGLC_15_28: Luuk, how can a doctor who doesn't value his own life save anyone else's?
MAIN_RGLC_15_29: You know, this is the second time you've said those words to me.
MAIN_RGLC_15_31: (If I hadn't been so cautious, I could've "taken care" of them this time.)
MAIN_RGLC_15_32: (I should send today's findings to {PlayerName}. It's been two years. I suppose I'm due for a report.)
MAIN_RGLC_15_33: Good, you got the intel. Would've been a shame if I got myself killed for nothing.
MAIN_RGLC_15_34: You want me to go to Lahai-Roi? Why?
MAIN_RGLC_15_35: There's evidence of their activity in Lahai-Roi. I need you to keep an eye on things. And frankly, you need a break.
MAIN_RGLC_15_36: Now is not the right time.
MAIN_RGLC_15_37: You've already drawn enough attention. Do we really have to wait for you to get killed to decide it's "the right time"?
MAIN_RGLC_15_38: How can a doctor save anyone else's life if he doesn't value his own?  Keep pushing like this and you'll be no different from them.
MAIN_RGLC_15_39: Not pulling any punches, are you?
MAIN_RGLC_15_40: Trust me, that's only the warm up. Lahai-Roi is a nice place, Luuk. Bright, passionate students, beautiful snow. Perfect for slowing things down.
MAIN_RGLC_15_41: Listen to me on this. Come.
MAIN_RGLC_15_44: So I've led a leisurely life in Lahai-Roi ever since. No need to worry, I know my limits.
MAIN_RGLC_15_45: Let's set aside the Fractsidus for now. We should discuss the Exostrider plan. But first, tell me what happened to you and Aemeath in the frostlands.
MAIN_RGLC_15_46: (You briefly recount to Luuk the events in the frostlands.)
MAIN_RGLC_15_47: I see. Aemeath, she... No wonder you're in such a state.
MAIN_RGLC_15_48: I understand her reasons. She was fighting for her dream, for Lahai-Roi, in the only way she knew how. And I respect that. The fate she chose for herself.
MAIN_RGLC_15_49: But I won't accept it. There's more I haven't tried. I'm not done fighting for her.
MAIN_RGLC_15_50: Of course. I wouldn't expect you to give up so easily.
MAIN_RGLC_15_51: Now, about the Exostrider... It started with the Spacetrek Collective finding a "giant Soliskin root network" in Bjartr Woods. They identified it as the "lid" sealing the Stridergate, so to speak.
MAIN_RGLC_15_52: It keeps the Threnodian's fractured forms sealed on both sides of the Stridergate. Break it, and these forms will reunite. That wouldn't just spell Lahai-Roi's doomsday, but the entire world.
MAIN_RGLC_15_53: But the Collective still yearned to open that gateway, to explore the unknown. So, they created the Synchronists. The idea was to use Augmented Resonance to amplify the Exostrider's power, hoping that would keep the Threnodian suppressed.
MAIN_RGLC_15_54: But lately, the Threnodian's attacks on the seal have been increasing. I'm afraid the Fractsidus is also getting ready to make a move.
MAIN_RGLC_15_55: With the Reactor Core returned, all you need now is a little patience. Wait for the Exostrider to awaken. Then we can focus on how to use it to find Aemeath.
MAIN_RGLC_15_56: You were a Synchronist in the Academy once before. I'll speak with Lucilla about getting you piloting access.
MAIN_RGLC_15_57: Then I'll wait for your news, Luuk.
MAIN_RGLC_15_58: Certainly. But our immediate priority should be the Fractsidus. I have a feeling they're planning to sabotage our plans for the Exostrider.
MAIN_RGLC_15_59:
In a secret workspace, Luuk introduces you to the wealth of intelligence he gathered while infiltrating the Fractsidus. His apparent indifference to his own life or death raises your suspicion. He promises to speak with Lucilla to smoothly advance your plans with the Exostrider, which entails you piloting it beyond the Stridergate to retrieve Aemeath.
In the past, Luuk once teetered on the edge of darkness, holding the Grand Architect's pen amidst burning flames. Your past self called him to Lahai-Roi, preventing his fall and ensuring he did not become the very enemy he hunted.

MAIN_RGLC_36_5: If we can't save Aemeath, she'll just be... forgotten. Left to drift in the void forever.

MAIN_RGLC_36_11: You're still the same person you were before. Just as resilient. Still bringing hope to others. That's why, after all these years, we're still willing to stand with you.
MAIN_RGLC_36_12: And it's not because you're a supposed savior. It's because you've always been you.
MAIN_RGLC_36_13: And... we're not just doing this for you. We're doing it for Solaris. For the future we all chose to fight for.

MAIN_RGLC_36_18: Who knows when... I'll wake up next time.

MAIN_RGLC_36_20: We'll see each other again next winter. You'll open your eyes, and I'll be standing right here, just like today.

MAIN_RGLC_36_25: They are. You'll need a miracle. But you've always been good at making those happen.
MAIN_RGLC_36_28: Come now. Enough with that face, {PlayerName}. Some candy?
MAIN_RGLC_36_29: You always carry candy with you... You sure they really work?
MAIN_RGLC_36_31: "It'll help take the edge off and lighten the mood." Your words.
MAIN_RGLC_36_32: Ah, that. Honestly, not really. It's become more of a habit of mine.

MAIN_RGLC_36_34: Later, after I inherited <te href=750043>Novialle</te>, I realized there were still so many things I couldn't control. So I'd eat them to cope, especially when I was up to my neck in trouble thanks to my business associates.

MAIN_RGLC_36_38: But I still enjoy candy. It reminds me that meeting people is still a gift, even if I know I might lose them one day.
MAIN_RGLC_36_39: If you let grief and anger burn you out, you become obsessed with results. You forget the joy you felt along the way.
MAIN_RGLC_36_40: A little sweetness helps keep the numbness at bay.
MAIN_RGLC_36_41: I'll have one of your candies.
MAIN_RGLC_36_43:
Luuk Herssen talks about you, about candy, and about his own past. He says that no matter how strong you are, some things lie beyond anyone's control. But if you let sorrow and rage consume you, you'll lose even the memory of how it feels to be happy with someone again. As you walk with Luuk in the snow, you feel your resolve harden once more. You finally understand the kindness and solace held within a simple piece of candy.
This time, you accept the one he offers.

Side_BYWS_1_1:
Log Entry–No. 322 I
Created by: Amur
 
The Shimmer was not present, and Void Storm concentration remains within normal parameters. However, a Void Storm burst occurred moments ago, engulfing our research outpost. The storm caught two personnel off guard, sweeping them both away. Fortunately, they sounded the emergency alarm in their final moments, ensuring that Tavia and I could evacuate just in time.
 
The storm took our vehicles, and it's only a matter of time before it catches up to us.
 
Haha, I heard that very few manage to survive a Void Storm. We've already encountered a Void Storm burst, which they call a one-in-a-billion event, so who's to say we won't end up meeting another that could save our lives? My vacation was supposed to start in two days... I even planned to call my mom.
 
The storm is closing in, but thankfully, I found a sled some researcher was kind enough to leave behind. I'm going to take a gamble: if we slide down this steep slope, we might be able to outrun the Void Storm. I think our chances are pretty good—after all, the odds of finding something like this in the access-restricted Roya Frostlands were small to begin with, so it looks like our luck is holding up.
 
Wish me luck, Mom.
 
Log Entry–No. 322 II
Created by: Tavia
Amur was taken by the Void Storm. I'll be joining him soon.
 
The sled was broken—that's why it was left behind. We spent too much time checking it and lost valuable time. But even if we hadn't picked it up, the Void Storm would have still swallowed us whole sooner or later. It's unfortunate we took a gamble and lost.
 
The Void Storm is growing stronger. I'm afraid I won't make it. Even so, I'll keep running to minimize Voidmatter corruption to the FCR.
 
Hopefully, the data collected will prove useful to future researchers.
...
...
Body temperature dropping. I can't feel my hands and feet anymore. The Void Storm is fading, but I can't go any further. I'm going to take one last gamble and toss my FCR down below.
 
If this report is recovered intact, then I'll have won my final bet.
 
Wish me luck in the name of truth and science.

Guid_CDYL_15_10: This is a blessing. For her, and for you.

Guid_CDYL_16_1: I took so many good photos!
Guid_CDYL_16_2: How was your chat with Miss Decima?
Guid_CDYL_16_4: Wanna know what we talked about?
Guid_CDYL_16_5: How are you able to start a chat with anyone wherever you go? That's impressive.
Guid_CDYL_16_6: I won't ask about your conversation... That would be awkward.
Guid_CDYL_16_7: I am a bit curious about her, though. She looks familiar somehow, but I can't remember where I've met her before.
Guid_CDYL_16_8: Anyway, never mind! All the signs along the way point to hot springs being nearby.
Guid_CDYL_16_9: The view around the hot springs must be a real break from all this ice! That'll be our next stop!
Guid_CDYL_17_1: Look, a cabin here. I can't believe it. Is someone actually living here?
Guid_CDYL_17_2: Do you think it'll be rude to be taking pictures around his or her house?
Guid_CDYL_17_3: Just a few photos for the trip, she won't mind.
Guid_CDYL_17_4: Good point, let's not take any pictures.
Guid_CDYL_17_5: Totally. Just some photos I'll keep to myself. I also want a few of the other places...
Guid_CDYL_17_6: Yes. Let's go somewhere else instead!
Guid_CDYL_17_7: Hmm... Where would be a good spot for the pictures? Let's see.. Here and here...
Guid_CDYL_17_8: Inara steps away, looking for a suitable photo spot somewhere else.
Guid_CDYL_18_1: Such a beautiful and breathtaking place, just like a painting.
Guid_CDYL_18_2: When I played building sims, I'd always put houses in places like this, like the hermits from Huanglong legends, or the hidden races you read about in New Federation novels.
Guid_CDYL_18_3: But later, I started building houses elsewhere.
Guid_CDYL_18_5: I had to travel so far from familiar ground to reach hidden gems like this. And the silence… it just made you feel alone almost immediately.
Guid_CDYL_18_6: When a beautiful view just becomes part of your daily routine, staying here means you're just… living in your own memories.
Guid_CDYL_18_7: Sometimes, dreamy can be another name for empty.
Guid_CDYL_18_8: Why the sentiment all of a sudden?
Guid_CDYL_18_9: Actually, I've been getting this strange feeling ever since coming to the frostlands.
Guid_CDYL_18_10: I feel like I lost something here somewhere.
Guid_CDYL_18_11: But I... I've never been to the frostlands before, have I?
Guid_CDYL_18_12: Let's assume you did lose something.
Guid_CDYL_18_13: Let's go look for it together.
Guid_CDYL_18_14: If it does exist, I... We... Does that mean those dreams...
Guid_CDYL_18_15: Okay, let's go find it. This time, I'll lead the way.
Guid_CDYL_2_3: I'm Inara, a maintenance worker at the Frostlands Polar Research Outpost. Running into you at a time like this, I'm starting to believe in fate!
Guid_CDYL_2_4: No need to get all emotional...
Guid_CDYL_2_5: Well, what can I do for you?
Guid_CDYL_2_6: Oops, sorry. I got a bit carried away.
Guid_CDYL_2_7: Here's the thing. I've been hard at work at the outpost for more than a decade now, and I've never taken the time to appreciate the frostlands' view.
Guid_CDYL_2_8: Can you believe that? Totally unacceptable to me anyway. So, I finally put in for some time off. I'm going to give this place a proper exploration it deserves.
Guid_CDYL_2_9: But a new problem has surfaced. Between the endless maintenance work and scrambling to get my leave approved, I did zero trip planning.
Guid_CDYL_2_10: From the looks of it, if I want to see everything the frostlands have to offer during my vacation, my best bet is to find a good guide...
Guid_CDYL_2_11: So you want me to be your guide?
Guid_CDYL_2_12: Exactly! I'd be so grateful if you could show me around all the best spots in the frostlands. Oh, and it comes with good pay, of course!
Guid_CDYL_2_14: Great! Let's head out right away!
Guid_CDYL_2_15: O magnificent frostlands. Challenger Inara, coming your way!
Guid_CDYL_2_17: Well, if I had to choose, definitely the SkyArk Space Station! It's a newly discovered space station, and I've been dreaming of seeing it with my own eyes.
Guid_CDYL_2_19: Hehe... This is my first trip in over ten years! Away we go!
Guid_CDYL_21_1: It's them... These monsters. I've dreamt about them several times.
Guid_CDYL_21_2: I've been dreaming about being on an expedition team, out there investigating the frostlands.
Guid_CDYL_21_3: Some teach me how to play video games, some... are very interested in Upphaf Forest, and talk about the many pre-Lament stories...
Guid_CDYL_21_4: But later, we are chased by the monsters, and then, a Void Storm hits us out of nowhere... Everyone, one after another... are all... all...
Guid_CDYL_21_5: In my dreams, I never make it back to the outpost. I'm just… stuck out there in the frostlands. Always. Over and over again... I just can't make it.
Guid_CDYL_21_7: I can't remember their faces. Each time I woke up, I always felt... those were just dreams.
Guid_CDYL_21_8: {PlayerName}, those weren't just dreams... right? I've forgotten something important, haven't I?
Guid_CDYL_21_9: Some memories might never come back.
Guid_CDYL_21_10: But you tried to remember as much as you could.
Guid_CDYL_21_11: ...It was right here... Now, there is nothing left.
Guid_CDYL_21_12: I didn't forget anything... except for a part of myself.
Guid_CDYL_21_15: You break open the ice and reveal a frozen safety box.
Guid_CDYL_21_17: This might be what you're looking for.
Guid_CDYL_22_1: Thanks for waiting, {PlayerName}. I feel much better now.
Guid_CDYL_22_2: Human memory can be so unreliable at times.
Guid_CDYL_22_3: Even if you try to hold onto a memory, repeating it over and over... you can still lose it one day, without even knowing.
Guid_CDYL_22_4: At least you remember it now.
Guid_CDYL_22_5: The dreams held that memory for you.
Guid_CDYL_22_6: Let's... take a picture here. I want to remember this place. I won't forget. Not again.
Guid_CDYL_23_1: Thank you. Now that our trip is wrapping up, allow me be your guide instead.
Guid_CDYL_23_2: This right here is the best photo spot. A lot of my colleagues came straight here when they first got to the outpost.
Guid_CDYL_23_3: You should take a photo for yourself as well.
Guid_CDYL_24_1: Look at this place. The research center, our supply hub, and the gateway to the underground oasis.
Guid_CDYL_24_2: This is where our frostlands journey started, and where it will end.
Guid_CDYL_24_3: Let's mark the end of our trip with this photo.
Guid_CDYL_24_4: That was a rough journey, we...
Guid_CDYL_24_6: Yes, that's right! W-We made it.
Guid_CDYL_24_7: I need to submit this Cassette and print out the pictures... Oh, there's so much to do.
Guid_CDYL_24_8: Thank you for traveling with me. Here's your pay, as we agreed.
Guid_CDYL_25_1: It's so beautiful... Why didn't I come here sooner?
Guid_CDYL_28_1: You take a few steps away. The wind drowns her soft whimpering, leaving fine marks on the frostlands.
Guid_CDYL_28_2: Not long after, she walks to your side.
Guid_CDYL_3_1: Wow—Oh—This is the view I saw in the reports just two days ago!
Guid_CDYL_3_2: Seeing it with my own eyes gives me a sense of nostalgia...
Guid_CDYL_30_2: Will this place still look the same when the owner returns?
Guid_CDYL_31_1: (I'll send her all these photos after she's back.)
Guid_CDYL_4_1: Ever since this station was discovered, nearly a third of the outpost have tried to get on the excavation crew.
Guid_CDYL_4_2: The folks who work here are always hungry for the unknown. An opportunity like this? They're on it in a heartbeat.
Guid_CDYL_4_3: But the actual excavation work hasn't even started yet, and people are already in a spin.
Guid_CDYL_4_4: The excavation work still hasn't started?
Guid_CDYL_4_5: Your last report showed that the threat level here is still unconfirmed. Researchers are only allowed in once that's settled.
Guid_CDYL_4_6: Strangely enough, the closer I get to it, the more I feel like I've seen this place before.
Guid_CDYL_4_7: But this fallen debris was only discovered a few days ago, and I've never left the outpost. So why does it feel... familiar?
Guid_CDYL_4_8: Maybe you've seen similar ruins before?
Guid_CDYL_4_10: We've come all this way... It'd be a shame if we don't take a peek at what's inside.
Guid_CDYL_4_11: There's a researcher from the expedition team by the entrance. Let's go have a chat.
Guid_CDYL_5_1: Oh, Miss Inara? And you must be... {PlayerName} from the Academy? Your reputation precedes you.
Guid_CDYL_5_3: I'm on vacation. I'd like to visit the inside of the space station. Have they given out visiting permits yet?
Guid_CDYL_5_4: Sorry, there're still parts of the space station that haven't been checked for safety yet. All visits are prohibited.
Guid_CDYL_5_5: Well, that's disappointing... Sigh, I guess I'll have to come back on my next vacation.
Guid_CDYL_5_6: P-Please don't give me that look. I'm starting to feel I'm the villain now...
Guid_CDYL_5_7: How about this, I'll send both of you some pictures we took from inside the space station as a souvenir.
Guid_CDYL_5_8: Do come back for a visit after we confirm it's safe inside the space station, Miss Inara.
Guid_CDYL_5_9: I guess it will have to be. I'll go have a look around to see if there're any good views for pictures.
Guid_CDYL_6_1: I have the pictures for Miss Inara uploaded, and some for you as well, {PlayerName}.
Guid_CDYL_6_3: By the way, {PlayerName}. It's probably not my business, but please take care of her while in the frostlands.
Guid_CDYL_6_4: Back when Miss Inara first came, she was very reserved. She just put her head down and did her job, hardly talking to anyone.
Guid_CDYL_6_5: Then a veteran expedition team noticed how dependable she was and invited her to support their frostlands operations.
Guid_CDYL_6_6: Two months later, that very team encountered a Void Storm. She happened to be away at a temporary camp, so she was spared from the disaster.
Guid_CDYL_6_7: The rescue team brought her back safely, but everyone soon learned that she had lost all memories of the expedition.
Guid_CDYL_6_8: Void Storms typically don't cause amnesia. We suspect that she might have wanted to remember this journey so badly that she inadvertently...
Guid_CDYL_6_9: I'm a bit worried that she might get shaken up again on her second trip here.
Guid_CDYL_6_11: And also... these are pictures of the space station's interior we took, {PlayerName}.
Guid_CDYL_8_1: I just remembered—there's an abandoned research outpost nearby! I heard the Roya use it as a rest stop. We can take a break there too.
Guid_CDYL_8_2: But I don't know how to get there. All I have is a map.
Guid_CDYL_8_3: But just a plan and a map won't do us much good if we run into something dangerous out there...
Guid_CDYL_8_5: Words of the mighty. If only I had learned a few moves back when I was still in school!
Guid_CDYL_8_6: Well, if you could handle a Voidworm, guess I'll be safe sticking with you.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_1: Oh, you're... {PlayerName}?! The one who rescued Rinascita from Leviathan?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_2: Forgive my excitement. I've heard a lot about you from the family, but this is my first time meeting you in person.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_3: My name is Italo... Italo Fisalia.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_5: That's right. The Fisalia family might be secretive, but Cantarella isn't as old-fashioned as the rumors would have you believe.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_6: She herself traveled far and wide in search of ways to save the family from Leviathan. But I suppose you already know that.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_7: She permitted me study at Startorch Academy, but I let the family down. In all my time in Lahai-Roi, I never found a way to overcome the Threnodian.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_8: Good thing you and your friends managed to defeat it. *Sigh* ...not that I was any help.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_9: Now that the threat to the family is gone, maybe I should focus on my studies... I might learn something which may prove helpful.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_10: That reminds me, aren't you a duelist too, {PlayerName}?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_11: My friends at the Academy keep telling me how powerful the machine deck is. But as a Rinascitan, lemme tell ya, nothing beats the Echo deck!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_13: Nah, machine deck all the way.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_1_14: Whatever... I'll prove it to you with my prized Echo deck. Let's duel, {PlayerName}!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_1: Oh, you must be a student at Startorch Academy. And a duelist as well!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_2: Can I ask you something? I promise I won't take up too much of your time.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_4: My knowledge is at your disposal.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_5: So, it's like this—I'm planning to study at Startorch Academy.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_6: I heard that at Startorch Academy, you guys conduct Peaks of Prestige duels while racing motorbikes at the same time.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_7: Is-is that true? Can you really duel while riding a cool motorbike?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_11: S.I.G.M.A.? Who's that? So, you're saying no one actually duels like that at the Academy? That's too bad...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_12: I really thought it was true... Dueling while on a motorbike sounds so exciting and romantic...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_13: When I get into Startorch Academy, I'm going to set up a motorbike dueling system!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_10_16: Until then... show me how you duel at Startorch Academy!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_11_1: I see... So, that's how you duel at the Academy? Noted!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_11_2: I heard this blonde girl who likes bubblegum say that students at the Academy can customize their motorbikes however they want.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_11_3: I have an idea—I'll make a motorbike dueling module!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_11_4: When a duelist loses HP, a holographic obstacle will be projected in front of the bike. Both players have to try their best to reach the finish line first before the duel ends!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_11_5: S.I.G.M.A. is really going to short-circuit.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_11_7: Hm... I still need to figure out how to get accepted into the Academy, though. I guess I have to get back to work!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_1: Ohhhh! I detect the aura of a strong duelist...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_2: I knew it was you, {PlayerName}! Lahai-Roi's greatest duelist!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_4: Of course! Word in the Academy is that "a transfer student has become Lahai-Roi's greatest duelist..."
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_5: I've always wanted to learn from someone so strong. It looks like today's my lucky day!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_7: ...But won't it get in the way of your work?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_8: Not at all. I just need to check and record the device's readings at the right times.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_9: Truth be told, this phase of research is pretty dull. If the device has an issue, I fix it; but if not, I just wait for it to finish collecting data.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_10: ...That's really it. What's scary is that I haven't been able to find a single strong duelist here.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_11: When I'm not working, all I do is mentally go over tactics and think about how to improve decks... But there's no one to fight.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_13_12: But now, I finally have an opponent!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_14_1: Ah... what an interesting duel that was!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_14_3: Now, even the boring work of data gathering and the bland taste of energy gel can't get me down.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_14_4: While I was still at Startorch Academy, a professor there was always saying:
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_14_5: "Researchers need to learn how to relax and have fun, or at least find things that make them happy. If not, one day they'll snap."
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_14_6: Peaks of Prestige has always been how I relax.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_14_7: When you have time, I hope you'll come back and duel me. I'll be ready!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_15_1: Do you want to duel? Let's do it!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_1: Ah... It's you, {PlayerName}. Did you come to the Roya Frostlands in search of strong fighters, too?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_3: Duelists in Peaks of Prestige, of course.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_4: You're the strongest known duelist in Lahai-Roi right now, but I bet... you want to face someone stronger than yourself, too.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_5: After all, that's what drives a duelist to keep dueling to surpass their own limits, and the limits of their opponents and all of humanity.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_8: Hmm... doesn't matter. I'm here to search for powerful duelists.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_9: Only the harsh frostlands could produce a strong, tough opponent... One as fearsome as a Glommoth is to a mech reindeer.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_10: I couldn't duel you sooner because I was sent on an expedition to the frostlands.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_11: But it's like fate stepped in—here I am, combing the frostlands for strong fighters, and I run into you.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_16_12: Will you duel me? Show me... just how far I am from the "strongest."
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_17_1: You really are strong. This is the first time I've felt powerless in a duel.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_17_2: It felt like battling a howling windstorm, or the immovable power of nature rather than a duelist...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_17_3: Where did you get this strength from? It's almost... unreal.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_17_4: I've been training for a long time.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_17_6: ...I thought I'd trained for long enough. But it looks like I still have more to learn.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_18_1: Are you planning to duel me again, {PlayerName}?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_1: It doesn't look like there are any here... I'll have to keep searching.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_3: Oh, I'm looking for lichen that only grows in the frostlands. They're one of my wife's favorite foods.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_4: But they can only be picked during a ten-day window. If it's too early, they won't have grown enough; if it's too late, they taste bitter.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_5: And they all seem to "migrate"... Even the most experienced Shepherds don't know where they'll appear in the frostlands.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_6: Since I'm already guiding Exoswarm, I thought I'd try my luck on my way back.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_7: But it's fine if I don't find any, hahaha... Cradle Lichen is also pretty tasty.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_9: Thanks! I'm going to rest a bit before heading out.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_10: By the way, you're a duelist, aren't you? So are my wife and I—though I can never beat her... Haha.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_11: But the joy of dueling is the most important factor. Winning is just a bonus, isn't it?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_19_12: Hm... Since I'm resting anyway, we might as well duel?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_2_1: Huh... Not as strong as I thought...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_2_2: You know, if you combined the Echo and the machine decks, wouldn't that be even stronger? Yeah, that's right! Like giving Cuddle Wuddle exoskeleton armor!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_2_3: Isn't that a Montelli Sentry Construct?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_2_4: I-is it...? Hahaha, let's not sweat the details.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_20_1: Amazing... Never mind me, I don't even think my wife could defeat you!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_20_2: Once I'm home, I'm going to tell her I met a powerful duelist in the frostlands! Though she won't believe me.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_1: Oh, the Exostrider is such a glorious creation... Right, {PlayerName}?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_3: I was in charge of monitoring the Exostrider in the Roya Frostlands outpost. I thought rebuilding it would take ages.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_4: I assumed I'd watch over it for the rest of my life, then pass the job on to my successor, and then their successor... Witnessing its majesty would be our life's work.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_5: But the New Solar Ceremony worked. A new sun has replaced the Exostrider's Drive above Lahai-Roi.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_6: The Exostrider will finally awaken—and my job is about to end.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_8: That sounds like a good thing.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_9: It'd be strange if I wasn't—I've been doing this for years, after all. Still, I won't miss this job that much.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_10: A good thing? That's true... And that's how it should be. I can find a new job and leave the frostlands.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_11: So, to celebrate the complete success of the New Solar Ceremony—let's have a duel!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_13: Haha, sorry, please forgive my boldness. I rarely meet duelists here, and I don't want to waste an opportunity to unwind after work.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_22_14: It's all the spirit of Mr. Furius's "Always be ready for a duel" mindset, right?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_23_1: Ah, what a terrific duel! And the Exostrider witnessed it, too.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_23_2: I once heard a theory that the universe is like a videotape: First, it plays through to the end, then it rewinds and replays itself forever.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_23_3: Maybe hundreds of years from now, people will have forgotten me, and Lahai-Roi's researchers will only get a passing mention in books—no one will know our names.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_23_4: But when I think about the Exostrider witnessing everything we've done, our intellectual efforts to achieve greatness, I feel... proud.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_23_5: Even though I only contributed a little, I gave it everything I had.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_23_8: Hah, I hope so. Sorry, I don't know what's wrong with me... It must be because the Exostrider is about to awaken. I'm a little too excited.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_24_2: It's another perfect day today, isn't it?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_1: "...When the pilots entered the cockpit, they became one with the machine."
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_2: "They guided the vehicle out of the layer of ice. Wielding a sword, the mech beat back the attacking Voidworms..."
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_4: Ah... sorry, I'm plotting out a story. It's inspired by the Exostrider.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_5: A large, poisonous Tacet Discord appears in the frostlands' underground rift, threatening the Academy, so their Synchronists pilot mechs to defeat the monsters.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_7: Right?! Humans love a story about conflict between mechs and monsters!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_8: I haven't figured out the ending, though. Right now, I'm thinking the main character will use Helios to destroy the rift...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_9: ...Then right as people start to believe he's gone, he falls from the <te href=750035>Etheric Sea</te>, unconscious! Then he and his comrades go face the final crisis!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_10: Haha, it's just an initial idea. The connection between the rift and the Etheric Sea is a key foreshadowing—though I think I'll keep that part to myself for now.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_12: Hahaha... Don't fret about the little details.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_13: In fact, I've shown the entire outline to a friend at the Pioneer Association. He was so impressed, he's going to recommend my work to a New Federation film director once it's done.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_14: Maybe it'll get adapted into a sci-fi blockbuster hit.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_16: I hope it does great at the box office!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_17: It's not a movie yet, but thank you anyway.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_18: *Sigh* ...Writing a novel is such a headache. If only someone would join me for a round of Peaks of Prestige...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_25_20: R-Really? You've got to duel me!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_26_1: Not bad... A clash between machines and Echoes. I think... I've found some inspiration.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_26_2: I've got to write it down now! Maybe I can use it in the prologue, when the Tacet Discords attack the Academy...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_27_2: I'm experiencing a minor case of writer's block... Let's have a duel! Maybe it'll inspire me again!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_1: Oh hi there, {PlayerName}! Lahai-Roi's greatest duelist!
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_2: Are you here in search of the legendary deck too?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_4: That's right. As you can see, we're in a spacecraft graveyard.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_5: I read a few pre-Lament historical texts that mention an amazing card game developed by a game studio.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_6: A player had put their deck in a spaceship and sent it toward the stars... but the spaceship eventually returned to Solaris's orbit.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_7: They say the deck was blessed by the universe, and whoever finds it will become the greatest duelist in Peaks of Prestige.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_8: According to my analysis, this is where the spaceship crashed.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_12: Peaks of Prestige is a newly released game, right? How can it be related to a card game from before the Lament?
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_13: Th-That's true, but I found those texts in the Spacetrek Collective's database. Let me double-check...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_14: Wilhelmina gets her Terminal and quickly scans through the information she found.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_16: That's why it sounded so familiar.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_17: Your source texts are from an anime.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_18: I-I see. And here I thought it actually happened...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_19: Oh well, I thought I could finally become the greatest duelist.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_28_22: Makes sense... Then could you practice with me? I'm sure I'll benefit tremendously from a few duels with an expert like you.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_29_1: Amazing... If I didn't know the alleged Universe Deck was from an animated fiction, I'd think it was in your hands, and that you've been blessed by the universe.
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_29_2: If only I could be as good as you...
Side_LYBYBVBTZ_29_3: Looks like I'll have to put in more work...

Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_1_1:
Academy Event Notice

Hi there! We've been waiting for you!
The New Solar Celebration is about to begin. Come on down to the event venue and soak up the incredible energy!

But that's not all... Have you heard the rumors? Someone's discovered the Academy's "Dark Side!" We're talking mysterious graffiti, strange, twisting hallways that stretch on forever, and secrets that are usually kept hidden... 

We bet you're just as curious as we are to explore this Dark Side! What kind of riddles and games await this time?

We heard an especially special riddle was hidden away somewhere. Solve it, and some serious luck may just come your way!
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_4: I failed… I couldn't do it… I'm sorry, I'm so, so sorry…
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_5: It's not your fault, Sigrika. What did you see in the Dark Side?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_6: I don't know. It's all wrong... Why... Why is this happening...?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_7: It felt like a nightmare... No, not a nightmare. It was all real.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_8: It's all my fault. The Tacet Discords, the riddles… all the disturbances in the Dark Side are coming from me.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_9: I'm not brave enough to face failure, so I tell myself I can handle everything. I'm terrified of letting everyone down… of not living up to expectations.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_10: I'm so scared. What do I do now…?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_13: It was just a nightmare. We got out with those students, remember? You did everything you could, and you did well.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_14: Was it… really just a nightmare?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_15: That voice, the one telling us to stay… I know who it is now.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_17: I was the one who made it. That's why I could solve the riddles and see those Tacet Discords. It told me... I would always end up back there.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_18: What should I do to stop it from getting worse?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_19: There's no "right" answer I can give you.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_20: But whatever you decide to do, I'll be there to help you.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_21: ...But isn't that just relying on someone else?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_22: No. The fight is yours to finish. But you won't be fighting it alone.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_23: You once told me that you hear so many voices when you close your eyes.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_24: The things you heard in the Dark Side aren't so different from what I'm telling you now. They're all just... voices.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_25: What matters isn't how they make you feel, but what you choose to do after hearing them.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_26: Even if what I choose ends up making things worse?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_27: Even then, it'll be okay. At least we've tried our best till the end and have no regrets.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_28: I know someone who saw her own end coming from a mile away. Someone very dear to me. But she walked right toward it, towards her own sacrifice.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_29: She wanted to save the world. In the end, she kept her promise.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_30: And I... I'm far from perfect. There are things I can't do, either.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_31: But no matter what happens, I won't regret the choices I've made.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_33: So I should try? Even if I might fail?
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_34: Senior, I... need some time to think about this.
Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_101_35: What she did... I couldn't judge. Still, I saw her resolve and courage. Those could never be wrong.

Lucilla follows the rabbit into a movie theater. A title flashes on screen: "The Tragic Life of Lucilla," directed by Lucilla, starring Lucilla. 
The Fractsidus have taken her past, twisted parts out of context, and stitched them all into a movie. It shows her as a child subconsciously absorbing too many memories, until she couldn't tell what was hers anymore and began to lose herself. Then comes the ending they've predicted for her: Lucilla, at the Academy's helm, leading everyone straight into the abyss. 
Lucilla scoffs at the movie's utter lack of taste. Then a familiar voice echoes through the theater. The Fractsidus have decided to remake the film, redesigning Lucilla's life and creating an entirely different version of events.
