Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_4: You only need to come a little closer, and take my hand.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_5: Our lives can trade places. No more pain, only warmth and bliss. The curtain's about to fall, and the choice is yours.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_7: All that noise for one purpose, the same trick you used on Sevi. Stirring fear, pressing old wounds.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_8: Let me guess what you're after. Targeting Sigrika was just a diversion. You wanted the Academy to intervene.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_9: Next, the memory-type Resonators affected in the Dark Side, and you knew I'd see it. That was your invitation.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_10: So this little play? It was meant for me and all the memory-type Resonators. You're afraid of something in us, aren't you? Something that threatens your grand scheme.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_11: You put on quite a hilarious show, I'll give you that. But you came to the wrong audience. You can ramble about pasts and futures all you like, but I only focus on the present.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_12: And that's exactly why your "message" in that film disgusts me.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_13: I don't deny the doubt, the struggle, or the pain we face in our search. Every soul in Startorch Academy has endured those.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_14: But the weight of civilization demands shoulders to bear it. And we, right from the beginning, are a flock walking willingly toward our own end.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_15: If the campfire's dying out, then these lambs you mock will burn themselves, just to walk one more mile before the final breath.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_16: No glory sought. No remembrance needed. We'll lie down here, leaving not a trace.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_17: But what's the point of it all?!
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_18: The point? You who watch us burn... You're the proof. You, and everyone behind you, that's our meaning.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_19: And one more thing. Whether I deserve to be the President... That's not for your cheap words or your lousy films to decide.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_20: If you're so desperate to tear me down, that only proves I'm doing something right.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_21: Tell me, who's the real desperate one here?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_22: Hehe, you're not the only one with backup. Checkmate.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_23: Hah... Did the others' memories bleed into mine again? How long was I out? The meeting's already over...
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_24: What's happening to me... I just want to forget. To erase this wretched Forte.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_25: Erase... right. If I erase the memory of my Forte itself, maybe then, everything will go back to normal.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_26: I'm done with all of it.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_27: She abandoned her title, her right to explore, and now even her own Forte.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_28: She chose to kill the person she used to be, like someone who had drowned, losing both her air and shadow.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_39_29:
Actor Lucilla reenacts this remade life where Lucilla gave up the President's position, her right to explore, and ultimately her Forte. If everything is destined to fade anyway, why not just enjoy fleeting pleasure before disaster strikes? She attempts to negate everything the real Lucilla has accomplished, tempting her to stay in the Dark Side forever. 
But she miscalculated. Lucilla doesn't budge. She tells her exactly what drives her and Startorch Academy to keep moving forward. And with that, the rabbit's illusion shatters.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_4_1: Dear {PlayerName}, student of Rabelle College of Startorch Academy, greetings! Thank you for your trust. A file transfer is waiting for your approval. To accept, please reply with "Accept Subscription."
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_4_4: [Attachment Received — Startorch Academy Dark Side Investigation Report No. AN25360.]
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_4_5: Reply accepted. Forced file transfer in progress...
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_4_6: [Attachment Received - Startorch Academy Dark Side Investigation Report No. AN25360.]
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_4_7: Got the file? It contains the basic information about our target, Professor Sevi.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_4_8: He's heading to the camp today for a geological survey. I'll leave the talking to you.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_4_9: You receive a WavesLine message from Lucilla.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_41_2: Go after it. I'll handle the rest.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_41_3: Come on. We've still got work to do.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_42_1: Stay sharp, {PlayerName}. It can take the form of anything in the Dark Side.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_42_2: There's only one passage here. It must still be around. Stay close.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_1: Told you... It's checkmate this time.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_4: Hmm... We still haven't figured out what the Fractsidus wants with the Dark Side.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_5: For now, this little one's our only lead. Let me try reading its memory first.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_6: Oh? Looks like I don't even need to use my Forte.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_7: I suppose this counts as our first proper meeting, Madam Lucilla?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_8: Proper meeting? You're talking to me through a rabbit from your little hideout. That's what you call "proper"?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_9: Still... thanks for the film. It was tasteless and trashy, but I'll admit, it added a little fun to my job.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_10: You knew I'd catch this rabbit from the start.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_11: And didn't you already know it was a trap meant for you? We both have what the other wants.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_12: What are you trying to do in Lahai-Roi?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_13: Uh-uh. As an educator, you of all people should know better. Finding the answer is the asker's job, you know.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_14: Still... congratulations. You've won this round.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_15: Won? I never agreed to play your little game. And neither did my students. Right, {PlayerName}?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_18: Flattering myself? That hurts. I worked very hard setting up those trials for you.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_19: If you didn't enjoy them, don't worry. There'll be a next round. And I promise, it'll be far more thrilling.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_20: Because next time, we'll be betting on the very fate of Lahai-Roi. Will it go boom and vanish... or will the flames of Startorch keep burning?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_21: I can't wait. Truly... I can't wait for our next meeting.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_24: It's alright. At least we dealt with the source of the Dark Side's anomaly.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_26: I know you've got many questions, but let's get out of here first.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_43_27: You and Lucilla seize the rabbit. The Grand Architect speaks through it to deliver a new announcement: "In the next game, we'll be betting on the fate of Lahai-Roi. Will it go boom and vanish, or will the flames of Startorch keep burning?" Then the rabbit disappears. You ask about the Miko you saw earlier, but Lucilla urges you to leave. The Dark Side is unstable, and explanations can wait until you're out.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_1: You said the things in the Dark Side wouldn't hurt them.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_2: Didn't I do what you asked? You wanted to help Sigrika, so I tweaked the Dark Side to help her see herself clearly.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_3: Besides… no one got hurt, right? Your friend, your teacher… and {PlayerName}.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_4: I should thank you, actually. You helped me finish an experiment…
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_6: The opposite of the void… How far can memory-type Resonators go before "its" power consumes them?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_7: And what other tricks is this petty Academy hiding?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_8: A miko wielding a sword, hehe…
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_9: Come, my sweet darling. We've still got much to do.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_10: What about the rabbit? Isn't it your pet?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_11: We don't keep trash. We dump it.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_12: So… please try hard to be useful, if you don't want to be disposable.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_44_13: Denia confronts the Grand Architect, reminding them of their promise that the Dark Side would not harm Sigrika or Rover. Unconcerned, the Architect points out that no one was actually hurt in the end. They mockingly thank everyone for their roles in this experiment exploring the opposite of the Void—testing the extent memory-type Resonators can resist "its" power. With that, the Grand Architect leaves with Denia to see to other matters awaiting their attention.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_1: Sorry, {PlayerName}. I've kept you busy all day.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_2: You do owe me an apology.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_4: From the moment you came to me, you already knew this was a trap set by the Fractsidus. Yet, you planned to walk right into it.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_5: All in a day's work for your President. Besides... it worked out pretty well, don't you think?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_6: But what if something had gone wrong?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_7: Don't worry. I know the Dark Side pulls people toward what they fear and try to escape from. But I learned to face my past honestly long ago.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_8: Then… what exactly happened to you back there?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_10: Didn't you say you wanted to introduce a new course, Startorch Guidelines: From Strangers to Confidants?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_11: Students and teachers should get to know each other, right? Maybe this counts as our first class.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_12: Sigh... I really set myself up for that one. Well...
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_13: Before I turned twenty, I couldn't tell which memories were mine and which belonged to the ones I had read.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_14: As I absorbed more and more of them, I saw too many births and deaths… I started to feel how small and ignorant I really was.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_15: That's exactly what the Dark Side preyed on. It then recreated the predicament I once lived through. The Fractsidus was questioning me, the representative of Startorch Academy…
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_16: When the future offers no answers, and existence itself is destined to fade… can anything we do, in our brief and ignorant lives, truly matter?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_17: As a student of Startorch Academy, what do you think, {PlayerName}?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_18: If there's no answer, then we create one.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_19: Haha, that's the kind of answer you'd say.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_20: Back then, I joined the Spacetrek Collective without a real purpose, but luckily, just like you, I met a good teacher.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_22: My teacher was an ordinary man, a Roya in charge of observation in the frostlands. We both spent our days watching and recording, each in our own realm…
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_23: But he never saw himself as just an observer. Again and again, he made connections with people and the things he studied and built bridges between them.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_24: It was like how we draw lines between the stars now. In these perilous frostlands, each person is a point of light for another.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_25: Maybe I used to stand too high, never stooping to feel the emotions in those memories… the ones that needed time to settle for an ordinary person.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_26: When I revisited the memories I once read, I realized they all shared one thing in common—everyone spends their whole life searching for answers.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_27: And it's those very answers that give meaning to our journey toward the future, even if we might find nothing in the end.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_28: Then, have you found your answers?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_29: No… I'm still searching. In that sense, I'm the same as all of you, just another student on the path.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_30: So don't worry. Until I find it, the Fractsidus won't be able to shake me. Also, about that miko lady you're curious about…
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_31: My lips are sealed on that, I'm afraid. A President has her principles, not to mention the Academy's safety protocol. But one day, you'll see her again.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_32: Anyway, I still have to write a full report on the Dark Side. Leave the rest to the adults now. It's getting late, {PlayerName}. I'll see you in class.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_45_34: Upon leaving the Dark Side, you reproach Lucilla for acting alone. She calmly explains that her confidence stemmed from having long since learned to confront her past honestly. She shares a story from her youth when, feeling lost, she met a Roya teacher. He taught her how to hold her own memories, respect others', and find meaning in whatever comes next. Noticing your curiosity about the Miko, Lucilla smiles and promises that you will meet her when the time is right.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_1: Hmm? Still something you want to say?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_2: I'd like to hear more about your past.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_3: Oh? But Startorch Guidelines: From Strangers to Confidants is designed for both teachers and students, isn't it?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_4: If you want to hear mine, you'll have to share your stories before coming to Lahai-Roi first.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_5: (Tell her part of your story in Jinzhou)
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_6: (Tell her part of your story in Rinascita)
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_7: You tell Lucilla part of your story in Jinzhou. She nods occasionally, respectful of the people there.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_8: People everywhere are protecting their homes in their own ways. The Fractsidus's claim that it's all meaningless is the greatest insult to our era.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_9: And your pen pal sounds like a sincere, kind girl. It's a blessing, in times like these, to have someone you can truly talk to.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_10: I hope I get to meet her again.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_11: You will. Human connections are stronger than you think.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_12: You tell Lucilla part of your story in Rinascita. Curiosity flickers in her eyes.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_13: I've only read about Rinascita in textbooks. Their culture of living alongside Echoes reminds me a bit of the Roya.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_14: If I ever get the chance, I'd love to visit there and hear their bards perform in person.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_15: All right, since you shared, I'll tell you something you wanted to know. Let's start with my Royan teacher.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_16: During an expedition in the frostlands, I got caught in a storm and was separated from the others. Due to my chaotic memories, I barely understood the concept of death.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_17: An old Royan observer rescued me and brought me back to his outpost.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_18: When he learned of my ability, he asked me to help him recall the memories he'd long forgotten.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_19: In that small cabin, I read the joys and sorrows of his past.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_20: He studied the behavior of Exoswarm alone, danced the Royan dances there, and shared laughter with passing researchers.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_21: He was never lonely. I began to follow his example and actively reached out to the memories I once read. I wanted to show my respect and experience them anew.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_24: No. It was the fear of death… For the first time, I truly feared death. I felt their most genuine human emotions facing the jaws of death.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_46_25: When I realized that, I knew I was finally waking up from the nightmare of those memories.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_1: It's just the two of us now. No need for all the formality, Hiyuki.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_2: Want to try one? It's pretty popular among the students.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_4: Candy's supposed to be eaten when you're not hungry. That's what makes it taste good. Go on, try it.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_6: Umm-hmm. A bit sour… and my tongue's tingling. Not my favorite.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_7: Huh? No reaction at all? That's odd. When Sigrika and the others ate theirs, they…
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_10: {Male=He;Female=She} saw me. Does that affect your plan?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_11: It's fine. The Fractsidus didn't just set the trap for me. It was meant to draw you out as well.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_13: I'm sorry for keeping you confined… for trying to hide your power. In the end, it still came to light.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_14: We both knew this day would come sooner or later.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_15: So… would you consider moving back to the Academy for now? If anything happens, you can respond right away.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_17: The Fractsidus went to great lengths to tamper with the Dark Side, but it poses little actual threat to the Academy.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_21: At worst, this anomaly might be tied to the power of the Threnodian, too. It seems they're already preparing their next phase.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_22: What do you need me to do?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_24: You should know that the Spacetrek Collective was built atop the Threnodian. That's why we've prepared countless contingency plans.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_25: Even if every single one failed… even if the Threnodian completely consumed the Collective, we still have a final card to play.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_26: Oh, and just so you know, the maintenance fee for that blade will be coming out of your paycheck this month.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_28: The one you used in the Dark Side. That makes it the fourth you've broken so far. Try to be gentler the next time, will you?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_29: Sure. What about my own sword?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_30: Its maintenance is mostly done. Don't worry, you'll have it back soon.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_31: Sometime later, the mysterious Miko reappears at Lucilla's side. Lucilla calls her  Hiyuki. As they review the incident, Lucilla acknowledges that the Fractsidus likely have bigger schemes in motion. While the Academy has prepared numerous contingency plans, should they fail, the Spacetrek Collective retains one final protocol—Hiyuki.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_14: It's worth noting that while many have entered the Dark Side, only a few were chosen by the rabbit.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_15: While the Celebration incident was a Fractsidus scheme targeting you and Sigrika, the other victims might have followed a pattern that drew the rabbit.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_16: And that pattern lies hidden among the victims themselves.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_17: Exactly. We need to find out what each of them did in the Dark Side and make comparisons.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_18: The common threads might be what attracted the rabbit. The Academy has already investigated the victims.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_19: Based on what we've found, a few possible factors stand out.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_20: Like how long they stayed in the Dark Side, whether they entered with a strong purpose or desire, and whether they brought anything back.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_21: Our next lead is a professor with a pretty strong opinion against the Academy's management. That's why... you, as a student, are a better choice to approach him.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_24: Not exactly. Some of his beliefs just don't align with the executives' ideas.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_25: Setting that aside, I'll support your investigation from the Dark Side. My Forte will be essential to uncover what they experienced.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_26: Don't worry. I'll be assisting from the Dark Side. My Forte will be essential to uncover what they experienced.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_27: Once you speak with him, try to obtain one of his personal items. That'll let me relive his memories in the Dark Side.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_28: So I'm on the bright side, and you're on the dark...
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_29: Take care of yourself in there.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_30: Hm. Now, I've <ano=WavesLine>texted</ano> you the basic info on that victim... And take this.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_33: Don't underestimate this little mirror. It's actually a communicator. It's only natural for partners to have a private line, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_34: It's getting late. I'm already on my way to the Dark Side. The on-campus investigation is in your hands now.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_35: Oh, and check your phone. I've sent you a new message.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_48_36:
Lucilla notes that the rabbit's attacks are highly selective. To determine how it chooses its targets, she proposes a coordinated investigation into the victims. You approach the victims and collect key personal belongings, and she will use her Forte to read the memories tied to them. 
Together, you'll dig through what she finds and look for answers.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_49_2: You've got a lot of nerve bringing that up.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_5_2: How am I supposed to use it?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_5_3: You're holding it too close. Using a communicator like that would make you look too suspicious.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_5_4: Relax. I already adjusted the settings before giving it to you.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_5_5: Just keep it in your pocket. The key is to stay calm and look natural.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_51_1: President, can you still hear me?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_51_2: Yes... The comms are stable. Let's begin.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_6: This is strange... I was setting up the room according to the riddle the Academy gave me, but now it's...
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_7: Who changed the riddle? Who altered the scene? Could it be that rabbit the students keep mentioning?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_8: Either way, I should focus on restoring the room through memory projection. If a student gets misled and causes another accident, it'll be a real headache.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_9: Mmm. So this is Professor Sevi's memory when he first entered the Dark Side. He stayed here quite a while and used his Forte.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_10: From what we just saw, he was one of the staff involved in the New Solar Celebration. He came here to restore the scene that had been tampered with.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_13: Not exactly. Maybe because I'm a memory-type Resonator too. Something caught my attention.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_14: People think memory-type Resonators like us are masters of memories and emotions, unshaken by illusions or insults.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_15: But no Forte is perfect. When we pour all focus into manipulating memories, information floods the mind.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_16: That's when we're most vulnerable. The anomaly in the Dark Side preys on the mind. If I were a Fractsidus member, I'd strike then...
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_52_17: This projection won't hold for long. Let's move forward.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_2: But it can. You've spent all your chips. What else do you have left to trade?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_3: Ah, right. Almost forgot about that. Your greatest honor, wasn't it? Let's see if it's worth anything.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_4: Look at that. You've given everything, and yet, you still can't trade for a single answer.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_5: Or maybe... the scale is the answer. The so-called scientific pursuit at Lahai-Roi contributes nothing to the advance of human civilization.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_6: And of course, it can't change what sleeps beneath Lahai-Roi. You know exactly what I mean.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_8: Oh? Don't I? You've got nothing left. Oh... but there's still one last thing you can trade.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_9: Your life. Go on! This is the part you idealists always love, isn't it?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_10: ...I told you. You don't understand! You're just preying on desperate seekers of truth!
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_11: I won't let anyone else enter this room!
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_17: Offer something of equal value, and the answer's yours. Look, I've even prepared the stakes for you, everything tied to your research.
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_18: Thesis, data... It's all here. So, which one's worth the truth?
Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_53_19: See? No weight at all. Your report's worthless.

GLXXDDD_1_2: The system says your order's ready. I don't want to know why your taste in food is the way it is, but can you please stop ordering weird stuff if you're not gonna pick it up?!
GLXXDDD_1_3: You order, you pay. That's how business works.
GLXXDDD_1_4: But it's not MY order! I ordered my usual custom mix, and I still haven't gotten it!
GLXXDDD_1_5: Your machine has spat out the wrong order three times in a row!
GLXXDDD_1_6: I looked it up. You're the only one who ordered at that time. Who else could it be? You trying to freeload or what? If you don't pick up your order, it blocks the output slot and I can't serve anyone else!
GLXXDDD_1_7: I said IT WASN'T ME! And just look at this... thing. You really think this is fit for human consumption?!
GLXXDDD_1_8: Okay, that's a bit much. Sure, the recipe's unconventional, but it was made exactly to the order. Your order!
GLXXDDD_1_9: Honestly, it looks better than the stuff you usually get... Wait, I get it. You're just messing with me to cause trouble, aren't you?
GLXXDDD_1_10: Oh, so now it's MY fault?!
GLXXDDD_1_11: The two reach a sudden impasse. Their gazes lock onto you simultaneously.
GLXXDDD_1_12: {PlayerName}! Perfect timing. Please, can you talk some sense into him? I swear this isn't what I ordered.
GLXXDDD_1_13: Yeah, give us a second opinion. All I know is I followed the order to the letter.
GLXXDDD_1_15: What exactly went wrong with this order?
GLXXDDD_1_16: Here. The note is clear: "Warming Memorial, Δ Ratio."
GLXXDDD_1_17: It's a base of compressed nutrient biscuits, topped with salted frozen algae, cheese powder, and some kind of... mineral flavor stabilizer.
GLXXDDD_1_18: It tastes... half-defrosted. Not spoiled, but not something you really want to swallow.
GLXXDDD_1_19: ...I never wrote that note. Besides, does that sound like something a student would even WANT to order?
GLXXDDD_1_20: Look, it's high-calorie. If you were out in the wilds or frostlands, this would be exactly what you'd need for an energy boost.
GLXXDDD_1_21: Exactly, why would I order that? And look here... DAN-013, AMU-013, WEG-013. What gibberish is this?
GLXXDDD_1_22: You didn't type that? They show up every time. They look like equipment IDs or old project tags. Either way, they've got no business showing up in a catering system.
GLXXDDD_1_23: I don't even bother memorizing the password to my lab. Why would I go that far in my food order?
GLXXDDD_1_24: I admit, it's weird. Same note, every time. Almost like someone's checking to see if it's actually being received. But every order goes through the system and gets made. It never gets ignored.
GLXXDDD_1_25: Fine, but I'm not taking the fall for this. {PlayerName}, think you could help run this by I.R.I.S.?
GLXXDDD_1_26: Her retrieval scope is wider than any system. If she can't find out where these orders are coming from, then it's something way above our pay grade.
GLXXDDD_1_27: Send me the IDs. I'll go ask I.R.I.S.
GLXXDDD_1_28: ...Sent. Ha, just don't make me look at this order ever again.

GLXXDDD_10_2: Cruise route: Multiple instances of manual overwrite.
GLXXDDD_10_3: Navigation Module: Logic intact, but target coordinates are missing.
GLXXDDD_10_6: I've seen the ones at the transport hub, but this one's different. Is this vehicle... an old model?
GLXXDDD_10_7: Let me check the status. Hmm... power's stable, but it's been continuously writing and outputting data. I can't tell where it's sending it to. Almost like it's just repeating the same request over and over.

GLXXDDD_11111_1: Look, I don't want to know why your taste in food is the way it is...
GLXXDDD_11111_2: But can you please stop ordering weird stuff if you're not gonna pick it up?!
GLXXDDD_11111_3: What in the world? That's not even what I ordered...!
GLXXDDD_12_1: Seriously, I was just out here poking around for fun! Didn't think I'd actually get wrapped up in an urban legend...
GLXXDDD_12_2: I just wanted to figure out why this vehicle drove itself out here. But these onboard records show the system actually allowed it to veer off. It flagged this route as reasonable. Wait—DAN-013, AMU-013, and WEG-013...
GLXXDDD_12_3: Aren't those the same IDs from those food orders you mentioned?
GLXXDDD_12_4: I.R.I.S. confirmed they were the tags for the three members of an expedition team who went missing.
GLXXDDD_12_5: ...So these aren't just random serial numbers. This is a roll call.
GLXXDDD_12_6: Well then, I've got three theories. Tell me which one makes the most sense to you.
GLXXDDD_12_7: Theory One: System glitch. The order got rerouted wrong. Wherever it's trying to ping, we just haven't found it yet.
GLXXDDD_12_8: Theory Two: You said the order was named "Warming Memorial." Maybe the team scripted it as some kind of ritual. Every year, when the warming window opens, it triggers this thing. Like saying, "We're still here. Still not done."
GLXXDDD_12_9: Theory Three: Someone's manually pinging the system right now using an old ID. That means someone can still connect to it.
GLXXDDD_12_11: W-what's this "mm" supposed to mean? It's been a year... You really think they could still be alive?
GLXXDDD_12_12: If they are... then the voice under the ice and the strange song heard by students... What if it's them, waiting for the window to open again?
GLXXDDD_12_13: You're getting good at ghost stories.
GLXXDDD_12_15: But the song! If only students heard it, I could explain it as hallucinations... But those Outcasts hum it too. That means it wasn't just in their heads. It existed out there. Heard. Remembered. Passed on.
GLXXDDD_12_16: That means the lost team might still be in the same area.
GLXXDDD_12_17: Exactly. Glacier edge. Warming zone. Exposed blue sediment. That student who crashed? Not an accident. He hit "their line."
GLXXDDD_12_18: That means we can deduce where the team went afterwards.
GLXXDDD_12_19: A northerly deviation... they left the vehicle and headed that way. Following the exposed blue sediment from the warming zone... all the way to... a glacier?
GLXXDDD_12_21: Look at this line: "Last recorded: 365 days ago." One-year anniversary. Same season. Same window.
GLXXDDD_12_22: The module loops. The vehicle checks for conditions. The order pings the system. Like someone hitting "play" on the same moment over and over.
GLXXDDD_12_23: We could take this component back and have I.R.I.S. shut it down. That'll stop the order and put an end to the vehicle's detours. Case closed.
GLXXDDD_12_24: Or, while this 72-hour window is still open, what if we followed the direction the expedition took? Go see where they actually ended up.
GLXXDDD_12_25: It's not like we'll definitely find anything there. And whatever took them out could take us out too. But...
GLXXDDD_12_26: I want to be brave like Mayo. Actually DO something about the weird stuff I'm into. And I... I'm really curious.
GLXXDDD_12_27: But I'm also kinda scared. Okay, REALLY scared. So... it's your call, {PlayerName}. Do you want to go?

AYJJZS_18_3: All this time, the little ones have held back their own sadness. Our parting, they know it comes. Yet gifts they prepared for me. And I... I thought they chased only shiny things. Foolish I was. A terrible Shepherdess.
AYJJZS_18_4: Were you really planning to leave Lahai-Roi?
AYJJZS_18_5: Yes... I had thought about it. I... heard your name just now. If I am not mistaken, you are the Predicted One the Solsworns speak of.
AYJJZS_18_7: What is it you wanted to ask?
AYJJZS_18_8: I have a thought. One so highly regarded by the Solsworns must have played a great role in the final battle. Might I ask you something?
AYJJZS_18_9: I'll answer as best as I can.
AYJJZS_18_10: There was... a gardener. A garden she inherited. A talent for tending flowers she happened to have. At first, everything went well.
AYJJZS_18_11: Like any gardener, a garden she tended. Hoping to grow the most beautiful blooms. Then came the ancient, sacred rite. It was her duty to attend.
AYJJZS_18_12: Before the rite began, the most radiant flowers, those in full bloom, had to be picked. It was tradition, and a duty every gardener carried.
AYJJZS_18_13: But during that rite, a thought struck her. A faint voice whispered, "Look, the flowers you cultivated with your own hands will soon wither."
AYJJZS_18_14: After, everyone returned to their gardens. New seeds they planted for the next rite. But she... she could not stop thinking of the flowers destined to fade.
AYJJZS_18_15: One rite passed. Then another. The voices in her head grew. Some urged her to stay. Others to flee, flee the garden and the fate that would never change...
AYJJZS_18_16: The voices to stay grew weaker. Until silence. So she decided to run.
AYJJZS_18_17: But then, there was a turning point. Heroes came. The crisis was resolved, and the rite abolished. The future she feared and the reason she wanted to flee... both gone.
AYJJZS_18_18: So she wondered... could she stay? Stay and tend to the flowers not yet bloomed?
AYJJZS_18_19: I ask you this: In your eyes, Strong One, the one who once tried to abandon her garden... does she still have the right to stay?
AYJJZS_18_20: I think the flowers would say...
AYJJZS_18_22: She has always cared for her garden well. Of course she hasn't lost the right to be its keeper. But... can she hear her own voice clearly now? Does that voice still wish to stay?
AYJJZS_18_23: I don't know. Before I decide, more time I need... More voices I must hear. Thank you, Predicted One.

Side_XBDXD_15_10: Retrieving system... Unit code identified: XTA-9000.
Side_XBDXD_15_11: Thank you for your selfless assistance to this unit and XTA-8000. All core functions are now back online. Conflicting memory sectors have been isolated.
Side_XBDXD_15_12: Looks like you're back to normal.
Side_XBDXD_15_13: Correct. An A-level data conflict was detected. Most likely, an unknown source inserted the command "wait for Brandon" into this unit's logic pathways.
Side_XBDXD_15_14: Current analysis suggests "Brandon" refers to Researcher Brandon Deville.
Side_XBDXD_15_15: Spacetrek Collective records show that twelve years ago, he led a mech squad to Lahai-Roi on a data-gathering mission.
Side_XBDXD_15_16: That squad was caught in a Void Storm en route. Researcher Brandon survived under their protection.
Side_XBDXD_15_17: The incident was later archived as a successful emergency response case of sapient mechanical entities, and was later included in the crisis-response memorandum for the XTA-series TARD-E Units.
Side_XBDXD_15_18: This unit concludes that the unknown source exploited that incident as a point of access and embedded the abnormal command into our logic systems.
Side_XBDXD_15_19: So, let me get this straight. You read that Brandon guy's story, something messed with your circuits, and you started acting like you were his old mech pals?
Side_XBDXD_15_20: That is the hypothesis most aligned with all current evidence, and it is fully self-consistent.
Side_XBDXD_15_22: No need to worry. We will regroup with Researcher Lector in accordance with emergency protocol and await his instructions.

Side_XBDXD_17_4: Emergency measures initiated... Contaminated module discarded... to prevent wider corruption. Remaining power... insufficient.

Side_XBDXD_19_3: ...To be another scrap of metal lost in this mysterious place.
Side_XBDXD_19_5: Its frequency matched the anomalous signal that previously infiltrated my external power module.
Side_XBDXD_19_6: Conclusion: a reverberation driven by an intense craving for energy. It targets nearby machines with sufficiently high power output and seizes their energy.
Side_XBDXD_19_7: Fortunately, it is no longer a threat to me.
Side_XBDXD_19_8: I need to regroup with Researcher Lector. He should have a replacement power module.
Side_XBDXD_2_1: Oh no... where did they all go...
Side_XBDXD_2_3: Ah... thank goodness! Finally, a familiar face...
Side_XBDXD_2_4: ...Oh, s-sorry. I forgot you might not actually know me.
Side_XBDXD_2_5: Ahem... My name is Lector. I'm currently surveying this area.
Side_XBDXD_2_7: Uh... yes. Honestly, we know this isn't exactly the best time for a full-scale survey...
Side_XBDXD_2_8: According to the Collective's report, Aleph-1 shouldn't be returning to Solaris for the next few hundred years.
Side_XBDXD_2_9: That said, a massive amount of Voidmatter is still lingering here, along with a whole host of TDs.
Side_XBDXD_2_10: Even so, we need to record the frequencies left by Aleph-1 and the Exostrider before they fade, and figure out the current state of the residual Voidmatter.
Side_XBDXD_2_11: Residual Voidmatter? It shouldn't be dangerous anymore.
Side_XBDXD_2_12: Yes. Mr. Shaper from the Solisylum reached the same conclusion.
Side_XBDXD_2_13: Calculations suggest the remaining Voidmatter has an extremely low chance of causing another major disaster.
Side_XBDXD_2_14: Still, low odds don't mean impossible, right?
Side_XBDXD_2_15: Don't worry. We've come fully prepared for this survey. We even borrowed a few TARD-Es from the Academy and refitted them into powerful combat units!
Side_XBDXD_2_16: As long as they don't charge straight into the Voidmatter, they're perfectly... Hang on. The TARD-Es...
Side_XBDXD_2_17: Shoot! I got so caught up talking. I forgot all about them! {PlayerName}, they're gone!
Side_XBDXD_2_19: Maybe their comms just went down?
Side_XBDXD_2_20: I sent the TARD-Es to investigate four areas with abnormal Voidmatter readings, but I lost contact with them a little while ago.
Side_XBDXD_2_21: They must have been disrupted somehow, or run into some kind of unforeseen problem...
Side_XBDXD_2_22: You're the only one I can rely on now, {PlayerName}! Without their protection, I could never make it through those hazardous zones by myself.
Side_XBDXD_2_23: All right. I'll go bring them back.
Side_XBDXD_2_24: Thank you, {PlayerName}. This area is relatively safe... I'll just stay here and wait for good news.
Side_XBDXD_20_1: That should be the last of them.
Side_XBDXD_20_2: Yep. Let's head back to Lector. Hopefully the others made it to him okay too.
Side_XBDXD_21_1: Oh... Welcome back. {PlayerName}, Abby, thank you for all your hard work.
Side_XBDXD_21_2: The TARD-Es have all returned, and they seem to have collected some very interesting data...
Side_XBDXD_21_3: You mean the reverberations of machines?
Side_XBDXD_21_4: Yes... Until now, all we knew was that mechs consumed by a Void Storm could undergo certain changes, and that human consciousness might linger briefly as a reverberation in Voidmatter-rich areas.
Side_XBDXD_21_5: But we never expected this... that something like a mech's "consciousness" could also be preserved by Voidmatter.
Side_XBDXD_21_6: These mech reverberations often seem to be stuck on the final command they received... To be honest, I still find that hard to believe.
Side_XBDXD_21_7: Some ancient texts often discuss the nature of the soul. As I see it, a soul is a collection of memories, emotions, and frequencies.
Side_XBDXD_21_8: Memory is the substance, emotion is the bond, and frequency the manifestation.
Side_XBDXD_21_9: ...Mech consciousness has been a research topic in the Academy for many years. Sure, mechs appear highly intelligent, sometimes even convincingly human.
Side_XBDXD_21_10: And yet, few people believe they possess a true "soul." Because they lack emotion, perhaps? Or, because their memories are not hazy recollections like ours, but precise, cold data?
Side_XBDXD_21_11: ...Or perhaps it's nothing more than human vanity. Our habit of crowning ourselves as the only intelligent life.
Side_XBDXD_21_13: Seems obvious to me. Mechs have souls too.
Side_XBDXD_21_16: ...That's a bold theory. But you are not the only one who's thought so.
Side_XBDXD_21_17: Yes, that is the dominant view at Startorch Academy. Then again, the word "soul" is hardly a rigorous or scholarly term to begin with.
Side_XBDXD_21_18: Haha... yes. We still understand far too little about this world.
Side_XBDXD_21_19: Maybe what these TARD-Es went through will bring us closer to an answer... or maybe not.
Side_XBDXD_21_20: As the old saying goes, I am not a fish, so how could I know what a fish thinks... Sigh.
Side_XBDXD_21_21: Anyway, thank you again, {PlayerName}. I'll return to those anomalous sites later... Of course, only after fitting the mechs with better Voidmatter shielding.

Zuoyequnxing_162_4: She always hid in the Void Storms. I have no wish to harm her… So I did not find the right moment to intervene.

Zuoyequnxing_168_29: From Lahai-Roi to the distant lands of Jinzhou and Rinascita, people rise up to fight the Threnodians.

Zuoyequnxing_168_43:
After defeating Denia, you prepare to journey beyond the Stridergate. Hiyuki hesitates before you go, wondering aloud whether a savior should walk a solitary path. Leading others down this road, she believes, only invites misfortune—just as it did for Aemeath. But you tell her that you have no regrets, and have always been proud of the person Aemeath is. Because of her, you no longer feel alone on this path.
Your words remind Hiyuki of her own sister, Gyokuro. Something shifts in her expression, and she confides that she is a little "jealous" of you, then tells you she will wait here for your safe return.

Zuoyequnxing_182_2: Directive: I voyaged here to fulfill my mission. Life on this planet has the right to explore the vastness of the cosmos.
Zuoyequnxing_182_3: You see the civilizations across the stars only as food to quiet your hunger. You cannot comprehend the will that drives them.
Zuoyequnxing_182_5: Opinion: Even if humanity's final frontier is an endless void, it is not proof of a meaningless pursuit, Aleph-1.
Zuoyequnxing_184_1: Confirmation: Battle concluded. Voidmatter responses within this sector have dissipated.
Zuoyequnxing_184_3: Analysis: Resonator Aemeath. Under current parameters, the permanent termination of Aleph‑1 is impossible.
Zuoyequnxing_184_4: Therefore, I exercised autonomous judgment and exiled it to the furthest reaches of this universe.
Zuoyequnxing_184_5: Request: Arbiter, permission to remain. Before your final judgement, allow me to submit a log of my experience in Lahai-Roi.
Zuoyequnxing_184_7: Log Retrieval: On multiple return transits, I was detected by Aleph‑1. It pursued me, its objective to enter Solaris through the Stridergate.
Zuoyequnxing_184_8: It attacked. I fell... but Resonator Aemeath answered me with her power, and I was able to banish a part of Aleph-1.
Zuoyequnxing_184_9: I should have initiated a full system seal to await repairs. But I saw countless pairs of terrified eyes.
Zuoyequnxing_184_10: Discovery: The Roya in the frostlands stood helpless before the Threnodian's Voidmatter calamity.
Zuoyequnxing_184_11: I saw panic and dread. Following the protocol shared with the Sentinels, I extracted my Reactor Drive and encased it deep within the ice. Then I powered down to slumber.
Zuoyequnxing_184_12: Exception: A momentary reactivation occurred. Resonator Aemeath resonated with me a second time.
Zuoyequnxing_184_13: She required my power to mend the Stridergate rift. I complied.
Zuoyequnxing_184_14: That was when I became a digital ghost. But was that the "second time" we resonated... or the "first"?
Zuoyequnxing_184_15: Initial Assessment: Upon reactivation, standard procedure was to request your retreat. Direct engagement with Aleph-1 was a tactical irrationality.
Zuoyequnxing_184_16: But the "human heart" granted me a voice. The will of this civilization gave me the strength to stand with you.
Zuoyequnxing_184_17: Component Analysis: This Drive Replica forged by humans is crude and fragile compared to my original Drive.
Zuoyequnxing_184_18: I can feel each one of its pulse cycles. Violent, eroding itself with every beat.
Zuoyequnxing_184_19: The shrill, grating friction of wear...This is the first time I have ever heard "myself." A heartbeat bestowed upon me by "them."
Zuoyequnxing_184_20: With this heart installed, I have acquired capabilities previously undocumented outside the Sentinel mech series.
Zuoyequnxing_184_21: Projection: Given Threnodian Aleph-1's abilities, we must assume it retains the capacity to return.
Zuoyequnxing_184_22: Once the Stridergate is fully sealed, I will remain on this side as its guardian. I will bar its re-entry into Solaris.
Zuoyequnxing_184_23: Request: Arbiter. I was born from humanity's hope. Please permit me to remain here and protect them until this heart ceases to beat.
Zuoyequnxing_184_25: Query: Resonator Aemeath. Are you willing to accept a portion of my power?

Zuoyequnxing_184_27: Your current state is a consequence for which I bear responsibility. While I slumbered, you safeguarded Lahai-Roi in my stead.
Zuoyequnxing_184_28: Now, the death that once drew near has been severed. Henceforth, your companion will be an enduring "life."

Zuoyequnxing_184_40: Its hull was marked with Solaris script. Its launch date is estimated to have occurred a long time ago.

Zuoyequnxing_184_42: Objective: I wish to offer this recording as a gift to the people of Lahai-Roi.
Zuoyequnxing_184_43: Status: Stridergate closure imminent. Preparing to return the Arbiter and Resonator to Lahai-Roi.

Zuoyequnxing_184_48: Objective: I wish to always be reminded of my heart's origin.
Zuoyequnxing_184_50: Designation change complete. Thank you, Arbiter.
Zuoyequnxing_184_51: Valediction: Farewell, Arbiter. Please deliver my temporary goodbye to the people who forged this heart.
Zuoyequnxing_184_52: Prediction—We will meet again in the boundless sea of stars.
Zuoyequnxing_184_53: Until we will meet again, in the boundless sea of stars.
Zuoyequnxing_184_54: Once the Drive Replica is embedded within the Exostrider, it completes its ascension and becomes a Sentinel. You and Aemeath pilot it together to defeat the mech forged by Aleph-1. But the victory is not permanent. The Exostrider warns that banishing Aleph-1 to the depths of the universe is only a temporary measure. It still retains the capacity to return one day. Because of this, the Exostrider chooses to bestow a portion of its power to Aemeath and elects to remain on the other side of the Stridergate, guarding the civilization that gave it a heart until the very end. Before you part, the Exostrider requests your permission to change its designation to bear a new name: "Lahai-Roi." It then leaves a gift for the people of Lahai-Roi inside your Cassette.

Zuoyequnxing_50_19: After that, he left the government and started diving into multiple large-scale investment projects. Some say he's still been Ashridge Energy's man the whole time, but no one's been able to prove it.
Zuoyequnxing_50_20: He's sharp, low-profile, and very smooth. At his age, he's seen it all. His only real concern is if the Exostrider's pilot can be controlled.
Zuoyequnxing_50_21: Normally, they'd pick Academy Synchronists who've been signing stacks of NDAs since day one. But—
Zuoyequnxing_50_22: Sounds like his attitude changed? Does that have something to do with the "changes" you mentioned?
Zuoyequnxing_50_23: Come in. Let's talk over some hot drinks.
Zuoyequnxing_50_24:
You enter Luuk Herssen's workspace to discuss piloting the Exostrider. Luuk tells you that the Academy's procedures have already been handled by him and Lucilla, but you still need to win over the board of investors from the New Federation.
The Head of the Spacetrek Collective, Chase, has recently returned to Lahai-Roi from the New Federation.
Zuoyequnxing_51_1: I heard Lucilla asked for your help after the ceremony. How did it feel working with her?
Zuoyequnxing_51_2: Well, at first she was pretty dominant, steering the conversation the whole time…
Zuoyequnxing_51_3: But now I understand it's because this Academy means so much to her.
Zuoyequnxing_52_1: Based on your intel, the Reactor Core has been returned. Ideally, we'd wait for the Exostrider to awaken before trying to help Aemeath or confront the Threnodian.
Zuoyequnxing_52_2: But, recent readings from the Institute's Stridergate monitors... they're off the charts.
Zuoyequnxing_52_3: Voidmatter reactivity is spiking. The Spacetrek Collective is getting twitchy. If Threnodian Aleph-1 breaks the seal, all of Solaris will be at risk, not just Lahai-Roi.
Zuoyequnxing_52_4: Now, the Collective didn't establish itself here without binders full of contingencies for a Threnodian event.
Zuoyequnxing_52_5: Problem is, every one of those plans would scorch decades of scientific progress.
Zuoyequnxing_52_6: Which, in our case, actually gives us some leverage. Enough to have a real conversation with their head.
Zuoyequnxing_52_7: ... Then I'll convince him. I'll show him the lowest casualty count is the only one that makes sense. He'll have to approve me as the Synchronist who pilots the Exostrider.
Zuoyequnxing_52_8: Luuk, you mentioned you have contacts in the Black Shores. And this workspace of yours... It's secure, right?
Zuoyequnxing_52_10: Lahai-Roi is closed off from the outside world. Public comms are probably tapped by Fractsidus moles inside the Academy. And right now... I need a direct line to the Black Shores.
Zuoyequnxing_52_11: I see. Give me a moment. I'll establish the link and leave the rest to you.
Zuoyequnxing_52_13: ...Is the situation in Lahai-Roi that dire? You look exhausted.
Zuoyequnxing_52_15: I'm alright. Just a little tired.
Zuoyequnxing_52_16: My frequency loss has been resolved. But Lahai-Roi is under imminent Threnodian threat. I need your help, Shorekeeper.
Zuoyequnxing_52_17: Understood. For this purpose… both I, and the Black Shores, exist.
Zuoyequnxing_52_18: Any additional intel on the Exostrider within the Tethys System? Verified or not, I need everything you have.
Zuoyequnxing_52_19: I trust Luuk. You can speak freely.
Zuoyequnxing_52_20: Records confirm that Luuk Herssen has been providing critical assistance and intelligence to the Black Shores. I trust your judgment.
Zuoyequnxing_52_21: After the founding of Startorch Academy, most information fell under their seal of secrecy. However, in its early days, you mediated negotiations between the Academy and the Roya. Through that process, the Black Shores gained partial access to certain archived insights.
Zuoyequnxing_52_22: The Spacetrek Collective fears that due to the Exoswarm's division, the Exostrider, even upon awakening, might not have enough power to face the Threnodian. This concern led to the Augmented Resonance initiative—the Synchronists.
Zuoyequnxing_52_23: Observing how Sentinels work with their Resonators, they theorized that the Exostrider, sharing similarities, could amplify its power through a Resonator as well.
Zuoyequnxing_52_24: However, considering your link with the Exostrider, the Tethys System does not recommend this method.
Zuoyequnxing_52_25: We have intel that deep beneath Lahai-Roi lies the <te href=851076>Keystone</te> left behind by the Exostrider long ago.
Zuoyequnxing_52_26: It rests directly atop the seal on the <te href=851077>Stridergate</te>. You can think of it as a kind of lock.
Zuoyequnxing_52_27: You do not need a cockpit to pilot the Exostrider. So long as its activation sequence remains unobstructed, you may pilot it using the Keystone.
Zuoyequnxing_52_29: Precisely. For one who shares its origin, a cockpit would be more of a hindrance.
Zuoyequnxing_52_30: As for Aemeath... I think Dr. Luuk's proposal is viable.
Zuoyequnxing_52_31: You mean using the Exoswarm-like "shell" that appeared in the cockpit to look for her?
Zuoyequnxing_52_32: Yes. The connection between frequencies will help. {PlayerName},  bring "her" with you when you activate the Exostrider.
Zuoyequnxing_52_33: Sure. While I'm there, the Black Shores will need to keep a closer eye on Lahai-Roi.
Zuoyequnxing_52_36: As long as I may be of help to you, I am… content.
Zuoyequnxing_52_37: Please return safely from the Stridergate, {PlayerName}.
Zuoyequnxing_52_39: I'll inform Lucilla. Take your time finishing that drink before you head out.
Zuoyequnxing_52_40: What do you think? I'm about to ask a man to sign off on a crazy plan, and I can't even promise him it'll work.
Zuoyequnxing_52_41: Nobody has a plan they promise will work. If Chase agrees, it's because he's betting that you're his best option. Just take the win.
Zuoyequnxing_52_42: At the end of the day, it all comes down to the person, {PlayerName}.
Zuoyequnxing_52_43:
Luuk tells you about unusual Voidmatter activity near the Stridergate, an opportunity that can be used to persuade the Spacetrek Collective of the necessity of your plan. To make preparations, you contact Shorekeeper from Luuk's private workspace, who, with the help of the Tethys System, informs you that you can pilot the Exostrider by activating the underground "Keystone."
Shorekeeper also notes that Aemeath's "shell" likely connects to her frequency beyond Stridergate. She suggests that you bring "Aemeath" with you when you go.
Zuoyequnxing_53_1: I believe Dr. Luuk has already briefed you about the meeting with the Spacetrek Collective's head.
Zuoyequnxing_53_2: Come to Academic Affairs. He's waiting for you there.
Zuoyequnxing_54_1: Mr. Chase. This is the student I mentioned, {PlayerName}. Our best hope for piloting the Exostrider.
Zuoyequnxing_54_2: Save the intro, President Lucilla. We've met before.
Zuoyequnxing_54_3: (Before…? In my past life at the Academy?)
Zuoyequnxing_54_4: Let's just get down to it. The Threnodian Aleph-1 situation is deteriorating. We're running out of time.
Zuoyequnxing_54_5: I wanted to wait for the Exostrider's self-regeneration to finish, but the clock has run out on that one.
Zuoyequnxing_54_6: So tell me, {PlayerName}. Why do you want to pilot the Exostrider? What's the play?
Zuoyequnxing_54_7: To find Aemeath and put down the Threnodian.
Zuoyequnxing_54_8: Aemeath… Name rings a bell. The one with the high-sync rate. Her disappearance was a real loss for us.
Zuoyequnxing_54_11: But finding one person in a goddamn interdimensional haystack? Not so easy. You understand our position... the Threnodian is our priority.
Zuoyequnxing_54_12: Stopping the Threnodian is my priority too. I'm gonna handle both.
Zuoyequnxing_54_13: Look, we have the same objective, so like you said let's "just get down to it." If Voidmatter erupts, Lahai-Roi is ground zero. Every one of your projects will take a hit.
Zuoyequnxing_54_14: Regarding Aleph-1, our intel is insufficient. We are not, at this time, considering its total destruction.
Zuoyequnxing_54_15: What we need is for the Exostrider to reinforce the seal on the Stridergate.
Zuoyequnxing_54_16: To do that, we need a qualified Synchronist. And we need the Institute's Drive Replica. When that gets embedded in the Exostrider's chest cavity, then its repair is complete.
Zuoyequnxing_54_17: Right now, the Replica is in its final phase of development. We're still missing critical data.
Zuoyequnxing_54_18: A Drive Replica... Is that what you're building from the fallen Reactor Drive after Helios was launched?
Zuoyequnxing_54_19: Heh, correct. It's based on the original Drive's framework. You had a hand to play in that. You made sure Helios got launched.
Zuoyequnxing_54_20: To complete the Drive Replica, we require precise data from the Exostrider operating in high concentrations of Voidmatter, and environmental readings from inside the Threnodian.
Zuoyequnxing_54_21: Without them, we can't guarantee the Exostrider can resist Aleph-1's corruption.
Zuoyequnxing_54_22: Here's the verdict, {PlayerName}. On behalf of the Spacetrek Collective, I authorize you to pilot the Exostrider.
Zuoyequnxing_54_23: But remember, our objective is the data. We need readings from the high-concentration zone to complete the Replica.
Zuoyequnxing_54_24: And your personal mission gets ten minutes. That's the max duration our Voidmatter Barriers can cover the Stridergate once it's opened.
Zuoyequnxing_54_25: After ten minutes, you return to Lahai-Roi. Whether you found Aemeath or not. Do you accept?
Zuoyequnxing_54_26: Deal. One more thing. I won't be using a cockpit. Just show me the way to the Keystone and have the Exostrider ready. That's all I need.
Zuoyequnxing_54_27: Heh. Still full of surprises. Always bringing us the... unconventional.
Zuoyequnxing_54_28: Lucilla, run a high-pressure sync test for {PlayerName}. I've seen the physical eval, but I want live data for validation.
Zuoyequnxing_54_29: The moment the numbers hit green, we'll begin preparations for activating the Keystone and deploy Voidmatter Barriers around the Stridergate.
Zuoyequnxing_54_30: There's something else. I need a favor.
Zuoyequnxing_54_32: The Fractsidus is lying low. Even after failing in the Dark Side, they could move the moment the Stridergate opens.
Zuoyequnxing_54_33: Ah. That's what's on your mind. Well, I have an update. Remember Sigrika's friend? The… somewhat lackadaisical one?
Zuoyequnxing_54_35: That's the one. She's gone missing. Our investigation points to her being the agent the Grand Architect referred to.
Zuoyequnxing_54_36: But don't let it distract you. I have a reliable friend keeping an eye on Fractsidus activity.
Zuoyequnxing_54_37: You just focus on waking the giant. Leave the rest to us, {PlayerName}.
Zuoyequnxing_54_38: The Black Shores just sent a formal communication request. They're offering full support for Lahai-Roi's evacuation, if it comes to that.
Zuoyequnxing_54_39: You handle it, Lucilla. You have a better read on the situation than I do. And you're better at talking with that {PlayerName}.
Zuoyequnxing_54_40: Heh... If there's anything else you want to ask me, now's the time.
Zuoyequnxing_54_41: I'm surprised you're placing this much trust in {PlayerName}, authorizing {Male=him;Female=her} so readily. Any particular reason?
Zuoyequnxing_54_42: We're different, President. I'm a businessman. And businessmen trust their instincts for a good investment.
Zuoyequnxing_54_43: The Threnodian could strike at any time. Given the circumstances, Lahai-Roi may have to be written off.
Zuoyequnxing_54_44: And with the timeline we have, relocating the Exostrider is impossible. If we're going to lose it anyway, why not let {PlayerName} take one last swing?
Zuoyequnxing_54_45: Understood. We still need to prepare for the worst-case scenario.
Zuoyequnxing_54_46: Of course. If this fails, we'll initiate the backup plan—Duskveil.
Zuoyequnxing_54_47:
Lucilla introduces you to Chase. The shrewd old man states plainly that he is more concerned with the Drive Replica's development, and hopes it will give the Exostrider the capability to reinforce the seal on the Stridergate. If you pass the Synchronist Test, he agrees to let you pilot the Exostrider. But you are only given ten minutes to achieve your personal goal of finding Aemeath.
After you leave, Chase remarks to Lucilla that the Black Shores already submitted an offer for assistance. The decision to trust you was based on a businessman's eye for opportunity. But if you fail, the Spacetrek Collective will abandon the Exostrider and initiate "Duskveil."

Zuoyequnxing_21028_6: Besides, {PlayerName} does seem to have a taste for chasing after the kind of trouble people write songs about.

Zuoyequnxing_21030_4: No kidding. She's already on her second set of tires!

Zuoyequnxing_21031_2: We can, but that kind of load could overwhelm it.
Zuoyequnxing_21031_4: "She" is everyone's fellow classmate here at Startorch Academy.

Zuoyequnxing_21032_4: Some of the others came back hurt. I figured... if I could do a little more, maybe they'd face less danger.
Zuoyequnxing_21032_6: Oh, please. You don't get to lecture me. You're in charge of the most dangerous zone, remember?
Zuoyequnxing_21032_7: Anyway, I'm counting on you to keep this secret from the teachers. Kay {PlayerName}?

Zuoyequnxing_21033_4: Keeping pace with you, at least.
Zuoyequnxing_21033_5: Heh, sounds like we're both making good progress. I'm done here too. Next stop is the final location.
Zuoyequnxing_21033_6: After we gather all the runes... you're heading back beyond the Stridergate, right?
Zuoyequnxing_21033_7: When I think about that, doing all this feels weird...
Zuoyequnxing_21033_8: I know what I'm signing up for.
Zuoyequnxing_21033_9: Knowing isn't nearly enough. You gotta sign up with the intention to come back!
Zuoyequnxing_21033_10: Don't let this be our last meeting.
Zuoyequnxing_21034_1: Upload complete. We can move to the next location.
Zuoyequnxing_21034_4: I was nearby anyway, so I came by to check on you.
Zuoyequnxing_21034_5: My side is progressing well too. President Lucilla's Void Storm reports came at the right moment.
Zuoyequnxing_21034_6: Mm... I'm alright. You're the one who needs to be careful from here on.
Zuoyequnxing_21034_7: Some things... really have changed. Back then, whenever a Void Storm hit, all we could do was run.
Zuoyequnxing_21034_8: You mean what happened in Honami?
Zuoyequnxing_21034_9: Yes. But now we can forecast them, and our defense systems last much longer.
Zuoyequnxing_21034_10: So we won't lose this time. Right?
Zuoyequnxing_21035_1: I should probably head back soon...
Zuoyequnxing_21035_3: There's still something left for me to do.
Zuoyequnxing_21035_6: They need all the hands they can get at the Academy right now.
Zuoyequnxing_21035_8: {PlayerName}, about you going back into Voidspace...
Zuoyequnxing_21035_9: Some things have to be done.
Zuoyequnxing_21035_10: I know... I really do. But still...
Zuoyequnxing_21035_11: Chisa... when summer comes, let's go back to that cafe in Honami together. We can visit Namipon. It asked us to come back and tell it about the Academy, remember?
Zuoyequnxing_21052_1: There was a shortcut here the whole time? You just saved us!
Zuoyequnxing_21052_2: It's nothing. I only remembered there might be a path leading this way.
Zuoyequnxing_21052_3: You're too modest. You know the entire plains like the back of your hand. Do you get sent out on fieldwork a lot?
Zuoyequnxing_21052_4: Not quite. It's more like I've spent a lot of time watching everyone else build these roads...
Zuoyequnxing_21052_5: Huh? Well, either way, we've made up time. That should be a rune over there. Let's go!
Zuoyequnxing_211_1: Mm... Understood. Royan rune collection is proceeding as planned.
Zuoyequnxing_211_2: According to the mission brief, we can head back once we're done here.
Zuoyequnxing_212_1: Voidmatter concentrations are increasing. We can't stay here for long.
Zuoyequnxing_212_2: Okay, according to the markers, the location should be nearby...
Zuoyequnxing_213_1: Not sure if we can make it this time. If we do, then I'll—
Zuoyequnxing_213_2: Uh-uh, not this again. You'd have quit a long time ago if you actually meant it. Just hurry up and get the work done.
Zuoyequnxing_214_1: You had no business coming out of the shelter. You should've stayed there and waited for evacuation!
Zuoyequnxing_214_2: Professor, if playing it safe was all I wanted out of life, I never would've come to Lahai-Roi.
Zuoyequnxing_215_1: We're running out of time. Let's finish our part and see if anyone else needs help.
Zuoyequnxing_215_2: Mm. Honestly, we shouldn't have asked the students to take this risk with us...
Zuoyequnxing_215_3: Don't worry about them. They work much faster than we do.
Zuoyequnxing_216_1: Lucilla sent a single student to Bjartr Woods?! Has she lost her mind?
Zuoyequnxing_216_2: Voidmatter concentrations there are too high for us to handle. Even if we go now, we would just be dead weight. Have some faith in that student.
Zuoyequnxing_217_1: Where is that miko? Is she still down there?
Zuoyequnxing_217_2: Yeah. Otherwise, we would have been swarmed by those monsters by now.
Zuoyequnxing_218_1: Wait, what happened to your leg?
Zuoyequnxing_218_2: Sprained. Nothing serious. Did you send the rune data back?
Zuoyequnxing_218_4: If anything happens to me, bring my Cassette back. The password to my safe is my work ID.
Zuoyequnxing_218_5: Cut the crap. We're going back! Together!
Zuoyequnxing_219_1: Well? Any sign of the runes?
Zuoyequnxing_219_2: Hold on. One more sweep... it should be somewhere close by.
Zuoyequnxing_220_1: Didn't expect these nonsensical runes to be this much help.
Zuoyequnxing_220_2: It's all thanks to that Roya girl.
Zuoyequnxing_220_3: Have you ever thought about... the future of Lahai-Roi?
Zuoyequnxing_220_4: Just do what we can for now. One step at a time. That way, we won't have any regrets when we're back in the shelter.
Zuoyequnxing_221_1: Easy there. It's likely just exhaustion. I'll get you both back to the Institute as soon as I can.
Zuoyequnxing_221_3: Stay still. We've done our part. N.A.N.A. will get us back.
Zuoyequnxing_221_5: Hey! Don't go quiet on me! Okay, forget staying still. Wake up! Wake up, damn it!
Zuoyequnxing_222_1: S.I.G.M.A., send the report to command. I'm counting on you.
Zuoyequnxing_222_2: Understood. Scanning area information... Comparison complete... Integrating data.
Zuoyequnxing_222_3: Didn't think the Voidmatter would leak up from underground. There's no one down there, right?
Zuoyequnxing_222_4: No idea. Command says the lower levels aren't our problem. Guess that miko's stuck dealing with it by herself again...
Zuoyequnxing_223_1: Allocating full processing power to conduct a unified screening of all historical data regarding the Spacetrek Collective and Startorch Academy.
Zuoyequnxing_223_2: Please vacate the current area and prepare for immediate evacuation.
Zuoyequnxing_223_3: And don't worry about me. I.R.I.S. has your back. Always have, always will.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_1_1: Hi {PlayerName}. This is Arman from the Spacetrek Collective. Can you come by now?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_1_2: Denia is awake and being kept in isolation at the infirmary. We'd like to work with you on her case.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_10_1: {PlayerName}, the approvals are through. Everything is set. You can pick up Denia at the station.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_1: You're here, {PlayerName}. The procedure and contact list have been sent to your Terminal. All steps and contingency measures are included.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_2: Very detailed. I see a Resonance suppression device and declared contact entries. Everyone's agreed on those?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_3: Yes. At Denia's request, we used her Terminal to schedule the meetings under a recovery discharge notice. She'll be approaching them today as a student.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_4: The suppression device was... her idea, a guarantee of cooperation. She said it would make things fair, even though she doesn't really need it in her current state.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_5: Here, take this. If she starts feeling unwell, have her use it. It should make her feel better.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_6: So you've found a way to relieve her frequency failure?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_7: No... these are only tranquillizers. We've adjusted the dosage for this operation. As for a treatment plan... we'll try and work out a revised version as soon as possible.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_8: (No wonder Denia behaved that way last time. She had already seen this coming.)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_10: The diagnosis from Rabelle College shows that the problem doesn't lie with her Resonance ability, but a failure in her self-regulation mechanism...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_11: We're still validating several hypotheses regarding the symptoms. Hopefully, we'll have answers soon.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_12: (This is looking grimmer than I thought. Still, if it's related to Threnodian frequencies, the Black Shores might have better solutions.)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_13: Don't concern yourself with the research. For now, we'll need you to focus on today's operation. Please contact us if anything arises.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_15: Yes. Hope you both have a pleasant day.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_16: So, I'll be in your hands today, {PlayerName}.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_17: You promised me a birthday, remember? Why the serious face?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_18: I have to keep the operation under control.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_19: ...You didn't sound like this last time.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_20: Even so, you can't walk around with that face. People will notice something's off.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_21: Because today, I'm Denia, a proud student of Startorch Academy.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_22: Come on... Try it like me. Loosen your mouth, relax your eyes...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_23: I can do that. But remember your situation, don't—
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_25:
Today is Denia's birthday. You head to the station to meet her.
At the station, Arman gives you the day's schedule. The Spacetrek Collective has made thorough preparations to minimize any risks during Denia's time outside.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_11_26: There. See? You look nicer when you smile.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_120_1: Ever since Void Storms vanished for good, this room has rarely been used.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_120_2: ...From the bedside, the dorms and residential zone stretch out in plain view. Out there, the Academy is still as loud and full of life as ever.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_129_1: The infirmary is closed at night.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_13_1: Yawn... Finally, they let me out for a walk.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_13_2: Feels kind of nice being a student, doesn't it, {PlayerName}?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_13_3: Hmm, funny, you'd think there'd be more people here on a weekend.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_13_4: Don't tell me they heard I was coming and decided to hide?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_13_6: So that's a yes, then? You could at least say something nice.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_13_7: Campus security is still our responsibility.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_14_1: This way leads to the Garden Zone, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_14_2: Yes. This is where you're supposed to meet Sigrika.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_14_4: When was the last time we went shopping together...?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_15_1: If the elevator breaks, do we get stuck here?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_1: Hey, {PlayerName}, uh... Want to swing by the Arcade first?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_2: Are you trying to avoid Sigrika?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_4: This is your own request. Give me a reason to cancel it.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_5: The reason is... I-I'm not feeling so great. Maybe we should just—
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_8: Wow, hi, Siggy. Did I keep you waiting?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_9: No, I just got here too... Hmm? Why are you with Denia today, Senior?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_10: The doctor asked me to keep her company.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_11: She wanted to go for a walk with me.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_12: Oh, I see. I heard Denia's been in the ward for quite a few days.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_14: I didn't realize you were that close... But... but that's nice. At least Denia finally gets some fresh air.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_15: Every time I went to the infirmary, Dr. Luuk said you still needed some rest... So, are you feeling better now?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_16: Oh, I was better a while ago... Yawn... Guess it's just bad sleep. I mean, a ward's never as comfy as your own room.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_17: Bad sleep... Have you been having nightmares again? I heard what happened last time really affected a lot of people...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_18: You don't think it's because of the Voidmatter contamination, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_19: Of course not... I just pretended to be sick for a bit longer so I don't have to get back to class so soon.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_20: Relax. Having {PlayerName} watch over me is plenty. Come on, Siggy, didn't you want to go photograph the white bird in the garden? It'll be off duty if you don't hurry...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_21: Okay then... Make sure you catch up with us later on, Senior.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_22: Did you know, Nia? The Photography Fan Club is planning to apply for a studio!
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_23: They have budget for that? Was it the prize they won from the campus event?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_16_24: Yeah. They won't stop talking about how much they owe you.

According to the schedule, you will meet up with Sigrika.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_160_1: Senior, do you remember Denia? You met her at the New Solar Celebration. She was the one who got us those tickets.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_160_2: She's been in the infirmary since the last incident. They're saying she's still not in any condition to take visitors.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_160_3: If it's not too much trouble, could you check on her for me? I've been asking N.A.N.A. for updates, but she tells me the same thing every time... I'm worried.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_166_1: A thick volume compiled from a dazzling array of student society publications. Pages have been whimsically torn out and rebound. Now it looks more like a yearbook than a club magazine.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_166_2: It captures a segment of life from the past two years shared by those within its pages: vibrant souls who converged from different worlds, each pursuing their own paths.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_166_3: No one knew where this train was headed. But the owner of this book chose to jump off early—that much is clear.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_166_4: If asked why, she'd probably say:
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_166_5: "I'll be waiting for you at the end of the line."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_17_1: You're yawning more than usual today. Are you sure it's not some kind of aftereffect?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_17_2: No way. I've just been inside too long. Got a little sensitive to sunlight...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_17_3: No, no, no. You can't stay shut in all the time. A little sunlight is good for you.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_18_1: Hello. Can I help you with something?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_18_2: (This guy's acting strange. I don't remember him on the contact list.)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_18_3: Please don't mind me. Denia is the one who needs your attention.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_19_1: Shh, don't look this way, {PlayerName}. We have to pretend we don't know each other.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_2_1: So, Denia... You think she's alright?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_2_2: (Denia... The Fractsidus made no move while she was unconscious. Have they really abandoned what they worked so hard to achieve? Or are they biding their time for something else?)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_1: Look, the Photography Fan Club's here. Wanna go say hi?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_2: I'll pass... a bunch of camera-obsessed weirdos. Their prize money has nothing to do with me anyway.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_3: What are you talking about? Without you, they would've shut down by now.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_5: It was for an academy promo thing... The theme was "Startorch: Moments of Happiness." Why?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_8: I was the model, actually. Someone came to me and said they'd buy me a luxury buffet if I agreed to pose for a couple of photos while eating... For a moment, I genuinely believed they were being generous.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_9: I even skipped a meal on purpose. Turned out their "luxury buffet" was the cafeteria.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_10: But the photos came out beautifully. They even made it to the F.U.E.L.'s "A Seal-Proof Guide to Enrollment."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_11: It's just marketing for freshmen. You smile no matter what you're eating. That's what being a model feels like, I suppose... Besides, you know I never really liked taking photos.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_12: Yeah, you're right. The only time we took a group photo was when Nivora insisted.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_13: Sigh... Speaking of Nivora, I wonder how she's doing now.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_17: Really? That's a first for you!
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_18: Come on, {PlayerName}, you too. And... can I borrow your camera?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_19: So this is what it's about?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_22: I'll save the photo on {PlayerName}'s Terminal for now. We can print it someday.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_20_23: Look, in the photo! It's the white bird... It flew that way!

You learn from Sigrika and Denia about small moments from their shared past.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_21_2: I heard there's a special arrangement. A lot of people weren't allowed over here this afternoon...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_21_3: Hold on... Did I just see a pink-haired girl?

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_22_4: That's good news. So she's been discharged already.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_22_5: Oh, sorry, my bad. We must have been mistaken.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_22_8: And honestly, things just don't feel the same without her.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_23_1: An unidentified rare species... the fabled pure white bird.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_23_2: It's been a year since we first saw it, and we still haven't gotten a close look.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_23_3: Heh... calm down. For all we know, it could just be someone's Resonance ability...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_23_4: As if. You and your dry humor, Nia.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_241_1: Is Sigrika running faster than me?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_241_2: I'd like to be able to do that too...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_25_1: I'm pretty sure it flew this way... where did it go?

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_25_3: Okay! Ping me on the Terminal if you find anything!
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_26_1: Could you come this way for a while, {PlayerName}...?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_1: Hey... can you imagine her face if we told her the white bird is just Hiyuki's ability?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_3: I don't think it'd be a big deal.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_6: Will she be watching us like this the whole time today?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_7: Hiyuki is just doing her job. And she's kinder than she looks.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_8: I know... She sometimes reminds me of you.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_9: But unfortunately, that's my least favorite kind of person.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_11: What... Are you saying you care about my opinion, {PlayerName}?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_12: Sorry. Being straightforward doesn't do it for me.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_14: Okay, okay. I'll stop... I wonder how Sigrika's getting on. Let's go find her.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_28_1: She headed this way, right? Where did she go?

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_3_1: Impossible. We will not agree to that condition...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_3_2: Please relay this message, Madam President. I'll take full responsibility.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_30_1: You can't find it, either? Maybe not today then.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_30_2: Seriously, Siggy. If you went into biology, you'd be a legend by now...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_30_3: Hehe, I just want to confirm a new species before I graduate.
