Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_5: ..."Do find your way home more often"?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_9: You are... literally my least favorite type of person.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_10: Now, can you tell me why you loathe me?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_12: {PlayerName}, we've detected a severe frequency fluctuation! Is everything all right?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_13: Everything's fine. We'll be back soon.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_14: Very well... I'll see you soon.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_15: Sounds like Professor Arman is getting a bit impatient. We should head back.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_17: Ahuhuh... No need to get ahead of yourself now, {PlayerName}. You're not quite there yet. I'm keeping it secret for now.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_18: Plus, we still haven't fulfilled our agreement yet. Can't let the cake go to waste.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_19: Would you want to come out with me again after tomorrow, {PlayerName}?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_22: Hmm... Well, that makes things trickier. I... still have things I have to do, after all.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_23: ...If only today could be a bit longer.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_24: Is that so? Then I'm relieved... I still have things I have to do, after all.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_25: However, did it ever cross your mind, {PlayerName}, that my being alive and staying here might be an even bigger problem?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_26: ...If you feel you don't belong here, then some day in the future, would you be willing to—
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_27: Stop right there—it was just a joke. I don't want to put you in a tough spot.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_28: Easy. Today is my birthday. I won't be going anywhere.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_29: At least to you... this will be my last lie.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_47_30:
At last, Denia confesses the secret of the Grand Architect's "gift."
Following her instructions, you destroy the thing that has bound her all along—a page infused with the power of the Threnodian Leviathan. 
For now, Denia's immediate danger seems to have passed. You talk about the future as you make your way back toward the Academy.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_1: N.A.N.A. is conducting a thorough checkup on Denia. I imagine this must have been a very long day for you, {PlayerName}.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_2: Her conditions have greatly improved since this morning. As for the frequency fluctuation earlier... Did something happen?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_4: You tell Arman about the book page left by the Grand Architect.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_5: Residual energy of the Threnodian from Rinascita? Could there be some form of interaction between the Threnodians? Is the Fractsidus actually manipulating her and suppressing her abilities through such means?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_6: It's no wonder we couldn't find the source of the symptoms. Fortunately, you were here to assist, {PlayerName}.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_7: What will happen to Denia after tomorrow?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_8: ...It'll be the same as the past few days. Although she won't be sent to the New Federation, she'll still be kept under containment and assist with our research.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_9: I know what you're thinking, {PlayerName}... I've been monitoring your itinerary and field reports all day.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_10: But even if everyone recognizes her as a victim, the Spacetrek Collective's work and responsibilities will not change for her.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_11: We don't have better solutions now. This is the fact.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_13: We haven't had a chance to get it yet. It's still with Zahira. You can only get that specific Fruit Crackle she requested from Zahira...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_48_14: But since she hopes you can accompany her on her birthday, I believe you should be the one to personally bring her the cake... We'll be waiting for you here.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_1: Back when I taught at the Academy, there was a student who would always sleep in my lectures.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_2: I would wake her up to answer questions on purpose, because she had no idea what she was wasting.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_3: Later, a TA named Nastasha asked me to go easy on her, saying she could only sleep in a place where she felt secure, and that her grades in my class were still doing well.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_4: ...I knew that girl had helped collect data for many people in the Department of Voidmatters, but the issue was that I couldn't understand her behavior at all.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_5: While everyone else was out pursuing their scientific dreams, how can you be here sleeping? Is your dream to be a research assistant for the rest of your life?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_6: It was after the Threnodian incident that I finally knew the answer.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_7: To be honest, when I just sent you the message, for a moment I even fantasized a reply in which you plan to take her far away from Lahai-Roi... to somewhere no one could find.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_49_8: Haha... I'm glad you didn't do that, {PlayerName}, or else we'd all be done for.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_1: Anything else you want to confirm, {PlayerName}?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_2: Any progress on tracking the Threnodian frequency?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_3: How was Denia acting when she spoke with you?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_4: That call earlier, was it Lucilla?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_6: We've narrowed down the location, but Voidmatter contamination there is heavy, so cleanup and investigation will be slow. That said, recent spectral analysis points to a direct correlation between the frequency and Denia's physical condition.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_7: "Cold" is the word. So cold that even N.A.N.A. can't establish any meaningful contact. We are still not sure if the Threnodian did this, but she is not the Denia we knew.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_9: I have. Back then, I was teaching a required course in Voidmatters Science, and she slept through a good portion of it, so I remember her.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_10: Yes. The President is busy smoothing things over with some big names. She asked me to send her regards.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_11: Oh, and she also has a message for you: "Only the kids who make it out alive get to grow up."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_12: Is that supposed to be about Denia?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_5_13: I honestly don't know. But that's her... always leaving you guessing.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_1: Are you here to pick up the birthday cake? One moment please...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_2: (Denia... She said she had to take care of something. But what, exactly? Does it have something to do with the Threnodian's frequency in the Dimmr Plains?)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_3: (If the Spacetrek Collective finding Denia was part of the Grand Architect's plan, then what about removing that page from her? Or maybe...)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_5: "Easy. Today is my birthday. I won't be going anywhere."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_6: You see the time shown by the Terminal: 00:15 a.m.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_8: Here it is... I know it's a bit late, but I believe it's more than enough to convey your heart.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_9: {PlayerName}, Denia has left the Academy and is heading towards the Dimmr Plains.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_11: With her Forte. We've detected residual Voidmatter particles at the platform. Professor Arman was trapped inside a bubble. Luckily, no broken bones.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_12: She hasn't removed her Resonance suppression device and tracker yet. Should we initiate the emergency protocol?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_17: But with her condition now... she would die if I tried any harder.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_19: Trees will grow tall, and leaves will turn green, {PlayerName}...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_50_20: That child simply made a grown-up decision.

For the final part of your deal with Denia, you go to Zahira to pick up a birthday cake.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_6_1: (Whatever her reason was for saving me and Hiyuki back then... she still carried out the Fractsidus's plan.)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_6_2: (And the Grand Architect's next move is still unclear... Have to stay cautious.)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_1: You can feel your eyelids sinking. In a haze, you seem to have returned to that familiar scene again.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_2: Denia... Do you have any clues about that scene in your memory?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_4: It was just a scene. Maybe from some movies I watched as a kid?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_5: But maybe... in my opinion... you still have a chance to...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_6: Now you're reminding me of what Nastasha once said.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_8: "Raise your head, what do you see?"
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_10: True enough. But my reply was "The void. The darkness."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_12: She said it was actually light fighting against darkness.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_13: "But it looks like darkness has the upper hand," I said.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_14: But there was only darkness in Lahai-Roi at the beginning. Then came the light.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_15: Haha, you answered exactly the same way as she did.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_18: I guess if you never give up, the story will one day have a good ending, no?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_68_19:
Sometimes you still think about Denia, and the times you sat together on that bench.
Will you see each other again?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_2: I just saw Sigrika. That was crazy, {PlayerName}. I didn't think you'd actually... you know, drive that thing off.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_3: So... you're just gonna keep staring? Do you always come empty-handed when you visit patients?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_4: (Looks like she's free of the Threnodian's influence now... but that way of talking...)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_5: Are you aware of your condition right now?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_7: That person gave me a gift a long time ago... Said when the time comes, I'd finally get a nice sleep.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_10: Who knows. But it's not hard to guess, is it? Just like a collar you put on cats and dogs, in case they get ideas.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_11: Mm, no. "Cats and dogs" might be too generous. At least they can still bite. I'm probably closer to a lab mouse now.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_12: So, {PlayerName}, did they send you to sweet-talk a lab mouse?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_13: Denia, I'm here because I chose to be.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_14: We've been on opposite sides before, but...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_15: There you go, still all serious...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_16: But I want to try trusting you.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_17: Right... In that case, am I supposed to look more excited?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_18: Too bad, {PlayerName}, I can't trust you in the same way.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_19: You saw me at my worst there, and you're still playing this game... You want answers. That's why you're here.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_22: How honest. I don't hate that.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_23: Hah... don't get the wrong idea... If you'd died back there, it would have been game over.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_24: If you really want answers, how about we make a deal?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_26: Yes, a fair exchange. The Collective can't get what they want from me, but you just might get what you want.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_28: Maybe you could stay with me for my birthday? This weekend. I'd like to have a good stroll in the Academy again.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_30: It could be, or not. Doesn't matter. What matters is... you are there.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_31: I'm running out of time. Some things deserve a proper ending—with a good day.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_32: (An ending... What is she planning to do? But in her current state...)
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_33: What, doesn't feel safe even if you're around? Then put another collar on me, or a bomb. What's one more, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_35: You mean that? But people at the Academy, do they know...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_36: Spacetrek Collective never made your identity public. So for that day, you'll still be the Academy student Denia.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_39: Relax. I'll cooperate with their research for the next few days. Just don't get your hopes up...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_40: ...The Grand Architect wouldn't be sloppy enough to leave me unhandled.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_41: Anyway, no point worrying about it now. I'll see you this weekend, {PlayerName}.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_7_42:
You visit the infirmary at Arman's request to talk with Denia.
From Denia, you learn that her frequency decay was part of the Grand Architect's plan. She seems to have already accepted her fate.
Denia ultimately offers you a deal: spend her birthday with her, and in exchange, she will assist the Spacetrek Collective's research and provide you with intelligence regarding the Grand Architect.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_71_1: ...Don't overthink it. Let's go over there for a moment.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_1: {PlayerName}. How did it go? Is she willing to cooperate?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_2: You pass along Denia's request to Arman
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_4: ...I see. That is an unexpected request.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_5: But if that's the key to cooperation, the Collective will treat it as a special case.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_6: She said she wants a "proper ending" for some things. But I don't know her true intent yet. We'd better be careful.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_7: Noted. We'll initiate a full risk assessment immediately, and draft a comprehensive operational and contingency plan.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_8: Thank you, {PlayerName}. Would you be available in the afternoons of this weekend? She asked for you specifically.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_11: Much appreciated. We'll ensure that all procedures and contingency measures are fully in place.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_12: We really appreciate your support! I know this is a very personal request, but we'll keep everything under control. You can think of it as a special escort mission.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_8_13: I'll send you the finalized plan before then. Let's stay in touch on WavesLine!
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_2: What do you know about the Grand Architect?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_3: Do you miss life at the Academy?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_4: Why did the Grand Architect leave you there?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_6: I've never seen her true face. Wouldn't be surprised if the real one's already dead.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_7: You care about that, do you? I'll tell you more once you've kept your side of the deal.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_8: Miss my life at the Academy? What made you think that?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_9: You keep staring out the window. That's where the dorms are.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_10: ...When you put it that way, maybe I do. The president once said that everyone ends up missing their school days when they grow up.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_11: I guess that really was my golden age.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_12: Trash gets dumped, you know... And those little tricks of mine? She probably noticed long ago.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_13: Or maybe... she simply decided it was better if I died here.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_9_14: Because you always try to save everyone, even someone like me... Heh. That kind of stubbornness must have gotten to her.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_1: She's right, little one... You might still have a way out.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_2: Because your suffering is nothing like hers. It cannot make you stronger, but neither will it last...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_3: Enough staring at the dead bird, Denia.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_5: What's worthless doesn't deserve to continue, see? That was mercy.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_6: Just hours ago, you accepted Aleph-1's gift, the first in this world to do so. Now tell me, how did it feel?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_8: So, nothingness. The void. The dark... Our good old friends.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_9: But why do you tremble, Denia? Everything begins in the void. And you, most of all, should find it cosy...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_11: Heh... Self-awareness. A lamentable flaw in the course of evolution.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_12: Now, look up, Denia. What do you see?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_90_15: You will accept them, Denia. Become one with them. This is the world's first gift to you, and its last.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_93_3: Sigh... Fine. Can't blame you. Let's go.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_94_1: In time, we will all meet again in eternal darkness.

Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_95_3: Can you hear my voice, Denia?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_96_1: It's still weak, but your frequency has indeed reached a level of syntony.

Zuoyequnxing_73_1: (Aemeath once said Voidspace in the depths of the Threnodian's black hole is a higher dimension. Like a kaleidoscope.)
Zuoyequnxing_73_2: (Time and space here don't flow. They're tangled. Is all of this… inside Aleph-1?)
Zuoyequnxing_74_1: (Those figures... That's Spacetrek Collective and Royan clothing.)
Zuoyequnxing_74_2: (They're reaching for something. Can't make out what.)

Side_YGJJ_1_1: {PlayerName}, we've completed the initial processing of materials recovered from the Fractsidus lab.
Side_YGJJ_1_2: The security protocols for these files are still being processed, so access is restricted for now.
Side_YGJJ_1_3: However, Dr. Arman says you're welcome to visit the Research Institute anytime to discuss anything academic.
Side_YGJJ_2_2: We've completed the initial archiving of Fractsidus assets. Although the data cannot yet be verified, the results have already far exceeded our expectations.
Side_YGJJ_2_4: In short, it fills a long-standing gap in the Rabelle College's research. While the Fractsidus's theories and methods are extreme, they did prove what was once considered impossible.
Side_YGJJ_2_5: Perhaps in the future, the experiment attempted on Denia... could help us pioneer an entirely new direction in this field.
Side_YGJJ_2_6: Despite the data being from the Fractsidus?
Side_YGJJ_2_7: Yes. Mr. Chase always said... knowledge and power have no inherent morality.
Side_YGJJ_2_8: As researchers, our vision is yet too narrow, our understanding too thin. We respect the unknown for what it is, but that doesn't mean we will walk their path.
Side_YGJJ_2_9: Anyway, I digress, {PlayerName}. The real reason I told I.R.I.S. to ask you here is because of Denia.
Side_YGJJ_2_11: Is this about a new job?
Side_YGJJ_2_12: I'm sorry, {PlayerName}. I'm sure you're aware it's not that simple.
Side_YGJJ_2_13: No, {PlayerName}. It's just that there are certain things I cannot tell you over WavesLine.
Side_YGJJ_2_14: We've made some... discoveries, from the Fractsidus's data. The Spacetrek Collective's Duskveil factored into their plan all along. It served as their ultimate fail-safe.
Side_YGJJ_2_15: They knew from the start that Aleph-1 could never descend upon Solaris. Unlike the Threnodian of Rinascita, Aleph-1 requires a "vessel" to establish a connection.
Side_YGJJ_2_16: Originally, this vessel was merely going to be a Voidmatter Pod, until a successful experiment finally granted them their ideal 'containment unit'...
Side_YGJJ_2_18: Precisely. Although the experiment was successful, for reasons unknown, the Fractsidus was dissatisfied with the outcome. Consequently, their researchers abandoned the Dimmr Plains and vanished.
Side_YGJJ_2_19: In other words, their real project in Lahai-Roi may have concluded years ago... this disaster might have been nothing more than a final stress test.
Side_YGJJ_2_20: As for those facilities... I.R.I.S. has determined that the reason they haven't been fully decommissioned is due to Denia's own deficiencies: She herself must rely on a Voidmatter Pod to modulate her frequency.
Side_YGJJ_2_21: Experiment logs show her synchronization with the Voidborne Threnodian has been steadily declining year by year. This trend only intensified after she came to Startorch Academy.
Side_YGJJ_2_22: (Meaning... To the Fractsidus, a "vessel" developing a sense of self was no longer perfect?)
Side_YGJJ_2_23: I'm sorry, {PlayerName}. I... couldn't stop her.
Side_YGJJ_2_26: Still, aside from my research these past few days, I've been thinking of something, {PlayerName}.
Side_YGJJ_2_27: To a researcher, the world is simply divided into existing and imminent knowledge.
Side_YGJJ_2_28: We constantly foist our logic upon things that exist within the scope of our understanding. We subconsciously assume that what is rational will yield the correct results.
Side_YGJJ_2_29: Yet perhaps this blind overambition breeds arrogance. We've traded our imagination of the unknown for progress through tunnel vision.
Side_YGJJ_2_30: This whole situation... we claim to reject the New Federation's policies, but what we did, what we tried to take from Denia. How are we different from the Fractsidus?
Side_YGJJ_2_31: Heh... listen to me, I'm getting ahead of myself again. Perhaps I should take the day off today.
Side_YGJJ_2_32: I appreciate everything you've done. It's high time you gave yourself a vacation, {PlayerName}.
Side_YGJJ_3_1: A job well done, {PlayerName}. Is there anything else on your mind?
Side_YGJJ_3_2: How are things with the New Federation?
Side_YGJJ_3_3: What will happen to the Department of Voidmatters?
Side_YGJJ_3_4: Is it possible to go back to the Voidspace?
Side_YGJJ_3_6: Currently, the Threnodian's frequency in Lahai-Roi and the Dimmr Plains has almost vanished. Thus, the New Federation's main accusation no longer holds. From here, I imagine it will simply be a dispute over money and interests.
Side_YGJJ_3_7: That said, the "Voidmatter Pod" has been operational ever since Startorch Academy laid its foundation... many building contractors working on Startorch at the time were from the New Federation.
Side_YGJJ_3_8: For the Fractsidus to hide their project in the Dimmr Plains, under the cover of high-intensity Void Storms... A bit too convenient, don't you think?"
Side_YGJJ_3_9: To be frank... I don't know either. I imagine future research will lean more toward theoretical and computational deductions. Then again, it's never wrong to keep pondering.
Side_YGJJ_3_10: Even without a research subject, we still have the data and our past achievements... These materials have given us new insights. Perhaps the true significance of Voidmatter Science will be revealed in the days to come.
Side_YGJJ_3_11: Our current methods don't work. But the future is yet unknown.
Side_YGJJ_3_12: The Exostrider, or rather "Lahai-Roi," is still waiting for us on the other side of Voidspace.
Side_YGJJ_3_13: Also, it could also be the case for Denia...
Side_YGJJ_3_14: Thank you for all your help. Now it's high time for your vacation, {PlayerName}.
Side_YGJJ_4_1: Senior, can I see you today?
Side_YGJJ_4_5: It's about Denia... I received a letter from her.
Side_YGJJ_4_6: I'll be waiting for you in the cafeteria.
Side_YGJJ_4_8: I'll be waiting for you in the cafeteria.
Side_YGJJ_5_2: I've been helping Professor Mornye with the Reactor Drive for the past couple of days... Feels like it's been ages since we met, Senior!
Side_YGJJ_5_3: Don't be too hard on yourself.
Side_YGJJ_5_4: It's fine, even though things have been a bit busy lately, I've been very productive.
Side_YGJJ_5_5: It's been the kind of day that when I look back, I'll be able to say with confidence, "I'm finally on the path to making my dreams a reality!"
Side_YGJJ_5_6: I'm not talking about physical exhaustion, Sigrika.
Side_YGJJ_5_7: Mmm. I know what you mean, Senior.
Side_YGJJ_5_8: Lately... whenever I have a moment to myself, I keep thinking about that afternoon we spent with Denia.
Side_YGJJ_5_9: That's why I wanted to meet you today.
Side_YGJJ_5_10: There's something I really want to make sure with you.
Side_YGJJ_5_11: I'll try to answer as best as I can.
Side_YGJJ_5_12: Senior, my friend, Nivora... She's never coming back, is she?
Side_YGJJ_5_16: Before the New Solar Celebration, I also asked President Lucilla and Dr. Herssen. Neither of them gave me a straight answer.
Side_YGJJ_5_17: They took me for a child back then.
Side_YGJJ_5_18: But... I had already guessed what had happened.
Side_YGJJ_5_19: And also about what happened to Denia. She always did tell me that ignoring certain things was the key to staying happy.
Side_YGJJ_5_20: But then I received her scheduled message... she chose to tell me everything in the end.
Side_YGJJ_5_21: She said on that day, she realized I didn't seek friendships just to make myself happy.
Side_YGJJ_5_22: ...And hopefully that would be true for her as well.
Side_YGJJ_5_24: Yes, that's also what Denia said.
Side_YGJJ_5_25: When the time comes, will I be a better adult?
AYJJWD_1_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. This is Linnea. I learned just now that Babu, Barton, Bada, and Banana all received your help. My thanks, I cannot give enough.
AYJJWD_1_2: That gardener story I told you before... You know, don't you? I feel that I am that very gardener.
AYJJWD_1_3: A plan I have made. With someone I trust, I wish to share it. Have you time? To come by the Base Camp?
AYJJWD_1_6: Thank you. The expedition fares well. Most of the little ones have returned with their teams. Bada remains in the Sealed Fissure to complete its task.
AYJJWD_1_7: Babu I will bring. See you soon!
AYJJWD_2_1: {PlayerName}, thank you for agreeing to my wish.
AYJJWD_2_3: After our talk, the gifts from Budee I accepted. Those magazines and old newspapers.
AYJJWD_2_4: Years old, most of them. Huanglong script I do not read well. But the parts about Lahai-Roi I understand...
AYJJWD_2_5: Reading it brings me great joy! Articles about the Exostrider. The Roya. Exoswarm. Soliskin. So many things... happening beyond Lahai-Roi, on this planet. Great things.
AYJJWD_2_6: On one of the title pages, it said, "Go see the world and witness history in the making." This has great meaning! This is a good reason to travel, better than running from a fate I fear.
AYJJWD_2_8: Yes! You know it, too? I thought so. A science journal of so many topics... many readers it must have!
AYJJWD_2_9: So have you decided to leave Lahai-Roi and see the world?
AYJJWD_2_10: Someday, yes. But for now, I wish to record the things I see right here. And if the Soliskin are willing, I also wish to record the world through their eyes!
AYJJWD_2_11: In Lahai-Roi, so much becomes history now. Choices forced. Changes made. My gift, talking with Soliskin, can achieve more. Much more, perhaps.
AYJJWD_2_12: I want to start with this expedition. Interview the little ones. The research teams they work with. Then, I will write an article and submit it to "Wutherium Geographic."
AYJJWD_2_13: The problem is... never have I interviewed a soul. Nor written for a magazine. Eirny suggested I find someone with wisdom to help review the draft. So, I thought of you! Have you any advice for me?
AYJJWD_2_14: Make the title pop. It should sound newsworthy.
AYJJWD_2_15: The content should be detailed. Try including a third-party perspective.
AYJJWD_2_16: The article can include photos and illustrations.
AYJJWD_2_17: That should be enough to start.
AYJJWD_2_18: A distinctive title... Well, the Lumen Intiative from the Soliskin's perspective I want to write. They... are the most distinctive. Oh! I'll call it: "Beyond Bjartr Woods—An Expedition through Soliskin Eyes."
AYJJWD_2_19: A third-party perspective? Besides the Soliskin...? Ah, I can interview the students! Many days they have spent with the little ones. Exciting stories they will have!
AYJJWD_2_20: You are right! That is a wonderful idea. But photos I do not take well. {PlayerName}, could you help?
AYJJWD_2_21: Okay, leave the camera work to me.
AYJJWD_2_22: My thanks for your guidance! Interviews I will start now. And with Babu and its friends, I will speak to first.
AYJJWD_2_23: Babu is timid. At the station it stays. But it told me it made a new friend. What happens at the base is also part of the story. As important as fieldwork, yes?
AYJJWD_3_1: Hello, Mao! I am Babu's Shepherdess, Linnea. Do you have a moment for a few questions?
AYJJWD_3_2: <ano=Hello>Ni hao</ano>, Ms. Linnea. Babu comes by to play with us all the time, so sure, happy to help. But uh... my name is Wenting, not Mao. You sure I'm the student you're looking for?
AYJJWD_3_3: Wait, if not you... then who is "Mao Wenti"?
AYJJWD_3_4: Mao Wenti? Hehe, could you mean <ano=Spear>Mao</ano>... <ano=Bill>Wen</ano>... <ano=Water Bird>Ti</ano>?
AYJJWD_3_5: If my guess is right, you're looking for this large water bird beside me. See its bill? Long and pointy, like a spear? In Huanglong, we'd call it a <ano=Spearbill Water Bird>Mao Wen Ti</ano>. But folks here call them Chuubill Gulpies.
AYJJWD_3_7: I-I see. It never even crossed my mind that Babu's new best friend could be a water bird.
AYJJWD_3_8: Haha! Yeah, I know. Doesn't look like the brightest bulb. But this guy's a total hit. Soliskin from everywhere come to hang out.
AYJJWD_3_9: Based on my field observations, there's actually a really cool mutualistic thing going on between Chuubill Gulpies and Soliskin.
AYJJWD_3_10: This Gulpy probably got to the Dimmr Plains ages ago. Their species is naturally drawn to the light emitted by Soliskin. And where Soliskin gather, food is usually plentiful...
AYJJWD_3_11: So our theory is that Chuubill Gulpies learned to follow the light and avoid Void Storms. Their fixation with the Soliskin is what helped them survive out here.
AYJJWD_3_12: But Gulpies have tiny brains, likely some evolutionary regression, too. They can't always distinguish between "food" and "Soliskin." So, occasionally when they feed... a Soliskin gets gulped down too.
AYJJWD_3_14: Oh, don't worry. They usually spit 'em back out after a minute or two. That's where the "Chuubill Gulpy" thing comes from.
AYJJWD_3_15: I've run some experiments. Data says it doesn't hurt them at all. In fact, some Soliskin just... jump right into the Gulpy's bill! On purpose. Like a game.
AYJJWD_3_16: Since so many Soliskin showed up at the station, we've had quite a few Gulpies drop by. This one's the boldest of the bunch. Strolls around like it owns the place.
AYJJWD_3_17: When it first got here, it tried eating everything you can imagine. Gulped down half the base, I swear. We had to set up a separate observation zone just to study it.
AYJJWD_3_18: That big Soliskin, Lisan, and little Babu are here all the time asking to play with it.
AYJJWD_3_19: I see... so Babu wasn't joking. A new friend it found to play games with.
AYJJWD_3_20: So, what would you like to know? Our friend here can't exactly answer, but if I can, I'll be happy to.
AYJJWD_3_21: "Please evaluate the role of the Soliskin in the expedition... Would you cooperate with them again... What is your most memorable experience working with the Soliskin..."
AYJJWD_3_22: Ugh... The questions I prepared earlier don't seem very useful now.
AYJJWD_3_23: But Wenting, you mentioned the mutualism between Chuubill Gulpies and the Soliskin. Fascinating, it is. Would you mind if I include your observations in my article for "Wutherium Geographic"?
AYJJWD_3_24: Not at all! I'm a loyal reader myself. Actually thought about submitting once...
AYJJWD_3_25: But the revision requests on my thesis have sucked the soul right out of me. I can't write another extra word.
AYJJWD_3_26: Good luck with the submission, Ms. Linnea! I'll be the first in line to buy a copy!
AYJJWD_3_27: Kind words you give! {PlayerName}, I think we have enough material for Babu's section now. Let's go interview the other little ones.
AYJJWD_4_2: Interview Barton and me for an article? Oh my gosh, of course! What do you wanna know? Wait—No, hang on. I can't decide for Barton. Barton! Do you wanna do an interview?
AYJJWD_4_5: It looks like you two have been getting along much better lately.
AYJJWD_4_7: Leave it to me! Simultaneous interpreting, ready to go!
AYJJWD_4_8: "Your most memorable experience... Pelagia put Barton's name in her research paper! In acknowledgments and as fourth author!"
AYJJWD_4_9: "Would you work together again... Pelagia is noisy sometimes. But now she asks Barton's opinion. Acceptable."
AYJJWD_4_10: "Future plans? Barton wants to be first author. Sounds the most impressive."
AYJJWD_4_11: Whoa, talk about ambitious! Sometimes I can only snag second author myself. How could I possibly give away the top spot?! Barton, I'll give you my whole stipend. All of it. But first authorship is an absolute "no"!
AYJJWD_4_12: "What if Barton writes it all by itself?"
AYJJWD_4_13: If you actually wrote it, I'd be totally fine with it! But the problem is... how exactly are YOU gonna write a paper?
AYJJWD_4_14: "Barton can learn. Linnea translates, Pelagia helps!"
AYJJWD_4_15: Sounds a bit far-fetched, but you always find a way to surprise me. Just like the time none of us dared to activate that Lumescribe Component Matrix, but you and {PlayerName} got it running perfectly.
AYJJWD_4_16: Now that I think about it, you do know Exostrider components well. Our research on environmental restoration wouldn't have moved an inch without you... Barton, you really are an incredible Soliskin!
AYJJWD_4_17: If being first author is your dream, then I'll help you make it come true!
AYJJWD_4_18: And help with the translation, I will.
AYJJWD_4_19: "Thank you, Pelagia. Thank you, Linnea. Barton loves research! Loves first authorship!"
AYJJWD_4_20: My thanks for taking the time to answer my questions. Barton, do you wish to spend a little more time with Ms. Pelagia?
AYJJWD_4_23: Then we'll leave you two to it. {PlayerName}, let us go find our next subjects.
AYJJWD_5_3: It says it was the one who originally found that copy of "Wutherium Geographic"...
AYJJWD_5_4: That's right. Budee gave it to me. Treasure it, I do. I hope our story is worthy of being published in such a magazine.
AYJJWD_5_5: Well, documenting this expedition from a Soliskin's perspective for "Wutherium Geographic"... that's a genuinely meaningful endeavor.
AYJJWD_5_6: The last time I was interviewed for a magazine, I was still a visiting scholar in the New Federation... That must have been over a decade ago.
AYJJWD_5_7: Since I moved to Startorch Academy for my research, my life has been entirely dictated by whatever schedule the TARD-E Units hand me. I've practically lost all sense of time, haha.
AYJJWD_5_8: But as of the Soliskin's role in this expedition... Let me explain my field of study first.
AYJJWD_5_9: In simple terms, I study "superfoods." I came to the Dimmr Plains to collect plant and animal samples for food development. And food mutation data from extreme environments.
AYJJWD_5_10: At first, I had no idea how to collaborate with a Soliskin, so I just left that problem to Finella.
AYJJWD_5_11: "Finella takes me out to find things!"
AYJJWD_5_12: Exactly. Finella handed me a paper titled "The Role of Royan Culture in New Molecular Gastronomy Processing Techniques" and then immediately bolted with Budee! I almost kicked her out of the lab!
AYJJWD_5_13: But then I realized they weren't just collecting junk. They were bringing back incredible plant samples and spores. Honestly? The quality was far better than anything Finella found on her own.
AYJJWD_5_15: Alright, alright, not junk. Just... several expired supplement bottles from three years ago.
AYJJWD_5_16: But after looking into Royan culture myself, I realized Finella's literature review wasn't total nonsense.
AYJJWD_5_17: Lahai-Roi's ecosystem is deeply tied to the Exostrider. As its creations, Soliskin have a built-in affinity with nature. You could say that finding rare plants and spores is their innate talent!
AYJJWD_5_18: Budee is also remarkably sharp. It's much more familiar with the terrain of the Silent Crag than Finella is, so it always brings me back "surprises."
AYJJWD_5_19: After analyzing the samples Budee brought back, I've come up with several new ideas for superfood development. If I get the chance, I'd definitely want to keep working with Budee. What do you say, little one?
AYJJWD_5_20: "Budee wants to, too! Budee likes Professor Maeve's Gemini Spores!"
AYJJWD_5_21: Haha! Then leave the paperwork with the Solsworns and the Academy to me!
AYJJWD_5_22: It feels like watching a child go off to school... Those parents who camp outside the Academy gates, just to be near their children... I finally understand them.
AYJJWD_5_23: They want their children to study hard, but they worry. Do they eat right? Are they taking care of themselves? They would move the whole family closer, just to see them every day. That yearning... I understand now.
AYJJWD_5_24: You could always move there, too.
AYJJWD_5_25: If you can't stand the parting, why not just join them?
AYJJWD_5_26: A point you have. Think on it I will. {PlayerName}, our last interviewees are Banana and its friend. Let us go now.
AYJJWD_6_1: Banana, you are here alone? Where are your Academy friends?
AYJJWD_6_3: Interesting! It says the Geospider is its friend.
AYJJWD_6_4: Soliskin and humans I understand. But a Geospider... can it be a subject for interview?
AYJJWD_6_6: Your job is to record the truth of what you see!
AYJJWD_6_7: Right you are! If Banana says the Geospider is its friend, then I will faithfully record their story.
AYJJWD_6_8: Banana... interferes with task execution... but... friend.
AYJJWD_6_10: It says, "Go for it! Show them our bond!"
AYJJWD_6_11: A bond forged through games? I am not sure... how to continue this interview...
AYJJWD_6_12: Wait, I know! {PlayerName}, could you please capture this moment for me?
AYJJWD_6_14: You're looking at a pro photographer.
AYJJWD_7_1: Thank you, {PlayerName}! What I still cannot express in words, this photo conveys. The joy between Banana and the Geospider can be seen by all now.
AYJJWD_7_2: We've gathered enough materials for today. Wonderful it has been, conducting these interviews with you by my side.
AYJJWD_7_3: I will organize these drafts. The Soliskin's stories from the expedition will be recorded. I wish for many people to know about them.
AYJJWD_7_5: Looking forward to reading the final article.
AYJJWD_7_6: Update you I will! After all, this is your story too!
AYJJWD_8_2: A reply I received! From "Wutherium Geographic"! They wish to publish MY article!
AYJJWD_8_3: Professional my wording was not. But kind the editor was.  Corrections she marked. She asked me to revise and resubmit the article.
AYJJWD_8_4: The photo of Banana and the Geospider, loved it she did! She encouraged me to keep recording Lahai-Roi through the eyes of the Soliskin!
AYJJWD_8_5: Going forward, I have decided I want to record the stories of the Soliskin who accompanied me in the past too...
AYJJWD_8_6: Professor Maeve said that Soliskin are born with an innate wisdom we should not underestimate. And I think, if they have all made choices true to their own hearts...
AYJJWD_8_7: Then even in the past, when the Soliskin and I faced that unavoidable fate... They knew how it would end, but they still chose to meet their Shepherds, right from the very beginning.
AYJJWD_8_8: The confusion and pain I felt... traces they are now. Left behind by those who are gone. But what they gave me is so much more.
AYJJWD_8_9: Remember them I can. Interview them I will. I can record the very first choices they made upon entering this world. A complete story, I can tell now. A Soliskin's life, from beginning to end!
AYJJSD_1_1: {PlayerName}, what are you up to? Busy? If you've got a sec, you should swing by the Dimmr Plains.
AYJJSD_1_2: It's the closest sector to the Stridergate, so the Threnodian markers took a while to drop to safety thresholds. Now the Academy is officially greenlighting the Lumen Initiative.
AYJJSD_1_3: Thing is, a lot of the faculty are still recovering after the last battle. We're short-staffed, you know how it is. But the Dimmr Plains does have fascinating ecology. So, can I tempt you to join?
AYJJSD_1_4: Sure, why not? Count me in.
AYJJSD_1_5: Sure, sign me up. Will you be out there too, Classmate Iris?
AYJJSD_1_6: Yep! Well, until the local field servers are live, I'll be providing related support. No field trips for me, of course, but I'll be running ops from the station.
AYJJSD_1_7: Coordinates sent. Heads up though, Solisia Landing can be a nightmare to navigate. Plus, there are reports of rampaging Exoswarm in the area. Victims of past Void Storms.
AYJJSD_1_8: The Academy's got someone meeting you near the shaft. Oh! And an "old friend" of yours is already there. She's dying to see you again.
AYJJSD_10_2: Woah, a lot more Soliskin showed up here.
AYJJSD_11_1: It's Mechascouts... a lot of them. {PlayerName}, the research station should be just ahead!
AYJJSD_3_1: (She shakes her head firmly, arms crossed in front of her chest defiantly.)
AYJJSD_4_2: (Her eyes light up when she sees you. She looks down at the Soliskin, then points toward a fork in the path.)
AYJJSD_4_3: You want the Soliskin to go back that way with you?
AYJJSD_4_5: Abby, it's your time to shine.
AYJJSD_4_6: Hehe, leave it to me! Simultaneous interpreting on!
AYJJSD_4_7: "Everyone else went out! Babu wants to play too!"
AYJJSD_4_8: (She puffs out her cheeks, staring Babu down. Then she turns to you with a pleading look.)
AYJJSD_4_9: (I.R.I.S. said there are Void Storm-affected Exoswarm nearby… Zahira is probably just trying to send this Soliskin back for its own safety.)
AYJJSD_4_11: It's too dangerous out here by yourself. The rampaging Exoswarm or Tacet Discords might get you!
AYJJSD_4_12: "N-no! They won't get me! Fine... You have the Exostrider's aura. I'll listen to you."
AYJJSD_5_1: Where could Babu have gone? What am I supposed to tell Linnea...
AYJJSD_6_1: Babu! Off you ran again on your own. Ah, Zahira... and who is this?
AYJJSD_6_2: "Chulululu! The Exostrider's friend brought me home!"
AYJJSD_6_3: The Exostrider's friend? This aura... Oh! The Predicted One, you must be. Well met. I am Eirny, a Shepherdess.
AYJJSD_6_4: Linnea, Babu's Shepherdess, asked me to watch the little one, but quite the escape artist it is. Thank you for bringing it back.
AYJJSD_6_5: So Shepherds and Soliskin come to the Dimmr Plains too?
AYJJSD_6_6: Babu said it wanted to play.
AYJJSD_6_7: You're welcome. It promised me it won't run off again.
AYJJSD_6_8: The environment here... unique it is. The Solisylum granted the Academy's request. So many of us, Shepherds and Soliskin, came to help. Surveys. Experiments. One big expedition team, we are now.
AYJJSD_6_9: Babu said it wanted to "play like everyone else." What does that mean?
AYJJSD_6_10: Many research teams asked for Soliskin help. Most of the little ones we brought have been assigned to different groups already.
AYJJSD_6_11: But Babu is young. Linnea thought work it should not do yet. Left behind it must have felt, thinking its friends all went to play.
AYJJSD_6_12: Play with Babu I will, for a while. That should cheer it up.
AYJJSD_6_13: "Babu stays! Tacet Discords won't get me! Babu stays and waits for everyone to come home!"
AYJJSD_6_14: I have taken too much of your time. The station, just ahead it is. Safe travels to you.
AYJJSD_8_1: (She gives a sly wink and a smug little grin.)
AYJJSD_8_2: I didn't expect you to be the one meeting me. Are you part of the Lumen Initiative too?
AYJJSD_8_3: (She looks at Chomp Chomp and the mountain of supplies.)
AYJJSD_8_4: So you and Chomp Chomp deliver supplies for the Roya?
AYJJSD_8_5: (She nods vigorously, then shakes her head. She draws a circle in the air with her index fingers.)
AYJJSD_8_6: Not just for the Roya, but for the whole station? Wow, Zahira. That's an entire operation. Respect!
AYJJSD_8_7: (She puffs out her chest and beams with pride.)
AYJJSD_8_8: (She pulls out a packet of energy gel and makes a "yuck" face, slumping her shoulders.)
AYJJSD_8_9: If you get tired of energy gel, just come find me.
AYJJSD_8_11: (She pauses, looks at Chomp Chomp, then mimics revving a motorcycle engine, making a low "vroom" sound.)
AYJJSD_8_12: Chomp Chomp... Motorbike... You want a rematch?
AYJJSD_8_13: Not here, but once I find a proper track, we'll see who's really the fastest!
AYJJSD_9_1: Well well. It's been a minute, {PlayerName}.
AYJJSD_9_2: Good to see you too, Classmate I.R.I.S.
AYJJSD_9_3: So! You're officially on the Lumen Initiative! Let me give you the quick and dirty on what we're doing.
AYJJSD_9_4: This expedition aims to complete geological surveys of the Dimmr Plains, catalog the local plant life, and carry out restoration work in Voidmatter-contaminated zones.
AYJJSD_9_5: The Academy has already handled the primary regional surveys and environmental modeling. But there are four ancient vegetation ruins acting up. They are the priority. I sent the coordinates to your Terminal.
AYJJSD_9_6: Oh, and I heard you had a little adventure on your way in. Already met the Roya Shepherds and their Soliskin, huh? I'm sure you know they're key members of this project.
AYJJSD_9_7: By the way, recent datasets on "{PlayerName}" suggest that you're kind of a big deal. Both on and off campus. Academy folks? Roya? Apparently everyone loves you.
AYJJSD_9_8: Speaking just for myself, I was hoping you could keep an eye on how the students and Soliskin are getting along... You'd be good at it. Anyways, anything else you'd like to know?
AYJJSD_9_13: The Light Energy and Voidmatter Science departments are handling the geo-ecology and restoration stuff. Meanwhile, Rabelle College is doing the cross-disciplinary deep dives.
AYJJSD_9_14: But those four ancient ruins I mentioned? They need boots on the ground. If it were me, I'd say go there.
AYJJSD_9_15: So here's the deal. Like the Roya, the Academy has a strict "no harming Soliskin" policy. Break that rule, and they won't let you off easy.
AYJJSD_9_16: But here's the tricky part. Based on my analysis of human language data, even well-intentioned interactions can cause harm, especially when neither side can actually understand what the other is saying.
AYJJSD_9_17: So the Academy hopes faculty and students will avoid actions that neglect or hurt the feelings of the Soliskin. But if you're there, maybe you can set a good example? The Soliskin already trust you. A perfect opportunity, don't you think?
AYJJSD_9_18: You'll be compensated, obviously. Standard stipend, plus some exclusive goodies the Academy cooked up just for this. The Roya kicked in some stuff too. Consider it incentive.
AYJJSD_9_19: {PlayerName}, thanks for joining the Lumen Initiative. Science as our light, danger as our path, truth as our reward. That's the motto, right? Go make us look good out there!
Side_BYLX_1_6: Good. President Lucilla gave me your contact. I actually have a favor to ask...
Side_BYLX_1_7: Let's go over the details when we meet.
Side_BYLX_10_1: It seems to be a viable path ahead. Maybe we can go upward from there...
Side_BYLX_11_1: These structures... They're Spacetrek Collective architecture. Did people truly live down here?
Side_BYLX_11_2: The Threnodian is sealed. Let's use the Frequency Cassette Recorder to scan the area. Perhaps we can catch a ghost of the past...
Side_BYLX_12_1: "Just one more second would be enough..."
Side_BYLX_12_2: "I have to hold the line... for our future..."
Side_BYLX_12_3: "Even if I have to burn... the last of my frequency... I will..."
Side_BYLX_12_4: These are the Reverberations of the fallen... Their unfinished desires...
Side_BYLX_12_5: Let's see the frequency match... Andrei, Annelia, Petri. I recognize those names. They were the prodigies in their departments. Everyone said the future was theirs for the taking...
Side_BYLX_12_6: But after graduation, they simply vanished. No one knew where they had gone. So this is the place... but why?
Side_BYLX_12_7: They did it for the future of Lahai-Roi.
Side_BYLX_12_8: Some people find a purpose greater than themselves.
Side_BYLX_12_9: …At the very least, someone should remember their sacrifices and what they endured.
Side_BYLX_13_1: Let's go... We need to keep moving forward.
Side_BYLX_14_1: These floating structures... Wait, this energy field is nauseating. Were they generated using Voidmatter particles?
Side_BYLX_14_2: Look at this intricate design... Meticulously engineered, yet completely twisted. Someone must've built them with pure malice.
Side_BYLX_14_3: Such world-shaping technologies, and this is how they choose to use them...
Side_BYLX_14_4: Let's document everything for the Academy. It can be a good warning, just in case.
Side_BYLX_15_1: We can't stay here for long. Let's move to the next location.

Side_BYLX_2_19: I'm not sure how any of that will help us.

Side_BYLX_2_22: Here, take this brochure. President Lucilla wants us to fill this "memory book" with our journey. There's a reward waiting for us at the end.

Side_BYLX_20_6: I want to dedicate my life to a vision. A vision for all of humanity. Beyond race, beyond borders.
Side_BYLX_20_7: A vision forged from the countless prayers across the world. A vision that so many have bled for... I-I want to be part of it.

Today, Papa took me to see the Solsworn lady. She said a lot of things I couldn't really understand... something about my Forte being special. So that's why the Exoswarm flee the second they see me. On the way home, Papa wouldn't stop sighing. I've never seen him look so worried before.
I think I know why. Last time, when I tried to play with the Exoswarm he was herding, they just... snapped. They panicked and ran wild. They even hurt Mama.
"Was that my fault?" I asked him. He just sighed, then reached out and rubbed my head with his big, warm hand.
"Do not fret, little one," he said, his voice light like always. "If you are not meant to be a Shepherdess, you are still a good girl."
...
Papa came home with nothing today. He said he gave the Exoswarm to the other Shepherds. I know he is afraid they will hurt Mama again.
This is all my fault. If I weren't like this, Papa wouldn't have lost his job. He'd still be out there, like one of those proud Shepherds guiding the Exoswarm across the frostlands, paying tribute to Baldur for the sunlight and everything we have.
...
Papa seemed happy today. I think it's because Mama is almost healed. He took me to a village far, far away. There's an old granny living there, and he asked me to stay with her to learn stone carving. The granny told me she has a power just like mine, something that makes the Exoswarm angry, so she moved out here to be alone. Papa promised me that carving is a lot of fun, and that he and Mama would come visit me as often as they could.
...
He was right. Stone carving is fun. The granny has taught me everything she knows. She even told me I have a "natural gift." That's the first time anyone has ever said that to me! Mama and Papa must be really busy, though. They haven't visited in over ten days. But it's okay, because I've made some new friends: Fenrir, a Toskr Lemming who can't stop dancing; Dallas, a Fluffguin who loves eating fish, and Bori, a Kronapuff who loves to nibble on flowers.
I carved all of us together onto a big stone slab. Granny says that means we'll be friends forever and ever.
...
Mama and Papa still haven't come. I asked Fenrir, Dallas, and Bori to go to the village and look for them. I miss them so much.
But I waited and waited... and nobody came back. Not Mama, not Papa... not my fluffy friends.
A few days later, Uncle Vilhelm from the village came to talk to Granny. He didn't look like the proud, strong Shepherd I remembered. He looked exhausted. They talked for a long time while I hid outside. I caught Papa's name, something about our village, and things like "Void Storms" and "Tacet Discords."
Just hearing those names makes my stomach do flips... I think I should sneak back to the village and see for myself. As long as I stay away from the Exoswarm, it should be fine.

It's all gone. Everything.
I searched for so long for where the village used to be. All I found was a small patch of scorched fur, a tuft of feathers... and half a beak. Papa. Mama... everyone in the village... my friends... they're all gone.
Something is watching me. I don't want to run anymore.
...
It took me a long, long time to learn how to speak again. Even longer to find the courage to open this diary.
The woman who saved me from those monsters called herself a professor from Startorch Academy. She's beautiful, but she doesn't look like anyone from our village. She told me I have a rare kind of Forte, something that makes me a "potential Synchronist."
I told her everything that happened to the village. I asked her: is this a blessing from <ano=the Exostrider>Baldur</ano>? Or the cruelest curse <ano=the Threnodian>Hvedrungr</ano> ever devised?
She was silent for a while. Then, she told me her own homeland had been swallowed by a similar disaster. She crossed an ocean so vast I can't even imagine it, all to find a way to free the world from this fate. She asked me to join the Academy. She said that whether my power is a blessing or a curse, it might be the key to opening the door to our future.
...But I have nothing left. Even if <ano=the Exostrider>Baldur</ano> is waiting behind that door, it can't give back what I've already lost.
...
I went back to Granny's place to say goodbye and thank her for everything. I told her I was leaving for the Academy.
"We Roya carve our words into stone," she said, her voice as kind as ever, "so that <ano=the Threnodian>Hvedrungr</ano> cannot erase our existence. And those children at the Academy use something they call 'Cassettes' to do the same. To me, you're just going somewhere else... to carve the statue that belongs to you."
"As long as the memory remains, so does the soul."
After I arrived at the Academy, I read this notebook from the very first page to the last. Papa, Mama, Fenrir, Dallas, Bori... Granny was right. They're still alive here in these pages, and deep within my mind. Maybe, without even realizing it, I've become a living statue carved with all their names.
I'll carry their souls with me, wherever I go. I promise.
...
Void Storms. Even the name is terrifying.
I've spent my life trying to outrun its shadow. It's one of <ano=the Threnodian>Hvedrungr's</ano> venomous tendrils, dragging everything I love into the nothingness. I thought... I thought I had learned how to ignore it.
But seeing it appear again, I realized something. All these years of study... they were just preparation for this exact moment. Again and again, I've pushed my Forte to its limit, right to the edge of Overclocking. And now, I finally understand. I'm ready.
Just like the professor said, only I, only my Forte, can save that village from being wiped out. I couldn't save my own home back then. But this time, I won't stand by and watch the dark take the people I love.
It's time to go.

SXNPCXS_1_12: The answers sought by the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective can be found within the hearts of men and women.
SXNPCXS_1_13: I hoped to find answers of my own: Why did the Exostrider cast out the Reactor Drive to illuminate us all? And why did its light bring me warmth?
SXNPCXS_1_14: To find those answers, I was prepared to sacrifice everything. Thus I walked among the Roya, and thus I found my purpose.
SXNPCXS_1_15: Have you found your answers now?
SXNPCXS_1_16: I once believed I never would. And yet, the outcome has surpassed my every calculation.
SXNPCXS_1_17: The purifier inside my chest continues to radiate warmth, even as the Voidmatter corrupts me. Faint, but still I feel it.
SXNPCXS_1_18: Perhaps the Exostrider also shared my desire to help. And so it lifted the Drive into the sky.
SXNPCXS_1_19: Tell me, fellow bearer... do you believe I have fulfilled my wish?
SXNPCXS_1_21: There must've been someone who felt your warmth.
SXNPCXS_1_22: Your answer brings me a great sense of peace.
SXNPCXS_1_23: The people have offered their thanks, even as I have offered mine to all.
SXNPCXS_1_24: I asked questions. I sought answers. I found my truth. That my mission and my searching should end together... that is my fortune.
SXNPCXS_1_25: I thank you for your steadfast aid, fellow bearer.
SXNPCXS_1_26: Another shall surely come after me, to carry on this duty. And for you, may the light of the new sun ever illuminate your path.
SXNPCXS_2_1: Arsenio, the first mech Solsworn in history, was confirmed to have shut down seven hours ago.
SXNPCXS_2_2: The Spacetrek Collective and the Solisylum extend their deepest condolences.
SXNPCXS_2_3: The one who labored to record our lives shall not pass unnamed from history.
SXNPCXS_2_4: The Solisylum will work alongside the Spacetrek Collective to compose a commemorative biographical poem for Arsenio, honoring the life of this Solsworn.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_1: ...E-Excuse me. Sorry to interrupt. Is that your expedition motorbike? Ahem... I mean, do you own an expedition motorbike?
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_4: Ha... haha... sorry, I'm not exactly great at talking to people.

Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_6: S-so, please, just talk to me like I'm a real person... I hope it's not too much trouble.

Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_13: Why are you so interested in the expedition motorbike?
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_14: Uh... It's a long story. You must have seen those simulator terminals in Lahai-Roi and on the ice fields.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_15: Well, I'm one of their designers. I wanted to create the ultimate, perfect, most grueling motorbike track—
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_16: But just when I was about to complete the track... A Void Storm hit. Luckily, I had this holographic device ready.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_17: See that simulator terminal over there? My ultimate track is preserved inside it!
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_18: I don't even know if I'm still... "alive," but as long as my track exists along with those who can challenge it, that's enough for me.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_20: Th... Then, I'll begin the scan now—
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_21: The researcher's hologram scans your expedition motorbike. He is in awe of the various modules equipped onto it.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_22: Wh... what truly creative designs... The synergy between the modules is cohesive and efficient. I believe she's more than capable of handling the "Ultra-Hard" challenge I designed.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_23: I had set aside some track prizes, though I'm not sure if they're still there... Please, you must try out my course. I'm counting on you!
Side_MTTZZZJZ_1_25: Just fire up that simulator terminal over there. Thank you, challenger!
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_1: How was that... challenger? What did you think of my track?
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_2: Definitely a bit of the tough side.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_3: It's alright. I wasn't trying my best.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_4: This track is impossible to complete.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_5: Haha... Some proper difficulty is exactly what makes it fun. If the track were too easy, the challenge would be meaningless.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_6: Were you... not entertained...? My apologies.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_7: Haha... well, it is a track designed to be highly difficult.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_8: Still, even if you didn't pass, you at least got to experience the track I designed. Here, this is the prize I promised.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_2_9: If you ever plan on giving it another shot, you're welcome to come back anytime.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_3_1: N... No way. I never imagined you'd actually complete this track...
Side_MTTZZZJZ_3_2: I feel... a spark of joy, but with a twinge of sadness.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_3_3: I thought the Ultimate Challenge I designed would be sufficiently difficult. But it seems... I still had a long way to go.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_3_6: Sigh... Nevertheless, this will probably be the greatest masterpiece of my life.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_3_7: Thank you, challenger. You've given my masterpiece its final purpose, instead of letting it rot away in some forgotten corner.
Side_MTTZZZJZ_3_8: If I were actually here right now... I would surely feel a sense of profound satisfaction.

III. I never imagined old tech from my hometown all those years ago would find a new life in an expedition motorbike. Even now, the mention of the "Inferno Rider" still strikes fear into people's hearts. I cannot erase the shadow cast by that Tacet Discord, nor can I truly give rest to the souls who perished long ago. Zuoyequnxing_48_3: You want me for the possibility that I could become the Threnodian's Resonator in the future.

Zuoyequnxing_48_5: That is your gift. Your talent.
Zuoyequnxing_48_7: From Ashinohara's legends and the Spacetrek Collective's investigative reports, you know who {PlayerName} is by now.
Zuoyequnxing_48_8: As a "savior" yourself, what do you think of {Male=his;Female=her} capabilities?
Zuoyequnxing_48_10: Hehe, you can afford to be more effusive. Unlike you, who failed Ashinohara time and again, {Male=he;Female=she} is the perfect "savior."
Zuoyequnxing_48_11: But let's be brutally honest. This world doesn't have a second {PlayerName}. {Male=He;Female=She} saved Jinzhou and Rinascita... but what about Honami?
Zuoyequnxing_48_12: Solaris is full of dark corners like Honami, places the savior's light will never reach.
Zuoyequnxing_48_13: You, Miko of Flaming Sakura, have a gift. You might not fear the curse of the Threnodian or Lament.
Zuoyequnxing_48_14: But what of "them?" The weak, those not blessed by fate? And yet, is it really fair to place the weight of an entire world on a single pair of shoulders?
Zuoyequnxing_48_15: Solaris needs more saviors, doesn't it?
Zuoyequnxing_48_16: I'm just using the Threnodian to bring more of them into this world.
Zuoyequnxing_48_17: You mean... You want to use its power, the way {PlayerName} once did?
Zuoyequnxing_48_18: I've tried before. But a miracle like Fleurdelys requires a billion coincidences. And Mya? Nothing but the delusional ravings of Leviathan.
Zuoyequnxing_48_19: Even the one that appeared in Rinascita at the end... was just a hollow, mute shell.
Zuoyequnxing_48_20: But with your help? Everything changes. You could wield the Threnodian's power just as {PlayerName} did.
Zuoyequnxing_48_21: Honami would not be a ruin. And Ashinohara would finally have its true "savior."

Zuoyequnxing_48_25: But I will not discard my dignity as a human for it. I will not become the very horror I hate. Not even for retribution.
Zuoyequnxing_48_26: You stand on Honami's soil. You stand on a graveyard of millions.
Zuoyequnxing_48_27: Go on. Ask them if your "dignity as a human" matters... I think they'd tell you that simply staying alive is what matters.
Zuoyequnxing_48_28: Eternal Miko... you know your limits.
Zuoyequnxing_48_29: You've crawled through countless defeats, barely protecting Ashinohara from the Threnodian's assault. But what of the future? You are no savior like {PlayerName}.
Zuoyequnxing_48_30: When you fall, who will take up the Suzu? Who will walk this lonely, futile path next?
Zuoyequnxing_48_32: We could always talk about the former miko... The bodies of the Left Behind are ephemeral. You'll find I have a far more durable proposal...

Watching Rover's journey through Hiyuki's eyes, the Grand Architect lays out her philosophy. For everyone to be saved, more saviors have to be made—After all, the world can't rely on Rover alone. Beyond what one person can reach, how many others are like Hiyuki? Powerless. Trapped in the pain of failure. 
Faced with the Grand Architect's temptation, Hiyuk's hand finds her blade, but she hesitates to draw.

Side_mnwjndyj_5_3: This is the machine we built together a long time ago. It monitors Voidmatter fluctuations in real time.

Side_mnwjndyj_5_13: I still remember that day... The day we made that promise.
Side_mnwjndyj_5_14: These are all the memories I have left of her.
