Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_58_3: You're very much welcome. Quick, let's go inside and check it out.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_59_1: You can read past entries from this Terminal recording experiment data and logs. It seems it hasn't been updated for quite a while.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_59_2: "...After Phase 2 of the clinical trial, significant differences in Voidmatter particle tolerance were observed between the experimental and control groups. During this period, the experimental target's physiological activities remained normal, with frequency states experiencing intense fluctuations, but no irreversible collapse occurred."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_59_3: "Towards the end of the trial, all physiological indicators of the experimental group were normal, with no tissue abnormalities and no significant weight changes. This concludes Phase 2."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_59_4: Aside from the staggered experimental records, the Terminal only has a pre-installed game called Lahai-Roi Blocks.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_60_1: A cabinet filled with various medicines, predominantly from the New Federation, including nutritional agents, antibiotics, suppressants, and other drugs...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_60_2: Some of the labels have been replaced with handwritten tags like "Painkillers: Gross but work", "Sedatives: Somewhat sweet", and "For fevers."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_61_1: An ordinary refrigerator. It's stuffed with tightly wrapped compressed food in the same packaging.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_61_2: Looks a bit creepy... Want to try it?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_61_5: There is absolutely no texture or taste to it. It can hardly be qualified as food, though fortunately, you feel no discomfort after consuming it.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_62_1: An operating table with restraining devices. Beside it is a table placed with various surgical cutlery and sterilization tools, and an IV stand with a Fleet Snowfluff sticker.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_62_2: A pillow is tied to the head of the operating table... Would anyone really sleep on something like this?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_63_1: A desk stacked with books, including Startorch Academy textbooks. All books are carefully labeled, showing the owner's efforts to understand the knowledge stored inside.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_63_2: A carefully preserved photo album sits right in the center of the desk. Take a look?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_63_5: It's filled with photos of Denia. She's smiling in every picture.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_63_6: You wonder if more photos will be added to this album.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_64_1: You see a notice on the door: "Denia's Room. Keep Out!"
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_64_2: Denia might be on the other side of this door... Open it?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_1: A bubble containing weak fluctuating frequencies. Looks like someone left a message for you.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_3: I assume by the time you get here, {PlayerName}, everything will have ended. Sorry I had to say goodbye this way.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_4: This is where it all started. The Fractsidus's Lahai-Roi plan... where the Grand Architect first made contact with Aleph-1. And... where I was created.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_5: I took the Threnodian fragment the Fractsidus left here. Leaving it here would only cause more suffering... As for the experimental data, consider it a parting gift from me to the Spacetrek Collective.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_6: To be honest, I did think of telling you everything about this place.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_7: But sometimes gifts can be incredibly inappropriate. Your worries were correct. When the book page was removed, I received the Grand Architect's final message.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_8: Now, I am the last anchor point between Aleph-1 and Solaris. If I die according to plan, its fragment will disappear, along with me.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_9: I used to tell myself that was karma. But what does an ending like that mean for Sigrika? For Nastasha? For someone like you, who always tries to save everyone?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_10: You're the Grand Architect's greatest rival. So, making you betray your own heart is a bigger prize to them than the Threnodian fragment.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_11: It would mean that after all the frustration and failure, you're no different from them. You'd end up going down the same path.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_12: But if you had removed that page, the fragment would've lost control after receiving the message... It would've tried to find me, attempting to connect with Aleph-1 out of instinct.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_13: So, when I think about it... it's a good thing you never got to finish what you wanted to say back there.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_14: I was a child who showed up at the Fractsidus's door out of nowhere. Became their Threnodian lab mouse by accident. Ever since I can remember, they told me I existed for one reason... to make that moment happen.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_15: I've questioned myself countless times: What is the point of everything that I've been through?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_16: The answer is always the same. There is no point. Birth, pain, struggle, death... None of these have meaning.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_17: That's why when I first heard your story from the Grand Architect, I absolutely hated you, {PlayerName}.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_18: If someone like that is actually out there... then where were they during the longest, most painful days of my life?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_19: And why... why would you appear before me just as everything was about to end?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_20: You know what I hated most? Why did everything about you have to be so impossible?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_22: So, I hope you can forgive me for not saying goodbye. This is something I must put an end to on my own.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_23: It's just... it hurts to watch the way you live, {PlayerName}... I can't even imagine a day when someone like you runs out of miracles.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_24: They call you Rover, but you don't even know where you started or where you're going... Even if you made your ideals real... where would that leave you? Where is your happiness in all of that?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_25: I never understood what the Grand Architect was mumbling. The future, evolution, or what's going to happen eons later—
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_26: But at that moment, in front of Aleph-1, I didn't want you to die. At least not at the hands of the Grand Architect, who's got nothing left but mere survival.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_27: What surprised me was that... despite hating you so much, I actually spent such an unprecedented day with you.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_28: For the first time, I had my own birthday. For the first time, I forgot about the fear brought by the void. For the first time... I met someone I can truly open up to.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_29: How should I describe this emotion? It's a kind of hate, isn't it?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_30: I don't know where Voidmatter particles will take me next... if I could start over, I'd like to visit the cities Nastasha talked about, to visit places where there are no Void Storms and Soliskin.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_31: Maybe I'll try picking a different major, try napping in different classes, and taste different cakes in every cafeteria I go to...
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_32: Then, no matter how many times it'll take, I'll come back to Lahai-Roi, back to all of you.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_33: Whatever you wanted to say, you can tell me the next time we meet.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_34: Oh, I almost forgot something important... Actually, all those powers the Grand Architect displayed, including shapeshifting, are not her true Forte.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_35: Those are derivatives at best... And the shapeshifting has a catch: she needs long-term observation and analysis of her target to pull it off.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_36: It's just... the idea of her using my face to talk to you... it makes me sick. So let's have a code word. Just between us.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_37: Next time, if it's truly me... all my old "hates" will become "likes."
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_65_38: Oh, and could you help me enjoy half of my birthday cake? You can save the whole thing for me, of course. But don't you throw away any of the toppings.
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_67_1: {PlayerName}... Will we ever see Denia again?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_67_3: Okay... But, what about the thing you didn't get to say, {PlayerName}?
Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_67_4: "If you feel you don't belong here, then some day in the future, would you be willing to..." And? What about the rest?
AYRLSJWFBC_1_1: The terrain of the Dimmr Plains is difficult, and several areas are still contaminated by Voidmatter.
AYRLSJWFBC_1_2: I've done my best to guide the Soliskin, but with so few Shepherds, many are still scattered across the Plains.
AYRLSJWFBC_1_3: If you happen to come across any lost Soliskin, could you tell them to find me here?
AYRLSJWFBC_1_4: The Giant Soliskin and I will be waiting here until they've all found their way home.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_28_1: I didn't expect there to be a place like this beneath Rabelle College.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_28_2: Before Sundermere base was built, this was a research facility for Augmented Resonance Effects and Void Storm countermeasures. It's been decommissioned for years.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_28_3: The Executive Committee told me I could do whatever I wanted with the space. So I used my Forte to do some light remodeling.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_28_4: Memories of my students that should exist only in my mind, here... they become real. A tangible piece to display.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_28_5: You're using your Forte to do all this? How long did it take you to create this?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_28_6: However long it took, it was worth it... So the ones who "stay" don't just stay, and the ones who "leave" don't just leave.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_28_7: We still have some time. If you're interested, feel free to look around.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_29_1: The exhibits we're looking for are here.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_29_3: Don't forget, this is my Memory Palace. Naturally, memory locks require memory keys to unlock.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_29_4: Allow me to demonstrate—This fancy trick only works in this little domain of mine.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_1: This is the very reason I built this exhibition hall in the first place.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_6: You spaced out there. Are you alright?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_7: I'm fine. Just had a dream that only lasted a few seconds. Rather fascinating.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_8: Maybe it's a good idea to rest before the review starts?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_9: Don't worry. I promise you I'll crash the second this is over. But right now, we must bring these exhibits with us.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_10: Will a few exhibits be enough to sway them?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_12: (She usually knows exactly how to sell anything, so why does she look so hesitant now?)
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_17: Thank you for your trust. I know you have a thousand questions burning in your mind.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_18: "How will she handle the New Fed?" "What's her plan for the Synchronists with the Exostrider gone?" Forgive me for not having the answers just yet.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_19: I know you'd never harm the students. That's the only answer I need.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_20: I... Terrible timing for a compliment, {PlayerName}.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_21: Anyway. Let's take these two exhibits and—
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_23: Some kind of force pulled us down here. Do you know where we are?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_24: If my memory serves, we're directly beneath the exhibition hall.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_31_26: During your pursuit of the exhibits with Lucilla, a mysterious girl suddenly appears. While you and Lucilla are left briefly dazed, she teleports you both to another research facility. Lucilla, however, seems very familiar with the place.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_33_1: A Synchronist's cockpit? Was this the prototype?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_33_2: It looks the part, but this was actually our "Plan B." Designed without safety limiters to get sync rates up quick. Lets a Synchronist pilot the Exostrider by force.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_33_4: I know, I know. It was meant as a last resort if civilization was staring down extinction. The project was terminated after the initial trials.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_33_5: The Synchronists who volunteered... In the end, they lost their ability to resonate with the Exostrider ever again.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_33_6: What our students are facing now isn't new.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_33_7: I just hope I can do better by them this time.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_4: Fine, no more jokes. Honestly, anyone watching would think you're the one facing the board. There, there, I know the way out.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_5: Remember what I told you before entering the Dark Side? About the memories I erase periodically that can never be recovered?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_6: Some things... I can't bear to remember, but I also can't bear to forget, so I store them here. Looks like some of them are tired of being locked up...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_7: {PlayerName}, look up. The exit is right above. We can use this <ano=Photo>key</ano> to leave. But I need your help to get there.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_8: Everything here is from my memory, but I know you are real. And wherever you are, that must be reality.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_9: I understand. I'll be your reference point. But what about that girl? Are we just leaving her?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_10: {PlayerName}, do you have any experience dealing with children? Tell me, what makes a child the most flustered when they're playing hide-and-seek?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_34_12: Now, come along. Let's treat this little escape as a warm-up for the review.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_35_1: Welcome to the Anti-Voidmatter Materials Lab. It's where they first developed the materials for the Academy's Antivoid Canopy.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_35_2: What's all of that in the center of the room?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_35_3: The scrap of the day. Even the best recycling can only keep up with so much.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_35_4: Let's look around to see if there are any leads.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_36_1: Only one in a thousand makes the cut. Which means nine hundred ninety-nine don't.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_36_2: People see the Antivoid Canopy and praise its ingenuity. They'll never get to see the blueprints of the ones who were rejected.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_2: Oh, dear me. This is but a pale imitation.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_3: Among the Synchronists who survived the experiments, there was one from Jinzhou. Once he realized he'd never resonate with the Exostrider, he returned home and joined the Ministry of Development's Defense Division.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_4: There, he and his colleagues worked together to develop Jinzhou's Retroact Rain defenses.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_5: You're saying the shields against Retroact Rain and Void Storms share the same origin?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_6: Not exactly. His approach didn't work on Void Storms at all... and it was discarded. Long ago.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_7: Before he left the Academy, the only things he asked to take with him were a few sheets of material buried under that pile of junk.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_8: I often wonder... was he just reluctant to let go of his design? Or had he already mapped out how to protect his hometown?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_9: The girl who trapped us here... She must be trying to show us something through this memory.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_10: Hmm. Seems I've been getting schooled by my own students a lot lately...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_37_11: Let's go. It's time to move on to the next "classroom."
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_38_1: Well... we made quite the headway there, didn't we?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_38_2: That said, I'm glad to see we're at least moving.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_38_3: Let's keep heading upwards. We'll find our way out soon enough.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_39_4: Stay where I can see you, {PlayerName}. We've wandered into an unpleasant memory.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_39_5: It's far too easy to get lost in here...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_39_6: It doesn't look like there's a way to cross the barrier ahead.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_39_8: {PlayerName}, just go with me on this, alright?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_40_1: Clear as day, Madam. Your daughter isn't sick. She has awakened her Forte, and it's a remarkably rare memory-type.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_40_2: Congratulations! I'm certain she'll make an immense contribution to the New Federation one day.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_40_3: Nonsense! My Luci will never become a Resonator!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_40_5: I don't want to be a Resonator. Please... no!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_41_2: (Without a "reference point", she's getting pulled into the deep end of her memories. I need to find her before too much time passes.)
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_4: What do you want me to say?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_6: This is the perfect moment—while our opponents are spread too thin, we take the reins. Just like the time you became President...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_7: Don't worry about the narrative. We'll play the villain. You just act tough, rope the independent auditor in, and we'll force another round of review.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_8: You fight hard. We express our "concerns." And then... we both take a step back. As long as we ensure our control over the future of the Synchronist Program, nothing else matters.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_9: And what do you want from my students?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_10: Simple. We both get what we want. They have talent, and we help them achieve their dreams. And it'll be their choice.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_11: Their choice? Whose dreams are we really achieving?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_12: It will be their choice, Lucilla. My Luci. I won't speak of your past choices, but tell me, has there been a single choice that wasn't your own?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_14: There. Just like that. "Act tough," "fight hard," and then we both "take a step back" at the review...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_15: From the Academy to the Pioneer Association, then to the Spacetrek Collective, and now here… No wonder I was never cut out to be President.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_16: Watch out! That's "me" from the Dark Side. I used this memory to trap her.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_17: When are you going to tell {Male=him;Female=her}, Professor Lucilla? President Lucilla? That you've already made a deal with the New Federation?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_19: You think you can outrun yourself, Lucilla?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_22: Your plan... Are you just following the New Federation's playbook?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_23: Don't let her get to you. How could I ever sell out my students? I have a plan, it's just...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_24: Before the meeting starts, I need you to take the time to fill me in on what's really happening.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_25: Thank you. I promise, I'd never let the New Federation lay a single finger on my students. But...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_26: That's just her wishful thinking. A moth to the flame, daring the sky with wings of wax.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_27: Your students will die because of you!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_29: You reunite with Lucilla within one of her memories, and unexpectedly learn that she had been hiding something from you: apparently, the New Federation has already offered a secret deal with her.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_43_1: Is this it? This is as far as we've got?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_43_2: That just means we'd better pick up the pace.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_44_1: Once again, I found the courage to step into this room. Time flows here, silent and peaceful, and the Academy is alive and thriving. We've come so much further than I ever dreamed. I wish you were here to see it.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_1: Is that Sundermere? Are we back before the Starward Riseway was even built?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_2: Most of the students who lost their Synchronist status in those forced sync trials decided to return home. All but one.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_3: She told me it wasn't that she'd lost the Exostrider. The Exostrider had lost her.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_4: She said she'd designed a revolutionary transport method.  A "rocket piercing the sky." A way to bridge that "sky" and the "earth."
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_5: This was the day she tested it. Her first crewed flight.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_6: Then that wasn't a falling star. It was—
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_7: A spacecraft. Carrying the most brilliant student I've ever known.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_8: Amiya to Sundermere Lookout. Professor, can you hear me?!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_10: The weather couldn't be more perfect today! Oh, and I just saw a super huge Soliskin! I'll snap a picture for you as soon as I can!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_12: Professor? You don't sound like your usual self. Are those investors giving you a hard time again?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_13: No, it's not that. I just... I haven't slept much lately. I'm a little tired. That's all.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_16: Hey, remember that old Huanglong saying? "Know the way at dawn, and... and something-something at dusk?" Ugh, it went right out of my head!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_18: That's okay! I'll look it up and tell you the second the experiment is over!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_21: From the way it fell, Voidmatter must've pierced the shielding mid-flight. But if we'd reinforced the coating... Hmm...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_22: What kind of civilization do you think built the Exostrider? If they were that advanced... do you think they'd already defeated the Threnodians? Overcome the Lament?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_23: But before they reached the stars, they must have fallen too. Again and again.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_24: Go. Be our eyes. Walk with humanity.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_25: Please give this to our teacher. Humanity's smallest step... and everything we had to give.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_27: You eventually glimpse the source of Lucilla's inner conflict. In her early years, she approved an experiment that allowed a student to chase a dream, only for it to result in that student's death. This still leaves her deeply burdened with guilt.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_49_1: Lucilla, your emotions are affecting this domain! It's dangerous!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_49_2: Staying here is the real danger. We have to leave.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_50_2: As long as we keep moving upward, we'll find the way out.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_1: So this is why you wouldn't tell me what your plan was.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_2: This "way out" you've been building for the Synchronists... It's just a dead end, isn't it?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_3: I don't want the New Federation to lay their dirty hands on my students. But the more I think about it rationally, the more I realize I can't reject their offer.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_4: Because on what grounds can I propose a plan that might kill them?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_5: I think I know why that girl trapped you here.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_7: You're terrified that your proposal will be their end.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_8: You're afraid because you know they'll support any plan you bring to the table.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_10: Because no one in this world understands them the way you do.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_11: Another lesson from my own student, huh...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_51_13: You hand Lucilla the prototype entrusted to you by the mysterious girl. Feeling the sincerity behind it, Lucilla finds the courage to face the truth.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_52_1: I hope humanity can soar even higher!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_52_2: I hope humanity can venture even farther!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_52_3: I hope humanity can weather any storm!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_52_5: My dream? My dream is simply to see all of yours come true.

Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_10: Do you always get up so early?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_11: Ah. Didn't realize the sun was already up.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_12: I haven't gotten any shut-eye yet. Didn't realize the sun was already up.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_13: So what's all this you've got going on, President Lucilla?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_14: Right... what am I even working on? After the hero defeats the demon king, shouldn't we all be enjoying our "happily ever after"?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_15: But here I am, burning the midnight oil like I'm part of some sleep deprivation experiment. Hmph.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_16: A former colleague from the Pioneer Association taught me how to make this special coffee blend. Want a sip?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_20: Oh, it's a favorite among the Goldrunners in the New Federation. Packs a punch. Heh, sometimes a little too much of a punch.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_22: (Ask about the photo of her student days.)
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_24: I saw that group shot of you and the students.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_25: What's the story behind that giant Soliskin photo?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_27: It wasn't the most thrilling time, but it certainly left me with some memorable moments.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_28: Now I'm around students every day, but it's hard not to notice how far I've drifted from their world.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_29: I didn't know you worked with Verina before. She helped me out back in Jinzhou.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_30: Oh! So that's where that girl went. Makes sense. The New Federation isn't the best place for a gifted Resonator like her in the long run.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_31: Maybe I should invite her to the Academy... She could keep me company while I drown in overtime.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_32: You look different now than you did in that photo.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_33: Yes, I suppose I do—Ahem, I was a bit slimmer back then, wasn't I?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_34: Ah, that one. One of my students took it. Shame I never got to see that Soliskin with my own eyes.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_35: Must be twice a person's height, at least from the picture. Can a Soliskin even grow that large?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_36: Do you plan to tell me what I'm really doing here?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_37: Alright, {PlayerName}. Technically, I shouldn't be asking a student this, so let's just call it a casual chat between friends.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_38: So, um, from a purely administrative standpoint... is there a chance that...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_39: Certain "unverified intel" I share with you off the record could, through private channels, somehow influence an inspection report issued by a particular independent international organization?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_41: Can you please explain that in a way even a Fluffguin could understand?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_42: Ahem. I mean... what's your network like at the Black Shores? Got any real pull there?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_44: Do you really want to know?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_45: I'll be straightforward, {PlayerName}. Startorch Academy has been in a bit of a bind ever since the Exostrider and Aleph-1 left Lahai-Roi.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_46: As you can see, our investors are reassessing the Academy's value now that the Exostrider is gone. They're holding a review next week to discuss new management policies moving forward.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_47: Before that happens, I pulled some strings to get a third-party agency in for an independent investigation. Whatever they put in their report will steer the whole review.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_48: So you brought in the Black Shores to audit Startorch? When's this happening?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_49: Dr. Luuk is waiting for the auditor at the Starward Riseway as we speak. They'll be here any minute.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_50: Now, {PlayerName}, I'm not about to interfere with an independent audit. But I'd like you to be there during this visit. And if possible...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_51: You want me to put in a good word?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_52: No need. Just make sure they see the Academy for what it really is. My students can speak for themselves.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_53: Dr. Luuk and the auditor have arrived. Shall we?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_960_1: What's the weather like at the Black Shores?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_960_2: Umm... It doesn't really change much.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_960_4: A bit better than what we get here.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_960_6: Hah... my students who joined the Black Shores barely write to me. Even when they do, they never mention their daily lives.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_960_7: If I do get a sudden call out of nowhere, it's just "Professor! I have a question!"
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_960_8: Adorable little gremlins, all of them... As long as they're safe, that's what matters.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_961_2: When was the last time you slept?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_961_5: Hehe, I did keep track of that.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_978_3: —Any instrument that nears the Etheric Sea...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_978_5: I am well aware of that.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_978_6: However, by relying on Augmented Resonance Effects...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_978_7: The Academy can overcome that barrier.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_978_11: Is that a chance you're willing to take?
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_978_14: If the answer lies beyond death—
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_978_19: Will pierce the sky for all to see!
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_56: You receive an invitation to Lucilla's office, where you learn that the Academy is facing an independent review from a third party, the Black Shores. Lucilla invites you to accompany her in receiving the Black Shores' auditor.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_11_34: In an unexpected turn, the auditor from the Black Shores is Aalto. On the other hand, Aalto is also caught off guard by the Academy's "warm welcome." In the end, Lucilla puts a stop to the drama and invites Aalto on a tour of Rabelle College.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_12_27: After exchanging intel with Lynae, you discover that Rabelle College is facing a review concerning its legal operations. Yet Lucilla's attitude remains ambiguous. It feels she needs your help, but hasn't told you the whole story...
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_13_39: Aalto and Lucilla's tour of Rabelle College is a complete chaos. The Synchronists either doze off during class or skip it entirely. Aalto also seems to have something to tell you in private. You agree to keep in touch through WavesLine.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_16_59: Aalto briefs you on the current situation. The upcoming review will determine Rabelle College's survival. Meanwhile, the Black Shores is wavering over whether to get involved in this dispute for Lucilla's sake. In the end, they choose to leave the decision to you on where the Black Shores should stand.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_24_39: A rushed experiment goes awry. Although the situation is brought under control immediately, the failed experiment becomes the final straw that pushes Lenie over the edge. "Professor, is it true that no one cares about us now that the Exostrider is gone?" she asked. "I care," Lucilla answered.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_56_54: The review begins, and Lucilla and Permanent Secretary Kamerel engage in a sharp exchange over the Synchronists. In the end, Kamerel proposes a solution in which "both take a step back," and Lucilla realizes it's only the gilded cage they prepared. The final battle has only just begun.
Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_61_4: The dust has settled, and Lucilla can no longer fight off her drowsiness and falls into a deep sleep. As if in a dream, and yet also in reality, the Spacetrek Collective Executive Committee has made its decision: we will, once again, challenge the sky.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_11_20: Can't say I trust you yet... but...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_11_24: Won't forget it. Your name... or your help.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_12_3: The monster on your tail just before.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_14_18: …Lucy? Yo, gotta snap out of it!

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_13: Head's still ringin' a bit, but otherwise seem to be fine.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_14: Crazy as it sounds... Not sure we're in our world anymore, if that's even the right word.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_30: Not bad, you little turd. You're growin' on me!

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_36: (Appearing suddenly in the Somnoire. Unknown modification tech. Using unfamiliar terms. No knowledge of Echoes and Tacet Discords...)
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_37: Maybe... the two of you really are from another universe.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_42: I'm looking to find the source of the disturbance and end it. To do that, I need a complete picture.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_43: How did you get here? Where did that Nightmare Tacet Discord come from? I'm hoping you can give me some kind of explanation.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_44: Rebecca... This might take a minute.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_45: Whatever. This crap's way over my head anyway.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_15_47: You return to Startorch Academy. Rebecca gawks at the unfamiliar world. Lucy deduces that they have crossed into another universe, aligning with your own conclusion. To prove they are not a threat, Lucy shows you the events that led to your initial encounter.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_33_20: 'Course, lotta peeps don't do it just for the money, but to make a name for themselves – to become legends.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_33_21: Yeah, think that's the best way I can sum it up.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_52_5: ...Just take care of the wounded. I'll handle this.

Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_3: I'll stall 'em long as I can. {PlayerName}... My crew will be here soon.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_6: Lucy... listen... Do not resist... Everything will be easier.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_7: You want to see David, don't you? If you remain in the dream, I can make it a reality.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_9: Do not lie to yourself. What reason do you have to return to that cold, empty world?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_10: Accept my offer. All of us win. Or... would you rather see everyone slaughtered?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_13: Tacet Discords took my father. I train and sweat to make sure no one else suffers the same fate.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_14: I won't let that happen this time!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_15: F*ck you! Get away from them!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_17: Don't know when to quit, do ya?! Show your face if you got the balls. Quit hidin' in that distortion field!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_18: Listen up, you freak, or corpo lapdog or whatever you are! I'll blow ya to bits!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_19: Big words for a tiny punk...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_22: Not really, meow! It's only an illusion the Nightmare made from your memories. Not the real person you know!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_23: Scrap, all of you—only a matter of time.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_24: Lucy struggles to hold the line alone. You arrive just in time to turn the tide. Rebecca taunts the one hunting Lucy, and it finally sheds its distortion field to reveal its true identity—Night City's deadliest merc, Adam Smasher, in the form of a Nightmare Tacet Discord.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_4: Of all the faces to wear, had to be Adam Smasher's... That Nightmare TD chose a grade-A piece of sh*t.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_6: Night City's boogeyman of legend, and Arasaka's top hitman.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_7: Bastard's chromed to the gills, nothin' 'ganic left in him. More killing machine than man.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_8: And he'll zero anyone 'Saka tells him to. Back in Night City...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_9: Anyway, just know that jerkwad's not someone you wanna mess with!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_10: We're in the clear now. The evacuated researchers were unharmed. Are you feeling all right?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_11: I'm fine... Just need a sec.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_12: The students you protected have been sent for treatment. They asked me to send their gratitude.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_14: I contained the Nightmare Tacet Discord by sealing the data rifts. But judging from what we saw, it's only a matter of time before it breaks out again.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_15: That's a bad sign. We need to collect all the Dream Band shards ASAP, meow.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_16: ...Wish it were that simple. Their locations are being jammed by the spreading frequency. Even I can't pinpoint them.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_17: You mentioned that the Dream Band and the Nightmare Tacet Discord have opposing frequencies.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_18: If we can analyze this shard's frequency, could we use it to cut through the interference and pinpoint the other shards?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_19: Meow?! That's clever! Never tried it, but in theory… it should work!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_20: The frequency analysis... could the Institute handle it?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_21: We want to help resolve this Somnoire incident, as well.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_22: Ms. Lucy... you can trust us.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_54_24: Smasher withdraws, but the shock of the revelation lingers. You and the Ivory Gatekeeper agree that the clock is ticking to reverse-engineer the abnormal frequency and track down the Dream Band shards. Lucy accepts Mornye's help and agrees to stand with the Institute to end this.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_1: Now let's discuss getting Lucy back home, meow.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_2: This is a first for me. From her description, Lucy crossed into Solaris through the Somnoire while dreaming.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_3: That means there must be a gateway connecting the two universes. Pass through it, and she can return to her world.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_4: That gateway should be in the deepest layer of the Somnoire. The place where the dreamer's most precious memories are held.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_5: But I can't sense its exact location, either. You'll need to find a way to reach it yourselves.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_6: What about the Ebony Gatekeeper? Where is he now?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_7: Handling other sectors of the Somnoire. The contamination is spreading there, too. He's a bit swamped, meow.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_8: Now, though I can't help you directly, I'll do my best to give you a last-ditch escape plan.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_9: If the worst happens, I'll activate it to get you to safety.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_10: A last-ditch escape plan? Gotta admit, that does sound cool.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_11: You'll know it when you see it... But I sure hope you won't need to.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_1: Mentor... Before you set out, there's something I want to discuss with you.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_2: The Nightmare Tacet Discords we're facing are unique. Their frequencies can somehow weaken and neutralize our weapons' attacks.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_3: As the abnormal frequency continues to spread, data rifts are also appearing more frequently.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_4: If another intrusion occurs, the Academy likely won't be able to hold them back with what we have right now.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_7: Easy. Counter them with the same frequency!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_8: Both Lucy and Rebecca's weapons are capable of this. Rebecca's firearm, in particular, demonstrates remarkable efficacy against Nightmare Tacet Discords.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_9: So, what you're sayin' is... I'm the heavy hitter?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_10: Yep. Maybe it's also your Resonance Ability.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_13: On that point... we don't have a definitive answer yet. Our theory is that their frequencies are somehow counterbalanced by your power of Separation.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_14: While we can't fully decode your power, we can study and replicate the frequency signatures of Lucy and Rebecca's weapons, applying it to our own armaments.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_15: So, Ms. Rebecca, would you be...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_16: Ya wanna study my guns? Sure, no prob.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_17: We created this mess. Should prolly do our part to mop it up.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_18: I might as well stick around. Any more of those freaks show up, I'll send 'em packin'!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_19: That gonk would rather see your face than mine when he's back anyway.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_20: The Dream Band's analysis is complete. You can trace the other shards in the Somnoire with your Terminals now.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_21: Just go get the shards. Meet up with you chooms once they're done eyeballin' my iron.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_22: ...Take mine. If those things hit again, you'll need to fight back.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_23: Pfft, yeah... OK, Mom... Then what about you? You'd be unarmed.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_24: Ms. Lucy, you're welcome to use one of the Academy's weapons. It won't be the same, but it's better than nothing.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_25: Really. {PlayerName} will have my back. I'll be fine.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_26: Hey, keep this dumbass safe 'til I can make it there.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_27: To brace for a probable mass-scale invasion, the Academy has rolled out defenses all around. What we lack at the moment are some frequency samples to finish the calibration.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_28: You all discuss next moves. Rebecca agrees to stay behind to let Mornye's team study her weapons, while you and Lucy re-enter the Somnoire to search for the remaining Dream Band shards.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_1: It will take a while to study your weapon, Ms. Rebecca. Do you have something to do in the meantime?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_2: You can stop callin' me "Ms. Rebecca." Ain't my vibe, like, at all. Just Rebecca's fine.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_3: ...I see. Then what do you plan to do now, Rebecca?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_4: I'll be bored outta my gourd just sittin' here. Think I'll take a stroll 'round the Academy.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_5: Yeah, I can run this spray can back to Lynae. And hey, shootin' the sh*t with Sigrika over some video games sounds pretty chill.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_6: Ah... I didn't realize you were already acquainted with Sigrika.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_7: Right now, they're likely still investigating a spatial anomaly together.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_8: ...We received a report not long ago.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_9: A wall and the ambient frequencies around it were overwritten, turning them into a state of static drift.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_10: Lynae also reported seeing a graffiti-like image at the anomaly's center. But we still don't fully understand what happened. The investigation isn't over yet.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_2: Choom, c'mon... Rather you used my name.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_5: I was just on my way to check on Verma and Fenella.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_6: Oh, here! Try this can, Coach Rebecca!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_7: It's the newest flavor. Maybe you'll like it!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_8: You guys live off cans, too? Eh... Sure, why not.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_9: I should be on my way now. See you next time, Coach Rebecca!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_1: It doesn't look like any Royan rune I've seen. Ring any bells, Sigrika?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_2: Mysterious graffiti appearing out of nowhere... Not Lahai-Roi lettering, but not a rune either...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_3: Hmm... this feels shifty. Smells like a conspiracy to me!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_5: Ran into a snag. We're trying to track down whoever did this...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_6: You mean this graffiti? On the wall here?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_7: You're lookin' right at her! Preem, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_8: So that's how it was... So it still looked totally normal when you left...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_9: What if the Somnoire is somehow behind its change? Come to think of it, their frequency readings do seem similar.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_10: Well, at least it's not a trap. That's the good news! Now, we just need fix the strange static drift.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_11: Hmm... Does this graffiti have a certain meaning?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_12: That's David's tag. The gonk sprayed it on his jacket, used it kinda like a signature.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_14: Yeah. David was our choom. Back in Night City...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_15: Look, you can tell I'm not like you guys. It's pretty obvious I'm not from your world, ain't it?!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_16: Jeez, kids here are sharp... Anyway, good. Makes layin' out the facts easier.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_17: We're edgerunners—mercs, essentially. Walk a fine line 'tween gettin' paid big and gettin' flatlined.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_18: This too much of downer for you, or what?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_19: Absolutely not! I actually want to know more about Night City!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_20: What about David's story...? You curious?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_21: He was a total rookie when I met him, fresh off chippin' his Sandevistan.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_23: A high-end piece of cyberware. Flick it on and—BOOM–you're lightning fast, and rest of the world looks like it's in slow-mo.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_24: Sounds nova, right? But runnin' chrome like that takes a toll... A big one.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_25: But David handled the Sandy like a pro, proved he was special... Just like that, he was one of us.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_26: Then... sh*t started to go sideways....
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_27: Lost my idiot brother first. Got his head blown off in a back alley 'cause he wouldn't mind his own biz.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_28: Then Maine, head of our crew... Got the raw end of a job gone wrong.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_29: Didn't matter how much military-grade chrome he was packin'... Couldn't save his ass in the end.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_30: ...I missed out on that whole damn gig. But the look on David's face that day? That, I remember.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_31: Everything changed after that. David kept chroming up. Got stronger. Took over for Maine as leader of the crew.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_32: Wouldn't stop pushin' himself. Told him to ease off the upgrades, but... was like talkin' to a wall.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_33: Guess he just... couldn't stand the thought of losin' anyone else.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_34: Well, same goes for me! Gonna protect that dork 'til the very end!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_35: I think you could like this place... At least, I hope you get to enjoy Academy life while you're here.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_36: Well, these ain't my streets, so... Prolly gotta bounce sooner rather'n later...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_37: Hey, no way you're passing through without signing the guestbook first!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_38: ...Hell yeah! I like how you think, choom!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_39: Heh, bored with all the chitchat anyway...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_40: Time to knock the rust off!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_60_41: Rebecca finds Lynae and Sigrika examining a graffiti tag, the same one she sprayed earlier. She looks at its now-digitalized form and tells them about the person it represents—David.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_61_1: Mornye? Sh*t, you gotta call now? I'm a little busy!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_61_2: We just finished the weapon's analysis. I've arranged for remote configuration. Lynae and Sigrika, your attacks should be effective now.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_61_3: Oh yeah, it's working! Great, now it's showtime!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_61_4: Scratch what I just said... Your timing was perfect!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_62_1: F*ckers! Eat sh*t and die already!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_62_2: Fall into the nightmare... Embrace your slumber...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_62_3: Ugh, shut your glitchin' pie holes!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_1: ...Another shard? No wonder those freaks were swarmin' the place!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_2: And here I thought you couldn't fight! Talk about a nice surprise!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_3: So... this is one of the Dream Band shards Professor Mornye mentioned?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_4: Yep. Guessin' that's what drew the Nightmare TDs to the Academy.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_5: Sorry... Dragged you two into this mess.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_6: Whoa whoa, don't gotta be like that with us!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_7: I think this is more of a "celebration" moment than a "sorry" one!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_8: Sooo... any idea what this shard's doing here?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_9: Maybe... David felt that someone was missing him, and it just... appeared?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_10: Ooh! That's the version I'm choosing to believe.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_11: Felt someone missin' him...? Heh, sure, I'll buy that.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_12: Right, now that that's wrapped up, gotta go grab my iron from Mornye and meet up with Luce.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_13: You chooms keep my masterpiece safe while I'm out 'n' about, 'kay?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_14: Sure, I'll keep it fresh in the meantime. We're tagging again when you're back!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_15: And you have to tell us about you next time!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_16: But… they left a while ago…
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_17: Do you know how you're gonna catch up?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_18: C'mon, I'm sure Rebecca's already got a plan, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_19: GAAAAAHHH! Falco! Where the hell's your jank-ass ride when I need it?! Sh*t, sh*t, SH*T!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_20: Not sure who this "Falco" is, but I've got an idea if you need to chase 'em down...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_21: After repelling another Nightmare Tacet Discord attack, Rebecca recovers the Dream Band shard that appears. She says goodbye to Sigrika and Lynae and heads into the Somnoire to back up you and Lucy.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_1: Is this... Night City? No, it's different from what I remember... What's goin' on here?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_2: Lahai-Roi seems to have affected your dreamscape.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_3: The frequencies of both are mixing together. What we're seeing is the overlap.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_4: ...Got a problem. Too much signal noise. It's affecting the tracker.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_8: My head's still spinning. Just a little. Nothing I can't power through.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_10: Another high-tech city, but nothing like Startorch Academy, is it?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_11: Y'know, Night City was never really home. Just somewhere I lived for a while.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_14: Can't say I love it or hate it. Some peeps see it as a place to plant roots, others—a place to escape from.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_15: It's true I once found a sense of comfort there. But now... feels more like a bad memory I'd rather forget.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_64_16: You and Lucy push deeper into the Somnoire and discover the abnormal frequency has reshaped it to mimic Lucy's memories of her world. With Abby's help, you follow the frequency signature the Academy decoded to track down the remaining Dream Band shard.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_65_1: Those translucent figures... Saw 'em mentioned in the files I scanned before.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_65_2: Reverberations that carry messages from the past, right?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_66_1: You sure about signing up for this the data run? Listen, Void Storms have been picking up recently. We get caught in one... that's it. No coming back.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_66_2: I've had my time, but you... you've still got your whole life ahead.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_66_3: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't scared. But this chance… it might be the only one we get.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_66_4: If we can figure out what this Threnodian really is, then maybe others can come up with the right measures to fight it.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_66_5: Dad, I'm doing this for the same reason you are... I want my little Rui to have a safe, happy future here in Lahai-Roi.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_66_6: ...When did you learn to talk so pretty? Alright. Gear up. We roll out soon.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_67_2: The bane of civilization. Something we've always been fighting against.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_67_3: That's one helluva system threat... Can't imagine how to win against something like that.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_68_1: So, what exactly are the kids at Startorch even learning all day?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_68_2: I saw a schedule once. Names and times in a crammed sheet. Many courses I did not know.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_68_3: Probably just a different department's course list. Back when I was a Rabelle College student, my major was in Phase-Coating Material Sciences.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_68_4: ...Doesn't sound like much fun to me. Hope you got some interesting stories out of it, hmm?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_68_5: I don't know... losing a bet and having to confess to my crush in public right outside the dorms?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_68_6: You have my attention now. Details, don't be stingy!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_69_1: Any interesting moments from your student life?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_69_2: ...There's been a few. But nothing like that.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_70_1: You seeing this, Mom? I'm strong enough to protect others now.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_70_2: I saved a kid from the Tacet Discords. Got her to the escape pod, just like how you saved me back then.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_70_3: Did I do it right, Mom? Will you... be proud of me?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_78_1: Looks like we're on the Nightmare TDs' radar now.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_78_2: Let's move this along, finish 'em 'fore Adam Smasher shows.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_79_1: The band's frequency is coming from behind this door. Ugh, my head's spinning again.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_79_4: Nah, it's nothing. But I'll have to take a nap. Just holler if you need me!
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_1: Well, not what I expected to find...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_3: David's and my place. Or... somethin' like it was.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_4: Not the same exactly, but mostly how I remember it.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_5: Always ran ads late at night. For anything you could think of, even tickets to the Moon.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_6: Y'know, wasn't even as crazy expensive as you might think.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_7: We just... weren't ready for it. Not yet.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_8: David couldn't stand the smell of smoke. Couldn't stomach fizzy drinks, either.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_9: But he'd always buy 'em, kept the fridge stocked. For me.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_10: As for smoking... I pretty much quit once we got together.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_11: When he couldn't sleep, David would just sit here.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_12: Sometimes he'd turn on the TV, stare at the screen... zone out.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_13: ...The more chrome he installed, the more often I'd catch him sittin' here.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_14: Gloria was David's mom. Worked herself to the bone for him, his future. Then she died in an accident.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_15: After that, David dropped outta school, became an edgerunner.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_16: Beyond the door lies the home David and Lucy once shared. Lucy looks at the familiar objects and begins to reminisce.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_4: He just... never got to see his dream come true. Smasher took that from him.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_5: The Ivory Gatekeeper said there's no such thing as dying in the Somnoire.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_6: As long as we find the other Dream Band shards and piece them together, we can see him again.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_7: Not talkin' about my dream. Talkin' about reality.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_8: Adam Smasher... Night City's top merc... Arasaka's most loyal attack dog...
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_9: At the foot of Arasaka Tower that day... He killed Rebecca. Then he killed David.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_10: Then… the Rebecca with us now is…
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_11: A ghost. Like David, she's just... a phantom born from my dreams.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_1: Hell of a backdrop, isn't it?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_2: The lights, this city, this... whole dream.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_3: Every day, people flood into Night City chasin' something. Nobodies dreamin' of becoming legends.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_4: Ever wonder why the Nightmare TD wears Smasher's face? Why it puppets corpo husks?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_5: Is it because… you're afraid of them, deep down?
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_7: I thought escaping to Night City would let me leave my worries behind… but all I found was a brief respite.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_8: During that time, I joined Maine's crew. And that's where... I met David.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_9: He stuck it out at school best he could, took all the bullying... All for his mom's dream.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_10: Same thing with our crew. A little recognition from Maine, and he was fully committed. No lookin' back.
Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_11: ...He was good. Truly good. A person like that... rare breed in Night City.

Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_480_67: I can feel it. A deep, lingering... longing.

GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_1: Welcome to the first live-action interactive project in the land of Xuanfang, the "Trapped Kernel Puppet under the Five-Fox Mountain"!
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_4: Ah, this is no simple case of an Autopuppet trapped beneath a rock. It's a classic scene from the "Chronicles of the Eastern Peaks"!
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_5: Legend has it, there was a cultivator who sought to rid himself of worldly distractions. Inspired by the storybook, he locked himself away at the foot of a mountain to meditate in silence, and stuck a sealing talisman on the mountainside.
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_6: What kind of story is that?
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_7: I don't get it. I'm outta here.
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_8: Wait! I actually rented this Kernel Puppet from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and I even had to write a long application letter to get it. Please, just do me a favor...
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_9: Alright, what do you need me to do?
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_10: Just follow the story and remove the talisman on the mountainside to "rescue" the Autopuppet.
GNNPC_WYGSTCD_162_12: Oh, I bought that from a young Taoist who visited Xuanfang Hold. She had a real knack for fortune-telling.

GNNPC_WYGSTCD_164_9: Yes, I'm a Xuanfang native. It's such a beautiful place, so I want more people to know about it.

Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_1_1:
Dear Rover,

How are you finding your time at Startorch Academy? I find myself wondering how long the sunlight I basked in today will take to reach you.

Lately... I have been having the same dream. In it, I am alone in the Gorges of Spirits, running and running... And just when it seems I am about to find something, something always pulls me back to reality.

Does that sound like I am complaining? Forgive me. Once in a while, I hope you will not mind if I write like this.

Oh, yes. Some time ago, my older sister said she wanted to come visit me in Jinzhou. It's been years since we last saw each other. I wonder what she is like now, but knowing her, I think she must still be the same sister I remember. I would like to introduce you two someday. I'm sure you would become very good friends.  

I assume by the time you receive this letter, Chixia and I will be on an assignment together. Things have been a little unsettled in Jinzhou lately, but do not worry. Just as you have sharpened your blade through so many stories and trials, I would like to think I have grown too, since the day we first met.

So next time, let me be the one to share my "adventures" with you, Rover.

Sincerely,
Yangyang

P.S. I've also included some seasonal snacks for Abby. Do share them with your friends at Lahai-Roi. I hope they are to everyone's liking.

Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_39: I can tell the journey was not an easy one.

Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_66: Please, bring Yangyang... bring the people of Jinzhou home safely.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_67: While I cannot dispatch any personnel, as Jué's Resonator, I may enter on a personal basis.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_111_54: {PlayerName}, Chixia is currently recovering at Huaxu Academy. Do pay her a visit before you depart. If you wish to learn more about Xuanfang Hold, you may also speak with Principal Investigator Xiangli and Baizhi there.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_111_56: Might I have a moment of your time? There's a matter I'd like to discuss with you, Madam Magistrate.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_111_57: As you wish. I'll answer as best I can.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_111_58: {PlayerName}, I will meet you at Huaxu Academy shortly.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_2: Zhezhi came to visit Chixia earlier and spoke about you. Judging from your look, you've already met with the Magistrate.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_5: She's right here. Still undergoing treatment.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_6: Chixia... the Midnight Rangers who brought her back said she was gravely injured, but she still made it across the Dreaming Cavern by herself. She stayed conscious long enough to tell them what happened to Yangyang before finally collapsing.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_8: No need to worry. She is no longer in critical condition. Her readings from late last night show she's slowly regaining awareness. However, she's still disoriented at the moment.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_21: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_23: We should step outside. She needs rest.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_24: Forgive me, {PlayerName}. After I heard, I also wanted to search for Yangyang immediately. But with Chixia in this condition, I had no choice but to...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_25: Thank you for taking care of her.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_27: That's right, Baizhi. Without you, Chixia's condition wouldn't have stabilized so quickly. And frankly, she might've been left with permanent damage.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_28: {PlayerName}, Sanhua told me about your situation. I take it you'll be heading to Xuanfang Hold soon?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_29: Do be extra cautious, {PlayerName}. Xuanfang Hold isn't just any military stronghold. It's the pinnacle of what Automata Mechanics as a field can achieve today, and for the foreseeable future.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_32: It's the masterpiece of Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin. A mechanical city built for the sole purpose of trapping and eliminating Tacet Discords to keep wider Mengzhou safe.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_33: Xuanfang Hold has stood at the border between our two states for over two hundred years now. Not a single incident in all that time. It's a "living" city in its own way that doesn't rely on people to run things. Instead, it uses creations called "Autopuppets" to fight off TDs.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_34: In theory, Xuanfang Hold is Mengzhou's most impenetrable fortress. And because of that exact reason, if something has gone wrong? The cause and the fallout are almost unimaginable.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_35: According to Chixia, while Yangyang was being surrounded by Tacet Discords, Xuanfang Hold's gates opened for reasons unknown. And to ensure Chixia's escape, Yangyang went through that gate alone.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_36: Meaning... Yangyang should still be inside.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_37: After I joined Huaxu Academy, I submitted several requests to Mengzhou to research the technological principles underlying Xuanfang Hold, but they were all rejected. So I'm afraid I don't know much more about what's actually in there. Sorry I can't be of more help in that regard.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_38: That said... while digging through old archives here at the Academy, I did stumble upon a report about Xuanfang.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_39: The contents were vague, frustratingly so. But there was a clue. Not sure if it'll help, but...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_40: Over two hundred years ago, when Xuanfang Hold was first being built, aside from Hsin and the forces of Mengzhou, there was another group that left their mark there.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_130_1: Xuanfang Hold has a long, long history. And that comes with a tangled web of events, each one tied to the next. I could elaborate, but I suspect you'd rather be on your way.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_130_2: This is good enough for now.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_130_3: Yes, finding Yangyang is the priority.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_130_4: Leave Chixia to us. Huaxu Academy will take good care of her.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_131_1: Ah... I sure hope Yangyang's all right...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_131_2: I know. She only just became an Outrider...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_3: What were you thinking just now?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_4: Oh, nothing. Just an old memory.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_5: I was thinking about the day Yangyang told Mother and me she was leaving for Jinzhou. I told her that if she'd found her path, then she needn't worry about anything else. Just take that step and go.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_6: Only I wasn't being entirely honest with her.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_7: That shows how much you love her.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_8: It's only natural to feel this way.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_9: Before coming to Jinzhou, I'll admit I was a little nervous. After so many years apart, I wasn't sure we'd still be the same people we remembered. I never imagined...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_10: Yangyang said the same thing to me.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_12: You two are a lot alike, you know.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_13: Are we? In some ways, perhaps. In others, not so much.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_14: She's determined. She's never wavered or doubted her own choices.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_15: My, my. You seem to know Yangyang rather well.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_16: My journey didn't really start until I met Yangyang.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_17: No matter how far I've come, no matter how many places I've traveled, meeting her will always be my starting line.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_18: So whether it's for everyone who cares about her, or for myself, I will find her. And I'll bring her back.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_25: Ah, there you are. Pay no mind, I've had this silly bird for years. Dumpling's her name.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_26: She's... in a bit of a mood right now. Probably because she didn't get to see Yangyang.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_27: They were thick as thieves back home. There was this one time when Yangyang—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_140_28: ...Sorry. This isn't really the best time to reminisce.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_141_19: Well, then. Shall we be on our way?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_141_20: To reach Xuanfang from Jinzhou, we'll need to cross through the Dreaming Cavern, north of the Gorges of Spirits. Since you've never been, I'll lead the way.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_150_1: So... you and Jinhsi. What was that about?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_150_2: Oh, just a little exchange of intelligence. It took some persuading, but she did eventually agree to grant me access.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_150_3: Other than that, we talked about you.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_150_5: Well, we may share the same goal, but I still need to know whether the person I'm traveling with is someone I can trust.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_150_6: And besides, Yangyang mentions your name so often in her letters. I couldn't help but be curious. Who is this person my dear sister is so utterly hung up on?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_150_7: And? Did you get the answer you were looking for?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_150_8: ...That, my dear, remains to be seen.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_160_1: These traces... Yangyang and Chixia must've left them when they fought.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_160_2: Yes, but no signs of TDs now...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_160_3: The mountain gate is just ahead.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_165_3: It does look rather magnificent from here.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_170_4: Only it's hard to tell if anything's wrong from this distance.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_170_5: Which means we need to be even more careful.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_2: Yeah... we haven't run into any of those Autopuppets Xiangli Yao mentioned yet.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_3: In any case, let's make for Shaftpost Yard first. It's not far. That's where Xuanfang's Ministry of Foreign Affairs is located. There ought to be some clues there.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_4: You seem to know your way around here.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_5: Not really. I've made a few visits on business, but never ventured far.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_6: Xuanfang Hold keeps the tightest security. Every visitor must pass through layers of screening. Not even a fly could get through without proper I.D.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_7: What if this incident wasn't an act of nature, but a human one...?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_3: Looks like it's up to us to find the leads.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_4: Just as I thought. Our Terminal comms went down the moment we entered Xuanfang.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_7: A pair of locators. Simple little things, really. They'll show us each other's position and vital signs. The downside is that they have no communication functions.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_8: The situation here is unpredictable. We're together now, but there's no guarantee it'll stay that way. Think of it as a safeguard.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_9: To help us make the right call when it matters most.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_11: You sound so sure we're getting separated...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_12: Just an old habit from my trading days. I always prepare for the worst.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_13: Besides, our priority is finding Yangyang. We wouldn't want to be distracted by anything else, would we?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_14: Still, think of it as a gift from me. Don't lose it, alright?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_15: (For a gift, it sure feels like a heavy one...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_190_16: There should still be clues around Shaftpost Yard. Let's investigate.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_2: (Write about how you and the Academy fought off the Voidborne Threnodian.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_3: (Write about how Rabelle College averted being shut down.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_7: The Voidborne Threnodian, Aleph-1... it devours a person's will and tries to strip human existence of all meaning. We could not have defeated it without Exostrider "Lahai-Roi," everyone at Startorch Academy, and the local Roya people.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_9: After that... Lahai-Roi could be reborn as something new. A different kind of civilization. Something even brighter.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_10: After the Exostrider disappeared, the Spacetrek Collective's investors even wanted to shut down Rabelle College at one point. But President Lucilla fought them tooth and nail, and the faculty and students let their work speak for itself. In the end, they saved it.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_12: And they'll only keep reaching for the stars.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_13: How's everyone in Jinzhou doing? Ever since that Moon-Chasing Festival, there hasn't been much opportunity for me to get together with everyone.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_14: My footsteps... Before I knew it, I'd already come a long way.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_15: Sometimes I find myself thinking... Maybe I should pause once in a while. Go back somewhere familiar. But every time the thought crosses my mind, some new trouble always finds me.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_17: What about you, Yangyang? How have you been?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_20_18: Every letter you send makes me realize how far I've come from where I started. I know you must be working on your own goals while I've been away, too. Next time we meet, let's trade stories. See what we've both made of ourselves.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_200_1: So this is a Xuanfang Autopuppet...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_200_2: Structurally, it's nothing like the Twin Nova units at Startorch. But the technical complexity is every bit their equal. Maybe more.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_210_1:
The Skywatch Ring has detected anomalies! All Ministry of Foreign Affairs personnel must evacuate immediately.
REPEAT: EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_220_1:
Weekly Inspection — Light damage: 34 units. Moderate damage: 67 units. Severe damage: 12 units. Destroyed: 7 units. Among the severely damaged units, 6 are beyond repair. Recommended transfer, along with the destroyed units, to the Skyworks for disposal. See below for detailed report.

...
