Reporter: Shenyuan
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_230_5: Where did this fog come from?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_235_7: (These must be the "rogue Autopuppets" Chixia's report mentioned...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_235_8: Stay sharp. Let's take them out together.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_240_7: Suisui, we need to stay close—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_241_4: (Not good. Need to find a way out first.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_250_1: Is that... the mechanical bird from earlier?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_250_2: Looks like it's trying to show me the way.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_250_3: Let's see where it takes me.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_255_1: Tch. The Disorienting Fog is here, too.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_255_2: Every road back to Jinzhou is blocked. With only a city garrison, we won't last long...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_255_3: What do we do...? Why now, of all times, would the Sentinel—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_6: Easy. I don't mean you any harm.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_7: You... you don't look like you're from Xuanfang. Who are you? Why are you here?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_8: I came to find someone from Jinzhou.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_10: Jinzhou? So you came through the south mountain gate? Does this mean... Jinzhou knows what's happening here? Are you the reinforcements they sent?!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_11: My name is {PlayerName}. You can think of me as the reinforcements.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_12: That name... I've heard it somewhere. Golden eyes, black hair, and a Tacet Mark on the back of your hand.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_14: Could it be—you're the one from the Battle of Norfall Barrens? The one who fought alongside General Jiyan and drove back the Threnodian Ovathrax... {PlayerName}?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_15: I'm here on behalf of Jinzhou's Magistrate. Can you tell me what's happening in Xuanfang?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_18: Yes. My name is Liangyu, and I serve under Mengzhou's Ministry of War, as part of the <te href=750046>Xuan Triad</te>. But now, I'm the only one left...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_19: Three days ago, one of Xuanfang's <te href=750045>Censure Courts</te> detected Tacet Discord activity of unusual scale. An elite squad of <te href=750049>Wardens</te> was sent to purge any remaining TDs.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_21: Standard procedure for the Ministry of War. But that day...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_22: The moment we stepped foot in the Censure Court, the Autopuppets stationed there suddenly attacked us—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_23: No one saw it coming. The people of Xuanfang Hold... especially the Wardens, we all trust the Autopuppets completely. They're our main tool against Tacet Discords, and one of the Sentinel's creations no less.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_24: By the time we realized what was happening, so many had already... My two fellow Triad squadmates didn't even have time to draw their weapons.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_26: Only a handful of us made it out alive. And now...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_28: All the Autopuppets are going rogue?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_29: Yes. Censure Courts are meant to trap Tacet Discords, but they're useless now. Now they pour into our lands, and the Ministry of War cannot keep up.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_30: And that's not all. The Warden Commander has sent countless requests to Mengzhou for reinforcements, but neither City Hall nor the Sentinel has answered.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_31: And with every road out of Xuanfang blocked by Disorienting Fog, the Wardens have no choice but to retreat to the Hold. But that is no solution, not even a poor one.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_33: (No one can leave the Hold... Which means Yangyang might still be inside.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_35: Have you run into anyone else from Jinzhou? Besides me?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_37: There was a girl. Yangyang. Said she was an Outrider for Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers. Two days ago, during the civilian evacuation, she traveled with us.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_38: That's her. Do you know where she is now?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_39: No. She volunteered to draw a large group of Autopuppets away so we could get the civilians into the Hold. We lost her after that.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_40: I sent a few scouts to search the Eastern Xuan Peaks area, but we failed to locate her trail.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_44: ...Do you have anything on you that's connected to her?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_45: (Now that she mentions it, Suisui did give me... one of her letters?)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_263_1: I'm sure you have a Terminal on you. One moment, I'll share the access.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_263_2: Xuanfang Hold has deployed "Skywatch Rings" everywhere to monitor Tacet Discord activity. They can track frequency fluctuations left behind in different areas. As of this moment... we're lucky they're still working.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_263_3: This letter carries her frequency. With that, we should be able to track some of her previous movements. I'll take you to the Four Chime Shaftpost. It has equipment that's connected to the Skywatch Rings.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_264_4: (Locator readings are normal. Suisui's safe for now...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_264_5: You said you traveled with Yangyang?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_264_6: That's right. She... I hope she's safe.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_264_7: (Like she said, the priority right now is finding Yangyang.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_266_1: Oh. While I'm at it, I'll unlock access to a Cloud Ride for you as well.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_266_3: Is it similar to Lahai-Roi's expedition motorbike?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_266_4: It's a type of transport vehicle developed by Mengzhou's Huaxu Academy. Very useful for quickly navigating rough terrain.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_266_5: Expedition motorbike...? Are there similar technologies in other places?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_266_6: Hmm... since you already have a means of transportation, I'll just share the functions with you.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_2: In countless tomorrows lie countless possibilities...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_4: Hello—! Yangyang! You comin' or what?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_8: (Ever since you woke me up, I've had many dreams of my own. Good dreams, bad dreams. Some slip away like the wind as soon as I wake. Others are seared into my heart for a long time.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_9: (But they're just dreams. Scenes that never existed. Lingering notes that the present hasn't yet swept away.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_10: (But that moment in the Gorges of Spirits, the first time we met, is a reality we share that no number of dreams could ever erase.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_11: (Just like the name you gave me, maybe I'm destined to rove endlessly. Maybe my journey is destined to be filled with the unknown.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_33_6: Lemme see... Once we pass through that checkpoint up ahead, that's Xuanfang territory. Didn't expect following those leads would take us all the way out here.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_33_7: This is where those missing people were last reported...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_33_8: And that's all thanks to you and that <te href=750055>Stream</te> of yours, Yangyang! If you hadn't connected all the dots, we'd still be runnin' circles back in Jinzhou!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_33_9: You're exaggerating, Chixia... According to the Patrollers' investigation reports, the victims all had reasons to travel to Mengzhou, and Xuanfang lies right along the only route there.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_33_10: But none of them ever made it to Mengzhou, nor did they come back. But if memory serves, Xuanfang—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_33_11: Come on, we'll find out what happened once we get there. I already filed for a warrant. Just gotta show the folks at the checkpoint the paperwork, and they should let us into the Hold.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_33_12: Phew... This is my first time on a field op this far from home. Anyway, we're bringin' those missing people back safe and sound! Right, Yangyang?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_40_1: By the way, what were you lookin' at back there all by yourself? I saw you smilin' the whole time... You don't get that look on your face every day, ya know.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_40_2: Huh? I'm not usually that serious... am I?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_40_3: Ain't the same. Anybody with eyes can tell ya, a smile ain't just a smile. There's the smile you put on 'cause you're s'posed to, and the smile that comes from the heart. So what's got my Yangyang smilin' like that, I wonder...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_40_4: ...Let's just focus on the mission, Chixia.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_50_1: That's weird. Where is everybody? There should be guards stationed here...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_53_2: Something's not right, Chixia. Ready your weapon.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_53_3: Yangyang? Are your birdie senses tingling or somethin'?!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_53_4: TDs... One. No, two. They're coming from every direction!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_53_5: That can't be right! This place is s'posed to be—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_60_1: What happened to the Xuanfang guards!? You don't suppose these TDs took 'em out...?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_60_2: I'm not sure. But there was something different about these TDs...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_60_3: The ones born in the wild don't usually form groups of this size...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_60_4: If they ain't comin' from outside the city, then that means... they came from—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_2: Loong Whiskers Crisps, Wuthercakes, Honeysuckle Cakes... Desserts from Rinascita and Lahai-Roi are great and all, but the stuff from Huanglong is what really hits the spot.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_3: Now that I think 'bout it, it's been ages since I've had Crispy Squab, Jinzhou Stew, Loong Buns, Poached Chicken, Candied Caltrops, Moon Pearls...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_6: What else am I supposed to do?! Blame Yangyang for sending us those tasty snacks. They brought back all my great memories of Jinzhou!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_7: Point taken... It really has been a while since we visited Jinzhou.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_8: (Yangyang hasn't written back yet. Yangyang, Chixia, Baizhi... and even Jinhsi. I wonder how everyone's doing?)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_9: Things here at the Academy are wrapping up. Maybe now's a good time...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_10: (And the thing we found inside that satellite... It might have something to do with the Court of Savantae...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_11: I know what you're gonna say! Let's go visit! We'll make it a surprise!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_12: We're not going on vacation, you know.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_13: We'll still have work to do when we go back.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_14: Rising Loong, Star Flakes, Jinzhou Maocai, Spicy Pulled Chicken... Teehee... Hehehe...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_15: (Abby's completely lost in a fantasy world now...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_600_17: (I should let everyone at the Academy know before I leave for Jinzhou.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_70_3: I'm okay. Just a scratch—I can still—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_70_9: One of us has to make it back—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_70_10: Jinzhou needs to know what's happening here.

Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_53_7: At a deserted checkpoint, the Streams warn Yangyang of danger closing in on her and Chixia.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_10_18: On a peaceful day, you receive an express package from Huanglong containing a letter from Yangyang.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_80_18: Abby chatters on about Jinzhou's delicacies as usual. When no reply comes from Yangyang, you consider returning to Huanglong. With Abby's encouragement, you decide to head back to gather intelligence on the Court of Savantae and visit old friends.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_81_13: As you prepare for your departure to Huanglong, Hiyuki, Mornye, and Luuk Herssen come to say goodbye. Hiyuki mentions a special farewell gathering  Lucilla has prepared.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_85_34: Lucilla and everyone close to you hold a special graduation ceremony in your honor. With their warm wishes close to your heart, you set off on your new journey.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_90_22: Jinzhou looks as familiar as ever, but a tense atmosphere grips the city. At Panhua's Restaurant, Zhezhi tells you that Yangyang entered the Land of Xuanfang and has since lost contact. Chixia, who accompanied her, was gravely injured in battle with Tacet Discords. Worried, you comfort Zhezhi and head straight to City Hall to ask Jinhsi for answers.

Jinhsi arrives and briefs you both on the crises in Jinzhou and Xuanfang Hold, entrusting you with a special frequency. Vowing to bring Yangyang and the missing citizens back safely, you accept the mission. Suisui decides to join you in your search for her sister.

Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_170_6: You use the frequency Jinhsi gave you to open the Gate of Xuanfang.

Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_44: Before setting out, you visit Chixia at Huaxu Academy and are relieved to find her condition stable. Baizhi and Xiangli Yao brief you on Xuanfang Hold, with Xiangli Yao revealing that the Court of Savantae was involved in its construction.

Side_JSQWBFLC_2_9: "...A custom known as 'Smeltguard's Feast of Fortune' has long been practiced in the land of Xuanfang, and is usually organized by local merchants on festive occasions."
Side_JSQWBFLC_2_10: "Locals believe that Smeltguard brings good fortune, so they place it atop a high platform and toss specially-prepared coins at it."
Side_JSQWBFLC_2_11: "The Smeltguard will leap gracefully through the air as it attempts to catch the coins, and its movements are said to represent the gathering of wealth."
Side_JSQWBFLC_2_12: "Coins that fall to the ground, however, are said to herald ill fortune—a diminishing of wealth. And so the fewer that fall, the better."
Side_JSQWBFLC_2_13: ...Basically, all we need to do is toss coins at Smeltguard and film it leaping through the air as it tries to catch them.
Side_JSQWBFLC_2_14: But to capture the most graceful movements possible, tradition says that someone has to direct the Smeltguard's actions and make sure it catches as many coins as possible.
Side_JSQWBFLC_2_15: I can handle the filming and coin-tossing, while you'll be the one directing the Smeltguard.
Side_JSQWBFLC_2_17: Now's not a good time for me.

Side_JSQWBFLC_2_19: Oh... No worries! Just come and find me when you have time!

WDYX_1_1: Ever heard of "A Street Lighter's Night Walk"? It's one of those eerie stories that'll make the hairs on your neck stand up...
WDYX_10_1: The Street Lighter had to go around.
WDYX_10_2: It was bizarre... Where did those stones blocking the road come from?
WDYX_10_3: The more it thought, the more uneasy it became...

WDYX_12_1: "Faster... faster... This place gives me the creeps..."
WDYX_12_2: The wind seemed to die among the trees, and the mist pressed in thicker, threatening to swallow even the lamplight...
WDYX_13_1: But something even more horrifying happened.
WDYX_14_1: The frail Autopuppet was gone... vanished into thin air!
WDYX_15_1: Panic set in. The Street Lighter turned and fled that dark, wooded place.
WDYX_16_1: It frantically lit the next lamp.
WDYX_17_1: All at once, the lamp flickered wildly—flaring bright, then threatening to die out at any moment. Deep in the mist, a shadow crept closer.
WDYX_18_1: Before the Street Lighter could react, the lamp went out.
WDYX_19_1: All around, dim purple lamps flickered to life.
WDYX_19_2: Not daring to linger, the Street Lighter hurried on.
WDYX_2_1: Ever heard of "A Street Lighter's Night Walk"? It's one of those eerie stories that'll make the hairs on your neck stand up... Ah! How long have you been standing there?!
WDYX_2_4: Oh, well, what's that saying again? "There are no strangers, only friends you have not met yet." Since you are already here, how about I tell you this eerie little tale?
WDYX_2_8: Here in the Land of Xuanfang, the night fog hangs thick and heavy. On the dampest evenings, you can scarcely see a man ten paces ahead. That's why the Skyworks deployed the Street Lighters along the roads.
WDYX_2_9: But just imagine, if you will... what if you were one of those very Street Lighters?
WDYX_2_10: What a pity! You simply must return when you have the time.
WDYX_20_1: And then the scariest thing of all happened—the Autopuppet was standing right in front of the Street Lighter, towering over it!
WDYX_2001_2: But in the blink of an eye, the Autopuppet was there again, pressing right against it.
WDYX_2001_3: Terrified, the Street Lighter spun around and sped the other way!
WDYX_201_1: Hello! Interested in this eerie little tale now?
WDYX_202_1: Now, the Street Lighters can walk on their own..
WDYX_21_1: Well? How was it? Was it good?
WDYX_21_5: I know, right? I'm glad you like it! Now I know it was worth all the time I spent coming up with it today.
WDYX_21_6: Huh? Really? ...So did I just waste my whole day for this?
WDYX_21_8: Actually, uh, to tell you the truth... I made that story completely up.
WDYX_21_9: I love reading those kinds of ghost stories! Especially the "Mirage Seeker's Tales" by Cat of the Nether Lamp—just think, a hundred and forty-plus chapters already, and every one makes you feel like you're really there!
WDYX_21_10: But he just stopped writing lately. I have no idea why. I keep waiting for a new chapter, but one never comes. It's driving me crazy!
WDYX_21_11: So I have to write my own stories. They can't hold a candle to "Mirage Seeker's Tales," but I just have to make do for now.
WDYX_21_12: Who knows? Maybe someday Cat of the Nether Lamp will see my stories. And even if he just said "not bad" and wrote me an autograph, I'd be a happy man for the rest of my days!
WDYX_21_14: Thank you! I'll keep working on the story... You're welcome to come back and hear it!
WDYX_3_1: Every foggy night, they would move along their routes, lighting the lampposts.
WDYX_3_2: On this night, a Street Lighter went about its work as usual, lighting the lamps one by one.
WDYX_4_1: A lamp blazed to life, revealing stacks of crates scattered nearby.
WDYX_5_1: What was in those crates? Spare parts, perhaps?
WDYX_5_2: The Street Lighter paid no attention. It simply continued on, fulfilling its purpose.
WDYX_6_1: But then a chill wind seemed to rise from all around...
WDYX_6_2: An almost imperceptible rustling reached its ears, and the Street Lighter couldn't shake a creeping unease.
WDYX_7_1: Who would have guessed? There was an Autopuppet sitting in the trees by the roadside in the middle of the night.
WDYX_8_1: The Autopuppet was in bad shape. Weakly, it begged the Street Lighter for help, asking it to fetch some spare parts...
WDYX_8_2: The Street Lighter remembered the crates. Hoping to find what it needed, it turned back the way it had come...
WDYX_9_1: And this is where the story takes a strange turn... The road back was blocked!

Side_XFC_ZHDFTYW_9_1: Stop... Keep going... There will be enemies...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_1: The frequency trace ends northwest of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Either it's heading somewhere a Skywatch Ring cannot monitor, or...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_2: Wait. There's something on the back of this letter.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_5: A factory in the Western Fang Peaks. It is where Xuanfang Hold produces its Autopuppets and "disposes" of Tacet Discords.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_6: The Ministry of War just flagged it. They say the Skyworks has become a hive for rogue Autopuppets. Even the Xuanfang Wardens and the Ministry of Development can't get close anymore.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_8: She went out of her way to leave us this message. I can't ignore it.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_9: What about you? What's your move?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_10: The Hold is under siege from all sides. My Commander's order was to reach Jinzhou through Shaftpost Yard's mountain gate. To call for reinforcements.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_11: But the gate is sealed. There is no other way out... If I do nothing, I'll just be waiting for death.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_12: I'm coming with you. If Yangyang went to the Skyworks, she must have sensed something important.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_13: Besides... I owe her a great debt.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_14: Only the Skyworks has become a den of horrors. Two souls alone... may not be enough.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_15: We'll just have to find out.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_17: These marks... Were they left by the Streams?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_18: Skyworks? Yangyang actually mentioned that place?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_19: Tracking Yangyang's frequency, you trace her movements over the past few days in Xuanfang. Following the clues from her letter, you head to the Skyworks in the Western Fang Peaks for more answers. Liangyu joins you, determined to find out why the Autopuppets went rogue.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_100_1: Muyu uses the remaining hostages to escape. Meanwhile, a massive Autopuppet emerges from the depths of the Skyworks to block your way.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_102_1: These attacks... have no effect on it?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_103_1: My power of Separation is being affected...?!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_103_2: Is it using the Sentinel's own technology?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_104_1: As I thought... Not useless, but not enough either...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_104_2: At this rate, the fight will drag on...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_110_8: This was never meant for you to wield...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_110_9: Thus, I ask of you a vow.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_110_10: The moment you choose to defy the ordained course—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_110_11: You must be ready... to bear the cost, and—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_110_12: Never... never ever forsake this city.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_11: It was you. You brought {PlayerName} here.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_12: This isn't a dream, is it?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_13: If it is, it's far too...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_15: Hey, relax. Feel that? I'm right here.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_16: Yes... You're just much earlier than I expected.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_17: And yet, much later than I'd hoped.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_18: I'm sorry. I couldn't stop him.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_21: Oh! Did you see Chixia in Jinzhou? Is she okay? Those wounds she suffered from the Tacet Discords were—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_25: Next time, don't throw yourself into danger like that.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_27: ...I suppose it's a bad habit I picked up without realizing.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_28: After all, a certain "role model" of mine likes to rove the world and send back stories of {Male=his;Female=her} own reckless adventures.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_29: Breaking that habit now... might be difficult.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_31: But you're right. I owe everyone an apology when we get back.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_32: And... I'm sorry, {PlayerName}. For making you worry.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_120_35: After defeating the Myriad Snare, Yangyang collapses from exhaustion. You wait by her side until she awakens. She initially thinks your presence is an illusion, but you assure her that you are truly there.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_35: (I've been standing here for a while...)
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_37: I'm... I'm alright. Liangyu, the civilians... did everyone make it back to the city?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_39: (I didn't see Yanlang and Mingyu. I fear they have...)
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_41: Say no more, Yangyang. Apologize to anyone you wish, but not to me. This burden is mine. This failure is mine. Let me bear it alone.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_42: The architect of the rebellion has fled. Now we must decide what comes next.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_43: {PlayerName}, the bird that delivered the token just now... could it be...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_44: Suisui is also in the Land of Xuanfang.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_45: I came here with your sister.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_47: I see. It seems your other companion has made some progress elsewhere as well.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_49: She's on her way to Xuanfang Hold.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_50: Then that is where we go first.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_51: I need to report the situation at the Skyworks to the Warden Commander. And the rescued civilians need to be settled.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_52: I agree. We should pool what we have learned.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_53: That sounds like a solid plan.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_55: Liangyu contacts the nearby Xuanfang Wardens. After arranging for the civilians to be escorted to safety, you prepare to head toward Xuanfang Hold.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_56: With the mastermind unmasked, you tell Yangyang that Suisui is also in the Land of Xuanfang. The three of you decide to return to Xuanfang Hold to regroup.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_1: Actually, {PlayerName}, weren't you in Lahai-Roi? What brought you back so suddenly?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_2: I got your letter. Figured it was time to come back.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_3: I just didn't expect all of this to happen the moment I returned to Jinzhou...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_4: So... I have dragged you into trouble again.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_5: Nothing I'm not used to. Besides...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_6: Seeing you safe is the most important thing.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_7: ...Looks like we're almost at Xuanfang Hold.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_8: You're right... I wonder what the situation is like in there.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_130_11: It's nothing, just there was something I wanted to say back there... but the moment passed, and then it felt a little too late.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_2: Yangyang, {PlayerName}, I need to report to the Commander. Why don't you two find your companion first?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_5: My sister... I wonder if she made it here safely.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_6: Actually, {PlayerName}... when she gets here, there's something I need to discuss with her in private. Would you mind—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_12: Oh, my poor Yangyang! You've gotten so thin! Is no one in Jinzhou looking after you? Do you not eat properly?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_13: This will not do. This will not do at all. You need to eat more, darling. How else am I supposed to enjoy hugging you?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_14: Sister, please! I'm not a child anymore. And I've been eating perfectly fine...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_15: Oh? Since when has my little Yangyang been so shy?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_18: Mm... All these years, and you don't hang on to me anymore. I find that rather crushing...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_19: That is not how it was! You were the one who dragged me everywhere. I missed so many of my vocal lessons...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_20: Oh Really? Hmm... it all gets quite blurry, doesn't it? But I seem to recall a certain someone begging me to sneak her out to see the festival boats, pestering for me to keep it from Mother.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_21: That was... But you were always sneaking out at night to watch the opera...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_22: Excuse me? I recall a certain little critter who stole my box of osmanthus cakes. Hint: mice don't usually wipe their mouths with napkins after they eat.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_23: How did this turn into a roast session...?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_25: Somehow... it feels like you're a completely different person now.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_26: Well, things were urgent back then. Now that the weight on my mind has lifted, of course I'm more at ease.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_27: Though the little sister I went through so much to see seems to have forgotten how to be nice to her older sister.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_29: Ahem... Thank you for taking the time to come see me, but let's focus on the issues at hand first.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_30: This thing you sent... What exactly is it?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_32: Just as I thought. You are qualified to wield it. My efforts to persuade that stubborn fox weren't in vain after all.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_34: ...My apologies, {PlayerName}, Yangyang. There is something I've been keeping from you.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_35: Well, let me start from the moment {PlayerName} and I got separated.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_140_36: Back in Xuanfang Hold, you and Yangyang reunite with Suisui. After a brief greeting, Suisui apologizes for having kept things from you and recounts her experience after you were separated in the fog.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_150_3: It seems... to be confusing my senses.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_150_4: Dumpling, go check if there's a way out.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_160_4: The fog is blocking the way back to the gate... It feels deliberate.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_160_5: The locator... everything looks normal. With {Male=his;Female=her} skills, {Male=he;Female=she} should be able to get out of here safely.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_160_6: Seems I have no choice but to press on.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_170_2: A village... Tacet Discords tore through here.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_170_3: But no bodies. No wounded. They must have evacuated before the attack.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_180_2: More of that fog here... I should probably find a way around just in case—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_180_10: This trick won't hold them for long. If you don't wanna die, get into the fog!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_180_12: While exploring, Suisui tries to bypass the Disorienting Fog but is suddenly surrounded by rogue Autopuppets. Suddenly, a mysterious voice from within the fog catches her attention. With no other way out, Suisui follows the voice and steps into the fog.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_2: Here, take this. It'll stop the fog from messing with your head.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_3: Picked it up from a fortune-teller in Mengzhou. S'posed to calm the mind. Thought she was full of it, you know those Jianghu types. But wouldn't ya know, it actually works.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_5: Hmph... 'bout time. This job's becoming a real pain. If I'd known Xuanfang would turn into this kind of circus, I'd have listened to my master's old lady. Saved up a little nest egg and quit while I still could...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_7: Hey, hey... don't tell me you don't recognize the man you hired.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_8: What, trust issues? Come on, look at my gourd. That'll prove it.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_10: ...Preloaded frequency data. The Terminals were set to alert each other when we drew close.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_12: Ahem... Then you... Ugh—Cat of the Nether Lamp, I presume?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_13: The one and only. S'pose that makes you the Chongming Pruner herself.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_20: You've been hiding your identity this whole time. Not the sort of thing you share with any Tom, Dick, and wandering rogue, I imagine. So what changed? Why come to Xuanfang at all?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_21: With all that is happening here, I should think you'd already possess certain insights, no?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_22: ...You mean the sudden Autopuppet rebellion. Think Zhuojun Atelier's got their hands in it, do you?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_23: Hmm... In Mengzhou, their "Flowerveil Puppet" Grand Helm hasn't made any moves. She doesn't seem to give a crap about Xuanfang, far as I can tell.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_24: Ten years I've been at this. Tracked every operative Zhuojun Atelier sent to the Ministry of Development. Every single one, except...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_25: ...Sorry. Say any more and I'd be out of a job. And I happen to enjoy eating.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_26: Anyway, I did what you asked. Mapped the whole Fogveil Pagoda top to bottom, just like you asked in your letter.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_27: Right then. If that's everything, I'll be off. Believe it or not, I do have honest work from time to time.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_29: Did you happen to come across a girl with a blue hat? Hair with feathered tips?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_30: Those features are hard to miss... If I'd seen her, I'd remember. Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_32: What, is she important to you?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_33: She's my sister. She... shouldn't have come here.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_35: And I... shouldn't have come here either.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_36: What's that saying again? Ah, right: "The fairest judge fails family feuds." Let alone a street rat like me.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_37: Looks like my work here's done. Well, Chongming Pruner, I'll be on my way.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_38: If you're aiming to get into that Fogveil Pagoda, head north. The Elseway Shroud's your ticket in.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_39: Look, I don't know if you're hunting a person or a prize, but you've put a lot of work into this. Don't choke at the finish line.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_40: The more you waver, the more you waste what was hard to win—Huh. That was pretty good. I should write that down...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_43: I really am a terrible older sister...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_190_46: After clearing the fog, Suisui meets the source of the voice—"Cat of the Nether Lamp." He is an informant Suisui had hired before even knowing Yangyang was missing, proving she had planned to come to Xuanfang all along. After exchanging intelligence with him, Suisui heads to Fogveil Pagoda to fulfill a prior promise.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_20_1: I was wondering, did you come here alone?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_20_2: No. I had a companion. We got separated before I ran into you.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_20_3: Was it because of the Disorienting Fog? Aren't you worried about her?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_20_4: I am... But we agreed we'd stick to our own goals unless things got really bad.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_20_5: She knows what she's doing. This fog won't stop her.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_20_6: Is that so... Then we should pick up the pace too.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_260_3: Dumpling, it's your time to shine. I'll treat you to as many plates of dumplings as you wish, so—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_260_5: Suisui secures the Sentinel's token and leaves the pagoda. Sensing a sudden anomaly erupting from the Western Fang Peaks, she asks Dumpling to deliver the token directly to your hands.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_30_5: I'm fine... Just been overusing my Forte the last few days. I'm a little tired.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_30_6: You, on the other hand... You look like you have barely broken a sweat.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_30_7: Let's just say I got plenty of practice against humanoid weapons back in Lahai-Roi.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_30_10: ...Compared to everything else, fighting is the easy part.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_30_11: Just what kind of life have you lived?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_17: Don't you think it looks like a gaint piece of candy?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_19: Nooooo—! Absolutely not! It looks nasty!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_20: My stomach isn't a trash can!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_21: This may help us locate Yangyang.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_23: Ugh, fine, if you say so... I'll do it.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_24: It's all for Yangyang, okay? Even if I get a stomachache, I'll still do it—!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_28: Well, I'm not sure how to put it... The frequency was messy, like a billion math formulas all tangled together. Looking at it makes my head hurt.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_29: What if it's the core programming driving the Autopuppets?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_31: It's weird... On top of that string of numbers, there's a ton of... emotions.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_33: A machine... isn't supposed to have emotions.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_34: Could that be what's causing them to go rogue?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_35: Blegh... Too much bad juju... My stomach's feeling all kinds of wrong.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_36: I'm out. Gotta crash for a bit... Wake me if something goes down.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_31_37: To investigate, you have Abby consume an Autopuppet's kernel. Surprisingly, beyond the original data and frequency, the kernel is warped with intense negative emotions.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_32_2: Sorry, but... What was that thing back there?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_32_3: Hm? You mean Abby? That's my Echo. It has a big appetite.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_33_1: For an Autopuppet kernel to possess emotions similar to those of people... I've never heard of such a thing.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_33_2: For the Ministry of Development, Autopuppet technology and the Hold itself both originated from the Sentinel's black box.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_1: You mentioned earlier that the Sentinel of Mengzhou is missing?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_2: Well, she holds a residence in Xuanfang Hold, but the doors have not opened in a long time.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_3: The Warden Commander tried to contact her many times, but received no response.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_4: We're missing too many pieces of the puzzle at this point in time.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_5: Agreed. Let's hope we find some clues at the Skyworks.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_35_1: These are... Someone fought an entire squad of Autopuppets here.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_35_2: The traces on the remains... It was Yangyang.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_35_3: Really...! Then we should be able to track the frequency she left behind.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_36_1: The fighting stretched all the way here...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_36_3: Watch out—! These things aren't dead yet!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_37_1: Someone treated their wounds here... It must be Yangyang. She's injured.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_37_2: It must not have been too serious. She doesn't appear to have stayed long.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_37_3: How many Autopuppets did she fight... They do attack humans sometimes, but she doesn't seem like the type to provoke them.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_37_4: She must've found something... Maybe the source of the Autopuppet rebellion.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_37_5: These tracks... It's a Cloud Ride. She took one to the Skyworks.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_39_2: Yangyang's doing. She left it for us.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_5: How unexpected. Uninvited guests... at a time like this.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_6: Let me guess... it was that foolish girl's Rafter Kite that led you here?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_8: Hmm... a Watcher who slipped the net. It seems I miscalculated the Paragon's capabilities.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_11: Yangyang... So that is her name.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_14: A shame, really. She could have contributed to my grand experiment. Instead, she chose... the path of self-destruction.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_16: Interesting... Black hair. Golden eyes. You match the description given by the woman in red.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_17: Such a shame. You fancy yourself a hero, but you are too late. Far too late.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_20: The experiment is nearing its final stage. Soon, Xuanfang Hold, this little "toy box" of the Sentinel, will finally realize its true value.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_40_25: Following Yangyang's trail deep into the Skyworks, you find a destroyed Cloud Ride and her hat. Just as you plan your next move, you cross paths with Muyu, who is attempting to flee the facility. He reveals that Yangyang is in grave danger. Enraged, you move to apprehend him, but he escapes into the depths of the Skyworks.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_41_2: Come on... What else can we use—?!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_50_1: That man—he's the mastermind behind the Autopuppet rebellion?!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_50_2: Hurry! We can't let him get away!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_51_1: Just now... He spoke like he knew you. Have you met him before?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_51_3: (The woman in red... Did he mean a Fractsidus Overseer?)
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_60_2: How dare they use Censure Cages on civilians!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_60_3: We need to get them out.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_1: Oh, thank the heavens... Thank the heavens! I thought my time had come.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_2: Are you... Uncle Dong from Jinzhou?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_3: Eh? Y-y-you... aren't you {PlayerName}? Oh, what a relief! Everyone, {PlayerName} has come to save us!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_4: Are you the ones Yangyang was looking for? The missing people from Jinzhou?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_7: That... Oh! Long story short, I was on my way to Mengzhou to visit family. When I passed through Xuanfang, I ran into a group of masked brigands.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_8: Ah...! And it was not just us. They seemed to have seized folks from all over these lands.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_9: Demons take him—what's that man plotting?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_10: Is there anyone else trapped here?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_11: Oh, yes, yes! You must hurry! They've been taking people deeper into the factory, and no one ever comes back.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_12: We will do everything we can.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_13: As you pursue Muyu, you rescue Uncle Dong, who was kidnapped and brought to Xuanfang. He tells you and Liangyu that all the missing citizens from Jinzhou have been imprisoned in the Skyworks by unidentified thugs.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_70_1: So relentless... Do you truly believe your actions can change anything? That unfounded confidence is simply arrogance wearing a mask.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_70_2: If you posed even the smallest threat to my plan, would I have let you come this far?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_90_1: A ghost that will not rest—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_90_2: But even a variable like you still falls within my margins.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_90_3: You wish to charge at windmills? Very well. I will indulge you.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_90_4: Go on. Strike it. Break it. Tell yourself you are saving something. It will be your only triumph.
YBWH_1_1: Chixia invited {PlayerName} to the group chat
YBWH_1_12: You do look nice, I'll be honest. Hehe.
YBWH_1_13: Oh, this... It's a long story...
YBWH_1_14: How about I tell you the full story after I'm back in Jinzhou?
YBWH_1_15: Ohhh... Now you've really piqued my curiosity! I'm gonna hold you to that.
YBWH_1_17: Enough about me. How have you been?
YBWH_1_18: Are you feeling sick? Any more headaches? Have you been hydrating?
YBWH_1_19: Baizhi told me your numbers are up, and there's nothing to worry about.
YBWH_1_21: Remember to rest well, and you'll be out in no time.
YBWH_1_22: Don't you worry! I'm fit as a fiddle, and everything is A-okay.
YBWH_1_23: It's just... I've been cooped up in here for too long...
YBWH_1_24: Aw, man... I could really use some sunlight. Breathe in that fresh air, and stretch my legs a bit...
YBWH_1_25: Chixia, adequate rest is a more appropriate approach to your current condition.
YBWH_1_26: As I understand, profound moaning and groaning have no positive effect on your recovery, and such childish behavior will only result in your extended stay at Huaxu Academy for up to two weeks.
YBWH_1_27: Uh... There's Baizhi being tough again...
YBWH_1_28: Fine, I'll be a good girl and behave myself. Can't have everyone looking after me forever...

Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_2: I had no idea... You and the Sentinel of Mengzhou shared such a complicated history.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_3: I'm sorry, {PlayerName}, for keeping this from you. My deal with Hsin was meant to stay between us. Until I stood before Her, I wasn't sure if revealing the truth would help or just make things worse.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_4: Thank you for finding Yangyang. In the end, I wasn't much help in that department.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_5: Don't say that, Suisui. It's over now. You've carried that burden alone for far too long.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_6: We wouldn't have made it out of the Skyworks without your help.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_7: In any case, the Sentinel's token has passed into your hands. That means your fate is now woven with Hsin the Moon Fox. When those threads will come undone, I cannot say.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_8: Would not be the first time.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_9: If She's in trouble, I won't just stand by.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_10: Before that, we have to stop the Autopuppet rebellion.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_11: Sister, you mentioned Zhuojun Atelier. Did you find something specific about them back in Mengzhou?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_12: They are a unique organization renowned for their mastery of mechanist art. Their roots run deep in Mengzhou, and their expertise rivals that of Huaxu Academy.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_13: But they lack discipline and have no unified code of conduct. Their leader, the Grand Helm "Flowerveil Puppet," is especially elusive, with questionable morals.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_14: You both know of the <te href=750057>Séance Society</te>, yes? Though it has since disbanded, their leader, the <te href=750058>Dollmaker</te>, was originally from Zhuojun Atelier.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_17: That man, Muyu... he was a member of the Atelier two hundred years ago. But it seems he's long since cut ties with them.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_18: Two hundred years ago... Even for a Resonator, that is an exceptionally long life. He might've had multiple identities in that time. Tracing his origins will prove difficult.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_19: There's something else. He knew me. The way he spoke... he knows my history.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_20: And he mentioned a "woman in red"...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_21: Could it be the woman we encountered in Jinzhou? Scar's companion?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_22: Zhuojun Atelier and the Fractsidus... If he has ties to both...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_23: With a Forte we don't yet understand, infiltrating the Autopuppet system and causing the chaos in Xuanfang would be well within his reach.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_24: But... why? He kept mentioning his "experiment." What could it mean?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_25: It might be related to what he took from the Skyworks.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_26: He's probably using the Reverberation for something.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_27: At least now we know who we need to stop.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_28: Let's find Liangyu and the Warden Commander. Maybe they can help us make sense of these leads.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_29: No, I don't think it's her... It sounds like an Overseer we haven't met yet. Someone still lurking in Huanglong.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_30: I can feel it, though... She's hiding something. A truth She cannot, or will not, speak. You will have to find that answer yourself.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_31: You, Yangyang, and Suisui exchange the intel you have gathered. Piecing the clues together, Suisui believes that Zhuojun Atelier, a prominent Automata Mechanics organization based in Mengzhou, is heavily implicated. To gather more evidence, you seek out the Warden Commander and Liangyu.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_271_1: By the way, earlier, I asked Abby to "analyze" the abnormal Autopuppet's kernel.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_271_2: It was packed with negative emotions. If those were somehow implanted from the outside...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_271_3: That could be how Muyu is controlling them...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_271_4: (But the source of those emotions... Could it be...)
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_272_1: These Autopuppets... What in the heavens could have caused this?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_1: These Autopuppets... What in the heavens could have caused this?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_2: With our current skills, we can inspect their mechanical structures and make simple repairs, but we cannot begin to understand their control kernels...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_5: Muyu? No one by that name works here. But the man you're describing... that sounds exactly like Master Shenyuan.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_6: He came to us twenty years ago. One of our most senior Artisans.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_7: He keeps to himself, but his skills are exceptional. We all trust him. A few days ago, he stopped showing up. We thought he had fallen victim to the rogue Autopuppets...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_8: You think... he's been plotting this for the past twenty years? No, that cannot be...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_9: He never said a word about Zhuojun Atelier. We used to discuss techniques together. I thought I knew him well...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_273_10: Why... why would he do this...?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_274_1: Have all the recovered Autopuppet remains been transported?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_281_1: Have all the recovered Autopuppet remains been transported?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_281_2: All accounted for... I still cannot wrap my head around it. I saw my own work—the transmission lever I just fixed.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_281_3: Keep a close watch on them. We will need to give an account for this later.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_282_1: Without the Autopuppets, how are we supposed to stop the Tacet Discords?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_282_2: We have to trust the Wardens.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_283_1: Those two over there... who are they?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_283_2: I heard they are reinforcements from Jinzhou. The Ministry of War has been greatly aided by them.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_283_3: But there's... only two of them...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_2: ...Check the Ministry of War, the Ministry of Development, and Huaxu Academy. If there's any space left, get the elderly and children in first.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_3: When the last civilian is inside the Hold, recall the remainder of our forces. Leave only a handful of scouts. The Autopuppets within the city remain operational, but watch them closely. Do not let them fight. Not until we know why this is happening.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_4: Understood. I will send someone at once—Oh, you're here.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_5: I assume this is the Warden Commander?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_7: ...You three must be the ones Liangyu spoke of. In these desperate hours, your willingness to stand with us is a comfort beyond words. I, Qiuhong, owe you a debt!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_8: Commander Qiuhong, there are things we need to discuss with you and Liangyu.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_9: I have just finished our next deployment schedule. We can talk at the Ministry of War.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_291_1: You mean... someone saved you from a rogue Autopuppet?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_291_2: Yes... but I couldn't see their face. They wore a hat.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_291_3: In times like these... who could it have been?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_10: The group arrives at the Ministry of War to exchange the intelligence they have gathered.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_11: So, this Muyu... spent years disguised as a Ministry Artisan, all to lay hands on the Sentinel's technology... That was a grave oversight on our part.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_12: And since Zhuojun Atelier never discloses its members' identities, I fear tracing his origins will lead nowhere...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_13: However, if one digs deeper, the Atelier's connection to Xuanfang Hold runs deeper than most realize.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_15: I discovered the connection in a dossier collected by the Commanders who came before me. Everyone knows when the Threnodian stirred at Norfall Barrens and Tacet Discords swelled beyond control, Sentinel Hsin looked ahead. She chose to build this Hold.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_16: But She did not build it alone. No. She needed hands and sought out a council of helpers.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_17: Back then, Zhuojun Atelier had already stood in Mengzhou for generations. Masters of the mechanist arts. Architects of <ano=Abyssal>Yuan</ano> Fortress. So when the call went out, they answered. They wished to take on the commission for Xuanfang.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_18: Yet for some unknown reason... the Sentinel passed them over.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_19: Who did Hsin choose to assist in the construction instead?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_20: I remember Xiangli Yao telling me that a group from the Court of Savantae once came to Mengzhou...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_21: Exactly. They were the ones who helped build the Hold, but no records of their whereabouts were found afterward.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_22: Could it be... that the Atelier has held a grudge against the Sentinel and Xuanfang Hold after being turned down?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_23: To wait two hundred years for revenge? That Muyu is certainly patient, if nothing else.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_24: No... While I can't say for sure, I believe his motives run deeper than a simple grudge.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_25: Manipulating the Autopuppets to cause chaos may only be one step in his plan. So far, only one place in Xuanfang remains untouched by rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_27: Given the sheer value this Hold represents to this land, it's only natural that he would set his sights on it.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_28: Regardless, we must stand ready to fight. Perhaps... without hope of aid. A fight to the death against rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_30: We stand together, no matter what.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_31: Our people have guarded this Hold for over two centuries...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_32: I hope that its history does not end with us.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_33: Communication across Xuanfang has been severed by unknown interference. Fortunately, the Ministry of Development has just finished a batch of signal nodes. Once we place them around the Hold, they will restore our internal comms and link directly to the defense systems.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_34: This will aid our defense. But we are short on hands... {PlayerName}, would you help set up some of the nodes?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_38: According to the Warden Commander, the Court of Savantae was the last faction involved in building Xuanfang Hold two centuries ago. But regardless of the mysteries weaving these events together, you must brace yourselves for an imminent siege.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_296_1: While you set up the nodes, how about I stay here at the Hold to keep an eye on things?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_296_2: The people you rescued from the Skyworks were brought here as well, weren't they? I'll go check on their condition.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_1: I just remembered... I need to return this sword to the villagers...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_3: It's a long story. A local I met earlier asked me to keep it for them.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_4: It's just... I don't know why, but I feel a strange familiarity with it.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_5: Looking at its edges, I've even started to see things. Flashes of the past.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_6: Like the visions I had when I saw Jué's statue?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_7: But that was because of the history you shared with Jué.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_8: I have never set foot in the Land of Xuanfang before...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_9: What if you've lost your memories too, like I did?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_300_10: {PlayerName}... Really now? How could that be...?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_301_1: Lady Hsin... Why has She not appeared...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_301_2: It's been too long since we last saw Her...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_301_4: I refuse to believe She would simply abandon us...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_303_2: The Huaxu researchers say his condition is stable now. He just needs rest. That sudden Resonance Awakening took a lot out of him.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_303_3: Thank goodness... If not for that power, he and his sister would have fallen from the cliff.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_310_1: There. The two nodes we were assigned are in place...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_310_2: We still have a bit of time. Let's go find the village chief.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_20: Is this what you spoke about before...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_21: Xuanfang Hold... It's like... we're in the past again.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_25: Let's find out where it's coming from, {PlayerName}.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_27: If it isn't Yangyang! You returned unharmed!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_28: Yes, I'm fine. Thank you for your concern.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_29: Your safe return... your safe return is all that matters...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_30: I brought back the blade you entrusted to Liangyu. There was... some trouble along the way, but I managed to keep it safe.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_31: This is... ah, thank you. Thank you.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_32: No thanks are needed, Chief. As I said, this blade gives the courage to walk forward even in the face of death.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_33: It... will bear witness as we weather this storm together.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_34: In the Hold, you and Yangyang meet the chief of Xianling Village and return the longsword to him. But as you place the sword back onto the altar, a familiar song echoes behind you, pulling you and Yangyang into a Sonoro Sphere.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_320_2: I didn't think I'd ever get to see them...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_320_3: (...Why... when I see them... do I have this feeling like...?)
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_322_2: Only a single lost piece. What settles the game lies not on the board, but with us.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_322_3: A lifetime of playing the board. And now, it seems... I am a piece on it myself.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_322_4: You old hack. That last move was the finest of your sorry life.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_323_1: Promise me you will eat well. Sleep well...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_323_3: What else... Ah, yes. Just stay safe, okay?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_323_4: Wait for my return. But if I do not... wait for the Ministry's letter.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_324_1: Oh, Xuanling... Will the Sword Transcendent finally descend from the mountain this time?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_324_3: Could you tell her how my greatest wish has always been to become her disciple?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_3: Now now, don't be so stubborn. Beyond Xuanfang, there are oh so many melodies waiting for you...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_8: Liangyu? Liang... Yu... Hmm. A beautiful name, but it is not mine.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_9: My name is Lingfang. Are you new recruits as well? Heh, the Ministry must truly be in dire straits if they cannot even give you proper uniforms.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_10: (She's the one I saw in those memories. She and Liangyu... Could it be...)
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_13: If I remember correctly, you were once... a musician?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_14: Oh? I did not expect to be recognized so far from Mengzhou.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_15: A shame I cannot play for you now. I have already sold my <ano=stringed instrument>liuqin</ano>. No place for music on a battlefield.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_16: Why did you join the army...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_18: No grand reason. Tacet Discords killed my beloved. So I took up a blade to avenge him. It is as simple as that.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_19: My father served in Mengzhou's Ministry of War. He taught me how to fight when I was young, but I grew bored after a few years and ran away to study music. It was during those wandering years that I met him.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_20: Others might have seen only an ordinary painter, but I saw the colors within him. He walked away from a chance to study at the Mingting Institute of Art, all to stay in the hometown he loved so dearly.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_21: He loved painting the Xuanling Birds. They were his voice. They helped him confess what he was too shy to say to me himself.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_22: But it's all gone now. Tacet Discords took everything.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_23: The thought of those monsters coming here to trample the land he held so dear...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_25: So I took up the sword again, just like my father had always wished. He used to say a sword is wielded for one's country and people. I still don't think I understand what that means.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_28: Whether it's for a person, an ideal, or something more profound that's hard to put in words...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_29: We feel for the things we hold dear. Sorrow. Joy. Fear. Shame. Anger.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_30: That is why we choose to protect.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_31: And you're protecting more than the memories you made with him. You're protecting the place where countless new memories and feelings will be born.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_33: Protect, you say... We have a baby girl, and I... I only wish I could protect her as she grows.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_36: Don't worry, she will grow up healthy and safe.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_37: She will find her own love, career, and family, and she will protect her child with the same love you gave her. That will pass on, for generations.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_38: To the future and to faraway tomorrows we can't yet see.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_41: Then... I will hold onto that hope.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_42: I must go. Though I do not know your name, it was a comfort to speak with you before I march onto the battlefield.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_43: I have nothing to offer you in return, so... I give you my song.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_44: The only thing I kept was this <ano=bamboo flute>xiao</ano>. My husband made it for me. I could not bear to part with it.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_45: It never made a single note, but I never told him. That lumbering man was never good with his hands...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_46: Inside the Sonoro Sphere, you see the memories of Lingfang, Liangyu's ancestor from two hundred years ago. Her husband had been killed by Tacet Discords, and she was about to march onto the battlefield. Before departing, she sang the familiar song once more as a thank-you to Yangyang for comforting her.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_340_3: The last node is in place. Communications around Xuanfang Hold should be fully restored.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_340_4: We have mobilized all functional heavy siege weapons from the reserves, and Commander Qiuhong has completed the defensive deployment.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_340_5: However... the enemy moves faster than we anticipated.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_340_6: No time to explain. Meet me at the front gate!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_340_9: It's our turn to protect this land now.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_350_3: No... We can't let them reach the Hold!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_350_6: There are too many of them...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_350_7: The frontline... leave it to me.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_360_1: Too many. If they break through here... the Hold falls.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_360_2: Hsin the Moon Fox... Lend me your strength now!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_361_1: ({PlayerName} is taking the brunt of it...)

Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_390_12: Turn back here. Leave what follows to ■■■, and you may remain in ignorant bliss, living only for "yourself."

Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_390_17: But no matter what, I won't let {Male=him;Female=her} face this alone.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_390_19: Forgive us. We never intended for any living soul to hear this Voice.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_390_20: For in every ending, not one has ever succeeded in saving anything.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_390_22: Will this time be different? We do not know.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_390_23: If this is your will, your wish, and the path you have chosen...
