Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_2: Oh? Having chased me here, did you enjoy this little game of pretend? And you—I wonder where you picked up that sickening habit of playing human.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_3: I don't know how you've managed to control the Autopuppets...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_4: But you'd better make them stop right now.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_6: No, there's no question that the Autopuppets are functioning exactly as they should. How could a mere mortal like me command the Sentinel's creations?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_7: ...Liar. If not for your interference, how could the Sentinel's constructs ever harm the very people they were built to protect?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_11: Heh... Sentinels protecting humans... What an absurd delusion.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_12: Is it because they guide civilization? Because the Sentinels of Huanglong reign alongside humans? You're from Jinzhou, aren't you? Did that girl who became the Sentinel's Resonator feed you that pretty fantasy?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_13: We know nothing of the Sentinels. Not their design, not their internal structure, not where they obtained knowledge that eclipses all human understanding.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_14: Is "protect humanity" written into their core code? Has a single Sentinel ever confirmed it to you?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_15: No. That idea is rooted only in shallow experience, in the numbness of those who have grown comfortable under borrowed protection.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_16: Sentinels... Why do they guide us? And to what end? No one knows.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_17: You cling to this notion that they protect us, because of what? Because they have grown to "feel" for us?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_20: Every Sentinel I've met has sacrificed everything for the people under their watch.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_21: You dragging their names in the dirt won't change that.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_22: Hah... "Feeling." If you want to say the world indeed walks on ice this thin...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_23: Then my work here is proof of how easily that feeling can curdle into carnage and suffering.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_25: Kill... Kill all of you... Tacet Discords... Rot in hell...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_27: Spare no one... Do not let any escape...!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_30: It took me two centuries to learn how to shape these useless passions into something useful.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_31: I have to admit, the process was not without its pleasures.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_33: I simply altered the <ano=parameters>perception</ano> of these Reverberations. Redirected their rage. Not at the Tacet Discords, but at humanity itself. Then I installed them into the Autopuppets.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_35: And just like that, the protectors become the butchers. A single thread of foolish obsession is enough to shatter every line of logic, every careful protocol.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_37: Feeling... is this dangerous. The enemy of reason. The wellspring of chaos. Humans must learn to control it... No, to discard it entirely.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_40: When the ones we love are taken, and our homes are trampled... when a parent realizes they will never watch their child grow, or a peaceful soul is forced to pick up a blade just to survive...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_41: Of course we grieve. Of course we resent. Of course we rage.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_42: Humans are not puppets. From the moment we're born, we find our own "voice."
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_43: Whether it laughs or weeps, roars or wails... those voices make up the colors of this world.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_45: But you... you twist them. Mock them. Treat them as tools. You will never understand what they truly mean.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_47: You are nothing but a coward covering his ears! A madman worshipping his own delusions as truth!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_50: You pride yourself on seeing through everything, but you're a greater fool than any you scorn.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_60: You will be eaten by the very "rage" you created.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_400_61: Deep within the Censure Court, you confront Muyu. He rants about his distrust of Sentinels and his rejection of human emotion, unveiling the truth behind the Autopuppet uprising. Refuting his twisted theory, you and Yangyang face Muyu's creation—the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion, a colossus powered by the Reverberations of countless fallen souls. To stop Muyu, you must shatter this distorted manifestation of his will.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_410_1: The simple addition of one superfluous thread, and the perfect guardian becomes a fearsome executioner in an instant.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_410_2: You still don't get it, do you? You don't believe, that's all. So you're desperate to be right and lord it above everyone else.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_410_3: What you have done... is not worth the breath it would take to refute it!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_410_59: If the Sentinels protect humanity only because they "feel," then one day, one moment, one of them could "feel" differently and do the opposite.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_415_1: These Reverberations have echoed in the abyss for two hundred years. Even now, their remnants serve my purpose.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_420_2: Isn't it ironic that the very voices you resonate with and mourn for are burying you alive?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_421_1: Stopped already? Feeling pity for these Reverberations?
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_421_2: Heh... So this is what your so-called "rage" looks like.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_425_1: Kill... Kill all of you... Tacet Discords... Rot in hell...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_428_2: Must... Kill them... Every last one...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_429_1: Tacet Discords! Tacet Discords! You damned Tacet Discords...!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_429_2: A hundred times... A thoudsand times... I'll keep killing you all!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_430_17: I have nothing to offer you in return, so... I give you my song.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_431_2: I knew it. You truly are special...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_431_3: I failed to claim your Reverberation at the Skyworks, but it is not too late...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_431_5: You will never... toy with another soul again!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_432_4: Everyone... entrusted their final voices to me.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_432_5: Let's... guide them to the end, {PlayerName}.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_5: Two hundred years of Xuanfang's history breathes through us—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_6: It's almost impressive that you two held your own against the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion for this long...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_7: You face a will more powerful than you can imagine!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_8: ...Pathetic fools. You have guarded this Hold for over two hundred years, yet still you're blind to its fundamental nature.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_9: I am but a single step away from my "destination." Anything that stands in my way now is nothing more than a momentary diversion.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_10: ...Everyone knows what this Hold means better than you ever will.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_11: You climbed this high by trampling others beneath you—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_440_12: You will never reach your "destination." Not today. Not ever.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_441_1: Spare no one... Do not let any escape...!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_442_1: Keep attacking! Don't stop! Leave them no breath!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_1: In the Fortress and Gorges War...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_2: And yet, in the hearts of the people...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_7: Even if the tragedy repeats, time and again...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_9: —We will always make the same choice.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_10: Then, from the past, we walk toward tomorrow.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_11: We lost everything we had built.
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_13: Is this enough? I can go back to the Hold for more—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_14: I'll be a Xuanfang Warden too—
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_460_15: Come now, darling. Dinner's waiting at home...
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_550_1: Incredible...! They actually held back that many Autopuppets and Tacet Discords!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_550_2: Soldiers, now is our chance! Press the attack!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_600_1: Damned monsters! Will they never stop?!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_600_2: There is no retreat... We fight until the very end!
Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_640_1: Rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords are gathering outside the city...{PlayerName}, are you ready?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_270_2: I don't expect any of you to read these words. If anything, I'd rather say them to your faces.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_270_3: What I've been through here, and what I still have yet to face...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_2: This way... Chixia will be safe...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_7: What is this?! Why are the Autopuppets—Ngh—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_13: ...I will go back for the others. Do not worry.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_15: ...Anyone still standing, with me! Push through!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_16: We have to get word back... to Xuanfang Hold...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_18: A Rafter Kite? Why'd it fly here? Ah! That's—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_19: Watcher Liangyu! Someone's fighting the Autopuppets over there!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_20: At a time like this... How is that—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_21: Everyone, get in formation! Keep them away from the village!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_24: To protect Chixia, Yangyang lures the Autopuppets and Tacets Discords deep into the Land of Xuanfang. Just as she is about to Overclock, a Rafter Kite leads a squad of Xuanfang Wardens to her rescue.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_290_1: But... in all these years, nothing like this has ever happened. Many still refuse to leave their homes.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_290_2: They're emergency orders from the Commander. Everyone outside the Hold falls back inside.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_290_3: Xuanfang has always stood under the Sentinel's protection. How could this possibly...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_290_4: I told you. We cannot reach the Sentinel right now.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_290_8: Yangyang wakes up in an old house, overhearing Lianyu speaking with an elder outside.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_2: ...No one is willing to believe it. The Autopuppets are creations of Mengzhou's Sentinel. Under no rightful circumstance should they ever spill the blood of innocents.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_3: And even if someone was pulling their strings, using them to throw Xuanfang into chaos... it's unthinkable! It would mean someone has the means to breach, maybe even unravel, the Sentinel's own intelligence.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_4: If this was all orchestrated from the shadows... then the only force I know that might be capable of such a thing is...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_5: ...Could this be the work of the Fractsidus?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_6: The Fractsidus... that infamous terrorist organization? I can't say. At the very least, we have seen no one in red robes within these lands for a very long time.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_7: If only Zhuojun Atelier could send one or two Helmsmasters right now... No. Wishful thinking.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_9: A Mengzhou organization devoted to mechanist art. Nearly half the craftsmen in Mengzhou have ties to Zhuojun Atelier. When it comes to mechanisms, they're second only to Sentinel Hsin and the Ministry of Development.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_10: But unlike the Minstry of Development or Huaxu Academy, they don't answer to City Hall. Their leadership rarely shows itself. And now that Xuanfang has lost contact with Mengzhou...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_11: ...Whatever the truth may be, the safety of the people comes first.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_12: As for the missing travelers from Jinzhou... I'm sorry. The Ministry of War never received word of them, and in our current situation, I fear we cannot spare the manpower to assist your investigation.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_13: Please don't apologize. I have no proof, but I can't shake the feeling that all of this... is connected somehow.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_14: Besides, as comrades-in-arms, we should stand by one another. If there's any way I can help, you need only say the word.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_15: ...Thank you. We are short of hands.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_16: Many of our soldiers were wounded in the clash with the Autopuppets. They need time to recover.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_17: Once our scouts have mapped a safe route back to the Hold, we'll escort everyone out of here.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_18: Until then, I'll go check on the villagers.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_20: After exchanging information with Liangyu, Yangyang volunteers to help the Xuanfang Wardens evacuate the villagers to safety.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_293_8: The men are still resting. We're counting who's left in the village...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_293_9: Once preparations are complete, we move out, Gra—Chief.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_293_10: Ah... how did it come to this...?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_293_11: Has the Sentinel... has our Lady Hsin truly forsaken us...?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_11: Oh, you're awake. You almost Overclocked and have been unconscious for hours. How do you feel? Anything hurt?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_12: I'm fine... I just don't understand what's happening...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_13: ...Name's Liangyu. I'm a <te href=750047>Xuan Watcher</te> under the Ministry of War, stationed at Xuanfang Hold. This is Xianling Village, at the foot of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Most folks here are locals.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_15: Now answer my questions. Who are you? Why are you here? And why were you fighting the Autopuppets?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_16: ...I am Yangyang. Outrider under Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers. I came to Xuanfang to help the Patrollers investigate the recent disappearances in Jinzhou.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_17: My partner and I followed the trail through the Dreaming Cavern, but we ran into a large swarm of Tacet Discords outside the mountain gate... But then it suddenly opened. To buy my partner time to escape, I went in alone to draw them off.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_18: What came after that... you already know.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_19: Jinzhou... Folks going missing... Tacet Discords running wild... The gate opening by itself...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_20: Jinzhou hasn't been informed... Mengzhou won't answer... What is all this...? Tch—!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_21: I thought the Autopuppets of Xuanfang Hold were meant to aid soldiers against Tacet Discords. Why did they turn on the people?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_23: Liangyu gives Yangyang a brief account of events.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_295_1: The Autopuppets could strike again at any moment...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_295_2: We need to get everyone to a safe rally point...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_295_3: And I should talk to the Wardens to learn more about Xuanfang.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_296_2: I'm sorry, Auntie. We couldn't bring him home. Please... stay strong.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_297_2: ...Please hurry. The Wardens want everyone gathered in the village square.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_297_4: Xiaoyi, pack your things. We're going to Xuanfang Hold.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_297_5: We're going inside the big walls? Then can I go see Uncle Qiu?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_297_6: We will not trouble Uncle Qiu. He's very busy.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_298_1: (Looks like this house is already empty...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_1: Hey, you! You're from Jinzhou, aren't you? Do you know Uncle Dong?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_2: (Uncle Dong... he's on the missing persons list!)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_3: I do. Have you seen him?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_4: I have! He was headed to Mengzhou and passed through our village. He told the most amazing opera stories!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_5: Pity he only stayed one night. Come morning, he hurried off at first light. No telling when he will return…
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_6: Oh... With Xuanfang in such a state, he likely won't be back anytime soon. I still wanted to hear the rest of his tale.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_7: (She still doesn't know what became of him...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_299_8: (But this confirms it. The people from Jinzhou all vanished somewhere in the Land of Xuanfang.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_1: Well now, young maiden... is this <te href=750051>Rafter Kite</te> yours? So lively, and such fine craftsmanship too. A master's hand, no doubt.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_3: No, sir. It's just that... for reasons I don't understand, it seems intent on guiding me to various places.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_4: Oh? Curious, very curious... I see feathers in your hair and a Tacet Mark upon your brow. You are a Resonator, yes? Ha... perhaps this Rafter Kite has grown a mind of its own and taken you for a <te href=750054>Xuanling Bird</te> of old.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_5: A Xuanling Bird... Forgive me, sir. I'm not from here. Might you tell me what that is?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_6: Ahh... never mind you outsiders. Unfortunately, plenty of young folk from these parts no longer care for the legend of the Xuanling either.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_7: Long before these lands were claimed under Mengzhou, a flock of spirit birds dwelt here. Azure of body, black of plume. People called them <ano=Numinous Plume>"Xuanling"</ano>.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_8: They did not think as we do, but they could see into the heart and bear its voice to another. In those days, the land was cruel and the roads few. People entrusted the Xuanling with their joys, sorrows, and longings, trusting the bird to carry them across the wilds.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_9: Such a pity... That war two hundred years ago laid waste to Xuanfang's land and people, driving the Xuanling to extinction as well.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_10: (Two hundred years ago... he must mean the <te href=750053>Fortress and Gorges War</te> that led to Jinzhou's founding.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_11: Later, after Xuanfang Hold was built, Mengzhou's mechanist arts found their way here. In memory of those birds, local craftsmen fashioned the Rafter Kite in their image, to carry letters and messages in their stead.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_13: You've been favored by this one. Treat it kindly... For when people cease to speak of the Xuanling, the hands that know how to craft a Rafter Kite will grow fewer and fewer.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_14: (Come to think of it, it was this little thing that led Liangyu and the Wardens to my aid before.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_15: An elder tells Yangyang the origins of the Rafter Kite and the legend of the Xuanling Bird.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_301_15: Uncle Gao! H-have you seen Qingyan...?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_18: Excuse me. Has a child from the village gone missing?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_19: Yes! He's about eight or nine. Not very tall, thin as a twig. Scruffy mop of hair.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_20: I'll help look for him. I'm quite good at finding people.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_22: He... he's been missing ever since Liangyu came back...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_23: I've asked the other children, but none of them know where he went...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_24: Yan... I haven't seen him. Was it because... Ah...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_309_1: I've checked out most of the village by now...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_309_2: Time to speak with a Warden and see how things stand.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_1: So you're the one who held off more than a dozen Autopuppets on your own... that is no small feat.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_2: Liangyu said you're an Outrider from Jinzhou? I should have guessed. The front lines against Tacet Discords do not breed ordinary soldiers. Only the finest make it there.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_3: I... I wouldn't go that far. But those Tacet Discords I fought here... they were nothing like the ones I've fought before. They were fast, vicious, like veterans tempered by countless battles.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_4: For two centuries, Xuanfang's Censure Courts have purged TDs within its borders. Anything that survived the Autopuppets and generations of Wardens would have to be brutal and cunning.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_5: Though to be fair, the Autopuppets do the heavy lifting. We Wardens mostly support them in combat.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_6: But now the Autopuppets have turned on us, the Paragon is trapped in a Censure Court, and of the Triad, only Liangyu remains... Even if we retreat to the Hold, we still will not be able to stop what's coming.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_8: It's okay, I don't need comforting. After decades in uniform, you learn to make peace with whatever may come. It is only...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_9: If you are willing, comrade, do us one favor. Look after Liangyu.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_10: She has talent, but she is still young. Most days, the other two Watchers kept her under their wing, like an older brother and sister. She saw them the same way.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_11: The battlefield has no place for tears. But any eye can see their deaths have left their mark.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_12: A leader cannot afford to show weakness before the ranks. Liangyu is too proud for that. She will only bury it inside.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_13: You look to be about her age, and you are not of the Xuanfang Wardens. So... she might open up to you.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_14: I see... Understood. I'll do what I can to help lighten her burden.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_15: It's clear she means a great deal to all of you.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_16: Of course she does. She lost her parents young and was raised by the whole village. For us, it's hard not to think of her as our little sister.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_17: In any case, I leave it to you.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_18: Back then, only a few people could face powerful Tacet Discords alone: the Warden Commander, the Xuan Triad Watchers... and that elusive Xuan Paragon.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_19: A Xuanfang Warden named Yanlang confides that Liangyu recently lost two comrades to Autopuppet ambushes. Out of concern, he asks Yangyang to keep an eye on Liangyu.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_311_1: Qingyan... Ah, Qingzhi's little brother. Yes, I saw him.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_311_2: He tried to sneak into the tents a little while ago, but the men on duty drove him out. After that... I think he headed toward the shrine.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_311_3: By the way, have you seen a child named Qingyan?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_311_4: I see... Thank you. That's all for now.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_313_1: Y-You! How did you find me?!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_313_2: Please... Don't tell my family I'm here, okay?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_313_3: I was just going to the shrine. I remember there's a sword there.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_313_4: If I take that sword... then maybe I can...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_314_3: (I'd better keep following him for now.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_315_1: (This must be the boy that woman was looking for...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_315_2: (His sister must've been in Liangyu's unit...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_315_3: (I'd better keep following him for now.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_4: Ling, why must you put yourself through this. Your little girl is only three. If you go to war...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_6: Forgive me, Grandmother. But my mind is made. My husband never came home. A Xuanling brought word that he was slain by Tacet Discords in the Gorges of Spirits...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_7: If I do not answer that blood with blood, then every vow we swore means nothing... Just think, he spent half his life painting Xuanfang's landscapes. How could I watch them be destroyed by Tacet Discords?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_8: Take this <ano=stringed instrument>liuqin</ano> to Mengzhou and pawn it. It should fetch enough to see you both through for a time.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_9: Once this war is over, I... will return to Mengzhou for you.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_11: Xuanling... So you birds already know what will happen, don't you?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_12: If you do, then go. Take nothing with you. Let it all be buried here.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_13: You are the solace people cling to. The bridge between hearts.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_14: Do not become an ill omen in their eyes. Do not be messengers of death.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_16: Leave... before it turns into hell.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_18: Are you well, young maiden? You look a bit dazed.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_19: You... you were the one speaking with Liangyu earlier.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_20: Yes. I am Qiankun, the village chief. I have watched over Liangyu since she was just a child.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_22: Chief, if I may ask, what is this sword enshrined here?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_23: A nameless sword. And because it bears no name, it belongs to every soul who fought in that battle.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_24: Two hundred years ago, the Fortress and Gorges War tore through Xuanfang. Not only did Mengzhou send its great armies, but most of Xuanfang's own sons and daughters also took up arms to defend their home.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_25: I was not yet born in those days. I know only what the elders told me. They spoke of a battle so ghastly that the sky itself ran red. For every ten who went to war, scarcely one returned alive.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_26: This sword was found among the ruins of that battle. Its owner is unknown. But this much is certain, the one who wielded it died protecting this land.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_27: When the war ended, those who had taken refuge in Mengzhou slowly made their way home. This shrine was raised in memory of the heroes who fell.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_28: (That woman I saw... was she going to join the Fortress and Gorges War?)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_41: If I have to... I'll take this sword...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_43: Leave me alone! I will slay those Autopuppets and Tacet Discords! I will avenge my sister!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_44: Yan! You foolish child! What are you doing here?!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_47: A boy leads Yangyang to Xianling Village's shrine, where an old longsword is preserved. In a fleeting vision, she sees a fragment of memory, and later learns from the village chief that the sword once belonged to an unknown soldier from the Fortress and Gorges War.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_30: We thought those days belonged to the ashes of history. And yet... this land must suffer a new calamity. I wonder what our ancestors would make of this, were they watching.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_31: ...Even so, we cannot simply sit and wait.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_33: It all comes down to what we do. At least for now, there are still things within our power.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_34: Chief, I believe this sword isn't just a monument to the fallen. It may also give people the courage to... walk forward even in the face of death.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_35: Well spoken. Now you make me sound like a bitter old fool.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_36: Would you do an old man a favor? Take this sword and pass it to Liangyu. Let the Wardens carry it back to the Hold.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_37: Tacet Discords scour the land bare. A sword is but iron and steel, but it is still part of Xuanfang's legacy. I would see it kept safe.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_38: Of course, Chief. Let me speak with Liangyu.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_39: You had the right of it, Yangyang. The Autopuppets were a gift from the Sentinel, and for two hundred quiet years, we have leaned upon that gift.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_40: And yet... it comes down to what we do. What we do.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_41: Little Yan... I understand his heart. He and Qingzhi were always so close.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_42: Out of respect for the fallen, the village chief asks Yangyang to deliver the sword to the Wardens for safekeeping.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_1: You must listen, Yan! Come back with me!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_2: I... I'm not leaving! If I leave... who will avenge our sister?!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_5: Tell me. Have you trained with a weapon? Do you know how to fight an enemy many times stronger than yourself? Do you think you can really avenge her?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_6: I... I've watched the Xuanfang Wardens train.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_7: Your sister was a Warden, and she was strong. But even she could not walk away from that battlefield alive.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_8: Then what... what am I supposed to do?! She... she's never coming back.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_10: What about your other sister? Don't you mean to protect her?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_12: Stay by her side. Go with the others to the rally point.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_13: Young miss... are you a soldier too? Like my sister?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_14: Yes. I became a soldier so I could protect those who can't protect themselves.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_15: That is not a vow you fulfill in a single day, nor a single year.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_16: Then... will you teach me? Swordwork, I mean. The kind that can beat those Tacet Discords!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_323_17: I will. That is my promise. But you have to promise me in return: until that day, keep your sister safe.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_340_1: (The Chief was right... I should go talk to Liangyu.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_343_1: Fly on, Xuanling, fly over rivers... Rivers flow, mountains loom...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_5: Do you need something? The scouts have not yet returned, but we cannot wait much longer.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_6: Once everyone is gathered, we move.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_7: I met the village chief just now. He wishes for this sword to be kept with the Xuanfang Wardens.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_8: A sword? At a time like this? Retreat will be dangerous enough. I'd ask everyone only to protect themselves and those beside them, not cold steel.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_9: Then I will carry it myself, for now.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_10: You... Fine. Do as you see fit.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_11: I also never properly thanked you for saving me. And for giving me a room to rest.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_12: It is nothing. I have not stayed in this village for years. The house was sitting empty.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_14: Just an old house... Soon enough, this village may be flattened by Tacet Discords. Nothing left but rubble.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_15: Houses can always be rebuilt. But the dead do not come back...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_16: Then let's focus on those who are still alive.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_18: Yangyang presents the blade to Liangyu and relays the chief's wish. Overwhelmed by anxiety, Liangyu refuses to take it, so Yangyang decides to keep it for now. Seeing how disheartened Liangyu is by the loss of her comrades, Yangyang steps in to comfort her.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_18: My Forte allows me to catch the messages the wind carries from far away.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_19: It's useful. Convenient. It lets me notice, in places no one looks, that someone is waiting for a hand to reach out to them.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_21: The echoes of tragedy. The aftershocks of disaster... Everything is already over and done with. There's nothing left I can change... and yet it forces me to listen.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_23: Even now, those sounds make my heart clench.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_25: It's all right. I know. Because I've already... heard it.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_26: ...I am afraid to look them in the eyes.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_27: I know what they are all waiting for. Because I am waiting too. Waiting for someone to step forward.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_28: Duzhong and Qingzhi were that kind of person. Xuan Watchers or not, they would have made great commanders. And yet they died. And I was the one who lived.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_29: If only I had seen it, just few seconds sooner. If my life could buy back theirs... I would...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_31: Better? It helps a little, saying it out loud, doesn't it?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_32: I think... you don't need anyone to tell you what to do. You already know.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_33: You're only afraid you won't do it well enough. Because some mistakes cannot be undone.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_34: But even so, sometimes we just have to go through with it, don't we?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_35: Was that how you all felt, too? During the Battle of Norfall Barrens?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_36: I can't speak for anyone else. But by the end, my mind was blank. I fought on instinct. On the will to stay alive.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_37: We only won that battle because so many stood with us. And back then, there really was someone who stood in front of me, in front of all of us.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_39: But I also know, {Male=he;Female=she} won't always be there.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_40: If I only ever chase someone else's shadow, I'll never truly move forward.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_41: I hope next time {Male=he;Female=she} and I meet, I'll be able to stand beside {Male=him;Female=her}. Not behind.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_42: The situation in Xuanfang Hold is still uncertain. But as I said before, the Streams brought me here. So the only thing I can do is...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_43: ...You are right. Whatever comes, I have a duty to fulfill.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_44: By the way, that song earlier...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_45: Song? Oh, did I hum it aloud?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_46: It's a little tune. My mother taught it to me when I was little.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_47: I never learned all of it. They say the written score was lost two hundred years ago. Now all people remember is a half-forgotten tune.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_54: You... knew this tune before? Or did you memorize it just from listening once?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_55: I just thought that it might help everyone breathe a little easier.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_56: Maybe it did. You certainly sing it better than I do.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_64: I... There is nothing to say.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_65: Any other time, I wouldn't press you.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_66: But Liangyu, we're soldiers. We have our duties. This is no time to indulge ourselves.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_67: Yangyang comforts Liangyu with a few gentle words and sings a song she heard from Liangyu earlier to ease the tense, suffocating atmosphere hanging over the village.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_57: Watcher Liangyu, a Skywatch Ring has detected Autopuppets moving this way. They will reach Xianling Village in about two hours.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_58: Then we have no time to waste. If the scouts still haven't reported back, we'll have to move and scout as we go.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_59: I'll go. Scouting is part of an Outrider's duties, and my Forte can help me avoid danger.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_60: Okay. Here are the coordinates for the garrison camp outside the city. There will be people waiting there to receive you. Once you arrive, have the guards send the route by a <te href=750051>Rafter Kite</te>. We'll move out as soon as we have it.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_61: I will have the officer in charge unlock the Cloud Ride for you. Should save you quite a bit of time.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_62: When Xuanfang Warden Mingyu reports incoming Autopuppet movements, Yangyang volunteers to scout the Eastern Xuan Peaks to map a safe retreat route in place of their missing scouts.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_360_1: I was expecting you. Hand me your Terminal. I'll grant you access to the Cloud Ride.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_360_2: It's a joint project of Mengzhou's Huaxu Academy and the Ministry of Development. Leaves any glider in the dust.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_360_3: If you're heading to the camp, there's a side path nearby.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_360_4: The Eastern Xuan Peaks are treacherous, and the Disorienting Fog hangs thick through much of it. Be careful.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_370_1: (The Cloud Ride... It's easier to handle than I expected.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_370_2: (Chixia would love this. I wonder if she made it out safely...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_380_2: (They are really closing in... I have to move faster.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_390_1: (This... this must be the Disorienting Fog that Warden mentioned.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_390_2: (Visibility's too low... I'll have to find a way around.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_400_2: (That must be the garrison camp Liangyu mentioned.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_400_3: (Looks like there are still soliders there. I need to make haste.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_401_1: First... I need to get a sense of the terrain.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_402_1: That path over there... should avoid most of the Autopuppets.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_403_2: I might be able to end this quickly!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_404_1: Too many... Engaging them would cause too much noise.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_405_2: Liangyu's scouts... This must be them.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_1: Halt! Who goes there?! Identify yourself!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_2: Yangyang gives the guards a quick briefing.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_3: So Watcher Liangyu sent you to map a route. Good! We've been waiting a long time.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_4: Also, I found scouts along the way. They're already...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_5: I see... Thank you for telling me. They were long overdue, so I... I feared as much.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_6: No time to lose. We must send word to Liangyu immediately.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_7: Good work. The camp is just ahead. I'll find you a place to rest.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_1: (I hope everyone makes it through safely...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_2: Excuse me, miss... do you have a Rafter Kite with you?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_3: If it's not too much to ask, could you let it carry a letter for me? A letter home, to Mengzhou.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_5: Ah... I've been away from home for many years now. Now Xuanfang has fallen into chaos. I may never see my wife and children again. This letter is my last wish.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_6: I asked every soldier in the Hold, but they all say that under these cirsumstances every Rafter Kite must be reserved for military reports. Please...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_7: It's alright. Give me the letter.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_8: Thank you... Thank you, oh, thank you!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_9: (I hope the first thing his family sees is not this letter, but the man himself returning home.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_11: (Sister said she'd come visit Jinzhou soon. If she can't find me, will she worry?)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_12: (Maybe I should... write down what I've seen here.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_13: (If nothing else, I can put the clues in order. Perhaps it will help whoever reads it.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_420_14: At the garrison camp, an Artisan begs Yangyang to use the Rafter Kite to send a letter home. She agrees, wishing him a safe return. As several cherished faces flash through her mind, Yangyang decides to pick up her pen and record her own journey, just in case.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_1: (Write about Xianling Village and the Rafter Kite.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_5: Since entering the Land of Xuanfang, I have been set upon by both Autopuppets and Tacet Discords. For what cause I was targeted, I cannot say. But the Xuanfang Wardens pulled me from the brink, and that is how I came to Xianling Village.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_7: Somewhere along the way, a mechanical bird began to follow me. The locals call it a "Rafter Kite." They say it was modeled after a spirit bird that once dwelt in Xuanfang. It is remarkably clever. Now and then, it seems to lead me to places. Almost like a real, living bird.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_9: In Xianling Village, I met Liangyu. She is young, yet she already holds the title of Xuan Watcher. She told me of the chaos that has swept across Xuanfang. Her squadmates were slaughtered in a Censure Court.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_11: Something in her reminds me of who I once was. If I can, I will lift some of the weight off her shoulders.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_12: The Autopuppets meant to purge Tacet Discords... have gone rogue. They now attack the people. I can't prove it yet, but something tells me this isn't just a malfunction. It's deliberate. Someone's behind it. But Xuanfang Hold's comms have been cut. The Wardens are barely holding the line against both Autopuppets and Tacet Discords. No one has the time or strength to find out what's really going on.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_15: If only I could gather some clues through the Streams...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_1: Really? None of them managed to？
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_2: Yangyang. Thanks to you, we slipped past the Autopuppets and TDs. We were blessed to make it with no losses.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_3: As long as everyone is safe.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_4: The Hold is just ahead. Once we catch our breath, I'll have the guards clear passage and escort everyone inside.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_5: As for your case, the Commander has been collecting intelligence by Rafter Kite. Once we reach him, we can decide our next steps together.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_6: Understood. And with any luck, Mengzhou may already have reinforcements on the way.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_7: Hah... I hope that is the case.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_9: How—? We should've avoided all of them—
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_10: Fire the signal! Rally the Hold's support!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_11: Tch—they're too fast... There's no time—Battle lines! Cover the civilians! Buy them time to fall back!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_13: That won't hold! We're outnumbered three to one. The line will break!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_16: Watcher Liangyu! The Hold is answering our signal!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_17: Liangyu, one of us has to stay behind to hold them off...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_18: Liangyu, you are our captain now. Don't lose sight of that.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_24: Everyone else—fall back! Stay in formation! Fall back as fast as you can!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_27: I'll play decoy and draw them away. Trust me. I've done this before.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_28: There are too many for one. If you ask me, we need three. At least three.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_29: With Yangyang's help, the Wardens escort the villagers safely to camp. But just as they begin to relax, a sudden wave of Autopuppets and Tacet Discords ambushes them. Yangyang and two Xuanfang Wardens volunteer as bait to buy time for the evacuation.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_445_1: I need to lead these Autopuppets another way...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_450_2: No one can hold that many alone. Don't let them surround you!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_450_3: We Wardens know these Autopuppets better than anyone. There's no way we let a Jinzhou Midnight Ranger bait them off by herself.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_460_5: I'm sorry. If I'd only gotten here a little sooner...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_460_6: Heh... Now you sound... just like... little Liangyu.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_460_7: I'm all right... Just need... to rest... some rest and I'll be fine.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_460_9: Quite a few girls... had taken a shining to him.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_460_13: After a grueling battle, the villagers evacuate, but Mingyu and Yanlang are killed in action. As Yangyang mourns them, a melody drifts through the air. She turns, only to find herself on a battlefield.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_463_16: A Sonoro? But how did I...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_464_20: Xuanling... tell me... Yuan Fortress... did it stand?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_464_21: Please... I still had... things I wanted to say...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_464_22: Walking through this Sonoro-formed battlefield, Yangyang hears a dying, blood-soaked Warden calling out to her in his final moments.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_470_1: (The frequency in the Streams has changed... So this is a Sonoro...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_470_2: (But why...? Is it because of that sword?)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_470_3: (Xuanling... I saw it in those memories back in the village...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_470_4: (Are they... seeing me as one of those birds?)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_480_2: Ugh... I think... I can't feel my legs...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_480_4: Don't know. Not many left, I'd guess...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_480_5: We held off the first wave, but the next one...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_480_6: Hey... Xuanling. Do you think... we'll win this?
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_480_7: Heh... Either way... I'm afraid neither of us... will live to find out...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_481_3: Go... Go now... The village is already...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_481_4: Pro-promise me... Go and see... if there's still... anyone...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_481_5: Take them away... Away from here...
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_482_2: I don't want to die... I can't die!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_482_3: My brothers and sisters... my parents... my wife and children... They're all waiting.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_482_4: Tacet Discords...! Tacet Discords! Those cursed, wretched Tacet Discords!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_482_5: KILLING YOU A HUNDRED TIMES, NO, A THOUSAND TIMES... WOULD NEVER BE ENOUGH!
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_490_1: (How many battles have been fought in this place...)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_490_2: (And how many more are still to come?)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_490_8: (These sounds... They just keep flooding in.)
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_490_11: The chaotic roar of ancient battle floods Yangyang's mind, splitting her head with pain. Amidst the agony, a faint, familiar song drifts from afar.
Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_500_1: Fly on, Xuanling... Fly with a shattered heart...

Main_Mengzhou_3_6_665_30: After enjoying a plate of Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar, you and Qingxiao stroll through the streets of Xuanfang Hold. Inside are illustrations of sword techniques you recognize as your own, from long ago.

Main_Mengzhou_3_6_491_31: You need not answer, but I shall call you such... even if only for this short while.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_491_32: You're a sight for sore eyes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_491_33: Neither. They are simply my thoughts.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_491_34: At any rate, you're still the Qingxiao I know.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_491_35: As Qingxiao wakes, you finally meet within her inner landscape. She has come to understand the path she will walk from here on. She tells you of the Fortress and Gorges War two hundred years ago, and how the two of you once crossed paths at the Gorges of Spirits. Even when aid offers no guarantee of a good end, you will both still follow your hearts and do all you can. In this shared calling to protect, neither of you stands alone. Fellow guardians at heart, you lay yourselves bare to one another, and Qingxiao sets aside her reserve and claims you as her disciple.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_1: Before we depart, is there anything you wish to ask? Time flows much faster here than out there. We still have a moment.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_2: Is this place your inner world?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_3: What of your inner demon? Are you alright?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_4: What's the situation at the Ministry of War?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_6: Yes. This <te href=800052>Inner Landscape</te> manifests during my meditations. It is a reflection of my state of mind.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_7: How did I get in here?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_8: ...That strand of <te href=800055>Lifebound Sword Intent</te> I gave you has, to a certain extent, bound our lives to the same wellspring.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_9: When my Resonance Energy ran dry, my Inner Demon surfaced. My inner landscape began to collapse. That is how you were pulled in. But...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_12: Do not worry. My mind has settled. My Resonance Ability is stabilizing. I am far from full strength, but I will not lose control again.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_14: You have me. No more soloing it, okay?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_15: Yes. I have you by my side.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_16: I have been sensing the battle through my Sword Intent. The line is holding. The soldiers and people of Xuanfang stand united. They will protect the Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_17: But that is all we can burden them with. The rest falls on us... We must end Muyu's schemes without delay.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_18: I do have a few questions.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_19: I'll stay here a bit longer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_500_23: It was also my wish. If I failed, you would've had the strength to stop me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_1: He's dead. And this time, it's no puppet. This is his true body.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_3: The wound was fatal. It must have been the strike Jingran landed earlier.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_4: If he's dead, then who's controlling those Reverberations? Who sent the Cloud Shuttles and the Autopuppets? This can't be over that easily.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_5: The Reverberations of the dead... They still pour in without end. They still cause the anomalies...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_6: The emotions in those Reverberations are weak little things. But they do make excellent fuel for transcendence.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_7: So... the two closest to the Sentinel. You've managed to find your way here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_8: Muyu, this corpse... Is this another one of your tricks?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_9: This is my true flesh. The mortal vessel I cast aside. I'm being entirely honest with you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_11: Your vision has narrowed, Paragon Qingxiao. I expected someone as elevated as you to understand this path sooner.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_12: We were never enemies, truly. This time, <ano=Xuanfang Hold>you two</ano> simply happened to stand in my way. Save or destroy. Neither has ever interested me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_13: To break that fox's tedious restrictions and taste the fruit of true knowledge, I had to take a path... from which there is no retreat.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_14: I don't care about your plans. I came to take your life.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_15: And this time, you will pay for everything you've done in Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_16: ...I came here to dissect the Sentinel's design. To understand the blueprint of divinity. Then build myself into its equal.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_17: And now, I've reached the pinnacle of mechanist arts...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_20: Then you shall make ideal test subjects.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_21: Think I see someone up ahead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_22: You reach the deck of the Sanctum Shuttle and, to your shock, find Muyu's corpse. Yet the disturbance here is still unresolved. While you grapple with the scene, his body suddenly "resurrects." Muyu explains that he resorted to this brute-force method to break the restriction Hsin placed on the Sentinel's knowledge. Your confrontation ends with him collapsing once more, and then, a voice rings out around you...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_600_1: I have shed my mortal flaws—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_600_6: Yet brought low by useless emotion and your pity for insignificant mortals.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_610_1: "Celestial"... You just copied the Savantae craftsmen and transferred your consciousness into an Autopuppet.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_611_1: You both stand with mortals. Again and again, you protect. Have you ever thought about why they are weak?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_611_2: Flaws must be burned away. Excess must be shed. Only then can an ant one day stand beside a god.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_612_1: This is not over. This is not my destination...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_612_2: Just a moment more... A moment more, and I will cast off this shell and ascend...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_614_1: Those slaves bound to the Sentinel are unworthy of the name. I am the true Celestial, free of all chains.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_614_2: I have taken the most fragile thing in this world and made it my road to perfection. I have arrived at a future you cannot even fathom.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_615_1: You are nothing but a monster feeding on the dead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_616_1: You just want the world to be a mirror of yourself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_616_2: Every soul has its own light. The "perfection" you speak of is a hollow lie.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_616_3: I fight for the lights of the living. Each flame is a life, distinct and irreplaceable.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_617_1: This grotesque puppet show ends now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_1: The Reverberations from the <ano=Earth>Di</ano> Realm... I'll have them all... Every last drop of rage, sorrow, and resentment—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_3: I shared my Sword Intent with the Autopuppets you experimented on.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_4: ...You... The guqin you played... Has your cultivation addled your wits? You'd even protect the Reverberations of the dead?!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_5: Even Reverberations should not be sacrificed to conspiracy and ambition, nor stripped of their right to exist.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_7: ...What a Sword Transcendent. What a Xuan Paragon.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_9: You infiltrated the Sanctum to steal the Civilization Capsule we're in, didn't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_10: Do not misunderstand. The Sentinel's knowledge is my only concern. The one who wanted this Capsule? Ask your old enemy.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_13: Xuanfang is but one corner of the chaos in Mengzhou. Unfortunately, I have no interest in Balanophora's petty schemes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_14: So she's the "woman in red" you mentioned before? A Fractsidus Overseer?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_17: I accept the consequences of my work. To regret it now would be to dishonor all the "materials" I used to get here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_18: It's irrelevant now... You defeated me because you were strong enough. Not because my path was wrong.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_19: Look at this <ano=barrier>sky</ano> trying to stop us... Doesn't it remind you of the Etheric Sea?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_20: Soon, the Reverberations' corruption will bring it all down. You may escape to reality, but Xuanfang Hold is doomed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_22: This wretched city was built on the Sentinel's meddling. Every life it saved was a <ano=cause>debt</ano> that must eventually be paid.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_23: Just like your protection. It has only delayed the <ano=effect>inevitable</ano>.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_24: And now, above you, the bill has arrived. The Tacet Discords. The dead. The destruction Xuanfang was always meant to face.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_25: So that was the plan? Trigger a collapse, destroy the barrier, and slip away in the chaos?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_26: I told you. I do not care about what happens to the Capsule. And I care even less for this Hold...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_27: I want the Sentinel's knowledge exposed to the light of Solaris. Whether it saves the world or sets it on fire... Frankly, you two, I don't give a damn.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_28: Leave it to the Sentinel? Better that knowledge in human hands. In my hands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_29: You're driven by nothing but greed and a hollow ego.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_30: At least you understand my "madness." I never once hid my intentions from you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_31: Enough talk... Your delusion ends here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_35: My Resonance Ability can purge the malice from these Reverberations. As long as someone stands against this "falling sky," this place will endure.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_37: Hsin asked me to vow that I would never forsake this city. And I promised you... that you wouldn't walk this road alone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_40: Whatever comes next, we'll face it together.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_620_41:
Muyu, drawing on the Reverberations of the dead from the Di Realm to sustain himself, is pierced through by the Sword Intent radiating from the Autopuppets Qingxiao empowered. As he falls, your questioning draws out his true intent: he came for the Sentinel's knowledge sealed within the Civilization Capsule. While he was willing to destroy the Capsule outright to get it, he claims it was someone else who wanted it intact. He warns you that Xuanfang Hold exists only because the Sentinel meddled in mortal affairs, and that every life it has saved comes at a cost that must eventually be paid. The disturbance now tearing through the Xuanyuan Domain, he says, is simply the destruction Xuanfang was always fated to face.
 
You defeat Muyu, but the "falling sky" unleashed by the Reverberation corruption still looms, and Xuanfang Hold's control kernel is on the verge of collapse.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_630_3: Our lives for the city! Never retreat!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_630_4: Xuanfang stands in peril, the sky about to fall...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_630_5: Everyone, will you lend me your swords?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_630_6: There's a whole group of "people" here!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_630_7: This is not the sword of one. It is the sword of all.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_630_8: Heaven falls, earth splits. But this sword will bring the dawn.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_1: Oh, you have both worked very hard indeed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_3: Thanks to the two of you and the people of this city, the Reverberation corruption in the control mainframe was largely purged. I handled the anomalies that remained.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_4: With the mainframe restored, the Censure Courts and Autopuppets will function as they should. The Tacet Discords will be contained in due time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_5: In short... Xuanfang Hold has weathered the storm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_7: Where exactly have you been all this time?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_9: Xuanfang has bled again and again, and its Sentinel was nowhere to be seen. Whatever your reasons were, you owe us an explanation.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_10: Very well. Then let us begin with the chaos Muyu sowed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_11: When Muyu invaded the Sanctum, I was not blind to it. But for certain reasons, I could neither intervene directly nor send word.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_12: In desperation, I trapped him inside the Xuanyuan Domain, within the mainframe, and strengthened the barrier to keep him from escaping.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_13: I believed he sought to extract the mainframe's core data. But to break my restrictions, he weaponized the Reverberations to collapse the mainframe itself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_14: One more thing. Is the Hold's control mainframe actually Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule? Muyu certainly believed it was.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_15: Not entirely. It is merely one small part of it...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_16: This situation exceeded even my calculations. Fortunately, you two were there. You saved Xuanfang from far greater loss.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_17: The Rafter Kite that led me to Fogveil Pagoda... You used the excuse of a meeting to lead me straight to {PlayerName}, didn't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_18: Heh... so you figured it out after all.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_19: With my clever <ano=Suisui>ally</ano> placing the Arbiter on the board as a wild card, I rather hoped you two would form a natural partnership.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_20: The visions of Xuanfang we saw in the Domain...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_21: I know your question. Those Cloud Shuttles and mechanisms were real, recorded blueprints. As for why they were never deployed during the Fortress and Gorges War...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_22: Qingxiao... the answer is simple. There was not enough time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_24: Besides, technology that outstrips its age is as much a curse as a blessing to the people of Mengzhou. It was never meant for the mortal world. It has already warped too many fates.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_25: Muyu's ruin is proof enough of where that path leads.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_26: I'm not here to judge your past choices. But if some of Xuanfang's problems began with its Sentinel, then its Sentinel should see them through.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_28: Arbiter, Paragon Qingxiao. When the time is right, I will give you and Xuanfang the answers you deserve.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_29: When that day comes, bring the Prism of Fate and come see...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_30: Hold on. Back in the Sanctum, the Prism of Fate flickered. Was that you? Did you guide us into the Xuanyuan Domain?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_31: Only by stopping Muyu's chaos from within, together with my power, could we minimize the harm that spilled beyond.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_32: In a mysterious garden, you and Qingxiao finally meet the long-missing Hsin the Moon Fox. Thanks to everyone's efforts, the crisis has, for now, come to a close. In answer to your questions, Hsin explains how She responded to the chaos Muyu set in motion, and you learn that Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe is actually just a small piece of the Civilization Capsule. As for why She never deployed the Cloud Shuttles or other mechanisms during the Fortress and Gorges War, Hsin says there simply was not enough time, and admits She still isn't sure whether such advanced mechanist arts are a blessing or a curse for Mengzhou, given how much they entangle and reshape people's fates. Before parting, She promises to give you and Xuanfang Hold answers when the time is right. As Hsin's form vanishes, the Rafter Kite that once guided Qingxiao flies into the distance...
Side_DXZW_QE_1_1: Being a Xuanfang Warden is such a big job... isn't it, Duzhou...

Side_DXZW_QE_11_18: But you sound like you had a good day.

Side_DXZW_QE_12_7: You helped a lot with the rebuild today.

Side_DXZW_QE_12_19: That boy... He's really something else. Come on, {PlayerName}. Dinner tonight should be a lively one.

Side_DXZW_QE_12_22: Well, you were the first person I thought of when I realized I needed help.
Side_DXZW_QE_12_24: Get to me? I don't really think about it like that.
