KuZhouYeDuan_4_17: "The Nether Debts that guy's carrying are denser than the traps in a Mirage Realm, and he's still in business... Anyway, I found him for you. That makes us even."
KuZhouYeDuan_4_18: No idea what the old man was after. Anyway... hm.
KuZhouYeDuan_4_20: ...This blasted cat's given me a headache. I'm fine.
KuZhouYeDuan_4_21: Anyway. Wanna come along? My Mirage Seeker's Tales series just hit a wall. Need some fresh inspiration.
KuZhouYeDuan_4_22: This letter practically fell into my lap. That's gotta mean something. C'mon, let's go have some fun and start a new chapter together. What do you say?
KuZhouYeDuan_4_25: Then it's settled. I'll track the guy down and send you a WavesLine when I've got him.
KuZhouYeDuan_4_26: Oh, right. That guy can be tough to handle, so I'll need a change of clothes...
KuZhouYeDuan_4_28: Exactly. I'll handle the guy, you handle the rest. Here, give me your camera. Let me add a little "new feature."
KuZhouYeDuan_4_29: Pale blue flame flickers to life. You watch Jingran's fingers brush lightly across the camera's casing.
KuZhouYeDuan_4_30: Wanna test it? Just snap Smokey, see what it does.
KuZhouYeDuan_4_31: You little brat, how many times do I gotta tell you?! Stop calling me Smokey! At least give me a name with some weight, like the ones in that crappy book of yours!
KuZhouYeDuan_5_1: The one in the camera looks way bigger than it does right now.
KuZhouYeDuan_5_2: "To see a thing's true form." Well, at least the gadget'll do that for a while.
KuZhouYeDuan_5_3: Have fun playing with it if you like. See you tomorrow.
KuZhouYeDuan_6_2: Anyone using Mirage Realm stuff to do evil can try to scrub himself clean all he likes. The stink never comes off.
KuZhouYeDuan_7_1: So... that rumor was true? That Mirage Realm opens next month... and you've got a way in?
KuZhouYeDuan_7_2: Of course, boss. Sharp eye you've got there. You know full well the value of what I just showed you.
KuZhouYeDuan_7_3: If I can get my hands on this, I can get my hands on something better.
KuZhouYeDuan_7_5: Tell you what, let's nail down the split first. Gotta settle the price before we set the whole thing up.
KuZhouYeDuan_7_6: (That lynx spirit's winking at me... Maybe it's asking me to use the camera over there?)
KuZhouYeDuan_7_7: (Now that Jingran's got the merchant distracted, I should go check it out.)
KuZhouYeDuan_8_1: (This figure... it's been drifting around this spot the whole time...)
KuZhouYeDuan_9_1: Following the traces, you dig out a damaged metal component, but you can't tell what it's supposed to be.
KuZhouYeDuan_9_2: It seems there's nothing else worth noticing here.
KuZhouYeDuan_17_8: Once the doctor leaves, the lynx spirit drifts over, glaring at the sleeping Jingran with an impatient noise.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_1: So, my disciple, you have returned.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_2: Have you had the chance to try the <ano=stringed instrument>guqin</ano> I gave you?
EVENT_XYJLN_1_4: I am completely lost. It's too hard for me.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_5: Good. You have considerable talent for music, and with adequate practice, I'm sure you'll make great progress.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_6: I see. You have considerable talent for music. Perhaps you simply lack the proper guidance.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_7: The art of the guqin holds that one must envision the note before the finger falls. The intent is born before the string ever sounds, much like the way of the sword.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_8: Lately, I've been pondering... Though I can teach you nothing more of the sword, I may yet guide you in the art of the guqin.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_10: Yes, I wish to teach you how to master the guqin. In doing so, you shall also learn something of my sword.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_12: How can I say no to my master's lessons?
EVENT_XYJLN_1_13: Very well. The method I shall teach you is somewhat unconventional. Think of it not as plucking the strings with your fingertips, but rather as playing them with Sword Energy.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_14: Next, I shall impart the practice guqin score to you through Sword Intent. Try to follow the notes, and I trust you will swiftly grasp it.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_16: I thought I had to familiarize myself with the scores first.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_17: No need to worry. Simply ease your mind, let a melody flow, and become one with the guqin.
EVENT_XYJLN_1_18: I shall join you in an ensemble. You need only follow my lead.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_1: Disciple, today I shall test your guqin artistry, and see how well you've mastered the section taught earlier.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_2: I didn't know there were pop quizzes.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_3: A test in name only. I merely wish to hear how well you can play without my lead.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_4: When my master taught me the guqin, tests were frequent. But worry not, I am not so strict as she was.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_5: Should your fingers falter, no rebuke will follow.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_7: To be honest, I forgot everything.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_8: Good, simply calm your mind and focus on the strings.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_9: If you've truly forgotten everything, it would actually be a good thing.
EVENT_XYJLN_10_11: It would mean you have truly grasped the score. From here on, you need only listen to your heart, and play the guqin as you please.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_1: Well played. Your strokes were clean, and your guqin produced not a single note of discord.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_2: I can tell your mind is at ease. No common storm could stir your composure now.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_3: You can tell all that from the melody?
EVENT_XYJLN_11_4: As you once discerned my emotions through the guqin's song, so too can I discern yours.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_5: The tone of your strings tightens at times. Have you not been resting well of late?
EVENT_XYJLN_11_6: A lot has been going on lately.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_7: Then why not stay at the training hall tonight? I will prepare some refreshing tea to help clear your mind.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_8: I have just received it from the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. Freshly picked, still rich with fragrance.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_10: Hard to say no to that.
EVENT_XYJLN_11_11: Once you've had your rest, we'll continue your guqin lessons tomorrow.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_1: You played beautifully. Skills not typical of a beginner. Do you have any insights to share?
EVENT_XYJLN_2_4: This piece is called "Clarity of the Transcendent," one I often play. It has the natural effect of quieting one's mind.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_5: It is called "Clarity of the Transcendent," one I often play. You heard it not long ago.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_6: To facilitate your training, I have already divided it into four sections. The one you just played was the first section.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_8: I'll teach them as you progress. All things in their proper time. This will suffice for today.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_9: You may practice the first section you learned today. Should any questions arise, you need only ask.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_11: Since you have agreed to learn the art of the guqin with me, It is only natural that I take responsibility for your progress. Assignments and examinations are necessary.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_12: If you can maintain your studies daily, there will be... rewards for your efforts.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_15: Nothing extravagant. Merely ordinary goods one might find at market.
EVENT_XYJLN_2_16: Now then, my disciple, I look forward to seeing you at my training hall at the same time tomorrow.
EVENT_XYJLN_20_1: Did you sleep well, disciple? Today, I plan to teach you the next section of the piece.
EVENT_XYJLN_20_4: I am glad to hear that. Should you ever feel exhausted again, you are welcome to rest here at the training hall.
EVENT_XYJLN_20_5: Hmm. Even the Quietude Art brings so little relief?
EVENT_XYJLN_20_6: Then I shall play a calming melody for you next time before you sleep.
EVENT_XYJLN_20_8: This courtyard is rather tranquil. On occasion, I come down the mountain to play my guqin here, or to clear away any Tacet Discords that happen to wander through.
EVENT_XYJLN_20_9: I imagine such a pleasant view would lift your spirits greatly while you train.
EVENT_XYJLN_20_11: Perfect. Same as before, disciple. Play through the section once, and let the shape of the strokes grow clearer in your mind.
EVENT_XYJLN_20_12: After that, I'll guide you through this section.
EVENT_XYJLN_21_1: Your skills grow ever more graceful, and they harmonize ever better with my own.
EVENT_XYJLN_21_4: Nothing. I am simply pleased. Your progress has been swifter than mine was, when I first began learning the guqin.
EVENT_XYJLN_21_5: In those days, I would practice a single score for ages, yet could never quite grasp it. I even once considered giving up entirely.
EVENT_XYJLN_21_6: That's because I have a great master and her careful teachings.
EVENT_XYJLN_21_8: Do remember to practice what you've learned today. Tomorrow I'll assess its outcomes.
EVENT_XYJLN_30_4: There you are, disciple. I was just recalling some memories about this courtyard.
EVENT_XYJLN_30_5: Is there a story to this place?
EVENT_XYJLN_30_6: It is a long tale... Two hundred years ago, I once received word from Xuanling and rescued a young Artisan couple here.
EVENT_XYJLN_30_8: During the Fortress and Gorges War, the two of them were sent to aid Yuan Fortress, but in the end, only the husband returned. Day after day, he planted peach trees in this very place that was once ravaged by war.
EVENT_XYJLN_30_9: He did so to honor a promise his wife made before she went missing, that she would return to him when the peach blossoms bloomed.
EVENT_XYJLN_30_10: When I met the man again and learned of his past, he was already old, his hair streaked with grey. He was still waiting.
EVENT_XYJLN_30_11: At least, this peach blossom grove is still growing strong and now covers the entire mountainside.
EVENT_XYJLN_30_12: Indeed. Now, disciple, as I said yesterday, why not play through the section you have just learned?
EVENT_XYJLN_31_1: Even with a discerning ear, I must say... you played very well.
EVENT_XYJLN_31_2: From your melodies, I hear a distant, timeless expanse. Perhaps it is the very landscape of your heart in this moment.
EVENT_XYJLN_31_3: Really? I actually wasn't thinking too much while playing. It felt like my mind was empty.
EVENT_XYJLN_31_4: Well, yes. Though you have yet to learn the piece in its entirety, your performance has already captured its essence, bearing its own spirit and grace.
EVENT_XYJLN_31_5: Let us meet again at the Western Fang Peaks tomorrow. The next section of the piece awaits.
EVENT_XYJLN_40_1: This place is rather far from my training hall. I wonder if it caused you much trouble coming here?
EVENT_XYJLN_40_2: It's fine. I have my Cloud Ride.
EVENT_XYJLN_40_4: Indeed. I've had the honor of witnessing your riding skills.
EVENT_XYJLN_40_6: Why did you choose a place directly above the Skyworks?
EVENT_XYJLN_40_7: This used to be one of my many cultivation grounds. From here, the entire Land of Xuanfang spreads out before your eyes.
EVENT_XYJLN_40_8: Clearer view, clearer mind. It greatly aids the study of music.
EVENT_XYJLN_40_9: The view is nice here indeed.
EVENT_XYJLN_40_10: Then, as before, have a try at the third section of the guqin piece.
EVENT_XYJLN_41_1: Gracefully measured and beautifully tempered... Were this an assessment, I daresay you have already passed with flying colors.
EVENT_XYJLN_41_2: I think I'm almost at the end of my learning session.
EVENT_XYJLN_41_3: Indeed, you have already learned most of this piece. There remains little of what I can teach you.
EVENT_XYJLN_41_4: Let us visit this place again tomorrow, my disciple.
EVENT_XYJLN_41_5: I have... something I would like to discuss with you.
EVENT_XYJLN_41_7: ...I shall keep it a secret for now.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_1: Speaking of which, disciple, what is your opinion regarding the Skyworks?
EVENT_XYJLN_50_3: A place that's always causing trouble.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_4: Indeed, most of Xuanfang's Autopuppets are manufactured here, then transported to various locations through mechanisms.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_5: Indeed, I imagine you have had your share of troubles to resolve here.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_6: Compared to the many things that dwell in this world, the Skyworks might well be called eternal. Yet even a thing so magnificent will, in time, be worn away.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_7: Surely one day, it will cease to operate, its purpose fulfilled at last. Even Xuanfang Hold is no exception.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_8: I will remember them as they were.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_9: As will I. As long as someone remembers, they will never truly vanish.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_10: Disciple, today will be your final assessment.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_12: If you have mastered the third section, that alone speaks to how far your technique has come. There will be no need for further assessments after this.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_13: I remember you said there's something you wanted to talk to me about?
EVENT_XYJLN_50_14: ...Yes, but let us wait until after you have finished playing this section.
EVENT_XYJLN_50_15: Over these two hundred years, I have watched Artisans envision Xuanfang Hold's future within the newly constructed Skyworks. And here, too, I have witnessed soldiers fighting alongside Autopuppets.
EVENT_XYJLN_51_1: A perfect unity of form and spirit. You have played better this time than before.
EVENT_XYJLN_51_2: So about that thing you wanted to discuss...
EVENT_XYJLN_51_3: Disciple, I... I confess. Teaching you the guqin these past few days was not without my own selfish motives.
EVENT_XYJLN_51_5: Yes. As your master, I wish to help you in any way that I can...
EVENT_XYJLN_51_6: But also, while you're still here in the Land of Xuanfang, I wish we might perform a duet together.
EVENT_XYJLN_51_8: The guqin is an instrument that cultivates one's own heart and spirit. A duet, therefore, runs against tradition…
EVENT_XYJLN_51_9: But if two hearts are in perfect accord, moving as one, then new understanding may arise from the interweaving of their melodies.
EVENT_XYJLN_51_10: Tomorrow, I should like to play a duet with you. I wonder... what do you think?
EVENT_XYJLN_51_11: It was you who taught me how to play the guqin, Qingxiao. I am sure to stick around to the very end.
EVENT_XYJLN_51_13: When the time comes, find me near the Ministry of War.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_3: No, I have only just arrived myself.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_4: This is where I first saw you playing the guqin.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_5: ...And also where I first met a kindred soul.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_6: I remember you were in a bit of a mood back then.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_7: Had you not been there, obsessive as I was, I might never have found my peace again. Worse, I might have jeopardized matters of great importance.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_8: You have already done so much for me during our journey together.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_9: Since I'm your disciple now, there's no need for that.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_10: True... There is no need to draw a clear line between us now, nor to measure what is owed.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_11: Come, disciple, let us play the guqin together. This shall be the final section of this piece.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_12: Wait, this guqin piece has four sections, but you've only taught me three, right?
EVENT_XYJLN_60_13: There is no need to teach you the last section. You are ready to grasp it on your own.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_14: Be it sword or guqin… I have nothing left to teach you, my disciple.
EVENT_XYJLN_60_15: Master… No, Qingxiao. Let's get started.
EVENT_XYJLN_61_2: From now on, "Clarity of the Transcendent" is yours.
EVENT_XYJLN_61_3: It was born from my meditation and cultivation in the mountains, echoing with the many encounters of my past. Yet here, it gains new meaning.
EVENT_XYJLN_61_4: I'll make sure not to disappoint.
EVENT_XYJLN_61_5: Time changes. Only the Way remains eternal. Yet so long as our hearts stay true... this very moment may outweigh eons.
EVENT_XYJLN_61_6: My disciple, should your heart grow troubled in your travels, let this piece bring you comfort once more.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_1_6: What's going on? Did something happen?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_1_8: She's about to go back to Mengzhou City!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_1_10: Where is Suisui now? She hasn't left yet, has she?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_1_11: She's with me... We're almost at the checkpoint to leave the Land of Xuanfang.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_1_13: Wait for me. I'll be there right away.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_100_1: Sounds like this "Granny Yanshu" has some connection to those Nethermancers.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_100_2: I know the old woman they mentioned.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_2: Ah... I thought there would be no need to send a Xuanling to trouble you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_3: But Bladepuppets alone could not hold back this tide of Tacet Discords...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_4: Evacuate the others. I will handle what remains.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_8: The figure in that old portrait... is that you and a Xuanling Bird?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_9: Yes. It never could settle. Always pecking at my hair.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_10: (If I remember right, Xuanling Birds have been extinct since the <te href=750053>Fortress and Gorges War</te> two centuries ago...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_11: Paragon Qingxiao, may I ask your age?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_12: ...How long have you been in the Land of Xuanfang?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_13: No need for formality. A Cultivator seeks to live long and see true. Age holds little meaning to me now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_14: Besides... you are not the younger of us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_16: It has not been long. Just over two hundred years.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_110_19: At the Yanshu family's home, you find an old painting of Qingxiao and a Xuanling Bird from years past. Reading the frequency left on the painting, you catch a hazy glimpse of Qingxiao protecting an unfamiliar young girl. As you're discussing the painting, Yanshu steps into the courtyard.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_1: Heh heh. An ancestor of mine left that painting a hundred years back. Said it would ward off evil and invite good fortune. Look at those colors, haven't faded a bit after all this time...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_2: Oh, Paragon Qingxiao! You are here too. If I'd known, I would have prepared a pot of good tea.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_3: Please do not trouble yourself. We came to ask you about a pendant.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_4: We found this inside Fogveil Pagoda.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_6: The villagers said the copper coins on it have ties to Mengzhou's Nethermancers.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_7: They do. They are "Yin coins," said to speak between the <ano=the living and the dead>Yin and Yang</ano>. Nethermancers carry them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_9: You have likely heard the ugly rumors. But in truth, they are a band of "old-world relics" who do not hold their own lives dear.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_10: Since olden times, Mengzhou has had many places of strange fengshui where Reverberations gather. Left untended, they grow into <ano=Sonoro Spheres>Mirage Realms</ano>, and from them, Tacet Discords are born.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_11: Nethermancers practice Vein Prospecting, the art of reading the land's hidden golden veins. Their trade is exploring Mirage Realms. It is an old, old craft.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_12: Sounds like the Pioneer Association's work.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_13: Hehe... Far less noble than that, I'm afraid. Nethermancers dispel Mirage Realms to stop disasters, yes. But also peddle the ownerless relics they find inside. That is the Jianghu way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_14: Their rules are loose, their ranks mixed. They walk where the dead walk, so misunderstandings cling to them like flies to honey.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_15: There are fewer Nethermancers each year. Few in that line meet a peaceful end. My late husband, Sandao, was no different... He did not even leave me a keepsake.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_16: Forgive me. I have drifted from the question. The pendant you asked about is a common token they carry.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_17: It is a mark of reverence for gods, spirits, and the dead. In a Mirage Realm, such a token often serves a special purpose.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_18: (Then the reason he left it behind likely has to do with a Mirage Realm. The anomalies in Fogveil Pagoda may be linked to whatever he did.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_19: Wait. This knotwork... I think I've seen it before...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_20: Could this belong to... Jing? But how...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_22: A nearby Censure Court has stopped functioning. We need to evacuate these people to Xuanfang Hold right away.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_24: Do Nethermancers always bring such pendants when they enter one?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_25: Yes. Rarely do they go without.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_26: Yanshu explains that the Qingfu pendant is the kind Nethermancers carry when entering a Mirage Realm, meaning the Cat of the Nether Lamp's clue likely points to one. Just as Yanshu seems to realize something, Yangyang arrives with the Xuanfang Wardens, bearing bad news: a nearby Censure Court has stopped functioning. The villagers need to be evacuated to Xuanfang Hold immediately. In that moment, Qingxiao looks toward Xuanfang Hold and senses the Celestial Ring Formation gradually grinding to a halt...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_120_1: It isn't safe here! Everyone, get to the Sky Pier at Shaftpost Yard!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_121_1: A few Tacet Discords slipped past the formation already. I will deal with them swiftly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_121_3: I'll go with you. We need to keep the evacuation route clear.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_121_5: It'll be fine. Yangyang and the Wardens have that side covered.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_122_1: The Wardens holding the line need backup.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_123_1: The Tacet Discords inside the formation have been mostly cleared.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_123_2: To the Sky Pier, then. Yangyang and the others must be ready to set off.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_124_1: You're here! This is the last group of people. You should board the Skybarge too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_124_4: There are still plenty of seats inside. Enough for everyone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_124_6: There's no need. I will ride escort from the sky, in case anything goes wrong.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_124_7: Under the Ministry's contingency plan, Commander Qiuhong has already set up a receiving party for those who left earlier.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_124_8: No time to waste. Let's go.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_125_3: The Ministry of War issued me one. I never could grow used to it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_126_1: Signs of evacuation everywhere. Most people have already left.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_130_1: (Pheeew... We finally got everyone to the Ministry of War in one piece.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_130_2: You say that like you did it all yourself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_130_3: (Uh, I did stuff too! That kid's shoe? The old man's bag? Who zoomed into the middle of those TDs to snatch 'em back? Me, that's who!)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_130_4: I know, I know. Everyone was quick on their feet this time. Soldiers and civilians both.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_130_5: (Yeah, well, the same thing happened not long ago. Everyone has an idea of what to do now.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_131_1: We really owe you for showing up this time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_131_2: Don't mention it, brother. We're all here to defend Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_132_1: Those Tacet Discords would have had me if not for Paragon Qingxiao's sword formation...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_133_1: Strange. The control kernel is completely intact...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_133_2: Looks more like it's been "shut down."
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_134_1: The warehouse should still have some medicine left. I'll fetch it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_134_2: I'll send someone with you. Tacet Discords could show up along the way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_2: Is the pain from his wound keeping him conscious? What did the Huaxu medic say earlier?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_3: The wound is dressed, and it will not worsen. But... we've no medicine for the pain. He must endure for now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_4: A young man barely in his first posting... He threw himself in front of us. Took those strikes so we wouldn't.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_5: Lady Transcendent, please help him. Can you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_8: ...How pathetic. I've dragged everyone down again...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_9: You did well. Now rest easy.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_10: ...The pain will not trouble him for now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_15: It is only a simple Quietude Art. It can help induce sleep, nothing more.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_18: Come. The Warden Commander is expecting you up ahead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_19: He looks like he's really hurting.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_140_20: A family is tending to a badly wounded Xuanfang Warden who was hurt covering their escape. At a little girl's request, Qingxiao uses her Quietude Art to ease the soldier into peaceful sleep. You notice she seems a little downhearted, aware that her ability cannot take away the soldiers' true pain.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_141_1: How are things looking right now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_141_2: The contingency measures have proved effective. Only a few were injured during the evacuation, and most Tacet Discords remain outside the Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_141_3: Still, we have taken a heavy blow. Even with aid from other cities, we are short on supplies.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_141_4: We can't let this drag on. Our priority should be to find the source of this disturbance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_1: ...The Hold's Autopuppets have all shut down. Even our defensive apparatuses, including the <te href=800049>Xuan Shield</te>, have failed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_2: Holding the main gate is no longer viable. We must fall back, line by line, and rally everyone around the Ministry of War. It is the sturdiest ground we have left.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_3: Only a few Tacet Discords have slipped into the Hold so far. We still have time to set up our defenses... Ah, you're here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_4: Any word on what caused this incident?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_5: Our tally shows nearly three in ten Censure Courts have stopped cold. The Ministry of Development has yet to determine why. This is not a simple malfunction.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_6: Earlier, while patrolling near the Skyworks with the others, we ran into a pack of Tacet Discords that had just broken loose.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_7: We fought our way through and found a nearby Censure Court shut down. Autopuppets fallen all around. It was as if every mechanism... gave out at once.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_8: If anything could trigger anomalies of this magnitude, it would have to be...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_10: It is Hsin's residence, and the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_11: Precisely. There may have been a change inside. Looking back, we overlooked something in our earlier operations—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_12: Tacet Discords and Autopuppets were not a concern within the Hold, so we assumed the Sanctum was safe. We posted only a handful of guards along the main approaches.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_13: When the Ministry of War searched for Muyu's true body, did anyone search inside the Sanctum?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_15: He might be hiding inside the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_16: He might be hiding in plain sight.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_17: During the fight... Muyu hinted that his attack on Xuanfang Hold had another purpose—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_18: ...Pathetic fools. You have guarded this Hold for over two hundred years, yet still you're blind to its fundamental nature.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_19: I am but a single step away from my destination. Anything that stands in my way now is nothing more than a momentary diversion.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_20: He sowed such chaos. Threw lives away... just so he could clear a path to the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_21: During the Siege of Xuanfang Hold, all eyes were on the fierce battle around the main gate... The Sanctum could indeed have been infiltrated.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_22: In any case, we should inspect the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_23: We can't be sure yet, but too many signs point to the Sanctum: Muyu's escape. The Censure Courts shutting down. The Sentinel missing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_24: It may well be the source of this disturbance. If we're lucky, we might find the truth and some trace of Hsin the Moon Fox there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_25: I will go with you. The Sanctum's mechanisms are intricate and ever-shifting. A moment's carelessness could make you lose your way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_26: Hsin once received me there as a guest. I can serve, at least, as a guide.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_27: "None may enter the Sanctum without the Sentinel's leave" has always been the Hold's iron law. But now... we cannot afford to observe it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_28: If the Mengzhou City Hall assigns blame afterward, I will bear full responsibility. Let them strip my rank again. It matters not. But...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_29: The city's fortifications are not yet finished. I must ask you both to stay the night and leave at dawn. We can't be too careful.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_30: I'll see the rest of the preparations through with the Wardens. Come what may, we'll be ready.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_31: {PlayerName}, you and Paragon Qingxiao should relax tonight. Prepare for whatever awaits you in the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_32: Then I will rely on you, Yangyang.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_34: I have preparations to attend to.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_35: You regroup with the Warden Commander and Yangyang to plan your next move. You suspect something may have gone wrong inside the Sanctum, the home of Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe, and that Muyu's true body could be hiding there, in the one place no one has searched. After discussion, you and Qingxiao are chosen to investigate the Sanctum while Yangyang and the others hold the line around the Ministry of War. Since defenses are not fully in place yet, you will rest for the night and set out the next day. Qingxiao slips away, apparently to make some preparations of her own...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_1: We meet again. Xuanfang has been anything but quiet this past while.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_3: I didn't see you when everyone evacuated.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_4: Bless you, child. Paragon Qingxiao looked after me well, and the young lady Yangyang was a great help too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_5: You came at the right time... I've been thinking about that pendant. The knotwork looked familiar to me, like something my Jing would make.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_7: His full name is Jingran. Sandao and I raised him. He followed at Sandao's heels, learned what he could, and became a Nethermancer himself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_8: He's one too? Does the name "Cat of the Nether Lamp" mean anything to you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_9: Heh... What a strange Jianghu moniker. Jing never spoke of it, but it does sound like something he would dream up.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_10: ...It has been years since I last laid eyes on him. He said he wanted to travel the world alone. But for six months now, pastries and money have been showing up at home every so often.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_11: I told myself it must be one of Sandao's old friends. Now I see that the boy must've been sneaking home all along, just can't bear to let me see him.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_12: If I run into him, I'll send word.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_13: Thank you. I hope Jing hasn't caused you any trouble. It's late now. You should rest.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_15: I will after I take another look around.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_152_1: Aw... I lost the little picture book the big brother gave me on the road.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_152_3: I met him near the village half a month ago. He wore a hat and had a grin like a bandit.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_152_4: But he was so nice to me! He shoved a picture book into my hands before he left. It was about adventurers in some old desert city.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_153_1: I wish Paragon Qingxiao could show me a few sword moves, then I wouldn't be afraid of Tacet Discords.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_153_2: I'd rather learn how to play the qin...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_153_3: I've been hearing her music a lot lately.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_154_1: The wound has been dressed. I'll have someone take you inside the Ministry of War to rest shortly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_154_2: When the Tacet Discords had me surrounded, I swear I saw a light coming off me...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_154_3: Maybe you need more examining... you're starting to spout nonsense.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_160_1: (This is... the same music I heard after saying goodbye to Suisui.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_160_2: (No, not quite the same. This time it sounds... sad.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_3: So this is what you meant by "preparations."
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_5: Through music, I can pass a wisp of my Sword Intent to another.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_6: I saw that same light in Xianling Village.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_7: It is a sword without form, forged from my will. If danger comes, it will release Sword Energy to keep its bearer alive.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_8: You're worried something may happen out here while we're in the Sanctum?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_9: If more Censure Courts fall, it is hard to predict what may happen. A few safety measures put my heart at ease.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_11: The Ministry of War has people looking after them. There's no need to worry.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_13: We go to the Sanctum while the Wardens guard the Hold. Everyone agreed this was the best arrangement for now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_14: Just as they trust us to do our part, we should trust them to do theirs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_15: ...Xuanfang Hold should never have come to this. As the Xuan Paragon, I cannot shirk my duty here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_16: The recent chain of incidents started with an abnormal Tacet Discord reading in one of the Censure Courts. I was on the investigation team.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_17: I heard... you stayed behind to cover the retreat so they could escape the rogue Autopuppets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_19: He laid the trap. He split our ranks. He bet that I would go back for the soldiers dragged deep into the Courts.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_20: Paragon Qingxiao. These Autopuppets cannot stop you. These Tacet Discords cannot defeat you. Even an entire Censure Court cannot bar your way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_21: But... can the same be said of these Wardens? Frail. Trembling. Mortal.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_22: So, stay to protect the weak and be buried by endless enemies, or walk away and save the next battlefield? Your choice.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_23: Come to think of it, during the Fortress and Gorges War, did our great Sword Transcendent not choose to send a group of soldiers... to their deaths?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_24: ...I know this was the best everyone could do. But... there may have been a better choice...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_25: We've already made our choice now, haven't we?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_26: Now we just have to see this choice through. The same way you always have.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_27: Think of all the people who are still here because you stayed true to that choice.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_28: Tomorrow, we finish the investigation as fast as we can and rejoin the others. Then no more worrying. Not about Xuanfang, or these impossible choices.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_161_32: Following the sound of a qin, you find Qingxiao playing in a pavilion near the Ministry of War. She is using the music to distribute protective Sword Intent to Xuanfang's soldiers and civilians as a safeguard. She explains why she arrived late to the earlier crisis: Muyu had set a trap, taking wounded soldiers hostage and forcing her to single-handedly fight off an entire Censure Court while protecting them. Now, with the Land of Xuanfang badly weakened and another crisis looming, Qingxiao cannot help blaming herself. Your words help her let go of her guilt and focus on what she can do now, sharing her Sword Intent with everyone who needs it. Under the bright moon, to the drift of her music, you stay quietly by her side...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_162_1: Was that... a taste of her Quietude Arts?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_163_1: (Daybreak already. Time to head for the Sanctum.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_163_2: (...I'll check in at the Ministry of War first.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_165_1: (Everyone else is asleep. But the qin is still playing...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_166_1: (I'm getting closer. Whoever's playing should be nearby.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_1: {PlayerName}, did you get enough rest? Paragon Qingxiao has been waiting for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_4: That's good. We don't know what awaits in the Sanctum, so conserve your strength.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_7: The surrounding defenses are complete. Many civilians volunteered to help. And another wave of reinforcements from Jinzhou just arrived.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_8: So the Midnight Rangers showed up with backup.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_9: Jinzhou answered at once, but recent activity from the Threnodian in the Norfall Barrens has tied down their main force.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_11: Only a small group could come, but they're elite Rangers. They will make a difference.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_12: We can manage the Tacet Discords within the Hold. It's just... some strange mechanism parts have appeared nearby. Look—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_13: It's like they spilled over from somewhere else into the Hold. The Ministry's Artisans examined them, and so far, they don't pose any danger.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_14: I will complete the Sanctum investigation quickly. Once the situation is clear, I shall return at once.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_15: If things get bad, don't risk yourself needlessly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_16: Mm. You too. I'll hold the line with everyone. Xuanfang Hold will remain standing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_18: This blade is shaped from my Sword Intent. It cannot break an army, but it should be able to protect you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_19: Paragon Qingxiao... Please come back safe, both of you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_20: The next day, you meet up with Qingxiao and Yangyang at the Ministry of War. Defenses around the Ministry are now complete, and a fresh unit of Midnight Rangers has arrived as reinforcement, though some abnormal modular parts have appeared nearby. After saying goodbye to Yangyang, you and Qingxiao set off for the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_171_1: These strange parts look as if the mechanism itself fell into a state of disorder.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_172_1: A few Tacet Discords are here too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_1: Just as I expected, it's locked tight.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_2: The Ministry of War has sent several parties here recently, and I came here as well, but there has been no answer from within.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_4: In the past, Hsin would send an attendant to receive those seeking an audience. If She did not wish to see guests, She would say so plainly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_11: Hey, that coin pendant you picked up is reacting to your Resonance Ability!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_12: ...That door looks like a <ano=Sonoro Sphere>Mirage Realm</ano> entrance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_13: It connects to a passage. It may lead directly into the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_15: ...So this coin pendant is the key?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_17: The one who left that pendant in the secret chamber must have foreseen that its finder would eventually seek out Hsin at the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_18: Hmm... So that shady guy left you a side door into this fancy schmancy place on purpose. Where d'ya think he is now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_19: Maybe we'll find out once we're inside.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_20: Bleh... It stinks in there. So, uh, if there's nothing else, I'm headed back. Yell if you need me!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_21: It appears we have no other path into the Sanctum. Let's go.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_23: Stay on guard after we enter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_180_24: The Sanctum's gate remains sealed, and not even using your Resonance Energy to activate the Prism of Fate can force it open. Surprisingly, it activates the Qingfu pendant instead, revealing a hidden passage that appears to lead inside the Sanctum. It seems whoever left the pendant intended for you to find this way in. With no other option, you and Qingxiao enter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_181_1: A compact Mirage Realm created by Resonance Ability. And I see quite a few Reverberations around us...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_182_1: Give me a number. How many years of life to crack this passage open?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_182_3: Hah... Greedier every time, ain't ya?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_182_4: Take it or leave it. And keep your voice down unless you want him to find us!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_182_6: Oh, you rotten brat... Four months!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_183_2: The Reverberations must have captured them not long ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_2: This fog... has Reverberations mixed in with it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_6: Well, well. Who dares trespass in the Sanctum?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_8: Just a lackey on door duty.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_9: Whew. No beating you, huh? I surrender.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_11: Oh? Seems there's no need to bar your way. Catch me... if you can.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_17: I think so. Probably checking if I was worth working with. But with Muyu watching, he couldn't risk blowing his cover.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_21: The control mainframe. It governs every mechanism in Xuanfang Hold, great and small. Reverberations have already eaten into it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_22: Muyu used Reverberations to alter Autopuppet programming before. This looks like a similar trick.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_23: Then this is where the disturbances we're now facing began.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_25: That man was testing your skill... Is he the Cat of the Nether Lamp?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_190_26: Inside the Sanctum, you encounter Jingran, the Cat of the Nether Lamp, amid a thick fog. He attacks without warning. After a brief clash, you gain the upper hand, while Qingxiao faces off against a phantom projection of Muyu nearby. Muyu shows little interest in stopping you, and Jingran withdraws as well, apparently satisfied with merely testing your skill in battle. You discover that Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe has been corrupted by Reverberations and is likely the source of the disturbance. At that moment, the Prism of Fate begins to react...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_1: Suisui... are you sure you won't stay a few more days?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_2: Come now, don't give me that face, darling. When I'm gone, get plenty of rest, eat on time, and don't push yourself when things get hard. And...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_4: Why didn't you leave a message?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_5: I only just heard you're heading back to Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_6: Well, I meant to slip away quietly. I didn't expect Yangyang to catch me halfway.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_7: What, going to miss me already?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_8: It's very sudden, that's all. Has something pressing come up in Mengzhou?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_9: Nothing major. It's just now that I've found my little sister, and she's grown strong enough to stand on her own, I can relax and return to minding the Guild's affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_10: Moreover, I plan to make full use of the Guild's connections and channels to dig into Zhuojun Atelier. Into Muyu.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_11: Muyu... He fled the last battle inside a puppet vessel. We still don't know where his true body is, or what he's scheming.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_12: For now, I'll join the Ministry of War patrols around Xuanfang Hold to search for any sign of him.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_13: To think, that man sowed chaos on such a scale in Xuanfang, yet Mengzhou City Hall shows so little concern... Makes you wonder, doesn't it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_14: So you're going back to Mengzhou to try to find answers.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_15: I am. That's where I shine. You have bigger fish to fry. Like tracking down a certain <ano=Hsin the Moon Fox>Mengzhou Sentinel</ano> I once made a deal with.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_16: She never told me where She was, but I've always had the feeling She was close to Xuanfang Hold. And wouldn't you know...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_17: The Sentinel is our best chance at understanding what's happening in Xuanfang.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_18: You obtained Her token and saw her frequency at Fogveil Pagoda. If there are clues anywhere, they'll be there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_19: Yes, you two chase down the leads here. I'll worry about Mengzhou. Divide and conquer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_21: Be careful. This is bigger than it looks.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_22: Relax, darling. I am esteemed Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. The eldest daughter in a family of musicians. And... Yangyang's big sister!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_23: I trust you, Suisui. But if anything happens that you can't handle alone, you need to contact us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_24: ...I was really trying not to make a fuss.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_25: ...I grew far too fond of the time we all spent together. So before I leave, one last reminder—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_27: Take care of Yangyang. If you let her get lost... you'll have to answer to me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_28: Sister... I can hear you, you know...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_29: Well then, let's say goodbye now. One of these days, I'll give you both a proper tour of Mengzhou!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_30: That qin music... I think I've heard it before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_31: ...It sounds expectant. Like the person playing is waiting for something.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_32: The Elseway Shroud I entered before has appeared again.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_33: At the crossroads leading towards Mengzhou, you and Yangyang see Suisui off. Suisui plans to head to Mengzhou to gather intel on Mengzhou City Hall and Zhuojun Atelier, while Yangyang joins Ministry of War patrols around Xuanfang Hold. You, meanwhile, set out for Fogveil Pagoda, the place where Suisui once obtained a Prism of Fate, to search for leads on Sentinel Hsin. Just before you leave, you and Yangyang hear the distant melody of a qin...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_5: So, when will you finally consider moving to Xuanfang Hold? I've even had a quiet room set aside for you in the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_6: No need to hide away on this cold, lonely mountain. Hm... the damp is getting to my tail.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_7: This place is quiet. Remote. Free from worldly disturbance. It suits cultivation.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_9: ...Hsin. You did not come only to chat.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_10: I did not. I do have something to ask of you this time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_11: Paragon Qingxiao, should disaster one day befall Xuanfang Hold, I hope you will raise your sword for its people.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_12: Should the tide become irreversible, then you may exercise <ano=Sentinel>my</ano> authority in my stead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_15: With you here, I am at ease. Perhaps soon... you will find the answer to that which you have asked the heavens.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_17: Shh. That is still a secret.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_21: Now it feels exactly like the day we first met.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_22: Qingxiao the Transcendent? Little, Qing, Xiao—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_30_23: High in the mountains, Qingxiao sits in quiet meditation, playing her qin, when she catches a Rafter Kite and recognizes it as a messenger from Hsin the Moon Fox. The sight stirs a memory—Hsin once came to her in person, entrusting her with the safety of Xuanfang Hold's people and granting her the authority to act in the Sentinel's stead, should the situation ever reach a point of no return. Sensing that the time has come, Qingxiao sets out at once for Fogveil Pagoda, determined to find the long-missing Hsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_31_1: Oh... Did you forget I gave you a locator back at Shaftpost Yard?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_31_2: Anytime you miss me, just take a peek. A little insight into my comings and goings, hm?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_31_5: That was a unique situation. I needed to know where you were and if you were still alive. But now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_31_6: If I need to check on you, I'll reach out first. Using that to see where you are should be for emergencies only.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_31_7: All right, I was only teasing, darling. I know how you are. The locator has a range limit anyway, so it'll be useless once I'm in Mengzhou City.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_31_9: Speaking of which... I left in such a hurry that I forgot.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_31_13: Yangyang's share is in there too. I'll leave it with you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_39_1: Hmph... Ugh... Pretty sure I just heard Yangyang. Did she leave already?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_39_2: Up at last? Suisui's already on her way to Mengzhou City, and Yangyang's out on routine patrol.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_39_3: Aw, what? Everyone's gone... So where are you off to, then?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_39_4: Fogveil Pagoda, where Hsin's frequency appeared before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_40_1: This is the path Suisui described. But I'm not seeing any of the Disorienting Fog she mentioned.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_40_2: (...Yep, even I can't smell that nasty head-spinning fog anymore. Seems like it's all cleared out.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_40_3: Let's go inside and take a look around.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_1: Be on guard. Tacet Discords have escaped from nearby Censure Cages.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_2: You must be... Paragon Qingxiao. We've met before.

Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_7: A Rafter Kite guided me. I am searching for someone of great importance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_10: You have come for Hsin the Moon Fox as well?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_11: I know of your deeds in Jinzhou. Alongside Jué and the Jinzhou Magistrate, you resolved the Temporal Disruption on Mt. Firmament.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_12: That someone connected to a Sentinel should be at Fogveil Pagoda, a place tied to Hsin, is likely no accident.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_13: Guess I'm more famous than I thought...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_14: Do not trouble yourself. Few know the details.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_15: "Bloom Bearer," "Hero of Jinzhou," "Dark Thunderbolt," "Laureate," "Hero of Heroes," "Voidworm Rider"... These are the stories the <te href=750048>Ministry of Foreign Affairs</te> recorded in broad strokes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_16: ...Sounds like the Ministry of Foreign Affairs knows a little too much.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_17: I came seeking Her too, only to find many Censure Cages failing, and the fog meant to confuse Tacet Discords has dispersed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_18: A nearby secret chamber stores the Sentinel's Relic. It may have been affected as well.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_19: By "Sentinel's Relic"... do you mean something like this?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_20: It does resemble an ornament worn by Hsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_21: Not long ago, Suisui met the Moon Fox in that very secret chamber and was given this <te href=750059>Prism of Fate</te>.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_22: Paragon Qingxiao, we're here for the same reason. Why don't we travel together? Watch each other's backs?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_24: ...From now on, please just call me Qingxiao.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_25: You know about Mt. Firmament too?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_27: You and Qingxiao cross paths at Fogveil Pagoda, both searching for Hsin. The pagoda's mechanisms are malfunctioning, and Tacet Discords are breaking loose for unknown reasons. Together, you decide to investigate the chamber that once held the Prism of Fate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_60_1: No external damage. Unlike last time, it has not been corrupted by Reverberations.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_60_2: Meaning this isn't one of Muyu's tricks?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_60_3: Yes, it seems they have simply shut down.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_61_1: This should be the entrance to the secret chamber. Looks like... nothing's stopping us from just walking in.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_61_2: It seems whatever ward kept it sealed is no longer in effect.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_1: There is no trace of Hsin nearby. She is not here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_2: The Prism of Fate isn't responding either...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_3: Hey, do you smell that? Something weird is nearby. Sniff, sniff... Huh?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_5: Uuugh... {PlayerName}, she's lookin' at me funny!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_6: In all my travels across Huanglong, I've encountered many Tacet Discords and Echoes. Yet never one quite so curious.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_8: This one lives in my Tacet Mark. Big time foodie.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_9: Yessiree! So uh... hi there. Nice meeting ya, I'm Abby.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_10: Big time what now? Anyway... hi there. Nice meeting ya, I'm Abby.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_11: Hello. Abby... I'll remember that name.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_12: Oh, I found where that smell is coming from. This way!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_14: Its frequency is a lot like that weird-smelling Autopuppet kernel from last time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_15: Hmm, Suisui did mention an informant who met her outside Fogveil Pagoda before—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_16: ...If there were no hiccups, the Cat of the Nether Lamp should have made contact with Muyu by now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_17: ...He is one of our people inside Zhuojun Atelier. But our cooperation with him has limits. Mutual limits. We don't even know his true name.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_18: ...Identifying traits? The Tacet Mark down his eye, a <ano=copper coin>Qingfu</ano> pendant on his belt, and... an odd lamp that's always burning.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_19: The Guild's intelligence says a special <ano=Remnant Creature>spirit</ano> is sealed within the lamp. That's where his Jianghu moniker comes from.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_20: If the informant wore a similar pendant, this didn't wind up here by accident. He likely left it on purpose.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_21: Hm, he likely did so because he anticipated that someone would come here soon.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_22: And those who come to this chamber are either connected to Hsin or seeking Her.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_23: Then this may be a clue that's meant for us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_24: Mm... I don't get it. Why only a pendant? A note or a letter would've been a whole lot more obvious.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_25: Could've been... that he had no time to leave a message, just something he carried on him.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_26: I have seen copper coins like this before. In Mengzhou's rural areas, many call them "Yin coins."
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_28: I know little beyond that. The people of Xianling Village should be more familiar with them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_29: Then let's go ask around Xianling Village. We don't have any other leads.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_30: Once we understand its significance, we can figure out what this "Cat of the Nether Lamp" was trying to tell us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_32: These disruptions in the ancient order are not trivial. If more Tacet Discords escape, the people around Shaftpost Yard will suffer first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_33: You and Qingxiao search Hsin's chamber together but find no trace of Her frequency. With Abby's help, you come across a mysterious Qingfu pendant, seemingly a clue left behind by the "Cat of the Nether Lamp," the Nethermancer who once worked with Suisui. Following this lead, you head to Xianling Village to ask the locals about it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_80_1: That is... the Four Chime Shaftpost alarm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_80_2: She can fly on her sword...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_80_3: The moment you reach the high ground above Xianling Village, the Four Chime Shaftpost sounds the alarm. Tacet Discords are attacking the village, and chaos has broken out. You rush in to help.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_800_1: Phew, thank you! Lucky for us you were here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_805_1: Our thanks for the assistance. We'll regroup with Watcher Yangyang and the others straightaway.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_81_2: Did these Tacet Discords escape from Censure Cages too?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_81_3: Yes. Perhaps... Fogveil Pagoda is not the only place compromised.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_850_1: Keep your eyes on the Rafter Kites. If there's a swarm of Tacet Discords headed our way, they will be our first warning.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_855_1: By order of General Jiyan, our unit has arrived to provide reinforcements.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_855_2: We are in position and awaiting your orders.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_855_3: Long march. You have my thanks.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_855_4: The defensive line is set, but we're spread thin. Your timing could not be better.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_1: Whew... Thank you for saving us, Paragon Qingxiao. And... Ah, you're the great hero who helped the Wardens defend Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_2: Never thought we'd see Tacet Discords around the village again. Times like these... we could really use those Autopuppets back.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_3: Is something wrong with the Autopuppets?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_4: Well... ever since the last incident, there haven't been many working ones left around the village.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_5: They'll be standing fine one moment, then just drop the next. Even the Ministry folks couldn't fix them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_6: (...That sounds exactly like the Autopuppets we encountered back at the Pagoda.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_7: These days, we rely on the Ministry's soldiers to keep us safe. But they're run ragged. Too much to do, not enough hands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_8: Do not worry. The Four Chime Shaftpost has sounded. The Xuanfang Wardens will arrive shortly. I will brief them myself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_9: With you down from the mountain, Paragon, we can rest easy. My mother, she never forgets your deeds. She even burns incense for you at home.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_11: Oh, that? She lights incense before the Sword Transcendent's spirit tablet. Prays for good luck and health. Some of the older folks believe in such things.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_13: There is something I would like to ask you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_14: We'd like to know what this pendant means in Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_16: Hsss... those are no ordinary copper coins. The Nethermancers in Mengzhou carry coins just like that.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_18: Not a good place to talk. Too many ears... But word is, they're a lawless bunch. "Thieves," through and through.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_19: Hmph, if you want the full telling, go ask Granny Yanshu by the village gate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_20: She's not a bad person, it's just... most folks in the village have their reasons for keeping a distance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_21: I see. I will go speak with her.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_22: That's not really fair. Some say they are righteous wanderers, too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_23: With the Tacet Discords eliminated, the villagers quickly gather around you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_24: The villagers tell you that Autopuppets across the region have been shutting down, and Fogveil Pagoda isn't the only place with such anomalies. The coins on the pendant you found seem tied to Mengzhou's Nethermancers. The villagers suggest you ask Granny Yanshu, who lives near the village gate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_91_1: So beautiful... First time seeing Paragon Qingxiao with my own eyes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_91_2: Grandfather and Grandmother were right. She looks exactly like the Sword Transcendent in the paintings.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_91_3: That's not the half of it. She's the master of the finest cultivation school in all the land.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_92_1: Huh? What does the Paragon have to do with a cultivation school?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_92_2: Well, she is the master of the Xuanyuan School in the Eastern Xuan Peaks. The only Perfected One in all of Xuanfang. She has watched over this land for centuries.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_92_3: At the Martial Arts Championship a few years back, she was an honored guest. Many sect leaders even greeted her as their "Transcendent Elder."
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_92_4: Why, even the great Daoist Master Jiufeng, with all his profound knowledge, sent his favorite disciples to her for guidance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_92_6: All I know is Paragon Qingxiao has been around since my great-great-grandmother's time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_92_7: But I've never heard of this Xuanyuan School... You didn't make that up, did you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_93_1: See that? That's what a true "cultivator" looks like.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_93_2: Growing both body and spirit. Being one with nature. Breathing the same breath as Heaven and Earth...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_93_3: Grandfather, what are you even saying?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_94_1: When your grandfather was young, I read a few storybooks. Got it into my head to roam the great mountains, find a famous master, and become a cultivator myself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_94_2: Then why not ask Master Qingxiao to take you as her disciple?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_94_3: Hah. Paragon Qingxiao does not take disciples. In all these years, nobody has proved worthy.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_94_5: Cultivation takes a bit of talent, yes. But it takes an even steadier mind. To let nothing in this world disturb your inner peace… That, my boy, is a rare and precious skill.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_95_1: Ah... I was hoping to set up my stall and tell tales of the Fortress and Gorges War.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_95_2: Now there's trouble in these parts again...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_96_1: Bless me, Paragon Qingxiao. Let me pass the Ministry of Development's selection.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_96_2: And Lady Hsin, bless me too, though it has been a long while since anyone laid eyes on You... Please, I beg you both, show your power!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_96_3: ...I can't tell if you're superstitious or just trying to cover all your bets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_97_1: The Qing who wrote "Records of Huanglong Tacet Discords"... That's actually Paragon Qingxiao?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_97_2: I would die for her autograph...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_2: (Did we fall all the way here from the air...? Why couldn't I fly with my wing?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_6: ...I'm fine. It happened so suddenly. The impact stunned me, that is all.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_7: We were still inside the Sanctum only moments ago. But now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_11: I wonder if Yangyang and the others in the Hold were affected. We need to find a way back.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_12: My Terminal won't connect... It looks like the signal got cut off.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_14: This valley is no ordinary place. It may not even be real.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_15: Hsin's authority can cause all things to proliferate as fractal forms of themselves. It is not impossible.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_16: There are signs of fighting all around us, as if a great battle occurred not long ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_19: We should leave the valley and find open ground.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_20: The Prism of Fate flickered, and we ended up here... Could this be something Hsin the Moon Fox is doing?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_22: ...That is, she can make mechanisms multiply... or decrease.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_23: Can the Hold's structures transform into what we just saw?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_24: I have never seen such a thing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_200_25: You shield Qingxiao as the two of you fall and crash to the ground. You wake one after another in an unfamiliar valley. Your Terminal is unresponsive, and Abby does not answer your calls. Traces of battle are scattered around, and Qingxiao senses something deeply off about the place. You decide to find higher ground to get your bearings.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_201_1: More fallen Autopuppets. Wreckage from the Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_201_2: Their condition is fresh... They were damaged in recent combat.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_202_2: I see people up ahead. Let's ask them about this place.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_1: Oh, Sword Transcendent, you've come down the mountain! Some time has passed since your last visit.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_3: We saw something fall from the sky in the distance, so we came to take a look.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_5: Is that so... Can't say I've seen you before, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. Are you from outside Xuanfang?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_6: Ah, I know. The Sword Transcendent brought you down in a Cloud Shuttle from the Hold, right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_8: You've not heard of them? The great airships flying overhead. If they had not fought in the battle a while back, we'd have been done for.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_9: "The battle a while back"? I don't recall seeing any of these Cloud Shuttles before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_12: It happened about half a month ago. They said a Threnodian vanguard attacked. Tacet Discords blackened the land as far as the eye could see.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_13: We thought we were doomed. But then the Shuttles came down, all together. In one day and one night, they destroyed every last monster.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_14: That Threnodian was called Ova... uh... something. I can never quite remember the name.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_211_16: Yes, that's the one! Fancy name, sounded fierce enough. But in the end, the Shuttles and the Autopuppets still sent it running.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_212_1: Ovathrax, Retroact Rain, and the Gorges of Spirits... They're talking about the battle that occurred years ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_212_2: ...The Fortress and Gorges War, two hundred years past.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_212_3: If their perception of events is true, then we might be standing in some kind of illusion.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_213_1: That grand structure... Is it the gate to Yuan Fortress?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_213_2: A fortress built not with the Sentinel's wisdom or divine might, but by mortal hands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_213_3: Yangyang told me about it. A City of Mechanisms, built long before Xuanfang Hold. The Mengzhou Ministry of Development led it, and Zhuojun Atelier carried out the construction.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_213_4: Then you know what became of it...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_213_5: Yes. It was destroyed in the Fortress and Gorges War. A last resort to stop the Tacet Discords.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_214_1: If only I'd known sooner! I'd have brought my sister along. How often does one get to meet a Transcendent?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_1: The Sword Transcendent herself! What a surprise to see you here. Are you here to help someone?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_2: I would ask about "the great battle" that happened not long ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_3: Ah, I only know bits and pieces. Grandfather, Grandmother, and I were too frightened to leave the house for those two days.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_4: I heard two moons appeared in the sky above the Gorges of Spirits. And the rain was going up, not down.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_5: Sounds like "The Day of Twin Moons" and Retroact Rain.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_6: Yes, Retroact Rain! People who came back alive said they saw phantoms of the past. Even family who had long since passed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_7: The Cloud Shuttles and Autopuppets weren't bothered by that strange rain. After they cleared the Tacet Discords in Xuanfang, they went on to the Gorges of Spirits and destroyed the source of the outbreak.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_9: Sword Transcendent... Why do you ask? Yuan Fortress is fine, of course.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_10: Just follow this mountain road and you'll see it for yourself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_219_1: That's odd... Why is the mountain gate closed?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_1: That's odd... Why is the mountain gate closed?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_2: Heh. You're not from around here, are you, lad? The gate is under repair. No one will be allowed through for a while.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_3: Oh, I see. I came from Taoyuan Vale to visit my brother. He's an Artisan in the Fortress.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_4: Taoyuan Vale? Heard it's about to become part of a new city. Soon enough, you'll all be calling yourselves Jinzhou folk.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_5: It is hard not to feel something. We traveled such a long way from Hongzhen to Taoyuan Vale. Now it finally feels like home.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_7: Are you talking about Jinzhou's founding?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_8: Yes. The war is over. Mingting's decree has been proclaimed. Huanglong is soon to have its sixth city.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_9: Excuse me, if I may ask... has Xianling Village fared well?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_10: Sword Transcendent, it has been some time since we offered incense to you. Please do not worry. When the Tacet Discords came, the whole village took refuge in Yuan Fortress. Every soul is safe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_12: If you wish to reach the Fortress, you will need to find another way. The mountain gate is closed today.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_220_13: Near Yuan Fortress's mountain gate, an elderly woman and a young man tell you Jinzhou is soon to be established. Although, it appears the mountain gate is closed to visitors.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_1: The elder's words were true. Yuan Fortress's gate remains closed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_3: You'd think doors would get tired of refusing us...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_4: This resembles Xuanfang from two centuries ago, yet history has taken a different course. The Fortress and Gorges War left no deep wounds, and Yuan Fortress still stands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_6: The villagers we met all seemed to know you. They called you "Sword Transcendent"...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_7: At this point in time, I hadn't yet accepted Hsin's request to serve as the Xuan Paragon. The "Sword Transcendent" title only came from an embellished tale.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_8: With the gate closed, we either detour, or—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_9: Wait, you mean to break it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_14: I-I'm Jadie! I know I look suspicious, but please believe me! I'm here to help.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_15: If you want to uncover the secrets of this place, find a way to get to the sky.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_16: So those are Xuanfang Hold's Cloud Shuttles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_17: Yes! They're heading for the lightway that runs through the Skyend Barrier, up into the higher sky.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_19: It may look like regular cloud and mist, but get up close and you'll see what it really is.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_20: To catch those Shuttles, you need to head for that lightway... Go through the Barrier to reach the <ano=Human>Ren</ano> Realm...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_21: This one has stopped functioning completely.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_22: A puppet that talks. That's rare.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_23: It talks. Too bad it was all riddles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_24: It laid out a route for us, at least... A fork nearby leads straight to that lightway.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_25: As we were falling from the Sanctum, we saw Xuanfang Hold flying on those very Cloud Shuttles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_26: It could be lying or telling the truth. Either way, we need to see for ourselves.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_27: Look! The Cloud Shuttles are coming!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_28: It all appears so real... This is no ordinary Mirage Realm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_230_29: The gates of Yuan Fortress do not open. This Mirage Realm you and Qingxiao find yourselves in resembles the Land of Xuanfang from two hundred years ago and feels unnervingly real, except history has taken a different course here: Yuan Fortress was never destroyed in the Fortress and Gorges War. A mysterious Autopuppet calling itself Jadie appears before you and points you skyward, explaining that to catch up with the speeding Cloud Shuttles, you'll need to take a side path leading to a distant lightway. The moment it finishes speaking, it shuts down. You head for the path near the mountain gate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_240_1: There are the Shuttles again. They fly toward the lightway.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_241_1: Flying on a sword. And here I thought I'd seen everything.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_241_3: Sword Flight is not as rare as you think. I've seen Magistrate Jinhsi and her counselor both possessing the skill.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_241_5: Shortly after the Magistrate took office, Counselor Changli visited Xuanfang Hold for a Ministry of War conference on regional defense. That was where I first met her.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_242_1: The lightway is just ahead. Looks like this mechanism track will take us right up to it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_242_2: This realm does not allow ordinary means of flight. Our fall taught us that.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_243_1: Brace yourself. The lightway is just ahead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_250_4: Remember, will and sword as one, that the edge follows your heart.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_251_1: When all this is over, how about a few lessons?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_251_2: ...Teaching is not my strength. I once instructed a disciple of the Thunder Spells. She spent most of her time trying to escape.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_251_3: Don't worry, I'll be the judge of whether your methods suit me. Plus, I trust you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_260_1: I've passed the fundamentals of Sword Flight to you through my Sword Intent. But to master it, you still need to practice.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_260_2: Guess I'm a quick study, huh?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_260_3: You may credit your unique constitution and disciplined foundation in swordcraft.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_260_4: My Heart Sword technique is simple: keep an unshaken will, and your Sword Intent will cut through anything.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_260_5: So, does that make me your disciple now, Qingxiao?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_261_1: I would not have believed it if I had not seen it myself. The mechanist craft of these Cloud Shuttles surpasses even that of the Xuanfang Hold we know.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_261_2: Still, you can see the Hold's influence in their design.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_262_1: Those Artisans ahead may know a thing or two.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_1: Sword Transcendent? Why are you... If we had known you were coming, we would have prepared tea. And the young {Male=man;Female=lady} at your side is...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_3: I'm the Sword Transcendent's very first disciple.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_4: A pleasure. Welcome to Xuanfang Hold—or rather, to the Cloud Shuttle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_5: Ah, so you are under her tutelage... That is why she keeps company.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_7: I remember you. You are Anyan.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_8: Indeed, I am. I was once with the Ministry of Development's Defenseworks. Now, I serve on the Cloud Shuttle's maintenance crew.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_9: Had you not held back the Tacet Discords when Yuan Fortress was first built, none of us would have lived to see Xuanfang Hold rise.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_12: This is the City of Mechanisms built with the aid of Mengzhou's Sentinel, right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_13: Sentinel...? Forgive me, but I don't quite follow.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_15: Sentinel Hsin, the Moon Fox. Isn't she the reason Xuanfang Hold and these Shuttles exist?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_16: Why would you also—Never mind. I shall brief you on the recent tidings.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_17: A Transcendent excelling in mechanist arts came to Xuanfang and taught us wondrous techniques. It was like learning how to turn stone into gold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_18: Mountains, pebbles, pearls, rough stone—anything could be turned into a mechanism. And those mechanisms could evolve and replicate on their own. With that knowledge, the Ministry and Zhuojun Atelier raised this magnificent city in just a few months.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_19: As for the Shuttles, they were first tested in real combat two weeks ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_20: We were on board, yet we barely had to lift a finger. They hunted and exterminated the Tacet Discords on their own.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_21: And for the tight spots they couldn't reach, we deployed Autopuppets. Like soldiers falling from the sky, scouring the earth clean.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_22: In a single day and night, from Yuan Fortress to the Gorges of Spirits, the Threnodian of War's vanguard was reduced to nothing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_23: Now, our Shuttles provide reinforcement across all of Huanglong. One fleet has already left for the Norfall Barrens, to protect the newly founded Jinzhou City.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_25: ...I'd like to know more about this Transcendent.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_29: Strange thing is, none of us can remember his face. Or his voice. Probably another one of his mystical tricks.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_30: If you want answers, board the Shuttle at the head of the fleet. The Transcendent is staying there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_31: Aboard a Cloud Shuttle, you question an Artisan who appears to be in charge and learn what has transpired. According to local accounts, a "Transcendent" recently appeared and taught the people miraculous mechanist arts, enabling the Ministry of Development and Zhuojun Atelier to build this Shuttle-borne Xuanfang Hold in mere months. Not long ago, the newly launched fleet wiped out a Tacet Discord outbreak unleashed by Ovathrax and won the Fortress and Gorges War without incident. The Artisan adds that the Transcendent is currently stationed on the foremost shuttle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_280_1: A Xuanfang Hold with no Sentinel, but a Transcendent who preaches mechanist arts...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_280_2: Whoever he is, he's probably connected to Muyu.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_280_3: To the lead Shuttle, then. Let's see who's really pulling the strings in this shadow play.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_285_1: Those Autopuppets over there... They look like they're guarding the Shuttle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_286_2: ...It seems we've been flagged as hostiles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_286_3: Then we'll just have to cool their systems down.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_287_1: These Autopuppets show no signs of malfunction, yet they attacked us without hesitation.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_287_2: We'll know if this was just an isolated glitch at the next Shuttle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_287_3: The airflows between the Shuttles are remarkably stable. Perfect for Sword Flight.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_287_5: Let's fly to the next one. Manifest a blade from your Sword Intent, then guide it at your will.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_288_1: Your form is steady. You learn quickly. All you need now is more practice.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_290_1: As we suspected. The first attack was no isolated incident.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_290_2: Does this mean... the entire fleet is turning against us?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_291_2: This mechanism looks like your sword formation.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_291_3: Years ago, a Court of Savantae Artisan had me test a similar device designed to snare Tacet Discords.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_291_5: I do not know its inner workings, but I know how to break it. Strike the "core," the eye of the formation, with a flying sword.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_291_6: I will handle this side. You take the other.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_292_1: All change in this world is but a shift in frequency. When you face an obstacle, find its pivot. Strike true and your blade will do the rest.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_292_2: The way you describe martial arts is always a bit... quaint.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_292_3: ...What I mean to say is, these mechanisms can be dismantled with flying swords.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_295_1: This one is more intricate. You must locate all the cores.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_296_1: This sword has a unique frequency.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_297_1: (Looks like I'll need to form more blades with my Sword Intent to break it.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_1: ...Are you the legendary Sword Transcendent from the mountain?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_2: I am not the one you seek.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_3: If not you, then who else could it be?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_4: Please, Sword Transcendent. The Tacet Discords are coming! Can you help us? They roam the Clouded Cliffs and are almost at our village!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_5: Lead the way. And your name is...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_6: Ruoyun. Ruo as in "if," Yun as in "cloud."
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_7: What I saw just now, was it a memory from your past?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_8: Yes... that girl was the Court of Savantae Artisan I mentioned. She grew up in Xianling Village.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_9: When I first came to the Land of Xuanfang, the Xuanling Birds guided her up the mountain to seek my help. She returned often after that, though usually on behalf of others.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_10: But... why would I see Ruoyun here?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_300_11: You find a sword embedded upright in the ground.
