The frequency clinging to it conjures a vision of the past: a young girl named Ruoyun, guided up the mountain by a Xuanling Bird, once sought out Qingxiao and pleaded with her to quell the Tacet Discord outbreak threatening the village.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_302_1: Well done. Leave the final core to me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_303_1: Qingxiao, you've been trying to teach me this whole time, haven't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_303_2: Was it that obvious? I told you, I'm not good at this.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_303_3: Quite the opposite, actually. Come on, let's keep moving.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_304_1: Sword Transcendent? We didn't expect to see you here. This way, please!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_305_1: The Artisans here seem completely blind to the rogue Autopuppets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_1: That sudden rampage from the Autopuppets caught us off guard. It's like their alert systems just triggered for no reason.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_2: ...It seems only you two noticed what was happening.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_3: It's working hours. We can't just abandon our posts.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_4: Is your job really that important?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_5: It's more like a habit. When we are assigned to a Shuttle, we tend to lose ourselves in the work.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_6: Though now that you mention it, more and more of us have been working around the clock. Some don't even know when to stop anymore.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_7: It is strange... My mind has been hazy for a while. I don't feel much of anything lately.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_8: That happened to me as well. I can't even enjoy a good novel like I used to.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_9: Have you met a certain Transcendent who teaches mechanist arts? Does the name "Muyu" sound familiar?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_10: Hmm... haven't seen anyone by that name, no. But we did host a Transcendent recently. Helped us solve a few technical hurdles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_11: I can't remember much else about him... Only that he had an answer for everything. No airs about him at all.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_13: I heard he's on the lead Shuttle now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_14: If you are heading that way, could you check on a friend of mine? She's sitting at the bow, watching the scenery.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_15: She's been acting very strange lately. It's like she's lost interest in everything and everyone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_306_16: Most of the Artisans aboard the Cloud Shuttle appear indifferent to the Autopuppets' unrest. From Shitang and Chigong, you learn that many Artisans have been acting strangely lately, even admitting to themselves that something feels wrong. Shitang asks you to check on a friend of hers who has seemed particularly listless recently.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_307_1: So... this Xuanfang Hold isn't as perfect as it seems.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_309_3: I watched the sunrise earlier. My memory told me it was beautiful, but I felt nothing. Just emptiness.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_309_4: I can no longer feel as a human should. It is as if I've become just another gear in this Shuttle's mechanisms.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_309_6: ...I will not, of course. But the thought does not trouble me. Nothing does.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_309_8: [You try to press for more, but she falls into a heavy, dead silence.]
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_3: I remember these people. Most of the Artisans on these Shuttles died when Yuan Fortress was destroyed during the war.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_4: And they are only alive here because this Xuanfang survived it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_5: Yes. In the world we know, the soldiers and Artisans defending the Fortress detonated it themselves. A final sacrifice to stop the Tacet Discords from overrunning Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_6: Were you there when it happened?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_7: No. I was... with the defending troops in the Gorges of Spirits.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_8: By the time I returned to Xuanfang, the Fortress was already in ruins.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_9: If only I had been faster. If only this version of Xuanfang were real... everything could have been different.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_11: Don't lose yourself in a past that never was.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_12: This can't be called a better world. Everyone we've met here isn't in a normal state of mind.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_13: That "Transcendent" isn't just handing out lessons. I think he's done something to them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_16: Qingxiao confides that, as far as she can recall, most of the Artisans aboard this Shuttle are among those who perished when Yuan Fortress self-destructed. Back then, the last Artisans and soldiers holding the Fortress had no choice but to detonate it to prevent the Tacet Discords from reaching Mengzhou. Qingxiao had been in the Gorges of Spirits supporting local forces at the time, and by the time she returned to Xuanfang, Yuan Fortress was already in ruins, and with it, those who had made their final stand there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_311_1: So this is how that Transcendent treats his guests, hm?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_312_3: Follow the airflows ahead. Navigate your sword to get closer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_314_1: Keep your stance steady. These attacks cannot touch you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_1: At last, you arrive. I hope my little "roadblocks" weren't too much trouble for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_4: And where is that ignorant, chattering little girl? The strike she landed last time... It left an impression.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_5: I will grant you a swifter end this time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_6: Easy now, Sword Transcendent. Surely you realize I am but a phantom.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_7: Why not stay for a chat? You must have questions. I would be disappointed if you didn't.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_8: What have you done to the minds of the Artisans in this Mirage Realm?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_9: This is Xuanfang as I have shaped it. A better version of what stood here two hundred years ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_10: Those Artisans are shadows of the past. I offered them a kindness— adjusted their perception, excised their emotional flaws. Now they are on their way to becoming perfect.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_12: You should understand, Qingxiao. A heart unsullied by desire or feeling, is that not the ideal state you Cultivators chase?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_13: Cultivation is not about making oneself an unfeeling lump of wood.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_14: Lump of wood...? No, no. This is perfection. Xuanfang Hold as it was always meant to be.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_15: Everything you see runs itself. Perfect order. Perfect efficiency. With mechanisms like these, we could fight another Fortress and Gorges War and lose no one.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_16: I am sick to death of those "Hero Plays" about devotion and sacrifice.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_17: They stir the heart, yes. But that is all they do. The weak swallow them because the truth is too bitter to bear.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_20: You have no right to judge them, Muyu.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_21: Heh... I built Yuan Fortress. I understand the limits of humanity far better than powerful Resonators like you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_22: When the Fortress fell, when our struggle meant nothing against the Lament, the one meant to "guide civilization" just stood there. Watching.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_23: The Xuanfang Hold you see now? This is what it was supposed to be. I just restored it from the blueprints in the database. Which is to say—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_24: It could have changed the course of the war. So what do you think? Did our Sentinel Hsin lack the power? Or... did She lack the will?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_25: Suspect the Sentinel all you want. Your fall from grace is your own doing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_26: All I see is a coward hiding in a Mirage Realm, running experiments that are only fooling himself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_27: Wherever your true body is hiding, I will find it. And I will end you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_28: I look forward to it. There's just one thing...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_29: Where did you get the idea that this place couldn't affect reality?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_320_30: The so-called "Transcendent" proves to be Muyu, as expected. He is using this Mirage Realm as his personal laboratory, rewriting the memories of the departed Artisans to construct a perfect "Xuanfang Hold as it was always meant to be." He informs you that every Cloud Shuttle here was rebuilt from technical blueprints already in the database, blueprints Hsin the Moon Fox could have used to change the course of the Fortress and Gorges War, yet chose not to...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_325_1: The fog disrupts the stability of our Resonance Abilities.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_325_2: Skywatch Lancers... Another Autopuppet series that never made it past the prototype stage.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_326_2: They were Ruoyun's work, too. She asked me to test them once, and I ended up shattering the prototype.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_1: Aaagghh! Those traitors are such big bullies! Lucky for me you showed up again! Thanks for saving me!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_2: You're the one from Yuan Fortress...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_4: Yep. You two are so fast. Took me forever just to catch up to you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_5: Call me Jadie. That's my name now. You two are too fast. Took me forever just to catch up to you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_6: The Fortress gate is indeed far from here. We thought you had gone offline when we left.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_10: The sky here is split into levels. Right now, we're in the <ano=Human>Ren</ano> Realm. Up there will be the <ano=Earth>Di</ano> Realm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_11: Why is this Mirage structured in such levels?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_12: Because it's extra special! Don't worry, you're super close to the source of it all now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_13: But I do have some bad news. Things are getting messy in the Hold outside.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_14: You mean the real Xuanfang Hold?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_15: Mm-hmm. A lot of evil things are swarming toward it as we speak. If you take too long, things might get really bad.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_17: Ah! I just ran out of juice. Lucky me, I woke up and found some spare power cells from the others. Then I flew all the way here!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_18: You know things we don't, and it's clear you've been keeping them from us this entire time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_19: ...If I could help it, I wouldn't want to be like this either.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_20: If you're after that creepy one‑eyed jerk, just keep heading up, up, up!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_330_21: You rescue Jadie from an Autopuppet attack. It appears to have just caught up with you. Jadie directs you higher into the sky, toward the "Di Realm." Pressed for more information, Jadie hesitates, clearly torn, but admits that conditions in the real Xuanfang Hold are deteriorating.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_1: Commander Qiuhong's Rafter Kites have detected a large Tacet Discord swarm approaching from the eastern peaks. All units, prepare to engage!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_2: I will intercept the biggest threats. Vanguards, stick to the formation we practiced. Do not break ranks.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_4: {PlayerName}, Paragon Qingxiao... It's been so long...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_6: Think I'd let you fight without me, Yangyang?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_9: Do not worry. My injuries have mostly healed. I was only staying at the Ministry of War because the medics insisted on quiet rest.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_10: Word is, those roaming Tacet Discords have begun to close in on the Hold. I will not let you face this alone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_11: We will fight together. The new Xuan Triad... Well, duo, for now. I will not let Qingzhi and Duzhong down.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_12: Yes. Shoulder to shoulder, once more.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_14: Don't worry. Even the final stragglers have been evacuated behind the defensive line.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_17: An urgent report from the Ministry of Development. Another Censure Court has just gone offline.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_19: Conditions around Xuanfang Hold continue to worsen: more Censure Courts have gone dark, and Tacet Discord hordes are closing in. As Yangyang rallies the vanguard troops before battle in her new role as Xuan Watcher, Liangyu returns, recovered and ready to fight alongside her. Together with the soldiers, they prepare to meet the oncoming hordes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_1: I know you're here to save the Hold. You don't need to trust me, but I'm trusting you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_2: I never told you my name.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_3: I, uh—I heard that one‑eyed jerk say it. Ahem... anyway! Once you enter the <ano=Earth>Di</ano> Realm, watch out for the <te href=800050>Reeling Fog</te>.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_5: It makes your head all spinny. You ran into a bit of it earlier.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_6: Are you not coming with us?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_7: I'd just slow you down. But don't you worry! I'll catch up as soon as I'm ready!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_9: It is true your words have not been false.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_10: Please, Qingxiao. You both have to keep going.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_11: Jadie asks you to press on without it, warning you to beware of the Di Realm's Reeling Fog, and claiming time to make preparations before rejoining you. You head for the lightway leading into the Di Realm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_350_1: That's Cloud Shuttle wreckage scattered among the cliffs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_350_2: So, not as perfect as Muyu made it out to be. The next level is probably going to be a mess.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_352_1: (That's about all I can do for now. Time to go play nice with the crazy man.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_352_2: Are you sure they will find that little breadcrumb you left?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_352_3: Sure? Nah. But you don't win bets by not playing. And so far, I'm on a roll.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_1: You've been gone for quite a while.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_2: Not every day I get to hitch a ride on a fancy airship like this. Had to do a little sightseeing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_3: Hmph. I'm interested to know what the Reverberations of the dead mean to a Nethermancer like yourself?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_4: Still hung up on that? They're just lingering obsessions.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_5: To me, they are the raw materials of transcendence. Resources to be shaped as I see fit.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_7: You are on a Xuanfang Hold Cloud Shuttle. Get acquainted with your new body. Go on.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_10: Before, I proved that Reverberations could influence an Autopuppet's behavioral logic. Now, I have gone a step further...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_11: Reverberations can drive a shell entirely on their own. Granting it new life.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_12: Waking the dead from their nap? You sure they won't have a bone to pick with you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_13: I have adjusted their perceptions. Scrubbed away the redundant emotions and petty desires.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_14: Progress takes time. For now, they are just the "intermediate products" of my experiment.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_15: Which is why I need a small favor... Dispose of that sample for me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_16: I agreed to help you out, Grand Helm's orders. I didn't agree to being your trash man.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_18: Impressive. A necessary cost, nothing more. One must discard the defects to make room for perfection.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_19: I guess you know that {PlayerName} and the Paragon have entered this Mirage Realm. Doesn't that concern you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_21: Hah. Well, you'd better pray when they find you. I'm not sticking around to fight them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_22: Guardians always suffer from the same delusion. They think that if they strike down the mastermind, the problem vanishes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_23: But the end was decided long ago. Until the time is right, I shall let them play their little game.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_24: (Boy. Why have me save the Reverberation from that broken puppet? Keeping it as a souvenir?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_25: (Just let it go. Same as always.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_26: Not quite alive, and not quite dead. This really what you wanted?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_27: Trifles no longer trouble them, so they have no reason to care about things like that.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_353_28: Not long ago, the Cat of the Nether Lamp meets with Muyu aboard a Cloud Shuttle. Muyu asks for his thoughts on the Reverberations of the dead, then demonstrates how a Reverberation can drive an Autopuppet entirely on its own. Once the Autopuppet stirs to "life," Muyu orders him to dispose of it. The Cat of the Nether Lamp outwardly complies with Muyu's test, but secretly preserves the Reverberation instead...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_354_1: By the way, still no sign of that Cat of the Nether Lamp. But since he was at the Sanctum with us, he must've been pulled into this Mirage Realm too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_354_2: If he has not blown his cover, he should be with Muyu.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_360_1: This must be the Reeling Fog Jadie warned us about. We shouldn't stay in it for long.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_360_3: Do you hear that? The Autopuppets nearby are speaking.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_361_1: Watch out. Something's not right. The fog... it's getting thicker.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_361_2: Rogue Autopuppets... too many. Tacet Discords... attack.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_363_1: The cut on this Autopuppet is clean. It has not been down for long.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_363_2: The frequency left on it feels like the Cat of the Nether Lamp's Resonance Ability. Probably his work.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_365_1: These mechanisms have been corrupted by the fog, but our flying swords can still dismantle them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_366_1: It is as if... they live here as people do.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_1: Thank you... breaking seal. Here... our village. I... Chief.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_3: Why is there a village in a place like this?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_4: We... have no home. We... gather here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_5: It carries Reverberations, just like the Autopuppets Muyu controlled during the Siege of Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_8: Much has faded from my mind. But I remember being human. I lived in Xianling Village long ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_9: Do you remember what happened back then?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_10: We fled back to the village during the chaos. Not long after, we were trapped by these strange mechanisms.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_11: Many villagers were left out there... If you leave, could you help them?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_13: Thank you. I just remembered... a young lass I did not recognize left a sword here. She said to give it to the outsiders who would come.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_15: ...Muyu implants the Reverberations of the deceased and binds them to these shells. Forces them to "live" like this.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_17: Another one of his sick experiments. What he did in the Ren Realm... this goes much further.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_20: I'm fine. It will not hinder our mission.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_21: Did she have any distinguishing features?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_22: Forgive me, I can no longer recall her face. Let me fetch the blade for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_23: We should examine that sword. It is likely the one we have seen before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_370_24: Aboard a Cloud Shuttle in the Di Realm, you stumble on an unusual "Autopuppet village" where its inhabitants appear to live ordinary lives like regular villagers. With the pendant's help, you see the truth: they are all souls of the departed, another one of Muyu's cruel experiments, it seems. While the Autopuppet village chief retrieves a sword left behind by someone, you notice Qingxiao appears unwell...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_371_1: Its frequency resembled my own Sword Intent...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_1: Sword Transcendent, I have come to bid you farewell. It was Lingfang who finally convinced me to do this.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_3: I am staying in Xuanfang Hold. The construction is nearing completion. I just... wanted you to know.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_4: I love this land. I love the people here. I want to use my mechanisms to give everyone the strength to protect themselves.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_5: That way... I will not have to keep sending Xuanling Birds to beg for your help.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_6: I have a question. If you spend your life chasing a goal so difficult that it has already cost you dearly, is it still worth it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_8: That's alright. I have plenty of time ahead of me to think about it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_10: What you saw just now was the day Ruoyun came to say goodbye.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_11: Where did she go after that?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_12: The Fortress and Gorges War broke out soon after. She was in the squad tasked with the Fortress's self-destruction.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_13: Later, I returned to the ruins to search for her... I found nothing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_372_14: The frequency on the sword reveals a memory of Ruoyun bidding farewell to Qingxiao. Qingxiao tells you the Fortress and Gorges War broke out soon after, and that Ruoyun was among those who carried out Yuan Fortress's self-destruction.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_374_1: ...Onward. We should be able to break this seal together.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_375_1: Autopuppets are attacking those "villagers." We should help them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_376_1: Thank you. Some friends... they are trapped on the Shuttle ahead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_376_2: Something went wrong with the Shuttle's mechanisms. It sent the Autopuppets into a blind rampage... we couldn't stop them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_376_4: You are from the world outside, aren't you? How is Yuan Fortress now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_376_6: I... I remember defending that Fortress. So many of us... we did our best. But the Tacet Discords were endless. Tell me... did we lose?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_376_7: You did not. It was your sacrifice that ensured two centuries of peace for Xuanfang.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_376_8: That's good... Somehow, my chest does not feel quite so empty.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_377_1: There are no Reverberations bound to the Autopuppets that attacked the villagers.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_377_2: Muyu must have been controlling them directly, just as he did back in the Ren Realm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_379_1: Why... why did you save me?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_379_2: I can move now. But... I don't know where I should go...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_381_1: This is... a note left by the Cat of the Nether Lamp.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_381_2: He's been through here. He made sure to leave this intelligence for us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_382_1: The Autopuppets up ahead look like they're repairing those heavy artillery pieces...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_383_1: So, Qingxiao. Between that cannon and your flying swords...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_383_2: ...Within a hundred paces, the sword is faster.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_385_1: (They all have a flame‑like frequency, same as before. I'll use the pendant to reveal their true forms.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_386_1: (Those unique frequencies again. I should use the pendant.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_387_1: Go on ahead. I'll stay to maintain the Xuan Bombards.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_387_2: I will not let any rogue Autopuppet get past this point.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_388_1: No enemies around. Xuan Bombards... I fix.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_389_1: I must restore the Xuan Bombards before the next wave of rogue Autopuppets arrives.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_389_3: A Cloud Shuttle's most advanced defense system. It can track and fire on multiple hostile targets at once.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_389_4: Think of it as a very powerful automated cannon.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_389_5: Almost there... I will fix them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_390_2: Let's stop and find somewhere to rest.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_390_3: Okay. Let us board that looming Shuttle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_1: Welcome aboard this Cloud Shuttle, modeled after the Ministry of War headquarters. Though, as you can see, it no longer requires the service of human soldiers.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_5: Muyu... you've bound the Reverberations of the dead to these machines, but you still send Autopuppets to hunt them down. Why?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_7: Failing minds, faded memories, with nary a shred of self left to act on their own... It is time for a fresh batch of samples.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_8: You defile the souls of the innocent treating them as disposables for your experiment.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_9: I prefer to call it... "resource optimization."
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_10: They were nothing but Reverberations haunting the ruins of Yuan Fortress. Left alone, they would have inevitably devolved into Tacet Discords.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_11: But now, they serve a great experiment. If Reverberations can be perfectly fused into mechanical shells, the line between life and death vanishes. Immortality becomes possible.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_12: If the shell wears out, we replace it. As long as consciousness remains, life is not extinguished. Death becomes obsolete, and the dead may rise once more.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_13: Is this also Zhuojun Aterlier's true purpose?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_15: Please. The Flowerveil Puppet sees nothing beyond Mengzhou's gilded little playground. Do not compare me to that narrow-minded woman.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_16: Ah, an amusing name. That little Jinzhou organization has not even come close to understanding the nature of the soul. They only use memories to fashion mockeries of life.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_17: Their <te href=750058>Dollmaker</te>... A third-rate puppeteer. A man so mired in his own past that a few offhand remarks, and I saw the weakness eating him from the inside.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_18: How about we discuss a topic you find more pressing? Say... the Ministry of War in the real world?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_19: Take a guess. As the Censure Courts continue to release Tacet Discords, how long do you think those Wardens can hold the line?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_20: They might survive the wave from one Court. But two? Three? Even if they hold, what will it cost?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_21: You underestimate the people of Xuanfang. Just as you never understood what they fight for.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_22: Hmph. You cling to the fragility of emotion and human will. Blind to the truth that only in superior technology will you master your fate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_24: ...Xuanfang Hold and its people will survive.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_25: No matter how great you are, Paragon Qingxiao, you cannot protect those beyond your reach.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_26: They will break soon enough. All I am doing... is accelerating the inevitable shutdown of the Censure Courts.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_27: When you confront him, Muyu's phantom reappears and lays out his "resurrection of the dead" experiment. In his view, every Autopuppet currently hosting a Reverberation is a failed specimen, which is why he has been sending other Autopuppets to destroy them. He tries to pressure you by revealing how dire the real Xuanfang Hold has become, but Qingxiao remains certain that everyone will make it out alive.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_392_1: Thank you. I... continue the repairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_400_2: As the heart wills, so the sword moves.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_2: This can't be... your frequency is all but drained...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_3: This whole time, that unique frequency the Shuttles detected affecting the real world... that was you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_4: How many are you propping up? The garrison? The entire city?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_5: Or could it be... the Land of Xuanfang itself?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_6: You are even more foolish than I thought, Sword Transcendent. Do you really think you can shield them forever?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_7: You of all people should know how fragile human lives are compared to a Resonator's. Xuanfang Hold will fall, and those people will fall with it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_8: You cannot change what is coming. Everything you are doing is just piling more weight on your own—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_10: Muyu's illusion being here means we're closing in on his real location.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_11: You look pale. Leave the rest of the fighting to me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_12: You need not worry about me... Keep your focus on the enemies.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_405_13: Once you confirm Xuanfang's soldiers and civilians have launched a counterattack, you push past Muyu's phantom without a second glance. Muyu is stunned to learn Qingxiao shared her Sword Intent with nearly everyone across Xuanfang. His phantom vanishes abruptly, and you are forced to fend off another wave of Autopuppets while Qingxiao appears increasingly exhausted...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_406_1: You said the Sword Intent you shared could only release one burst of Sword Energy. But now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_406_2: It is alright. As long as I maintain the link to my Sword Intent, the power I shared to protect the people will not run dry.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_406_3: No, what I want to know is who's paying the price for all that power?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_700_1: Pay attention. Stop gawking. You'll get tired of the view soon enough.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_700_2: Sorry, it's just the mechanisms are beyond anything I've ever seen...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_702_1: You've been on this Cloud Shuttle for days now. How are you still acting like a rookie on their first day?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_702_2: Master, I was just thinking. If these mechanisms can already run themselves... then won't the repair crews be out of a job one day?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_702_3: A fleet this massive... and all it takes to keep it running is a handful of people from the Ministry of Development and Zhuojun Atelier.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_702_4: All we really do is inspect them every day. If something breaks, swap in a spare part. That's it...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_702_5: So we keep studying mechanist arts... and before we know it, the machines will have taken our place.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_702_6: So? If you don't learn this craft, then when one of them does break down, you won't even know where to look.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_705_1: I miss the braised pork from Yuan's Flavors.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_706_1: Homesick? Once the Cloud Shuttles dock at Yuan Fortress to restock, I'll be able to go home anyway.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_706_2: Then why bring up braised pork all of a sudden? Are the rations finally getting to you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_706_3: You know, I can barely taste a thing nowadays. Whatever I eat or drink... nothing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_706_4: So... just thought the food at Yuan's Flavors might make a difference.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_706_5: ...Truth is, I'm the same. For some reason, I feel like... I've just stopped feeling much of anything lately.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_709_1: Back during the Fortress and Gorges War, these Autopuppets were like heavenly soldiers from the legends.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_710_1: Back during the Fortress and Gorges War, these Autopuppets were like heavenly soldiers from the legends.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_710_2: But the truth is, we know nothing about their internal structure or how they function. Is this technology we were ever meant to possess?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_710_3: What would happen if one day they stopped helping us and instead became accomplices to some person or purpose instead?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_710_4: Even the Cloud Shuttles themselves might... Ugh. Maybe all these sleepless nights are making me paranoid.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_750_1: There's some bad news. You should probably brace yourself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_750_3: Your sister's condition worsened not long ago. She's gone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_751_1: Your sister's condition worsened not long ago. She's gone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_751_2: I always knew this day would come.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_751_3: Are you okay? It wasn't just anyone who died. It was the little sister you cared so much about!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_751_4: ...I know. But right now, all I feel is emptiness.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_751_5: Once the maintenance work is done, I'll return to Yuan Fortress for the customary funeral.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_755_2: ...I think I dreamed of a different Fortress and Gorges War.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_756_2: ...I think I dreamed of a different Fortress and Gorges War.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_756_3: In it, Tacet Discords swarmed toward Yuan Fortress without end, but there were no Cloud Shuttles or Autopuppets to save us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_756_4: All we had were Bladepuppets, city walls, and trenches. The defenses were shattered. So many people fell...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_756_5: Guess I've gone too long without sleep. That must be why my mind conjures up such nonsense.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_760_1: One hundred and thirteenth routine inspection...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_760_3: One hundred and fourteenth routine inspection... One hundred and fifteenth routine inspection...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_771_1: The one inside it is my wife. While we were fleeing, she protected me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_771_2: She can't seem to move anymore. But if I stay here beside her...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_771_3: Maybe one day she'll stand up again, right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_781_1: We "woke up" one by one. None of us could remember where we were supposed to go.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_781_2: But we knew one thing: we were different from those Autopuppets that only follow orders.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_781_3: Slowly, we gathered here... hoping to live normal lives again, like before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_781_4: This place is our base, our village, and our new home. We won't let it be taken from us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_1: The village chief did not tell you, but... it was me. I am the one who set off the seal to close off our village.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_2: I only meant to keep those Autopuppets out. But the fog corrupted the mechanism. Now it will never shut off.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_3: We live again... but so many were left outside. Did I do the wrong thing?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_4: This isn't a simple matter of right or wrong.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_6: I have been thinking about it all this time. I have not found an answer. If none of this had happened, maybe we could have gone on living in these bodies. Peacefully.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_7: Thank you. An answer, even a hard one, is better than being stuck ruminating forever. I will go apologize to the dead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_8: The one at fault is the man who sent the Autopuppets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_791_9: ...Thank you. I understand now. No matter what, I should apologize to the dead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_501_1: Looks like we don't need to do anything.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_501_2: The pendant is reacting... It's guiding us forward.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_502_1: While we were in the cabin, others were keeping watch outside.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_1: Heh. {PlayerName}, Paragon Qingxiao. Took you long enough. Any later, and I wouldn't've held out.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_2: That pendant and those notes I left... They did the trick, I s'pose?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_4: Our inside man. We meet again.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_5: Just a Jianghu alias to earn my keep. Let me introduce myself proper—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_6: Sounds a bit dull. I'd much rather you call me—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_7: The Nethermancer who went three years undercover in Zhuojun Atelier's snake pit without a single bite—Jingran. You didn't pull any punches back at the Sanctum, by the way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_9: Haha! Heard stories 'bout your style. Had to see for myself if the rumors were true.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_10: Your cover must be blown now, right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_12: While he was running his mouth at you, I gave him a little love tap in the back. Shame he slipped away behind a wall of Autopuppets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_13: I see... that's why Muyu's phantom vanished so suddenly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_14: Right, let's skip the chit‑chat. We're all hunting the same soulless fart, so why not team up?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_15: You've helped a great deal, and I've no reason to refuse. I need your intel. But you... what do you need from me?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_16: You get right to it, huh? Love it. I want to stick with you because it's better odds for making sure Muyu doesn't get away again.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_17: I don't have any of your "noble" motives, just an old score to settle with that bastard.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_19: Yeah, well... if we trip over any Sanctum relics or Hsin's secret stash of treasure, maybe toss one my way? Hah. Kidding.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_20: Let me be clear, no Nethermancer stands by while someone toys with the dead's <ano=obsessions>Reverberations</ano>.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_25: He took the Shuttle up to the top level. The <ano=Heaven>Tian</ano> Realm. That's his playground.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_26: According to "Lucky," there's a sea of Reverberations up there. Almost like... all of Xuanfang's Reverberations got sucked into one place.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_27: To hell with you, I told you that's not my name! You forgetful brat!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_28: Tch. Always so lively... That's just a foul-mouthed <te href=800054>Lynx Spirit</te> I caught. Pay it no mind.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_30: In a coded letter to Zhuojun Atelier, he claimed he'd get his hands on "Sentinel technology." The mechanistic mojo Hsin used to build the Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_31: But think about it. If all he wanted was to steal something in the Sanctum... isn't all this chaos a bit unnecessary?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_32: He's been running experiments on the mechanisms. It's like he's trying to figure out how they work before he does something.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_33: Either way, we need to find him quickly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_34: This is the last Shuttle, but I see no lightway to the Skyend Barrier.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_1: Looks like you still have questions. Go on. I got nothing to hide.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_3: Why did you just leave that pendant behind?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_4: How did you manage to get close to Muyu?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_6: After our little run-in at the Sanctum, I used a Spirit Portal to enter this Mirage Realm. Landed in this level first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_7: As soon as I got there, I walked right into Muyu collecting data. Played along, got cozy. After my cover blew, I stole a Shuttle to give his toys the slip. That's how I ended up here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_8: Lucky or not, you two showed up. With a parade of those things. Heh. Gotta say, you really know how to wear a guy out.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_9: Right before the siege, Muyu and I reached a secret chamber in Fogveil Pagoda. He didn't find Hsin's trail, so he geared up for the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_10: Time was tight, so I left that pendant behind as a breadcrumb. Laced it with my Resonance Ability. Then I followed him.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_11: It was a gamble. Could've blown up in my face a hundred ways. But turns out... I bet on the right horse. Spent my life in the right place, too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_13: Oh, I cut a deal with the "debt collector" in this <ano=Life Lamp>lamp</ano>. Traded a bit of my lifespan. Just enough to juice that pendant.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_14: Add in the passage to the Sanctum? A year or two off the clock. I figure that's a tidy price for you and the Paragon on my side.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_15: The snake needed a hand from within Zhuojun Atelier to get supplies moving to lay the groundwork. That hand... just happened to be me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_16: But he was paranoid. Notes at drop points, never a face. Didn't get a meet‑and‑greet 'til all hell broke loose with the Autopuppets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_17: He kept me at arm's length. Used me like a doorman. If you two hadn't've scared him, he never would've let me come this far.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_511_19: Same portal I opened for you back then. It cuts a passage between any two places thick enough with Reverberations.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_1: ...We cannot let the escaped Tacet Discords into Mengzhou. We are running out of options...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_2: Anyone willing to follow me into the Fortress mainframe, step forward!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_4: The rest of you... Guanchuan is in command now. Stick to the plan. Cover the evacuation and withdraw immediately!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_5: I'm going with you. I know a shortcut to the mainframe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_6: ...Savantae girl, this is not your fight. Get to safety.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_7: Commander, this is my home. I'm from Huanglong, but I'm a daughter of Xuanfang too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_8: Just like everyone else here, I want to make sure more people can live to see the sunrise.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_9: ...These are memories and emotions from the past. From before Yuan Fortress self-destructed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_10: My Shifu told me about this. The ones who stayed behind... They were all great heroes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_513_1: Huh, it's been quiet for a while... That's not a good sign.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_515_2: Tch. Sent a big one after us. Muyu must be getting desperate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_515_3: Focus on the defense of our own Shuttle first!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_515_5: Heh, with you two around? I almost feel safe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_515_6: Status: Autonomous attack mode activated. Deploying combat units.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_516_1: Hello, hello—can you hear me? I just connected to the Cloud Shuttle control room.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_516_2: The Xuan Bombards on deck are all ready to fire. Use them as much as you want!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_516_5: Let's blast those bots to pieces!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_517_1: Ugh, not good! The Bombards overheated and shut down! Repairs will take some time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_517_2: We cannot let a single one slip through.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_517_3: Let's split up and cover both sides.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_517_4: Fine by me. This side is mine.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_518_1: Watch the flank! Another wave incoming!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_519_1: Ah! Remote repairs complete! Xuan Bombards are back online!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_520_1: These Autopuppets are a lot tougher than the last batch.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_520_2: Don't let them stall us. We need to end this quickly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_520_3: Uh‑oh, that big bully just wrecked our best cannon!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_521_1: Those grapples are messing with the Shuttle's flight stability... If this keeps up, we'll be in big trouble!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_522_1: I will hold the line here. You two go deal with those Shuttles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_522_2: Got it. Jingran, can you keep up?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_522_3: That far? Heh, don't sell a Nethermancer short.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_523_1: Warning: Foreign object intrusion detected. Threat level updated.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_523_2: Doesn't matter how many minions they throw at us. Minions are still minions.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_524_1: Hurry, destroy the Cloud Shuttle's core! Bring it down!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_525_1: Warning: Sub-vessel power insufficient. Crash imminent.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_525_2: That's one down. Time to take down the next.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_526_1: Heads up. These Shuttles have gone completely haywire.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_527_3: Phew, our side's clear. Wonder how the Paragon's doing—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_529_1: Incredible work, team! The enemy Shuttles are pulling back, and the Autopuppets have stopped attacking!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_529_2: Yeah, but the fog's still here. Doesn't feel like a win to me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_529_3: My gut tells me this is a trap.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_529_4: It probably just pulled back into the fog. Getting ready to hit us again.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_529_5: ...Brace yourselves. That Shuttle is approaching once more.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_530_1: Warning: Sub-vessel core region under attack. Requesting emergency reinforcements.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_530_2: Tch. That voice is really starting to get on my nerves.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_530_3: Destroy that orb, then we're done here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_531_1: Directive: Full assault. Unit deployment intensity raised to maximum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_532_1: That Shuttle is the source of the fog. Until it falls, this will not end.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_532_2: Then we board it and destroy the control orb.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_532_3: Interesting... so we're trading "bases"? Autopuppets are still pouring in. If we all leave, this place is done for.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_532_5: It's finally my turn to fight. Sheesh... Took me forever to fix these guys up.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_532_6: You go take down that Cloud Shuttle! Leave this place to me and my Lancers!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_532_7: Sure you can handle it? I'll stay back for a bit and help you hold the line.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_533_1: Directive: Activating emergency defense mode. Eliminate all intruders at maximum capacity.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_533_2: It's trying to slow us down with the Reeling Fog.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_533_3: I activated my Sword Intent. It should help us resist the fog's effects for now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_535_1: I'm back! Time to sink this behemoth!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_537_1: Warning: Core integrity decreasing... Crash imminent... Crash imminent...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_540_1: (We can't expect to board it yet. Gotta clear the deck of Autopuppets first.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_541_1: Warning: Main vessel core under threat. Eliminate all intruders immediately.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_541_2: Its defenses won't hold much longer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_542_1: This flying piece of junk's been playing hide-and-seek long enough. Let's put it down!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_1: That big one's finally gone. Ugh, I'm so exhausted... Quite sure my parts are about to fall off one by one.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_2: Thank you for your help back there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_4: Hehe. After all, they are my proudest cre—ugh, partners!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_5: Little riddle-box? Everything I say makes perfect sense!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_6: You... Why have you been helping us all this time?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_7: I want the city out there to be okay! If we don't fix things here, that place is gonna be in big, big trouble too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_8: Alrighty! Now I'll scoot us along to the next level—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_10: Whoa. So that's the Moon Fox's relic from Fogveil Pagoda? Figured it ended up with you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_12: ...Yes. Sword Transcendent Qingxiao... It has been... a very, very long time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_14: Explain yourself. And don't try to dodge.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_15: Uhh... How was I supposed to know the Sentinel's relic would reveal my true form like that?!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_16: Wait, this Prism of Fate, the Lexicon Axis, and the Sanctum... Are the knowledge restrictions lifting?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_17: Now this is something. Have you two heard the legends about Xuanfang's Celestials?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_20: Good, saves time. The story goes that the Savantae crew didn't just vanish after building the Hold. They just... "upgraded." Celestials, they call 'em. Been watching over the city's mechanisms ever since.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_21: Celestials... That's the name they gave the Savanate crew that built the Hold. Soon after its completion, poof. Gone without a trace.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_22: But if you buy the old stories, they never really left. Just became invisible caretakers keeping the Hold's gears turning to this day.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_23: The Fortress and Gorges War broke out before Xuanfang Hold was even finished. Ruoyun, what exactly are you...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_24: Very good. I am a Celestial. But my case... was a little different.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_25: Long ago, I triggered the self-destruct at Yuan Fortress's mainframe—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_26: ...I'm... still alive...? Did I... make it...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_27: ...If that wasn't enough... What do I do now... Everyone has...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_28: You have already done more than enough.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_30: Your will and heart have reached me. The rest is for me to handle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_31: Ruoyun. In a moment, you will die from your wounds. But I offer you a choice—
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_32: Cast aside your mortal body and become part of Xuanfang Hold, guarding it for what may be eternity. Or accept the peace of death here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_33: Endless restraint, or quiet release. I wish to know what you can truly accept.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_34: ...I gave my word that I'd be one of the Celestials... I want to keep... protecting my people.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_35: This path is not easy. Time may wither your spirit. There will be no turning back... even if you beg.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_36: ...I'll let... my future self... worry about the regrets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_37: Then entrust the whole of your being to <ano=Xuanfang Hold>me</ano>.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_38: —To be a Celestial is to accept a leash. You bind your life to the Hold and swear never to reveal its secrets.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_39: But this crisis is endangering its people. I did what I had to and projected my consciousness into an Autopuppet to guide you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_40: And you can speak the truth now because of this? Why only now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_41: The restrictions have been lifted for now. Likely because we're near the core data zone, and your connection to the Sentinel has grown stronger.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_42: Then tell me, what is this place? And how is it connected to the Hold?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_43: You're in the Hold's control mainframe, a space called the Xuanyuan Domain. It stores vast amounts of the region's historical data.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_44: Muyu uploaded outside Reverberations, twisting the execution logic. He tried to take full control of the Mirage Realm, but it ended up triggering all these anomalies.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_45: If this continues, his Reverberations will continue their contamination until everything collapses. In the end... the Hold itself will fall.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_47: Simulating... Xuanfang Hold... Reconstructing... Future possibilities converged...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_48: Is this control mainframe actually a <te href=800053>Civilization Capsule</te>? Could we be inside it right now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_49: I... That data is restricted under the highest clearance. Even now, it hasn't lifted.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_50: There's the lightway to the Skyend Barrier. This is as far as I can take you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_51: Muyu turned guardians into killers, and souls of the departed into toys. I beg you... Please stop him.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_52: I accept your request. Take care.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_53: Qingxiao, do you remember... our farewell back then? You never gave me an answer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_55: (This voice. It sounds like the one I heard in Rinascita's Civilization Capsule. If Imperator wasn't the only Sentinel that left a relic storing legacy data...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_1: Before you go, are there any more questions? I'll tell you what I can.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_5: Xuanfang Hold's technology comes from the Sentinel Herself. It is far more advanced than anything else in this age. It can never be allowed to leak.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_6: The restrictions on us Celestials come from that consensus. We accepted our fate when we signed on to build the Hold. We knew what we would become when it was finished.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_7: Now... we are just consciousness in machines. Frequencies that watch over and maintain the Hold, never to leave.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_8: Why haven't we seen any other Celestials?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_9: Right now, they... I'm sorry. That is another thing I cannot speak of.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_10: Is Hsin the Moon Fox in the Sanctum? If you can't say, just nod or shake your head.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_11: ...Forgive me. The restrictions are woven into our thoughts. Any attempt to reveal classified information is blocked.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_12: But I can say this... I only made it to the Xuanyuan Domain because of the Sentinel's help.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_13: Those Swordlights were imitations of Qingxiao's Sword Intent. I created them from stray frequencies in the Domain. They can restore one's Resonance Energy.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_14: I could not carry them in my Autopuppet body, so I left them near where I made them... Did they help?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_15: They did. I even saw some of your memories.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_16: ...Huh? You didn't see anything embarrassing, I hope?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_17: I suppose it's because those frequencies are tied to the region's history... Or there's a chance I accidentally mixed in some of my own...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_18: I wish you both the best. Stay safe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_551_19: (Ask about Hsin the Moon Fox's whereabouts.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_552_1: Jingran, we'll fly up there on swords. What about you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_552_2: All good. I got my own way of keepin' up.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_552_3: The road ahead is bound to be perilous. Allow me to lead the way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_560_1: Careful, the Skyend Barrier in this level has spiraled into chaos.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_560_2: Tch. Muyu really set a storm in motion. Now even he can't steer his own disaster.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_560_3: No stopping... Let's get through this quickly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_1: There it is. The Sanctum's Shuttle. Muyu's little fortress.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_3: That barrier of warped machinery won't yield to a simple strike.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_4: Look. Two weak spots in the perimeter. We can force a breach there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_5: Hold on. I got a better idea—See that Shuttle over there?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_6: I'll ram it straight through the barrier. You two fly through before the crack closes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_8: That, over there, is worse than the Skyend's dangers. Even with a Shuttle as a shield, you'll be putting your life at risk.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_9: Safe paths don't lead to lost places. If there's an opening, I'm not letting it go to waste.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_11: Haha, ninety percent shot I get you two inside.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_12: No, I mean, what are the odds you come back alive?
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_13: Some things, you don't know 'til you try. Besides, we're running out of time. Those openings could disappear any second.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_14: Look, I've always known my wick was shorter than most. But how I burn it? That's my call, even if the gods themselves disagree.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_15: So go save Xuanfang, big hero. I'm not planning on checking out just yet.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_16: Once this is over, maybe you'll see me again at my Shifu's old lady's place in Xianling Village.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_18: We're saving our chat for another day.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_19: This wisp of Sword Intent may not work miracles. But with your resolve fueling it, it will not fail you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_21: I'll leave that corpse-fiddling creep to you, then!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_580_3: Hah... minor hiccup. Steering's busted on this clanker. Gotta find another way!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_580_4: We'll head to the other opening!
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_510_36: You run into Jingran again aboard a Cloud Shuttle and learn that Muyu, wounded by Jingran, fled under the cover of Autopuppets to the final level, the "Tian Realm." Jingran lays out his own motives, and the two of you strike a truce, agreeing to team up against Muyu. It seems Muyu is after mastery of Sentinel technology for some deeper, hidden purpose.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_512_14: The sword's frequency shows you what happened just before Yuan Fortress's self-destruction. When the Warden Commander of that era gathered everyone to head for the Fortress mainframe and carry out the self-destruct, Ruoyun insisted on joining them as well.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_529_6: You seem to have driven off the enemy Shuttles for now, but the fog around you refuses to clear. Just then, Qingxiao senses the massive Cloud Shuttle drawing near.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_532_9: The massive Cloud Shuttle proves to be the source of the Reeling Fog, and the fight will not truly end until it is dealt with. Reinforcement Autopuppets brought by Jadie ease the immediate pressure. You decide that Jingran and Jadie will hold the line here while you and Qingxiao go finish things aboard that Shuttle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_56: After beating back a fleet of Shuttles sent by Muyu, you regroup with Jadie. The Prism of Fate reveals the truth: the consciousness inside Jadie belongs to Ruoyun, the Court of Savantae Artisan from years ago. With the Sentinel's help, the Savantae crew who built Xuanfang Hold all transformed into Celestials, living in symbiosis with the very mechanisms they created. This Mirage Realm you stand in is actually the inner space of Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe—and may be connected to Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule. Ruoyun begs you to stop Muyu's scheme: if this continues, the collapse of the control mainframe will bring Xuanfang Hold down with it...
Main_Mengzhou_3_6_570_22: You break through the Skyend Barrier and arrive on a Cloud Shuttle in the Tian Realm. Muyu's Sanctum shuttle is shielded behind a barrier of corrupted mechanisms, making it impossible to approach. Seeing this, Jingran decides to ram a nearby Shuttle straight into a gap in the barrier, clearing a path for you and Qingxiao...
St_QSGZMNY_1_4: It's been a while, Valentina. How are things at the Black Shores?
St_QSGZMNY_1_5: We're doing fine. Everyone's doing their jobs at their own pace.
St_QSGZMNY_1_7: I'm Valentina, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores.
St_QSGZMNY_1_8: {PlayerName}, actually... I have a favor to ask of you.
St_QSGZMNY_1_9: Recently, the Black Shores is exploring the coordination of multiple Resonance Abilities on an individual agent.
St_QSGZMNY_1_10: So we've set up a new simulation domain, hoping to collect combat data in a more realistic environment.
St_QSGZMNY_1_13: Wielding multiple Resonance Abilities? Sounds a whole lot different than the previous combat drills we've done.
St_QSGZMNY_1_14: A new simulation domain? Sounds a whole lot different than the previous combat drills we've done.
St_QSGZMNY_1_15: Yes. In this simulation, the Tethys System will make available various Resonance Ability samples called Resonance Factors for the testers.
St_QSGZMNY_1_16: In other words, these Resonance Abilities will be converted into powers for the testers to use in the simulation. Testers are expected to mix and match to explore new combat styles.
St_QSGZMNY_1_17: For the same reason, we cannot yet determine whether the combat intensity is manageable for Black Shores members of all ranks. We must test different combinations of Resonance Abilities and evaluate their interactions, switching, and effects on combat strategy and tactics, as well as their impact on the combatants themselves.
St_QSGZMNY_1_18: So, we'd like to invite you as our first tester. You're the best candidate for this role.
St_QSGZMNY_1_21: Additionally, we've built in several support nodes to assist you in the operation.
St_QSGZMNY_1_22: Some Black Shores members and Shorekeeper will provide you with the necessary assistance via Tethys System.

Side_FSCHPOI_1_1: You've finally come. I've been waiting for you!
Side_FSCHPOI_1_2: There's a task only you can help me accomplish. You must come find me! Please!
Side_FSCHPOI_10_1: What are you doing all the way out here by yourself, Tuntun?
Side_FSCHPOI_10_2: You have the last fragment of the Feeling Capsule, don't you? Be a good boy and spit it out, okay?
Side_FSCHPOI_10_4: You... You want to keep it?
Side_FSCHPOI_10_6: Oh, Tuntun. I can't let you do that.
Side_FSCHPOI_10_7: I've been holding onto this gift for a while. And gifts, after all, are meant to be given away.
Side_FSCHPOI_10_8: Why don't we fix the Feeling Capsule together? Me, you, and {PlayerName}. Doesn't that sound better?
Side_FSCHPOI_101_1: Is this what's inside Tuntun's body?
Side_FSCHPOI_101_2: The Capsule's final missing piece should be around here somewhere. I need to find it fast.
Side_FSCHPOI_102_2: The frequencies are destabilizing! I'll open up a connection for you to the outside, but I'd come out soon if I were you!
Side_FSCHPOI_11_3: Hey, didn't you say you just wanted that Capsule piece back? So why did it disappear like that...?
Side_FSCHPOI_11_4: It... violated the Nexus's directive it was created with. So the Nexus erased it.
Side_FSCHPOI_11_5: Because it wanted to keep this for itself.
Side_FSCHPOI_11_6: And just like that, the Feeling Capsule and I are whole again.
Side_FSCHPOI_11_7: Aha! I knew it! I knew you smelled too much like that fox to be a coincidence!
Side_FSCHPOI_11_8: Well, this is my true form, after all. What do you think? Unique, huh?
Side_FSCHPOI_11_9: Fox ears and a fox tail...
Side_FSCHPOI_11_10: Plus a reaction from the Prism of Fate...
Side_FSCHPOI_11_11: Hehe, what's going through that head of yours?
Side_FSCHPOI_11_12: Look, the Capsule is back together now. But to fully restore it, someone needs to go inside and do the final repairs.
Side_FSCHPOI_11_13: And that, only you can do. When you're ready, place it on the Inner Threshold.
Side_FSCHPOI_11_14: Who knows, maybe you'll find the answer you're looking for in there.
Side_FSCHPOI_12_1: A Sentinel's Resonator... If choosing one will make the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs cease their nagging, then a Resonator they shall have.
Side_FSCHPOI_12_2: I suppose I can treat this trip as a chance to stretch my legs beyond Mengzhou's borders.
Side_FSCHPOI_12_3: (The Feeling Capsule... It contains Hsin's memories?)
Side_FSCHPOI_12_4: (So this is what it's like on the inside. Let's see where this goes.)
Side_FSCHPOI_13_1: You are... Lady Hsin! Ha! To think we'd be blessed with your presence in this humble village. This year is off to a fine start, I'd say!
Side_FSCHPOI_13_2: Thanks to your Magpie Tiller, our harvest is already up by twenty percent from last year. We don't know how to thank you!
Side_FSCHPOI_13_3: Hehe, it is my duty. But I take heart in seeing my efforts bring you ease, even if only a little.
Side_FSCHPOI_13_4: Not long ago, I used Fractal Proliferation to place hundreds of fox statues across Mengzhou. If someone with the aptitude to be my Resonator touches one, the statue will glow.
Side_FSCHPOI_13_5: I sensed a reaction from one of the statues nearby recently. Do you happen to know which child it was?
Side_FSCHPOI_13_6: Ah, the glowing statue at the village entrance! Hahaha, that explains why a messenger from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs came by and urged us to take good care of the girl who touched it.
Side_FSCHPOI_13_7: Fortunately, the Ministry allowed her to go about her days as usual. She should be up ahead, playing with the other children.
Side_FSCHPOI_13_8: She's a sharp one, quick-witted and charming. You'll recognize her the moment you see her.
Side_FSCHPOI_13_9: Very well... And what is the child's name?
Side_FSCHPOI_13_11: Hahaha... Heaven's light turns from the loom of destiny, tending instead to the gardens of the human heart.
Side_FSCHPOI_14_1: (Just as I thought. Xuanqing is Hsin's Resonator.)
Side_FSCHPOI_14_2: (But that must've been a long time ago... So why did she come looking for me in the Simulacrum Nexus?)
Side_FSCHPOI_14_3: (Hold on, but Hsin's Resonator should already be...)
Side_FSCHPOI_15_1: I could smell that rice fragrance from a mile away. It's coming from your shop, I presume?
Side_FSCHPOI_15_2: Oh! Lady Hsin! What an honor!
Side_FSCHPOI_15_3: Please, won't you try our specialty, Yueji Rice Cakes? They're fresh out of the steamer. We would be deeply honored!
Side_FSCHPOI_15_4: Hmm… Chewy, but not sticky. Soft, but not cloying. A sugary sweetness greets the palate, then the fragrant aroma of rice lingers. And that flourish of osmanthus syrup is the cherry on top.
Side_FSCHPOI_15_5: If you were to open up shop in Mengzhou, I fear I'd have to stop myself from visiting every single day.
Side_FSCHPOI_15_7: Such praise from the Sentinel Herself... From now on, these cakes are no longer Yueji Rice Cakes, but Moon Fox Rice Cakes!
Side_FSCHPOI_16_1:
This good and pious girl vows three days without meat, if only Yuecheng will try the chili rice cake! —Xuanqing
Then what was that Fish in Vinegar you came by for two nights ago? —Yuecheng
Side_FSCHPOI_17_1: This melody... Pure and lively. It carries the unclouded mood of the one playing it, doesn't it?
Side_FSCHPOI_17_2: Only a simple folk song, and yet it brings such joy.
Side_FSCHPOI_18_1: Excuse me, miss! Are you here to play with Sister Xuanqing too?
Side_FSCHPOI_18_3: Mm! She's the one playing that song. Pretty, right?
Side_FSCHPOI_18_4: I'm sure she'd want to meet someone as beautiful as you! I'll go get her!
Side_FSCHPOI_18_5: No need. I will go myself.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_1: Hello, there. I see you're back! How was your trip inside the Feeling Capsule?
Side_FSCHPOI_181_2: So, in Hsin's memories, It didn't say anything bad about me, did It? Or doodle anything weird on my face?
Side_FSCHPOI_181_3: It seemed to be looking forward to meeting you.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_5: Ugh, I'd love to go in and have a look myself! But after that little spat we had, It locked me out of the Feeling Capsule for good.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_6: Coming from the Sentinel of Mengzhou, that's so petty!
Side_FSCHPOI_181_8: In the memories, I saw Hsin searching for a Resonator. You and the Resonator have the same name.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_9: But I remember Hsin recalling that Her Resonator had already...
Side_FSCHPOI_181_11: Now, now. No asking such tough questions, okay?
Side_FSCHPOI_181_12: Let's talk about something more fun instead... So, if there's anything else you're curious about, I'd be happy to answer it now!
Side_FSCHPOI_181_15: What is the Feeling Capsule supposed to be?
Side_FSCHPOI_181_16: Why did you come to me?
Side_FSCHPOI_181_17: Why didn't you tell me who you really were?
Side_FSCHPOI_181_18: That's all I wanted to ask.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_19: Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of Mengzhou, was born with an abundance of emotion.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_20: And after "that incident," the Fractal Form "Hsin" was born from Its emotions.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_21: But a newborn consciousness can't handle too much feeling all at once. She needed time to learn. "Joy," "sorrow," "anger," "fear"... She sealed these emotions away, and as "Hsin" lived among mortals, She gradually received them.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_22: And the Feeling Capsule contains the last vestige of emotion, one that She can only obtain the moment She becomes a true Sentinel.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_23: The emotions sealed away by the Moon Fox take the form of a hundred little stories inside the Simulacrum Nexus, all for "Hsin" to slowly make sense of.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_24: But that one story, and only that one, glitched during its creation. It formed a messy, unstable region in the Nexus. And, you know, following the local naming rules, I called it the Heart of Ruin.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_25: The Feeling Capsule and the Heart of Ruin are linked by frequency. If the Heart of Ruin stays broken, the Capsule's contents remain incomplete as well.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_26: I could just hand it over to "Hsin" and let Her handle it Herself. But knowing everything She's been through… I want to give Her a complete gift.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_27: The problem is, I don't have the clearance to repair either the Feeling Capsule or the Heart of Ruin. Soooo, that leaves only one option: the all-powerful, authority-wielding Arbiter!
Side_FSCHPOI_181_28: Hehe, I didn't mean to hide it.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_29: I'd heard stories about the "Arbiter" from Hsin... Heh, if I were the "Sentinel's Resonator," the last thing I'd want is to offend the person who has authority over all the Sentinels and mess up the relationship between you two. That would be awkward, wouldn't it?
Side_FSCHPOI_181_30: Besides, I also wanted to see for myself what kind of person this Arbiter was who bosses around all the Sentinels.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_31: Anyway, there's one thing I'm actually jealous of!
Side_FSCHPOI_181_33: I've been here for a very, very long time. I couldn't talk, but I've been keeping an eye on "Hsin" the entire time. And then you showed up out of nowhere and became friends with Her just like that!
Side_FSCHPOI_181_34: So unfair. I want to be friends with the little fox too!
Side_FSCHPOI_181_36: So, for "Hsin's" sake, you're going to help me no matter what.
Side_FSCHPOI_181_37: Come on. Let's get this Heart of Ruin running again.
Side_FSCHPOI_192_1: So this is what it's like inside the Heart of Ruin.
Side_FSCHPOI_192_2: This is my first time too! It's incredible...
Side_FSCHPOI_2_1: What's that giant toaster oven doing here?!
Side_FSCHPOI_20_1: Look over there. Those three spots are where the frequencies are most chaotic. That's where we should start.
Side_FSCHPOI_201_1: Tuntun, you've been up to no good again, haven't you?
