Side_XZQTCHJ_1_1: Ren Water runs through the rivers, softening Metal Chi. Gui Water rises to the Heavenly Stems, surging out over the world.
Side_XZQTCHJ_1_2: But look at the way this mountain leans. Ren Water can't run clean, and the Metal Chi's all backed up...
Side_XZQTCHJ_10_1: That fox in Wuluo's memory... was that you?
Side_XZQTCHJ_10_2: I'm sorry, I... don't remember. I don't remember who I am. Or why I'm here, or how long it's been.
Side_XZQTCHJ_10_3: The only thing I know is... Wuluo. I must save her.
Side_XZQTCHJ_10_4: ...Maybe once we find all the memory fragments, I'll finally remember who I am, too.
Side_XZQTCHJ_11_1: I can feel it. Another memory fragment is here.
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_1: ...Things have been going my way lately. Ever since I met you, it's like luck just decided to sit down beside me.
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_2: My Forte hasn't improved a bit, but I still made it into the Xuanfang Wardens.
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_3: And you know what? The instructor actually praised me. Said I'd been working hard.
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_5: Hm? You think so too? Sometimes I really wonder how much of this you understand.
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_6: Hold on. What if you're the Sentinel's envoy? Or one of Her Fractal Forms? If I'm right, give me a nod, will you?
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_8: Haha, fine, fine. You're just an ordinary little fox, I know.
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_9: But the Lady Sentinel is watching over me. I'm sure of it. She saw how hard I worked, heard what I wished for, and gave me what I wanted most.
Side_XZQTCHJ_12_10: Which means I have to push harder. The person I am right now isn't worthy enough to bear Her expectations.
Side_XZQTCHJ_13_3: It feels... familiar? But strange, too. Like I'm watching myself from somewhere I've never stood.
Side_XZQTCHJ_13_4: Don't worry about me, kind stranger... It's probably nothing. All in my head.
Side_XZQTCHJ_16_3: ...Nothing. This should be the last fragment. Let's keep going.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_1: —Orders from the Ministry of War. All units are to assemble at once and deploy to the Central Plains to hold the line. No delays.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_2: This battle decides whether the people of the Fortress live or die. Our objective is simple: stop the Tacet Discord Outbreak at all costs.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_3: ...I can see the question in your eyes. And you're right. The order doesn't say how long we're to hold. It doesn't say whether reinforcements are coming, either.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_5: That's right! You're blessed by the Lady Sentinel. Follow you, and we don't lose!
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_7: All units, same as always. Pack your kits, write your letters home. Report to the drill ground in three hours.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_8: The Sentinel walks beside us. Now, dismissed!
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_11: So this was one of the units sent to the Fortress and Gorges War. They say not a single soldier who held the Central Plains ever came home.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_13: No. Her end... wasn't the fearless, glorious sacrifice you're picturing.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_14: She betrayed her faith out of weakness. And she paid for it.
Side_XZQTCHJ_17_16: I don't know that either. Perhaps the next time we find her, we'll have the truth.
Side_XZQTCHJ_19_2: Xuanfang Wardens? But now, they're nothing but hollow ghosts...
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_1: Ren Water runs through the rivers, softening Metal Chi. Gui Water rises to the Heavenly Stems, surging out over the world.  But look at the way this mountain leans—Ren Water can't run clean, and the Metal Chi's all backed up...
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_2: Mm. No matter how many times I read it, the answer comes out the same... It's an absolute dead end.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_5: Oh! Friend, are you headed up the mountain? Watch your footing. Something ill-omened lurks up there.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_7: That's right. Odd thing for me to say, I know... Here in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, we Court of Savantae Artisans usually handle maintenance and repair work.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_8: But this one's different... It's not a malfunction, and it shouldn't even exist here. I suspect Lady Hsin brought it back from the outside, a very long time ago.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_9: So what was that Hexagram Judgment about...?
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_10: My master once taught me Chinese Geomancy and Chi Observation Arts. At first, I figured Fengshui wouldn't apply inside the Simulacrum Nexus, and I felt sorry about letting all that teaching go to waste.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_11: Then a few years back, I discovered the terrain here mirrors the very contours of fate itself. See the clouds and mist hanging frozen over the peak? That's Metal Chi converging. And I'm afraid the cause is... <color=Highlight>warfare</color>.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_12: I asked Lady Hsin about it once. She told us not to go poking around. Said we'd fall prey to its baleful Chi. She said that when the time came, an outsider would arrive and set it right—
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_13: —Hold on. Friend, could you be the one?
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_15: I'm caught up in this too?
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_16: ...Haha. Maybe I'm overthinking it. But you're the only outsider I've seen in all these years.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_17: So if you're heading for the summit anyway, would you do me a favor and look into that ill-omened thing?
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_18: Lady Hsin did leave word on how to deal with it. And today might be exactly the right moment.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_19: Sure. I'll give it a shot.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_20: If it gets too dangerous, I'll quit.
Side_XZQTCHJ_2_22: Of course. Just be careful out there, my friend!
Side_XZQTCHJ_20_3: That's right... I have to prove it. I have to prove I'm worthy of Her favor.
Side_XZQTCHJ_21_2: Lady Sentinel... Have you not been watching over me? Save them. I'm begging you. Please help us...
Side_XZQTCHJ_21_3: Why can't I hear you? Please... answer me...
Side_XZQTCHJ_22_2: —I can't hear Her. Only the cold of the hilt, biting into my palm, laughing at how useless I am.
Side_XZQTCHJ_22_3: I was never chosen. Not once. Not ever.
Side_XZQTCHJ_22_4: It was a lie. A lie I spun myself. How ridiculous.
Side_XZQTCHJ_23_1: ...So that's what it was. She believed she was blessed, and that belief carried her to everything she achieved. It even let her dream of being a hero.
Side_XZQTCHJ_23_2: Until the truth caught up with her. And she saw with her own eyes that she was never more than a fragile, talentless, utterly ordinary... human.
Side_XZQTCHJ_24_2: I... What am I supposed to do? Lady Sentinel... She abandoned me.
Side_XZQTCHJ_24_3: —Watcher Wuluo! Pull yourself together! Only one thing matters now!
Side_XZQTCHJ_24_4: We cut through these damn things and break the siege! And if we can't... we make sure every last one of them pays for our fallen comrades!
Side_XZQTCHJ_24_6: Xuanfang Wardens, on me! Form up! Engage!
Side_XZQTCHJ_25_1: ...Come to think of it, if that was a scene from the Fortress and Gorges War, there shouldn't be a single Autopuppet on the field.
Side_XZQTCHJ_25_2: Autopuppets? You mean the mechanical constructs fighting alongside the Wardens?
Side_XZQTCHJ_25_3: That place isn't only Wuluo's Reverberation. Other soldiers' Reverberations are tangled up in it. But they're too faint to hold a consciousness of their own.
Side_XZQTCHJ_25_4: Scraps of memory, most likely. They're just hollow ghosts.
Side_XZQTCHJ_26_1: Watcher Wuluo, leave me! Just get the others outta here!
Side_XZQTCHJ_26_2: Look at you. What a pitiful sight. That useless fox threw you away. What do you have left to carry their hopes?
Side_XZQTCHJ_26_3: Surrender to the fear... and it all becomes easy.
Side_XZQTCHJ_26_4: Who... Whose voice was that...? Did any of you hear that?
Side_XZQTCHJ_27_2: Brave. And utterly pointless. Mortals are so weak... so ignorant. Not a single one of you grasps what war truly is.
Side_XZQTCHJ_27_3: —Shut up! Get out of my head!
Side_XZQTCHJ_28_1: Watcher Wuluo, I... I just want to go home...
Side_XZQTCHJ_28_2: They didn't have to end like this.
Side_XZQTCHJ_28_3: But your weakness, your folly, your insufferable pride in being "the chosen one"... you led them to their graves.
Side_XZQTCHJ_29_2: Who can say. A powerful Tacet Discord whispering to her. The Retroact Rain. Or nothing but her own despair. In other words... an inner demon.
Side_XZQTCHJ_29_4: I wasn't there to witness what happened in the end. But it's possible. She was always one to be easily swayed.
Side_XZQTCHJ_3_1: (So this is the place Youfang mentioned. The summit, home of this "ill-omened thing." )
Side_XZQTCHJ_30_1: Damn it all... Why do they just keep coming...
Side_XZQTCHJ_30_2: Am I... the only one left? Hah.
Side_XZQTCHJ_30_4: I've been lying to myself. Telling myself that I was the Sentinel's favored one.
Side_XZQTCHJ_30_5: Telling myself that one day... I'd be a hero.
Side_XZQTCHJ_30_6: But if you think this is where I break... where I get down on my knees and beg like a coward, then you're wrong.
Side_XZQTCHJ_30_7: The Sentinel has nothing to do with this. This—is my own choice!
Side_XZQTCHJ_31_2: That hand... It looked like Hsin's. But there was no Sentinel's frequency on it. No Threnodian's either.
Side_XZQTCHJ_31_3: ...You're right. It was never the Threnodian. There was no Threnodian here to begin with. That was her own inner demon, here to pass judgment on her.
Side_XZQTCHJ_31_5: ...But there's no time for this. I... No, Wuluo will stay trapped in here, running this nightmare of blood over and over for eternity.
Side_XZQTCHJ_31_6: We have to end it before the loop starts again. Follow me, and keep clear of those Homeward Fins.
Side_XZQTCHJ_32_1: It's fine... As long as I keep fighting, keep pushing forward... someday, I'll save them...
Side_XZQTCHJ_32_2: As long as I'm still holding a sword in my hand, there's still a way to...
Side_XZQTCHJ_32_4: The war ended a long, long time ago.
Side_XZQTCHJ_32_5: Is this another one of the Threnodian's tricks? You think wearing {Male=his;Female=her} face will make me—
Side_XZQTCHJ_32_7: ...You fought well, Wuluo. Or should I say, "I fought well."
Side_XZQTCHJ_32_8: It's time. Time for our duty... to be over.
Side_XZQTCHJ_32_9: Wake up, Wuluo. Remember what you made yourself forget.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_2: Thank you for pulling me free from my inner demon.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_4: Looks like that fox was actually a part of you.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_5: It's a long story. I was leading the Xuanfang Wardens, holding a defense line around the Central Plains.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_6: Tacet Discords poured into our position without end. Even the Threnodian's vanguard came for us, the one they call Thundering Mephis.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_7: My comrades died in front of me, one after another. I prayed to the Sentinel, but She never answered.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_8: I took on the Thundering Mephis myself. I was never anywhere close to its equal.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_9: It... no, the malice behind it was playing with me. A cat toying with a mouse. I could feel it looking down on me. It wanted me broken. Wanted me to yield, to beg for mercy...
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_10: You saw the rest, I imagine.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_12: You didn't give it what it wanted.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_13: Exactly. What came after that... I don't remember.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_14: Only the feeling of being torn apart and thrown back into that same battle, again and again...
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_15: Every time, I tried to save them. Every time, all I could do was stand there and watch them die.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_16: Somewhere in all those repetitions, my memories started slipping away, taking the dearest parts of me with them.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_18: The Homeward Fins in this pocket gathered up what was left and tried to rebuild it. They even assembled another "me"—shaped after the thing I loved most.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_19: That "me" knew almost nothing of her own past. And still, her instinct drove her to find a way to save me.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_20: ...For what it's worth, when the war broke out in the Central Plains, the Sentinel was evacuating the people of Yuan Fortress.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_21: Your sacrifice, and all the other soldiers'... She's carried the guilt ever since. She believes it was Her responsibility. That She failed to protect you.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_22: ...Is that true? So She... didn't mean to abandon us?
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_23: Thank you for telling me. Then, there's just one last thing I'd ask of you.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_24: You've probably noticed. What's left of my frequency is stretched as thin as it can go. I can barely hold this shape anymore.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_25: It won't be long before I turn into a Tacet Discord. Am I wrong?
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_27: I won't end that way. My comrades and I fought those things until there was nothing left of us. I refuse to become one of them now.
Side_XZQTCHJ_33_28: So please, destroy the Autopuppet kernel. My frequency is bound to it. When it goes, I go.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_1: Kind stranger, you've seen the whole of my story now.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_2: So what am I in your eyes? A failure? A butcher? A liar? A coward who let go of her faith at the very last moment? Or...
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_5: You held on to what it means to be human.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_6: —And I think if Hsin the Moon Fox ever heard this story, She'd be proud of you, truly.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_8: I've met others out there on the road. People who lost their way, who wept over how little strength they had, who couldn't save the lives they wanted to.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_9: One of them thought he was a hero, only to find out his fate had been written for him, start to finish.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_10: Another burned the last of his Reverberation just to become one single spark in a beacon.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_11: ...Whoever they were, when the moment came to choose, every one of them showed exactly the courage you did.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_12: You didn't become a Xuan Watcher or a hero because the Sentinel granted you great power.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_13: Whatever miracle happened out there, you were the one who made it.
Side_XZQTCHJ_34_15: Favored enough to hear these words... right at the end...
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_1: {PlayerName}! Are you alright?! I saw something strange happening up here from the foot. Couldn't stand the worry, so up I came.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_4: You tell Youfang everything that happened inside the Heart of Frost.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_5: ...I see. So it really does go back to the Fortress and Gorges War.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_6: That Xuan Watcher, Wuluo. The name rings a bell. After the war, Jinzhou sent out search-and-rescue teams, but her remains were never recovered.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_7: She was recorded missing. And everyone held on to that thin little hope that the heroes who fought the Threnodian to their last breath might still return home someday.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_8: There's one thing I still don't follow. How did her frequency end up inside the Simulacrum Nexus?
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_9: My guess? Lady Hsin recovered it from the battlefield Herself. And by your account, plenty of other Wardens' frequencies are kept here too.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_10: Wuluo's frequency and the others' got tangled together, and that interference bled into the Heart Realm. That's why things that never belonged to the Fortress and Gorges War showed up in it. The Autopuppets, for instance.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_11: It doesn't add up completely, I know, but perhaps... not every question comes with an answer.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_13: There's no point in dwelling on it.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_14: Yeah... Whatever you saw in the Heart of Frost, it was a Reverberation from the past. Its ending can't be rewritten.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_15: Just think of it as... a story.
Side_XZQTCHJ_35_16: She likely couldn't bear to let them scatter into nothing or turn into Tacet Discords. So She kept them here instead.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_1: I'm at the summit, Youfang. There's an Autopuppet wreck up here. It's probably the only thing around here worth a second look.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_2: An Autopuppet wreck...? Just like what Lady Hsin said. That must be the "ill-omened thing."
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_3: Did She say how to deal with it?
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_4: I'll take it apart right now.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_5: Let me think... She did mention a method...
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_6: Better not! Lady Hsin kept it here in the Simulacrum Nexus instead of just getting rid of it. She must have had Her reasons.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_7: The way She told it, there's an abnormal frequency still lingering in the Autopuppet kernel. That's the root of the anomalies.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_8: To settle it appropriately, find a port nearby and link it to the Heart of Frost. That'll let you analyze the frequency.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_9: Do it right, and an independent pocket will open up. Go deep inside, and you can find the source of all this and quiet that abnormal frequency for good.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_11: Going by the Judgment, most likely a mirror of the Fortress and Gorges War. The one fought at Yuan Fortress and Jin Pass ages back. Though as far as I know, that war happened before Autopuppets were ever built...
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_12: Then again, I could be wrong. My master only ever taught me a few tricks.
Side_XZQTCHJ_4_13: It's fine. We'll know once I'm inside.
Side_XZQTCHJ_5_1: (That didn't feel like striking anything solid... An illusion? Who was she?)
Side_XZQTCHJ_50_1: —Word is the general is blessed by the Divine Fox. Chosen by the Lady Sentinel Herself.
Side_XZQTCHJ_50_2: I heard she was nothing special to begin with, until the Lady Sentinel taught her some special martial secret...
Side_XZQTCHJ_51_1: Tacet Discords... They're everywhere! We can't hold like this! Watcher Wuluo, we have to break the siege—
Side_XZQTCHJ_52_1: The line is about to break... Cough... Damn this Retroact Rain... The only unit with any fight left is...
Side_XZQTCHJ_61_1: ...Careful. These Censure Cages move fast. One slip, and the abyss will take you.
Side_XZQTCHJ_61_2: Don't worry. I can lock them in Stasis for a moment. It'll be enough for me to open a way through.
Side_XZQTCHJ_61_3: Very well. Still... please proceed with caution.
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_1: (A fox statue? I feel a faint frequency clinging to it.)
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_2: (Hsin...? No, that isn't the Sentinel's aura. But it doesn't feel hostile, either.)
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_3: Were you the one calling out just now?
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_4: ...Yes. Please. Help me. Help me save her.
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_5: You mean that illusion who just attacked me?
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_7: Yes. Her name was Wuluo, a Xuan Watcher. Her lingering frequency is trapped in this place.
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_8: Wuluo, a Xuan Watcher... Her lingering frequency is trapped in this place.
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_9: What do you want me to do?
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_10: Before Wuluo completely lost herself, she sealed away her most precious memories of her own free will.
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_11: Gather the memories scattered here. Piece them back together, and she may yet find herself again and awaken from this nightmare.
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_12: Carry my frequency with you, kind stranger... This pocket is unstable. Take the form of a fox so the souls resting here are not disturbed.
Side_XZQTCHJ_7_13: This way. I'll show you the path.
Side_XZQTCHJ_8_2: The fragments we're after are buried deep in a tangle of other memories... Your Stasis ability should be able to sift them out.
Side_XZQTCHJ_9_2: Easy, don't be scared. I already chased off those nasty Tacet Discords!
Side_XZQTCHJ_9_3: Mm, let me have a look... No blood, no wounds... Looks like I got here in time.
Side_XZQTCHJ_9_5: Come on... You're a fox, and the Lady Sentinel is a fox too. How did the two of you turn out so different? If you were Lady Hsin, the Tacet Discords would've been the ones running.
Side_XZQTCHJ_9_6: Speaking of Her... I'll bet it was Her guidance that led me here in time to save you today.
Side_XZQTCHJ_9_8: Was She trying to tell me something? That even someone like me—weak Forte, no gift for martial arts—still has something only I can do?
Side_XZQTCHJ_9_11: Off you go, little one. And don't go getting yourself hunted by Tacet Discords again.
Side_ZZHNY_1_2: Who exactly would I be helping?
Side_ZZHNY_1_3: Who exactly would I be helping?

Side_ZZHNY_1_12: I'll see what I can do.
Side_ZZHNY_1_14: I'll see what I can do.

Side_ZZHNY_11_1: Mashan, what are you doing here? Aren't we... at the Waking Moon Festival?
Side_ZZHNY_11_2: Mm... where are the others from the Fellowship?
Side_ZZHNY_11_3: They... Never mind that for now. How are you feeling? Are you hurt?
Side_ZZHNY_11_4: No, nothing feels wrong. But it feels as if I slept for a very, very long time...
Side_ZZHNY_11_5: As long as you're safe, that's enough.
Side_ZZHNY_11_6: Ah...! Right, have I missed too many Moon-Reverence Dance practices?
Side_ZZHNY_11_7: What do I do, what do I do?! No, wait... by the look of it, the Festival has only just begun. There's still time!
Side_ZZHNY_11_8: Mashan, let's go practice, quick! If Lady Hsin comes down to us this year, I don't want to embarrass myself—!
Side_ZZHNY_11_9: We... can't spare the time for that just yet. Lingyuan and Lingtang have gone missing too. We have to find them first...

Side_ZZHNY_11_11: What?! I can't believe so much happened while I was dozing off... I'll follow your lead, Mashan!
Side_ZZHNY_11_12: Good. Oh, I was so caught up talking I forgot to introduce you... This is an honored guest from afar. It's thanks to {Male=his;Female=her} help that I found you.
Side_ZZHNY_11_14: {PlayerName}, so it was you who saved me! Thank you so much!
Side_ZZHNY_11_15: You nod politely, yet the girl before you keeps blinking, watching you with open curiosity.
Side_ZZHNY_11_16: {PlayerName}, {PlayerName}! From the look of your clothes, are you from beyond Mengzhou?
Side_ZZHNY_11_18: So you came for Lady Hsin too, didn't you?
Side_ZZHNY_11_19: I knew it! Mengzhou is full of tales about Her. Like "A Thousand Lanterns Lifting the Moon," "The Fox and the Moon," and the like!
Side_ZZHNY_11_20: Some even say She visits ordinary households to chase away people's loneliness. Oh, doesn't that sound wonderful!
Side_ZZHNY_11_21: Lingzhi, don't trouble our guest with such trifles.
Side_ZZHNY_11_24: Right, right?! I only joined the Dance Fellowship a few years back, but I've been practicing nonstop so I can meet Lady Hsin!
Side_ZZHNY_11_26: Lingzhi, what if we don't get to meet Hsin the Moon Fox this year?
Side_ZZHNY_11_27: Then that would be a terrible, terrible shame! But still, next year, who knows...
Side_ZZHNY_11_29: What...? I don't understand. But the Moon-Reverence Dance requires it, doesn't it?
Side_ZZHNY_11_31: You're being far too gloomy, Mashan. But never mind... When the time comes, all this dark brooding of yours will just melt away.
Side_ZZHNY_11_32: Oh, right, {PlayerName}! When we perform the dance, you simply must stand right up front! I'll make sure you get the very, very best blessing!
Side_ZZHNY_11_33: Hehe. And trust me, everyone wishes they could get a blessing from the Moon-Reverence Dance Fellowship!
Side_ZZHNY_11_35: ...Lingzhi, let's see to the matter at hand first.
Side_ZZHNY_11_36: Mashan brushes off Lingzhi's excitement. Where the Moon-Reverence Dance is concerned, he seems far less eager than his junior sister. You want to ask more, but Mashan has already moved on without a word.
Side_ZZHNY_11_37: As the last monster is struck down, the surroundings slowly brighten. The Lantern Carriage rises eerily and drifts off, swift as flight, into the distant gloom.

Side_ZZHNY_12_2: (Could the "monsters" on the Lantern Carriage all be village locals...?)

EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_1: Well, {PlayerName}? Have you tried out Cubie Wars yet?
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_3: It's got potential for more interesting gameplay...
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_4: Oh... Oh! Told ya so! My favorite part is where the Cubie Warriors raise their swords and use their cool skills. Like "bang"! And "pow"!
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_5: Yeah! I gotta share this with everyone at the Second Coming of Solaris!
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_6: Yeah... I guess there's still room for improvement... Add more interesting gameplay. How do we do that, I wonder...?
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_7: Well, the world of Wooly Kingdom will continue to grow, and so will there be more stories and adventures. You'll be in for a real treat!
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_8: But still, aside from these adventures, I want to explore the world on my own.
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_9: I've been doing a great job on all the homework Shorekeeper's been giving me lately, and even helped out Aalto with some tasks from KU-Roro.
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_10: So when do I get to go on an adventure with everyone? With you...?
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_12: Have time... Got it! Then I hope you're not busy all the time, {PlayerName}...
EVENT_TTYZDLD_2_13: Promise that we'll go on adventures, water flowers, and save the world together!
DTQCD_1_1: Whoa, that awful smell, just like last time!
DTQCD_1_2: What was it called... Anyway, a big carriage!
DTQCD_1_3: We should fix it fast, or the anomaly in the Heart of Flames will keep spreading. Let's find some Flamejaw Chi to help.
DTQCD_11_1: (Two waterfalls cascading side by side, mirroring each other. Somewhere in Mengzhou, there must be a picturesque view just like this.)
DTQCD_12_1: How did it break so badly...? This was Lady Hsin's favorite Lantern Carriage last year!
DTQCD_12_2: And of all days, today... If we can't get it to the Waking Moon Festival, She'll be so disappointed...
DTQCD_13_1: (Looks like She's fond of your Lantern Carriage this time as well.)
DTQCD_14_1: Oh no, the Realm Key I've got only handles Proliferation Anomalies, it won't do a thing against a Stasis Anomaly...
DTQCD_14_2: And now I'm stuck here... What do I do...
DTQCD_15_2: Oh! That voice—it's {PlayerName}, isn't it?! I'm stuck over here! Could you help me out?
DTQCD_15_3: Sure, don't worry. I'll handle these anomalies.
DTQCD_16_1: Thank you, {PlayerName}. I could hardly believe it when I heard you could wield multiple Keys at once. You're truly amazing.
DTQCD_16_2: Mastering the Keys is no easy feat, but you've mended countless anomalies with that power over the past century. You're the ones who are truly remarkable.
DTQCD_16_3: Haha, then I'd better prove myself worthy, or I'll never live up to praise like that!
DTQCD_2_1: Look at this goofy little guy. We'll just—whoa!
DTQCD_5_1: Whoa! So this is what they call "a sky full of lanterns"?
DTQCD_5_2: Yeah, it's gorgeous. The anomaly here's settled. Let's go.
DTQCD_6_1: (This Autopuppet shows traces of both Stasis and Reconstruction...)
DTQCD_8_1: (This sight... So the anomalies of the Heart of Flames and the Heart of Frost have fused together?)
DTQCD_8_2: (Below should be the Inner Threshold of the Heart of Frost, but why is it giving out the frequency of the Heart of Flames...?)
DTQCD_8_3: (The Key to the Inner Threshold should be there. I should retrieve it and step inside to take a look.)
DTQCD_9_1: (Unlike me, the Celestials don't have the access to the Prism of Fate. They can't wield several Realm Keys at once.)
DTQCD_9_2: (Those damaged Kernel Puppets... Guess they couldn't withstand this composite anomaly...)
Side_GMXQ_1_1: Sorry to bother you, Arbiter, but there's a favor I'd like to ask.
Side_GMXQ_1_2: Hsin the Moon Fox asks that we reach the Simulacrum Nexus and complete... a certain task. I'll brief you on the details in person when you have the time.
Side_GMXQ_1_5: Understood, Seal Master! Where should we meet?
Side_GMXQ_1_7: No problem. Where should we meet?
Side_GMXQ_1_9: Let us meet before the Manifold Sanctum. That way, we can head straight into the Simulacrum Nexus after our discussion.
Side_GMXQ_1_15: That title... I'm afraid I hardly deserve to be called that by you, Arbiter.
Side_GMXQ_10_1: Hsin. Suoming and I are at the Simulacrum Nexus.
Side_GMXQ_10_2: I suppose you have seen those phantoms by now, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_10_4: I understand if you want to keep this from Suoming, but at least tell me what you're planning.
Side_GMXQ_10_5: To put it simply, I'd like her to meet the Ten Seals again... but truth be told, I am unsure if this is the right thing to do.
Side_GMXQ_10_6: Perhaps this is nothing more than forcing her to experience the pains of her past. Or perhaps she has simply kept all that longing locked away inside her heart.
Side_GMXQ_10_7: So that's why you called me?
Side_GMXQ_10_8: So that's why you asked me to accompany her, just in case?
Side_GMXQ_10_9: Indeed, Arbiter. I worry that facing the phantoms of her fallen companions may be too much to bear, so I had her seek out items from her memories...
Side_GMXQ_10_10: The Simulacrum Nexus is now under my full control, so do not hesitate to inform me whenever you encounter anything unusual.
Side_GMXQ_10_12: And what are the pictures for?
Side_GMXQ_10_13: The task is indeed of great importance. Those from the Court of Savantae can extract vital data from images recorded in the Simulacrum Nexus.
Side_GMXQ_10_14: They often use this method to survey anomalous areas that are otherwise unreachable. So, I leave this matter in your capable hands, Arbiter.
Side_GMXQ_10_19: Please, Arbiter, see her through this journey.
Side_GMXQ_11_1: Arbiter, was that Hsin the Moon Fox just now?
Side_GMXQ_11_2: You can stay for a while if you want.
Side_GMXQ_11_3: You can spend time with them a little longer if you want. We're in no rush.
Side_GMXQ_11_4: No need to worry about me. Understanding what was on Her mind is more than enough.
Side_GMXQ_11_5: Our next stop is the <color=Highlight>Heart of Flames</color>. Shall we press on, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_11_7: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_11_8: Uh-huh. She was the one who projected the phantoms of the Ten Seals here, and got worried it might be too much for you...
Side_GMXQ_11_9: So she asked me to keep you company.
Side_GMXQ_11_10: I see... Have you finished taking the photo? Shall we move on, then?
Side_GMXQ_12_1: So, shall we head to the <color=Highlight>Heart of Flames</color>, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_12_3: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_13_1: Check out the view... This place is huge. What's it called again? Something something Heart Hall?
Side_GMXQ_13_2: I've never seen a house like this in Huating. We'd better ask the boss next time. She'll know for sure.
Side_GMXQ_14_1: Third, it's called the Heart Ring Pagoda.
Side_GMXQ_14_2: Sixth, before the Evil Miasma, Huating hardly saw any rain. Buildings like this are only found in the rainy regions of Mengzhou.
Side_GMXQ_15_1: So you said this is called the Heart Ring Pagoda?
Side_GMXQ_15_2: Yes. A rather unique design I'd often come across while on assignments in Mengzhou.
Side_GMXQ_15_3: The eaves are sloped to channel rainwater straight into the central courtyard well, and the name itself carries the meaning of bringing people's hearts together.
Side_GMXQ_15_4: Still, a structure this grand... brings to mind an old story from Huating.
Side_GMXQ_15_5: Care to share it with me?
Side_GMXQ_15_6: A small matter. Back then, there was no place in Huating more extravagant than the estate of that ruthless ruler.
Side_GMXQ_15_7: After I dealt with him, the townspeople celebrated in his mansion for days. Third got so swept up in the joy that he nearly drank himself into oblivion.
Side_GMXQ_15_8: In the end, I had to kick him into the courtyard well just to sober him up.
Side_GMXQ_15_10: The Evil Miasma had yet to be purged back then, but... brief as it was, it truly was a moment of pure joy.
Side_GMXQ_17_4: Always. But as I said before, this will more than suffice.
Side_GMXQ_17_5: Next is... <color=Highlight>Heart of Frost</color>, I suppose? Shall we proceed, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_17_7: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_18_1: So, shall we head to the <color=Highlight>Heart of Frost</color>, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_18_3: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_19_2: Oh, Seal Master, we swore to protect Huating from such fate, did we not?
Side_GMXQ_2_1: I've discussed it with the Ministry of Development. Their restoration work will continue as planned.
Side_GMXQ_2_2: Coordinate with the Xuanfang Wardens and ensure no one enters the Simulacrum Nexus other than myself and the Arbiter.
Side_GMXQ_20_1: Indeed, we did. We've successfully purged the Evil Miasma. Do you see it?
Side_GMXQ_20_2: Huating's mountains and rivers are clearer and more serene than they were ever before...
Side_GMXQ_21_1: The Seventh Seal was very forthright. As part of Huating's Ministry of War, even with a ruler as vile as sin, he couldn't bring himself to defy orders.
Side_GMXQ_21_2: No matter how much I tried to persuade him, he still refused to join me.
Side_GMXQ_21_3: It was until I brought him face-to-face with those suffering in the depths of the Evil Miasma.
Side_GMXQ_21_4: What does Huating look like now?
Side_GMXQ_21_5: It's a small town cradled by mountains, with clear streams winding through it and four distinct seasons.
Side_GMXQ_21_6: Whenever it snows like the one before us... it's breathtaking.
Side_GMXQ_21_7: Hm... I suppose that will be all for now.
Side_GMXQ_22_1: You taught me the spear, and I've never let this skill dull...
Side_GMXQ_23_1: Arbiter, shall we proceed to the <color=Highlight>Heart of Bloom</color>?
Side_GMXQ_23_3: I appreciate your concern, but worry not. In fact, it brings me a sense of peace.
Side_GMXQ_23_4: Later I'll convey my gratitude to the Sentinel in person. For now, we press forward.
Side_GMXQ_23_6: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_24_1: So, shall we head to the <color=Highlight>Heart of Bloom</color>, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_24_3: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_25_1: Ripples across a pool of emerald green, reflecting... clear skies and distant clouds.
Side_GMXQ_26_1: The life of a poet suits you far better. If only I had simply freed you from that mansion...
Side_GMXQ_26_2: ...And never asked you to become the Fourth Seal.
Side_GMXQ_27_1: I remember Suhsin dropped you off right around here back when it snatched you up.
Side_GMXQ_27_2: Mm. It was thanks to the Fourth Seal's Resonance Ability that I was able to break free.
Side_GMXQ_27_3: Regardless of what happened back then, the Heart of Bloom offers a serene view today.
Side_GMXQ_27_4: The Fourth Seal was once a highborn lady confined to her family's estate, with lotus ponds and gardens much like the ones before you now.
Side_GMXQ_27_5: Since then... so much has come to pass. I helped her escape the walls that bound her, and she chose to join my cause.
Side_GMXQ_28_1: You see? I can comb my hair just as well as you did for me.
Side_GMXQ_29_1: That leaves the <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color> and <color=Highlight>Mengxuan Vale</color>. Arbiter, where shall we head first?
Side_GMXQ_29_2: The <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color>, then. That Yijun we're looking for should be at Mengxuan Vale. Making that our last stop will keep us right on track.
Side_GMXQ_29_3: The <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color> is a bit different from the realms we've visited so far. Have you had a chance to learn anything about it, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_29_4: I've only seen it from a distance. I recall seeing the wreckage of fallen Cloud Shuttles there.
Side_GMXQ_29_5: Cloud Shuttles are not creations of Mengzhou. I wonder why Hsin brought them here. It might be worth looking into.
Side_GMXQ_29_6: But our priority for now is completing the task Hsin entrusted to you.
Side_GMXQ_29_7: Very well. Shall we head to the <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color>?
Side_GMXQ_29_9: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_3_1: Are they the siblings you talked about? The ones in charge of the Sanctum's restoration?
Side_GMXQ_3_2: Indeed they are. Now that the entrance to the Simulacrum Nexus has been revealed, we must exercise the utmost caution.
Side_GMXQ_3_3: Got it. So, about that task you mentioned in your message...
Side_GMXQ_3_4: Right... The Sentinel wants us to take photographs of several areas within the Simulacrum Nexus and bring them to a Celestial named Yijun.
Side_GMXQ_3_6: Sounds like Hsin is planning something.
Side_GMXQ_3_7: I did ask why She chose us specifically. Surely the Celestials would be a better fit.
Side_GMXQ_3_8: She said we'd figure it out once we got there. That's Her way of telling me not to press the matter.
Side_GMXQ_3_9: Something tells me this isn't the first time.
Side_GMXQ_3_10: Sigh, whether it's Hsin or the late Sentinel, they both have the habit of coming to me with these strange requests on a whim...
Side_GMXQ_3_11: Besides, I'd like to see the state of the Simulacrum Nexus now that Suhsin is no more. We can start with the <color=Highlight>Heartscape Labyrinth</color> at the entrance.
Side_GMXQ_3_14: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_3_15: Perhaps the rogue Autopuppets Suhsin left behind are beyond what the Celestials can handle.
Side_GMXQ_3_17: You didn't ask Her for more details?
Side_GMXQ_3_18: Yet all of them turned out to be fruitful in the end, so I suppose She has Her reasons...
Side_GMXQ_30_1: That leaves the <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color> and <color=Highlight>Mengxuan Vale</color>. Arbiter, where shall we head first?
Side_GMXQ_30_2: The <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color>, then. That Yijun we're looking for should be at Mengxuan Vale. Making that our last stop will keep us right on track.
Side_GMXQ_30_3: The <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color> is a bit different from the realms we've visited so far. Have you had a chance to learn anything about it, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_30_4: Mm, there are wreckages of fallen Cloud Shuttles there. Also... I met Xuanqing there. I suppose you know her?
Side_GMXQ_30_5: I do. The sorrow on the Sentinel's face whenever She mentioned her name is hard to forget.
Side_GMXQ_30_6: More about that later. Shall we proceed?
Side_GMXQ_30_8: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_31_1: So, shall we head to the <color=Highlight>Heart of Ruin</color>, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_31_3: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_32_1: These mechanisms... I can't make head or tail of any of them.
Side_GMXQ_32_2: They're clearly beyond our understanding of the mechanist arts. It's normal to be confused.
Side_GMXQ_33_1: Despite the age gap between you, the two of you are awfully close to each other.
Side_GMXQ_34_1: Arbiter, those Cloud Shuttles you mentioned are weaving through the mountains as we speak. What a spectacle to behold.
Side_GMXQ_34_2: It really is... Aren't you going to introduce those two to me, Suoming?
Side_GMXQ_34_3: If that's your wish, Arbiter. I'm always happy to share their stories.
Side_GMXQ_34_4: When I first met the Second Seal, his hair was already silver.
Side_GMXQ_34_5: His mastery over the mechanist arts was unrivaled. Both the Vermillion Locks and the Nine Shadows in my hand are his masterpieces.
Side_GMXQ_34_6: The Eighth Seal was the youngest of us all, yet easily the sharpest mind in our ranks. It was she who drew up the battle plan for our final stand against the Evil Miasma.
Side_GMXQ_34_8: Hehe, exactly. Out of everyone, those two were the least I ever had to worry about.
Side_GMXQ_35_1: Since I've already met you all, then that leaves only...
Side_GMXQ_36_1: Well, since we've visited all the other Heart Realms, our final stop is <color=Highlight>Mengxuan Vale</color>.
Side_GMXQ_36_2: We've met eight Seals so far, which means the last one...
Side_GMXQ_36_3: Yes, it should be her. Let us proceed.
Side_GMXQ_36_5: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_37_1: So, shall we head to the <color=Highlight>Mengxuan Vale</color>, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_37_3: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_39_2: Where is the Ninth Seal? Hsin knew how much you cherished her. Surely nothing could have been overlooked.
Side_GMXQ_39_3: It could be Suhsin's doing. It created a duplicate of the Ninth, one indistinguishable from her true self. Perhaps ever since then, she just...
Side_GMXQ_39_7: Forgive me. I should have kept my composure. They all passed away so long ago. It's only natural that they are not here.
Side_GMXQ_39_8: I appreciate your gesture, Arbiter, but that won't be necessary. The experience this journey with you has brought is enough to ease my heart.
Side_GMXQ_39_9: I suppose... this is where it ends.
Side_GMXQ_4_1: Let me know if you are ready, Arbiter.
Side_GMXQ_40_1: Ninth... Is it because you haven't forgiven me?
Side_GMXQ_41_1: I have the picture. So... you sure you don't want me to ask Hsin?
Side_GMXQ_41_2: After everything we've seen along this journey, I don't think I could maintain my composure if I met Ninth here...
Side_GMXQ_41_3: I trapped them all within these locks out of sheer selfishness. I even burdened Hsin to create these phantoms, all to satisfy my own longing.
Side_GMXQ_41_4: This has been enough. I should leave—
Side_GMXQ_41_5: If only Sister Suoming and the others were here with me.
Side_GMXQ_41_6: We never got to celebrate the Waking Moon Festival together. I really want to buy a Moon Fox Rice Cake and balance it right on Sister Suoming's head! Hehehe...
Side_GMXQ_41_8: Arbiter, Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs is finally free from blights such as Balanophora.
Side_GMXQ_41_10: The younger generation... People like Tangning and Jiqing are more than capable of carrying out their duties from now on.
Side_GMXQ_41_11: And Hsin the Moon Fox has returned to Mengzhou, Her heart unburdened, and Her powers restored.
Side_GMXQ_41_12: Does that mean... even without me, the future of the Ministry, and of Mengzhou, will remain a bright one?
Side_GMXQ_41_13: Do you wish to stay, Suoming?
Side_GMXQ_41_16: I do. I want to stay here with those dearest to me.
Side_GMXQ_41_17: If the Moon Fox could spare just a little more of Her computational power, She could make it appear even more realistic, couldn't She?
Side_GMXQ_41_18: Indeed. Even though a wondrous dream lies perfectly within my reach...
Side_GMXQ_41_19: I know the weight of my responsibility. I know they laid down their lives for the real Huating—the home we left behind.
Side_GMXQ_41_20: We made a promise. The path of righteousness we vowed to walk from Huating still stretches ahead, and I cannot stop halfway.
Side_GMXQ_41_23: Still, you have every reason to rest here a while. I believe Hsin wishes the same for you, knowing you won't lose yourself to the phantoms.
Side_GMXQ_41_24: I am honored by your trust, Arbiter. Well, in that case... I want to have a chat with Ninth.
Side_GMXQ_41_25: Could you please deliver these photographs to Yijun for me?
Side_GMXQ_41_26: Of course. Do what you have to do.
Side_GMXQ_41_27: Arbiter... am I making the right choice?
Side_GMXQ_41_28: I think you already know the answer.
Side_GMXQ_42_1: I have something to tell you, Ninth.
Side_GMXQ_43_1: Ninth, I met the First Seal earlier. She indulged my willful nature more than anyone, shaping me into the Seal Master you all knew.
Side_GMXQ_43_2: The Second Seal was there, too. You know the guilt I carry for him... After losing his children, he wanted no part in any worldly affairs, yet I dragged him back to the battlefield.
Side_GMXQ_43_3: The Third Seal is as silly as ever, but the moment his blade is drawn, his spirit blazes bright.
Side_GMXQ_43_4: The Fourth Seal wrote poetry again after so long. Remember how she used to comb my hair while reciting her verses?
Side_GMXQ_43_5: Then there's the Fifth Seal... I was too impatient back then and pushed her too hard. She told me not to dwell on it, but how could I not?
Side_GMXQ_43_6: I met with the Sixth Seal, as well. She was always far more eloquent than I was. Without her, we never would have gained support from Huating's people.
Side_GMXQ_43_7: The Seventh Seal still wears that same worried look. None of us loved Huating more than he did.
Side_GMXQ_43_8: As for the Eighth Seal... standing before her felt like looking in a mirror. We both grew up too soon, having seen far too much tragedy.
Side_GMXQ_43_10: I just wanted to see all of you again, and I truly wished I could stay here with you...
Side_GMXQ_43_11: How come the others aren't here with you, Sister Suoming?
Side_GMXQ_43_13: Ah well, at least the Waking Moon Festival hasn't started yet! Guess everyone will be here soon.
Side_GMXQ_43_15: Yes, we will meet again soon.
Side_GMXQ_44_1: Hm... Why didn't Lady Hsin tell me who's delivering the photos...
Side_GMXQ_45_1: You must be Yijun? I'm here with the photos from the Simulacrum Nexus.
Side_GMXQ_45_4: I was planning to photograph every realm in the Simulacrum Nexus now that Suhsin the Inevitable is gone.
Side_GMXQ_45_5: But somehow, Lady Hsin caught wind of my plan and told me to stay put. She promised someone would take care of it for me.
Side_GMXQ_45_6: I-I'm so sorry to trouble you with this! It must have been such a hassle running all across the realm... Thank you so much!
Side_GMXQ_45_7: Don't mention it. I found the journey quite rewarding myself.
Side_GMXQ_46_1: The task's done, Hsin. I believe Suoming is pretty satisfied.
Side_GMXQ_46_2: I received her message earlier, and it's rare to hear such gentleness in her tone.
Side_GMXQ_46_4: Thank you for doing this for her.
Side_GMXQ_46_5: She is from Mengzhou, so it's only natural that I look after her.
Side_GMXQ_46_6: Besides, she stood by the Sentinel during Its final moments and helped me reclaim my power.
Side_GMXQ_46_7: If what I've done can repay even a fraction of her efforts, it would bring my mind at ease.
Side_GMXQ_46_8: Allow me to extend my gratitude to you as well, Arbiter. Thank you.
Side_GMXQ_47_1: This fog... She knew we would be here, so there should be a way to clear it.
Side_GMXQ_47_3: Old relics whisper memories past. Seek them, and the fog shall part.
Side_GMXQ_47_4: Hm? That hum... It's the same one we heard when we first entered the Simulacrum Nexus, remember?
Side_GMXQ_47_5: I do, but—Never mind. It's best not to guess what She has in mind.
Side_GMXQ_47_6: Let's try following the statue's guidance first.
Side_GMXQ_48_1: The Fifth Seal collected traumatized tissue from victims to study the corrosive effects of the Evil Miasma on the human face. Based on their findings, they designed a protective mask against the Blight Rain. The Second Seal crafted the prototype, and the Fourth Seal replicated it. Ten identical masks, each flawless in function. With them, the Ten Seals gained the ability to walk into the Miasmic Rain and fight the Evil Miasma.
Side_GMXQ_49_1:
1. The mechanical parts requested by the Second and Eighth Seals have arrived. Don't forget to collect them.
2. The Third and Seventh Seals have gone to patrol the outskirts of the city. If they don't return within six hours, report to the Seal Master.
3. The Fourth Seal has been overusing her Forte for days and needs rest. (Send Sister Suoming to keep her company, that'll lift her spirits in no time!)
4. The Fifth and Sixth Seals have gone to the clinic together to tend to the patients.
Side_GMXQ_5_1: So, shall we head to the <color=Highlight>Heartscape Labyrinth</color>, Arbiter?
Side_GMXQ_5_3: I need some time to prepare.
Side_GMXQ_50_2: Wait, there are anomalies ahead. I've dealt with this before. Leave them to me.
Side_GMXQ_52_1: I don't know what hole you fiends crawled out of, but don't you dare set foot in Huating!
Side_GMXQ_54_1: I'll take this Orb Hairpin of yours. No need for gold, jade, or fine brocade.
Side_GMXQ_54_2: Why? Hehe, because it suits your hair best, Seal Master.
Side_GMXQ_55_1: These mechanisms... I can't make head or tail of any of them.
Side_GMXQ_55_2: They're clearly beyond our understanding of the mechanist arts. It's normal to be confused.
Side_GMXQ_55_3: Indeed. Both the design and the scale are simply unfathomable for human minds...
Side_GMXQ_55_4: Could they have been crafted by the Sentinel?
Side_GMXQ_55_5: Most likely. I'd love to study these intricacies myself, but if they truly are the Sentinel's creations, I doubt we'll be allowed anywhere near them.
Side_GMXQ_55_6: Why don't you ask the Seal Master?
Side_GMXQ_55_7: Haha, good point. Maybe she has a way to get us access.
Side_GMXQ_56_1: (There's no way Hsin forgot the Ninth Seal. I should ask the Celestials here.)
Side_GMXQ_58_2: You know her? Have you seen the phantom of a girl with her hair in double buns nearby? She's a close friend of Suoming's.
Side_GMXQ_58_3: Ah, I think I know who you mean. Intendant Suoming once rescued me back in the Heart of Bloom.
Side_GMXQ_58_4: I was piloting an Artisan Autopuppet when I met the Intendant and that girl.
Side_GMXQ_58_5: But... sorry, I haven't seen her around here. It's just that Lady Hsin recently left the Simulacrum Nexus. That's never happened before.
Side_GMXQ_58_6: Perhaps that disturbance is making the phantom Intendant Suoming is looking for unstable. She'll probably appear in a little while.
Side_GMXQ_58_8: (Hmm... I should take photos of Mengxuan Vale first. If the Ninth Seal still hasn't appeared by then, I'll ask Hsin.)
Side_GMXQ_59_1: There are so many more phantoms around here than there used to be.

SIDE_KHDJ_4_2: Ugh, my big fish's gone again!
SIDE_KHDJ_4_3: But this lake doesn't look like it has any fish in it.
SIDE_KHDJ_4_5: Course I know! I only dragged my line all the way over here to keep hold of that fish...
SIDE_KHDJ_4_6: Of course you don't see any, young one. You were too slow... The fish already slipped away!
SIDE_KHDJ_4_8: You don't believe me? It's right over there...
SIDE_KHDJ_4_9: Out that way—a little farther on. That lake's a big one. When the wind picks up, the waves crash like the sea... A light boat can't even hold its ground!
SIDE_KHDJ_4_10: Pry the scales off the biggest fish and you could roof a house with it. Without real muscle, it'll just drag you straight into the water...
SIDE_KHDJ_4_13: When I was young, I hooked a fish just like that... Pity I was still wet behind the ears. In the end, the big fish got away...
SIDE_KHDJ_4_15: ...I'm off my game. Had a nightmare last night. Tossed and turned, barely slept a wink...
SIDE_KHDJ_4_16: Pity I missed my chance this time. Who knows when I'll ever hook it again...
SIDE_KHDJ_4_18: Ugh, no proof, no witness. Old Li'll just deny it like always... Call me a braggart, say there's no fish that big anywhere in the world...
SIDE_KHDJ_4_19: Do you believe me, young one?
SIDE_KHDJ_4_21: Heh, you're just as stubborn as Old Li! Just wait till I catch it... you'll both be sorry!
SIDE_KHDJ_4_24: Ah, but then again... I could tell right off, young one, you've got a good heart and a true hero's spirit. Cut from the same cloth as I was back in the day!
SIDE_KHDJ_4_25: (Before diving into it, I should check in with Zhiyuan again.)
SIDE_KHDJ_4_26: You trace the voice to its source and find an old man fishing. As you approach, you notice his line is coming up empty.

SIDE_KHDJ_5_7: I see. That's very likely where the "anomaly" lies.

SIDE_KHDJ_6_3: I'm picking up a really chaotic anomalous frequency...

SIDE_KHDJ_7_5: Then... I'll give it a try!

SIDE_KHDJ_8_4: (I didn't cross any boundary, so why am I back here...)
SIDE_KHDJ_9_1: Hey, hey, hey, easy there, friend.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_3: Quit mumbling. Yes, I'm talking to you, friend.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_4: Bet you didn't know. There's a giant fish hiding in this lake... Make too much noise and it won't bite.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_7: Phew... Good thing you're not the unreasonable type, or I'd be heading home empty-handed again today.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_8: Well, well, I didn't expect to meet someone so well-informed. Every time I bring this up, not one of them ever listens. Those ignorant fools!
SIDE_KHDJ_9_9: Since we just clicked, call me Yunshou.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_11: Rover... That's an interesting title. If I were a few years younger, I'd have picked myself a fine title like that too, something like "the Angler." Hahaha!
SIDE_KHDJ_9_13: Haha, don't let my empty creel fool you. I'm a master angler. I just can't be bothered with ordinary little fish!
SIDE_KHDJ_9_14: I haven't caught that legendary big fish yet, but sooner or later I'll prove it's real. And until then... I've no plans to leave here.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_15: Even if you grow old here?
SIDE_KHDJ_9_16: Even if you become Old Wu?
SIDE_KHDJ_9_17: Hahaha, then I'd better hope that fish lives a good long while.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_18: Hahaha, you're a funny one... If we'd met somewhere else, I'd have poured you a few rounds!
SIDE_KHDJ_9_19: As the saying goes, in a whole lifetime, how many things can a man find that are truly worth devoting his life to?
SIDE_KHDJ_9_20: If a man can stay true to one thing into old age, that's no bad way to spend a life.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_23: Ugh, Rover, you really don't let things go, do you?
SIDE_KHDJ_9_24: Fine, fine. I guess nothing escapes you. I'll spare you the grand speeches. Truth is, I have to prove the big fish exists to a stubborn blockhead.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_25: Is he a friend of yours?
SIDE_KHDJ_9_26: You could say that. But there's a wager between us. Win it, and only then can we be true friends!
SIDE_KHDJ_9_27: If I can't find proof, I'll be laughed at by that fellow for the rest of my life.
SIDE_KHDJ_9_28: Wang is the most stubborn person I've ever met in my life!
SIDE_KHDJ_9_29: All right, now... I'd best get back to work...
SIDE_KHDJ_9_30: I won't have Wang nagging me even after I'm gone, calling me a "big talker" spouting "nonsense"...
Guide_XYYH_1_1: {PlayerName}, there is a favor I must ask of you.
Guide_XYYH_1_2: If time allows, might you come to this place and quell the anomaly?
Guide_XYYH_1_3: I wonder whether, somewhere nearby, you have glimpsed that giant, looming shadow...
Guide_XYYH_1_4: ...No, it is nothing. I will wait here. We can speak of it in full once you arrive.
Guide_XYYH_3_2: Just now, I watched you deal with those troublesome Proliferation Anomalies. You have my thanks for the help.
Guide_XYYH_3_4: You're from the Court of Savantae.
Guide_XYYH_3_5: Exactly. The name is Zhufeng. It seems that you've already crossed paths with a few of my colleagues.
Guide_XYYH_3_6: Just as I thought, you have indeed come for that giant shadow.
Guide_XYYH_3_7: Have you met Mingxiao yet, by any chance? She is an Artisan too, and an... old acquaintance of mine.
Guide_XYYH_3_8: It was her idea that I station myself here and look into the shadow. I've rather lost count of the days since I arrived.
Guide_XYYH_3_11: So what exactly is that giant shadow?
Guide_XYYH_3_12: That shadow is no ordinary construct. It's one of Lady Hsin's manifestations. Ordinarily, it shoulders a share of Her administrative burdens in Her stead.
Guide_XYYH_3_13: Then surely she's told you how the Nexus Fox Shadow is bound to Lady Hsin. I won't bore you by going over old ground.
Guide_XYYH_3_14: But it's no longer under the Sentinel's control.
Guide_XYYH_3_15: Precisely. And knowing that much only makes the rest more baffling.
Guide_XYYH_3_16: At first I assumed a manifestation under Suhsin the Inevitable's control would move by nothing but established logic.
Guide_XYYH_3_17: The longer I watch it, though, the less I believe that. Every movement it makes still carries a sensibility that belongs to Lady Hsin alone.
Guide_XYYH_3_18: So I began taking note of everything that could draw a reaction out of it.
Guide_XYYH_3_19: Later, we made a discovery: quell the anomalies and clear the aberrations within the Heart Realms of the Simulacrum Nexus, and, with some fortune, you may come by a token shaped like a blooming Gilded Ball—just as you did a moment ago.
Guide_XYYH_3_20: Yes, I already have one of these tokens.
Guide_XYYH_3_21: We call it the "Thousandfold Petals." I too was fortunate enough to come by one, and I tried offering it to the giant shadow through the Heart Calmer Altar over there. What followed were two wonders I'll never forget.
Guide_XYYH_3_22: First, the scenery here changed. Shifted, much like that ever-changing Manifold Sanctum.
Guide_XYYH_3_23: Unless I'm mistaken, this place is a Heart Realm too. The way the scenery here keeps getting richer almost certainly traces back to Lady Hsin's authority.
Guide_XYYH_3_24: Second, the shadow gave a rather... intriguing response to the Thousandfold Petals. Hard to put into words. As though it lowered its guard, and became... easier to approach.
Guide_XYYH_3_25: What made you feel that way?
Guide_XYYH_3_27: This likely touches on Lady Hsin's true intent. And until I've seen the whole of it, I'd rather not rush to a conclusion.
Guide_XYYH_3_28: {PlayerName}, why not try offering the Thousandfold Petals at the Heart Calmer Altar? That way, you will better grasp the shift I described.
Guide_XYYH_3_29: Sure. I'll give it a try.
Guide_XYYH_4_1: It seems the giant shadow has accepted your token.
Guide_XYYH_4_2: I didn't expect it to reach out a hand, though.
Guide_XYYH_4_3: It caught me off guard as well, the first time I offered a token. By the way, did you notice any change in the giant shadow?
Guide_XYYH_4_4: There were indeed a few changes.
Guide_XYYH_4_5: If you come across more Thousandfold Petals in the future, do bring them here.
Guide_XYYH_4_8: By the way, you've come to the Simulacrum Nexus as an Arbiter. You have business of your own, don't you?
Guide_XYYH_4_9: Go see to it. I'll keep digging in the meantime. Come see me once you're finished your work. By then, I may have untangled a knot or two.
Guide_XYYH_4_10: You can tell this Artisan has no intention of saying more. Just as you're about to press him, he turns the conversation elsewhere.
Guide_XYYH_4_11: While you're clearing anomalies in the Heart Realms, keep an eye out for Shadow Binders. They are mechanisms of a sort, scattered here and there.
Guide_XYYH_4_12: We once used them to halt the giant shadow's movements, even control it, on occasion. These days, though, I suspect only you—the bearer of a Prism of Fate—can get one running.
Guide_XYYH_4_13: And if my suspicion holds, a working Shadow Binder will guide the giant shadow along, and prove no small help to you.
Guide_XYYH_4_14:
Zhufeng turns his eyes toward the giant shadow. His gaze lingers there a moment, and a smile crosses his face, knowing and faintly helpless. 
Then he flicks his sleeve, lowers his head, and says nothing more.
Guide_XYYH_5_1: Word has reached me that Lady Hsin has reclaimed the authority belonging to the Nexus Fox Shadow.
Guide_XYYH_5_2: And it's already at work, assisting the Ministry of Development Artisans stationed in the Simulacrum Nexus to address the chaos here.
Guide_XYYH_5_3: So that was it. With its authority restored, the Nexus Fox Shadow should return to what it was meant to be. A lot of things that used to puzzle me finally make sense.
Guide_XYYH_5_4: If you can spare the time, stop by for a chat. This time, I believe I can answer the questions you left with me.
Guide_XYYH_6_1: I see... It all makes sense now.
Guide_XYYH_6_3: So you've solved the mysteries from before?
Guide_XYYH_6_4: I'd say I have my answers, yes.
Guide_XYYH_6_5: Mingxiao brought back word of Lady Hsin, and it lines up neatly with everything I've pieced together these past days.
Guide_XYYH_6_6: The Nexus Fox Shadow has broken free of Suhsin the Inevitable's shackles at last. Seen in that light, every change I recorded was simply its gradual restoration.
Guide_XYYH_6_7: Mingxiao, several other Artisans, and I went over it again and again. In the end, we named this Heart Realm the "Heart of Appearance." The inspiration came from the saying, "One's appearance reflects one's character."
Guide_XYYH_6_8: And the mystery of the shifting scenery?
Guide_XYYH_6_9: At first I was convinced it was the Thousandfold Petals that changed the scenery here.
Guide_XYYH_6_10: Later, it dawned on me. What truly changed was never the scenery. It was the Nexus Fox Shadow itself.
Guide_XYYH_6_12: The Thousandfold Petals holds one of Lady Hsin's most treasured memories—the countless moments in which She received gifts from Her followers.
Guide_XYYH_6_13: Offering it up makes the Nexus Fox Shadow's emotions whole again, and returns it to a quiet, clear state of mind. And the Heart of Appearance recovers its true form right along with it.
Guide_XYYH_6_14: So it steadies its emotions, right?
Guide_XYYH_6_15: Hehe, you could put it that way. The more its emotions come into balance, the more abundant the Heart of Appearance grows.
Guide_XYYH_6_16: After all, "emotion" has always been two sides of one coin. Take that Heart Realm burning red like raging flames: "wrath" scorched it barren, and now "passion" has brought it roaring back to life.
Guide_XYYH_6_17: I thought I was studying the Nexus Fox Shadow, or Lady Hsin's authority. Now I see what actually deserves study... is the "heart," in the literal sense.
Guide_XYYH_6_18: An interesting way to look at it.
Guide_XYYH_6_19: Should you come across any Thousandfold Petals, do bring them back here. It will do good for the Heart of Appearance, and for the Simulacrum Nexus both.
Guide_XYYH_6_22: Me? I'll stay. Keep watch over this place. Now that I know the truth, I've all the less reason to leave.
Guide_XYYH_6_23: To witness the truth with my own eyes, and carry even the smallest fraction of Lady Hsin's burden... For me, that is more than enough.
Guide_XYYH_6_24: Zhufeng looks toward the Nexus Fox Shadow once more. This time he gives a small, light nod, his eyes clear and still.

Guide_YPGX_1_1: Sorry to trouble you. My name is Luojing, and I oversee the seal on a certain mechanism within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.
Guide_YPGX_1_2: For the first time in four hundred and seventy-three days, the seal's readings have strayed from the record.
Guide_YPGX_1_3: I checked the monitoring logs. Before and after the anomaly, you were the only one who had any contact with it.
Guide_YPGX_1_4: I cannot say what happened, so I would like to consult you in person.
Guide_YPGX_1_5: If it isn't too much trouble, please come and see me. I'll send the coordinates shortly.
Guide_YPGX_2_1: You really came... I thought my message would be treated as spam...
Guide_YPGX_2_2: ...Wait, I know that face... You're the Golden-Eyed One.
Guide_YPGX_2_3: I see... No wonder the seal reacted.
Guide_YPGX_2_5: So what exactly is this seal you spoke of?
Guide_YPGX_2_6: It's a study abandoned long ago. I once led it, and watched with my own eyes as it spiraled out of control.
Guide_YPGX_2_7: Now, it still lies sealed deep within the mechanism. I hope... it can one day be set free.
Guide_YPGX_2_8: Lady Hsin laid this seal Herself. As the Arbiter, you have surely sensed that it is incomplete.
Guide_YPGX_2_10: I can sense it. Part of its frequency is missing.
Guide_YPGX_2_11: More precisely, the frequencies that held the Autopuppet's mind together were stripped away by Suhsin the Inevitable, then scattered across several other Autopuppets.
Guide_YPGX_2_12: Without that frequency, it is now little more than wreckage, all but beyond repair.
Guide_YPGX_2_13: {PlayerName}, could you help it recover those lost frequencies? I can't bear to see it forget even who it is...
Guide_YPGX_2_14: Once it's done, I need to know the truth.
Guide_YPGX_2_15: After all, it has something to do with Suhsin the Inevitable.
Guide_YPGX_2_16: As it should be. I'll keep nothing from you. After all, the blame for what it has become rests with me.
Guide_YPGX_2_17: If its frequencies can be recovered... perhaps it will remember itself.
Guide_YPGX_2_18:
Luojing's gaze settles on the Autopuppet, his brow faintly furrowed.
It is not the look one gives a machine, but the look one gives an old friend long laid low by illness.
Guide_YPGX_3_4: Now that its frequencies are back, it can finally "speak."
Guide_YPGX_3_5: I've heard it repeat the same word, over and over.
Guide_YPGX_3_6: Can you guess what it is?
Guide_YPGX_3_7: So you really do understand what it says...
Guide_YPGX_3_10: Ever since it awoke, all it has longed for is "battle." That is the fate it was born to bear.
Guide_YPGX_3_11: {PlayerName}, I've heard of your valor. If this is a fate it can never escape, then please, grant it this final, destined battle.
Guide_YPGX_4_2: Four hundred and seventy three days.
Guide_YPGX_4_5: I saw an Autopuppet like this once.
Guide_YPGX_4_6: It closely resembles the Skywatch Lancers.
Guide_YPGX_4_7: The Autopuppet before you is exactly the prototype of the Skywatch Lancer.
Guide_YPGX_4_8: Back then, Suhsin the Inevitable stole the Cloud Shuttle blueprints and tried to mass-produce Autopuppets to turn against Xuanfang.
Guide_YPGX_4_9: Fortunately, Lady Hsin intervened in time, and Suhsin could not carry its plan through.
Guide_YPGX_4_10: As one of the "Unit-01" batch, and one of its failures, it was sealed away here and left forgotten.
Guide_YPGX_4_11: But how did you know all this?
Guide_YPGX_4_12: Because I witnessed its birth, and I was the one left behind to answer for it.
Guide_YPGX_4_13: Of course, Lady Hsin never asked us to sacrifice ourselves. She simply knew we would make the choice, of our own accord.
Guide_YPGX_4_14: Every time I came, I'd hear faint, broken noises. At first, I took them for the mechanism creaking.
Guide_YPGX_4_15: Only later did I realize it was its voice. It never stopped "thinking."
Guide_YPGX_4_16: To many, an Autopuppet is nothing but a machine. But once it possessed a mind of its own... I, as a so-called "Celestial," could no longer see it as mere machinery.
Guide_YPGX_4_18: No. The disorder and damage of long years won't be undone by a single battle.
Guide_YPGX_4_19: But at least, it can finally live as "itself."
Guide_YPGX_4_21: {PlayerName}, I may yet have to call on you again someday...
Guide_YPGX_5_1: {PlayerName}, just letting you know all is well.
Guide_YPGX_5_2: It's regained its stability. No more losing control or harming passersby from a disordered mind-frequency.
Guide_YPGX_5_3: Still, it needs to keep sparring, to refine its own data and settle into its frequency.
Guide_YPGX_5_4: You mean it needs a sparring partner again?
Guide_YPGX_5_5: Exactly. If you can spare the time, spar with it a few more rounds.
Guide_YPGX_5_6: Every bout brings it closer to being whole.
Guide_YPGX_5_7: Looks like I've found myself a worthy opponent.
Guide_YPGX_5_8: Word of your help last time has reached many of my old colleagues.
Guide_YPGX_5_9: They've offered to help with the upkeep, and brought in more capable friends besides.
Guide_YPGX_5_10: To make the results easier to track, I've fitted it with a "Sparring Count." From now on it will tally the bouts itself.
Guide_YPGX_5_11: As a keepsake, I set the starting figure to the number of battles it has fought since its creation. Every one of those numbers is drawn from its own mind-frequency.
Guide_YPGX_5_14: Your hard work made this happen.
Guide_YPGX_5_15: Once, I only wanted to right a mistake. But now I understand...
Guide_YPGX_5_16: What's truly worth doing isn't to erase it, but to give it a reason to go on living.
Guide_YPGX_5_17: So it needs a sparring partner?
Guide_YPGX_5_20: Your hard work made this happen.
Guide_YPGX_6_4: It's still looking forward to the next round of sparring.
Guide_YPGX_6_5: If you've got a moment, why not trade a few blows with it?
Guide_YPGX_6_6: Lately, it lingers a while after each round of sparring.
Guide_YPGX_6_8: Its frequency is steadier today than it was yesterday.

zhuiyuejie_first_10_124: Xiangli Yao reveals that Patty has encountered some technical difficulties, likely due to four unreadable wishes, which he believes are causing the malfunction. Wanting to ensure everyone enjoys the festival, you offer to help Xiangli Yao resolve the issue.
zhuiyuejie_first_13_52: The first wish is from a researcher, though you are unsure who they are. Xiang-LEE, a silver robot created by Xiangli, provides a reasonable analysis, helping you begin your search for the wisher's true desire. zhuiyuejie_first_14_47: Outside the Academy, Xiang-LEE analyzes the characteristics of the wisher, and they seem to match a young woman nearby. She introduces herself as Zhezhi, a painter, but it turns out she isn't the person you're looking for after all.
zhuiyuejie_first_16_44: You overhear two researchers discussing something called "Nighttime Blues Syndrome" and decide to ask one of them, Shifan, about the wisher you are looking for. As the robot processes the information, Shifan seems flustered for a moment and quickly bids you farewell.
zhuiyuejie_first_19_43: Just then, a researcher named Jiuli, who had been eavesdropping, approaches and tells you that Shifan is indeed the wisher. Jiuli is eager to understand what caused the rift between them and suggests you pique Shifan's interest by gathering Echo-related research data.
zhuiyuejie_first_21_73: After collecting the necessary data, Xiang-LEE suddenly speaks in Xiangli Yao's voice. It turns out Xiangli Yao is remotely controlling Xiang-LEE to assist you in uncovering Shifan's true desire.

zhuiyuejie_second_51_15: But then my prototype... gone. Everything... gone...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_16: The margin of error was too big. Not enough time, not enough range...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_17: When I got there, the Waveworn had already...

zhuiyuejie_second_51_20: Yes... Yes, I remember... It's all coming back to me now...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_21: I didn't trigger the Waveworn! That's what I've been trying to tell you!

zhuiyuejie_second_51_28: No... Your sacrifice was not in vain.

zhuiyuejie_second_51_33: Yes, it's your theory. We named it after you.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_42: So... my research actually helped others...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_43: It did, and it will keep on benefiting people.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_45: Thank you, my friend. Please... Please witness the world we've protected... on my behalf...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_46: My wish has come true. Thank you, Wishing Tree...
zhuiyuejie_second_51_47: Rover... Let's witness Pascar's wish. Together.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_55: Our classmates and I… We found your notes after the Waveworn receded.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_56: After filling in the missing information, we restored this theory and named it after you.
zhuiyuejie_second_51_58: Yes, and we all know it wasn't your fault.

zhuiyuejie_second_51_60: Your research has inspired many, even attracting interest from the Black Shores, that mysterious organization. They've actually sent one of their Consultants to learn about the theory.
