Side_XYHTZST_52_5: ...I see. I'll give it another try!
Side_XYHTZST_53_1: Watching these young men practice reminds me of my days as an apprentice.
Side_XYHTZST_53_2: Back then, all I cared about was strength and victory. Every drop of sweat I shed held such significance.
Side_XYHTZST_53_4: Now? Hmm, I realize the world is much more complicated than I thought.
Side_XYHTZST_53_5: But if I had the chance to do it all over again, I wouldn't hesitate. After all, I learned a lot from the mistakes of my youth.
Side_XYHTZST_54_1: Ah... Look at all the people!
Side_XYHTZST_54_2: Guess I can take my time... and enjoy the festival.
Side_XYHTZST_55_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. Here for the Moonlit Fair too?
Side_XYHTZST_55_3: Hehe, in that case, let's make sure we soak up all the fun.
Side_XYHTZST_55_4: So much to see and do at a grand festival like this. If you're not careful, these moments slip away like whispers in the wind…
Side_XYHTZST_55_6: Can't believe how fast time's going!
Side_XYHTZST_55_7: Yes, so it makes perfect sense to enjoy the Moonlit Fair to the fullest.
Side_XYHTZST_55_8: If you're tired, maybe sneak in a little nap. Speaking of which… Hmm, I'm feeling a bit sleepy myself now…
Side_XYHTZST_56_2: Hope it gives me a sweet dream.
Side_XYHTZST_57_1: Hello there. You must be {PlayerName}. Your name is often spoken of throughout Jinzhou.
Side_XYHTZST_57_2: Allow me to introduce myself. My name's Danjin. I'm currently visiting all the different regions of Huanglong.
Side_XYHTZST_57_3: Nice to meet you. What are you doing here?
Side_XYHTZST_57_4: Oh, I'm sending off a lantern.
Side_XYHTZST_57_6: Yes. You see these delicate lanterns here? People say they'll carry your wishes to a faraway land.
Side_XYHTZST_57_7: In that land, free from pain and evil, wishes will manifest and eventually return to us here.
Side_XYHTZST_57_10: Yes. Maybe you can try sending off a lantern yourself. You must have wishes to make, right?
Side_XYHTZST_59_1: An inexplicable sense of familiarity rises in you.
Side_XYHTZST_59_2: Memories of the time you sent off Loong Lanterns with Jinhsi and the conversations you shared seem like yesterday.
Side_XYHTZST_59_3: You asked what my wish was.
Side_XYHTZST_59_5: The Loong Lanterns hanging from the trees look as if they're listening intently to your heartfelt words, carrying them to the one who stood here with you.
Side_XYHTZST_6_3: The Liondance Troupe performed on the Main Street earlier, on those Plum Blossom Poles, and the crowd loved it.
Side_XYHTZST_6_4: So I was thinking, why not do it again at the Moonlit Fair? Everyone could give it a try.
Side_XYHTZST_6_5: After all, festivals are all about having fun, right? The more, the merrier!
Side_XYHTZST_9_1: Have you ever met Xiuyi, {PlayerName}? He used to perform on the Main Street.
Side_XYHTZST_9_2: We're both in the Liondance Troupe. If you've seen his performances, you might recognize the Plum Blossom Pole dance.
Side_XYHTZST_9_3: We haven't celebrated the Moonlit Fair in so long. This year is our chance to set up a stall to promote our troupe's services.
Side_XYHTZST_9_4: Ahem... It's not just about business. It's also about introducing more people to the Liondance.
Side_XYHTZST_9_5: When I get some free time, I'll show you the dance myself! I need to keep my skills sharp.
Event_SRSCWX_1_1: Hmm... Sentinel in the sea. The Golden Bough. Is that... ah... so you've been with me all along...
Event_SRSCWX_1_2: Mm... Where are you taking me... So many mirrors, crows, like writing desks...
Event_SRSCWX_1_3: Fisalia... The Dark Tide. Stay away. Mother, save me...
Event_SRSCWX_2_1: A painting bursting with chaotic, indistinct colors radiates a distinct frequency...
Event_SRSCWX_2_2: You sense something familiar from it.
Event_SRSCWX_3_1: A finely dressed girl sleeps before the painting, her brow furrowed, beads of sweat trailing down her face. She seems ensnared in a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_3_3: Mmm... I... Where am I? Am I awake? Or is this another dream... Oh, did you wake me up?
Event_SRSCWX_3_4: It seems like you had a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_3_5: Yes, I did... Thank you for your help. I'm Claudia, a traveling artist capturing inspirations and the history of artworks.
Event_SRSCWX_3_6: I fell asleep after touching the painting and had a long nightmare. It felt like I became someone else in the dream... How embarrassing for you to see me like that.
Event_SRSCWX_3_7: By the way, my foreign friend, are you familiar with morph paintings like this one?
Event_SRSCWX_3_8: I know it's a painting that links to another dimension.
Event_SRSCWX_3_9: Is that a pocket that pulls out magical tools from another dimension?
Event_SRSCWX_3_10: I see, you must have glimpsed some of the mysteries hidden within these paintings.
Event_SRSCWX_3_11: What? They can do that? No wonder the senior line possesses so many secret treasures of mysterious origin...
Event_SRSCWX_3_12: Anyway... despite the danger, the memories I glimpsed in my dream may be connected to the artist of this painting.
Event_SRSCWX_3_13: Unfortunately, I can't recall the dream's details. If only I could investigate again... But since I'm not a Resonator, I can't grasp the essence of this morph painting.
Event_SRSCWX_3_14: Could I entrust this quest to you? I hope you can uncover the secrets hidden within the painting and reveal the fragments of past memories it holds.
Event_SRSCWX_3_16: Thank you. I will prepare a reward for your help. Oh, and please take this talisman. The world inside the painting will be dangerous, and it should help you.
Event_SRSCWX_3_17: It is a gift from my ancestors, believed to be a fragment of the beacon that once guided people to Ragunna.
Event_SRSCWX_3_18: With its aid, should you lose your way within the painting, the light of the Sentinel will guide you.
Event_SRSCWX_3_19: After hearing your call, the girl wakes from her nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_4_1: Claudia sleeps before the painting, her brow furrowed, beads of sweat trailing down her face. She seems ensnared in a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_4_3: Mmm... I... Where am I? Am I awake? Or is this another dream... Oh, it's you, {PlayerName}. Did you wake me up?
Event_SRSCWX_4_4: It seems like you had a nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_4_5: I... I fell asleep after touching the painting and had a long nightmare. It felt like I became someone else in the dream. Wait, did I speak in my dream?
Event_SRSCWX_4_7: ...Ahem. I hope I haven't made a fool of myself.
Event_SRSCWX_4_8: By the way, {PlayerName}, are you familiar with morph paintings like this one?
Event_SRSCWX_4_9: I know it's a painting that links to another dimension.
Event_SRSCWX_4_10: Is that a pocket that pulls out magical tools from another dimension?
Event_SRSCWX_4_11: I see, you must have glimpsed some of the mysteries hidden within these paintings.
Event_SRSCWX_4_12: What? They can do that? No wonder the senior line possesses so many secret treasures of mysterious origin...
Event_SRSCWX_4_13: Anyway... despite the danger, the memories I glimpsed in my dream may be connected to the artist of this painting.
Event_SRSCWX_4_14: Unfortunately, I can't recall the dream's details. If only I could investigate again...
Event_SRSCWX_4_15: By the way, would it be possible for you to investigate the secrets within the painting for me, {PlayerName}? I want to uncover what's hidden within those past memories.
Event_SRSCWX_4_17: Thank you. I'll prepare a proper reward for your help. And please take this talisman. The world inside the painting will be dangerous, and it should help you.
Event_SRSCWX_4_18: It is a gift from my ancestors, believed to be a fragment of the beacon that once guided people to Ragunna.
Event_SRSCWX_4_19: With its aid, should you lose your way within the painting, the light of the Sentinel will guide you, {PlayerName}.
Event_SRSCWX_4_20: After hearing your call, Claudia wakes from her nightmare.
Event_SRSCWX_5_1: That color... I want to learn more about it, no matter what... Thank you for the help.
Event_SRSCWX_6_1: These magical morph paintings... Are they really created with just brushes and paints?
Event_SRSCWX_6_2: If so, what was going through the creators' minds when they painted them?
Event_SRSCWX_7_1: What did you see in that painting, {PlayerName}?
Event_SRSCWX_7_2: What? A different world every time? The painting is filled with monsters? My talisman turned into an Echo? How quaint...
Event_SRSCWX_7_3: But thank the Sentinel you're safe and sound, {PlayerName}, and that's the most important thing. I'm actually curious about your thoughts, {PlayerName}. What did you feel in the worlds inside the painting?
Event_SRSCWX_7_4: It feels like a dream from the Somnoire...
Event_SRSCWX_7_5: I felt a vortex of heartfelt emotions from many creators.
Event_SRSCWX_7_6: I was exhilarated, as if something was calling me to battle.
Event_SRSCWX_7_7: A dream from... the Somnoire? Is that a place where people's dreams come together?
Event_SRSCWX_7_8: I've heard from the elders that the Sentinel can connect our souls, making us one... But looking at it now, is that really a good thing?
Event_SRSCWX_7_9: I see. No wonder I've always felt that this painting doesn't seem to present a full concept. My elders also mentioned that the Sentinel can make people's hearts connect, becoming one...
Event_SRSCWX_7_10: But if all become one, then no matter how deep the artists' feelings were, everything loses its shape and meaning when the colors mix together.
Event_SRSCWX_7_11: A surprising answer. You always speak your mind, {PlayerName}. I... admire how straightforward you are.
Event_SRSCWX_7_12: But no matter how vibrant the colors are, they just turn into a grayish-black mess when mixed together...
Event_SRSCWX_7_13: Painting, after all, is an art that expresses the colors of the heart. Those stifling blues and fiery reds are the hidden reflections of the creator's inner world.
Event_SRSCWX_7_14: The worlds within the painting are fascinating, but being trapped in them prevents me from creating my own work... I should shift my focus outward and observe more.
Event_SRSCWX_7_15: {PlayerName}, thank you for your assistance in completing this investigation and for sharing your feelings.
Event_SRSCWX_7_16: Please take this talisman, if you don't mind.
Event_SRSCWX_7_17: After all, it can only serve its purpose in those worlds.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_1: (Terminal Communication) Yes, yes, user experience has always been the cornerstone of Lollo Logistics, and it's fundamental to our survival.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_2: I understand what you mean. You want us to maintain quality while shortening the update cycle for each event to enhance user experience, but the cost... Oh, right, Man-Made Arctic...?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_3: Sure thing, absolutely! Your request is my mission! I'll make sure everything's set, and I look forward to you personally guiding us!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_4: I'm sorry, I was just on a call with my boss. So, old friend, did you miss me?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_7: Did the boss send me new tasks through you again?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_8: Of course, Lollo Stamps, my old buddy, I've missed you like crazy!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_9: Why are you suddenly speaking with a foreign accent? And hey, are you thinking about me or what?!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_10: Sure, I won't let you work for nothing.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_11: What are you talking about? In all of Solaris, you're the most dependable one. Only I, Maji, could find someone as reliable as you.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_12: Since we last met, I submitted a new proposal, and they've finally agreed to let me handle part of the event activities!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_13: I was thinking of using a completely new strategy for the event. Pretty bold, huh?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_14: The entire event is brand new, completely different from the last one. It's a fresh Lollo promotional campaign with an all-new approach.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_15: Let's identify new hooks—not by breaking through user pain points, but by creating new ones for them!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_16: A new chapter for Lollo Logistics: The Maji Era is buzzing with excitement!
Event_WWQHEQ_1_21: Sure, it's just like last year, except we swap out some buzzwords on the slides to make them look impressive for the bosses.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_23: Why are you looking at me like that? I have to report, you know. Besides, I've just been transferred to headquarters — I still need to put food on the table, right?
Event_WWQHEQ_1_24: However, I've initiated an optimization plan for the entire Lollo Stamps exchange feature, making it easier to acquire Lollo Stamps without having to detour through the finance department for approvals.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_28: Ahaha, but for now, I'm personally covering the expenses brought by the Lollo Stamps after the update... Anyway! I'll clearly list all the help you need on the panel, so you can directly claim the Lollo Stamps from the Feature when the time comes.
Event_WWQHEQ_1_29: I've got the rest in your hands, {PlayerName}!
GuideLZDG02_1_1: Honored guest from afar, I am relieved to finally see you.
GuideLZDG02_1_2: I'm afraid it's not right to burden you with such a troublesome matter, but I can't think of anyone else capable of handling it.
GuideLZDG02_1_4: Heh, lucky for you, you came to the right person.
GuideLZDG02_1_5: This isn't as complicated as it seems.
GuideLZDG02_1_6: I knew you would be willing to help.
GuideLZDG02_1_7: Recently, my family entrusted me with managing an ancestral site, where a handed-down "Terminal" still remains.
GuideLZDG02_1_8: This thing... it has a certain malevolence to it, you understand?
GuideLZDG02_1_9: Shadowy monsters frequently emerge from within, causing chaos before disappearing on their own.
GuideLZDG02_1_10: I'm asking for your assistance in dealing with these shadows, and rest assured, you'll be well compensated.
GuideLZDG02_1_12: I entrust this task to you, and I shall await your triumph here.
GuideLZDG02_2_1: (Something's off here. Traces of the Dark Tide's power linger...)
GuideLZDG02_3_1: Hello, one who has passed the trial.
GuideLZDG02_3_2: I don't know what kind of person you are, but your strength is undeniable, among the world's finest.
GuideLZDG02_3_3: Drawing on the mechanics of the Thorncrown Rises and the Remnant Energy within Nimbus Sanctum, I have recreated powerful frequencies from various dimensions.
GuideLZDG02_3_4: To amplify these frequencies to the necessary strength, we even risked harnessing the power of the Dark Tide.
GuideLZDG02_3_5: We have taken on the job from Fisalia, exerting great effort and even collaborating with those from the Order, all to harness these "phantoms of salvation" and bring forth a true "savior."
GuideLZDG02_3_6: Savior, no matter which family you hail from, we have prepared a generous welcome gift for you!
GuideLZDG02_3_7: The "Savior's Proof," obtainable only here and forged into crest coins from the wealth of Fisalia, will bring you endless riches!
GuideLZDG02_3_8: To obtain them, you must become stronger and embrace continuous challenges!
GuideLZDG02_3_9: I await here, eagerly anticipating the emergence of the "Savior"!
GuideLZDG02_4_1: You've returned, Victor! How did it go?
GuideLZDG02_4_2: I'm not going to lie, they've entrusted this place to me, but I truly don't know how to handle that Terminal.
GuideLZDG02_4_4: It's better not to tell him.
GuideLZDG02_4_5: (He genuinely seems unaware... Should I tell him the truth?)
GuideLZDG02_4_6: You told Botim everything the phantom revealed...
GuideLZDG02_4_7: It all makes sense now... So that's what it is... Yes, I understand.
GuideLZDG02_4_8: Esteemed Savior, thank you for sharing the truth with me.
GuideLZDG02_4_9: Certainly, anything you gain from the Terminal is well-deserved. If you wish, you may proceed to the Terminal at any time to undertake the trials.
GuideLZDG02_4_10: I have personal matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave for now.
GuideLZDG02_4_11: Botim left, weighed down by his worries.
GuideLZDG02_4_12: (He really seems unaware... It's probably best not to tell him.)
GuideLZDG02_4_13: I'm on it. Just a few dangerous monsters left to handle, but I'll see it through.
GuideLZDG02_4_14: I'm... I'm not sure how to express my gratitude... but truly, thank you so much!
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. Can you hear me...? It is I, the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_4: Hello, and I'm the Ivory Gatekeeper.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_5: Ahem. I am the Administrator of the <ano=domain of dreams>Somnoire</ano>, the Ebony Gatekeeper.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_6: Well... to see you about matters concerning Somnoire naturally.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_7: Ahem. Maybe save the jokes for later, Dreamwalker.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_8: I was wondering if you have noticed... A gateway to the Somnoire has started to appear in Rinascita.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_12: The dreamscape seems to be experiencing some kind of interference... Ah, there, it's working again.
Guide_QDMFDYX_1_13: If possible, I'd like to speak with you in person. I'll be expecting you, Dreamwalker.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_2: Emm... I gather you must be puzzled by my current appearance. I can assure you I am the Ebony Gatekeeper who contacted you earlier.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_4: ...I see how it is. It was you who I spoke to that time!
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_5: I'm afraid Ms. Encore has no involvement in this. This entity is a replica of memory fragments from the Somnoire. I am merely borrowing its appearance for the time being.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_7: Now, then. This is unrelated to the topic we're about to discuss.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_9: That time when I used Echoids against the TDs.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_10: Ahem... Well... Yes, you're absolutely correct. It was me who you spoke to.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_11: I indeed owe you an apology for engaging you in the experiment to test out the new Gateway through a false identity. It was all part of my plan to save those dreams... One which you've thwarted.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_12: Okay, out with it. What are you up to this time?
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_13: Please, Dreamwalker. I assure you that I have no secrets to hide.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_14: I've been optimizing the memory storage logic of a few Memory Zones, and if all goes accordingly the Somnoire should be able to house more dreams with its current space.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_15: Yet I've discovered impurities lingering within the dreams of Rinascita. When the Dreamscape Nodes in Rinascita were activated, these impurities flooded in Somnoire along with the dreams.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_17: Unlike what we've handled before, they are composed of something more sinister than negative emotions in nightmares. Something that's close to a spiritual plague. However, I have yet to achieve a definitive answer.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_18: More Memory Zones fall under their influence as we speak. If left untreated, they could not only put my work on hold but also undermine the integrity of the Somnoire itself.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_19: Dreamwalker, I wish to seek your aid in handling these impurities. But not for me, for the entire Somnoire.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_20: Fine. Not the first time I've done this.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_22: Rest assured, there will be plenty of rewards waiting for you inside the dreamscapes. I will also be available to assist you in any way my abilities allow.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_23: About the Somnoire gateway in Rinascita I mentioned to you earlier... In order to prevent further spread, I have sealed the impurities in the Memory Zones behind it.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_24: As you progress, I will periodically open more gateways located across various areas. The Somnoire will also have necessary utilities in place at your and your comrade's disposal.
Guide_QDMFDYX_2_25: Proceed to the gateway and restore Memory Zones affected by impurities, Dreamwalker.
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_1: Dreamwalker, to the Somnoire you are a variable of incredible weight. You bring about a change...
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_3: A change for the better. After years of lying dormant, the colossus is now experiencing transformation. Together, we shall preserve even more... treasures.
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_4: Whilst deep inside the Memory Zones, I'm sure you came across plenty of familiar views and occurances.
Guide_QDMFDYX_3_5: Go, Dreamwalker. In the realms of dreams, only the dream itself holds the answers we seek.
DYHD_1_1: Ah, call me Ishmael. Well, well! The Laureate, I presume? Have you ever tried fishing before?
DYHD_1_2: The trick to it is a flexible line and a subtle lure.
DYHD_1_3: Fancy trying your hand at deep sea fishing? It's one of Rinascita's many lasting traditions, like the Carnevale.
DYHD_1_4: Sure, I want to become a pro angler.
DYHD_1_5: I'd like to give it a try.
DYHD_1_6: Wonderful, then I've got a good place for you. Riccioli Islands, north of Ragunna. It's right where the currents of the Stormy Sea meet, drawing in swarms of fish.
DYHD_1_7: And if you're alone, angling on a fishing boat would suit you better. A net will just get you tangled up in trouble.
DYHD_1_8: Once you reach the islands, go visit an old captain called Ahab. He'll be more than glad to show you the ropes.
DYHD_1_9: I've got to make my way back to the islands myself. There's a boat at the harbor that'll take you straight there. Just let the boatman know you're off for some fishing!
DYHD_10_2: The Gondola loaded with cargo seems to be saying, "Give me money and I'll give you goodies!"
DYHD_11_2: No one else knows. It's just between us.
DYHD_11_3: Wait for my return, my darling... fiancée...
DYHD_11_4: Er, excuse me, sir? Are you the one who witnessed Cetus the Tidebreaker?
DYHD_11_5: Hmm? Yes, that's me! Are you here to witness our union? Marvelous! Come, according to tradition, a wedding witness must be present.
DYHD_11_7: A wedding witness? Well, the Codex does allow Acolytes to serve as witnesses during weddings.
DYHD_11_8: What makes you want to marry a fish?!
DYHD_11_9: He's certainly not acting like himself...
DYHD_11_11: Is he... under some kind of enchantment? I've read of symptoms like this in the Order's archives before.
DYHD_11_12: O Imperator's blessings, gaze upon this...
DYHD_11_14: Huh? I did what was written in the archives...
DYHD_11_16: Golden white... Jellyfish... Pitch black... A large fish... Huh? You're human... I'm a fish... No wait... My fish...
DYHD_11_17: Ow, my head hurts... Who are you?
DYHD_11_19: Mind if I give him another smack?
DYHD_11_20: Where the hell's my boat? And how did I get here... What?
DYHD_11_21: The fish... My, oh, my... From Serene Bay... The fish... Heeheehee...
DYHD_11_22: He's at it again! Here I go!
DYHD_11_27: I treated their broken leg from a Gondola accident back at the market.
DYHD_11_29: Did... Mr. Coffin ask you to come here?
DYHD_11_30: I think they're trying to say that Mr. Starbuck's Gondola might know something. They're stranded on a reef nearby.
DYHD_11_31: And Mr. Starbuck has been like this for two weeks now...
DYHD_11_33: You want us to use these to free the Gondola?
DYHD_11_34: Hmmm, I fear Mr. Starbuck might not withstand any more of the Order's disenchantment tricks anyway.
DYHD_11_37: In that brief moment when Mr. Starbuck seemed to recover, he mentioned his Gondola and a place called Serene Bay.
DYHD_11_38: Finding that boat and uncovering the cause behind his enchantment might be a good starting point.
DYHD_11_41: Heehee... Yes, we must have fireworks at our wedding ... "Sweetened fireworks"...
DYHD_11_42: Following Captain Ahab's instructions, you and Phoebe manage to find his old First Mate, Starbuck, but the man seems to have fallen under some kind of enchantment. To help Starbuck come to his senses, you decide to locate his Gondola for clues.
DYHD_1101_1: I say, it's been what... over ten days?
DYHD_1101_2: And his brain's still all scrambled eggs up there.
DYHD_1101_3: Didn't someone fetch a doctor from Ragunna City or something?
DYHD_1101_5: Well, if it was worth something, you think the man would still be in this state?
DYHD_1102_2: Why does that fish still look the same when it was fished up?
DYHD_1102_3: And would you look at that weird glow in its eyes...
DYHD_1102_4: There's got to be something wrong with it!
DYHD_12_2: Huh? Why is there a sweet scent in the air...？
DYHD_13_2: The rescued Gondola appears to be shouting something.
DYHD_13_3: You came across a "siren"? A creature with a human body and a fishtail?
DYHD_13_5: Isn't she supposed to be in Nimbus Sanctum?
DYHD_13_6: Could there be another being like Lorelei?
DYHD_13_8: I suspect that the fish we saw earlier is connected to this "siren."
DYHD_13_9: There's got to be a reason it stayed fresh after all these weeks.
DYHD_13_10: This means we need to think of a way to get that fish out of Mr. Starbuck's hands.
DYHD_13_12: It's time for a little switcheroo.
DYHD_13_13: We catch one that looks similar and call it a day.
DYHD_13_15: We're running low on options here.
DYHD_13_17: Well, only one way to find out.
DYHD_13_18: You and Phoebe find Starbuck's lost Gondola. Having theorized that Starbuck's enchantment has something to do with the fish he was holding, the two of you begin brainstorming a plan to get it off his hands.
DYHD_1301_1: A large dark gray fish flies onto your boat...
DYHD_1301_2: It does look similar to the fish Starbuck is holding. Maybe you can swap the fish in Starbuck's hands with this one.
DYHD_14_2: Oh? My dear witness, have you seen my fiancée around?
DYHD_14_3: Hehehe... You… What are you up to?
DYHD_14_9: Who are you? What am I doing with this fish?
DYHD_14_10: Mr. Starbuck? Captain Ahab asked us to come find you.
DYHD_14_11: Old Ahab? Wait, what's going on here?
DYHD_14_12: Do you know anything about this blue fish?
DYHD_14_13: Do you remember what happened to Cetus the Tidebreaker?
DYHD_14_14: All I remember is being out at sea fishing not long ago.
DYHD_14_15: But all I could hear was a song, drawing me in. It felt like my whole body was being beckoned to follow that tune.
DYHD_14_16: The next thing I knew, I was drifting right out of Serene Bay, where the Tidebreaker is said to slumber.
DYHD_14_17: The singing was still there, like it was rising from the depths. I swear I caught a glimpse of the Cetus's shadow... then another shadow of a massive fish.
DYHD_14_18: Oh, the curves of that shadow. A true beauty...

Guide_CZRGDYY_1_1: There you are! Right on time, {PlayerName}.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_4: Don't worry. There's no immediate crisis that requires your attention… at least, not yet.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_5: This time, it's an invitation we never saw coming.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_6: The Ivory Gatekeeper hands you a finely crafted invitation. As you scan the unfamiliar handwriting, the words "Solaris Film Festival" stand out.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_11: This is a first for us as well. The invitation undeniably carries the deep dream frequencies of the Somnoire, but… that's a dreamscape. Objects from a dream aren't supposed to manifest in reality.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_13: We have two theories. One, the Somnoire has developed a consciousness of its own. Two, someone within the Somnoire possesses an ability powerful enough to shatter the boundary between dreams and reality, someone we never knew existed.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_14: And now, they've sent an invitation. Maybe a path to the deeper layers of the Somnoire has finally opened.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_16: Or… maybe it's just a new film festival?
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_17: It does. While we can't determine the host's true intentions yet, one thing is certain: neither of us Gatekeepers can access the deeper layers. Only you can.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_18: You're right. There's no reason to dismiss that idea. The Somnoire is a place of endless possibilities. Maybe something new has come into existence, and it doesn't necessarily spell trouble.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_19: But neither of us Gatekeepers can access the deeper layers. Only you can.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_21: In other words, this invitation was meant for you alone.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_23: Looks like I don't have much of a choice.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_24: Our best hope is that the invitation comes with goodwill, and you are just attending a film festival within a dream... But no matter what happens, keep your guard up. We'll support you however we can.
Guide_CZRGDYY_1_25: If it turns out to be safe, enjoy the festival. We'll be waiting for your return.

Event_WWQHSQ_2_11: I bet you liked it, right? But that'll be the last of it.

Event_WWQHSQ_2_22: Which is why I went and found the head of accounting, had my knees give the floor a gentle touch, plus a little kiss with my forehead on the ground while I was at it. And voila. They had no choice but to give me a second chance!

Event_WWQHSQ_2_25: For my salary, and for the happiness of my old friend. I, Maji, will do anything!
Event_WWQHSQ_2_26: All right. Same as usual, the panel will post daily updates of requests, which you'll easily breeze through, and the Lollo Stamps will come flying into your pocket.
Event_WWQHSQ_2_27: And remember, friend. My own fate, and the fate of you not having to travel across the entire Solaris just to reach me for rewards, depends on you and your accomplishments in the upcoming days!
Event_WWQHSQ_2_28: Good luck, {PlayerName}! With our powers we shall unite our customers, and force the evil-doers at accounting flatten and overthrow themselves!

Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_10: Not long ago, I went to Septimont to watch an Agon. The Gladiators' fiery passion, their movements... It moved me to my core!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_11: Even I was waving my arms, screaming myself hoarse.
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_12: And right then, I thought… sure, there were vending machines in the stands, but if someone came running over with a drink clinking with ice cubes... Ah! Wouldn't that be more refreshing than any perfectly-aligned workflow?
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_13: Maggie, throw away that How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite.
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_14: …Up until you said "workflow," it actually did sound refreshing.
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_15: You don't get it! Lose freedom, you lose a lot. Lose perfectly-aligned workflow, you lose everything!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_16: (…Pretty sure that's not how the saying goes.)
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_17: Anyway! I jumped right into putting the plan into action.
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_18: But as I said, no matter what I try, I can't outrun melting ice!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_19: Not even with coolers or ice packs?
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_20: No! Friend, no cooler and ice pack can withstand the blazing passion of the crowd!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_21: Don't suddenly get all worked up, Maggie!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_22: Sorry, sorry. Septimont's Agons just fire me up. But you see, my career is now melting away like those ice cubes.
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_23: A cold drink is heaven in a glass in this scorching heat.

Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_25: If Lollo Logistics gets branded as a "watered-down company" because of this…
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_26: My colleagues will drag me back to the HQ as cargo and put me on trial!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_27: So please, my old friend, save me!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_28: Somehow, I get the feeling I'll be hearing this sort of wailing from you often…
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_29: Then I suggest asking Lumi to deliver you back to the HQ. Maybe she'll go soft on you.
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_31: Come on, I know you'll help me. I don't expect you to shoulder the risks for me. But if you do, I promise you'd always have a stake in my payroll. We’ll go from rags to riches together.

Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_33: Think about it! Who else will answer the desperate cries of those parched, hoarse, dizzy fans? No one but us!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_34: We'll be the rising heroes! Not only the Gladiators fighting valiantly in the arena are heroes! So are we, delivering chilled drinks with swift and shining valor!
Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_35: So remember! Beat the ice before it melts!

Event_JZDB_1_5: Usually, students have access to almost everything. But then there are these rare, special ones locked away deep in the database. The kind that's totally off-limits.
Event_JZDB_1_6: So, of course, that makes us a pretty tempting target for all sorts of factions and nations. We get hit with over a million attacks daily. Some out in the open, some... not so much.
Event_JZDB_1_7: Naturally, Startorch Academy's most exceptional AI Keeper has kept our defenses watertight against most of the attacks so far. Thanks to her, dozens of global-scale crises have been nipped in the bud. Pretty impressive, right? I certainly think so.

Event_JZDB_1_11: She has thrown every bit of available computing power into building a defense matrix, and all it's done is slow it down. My, that's an unprecedented crisis for real...
Event_JZDB_1_14: It's pretty serious... Worst-case scenario? Our lovely Keeper might just get herself fired for dropping the ball.
Event_JZDB_1_15: I don't think that's the worst-case scenario...
Event_JZDB_1_16: However, thankfully, I have found a solution!
Event_JZDB_1_17: So you called me here to...

Event_JZDB_1_20: In short, I need someone to dive into the matrix I built. Your lovely Keeper has gone out of her way and turned it into a virtual playground, so those nasty viruses will look just like enemies they can actually get their hands on.
Event_JZDB_1_21: After reviewing the files of every student, I deemed you the best candidate for the job, {PlayerName}.

GuideLZDG03_1_6: We've gathered data from across various regions and managed to simulate highly formidable frequencies that have appeared all over the world!

Flow_131000001_16: Take a quick look at this info touch pad, can you find any clues

Huanglong_main_1_5EX_1_1: A hidden passage... As I expected.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_1_2: That must be the entrance to the Database.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_1_3: A part of the building is submerged... I should be able to find the hidden path underwater.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_1_4: It seems I have a puzzle to solve. Guess I will check on the mechanism in the middle first.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_10_1: The water level just dropped again. There's another two drums, one in the east, and another in the west.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_10_2: I may find more Sonodisks down there.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_11_1: It seems locked... Guess I'll need to activate the other one first.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_12_1: So this is the right way to go.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_12_2: I am being fed just enough information to work out the puzzle. This does look like Miss Magistrate's doing.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_12_3: The drum on the other side has unlocked. Guess I'll go check on it before I leave, just to be safe.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_12_4: Another Bell just rose up from the water, but it's still locked... I'll need to connect the passageways first.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_13_1: The music I just heard... It must be the Sonodisk.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_14_1: Here it is. Time to deal with the guards.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_14_2: (Jinzhou's City Hall is the political hub, while the Grand Library holds vital data. Considering how I just took out all those guards, this place is oddly under-protected. If my guess is correct, the Magistrate may have other plans for me...)
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_15_1: I've retrieved the third Sonodisk. Time to head back.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_16_2: ”The Bells will lead my path," huh. I'll go work out the passageways.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_18_1: It seems the guards only show up when someone approaches a Sonodisk.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_19_1: This is the fourth missing note.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_2_1: "...Gather five tones to align in tune. The Bells shall guide your path."
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_2_2: "...Find keynotes to determine tone. The Archive shall be unmasked."
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_2_3: I see. The control panel here does look like a musical instrument, but five music notes seem to be missing.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_2_4: So to gain access to the Database, I will need to recover the five missing notes stored in those Sonodisks...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_2_5: What is that sound coming from behind the <ano=control panel>Symphodai</ano>?
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_20_1: Now the water is all gone.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_21_1: This is the last one. They've prepared quite the welcome for me.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_22_1: I have the last Sonodisk ready. Time to go back to the Symphodai.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_23_1: Now I should have access to the Database...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_24_1: So this is the "Grand Library." It's said to hold the answers to every question imaginable...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_24_2: I'm not seeing anyone here. I guess the Magistrate is yet to arrive.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_24_3: Well, it wouldn't hurt to browse the archives for a bit as I wait for her to show up.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_3_1: This must be one of the missing notes. Now... How do I connect it with the Symphodai?
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_4_1: Part of the Scoreholder just lit up. As I expected.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_4_2: The drum over there seems to have unlocked.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_5_1: A Bell just raised out of the water... So that's what it meant by having the Bells guide my path.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_6_1: A new walkway has shown up. I must have solved the first puzzle.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_6_2: Seems I will need to look for more Sonodisks in there.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_7_1: Tacet Discords... Inside the City Hall?
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_7_2: No, they are not real... They must be some kind of digital simulation. It seems they are the guards here. Interesting how I'm not hearing sirens, despite having destroyed every one of them.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_7_3: Apart from the simulated Tacet Discords, It's unusually quiet in this place...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_8_1: "...Multiply fifty-four with four thirds for the Frequency you seek. Find this note in the West, while the prophet is beyond reach."
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_8_2: I suppose it's telling me where I can find the next Sonodisk... I think it mentioned a direction. What does that last sentence mean, though...
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_8_3: That sound... It's coming from the west.
Huanglong_main_1_5EX_9_1: This is the second Sonodisk. I should bring it to the Symphodai.

NPC_MAINSY_1_21_5: It is your conflicting emotions that obscure the true face of destiny.

NPC_MAINSY_1_26_1: I overheard a few Gladiators guessing who the next Hero of Heroes might be.
NPC_MAINSY_1_26_2: I don't need the Sacred Flames' guidance to know the path to the throne is already shadowed by conflict.
NPC_MAINSY_1_26_3: We still haven't seen the new Hero's face. No one knows who deserves to claim that title.
NPC_MAINSY_1_26_4: That very uncertainty is why prophecy, once a beacon meant to guide the people, is now being twisted to serve the ambitions of a few.

NPC_MAINSY_1_410_4: We've fought as hard in Jinzhou to hold off the TDs…

NPC_MAINSY_1_415_3: Let's see if Augusta can hold her ground when the storm hits.
NPC_MAINSY_1_415_4: When the time comes, the people will know who their leader is...

NPC_MAINSY_1_420_2: Gather your strength, ignite your spirit!
NPC_MAINSY_1_420_4: And walk the path of glory!

NPC_MAINSY_1_450_9: For the glory of my House, I'll prove myself worthy of this sword.
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_2: Barely… This hunt was beyond anything I imagined. Just staying alive took all I had. If it weren't for Ephor Augusta and the others...
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_3: Survival is an honor in itself. Don't be too hard on yourself.
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_4: Also… the sword you gave me, I lost it in the battle…
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_5: A Gladiator should never let go of their blade. I guess I'm not ready yet…
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_6: Haha! A sword's a sword. I can always forge another.
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_7: But you, you are the real blade of Septimont. This hunt only whets your edge.
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_8: Shame, though. The sword with your name will have to wait for another day.
NPC_MAINSY_1_460_9: Until then, I'll keep sharpening myself.

Flow_31000001_1: I just don't understand why they haven't started fixing the Sentinel's statue yet...
Flow_31000001_2: All the issues in the report… they're all solvable!
Flow_31000001_3: The mountains are unstable… and those Tacet Discords keep popping up…
Flow_31000001_4: You don't get it. Folks are really on edge. They're terrified those disasters will hit again.
Flow_31000001_5: If they could just fix the Sentinel's statue, it would lift everyone's spirits.
Flow_31000001_6: After all, we all grew up hearing stories about the Sentinel's power!
Flow_31000001_7: Do you think the report I sent to Yirou was too blunt? I really hope she doesn't take it the wrong way.
Flow_31000001_8: She and I don't see eye to eye on the restoration of the Sentinel's statue.
Flow_31000001_9: She's got this idealistic, optimistic way about her. I do like how determined she is to get the project moving.
Flow_31000001_10: It's not that kind of like, okay? Don't get the wrong idea!
Flow_31000001_11: I just don't think fixing the statue is our biggest priority right now. We've got more pressing stuff to deal with—like upgrading the border walls, for example.
Flow_31000001_12: Hmm, how do I put this nicely and get her on board?
Flow_31000001_13: This rock wall's way too loose. I barely pushed, and a chunk came right off.
Flow_31000001_14: Writing that report couldn't have been easy for Haobai. Wonder what Yirou's gonna think when she sees it...
Flow_31000001_15: Haha, it's not all about brute strength, you know.
Flow_31000001_16: As long as I can find the right launching point, I can pull off things that seem impossible.
Flow_31000001_17: I guess that's kinda my Resonance ability... sounds pretty basic, huh? Haha.
Flow_31000001_18: There's a rockslide caused by those monsters every couple of days. If one blocks the road, people end up stranded up here in the mountains.
Flow_31000001_19: If you hit any snags, especially with rockslides or blocked paths, just give me a shout.
Flow_31000001_20: Did you know water can speak?
Flow_31000001_21: Haha, very funny. No, I mean...
Flow_31000001_22: It's more like... the raindrops in the clouds are talking to me, telling me when they're coming and how long they'll stay.
Flow_31000001_23: You won't hurt my feelings if you tell me that this kind of Resonance Ability... is kind of useless.
Flow_31000001_24: I used to feel insecure about it, but since I started working on the Exploration Canal, my skills have been super helpful.
Flow_31000001_25: I realized that there is no such thing as a strong or weak ability, it's how you use it that matters.
Flow_31000001_26: Anyway, I just gotta live up to my name... no more sulking!
Flow_31000001_27: That's actually what Pops always wanted for me, to carve through mountains and guide rivers to the sea.
Flow_31000001_28: Just like him, I work for the Ministry of Development on water projects.
Flow_31000001_29: He was out there, digging canals in the Gorges of Spirits, right up until the Tacet Discord outbreak.
Flow_31000001_30: Nothing. Now I carry on his legacy and try to push forward with his unfinished business.
Flow_31000001_31: To be honest, that's where my own passion comes in, too.
Flow_31000001_32: Pops is probably smiling down on me right now.
Flow_31000001_33: Huh? Come on, we can't dig here. That would mess up the ecosystem.
Flow_31000001_35: There's a lot of research on Tacetite in the academy. I mean, with all these Tacet Discords, Tacetite weapons are the big thing. Projects get greenlit fast, and funding is rarely an issue.
Flow_31000001_36: Life is tough for us biologists... I just want to keep the research and development from wrecking the ecosystem.
Flow_31000001_37: Our world's hanging by a thread as it is.
Flow_31000001_38: That being said, from what I've figured out, there should be giant Tacet Discords in the Gorges of Spirits' water system that mimic normal animals.
Flow_31000001_39: Never seen anything like it in the reports, though. Weird...
Flow_31000001_41: Good luck fixing that anytime soon.
Flow_31000001_43: Didn't know you had that kind of strength in you.
Flow_31000001_45: Is there a story behind your name?
Flow_31000001_48: You're right, that's a tough problem.
Flow_31000001_52: Lucky for them, I've saved more than a few thanks to my Resonance abilities.
Flow_31000001_53: This ability's been pretty handy, though. Lately, more Tacet Fields have appeared, and the Tacet Discords have been acting up big time.
Flow_31000001_54: You're saying the rain talks to you?
Flow_31000001_55: Nah, I can only hear regular rain. When it's that Retroact stuff? Nothing.
Flow_31000001_56: Technically, Retroact Rain isn't even real rain. It's more like… Remnant Energy.
Flow_31000001_57: Remnant Energy replays old events. When the rain flows up, you get these mirages of the past showing up in it.
Flow_31000001_60: If you can't tell what's real and what's not, those mirages can mess with your head. I guess everyone's got someone they can't let go of...
Flow_31000001_61: So if you run into Retroact Rain, stay sharp. Don't let your emotions get the better of you.
Flow_31000001_62: I can't hear the Retroact Rain, only the ordinary kind... Do you think my Resonance Ability is weak?
Flow_136000001_1: We can take that camp down today with just a few soldiers.
Flow_136000001_2: But we're just here for reconnaissance...
Flow_136000001_3: Just a pack of thieves inside. What's there to fear? They're getting in the way of our scouts' ability to watch the frontlines!
Flow_136000001_6: Ah, you're here! Cunren has already led an attack on the camp, but...
Flow_136000001_18: The captain's orders were clear. No unsanctioned ops. Violators won't get away scot free. If he finds out, I don't even want to imagine...
Flow_136000001_19: If he finds out what? He'll only hear of our victory and heap praise upon us.
Flow_136000001_20: It's finally finished. These cunning Exiles...
Flow_136000001_21: Phew... guess we dodged a bullet there.
Flow_136000001_34: When I get outta here... you're gonna regret it.
Flow_136000001_37: Thank you... it seems that some of my brothers have been captured! I'd give anything to fight alongside them again...
Flow_136000001_39: All the enemies in the base have been eliminated!
Flow_136000001_40: The Exiles in the high ground have been cleared!
Flow_136000001_41: Thank you for the rescue, Rover!
Flow_136000001_43: It's just a scratch. I'm cleaning it up. Tough it out!
Flow_136000001_55: Ah! It's an Exile, p-please, leave me be...
Flow_136000001_56: What Exile... Look at {Male=his;Female=her} attire, does that scream thief to you?
Flow_136000001_60: Sharp eyes, I like that. I'm a man of action. You seem like the capable sort, so let me introduce myself.
Flow_136000001_61: Just passing through? Not many wander these hills... but it's good timing. I'm in need of some help.
Flow_136000001_62: We're a makeshift team, Outrider Squad. I'm Cunren, and this is Lingdi. We came to scout out the camp.
Flow_136000001_64: But I've already figured out the situation. It's just a group of Exiles, so I'm launching the first attack!
Flow_136000001_65: So, what's it gonna be? You in? Let's fight for the Midnight Rangers.
Flow_136000001_66: I don't want the captain giving me a tongue lashing. Don't drag me into this...
Flow_136000001_69: Why bother asking? We hit the camp early, give him a surprise. What's better than that?
Flow_136000001_70: Think it over? Hesitation is death on the battlefield!
Flow_136000001_71: Forget it. You two are too hesitant. I can't rely on you.
Flow_136000001_72: I'll lead the charge at the set time. You just sit tight and wait for my victory lap.
Flow_136000001_74: Look at you, all scared. You'll regret not joining when you see me become a full-fledged Midnight Ranger.
Flow_136000001_76: Looks like they got tangled up in the Exiles' infighting. Haven't heard from them in a while.
Flow_136000001_77: The captain's still not back... I've got no idea what to do.
Flow_136000001_79: You gonna head up there to help? But those Exiles...
Flow_136000001_81: Hmm... you do seem more reliable than Cunren, I believe in you.
Flow_136000001_82: Follow the path and you'll hit the camp. Some of our crew should be out front. You ask them for the details.

StZLCZ_155_3: Oh? You ask about the Trine Myth? Rare it is to find curious ears.
StZLCZ_155_4: I guess we're a rare breed. Hazel and I were captivated by how the epic scenes in the predictions align with reality. We started a fan club, but after all these months, it's still just the two of us.
StZLCZ_155_5: We thought the Royan students would be interested and tried inviting them. Got rejected every time!
StZLCZ_155_6: Blame them not. They have heard those stories since they were babes in the cradle.
StZLCZ_155_7: But the Twilight Epoch tells us that our end will not be one of unstoppable doom. It will be an opportunity to stand with Baldur and fight against Hvedrungr!
StZLCZ_155_8: Whether it is outsiders to Lahai-Roi like the two of you, or the Heliodic Six, there are those who prepare for the Twilight Epoch's arrival.
StZLCZ_155_9: If you ask what I believe, it is this: Lahai-Roi will weather the Twilight Epoch. It will find its way into the new era beyond it.
StZLCZ_155_10: Sir, your words... I haven't felt this moved since I first read the Trine Myth!
StZLCZ_155_11: Right! We'll double our efforts! We'll recruit more members, upgrade to a full society so that more people will see how incredible the Trine Myth is!

StZLCZ_155_13: And just as the Sacred Reactor Epoch foretold, forgotten the past, many of my people have. They do not worry about the future.

Guide_TSDXT_2_1: Hello! Welcome to the Jinzhou branch of the Pioneer Association!
Guide_TSDXT_2_2: I guess you must be Rover?
Guide_TSDXT_2_5: Our headquarters has extended an invitation to you. Please consider joining the Pioneer Association!
Guide_TSDXT_2_6: Measure the planet with your own feet, and witness civilizations through your own eyes.
Guide_TSDXT_2_7: Let's go explore the world together!
Guide_TSDXT_2_10: Allow me to make a brief introduction.
Guide_TSDXT_2_11: Our core mission at the Pioneer Association is to push the boundaries of humanity's understanding through exploration. We ignite curiosity and embrace a trailblazing mindset, inviting adventurers from all backgrounds to join us.
Guide_TSDXT_2_12: Our team consists of top journalists, writers, photographers, and expeditioners from around the world.
Guide_TSDXT_2_13: Pioneers are free to plan their own expeditions with our support, and we offer platforms for publishing high-quality content such as magazines, podcasts, and books.
Guide_TSDXT_2_14: What can I get from this?
Guide_TSDXT_2_16: Our Pioneers earn cash for submissions, plus dedicated funding for approved expedition plans from the Association.
Guide_TSDXT_2_17: Pioneers also have the opportunity to receive special outdoor tools essential for their journeys. As they venture further, these tools can become invaluable aids in exploration.
Guide_TSDXT_2_19: Great! I'll get your profile set up real quick. You'll be able to check your exploration process so far on your Terminal at any time.
Guide_TSDXT_2_20: And... all set! From now on, Rover, you are a member of the Pioneer Association. You are sort of like my family now!
Guide_TSDXT_2_21: By the way, you should check out our expansive selection of publications and merchandise here, Rover. Now we've got the latest issue of Wutherium Geographic, the thrilling series of Into the Depths of Waves, and subscription discount coupons for our Pioneer Podcast...
Guide_TSDXT_2_22: There's also the bestselling All You Have to Know about Wuthering Waves and The One Hundred Lives of a Pioneer Association Reporter, plus our customer favorite—Gulpuff plushies!
Guide_TSDXT_2_23: New customers can buy one and get one 50% off!
Guide_TSDXT_2_28: We publish two periodicals actually. Wutherium Geographic for general readers, and Post-Lament Anthropocene for academics.
Guide_TSDXT_2_29: If you're interested in subscribing to our magazines, tell me now and we’ll send the latest issues to your doorstep every month!
Guide_TSDXT_2_30: For adventurers looking for top-notch entertainment, our Pioneer Podcast has it all. The Podcast is free, and there's also an Insider Channel for paid subscribers.
Guide_TSDXT_2_31: With diverse shows covering news, music, and science, there's something for everyone.
Guide_TSDXT_2_32: The Insider Channel features updates on ongoing explorations by contracted reporters and seasoned explorers.
Guide_TSDXT_2_33: Let me know if you'd like to subscribe!
Guide_TSDXT_2_34: Oops, Gulpuff plushies sold out... Want me to reserve one for you?
Guide_TSDXT_2_35: Anyway, you can always reach out for help on your journey. The Pioneer Association is here for you through any obstacles!

Guide_BWHC_10_3: I’ve got some synthesis materials right here. Go ahead, give it a try.
Guide_BWHC_10_4: It might seem a bit tricky just hearing about it, but once you try it hands-on, you’ll get the hang of it real quick.
Guide_BWHC_11_1: How do you feel? Quite handy, huh?
Guide_BWHC_11_2: With technology getting fancier by the day, life’s becoming a breeze around here.

Guide_BWHC_12_5: While it may not end up being a regular menu item, we’ve put in a lot of effort to gather the ingredients, so it would be a shame not to at least try it. Besides, there are loads of folks out there dying to give it a try.
Guide_BWHC_12_7: We won’t know how it tastes until we give it a shot.
Guide_BWHC_12_8: True. You’ve gone through all the trouble to gather the ingredients. It’d be a shame not to give it a try. Come on, everyone. The stove’s right here. Let’s whip it up together!
Guide_BWHC_13_1: After some dedicated effort, you successfully prepared the Essence Medley Soup together.
Guide_BWHC_13_2: You, Chixia, and Panhua taste the Essence Medley Soup together.
Guide_BWHC_13_3: The combination of bitter medicine and delightful ingredients creates a unique taste on your tongue. You notice the same intricate expression mirrored on the faces of the other two.

Guide_BWHC_14_1: Wow, can you believe we’ve covered almost half of Jinzhou in just one day?
Guide_BWHC_14_2: Tiring, but so worth it! I’m usually tied up with patrols, so catching up with so many friends all at once like this is a total first for me.
Guide_BWHC_14_3: Introducing you to everyone, shooting the breeze... It’s like reconnecting with old friends all over again. Wait, didn’t I promise to treat you to a meal? How did it end up with you being my tour buddy instead?
Guide_BWHC_14_4: But hey, thanks to you, I finally get why folks rave about the Essence Medley Soup as they do.
Guide_BWHC_14_5: Brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients, with every essence distilled into a single bowl... The real treasure lies in everyone’s willingness to share their most prized grub, don’t you think?
Guide_BWHC_14_7: Exactly! If we were back in wartime, Auntie Panhua reminding me to eat on time, Uncle Mahe caring about my work, Koko fretting over my safety, Uncle Wei dropping knowledge bombs on me, and all the other folks in Jinzhou...
Guide_BWHC_14_8: They’d all without a doubt open up their pantries and share their most cherished grub with us.
Guide_BWHC_14_9: As for me, I wanna be someone who can protect every single soul in Jinzhou... including you! I wanna keep you safe too! I’ve had a great time hanging out with you.
Guide_BWHC_14_10: So, while we’re in Jinzhou, let me shoulder your worries and troubles, alright?
Guide_BWHC_14_11: Looks like I can’t say no.
Guide_BWHC_14_12: You can bet on this Jinzhou Speedster’s determination!

Guide_BWHC_2_4: No worries. Delicacies are always worth the wait.

Guide_BWHC_2_10: Oh dear, then I must show {Male=him;Female=her} something!
Guide_BWHC_2_11: Any preferences or dislikes? Sweet, salty, sour, spicy, just let me know what you like. There’s always a Jinzhou cuisine for every taste!
Guide_BWHC_2_12: I prefer something light, something that lets the ingredients shine.
Guide_BWHC_2_14: I’m not picky. Chixia, any recommendations?
Guide_BWHC_2_15: Alright, something light... Find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Guide_BWHC_2_16: Before long, Panhua served up the dishes. The delicious pairing of sweet Candied Caltrops and slow-cooked Jinzhou Stew made you hungry.
Guide_BWHC_2_17: Alright, something spicy... Find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.

Guide_BWHC_2_20: I’ve decided. Let’s get all of them.

Guide_BWHC_2_24: To cater to all appetites, Auntie Panhua’s rolled out a small portion menu. Same fantastic flavors, just less food waste. So, no need to fret about over-ordering!
Guide_BWHC_2_25: Alright, find yourselves a spot inside. The dishes will be ready soon.
Guide_BWHC_2_26: Before long, Panhua served up the dishes. The delicious mix of Candied Caltrops, Poached Chicken in sauce, and Jinzhou Stew made your mouth water.
Guide_BWHC_2_28: Yeah, it was amazing. I’ll certainly be back for more.
Guide_BWHC_2_30: I want something special this time.

Guide_BWHC_2_32: If you come next time, I’ll have to treat you to a taste of my famous Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_2_33: That’s all? Seriously? Not even Auntie Panhua’s culinary magic can shake you?
Guide_BWHC_2_34: Looks like I’ll have to introduce you to the wonders of the Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_2_35: Something special? Hmm, give me some time to think.
Guide_BWHC_2_36: In that case, I’ll have to introduce you to the wonders of the Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_2_38: It's brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients. Every essence is simmered and distilled into a single bowl. Some gourmets claim it's the epitome of Jinzhou's flavor, captured in a nutshell.
Guide_BWHC_2_39: Don't tell me you're thinking of trying it right now...
Guide_BWHC_2_41: It sounds super delicious. I’m eager to give it a taste myself.
Guide_BWHC_2_42: Even though I just polished off my plate, there’s always room for soup in my second stomach. Rover, fancy trying it out? Auntie Panhua, can you whip it up for us?
Guide_BWHC_2_43: Whoa, did you hear that? Brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients! My taste buds are tingling already... Rover, fancy trying it out? Auntie Panhua, can you whip it up for us?
Guide_BWHC_2_44: It's not that I'm unwilling to make it right now... In fact, it's an old wartime dish, a recipe lost to the ages. We keep it alive through word of mouth, preserving its memory. Now, about its taste, people have a lot of fun debates about it, but one thing's certain: it's like a warm, fresh hug, absolutely delightful and unforgettable.
Guide_BWHC_2_45: However, while searching through old books, I stumbled upon its recipe. Though, calling it a recipe might be a stretch. See, back then, they used names for ingredients that are like riddles to us now. “Red beads,” “sweet roots,” “Monkvyrid,” “golden handle spoon”... I have no idea what they are.
Guide_BWHC_2_46: Speaking of peculiar ingredients, it does remind me of someone...
Guide_BWHC_2_48: Stop beating around the bush. Just tell me. I won’t take offense.
Guide_BWHC_2_50: Hmph, he’s always bragging about how he can get any ingredient, but if he’s clueless about these, he’s just wasting his time in this business.
Guide_BWHC_2_51: Just so we’re clear, I won’t go to him for answers, but if you want to give him a shot with this recipe, it’s your call.
Guide_BWHC_2_52: Auntie Panhua! You’ve got the sweetest heart. I always knew it!
Guide_BWHC_2_53: Alright, I’ll copy the recipe for you.
Guide_BWHC_2_54: I’ll take a stroll around the city with Chixia to get a feel for the place.
Guide_BWHC_2_55: Once the soup’s done, don’t forget to let us have a taste!
Guide_BWHC_2_56: Don’t worry! I won’t let you do it for nothing! Auntie here will make sure you eat your fill!
Guide_BWHC_3_1: Well, well, look who’s here. Chixia, back at it with the deliveries, eh?
Guide_BWHC_3_2: Nah, that makes me sound like a delivery person. Besides, I’ve got a whole bunch of other stuff on my plate, you know? But hey, I’m here to ask you to check out this recipe.
Guide_BWHC_3_3: Haha, but I truly owe you big time for lending a hand. You’re the reason those elderly folks with mobility issues get their goods on time. Thanks!
Guide_BWHC_3_4: You’re always on the go, I see. You’re always there to help, whether it’s on patrols or off duty. I suppose deciphering this recipe is just another one of your good deeds?
Guide_BWHC_3_5: Well, yeah... But fun fact, it’s Auntie Panhua who gave me this recipe.
Guide_BWHC_3_6: What? Is she in trouble? Hand over the recipe!
Guide_BWHC_3_7: After listening to your explanation, Mahe scrutinizes the old recipe.
Guide_BWHC_3_8: Hmm? There’s clearly something going on between them!
Guide_BWHC_3_9: Hey, Uncle Mahe, did you catch any hints?
Guide_BWHC_3_10: Their dynamic is something else, like straight out of a Hero Play, you know? She’s all caring, and he’s all caring, but she’s playing it cool like she doesn’t care. You catch my drift?
Guide_BWHC_3_11: I see. They’re doing that whole "acting-cold-but-secretly-caring" thing, right?
Guide_BWHC_3_12: Oh my, it’s like a puzzle! Impossible to crack.
Guide_BWHC_3_13: Chixia, you seem to know a lot.
Guide_BWHC_3_14: Oh yeah! That’s right! Didn’t realize you had such a knack for summarizing. You must be a big fan of Hero Plays, am I right?
Guide_BWHC_3_15: Never mind. Relationships are like tangled webs, even I can’t untangle them!
Guide_BWHC_3_16: Of course! I’m like a walking encyclopedia for all things in Jinzhou! Worries and woes, they’re all part of the package when dealing with relationships!
Guide_BWHC_3_17: ...Ah, I see. This recipe seems to be quite old. It uses old-fashioned aliases instead of the ones we’re familiar with, making it tricky to decipher.
Guide_BWHC_3_18: Let me see... The red gems here must be Gemberries. Sweet roots are Caltrops, and there’s also Kudzu, Honeysuckles... Lucky for you, I’ve got all these ingredients. I’ll sort them out for you later.
Guide_BWHC_3_19: Uncle Mahe’s got quite the collection here.
Guide_BWHC_3_20: Absolutely! Uncle Mahe’s the go-to guy for anything and everything in Jinzhou. Not only food ingredients, he can get you many strange things!
Guide_BWHC_3_21: If there’s anything you wanna buy, just come take a look.
Guide_BWHC_3_22: Chixia, you’re being too kind. It’s entirely all thanks to everyone in the neighborhood supporting my business. If you need anything, just let me know.

Guide_BWHC_3_26: I know every food alias in the book, and these two are clearly not food ingredients.
Guide_BWHC_3_27: I’m not good at cooking, but this recipe looks like it could be a medicinal cuisine or a chowder because it has many different ingredients in small amounts. What’s your take?
Guide_BWHC_3_28: Are we looking in the wrong direction?
Guide_BWHC_3_29: Maybe...? I got it! If it’s a medicinal recipe, we can go ask Koko at Shifang Pharmacy! She’s all about that medicinal recipe life, so she might just have the hookup.
Guide_BWHC_3_30: Thanks for the inspiration! Uncle Mahe, how much are these ingredients? I’ll cover the bill.
Guide_BWHC_3_31: Hey, they’re free. You’ve been an enormous help, and I appreciate it. Plus, I have a thing for Panhua... er, for what Panhua wants to make. Count me in for a taste, alright?
Guide_BWHC_3_32: You betcha! If Auntie Panhua whips this up, you’re getting a front-row seat to taste it!
Guide_BWHC_4_1: We’ve covered more ground from Gourmet Street to here. Bet you haven’t had many city strolls like this before, huh?
Guide_BWHC_4_2: Even though it’s a bit of a trek, I’m thrilled to show you around my hometown. We’re nearing the Main Street, where things get even more interesting.
Guide_BWHC_5_1: Hello there, how can I help...? Oh, Ms. Chixia?
Guide_BWHC_5_2: What brought you here? Picking up medicine for someone else, or feeling under the weather? Any injuries? Have you seen a doctor? Need any prescriptions?
Guide_BWHC_5_3: Wow, quite the enthusiastic welcome there.
Guide_BWHC_5_4: It seems you get worried for her pretty often.
Guide_BWHC_5_5: Oh no, it’s just a habit I’ve picked up from running this pharmacy. Sometimes people struggle to describe their symptoms, so I ask a lot of questions to get a clearer picture.
Guide_BWHC_5_6: Yeah... Hold up! Rover, what’s that supposed to mean? Obviously, I...
Guide_BWHC_5_7: Obviously, just like this {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} said, once you get carried away, you forget your own safety!
Guide_BWHC_5_8: Ms. Chixia, you’re the reigning champ on our pharmacy’s medication leaderboard. While I wholeheartedly appreciate your support, topping the charts won’t result in any discounts here.
Guide_BWHC_5_9: Seriously, don’t you have work to do? Who keeps tabs on this stuff anyway!
Guide_BWHC_5_10: Alright, let’s cut to the chase. {PlayerName} and I are here to get you to check out this recipe Auntie Panhua handed us.
Guide_BWHC_5_11: Essence Medley Soup? I felt like I heard it from my grandmother or someone of her generation.
Guide_BWHC_5_12: Really? C’mon, wrack your brain for it! Uncle Mahe thinks it’s more of a medicinal cuisine than a regular dish.
Guide_BWHC_5_13: Let's see... Caltrops, Kudzu, Honeysuckles, a handful of Gemberries, and some pulled poultry breast. Simmer with water from the Monkvyrid. Once it's boiled, give it a stir with a golden-handled spoon... Water from the Monkvyrid? Isn't that the medicinal soup made from Coriolus, Perilla, and Lemongrass?
Guide_BWHC_5_14: Who knew the medicinal soup could serve as a base... In a way, it leans towards medicinal cuisine. But with so many ingredients, wouldn’t it dilute the medicinal effect? There’s always something new to learn in dietary therapy.
Guide_BWHC_5_15: Since we know the ingredients required, Chixia and I will head out and grab what we need.
Guide_BWHC_5_16: Are you interested in dietary therapy?
Guide_BWHC_5_17: No need to go through all that trouble. Remember where you are? A pharmacy! I’ve got some pre-made medicinal soup right here.
Guide_BWHC_5_18: Good medicine often tastes bitter, so I've been thinking of ways to make it more palatable.
Guide_BWHC_5_19: By making it into medicinal cuisine, we preserve its healing qualities while getting rid of the bitterness, so it’s enjoyable for everyone.
Guide_BWHC_5_20: This recipe seems ancient. The Monkvyrid water is an old term from pharmacies, referring to that medicinal soup. Hold on, I’ve got the pre-made stuff for you.
Guide_BWHC_5_21: Oh, and here are some new recovery and synthesis potions. Consider them a bonus.
Guide_BWHC_5_22: But even with potions to treat your injuries, stay safe out there, alright? Always keep your guard up when exploring.
Guide_BWHC_5_23: Don’t be like Chixia, just barging in and scaring everyone.
Guide_BWHC_5_26: Are you for real right now? My reputation as the Jinzhou Speedster is...
Guide_BWHC_5_27: I-I had no other choice! How can I remember all those safety rules when there are bad guys coming at me? They’d only slow me down... Okay, okay, next time, I’ll watch out!
Guide_BWHC_5_28: So, are you two heading back to help Auntie Panhua with this Essence Medley Soup? If so, count me in on learning that recipe too!
Guide_BWHC_5_29: Just let Auntie Panhua know. It should be cool for you to join in!
Guide_BWHC_5_30: But there's still one last piece of the puzzle to crack: the golden-handled spoon. If we whip up the soup without figuring out what that is about, the flavor might not hit the mark, right?
Guide_BWHC_5_31: Wait, isn’t the golden handle spoon that big pyrite spoon from Uncle Wei’s shop? I thought you both knew.
Guide_BWHC_5_32: The answer was right in front of us all along.
Guide_BWHC_5_33: That makes sense... After all, pyrite is called fool’s gold.
Guide_BWHC_5_34: Seriously? No way! Who’d have guessed that!
Guide_BWHC_5_35: Oops, looks like I gotta step down from my role as the Jinzhou encyclopedia. I’ve never even heard of that pyrite spoon!
Guide_BWHC_5_36: Haha, no worries. I spotted that spoon the last time I dropped off medicine at Uncle Wei’s and asked out of curiosity.
Guide_BWHC_5_37: Why does the best weapon maker in Jinzhou have a big pyrite spoon tucked away? Well, I’m counting on you to solve that mystery, along with the last step of the recipe.
Guide_BWHC_7_1: Check it out. That’s Uncle Wei’s weapon shop right over there.
Guide_BWHC_7_2: He’s the top-notch weapon maker in Jinzhou! If you have any weapon-related questions, just go ask him.
Guide_BWHC_7_3: How’s your weapon maintenance? Once we figure out what that big spoon deal is, you can ask him to check it for you!
Guide_BWHC_8_1: Well, well, if it isn’t our Xiaofang. Back so soon? Didn’t I just fix up your pistols last week? You broke them again already?
Guide_BWHC_8_2: ...Aw, please don’t call me Xiaofang! It’s Chixia!
Guide_BWHC_8_3: Oh no, I'm doomed. It seems everyone knows my other name now.
Guide_BWHC_8_4: Haha, you’re exaggerating. As far as I know, only we, your old pals, are calling you that.
Guide_BWHC_8_5: Uncle Wei, no need to tease her.
Guide_BWHC_8_7: Cool, cool. Let’s get to business then.
Guide_BWHC_8_8: {PlayerName}, you too?! No, please no... Let’s keep that name between us, alright?
Guide_BWHC_8_9: Anyway, we're here to help Auntie Panhua recreate the Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_8_10: The recipe says we need to stir it with a golden-handled spoon once it starts bubbling. And Koko mentioned you happen to have a pyrite spoon with that exact name, right?
Guide_BWHC_8_12: That’s right. The golden handle spoon, indeed the pyrite spoon I have. And let me tell you, I have a bit of history with this Essence Medley Soup. Any guess what this soup is all about?
Guide_BWHC_8_16: Just a simple brew of herbs, really. Barely qualifies as medicinal cuisine in my book.
Guide_BWHC_8_17: Well, I don’t think it’s a formal dish, seeing as we just throw a bunch of ingredients together.
Guide_BWHC_8_18: Haha, you have the point. It’s indeed a chowder, but not an ordinary one.
Guide_BWHC_8_19: You youngsters didn’t witness the making of this soup. Back then, Jinzhou was still under construction, right around the year-end. Every household would bring out their cherished foods to share. And if they had nothing, they’d whip up some medicinal soup. If that wasn’t an option, they’d pitch in however they could.
Guide_BWHC_8_20: And that’s when I forged this large pyrite spoon. Made stirring that big pot a breeze. What a shame though, those border guards insisted on every bit of metal being used for weapons. Otherwise, you’d still see it around.
Guide_BWHC_8_21: So that’s the authentic Essence Medley Soup.
Guide_BWHC_8_23: No wonder Auntie Panhua said it’s passed down through word of mouth, sparking debates over its flavor.
Guide_BWHC_8_24: Seems like this recipe is more of a shopping list than a detailed guide.
Guide_BWHC_8_25: I know it must be delicious.
Guide_BWHC_8_26: Is it really going to taste good?
Guide_BWHC_8_27: Absolutely! Every household pulled out their secret stash of ingredients to brew up this soup. It’s gotta be divine.
Guide_BWHC_8_28: Even if it doesn’t require any fancy cooking techniques, those good reviews can’t be bogus, right? Just like Auntie Panhua said, it’s brewed from the finest Jinzhou ingredients...
Guide_BWHC_8_29: Now I’m even more eager to get a taste, knowing the backstory! Uncle Wei, mind lending us your big pyrite spoon?
Guide_BWHC_8_30: The reason that the spoon affects the soup's flavor is because it releases a few minerals while stirring. You could use a smaller pyrite spoon instead.
Guide_BWHC_8_31: That makes sense... By the way, doesn’t Auntie Panhua already have one on standby?
Guide_BWHC_8_32: Since we’re here, might as well make the most of it. Can you lend a hand and check out my friend’s weapon?
Guide_BWHC_8_33: Ah, I remember you. New to Jinzhou, right? You’re that... that...
Guide_BWHC_8_36: That’s right. Madam Magistrate mentioned you’re Jinzhou’s guest.
Guide_BWHC_8_37: Let’s have a look at your weapon... Hm, this wear and tear... Can’t let youngsters like you wander around with a weapon in this state.
Guide_BWHC_8_38: Here, take these unused <color=Highlight>casting molds and ores</color> the Ordnance Division gave me. They’re the building blocks of a weapon. With these, you can forge a new one.
Guide_BWHC_8_39: I feel bad for taking them...
Guide_BWHC_8_41: Kid, materials are meant to be used. If you want to thank me, put them to good use.
Guide_BWHC_9_1: Well, this weapon looks decent enough. Take care of it, alright?
Guide_BWHC_9_2: If you don’t like what you’re currently using or want another one made, come find me anytime. As long as you've got the <color=Highlight>casting molds and ores</color>, I'll make it for you.
Guide_BWHC_9_4: No need to be so formal, kid. I’m not really useful for much else besides tinkering with weapons.
Guide_BWHC_9_5: Just so you know, the ores and materials I just gave you aren’t top-notch. For higher-quality stuff, you’ll want to check out the Synthesizer.
Guide_BWHC_9_6: Oh, I heard about it! It's a new type of device the Academy introduced a couple of years back, right over there!
Guide_BWHC_9_7: Well, since you know the place, how about having Chixia show you the way there? If you’re short on materials, I can...
Guide_BWHC_9_8: Hey, no worries, Uncle Wei. I just snagged some synthesis materials recently. Rover can borrow mine!
Guide_BWHC_9_9: Once we check out the Synthesizer, we’ll head straight back to Auntie Panhua’s restaurant. Just sit tight for the good news about whipping up that Essence Medley Soup.

Flow_31000124_429: None of those rings any bells.
Flow_31000124_430: Once you spot a moon, let me know! Hoohoo and I will bring it back to this place. Let's come back here once we're doen checking all of the places.
Flow_31000124_433: Fantastic! No wonder they all admire you!
Flow_31000124_434: Let me see. There seem to be words on these moons...
Flow_31000124_435: Moon... on the tree... gives happiness... Mey all go well you... I think this person meant "May all go well with you."
Flow_31000124_436: Looks like a child's work. The handwriting looks a bit crooked, and it's mostly phrases of good wishes and greetings.
Flow_31000124_437: I wonder who carved them... Anyway, let's hang these up!
Flow_31000124_440: Rover, look! So beautiful! The entire Violet Banyan is illuminated!
Flow_31000124_441: But why the artificial moons... Judging by the story in that nursery rhyme and the words on the moons, someone must have lived here long ago!
Flow_31000124_442: I've read about a type of creature called "Suan'ni" that once lived this place. But unfortunately, they're nowhere to be found now.
Flow_31000124_443: Theoretically, they don't speak human languages. With the limited info we have, who knows if it's true?
Flow_31000124_444: Perhaps those Suan'nis hung these moons.
Flow_31000124_445: Having lived in this dark place for so long, they may have yearned for light, even if it's just artificial moonlight.
Flow_31000124_446: Anyway, this is just a guess. There are still many mysteries in the Dim Forest waiting for us to unveil.
Flow_31000124_448: Hoohoo's curious too! We'll keep exploring and see if we find more clues.
Flow_31000124_449: Thank you so much for helping us, Rover! Hope to see you again soon!
Flow_31000124_451: A hand-carved moon full of bumps and hollows, with "Mey all go well with you" written on it…
Flow_31000124_452: Something seems carved on it... "moon… tree... happiness.."
Flow_31000124_453: It feels heavy to pull up. Not sure if it still works...
Flow_31000124_454: This moon seems a bit rusty. Hopefully, it can still be lit up…
Flow_31000124_455: The moon pool… It should be a crescent-shaped pool nearby…
Flow_31000124_456: A cave with dry branches... It should be here.
Flow_31000124_458: It's okay! I've marked potential hiding spots on the map. Can you go check them out?
Flow_31000124_459: Look! There's a moon hanging there, like a small lamp.
Flow_31000124_460: It's been hanging above the Violet Banyan for a long, long time.
Flow_31000124_461: No clue who put it there, but it brightens up the place and lifts our spirits.
Flow_31000124_462: Hoohoo and I are both interested in this moon, so we've been investigating it for a while.
Flow_31000124_464: We found a booklet on the moon.
Flow_31000124_465: Check it out. It's a bit worn, but the content is still clear to read.
Flow_31000124_466: It's got a nursery rhyme about the moon. Quite intriguing. Take a look.
Flow_31000124_472: Sounds like you've made some discoveries.
Flow_135000002_89: It looks like the lamp in the lighthouse is damaged and might need an engineer to fix it. Look for help along the way.
Flow_135000002_199: The announcement says the power to this lighthouse is scheduled to be restored in the near future for the retrofit project.
Flow_135000002_200:
The power supply facility is located at the entrance to the ramp below the lighthouse. For more information, please contact the members of the Ministry of Development Infrastructure Division stationed at the power supply facility.

Side_DTMZ_10_2: I don't know how you're keeping a straight face while you fight TDs like that. Must be a perk of being a Resonator.
Side_DTMZ_10_3: If it were a normal person... All they can do is run for their lives. Just like me. *sigh*
Side_DTMZ_11_1: What took you so long...? Did you go slacking off again?
Side_DTMZ_11_2: Chief! I can explain! It was those TDs. I-I wanted to get back as fast I could. You can ask Rover what happened.
Side_DTMZ_11_4: All right. I'll let it slide this time... Well, since you still got your arms and legs, get over here and give me a hand with this thing, will ya?
Side_DTMZ_11_5: The engineers fixed up the the lighthouse in no time.
Side_DTMZ_11_6: There. Don't know how many years this old hunk of building's got in it, but the people who built it did a good reliable job. Most of the equipments inside are still in running condition.
Side_DTMZ_11_7: Now, you can get up there and see what you can find, Rover. You should be able to get the console going.

Side_DTMZ_12_3: This is Acting Captain Moak of the Stingray... Today is our forty-third day since our departure from the harbor.
Side_DTMZ_12_4: Xie Qi reported the ship's first sighting of a lighthouse's light beam from up on the highlands. We followed it and arrived at these coordinates in preparation for landing...
Side_DTMZ_12_5: To our surprise, not a single person was found on the shores, only the lighthouse projecting its lonely light... Not a very assuring sight to say the least.
Side_DTMZ_12_6: Xie Qi insisted on staying... As an engineer, he wanted to stay behind and modify the communications equipment of the lighthouse.
Side_DTMZ_12_7: In his words, with necessary modifications in place should make communication with other survivors possible. He'll inform us when the time comes... We hope his efforts will not go in vain.
Side_DTMZ_12_8: Since Xie Qi's the brightest out of any of us, he wouldn't have suggested it if he didn't know what he was doing. We respected his decision and provided him some of the supplies before setting sail again.

Side_DTMZ_14_4: Three months has passed, and the Stingray is running dry on her fuel reserves. We'll soon be drifting on open waters at this rate...
Side_DTMZ_14_5: At long last we spotted another lighthouse on the edge of this forest. No traces of those monsters.
Side_DTMZ_14_6: Chances of finding fuel in this forest is non-existent, but at least there's plenty of fruits and mushrooms to go around.
Side_DTMZ_14_7: Qi Shuqing and Rana agreed to disembark and start a living here. They plan on building a wooden house, raise a vegetable field, and become self-sufficient. A small home of their own.
Side_DTMZ_14_8: Initially, I thought of talking them into staying aboard, but there's no guarantee the monsters won't appear again... even on sea.
Side_DTMZ_14_9: In a time where the path leading to tomorrow is obscured, being able to live a simple life with the people you love is probably the last bit of happiness one can savor.
