Side_DTMZ_17_4: Everything else was swiftly taken care of for a genius such as myself.
Side_DTMZ_17_5: Little did I expect to get stuck at the final step of turning on the power...
Side_DTMZ_17_7: This power station utilizes a pulsed power supply system. After the battery is installed, the circuit must be fully connected within a certain time frame.
Side_DTMZ_17_8: In order to complete the connection, the <color=Highlight>pylons</color> along the circuit must be activated using physical force in sequential order within the time limit.
Side_DTMZ_17_9: Unfortunately, I was only bestowed with a genius brain but not strong physiques. I've always been at the bottom in terms of fitness, and I simply can't complete the route in time.
Side_DTMZ_17_10: I can offer you some help.
Side_DTMZ_17_11: Really?! You would do that? Thank you!
Side_DTMZ_18_1: There's just no way I can activate all the <color=Highlight>pylons</color> leading up to the lighthouse within such a short time period...
Side_DTMZ_19_1: H-Hello? Rover, can you hear me?
Side_DTMZ_19_2: The electromagnetic pulse just went out... I guess you didn't make it in time. You should come back for another run.
Side_DTMZ_2_1: (The power's reconnected. The console is back online.)
Side_DTMZ_2_2: (Let's head back to the lighthouse and <color=Highlight>hack</color> into the console.)
Side_DTMZ_20_1: It's proving to be a bit harder than expected, huh? Want to give it another go, Rover?
Side_DTMZ_20_2: Just reinstall the <color=Highlight>power unit</color> and the electromagnetic pulse will start its count down.
Side_DTMZ_20_3: Try to pick up the pace a notch this time. I'm counting on you, Rover!

Side_DTMZ_22_3: Stingray here... Acting Captain Moak recording...
Side_DTMZ_22_4: I say Captain, but I'm actually the only one left on this ship. This morning, Espey, my last companion, also quietly left the Stingray unnoticed.
Side_DTMZ_22_5: It was already late evening when we found this lighthouse on the mountain yesterday, so we made an approach and prepared to go on land and check the place out after dawn, as we have done in the past.
Side_DTMZ_22_6: It wasn't until dawn that I found Espey had already gone missing... I'd thought that he had escaped with all the remaining supplies.
Side_DTMZ_22_7: But I was quickly put to shame by my own suspicions—the supplies were untouched. Espey left them all for me.
Side_DTMZ_22_8: He knew fully well that the remaining supplies weren't enough to support two people on sea, so he left the last hopes of life to me and went ashore to seek for survival.
Side_DTMZ_22_9: What an idiot... Even if we both were to die at sea, I would never have the thought of abandoning my crew.
Side_DTMZ_22_10: So I left some supplies at these coordinates, hoping that they would be useful to him... From here on out, this will be the final voyage for me and the Stingray.

Side_DTMZ_24_3: This is the Stingray... Acting Captain Moak recording...
Side_DTMZ_24_4: This morning, I received a communication from Xie Qi. The bastard actually managed to make contact with some survivors.
Side_DTMZ_24_5: He tells me that the disaster is over. All the monsters have been wiped out, and the crisis of humanity has been resolved.
Side_DTMZ_24_6: Best of all, the crew members that stayed behind on land are all safe and sound. It's news nothing more worth celebrating.
Side_DTMZ_24_7: Our seventeen-month-long voyage on the sea has finally come to an end. I'm preparing to return to the harbor where it all began. This journey of suspense is finally over.
Side_DTMZ_24_8: I don't plan on bringing the remaining supplies back with me, so I buried them somewhere near the lighthouse. Maybe they can come in handy for someone in need oneday.
Side_DTMZ_24_9: *chuckle* But it wouldn't be fun if they're too easy to find, would it? I left behind a little riddle. I'm sure anyone who happens to listen to this recording can solve it.
Side_DTMZ_25_1: Hello, hello! You must be the one who solved the mysteries of the lighthouses.
Side_DTMZ_25_3: Please, describe to me your findings within the consoles. I am truly intrigued.
Side_DTMZ_25_4: You tell the historian about what you found inside the consoles.
Side_DTMZ_25_5: Hmm... I didn't expect such stories to have occurred.
Side_DTMZ_25_6: What was the final destination of the "Stingray"? A question that would truly arouse one's interest... It feels that this would make a wonderful research topic.
Side_DTMZ_25_7: Having studied the historical records, I have learned that there are five of these identical lighthouses within Jinzhou in total.
Side_DTMZ_25_8: Obtaining the records from all of the lighthouses' consoles may just reveal the whereabouts of the "Stingray."
Side_DTMZ_25_9: Can I ask you to find the records of the remaining lighthouses? I'll prepare gifts in return for your troubles!
Side_DTMZ_25_10: Not a problem, leave it to me.
Side_DTMZ_25_11: Doesn't matter. I'm just here for the history part.
Side_DTMZ_25_12: Haha. Then I shall entrust the task to you!
Side_DTMZ_26_1: Hello, hello! You must be the one who solved the mysteries of the lighthouses.
Side_DTMZ_26_3: Please, describe to me your findings within the consoles. I am truly intrigued.
Side_DTMZ_26_4: You tell the historian what you found inside the consoles.
Side_DTMZ_26_5: How could this be?! You managed to find information from all five lighthouse consoles you say...!
Side_DTMZ_26_6: Your passion for history is much greater than that of my own pupils. This brings tears to my eyes.
Side_DTMZ_26_7: Are we now able to find the location of the Stingray?
Side_DTMZ_26_8: Of course, this information is more than adequate for me to calculate the Stingray's whereabouts. But there is something strange about this...
Side_DTMZ_26_9: What is it? You can't find it?
Side_DTMZ_26_10: No. It's just that it is not worth searching for it anymore.
Side_DTMZ_26_11: According to those coordinates, I can say with confidence that this Stingray is the same ship that we salvaged near the harbor of the Whining Aix's Mire a few years prior.
Side_DTMZ_26_12: Inside the wreckage, we found some of the crew's logs, although broken into pieces, we still managed to link them with the stories found in the consoles.
Side_DTMZ_26_13: So were Moak and his crew all safe?
Side_DTMZ_26_14: Unfortunately, we also discovered six bodies inside... Based on the information we have, they belong to Moak and his crew members.
Side_DTMZ_26_16: Further investigations found that the deaths of the other five members date back even further than the time when Moak made his first recording in the lighthouse.
Side_DTMZ_26_17: In other words, Moak had been sailing on the sea alone all this time, and his crew members had long since fallen victim to the TDs...
Side_DTMZ_26_18: Experiencing such losses, Moak refused to accept such an ending. So he fell into a fantasy, that he and his crew members all found the lighthouses one by one, found their own homes, and left the Stingray safely.
Side_DTMZ_26_19: In the end, only he himself completed the voyage and forever laid in that seabed with the Stingray.
Side_DTMZ_26_20: Are you sure this is what truly happened...?
Side_DTMZ_26_21: I cannot make any guarantees, as these are just my own speculations. Yet, unfolding forgotten stories, is what makes history fascinating.
Side_DTMZ_26_22: Regardless, I'm really grateful for letting me see the whole story. Your passion for history truly deserves these rewards.

Side_DTMZ_4_6: They were supposed to meet right by the lighthouse. He's a month late, wonder if they'd kicked him out of the school for it by now.

Side_DTMZ_8_2: I can't even imagine how people managed to deal with them back in the old days.

Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_4: I need to head out to the city to stock up on some supplies, but I'm worried about leaving him out there.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_5: Oh. Where are my manners? I'm Xiaoju, the owner of this here restaurant.
Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_6: Are you here for a bite to eat? Sorry, but we're not open for the day yet.

Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_2_11: I'll bring him back for you.

Daliy_ZJSJZJMM_3_10: Don't be afraid. It's just... how I show my love for cats, that's all.

Side_DSDPJ_1_1: Rover? What a pleasant surprise. I've heard a lot about you!
Side_DSDPJ_1_2: I'm Beigu, the captain of the camp. Currently caught up in an investigation regarding a theft case.
Side_DSDPJ_1_4: Lollo Logistics regularly delivers supplies to the camp, covering all our needs. When they unloaded the supplies, the quantities matched our order perfectly.
Side_DSDPJ_1_5: However, during the nightly inventory check, a team member responsible for counting noticed one box missing, though it was not something important.
Side_DSDPJ_1_6: But we still need to figure out where it went.
Side_DSDPJ_1_7: You're right. It's packed with everyone's favorite hometown dishes.
Side_DSDPJ_1_8: To treat the soldiers here,  I secretly asked Panhua to prepare a batch of pre-made dishes—
Side_DSDPJ_1_11: My apologies. It's been a while since I last visited Jinzhou. I miss the hometown dishes so much.
Side_DSDPJ_1_12: Anyway, I hope you can keep our conversation between us. Unfortunately, I can't conduct the investigation myself.
Side_DSDPJ_1_13: For the soldiers here, trust is often more valuable than their lives. It's built through shared experiences and overcoming challenges together. I don't want this incident to sow even the smallest seed of doubt.
Side_DSDPJ_1_14: So you want me to find out the truth for you?
Side_DSDPJ_1_16: As a token of gratitude, I'll treat you to a feast at Panhua's Restaurant.
Side_DSDPJ_1_18: Without further ado, you can start by checking the guard post. Investigate the entry and exit records from yesterday afternoon until now.
Side_DSDPJ_10_2: What… what can I do for you?
Side_DSDPJ_10_3: The oil stains on your clothes…
Side_DSDPJ_10_4: Ugh, I went back to Jinzhou not long ago. I accidentally splashed some on while eating at Panhua's Restaurant.
Side_DSDPJ_11_2: Well, I also have a preliminary speculation. Rover, who do you think took away the supplies?
Side_DSDPJ_11_6: It's a bit different from what I expected. Maybe it's someone else.
Side_DSDPJ_11_7: It's a bit different from what I expected. Maybe it's someone else.
Side_DSDPJ_11_8: Seems like we're on the same page. Let's go talk to Wuheng.
Side_DSDPJ_13_1: Rover, thank you for your help.
Side_DSDPJ_13_3: She left her hometown at a young age and has been stationed at the camp for years. No one ever taught her how to handle mistakes, which is why she dealt with them in such a straightforward way.
Side_DSDPJ_13_4: As a soldier, she left her post without permission, trying to solve a problem that was beyond her ability. She should have placed more trust in her comrades. There's still much for her to learn.
Side_DSDPJ_13_5: As for those spilled dishes, I'll let Wuheng make up for it by cooking them for us.
Side_DSDPJ_13_6: Rover, when I return to Jinzhou, let's meet again at Panhua's Restaurant!
Side_DSDPJ_2_1: Hi, Rover! What can I do for you?
Side_DSDPJ_2_3: Oh, you want to look into the entry and exit records, huh?
Side_DSDPJ_2_4: Even though I just started this post this morning, I can check the duty log for you. It has all personnel entry and exit records. Just give me a moment.
Side_DSDPJ_2_6: Other than the Lollo Logistics delivery folks, there aren't any other entry and exit records.
Side_DSDPJ_2_8: Aren't you curious about why there's an investigation going on?
Side_DSDPJ_2_9: General Jiyan asked all members of the Midnight Rangers to assist you in any way possible.
Side_DSDPJ_2_10: So, whatever your reason is, I'm glad I can help you.
Side_DSDPJ_3_1: No one entered or left the camp.
Side_DSDPJ_3_2: Maybe I should brace myself for the worst. If that's the case, the thief could only be someone from within the camp.
Side_DSDPJ_3_3: While you were looking into the entry and exit records, I took the chance to review the surveillance footage from when the supplies were loaded and unloaded.
Side_DSDPJ_3_4: Mingyi, Tianlang, and Wuheng were present throughout the entire process of loading, unloading, and stocking supplies. You might want to start with them to see if you can uncover any useful clues.
Side_DSDPJ_3_5: Oh, by the way, the unloading area is a blind spot in the surveillance. Rover, you might discover some hidden clues there. I'm counting on you!
Side_DSDPJ_4_1: Heavy footsteps. The pace isn't far, as if the person was hauling something weighty.
Side_DSDPJ_4_2: The shoe prints at the heels show numerous cracks, signaling significant wear and tear at the back of the shoes. It suggests the person walked with a backward-leaning posture.
Side_DSDPJ_5_1: The supply box of Lollo Logistics. The moment it's opened, a pungent fragrance swarms out, but the box is disappointedly empty.
Side_DSDPJ_5_2: At the box's bottom, a faint sheen of oil lingers. The delightful scent... can't be mistaken! It's Panhua's Restaurant's Poached Chicken.
Side_DSDPJ_5_3: The more you inhale, the hungrier you become. It's probably wise to leave this spot promptly. Perhaps a chat with the nearby Midnight Rangers could shed light on any observations they've made.
Side_DSDPJ_6_3: Someone spilled the food along the way. The Gray Crested Gulls smelled it and came in swarms. I can't drive them away!
Side_DSDPJ_6_4: It took me great effort to clean it up here. Look at what these birds did to me!
Side_DSDPJ_6_6: Well, in that case, you should look for Mingyi. She's the one responsible for the storage area in the camp.
Side_DSDPJ_6_7: Usually, Mingyi handles checking the inventory and stocking supplies, while Tianlang and Wuheng take care of loading and unloading supplies.
Side_DSDPJ_6_8: Oh, you reminded me. I'll need to go ask Mingyi. I'll find out who did this!
Side_DSDPJ_7_1: Rover? Did Captain Beiwang send you over?
Side_DSDPJ_7_2: I reported the missing supplies. I stepped away for a moment during the stocking, and it happened.
Side_DSDPJ_7_3: Did you leave for a moment?
Side_DSDPJ_7_5: I asked Tianlang to take over for me when I stepped away.
Side_DSDPJ_7_6: Tianlang and Duying can both vouch for me! I have an alibi!
Side_DSDPJ_7_8: There was a package for Duying in the supplies, so... so I just happened to take it to him.
Side_DSDPJ_7_9: I had no other suspicious intentions! I promise!
Side_DSDPJ_8_1: There's something I want to ask you.
Side_DSDPJ_8_2: Sorry, but I'm in the middle of counting the newly arrived field uniforms.
Side_DSDPJ_8_3: Did they come with yesterday's supplies?
Side_DSDPJ_8_4: Indeed. The soldiers' field uniforms are regularly replaced. Some time ago, we collected applications for new uniforms, and some of the reasons on the applications were really... amusing.
Side_DSDPJ_8_5: There are reasons like pants torn by the fangs of a Sabyr Boar or a hat stolen by the Hoochiefs in the Dim Forest...
Side_DSDPJ_8_6: I've placed all those application forms on the table in the corner. If you're interested, you can take a look there.
Side_DSDPJ_8_8: Mingyi left for another business for a little while, and during that time, I helped in counting the inventory.
Side_DSDPJ_8_9: Another team member, Wuheng, was responsible for loading and unloading the supplies outside the warehouse on her own. I didn't notice anything unusual in the warehouse.
Side_DSDPJ_8_10: Maybe the application forms can be a breakthrough.
Side_DSDPJ_9_1:
Applicant: Duying
Request: Replacement of the upper garment
Reason: While rescuing a researcher kidnapped by the Exiles, the upper garment was pierced through by bullets.
Side_DSDPJ_9_2:
Applicant: Kelin
Request: Replacement of the hat
Reason: Accidentally offended Gray Crested Gulls and therefore received their gifts dropping from the sky all the time.
Side_DSDPJ_9_3: Looks like Wujing is going to face some challenges too...
Side_DSDPJ_9_4:
Applicant: Wuheng
Request: Replacement of the boots
Reason: Carrying heavy loads led to severe wear on the heels, causing frequent falls.
Side_DSDPJ_9_5: The description seems to align with the shoe print characteristics near the supply box. Just to be sure, go and confirm with the individual involved.
Side_CXLR_1_1: I'm begging you. Miss Koko, you must have some way to save my daughter.
Side_CXLR_1_3: Is it about the payment? I'll give you all my savings if that's what it takes.
Side_CXLR_1_5: {PlayerName}, you're here. But sorry, the shop's closed for now.
Side_CXLR_1_6: Miss Koko, do you need any help?
Side_CXLR_1_7: Don't worry. I'm okay. This lady here isn't a threat.
Side_CXLR_1_8: Her daughter's dealing with a rare illness—non-life-threatening for now, but it could get worse.
Side_CXLR_1_10: Doctors have tried everything, but regular medicine isn't working. There's one last hope, though.
Side_CXLR_1_11: Yes, my teacher handled a similar case before, and I still have the prescription from back then.
Side_CXLR_1_12: The issue is, the crucial "guide drug" is tough to get.
Side_CXLR_1_14: The "guide drug" is the most critical ingredient in the prescription. Currently, only some wealthy folks have the "guide drug" we need, and they probably won't sell it for money unless...
Side_CXLR_1_16: Unless you can find some rare items to exchange with them. Oh, by the way, Rover, have you ever heard of something called "Bell Spiriton"?
Side_CXLR_1_18: If we had that "Bell Spiriton," we could use it to exchange for the "guide drug."
Side_CXLR_1_19: It's not something easy to obtain.
Side_CXLR_1_20: Miss Koko, do you know how to get it? I'll do anything!
Side_CXLR_1_21: You can only find "Bell Spiriton" from a Calamity-Class Tacet Discord called Bell-Borne Geochelone. Have you heard of it?
Side_CXLR_1_24: Fought one, but didn't find any "Bell Spiriton."
Side_CXLR_1_25: Even Rover hasn't heard of it. Not that surprising, though. Only a handful of people have the chance to see it.
Side_CXLR_1_26: It's said to have a body as huge as a mountain, can crush an armored car with only one step, and freeze a river with a single breath!
Side_CXLR_1_27: Many tried to hunt it down in the past, but they all became revenants frozen in the river.
Side_CXLR_1_28: However, it doesn't usually leave its territory, so it's even rarer for people to see it.
Side_CXLR_1_29: People with sanity won't willingly pick fights with it, let alone risk their lives for an herb.
Side_CXLR_1_30: Yeah, you get how formidable it is. Nobody dares to challenge it, not to mention putting their lives on the line for an herb.
Side_CXLR_1_31: Seriously? You took it down? You're not pulling my leg, right?
Side_CXLR_1_32: Even so, you didn't get the "Bell Spiriton." That's a pity.
Side_CXLR_1_33: How can this be? Is there really no way?
Side_CXLR_1_36: Well, there's someone I know who might still have some "Bell Spiritons," but the problem is, he's a bit unreliable.
Side_CXLR_1_38: Not sure, but he did sell me plenty of rare TD materials before. It seems like he's got a few tricks up his sleeve.
Side_CXLR_1_39: Please tell me how I can find him. No matter how slim the hope is, I'll give it a try.
Side_CXLR_1_41: Thanks! So, let this lady stick around to help me prepare other herbs, and I'll leave the task of obtaining "Bell Spiriton" to {PlayerName}? Sound good?
Side_CXLR_1_42: No problem. Leave it to me.
Side_CXLR_1_43: His name's Lianfeng, and he hangs around the theater all the time. You should spot him there.
Side_CXLR_1_44: How will I know who he is?
Side_CXLR_1_45: He goes by "TD Hunter" and talks a big game about hunting formidable TDs, although no one has actually seen him fight.
Side_CXLR_1_46: If you see someone being loud and boastful over tea at the theater, that's Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_10_3: Fine, staying here is also a job.
Side_CXLR_11_3: It's a signal that Bell-Borne Geochelone is waking up.
Side_CXLR_11_6: Nothing, just a bit of a headache.
Side_CXLR_11_7: (Darn, it's happening again. It feels like something in my memories is about to be awakened.)
Side_CXLR_11_8: The problem is, the traces left by the Pioneer Association members seem to disappear here…
Side_CXLR_11_9: We can follow the sound of the bell.
Side_CXLR_11_10: Right, they must be where the bell sound is. Let's go.
Side_CXLR_12_1: Hey! Wake up! Can you hear me!
Side_CXLR_12_3: Ugh, you are… those people at the teahouse?
Side_CXLR_12_4: Enough talking. I'll check your injuries with my Forte.
Side_CXLR_12_5: No major organ damage, but there are multiple fractures. Did you fight against Bell-Borne Geochelone?
Side_CXLR_12_6: Ha, it can't be called a fight. We're completely crushed.
Side_CXLR_12_7: You should leave. Though it's calm now, no one knows when it'll wake up again.
Side_CXLR_12_8: It's not an opponent you ordinary people can deal with.
Side_CXLR_12_9: Ordinary people? You've got us wrong. I'm Lianfeng, a professional "TD Hunter," and this is my top apprentice.
Side_CXLR_12_10: "Top apprentice"… You've only got one apprentice, okay?
Side_CXLR_12_12: Just leave it to me and my master!
Side_CXLR_12_13: You guys stay here and rest. Leave the rest to us.
Side_CXLR_12_14: {PlayerName}, listen carefully to what I'm about to say.
Side_CXLR_12_16: Do you see the large bell in the center of the "Bell-Borne Ravine"? Ringing it will awaken Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_12_17: Since it's giant, it moves and turns slowly, so we'd better…
Side_CXLR_12_20: Staying away from it will only force us into corners with its massive body. It can also use icy breath and condense water into ice crystals for indiscriminate attacks.
Side_CXLR_12_21: Though it may seem crazy, it's actually safer to get as close to it as possible.
Side_CXLR_12_22: Yeah, getting close allows us to take advantage of its blind spots during its turns and attacks. Smart move.
Side_CXLR_12_23: Its four legs, head, and tail are all highly offensive weapons. Don't underestimate them.
Side_CXLR_12_24: Also, its weakness is the big bell on its back, but it's relatively high and not easy to attack under normal circumstances.
Side_CXLR_12_25: Unless we can find a way to make it fall…
Side_CXLR_12_26: You have a clear head, huh?
Side_CXLR_12_27: Bell-Borne Geochelone's feet are covered in hard ice, protecting them from hard.
Side_CXLR_12_28: However, it's also its weakness. Once the ice is shattered, Bell-Borne Geochelone will lose balance and fall down, which gives us a good chance to attack its most vulnerable point.
Side_CXLR_12_30: I'll draw its attention, and you seize the chance to attack.
Side_CXLR_12_31: Won't that put you in danger?
Side_CXLR_12_32: Tsk, are you underestimating a "TD Hunter"? Once you figure out its attack pattern, dodging is easy. That's how we took it down before.
Side_CXLR_12_33: We? I thought you defeated it on your own?
Side_CXLR_12_35: Was there anyone else who fought Bell-Borne Geochelone with you?
Side_CXLR_12_36: (In my memory, there's a group of people fighting alongside me.)
Side_CXLR_12_39: Don't push yourself too hard. You'd better take a rest in your condition.
Side_CXLR_12_40: It's dangerous to confront Bell-Borne Geochelone on your own.
Side_CXLR_12_41: It'll be fine. Leave it all to me.
Side_CXLR_13_1: You really took down that monster all by yourself! That's astonishing!
Side_CXLR_13_2: That's my apprentice! It should be a piece of cake for {Male=him;Female=her} to deal with such a small fish.
Side_CXLR_13_4: Don't know about them, but I'm perfectly fine.
Side_CXLR_13_6: What are you worried about? It's just a small hiccup. Anyway, let me see the material you got from Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_13_7: Yeah, that's it—the "Bell Spiriton." It's actually the seed produced by the plant on Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_13_8: Haha? Really? Good to know! I need to note it down.
Side_CXLR_13_9: Oh my, can't you forget about your stupid research for one second?
Side_CXLR_13_10: Never mind. Forget about them. You need to hurry back to Jinzhou and give this to Koko. I'll contact the Pioneer Association to get them medical treatment.
Side_CXLR_14_2: Is everything okay? Did you find Lianfeng?
Side_CXLR_14_5: It's a long story. Here, take it.
Side_CXLR_14_6: "Bell Spiriton"? Oh, yes, this is it!
Side_CXLR_14_7: So my daughter can be saved?
Side_CXLR_14_8: Yes, with this, your daughter can be cured.
Side_CXLR_14_9: But it looks so fresh. I thought Lianfeng got it a long time ago.
Side_CXLR_14_12: Hey, show me some respect. It's Brother Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_14_14: Just a little aftereffect of Overclocking. See, I'm totally fine.
Side_CXLR_14_15: Overclocking? But your symptoms don't seem like it. The aftereffect of Overclocking is supposed to be associated with a Resonator's Forte.
Side_CXLR_14_16: So what? My Forte is frequency perception.
Side_CXLR_14_17: But your symptom is memory loss.
Side_CXLR_14_19: Is there a possibility that you didn't really go through Overclocking, and some other incident caused your memory loss?
Side_CXLR_14_20: I believe you had teammates fighting with you.
Side_CXLR_14_21: No way. I've never had any companions or teammates. My dear apprentice, you worry too much. I handle my affairs, and you handle yours.
Side_CXLR_14_24: He insisted on being my master.
Side_CXLR_14_26: I'll share with you the exciting battle between Rover and Bell-Borne Geochelone later. For now, let's make the medicine this lady's daughter needs.
Side_CXLR_14_28: No big deal. Taking down enemies of this level is just a walk in the park for a "TD Hunter".
Side_CXLR_14_29: Uncle Lianfeng, what do you think about continuing hunting those giant TDs? If you happen to get any rare materials, I'm still willing to buy them at a good price!
Side_CXLR_14_30: Call me "Brother"! Anyway, I've already retired. I'll leave the title of "TD Hunter" to my chief apprentice.
Side_CXLR_14_32: Really? That's good news. Rover's much more reliable than Uncle Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_14_36: Don't worry! I'll keep teaching you, hahaha!
Side_CXLR_14_37: Okay, fine, but not being a TD Hunter is surely a waste of your skills.
Side_CXLR_14_38: Great. Now you're the new "TD Hunter," and I'm sure you can do it well.
Side_CXLR_14_39: Right, and of course, you'll earn a fair wage for your work.
Side_CXLR_14_40: (Perhaps, I can find out the true reason for my memory loss in battles against TDs.)
Side_CXLR_14_41: Well then, my dear apprentice, if there's information about new large TDs, I'll contact you!
Side_CXLR_15_2: I'm looking for a man called Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_15_4: Nope. Hey, don't talk to me! I haven't forgiven you yet!
Side_CXLR_16_1: You've been standing there for a while. How can we help you?
Side_CXLR_16_2: I'm looking for a man called Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_16_3: Lianfeng… Sorry, never heard of him.
Side_CXLR_16_4: Your friend, huh? Maybe he joined the Midnight Rangers?
Side_CXLR_16_5: No, I just have business with him.
Side_CXLR_16_6: I see. Good luck finding him.
Side_CXLR_17_2: I'm desperate here. You've got to help me save my daughter. You're my last hope.
Side_CXLR_17_3: It's not that I don't want to help…
Side_CXLR_18_1: How long do we have to wait here? Darn, I want to go investigate Bell-Borne Geochelone instead of staying in this boring place.
Side_CXLR_18_3: The captain thinks it's too dangerous if there are too many people going there, so we're left here to act as support and ensure a safe retreat. I don't think we'll be needed though.
Side_CXLR_19_2: I need to organize a research report as soon as possible. Ouch! That hurts.
Side_CXLR_2_1: If you see someone being loud and boastful over tea at the theater, that's Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_2_2: Rover, please help me. I've got no other options.
Side_CXLR_3_1: Bro, not that I don't trust you, but you gotta show us how you take down those TDs at least once!
Side_CXLR_3_2: Hey, I would, but here's the problem.
Side_CXLR_3_3: Guys like you might get smashed into meat pulp standing by my side.
Side_CXLR_3_4: Haha, brag. Do you really think he can take down TDs, or am I the Magistrate of Jinzhou?
Side_CXLR_3_5: Sir Magistrate, may I express my deepest respect.
Side_CXLR_3_6: How unlucky I am to run into a bunch of short-sighted fools like you. Can't believe you haven't even heard of the title "TD Hunter"!
Side_CXLR_3_7: No wonder you can only afford this cheap tea. Hey, waiter, bring me the finest Jade Tea.
Side_CXLR_4_1: What do you have to explain, you liar!
Side_CXLR_4_2: Hold on, at least let's listen to his excuses.
Side_CXLR_4_3: Forget it, let him be! No matter what I say, he won't listen...
Side_CXLR_4_4: Have some tea, guys. As friends, everything can be talked over, huh?
Side_CXLR_5_1: My friend joined the Midnight Rangers. I'm worried she might be in danger now.
Side_CXLR_5_2: New recruits generally aren't assigned to dangerous missions, right? I remember your brother joined last year.
Side_CXLR_5_4: But, in any case, they have to fight against those Tacet Discords. Just thinking about it gives me the shivers.
Side_CXLR_5_5: Yeah, thanks to their efforts, us ordinary folks can live in peace.
Side_CXLR_6_1: Hey, Lianfeng, you have a guest here.
Side_CXLR_6_2: Who are you? I don't know you.
Side_CXLR_6_4: Are you looking for me? Who told you I'm here?
Side_CXLR_6_6: Darn. Did she send you to collect debts?
Side_CXLR_6_8: Nothing, forget it. Anyway, why are you looking for me? Spill it. I don't have time to waste.
Side_CXLR_6_9: Come on! You're just having tea here with us. Oh! Nice tea.
Side_CXLR_6_10: Just so you know, if you're here to borrow money, then you can turn around and leave. I'm broke. Flat broke.
Side_CXLR_6_11: You can sell those PRECIOUS materials you've obtained from TDs, huh? They should earn you a great sum.
Side_CXLR_6_12: I sold them all a long time ago.
Side_CXLR_6_13: All of them? What about the material called "Bell Spiriton?
Side_CXLR_6_14: I don't have any. Speaking of which, I once obtained some from a TD called Bell-Borne Geochelone. Well, forget about it. After all, you won't have a chance to see it.
Side_CXLR_6_15: Why am I telling you all this? You're just wasting my time. Get outta here; don't spoil my moment drinking this delicious tea.
Side_CXLR_6_16: Where else can I find it?
Side_CXLR_6_17: I'm not lying, but I'm the only one that can obtain "Bell Spiriton".
Side_CXLR_6_18: Then why not go take down that Bell-Borne thing again?
Side_CXLR_6_19: Seriously? I'm not going! I'm tired of dealing with minions like Bell-Borne Geochelone. Whoever wants to go can go by themselves.
Side_CXLR_6_20: If you're that strong, why did you quit the Pioneer Association? Or, were you kicked out?
Side_CXLR_6_21: I heard from Miss Maqi that you quit. So it's true, huh?
Side_CXLR_6_22: Nonsense. I quit because I don't need any companions or assistance to take down TDs.
Side_CXLR_6_23: I'm a lone wolf. I don't waste time getting along with people.
Side_CXLR_6_24: Hey, friend, I remember you're Rover who just came to Jinzhou, right? Why do you want this thing?
Side_CXLR_6_25: (You explain the situation about that mother and her sick daughter)
Side_CXLR_6_26: That's unfortunate, but so what? Why should I help someone I barely know? Go find someone else.
Side_CXLR_6_27: Hey, how can you be so cruel? Have some compassion!
Side_CXLR_6_28: Oh my, I really can't stand stories like this.
Side_CXLR_6_29: What's the matter with you two?
Side_CXLR_6_30: Mr. Lianfeng, please lend us a hand.
Side_CXLR_6_32: Hahaha! Please explain this matter in detail to us Pioneer Association!
Side_CXLR_6_33: Sorry for the abrupt intrusion! We didn't intend to eavesdrop your conversation. It's just your voices were a bit loud.
Side_CXLR_6_34: Tsk, are all members of the Pioneer Association this rude?
Side_CXLR_6_35: In fact, we're the Explorers of the Pioneer Association, and I'm the captain of this squad. Are you Rover? Nice to meet you!
Side_CXLR_6_38: Shut up. Hey, what do you want?
Side_CXLR_6_39: Well, we're heading to the Gorges of Spirits to investigate a giant Tacet Discord found there.
Side_CXLR_6_41: Yes. Our goal is to take Bell-Borne Geochelone down for further research.
Side_CXLR_6_42: Then we happened to hear your conversation and thought if we could help the unfortunate mother and daughter at the same time, it'd be great.
Side_CXLR_6_44: You're such good guys, unlike Lianfeng.
Side_CXLR_6_46: Can you really defeat that giant Tacet Discord?
Side_CXLR_6_47: Don't worry. We've thoroughly investigated Bell-Borne Geochelone, and our squad is composed of experienced Resonators.
Side_CXLR_6_48: But we've never heard of this "Bell Spiriton" before. It seems like an interesting research subject. I'm sure the Editorial Department will be thrilled.
Side_CXLR_6_49: Well, Rover, just wait for our good news! Bye!
Side_CXLR_6_50: Wait, that's too dangerous! You're all going to die! Hey, stop!
Side_CXLR_6_51: Just let them do their work, Lianfeng. You're being ridiculous.
Side_CXLR_6_52: Me? Ridiculous? I just don't want to see them throw away their lives so rashly!
Side_CXLR_6_54: I'm not a member of the Pioneer Association anymore. They can do whatever they want. I don't care.
Side_CXLR_6_55: But they're underestimating that TD. Members of the Pioneer Association are too focused on research and investigation. Sometimes, they forget they're dealing with extremely formidable creatures.
Side_CXLR_6_56: Since you're a man of strength, why not join in and help out? We'll respect you as a true man.
Side_CXLR_6_57: Mr. Lianfeng, let's go help them.
Side_CXLR_6_58: Tsk, easy for you to say.
Side_CXLR_6_60: Are you underestimating me? Fine, I'll go! But I won't help them fight Bell-Borne Geochelone. I already said I'm done with the Pioneer Association!
Side_CXLR_6_61: I'll tell {Male=him;Female=her} how to take down Bell-Borne Geochelone as {Male=his;Female=her} "Master"!
Side_CXLR_6_63: Looks like you're skilled enough. With my guidance, you'll be more capable than those guys in the future.
Side_CXLR_6_64: Well, as long as you're happy.
Side_CXLR_6_68: Good. Hope you'll be as composed facing that formidable TD.
Side_CXLR_6_69: Tsk. Anyway, with an experienced "TD hunter" by your side, nothing could go wrong.
Side_CXLR_6_71: In that case, you'll know I wasn't bragging. Wait and see.
Side_CXLR_6_72: Rover, come! Let's have a private talk over there. Don't let these fools hear.
Side_CXLR_6_73: As if we'd love to hear. We've had our fill of tea. Bye.
Side_CXLR_6_74: Boss, put it on Lianfeng's tab!
Side_CXLR_6_75: Out, out, out! Get out! Don't waste our time.
Side_CXLR_7_3: Aren't you afraid to fight against TDs?
Side_CXLR_7_4: I mean, Bell-Borne Geochelone is a very dangerous opponent. You might get hurt or even lose your life fighting it.
Side_CXLR_7_5: Though that mother and daughter are quite pitiful, you don't have an obligation to help them.
Side_CXLR_7_6: Even if you back out now, no one can blame you, including that mother and daughter.

Side_CXLR_8_15: Bell-Borne Geochelone lives in the Gorges of Spirits, which is the source of the Qing River flowing through here. I can sense the state of a TD through the remaining frequency in the medium.

Side_CXLR_8_20: We're pretty lucky. There's a high chance we'll get the "Bell Spiriton" if we hunt Bell-Borne Geochelone now.

Side_CXLR_8_22: I can see signs of someone camping here.
Side_CXLR_8_23: Seems like they're well-prepared. The Pioneer Association is really interested in Bell-Borne Geochelone.
Side_CXLR_8_25: You wanna know? Curiosity is a good trait! The more you know about your enemy before a battle, the more confident you'll be.
Side_CXLR_8_26: Let's start from the question "how Tacet Discords are formed." Most people believe that they are born out of chaos, but there are some exceptions—some TDs seem to come from legends or even real history.
Side_CXLR_8_27: Legend has it that the ancient army in Huanglong used to sound a bronze bell in battle, inspiring soldiers to fight bravely and symbolizing the good wish of a triumphant return.
Side_CXLR_8_28: One day, the bell ringer saved a turtle along the Qing River by accident. From then on, that turtle became an indispensable part of the soldiers, sharing their happiness and sorrow.
Side_CXLR_8_29: Before the fierce battle ended, the bell ringer died. However, the sound of the bell still echoed on the battlefield. It's said that the turtle was the one who sounded the bell.
Side_CXLR_8_30: The turtle carried on the duty of that bell ringer.
Side_CXLR_8_31: Yes, that's the story. Later, someone found a rusted ancient bell in the Gorges of Spirits, similar in style to the bronze bell the ancient army used.
Side_CXLR_8_32: Underneath that ancient bell was a giant turtle-shaped Tacet Discord. It witnessed the fierce war and bid farewell to the bell ringer and soldiers. These memories tied the heavy ancient bell to its back.
Side_CXLR_8_33: But it's just a story. After all, no one knows if TDs have memories and emotions.
Side_CXLR_8_34: No matter what happened in the past, this TD is now a hideous creature bringing nothing other than pain and torture to Huanglong.
Side_CXLR_8_35: You don't need to show any mercy. If it really had emotions, it wouldn't want to be a creature destroying happiness and peace of people in Huanglong.
Side_CXLR_8_36: Rule Number Two for "TD Hunter"—"Never show mercy to Tacet Discords!"

Flow_31000183_1: Please respect the park and its infrastructure. Keep a safe distance and do not feed the animals.
Flow_31000183_2: The area ahead is the Dim Forest. Mutant Organisms frequently appear and are known to organize attacks on humans.
Flow_31000183_3: The Midnight Rangers are conducting a recovery operation. Until the area is fully recovered, non-mission personnel are not allowed to enter.
Flow_31000183_4: The park is large. To ensure a good experience, we recommend driving or taking the park bus.
Flow_31000183_5: Every Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday are performance days. Free parking is available all day.
Flow_31000183_6: Thank you for visiting! A new group performance is being planned. Stay tuned!
Flow_31000183_7: The exit is ahead. If you are driving, you will need to purchase a new ticket to re-enter.
Flow_31000183_8: The area ahead is a conservation area and is only open to staff. Visitors, please do not enter.
Flow_31000183_9: Please enter the park in an orderly manner and take your assigned seat. Please respect the performance and do not make loud noises.
Flow_31000183_10: Please follow the designated route in the ecological tour area. Do not climb over the fence.
Flow_31000183_11: Hoochiefs often appear in groups in the forest and launch brutal attacks on humans.
Flow_31000183_12: Please do not enter the forest unless necessary. If you enter by mistake, please leave as soon as possible.
Flow_31000183_13: Who knows what the boss was thinking, choosing such a terrible place to camp...
Flow_31000183_14: It looks like we have a lot of supplies, but they all belong to those apes!
Flow_31000183_15: They are all so cunning, you can't even take a Coriolus from them!
Flow_31000183_16: It looks like we're going to starve again today, sigh...
Flow_31000183_17: The performance is over. Three lucky audience members will be selected to interact with...
Flow_31000183_18: The facilities here have mechanisms, suspected to be operated by the Hoochiefs. Please be careful when carrying out your mission.
Flow_31000183_19: The thing you gave me is indeed a bit old. It's a microelectronic device part from before the Lament. It's used for... you wouldn't understand even if I told you.
Flow_31000183_20: It's relatively simple to fix... Wait for me here, I'll be back soon.
Flow_31000183_23: It cost me several electronic components, the ones that are out of production... Fortunately, the data in them at least made me feel that I didn't lose out.
Flow_31000183_25: The Midnight Rangers have always been puzzled by the strange behavior of the Hoochief. After I looked at this hard drive, I think it's actually simple. They are planning to take revenge on humans.
Flow_31000183_27: The Dim Forest was a famous zoo before the Lament, known for its animal performances.
Flow_31000183_28: Because of their high intelligence, the apes could master many skills. They were the first to be trained for performances, becoming the most popular exhibits.
Flow_31000183_29: After the Lament, humans gradually fled the forest. The apes built their nests, becoming the masters, and even started to attack humans.
Flow_31000183_30: At first, humans could handle it, until they were infected by the Tacetite, and mutated into the more dangerous creatures they are now.
Flow_31000183_31: So... setting traps, locking humans in tree cages, and making humans perform in the theater... is their clumsy revenge, at least that's what I think.
Flow_31000183_32: Using the knowledge taught by humans, they are returning what humans have done to them in double.
Flow_31000183_33: That's probably it, do you have any other questions?
Flow_31000183_35: The origin of the Feilian Beringal?
Flow_31000183_38: It's probably a... amusement place? Before the Lament, humans liked to lock animals in cages, rooms, in other words, in fixed areas, for visitors to appreciate.
Flow_31000183_39: The largest venue, it is said, can exhibit five to six hundred animals at the same time, and it has also spawned a huge supporting industry.
Flow_31000183_40: How much idle time did the people before the Lament have to squander... it's unimaginable now.
Flow_31000183_42: Hmm, should it be considered lucky, or unlucky...
Flow_31000183_43: It was originally a special albino individual, rescued by humans from the wild and kept in a zoo, and it was deeply loved by visitors because of its eye-catching appearance.
Flow_31000183_44: Gradually, it became the star of the zoo, and every time it performed, the venue was packed.
Flow_31000183_45: But because of this, the albino orangutan was forced to undergo stricter training, learning to do things that only humans can do...
Flow_31000183_46: There were also some people, from the orangutan's perspective, who opposed animal performances.
Flow_31000183_47: But their voices were too small, and in the end, they were unable to stop the Feilian Beringal from taking the path of revenge... this is a futile effort, don't you think?
Flow_31000183_48: Oh, it's strange, the big leader mobilized a large number of troops in the Dim Forest, but in the end, nothing happened.
Flow_31000183_49: It is said that the message conveyed by the Feilian Beringal before its death affected the entire monkey group.
Flow_31000183_50: Contrary to expectations, the aggression and combat power of the monkeys have greatly decreased, and it is much easier to deal with.
Flow_31000183_51: The Midnight Rangers will also arrange a permanent training ground in the Dim Forest, and you can go and have a look if you have nothing to do.
Flow_31000183_52: Although I rarely praise people, I have to say that you did a good job with the Feilian Beringal.
Flow_31000183_53: Oh, there's also a video of it when it was a baby.
Flow_31000183_54: In fact, albino individuals have a hard time surviving in the wild, so objectively speaking, it was humans who gave it a life.
Flow_31000183_55: The people who saved it were probably researchers or something, it's quite romantic, they even held a celebration ceremony when it completed its treatment and left the rescue cabin.
Flow_31000183_56: I saw it was quite happy, jumping around on the backs of those people, haha.
Flow_31000183_57: I wonder if it started to know about "humans" from that time on?
Flow_31000183_58: Alright, that's enough talking. Take care, I won't see you off.

Event_DAZYHQLZD3_5_18: I believe her wish has already come true.
Event_DAZYHQLZD3_5_19: On that note, I trust you've heard of the place "where a river of stars falls."

Event_DAZYHQLZD3_5_21: As it happens, we have prepared a grand fireworks show for today. Please, come and find me when the party is at its peak. By then, this place will be exactly as the lady imagined it.

Event_WWPDJSBF_4_12: Besides, like I said, I'm not here on assignment. I'm simply "Yinlin," on vacation.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_14: So, you recovered the identity that was erased?

Event_WWPDJSBF_4_16: The Carnevale, Septimont… No doubt the Fractsidus were pulling the strings behind all those incidents.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_17: To understand their plans, I followed the clues and did some digging of my own.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_18: The Fractsidus are not to be taken lightly.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_19: Yeah, they're a hard nut to crack. Luckily, I had support from the Magistrate and others in Jinzhou. I never planned to take them head-on.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_20: With their help, I infiltrated one of their bases and discovered a new scheme they were whipping up.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_21: We neutralized it before they could act. Those Artificers were no match for the Midnight Rangers.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_22: After the operation, the Magistrate restored my official file. She wanted me to return to the Public Security Bureau as a Patroller, not as an undercover agent.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_23: It was my chance to step back into the light... And honestly, living in the shadows as a suspect wasn't exactly pleasant.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_25: You must've waited a long time for this.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_26: …It was a tempting offer, but I turned it down.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_28: Every undercover agent has their reasons for staying in the game. Justice, ambition, revenge… you name it.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_29: No matter the motive, the work eats away at you. But someone's got to do the dirty work to keep Jinzhou safe.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_30: Rather than burden a rookie Patroller... better to leave it to an experienced pro like me.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_33: …Heh, how'd we end up on such a heavy topic? Let's drop it. For now, we're just here to have fun.
Event_WWPDJSBF_4_34: Next time we meet, make sure you play along and don't blow my cover, alright?

Event_WWPDJSBF_3_19: That said, I can scarcely recall the last time I had a true respite...
Event_WWPDJSBF_3_20: Since you're already at the party, why not treat this as a vacation and relax a little? Even a general needs to recharge.
Event_WWPDJSBF_3_21: ...You're right. No matter how much I deliberate, decisions must wait until I return to Jinzhou.
Event_WWPDJSBF_3_22: The delegation is secure for now. A brief rest here shouldn't hurt...
Event_WWPDJSBF_3_25: …Thank you. May you also find joy at this party, {PlayerName}.

Event_SYHJ_1_5: Huh? Excuse me if I'm disturbing you by talking to myself.
Event_SYHJ_1_6: A crevice appeared in the mine underground lately.
Event_SYHJ_1_7: From the looks of it, it seemed like an entrance to some unstable Sonoro Sphere.
Event_SYHJ_1_12: However, several miners who work with my ore shop told me that with this crevice, they are afraid and unwilling to go down the mine recently.
Event_SYHJ_1_13: They can easily find other jobs, but without their supply, my shop would go bankrupt.
Event_SYHJ_1_14: Can't you find someone else for your stock?
Event_SYHJ_1_15: I have some ore with me.
Event_SYHJ_1_16: It's a small business. If I want to stay in this game, I have to fight a price war.
Event_SYHJ_1_17: And if I lose these old suppliers who offer lower prices, I simply cannot compete with those monopolies like Huaipu Mining Firm...
Event_SYHJ_1_18: Let me see... well, I appreciate your kindness, but you don't have enough to keep me stocked. So keep it for yourself.
Event_SYHJ_1_19: At this point, we have to figure out what’s inside the crevice...
Event_SYHJ_1_20: As long as we confirm that it is not dangerous, I can convince the miners to keep working with me.
Event_SYHJ_1_22: I am familiar with Sonoro Spheres.
Event_SYHJ_1_23: I can't believe there is someone as friendly as you...
Event_SYHJ_1_24: If you can confirm the situation inside the crevice and help me get my shop back up and running, I'll be sure to thank you with a large sum of money!
Event_SYHJ_1_25: It's okay. I didn't come here for the money.
Event_SYHJ_1_26: Please pay me a lot of money.
Event_SYHJ_1_27: You're a good person, but a businessman's reputation is on the line. Since I made a promise, I have to give you the payment.
Event_SYHJ_1_28: Of course, my word is my bond.
Event_SYHJ_1_29: Before you go, please bring this "Sample Alloy" with you.
Event_SYHJ_1_31: It's an alloy I smelted myself. The formula is still under review...
Event_SYHJ_1_32: But my goal is very clear: I will make the best-performing alloy material in the world!
Event_SYHJ_1_33: Back to the point... I found that my alloy glows when it gets close to the crevice.
Event_SYHJ_1_34: I don't quite understand how it works, but I have a hunch it might help you.
Event_SYHJ_1_36: Right. Go on, then. I’ll wait for your good news!
Event_SYHJ_2_3: There were a lot of Tacet Discords inside.
Event_SYHJ_2_4: I didn't know it was so dangerous there... Are you hurt?
Event_SYHJ_2_7: Your alloy helped me a lot.
Event_SYHJ_2_8: Did, did it really?! How did it help you?
Event_SYHJ_2_9: It seemed to have strengthened me.
Event_SYHJ_2_10: My alloy strengthened the bearer in this Sonoro Sphere...
Event_SYHJ_2_11: I, I'm really good at smelting!
Event_SYHJ_2_12: Tell you what, I'll give you some more alloys, and you help me test them in the Sonoro Sphere!
Event_SYHJ_2_13: What happened to eliminating the threat of the crevice?
Event_SYHJ_2_15: That's not the point. Two days out of business won't kill me.
Event_SYHJ_2_16: Even though I'm a businessman, I have a dream.
Event_SYHJ_2_17: If I can make the most powerful alloy in the world, then all the mine companies will remember my name!
Event_SYHJ_2_18: Compared to that, a temporary business setback is no big deal.
Event_SYHJ_3_1: Though I've been tweaking the recipe for my alloy, the progress of its improvement has always been limited.
Event_SYHJ_3_2: I really can't compare myself with the academics and engineers at the academy who specialize in weapons materials.
Event_SYHJ_3_3: But this crevice in the mine seems to have a special connection to my alloy.
Event_SYHJ_3_4: Only my alloy glows near this crevice...
Event_SYHJ_3_5: I was excited and scared at once.
Event_SYHJ_3_6: Excited, because I felt my efforts were recognized, and my alloy was special in this Sonoro Sphere.
Event_SYHJ_3_7: But I'm also scared that if the crevice disappears, will my alloy become meaningless?
Event_SYHJ_3_8: Every time I think about this, I stop worrying about my business, and I even hope the crevice lasts a little longer...
Guide_CLLJ_1_5: I'm the one who had witnessed Hongzhen grow into what it is today before I handed it over to Xinyi.
Guide_CLLJ_1_6: Alas, let the past stay in the past… Just call me Uncle Fu.
Guide_CLLJ_1_7: So, what do you think about Hongzhen nowadays?
Guide_CLLJ_1_10: Ah, you're quite optimistic, young one.
Guide_CLLJ_1_11: You've seen the crisis at Mt. Firmament, yet you're not scared, are you?
Guide_CLLJ_1_13: You remind me of Xinyi the first time I saw her.
Guide_CLLJ_1_14: You are both someone who lived through turbulent times and stood tall against all odds.
Guide_CLLJ_1_15: Forgive me, I've lost myself. I wanted to see you because I have something to give you.
Guide_CLLJ_1_16: Uncle Fu takes out a scale-like object and hands it over to you solemnly.
Guide_CLLJ_1_19: When I first became the Mayor of Hongzhen, I came across this thing on one of my walks in the mountains.
Guide_CLLJ_1_20: At first, I was intrigued by its peculiar shape, so I brought it back to town with me. But afterward, it revealed some truly amazing power.
Guide_CLLJ_1_23: Well, no... Listen, I might be old, but I've always let nature take its course.
Guide_CLLJ_1_24: People age and die, even in Hongzhen. The Sentinel's power could only slow down time but not reverse it.
Guide_CLLJ_1_25: This scale—It seems like it has captured Hongzhen in a frozen slice of time.
Guide_CLLJ_1_26: A few nights after I found it, I dreamed of the moment I picked it up.
Guide_CLLJ_1_27: The dream felt as real as life. I could even see the falling snow clearly—as if time had frozen.
Guide_CLLJ_1_30: Yeah, I was elated by the surprise like you did.
Guide_CLLJ_1_31: I kept going back to it for the better half of a month until I finally realized I wasn't dreaming that night.
Guide_CLLJ_1_32: Though small, this scale contains unimaginable power. When I carry it, it records my experiences and lets me relive them later.
Guide_CLLJ_1_33: I call this ability "Chrono Tracing". With it, I can see and hear everything I've experienced before and even talk to those people in the Chrono Trace…
Guide_CLLJ_1_34: I used this ability to record every detail in Hongzhen. It certainly made the compilation of the Hongzhen Chronicle much easier.
Guide_CLLJ_1_35: During the day, I'd go through the archives and visit residents. At night, I used this magical token to organize the information I'd gathered.
Guide_CLLJ_1_36: As I was ankle deep in the governing affairs... I couldn't picture what a lousy job I would have done on my official duties without its help.
Guide_CLLJ_1_38: Maybe it's better to give it to Xinyi?
Guide_CLLJ_1_39: Why don't you keep it yourself?
Guide_CLLJ_1_40: Hahaha, before I answer your question, let me ask you one.
Guide_CLLJ_1_41: Guess what I recorded the most with this scale?
Guide_CLLJ_1_44: At first, I used it solely for important events. But as time passed, I changed the way I handled it.
Guide_CLLJ_1_45: You're right. After I had stepped down as the Mayor of Hongzhen, I was no longer involved in Hongzhen's affairs.
Guide_CLLJ_1_46: When I handed over the position to Xinyi, I gave this scale to her as well.
Guide_CLLJ_1_47: But she was a considerate one and soon returned it to me.
Guide_CLLJ_1_48: For she saw that I found I needed it more. So rather than using it to archive the nitty-gritty of her work, she allowed me to record the people I cherished.
Guide_CLLJ_1_49: I watched many kids in Hongzhen grow up and leave.
Guide_CLLJ_1_50: At first, I thought they’d come back someday, but I realized I'd never see many of them again.
Guide_CLLJ_1_51: Over the years, I've really missed those young folks who left Mt. Firmament for new lives.
Guide_CLLJ_1_52: So, I used the scale to create a Chrono Trace for nearly every resident in Hongzhen.
Guide_CLLJ_1_53: Whenever I missed them, I visited and talked to them in those Chrono Traces.
Guide_CLLJ_1_55: Alright, enough talk about me. Let's talk about you, {PlayerName}?
Guide_CLLJ_1_56: Something tells me this scale is related to Jué.
Guide_CLLJ_1_57: Back then, I thought Hongzhen needed Xinyi more than me, just like Jinhsi did Jué.
Guide_CLLJ_1_58: I've built my life around this town, but you, {PlayerName}, you're not bound to Hongzhen or even Huanglong.
Guide_CLLJ_1_59: There's a world of expanse out there awaiting your exploration and many interesting souls for you to bond with.
Guide_CLLJ_1_60: You'll need this scale more than I do... Or, rather, you two fit right together.
Guide_CLLJ_1_61: You can give it Chrono Traces that I can't, showing it truly important moments.
Guide_CLLJ_1_63: I'll make good use of it.
Guide_CLLJ_1_65: I have a feeling you're different from those who never return.
Guide_CLLJ_1_66: However far you go, when you're tired, you're always welcome back to Mt. Firmament.
Guide_CLLJ_1_67: You know where to find me. Let me know when you want to catch up over a pot of tea.
Event_GFMY_1_1: Still clinging to those obscure words?... Indeed, things remain a riddle.
Event_GFMY_1_2: Only by going through those doors, into the depths of these orderless dreams, can you reach the truth.
Event_GFMY_1_3: When you're in a dream, dream on until you get the answer.
Event_GFMY_1_4: Look forward to dreaming with you again next time...
Event_DRSL_1_1: Ever heard of Second Coming of Solaris before, {PlayerName}?
Event_DRSL_1_3: A new periodical by the Pioneer Association?
Event_DRSL_1_4: A new merch by the Pioneer Association?
Event_DRSL_1_5: So you don't know about it?
Event_DRSL_1_6: Oh, that's not my job. Periodicals and merchandise are only sold at Ganxue's shop.
Event_DRSL_1_7: But how come you don't know about this book?
Event_DRSL_1_8: Second Coming of Solaris... It's the fiction that everyone's talking about across Huanglong. It has been a bestseller for three weeks in a row!
Event_DRSL_1_9: Its author, Karl, is from the New Federation. It's his debut work and he's already been named one of the top-earning writers in recent years with this single book.
Event_DRSL_1_10: It rivets nearly all the attention of our editors from the headquarters.
Event_DRSL_1_12: Of course not... Some swooped in only to try to find the trick to write a top seller.
Event_DRSL_1_13: But I can't deny that it's the best piece of work among all the candidates in recent years.
Event_DRSL_1_14: I was taken on an epic adventure through the protagonist while I was reading Second Coming of Solaris...
Event_DRSL_1_15: Oh, I got carried away. Let's turn back to our topic. {PlayerName}, we hope you could lend us some help.
Event_DRSL_1_16: The Pioneer Association has reached an agreement on developing a game franchise based on Second Coming of Solaris and the production of the game is already underway.
Event_DRSL_1_18: When is it expected to be released?
Event_DRSL_1_19: The development is still at a very early stage. The basic framework is complete, but we're still working on the production of a huge body of art assets.
Event_DRSL_1_20: The dev team is still struggling to find a creative direction that enables them to recapture the grandeur of the world in the novel.
Event_DRSL_1_21: In our meeting yesterday, a few colleagues mentioned that a well-traveled guest had just arrived in Jinzhou... that is what brought me to you.
Event_DRSL_1_22: Do I get an early access to the game as a perk?
Event_DRSL_1_23: But I've never read it before...
Event_DRSL_1_24: Of course, we'll let you know whenever there's progress in the game.
Event_DRSL_1_25: It's okay. I'll describe to you in detail the related scenes in the novel when you need me to.
Event_DRSL_1_26: Simply put, all you need to do is find us some real-world references that fit the descriptions in the novel.
Event_DRSL_1_27: With these references, the developers can have a general picture of what the in-game world should look like.
Event_DRSL_1_29: You don't need to worry about that. We have a deep budget for the game and you'll be well compensated for your efforts.
Event_DRSL_1_31: Don't forget to include me in the credits.
Event_DRSL_1_32: Of course. If this goes smoothly, the name of {PlayerName} may appear on our "Special Thanks" list.
Event_DRSL_1_33: Let's begin with today's job if you're ready.
Event_DRSL_10_1: Rongqing has told me some about this book.
Event_DRSL_10_2: I can't say I have much experience with stuff like this... I'm just too old for a packed page...
Event_DRSL_10_3: I can read the pages to you if you like.
Event_DRSL_10_4: You're so sweet. Just tell me if you want to buy some <ano=Bonsai>Penjing</ano>. I'm giving you discounts!
Event_DRSL_10_5: Anything similar to what's described in the novel?
Event_DRSL_10_6: Well, you certainly can't expect a potted plant to look nearly as impressive as an actual sea of flowers.
Event_DRSL_10_7: But I guess a luxuriant pot of irises may capture the feel.
Event_DRSL_10_8: It originates from Whining Aix's Mire and its flower language is fragile, untold affections. Romantic, isn't it?
Event_DRSL_10_10: It has a short flowering season, making it unsuitable for <ano=Bonsai>Penjing</ano>. So we usually don't sell them here. But Verina happened to drop by a few days ago and gave me a few.
Event_DRSL_10_11: I'll give one to you if you need it.
Event_DRSL_10_13: You're welcome. Just drop by anytime.
Event_DRSL_11_1: It's beautiful. Thank you for the work. I'll hand it over to the dev team.
Event_DRSL_11_2: It would be easier for them to imagine a sea of flowers with this.
Event_DRSL_12_1: Some time passed while Maqi was away to hand over the item...
Event_DRSL_13_1: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!
Event_DRSL_14_1: Let me explain our job today.
Event_DRSL_14_2: In this chapter, our protagonist paid a visit to a mystic island.
Event_DRSL_14_3: It goes: "The autumn seemed to be permanent here. Leaves and foliage were bathed in burning gold..."
Event_DRSL_14_4: "As the sea breeze gently met the shore, a golden shower fell upon our shoulders..."
Event_DRSL_14_5: "For once, I caught a whiff of fragrance in the fallen leaves... It was only many years later that I realized it had been a kind of <color=highlight>golden insect</color> hidden in camouflage in those leaves."
Event_DRSL_14_6: The insect served as a metaphor by the author for the following plots.
Event_DRSL_14_7: What's more. At the end of this chapter, the elders of the island would use this insect to—
Event_DRSL_14_9: I want to see it myself when the game comes online.
Event_DRSL_14_10: Sorry, my bad... This is one of my favorite bits so I got carried away.
Event_DRSL_14_11: Anyway, the dev team wants a reference for such an important element in future plots.
Event_DRSL_14_12: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.
Event_DRSL_15_1: An entomologist... I have no clues.
Event_DRSL_15_2: Maybe you should go to the pond. Some kids are frequently seen catching flies there.
Event_DRSL_16_2: No, Mingming. {Male=He;Female=She} needs you to answer a question.
Event_DRSL_16_3: Daddy has told us stories about it. The legend of a hero! Do you still remember?
Event_DRSL_16_4: Oh, I know! And a hero and a big bad guy, the Hatless, right?!
Event_DRSL_16_7: So, {Male=you;Female=you} are looking for the insect in the book, right?
Event_DRSL_16_8: A golden fly that smells sweet... Sounds like the yellow butterfly we caught today.
Event_DRSL_16_9: A giant yellow butterfly! Just show {Male=him;Female=her} what we get!
Event_DRSL_16_10: Take a look, {Male=sir;Female=miss}. We had it in the shrubs.
Event_DRSL_16_11: It feeds on honey and smells sweet just like the kind of candy Daddy would treat us to.
Event_DRSL_16_15: Of course! But promise me to come over to play hide-and-seek with us!
Event_DRSL_16_17: I'm quite the expert at this.
Event_DRSL_16_18: Daddy taught us tricks. You can't mess around!
Event_DRSL_16_19: Please accept the butterfly. And don't forget your promise!
Event_DRSL_17_1: The bug does have elegant patterns. Thank you for your efforts. I'll deliver it to the dev team.
Event_DRSL_17_2: It will contribute a lot to the building of the island.
Event_DRSL_18_1: Some time passed while Maqi was away to hand over the item...
Event_DRSL_19_1: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!
Event_DRSL_2_1: Let me explain our job today.
Event_DRSL_2_2: In the opening chapter, our protagonist paid a visit to a city called Tiancheng.
Event_DRSL_2_3: According to the book, "the cries of peddlers fill the market... a bewildering array of goods lines the shelves of every shop..."

Event_DRSL_2_6: This Tiancheng here is so much alike to Jinzhou.

Event_DRSL_20_1: Let me explain our job today.
Event_DRSL_20_2: In this chapter, the true identity of the protagonist's nemesis is finally revealed.
Event_DRSL_20_3: According to the book, it's "...a towering figure with rough edges like a statue..."
Event_DRSL_20_4: "An aura of brilliant stars surrounded this <color=highlight>Crownless King</color> like loyal courtiers..."
Event_DRSL_20_5: "It nearly compelled me to bow down... I gathered all my strength from falling on my knees..."
Event_DRSL_20_8: Where did you learn that name?
Event_DRSL_20_9: Second Coming of Solaris has received overwhelming favor for this part. Fans of this book call this mighty figure The Crownless.
Event_DRSL_20_11: Maybe I have read this book after all.
Event_DRSL_20_12: Really? We must have made a wise decision to pick you as our exclusive consultant.
Event_DRSL_20_14: We want something to help the dev team to picture the image of the Crownless.
Event_DRSL_20_15: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.
Event_DRSL_21_1: A ferocious opponent... The Crownless... Maybe you should ask someone who frequents the danger zone?
Event_DRSL_21_2: Xianchen over there is an experienced Pioneer explorer. If you need help, how about asking her?
Event_DRSL_22_1: I've read Second Coming of Solaris. A good piece of work, I'd admit... But I've never finished it.
Event_DRSL_22_3: Because it makes me sweat bullets when reading the portrayal of the monsters.
Event_DRSL_22_4: Those monsters in the book... They must be the Tacet Discords.
Event_DRSL_22_5: Do they really look that scary?
Event_DRSL_22_6: I fight Tacet Discords a lot.
Event_DRSL_22_8: *sigh* I ventured into Tacet Fields a lot when I was young, wishing to get some first-hand reports about Tacet Discords.
Event_DRSL_22_9: But my adventure was cut short by an accident, where I was heavily injured by Tacet Discords. After that, I decided to leave the field and work for the support staff.
Event_DRSL_22_10: This is something I brought from the Tacet Field back in those days. Just take a look at this ominous structure. It's too weird to be a natural formation.
Event_DRSL_22_11: If you're after something related to monsters, just take this.
Event_DRSL_22_12: Are you really okay with that?
Event_DRSL_22_13: I can feel it's important to you.
Event_DRSL_22_14: Don't take it to your heart. Life is much better when you don't have to handle those Tacet Discords.
Event_DRSL_22_15: But it does remind me of those young Pioneer reporters. They can risk everything for a field trip about Tacet Discords. I can't help but worry about them.
Event_DRSL_22_16: Wait, no. Let's continue this topic next time. I'm off to talk to Zhuyi about his dangerous field trip...
Event_DRSL_23_1: How peculiar... I'll hand it over to the dev team right now. Thank you.
Event_DRSL_23_2: I believe the team would have a much more vivid picture of the protagonist's first encounter with the Crownless.

Event_DRSL_25_3: So you know the name? Many take "Big Brother" as a nickname for the Crownless.
Event_DRSL_25_4: Anyway, let's call it a day. See you tomorrow, {PlayerName}.
Event_DRSL_26_1: Let me explain our job today.

Event_DRSL_28_1: Though I've never read the book, the story certainly feels close to home!
Event_DRSL_28_2: I remember back when I was young and my family was struggling to make ends meet, I could nibble on a plain flatbread that the kind old man of the village gave me to get me through the day.
Event_DRSL_28_3: Perhaps it was these days that nurtured my love for cooking.
Event_DRSL_28_4: What could be happier than to please your guests with all your cooking skills?
Event_DRSL_28_5: Speaking of which, here is a specialty I made just now.
Event_DRSL_28_6: It's called Jinzhou Stew, General Jiyan's favorite food of all time.
Event_DRSL_28_7: It's also a taste from their childhood for many in Jinzhou
Event_DRSL_28_10: Hehe, right? A stew of meat and vegetables always serves the best when you're hungry!
Event_DRSL_28_11: Oh, don't forget your urgent errands. Let's continue our food conversation next time. I still have a few dishes to serve.
Event_DRSL_28_12: You can drop by for a slow enjoyable meal when available. I'll cook for you!

Event_DRSL_31_1: Thank you. That wraps up today's work!

Event_DRSL_32_1: Let me explain our job today.
Event_DRSL_32_2: In this chapter, they ventured all the way to the North and reached Mt. Moore, preparing to meet the final enemy.
Event_DRSL_32_3: Before their enemy showed up, the air of Mt. Moore had already chilled the protagonist to the bone.
Event_DRSL_32_4: It goes: "...Obscuring the moonlight, <color=highlight>black clouds</color> even made the <color=highlight>Mithril</color> on the hills lose its sheen..."
Event_DRSL_32_5: "Everything seemed to be flowing, filling my lungs like condensed ink. As I took my breaths, I was dragged into darkness further."
Event_DRSL_32_6: This part can never cease to impress me with the howling sense of despair, even after all of my repeated readings.
Event_DRSL_32_7: I can't help but wonder, what would induce such a sensational scene? And this Mithrill... what does it look like?
Event_DRSL_32_8: We need a reference for this.
Event_DRSL_32_9: It says it shines bright like the moon.
Event_DRSL_32_10: Indeed. The black clouds had an overwhelming presence as they had swallowed the glow of the moon and minerals.
Event_DRSL_32_11: Samples of Mithrill will help improve the mental image of this chapter, I believe.
Event_DRSL_32_12: If you happen to come across some samples, feel free to drop by.
Event_DRSL_33_1: Well, maybe you should ask the owner of Huaipu Mining Firm. He is a knowledgeable mineral expert.
Event_DRSL_33_2: Since it's about the Mithril, I suggest you go ask for his advice.
Event_DRSL_34_1: Second Coming of Solaris? I could spare little interest for these casual reads of you youngsters...
Event_DRSL_34_2: ...though I do know a thing about this Mithril.
Event_DRSL_34_3: A translucent mineral called Lampylumen would produce an azure shine that makes it even brighter in the dark.
Event_DRSL_34_4: I'm assuming the Mithril probably originates from the Lampylumen.
Event_DRSL_34_5: You've mentioned its writer, Karl, right? I would like to have a little chat with a mineral expert like him.
Event_DRSL_34_6: I don't know if it's possible.
Event_DRSL_34_7: He is out far in the New Federation now.
Event_DRSL_34_8: *sigh* What a shame... As you get older, you'd realize how hard it is to meet someone who shares your passion.

Flow_312900000_7: I dreamed of a new world rising from the ashes of the old.

Guide_YXQJCZ_10_3: Are you that white cat from before?
Guide_YXQJCZ_12_4: Come on, I know you can talk.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_3: The Ebony Gatekeeper didn't recognize me.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_4: Didn't we just have a grand adventure together? I know, you haven't managed to wrap your head around it yet, have you?
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_5: Yes, you see… he's in a bit of situation.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_6: That fella who greeted you at the gateway wasn't actually the real Ebony Gatekeeper.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_9: After your battle in the Somnoire, he lost control over that realm for a time. To fill his unforseen absence, the Somnoire activated his backup.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_10: The backup only retains limited memories from a certain point in the past, so it makes sense he doesn't remember what happened.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_11: He asked for my help in restoring the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_12: So... is there another problem brewing?
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_13: At the moment, that fella is just a backup, so he's probably just doing his job, plain and simple.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_14: Behind this gateway lurks all sorts of mysteries. The chaos in the Somnoire hasn't been fully resolved, and I'm continuing my investigation.
Guide_YXQJCZ_14_15: I'll be here to help you along the way, just as I did before.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_1: I hope it will make a difference.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_3: You can follow "his" guidance and carry on with your exploration.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_5: You mean to complete this beginner's guide?
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_6: Thank you, this will help to restore some of the Memory Zones.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_7: Exactly. "He" has mistaken you for a newcomer to the Somnoire and laid out a special route for you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_8: But the real Ebony Gatekeeper's power is gradually being restored. Before long, that backup of his might be decomissioned...
Guide_YXQJCZ_15_9: But that's for another day. For now, your path is already set.
Guide_YXQJCZ_16_1: What took you so long to leave that Memory Zone?
Guide_YXQJCZ_16_4: But you handled them like it's second nature... Truly impressive.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_1: As you can see, we are now inside the Somnoire. What do you think of it?
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_5: After all, it's made up of the memories and dreams of countless individuals.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_6: Dreams often take us beyond what we can imagine.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_7: Back to the point, in the Somnoire, you'll encounter other entities apart from me.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_10: She is a virtual entity, a fusion of countless consciousnesses within the Somnoire, and the one experiencing this dream.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_11: Just think of her as someone dreaming, but she doesn't truly exist. She's just an Illusia created by the gateway to the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_13: Because there has to be someone dreaming for a dream to exist, doesn't there?
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_14: In fact, she will be a valuable ally as you navigate the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_15: You cannot bring anything inside here. If you need anything in battle, you'll need to manifest them from the dreams recorded in the Somnoire.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_16: Such as... the Echoes you use in battle.
Guide_YXQJCZ_7_17: Go talk to her. She'll give you some important things for your dream.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_1: Ah, hello. Are you dreaming too?
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_4: Hi, please give me an Echo or two.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_5: Yes, I've been dreaming forever. You wouldn't believe the things I've dreamed.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_6: Haha, hello to you! I've never seen anyone as lively as you here.
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_7: There is no need to rush…
Guide_YXQJCZ_8_8: Now that you've found me, I'm guessing you want to hear about my dreams? I've been dreaming up some amazing things!
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_1: So, what do you think? Aren't my dreams exciting?
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_2: There are some powerful things in your dreams.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_3: Thank you for sharing your dreams with me.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_4: Hehe, I didn't lie to you, did I?
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_5: You're welcome! I really enjoyed sharing that with you.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_6: I've had so many amazing dreams, but sadly, there's no one here to listen...
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_7: I'd be happy to share my dreams with you anytime you want!
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_9: Because I understand you're here for business, not my dreams.
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_10: You know that something's gone wrong here, right?
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_11: Strange things have been gathering in the Somnoire lately, and I've been having nightmares too...
Guide_YXQJCZ_9_12: So I won't keep you much longer. If you can help restore things to normal, we'll have all the time in the world to chat.
Guide_YXQJ_100_4: I thought this task wouldn't be easy, even for someone like you.
Guide_YXQJ_100_6: The Somnoire has grown increasingly chaotic and dangerous.
Guide_YXQJ_100_7: Recently, it has been devouring and copying all dreams without discrimination...
Guide_YXQJ_100_8: You'll encounter more bizarre occurrences in the Somnoire… Creatures, plants, Tacet Discords, and even your cherished friends.
Guide_YXQJ_100_9: While you are aware it's a dream, these sights may still leave a lasting impact on your psyche. I hope you are prepared.
Guide_YXQJ_100_10: Anyway… You did well today. I'll meet you outside the Gate.
