GondolaRideSharingPlot_41_1: So this hunt takes us to deep sea?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_1_1: Once again, we find ourselves aboard a ship. So… ready to hoist the sails with me once more?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_2_1: Uncharted seas, hidden riches… How about you name our new route?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_3_1: A view like this… I couldn't ask for better company than you.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_4_1: We drift through ocean halls where sirens weave crimson and amber seaweed. Yet, with the first call of human voices, we fade away.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_14_1: Hehe, if you wish. Gondolas are such private escapes. Any commotion fades into the water.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_15_1: Mysterious, bitter, venomous... do you see the Fisalias in the same light?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_16_1: A beautiful sight, made even more so in your company.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_17_1: Ships and the sea. Many associate them with freedom. Well, Captain, which free land is our next stop?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_18_1: Let's look at it another way. Right in front of us is a golden land filled with endless adventures, just waiting to be explored. There, it becomes more exciting, doesn't it?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_19_1: I really admire the wind. It's free to go anywhere without restraint. If only it could carry my poems into the hands of everyone across the world.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_36_1: When I was young, I feared the sea—a vast blue wilderness with towering tides, nowhere firm to stand. Gladiators can hunt on land, but at sea, they're helpless. That fear stayed with me until I boarded a Gondola. The moment I took the helm, I realized the ocean can be conquered too... just by a different kind of strength.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_37_1: See that grand statue over there? That's Fabius, the founder of Septimont and the first to be dubbed a "Hero of Heroes." It was Fabius who gave this great land its name—a mighty name that traces back to our ancestors' homeland. It is said that before they were forced to give up their homes, they once lived on land surrounded by seven hills.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_38_1: Ah, what an unforgettable sight. A magnificent sunset will rise later from the west. The people of Septimont cherish this hour, letting the fading light fill their dreams, so when they wake, it feels as if the sun never set. Rather than place our faith in distant Divinities, we choose to believe in the light within reach. That light... we call it hope.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_39_1: The Sanguis Plateaus, border to the abyss... countless unsung heroes have fallen in these hunting grounds. May the fragrance of Asphodels bring peace to their souls, and may the wings of Gryphons guide them home to the Vale of Glory.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_32_1: Very well. Let us journey deeper into the waters however we please. Just you and I. Till we begin to tire.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_33_1: Having no destiny in mind isn't entirely a bad thing... It's a good pastime, losing ourselves in one little mystery moment after another.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_34_1: The words, the chanting, and the singing... You can hear them even from here? With all their pretentious formalities and sophistication, I never expected the Ragunnesi to be so unrestrained in performance. Such passion, such richness, such life... How to put it? The true self behind a mask?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_35_1: I've never quite looked at the ridges surrounding the hunting grounds like this before. Solid. Stalwart. They shape the very space we live in, giving us the room to run, to chase freely everything we are meant to conquer. So what exactly defines Septimont? It's a legend of glories standing right before our eyes. We and our futures are rooted in the land between those ridges.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_11_1: Chart the course, "Captain!" I'll handle the steering. Let's have a whale of a time today!
GondolaRideSharingPlot_12_1: Home sweet home! Care to join me for dinner?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_13_1: What a splendid view! A perfect spot for a few surprises!
GondolaRideSharingPlot_29_1: I hope I won't fall in this time.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_30_1: Melodies of decay echo in these grounds.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_5_1: I've got plenty of experience as a deckhand, let me help. Ah, sorry. I forgot I'm not on the job...
GondolaRideSharingPlot_7_1: Look at that view, it's like a natural stage... Want to put on a show? I've got a little tune that might be just right.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_10_1: What a splendid view. Too bad Signor C-MOSS isn't here to take our picture... Wait {PlayerName}, doesn't your Terminal function as a camera?
GondolaRideSharingPlot_8_1: It's an honor to sail with the Laureate... (*Echo boat trumpeting noises*) (Smiling) Look, they think so too.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_9_1: We give thanks to the Sentinel for all that is ours.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_20_1: Where are you sailing? I can be the navigator.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_21_1: Oh, I'm fine from here. I should get back to work. Just kidding! Today's not a workday
GondolaRideSharingPlot_22_1: What a stunning view. It's like we've stepped into a painting and became part of it.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_26_1: When troubled, I like to ride a Gondola alone. A peaceful afternoon at sea resets me... just like now, with you by my side.
GondolaRideSharingPlot_27_1: I do miss the times we fought side by side here. Every moment was pure exhilaration!
GondolaRideSharingPlot_28_1: Countless warriors from Septimont rushed here to fight. Some returned home in glory, others rest in peace beneath the hunting grounds.
EventCLFY_1_1: Watch out! Stay clear of the way! It's dangerous!
EventCLFY_10_1: A student on the road at this hour? Are you here for field work?
EventCLFY_2_1: Phew... Thanks to Spacetrek Collective's built-in precaution & auto-braking system on this vehicle. That was a close one.
EventCLFY_3_1: Stay clear! Don't want any scratches!
EventCLFY_4_1: This is dangerous. Please stay clear of the traffic.
EventCLFY_5_1: Please don't do such reckless things!
EventCLFY_8_1: Impressive! Never occurred to me to use Pathfinder Ramp like that!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_1_1: Greetings, {PlayerName}. The System shows you have successfully completed multiple requests issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_1_2: Your contribution to the security and stability of Xuanfang Hold is appreciated.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_1_5: You need not be so modest, {PlayerName}. You have aided many. They will remember what you have done for them.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_1_6: Please keep up the good work and assist us in complEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE
Side_YJYAHXWJ_1_11: ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇, Four Chime Shaftpost ▇▇▇▇ in danger. Please assist ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_10_1: The Artisans say the saboteur knows the Four Chime Shaftpost inside out. They must've been studying it for a long time.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_10_2: Their coding style suggests they haven't updated their methods in years. Why?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_10_3: Could the Wardens and the Four Chime Shaftpost have kept them trapped in the Hold, cut off from the outside?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_10_4: I don't know the exact date they infiltrated the Hold, but it had to be years ago.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_11_1: Whoever their leader is, they mentioned being "abandoned" years ago—assuming there really is a mastermind behind all this.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_11_2: Wait... "abandoned?" That would explain why they've completely lost contact with the outside world.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_11_3: Could the Wardens and the Four Chime Shaftpost have kept them trapped in the Hold, cut off from the outside?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_11_4: If that's the case, they must have infiltrated the Hold years ago.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_12_2: I need to look at this from a different angle.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_13_1: So... what exactly are they trying to achieve by destroying the Four Chime Shaftpost?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_14_1: ...Muyu. He knows the saboteurs and their real identities. In fact, he's the one who asked them to distract the Wardens.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_14_2: It sounds like he's looking for allies, but he's probably just using them as a smokescreen for his own plan.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_14_3: But these saboteurs have their own agenda, too. They're not actually working with him, just covering their bases against him.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_14_4: They only agreed to muddy the waters so they could fish for what they want... Alright, this should be enough to go on.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_15_2: I need to look at this from a different angle.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_16_1: Now for the most important question: who exactly are these infiltrators?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_16_2: Their organization has a clear chain of command. And the higher-ups go out of their way to hide their identities.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_16_3: But why? Pure caution? Or... is there something else at play?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_16_4: There have to be clues I missed around the scene...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_17_1: ...Those claws. Judging by their height on the wall, whoever left them was around human height, more or less.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_17_2: Doesn't look like the work of an Autopuppet or a Tacet Discord. The residual frequency doesn't match either. I'd bet on it being... a modified human.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_17_3: And the only group that fits that description is... the Fractsidus.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_17_4: That explains why they tried so hard to scrub themselves from the Shaftpost's surveillance footage.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_17_5: They can hide their distorted bodies under cloaks to avoid drawing attention, but the Constables wouldn't be fooled so easily.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_18_2: I need to look at this from a different angle.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_19_1: It's no surprise the Fractsidus set their sights on a city as advanced as Xuanfang Hold. But there are still a lot of unanswered questions.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_19_2: How did those saboteurs first make contact with Muyu? What's their real mission? And... why target the Four Chime Shaftpost?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_19_3: The Fractsidus have been lurking in the shadows this whole time. They were already making preparations back when Muyu first attacked Xuanfang Hold.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_19_4: And the moment he fled, they moved into action almost instantly.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_19_5: This could be just one of their many schemes. If so, is there still time for us to get ahead of it?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_19_6: ...But they've tipped their hand now. Now we need to be prepared for whatever they've got coming.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_3: They managed to get the basics running again, but as for the rest, all we can do is wait and let the mechanism core repair itself.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_5: And until the System's fully back online, we'll be on high alert for any unexpected trouble. The Wardens will back us up.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_6: Trouble is, Muyu's attack cost us a lot of people. And now, without real-time intel from the System, keeping a handle on emergencies across the entire Hold is...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_7: ...Well, it's a lot, to be honest. But everyone will do what they can.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_8: Is there anything I can do to help?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_10: We swept the Shaftpost area earlier, looking for whoever did this. Already got a few leads.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_12: But with the unrest the Mingshen System's crash could potentially unleash, we had to deprioritize the investigation and send our Constables out to keep order.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_13: Luckily, the Artisans just told me the System's rollback function is back online. The trail's still hot. Our best chance at finding what exactly happened is right now.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_14: So I'd like to ask you to track down the saboteur behind this.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_17: Ugh, trust me, I want to. What kind of Constable would leave a case like this sitting there?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_18: But I have to stay here to coordinate the Wardens and the other Constables. Have to send the Artisan's maintenance progress up the chain of command, too...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_19: I've no choice but to ask this favor of you, {PlayerName}. I'll sync our current case file to you now.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_20: If you need more details about the breach, go talk to the Artisans repairing the mechanism core.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_21: Thank you. I'll sync our current case file to you now.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_22: If you need more details about the breach, go talk to the Artisans repairing the mechanism core.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_23: We're counting on you to find the saboteur.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_24: As you can see, the Mingshen System crashed out of nowhere, taking all its subsystems down with it.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_2_25: We're still figuring out what happened. The Artisans who came to repair it say there are signs of an outside breach.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_20_2: Multiple sectors across the Hold are under attack! There are Autopuppets, Tacet Discords, and—
Side_YJYAHXWJ_20_4: Ah... Yes, them! Those lunatics in red! Came out of nowhere!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_20_5: They've been hiding in the Hold for years. With the Wardens and Autopuppets already crippled from the last attack, this was the perfect opportunity for them to strike.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_20_6: Makes sense... Good thing we set up defenses early. Got the civilians out too.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_20_7: But a few sectors are in bad shape. The Wardens there are spread too thin to handle that many at once.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_20_8: They've begged the Ministry for reinforcements multiple times, but our very last backup squad was deployed minutes ago.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_20_10: ...Then I'm leaving it in your hands, {PlayerName}. All attack sites are marked on the Mingshen System. Use it to find where they need you most.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_21_1: (Figured the Fractsidus would hit the Hold at full-scale.)
Side_YJYAHXWJ_21_2: (But even for them, I doubt pure destruction is their end goal.)
Side_YJYAHXWJ_21_3: (This chaos is likely just a smokescreen for their true objective. If so... what are they really after?)
Side_YJYAHXWJ_21_4: (I need to call in some backup.)
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_2: Yangyang, something big is going down.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_3: You mean the attacks? I just heard... the Fractsidus is behind them.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_4: My current sector hasn't been hit yet. I'm helping the Constables evacuate civilians right now.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_6: (Ask Yangyang to reinforce the Four Chime Shaftpost.)
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_11: The Fractsidus is hitting the Hold hard, but I think it's a diversion to draw our forces away.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_12: The Four Chime Shaftpost is wide open. Please, go there and find Weining. She might need your help.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_13: The Shaftpost... Understood. I'll be there as soon as I can.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_22_18: How are things on your end? I'm almost finished here... Do you need backup?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_23_1: Where on earth did these TDs come from?!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_23_2: Stay in formation! Keep them out of the residential sector!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_24_1: Watch out, {PlayerName}! These Autopuppets have gone rogue again!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_24_2: Not as aggressive as before, but still dangerous!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_25_3: Dammit... What is wrong with them?!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_27_1: —{PlayerName}! The Fractsidus are attacking the Four Chime Shaftpost!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_27_2: Ugh... We're holding for now, but there are too many of them! We—
Side_YJYAHXWJ_27_3: —Miss Weining! Fall back and catch your breath. I'll take it from here!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_27_4: (The Shaftpost. Of course, that's their target. Good thing Yangyang got there in time.)
Side_YJYAHXWJ_27_5: Hang in there, I'll be there soon.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_1: Brave and tenacious... We'll give you that. But throwing your lives away here is pointless.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_2: Drop your weapons and leave the Four Chime Shaftpost to us.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_3: Not a chance! You're not getting one step closer as long as we're still breathing!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_4: I've dealt with their kind before, Miss Weining. They aren't... the charitable sort.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_5: Maybe I didn't make myself clear. We don't want your blood on our hands. We just want... to go home. To leave this cage.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_7: Ah... {PlayerName}. Heard a lot about you. I think... you might be different from the rest. Maybe there's room for us to talk.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_8: Word is, back in Jinzhou, Rinascita, and Lahai-Roi, you "took care" of them real well.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_10: If you were one of the Fractsidus I fought before, you would have said "us."
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_11: ...Hmph. You'd think, right? But they abandoned us to this rotting cage... left us like pathetic TDs in the Myriad Snare.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_12: We hoped, you know. Hoped we'd be the ones to finish that grand mission. Hoped they'd deliver on that promise—ultimate power, they said.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_13: We hid under these cloaks, scurrying through the Hold like rats, all to dig up secrets about this region's Sentinel.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_14: But they never came back for us as they promised. We waited, and waited... day after day, year after year.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_15: That fool Muyu actually thought we'd act as bait just to cover for his sorry excuse of a plan.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_16: It made us realize... whether it's an Overseer or anyone else up top... we're all just puppets to them.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_17: We don't want to fight you, and we don't want needless bloodshed. We only want out of this cage. To go home.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_18: ...Don't listen to her, {PlayerName}! They... You know what they're doing in Xuanfang Hold as we speak...!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_19: We held back. Stirred up a few disturbances, nothing more. We held back from wanton killing. Even went out of our way not to hurt people.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_20: Our methods... are nothing like Muyu's, or the rest of the Fractsidus.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_25: ...You'll never trust anyone like us, will you, {PlayerName}? That's... a pitiable flaw.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_26: We could have settled this peacefully. But now—
Side_YJYAHXWJ_29_27: —Go! Pin {PlayerName} down! The rest of you, tear the Four Chime Shaftpost apart!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_3_1: No... I don't believe it. This is too crude...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_30_2: Strike the Shaftpost! Open the way out!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_30_3: ...Did it work? Wait.. No, that's not... NOOO—
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_1: What... what is that thing floating in the air?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_2: It's the mechanism core. The impact it took must have triggered the Shaftpost's automated self-defense system.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_3: It's calling every Autopuppet nearby to protect it... Miss Weining, if this keeps up, the system might end up targeting civilians in the crossfire!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_4: ...Is there any way to shut it down?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_5: The core's forceshield is blocking all external signals. If we can break through it, we can send a remote command to force an override.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_6: Understood. So I just keep hammering the shield until it breaks?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_7: In theory, yes. But... you must be careful! The Autopuppets are already converging on your location. They seem to have flagged you as a target that needs to be neutralized.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_32_8: Miss Weining, let's handle the remaining Fractsidus operatives. We can't let them distract {PlayerName}.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_34_1: Initiating elimination protocol... Requesting Autopuppet reinforcement.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_35_1: Forceshield damage detected... Running self-diagnosis now.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_36_1: W-we did it! I... I can't believe we actually made it stop!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_36_4: Can you come back to the Four Chime Shaftpost? I... I want to thank you in person.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_2: The Fractsidus in Xuanfang mobilized almost all of their remaining forces for this attack. Most of them are in custody now.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_3: A few might've slipped through the cracks, but they no longer pose a threat. We can leave it to the Constables to clean up the rest.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_4: The Hold is safe. Only a handful of people were injured... it feels like an absolute miracle.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_5: It's all thanks to you, {PlayerName}. And you, Miss Yangyang.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_6: On behalf of the Constables and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, I want to extend my sincere gratitude for your heroic actions during this crisis.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_7: You're far too kind, Miss Weining.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_9: No need to be so formal.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_10: Please, accept the praise... I'll feel terrible otherwise.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_12: Ah, look at the time... I need to get back to tying up loose ends. Now that we've captured so many Fractsidus operatives, I have to submit an official report to Mengzhou City Hall through the Ministry of War.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_13: City Hall decides their fate. But I'm the one stuck writing the reports... Haaa...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_38_14: Anyway, if you ever need my help with anything in the future, please don't hesitate to ask!
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_1: No... I don't believe it. This is too crude...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_2: The Court of Savantae's work is the same as their creed—pure order, pure utility. Zhuojun Atelier, on the other hand, chases ingenuity of the highest kind.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_3: Simple as that... you get what I mean, right? They're artists. But this... this isn't an Artisan's work. Not in my eyes.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_4: So... you're saying the breach lacked finesse?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_5: Exactly. They used makeshift external hardware and forced their way into the Four Chime Shaftpost's mechanism core, consequences be damned. This was built to break, not to build.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_6: Look at it. The Terminal they used got so overloaded that it melted into a twisted lump of metal.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_7: True, but you have to admit... they hit the Shaftpost right where it hurts. And they bypassed the mechanism core's firewall entirely.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_8: Whoever did this knows this place inside out. Even the Ministry of Development took years to figure out how the core works.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_9: Though, come to think of it, this actually lines up with the trace frequency data we pulled from the Mingshen System.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_10: Remember how I said their coding style was primitive? It's the kind of style that went out of fashion years ago.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_11: Wait. If all these pieces fit... that leads us to a very concerning conclusion.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_12: ...There's a faction out there we don't know about, and they're not Artisans. They've been lying low in Xuanfang for ages, long enough to map out every single blind spot in the Shaftpost's defenses.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_13: They've never made a move before, which is why we've never seen a breach like this. They've just been waiting, like bamboo shoots under the snow, biding their time for the perfect moment to poke their heads out...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_14: ...We need to report this to Miss Weining.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_4_15: Agreed. But I bet she already knows. Or at least, she saw it coming.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_40_1: ...{PlayerName}, did you receive the messages I just sent? WavesLine crashed right after, so I wasn't sure if they reached your Terminal.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_40_2: I got some of them... I'm closing in on the Four Chime Shaftpost now. Did something happen to the Mingshen System?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_40_3: Yes... it's a total mess. Let's talk more when you've made it here, {PlayerName}.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_5_1: There are deep gouges in the corner of the wall. Claw marks sunk into the stone like a beast's handprint.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_5_2: You can almost see it as it lurked in the dead of night, bracing against the wall, peering toward the Four Chime Shaftpost.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_5_3: The height of the marks suggests a human left them. But the size and depth say otherwise. No ordinary human could have the strength or biology to do that.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_5_4: A humanoid Autopuppet? Or a human augmented with mechanical parts? Or...
Side_YJYAHXWJ_5_5: A vague suspicion crosses your mind, but you need more evidence to be sure.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_50_1: When did the saboteurs' organization infiltrate Xuanfang Hold?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_51_1: What exactly are they trying to achieve by destroying the Shaftpost?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_53_1: I can't pin down the exact date they slipped into the Hold, but it's safe to say it happened years ago.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_54_1: They plan to destabilize Xuanfang Hold, using the chaos as a smokescreen to carry out an even more insidious plot.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_55_1: These hidden infiltrators... They must be the Fractsidus.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_1: Hello, {PlayerName}. I'm Weining, a Constable of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. I'm in charge of security around Shaftpost Yard and managing the Mingshen System.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_2: Miss Liangyu of the Xuan Triad mentioned that she granted you access to use the Skywatch Rings to interface with the Mingshen System.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_3: Have you had a chance to try out its functions yet?
Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_8: Got it. The Hold is overwhelmed with different matters right now, and our Constables are spread incredibly thin.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_10: I see. That saves us some time on the explanations, then.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_13: If you have a moment, please come find me at Shaftpost Yard. There is an important matter I would like to ask of you.

Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_3: Tell me more about the Mingshen System.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_4: I'd like to know more about the Skywatch Rings.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_6: As you can see, Xuanfang Hold is currently facing a shortage of manpower.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_7: Many Xuanfang Wardens and Constables were injured in the recent battles and need time to recover. The rest of our forces are occupied dealing with the fallout of the rogue Autopuppets.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_8: So we've decided to try delegating some of the Hold's internal affairs to trusted Resonators like yourself through these commissions.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_9: If a case proves too complex or difficult to resolve on your own, you can submit a report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs once you've gathered enough clues. We'll send people to take over.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_10: Once a case is closed, or once you give us critical leads, you'll be rewarded accordingly.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_11: In short, feel free to take them on. Just watch your back out there.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_12: The Mingshen System...? It's how we monitor potential security threats across the Land of Xuanfang. Its name comes from the old principle of  <ano=uphold virtue and use punishment with caution>"Mingde Shenfa."</ano>
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_13: It aggregates logs collected from Skywatch Ring surveillance units, alongside resident reports about suspicious activities or anomalies. Using this data, it triangulates the coordinates of potential incidents.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_14: That way, our Constables don't have to patrol all day blindly. They can head straight to the likely location and start investigating.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_15: Besides security threats, the System also picks up other minor incidents, such as dispute mediations, lost-and-found notices, and general requests for help.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_16: These aren't as urgent. But if you're in the area, feel free to help out.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_17: The Skywatch Rings are a network of devices scattered across the Land of Xuanfang. Their main job is monitoring Tacet Discord activity.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_18: They track surrounding TD frequencies and record visual footage within a certain radius to help locate threats.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_19: The Mingshen System also has the authority to retrieve specific data from these rings.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_20: When investigating cases, Constables often check the recorded footage to track a target's location or escape route.
Side_YJYAHXWJ_58_21: Great. I'll be here if you need anything, {PlayerName}.

NPC_LNXTMDST_16_15: Lario is an Echo, so nobody knows why barnacles still grow on him. Another mystery, I suppose.
NPC_LNXTMDST_16_16: Anyway, whenever we went ashore we gave him a good scrub. That's when we really started to bond. He was so happy he even let us dance on his back!
NPC_LNXTMDST_16_17: Now, every time we land in a new city, we give him another good bath. In return, he lets us set up a stage on his back and put on a performance.
NPC_LNXTMDST_16_18: Ah, looking back, it's been quite the journey, hasn't it?
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_1: Have you finished reading the Order's new play? What do you think?
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_2: Same tired themes again. Praising the doctrine, dictating morality... Always painting those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail as the scum of the earth.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_3: Exactly! By the end of it, I almost felt like marching straight back to the city and slapping every one of them, just to show them how ridiculous their little play really is.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_4: If all we're after is revenge, might as well join Aldric and become pirates. Go after Ragunna's merchant ships, raid the Order's Acolytes, take whatever we want.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_5: But that'd make us no better than the heretics they love to write about in their dramas.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_6: There would be no turning back. We'd have no voice left, no way to clear our names or expose Fenrico's lies.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_7: We'd just have to watch everyone we love become tools used by the Order.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_9: I still want our story to be seen. The real story. Let the world see who we truly are.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_10: Alright then, Mask up. Let's run through another scene.
NPC_LNXTMDST_17_11: This Carnevale, we aren't who we used to be in Ragunna—we're the Fools who fight for equality, for freedom. That's who we must become.
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_1: I'm done. Inspiration's as elusive as the moon in the sky, and I'm just a headless seaweed adrift in the ocean...
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_3: I'm... I'm the traveler without shoes, stumbling down a path to inspiration that's nothing but thorns... *cough*!
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_4: Alright, I'll confess. The truth is I just can't seem to write a thing.
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_5: I've got a handful of half-baked manuscripts, but none of them capture the life of the Blessed Maiden.
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_6: How did she grow up, and what aspirations did she set for herself? How were her studies in the seminary, and how did she pursue her dreams?
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_7: I'm at a loss. I can't even figure out the ending for this script. I talked with the captain about it earlier, and he's just as stumped.
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_8: Recently, I received a mysterious package. The captain says it's a private collection from the Fisalia family. No idea who sent it, but they must have had a soft spot for me...
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_9: After reading, I felt like I was on the verge of piecing it all together. But inspiration's like a shooting star. Every time I reach for it... poof! It slips through my fingers.
NPC_LNXTMDST_18_10: I don't know what to do! Perhaps I am just a seaweed. Brainless, drifting with the tide...
NPC_LNXTMDST_19_1: What kind of fireworks display would fit the grand spectacle of Ragunna's Carnevale?
NPC_LNXTMDST_19_2: Fireworks shouldn't just light up the night... they need to dazzle in the daylight too!
NPC_LNXTMDST_2_1: Golden Fleece, burst forth in colorful flames! Wait, that's strange...
NPC_LNXTMDST_2_3: I'm Kasper, the troupe's Fireworks Master. I'm experimenting with this Golden Fleece, you see.
NPC_LNXTMDST_2_4: It comes from the sighs of ancient dragons, the remnants of their flames. It was once used to make gunpowder.
NPC_LNXTMDST_2_5: But now, it will be transformed into the finest firework material!
NPC_LNXTMDST_2_6: No longer will it bring terror, but joy and laughter instead.
NPC_LNXTMDST_2_7: It will explode in the sky, lighting up Ragunna's sky!
NPC_LNXTMDST_2_8: But... there's still something missing... What could it be? Let me think a moment.
NPC_LNXTMDST_20_1: I've got it! I've got it!
NPC_LNXTMDST_20_2: Some Golden Fleece, a touch of unstable glazed young rock, and a feather from Pan Cake! I'll get consent first, I promise!
NPC_LNXTMDST_20_3: After that, three happy Nimbus Wraiths. I'll use their laughter to catalyze a rainbow of flame.
NPC_LNXTMDST_20_4: Then, the grand finale—Boom! My power will set it all off!
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_1: Oh, dear friend! Keep your distance, will you? I wouldn't want to blow you up by accident!
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_3: I'm working on a new firework invention... Just about to let out a sneeze!
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_5: Oh? Didn't they tell you? Every time I sneeze, it sets off a little explosion.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_6: Before I close my eyes, wherever my gaze lands, boom! That's where the spark happens.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_8: Aha! That's why I need to pluck a feather from Pan Cake. You see, just a little tickle on the nose with it, and I'll—
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_11: Whoops! Sorry, almost caused another disaster.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_13: It's a long story. You see, I was just accompanying my beloved Miranda to the Cathedral of Mercury to pray...
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_14: When wouldn't you know it, a pigeon feather landed right on my nose. Just as I was devoutly gazing at the Sentinel's statue, too... and then—sneeze!
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_15: So that's why you ended up being...
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_16: Exactly. The Acolytes thought I was a heretic trying to deface the statue. Without a second thought, they tossed me onto the Pilgrim's Sail.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_17: I've spent years as a fireworks master in Ragunna without a single soul noticing. But one sneeze, and suddenly, I'm making headlines! Guess I finally got my moment.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_18: You see the scar on my nose? The Acolytes were so afraid I'd sneeze on the Troupe of Fools that they actually clipped my nose before I boarded.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_19: If it weren't for Brant saving me, I'd be breathing through my mouth for the rest of my life!
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_20: Speaking of odd things... if you manage to climb up to the Sentinel statue, you might find the little hole I left behind. My sneeze mark.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_22: Absurd? This is Ragunna! At least I'm still alive to tell the tale.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_23: Since I've been with the Fool's Troupe, business has been booming. Got me a solid group of customers.
NPC_LNXTMDST_21_24: When I was a fireworks master in Ragunna, business wasn't nearly this good. Now look at me, practically blowing up the competition! Ha!
NPC_LNXTMDST_22_1: Ragunna... the false Righteous One... cloaked in divinity, divinity... hmm...
NPC_LNXTMDST_22_2: Father... Mother... It's me, Todd... Did you like my performance...?
NPC_LNXTMDST_22_3: Don't cry... I'm here... I'm home...
NPC_LNXTMDST_23_1: I get what you're saying... but I want a No. 65 Tubpup with Nuvola Pasta...
NPC_LNXTMDST_23_2: It's so deep... It's all Troupe Strength in the Tubpup... I can't drink anymore...
NPC_LNXTMDST_23_3: Too much Tubpup... bad for your health...
NPC_LNXTMDST_24_1: I love you... but I can only see you in my dreams...
NPC_LNXTMDST_24_2: Look at our daughter... how adorable she is... Marina...
NPC_LNXTMDST_24_3: Can I see her one last time, please... Why... Why can't I see her face clearly...
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_3: As you can see, it's only when I'm fully awake that I can "craft" their dreams.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_4: What kind of dreams do you craft?
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_5: Hmm… it varies, really. Most of the time, I create beautiful visions to heal the regrets that weigh on their hearts.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_6: But, from what I've seen, the fear of "boarding the Fool's Sail" appears to be so deeply rooted that the dreams don't always turn out as they hoped.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_8: Todd, hailing from an underground theater troupe, was banished merely for using comedy to satirize the Order's tax policies...
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_9: Gideon's family was framed by the Acolytes. At his lowest, he could only find solace with a Tubpup. It became his shelter, his only home in the storm.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_10: Knox was sent aboard the Fool's Sail before his newborn child even had a chance to open their eyes. And as kin of a "heretic," the future doesn't look kind.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_12: During this Carnevale, we all have to hide our identities and take on roles in the Fool's Troupe as we return to Ragunna City, after so long.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_13: We must suppress our desire to reconnect with old friends while trying to complete the Montelli family's mission. It's... complicated. So insomnia, I suppose, is inevitable.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_14: That's why I need to create dreams for them, to help them get some rest.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_15: Why do you hide your true identities?
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_16: Well, the Order doesn't know... but most of the Fool's Troupe are survivors from the Pilgrim's Sail.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_17: The moment the Order uncovers the truth, our Fool's Elysium will burn to the ground. We have to keep our silence, no matter the cost.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_18: In our plays, we sing to condemn the oppression, to shed light on the bloodshed… One day, all of Rinascita will know what Fenrico has done.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_19: Take a break when you feel ready.
NPC_LNXTMDST_25_20: Thank you… for taking the time to understand us, for wanting to know the Fools' story.
NPC_LNXTMDST_26_1: Who... who are you? How did you suddenly appear at sea? Why are you rescuing us?
NPC_LNXTMDST_26_2: I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
NPC_LNXTMDST_26_4: I understand your panic, Mr. Fede. But remember this—
NPC_LNXTMDST_26_5: In the eyes of The Order, a pilgrimage is no different from an execution...
NPC_LNXTMDST_27_1: (Narrator: A mere infatuation is far from enough. What Chappell, now fallen to mortality, needs is a heart consumed by desire. Without it, anyone's love is nothing but a delusion!)
NPC_LNXTMDST_27_2: (Narrator: The doctrines that sever human desires and the silence, the tasteless laws and divine meals, now only provoke her instinctive revulsion—)
NPC_LNXTMDST_27_3: I don't need a sermon, Acolyte Bugatti. Either shut up or join me in enjoying this delicious Golden Crab Pie.
NPC_LNXTMDST_27_4: Don't look at me like that, Bugatti. I'm not the Acolyte you once knew.
NPC_LNXTMDST_27_5: Call me Chappell... My name is Chappell Romanya, Lord Bugatti.
NPC_LNXTMDST_28_1: Hmm… These botched recreations. But I guess I'll have to finish them off anyway.
NPC_LNXTMDST_28_2: The taste and presentation might be lacking, but it's still edible!
NPC_LNXTMDST_28_3: Oh my! This one is... Poached Egg with Slug Relish, from "The Merchant of Ragunna."
NPC_LNXTMDST_28_4: Seems the slug meat got overcooked. No wonder Gisle's jaw started twitching halfway through his lines...
NPC_LNXTMDST_28_5: And here we have the Layered Yak Short Rib Bake... Must be the family feast main course from Act 3, Scene 6 of "The Lady of Camellya."
NPC_LNXTMDST_28_6: Ugh, this yak meat is far too fatty. No wonder Heather's aria sounded like it was dripping in butter...
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_1: Hello there, {PlayerName}! I'm testing out some new recipes, but I won't invite you to sample them just yet.
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_3: Yes, inspired by the plays, you see. Though recreating them has proven to be a bit more troublesome than I anticipated.
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_4: Golden Crab Pie is one of my few triumphant creations!
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_5: I'm Rossini. I didn't get the chance to introduce myself during today's rehearsal. I used to work in the kitchens of the Order of the Deep, preparing meals for the council members.
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_6: Why did the Order exile you?
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_7: I merely enhanced the council's meals—naturally, in the best way possible.
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_8: The head chef accused me of using sinister methods to incite the Acolytes' appetites, corrupting their piety and undermining the Order.
NPC_LNXTMDST_29_9: Heretic, he called me...  a laughable but effective accusation.
NPC_LNXTMDST_3_1: I suspect we'll head for Lilyland next.
NPC_LNXTMDST_3_2: I'd wager that Septimont is more likely.
NPC_LNXTMDST_3_4: We're debating our next destination. We're still on a Pan-Ragunna Tour, after all.
NPC_LNXTMDST_3_5: The Captain often says, "Wherever the applause calls, there we'll go to 'capture laughter.' With our craft, our wit, and a touch of our own flair, we'll claim what's rightfully ours."
NPC_LNXTMDST_3_6: True enough. But each island has its own tastes when it comes to theater. We'll need to tailor our efforts to make sure everyone feels the journey was worthwhile!
NPC_LNXTMDST_3_7: But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!
NPC_LNXTMDST_30_2: Look at me! I'm your audience. Break the fourth wall with your gaze!
NPC_LNXTMDST_31_1: Madame Nyarla has thrown us another curveball...
NPC_LNXTMDST_31_2: The imaginative design of this stage truly aligns with Madame Nyarla's signature style—"a labyrinth of opulent, fevered dreams."
NPC_LNXTMDST_31_3: But why do I feel like this "fevered and opulent dream" has left me standed outside the gates?
NPC_LNXTMDST_32_1: This new brew's potency should carry us through the entire Carnevale.
NPC_LNXTMDST_32_2: If Brant manages to snag the Laurel this year, you can bet Troupe Strength will sell like hotcakes. Heh, heh, heh...
NPC_LNXTMDST_33_1: This... this... is yet another baseless slander!
NPC_LNXTMDST_33_2: If this religious play actually gets performed, how will my wife and daughter see me? How will the rest of the town see them?
NPC_LNXTMDST_33_3: How are they supposed to live in Ragunna after this? Damn it!
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_1: Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_3: Wake up, Fede. No city-state will take in outcasts without identity, unable to prove their very existence. We've lost our status as citizens of Ragunna.
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_4: Even our papers... they've turned to nothing but scraps of useless parchment.
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_5: Is there really no one who'll take us in? I still have a few friends... I...
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_6: Your friends? Do you truly think they'd welcome "heretics" like us?
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_7: What would you have me do, Chantelle? The Order's just left us to die out here, haven't they? How could they do this to us...?
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_8: Mr. Federico, please... stay calm. You can stay here while you plan your next steps.
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_9: Thank you so much Ahem... Fid?
NPC_LNXTMDST_4_10: Y-yes, thank you. I... we don't know how to thank you enough...
NPC_LNXTMDST_5_1: Oh, dearest Elisha... what shall our next ballet be?
NPC_LNXTMDST_5_3: Ah, {PlayerName}, is that you? I was just asking Elisha what our next performance should be...
NPC_LNXTMDST_5_4: See, each island nation has its own preferences, you know.
NPC_LNXTMDST_5_5: Take Septimont, for example. They favor plays like "The Three Hundred Knights of Capitoline" and "Assassin's Journey"—you know, action-packed, filled with historical sagas and war. That's their thing.
NPC_LNXTMDST_5_6: I like them too, but Elisha doesn't share my enthusiasm.
NPC_LNXTMDST_5_7: She prefers heart-wrenching tragedies like "The Shape of the Ocean" or "The Perished Waterworld." You know, those tear-jerking stories that only the Riccioli people seem to appreciate...
NPC_LNXTMDST_5_8: But I can't stand that place. And let's be honest, tragedy is not in my wheelhouse. Ugh... it's so frustrating, Elisha, my dear Elisha...
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_1: Hey! Want to try my first latest dish?
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_4: Ah, yes! This is inspired by a performance I saw. A true Rinascita culinary creation, born from the stage!
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_5: Place a Goldcrest Scarab into a pie, baked with Mastic Nuvola and Viscum Berry... then nestle it in a Bell Crab shell, arranging it just so, to mimic the playful movements of the scarab...
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_8: Yes, exactly! Isn't it fascinating? To help the actors truly feel their roles, I've gone all in to recreate these legendary dishes!
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_9: So, what do you think? Want to try this dish—the one that brings "Chappell Romanya" back to the mortal realm, but leaves "Acolyte Bugatti" with a most perplexed expression?
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_12: No, no, no! No way! There's just no way!! You eat it, I'm not eating it!
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_13: Scared you enough to jolt you awake?
NPC_LNXTMDST_6_14: Hey! Are you sure you don't want to give it a try? I can guarantee this dish has a flavor like no other!
NPC_LNXTMDST_7_1: What should I do, Mama Jemma? I can't go anywhere, and I can't sing...
NPC_LNXTMDST_7_2: It's alright, I can't sing either, and I'm doing just fine here, aren't I?
NPC_LNXTMDST_7_3: Come on, let me show you around. Let's see what you might be able to do.
NPC_LNXTMDST_8_3: Jemma is comforting those recently exiled by the Order. I'll see if there's anything I can do to help.
NPC_LNXTMDST_8_4: The captain said if they're headed to the Riccioli Islands or Septimont, we should arrange for Echoes to help them avoid dragons and safely get to where they want to go.
NPC_LNXTMDST_8_5: Everyone's got their own path to walk, after all. Not everyone's going to stay here.
NPC_LNXTMDST_8_6: In the past, some have sought refuge with their families in the Riccioli Islands, while others ventured to Septimont, trading honor for a new identity, all holding onto the hope of one day returning to Ragunna.
NPC_LNXTMDST_8_7: And then there are those who turned to piracy. That's not really our way.
NPC_LNXTMDST_8_8: But that's fine, everyone's choices take them down different roads. Let's just help each other while we can!
NPC_LNXTMDST_9_4: We're rehearsing. This is Doggins, the main character of our play!
NPC_LNXTMDST_9_5: An Echo as the main character?
NPC_LNXTMDST_9_6: Ha! Don't underestimate our Doggins. This kid is sharp as a tack!
NPC_LNXTMDST_9_7: He sneaked aboard the Pilgrim's Sail, searching for his exiled friends, and ended up here.
NPC_LNXTMDST_9_8: But the friends he was looking for... they're not here. They went somewhere else.
NPC_LNXTMDST_9_9: Still, our little Doggins didn't give up. He decided to stay with us and join the tour across Rinascita!
NPC_LNXTMDST_9_10: This play we're rehearsing is all about Doggin's own journey. I'm sure if his friends see it, they'll come looking for him.

Activity_108300001_Desc:
[About]
During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings to unlock and claim rewards. Purchase merchandise tagged with <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/Activity31/CumulativeRecharge/Common/T_TempScoreIcon.T_TempScoreIcon,0.5/> in the <color=#ad893a>Recommended - Weekly Subscription, Recommended - Lunite Subscription, Bundles - Special Offers, Outfits - Vehicle Looks, and the Lunite Purchase</color> sections of the Store to obtain Moonlit Rings.

When the Moonlit Path event ends, the Moonlit Rings will expire and will not be converted to other items. After the event ends, any unclaimed event rewards will be reissued via in-game mail if you log in within 30 days. If you fail to log in within 30 days, the rewards will not be reissued. Don't forget to claim them in your in-game mailbox.

[Eligibility]
- Reach Union Level 5.
- Or complete the combat trial in the Main Quest "First Resonance."
- Or access Main Quest Fast Track Event and proceed with the Main Quest until you reach a specific point.

[Rules]
During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings to unlock and claim rewards.

Log in and enter Moonlit Path to claim: Lustrous Tide x1
Obtain 30 Moonlit Rings to claim: Radiant Tide x1
Obtain 88 Moonlit Rings to claim: Motorbike Accessory - Little Savior
Obtain 198 Moonlit Rings to claim: Forging Tide x2
Obtain 328 Moonlit Rings to claim: Custom Livery - Singer in Deepspace (Full set includes: Left Fender, Right Fender, Front/Rear)
Obtain 450 Moonlit Rings to claim: 5-star Weapon Supply Chest - Synth Armament x1 (Open to choose one weapon: Laser Shearer, Radiance Cleaver, Phasic Homogenizer, Pulsation Bracer, or Boson Astrolabe)
Obtain 680 Moonlit Rings to claim: Transducer x3
Obtain 980 Moonlit Rings to claim: Stellar Anchor of Memories x 1 (Exchanged for Shorekeeper, Camellya, or Jinhsi, or Transducer x8)
Obtain 1600 Moonlit Rings to claim: Cosmetics Set x1 (Full set includes Avatar: Choir of Stars, Sigil: Favor of Stars, Custom Accessory: Starbright Resonance)

[Note]
- If you make purchases through any non–in-game channel, such as the official website's top-up center, please log in to the game while the event is ongoing to receive your purchases, as well as the corresponding Moonlit Rings. If you log in after the event ends, you will not receive the corresponding Moonlit Rings.
HelpText_492_Content: [Weekly Subscription] The Weekly Subscription is available for purchase once per period. The Weekly Subscription is valid for 15 days from the date of activation. Log in on or after the specific days during the subscription period for a total of Lunite x680, Astrite x1600, and Transducer x1. Reward unlock rules: - Activating the Weekly Subscription immediately unlocks Lunite x680 and Transducer x1. - During the subscription period, log in on the 3rd day or later to unlock Astrite x800. - During the subscription period, log in on the 7th day or later to unlock Astrite x800. - Rewards can only be claimed anytime once unlocked. If you have unlocked but unclaimed rewards when the Weekly Subscription expires, please log in to the game within 30 days after the expiration, and the rewards will be sent via mail. Rewards will not be reissued past these 30 days. Please claim your rewards in time. [Note] - The Weekly Subscription is valid for 15 days upon activation and is not affected by its sales period. E.g., if you purchase and activate the subscription three days before it is removed from the store, you can still log in during the 15 days to unlock and claim your rewards. - For purchases made outside the game (e.g., web purchases), the subscription must be activated by logging into the game before it is removed from the store, with the activation time starting from the first login after your purchase. - For purchases made outside the game (e.g., web purchases), if you have not logged into the game before it is removed from the store, the Weekly Subscription cannot be activated, and you will receive a refund of Lunite x750. - In case of accidental multiple purchases, the Weekly Subscription will not stack, and each extra purchase will result in a refund of Lunite x750.

HelpText_640_Content: [New Voyage Weekly Subscription] The New Voyage Weekly Subscription can be purchased only once during the availability period. The New Voyage Weekly Subscription is valid for 15 days from the date of activation. Log in on or after the specific days during the subscription period for a total of Lunite x680, Astrite x1600 and Crystal Solvent x5. Reward unlock rules: - Activating the New Voyage Weekly Subscription immediately unlocks Lunite x680 and Crystal Solvent x5. - During the subscription period, log in on the 3rd day or later to unlock Astrite x1000. - During the subscription period, log in on the 7th day or later to unlock Astrite x600. - Rewards can only be claimed anytime once unlocked. If you have unlocked but unclaimed rewards when the New Voyage Weekly Subscription expires, please log in to the game within 30 days after the expiration, and the rewards will be sent via mail. Rewards will not be reissued past these 30 days. Please claim your rewards in time. [Note] - The New Voyage Weekly Subscription is valid for 15 days upon activation and is not affected by its sales period. For example, if you purchase and activate the subscription three days before it is removed from the store, you can still log in during the 15 days to unlock and claim your rewards. - In case of accidental multiple purchases, the New Voyage Weekly Subscription will not stack, and each extra purchase will result in a refund of Lunite x750.

ItemInfo_70360001_BgDescription:
Seated, it draws cloud-wreathed mountains into the courtyard. Within a hand-sized screen, ten thousand ravines unfold.
Built on the ever-changing Automata Mechanics, the Artisans of the Court of Savantae and the Ministry of Development have deftly woven Mengzhou's natural splendor into this seat. At rest, it is but an ordinary bench. Sit upon it, and a myriad of scenes drift across the screen: haze and cloud-wreathed peaks like gauze and silk.
It is said that a wandering cultivator once passed through the Land of Xuanfang and sat alone on this seat for three days. When he finally rose, he declared he had "seen every sight in Mengzhou's mortal world," and left with a flick of his sleeve. Whether the tale is true, not even he himself seems to remember...

[About]
During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings to unlock and claim rewards. Purchase merchandise tagged with <texture=/Game/Aki/UI/UIResources/UiActivity/Image/Activity31/CumulativeRecharge/Common/T_TempScoreIcon.T_TempScoreIcon,0.5/> in Store sections such as <color=#ad893a>Recommended - Lunite Subscription, Bundles - Special Offers, Outfits, and Lunite Purchase</color> to obtain Moonlit Rings.

After the event ends, any unclaimed event rewards will be reissued via in-game mail if you log in within 30 days. If you fail to log in within 30 days, the rewards will not be reissued. Don't forget to claim them in your in-game mailbox.

ComboTeaching_11020101_DescriptionConten: Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio DMG</color>. Gain 1 stack of "Clarity" upon casting Basic Attack V.
ComboTeaching_11020201_DescriptionConten: Hold <color=#f4d582>Heavy Attack</color> and release when the cursor is inside the "Frostbite" area to cast <color=#d4bf5f>Heavy Attack: Detonate</color>, dealing <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11020301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11020401_DescriptionConten: Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Leave behind 1 "Ice Prism". Gain 1 stack of "Clarity".
ComboTeaching_11020501_DescriptionConten: Deal <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio DMG</color> and create 1 "Glacier". At the same time, gain 2 stacks of "Clarity".
ComboTeaching_11020601_DescriptionConten: <color=#f4d582>Heavy Attack: Detonate</color> will detonate "Ice Thorn", "Ice Prism" and "Glacier" on the path of the attack, dealing <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11030101_DescriptionConten: Command You'tan to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11030201_DescriptionConten: Continuously consume Stamina and pull You'tan to constantly rotate and attack nearby targets, dealing <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio damage</color>. You'tan can be commanded to move during Heavy Attack.
ComboTeaching_11030301_DescriptionConten: Consume STA to summon You'tan to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_11030401_DescriptionConten: Call You'tan to deal <color=#1891e7ff>Glacio DMG</color> and restore HP to all characters on the nearby team.
ComboTeaching_11030402_DescriptionConten: Gain 1 Concentration when <color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color> hit the target. Cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Emergency Plan</color> to consume all Concentration and restore HP for 1 extra time for every 1 Concentration consumed. Restoration happens every 2s.

ComboTeaching_14090601_DescriptionConten:
Fleurdelys performs 5 stages of Basic Attack to deal Aero DMG and restore <color=Highlight>Conviction</color>.
Basic Attack Stage 5 immediately triggers <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color> DMG once and then consumes 1 stack of <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color>.

With <color=Highlight>Power of Discord</color>, Basic Attack Stage 5 propagates the highest stack count of <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color> among targets.

With <color=Highlight>Power of Discord</color>, Mid-air Attack Stage 2 propagates the highest stack count of <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color> among targets.

With <color=Highlight>Power of Discord</color>, the second stage of Resonance Skill propagates the highest stack count of <color=Wind>Aero Erosion</color> among targets.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump again to switch back to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>.

When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.

- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill consecutively to cast these skills in sequence:

ComboTeaching_13061000_DescriptionConten:
With 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Majesty</color>, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color> generates the <color=Highlight>Ruler's Realm</color> and sends Augusta into the <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> state.
