GuideTips_61_Content: Stand near the Resonance Beacon and press {0} to activate it.
GuideTips_7_Content: Stand beside the walls and hold {0} to climb.
GuideTips_84_Content:
Hold {0} and {1}/{2} next to a wall to perform <color=#ffd12f>Wall Dash</color>.
Wall Dash consumes <color=#ffd12f>STA</color> and automatically ends when your STA runs out.
GuideTips_88_Content: {0} Move to the cliff edge and prepare to glide.
GuideTutorialPage_1000001_Content: When a Tacet Discord is defeated, the remaining frequency may become an <color=#ffd12f>Echo</color>. You can obtain <color=#ffd12f>Data Bank</color> EXP by absorbing an Echo for the first time. Level up Data Bank to raise the probability of Echo drop.
GuideTutorialPage_1000002_Content: Damaging or defeating enemies grants <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Energy</color>. When Resonance Energy is full, the powerful <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Liberation</color> becomes available.
GuideTutorialPage_1000003_Content:
After a <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Beacon</color> is activated, you can open the Map and <color=#ffd12f>fast travel</color> to an activated Resonance Beacon.
Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_1000004_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Nexus</color> stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Map</color> data.
GuideTutorialPage_1000005_Content: Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_1000006_Content: When the enemy is about to use certain moves, a <color=#ffd12f>Weakness Halo</color> will appear. Attack in time to trigger a <color=#ffd12f>Counterattack</color> to block the incoming attack and gain an upper hand.
GuideTutorialPage_1000007_Content: Perform Dodge at the right moment to avoid enemy attacks. A successful <color=#ffd12f>Dodge</color> grants <color=#ffd12f>damage immunity</color> for a limited amount of time, allowing you to perform <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counter</color> in your next Basic Attack.
GuideTutorialPage_1000008_Content: Deal damage to reduce enemy <color=#ffd12f>Vibration Strength</color>. <color=#ffd12f>Counterattack</color> greatly reduces enemy Vibration Strength. When the Vibration Strength is fully depleted, the enemy is <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> and cannot take any action for a period of time.
GuideTutorialPage_1000009_Content: When some enemies are <color=#b49f50>Immobilized</color>, you can use <color=#b49f50>Finishing Attack</color> to deal great damage to them. After taking the Finishing Attack, they will recover from Immobolized.
GuideTutorialPage_1000010_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Grapple module</color> can help to overcome complex terrain. When it is used directly, the operator can <color=#ffd12f>leap</color> a short distance upwards.
GuideTutorialPage_1000011_Content: There are <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Points</color> in overworld, and you can make a long-distance leap by aiming your Grapple at them.
GuideTutorialPage_1000012_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> module in the Utility helps reveal valuable content in the scene, such as <color=#ffd12f>collectibles</color>, <color=#ffd12f>enemy weaknesses</color>, etc.
GuideTutorialPage_1000013_Content:
Resonators gain <color=#ffd12f>Concerto Energy</color> when dealing damage or performing Dodges in combat.
When Concerto Energy is full, the other Resonators' icons will glow up.
GuideTutorialPage_1000014_Content: By reaching a higher <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase</color>, you will have the opportunity to gain more <color=#ffd12f>rewards</color> after defeating enemies or clearing Sonoro Spheres. However, be warned that the enemies you encounter will also be more <color=#ffd12f>dangerous</color>, and vice versa.
GuideTutorialPage_1000015_Content: After clearing Tacet Fields, you can consume Waveplates to obtain various Echo development materials and the <color=#ffd12f>collected Echoes</color> of the corresponding Sonata set.
GuideTutorialPage_1000016_Content: Tacet Fields will revive periodically, so you can challenge them repeatedly for materials. It should be noted that you need to consume the Waveplates to obtain the materials.
GuideTutorialPage_1000017_Content: A Simulation Training Ground located in Jinzhou. Complete the trials to obtain necessary materials for Resonator upgrade and development. Increase <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase</color> to unlock more rewarding trials.
GuideTutorialPage_1000018_Content: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. If you are lucky enough to discover one, the <color=#ffd12f>Relic Merchants</color> will gladly exchange valuable items for it.
GuideTutorialPage_1000019_Content: The Mutterfly swarm will move to the next location when you approach. Follow them to find out more content to explore.
GuideTutorialPage_1000020_Content: The Mutterfly swarm will move to the next location when you approach. Follow them to find out more content to explore.
GuideTutorialPage_1000021_Content: A common general-purpose training mechanism. Find and hit all the mechanisms to complete the training.
GuideTutorialPage_1000022_Content: A common intelligent training target. Different targets have different <color=#ffd12f>training rules</color>. After activation, drones will be released. Hit all the drones to complete the training.
GuideTutorialPage_1000023_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Propulsion Flux</color> is a gravitational anomaly in the overworld. <color=#ffd12f>Use the Glider</color> in it to <color=#ffd12f>lift</color> the Resonator.
GuideTutorialPage_1000024_Content:
Accumulate <color=#ffd12f>Union EXP</color> to increase <color=#ffd12f>Union Level</color> and unlock more quests and activities.
You can quickly obtain Union EXP through the following ways: 
I. Complete the <color=#ffd12f>Daily Activity</color> quests.
II. <color=#ffd12f>Consume Waveplates</color>.
III. <color=#ffd12f>Complete various quests</color>.
IV. <color=#ffd12f>Open Supply Chests</color> and complete gameplay activities in the overworld.
GuideTutorialPage_1000025_Content: Absorb Echoes to increase Data Bank level. The higher the level, the higher the <color=#ffd12f>Drop Rate</color> of Echoes and the higher the <color=#ffd12f>max absorbable Rarity</color> of Echoes.
GuideTutorialPage_1000029_Content: Some special frequencies will form visible Acoustic Prints. Follow the Acoustic Prints and find the source of the sounds.
GuideTutorialPage_1000030_Content: Select and use the Zoom Camera via the wheel to locate targets.
GuideTutorialPage_1000031_Content: The requirements of the photo are shown on the left. When met, they turn green. Tap the camera icon on the right to shoot.
GuideTutorialPage_1000032_Content: Once you've taken the photo, if a "Goal Completed" pop-up appears at the top, tap the upper-right corner to exit.
GuideTutorialPage_1000033_Content:
The <color=#ffd12f>Tacetite Fulminate</color> emits a golden light, with unstable energy contained within it.
After Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab it.
GuideTutorialPage_1000034_Content: After grabbing <color=#ffd12f>Tacetite Fulminate</color>, you can either throw it <color=#ffd12f>directly</color> at the target or use <color=#ffd12f>Aim</color> to <color=#ffd12f>precisely control</color> where it lands. Once thrown, the Tacetite Fulminate will trigger a violent explosion.
GuideTutorialPage_3005_Content: An operation platform developed by Huaxu Academy and available to Resonators. Use it to synthesize Potions, craft objects, and purify advanced materials.
GuideTutorialPage_3007_Content: Deal damage to reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength. When Vibration Strength drops to 0, the enemy is <color=#8c7e51>Immobilized</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_301401_Content: Resonators gain Concerto Energy when dealing damage or performing Dodges in combat. Switch Resonators when the Concerto Energy is full to consume all Concerto Energy and trigger the exiting Resonator's Outro Skill, and at the same time trigger the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill.
GuideTutorialPage_32001_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Dodge Counters</color> to interrupt enemy actions.
GuideTutorialPage_32002_Content: Most of your enemy's moves can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>. Frequently use Counterattacks to reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength and put it into an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_32003_Content: When the Impermanence Heron raises its wings to protect its head, it will enter a defensive state. Use the Intro Skill to reduce its Vibration Strength, putting it in an <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_32004_Content: When Inferno Rider casts its charge, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>special Echo</color> to defend. Successful defense will put it in a <color=#ffd12f>Immobilized</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_32005_Content: You can avoid ground shock attacks by getting to a higher ground.
GuideTutorialPage_32006_Content: When Lampylumen Myriad is in the air, you can attack the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Chrysalises</color> on the ground to shoot it down. Your <color=#ffd12f>Freeze Meter</color> will grow as you are exposed to the attacks of Lampylumen Myriad, the attacks of the Ice Chrysalises, and the fog on the ground. When your Freeze Meter is filled, you will be <color=#ffd12f>Frozen</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32007_Content: The grab attacks deal massive damage. Use <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> to block the grab attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32008_Content: After taking a certain amount of damage, Mech Abomination shapeshifts and releases a powerful attack.
GuideTutorialPage_32009_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Destroy the legs, head, and the ancient bell</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength. Using <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> against the giant ice balls will also greatly deplete its Vibration Strength, <color=#ffd12f>but it's not an easy task to achieve</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32010_Content: After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32011_Content: After absorbing the <color=#ffd12f>Prisms</color> of different attributes, the Heron will <color=#ffd12f>recover all its HP</color> and enter the <color=#ffd12f>enpowered state</color> of the corresponding attribute. The enhanced Heron will launch fiercer attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32012_Content: After entering the berserk state, it will gain a shield and <color=#ffd12f>great DMG Reduction</color>. When the <color=#ffd12f>shield</color> is destroyed, its Vibration Strength will be greatly depleted.
GuideTutorialPage_32013_Content: When the Roseshroom enters the charging state, target the <color=#ffd12f>core at its head</color> with <color=#ffd12f>Pistols</color> to greatly deplete its Vibration Strength.
GuideTutorialPage_32014_Content: The Hoochief Cyclone can generate a wind field to restrict the movement of Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_32015_Content: The Autopuppet Scout can generate an ice wall to block ranged attacks from Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_32016_Content:
The Fusion Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Fusion</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which greatly increases the damage they deal.
The Fusion Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent damage bonus for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32017_Content:
The Glacio Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Glacio</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which grant them Super Armor (their moves won't be interrupted when hit).
The Glacio Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Super Armor state for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32018_Content:
The Spectro Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Spectro</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which periodically grants them a shield.
The Spectro Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent shield for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32019_Content:
The Havoc Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Havoc</color> DMG. It provides a buff for surrounding enemies, which allows them to deplete Resonators' Resonance Energy with their attacks.
The Havoc Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent Energy Depletion effect for the Herons after absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_32020_Content: When an Excarat burrows underground, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to force it to surface.
GuideTutorialPage_32021_Content: The Traffic Illuminator can put Resonators in a <color=#ffd12f>stagnant</color> state.
GuideTutorialPage_32039_Content: Resonators' attacks can reflect the halbard illusions and light arcs from the Lioness of Glory back at it to deal damage to the Lioness of Glory.
GuideTutorialPage_32040_Content: When Kerasaur recovers from being Immobilized, it will be highly resistant to whichever Attribute DMG it took the most before this Immobilization.
GuideTutorialPage_32041_Content: When the Pilgrim's Shell is Immobilized. Use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to instantly defeat it.
GuideTutorialPage_32042_Content:
Gladiators will summon Echoes to aid them at the start of the fight.
When a Gladiator is defeated, so too is their Echo.
GuideTutorialPage_32043_Content:
When Cartethyia casts <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Skill, Heavy Attack, or the final stage of a Basic Attack</color>, she will summon Sword of Virtue's Shadow, Sword of Discord's Shadow, and Sword of Divinity's Shadow.

Cartethyia can recall these three Sword Shadows when performing a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> to increase the DMG dealt by this attack. 

Recalling the Sword Shadows also grants the corresponding <color=Highlight>Heart of Virtue</color>, <color=Highlight>Power of Discord</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mandate of Divinity</color>, which enhance Cartethyia when she turns into Fleurdelys.
GuideTutorialPage_32044_Content:
Upon casting Resonance Liberation, Cartethyia turns into Fleurdelys and unlocks new moves.

Fleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction. When Conviction is full, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation again to cast Blade of Howling Squall, dealing massive DMG.
GuideTutorialPage_33001_Content: Upon reaching certain Union Levels, you need to complete <color=#ffd12f>SOL3 Phase Ascension Quests</color> to lift the <color=#ffd12f>Union Level cap</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3303602_Content: View Echo details at Echo Collection or Echo Overview.
GuideTutorialPage_33036_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} button with an icon of magnifying glass at the bottom left of the card to see its details. Spend Prestige Points there to unlock it.
GuideTutorialPage_3303702_Content:
Through dueling, you gain Duel Resonance, which increases your Duelist Level and grants abundant rewards. There is a weekly cap on the amount of Duel Resonance that you can obtain.

Your dueling skill is represented by Fame Flags. Each victory grants you Fame Flags. There is no limit to the amount you can obtain.
GuideTutorialPage_33037_Content: Once you become the "Apex Duelist," Endless Challenges become available where you are free to challenge any duelist in Septimont. Show them what it means to be the best!
GuideTutorialPage_3400101_Content:
After interacting with Corroders nearby, the <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color> will temporarily <color=#ffd12f>follow</color> you.
Bring them <color=#ffd12f>close to Spikes</color>, and they will dissolve the golden pillar to the side, eventually dissolving the Spikes.
GuideTutorialPage_34001_Content:
In the wild, where Tacetite clusters develop freely, sometimes <color=#ffd12f>Spikes</color> can be found blocking the path or <color=#ffd12f>sealing off</color> items or puzzles.
Look closely around the Spikes for <color=#ffd12f>Corroders</color>. They will dissolve the Spikes.
GuideTutorialPage_3400201_Content: Induction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the corresponding colored Induction Cell Sockets to activate the puzzles.
GuideTutorialPage_34002_Content:
Use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the Induction Cell Socket to turn on or off the mechanical device.
Induction Cells of different colors have to be placed into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Sockets of corresponding colors</color> to activate the puzzles, or the Induction Cells will be popped.
GuideTutorialPage_34003_Content: Use Levitator to put the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cells</color> into the <color=#ffd12f>Induction Cell Changer</color> to change the operating mode of the Induction Cell, and <color=#ffd12f>change</color> the current <color=#ffd12f>color</color> of the Induction Cell.
GuideTutorialPage_34004_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Fragile rocks</color> can be destroyed by means like Basic Attacks. You might find good things inside.
GuideTutorialPage_34005_Content: Touch the <color=#ffd12f>signs</color> to restore a certain amount of <color=#ffd12f>STA</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34006_Content: After activation, it will summon enemies in the form of a projection. <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> all <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> to complete the challenge and receive rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34007_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34008_Content: After activation, <color=#ffd12f>reach the finish line</color> or <color=#ffd12f>collect a certain amount of Target Points</color> within the specified time to claim the corresponding rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_340090102_Content: When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Slow</color>, STA consumed will increase and their <color=#ffd12f>Movement Speed will be reduced</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3400901_Content: When a Resonator is on the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Speed</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>launched</color> in the direction of the arrow.
GuideTutorialPage_34009_Content: When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Module: Jump</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.
GuideTutorialPage_3401001_Content: After interacting with the Signals Console, you will start the <color=#ffd12f>Decryption</color>. The Signals Hub will only be unlocked after all Signals Consoles are decrypted.
GuideTutorialPage_34010_Content: When the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Hub</color> is locked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the <color=#ffd12f>Signals Consoles</color> that are connected to the Signals Hub but hidden in a different location.
GuideTutorialPage_3401101_Content:
The Weight Block is placed near the Pressure Table. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab the <color=#ffd12f>Weight Block</color> and place it at the intended <color=#ffd12f>landing</color> spot.
When the Weight Block is placed on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color>, it will <color=#ffd12f>stick</color> to it.
GuideTutorialPage_3401102_Content:
You need to <color=#ffd12f>place an object</color> on the <color=#ffd12f>Pressure Table</color> to <color=#ffd12f>activate</color> it.
When there is <color=#ffd12f>no object placed</color> on the Pressure Table, the item(s) controlled by it will be <color=#ffd12f>locked</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34011_Content:
The Weight Block is located near the Pressure Platform. Use the Levitator to grab the Weight Block, and then use the Levitator again to position it at the intended landing spot.
Unlock the Utility to access this feature.
GuideTutorialPage_34012_Content:
After Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color>
to place the scattered <color=#ffd12f>Components back to the Matrix</color>.
While using Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction of the Components.
GuideTutorialPage_34013_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Key Repeaters</color> emit the Decryption Pulses in different directions. After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to place the Key Repeaters on the Encryption Blocks. While using the Levitator, you can <color=#ffd12f>rotate</color> to adjust the direction in which the Decryption Pulse is emitted.
GuideTutorialPage_34015_Content:
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Shooter</color> to launch temporary <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Points</color>, facilitating swift movement of the Resonators.
Unlock the Utility to play this.
GuideTutorialPage_34016_Content: When a Resonator jumps onto the <color=#ffd12f>Flobble</color>, they will be <color=#ffd12f>bounced</color> upward.
GuideTutorialPage_34017_Content:
The <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charge</color> triggers a violent <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color> if stimulated.
After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to grab the Explosive Charge on branches.
GuideTutorialPage_34018_Content:
After grabbing an Explosive Charge, you can throw it to a distance to trigger an explosion. By <color=#ffd12f>Aiming</color>, you can <color=#ffd12f>precisely control</color> its landing spot.
Explosive Charges scattered on the ground cannot be controlled with Levitator, but you can <color=#ffd12f>attack</color> them directly to trigger an <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34019_Content: Following the instruction on the track, <color=#ffd12f>attack the Magnetic Cube</color> to move it along the specified direction. When Magnetic Cubes <color=#ffd12f>reach</color> specified <color=#ffd12f>Magnetic Conveyors</color>, the challenge is completed.
GuideTutorialPage_34020_Content:
Transform into <color=#ffd12f>Cruisewing</color> to take on a flying challenge and collect as many Coins as possible within a specified time to earn points.
The higher your points, the better rewards you can unlock.
During the flight, <color=#ffd12f>rotate your view</color> to change your route. Hold the Accelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>speed up</color>, and hold the Decelerate button to <color=#ffd12f>slow down</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34021_Content:
These mysterious Tacet Discords are scattered across the world, holding a special interest in human items. Unexpected rewards often await where they linger.
<color=#ffd12f>Blobflies</color> follow a <color=#ffd12f>fixed route</color>. If they fly too high, try shooting it down using <color=#ffd12f>ranged attacks</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34022_Content: After gliding through the <color=#ffd12f>Gravitation Vortex Ring</color>, you will be granted <color=#ffd12f>acceleration</color> in the specified direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34025_Content: Use Lingyang's Plunging Attacks to destroy the obstacles or avoid them along the path to your destination.
GuideTutorialPage_34026_Content:
After interacting with the puppet mechanism, you will enter the <color=#ffd12f>Puppet Control</color> state.
In this state, you can leave the puppet where it is <color=#ffd12f>whenever necessary</color> and <color=#ffd12f>switch back</color> to control your Resonator.
Utilize the puppet to access places beyond your reach and deactivate the laser mechanisms obstructing your way.
GuideTutorialPage_34027_Content: Interact with the special mechanisms to rotate and shift the scene.
GuideTutorialPage_34028_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attacks</color> to hit the mechanism on the ground to match the random patterns with the <color=#ffd12f>Target Patterns</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34029_Content: Use the <color=#ffd12f>Spinning</color> Device to <color=#ffd12f>connect pathways</color> and complete the information transmission.
GuideTutorialPage_340301_Content: There are multiple groups of strings of the same color on the Terminal panel. Ensure that there are no overlappings between the lines connecting them.
GuideTutorialPage_34030_Content: The areas contaminated by toxic spores are highly dangerous. Prolonged exposure may cause limited visibility and difficulty in breathing. If you encounter such areas during exploration, please <color=#ffd12f>leave</color> the contaminated areas as soon as possible.
GuideTutorialPage_34031_Content: After the challenge starts, use the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Charges</color> and other means reasonably to <color=#ffd12f>hit</color> as many <color=#ffd12f>targets</color> as possible.
GuideTutorialPage_3403201_Content: After the challenge starts, reach the finish line within the specified time while collecting as many Hologram Tokens as possible. Upon reaching the finish line, challenge points will be calculated based on the number of Hologram Tokens collected. Reach higher points for better rewards!
GuideTutorialPage_3403202_Content: The Overdash Club has set up various modules in the tracks. You can utilize them strategically to reach the finish line faster, but be sure to avoid the traps at the same time.
GuideTutorialPage_34032_Content: The Overdash Club has set up various tracks for the challenge. You can choose any one of the unlocked tracks for your challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_34033_Content: Connect the strings of the same color on the Terminal panel to complete decoding.
GuideTutorialPage_3415302_Content:
When in the Challenge Zone, your <color=#ffd12f>Glory Level</color> is shown on the top left corner of the screen.

Search for and defeat Tacet Discords or occupy Banners of Conquest to gain Hunt Points. Hunt Points are used to increase Glory Level and acquire buffs.

The difficulty of the challenges will decrease as the Glory Level gap between you and the enemy narrows.
GuideTutorialPage_3415303_Content:
The competition does not end when you're downed in the Challenge Zone, but your Glory Level will decrease to the number of your <color=#ffd12f>Trial Level</color>. However, you will gain a Hunt Points bonus, which remains in effect until your Glory Level recovers to the highest level you've ever achieved. Please take note of this when fighting tough opponents.

You can gain Trial Points by occupying Banners of Conquest. Trial Points will increase your Trial Level, which will only be effective in this competition and does not reset when you are downed.
GuideTutorialPage_3415304_Content:
Areas of greater danger house Tacet Discords of greater Glory Levels. It might be wise to obtain Buffs by raising your Glory Level first before facing Tacet Discords of a higher Glory Level.

There are five areas in the Old District. Each area contains a special Tacet Discord that has the highest Glory Level of that area. Defeat them to obtain <color=#ffd12f>abundant rewards</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34153_Content:
Draining of floodwaters in the Old District has revealed a large number of Tacet Discords. The Gladiators of Septimont have now launched a competition to hunt them.

Defeating Tacet Discords in the Challenge Zone and occupying Banners of Conquest will increase your Glory Level, granting you <color=#ffd12f>powerful buffs</color>.  Make good use of these buffs to claim victory and glory in the challenge!
GuideTutorialPage_34154_Content:
Banners of Conquest can be found in the Challenge Zone.

Interacting with the ones marked by a yellow light grants you Hunt Points and Trial Points.

Interacting with the ones marked by a blue light grants you Buffs.
GuideTutorialPage_34155_Content: Some Banners of Conquest in the Challenge Zone have been overrun by Tacet Discords. Defeat them and occupy the Banners of Conquest to gain Hunt Points and Trial Points. Trial Points increase your Trial Level. Defeating the Tacet Discords will occupy the Banner. Once occupied, the Banner of Conquest will no longer be interactable.
GuideTutorialPage_34156_Content:
Counterattacks, Dodge Counters, and Attacks in combat grant <color=#ffd12f>Battle Engagement Points</color>, which can <color=#ffd12f>temporarily raise Glory Levels</color> by 100 levels as Hunt Points do.

Upon taking damage, only Glory Levels added by Battle Engagement Points will be lowered. But not the Glory Levels provided by Hunt Points.

The Glory Levels added by Battle Engagement Points will rapidly decrease when out of combat.
GuideTutorialPage_3415702_Content: These Dreamscape Tacet Discords have been affected by Contagion and are much tougher than their regular counterparts. You must find their weaknesses to defeat them. Completing Challenge Goals or casting Special Moves grants powerful buffs against the Tacet Discords in Dreamscape Contagion.
GuideTutorialPage_34157_Content: Septimont's Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.
GuideTutorialPage_34158_Content: Counterattack can Immobilize Kerasaur. When a Kerasaur is Immobilized the second time, its ATK and RES will be reduced.
GuideTutorialPage_34159_Content: Dodge the Drakes' attacks several times to decrease their RES. Defeating one Drake in the group makes them unable to coordinate their attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_34160_Content: Continuously attack a Gladiator with a raised shield to break their defenses and instantly defeat them. Doing so also decreases the RES of other Gladiators.
GuideTutorialPage_34161_Content: Dodge Counter greatly reduces the Vibration Strength of Pilgrim's Shell. Attacking an Immobilized Pilgrim's Shell deals Electro DMG to targets within a certain range.
GuideTutorialPage_3416202_Content: After taking the gladiator spear, follow the interaction prompt to throw the spear and destroy the Tidal Blight on the giant statue.
GuideTutorialPage_34162_Content: Find the Patrol Units and help them reach the platform so they may activate it to get you the gladiator spears.
GuideTutorialPage_3416302_Content: The Hero's Legacy Armor will unlock the <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> Skill in certain scenarios when the enemy is in a certain state. Use this Skill to instantly defeat or weaken the enemies.
GuideTutorialPage_34163_Content: Aim at the mechanism, then press the highlighted button to don the Hero's Legacy Armor and gain the <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> Skill. Aim and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the corresponding button to slash.
GuideTutorialPage_3416402_Content: Hold the Skill button and release once Rend is fully charged to cast the skill, destroying all destructible objects nearby.
GuideTutorialPage_34164_Content: Gather three Recollections of Heroes to charge the Hero's Legacy Armor. When the armor is charged, aim at the mechanism and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the highlighted button to don the Hero's Legacy Armor and access a powerful <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Rend</color> Skill.
GuideTutorialPage_3416502_Content: Some stubborn Bitter Resentments can only be cleared by using <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Rend</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34165_Content:
Frequencies of bitter resentment are flowing in these strange threads...
When Bitter Resentment is shelled up, use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to eliminate them.
GuideTutorialPage_3416602_Content: Try switching rails to collect more energy and obtain more points.
GuideTutorialPage_34166_Content: You can jump to the rails on the left or right.
GuideTutorialPage_34167_Content: Some Tactical Hologram: Vitreum Dancers have a slowing debuff. During the Hologram challenge, zones that greatly slow you down will appear.
GuideTutorialPage_34168_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Hero's Slash</color> to destroy more Aftertune Figments in a short time. Slash Vibration Figments to release a blast of energy to destroy multiple Figments nearby at the same time.
GuideTutorialPage_34169_Content: Destroying Cacophany Figments lowers your points. Try to avoid them.
GuideTutorialPage_34170_Content: Touch Ta-da's Protection and then use Dash to enter the Speed Hooray mode, dashing forward and running much faster.
GuideTutorialPage_34173_Content: If your Glory Level is below the recommended level for the next Banner, you may raise your Glory Level by <color=#ffd12f>activating Banners of Conquest, exploring the current area, or defeating TDs</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3601002_Content:
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} Echoes in the list on the left to add them to your deck.
Each deck can contain Echoes of up to 2 Attributes. To change Attributes, remove Echoes with the Attribute you are replacing from the deck first.
GuideTutorialPage_36010_Content:
A deck is comprised of 21 Echoes, one of which must be a Core Echo and the remainder, Normal Echoes. The number of Echoes in a deck is subject to an upper limit and a minimum requirement that must be met to proceed with the duel. 

Echoes have different Skills. Some Skills complement or boost other Skills. Please keep this in mind when building your deck.
GuideTutorialPage_36_Content: An error occurred. Please contact our Customer Service for assistance
GuideTutorialPage_3700102_Content:
Drag Echoes from your hand into the Deployment Zone to Deploy them.
The left side is the Frontline, and the right side is the Backline. Position your Echoes strategically according to their attack range.
GuideTutorialPage_3700103_Content:
Drag Echoes from your hand or the Deployment Zone to the Reconstruction Area on the right to Reconstruct them.
Reconstructing the Echo shuffles it back into the card stash and restores 1 Energy. You may draw the Reconstruted Echo again in later rounds.
GuideTutorialPage_37001_Content:
Each Echo has four basic stats.

Strength (STR): Affects the DMG dealt during the Battle Stage.
Constitution (CON): Represents the Echo's ability to withstand DMG.
Energy Cost (Cost): Represents the Energy required to Deploy or Modulate this Echo.
Damage (DMG): At the end of each Battle Stage, surviving Echoes deal DMG to the opponent equal to this value.

Generally, higher values indicate more powerful stats.
GuideTutorialPage_37002_Content:
The Deployed Echoes surviving the Battle Stage will deal damage to the opponent equal to the sum of all of their <color=#ffd12f>DMG</color>. Certain Echo Skills may also affect the DMG dealt by the Echoes.

Each duel lasts a maximum of 8 rounds. After the 8th Round. The duelist with more HP wins.
GuideTutorialPage_3700303_Content: Using Transform may sometimes consume or refund additional Energy. The exact amount depends on the skill's effect.
GuideTutorialPage_3700304_Content: Echoes with Transform in the Deployment Zone can also be dragged directly to the Transform Area to activate it. Echoes used this way will also be consumed.
GuideTutorialPage_37003_Content:
Some Echoes possess the special <color=#ffd12f>Transform</color> Skill.
Drag an Echo with <color=#ffd12f>Transform</color> Skill to the Transform Area to activate it. However, this Echo will be consumed, and you won't be able to draw it again for the rest of the duel.
GuideTutorialPage_3700402_Content: Echo A will replace Echo B in the Deployment Zone upon Modulation, inheriting Echo B's DMG (the inherited DMG will add to Echo A's original DMG). Echo B will be shuffled back into the deck after Modulation and may be drawn again in later rounds.
GuideTutorialPage_3700403_Content:
Modulation activates an Echo's Modulation effects. The full effects are dependent on the specific Skills.

Only on-hand Echoes can be Modulated. You cannot Modulate a Deployed Echo with another echo in the Deployment Zone. Stacking two Echoes that are both in the Deployment Zone will only result in them swapping positions.
GuideTutorialPage_3700405_Content:
A Deployed Echo can only be Modulated twice.

To Modulate a Cost 3 Echo, it must be stacked on top of a Modulated Echo. In other words, you must Modulate a Cost 1 Echo first before you can Modulate a Cost 3 Echo.
GuideTutorialPage_37004_Content: Drag Echo A from your hand onto Echo B in the Deployment Zone to perform a Modulation.
GuideTutorialPage_3700502_Content: When you Modulate Echo B on the Deployment Zone using Echo A from your hand, Echo A inherits Echo B's Special Skills and activates them.
GuideTutorialPage_3700503_Content: Every Echo in the Deployment Zone can be Modulated at most twice.
GuideTutorialPage_37005_Content: Some Echoes possess a Special Skill that only activates under specific conditions.
GuideTutorialPage_3700602_Content: Deploying a Core Echo costs no Energy. It will stay on-hand throughout the duel before being Deployed, but cannot be Reconstructed or Modulated.
GuideTutorialPage_37006_Content: Each Core Echo has its own Trial. During the duel, you can only add Core Echoes to your hand after completing the corresponding Trial.
GuideTutorialPage_50001_Content:
When Resonators enter the <color=#ffd12f>Sea of Flames</color>, they become eroded by the Incinero Petal Pollens, causing a <color=#ffd12f>steady decline in their HP</color>.
This effect will gradually disappear within seconds after the exposure stops.
GuideTutorialPage_50002_Content:
Resonators can use the <color=#ffd12f>Shooting Mechanism</color> to train their shooting skills. Hitting different targets will trigger different effects:
Normal Targets: Yellow. Hit all of them to proceed to the next stage.
Explosive Targets: An explosion symbol marked on it. When hit, it will trigger an explosion, breaking the surrounding targets.
Trap Targets: A prohibition symbol marked on it. When hit, your points will be deducted.
GuideTutorialPage_5000301_Content: Connect the pipelines to ensure the fuel in the tank smoothly reaches the ignition device, enabling the flames ejected to achieve the firepower required to activate the sensor.
GuideTutorialPage_50003_Content: After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to connect the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> to the remaining section. Adjust the direction of the <color=#ffd12f>fuel pipelines</color> by rotating them with the Levitator.
GuideTutorialPage_5000401_Content:
A poor-quality spear barrel will be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full, granting the Resonator a temporary <color=#ffd12f>Immunity</color> to the surrounding Incinero Petal Pollens.
A good-quality spear barrel will not be destroyed after the Hit Gauge is full. It can be used to assemble the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_50004_Content: Attack the spear barrel with your weapon to build up the Hit Gauge displayed at the top.
GuideTutorialPage_50005_Content:
After the Utility is unlocked, you can use the Levitator to throw the <color=#ffd12f>Explosive Spear</color> at the enemies, dealing AoE multi-stage DMG.
Defeat all Tacet Discords and protect the three Sound Emulators to complete the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_5000601_Content: You can crush the scrapped vehicles and boxes along the road. They may contain useful materials.
GuideTutorialPage_50006_Content:
Transform into the Inferno Rider and speed along the track created by the floating highways.
As you race, you can control the Inferno Rider to wield its blade to <color=#ffd12f>destroy</color> obstacles in your path and <color=#ffd12f>avoid</color> road signs.
GuideTutorialPage_50007_Content: You can equip an <color=#ffd12f>Ultrasonic Pulse Chip</color> to launch a Water Vortex. The Water Vortex can <color=#ffd12f>clear</color> the mud along the path. Upon hitting the enemies, it can <color=#ffd12f>remove</color> the enemies' <color=#ffd12f>Mud Shields</color> and knock them back. Upon hitting the Swamp Vortex, it can trigger an <color=#ffd12f>AoE DMG</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_50008_Content: The Swamp Vortex <color=#ffd12f>knocks back</color> the units it hits and deals <color=#ffd12f>minor damage</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip can dispel the Swamp Vortex, dealing <color=#ffd12f>a large amount of damage</color> to the enemies within the range.
GuideTutorialPage_50009_Content: After activating the Suppressor, you must <color=#ffd12f>remain within its range for a period of time</color> to advance the repair progress. When <color=#ffd12f>mud</color> and <color=#ffd12f>enemies</color> appear within the range, the Suppressor will cease to function.
GuideTutorialPage_50010_Content: The mud <color=#ffd12f>blocks the mechanisms and grants the enemies special Mud Shields</color>. The Water Vortex released by an Ultrasonic Pulse Chip and the Swamp Vortex can remove the mud and the shield it grants.
GuideTutorialPage_50011_Content:
To address the issue in the Dim Forest, try to eliminate the Offshoot Cores.
When the drones light up, use either <color=#ffd12f>melee or ranged</color> attacks to rotate them, directing the sound wave emitted by the central drone towards the Offshoot Core. If successful, you'll eliminate the Offshoot Core and obtain a valuable Offshoot Core sample.
GuideTutorialPage_5002_Content: <color=#b49f50>Use Waveplate</color> to claim rewards and gain EXP. Accumulate EXP to level up Union Level.
GuideTutorialPage_5003_Content: Various Utilities are available on your Terminal, making your exploration easier. Utilizing these tools well helps you uncover more mysteries.
GuideTutorialPage_5004_Content:
Sensor
The Sensor can reveal valuable content within a certain range of area, such as <color=#b49f50>collectible items, enemy weaknesses or Acoustic Prints</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_5005_Content:
Sensor II
You may find some Acoustic Prints concealing special information during your exploration. When you approach them, they will display certain appearance changes. Use the Sensor to uncover hidden mechanisms or supply chests.
GuideTutorialPage_5006_Content:
Grappling Hook
Grappling Hook can assist Resonators in crossing over terrains. Use it in open areas to make a leap upward, or look for Grapple Points in the map for even further travels.
GuideTutorialPage_5007_Content:
Levitator
Levitator allows you to control highlighted objects and throw them at specific targets for different effects. Use levitator to capture and manipulate these objects as needed.
GuideTutorialPage_5008_Content: After activating a Resonance Beacon, you can open the Map and fast travel to the activated Resonance Beacon.
GuideTutorialPage_5009_Content: The Resonance Nexus stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding Map data.
GuideTutorialPage_5010_Content: Head to a Resonance Nexus to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_5011_Content:
Injured or downed Resonators can rally at a<color=#b49f50>Resonance Nexus</color> to recover to their optimal state. 
If you're temporarily unable to reach the nearest Resonance Nexus, you can <color=#b49f50>Cook</color> and consume food to restore Resonators' HP.
GuideTutorialPage_5012_Content: Resonance Terminal preserves relevant enemy data. Use <color=#b49f50>Sensor</color> installed with Resonance Terminal to reveal enemy <color=#b49f50>Weaknesses</color>. Attack their weaknesses with certain methods to deal more damage.
GuideTutorialPage_5014_Content: Once you reach certain Union Level caps, it is necessary to clear Ascension Quests to increase your SOL3 Phase.
GuideTutorialPage_5017_Content: The first clear of a Tacet Field will reward <color=#b49f50>Waveplate Plate</color>, which can be used to exchange for rare materials in cities.
GuideTutorialPage_5018_Content: Relic Merchant Chenpi is collecting Sonance Caskets. He's willing to pay you with various rewards in exchange for the Sonance Caskets you found.
GuideTutorialPage_50_Content: Use the equipped Zoom Camera to locate the targets.
GuideTutorialPage_7007_Content: Certain obstacles that have been eroded with Wutherons cannot be destroyed using normal methods. It can only be broken by using Levitator to grab a nearby Tacetite Fulminates to trigger an explosion by throwing onto it.
HelpText_10_Content:
<color=yellow>Basic Attack: Blade Sheath</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive slashes and the 3rd slash can spread the [Black Tortoise Domain], causing AOE Slow Down effect and restoring HP for all party members.
HelpText_114_Content:
[About]
Fulmine, the manager of Wutherium Film Studio, looks worried these days.
The deadline for the next periodical is around the corner, but he seems to have trouble picking the right photos...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act III "What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

This feature is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Traces of Tides ends.
HelpText_11_Content:
<color=yellow>Black Tortoise Counterattack</color>
When Taoqi performs Heavy Attacks, if the attack action is interrupted, she can consume 1 point of Shangneng to perform the [Black Tortoise Counterattack] with a Basic Attack, triggering the [Black Tortoise Netherworld].
HelpText_128_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach SOL3 Phase 3.

[Double Rewards]
You can consume a double amount of Waveplates to claim double rewards after completing certain challenges.
This effect now stacks with Bountiful Crescendo and Chord Cleansing.
If these two events are active, and their corresponding double-yield attempts are greater than 2, then 2 attempts will be used up to claim quadruple rewards. If only 1 corresponding double-yield attempt remains, then that 1 attempt will be used up to claim triple rewards.

[Applicable Challenges]
Forgery Challenge, Simulation Challenge, Tacet Suppression, and Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways.
HelpText_13_Content:
<color=yellow>Resonance Skill: Black Tortoise Wall Guard</color>
After Resonance Skill is released, deals AOE Havoc DMG, gaining 1 point of Shangneng and generating 3 [Black Tortoise Armor] to reduce the damage taken. When the effect ends, unshattered [Black Tortoise Armor] will be transformed into [Shangneng].
HelpText_14_Content:
<color=yellow>Resonance Liberation: Time Stop Slash</color>
After Resonance Liberation is released, causes AOE Havoc DMG and AOE Slow Down effect and consumes all [Shangneng]. Restores all party members' HP based on the consumed points of Shangneng.
HelpText_17_Content: Utilize the knowledge just learned to defeat all enemies present
HelpText_19_Content:
Lunite Subscription
1. Purchase Lunite Subscription to immediately claim Lunite x300 and extend the duration of Lunite Subscription by 30 days.
2. Before the Lunite Subscription expires, you can claim Astrite x90 per day upon log-in. This resets at 04:00 AM server time every day.
3. Before the Lunite Subscription expires, any unclaimed daily rewards on the days you haven't logged in will not be redistributed.

[Notes]
1. When your current Lunite Subscription duration is ≤180 days, you can extend the duration by 30 days with each Lunite Subscription purchase.
2. When your current Lunite Subscription duration is >180 days, you cannot extend the Lunite Subscription further.
3. Any repetitive purchase when your current Lunite Subscription duration is >180 days will be refunded in Lunite x330 without extending the Lunite Subscription.
HelpText_203_Content:
[About]

Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs at the Lollo courier truck to get various rewards! 

[Eligibility] 

Reach Union Level 14. 

[Event Rules] 

During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs. 

Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package. Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards. 

There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
HelpText_20_Content:
The number of unlock points refreshes daily.

Unlock points can be used to unlock important Character Stories, subject to the following conditions: 

I. Less than 3 important Character Stories are currently in progress

II. The prerequisite conditions for unlocking Character Stories have been met

III. The current remaining unlock points are sufficient to unlock the target Character task.
HelpText_218_Content:
[About] 
In the eyes of the Ragunnesi, Avinoleum Theological Seminary represents a lost era. Those glorious days have been forgotten with time. Perhaps one day, no one will remember the origins of that expanse of shadows hanging in the sky.

An elderly hermit is writing his memoirs by the seminary ruins. He needs some images of Avinoleum...

[Eligibility] 
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act IV "The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier" and Side Quest "Scale of Past" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future...
 
This system is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Acropolis Documentarian ends.

<color=yellow>Stage Details</color>: 
For an enhanced experience of utilizing Resonators' unique abilities, additional buffs will be granted in the trial stages.
HelpText_2200201_Content:
<color=yellow>Basic Attack: Photosynthesis</color>

Verina can perform up to VI attacks, causing Spectro reaction DMG. Her 6th Basic Attack plants a Flower Drop on the target. Verina automatically picks up nearby Flower Drops, converting them into Photosynthesis Energy. Verina can have up to 4 stacks of Photosynthesis Energy.
HelpText_2200202_Content:
<color=yellow>Chain Attack: Photon Bomb</color>

When Verina uses a Heavy Attack to hit a target, if she has photosynthetic energy, she will automatically consume a layer of Photosynthetic Energy, detonate a range of damage caused by a Spectro reaction, and restore the equivalent of 50% of Verina's ATK to the entire team's health.
HelpText_2200301_Content:
<color=yellow>Resonance Skill: Green Vine Bloom</color>

Verina gathers energy in front, causing plants to grow rapidly, causing Spectro reaction area DMG, and absorbing the flower particles on the nearby targets, randomly attaching 1 flower particle to 1 target within the skill range.
HelpText_2200302_Content:
<color=yellow>Resonance Liberation: Incandescent Light</color>

Verina deals area damage and adds photosynthesis marks to surrounding targets.

When attacking targets in the state of photosynthesis marks, it will cause additional damage of X% of Verina's ATK, and restore X% of Verina's ATK to the character causing the damage.
HelpText_2200401_Content:
<color=yellow>Character Pairing Tutorial (Example): </color>

Accumulate elemental damage through the Resonance Skill of the light attribute, and after triggering the Intro Skill, Verina deals high damage.
HelpText_2200402_Content: Use the knowledge you just learned to defeat all the enemies present
HelpText_22_Content:
[<color=#c19f51>Team Selection</color>]

After the trainee has formed a team, they can enter the challenge. The minimum number of Resonators in a single team is <color=#c19f51>1</color> and the maximum is <color=#c19f51>3</color>. The team formation will record the development status of the selected Resonators, which will remain unchanged in a large-scale training.

Starting from the <color=#c19f51>3</color>rd level training - Real Scene Simulation, trainees need to form <color=#c19f51>2</color> teams to challenge before the training begins.

[<color=#c19f51>Training Purpose</color>]

If the trainee eliminates all the enemies within the limited time, the training is considered successful. Only after success can they enter the next training. If all the small trainings within a large-scale training are completed, the large-scale training is considered successful.

In large-scale training, the status of the Resonators will be inherited. The trainee needs to ensure that at least <color=#c19f51>1</color> Resonator in the team survives, which is considered to have passed the large-scale training.

[<color=#c19f51>Training Subjects</color>]

The entire gameplay is composed of <color=#c19f51>4</color> large-scale trainings. In the first <color=#c19f51>3</color> large-scale trainings, each large-scale training has <color=#c19f51>4</color> rounds of small training. The <color=#c19f51>4</color>th large-scale training has only <color=#c19f51>1</color> training.

Trainees can temporarily leave the Tower of Adversity after completing a training, and the training progress of the trainees will be recorded. They can then choose to continue or reset the training progress.

Except for the behavior of continuing training, trainees can only play from the first training of the large-scale training.

[<color=#c19f51>Ability Limitations</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity gameplay, trainees cannot develop Resonators, use items, change equipment and Echo during the training process, and some system functions will also be prohibited.

[<color=#c19f51>Guardian of the Voice</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity gameplay, different trainings may have different buff effects. Trainees can adjust the team formation, equipment or Echo according to the buff effects.

[<color=#c19f51>Reward Rules</color>]

When passing a training for the first time, the trainee will receive a reward after the training settlement. <color=#c19f51>Repeatedly passing the cleared training will not receive the reward again</color>.
HelpText_2300101_Content:
<color=yellow>Yangyang's Unique Ability: Listening to the Wind</color>

When Yangyang uses a [Heavy Attack], she can consume 1 layer of [Echo] to perform a [Basic Attack] again, causing wind attribute damage.

[Echo] can be accumulated through [Basic Attack Combo], [Intro Skill], [Feather Release Slash], and [North Wind Effect].
HelpText_2300102_Content:

Yangyang's Resonance Skill "Wind Feather Break" and Resonance Burst "North Wind Effect" can both generate monster gathering effects, greatly improving output efficiency.
HelpText_2300103_Content:

For an enhanced experience of utilizing Resonators' unique abilities, additional buffs will be granted in the trial stages.
HelpText_2300201_Content:

HelpText_23_Content:
"[<color=#c19f51>Tower of Adversity</color>]

A large underground comprehensive experimental center built before the Lament. It sank into the sea due to the terrain changes during the Lament, and only recently resurfaced. 

This research station has a depth of over ten thousand meters reaching the Moho, and there is a trend to continue to expand downwards. At the same time, there seems to be a periodic echo coming from the deep well, as if it is breathing. Therefore, the deep well has also gained the nickname of the Gate of Hell. 

Without a doubt, humans do not have the industrial capacity to build such a facility. At the bottom of the deep well, countless mysteries are waiting to be unveiled...

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Cycle</color>]

The environment of the Tower of Adversity naturally recovers in a <color=#c19f51>two-week</color> cycle, and the data and monsters will be updated after the cycle is reset. The rewards from the data will also be updated. 

[<color=#c19f51>Underground Structure</color>]

The Tower of Adversity has <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas to be explored, and each area has <color=#c19f51>4</color> depths. Only after the explorer has completed the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas at the same depth, can they proceed to explore the deeper layers. 

[<color=#c19f51>Lineup Selection</color>]

Exploration requires the formation of <color=#c19f51>3</color> teams, each to complete the exploration of <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas. The Resonators who have already fought will be locked in the exploration area and cannot participate in the exploration of other areas until the exploration of the <color=#c19f51>3</color> areas of the same difficulty is completed. The explorer can choose to manually unlock the Resonators, but after the unlock, the exploration points of the current area will be reset. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Rules</color>]

Explorers need to conduct multi-layer exploration in each area, each layer of exploration has a certain time limit. If the exploration is not completed within the time limit, it will be judged as a failure; if all the monsters are defeated within the time limit, it will be judged as a pass. 

[<color=#c19f51>Exploration Degree</color>]

When the explorer is exploring the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, the exploration degree will be evaluated in real time according to the explorer's performance. After the exploration is completed, a fixed amount of exploration points will be settled; 

When the explorer is exploring the mutation layer, the exploration should be ended as soon as possible to avoid pollution. The <color=#c19f51>faster the exploration is completed</color>, the <color=#c19f51>more exploration points will be obtained at the time of settlement</color>. 

[<color=#c19f51>Residual Echo</color>]

In the research station, each area node will have a Master of Illusion. The Master of Illusion has obtained the enhancement of the Lament's Echo, and has a stronger power than the general monsters, and even has rule-like characteristics (such as enhancement effects). The explorer needs to choose the lineup carefully according to the characteristics. 

[<color=#c19f51>Reward Rules</color>]

The deeper the exploration, the more information obtained, the more rewards. Every time a certain exploration degree is reached, rewards will be settled at the end of the cycle; when the explorer has completed the exploration of the surface layer, the relay layer, and the deep layer, rewards can be obtained in advance. 

[<color=#c19f51>Ability Limitations</color>]

In the Tower of Adversity, it is not possible to cultivate Resonators, use items, change equipment and Echo during the exploration, and some system functions will also be prohibited."
HelpText_244_Content:
[About]
Victory does not come easily. A Cube's got to sweat a little to win the race! Join the Cubes in training, complete practice rounds to earn some exciting rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
1. In "Cubie Derby: Warmup," complete tasks to earn dice. Roll the dice to move Rover Cube across the map and collect rewards along the way.
2. Land on certain pads to meet new Cubes and unlock unique Cube Bonuses.
3. The event includes 12 rounds with two types of rewards: Map Rewards and Round Rewards. Map Rewards are picked up as your Cube moves, and Round Rewards unlock after you complete each round.
Unclaimed Round Rewards will remain available for 30 days after the event ends and will be sent via Mail when you log in during this period. Please note that unclaimed Map Rewards and Daily/Weekly Quest Rewards will not be reissued.

HelpText_246_Content:
[About]
KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvenirs in the Second Coming of Solaris!

[Eligibility]
Complete Side Quest "Scale of Past" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future...

This is a permanent event. Scale of Past will remain accessible via the special item Trace Scale after the event Memory Travelogue has ended.
HelpText_251_Content:
Dear Rover, every year on your birthday, we prepare a unique gift to make your day extra special. Whatever is that you wish for, we believe it will surely come true one day.
This is Solaris-3, a place made better because of you, a story written together with you. Wherever your journey leads, take our blessings with you. And on this special day, we hope you'll take a moment to pause and stay with us, even if it's just for a while.

[Set Your Date of Birth]
1. Once you've set your date of birth and reached Union Level 2, the Birthday Blessing feature will be unlocked.
2. Please note, <color=HighlightB>your date of birth cannot be changed once set</color>. Be sure to enter the correct date.

[Birthday Blessing]
1. Log in on the day of your birthday or within 7 days after to receive a unique birthday surprise.
2. If you missed the 7 days but logged in within 30 days after your birthday, the gift will still be sent to you via WavesLine. If you haven't unlocked WavesLine, the gift will be sent directly to your Backpack.
3. If features such as the "Reprise of Tides" are triggered when you log in on your birthday or within 7 days after, the Birthday Blessing will be delayed and delivered on your next login.
4. <color=HighlightB>If your birthday has passed when you finish the birthdate initial setting, you can still receive the birthday blessings and gift for the current year via WavesLine.</color>
HelpText_248_Content:
[About]
To encourage the Pioneers to further share their Ragunna explorations, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs to the Lollo courier truck to get various rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete the Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs.
Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package; Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards.
There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
HelpText_249_Content:
To every Rover who's walked this long road with us, thank you for being here.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
Log in during the event period to claim the rewards.
Rewards for this event will NOT be reissued via in-game mail once the event ends. Please pay close attention to the event time and claim the rewards beforehand.
HelpText_24_Content:
[Pioneer Podcast]
A podcast operated by the Pioneer Association. It serves as a guide for enhancing your world exploration experience while providing lucrative rewards.
Each time the Pioneer Podcast is activated, the Public Channel will be automatically unlocked.
You can purchase the Insider Channel or the Connoisseur Channel to obtain more rewards.

[Pioneer Podcast Tasks]
You can obtain Podcast EXP by completing Podcast Tasks to increase the Podcast level, allowing access to more channels and rewards.
Podcast Tasks include the Morning Broadcasts, the Weekly Highlights, and the Seasonal Specials. Podcast EXP obtained from the Seasonal Specials is not counted in the weekly EXP limit.
The Morning Broadcasts are updated every day at 04:00 server time, and the Weekly Highlights are updated every Monday at 04:00 server time.
Once the Podcast Level of the current period reaches its cap, it will no longer increase.

[Notes]
If you happen to repeatedly activate the Channel (such as the Insider Channel, the Connoisseur Channel, or upgrading the Insider Channel to the Connoisseur Channel), rewards will not be repeatedly distributed and Lunites of equivalent value will be directly refunded.
When the current Pioneer Podcast concludes, any unclaimed level rewards will be distributed via mail.
HelpText_258_Content:
[Watch Films]
-Encounter a variety of events during the Solaris Film Festival. Use Film Rolls to explore stories and reach different endings!
-The Somnoire is pulsing with mysterious power. Upon entering, all Resonators are stripped of their Echoes, but in their place are Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, and other unique buffs waiting to be discovered.
-Explore different team builds and combinations for diverse combat experiences.
-This event features a new Bond system. Bond can now be formed between Resonators, granting various combat buffs and powerful Synergy Burst as its level increases.
(Rover's attribute is locked the moment you enter the Festival.)

[Dream Archive]
Track Metaphors and Events you've collected during the films and claim corresponding rewards.

[Watchlist]
Complete corresponding tasks during the opening period of the Watchlist to earn rewards. Once the period ends, the Watchlist will no longer be accessible.

[Dream Pawnshop]
Earn "Tradable Dreams" by watching films and exchanging them for various rewards.

[Film Theory]
Earn "Observer's Dice" from exploring the Solaris Film Festival. Use them in [Film Theory] to activate special bonuses that empower your Resonators.

[Film Stills]
Each story features one or more endings. Collecting different endings to unlock milestone rewards.
HelpText_25_Content:
[Mission Release]

The Pioneer Association releases several missions daily. Rewards can be obtained through the Pioneer Association after the completion of the missions.



[Mission Preference]

1. Missions may come from different countries and different forces. The mission taker can modify the mission preference independently, but cannot accept missions from countries and forces that have not yet been contacted.

2. After modifying the mission preference to "Random Country", missions from any forces from any country can be obtained.

3. After modifying the mission preference to "Random Force", missions from any forces from the selected country can be obtained.

4. The modification of the mission preference will take effect the next day.
HelpText_261_Content:
Trial Resonators include Featured Trial Resonators and Permanent Trial Resonators. Featured Trial Resonators change periodically.
You can recruit any available Trial Resonators during challenges (based on the list of available Resonators at the time of challenge start).
HelpText_27_Content: Locate specific enemies on the map via Enemy Tracing.
HelpText_286_Content:
[About]
The clouds above bear witness to echoing battle cries, the wild lands remember the footsteps of warriors, and rushing currents carry the fiery passion of the brave. Here, every corner holds shining tributes to a glorious history. The towering cities, spires, and mighty walls forged by the people of the Septimont stand as enduring proof of their strength and resolve.

At the harbor, you meet a quarreling father and daughter. This unexpected encounter sets you on a journey to uncover the rich history of Septimont...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act V "Shadow of Glory" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future...

This system is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Uncovering Past Heroes event ends.
HelpText_287_Content:
[About]

The Lollo Campaign is facing an unexpected crisis! To save Maji's career, and to keep those convenient services running, help him verify the reliability of Lollo Campaign!

Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics. Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps. 

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
HelpText_30_Content:
Activity Task
Complete Activity Tasks to claim rewards. Activity Task resets at 4:00 every day.

Activity Reward
Earn Activity Points to claim corresponding rewards.
Activity Points and Stage Rewards reset at 4:00 every day. Unclaimed rewards will be cleared. Please note the reset time and claim your rewards.

Weekly Activity Task
Doing any Weekly Activity Task allows you to claim the corresponding Weekly Activity Points Rewards. The progress of Weekly Activity Tasks resets every Monday at 4:00.

Weekly Activity Rewards
Upon reaching specific Activity Point milestones, you may claim the corresponding Weekly Rewards.
Your accumulated Weekly Activity Points, as well as the Weekly Rewards for each milestone, are reset every Monday at 04:00. Any unclaimed Weekly Rewards at that time will be sent to you via in-game Mail. Please claim them promptly.
We will continue to introduce more "Weekly Activity" events in future updates. Stay tuned!
HelpText_314_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 35 and reach the Bell Tower during Main Quest "Flames of Heart."

[Event Rules]
1. During the challenge period, head to various city districts to explore and battle. Defeat the Elite enemy in five challenge zones to earn Astrites and more.
2. Being defeated within the challenge zones will reset your Glory Level back to your Trial Level. Defeating enemies or activating Banners can help you increase your Glory Level.
3. Successfully using techniques like Counterattacks and Dodge Counters will steadily increase your Battle Engagement Points, which temporarily increases your Glory Level. Skillful use of these techniques leads to greater combat efficiency.
4. Banners are scattered throughout the area. Find and activate them to gain bonuses to both your Trial Level and Glory Level. Some banners also grant additional buffs.
5. Finish all "Banners of Conquest: Medium" and "Banners of Conquest: Major" challenges to conclude the "Banners Never Fall" Challenges. Once the event ends, the challenge zones will continue offering special buffs, and regular enemy spawning will resume.

※Defeating the Elite enemy unlocks the other Banners of Conquest and reveals all hidden Trophy Chests in the zone.
※This is a Permanent gameplay feature. If "Banners Never Fall" Challenges haven't been completed after Version 2.4 ends, you can continue to access the event through the Permanent Event menu.
