HelpText_322_Content:
After completing all "Banner of Conquest: Medium" and "Banner of Conquest: Major" challenges, you can deactivate the "Banners Never Fall" gameplay through the Tutorial Quest "Path of the Victorious."
Once the gameplay is deactivated, normal enemy spawning will resume in the area, and the Glory Level system will be disabled. However, you can still gain buffs within challenge zones.
Any unclaimed Trophy Chests in the challenge zones will remain available for collection.
HelpText_333_Content:
[Event Overview]
A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called "Peaks of Prestige." It's said that countless challengers have set out on a journey to claim the legendary title of "Apex Duelist."
"Countless Echoes. Limitless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and reach Capitoline Hilltop in Main Quest "Shadow of Glory."

[Event Rules]
- You can summon special Echoes from "Peaks of Prestige" to build your own deck and engage in thrilling duels across Septimont. Claim honor and fame while you rise to become the very first Apex Duelist of Septimont!
- In the event, you need to defeat five Lords of Prestige and one Conqueror of Prestige to complete the challenges and earn the rewards. After claiming the title of Legendary Duelist, you'll unlock Endless Challenge and face mysterious duelists.
- This event cannot be completed in Co-op mode. Please exit Co-op to progress through event quests.
- During the Limited-Time Rewards period, you can claim generous rewards by completing tasks or by spending Token of Radiance earned through duels in the Radiant Selection shop. Exclusive rewards include the Echo Aspect "Moment of Triumph" and more!
- Once the period ends, Limited-Time Rewards will no longer be available, but you can continue participating in the event to earn Standard Rewards.
HelpText_334_Content:
1. During the event, you can build your own deck and select Resonator Tactics to challenge the great Duelists known as the Lords of Prestige and Conqueror of Prestige. You can Fast Travel to their locations via Map.
2. You can earn Glory Points through duels. Glory Points can be spent to unlock more Echoes for customizing and strengthening your deck.
3. Duels also grant Duel Resonance, which can be used to increase your Duelist Level. Leveling up unlocks new dueling abilities and enhancements, along with various rewards.
4. After completing the event, you will unlock Endless Challenges, where you'll compete against duelists from across the Septimont and earn rewards.
5. After completing the event, you will face challenges from mysterious duelists. Rise to the challenge and earn rewards.
HelpText_335_Content:
1. Event Tasks are divided into four parts. Complete them to gain Tokens of Radiance, which can be exchanged for rewards in the Radiant Selection.
2. The Radiant Selection shop will only be available for a limited time, and Tokens of Radiance will be cleared when it closes, so please pay attention to the remaining time.
HelpText_337_Content:
1. Progressing through the event will unlock multiple Tactic sets corresponding to different Resonators. These Resonator Tactics provide powerful effects during duels.
2. Each Resonator has one Active Tactic and one Passive Tactic.
Active Tactics require Energy to use, while Passive Tactics activate automatically when their conditions are met.
3. You'll also receive rewards when unlocking each Resonator's Tactics set for the first time.
HelpText_338_Content:
[Medal of Prestige]
- Earn Medals of Prestige by defeating Lords of Glory or increasing your Duelist Level. Collect Medals of Prestige to claim various rewards.
- Medals of Prestige provide set bonuses. Collecting a certain number of Medals of the same type will activate special buffs.

[Echo Collection]
- Collect different Echoes to unlock rewards. You can view detailed info about each Echo, and use Glory Points to unlock those you haven't obtained yet.
- During the event, you can also upgrade the appearance of your Echoes.
HelpText_477_Content:
[Card Collection]
Collect cards to unlock rewards. Click on the cards for more details, or use Prestige Points to unlock more cards.
HelpText_339_Content:
[About]
The Fabricatorium of the Deep has stirred beneath the waves, its unrest quietly noted by the nobles and the Order. To prevent further disruption to the lives of the people of Ragunna and to avoid unnecessary panic, both sides held a rare private meeting. In an unprecedented move, they reached a consensus: a full re-survey of the facility must be conducted to inform joint discussions on the fate of the Fabricatorium and the Common Echoes it holds.

As the only one to return from that place unscathed, you are undoubtedly the best person to lead this expedition.

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act VII "Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens" and Side Quest "Scale of Past."

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

This feature is permanently available, and Scale of Past can still be accessed via Trace Scale after Deep Sea Survey ends.
HelpText_33_Content:
[Tower of Adversity]
In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. With enough Crests, you shall collect hefty rewards.

[Zone and Tower]
<color=#c19f51>The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, Hazard Zone, and Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers, and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing Stable Zone will unlock Experiment Zone, and clearing Experiment Zone will unlock Hazard Zone and Overdrive Zone at the same time.

[Vigor]
In the Tower of Adversity, clearing a challenge reduces participating Resonators' Vigor by a specific amount. Once a Resonator's Vigor is depleted, they can no longer take part in new challenges. <color=#c19f51>Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Reset] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.</color>

[Area Effects]
In the Tower of Adversity, special environmental effects will influence your combat tactics.

[Trial Phase]
Crest Rewards in the Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, and Overdrive Zone can only be claimed once. <color=#c19f51>However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are periodically reset, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and claim fresh rewards.</color>

[Record Sync]
Your challenge records for <color=#c19f51>Floor 1-2 of Resonant Tower and Echoing Tower</color> from the previous Trial Phase will be carried over if you earned <color=#c19f51>24</color> Crests in the previous Trial Phase with <color=#c19f51>full Crests</color> in these Floors;
Your challenge records for <color=#c19f51>Floor 1-3 of Resonant Tower and Echoing Tower</color> from the previous Trial phase will be carried over if you earned <color=#c19f51>30</color> Crests in the previous Trial Phase with <color=#c19f51>full Crests</color> in these Floors.
HelpText_341_Content: Participate in duels to earn Duel Resonance. Use Duel Resonance to increase your Duelist Level and unlock new dueling abilities and enhancements, along with various rewards.
HelpText_34_Content: After completing Sonoro Sphere challenges, you can consume Waveplates to claim rewards.
HelpText_352_Content:
[About]
To Septimontians, the Sanguis Plateaus are the very embodiment of glory. Generations of Gladiators have stepped onto this crimson land with unwavering passion. Beneath the gaze of the colossuses of the Hero of Heroes, they fell enemies with blades swift and hearts ablaze, their blood painting the red forests. Countless legends were forged here, yet few know the shadows buried beneath its grandeur.
At an old lady's request, you track a fallen hero's soul, retracing memories of a forgotten past...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act VIII "By Sun's Burning Hand" and Side Quest "Scale of Past" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Follow the clues to explore areas and collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all the Chrono Traces to earn Astrites and more.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

This feature is permanently available, and "Scale of Past" can still be accessed via Trace Scale after "Prints of Plateaus" ends.
HelpText_357_Content:
The "Back to Solaris" web event is now live! Participate to earn up to 530 Astrites and other rewards.
Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Rules]
1. Share your invitation code with up to 3 Returning Players in your server, complete in-game tasks to obtain Spiritual Flames, and exchange them for up to Astrite x480 and Shell Credit x300,000.
2. Returning Players can link their accounts with the Player of their choice by using their corresponding invitation code. This can be done once and cannot be changed later. After linking, Returning Players are eligible to claim a reward of Astrite x50, Advanced Enclosure Tank x5, and Shell Credit x50,000.

※ In-game reward Mail can be claimed within 30 days after the issuance of the reward. 
※ Upon completing an event task, there may be a slight delay before you can claim the rewards. If this occurs, please wait at least 2 minutes before refreshing the page or restarting the game.
※ A Returning Player cannot be both the inviter and invitee of another Returning Player.

[Returning Player Eligibility]
1. Reach Union Level 8 or higher.
2. Has not logged into the game for at least 14 consecutive days immediately before the start of this event or before August 14, 2025, 03:59 (UTC+8).
3. Eligible Returning Players will retain their status for the duration of this event.
HelpText_358_Content:
[About]
On the crimson earth of the Sanguis Plateaus, the scorched front of Septimont's war against the Dark Tide, generations of Gladiators have carved their legends into the land with their blood. Now, it's time to walk their path, fight beside the heroes' spirits, and forge an immortal name in the fires of glory.

[Eligibility]

To lower the risks they face in fighting the TDs, the Black Shores has developed specialized combat devices designed to counter the threat. HelpText_383_Content:

HelpText_42_Content:
[Echo Upgrade]
Upgrading an Echo raises an Echo's Mainstat. This improvement is not randomized.
Echo Upgrade also unlocks new Substat slots every 5 levels.
The level cap of an Echo depends on its rarity.

[Echo Tuning]
By Tuning an Echo, you can unlock new random Substats and unleash its potential. The unlock Substats will be fixed and cannot be tuned again.
(Echoes with the lowest rarity may not be able to be Tuned due to data interference.)

[Data Modification]
Data Modification for Mainstats and Substats has different rules and item requirements.
Use a Modifier to adjust the first Mainstat of a selected Echo into the designated stat. This can only be done on unupgraded 5-star Echoes.
1 Modifier is consumed for each Mainstat Modification.
Use a Transducer to adjust the Substats of a selected Echo to random stats, excluding locked Substats. This can only be done on fully tuned 5-star Echoes.
The number of locked Substats determines the amount of Transducers consumed in each Modification:
- With 2 or fewer locked stats, consume 1 Transducer.
- With 3 locked stats, consume 2 Transducers.
- With 4 locked stats, consume 3 Transducers.
You may choose whether to apply the Modification results in Substat Modification. Discarding the result does not refund used Transducers.

Substat Modification results that are not confirmed due to unexpected errors will be saved in the server for up to 30 days. Please confirm your results in time.

Symphony Rank is activated during battle.
All combat actions will progressively raise your Symphony Rank, while being attacked will significantly lower it.
During battles, if you do not achieve a Symphony Rank within a specified period, your Symphony Rank will decrease over time.

Symphony Rank is categorized into 6 tiers: D, C, B, A, S, and SS. If you achieve Rank A or higher, you'll obtain special buffs.
Rank A: Dodge Counter DMG is increased by 100%.

HelpText_493_Content:
[Basic Gameplay]
The game is played with a deck of 16 cards. Each player starts with a hand of 8 cards. Players flip a coin to decide their play order in each round.
In a player's turn, they draw one card from their opponent's hand. If a player has two identical cards in hand, they may play them as a pair.
The game ends when any of the victory conditions are met.

[Victory Conditions]
1. Each player starts with 2 HP. Drawing the Crownless Card costs 1 HP. If a player's HP drops to 0, they lose the game.
2. If a player plays every card in their hand while their opponent is still holding the Crownless Card, the player who goes out wins.

[Card Details]
1. Wild Card: At the start of each turn, the Wild Card randomly transforms into another number card in the player's hand. It cannot transform into the Crownless Card, a card that has already been played, or repeat its transform in previous rounds. Wild Cards can form pairs like standard cards.
2. Crownless Card: There is only one Crownless Card in the deck. Drawing it causes the player to lose 1 HP (out of 2). The first player to lose 2 HP loses the game.

[Instructions]

1. Select the first drink base.
2. Select the second drink base.
3. Select add-ins.
4. Select a topping.
The flavor of a drink depends on the combination of bases and add-ins you use, which also determines its type.
Your companion will rate each drink based on how well its flavor matches the order and whether its type is her personal preference. To receive the first-clear rewards, you must earn a rating of "Satisfied" or higher.
Earn a "Very Satisfied" rating to unlock bonus dialogue.

[Standard Merge]
You can merge or Batch Merge 5 unupgraded Echoes into 1 random new Echo in the Terminal.

[Targeted Merge]
This feature unlocks at Data Bank Lv. 15.
You can merge 5 unupgraded 5-Star Echoes into a random new Echo of the Sonata Effect of your choice.
You cannot select equipped and locked Echoes as Merge Materials.
*If a selected Sonata Effect currently only has Cost-1 or Cost-3 Echoes unlocked, Targeted Merge may still produce an Echo of a locked Cost type. In this case, the Echo produced will be of 3-Star rarity and will unlock the corresponding Echo Collection entry. Afterward, you may obtain Echoes of the newly unlocked Cost type. The highest Rarity of the Echoes obtained will depend on the current Data Bank level.

[New Echoes]
The Rarity of the Echo produced depends on your Data Bank level and is irrelevant to the Rarity of merged Echoes. Upgrade your Data Bank to get Echoes of higher Rarity from Data Merge.
Data Merge only produces Echoes already unlocked.

[Extra Yield]
Standard Merge sometimes produce extra Echoes in addition to the base yield.
Merge Echoes of higher Rarity and Cost for a higher chance to yield extra Echoes.
*Targeted Merge does not produce extra Echoes.

[Auto Select]
Auto Select lets you quickly select available Echoes in the order displayed. You can change the sort and filter settings to change which Echoes are displayed and selected first.

Some <color=Wind>Aero</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> to the target.
While the <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> lasts, it deals periodic <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to the target.
GuideTutorialPage_3100202_Content:
The damage of <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> scales with its stacks.
Dodge attacks to avoid the buildup of the <color=#ffd12f>"Aero Erosion Effect"</color> stacks.
GuideTutorialPage_31003_Content:
Some <color=Thunder>Electro</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> effect to the target.
While <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> lasts, it deals periodic <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target. The target loses half of the effect stacks with each instance of damage.
<color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG dealt.
GuideTutorialPage_3100302_Content:
At maximum stacks of <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color>, any new stack inflicted becomes stackable <color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color>.
<color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color> increases the DMG dealt by the next <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> triggered. <color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color> is removed once triggered.
<color=#ffd12f>Electro Rage</color> stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> deals.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Electro Flare</color> effect.
GuideTutorialPage_31004_Content:
Some <color=Ice>Glacio</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> effect to the target.
When <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> is inflicted, the target receives <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG dealt.
Each stack of <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> effect reduces the target's Movement Speed.
GuideTutorialPage_3100402_Content:
When <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> reaches max stacks, the target will be <color=#ffd12f>frozen</color>, and all stacks of <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> will be removed. Struggle to accelerate your recovery from the <color=#ffd12f>frozen</color> state.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Glacio Chafe</color> effect.
GuideTutorialPage_31005_Content: Some <color=Fire>Fusion</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> effect to the target.
GuideTutorialPage_3100502_Content:
When <color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> is stacked to its max, all stacks will be removed to trigger an <color=#ffd12f>explosion</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> around the target.
<color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> effect stacks up to 10 times by default. The higher the stacks, the more DMG dealt.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Fusion Burst</color> effect.
GuideTutorialPage_31006_Content:
Some <color=Light>Spectro</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> to the target.
While <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> lasts, the number of its stacks is periodically reduced by 1 to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to the target.
GuideTutorialPage_3100602_Content:
The building up of <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> greatly increases the DMG it deals.
Dodge attacks to avoid the accumulation of <color=#ffd12f>"Spectro Frazzle Effect"</color> and effectively reduce the DMG taken.
GuideTutorialPage_31007_Content:
Some <color=Dark>Havoc</color> attacks will apply a stackable <color=#ffd12f>Havoc Bane</color> effect to the target.

GuideTutorialPage_3100702_Content:
<color=#ffd12f>Havoc Bane</color> stacks up to 3 times by default, with each stack reducing the target's DEF by 2%.
Dodge attacks carefully to avoid building up <color=#ffd12f>Havoc Bane</color> effect.

HelpText_107_Content:
[About]
The Moon-Chasing Festival is a Huanglong traditional festival that features various origin stories, with the most popular being the tale of The Fox and the Moon. On this special night, families and friends come together to admire the moon and make wishes, expressing their hopes for a brighter future.

[Event Rules]
1. Help Xiangli Yao prepare for the Moonlit Fair to boost the festival's Popularity.
2. Increase Popularity by fulfilling Wishes and building stalls.
3. Invite Companions to assist in preparations by completing the corresponding Side Quests, and earn higher Wish Ratings and Funds.
HelpText_101_Content:
1. During the Moon-Chasing Festival, you can increase Popularity via the activities in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> and <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> to make the Moonlit Fair more lively.
2. Popularity starts from Level 1 and can reach as high as Level 6.
HelpText_102_Content:
1. Build or upgrade stalls to increase Popularity, gain buffs, and unlock Companions.
2. Building or upgrading stalls requires Funds, which can be earned by completing Lodge Wishes.
3. Stalls can be upgraded multiple times, with higher levels providing greater buffs.
4. After building a stall, you can participate in the stall's activities and may earn unexpected rewards.
HelpText_103_Content:
1. You can spend Funds to fulfill people's Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. Each Wish has its own resource cost.
2. Fulfilling Wishes will earn you Funds and Wish Tags. Setting new records will boost Popularity.
3. Send the right Companions to fulfill the Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>. You can view their detailed stats on the Companions page.
HelpText_104_Content_1:
There is a preferred Companion Stat for each Wish. Selecting your Companions accordingly will earn you a higher score.
To boost your Companions' stats, interact with them on the Companions page.
HelpText_104_Content_2:
Preparation Underway: Your Companions act in turn, earning scores based on their stats.
Scoring Rules: Scores fluctuate each round, as your Companions can't always perform at their absolute best. Nevertheless, Companions with higher stats have the potential to earn higher scores.
HelpText_104_Content_3: During preparation, Companions may experience a "Eureka" moment. The likelihood of this occurring varies for each Companion.
HelpText_104_Content_4: "Eureka" allows for additional investments. Higher risks yield greater rewards. Make your choice wisely.
HelpText_104_Content_5: Results: A Wish Rating depends on the combined scores of your chosen Companions. Higher Ratings earn you more Funds and Wish Tags.
HelpText_105_Content:
1. Companions can help you fulfill Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color>.
2. They have three stats: Knowledge, Action, and Teamwork. Higher stats and better matches with the Wish's recommended stat lead to higher Wish Ratings.
3. Build and upgrade <color=#8c7e51>Fair Stalls</color> and complete the <color=#8c7e51>Festival Journal</color> quests series to unlock more Companions.
HelpText_106_Content:
1. You can interact with Companions to boost their stats and Bond Level.
2. Each Interaction has its own cost of Wish Tags. A higher cost results in greater enhancements.
3. Complete Wishes in <color=#8c7e51>Lodge Wishes</color> to earn Wish Tags.
HelpText_185_Content:
1. The fishers of the Riccioli Islands follow a strict tradition of working from sunrise to sunset, believing the night belongs to Cetus the Tidebreaker, who guides lost souls back home.

2. While sailing in certain waters around the Riccioli Islands at night, Rachel's Threat Level will rise. Once it reaches a critical point, Ghost Medusas will emerge and attack. Stay alert and avoid their strikes!

3. The riskier the waters, the greater the rewards. Fish caught in areas where Ghost Medusas appear tend to be of higher quality.

4. Some special species only appear at night. Check the Index for details.

5. Night on the Riccioli Islands spans from 19:00 to 5:00.
HelpText_186_Content:
1. As a Gondola Echo, Rachel takes damage upon bumping into hazards on the sea. Steer clear of Bampuffs, Tornadoes, and Ghost Medusas while navigating the waters.

2. Rachel's Durability decreases when damaged. If it reaches zero, it will automatically return to the dock, and all collected catches will be lost.

3. To ensure a safer and more successful voyage, you can use Riccioli Fishery Coins to restore Rachel's Durability before weighing anchor at the dock. Keep a close watch on its Durability to avoid unnecessary losses.
HelpText_188_Content:
1. Fame reflects your skill in fishing and the recognition you've earned from the fishers of the Riccioli Islands. Increasing your Fame will grant you more convenience while sailing across the Riccioli waters.

2. You can earn Fame by exploring the Riccioli Islands, completing Requests from Merchant Planck, and updating the Index.
HelpText_191_Content:
1. Certain Requests require specific Fishing Abilities. If you haven't unlocked the necessary ability, you won't be able to complete these requests.

2. On the Fishing Abilities page, you can consume a certain amount of materials and coins to unlock the Fishing Abilities.

HelpText_73_Content:
[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered. There's a maximum limit to the number of Technical Points that can be earned from each challenge.
HelpText_72_Content:
For certain classes of Tacet Discords, your Terminal can consume extra computational power to enhance its Echo absorption and increase your chances of getting Echo drops. It can perform a limited number of enhanced absorptions, and then it will need time to recharge.
The enhanced absorption attempts of different classes are counted separately.
*Cooldown resets at server time 04:00 every Monday.
HelpText_77_Content:
[About]
Complete the Lollo Campaigns proposed by Maji, the administrator of Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.
Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.
There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
HelpText_78_Content: [Event Rules] The Pioneer Association has picked Mt. Firmament as the theme for an upcoming edition of Wutherium Geographic. To that end, the association has organized a special survey of Mt. Firmament. Complete Survey Tasks and accumulate Survey Points to secure valuable rewards offered by the Pioneer Association. [Task Reset] Survey Tasks reset daily at 04:00. Upon reset, any unclaimed Survey Points will be automatically claimed, and uncompleted tasks will expire. If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
HelpText_79_Title: About the Tales from Mt. Firmament
HelpText_79_Content:
[About]
Mt. Firmament is a secluded haven, detached from the rest of the world. It is rumored to be the very place where the Sentinel Jué descended...
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at Mt. Firmament in the main quest "Voyage to Firmament."

[Event Rules]
The event consists of four phases, with each phase unlocking progressively as you advance through the main quests.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available while in certain game scenes.
HelpText_80_Title: Gifts of Celestial Light Event Rules
HelpText_80_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Event Rules]
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim daily sign-in rewards. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time.
After the event ends, any unclaimed sign-in rewards you earned will be reissued via in-game mail within 30 days upon your next login.

GuideTutorialPage_34037_Content: Use the Chronosorter to alter the flow of time in a small area, changing the state of certain items within that space.
GuideTutorialPage_3403702_Content:
Move the timeline to the <color=#ffd12f>right</color> to <color=#ffd12f>fast forward</color> time in its effective range.
Move the timeline to the <color=#ffd12f>left</color> to <color=#ffd12f>rewind</color> time in its effective range.
After finishing your adjustments, the objects affected by the Chronosorter will maintain the state they were in after the most recent timeline adjustment.
GuideTutorialPage_34038_Content:
Photonvaults usually appear in sets and emit golden energy paths connected to the Photon Barrier.
Both <color=#ffd12f>Ranged Attacks</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Melee Attacks</color> can deactivate Photonvaults. Disabling all Photonvaults in a set will deactivate the Photon Barrier.
Once the Photon Barrier is down, the stationary enemies inside will become active again.
GuideTutorialPage_34039_Content:
Flare Crests typically come in sets and are used to seal the entrance of a ruin or other devices.
Each <color=#ffd12f>Flare Crest</color> corresponds to one <color=#ffd12f>Flare Stone</color>. Flare Crests can be extinguished by approaching and activating the corresponding Flare Stones.
After all Flare Crests of a set have been extinguished, the seal will be lifted.
GuideTutorialPage_34040_Content:
Transform into Clang Bang and fill in the missing ice cube to complete the challenge.
Make sure to <color=#ffd12f>face the right direction</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34041_Content: Interact with the mechanic to start the Echo Challenge: Clang Bang, and transform into Clang Bang.
GuideTutorialPage_3404101_Content: Transform into Clang Bang and use the <color=#ffd12f>Leap Device</color> to launch yourself at the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Walls</color> to break through it.
GuideTutorialPage_3404102_Content: Transform into Clang Bang, <color=#ffd12f>jump</color> and then launch a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> to break through the <color=#ffd12f>Ice Caps</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34042_Content:
Stand on the Leap Device for a moment to launch yourself in the target direction. 
The Leap Device can also be used while you transform into Clang Bang.
GuideTutorialPage_34043_Content: Windchimers are scattered across Mt. Firmament and can be collected using <color=#ffd12f>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#ffd12f>Ranged Attack</color>. Someone has a keen interest in them. Gather Windchimers to exchange for valuable resources with her.
GuideTutorialPage_34044_Content: Smash Ice Piles with attacks, and they might drop unexpected rewards.

GuideTutorialPage_34048_Content:
After activating Tactical Hologram: Ski, throw the Grapple at the <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Point</color> ahead to begin skiing.

Ski: Earn <color=#ffd12f>points</color> as you ski and reach the finish line within the specified time. Aim for higher points to receive better rewards!
GuideTutorialPage_3404802_Content:
While skiing, move left and right to pass through the <color=#ffd12f>Acceleration Rings</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Point Rings</color>.
Passing through an Acceleration Ring will boost your skiing speed for a limited time.
GuideTutorialPage_3404803_Content: Passing through a Point Ring grants you a certain number of points.
GuideTutorialPage_3404804_Content: Passing through a Bonus Ring grants you a large number of points.
GuideTutorialPage_34049_Content:
A special creature that huddles up and hides underground to protect itself when approached or attacked head-on.
Attack the <color=#ffd12f>weak point on Frostbugs' backs</color> <color=#ffd12f>from a distance</color> to defeat them.
GuideTutorialPage_34050_Content:
The last step of the Rite of Offering can only be completed after the Loong's Pearl is placed on the rite platform.
It is necessary to stand in the position in the light and <color=#ffd12f>change the viewing angle</color> to align the <color=#ffd12f>Loong's Pearl</color> on the rite platform with the <color=#ffd12f>mouth</color> of the dragon-shaped peak of Mt. Firmament in the distance.
GuideTutorialPage_34051_Content:
The Offering Site's entrance. Some entrances are still inaccessible due to the lack of a <color=#ffd12f>Meteor Key</color>.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Levitator</color> to put the Meteor Key into the opening at the center of the entrance to open the Offering Site.

HelpText_553_Title: Second Coming of Solaris: Collab Season
HelpText_553_Content:
[About]
The 2nd Anniversary of Second Coming of Solaris is officially a go! This year, the event is powered by the four-way partnership of the Spacetrek Collective, Startorch Academy, Lollo Logistics, and the Pioneer Association. Dive into the celebration and claim your bounty of rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
- During the event, visit the event page to take part in various anniversary activities, including: Gifts of Grand Celebration, Star Bouncing, Lollo Express: Promise Delivered, and Cubie Derby: Championship. Earn 2nd Anniversary Coins through them to unlock various rewards.
- Rewards come from two progress tracks: Individual Progress and Server Progress. Individual Progress rewards are based on the number of coins you personally earn during the event. Server Progress rewards are based on the server's total coin count.

HelpText_555_Content:
[About]
Guided by the orbit, led by luck, and fueled by romanticism.
This is the great adventure—a vibrant trek across the galaxy.
Time to let the sea of stars bounce in rhythm with your heart!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14, and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock (complete "Gold Suspended in Shadows" for a better experience).

[Rules]
1. Access the game in the Mind Dive Arcade or the event page and start your adventure in the infinite galaxy of Star Bouncing.
2. Along the way, you can collect various Persona Pinballs and use them to build different lineups to take on your foes.
3. Level up your Persona Pinballs and gather powerful Tactical ROMs to strengthen your team as you progress. Stronger enemies await, bringing even greater rewards.
4. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your in-game mailbox automatically if you log in within 30 days after the event ends.

[Instructions]
1. Bounce DMG: Collide with an enemy to deal Bounce DMG based on the Pinball’s ATK.
2. Skill Energy: Each Pinball can hold up to 600 points of Skill Energy. Casting a Skill costs exactly 600 points.
3. Rush Energy: The team shares up to 400 points of Rush Energy. Every launch from the Flippers restores 200 points.
4. Combo & Power Strike: Dealing Bounce DMG adds to your Combo hit count. At 5, 10, or 25 hits, your next launch becomes a Level 1, 2, or 3 Power Strike, dealing Power Strike DMG based on the Leader Pinball's ATK.
5. Burst: The team can hold up to 500 Burst Points. When the Burst Gauge is full, activate the following effects for a limited time:
(1) Collision with an enemy deals Power Strike DMG based on the Leader Pinball's ATK and increases the Combo hit count by 1.
(2) Directional Bounce mechanisms appear. Touching them sends the Pinball Rushing in a set direction, dealing Rush DMG based on the Leader Pinball's ATK.
(3) The team regenerates more Skill Energy every second. 
(4) The team's Movement Speed is increased by 20%.
HelpText_556_Content: Random past challenges await you in the Galaxy Forage Tour. Take them on again to earn your rewards.
HelpText_557_Content:
In the Endless Galaxy Track, challenge yourself with increasingly difficult stages.
1. Clear a stage to unlock the next.
2. Complete all stage goals to have your lineup and clear time recorded in Ranking.
3. Your record will be updated whenever you finish all goals on a higher stage or beat your time on a stage you've already cleared.
4. Your record will be cleared after 90 days without logging in to the game.

Journey deep into the silent cave and help guide the Jadeplume Eagle out of danger and back to its nest. And win Astrites in the process!
Complete event tasks to win Advanced Sealed Tubes and more.

Challenge Stages 3 & 4: 2026-07-31 10:00 (server time)
Challenge Stages 5 & 6: 2026-08-01 10:00 (server time)

HelpText_630_Title: Save in Lament Recon: Tacet Crisis
HelpText_630_Content:
[Save in Simulations]
1. You can pause and save your progress at any stage, then exit the stage.
2. After exiting, you can resume your challenge from the stage selection screen.
3. Saves for different stages are independent of one another. All saves will be reset with every major version update.

HelpText_642_Content:
[About]
The Black Shores has recently opened a new, high-spec simulation realm, and you've been invited to take part in its first official test. Unlike past tests that focused on validating a single ability, this is an open-ended test of ability diversity, a simulated experiment that keeps iterating under layer upon layer of interference. Its core goal is to record and analyze how many different types of Forte perform within a single vessel. Throughout the test, the Tethys System will continuously provide Resonance ability samples of various types for you to use. As the test progresses, you're free to connect to different types of ability circuits and explore ever richer structures of Forte. Every type of Forte you bring online opens up new possibilities in future battles....


[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.


[Event Rules]
In this mode, you fight simulated battles from a top-down side view using Rover: Spectro or Rover: Havoc. Within a stage, Rover can obtain Resonance Factors of different Resonators, granting corresponding special enhancements to the basic skills or strengthening other combat abilities.
Rover can also gain additional Morph Skills through Resonance Factors. Dealing damage to the enemies generates Morph Energy. Once Morph Energy is full, you can summon or transform into the corresponding Resonator and unleash a special skill.
The event features 7 stages of varying difficulty. Clearing stages unlocks new Resonators and awards Knowledge Modules and Threshold Sigils. By consuming Threshold Sigils, you can obtain a variety of rewards, including Astrite.
HelpText_665_Content:
[About]
Here Mengzhou's mountains and rivers, its woods and wilds, meet its pavilions and towers, the very place the people of Mengzhou, bound to one another across time, make their homes and live out their lives. Peace and quiet, ardor and flame, despondency and sorrow, every feeling there is settles into a Heart Realm of its own, continuing without end. In this small world, the Court of Savantae and Hsin are shaping the face of Mengzhou anew.
This is the Simulacrum Nexus.

[Eligibility]
Meet the Nexus Fox Shadow in Mengxuan Vale in Main Quest "Simulacrum of the Heart" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
The event consists of four phases, with each phase unlocking progressively as you advance through the main quests.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available while in certain game scenes.
HelpText_663_Content:
The "Back to Solaris" web event is now live! Participate to earn up to 530 Astrites.
Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts!

[Eligibility]
Union Level ≥ 8.

[Rules]
1. Share your invitation code with up to 3 Returning Players in your server, complete in-game tasks to obtain Fox Fortune Sticks, and exchange them for up to Astrite x480 and Shell Credit x300,000.
2. Returning Rovers can link their accounts with the Player of their choice by using their corresponding invitation code. This can be done once and cannot be changed later. After linking, Returning Players are eligible to claim a reward of Astrite x50, Advanced Enclosure Tank III x5, and Shell Credit x50,000.

※ In-game reward Mail can be claimed within 30 days after the issuance of the reward.
※ Upon completing an event task, there may be a slight delay before you can claim the rewards. If this occurs, please wait at least 2 minutes before refreshing the page or restarting the game.
※ A Returning Player cannot be both the inviter and invitee of another Returning Player.

[Returning Player Eligibility]
1. Union Level ≥ 8.
2. Has not logged into the game for at least 14 consecutive days immediately before the start of this event or before September 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC+8).
3. Eligible Returning Players will retain their status for the duration of this event.
HelpText_664_Content:
[About]
The "Waking Moon Fishing" web event is live now! Participate to win Astrites and more!
The Waking Moon Festival begins right on schedule, its lanterns bright as day. Before you stands a mysterious stall...
Participate in the fishing challenge and unlock entries in the Fishing Index to win Astrites! And complete event tasks to win Advanced Sealed Tubes and more.

[Eligibility]
Union Level 8 or above.

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you can challenge event stages and complete event tasks to earn Astrites, Shell Credits, Advanced Sealed Tubes, and other in-game item rewards.
2. Event Stage schedule:
Normal Stages 1-2: Available from October 15, 2026, 10:00 (UTC+8)
Normal Stages 3-4: Available from October 16, 2026, 10:00 (Server Time)
Normal Stages 5-6: Available from October 17, 2026, 10:00 (Server Time)
Challenge Stage: Available from October 17, 2026, 10:00 (Server Time)
3. Some stages unlock only after their preceding stages have been cleared.
4. Each stage can be challenged repeatedly.

[Event Rewards]
1. Clear all Normal Stages to earn a total of Astrite x60.
2. In Normal Stages, catch Shell Credit items and clear the stage to earn up to additional Shell Credit x60,000.
3. Complete all event tasks to earn a total of Astrite x40, Advanced Energy Core x5, Advanced Resonance Potion x5, and Advanced Sealed Tube x5.



[Notes]

1.All stages will close once the event ends. Be sure to participate in time.

2. Please log in during the event period to claim your event rewards. Rewards cannot be obtained after the event ends.

3. The content of this web event is independent of the game's story and lore.
HelpText_108_Content:
[About]
Arno, a special agent of the Black Shores, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on the Lament with the promise of generous rewards. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Act VII "Thaw of Eons."

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different regions. You can participate in any unlocked challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. Once all existing Datasets are collected, new Datasets will appear. The more Datasets you collect, the better the rewards.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your mailbox when you log in again within 30 days.
HelpText_113_Content:

HelpText_115_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
1. Gain as many Tactic Points as possible in the Infinite Battle Simulation.
2. Each area of the simulation contains three Charting Nodes, with enemies growing stronger at each node. Defeating enemies at the third Charting Node will reward you with a great amount of Tactic Points.
3. Open Supply Chests after defeating enemies to claim Tactic Points and Low-Capacity Variable buffs.
4. Once you've collected enough Low-Capacity Variables, you can unlock new powerful buffs—High-Capacity Variables, which will greatly boost your combat power in the Infinite Battle Simulation.

HelpText_117_Content:
[Mail Types]
There are two types of mail: Starred Mail and Other Mail.
Starred Mail stays pinned at the top of your mailbox and does not expire. It will not be deleted when you select "Delete Read Mails."
Other Mail has an expiration date and will be automatically deleted when it expires.

[Mail Storage]
The mailbox can store a maximum of 200 mails.
Once the limit is reached, the oldest mails without attachments or with claimed attachments will be automatically deleted.
Make sure to claim your attachments promptly to avoid any loss from expiration and deletion.

[Mail Favorites]
You can favorite up to 100 mails.
Favorited mail never expires while it remains favorited, and will not be removed when you use "Delete Read Mails."
For some mail with a set validity period, unfavoriting it after that period has ended will delete it automatically at the same time.
HelpText_118_Content:
[About]
Maji, the administrator of Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, decides to relaunch the Lollo Campaign. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.
Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.
There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.

Use Quick Navigate to teleport to an active Resonance Nexus or Resonance Beacon within 500 meters of the target location.

Quick Navigate is unavailable under the following situations:

[About]
Starlight streams through your fingers as you mount the expedition into the depths of the universe.
The gentle twinkles silently chant a song of gratitude, a tribute to the treasured gifts you once bestowed upon them.

HelpText_147_Content:
[About]

A mysterious combat simulation program has gone viral on the Academy's Huaxu Hive. Researcher Lizhu, an active user, seems to have insights on this intriguing program...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 40.

[Event Rules]

1. In Pincer Maneuver Warriors, challenge waves of powerful enemies by controlling two teams with special buffs across two separate simulated battlefields.

2. The simulated battlefield offers buffs that either apply to both teams or are exclusive to one team.

3. There are 4 stages with limited enemy waves and 1 stage with infinite waves.

i. In stages with limited enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half of the battle when time runs out or after eliminating all enemies.

ii. In the stage with infinite enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half when time runs out.

4. Points earned in stages with limited enemy waves include both Time Points and Monster Points, while Points earned in the stage with infinite waves include only Monster Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time left when a challenge is completed.

ComboTeaching_13111001_DescriptionConten: While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111002_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
ComboTeaching_13111003_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111004_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and in mid-air, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, continuously consuming STA and dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target.
Release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack and dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111005_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, when Hsin's <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color> reaches 100 points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color>. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target.
While casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color>, if Hsin is not in the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state, unlock <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111006_DescriptionConten:
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> unlocks <color=Highlight>Formshift</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Formshift</color> to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin turns into <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state.
ComboTeaching_13111007_DescriptionConten: While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and not in the <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111008_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, consume STA to command Xuanfang Mechanisms, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111009_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>:
- When on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Upward Cut - Illumining Form</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
- When in mid-air, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form</color>, consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111010_DescriptionConten: While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and Hsin is on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111011_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, when Hsin's <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color> reaches 300 points, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>.
When Hsin is on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to surrounding targets, and send Hsin into the <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> state.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and in the <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111012_DescriptionConten:
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, when <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color> reaches 0 during the <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> state, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> ends the <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> state and unlocks <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color>.
ComboTeaching_13111013_DescriptionConten:
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> unlocks <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color> to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target.
Hsin returns to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and exits the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state.
ComboTeaching_14050401_DescriptionConten: Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to take a stance and get ready to parry the enemy's next attack, and gain Chi. If an enemy attack is parried, ignore the damage of that attack, counterattack to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, and gain Chi. Interrupt the stance and launch an attack to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> by releasing the Resonance Skill button, and gain Chi.

HelpText_41_Content:
[Equip Echoes]
Equip Echo to gain attributes, Echo Skills, and specific bonuses.
Drag and drop for faster equipping.

[COST]
The number of Echoes you can equip is limited by the total COST. The COST of equipped Echoes cannot exceed your current COST limit. 
Collect Echoes of new types to upgrade your Data Bank level and increase the COST limit.

[Echo Skills]
The Echo assembled in the main Echo position (first position) can activate the corresponding Echo skills. Switch the "Summary" button to view the detailed and brief descriptions of Echo skills.
When Echo skills are in use, the corresponding main Echo cannot be replaced or unloaded temporarily.

[Sonata Effects]
Every Echo comes with its own "Sonata." When the number of Echo assembled with the same Sonata reaches 2 or 5, the corresponding Sonata Effect can be activated.
Multiple Echo with the same Sonata and the same name equipped will only count towards the Sonata Effect once.
Echo with the same name may carry different Sonata due to data differences.

[About]
Events with the "Permanent" tag offer limited-time rewards when they first launch in a new version update. After this initial claiming period ends, the event remains available permanently, but without the limited-time rewards.

HelpText_131_Content:
[About]
The Ragunna branch of the Pioneer Association is preparing to release a fresh line of merchandise. To hit the sales target set by her supervisor, Alannah is seeking a reliable advisor to assist with the task...

HelpText_132_Content:
[About]
A train crashes from the dreamscape into reality, ripping open a gateway to the realm of illusions.
A looming shadow greets you with a grim prophecy: the world will succumb to this nightmare, and night will reign eternal.
You struggle to awaken from this terrifying vision, desperately clinging to shreds of reality left in the shattered dreams...
Thankfully, a white cat appears and guides you back on track, helping you find the lost allies trapped in the realm of dreams. Together, you battle against the darkest terrors of chaos.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 17.

[Dreamscape Odyssey]
Join the strange white cat in rescuing your Resonator companions from their Dreamscapes. Together, you will delve deep into the Somnoire to uncover the truth behind the nightmares. Each of the 6 Dreamscapes offers unique rewards upon completion.


[Rift Runner]
Nightmares have torn through the veil of reality, wreaking havoc across the world. It's down to you to restore the crumbling order to the land, with the mystic boon of Illusive Sprint received from the strange white cat.
Compete "Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits" to unlock "Rift Runner."
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Nightmare Revisits]
The looming shadow stares at you with its fiery eyes, as if trying to draw you back into the endless darkness. Enter the Somnoire with your trusted companions, link your minds and spirits, and relive your epic battle against the ever-lurking nightmare. Fight the Black Cat again with Resonators of your choice. This time, the combat challenge will feature new exciting twists. Use the power of Dream Link to gain an upper hand!
Complete "When the Night Knocks" to unlock "Nightmare Revisits."
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Dream Shards]
Complete Rift Runner, Nightmare Revisits, and the quest "When the Night Knocks" to earn Dream Shards.
Collect the required quantities of Dream Shards to unlock the corresponding milestone rewards.
Dream Shards are obtainable at any time by participating in the event.

[Limited-Time Rewards]
Complete the Limited-Time Rewards objectives to earn exclusive rewards, including the Featured 4-Star Weapon "Somnoire Anchor" and Featured Weapon Projection "Projection: Somnoire Anchor."

[Tips]
The Limited-Time Rewards objectives will expire when the event ends, but you can continue challenging the stages afterward to earn the standard rewards.

HelpText_136_Content:
[About]
The looming shadow stares at you with its fiery eyes, as if trying to draw you back into the endless darkness. Enter the Somnoire with your trusted companions, link your minds and spirits, and relive your epic battle against the ever-lurking nightmare.

Revisit the epic battle with Resonators of your choice. Use the power of Dream Link to gain an upper hand in this fight!
Each of the 6 challenge stages offers unique rewards upon completion.

[Team Comp]
Select 1 Main Resonator and 2 Support Resonators to start the challenge.
You will only control the Main Resonator, while the Support Resonators will stay on the battlefield and automatically fight alongside you.
During this event season, Resonators available include: Rover-Spectro, Encore, Yinlin, Changli, Zhezhi, Camellya, and Lumi.

[Dream Link]
"Dream Link" is available in Nightmare Revisits challenges:
When your Sync Energy is full, cast every team member's Resonance Liberations in a row to activate the Link Field.
When the Link Field is active:
1. All team members' ATK, Crit. Rate, Crit. DMG, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed are significantly boosted, while Resonance Skill Cooldowns are greatly reduced.
2. A Stagnation Zone is generated, immobilizing enemies within the Link Field.
3. Nearby enemies are pulled toward your Resonators upon activation.
4. When the Link Field ends, your team gains continuous HP regeneration.

[Sinister Calling]
Defend the [Dreamscape Telephone] until you defeat all the nightmares.
Points are calculated as follows: Remaining Time × Time Coefficient + [Dreamscape Telephone] Integrity × Integrity Coefficient + Points earned from defeating enemies.
Eliminate all enemies in a wave before the countdown ends to earn extra Time points.

[Terror Reborn]
Eliminate all the deep dream nightmares.
Points are calculated as follows: Remaining Time × Time Coefficient + Points earned from defeating enemies.
Eliminate all enemies in a wave before the countdown ends to earn extra Time points.

[Rewards]
The point challenges are available permanently. Reach milestone goals to earn a variety of rewards.

GuideTutorialPage_33013_Content: In the Tower of Adversity, your skills are put to trial. Complete the specific challenge goals to earn your Crests. Collect enough Crests to earn hefty rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_3301302_Content: The Tower of Adversity features four Zones: <color=#c19f51>Stable Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Experiment Zone</color>, <color=#c19f51>Hazard Zone</color>, and <color=#c19f51>Overdrive Zone.</color> Each Zone contains one to three Towers and each Tower has multiple Floors, each representing a unique challenge. Progress through the challenges to unlock new Towers and Zones. Clearing all challenges in a Zone unlocks the next Zone.
GuideTutorialPage_3301303_Content: In the Tower of Adversity, clearing a challenge reduces participating Resonators' <color=#c19f51>Vigor</color> by a specific amount. Once a Resonator's Vigor is depleted, they can <color=#c19f51>no longer take part in new challenges</color>. Vigor does not restore over time, but you can use the [Reset] option on a Floor to recover the Vigor.
GuideTutorialPage_3301304_Content: In the Tower of Adversity, environmental effects affect your combat tactics. Use them strategically to gain an advantage.
GuideTutorialPage_3301305_Content: Crest Rewards in the Stable Zone, Experiment Zone, and Overdrive Zone can be claimed only once. However, the challenges in the Hazard Zone are <color=#c19f51>periodically reset</color>, along with your progression, bringing in new enemies, challenge goals, Area Effects, and rewards. Take on the challenges again to earn Crests and <color=#c19f51>claim fresh rewards.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_3301306_Content: Complete the challenges and meet their challenge goals to obtain Crests. Collect a certain number of Crests to get various rewards, including Astrites and Hazard Records. Hazard Records can be exchanged for Phantom Echoes, Premium Tuners, and more at the Adversity Exchange.
GuideTutorialPage_34071_Content:
Deal damage to accumulate Sync Energy. When the Link Energy is full, get ready to activate Dream Link.
Successful <color=#ffd12f>Dodges</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color> provide a lot of Sync Energy.
GuideTutorialPage_3407102_Content: When Sync Energy is full, cast any Resonator's Resonance Liberation to enter the Illusive Sync state.
GuideTutorialPage_3407103_Content: The Illusive Sync only lasts 10 seconds. If you don't cast the next Resonator's Resonance Liberation within that time, you'll lose all Sync Energy, and the sync will end.
GuideTutorialPage_3407104_Content:
Casting Resonance Liberation while in Illusive Sync triggers the Dream Link state and activates the Link Field.
When the Link Field is active:
1. All team members' ATK, Crit. Rate, and Crit. DMG are significantly boosted, while Resonance Skill cooldowns are greatly reduced.
2. A Stagnation Zone is generated, immobilizing enemies within the Link Field.
3. Nearby enemies are pulled toward your Resonators upon activation.
4. When the Link Field ends, your team gains continuous HP regeneration.

GuideFocusNew_1332_Content: When Lupa rises up from the ground at the end of <color=#8c7e51>Basic Attack 3</color>, use <color=#8c7e51>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=#8c7e51>Mid-air Attack 1</color>.
GuideFocusNew_1333_Content: When Lupa rises up from the ground at the end of <color=#8c7e51>Basic Attack 3</color>, use <color=#8c7e51>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=#8c7e51>Mid-air Attack 1</color>.
GuideTips_1301_Content: The Enhanced Resonance Skill sends the target into <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color>.
GuideTips_1302_Content: The Enhanced Resonance Skill sends the target into <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color>.
GuideTips_1303_Content: The Enhanced Resonance Skill sends the target into <color=Highlight>Hazy Dream</color>.
GuideTips_1231_Content: After Basic Attack Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to cast Enhanced Heavy Attack and leap into the air.
HelpText_139_Content:
[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra II, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered.

[Combat Rank]
Hitting the enemy steadily improves your Combat Rank, while successful Dodges, Dodge Counters, and Counterattacks provide a greater boost. However, getting hit significantly lowers your Combat Rank.
GuideTips_20298_Content: Hold Dash to enter the Illusive Sprint state after touching the white cat's blessings.
HelpText_148_Content:
[About]

It seems that someone has just updated the mysterious combat simulation program that's going viral on the Huaxu Hive at the Academy...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 40.

[Event Rules]

1. In Pincer Maneuver Warriors, challenge waves of powerful enemies by controlling two teams with special buffs across two separate simulated battlefields.

2. The simulated battlefield offers buffs that either apply to both teams or are exclusive to one team.

3. There are 4 stages with limited enemy waves and 1 stage with infinite waves.

i. In stages with limited enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half of the battle when time runs out or after eliminating all enemies.

ii. In the stage with infinite enemy waves, you can only proceed to the second half when time runs out.

4. Points earned in stages with limited enemy waves include both Time Points and Monster Points, while Points earned in the stage with infinite waves include only Monster Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time left when a challenge is completed.
