HelpText_151_Content:
Team I Buff: Casting Resonance Skill grants the team an extra stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. This effect lasts for 4s.

Defeat the special enemies to gain special buffs.
Special Buff 1: The team's resistance to interruption is significantly enhanced for 30s.
Special Buff 2: The team gains 100 Concerto Energy.
HelpText_152_Content:
Team II Buff: Triggering Impact increases all team members' ATK by 30% for 30s.

Defeat the special enemies to gain special buffs.
Special Buff 1: The team's resistance to interruption is significantly enhanced for 30s.
Special Buff 2: The team gains 100 Concerto Energy.
HelpText_153_Content:
Team I Buff: The team gains 2 extra stacks of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Electro DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Defeat the special enemies to gain special buffs.
Special Buff 1: The team's resistance to interruption is significantly enhanced for 30s.
Special Buff 2: The team gains 100 Concerto Energy.
HelpText_154_Content:
Team II Buff: The team gains an extra stack of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Coordinated Attack DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Defeat the special enemies to gain special buffs.
Special Buff 1: The team's resistance to interruption is significantly enhanced for 30s.
Special Buff 2: The team gains 100 Concerto Energy.
HelpText_155_Content:
[About]
The Fisalia family's heir seems to have a request.
In Thessaleo Fells, a mysterious Terminal is flickering with ominous light. What secrets of the past might it hold?

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 27.

[Trial Store]
Complete the Trial Challenges to earn Astrites and [Trial Coin], which can be exchanged for a variety of rewards in the [Trial Store].

[Tactical Hologram: Phantom Pain] is a permanent activity that can be experienced at any time and will continue to be updated in future versions. Please stay tuned.
HelpText_156_Content: Team I Buff: Casting Resonance Skill grants the team an extra stack of Momentum Mark when hitting a target. This effect lasts for 4s.
HelpText_157_Content: Team II Buff: Triggering Impact increases all team members' ATK by 30% for 30s.
HelpText_158_Content: Team I Buff: The team gains an extra stack of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Electro DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.
HelpText_159_Content: Team II Buff: The team gains an extra stack of Thunder Mark when the active Resonator deals Critical Coordinated Attack DMG to a target. This effect can be triggered once per second.
GuideTutorialPage_32027_Content: Fae Ignis explodes when defeated, damaging nearby targets. This effect won't be triggered if it's defeated <color=#ffd12f>in mid-air</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32028_Content:
Chop Chop: Headless attacks with laser beams, which can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
Successful Counterattacks deal great DMG to Chop Chop: Headless.
GuideTutorialPage_32029_Content: Chest Mimic can be instantly defeated by <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32030_Content: Cuddle Wuddle can team up with Diggy Duggy, Hocus Pocus, or Lottie Lost to perform combo attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_32031_Content:
In defense mode, the Sentry Construct gains high DMG Reduction and slowly restores its Vibration Strength. <color=#ffd12f>Attacking it from behind</color> disables its defense mode.
If attacked while in mid-air, it loses more Vibration Strength and becomes easier to immobilize.
GuideTutorialPage_32032_Content: Lorelei summons special water balls that float toward her. These water balls grant buffs when absorbed by Lorelei or the active Resonator.
GuideTutorialPage_32033_Content: Hecate's whip is an extension of herself and can be blocked with <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacks</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_32034_Content: When Chop Chop: Headless combines with a windmill, their attacks can be Counterattacked using <color=#ffd12f>Questless Knight's Echo Skill</color>, dealing great DMG.
GuideTutorialPage_3203402_Content: Chop Chop: Leftless/Rightless are invulnerable until Chop Chop: Headless is Immobilized.
GuideTutorialPage_33014_Content:
A remnant creature with an intense fixation on music. <color=#ffd12f>When struck</color>, it drops the Melody Box it has collected.
Deliver the Melody Box to Aria Mummer to add the corresponding track to your collection list.
GuideTutorialPage_3301402_Content: A crafted collection of recorded music, which, when given to the Aria Mummer, adds the tracks to their collection list.
GuideTutorialPage_3301403_Content: Visit the Aria Mummer to access the Archive of Melodies feature. Select a track in an album to play. You may set a selected track as the background music around Aria Mummer by enabling <color=#ffd12f>Set As Background Music</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_33015_Content:
You can steer the Gondola using movement controls. Use Dash to speed up.
Hold Exit to exit the steering mode.
GuideTutorialPage_3301502_Content: When steering a Gondola in Single Player mode, you can open the Cruise Share menu by pressing the <color=#ffd12f>Cruise Share button</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3301503_Content: On the Cruise Share menu, Rover can invite <color=#ffd12f>an obtained Resonator</color> to take the Gondola together.
GuideTutorialPage_33016_Content: Check the obtained mask in your Backpack.
GuideTutorialPage_3301602_Content: Select a mask to wear it or take it off.
GuideTutorialPage_33017_Content:
A <color=#ffd12f>beacon</color> you once set for yourself, imbued with the strength and faith to keep moving forward.
<color=#ffd12f>Rover: Spectro</color>'s abilities have been enhanced. Resonance Liberation <color=#ffd12f>Echoing Orchestra</color> and Resonance Skill <color=#ffd12f>Resonating Spin</color> now inflict <color=#ffd12f>Spectro Frazzle Effect</color> on the target while retaining their original effects.
Check the Resonator's Forte interface for more details.
GuideTutorial_34082_GroupName: Plushie Village in the Garden of the Lost
GuideTutorial_34100_GroupName: Dream Patrol: Fae Ignis from Dreamscape
Tutorial_34082_Title: Plushie Village in the Garden of the Lost
Tutorial_3409902_Title: Tacet Discords Attracted to Dreamscape Nexus
GuideTutorialPage_34076_Content: Flying along the Wind Trail allows you to <color=#ffd12f>automatically</color> follow the wind's direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34076_02_Content: Follow the Wind Rings to stay on course. Pass through them to earn challenge points!
GuideTutorialPage_34077_Content:
Across Rinascita, you may stumble upon these fragile containers scattered around. Shatter them to uncover hidden treasures within.

Keep a close eye on those bearing the Montelli family crest, as they contain Monnaies—an old currency that can be redeemed for rewards at Averardo Bank.
GuideTutorialPage_34077_02_Content: Smash the floating containers with the Gondola or your attacks and collect the treasures within!
GuideTutorialPage_34078_Content:
These collapsed morph paintings drain frequencies and energy from their surroundings to maintain their forms, causing the minerals, plants, and even animals nearby to lose their vibrancy and color.
The absorbed colors transform into chaotic color blocks on the Overflowing Palette. <color=#ffd12f>Adjusting all the blocks into a designated color</color> will restore the environment's former vibrancy.
GuideTutorialPage_34078_02_Content: Select a color on the right and apply it to the blocks on the palette to the left. The new color will spread to all connected blocks of the same color.
GuideTutorialPage_34078_03_Content: Different Overflowing Palettes have different move limits. Plan your moves carefully to return the land to its former vibrancy!
GuideTutorialPage_34079_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Nexus</color> stores information on the surrounding area. Activate it to obtain the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Map</color> data.
GuideTutorialPage_34079_02_Content:
After a <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Beacon</color> is activated, you can open the Map and <color=#ffd12f>fast travel</color> to an activated Resonance Beacon.
Head to a Resonance Nexus or Resonance Beacon to <color=#ffd12f>heal</color> injured or downed Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_34080_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Defeat</color> the nearby <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords</color> to ensure the successful activation of the <color=#ffd12f>Sound Emulator</color>. Complete the challenge to receive rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34081_Content:
The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, found throughout the world. It records undistorted memories of the past.
Use Grapple to hook and quickly approach the Sonance Caskets in Ragunna. The Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost are collecting them—perhaps a visit will reveal more.
GuideTutorialPage_34082_Content: A village of Plushie Echoes in the Garden of the Lost. The villagers are gathering Sonance Caskets throughout Ragunna to unlock the Sonoro Sphere within a morph painting.
GuideTutorialPage_34083_Content:
While steering a Gondola, you can use Waterfall Surge to swim up a waterfall.
<color=#ffd12f>(Please note that this function can only be used in safe waters. Protect your Gondolas, and protect yourselves.)</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34084_Content:
A special Gondola that cruises along the most scenic spots in Ragunna City, often called the city sightseeing water bus.
Board the Gondola to relax and enjoy the voyage.
GuideTutorialPage_34085_Content: Aim your Grapple at the Wingray. When the visual cue appears, cast Grapple to link yourself to the Wingray. It will carry you upward.
GuideTutorialPage_34085_02_Content:
The link will automatically break once you reach the highest point.
The Wingray will return to its starting point after a short time.
GuideTutorialPage_34086_Content: Use Utility: <color=#ffd12f>Flight</color> to leap into the air and start flying. Flight is a Utility specific to Jinzhou (including Mt. Firmament), the Black Shores, and Rinascita regions. Available only while out of combat.
GuideTutorialPage_34086_02_Content:
When in Flight, use movement keys (or the control stick) to ascend or dive.
As you dive, you gain momentum for the Echo Wings, allowing you to ascend higher.
Try diving to restore momentum when it depletes.
GuideTutorialPage_34086_03_Content:
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Ultra Flight button to activate <color=#ffd12f>Ultra Flight</color>.
This mode allows you to defy gravity completely but consumes <color=#ffd12f>more STA</color>.
Compared to level flights, your STA consumption rate increases when ascending and reduces when descending.
GuideTutorialPage_34086_04_Content: Boost Unit: Flight is a reward for <color=#ffd12f>Exploration Progress</color>. It increases <color=#ffd12f>max STA</color> while Flying.
GuideTutorialPage_34086_05_Content: The settings menu offers an option to invert ascending and diving input, allowing you to customize controls to your preferences for smoother experience!
GuideTutorialPage_34087_Content: Once the challenge begins, follow the ground cues to avoid the Vitreum Dancers dashing toward you.
GuideTutorialPage_34088_Content:
When you reach a Leap Spot, using Utility will activate Echo transformation automatically. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and jump.
Aim your camera to the next Leap Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to leap again.
GuideTutorialPage_34089_Content:
When you reach a Climbing Spot, the Utility will automatically become Echo transformation. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle for the climbing challenge.
Aim your camera toward the next Climbing Spot and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Utility button to climb again.
GuideTutorialPage_34089_02_Content: Reach the final Climbing Spot to perform the Leap for the Top!
GuideTutorialPage_34090_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and smash the Seamrock. Ready to throw this Plushie Punch!
GuideTutorialPage_34090_02_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the button while the pointer is in the highlighted section to speed up the progress. The rock will break once the progress bar is full.
GuideTutorialPage_34090_03_Content: When the pointer enters the orange zone, activate Powerful Punch mode. Rapidly {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the left and right buttons to speed up the smashing.
GuideTutorialPage_34091_Content: Press the Utility button to transform into a Cuddle Wuddle and break the Friable Rock with a single punch!
GuideTutorialPage_34092_Content:
Ordinary Nightmare Clouds can be absorbed into Lottie Lost's picture book, transforming them into beautiful paintings.
Absorb Nightmare Clouds to earn rewards!
GuideTutorialPage_34092_02_Content:
Nightmare Clouds of ghostly flames. 

Observe the number of flames and absorb Nightmare Clouds <color=#ffd12f>in the correct order</color>. Absorbing them in the wrong order will reset the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_34092_03_Content:
Nightmare Clouds that keep multiplying.
 
Lottie Lost must use the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color> and <color=#ffd12f>Hold</color> the Enhanced Absorption button to <color=#ffd12f>absorb</color> and eliminate all Nightmare Clouds at once.
GuideTutorialPage_34093_Content:
Lottie Lost draws power from the stories in the <color=#ffd12f>Finished Book</color>, enhancing her ability to absorb Nightmare Clouds.
 
<color=#ffd12f>Hold the Enhanced Absorption button</color> to absorb all Nightmare Clouds within her radius.
 
The Enhanced Absorption state lasts for a limited time and can be refreshed by reading the Finished Book again.
GuideTutorialPage_34094_Content: Lottie Lost can resonate with the Unfinished Book, sensing the trail of its lost pages.
GuideTutorialPage_34094_02_Content:
Guide Lottie Lost to collect the lost pages by following the sensed trail as closely as possible.
Once all the pages are collected, the Unfinished Book will be fully restored.
GuideTutorialPage_34095_Content: Stand right before the monument base, then use Grapple to pull the misplaced monument back to its base to restore the monument.
GuideTutorialPage_34095_02_Content: Restore all the monuments, and you might uncover something unexpected!
GuideTutorialPage_34096_Content:
Approach the base and interact with the flickering point to read the <color=#ffd12f>inscription</color>.
Find the painting mentioned in the text and use Levitator to place it on the <color=#ffd12f>matching base.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34097_Content:
Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain.

Clear the Dreamscape Tacet Discords and meet all <color=#ffd12f>challenge goals</color> to link the Node to Somnoire. You can interact with the node's core to retry challenges as many times as needed.
GuideTutorialPage_34098_Content: Some special Dreamscape Nodes feature <color=#ffd12f>enhanced</color> Nightmare Tacet Discords.
GuideTutorialPage_3409802_Content: To complete the challenge, <color=#ffd12f>meet all challenge goals within the time limit</color> or defeat the Nightmare Tacet Discords directly.
GuideTutorialPage_34099_Content: The Dreamscape Nexus serves as a central point for transmitting frequencies and dreams to Somnoire. Protect it from being destroyed within the time limit. Each defeated wave of enemies <color=#ffd12f>reduces the remaining defense time.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_3409902_Content: Beware of Nightmare Tacet Discords in some waves, which can <color=#ffd12f>deal greater DMG</color> on the Dreamscape Nexus.
GuideTutorialPage_34100_Content: Fae Ignis from the Dreamscape doesn't die when its charge is interrupted. However, when defeated, it will always explode and release fireballs at a faster rate.
GuideTutorialPage_34101_Content: Cuddle Wuddle enters a prep phase of synergy when its HP drops below 80%. During this time, you can interrupt the synergy by dealing DMG equal to 20% of Cuddle Wuddle's max HP or defeating the other Plushies Echoes.
GuideTutorialPage_34101_02_Content: Once Cuddle Wuddle enters the synergy with other plushies, they will launch Coordinated Attacks. However, if Cuddle Wuddle's <color=#ffd12f>HP drops below 30%</color>, the synergy will end, and Cuddle Wuddle will be paralyzed.
GuideTutorialPage_34102_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Counterattacking</color> the Vitreum Dancer's strikes can break its weapon, which makes the Vitreum Dancer enter an Enraged state and become even more powerful.
GuideTutorialPage_34103_Content: Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights, and Nocturnus Knights can enhance their weapons, indicated by a glowing effect. Counterattack them three times to remove the enhancement, or they will continue to enhance their weapons repeatedly.
GuideTutorialPage_34104_Content: Face the Nightmare Clouds and use Utility to transform into a Lottie Lost. <color=#ffd12f>Hold the button</color> to absorb the Nightmare Clouds with her picture book!
GuideTutorialPage_34105_Content: When the Roseshroom charges for shooting a laser, shoot the core at its head to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_34106_Content: Select a piece to preview its landing point, then select the point to move the piece.
GuideTutorialPage_34106_02_Content: When a black piece lands on the outer circle, it <color=#ffd12f>opens all gates and maze walls in that direction.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34106_03_Content: You can pause the game at any time, and <color=#ffd12f>all pieces will stay in place.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34106_04_Content: Press the <color=#ffd12f>Reset button</color> to restart the game.
GuideTutorialPage_34106_05_Content:
The game ends when either side's pieces form a straight line.
<color=#ffd12f>If black pieces connect, you win</color>; if white pieces connect, the Lifer wins.
GuideTutorialPage_34107_Content: Use <color=#ffd12f>Sensor</color> to locate the Terminals granting buffs to the Lifer.
GuideTutorialPage_34107_02_Content: Submit a <color=#ffd12f>Stake of Imbalance</color> at a Terminal to remove the buffs.
GuideTutorialPage_34107_03_Content: After submitting the Stakes, you can freely <color=#ffd12f>turn The Lifer's buffs on or off</color> through the Terminal.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_Content:
Each of the three altars is connected to the Discipline Steles around it.
Stand on the altar platform to charge the steles, but <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords will appear</color> to disrupt the effort.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_02_Content: <color=#ffd12f>When only the player is within the altar's range</color>, the steles charge most efficiently.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_03_Content: <color=#ffd12f>When there are Tacet Discords within the altar's range</color>, the steles stop charging.
GuideTutorialPage_34108_04_Content: <color=#ffd12f>When the player is out of the alter's range,</color> the steles stop charging, and the energy begins to drain.
GuideTutorialPage_34109_Content: In the dark area not illuminated by the Macabre Torch, Tacet Discords are enhanced, entering the Shadow state that makes them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all attacks.</color>
GuideTutorialPage_34109_02_Content: The Macabre Torch's light can dispel the Shadow state of Tacet Discords, making them vulnerable again.
GuideTutorialPage_34109_03_Content: There are certain enemies who will try to extinguish the nearby Macabre Torch after taking specific amounts of damage.
GuideTutorialPage_34110_Content: Use Levitator to collect the stained glass pieces.
GuideTutorialPage_3411002_Content:
Place the collected pieces onto the missing parts of the stained glass.
A <color=#ffd12f>golden glow</color> will appear if the piece fits correctly.
A <color=#ffd12f>red glow</color> will appear if the piece doesn't fit.
GuideTutorialPage_34111_Content:
Go through the Tacet Mark protruding from the ground to enter the Tacet Field in another dimension.

After clearing the Tacet Field, you can consume Waveplates to obtain various Echo development materials and collected Echoes of the corresponding Sonata set.
GuideTutorialPage_34112_Content: Surveillance cameras are used to scan for suspicious activities. Staying within their view increases Alertness.
GuideTutorialPage_34114_Content: Vitreum Dancers patrol the Vault, charging at intruders and dealing DMG on impact.
GuideTutorialPage_34115_Content: Scatter Prisms greatly enhance Carlotta's Forte. Shooting them with the "jewelry set" disables the surveillance cameras and Vitreum Dancers within a large area permanently.
GuideTutorialPage_34116_Content: Alertness indicates how alert the Vault's security system is to your actions. It increases when you are detected by Vitreum Dancers, spotted by surveillance cameras, or engage in combat. You can lower it by disabling security systems or defeating enemies. If Alertness reaches 100, you will be forced to retreat and restart from the previous area.
GuideTutorialPage_34117_Content: Defense Lasers block certain pathways and deal DMG to anyone who touches them.
GuideTutorialPage_35001_Content: Immune to interruption when HP is above 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35002_Content: RES to all Attribute DMG is increased by 200%.
GuideTutorialPage_35003_Content: When hit by a Counterattack, Vibration Strength Reduction is increased by 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35006_Content: Damage dealt by allies within the range is increased by 100%.
GuideTutorialPage_35007_Content: ATK is increased by 100% every 20s. This effect can stack unlimited times.
GuideTutorialPage_35008_Content: Immobilized state duration is reduced by 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35009_Content: Explode upon being defeated, dealing DMG equal to 100% of their ATK.
GuideTutorialPage_35010_Content: After taking no DMG for 2s, restore 10% of their Max HP every second. This effect resets upon taking DMG.
GuideTutorialPage_35011_Content: Dealing DMG increases ATK by 20%, stacking up to 4 times. All stacks will be removed if they don't deal any DMG in 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35012_Content: Knock back nearby enemies when taking DMG equal to or greater than 25% of their Max HP in 1s, dealing DMG equal to 100% of their ATK.
GuideTutorialPage_35015_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35016_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Electro Flare on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35017_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35018_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Fusion Burst on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35019_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Spectro Frazzle on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35020_Content: Dealing DMG inflicts 1 stack of Havoc Bane on the target. This effect can be triggered once every 6s.
GuideTutorialPage_35021_Content: This type of enemy has much higher HP and ATK. Dodge Counter and Counterattack can additionally decrease their Vibration Strength and HP.
GuideTutorialPage_35023_Content: Restore 20% HP for nearby allies upon being defeated.
GuideTutorialPage_35024_Content: Deal Fusion DMG equal to 2% of the target's Max HP per second to the nearby enemies. This effect does not stack.
GuideTutorialPage_35025_Content: Immune to Electro DMG when HP is below 50%.
GuideTutorialPage_35026_Content: Receive 100% more damage when inflicted with Spectro Frazzle.
GuideTutorialPage_35027_Content: Increase nearby allies' ATK by 60% for 15s upon being defeated.
GuideTutorialPage_35029_Content: Receiving DMG increases DMG dealt by 10% for 8s, stacking up to 10 times.

HelpText_174_Title: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men
HelpText_174_Content:
[About]

John Wicktorio, a retired Acolyte and accountant of the Order, found his cherished Echo brutally killed by some thugs.
Determined to settle the scores and avenge his old pal, he's stepping back into the game to make the culprits pay.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and unlock the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City during the Main Quest: "The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes."

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you will enter a special sphere to battle waves of enemies within a set time limit, with the aid of unique buffs.

2. You will collect Coins by dealing damage to enemies, but taking damage will cause you to lose Coins.

3. Progressing through enemy waves unlocks more special buffs to give you the support you need.

4. The Coins you have collected by the end of the countdown will be your Coins record of this stage.

5. Defeating each enemy wave grants additional time.
HelpText_180_Content:
[About]
O Rover guided by the tides, you have banished the shadows of war in Jinzhou and crossed the boundaries of time on Mt. Firmament. When you stood upon the secluded shores, did you hear the gospel carried on the tempest winds, echoing across the Stormy Sea? Did you glimpse the unparalleled splendor that lies within the fabled land of the Echoes? Now, steel your heart and embark on a journey into the unknown, brave the storm, and carve a path to Rinascita.

[Eligibility]
Go to the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou and unlock the Terminal during Main Quest "First Resonance."

[Event Rules]
Main Quest Chapter II is now available, eligible players can now experience this Chapter early.
After accepting this Quest, all Main Quests can be experienced non-exclusively.
Early access to Chapter II also unlocks Time Adjustment, Resonance Conversion functions, as well as some Utilities.
HelpText_181_Content:
[Event Rules]
During the event, you can use trial Resonators in special outfits to repeatedly challenge specific stages. 

The trial Resonators are at fixed levels and equipped with preselected sets of weapons and Echoes. In the trial stages, team composition and the sets of weapons and Echoes cannot be changed.

[Event Rewards]
After completing the event stages, you can claim stage rewards on the event page.
Each stage rewards can be claimed once only.
After the event concludes, rewards for cleared stages will be distributed via mail.
HelpText_182_Content:
[Outfit]
Outfits are alternative appearances for playable Resonators.

[Notes]
Some Outfits include special Weapon Projections that can change the weapon's appearance.

Some Outfits can be purchased at a special offer when on sale. Outfits on special offer revert to their original price after the sale.

Each unique Outfit is purchasable once. Please ensure that you own the Resonator before purchasing their Outfit. You may purchase an Outfit without owning the corresponding Resonator, in which case the Outfit becomes usable once you own the Resonator for that Outfit.
HelpText_173_Content:
[About]
After braving the perilous sea mists and tumultuous waves, you've finally arrived in Rinascita, the Land of Echoes.
Radiant lights stretch across the horizon, while cheerful melodies echo through the bays and blooms.
The Carnevale is around the corner. May your journey be one to remember.
This is a Permanent Event. Complete event quests to earn rewards.

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock

[Event Rules]
Complete event tasks to earn Stamps, which can be used to increase your Event Level. Advancing to higher levels unlocks rich rewards and the Amidst the Sea of Clouds challenges.
Please note that some event quests are unavailable in Co-op Mode, and the quest-tracking feature may be disabled in certain game scenarios.
HelpText_183_Content:
[About]

Maji, your good old friend, is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan." As always, your support is greatly appreciated. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
HelpText_184_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Event Rules]
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim daily sign-in rewards. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time.
After the event ends, any unclaimed sign-in rewards you earned will be reissued via in-game mail within 30 days upon your next login.

[About]

Beside a mysterious morph painting, you find a painter named Claudia, trapped in her nightmares. 
Claudia asks you to investigate the world within the painting and gives you a protective talisman.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22, unlock Co-op mode, and unlock the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City during Main Quest "The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes."

[Event Rules]

Claudia asks you to investigate the world within the painting and gives you a protective talisman. Within the painted world, the talisman transforms into various Echoes to assist you.
Clear all enemies in the investigation area to advance. The Echoes transformed by the talisman will boost your Resonators' power as you progress.
Clearing enemies before the countdown ends earns extra points. Reach the required stage points for Stage Rewards and the required total points for Point Rewards. The Match feature is available for all challenges, allowing you to team up with other players.

※Only specified Echoes can be equipped in this event. The Echo will replace your main Echo Skill, but activated Sonatas remain effective.

HelpText_193_Content:
1. After unlocking Fishing Ability: Wonder Bubble, you can purchase Wonder Bubbles of the area from Planck, the dock merchant. Upon purchase, a Wonder Bubble will be automatically generated near the current dock, gradually catching crabs and urchins in the area.

2. The Wonder Bubble has a limited capacity. Once full, it will stop catching fish. Please claim your catches in time.

3. Steer Rachel to the Wonder Bubble and interact with it to claim your catches.

4. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Wonder Bubble's capacity and improve the quality of the catches.
HelpText_194_Content:
1. After unlocking Trawl, it will be automatically equipped to Rachel and help you catch previously fished species in the area.

2. The Trawl has a limited capacity. Once full, it will stop catching fish. Please claim your catches in time.

3. The Trawl can only be accessed at the Dock interface, where you can manage your catches from the Trawl.

4. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Trawl's capacity and improve the quality of the catches.
HelpText_195_Content:
1. After unlocking Quick Sale, a dashed Quick Sale area will be automatically generated in the Cargo every time you open the Dock interface. Place your catches within this area during sailing for Quick Sale.

2. When the Quick Sale area is fully occupied, you can immediately sell all catches within or partially occupying the area.

3. Catches sold through Quick Sale fetch higher prices compared to dock sales.

4. Quick Sale is only available during sailing.
HelpText_196_Content:
1. You can store your catches in Rachel's Cargo.

2. The Cargo has a limited capacity. Catches exceeding this limit cannot be stored, and stacking is not allowed.

3. Enhance your Fishing Abilities to increase the Cargo's capacity.

4. While storing catches, you can Place, Rotate, Discard, or Return them as needed.

5. Upon reaching the dock, Coast Flax, Palm Tree Log, Metal Debris, and Bampuff will be automatically converted into regular items.
HelpText_197_Content:
1. Deliver the required fish based on the profile provided. Only normal species can be delivered—mutants are excluded.

2. To complete a delivery, place the fish onto the corresponding profile and rotate it until the shape and angle align perfectly.

3. If multiple deliveries are required, you can submit some required species and complete the remaining deliveries in future attempts.
HelpText_198_Content:
[Recommended Attributes]

On the Echo Selection page, use "Suggest" to open the filter. This allows you to check the most commonly used Mainstats and Substats for the current Resonator and quickly filter out suitable Echoes.

While switching between "All," "COST 1," "COST 3," and "COST 4" Echoes on the Echo List on the left, the recommended attributes will adjust accordingly.

[Recommended Sonata Effects]

On the Resonator - Echo page, use "Suggest" to check the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator.

Use "Auto Equip" to equip all Echoes that best match the selected Sonata Effect.

On the Sonata Selection and Sonata Gallery pages, the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator will be marked with a thumb-up icon.


[Data Updates]

The recommendations are based on data collected from recently active players and refresh every Wednesday at 00:00 (server time). Actual refresh may experience some delay.

If there is not enough data, default recommendations generated by the system will be displayed instead.
HelpText_199_Content:
Echo Presets allow you to easily save and apply customized Echo lineups for your Resonator.

[Saving Presets]

Select the "Current Setup" column and use "Save As Preset" to save the equipped Echo lineup for the Resonator.

Each preset can be named to your liking. Please ensure the names follow local laws and regulations.

You can save up to 20 Echo Presets. If you reach the limit, you will need to delete an existing preset to create a new one.

[Applying Presets]

Select any saved preset and use "Apply" to equip the preset to the current Resonator.
HelpText_200_Content: [Event Rules] The Pioneer Association has picked the Nimbus Sanctum as the theme for an upcoming edition of Wutherium Geographic. To that end, the association has organized a special survey of the Nimbus Sanctum. Complete Survey Tasks and accumulate Survey Points to secure valuable rewards offered by the Pioneer Association. [Task Reset] Survey Tasks reset daily at 04:00. Upon reset, any unclaimed Survey Points will be automatically claimed, and uncompleted tasks will expire. If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
HelpText_190_Content:
[About]

The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock.

[Event Rules]

1. In Tactical Simulacra III, challenge waves of powerful enemies by using special buffs across different simulation domains.

2. As you complete more challenges, more special buffs will be unlocked to aid you in taking on subsequent challenges. Use different buffs to defeat enemies to complete the challenge objectives in Bonus Challenge and obtain additional rewards.

3. The results of each challenge consist of three parts: Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.

i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.

ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining when a challenge is completed. The more enemies that are defeated, the higher the point conversion factor.

iii. Technical Points are earned for each successful Counterattack and Dodge triggered.

[Combat Rank]

Hitting the enemy steadily improves your Combat Rank. Defeating enemies provides a significant boost.

GuideTutorialPage_32035_Content: This Tacet Discord enters a defensive state when its Vibration Strength is low. Attack it by then to <color=#ffd12f>Break its hand defense</color> and <color=#ffd12f>immobilize</color> it.
GuideTutorialPage_32036_Content:
The Aero Prism is immune to <color=#ffd12f>Aero</color> DMG.

It targets a nearby ally, granting itself a constant buff that enables it to keep attacking. Once the selected target is defeated, the Aero Prism ceases attacking.

The Aero Prism can be absorbed by Cyan-Feathered Herons and Violet-Feathered Herons, providing a permanent buff for the Herons after the absorption.
GuideTutorialPage_33020_Content:
Familiar gateways are appearing throughout Rinascita. Interact with these gateways to enter the Somnoire.

Venture into the gateway and help restore the corrupted Memory Zones!
GuideTutorialPage_33021_Content:
Interact with the Fishing Spot to fish.

Some Fishing Spots require specific Fishing Abilities. Acquire the corresponding Fishing Abilities to gain access to these spots.
GuideTutorialPage_33022_Content:
Various frequencies gather beneath the waters of the Riccioli Islands. Ghost Medusas appear at night.

As you sail and fish, your Threat Level to these waters increases. Higher Threat Level attracts fiercer Ghost Medusas.

However, on a high Threat Level, <color=#ffd12f>catch quality</color> will be higher, and the chance to catch <color=#ffd12f>Mutants</color> will increase.
GuideTutorialPage_33023_Content:
You may switch between Fishing Abilities on your voyage with the wheel.

Using this feature wisely makes your fishing trips more efficient and rewarding.
GuideTutorialPage_33024_Content:
Under the influence of the Sentinel or the Threnodian, mutants can be found among the many species in the sea.

Mutants can always be found at the Fishing Spots of their original species.

Enhancing Phoebe's Fishing Abilities or fishing in the areas where Ghost Medusas appear at night can increase the chance of catching Mutants.
GuideTutorialPage_33025_Content:
To catch the "biggest fish," you'll need a bigger ship. Captain Ahab has just one, but it really needs some repairs.

Provide Queequeg with a design print, logs, and Fishery Coins, and he'll handle the rest for you.
GuideTutorialPage_34120_Content: Board the train Echo and steer it along the tracks.
GuideTutorialPage_3412002_Content:
Use the Clearance Device to <color=#ffd12f>shoot the target mechanisms</color>. This will change their status, allowing you to turn cameras on and off, switch track directions, and control security mechanisms within the vault.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

Board and steer the Echo Train, choose its path, and control mechanisms along the way.
GuideTutorialPage_3412003_Content:
Some tracks within Averardo Vault are under maintenance. Use the switches to ensure the train stays on <color=#ffd12f>tracks that allow passage</color>.

If the train is on the wrong track, it will automatically return.
GuideTutorialPage_34121_Content: A device designed to switch train tracks. The displayed direction on the device shows the current track the train is following. Use the Clearance Device to change the track direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34122_Content: A Clearance Device specially prepared by Carlotta, granting you the highest level of access within Averardo Vault. Verify your clearance at designated security rooms in the vault to increase your Clearance Level and unlock additional functions.
GuideTutorialPage_3412202_Content:
Use the Clearance Device to <color=#ffd12f>shoot the target mechanisms</color>. This will change their status, allowing you to turn cameras on and off, switch track directions, and control security mechanisms within the vault.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

You can control various mechanisms within the vault with this device.
GuideTutorialPage_34123_Content:
Use the Clearance Device to turn the hostile security Echoes in the vault into allies. In this state, they will prioritize the safety of the clearance holder above all else.
 
If an allied Echo is too far from the Clearance Device or the Clearance Device is not equipped, it will revert to its hostile state.
 
*Controllable Echoes are marked by a golden aura.
GuideTutorialPage_3412302_Content:
The Clearance Device can only control a limited number of Echoes. Once this limit is reached, you won't be able to control any additional Echoes.

Upgrade your Clearance Level to increase the number of Echoes you can control simultaneously.

*Controllable Echoes are marked by a golden aura.
GuideTutorialPage_34124_Content: Interact with the mechanisms in the security rooms to upgrade your Clearance Level and unlock more functions.
GuideTutorialPage_3412402_Content:
Upgrade your Clearance Level to unlock more functions.

Clearance Command - Security Mechanism: Upgrade your Clearance Level to gain access to a broader range of security mechanisms.


Authorization Command - Echo Control:

Level 1: Converts the target to your ally, making it prioritize the safety of the clearance holder above all else. However, this effect will be revoked and the Echo will return to its default state if a friendly Echo is not within the effective range of the Clearance Device or when the Clearance Device is not equipped as Utility.

Level 2: The controlled Echoes will actively attract enemies' attacks.

Level 3: The number of Echoes you can control is increased to 2.
GuideTutorialPage_34125_Content: You can use the Clearance Device to control the movements of the silenced Vitreum Dancers.
GuideTutorialPage_3412502_Content:
Due to limited functionality, the Vitreum Dancer can only perform straight-line dashes in four directions. 

Keep it within the camera's authentication range to unlock security doors.
GuideTutorialPage_34126_Content: The <color=#ffd12f>hilt platform</color> of the Statue of Divine Justice radiates strong Remnant Energy. Before proceeding, adjust your gravity direction to be <color=#ffd12f>perpendicular to the platform</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_34127_Content: Casting a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> above the hilt platform will cause the Statue of Divine Justice to descend, triggering a section of the ruin to move.

HelpText_204_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Phoebe, Jinhsi, Shorekeeper, Verina. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!

Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain 30% Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack grants 20 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second. Casting Resonance Skill grants 50 Dreamscape Energy, and healing a Resonator with Resonance Skill grants another 50 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Damaging a target affected by Spectro Frazzle grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%.  Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

HelpText_219_Content:
[About]

To the north of Ragunna City lies Rinascita's largest fishing ground: the Riccioli Islands, an enticing destination for an intriguing adventure. Ready your sails and prepare for the vast blue waters, Captain!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and complete the Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock (complete quest "Silent as a Falling Leaf" for the best experience).

[Event Rules]

During the event, join Phoebe on a captivating voyage in the Riccioli Islands. Steer the Gondola "Rachel" and fish for unique, local species to boost your Fame and become a true fishing master!

Throughout the limited-time reward period, complete special goals to earn Nameless Coins. Collect enough Nameless Coins to claim the Rectifier "Ocean's Gift" (including its weapon projection).

Nameless Coins can be used to redeem rewards at the limited-time event shop. Please make sure to claim your rewards before the event concludes.

Any unclaimed rewards will be automatically sent to your mailbox if you log in within 30 days after the reward period. However, unredeemed rewards will not be delivered to your mailbox.

After the limited-time reward period, you can still participate in the event and claim the Chanty Bounty standard rewards.

HelpText_225_Title: About Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways
HelpText_225_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm.
- The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Divined Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more rewards from the Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.
HelpText_226_Content:
Fishing Spot Rules:

1. There are two types of Fishing Spots: Sea Life Fishing Spots and Material Fishing Spots, each offering different resources.

2. Each Fishing Spot requires a specific Fishing Ability to access. Check the Fishing Abilities page for details.

3. Each Fishing Spot has a limited number of catches. When depleted, the spot will disappear and automatically generate after a certain period, possibly at a different location.

Fishing Rules:

1. When the harpoon lands within a glowing area, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} the button to accelerate the Fishing Progress. Brighter areas grant greater acceleration.

2. Once the Fishing Progress reaches 100%, 1 Fishing Attempt will be consumed, and you will have a chance to catch the target.

3. When all Fishing Attempts are used up, no further fishing can be done, and you will proceed to handle the storage for the harvest.

4. During fishing, you can access the Cargo page to manage your catches. Doing so will interrupt the current fishing attempt.

[About]
Beneath the iceberg of thought's deepest layers, all dreams are interconnected. Those neglected in the deep sea accumulate over time, merging and entangling in the abyss.

HelpText_233_Content:
[About]

Maji, a manager at Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, decides to launch a new Lollo Campaign. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps, a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.

Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 rounds of Inventory for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.

HelpText_234_Content:
[About]
KU-Ryan, a Black Shores robot, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on Waveworn Phenomena in Ragunna. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue.
 
[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different regions. You can participate in any activated challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. When all the datasets have been collected or when time runs out, you will receive rewards based on points obtained.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your mailbox when you log in again within 30 days.
HelpText_235_Title: New event "If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams" is now available!
HelpText_235_Content:
[About]
A girl called Dorothy appears next to a mysterious gate. She claims a sudden crisis is taking place inside.
 
[Eligbility]
Reach Union Level 22.
 
[Event Rules]
1. In this challenge, you can choose "Dorothy's Companions" as Echoes to assist you in battle, which greatly enhances the combat abilities of Resonators.
2. Downed Resonators will be automatically revived after a while. 
3. You can complete the task with your Friends.
4. You can only use designated Echoes in this mode (Sonatas will remain effective and only the main Echo Skill will be replaced).
5. Point Calculation: Clearance Points + (Remaining Time x Time Coefficient).
The Total Points will be the sum of the highest points achieved in regular levels. (Points will not be awarded for challenge levels).
HelpText_237_Content:
[About]
The Black Shores has developed a special training program that can simulate dangerous trials in Solaris by using Tethys system data. The program is a good measure of the challenger's combat capabilities under adverse conditions.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.
 
[Crisis Trials]
As a member of the Black Shores, take on trials under a selection of Stress Modules.
Select a Stress Level for each trial. The Stress Level must meet the requirements to complete the trial.
Each trial has a default Stress Module. Support Modules are available to lower the trial's difficulty.
After completing a Crisis Trial, the corresponding Disaster Trial along with its Stress Module and Support Module will be unlocked.
 
[Disaster Trials]
To gather additional combat data and improve the Black Shores's crisis response plans, this training program also includes a Hard Mode.
As a member of the Black Shores, you will face <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> with various Stress Module combinations.
Disaster Trials have no required Stress Level. Data samples are gathered from participants pushing their limits.
Participating in a Disaster Trial will consume Support Modules, so select them carefully in advance.
Certain high-difficulty Stress Modules can only be unlocked after clearing a Disaster Trial.
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>
 
[Revival Mechanism]
If a participant is downed in a trial, they can consume Stress Levels to revive. This also gives a corresponding buff.
Please note that consuming Stress Levels will affect the completion and final result of Challenge Goals.

[Matrix Crystals]
Obtain Matrix Crystals by completing Challenge Goals in the Crisis and Disaster Trials. Matrix Crystals can be exchanged for rewards at the Supply Station. Completing certain Stress Level challenges in Disaster Trials will grant an <color=#c89a45>event-exclusive Title reward</color>.
<color=#c89a45>The Supply Station closes when this event ends. All remaining Matrix Crystals will expire and will not be reserved after the event ends. Please exchange your Matrix Crystals in time.</color>
HelpText_238_Content:
[About]
Suspended in the sky, Avinoleum Theological Seminary has become a shattered reflection of a glorious bygone era in Ragunna.
Step into this forsaken and forbidden land to search for the truth behind faith.
Obtain abundant rewards after completing this event.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at Avinoleum Theological Seminary in Main Quest Chapter II Act III "The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier."

[Event Rules]
This event is divided into three stages, unlocking as you progress in the Main Quest.
Complete the Event Quests to obtain abundant rewards.
Unclaimed rewards will remain available for 30 days after the event ends and will be sent via Mail when you log in during this period.

Please note, some quests in this event cannot be completed in Co-op Mode, and Quest Tracking is unavailable in certain areas of the game.

Certain stages support progress saving when you quit mid-challenge. Upon re-entering the stage, you can choose to continue from your last save or start over.

3. You can save up to 10 challenge progress at a time. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest save will be overwritten.
4. If a Rover gender change is made, all mid-challenge saves will be lost.

GuideTutorialPage_34148_Content:
Attack the Sequence Mechanism continuously to fully charge it and unlock certain mechanisms and entrances. 

The charging progress is shown as the <color=yellow>highlighted portion</color>. The charge will begin to drop if you stop attacking.
GuideTutorialPage_34149_Content: Turn the Messenger Statue to the correct direction to activate the mechanism. Different mechanisms require you to turn the Statue in different ways and different directions. Look for nearby <color=yellow>hints</color> to solve the puzzle.
GuideTutorialPage_34150_Content: Strong airstreams flow through the activated ventilation tunnel. Follow Zani and stay within the <color=yellow>protection zone</color> created by her shield. Otherwise, you may be blown off course.
GuideTutorialPage_34151_Content:
Activate the drain on the spiral column to release water from the tunnel and create a new passage. 

Adjust the spiral column to control the water level.
GuideTutorialPage_35032_Content: At the beginning of the challenge, gain a shield equal to 20% of your Max HP. After not taking any DMG for 3s, gain a shield equal to 20% of your Max HP.
GuideTutorialPage_35033_Content: Hitting the target increases your ATK by 20%, up to a max of 80%.
GuideTutorialPage_35034_Content: Every 5s, provide a shield to all friendly units within 15 meters.
GuideTutorialPage_35035_Content: ATK is increased by 30% for 5s when friendly units are within 15 meters of you.
GuideTutorialPage_36001_Content: Complete Training Tasks to obtain Magic Dice and move your Cube forward. Roll the Magic Dice and watch your Cube advance based on the roll.
GuideTutorialPage_3600102_Content: As your Cube moves forward, it will collect rewards from all the pads it passes.
GuideTutorialPage_3600103_Content: In each round of the race, you'll encounter Resonator Cubes. Meet them to activate their special Cube Bonus!
GuideTutorialPage_3600104_Content: After each round of the Race, you'll see a Summary where you can view the Cubes met, the rewards earned, and other Race data. Close the Summary to move on to the next round!
GuideTutorialPage_36002_Content:
Conquer Abbowser Castle with your Cube companions to free the other trapped Cubes.

Utilize the resources in Abbowser Castle to level up your Cubes until you're ready to defeat Abbowser.

Gather all your Cubes and host the Ceremony together.
GuideTutorialPage_3600202_Content:
Your rescued Cube companions from Abbowser Castle will help with Ceremony preparations.

As the preparation progresses, the Anniversary Cake will change in stages.

Freed Cubes will stick around in the Cube World. Maybe they'll have a story to share?
GuideTutorialPage_3600203_Content:
Cube companions will fight alongside your Resonators in Abbowser Castle. 

Use Echo Skills to make your Cubes cast <color=#ffd12f>powerful attacks</color>.

Some Cubes can even cast themselves to form Combos with Resonators or other Cubes.
GuideTutorialPage_36003_Content: Defeated Elite or Boss enemies may drop Data Modules.
GuideTutorialPage_3600302_Content:
Cubes can be equipped with Data Modules to gain extra powers in battle.

Data Modules come in many types. Be sure to <color=#ffd12f>equip them to the corresponding slot</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3600303_Content: Extra Data Modules can be <color=#ffd12f>decompiled</color> and recycled into upgrade materials.
GuideTutorialPage_36004_Content: Leveling up Cubes <color=#ffd12f>unlocks</color> more of their Data Module <color=#ffd12f>slots</color>, allowing them to be equipped with more Data Modules.
GuideTutorialPage_3600402_Content:
There are 3 types of Data Modules for your Cubes. 

Aside from Abbowser Castle, Abbowser's Shop also has powerful Data Modules. To shop there, collect the coins obtained by conquering Abbowser Castle.
GuideTutorialPage_36005_Content:
Equip Ability Modules to give your Cubes the Abilities of other Cubes. 
An Ability Module <color=#ffd12f>cannot be equipped</color> if the Cube already has <color=#ffd12f>that same ability</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_36006_Content: A Cube's final slot is unlocked when it reaches Level 10. Equip an Awakening Module to this final slot to completely change the Cube's Ability.
GuideTutorialPage_36007_Content: Players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> a <color=#ffd12f>Cube</color> by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the match <color=#ffd12f>Winner</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3600702_Content: Each day from 8:00 to 19:30, players can support their favorite Cube by predicting that it will be the match winner. Each day, the match starts at 20:00, and the match winner will be decided on the same day.
GuideTutorialPage_3600703_Content:
During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.

Cubes on the same pad <color=#ffd12f>stack</color>. When the bottom Cube moves, it will <color=#ffd12f>carry along</color> all Cubes stacked above it.

During a round, <color=#ffd12f>there is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Ability</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3600704_Content:
In each match, the <color=#ffd12f>No. 1 Ranked</color> Cube wins. Players who <color=#ffd12f>supported</color> the winning Cube will <color=#ffd12f>receive</color> Popularity Rewards.

The Popularity Rewards are determined by the Popularity consumed in Support, and the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color>. These odds <color=#ffd12f>refresh regularly</color> based on how much Support the Cube receives.
GuideTutorialPage_3600705_Content: Each match is split into the 1st Half and 2nd Half. The rankings in the 2nd Half will determine whether a Cube <color=#ffd12f>advances</color> to the next match.
HelpText_267_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Zani, Jinhsi, Phoebe, Shorekeeper, and Verina. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!
Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain a 30% Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack grants 20 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second. Casting Resonance Skill grants 100 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Dealing Spectro DMG grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%. Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm.
- The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

[About]
The celebration is about to begin. Invite your friends back to join the fun in Rinascita. Complete tasks together to earn Astrites and other rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 or higher during the event.

[Rules]
1. Share your invitation code with up to 3 Returning Players in your server, complete in-game tasks to obtain Celebration Balloons, and exchange them for up to Astrite x480 and Shell Credit x300,000.
2. Returning Players can link their accounts with the Player of their choice by using their corresponding invitation code. This can be done once and cannot be changed later. [Returning Player Eligibility]
1. Union Level 8 or higher.
2. Has not logged into the game for at least 14 consecutive days immediately before the start of this event or before April 7, 2025, 00:00 (UTC+8).
3. Eligible Returning Players will retain their status for the duration of this event.

[Additional Notes]
※ Upon completing an event task, there may be a slight delay before you can claim the rewards. If this occurs, please wait at least 2 minutes before refreshing the page or restarting the game.
※ A Returning Player cannot be both the inviter and invitee of another Returning Player.

GuideTutorialPage_36008_Content:
During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.

<color=#ffd12f>There is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Ability</color> to try to reach the finish line first.

Cubes that arrive later at the target pad will stack on top of those that arrived earlier.
GuideTutorialPage_3600802_Content: When Cubes are stacked, if the bottom Cube moves first, it will carry along all the Cubes stacked above it. Among stacked Cubes, the higher up a Cube is, the higher its rank.
GuideTutorialPage_3600803_Content:
During the Support Phase, players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> their favorite Cube by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the <color=#ffd12f>Match Winner</color>.

<color=#ffd12f>Supporting</color> a Cube consumes a player's Popularity. <color=#ffd12f>Popularity</color> can be obtained by completing the event's <color=#ffd12f>Daily Tasks</color>.

If the Cube you Supported wins, you will <color=#ffd12f>receive Popularity Rewards</color> based on [Popularity Given] x [Underdog Odds].

Don't worry, you'll get back 80% of the Popularity you gave in Support if your prediction turns out wrong!
GuideTutorialPage_3600804_Content:
The Support Phase lasts from 08:00 to 19:30 every day.

Based on the Support a Cube receives and its starting position, the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color> are <color=#ffd12f>refreshed</color> daily at 12:00 and 18:00. 

Your Popularity Rewards for correctly predicting the winner will depend on the Cube's Underdog Odds. Be sure to keep an eye on any changes to those odds!
GuideTutorialPage_36009_Content:
The Race Page shows all stages of the Race and who's advancing.

The Race consists of 5 stages: Group A, Group B, Quarterfinal A, Quarterfinal B, and the Final, with 10 matches in total.

During the Support Phase, the current Contenders and match will be highlighted. After each match is over, the page will update with the Contenders for the next match.
GuideTutorialPage_3600902_Content:
Each Group Stage is split into the 1st Half and the 2nd Half.
A Cube's ranking in the 1st Half will determine its starting position in the 2nd Half.

After the 2nd Half ends, only the <color=#ffd12f>frontrunner Cubes</color> will <color=#ffd12f>advance to the next Stage</color>.

The top 4 ranking Cubes from each Group Stage will advance to the Quarterfinal Stage. The top 2 from the Quarterfinal Stage will move on to the Final, where the champion will be decided.
GuideTutorialPage_3600903_Content:
After each match ends, the Match Recap page will allow you to watch the match replay. 

If the match that just concluded was the 1st Half, a "2nd Half Starting Position" button will appear on the main page. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} to view the starting positions of the Cubes for the 2nd Half.

HelpText_253_Content:
1. Enter Abbowser Castle with up to 3 Cube allies. Your Cube allies will proactively assist you in battle. Additionally, casting Echo Skill triggers the Cube allies' active skill.
2. Each Abbowser Castle level provides Data Modules, granting a massive increase to your Cube's combat powers. Certain modules also come with extra skill effects.
3. Gain level progression by defeating enemies. Enemies of different strengths count towards different amounts of progression. Once the progress bar activates a chest, you'll obtain its rewards after the end results.
4. Resonators on the same Floor share Revival Chances. Resonators will not be able to recover from being downed after all Revival Chances are depleted.
5. Upon either reaching 100% progression, 0 remaining time, or 0 Revive Chances, the level will be finalized.
6. Items not picked up or unopened chests will automatically be placed into your Backpack after the end results.
7. Levels 5, 10, and 15 to 21 can be challenged in Co-op mode.

HelpText_265_Content:
[Patron Board]
1. The Patron Board is formed according to the results from supporting the Cubes. The top 100 players from your server will be displayed on the Patron Board.
2. Your ranking will also be available on the Patron Board. Your info will not be displayed on the Patron Board if you haven't supported a Cube or if your results are below 50% of the participants.
3. Rankings on the Patron Board are determined by total Popularity. Two or more players will have the same ranking if they have the same Popularity, with the order within the Patron Board determined by the number of correct predictions and the time at which they were made.
4. Only Popularity obtained from supporting Cubes counts toward the total Popularity Rankings. Popularity obtained from doing Daily Event Tasks will not be counted.
5. You need to have supported a Cube at least once to be ranked.
6. The Patron Board will show your avatar and name as it was when you supported the Cubes.
7. You will be removed from the current Patron Board if your name contains sensitive characters that violate the User Agreement. If abnormalities are detected during the Cube supporting process, the offending player's ranking data will be deleted, and they will be banned from the current rankings. The Dev Team reserves the right of final interpretation.

[Patron Board Update]
The Patron Board is updated at set times. Update times for each server are:
Mainland China: 04:00 (UTC+8)
HK, MO, TW: 04:00 (UTC+8)
SEA: 04:00 (UTC+8)
Asia: 04:00 (UTC+8)
America: 04:00 (UTC-5)
Europe: 04:00 (UTC+1)

1. The Patron Board will not be accessible during the Preliminary stage. After Preliminary B - 2nd, the rankings will be unlocked at 04:00 a.m. of the following day.
2. After each match, the rankings will be refreshed at 04:00 a.m. of the following day. There may be a slight delay before the Patron Board is updated with the latest rankings. We appreciate your patience.
HelpText_263_Content:
[Event Duration]

2025-05-14 08:00 to 2025-05-26 03:59 (server time)

*From 2025-05-14 08:00 to 2025-05-23 19:30 (server time), you can support your favorite Cube every day. From 2025-05-23 19:30 to 2025-05-26 03:59 (server time), support will be closed. During this period, you can view race results, check the Patron Board, watch replays, and claim event rewards.

[About]

The first Cube Games hosted by the Pioneer Association are officially up and running! Twelve Cube stars are set to showcase their skills on the track, setting aside their standings and identities, as they fully commit to compete for the title of fastest Cube!
For those who cannot participate in the race, no worries! We've got you covered! You can support potential winners through our official channels! Plus, the Pioneer Association will offer full live event coverage, and everyone is welcome to tune in and cheer for their favorite contestants!
(This program is brought to you by the Montelli Second Coming of Solaris Branch, in partnership with the New Black Shores.)

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 8.

[Rules]

1. During the event, 12 Cubes will take part in elimination matches in 2 Groups, with 1 match taking place per day and 10 matches in total to decide the Ultimate Race Winner.
2. From 08:00 to 19:30 server time, you can support your favorite Cube by predicting the Match Winner of the day.
3. Each match starts at 20:00 server time. From the event page, you can view the race live broadcast and cheer for your favorite Cube in the live chat.
4. After the match, you must go to the event page to finalize the calculations for your Popularity rewards based on the Cubes' final placements and the prediction outcomes.
5. The Patron Board will be updated at 04:00 on the following day. You can view your ranking on the Patron Board.
6. After the 2nd half of the Final, a commemorative item will be sent out to all Rovers who unlocked this event. Please claim it before the event ends.
HelpText_296_Content:
[About]
The Second Coming of Solaris's Anniversary is approaching, but trouble has struck the Cube World. The mysterious demon king Abbowser has captured all Cubes and issued the legendary Black Cat Warrior a mighty challenge. "You show up in a strange land, take on my minions, save your buddies, and then face off with me in an epic boss fight! Classic! This is gonna be a blast!"

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 22.

[Rules]
1. Enter Abbowser Castle with up to 3 Cube allies. Your Cube allies will proactively assist you in battle. Additionally, casting Echo Skill triggers the Cube allies' active skill.
2. Each Abbowser Castle level provides Data Modules, granting a massive increase to your Cube's combat powers. Certain modules also come with extra skill effects.
3. Gain level progression by defeating enemies. Enemies of different strengths count towards different amounts of progression. Once the progress bar activates a chest, you'll obtain its rewards after the end results.
4. Resonators on the same Floor share Revival Chances. Resonators will not be able to recover from being downed after all Revival Chances are depleted.
5. Upon either reaching 100% progression, 0 remaining time, or 0 Revive Chance, the level will be finalized.
6. Items not picked up or unopened chests will automatically be placed into your Backpack after the end results.
7. Levels 5, 10, and 15 to 21 can be challenged in Co-op mode.
HelpText_318_Content:
[Echo Aspect]
By switching Aspects, you can change the appearance of Echo Wings and Glider.

[Important Notes]
Each Echo Aspect can only be purchased once and can be used on all Resonators you own.
Echo Aspects have usage requirements. You must progress through Main Quest Chapter I Prologue to unlock Glider Aspect, and Main Quest Chapter II Act II to unlock Echo Wings Aspect.
You may purchase Aspects even if you haven't met the requirements yet. Once you meet them, the Aspects will become usable.
HelpText_319_Content:
[About]
Tethys's crisis simulation program is getting an upgrade. With newly gathered data from the Black Shores and Rinascita, harsher scenarios await those who dare to face the challenge…

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.

[Crisis Trials]
As a member of the Black Shores, take on trials with different combinations of Stress Modules.
Each Crisis Trial has a default set of Stress Modules. Support Modules are available to lower the trial's difficulty.
After completing a Crisis Trial, the corresponding Disaster Trial along with its Stress Modules and Support Modules will be unlocked.

[Disaster Trials]
To gather additional combat data and improve the Black Shores's crisis response plans, this training program also includes a Hard Mode.
As a member of the Black Shores, you will face <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> with various Stress Module combinations.
Disaster Trials have no required Stress Level. Data samples are gathered from participants pushing their limits.
Participating in a Disaster Trial will consume Support Modules, so select them carefully in advance.
Certain risky Stress Modules can only be unlocked after clearing the corresponding Disaster Trials or clearing a Disaster Trial with the required Stress Level. 
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>

[Revival Mechanism]
If a participant is downed in a trial, they can consume Stress Levels to revive. This also gives a corresponding buff.
Please note that consuming Stress Levels will affect the completion and final result of Challenge Goals.

[Matrix Crystals]
Obtain Matrix Crystals by completing Challenge Goals in the Crisis and Disaster Trials. Matrix Crystals can be exchanged for rewards at the Supply Station. Completing certain Stress Level challenges in Disaster Trials will grant an <color=#c89a45>event-exclusive Title reward</color>.

<color=#c89a45>The Supply Station closes when this event ends. All remaining Matrix Crystals will expire and will not be reserved after the event ends. Please exchange your Matrix Crystals in time.</color>
HelpText_324_Content:
[About]
"Hi, Rover, welcome to the Solaris Photo Show!"
How will your journey unfold in this brand new world? The scenery you dream of, the companions you wish to encounter, and the stories you are about to write... memories will unravel in full color, starting right here, with you.
 
[Eligibility]
Create a character profile after the Version 2.4 update and reach Union Level 5.
 
[Duration]
The Solaris New Voyage Celebration unlocks once you meet the requirements. The event lasts 30 days.
 
[Event Rules]
The event has four types of tasks: Tidal Memories, Combat Scenes, Scenic Wonders, and Growth Roadmap. Complete these tasks to earn item rewards and Celebration Festivity Points.
Accumulate Festivity Points to unlock valuable rewards. Keep building it up to claim a <color=#ffd12f>standard 5-star Resonator of your choice</color>!
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
If you do not select a preferred 5-Star Resonator as your Celebration Gift during the event, this reward cannot be reissued. If you meet the requirements and have already made your selection, the corresponding standard 5-Star Resonator reward will be reissued via Mail.
Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode. Quest Tracking is not available in certain areas.
HelpText_325_Content:
[About]
The streets of Septimont are teeming with life. Travelers from near and far have gathered in their finest for the Great Agon.
Go explore Septimont in this time of celebration, taste the bitterness of defeat and joy of triumph in the competition, and experience the glory of the arena amidst stunning landscapes.

[Eligibility]
Arrive in Septimont during the Main Quest "Shadow of Glory."

[Event Rules]
The event has four phases, each unlocking progressively as you advance through the Main Quest.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain event content is not available while in Co-op mode, and event Quest Tracking is not available in certain areas.
