HelpText_316_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Cartethyia, Ciaccona, Jiyan, Jianxin, Yangyang, Aalto. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Illusive Points Bonus!
Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain a 30% Aero DMG Bonus.
- Dealing Aero DMG grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%. Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm.
- The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies.
Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

HelpText_345_Content:
1. Swipe left or right on the story cards to make choices based on the narrative.

2. You can preview how the Resonator stats will be influenced by your choice as you swipe. The icon of the influenced stat will glow up and the extent of the influence will be indicated by the strength of the glow.
- Depending on your choice, the stats may increase or decrease.

3. Once confirmed, your choice will affect the stats. If the stats requirements are met at the final stage, the challenge succeeds and the story proceeds.

4.  If the stats requirements aren't met at the final stage, the challenge fails and the story starts again.

5. If any stat drops to 0, the challenge fails and the story starts again.

HelpText_349_Content:
[About]
A strange gate to the Somnoire appears. Through it, a curious Conductor glimpses a forsaken Dreamland. There, a host of peculiar Echoes have gathered, striving to restore its former glory. The Conductor chooses to linger, silently awaiting the unfolding of this dream...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete the Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock (complete quest "Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens" for the best experience).

[Event Rules]
During this event, Phrolova will take charge of a long-abandoned amusement park within the Somnoire, directing Echoes to keep the park running. Strategically assign Echoes to maintain the park’s stability and prolong its existence.

Within a set number of days, guide the Echoes and collect enough Dreamland Coupons to complete stage objectives and keep the park operational.

During the limited-time reward period, you can earn Dreamland Badges by completing special goals. Collect enough Dreamland Badges to unlock the Sigil: Dreamland Reverie.

If you miss any limited-time rewards, they will be sent via in-game Mail provided that you log in within 30 days after the event ends.
Limited-time rewards cannot be claimed once the reward window ends, but you can continue playing to earn permanent rewards.

HelpText_353_Content:
[Stage Selection]
1. Meet the revenue target to clear Stages and earn rewards.

2. Some Stages have multiple difficulty levels. Clearing higher difficulties unlocks special Dreamland Members and Props.

3. In certain Stages, you can select Echo Dream Attributes that align with the Stage Environment, making your management more efficient.

4. Before starting a Stage, you can equip a Phantasma Blessing. These blessings provide various buffs to support Phrolova in reaching her goals.

5. Some Stages feature Infinite Mode. Meeting the revenue target of Phase 5 in these Stages counts as successful completion. Afterward, you may continue playing to take on increasingly difficult Phases and aim for the highest Phase record possible.
HelpText_354_Content:
[Phase & Day]
 - In each phase, you must reach the required revenue target within a given duration to advance to the next phase.
 - Entering a new phase will raise the difficulty of the Phase Goal.
 - <color=#c79f49>Completing all Phase Goals</color> to clear the stage.
 - Each new phase grants some Frequency Crystals and will <color=#c79f49>automatically deduct the required Dreamland Coupons for the previous phase</color>.
 
 [Dreamland Echo]
 - The number of Dreamland Coupons earned each day is affected by the Echoes, props, and Dream Block types.
 - A maximum of 20 Echoes can be placed on the field at one time. Up to <color=#c79f49>100</color> Echoes can be accommodated on and off the field. 
 - At the start of each new day, Echoes on the field will randomly change positions.
 - If the field is full when a new Echo arrives, the newcomer will be concealed and may appear on the field the next day.
 - As phases progress, the rarity of Echoes available for recruitment will gradually increase up to Gold rarity.
 - Echoes with Dream of Connection attribute will be added to the recruitment pool once unlocked.
 
 [Phantasma Blessing]
 - Phantasma Blessings provide different effects that can aid in Dreamland management.
 - Each use consumes one Blessing attempt. Once all attempts are used, Blessings can no longer be activated.
 
 [Dreamland Details]
 - In the Dreamland Detail page, you can view all Echoes currently on and off the field, as well as your daily yield.
 - In the Dreamland Detail page, you can also <color=#c79f49>Dismiss</color> any Echoes on the field.
 
 [Infinite Mode]
 - Certain stages offer Infinite Mode after being cleared.
 - In Infinite Mode, Phase Goals are significantly harder to reach, and the Phase durations will be <color=#c79f49>infinite</color>. Your challenge is considered successful once you reach the system limit for revenue.
 - You can choose to end the run at any time, and it will still count as a cleared challenge.
HelpText_356_Content:
[Echo Management]
- You can create multiple management plans for Echoes based on quality, COST, Sonata Effects, and Mainstats.
- Multiple plans can be active at the same time. When a new Echo is obtained, it will automatically be locked or marked for discard according to the active plans.

[Echo Auto-discard]
If an Echo meets both lock and discard criteria, it will be locked rather than discarded.

[Suggested Plan]
You can directly import multiple suggested plans. The suggested plans do not cover all Sonata Effects and must be manually activated.

GuideTutorialPage_32044_02_Content:
Fenrico may cast Holy Summon to summon Divine Envoys at his command and start channeling Retribution.
When Fenrico casts Holy Summon, Phrolova will charge up to counter the incoming Retribution.
Defeating the Divine Envoys ensures that Prolova's charge-up remains uninterrupted and allows her to generate a Remnant Field that defends Resonators inside against Retribution. After Retribution ends, Phrolova will counter Fenrico, lowering his vibration strength.
GuideTutorialPage_32044_03_Content: If the Remnant Field could not be generated, Retribution will deal massive amounts of damage to any active Resonator.
GuideTutorialPage_34174_Content: Orchestration is one of Phrolova's Resonance abilities. It can tap into an object's essence and change its state. After Orchestrating, the behaviour of nearby objects will be affected for some time. Orchestration can be ended early.
GuideTutorialPage_3417402_Content: Orchestration consumes energy. Energy gradually recovers when not Orchestrating.
GuideTutorialPage_34175_Content: Special Grapple Points will appear during Orchestration. They function just like normal Grapple Points.
GuideTutorialPage_34176_Content: During Orchestration, each attack slows the enemy's attack speed. After taking 5 attacks, the enemies will be locked. All locked enemies will be instantly defeated when the Orchestration ends.
GuideTutorialPage_3417602_Content: Enemies cannot hit you when you're in Orchestration.
GuideTutorialPage_34177_Content:
Micro Echo Brooders are stored centrally and require significant space. To preserve valuable manufacturing floor area, they are usually concealed within structural partitions.
These units deploy rapidly when activated and may bump into surrounding objects. You can control them via Orchestration.
GuideTutorialPage_34178_Content: Defective Power Controllers will periodically release large shockwaves that damage anything nearby. Use Orchestration to fix the Power Controllers.
GuideTutorialPage_34179_Content: Special music stands are found around the Orchestration Altar. Put a complete Music Sheet on the stand corresponding to the altar to activate the Orchestration Altar and initiate Polyphone Orchestration mode.
GuideTutorialPage_3417902_Content: During Polyphone Orchestration, drag to link the music notes by number in ascending order up to number 5.
GuideTutorialPage_3417903_Content: After connecting the numbers in ascending order, the missing notes on the top of the screen will be restored, and the Orchestration will be complete, returning the chaotic melody to its original form.
GuideTutorialPage_3417904_Content: If there are multiple notes, link all notes up to number 5 of their corresponding colors.
GuideTutorialPage_34180_Content: Use Grapple to enter the special water current that can rapidly transport you between connected areas.
GuideTutorialPage_3418002_Content: Use the up and down movement keys (or the control stick) to ascend and dive. Use the left and right movement keys to control your direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34181_Content: Energy pipes supply large amounts of energy to various areas and connect to an array of opening and closing valves. Operate the valves by sending energy through the pipes to the correct place.
GuideTutorialPage_34182_Content: The Breaker is one of the safety devices for the Energy Pipes. Press on the pedal to reconnect the disconnected Energy Pipe.
GuideTutorialPage_34183_Content: The Prayer Rite must be performed exactly as specified by the Order of the Deep for it to be considered a display of devotion. Failure to do so warrants expulsion from the group.
GuideTutorialPage_34184_Content: When the Triptych Chest displays 3 identical icons, hit its button to open the chest.
GuideTutorialPage_36011_Content:
In each Phase, you must reach the required revenue target within a given duration to progress to the next Phase.
Entering a new Phase means a more difficult target. Completing all the Phase Goals will clear the Stage.
Each new phase grants some Frequency Crystals and will automatically deduct the required Dreamland Coupons of the previous Phase.
GuideTutorialPage_3601102_Content:
The number of Dreamland Coupons earned each day is affected by the Echoes, Props, and Dream Block types.
Up to 20 Echoes can be placed on the field.
At the start of each new day, Echoes on the field will randomly change positions.
If the field is full when a new Echo arrives, the newcomer will be placed off the field and may appear on the field the next day.
As Phases progress, the rarity of Echoes available for recruitment will gradually increase up to the Gold rarity.
GuideTutorialPage_3601103_Content: In the Dreamland Detail page, you can view all Echoes currently on and off the field, as well as your daily yield.

GuideTutorialPage_36012_Content:
Echoes with this Dream Attribute center around <color=#ffd12f>Gradation</color> as their core ability.
Certain Echoes will <color=#ffd12f>trigger Gradation once and obtain buffs after staying on the field for a set number of days</color>.

To maximize your gains, <color=#ffd12f>try placing as many Gradation Echoes in the early days as possible</color> if you select Dream of Gradation.
GuideTutorialPage_36013_Content:
Echoes with this Dream Attribute center around <color=#ffd12f>Devouring</color> as their core ability. 
Certain Echoes grow stronger in the Dreamland by Devouring. <color=#ffd12f>When a powerful Echo absorbs a weak one, its Daily Coupon yield increases.</color>
Certain Echoes grant additional buffs upon being Devoured.

To maximize your gains, <color=#ffd12f>make sure you have enough Echoes on the field that can be Devoured</color> if you select Dream of Devouring.
GuideTutorialPage_36014_Content:
Echoes with this Dream Attribute center on <color=#ffd12f>Exchange</color> as their core ability. After staying on the field for a set number of days, some Echoes will remove themselves and leave behind various buff effects.
<color=#ffd12f>Certain Dream of Exchange Echoes can produce Echoes with the ability to Exchange. Whenever Exchange is triggered, this type of Echo becomes buffed.</color>

To maximize gains, <color=#ffd12f>make sure you can produce enough Echoes with the ability to Exchange</color> if you select Dream of Exchange.
GuideTutorialPage_36015_Content:
Echoes with this Dream Attribute center on <color=#ffd12f>Integration</color> as their core ability. Some Echoes can reshape the Dreamland through Integration. <color=#ffd12f>When conditions are met, certain Echoes will merge with another Echo on the same row into a brand-new Echo and grant various buff effects.</color>

<color=#ffd12f>Try Integrating many Echoes of the same rarity</color> to create powerful Echoes if you select Dream of Integration.
GuideTutorialPage_36016_Content: Echoes with this Dream Attribute have no core ability. <color=#ffd12f>They are suited for synergizing with Echoes of other Dream Attributes.</color> These Echoes will automatically be added to Echo Recruitment after being unlocked, without the need to specifically select this Dream Attribute.
HelpText_362_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid]
Manually trigger the Divined Dream state when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500 points. In this state, Sigils and certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively. The cooldown of Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%, triggered once every 4s. Divined Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. 
- The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Sigils and certain Metaphors provide additional enhancements when Divined Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

HelpText_374_Content:
[About]
To help prevent another Waveworn Phenomenon on the scale of a Dark Tide, the Black Shores and Rinascita have come together on a joint project: to conduct simulations using a hologram device in regions vulnerable to the Threnodian's power. Thus, you and your reliable companions have been invited to help test this unique device.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14, and unlock the Resonance Nexus in Ragunna City during Main Quest "The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes."

[Event Rules]
Choose a participating Resonator and dive into simulated combat drills! Under a special tactical view, you'll direct them as they fend off waves of enemies with brand-new weapons. As you battle, spend the Enhancement Modules gained to power up your Resonator or improve their weapons. To clear a drill, you must survive every wave of attack.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.

HelpText_376_Content:
[About]
Maji, the idea king, is back with yet another new campaign—
This time, he's riding the tech wave and trying to create his very own smart assistant, Lollo Genie.
Interact with adorable Echoes and submit their behavioural data to Maji to collect Lollo Stamps and participate in the thrilling lottery!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps. Each Lollo Stamp lets you peel off one Lollo Campaign lottery ticket.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
GuideTutorialPage_3418402_Content: Rotate the items given by the prophecy seekers to find and activate hidden "Omens" on them. These Omens give clues about each seeker.
GuideTutorialPage_34185_Content: Inspect all the found "Omens" to gather enough information and glimpse the future of the prophecy seeker.
GuideTutorialPage_3418502_Content: Find Iuno's specter within the Chaos. Take her hand and walk with her to relive her past and complete the Anchoring.
GuideTutorialPage_34186_Content: Hold the hand-holding icon to release Iuno's hand. Moving more than 5 meters away from her specter will break the Anchoring and cause you to become lost in the Chaos. If you do not take her hand again within 15 seconds, the Anchoring will end, and you will return to the last Anchored memory.
GuideTutorialPage_34187_Content: In this battle against the Dark Tide, Iuno can use certain skills to heal allied Gladiators nearby. After reaching a certain amount of health, Gladiators will return to combat.
GuideTutorialPage_34189_Content: Insert the <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Stone</color> into the <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Obelisk</color> to activate it. Once activated, it repels the Dark Tide fog and boosts the Sacred Flames in Maroonwood.
GuideTutorialPage_34190_Content: The moving "light dots" will awaken the sleeping <color=#ffd12f>Hollow Figures</color> along the way. Proceed with caution.
GuideTutorialPage_3419002_Content: The awakened Hollow Figure can be <color=#ffd12f>shattered</color>. Approaching a Hollow Figure will cause it to <color=#ffd12f>charge up</color> and explode, thus summoning Tacet Discords. <color=#ffd12f>Shattering</color> the Hollow Figure before it completes <color=#ffd12f>charging up</color> can prevent the summoning.
GuideTutorialPage_34191_Content: Interact with the Waystone to enter or exit Sonoro at any time.
GuideTutorialPage_34192_Content: Watch your surroundings. When a <color=#ffd12f>Grapple Point</color> appears near a gaint rock, you can use <color=#ffd12f>Grapple</color> at the right moment to pull it down and stun enemies below.
GuideTutorialPage_34193_Content:
Interact with the Dreamscape Nodes in the Sanguis Plateaus to unlock the challenges and clear the Nightmares sealed within.
There are three challenges in a Node. Completing a challenge unlocks the next one. Complete all challenges to obtain rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34194_Content:
During combat, Augusta slowly builds up her Momentum. When the <color=#ffd12f>Momentum Bar</color> is full and turns <color=#ffd12f>yellow</color>, she enters the <color=#ffd12f>Attack Preparation stage</color>. After a while at yellow, the <color=#ffd12f>Momentum Bar</color> will turn <color=#ffd12f>red</color>, and Augusta will <color=#ffd12f>launch her attack</color>.
Casting <color=#ffd12f>Resonance Liberation</color> <color=#ffd12f>interrupts</color> Augusta's attack and she'll recharge Momentum from the start.
GuideTutorialPage_36017_Content:
In the Tidal Defense Simulator, you need to deploy Combat Machines to fend off waves of Tacet Discords aiming to destroy the Energy Matrix.

Tacet Discords attack in waves. During the <color=#ffd12f>Preparation</color> phase before each wave, you can consume Sim Credits to deploy various types of Combat Machines.
GuideTutorialPage_3601702_Content:
There are three terrain types in the Tidal Defense Simulator: ground, wall and ceiling. Combat Machines can only be deployed on specific terrain based on their type.

In each Preparation phase, you will receive a certain number of Sim Credits. You will also earn a small number of Sim Credits by defeating Tacet Discords.
GuideTutorialPage_3601703_Content:
Once Combat Machines are deployed, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} Start to begin the simulation. Tacet Discords will advance along preset routes.

If Tacet Discords reach the Energy Matrix, they'll reduce its Durability. The amount of depletion depends on the Tacet Discord type. The simulation fails if Durability drops to 0.
GuideTutorialPage_3601704_Content:
Tacet Discords enter through invasion points. During the simulation, they won't attack you directly but will follow preset routes. You can see these routes as marked lines in the Preparation phase.

Additionally, the Preparation phase shows previews of Tacet Discords moving along these paths. Use this info to strategically deploy your Combat Machines based on their movement patterns.
GuideTutorialPage_3601705_Content:
After completing a simulation, you'll be granted Rating Stars based on the remaining Durability of the Energy Matrix.

Rating Stars can be used to unlock Overwatch Protocols, granting tactical advantages for future simulations.
GuideTutorialPage_36018_Content:
In Deathtrap Mode, you'll be able to choose a Tactic during the Preparation stage before each wave. Tactics grant powerful combat buffs.

Each Tactic belongs to a specific Tactic Set, where you can view detailed descriptions and effects.
GuideTutorialPage_3601802_Content: In the Total Defense Test of Deathtrap Mode, Tacet Discords do not stop attacking and become more powerful with each wave. Defend against an unending stream of enemies and strive to set your highest wave record!
GuideTutorialPage_36019_Content:
In some stages of the Tidal Defense Simulator, certain paths will be blocked at the start of combat.

Once a specific wave is reached, these paths will open, creating new invasion points and changing enemy routes.
GuideTutorialPage_36020_Content: KU-Money's Shop appears after every certain waves, spend your Sim Credits there to purchase items.
GuideTutorialPage_3602002_Content: You can use the purchased items by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the corresponding buttons. Consumables will be depleted upon use.
GuideTutorialPage_3602003_Content:
Use the wheel to quickly switch between your carried items.
You can only carry a limited number of items. Different items have different carry limits. Once you reach the limit, you won't be able to purchase more.
GuideTutorialPage_36021_Content: Drag frequency samples of the same Attribute (color) to connect them.
GuideTutorialPage_3602102_Content: Once samples of the same Attribute are connected, all other single samples of that Attribute will become fixed. Drag the connected samples to link with the fixed ones.
GuideTutorialPage_3602103_Content: Connect all frequency samples of the same Attribute within the move limit to complete the analysis and win the challenge.
HelpText_387_Content:
[Terminal Swap]
Once a new Terminal is obtained, you can swap Terminals in the Terminal page. Terminals not yet acquired will not be shown.
Terminal Swap can only be applied to Rover, and is not available to other Resonators. Changing Rover's gender does not affect the current Terminal configuration.
HelpText_390_Content:
[Eye Comfort]
Eye Comfort adjusts screen display for easier viewing, except for cutscenes and UI elements.
It comes with three modes: [Low Light], [Bright Light], and [Custom], which can be selected according to the current user environment.
In Custom mode, you can adjust color temperature, intensity, brightness, and texture intensity.
Please note that the Eye Comfort feature is not compatible with Global Filter.

GuideTutorialPage_36022_Content:
In this simulation, some Tacet Discords are Shielded. Shielded Tacet Discords are immune to Slow effects.

Use pulling-in-type Combat Machines (Vortex Generator and Whirlpool Device) to directly remove Tacet Discords' Shields.
GuideTutorialPage_36023_Content: Use knockback-type Combat Devices and KU-Roro's Weapons to push Tacet Discords off the edges, instantly defeating them. Tacet Discords defeated this way will not trigger their Deathsound effects.
GuideTutorialPage_36024_Content: Tacet Discords with Passive - Fortified have very low HP, but the DMG they take is fixed at 1 for each hit.
GuideTutorialPage_36025_Content: Tacet Discords with Domain - Disable periodically disable nearby Combat Machines for a short time.
GuideTutorialPage_36026_Content: Tacet Discords with Passive - Invisibility do not trigger Combat Machines on walls and ceilings.
GuideTutorialPage_36027_Content: Tacet Discords with Domain - Barrier periodically grant Shields to nearby Tacet Discords.
GuideTutorialPage_36028_Content: When Tacet Discords with Deathsound - Contamination are <color=#ffd12f>defeated</color>, they release Frequency Contamination on the spot. Combat Machines cannot be deployed in the contaminated areas, and the already deployed ones <color=#ffd12f>become disabled</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3602802_Content:
The <color=#ffd12f>Frequency Neutralizer</color> removes Frequency Contamination.
When <color=#ffd12f>carrying</color> Frequency Neutralizers, you can deploy Combat Machines to contaminated areas. The system will <color=#ffd12f>automatically consume</color> the required number of Frequency Neutralizers for the deployment.
Certain Combat Machines can also clear contamination using their Optional Modules.

You receive a new message from the Hunter's Den: Please examine the traces left by TDs and track them down.

GuideTutorialPage_36029_Content:

Elite and Dangerous Tacet Discords deal <color=#ffd12f>extremely high DMG</color> and can thus reduce much of the Matrix's Durability. They must be treated carefully.

HelpText_402_Content:
[About]
The Lollo Campaign is facing an unexpected crisis! To save Maji's old reliable delivery legs, and to keep those convenient services running, help him complete his new program, Lollo Ice Drinks! Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics. Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act V "Shadow of Glory"

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.

HelpText_411_Content:
[About]
KU-Ryan, a Black Shores robot, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on Waveworn Phenomena in Septimont. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and successfully collapse the experimental unit during the Main Quest "Shadow of Glory."
 
[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different locations. You can participate in any activated challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. When all the datasets have been collected or when time runs out, you will receive rewards based on the points obtained.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your inbox when you log in again within 30 days.

GuideTutorialPage_33038_Content: After unlocking new Terminal appearances, you can swap Rover's Terminal. This feature is exclusive to Rover for now.
GuideTutorialPage_34195_Content: Distorted temporal zones exist throughout the Plane of Dark Tide. Use the Lantern of Napoli the Second to separate and switch between "worlds" in the Dark Tide.
GuideTutorialPage_34196_Content: Influenced by the Journeying Paradise frequencies, Tidespawn in the Plane of Dark Tide will gain Paradise Shelter and take less damage.
GuideTutorialPage_34197_Content: Battles with Tidespawn in the distorted zones will disturb the power of the Lantern. You'll need to build up frequency to reactivate it.
GuideTutorialPage_3419702_Content: Once the Lantern of Napoli the Second switches you to another "world," Paradise Shelter will be broken, leaving the Tidespawn vulnerable.
GuideTutorialPage_34198_Content:
Galbrena's "cassette tape" stabilizes your frequency. Your Concerto Energy and Resonance Energy will steadily increase as it plays.
Seize this chance to fight your way out.
GuideTutorialPage_3419802_Content: Your battle further destabilizes the frequency of this "world." Annihilate your foes by striking at the moment you switch worlds.
GuideTutorialPage_34199_Content: Galbrena has entered Beholder's Vision, allowing her to detect weak spots and openings. Using the TD power within her, she can swiftly traverse the battlefield to eliminate enemies.
GuideTutorialPage_3419902_Content:
Galbrena imbues Feather Blades with Shadow Fiend's power. Aiming and throwing them at a point allows her to move instantly to that point.
If an enemy is at the target point, she slays them as she moves.
GuideTutorialPage_3419903_Content: Galbrena summons Chimera and uses its power to change the "world" in the Dark Tide, uncovering new pathways via another "world."
GuideTutorialPage_3419904_Content:
In Beholder's Vision state, Galbrena's attack style changes.
And she can also unleash a special skill to sweep away all obstacles ahead.
GuideTutorial_36034_GroupName: Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier - Helltide Mode
GuideTutorial_36035_GroupName: Lament Recon: Solaris Soldier - Clearing a Wave
GuideTutorialPage_36030_Content: In this zone, Resonators' total DMG increases over time. Landing hits, Dodge Counters, or Counterattacks further boost total DMG for a short duration.
GuideTutorialPage_36031_Content: During the drill, Resonators' Weapons will auto-attack. They cannot use regular skills, but may Dash, Sprint, and cast Active Skills.
GuideTutorialPage_3603102_Content: The drill is presented from a wide overhead perspective, providing a clearer view of the battlefield.
GuideTutorialPage_3603103_Content:
During the drill, defeating TDs yields Enhancement Modules. You can spend them in the Shop between waves to upgrade Resonators, Weapons, or purchase Items.
Survive the required waves to complete the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_36032_Content: New Weapons unlock in certain waves. Resonators will use multiple Weapons at the same time.
GuideTutorialPage_3603202_Content: Some weapons can be absorbed to evolve another weapon into its Ultimate Form. The evolution requirements differ depending on the Weapon. The evolved Weapons inherit all buff effects of the absorbed weapon.
GuideTutorialPage_36033_Content: Some waves spawn Chest TDs. Defeating them grants Upgrade Card rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_36034_Content:
In Helltide Mode, the final battle has no time limit. The drill ends only if the Resonator is downed or when all TDs are eliminated.
TDs will constantly spawn, while both sides' HP and ATK increase periodically.
GuideTutorialPage_36035_Content: Defeating the final Elite enemy in a Wave clears the wave immediately. Surviving until the timer runs out also clears the Wave.
GuideTutorialPage_36036_Content: Elite enemies will spawn during the drill. Defeating them yields a large number of Enhancement Modules.
GuideTutorialPage_36037_Content:
Items spawn when eliminating certain TDs, reaching a certain number of waves, or at specific locations on the drill field. Pick them up for instant effects including:
- Magnetic: Automatically collect all Enhancement Modules on the field within range.
- Healing:  Restore 20% of Max HP.
- Rampage: Greatly increase DMG, Movement Speed, and Attack Speed for 10s.
GuideTutorialPage_36038_Content: Each Freeze Frame Challenge assigns three photo objectives. Complete them by capturing Resonators performing the required combat actions.
GuideTutorialPage_3603802_Content: In Normal Mode, performing the designated action with the required Resonator automatically triggers <color=#ffd12f>Slow Motion</color>, allowing you to observe and capture the Resonator's action precisely.
GuideTutorialPage_36039_Content:
In Hard Mode, Freeze Frame objectives are less obvious. You must try to find the correct combat actions.
In Hard Mode, Slow Motion no longer triggers automatically. You need to <color=#ffd12f>manually activate the Slow Motion gadget</color> to slow time.

HelpText_414_Content:
[About]
As the Tactical Simulacra project advances, the Huaxu Academy has successfully achieved the measurement of Tunability, a property through which countless Reverberations converge into Tacet Discords. Disrupting their Tunability would mean a lethal blow that paralyzes them...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
1. In Tactical Simulacra: Off Tune, challenge waves of powerful enemies using special buffs across different simulation domains.
2. As you complete more challenges, new special buffs will be available to you in the subsequent challenges. 
3. The results of each challenge will be tallied based on Monster Points, Time Points, and Technical Points.
i. Monster Points are earned by defeating enemies in challenges.
ii. Time Points are earned based on the time remaining at challenge completion and a conversation factor that increases with the number of enemies that are defeated.
iii. Technical Points are earned by triggering Counterattacks, successful Dodges, and Dodge Counters.
HelpText_419_Content:
[About]
To encourage the Pioneers to further share their Lahai-Roi explorations, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs to the Lollo courier truck to get various rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during the Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs.
Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package; Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards.
There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
HelpText_420_Content:
[About] 
Green and hazy as they may feel, school days always shine like gems in the river of memory. Those stories drift among the stars, your constant companions through every quiet night. 
As the New Solar Celebration unfolds, fresh little tales begin to blossom between you and your friends...  

[Eligibility] 
Solve the first riddle with Sigrika in Main Quest "Gold Suspended in Shadows" to unlock

[Rules] 
Progress the Main Quest to unlock the events of the corresponding Resonators. Certain conditions are required to unlock some of the events. Complete "Whispers Between Stars" to earn exclusive rewards, including Astrites and a Livery.

HelpText_426_Content:
[Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, your skills will be tested through multiple challenging stages. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Eligibility]
Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of the Tower of Adversity and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of the Respawning Waters: Torrents in Whimpering Wastes after 3.0 is released.

[Matrix]
Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion.

[Stability Accords]
You may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge.

[Singularity Expansion]
There is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will open the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.

[Power Circuits]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge.

[Demo Resonators]
Demo Resonators are available only if you own the corresponding Resonators. Each Demo Resonator is set to Lv. 90, equipped with a Lv. 90 weapon and a fitting Echo set with Lv. 25 Echoes . They inherit the Resonance Chain from your own Resonators.

[Resonator Enhancements]
In Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot, certain Resonators will receive special skill enhancements.

[Viral Infection]
In Singularity Expansion, enemy HP increases by each round, and stronger enemy effects will be unlocked as rounds progress.

[Vigor]
Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.

[Weapon & Echo Occupation]
Different Resonators cannot use the same weapon and Echo in this event. If a Resonator in the team has equipped a weapon or Echo used by another Resonator with a challenge record, you cannot start the challenge with this team.

Tutorial_3304402_Title: Stranger Things in Honami: New Content
GuideTutorialPage_33040_Content: Loot obtained in Honami City carries special frequencies and must be placed in the Storage Bag.
GuideTutorialPage_3304002_Content: Stickers contain harnessable Remnant Energy. These Stickers can be equipped in your Storage Bag interface to offer Resonators a variety of enhancements.
GuideTutorialPage_3304003_Content:
Namipon Stickers can be obtained by eliminating Tacet Discords, breaking destructible objects, or opening Supply Chests.
Stickers come in different types, which offer different enhancements and base stats.
GuideTutorialPage_33041_Content: As you explore Honami City, the Lament Residue will slowly corrupt your Resonators. Their resistance against the corruption is shown as Stability.
GuideTutorialPage_3304102_Content: Stability will decrease when attacked by Tacet Discords influenced by Lament Residue. If <color=#ffd12f>all Stability is lost</color>, <color=#ffd12f>the exploration will be terminated</color>, and all items in your Storage Bag will be lost.
GuideTutorialPage_33042_Content: Sparkling Water can be found throughout Honami City. Break them to restore some Stability and HP.
GuideTutorialPage_33043_Content: Namipons will assist in your exploration of Honami City. Selecting different Namipons will allow you to cast various Support Skills while exploring.
GuideTutorialPage_3304302_Content: Wearing the Namipon Badge increases your Max Stability in Honami City.
GuideTutorialPage_3304303_Content: Different Namipons are attached to specific Sticker sets. Equip the corresponding Stickers to activate their special effects.
GuideTutorialPage_33044_Content:
Although the looping crisis is over, there are still unresolved mysteries in Honami City.
Explore Honami City with Namipon and Chisa in search of loot to enhance your combat power and upgrade Shashou Cafe. Uncover the truths behind the anomalies in the city!
GuideTutorialPage_3304402_Content:
Unlock more Namipon Support and Namipon Stickers as you investigate and venture into yet unexplored areas in search of valuable loot.
Build up your team's abilities as you plumb the depths of Honami City!
GuideTutorialPage_33045_Content: While exploring, you'll come across loot contaminated by Lament Residue. Interact with the loot item to purify it and obtain rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_33046_Content: Aside from Stickers, Honami City is filled with unique collectible items that, while lacking practical effects, hold significant value. These loot items can be sold to the Sales Champ in exchange for Rice Dangos, which can be spent to enhance your exploration abilities in Honami City.
GuideTutorialPage_33047_Content: Due to Lament's residue, TDs in Honami City will grow increasingly dangerous over time, and enemies will deal greater Stability DMG. Be mindful of the time elapsed during your exploration.
GuideTutorialPage_3304702_Content: When an enemy's level far exceeds yours, its level indicator will be red. Please proceed with caution.
GuideTutorialPage_33048_Content: In heavily contaminated zones, TDs affected by Irideglow may appear. Defeat them all to purify the zone and obtain higher-value loot.
GuideTutorialPage_33049_Content: Stability can be consumed to open Capsule Machines contaminated by Lament Residue, which have a higher chance of containing high-value items.
GuideTutorialPage_33050_Content: You can book the Namipon Shuttle from a Telephone Booth, which lets you safely extract at any moment. Extraction by Namipon Shuttle does not incur item loss.
GuideTutorialPage_33051_Content: Honami City is now open to free exploration. Aside from the Telephone Booth, you can also book the Namipon Shuttle from the Preparations menu. Ticking that option allows you the freedom to extract at any time.
GuideTutorialPage_33052_Content: All areas in Honami City have been unlocked. You may now freely explore Honami City or continue with the story.
GuideTutorialPage_3305202_Content: Various Irideglow Portals might appear while you're exploring. They can randomly transport you to special areas in Honami City.
GuideTutorialPage_36041_Content:
Some of your attacks build up certain enemies' Off-Tune Level.
Once their Off-Tune Level reaches the limit, they enter the Mistune state.
During this state, you can unleash a powerful Tune Break to shatter their defenses.
Landing a Tune Break resets the enemies' Off-Tune Level and inflicts Tune Disruption, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.
GuideTutorialPage_3604102_Content: When an enemy uses a Special Skill (a red ring will appear as a warning), if you <color=#ffd12f>successfully Dodge or counter</color> the attack, the enemy will immediately enter the Mistune state. Attack enemies with Tune Break in this state will not reset their Off-Tune Level.
HelpText_427_Content:
[About]
Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!
Use rebuild materials gathered in Lahai-Roi to assist Dhalifa in restoring the Route Network and the Spacetrek Observatory.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and complete Tutorial Quest "Operation: Frontier Renewal"

[Event Rules]
Explore Lahai-Roi and use 3 types of materials to rebuild 10 routes.
Reaching a Route Constructor unlocks it as a Fast Travel point.
Once activated, the Constructor will automatically complete the route rebuild. Restored routes will revitalize the surrounding area, unlocking a variety of side quests and challenges.
Each completed route increases Network Activity. Reaching certain Activity milestones advances the Spacetrek Observatory's rebuild progress.

This event is permanently available. From Version 3.0 onward, you can access this event via the Region Guide on the Lahai-Roi map.
HelpText_428_Content: Rebuild Lahai-Roi's route network to increase Network Activity, enabling more supplies to reach the Spacetrek Observatory and accelerate its reconstruction.
HelpText_429_Content:
[About]
The Synchrolink System is now online in the Exostrider simulator cockpit.
The cockpit is embedded with the Exostrider's neurons, designed for training Synchronists in Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider. 
During this process, Synchronists can measure and record their resonance stress to assess adaptation levels and neural-load thresholds.
Complete training goals to earn Department-issued Synchro Coins, which can be exchanged for a variety of rare supplies and rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 27 and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands."

[Synchro Shop]
Complete Tactical Hologram: Synchronization to obtain Astrite and Synchro Coins, which can be exchanged for rewards at the Synchro Shop.

Tactical Hologram: Synchronization is a permanent event that can be experienced at any time and will continue to be updated in future versions. Please stay tuned.

[How to Unlock]
In Tactical Hologram: Synchronization, clearing a difficulty in any challenge unlocks all levels up to that difficulty across all challenges. Once you clear a difficulty, you can claim all rewards for lower difficulties.
HelpText_432_Title: Stranger Things in Honami: New Content
HelpText_430_Content:
[About]
After the end of Honami's City looping crisis, Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your and Chisa's help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City.
Assist Namipon with the investigation while also gathering supplies to renovate Shashou Cafe.

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II - Segue "Flowing Starlight in the Iris."
Reach Union Level 14

[Rules]
Explore the strange occurrences in Honami City and unravel their stories in the Stranger Things in Honami event.
Find loot to sell for revenue or to upgrade your combat power as you explore.
Resources gathered during exploration can be used to upgrade Shashou Cafe's Decor to provide support for your Resonators.
Due to the prevailing Lament Residue, Resonators cannot equip their Echoes, and downed Resonators cannot be revived by normal means.
Large amounts of Rice Dango rewards can be obtained by clearing Neon Tower challenges.
Limited-time rewards cannot be claimed once the reward window ends, but you can continue playing to earn permanent rewards.
HelpText_431_Content:
When exploring Honami City, after bringing any Legendary Quality unequippable loot item back to Shashou Cafe for the first time, that item will be displayed in the Gallery.
Even if you later sell that item from the Warehouse, it will remain displayed in the Gallery.

GuideTutorialPage_33055_Content: In addition to the universal Stickers, Namipon Stickers also include exclusive Stickers that only work for specific Resonators. These stickers can alter a Resonator's skill forms or grant new effects.
GuideTutorialPage_33056_Content: Neon Tower challenges consist of three stages, where you'll face powerful enemies in succession. Defeat each enemy to earn a large number of Rice Dangos.
GuideTutorialPage_3305602_Content: The Irideglow contamination inside Neon Tower does not increase with time, but it intensifies when an enemy is defeated.

HelpText_443_Content:
[About]
New players may receive bonus rewards and unlock new Support Resonators through this event to aid their leveling.

[Eligibility]
Create a character profile after 2025-12-12 04:00 (server time) during the event.

[Rules]
The Herald of New Tides event lasts for 30 days.
During the event, upon unlocking new SOL3 Phases, new players may claim the Astrite and Data Bank EXP rewards along with 5-Star Support Resonators: Yinlin, Jinhsi, Changli, Shorekeeper, and Camellya.
During the event, to fast-track leveling for new players, you will enjoy access to locations that contain the upgrade materials and the recommended Echoes of the current Featured Resonators and New Voyage Resonators.
(Note: Support Resonators can only join you in the overworld and certain recurring Sonoro Spheres)
GuideTutorialPage_33057_Content: To progress the story, you must follow the Main Objectives of your journey in Honami to investigate and resolve the unexplainable events throughout the city.
GuideTutorialPage_3305702_Content: Free exploration is available in Honami City after you resolve the city's major unexplainable events.
HelpText_448_Content: WavesLine is a Terminal messaging app developed by the Pioneer Association. It is available to all inhabitants of Solaris.
HelpText_449_Content:
[About]
O Rover guided by the tides, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores. You've braved tempests, heard the dual nature of Ragunna's faith, and tasted the glory in the arenas of Septimont. Now, the path to the frozen frontier unfolds in Honami City. It's time to set forth to Lahai-Roi.

[Eligibility]
Go to the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou and unlock the Terminal during Main Quest "First Resonance."

[Event Rules]
Main Quest Chapter III is now available. Eligible players can now experience this Chapter early. Chapters I, II, and III are available in parallel. Taking on later Chapters early does not affect progress in previous Chapters, and you can always resume previous Chapters from where you left off.
Early access to Chapter II/Chapter III also unlocks Time Adjustment, Resonance Conversion functions, as well as some Utilities.
*For the optimal experience, we recommend completing Chapter II - Segue "Flowing Starlight in the Iris" before starting Chapter III.
HelpText_450_Content:
Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid Update]
Current Dreamscape Aid Resonators: Lynae, Zani, Jinhsi, Phoebe, Shorekeeper, Verina. Use at least one Dreamscape Aid Resonator to gain a 150% Points Bonus!
Current Dreamscape Aid Effects:
- All Resonators in the team gain 30% Spectro DMG Bonus.
- Dealing Spectro DMG grants 30 Dreamscape Energy. This effect can be triggered once every second.
- Enter Lucid Dream when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500. In this mode, certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively, and the cooldown of their Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%. Lucid Dream lasts for 10s and depletes all Dreamscape Energy when it ends.

[Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators from the Resonator pool and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm.
The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Metaphors marked with Dreamscape Power provide additional enhancements when Lucid Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Illusive Points and reach milestones to claim bountiful rewards.

[Remnant Crystal]
A Remnant Crystal will appear in the Memory Zone after defeating the powerful enemies found in the deepest parts of the realm. Use Waveplates to collect its rewards.
Each week, the first 2 reward collections from the Remnant Crystal are free and do not require Waveplates. Free reward collections do not carry over to the next week.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more rewards from the Remnant Crystals and Illusive Points. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty and rewards of the current cycle.

Past memories lie buried deep within dreams, and the key to exploration is in your hands. Please do not forget, only within dreams will the answers be revealed.

[Dreamscape Aid]
Manually trigger the Divined Dream state when Dreamscape Energy reaches 500 points. In this state, Sigils and certain Metaphors will be enhanced, Crit. Rate and Energy Regen of all Resonators in the team are increased by 50% and 100% respectively. The cooldown of Resonance Skill or Resonance Liberation is reduced by 50%, triggered once every 4s. [Exploration]
- Choose three Resonators and embark on epic battles in the Illusive Realm. 
- The Echo Skills, Stats, Levels, Resonance Chains, and Weapons of Resonators can be carried over in the event.
- In the Illusive Realm, you can gain powerful boosts from Metaphors. Sigils and certain Metaphors provide additional enhancements when Divined Dream is activated through Dreamscape Aid.
- Each battle in the Illusive Realm brings you against different enemies. Complete these challenges to earn Weekly Activity Points.

[Difficulty]
Higher SOL3 Phases offer more challenging Exploration in the Illusive Realm with more Weekly Activity Points as rewards. The difficulty of the Illusive Realm is dependent on the SOL3 Phase you're in when the Illusive Realm resets (04:00 every Monday). Adjusting your SOL3 Phase during each exploration cycle does not affect the difficulty of the current cycle.

HelpText_466_Content:
[Motorbike Modding Level]
The Motorbike Modding Level can be raised by completing quests in Lahai-Roi, opening Supply Chests, and defeating enemies. Reaching the next Modding Level improves your motorbike's performance and unlocks abundant rewards.
Defeat enemies in Lahai-Roi (including Tacet Discord Nests, Boss Challenge, and Void Storms) to generate Modding EXP, up to a daily limit of 5,000. This limit is reset every day at 04:00 a.m. server time. Modding EXP can no longer be earned once you hit the Modding Level cap.

[Motorbike Specs]
Some of the motorbike's specs can be improved by raising the Modding Level. The motorbike's ATK and Shield Strength increase with your SOL3 Phase. 
 
[Motorbike Expansion Modules]
Complete Motorbike Modding Tasks to obtain Modding Points for specific modules, then spend those points to upgrade the Module to unlock more motorbike functions.
Expansion Modules are either Core or Specialized types. The Specialized Modules can only be effective after being upgraded and installed on the corresponding Motorbike Expansion Modules. Core Modules can be installed on any Motorbike Expansion Module to receive their effects when upgraded.

[Motorbike Modding Tasks]
Expansion Modules have their corresponding Modding Points and Modding Tasks.
Modding Tasks are either Permanent, Limited-Time, or Recurring.
Limited-Time tasks have to be completed within the specified time. They cannot be progressed any further once time is up, and rewards are not granted for uncompleted Limited-Time Tasks.
Limited-Time Tasks in this game version will be replaced with Recurring Tasks after the next game version update. Recurring Tasks are also permanent. You may complete the Recurring Tasks to earn the needed points for the corresponding Expansion Module.

[About]
Join the Lahai-Roi Pioneer Project launched by the Spacetrek Collective! Explore every corner of Lahai-Roi, uncover its wonders, and earn rewards along the way.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and arrive at Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Complete event tasks to collect Exploration Data, then use it to raise your Pioneer Level. Higher levels unlock even greater rewards.
Please note that some event tasks can't be completed in Co-op Mode, and the quest-tracking feature may be disabled in certain game scenarios.

1. Specialized Modules can be upgraded after the preceding module has been upgraded to Lv. 1.

You may project Echoes by equipping unlocked Echoes from the Gallery into the Projector via the Utility Wheel panel.

HelpText_465_Content:
[Resonator Level]
As your SOL3 Phase goes up, the level of Support Resonators available for you will increase to the level cap at the current SOL3 Phase.

[Sync Level]
If you reach a new SOL3 Phase during combat with a Support Resonator on your team, they cannot level up automatically. You may later level up your Support Resonator manually via the event page, after you've exited the combat state.
HelpText_475_Content:
Use the Spacetrek Observatory to broadcast control signals, adjusting the Sky Projection Array to generate simulated weather across Lahai-Roi.
Certain weathers can only be simulated at specific times and areas. Please make sure you have adjusted to the right time or moved to the corresponding areas for the simulation.
Some weather may trigger special events.
HelpText_476_Content:
[About]
Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!
Use rebuild materials gathered in Lahai-Roi to assist Dhalifa in restoring the Route Network and the Spacetrek Observatory.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and complete Tutorial Quest "Operation: Frontier Renewal"

[Event Rules]
Explore Lahai-Roi and use 3 types of materials to rebuild 10 routes.
Reaching a Route Constructor unlocks it as a Fast Travel point.
Once activated, the Constructor will automatically complete the route rebuild. Restored routes will revitalize the surrounding area, unlocking a variety of side quests and challenges.
Each completed route increases Network Activity. Reaching certain Activity milestones advances the Spacetrek Observatory's rebuild progress.

This event is permanently available. From Version 3.0 onward, you can access this event via the Region Guide on the Lahai-Roi map.

GuideTutorialPage_34201_Content:
There are two waves of enemies within the Void Storm Zone.
Due to the Void Storm, Resonators lose HP each second, and their Healing received and Healing Bonus are halved.
Resonators will be inflicted with Warp upon being hit, increasing their damage taken.
Unleashing Tune Break on enemies during Wave 2 deals massive amount of damage, restoring HP for Resonators and removing their Warp.
GuideTutorialPage_3420102_Content:
Clear the Void Storm Zone for the first time to earn rare Tidal Heritages.
Enemies within the Void Storm Zone respawn daily. Repeat the challenge to earn Modding EXP for your expedition motorbike.
Tutorial_3305804_Title: Things to Note While Riding the Motorbike
GuideTutorialPage_33058_Content: The expedition motorbike helps you move faster. Its functionalities improve through upgrades.
GuideTutorialPage_3305802_Content: When riding the expedition motorbike, you have access to features such as Acceleration, Boost, Drift, and Bounce Jump. While moving, a force field is deployed around the expedition motorbike, and the Resonator will be forced to dismount upon taking damage or being controlled after the force field is down.
GuideTutorialPage_3305803_Content: You can summon the expedition motorbike or adjust the relevant settings via the Utility Wheel. The motorbike cannot be summoned while in combat or when there is insufficient space.
GuideTutorialPage_3305804_Content:
There is a speed limit when riding the motorbike on the Startorch Academy campus grounds, and Boosting will be restricted. There are certain areas with restricted access for motorbikes.
Riding the motorbike and using Boost on decorated roads does not consume Energy.
GuideTutorialPage_33059_Content:
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Autopilot button to enter Autopilot Mode.
During this time, Cinematic Mode can be switched on, and the game's aspect ratio will change, and automatic camera movement will occur.
GuideTutorialPage_33060_Content: After placing a navigation waypoint, a recommended route will be plotted along the highway to the waypoint on the map. Once you are within range of the highway, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Autopilot to arrive near your destination.
GuideTutorialPage_3306002_Content: On maps that support Autopilot, you can set specific markers as the destination. A recommended route will be plotted on the current road network, allowing you to reach the destination manually or via Autopilot.
GuideTutorialPage_3306003_Content: Autopilot Mode allows free camera movement and will automatically avoid obstacles (such as traffic) on the road. During Autopilot, feel free to move around the camera, listen to the Heart Radio Channel, take photos, and switch to Cinematic Mode when available.
GuideTutorialPage_3306004_Content: On highways, Autopilot Mode can still be activated even without a destination, and the expedition motorbike will loop along a designated route on the current road network until you exit the mode.

GuideTutorialPage_3306402_Content:

During this time, route network reconstruction will increase the Network Activity of this area and unlock various new contents.
GuideTutorialPage_3306403_Content: After completing the route network's reconstruction, use the expedition motorbike's Autopilot Mode to quickly travel to the next Route Constructor and conduct subsequent reconstruction work.

Tutorial_3306502_Title: Assist the Spacetrek Observatory reconstruction project
GuideTutorialPage_33065_Content:
Continue tracking the locations of remaining Route Constructors to complete the route network's reconstruction.
During your exploration, <color=#ffd12f>material collection</color> can be conducted across <color=#ffd12f>various locations in Lahai-Roi</color>.
Each route network completion <color=#ffd12f>increases Network Activity</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3306502_Content:
Once Network Activity <color=#ffd12f>reaches a certain point</color>, project missions become available to further the <color=#ffd12f>Spacetrek Observatory reconstruction project phase</color>.
Completing the Spacetrek Observatory's reconstruction unlocks Weather Simulation, which enables players to change the weather in the Lahai-Roi region.

GuideTutorialPage_31011_Content: Some of the Resonators' attacks accumulate Off-Tune Level on certain enemies. The enemy enters the <color=#ffd12f>Mistune</color> state once their Off-Tune Level is full.
GuideTutorialPage_3101102_Content: An indicator will pop up when the Resonator attacks or successfully Dodges an enemy in Mistune state. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} to perform a powerful <color=#ffd12f>Tune Break</color>, and break the enemy's Mistune state.
GuideTutorialPage_3101103_Content: Hitting the enemy with Tune Break interrupts them, clearing their Off-Tune Level, and forcing them into the Tune Disruption state.
GuideTutorialPage_3101104_Content: While the enemy casts certain skills or is in certain phases, Off-Tune Level cannot be accumulated. The enemy cannot enter Mistune state during this time. The state will be removed if the enemy is already in Mistune.
GuideTutorialPage_3101105_Content: Some enemies will be exposed to Mistune when casting certain skills or in a certain state.
GuideTutorial_32047_GroupName: Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade and Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon
Tutorial_32047_Title: Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade and Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon
GuideTutorialPage_32045_Content:
When Hyvatia opens its Eye of Prediction, it observes and records Resonators' Dodges and Counterattacks.
Afterwards, Hyvatia's next attack cannot be Dodged or Counterattacked.
GuideTutorialPage_32046_Content: Reactor Husk's special ranged attack, Cinder Cut, can be deflected back, dealing damage to the Reactor Husk and reducing its Vibration Strength.
GuideTutorialPage_3204602_Content: After attacking or taking Counterattacks several times, a Vulnerable Core will be exposed on Reactor Husk's left arm. Attacking the exposed core will destroy Reactor Husk's armor, rendering it unable to attack.
GuideTutorialPage_32047_Content: Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade and Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon take more DMG for a certain period of time after being hit by Tune Break.
GuideTutorialPage_32048_Content: The mechanical horns on its head can be damaged by Counterattacks. Successfully breaking the horns will reduce its attack power and range.
GuideTutorialPage_32049_Content: The Mining Reindeer's pulse beam can be deflected to deal damage to itself.
GuideTutorialPage_3204902_Content: The mechanical antlers on the Mining Reindeer's head can be damaged by Counterattacks. Successfully breaking the antlers will reduce its attack power.
GuideTutorialPage_32050_Content: The mechanical antlers on the Flora Reindeer's head can be damaged by Counterattacks. Successfully breaking the antlers will reduce its attack power.
GuideTutorialPage_32051_Content: Dreamless enters the Looming Turmoil state upon recovering from the Immoblization for the first time. During this state, Dreamless sends out deflectable Halberd of Destruction and Vectors of Ruin, which reduces Dreamless's Vibration Strength if successfully deflected. Dodging Halberd of Destruction and Vectors of Ruin cannot trigger Successful Dodges.
GuideTutorialPage_3205102_Content: Dreamless will unleash Twilight Eve after entering Looming Turmoil. Reduce Dreamless's Vibration Strength to below 50% to interrupt the channeling of Twilight Eve.
GuideTutorialPage_32052_Content: Hitting Spacetrek Explorer with Tune Break disables its shield generator, removing its active Shield and preventing new ones from generating.
GuideTutorialPage_32053_Content: Hitting Sabercat Prowler with Tune Break forces it out of Invisibility.
GuideTutorialPage_3205302_Content:
Sabercat Prowler lacks vision and relies on dodgeable frequency waves to locate enemies.
Before locating an enemy's position, Sabercat Prowler will not actively attack and periodically emit positioning frequency waves to locate the enemy. Once an enemy is located, Sabercat Prowler will initiate an attack and continue emitting positioning frequency waves to track the enemy's movements.
GuideTutorialPage_33061_Content: Consume Energy to activate Boost, giving you an increase in top speed and enhanced climbing performance. Energy regenerates while not in use.
GuideTutorialPage_34202_Content:
Inside the Solisylum, the Heliogyre has been deactivated.
Rotate six <color=#ffd12f>Stars</color> to realign their beams toward the Heliogyre and reactivate it.
GuideTutorialPage_34203_Content: Use the Grapple to reach the Mechascout: Transition's hand.
GuideTutorialPage_3420302_Content: While in the Transition interface, aim in the direction you wish to Transition.
GuideTutorialPage_34204_Content: The motorbike gains a speed boost after driving onto a ramp and another when passing through the blue screen, allowing you to perform unique stunts.
GuideTutorialPage_34205_Content: Drive through the blue screen to enter Owlwatch Hacking
GuideTutorialPage_3420502_Content:
After passing through the barrier area, you enter a slow-motion hacking mode.
<color=#ffd12f>Rotate the camera to aim</color> at multiple targets. Once a target is marked,  {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the button to complete the hack.
GuideTutorialPage_34206_Content: Interact to quickly travel to your destination.
GuideTutorialPage_34207_Content: The motorbike is equipped with an Adaptive Hook module that has a variable range when the player is mounted or dismounted.
GuideTutorialPage_34208_Content: Some Soliskin gone astray way across Lahai-Roi. Find and guide them back to Bjartr Woods.
GuideTutorialPage_34209_Content: During Exploration Quest “Where Light Takes Shape,” Rovers will need to gather Soliskin, which will accompany you as you travel through <color=#ffd12f>Bjartr Woods</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3420902_Content: While inside the giant trees of Solvein Canopy, certain devices can only be activated with the help of the Soliskin's powers. Locate the <color=#ffd12f>Solis Orb</color>, and assemble enough Soliskin to activate these devices.
GuideTutorialPage_3420903_Content:
If you leave Bjartr Woods during the quest, Soliskin will stay and rest in the Woods until you return.
After the quest is completed, Soliskin return to Solvein Canopy and will no longer follow you.
GuideTutorialPage_34210_Content:
When a "Cassette" bearer is lost to a Void Storm, the Cassette is corrupted and its data disrupted. It becomes a Tape of Last Words.
Now, a mech in Solsworn attire seeks these Tapes of Last Words to cleanse their Voidmatter contamination and restore the data within.
GuideTutorialPage_34211_Content: You can utilize the Adaptive Hook module on the motorbike to grab resources, Sonance Caskets, and other items over long distances.
GuideTutorialPage_34212_Content: Resonance Beacon is activated automatically when you ride through its range.
GuideTutorialPage_34213_Content: You and your Terminal's interaction ranges increase while riding the motorbike.
GuideTutorialPage_34214_Content: The expedition motorbike's force field can break destructible obstacles on the road.
GuideTutorialPage_34215_Content: You may view and equip all available Echoes in the edit page. Use Utility: Projector to call out the selection menu and choose the Echo to be projected. Some areas present puzzles that require special interactions. Use the Projector to create the appropriate Echo Projection to help your exploration.
GuideTutorialPage_34216_Content: In Lahai-Roi, Zip Zap can detect immobilized Spacetrek Explorers nearby and release an electrical pulse to get them back online.
GuideTutorialPage_34217_Content: In Lahai-Roi, Zip Zap can detect broken power lines nearby and release an electrical pulse to reconnect the line.
GuideTutorialPage_34218_Content: Geospiders S4 in Lahai-Roi gravitate towards places bathed in Lumiglow where they perform Lumiglow Revelation. Once the revelation is complete, the Lumiglow fades, revealing the hidden objects inside.
GuideTutorialPage_34219_Content: In Lahai-Roi, Mining Reindeer can sense nearby Soliskin sealed inside special Luxites. The reindeer can fire a sustained laser beam to break the rock's outer shell, allowing you to free the trapped Soliskin.
GuideTutorialPage_34220_Content: You can use certain environmental structures as glide rails while riding the motorbike.
GuideTutorialPage_3422002_Content: When approaching a glide rail, the Jump button will light up and switch to a Rail Glide button. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} this button to make the motorbike leap onto the rail and enter Rail Glide. Landing on the rail from the air will also trigger Rail Glide.
GuideTutorialPage_34221_Content: When aproaching the rail, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the Jump button to enter Rail Glide.
GuideTutorialPage_3422102_Content: While riding on the Cruise Conduit, you can jump to adjacent Cruise Conduits. Use Jump while holding down directional buttons to jump off the conduit in the corresponding directions.
GuideTutorialPage_3422103_Content: You earn Riding Points by Rail Gliding. Use Rail Drift to collect points on both sides of the rail. Use Bounce Jump to collect points in the air. Earn enough Riding Points to claim Shell Credits rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_34222_Content: Riding the motorbike through rings of three separate colors restores various amounts of Energy in descending order: Gold, Pink, and Blue.
GuideTutorialPage_34223_Content: Ride the expedition motorbike through Score Rings to <color=#ffd12f>collect points</color> while riding toward the finish line.
GuideTutorialPage_34224_Content: While riding the expedition motorbike, use the Pathfinder's Trailer Ramp to jump.
GuideTutorialPage_34225_Content: Startorch Academy's holographic printers can print device components from the Academy.
GuideTutorialPage_34226_Content:
Voidmatter Orbs are spawned as the Voidworm burrows and surfaces from the ground.
Ride the motorbike and collect Voidmatter Orbs to increase the Energy Pulse charging progress.
GuideTutorialPage_3422602_Content: Photonic Beam can be fired when Energy Pulse is 100% charged.
GuideTutorialPage_3422603_Content: Photonic Beam deals massive damage to the Voidworm.
GuideTutorialPage_37013_Content: Novelty is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. They are items with unique powers.
GuideTutorialPage_3701302_Content:
Novelties can be placed onto the Deployment Zone like Echoes, but do not directly participate in the Battle Stage. Instead, they influence the duel with unique abilities, such as Quick-Deploy, drawing extra cards, or boosting stats.
Keep in mind that Novelties usually last for a limited time or have a set number of uses, and will be shuffled back to your deck after their duration or uses are finished.
While you can only deploy up to 4 Echoes, Novelties have no such limit.
GuideTutorialPage_37014_Content: Domain is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. These cards possess extremely powerful abilities that can shift the tide of any duel.
GuideTutorialPage_3701402_Content: You may only include one Domain card in your deck. Each Domain features a powerful Active Skill, such as Energy recovery, drawing extra cards, and Quick-Deploy. They can even gain new effects if your deck meets certain requirements.
GuideTutorialPage_37016_Content:
<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blocker</color> is the core component of the Smartprint Cube. It can be moved along the circuit as long as there is enough secure space along its path.
<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blockers</color> come in two forms, each with different secure space requirements to move.
GuideTutorialPage_3701602_Content:
Use <color=#ffd12f>Directional Input</color> to control the Blocker's movements. Move the <color=#ffd12f>Cube Blocker</color> to the <color=#ffd12f>Endpoint Module</color> to bring the Smartprint Cube back online.
Long Cube Blockers (1x2) must be perfectly aligned to trigger the Smartprint Cube's compilation.
Use the <color=#ffd12f>Reset</color> button to reset the progress.
GuideTutorialPage_37017_Content:
Bounce Modules launch the Cube Blocker two blocks in the arrow's direction, allowing the Blocker to bypass faulty components on circuit modules.
Long Cube Blockers must be perfectly aligned to trigger this module.
The module will not be triggered if there is not enough secure space for the Blocker in the target direction.
GuideTutorialPage_37018_Content: Faulty Components in the circuit cannot be passed through and can be destroyed through other means.
GuideTutorialPage_3701802_Content:
Move the Blocker to the button connected to the Faulty Component to break the component.
Long Cube Blockers must be perfectly aligned to trigger the module.
GuideTutorialPage_37019_Content: The module will crack and disappear after the Cube Blocker passes through.
GuideTutorialPage_37020_Content:
Some compilation processes will involve multiple Cube Blockers. All Cube Blockers must reach the corresponding Endpoint Module to complete compilation.
You can only control one Cube Blocker at a time. Use the <color=#ffd12f>Switch</color> button to change between Blockers.

HelpText_479_Content:
[About]
A team of Royan herders has run into trouble while guiding their Exoswarm across the frostlands. Now, they need your help to track down the strays.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during the Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
During the event, "Migration Mayhem" stages unlock daily and come in Easy and Hard difficulties. The Easy and Hard levels include 1 and 2 lost Exoswarm respectively.

You and the Exoswarm will take turns to move in the game. You may place the Royan Shepherd's Staffs in the frostlands as barriers, use terrain features such as sinkholes and ice walls to restrict the Exoswarm's movement and surround them, and guide the lost Exoswarm back to the migration pack.

Fully surround the Exoswarm to complete the stage. Upon completion, you will receive rewards such as Astrites and upgrade Materials. Your personal record will be logged as the minimum number of Shepherd's Staffs used during each challenge.
You fail the challenge if you fail to surround the Exoswarm before they escape the current frostlands area and cause them to be lost in sight. You will need to reattempt the stage.

You may repeat each stage after its first completion. You can retry challenges as many times as needed to refresh your personal record.

HelpText_507_Title: Rein Back! Migration Mayhem!—Easy and Hard Mode Details
HelpText_507_Content:
[Difficulty]
Each stage comes in Easy and Hard difficulties, which involve 1 and 2 lost Exoswarm respectively.

[Turn Order]
Easy: Player and 1 Exoswarm take turns to move, and player moves first.
Hard: Player and 2 Exoswarm take turns to move in this order: Player → 1st Exoswarm→ Player → 2nd Exoswarm, repeat.

[Game Rules] 
- Victory Condition: You clear the level when all Exoswarm are completely surrounded  with no way of escaping.
- Failure Condition: You lose the level when any Exoswarm flees the current frostlands area.

[Requesting Aid]
You may choose to accept aid from the herders after failing or resetting a level 3 and 6 times respectively. Once accepted, the herders will place several Shepherd's Staff in the frostlands in advance to make it easier to surround the Exoswarm.

You may reattempt both Easy and Hard levels after the first clearance.
HelpText_509_Content:
[About]
The frostlands of Lahai-Roi beckon the curious. Many find their eyes fixed upon the endless white expanses. Truth seekers walk this polar region, one step at a time, chasing but echoes of truth in this land of snow where silence reigns. Now, join them in their exploration of the frostlands and go where no one has ever been before.

[Eligibility]
Reach the Frostlands Surface during Main Quest "The Star That Voyages Far" for the first time.

[Event Rules]
- The event is divided into four phases, each unlocking as you progress through the Main Quest. Complete event tasks to earn generous rewards.
- If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
- Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode, and Quest Tracking is not available while in certain areas of the quest.
