HelpText_512_Content:
Data Modification can adjust the stats of Echoes.

Use a Modifier to adjust the first Mainstat of a selected Echo into the designated stat. This can only be done on unupgraded 5-star Echoes.
1 Modifier is consumed for each Mainstat Modification.

Use a Transducer to adjust the Substats of a selected Echo to random stats, excluding locked Substats. This can only be done on fully tuned 5-star Echoes.

The number of locked Substats determines the amount of Transducers consumed in each Modification:
With 2 or fewer locked stats, consume 1 Transducer.
With 3 locked stats, consume 2 Transducers.
With 4 locked stats, consume 3 Transducers.
You may choose whether to apply the Modification results in Substat Modification. Discarding the result does not refund used Transducers.

Substat Modification results that are not confirmed due to unexpected errors will be saved in the server for up to 30 days. Please confirm your results in time.

GuideTutorialPage_3605002_Content: During a match, light gates granting buffs appear along the track. Steer H.E.R.M.E.S. through them to collect these buffs (Up to 1 each time.)
GuideTutorialPage_3605003_Content: Redundant system data manifests into enemies on the track. Shoot them down to claim buffs, or crash through them to clear the path. But crashing causes DMG equal to the enemies' remaining HP.
GuideTutorialPage_36051_Content: Special stages feature a boss enemy that stays on the track for a limited time, continuously attacking the biker with projectiles.
GuideTutorialPage_3605102_Content: Defeating the boss grants Support Items with special buffs, which the biker can claim based on their current build.
GuideTutorialPage_3605103_Content: Failing to defeat the boss before the countdown ends results in the boss crashing into the biker, dealing DMG based on its remaining HP. The challenge progress is saved after the boss is defeated and Support Items are claimed.
GuideTutorialPage_36052_Content: Elites are tougher enemies with higher HP. Defeat them promptly, or the biker will fail to dodge them and take damage.
GuideTutorialPage_36053_Content: In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S. is equipped with the Main Weapon: Zap Module. It fires an additional laser beam at regular intervals, dealing massive damage.
GuideTutorialPage_36054_Content: In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S. is equipped with the Main Weapon: Repeater Module. It fires multiple projectiles in a short burst, making it a good choice for focusing fire on a single target.
GuideTutorialPage_36055_Content: In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S. is equipped with the Main Weapon: Shotgun Module. It fires multiple projectiles at once in a wide, front-facing fan area, making it a good choice for dealing with groups of enemies.
GuideTutorialPage_36056_Content: In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Orbital Strike Protocol. When attacking, it automatically locks onto targets and calls down an orbital laser strike, dealing area damage to the designated zone.
GuideTutorialPage_36057_Content: In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Sustained Combustion Protocol. It fires projectiles that inflict a burning effect, continuously dealing damage to the target.
GuideTutorialPage_36058_Content: In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Guided Missile Protocol. It automatically fires a guided projectile that locks and attacks the closest target.
GuideTutorialPage_36059_Content: In Endless Track, H.E.R.M.E.S. continuously generates new track segments, introducing more buffs and powerful boss enemies. Push to your limits and challenge your own record!

GuideTutorialPage_36043_Content:
Objective: Corner the Exoswarm and block all their escape routes.
Defeat: The target Exoswarm escape the area and can no longer be sighted.

Abby's tip: Strayed Exoswarm are easily spooked. Place the Shepherd's Staffs around the outer edges first to make things easier.
GuideTutorialPage_36044_Content: Join the event "Where Stars Cascade Down" to raise the Vibe Gauge by helping Cobb Copo decorate the Fest Areas and spread more cheer.
GuideTutorialPage_3604402_Content: Increase the Vibe Gauge to unlock more area decorations and gameplay content.
GuideTutorialPage_36045_Content: Invite your companions to play a two-player card game during the Lone Star event. Complete a game with one companion to unlock the next companion for invitation.
GuideTutorialPage_3604502_Content: Your companions have their own special skills that may turn the tide of the game.
GuideTutorialPage_36046_Content:
Each player starts with 8 cards in hand. A coin toss decides who goes first each turn. 
Each player draws a card from their opponent's hand in their own turn. 
The first player to run out of cards wins the game.
GuideTutorialPage_3604602_Content: Two identical cards in your hand form a "pair." Try playing pairs to run out the cards you have as quickly as possible.
GuideTutorialPage_3604603_Content:
Every player starts with 2 HP. Drawing the Crownless Card loses 1 HP.
Losing all HP loses the game.
GuideTutorialPage_36047_Content:
You may use Instant Veto whenever the opponent draws a special card from you to cancel the draw and force a redraw. 
This skill can be used once per game.
GuideTutorialPage_36048_Content:
Use different decorations to boost the party's vibe in the Party Decor page. 
Placing decorations fills the Vibe Gauge. 
The gauge of <color=#ffd12f>your current area</color> is displayed in the upper-left corner.
GuideTutorialPage_3604802_Content: After decorating, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} Save Design to save the decorations displayed <color=#ffd12f>in this area</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3604803_Content: Obtain more decorations by increasing the <color=#ffd12f>Vibe Level</color>, visiting the <color=#ffd12f>Decor Shop</color>, and <color=#ffd12f>inviting companions</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_36049_Content: Each companion has her own preferences for drinks. Try to find out their favorite ingredients and flavors through conversation, then create the drink they like best.
GuideTutorialPage_3604902_Content:
Making a drink consists of four steps:
1. Select the first drink base.
2. Select the second drink base.
3. Select add-ins.
4. Select a topping.
The flavor of a drink depends on the combination of bases and add-ins you use, which also determines its type.
GuideTutorialPage_3604903_Content:
Your companion will rate each drink based on how well its flavor matches the order and whether its type is her personal preference. To receive the rewards, you must earn a rating of "Satisfied" or higher.
Earn a "Very Satisfied" rating to unlock bonus dialogue.
GuideTutorialPage_37028_Content:
There are two forms of <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Module</color> in the circuit:
- <color=#ffd12f>Tangible Module</color> that can block the Cube Blocker.
- <color=#ffd12f>Intangible Module</color> that won't block the Cube Blocker.
GuideTutorialPage_3702802_Content:
When a Cube Blocker passes through a <color=#ffd12f>Data Expansion Module</color>, all <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Modules</color> on the circuit will <color=#ffd12f>switch their form</color>.
However, if another Cube Blocker is already positioned on a <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Module</color>, this <color=#ffd12f>Digital Shadow Module</color> will not switch its form.
Long Cube Blockers (1×2) must be perfectly aligned with the Data Expansion Module to trigger its effect.
GuideTutorialPage_37029_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Laser Beam Modules</color> continuously fire laser beams. These beams can pass through <color=#ffd12f>Intangible Digital Shadow Modules</color> but are blocked by <color=#ffd12f>Tangible Modules</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3702902_Content:
When a Cube Blocker comes into contact with the laser emitted by a
<color=#ffd12f>Laser Beam Module</color>, it will be instantly fused, causing the Smartprint Cube to reboot.

GuideTutorialPage_36060_Content:
The Wild Card changes into a random card (except for the Crownless Card) in the player's hand at the start of each turn. A Wild Card will not change into a card that has already been played or repeat the same transformation in the same turn.
Wild Cards can be used to form pairs, as with standard cards.
GuideTutorialPage_36065_Content:
Exoswarm Containment Units will appear on the terrain in this challenge. When Exoswarm moves onto a Containment Unit, it enters a Rest state and skips its next turn.
Compact and inconspicuous, Containment Units are difficult for Exoswarm to detect. As a result, Exoswarm will not actively avoid them while moving.
GuideTutorialPage_32054_Content:
Sigillum gains a stack of Off Course when hit by Echo Skill, stacking up to 5 times. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
Each stack of Off Course makes Sigillum take 10% more total DMG. At 5 stacks, the total DMG taken is increased by another 30%.
GuideTutorialPage_31012_Content:
The guidance you gave Aemeath in childhood is now in the blade she raises to protect her family. Within a limited time, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to have Aemeath cast the techniques you once taught her, unleashing a joint combo attack. 
During this duration, Aemeath cannot use her Echo Skill or Resonance Liberation.
GuideTutorialPage_31013_Content: Aemeath can switch between her human and mech form by casting Resonance Skill.
GuideTutorialPage_3101302_Content: If Aemeath casts Resonance Skill within a certain time after performing Basic Attack Stage 2, 3, or 4, she can cast Chained Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge or Sync Strike: Call of Dawn. After that, Aemeath can perform Basic Attacks or Chained Resonance Skill to increase her Synchronization Rate.
GuideTutorialPage_3101303_Content:
When her Synchronization Rate reaches 50%, Aemeath can cast Resonance Skill within a certain time after performing Basic Attack Stage 4, then cast Chained Skill Seraphic Duet: Overture or Seraphic Duet: Encore.
After that, Aemeath can cast Enhanced Chained Resonance Skill, Intro Skill, or Resonance Liberation to increase her Resonance Rate.
When her Synchronization Rate and Resonance Rate are full, Aemeath can cast Enhanced Resonance Liberation - Heavenfall Edict: Finale.
GuideTutorialPage_32055_Content:
The Nameless Explorer ascends into the sky, preparing to cast Reckoning of Stars.
Use the stars on the battlefield to move to the upper platform, then use the Grapple to pull down the shadow of the fallen space station and interrupt the skill.
GuideTutorialPage_32056_Content:
While in Tune Strain – Shifting, the Nameless Explorer gains an additional stack of Tune Strain – Interfered when hit by Tune Break.
Resonators can inflict up to 2 additional stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the Nameless Explorer.
Each Tune Strain stack further increases the total DMG it takes by 4%.
GuideTutorialPage_32057_Content:
After remaining in combat for a period of time, they will enter the Rage Feather state and be enhanced.
When hit by Tune Break, they will exit the Rage Feather state.
If they are hit by Tune Break while in Tune Rupture - Shifting, their All-Attribute RES is greatly reduced.
Successfully performing a Counterattack can damage their crest and wings, weakening their attacks and reducing the number of ranged projectiles.
GuideTutorialPage_32058_Content:
When Glommoth enters combat, it gains Frost Armor, which grants additional resistance.
When Fusion Burst on it reaches 3 stacks, Glommoth will lose the Frost Armor, along with the extra resistance it provides.
GuideTutorialPage_3205802_Content: Glommoth's left tusk can be damaged. Once broken, Glommoth will lose some of its combat abilities.
GuideTutorialPage_34231_Content:
In the frostlands, Glommoths can sense and shatter massive ice formations.
Shattering the ice reveals paths and objects once sealed by the cold.
GuideTutorialPage_34232_Content:
In the frostlands, Glommoths can interact with Soliskin hiding within caves.
Look for glimmering caves where the Soliskin hide, then use the Glommoth Projection to uncover the secrets they conceal.
GuideTutorialPage_34233_Content:
Use the Support Module to break the ice and activate the Voidmatter Forcefield, then enter it with the Grapple Point.
Entering the forcefield while riding your motorbike will charge it up, launching you into a powerful leap.
Entering the forcefield on foot will cause you to glide automatically and ascend into the air.
GuideTutorialPage_34234_Content: Activate the Glacier Probe to shatter ice and reveal objects that were once frozen beneath the glacier.
GuideTutorialPage_34235_Content: In certain environments, the expedition motorbike can use the <color=#ffd12f>Glacier Track Module</color> to create frozen tracks, allowing it to travel across the terrain.
GuideTutorialPage_34236_Content: The expedition motorbike now has access to additional features. When approaching targets a Support Module can destroy, the module will be summoned automatically to aim at them.
GuideTutorialPage_34237_Content:
In regions with stable signals, you may find Module Adapters at bases left by Startorch Academy. 
These devices detect frequencies disrupted by Voidmatter and manifest them as Adaptive Modules.
GuideTutorialPage_3423702_Content: Use the Module Adapter to shoot the Unstable Frequency Cores, switching them between their tangible and intangible states.
GuideTutorialPage_3423703_Content: When the Module Adapter is equipped, certain Stable Adaptive Modules will automatically respond and form a persistent route.
GuideTutorialPage_3423704_Content: When the Module Adapter is equipped, you can pass through the Unstable Barriers.
GuideTutorialPage_34238_Content: Void Barriers cannot be passed through, even with the Module Adapter equipped.
GuideTutorialPage_34239_Content: When the Module Adapter is equipped, you can detect and collect Exoenergy affected by Voidmatter. After collecting it, you can proceed along the designated route at a higher speed.
GuideTutorialPage_34240_Content: The Mass Relay Device's energy core can restore the Etheric Sea Droplets disrupted by Voidmatter to a stable state, clearing obstacles that block your path.
GuideTutorialPage_3424002_Content: After interacting with the Mass Relay Device, you can use it to jump between different sector platforms within the space station.
GuideTutorialPage_34241_Content: When the Soliskin absorb the Reactor's rays, some excess energy spills into the surrounding environment. Collecting it grants a movement speed boost.
GuideTutorialPage_34242_Content:
Across the frostlands, Void Storms are contaminating the Soliskin.
Guide the Soliskin toward the corrupted Giant Soliskin to help cleanse it.
GuideTutorialPage_3424202_Content:
A path formed from Adaptive Modules has appeared on the field.
Fire a projectile at the <color=#ffd12f>Unstable Frequency Core</color> to shift nearby <color=#ffd12f>Adaptive Modules</color> between their two states.
However, <color=#ffd12f>Solidified Modules</color> (shown in gray) cannot be altered by the <color=#ffd12f>Unstable Frequency Core</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3424203_Content:
Soliskin can move along a continuous line of materialized <color=#ffd12f>Adaptive Modules</color>.
They can jump up one level and will automatically jump down when encountering a gap.
Once a Soliskin determines that it can reach the Giant Soliskin, it will begin moving on its own.
Adjust the <color=#ffd12f>Adaptive Modules</color> on the field and guide all Soliskin safely to the Giant Soliskin.
GuideTutorialPage_34243_Content:
There are two waves of enemies within the Void Storm Zone in the Frostlands Surface. 
Due to the Void Storm, Resonators lose HP each second, and their Healing received and Healing Bonus are halved. Resonators will be inflicted with Warp upon being hit, increasing the DMG they take. 
Unleashing Tune Break on enemies in the second wave will trigger Recurrence Impact. This impact deals AoE damage, restores HP to the active Resonator, and removes all stacks of Warp.
GuideTutorialPage_36066_Content:
Ice Walls will appear on the terrain in this challenge as temporary obstacles on the frostlands. After a certain number of turns, they will melt and disappear.
While active, Ice Walls block Exoswarm movement. Exoswarm cannot move onto tiles occupied by an Ice Wall.

GuideTutorialPage_3605302_Content: H.E.R.M.E.S. now has access to the active skill Boost. Driving forward charges up the skill. When Boost is activated, H.E.R.M.E.S. gains a burst of speed, becomes immune to impacts from normal enemies and projectiles from bosses, and automatically collects all light gate buffs along the track.

HelpText_528_Content:
[About]
Outside the Mind Dive Arcade, a student named Tetoris beckons you to try the latest "Game of the Year," Lahai-Roi Blocks. The game has many wondrous properties, or so she claims...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14, and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Rules]
A new stage will be unlocked each day during the event.
Each stage has two difficulties: Normal and Hard. Finish the Normal difficulty to unlock the Hard challenge.
Complete the goals of each stage to earn rewards.
HelpText_530_Content:
[Endstate Matrix]
In Endstate Matrix, your skills will be tested through intense combats. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Eligibility]
Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of the Tower of Adversity and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of the Respawning Waters: Torrents in Whimpering Wastes after 3.2 is released.

[Challenge Cycle & Phases]
Endstate Matrix progresses through Challenge Cycles. Each Challenge Cycle spans multiple Challenge Phases, which reset with version updates. Rewards are offered independently for Challenge Cycles and Challenge Phases 

[Cycle Rewards - Adversity Vanguard]
The current Challenge Cycle is "Adversity Vanguard." Complete the Cycle Tasks and Challenge Tasks to earn Encrypted Data and unlock exclusive rewards. Encrypted Data will be cleared at the end of the Cycle.
- Cycle Tasks reset at the start of a new Challenge Phase. In Adversity Vanguard, you may earn up to 600 points of Encrypted Data via Cycle Tasks.
- From Cycle 2, 3 Challenge Tasks are updated at each Challenge Phase and last for the duration of the Adversity Vanguard Cycle. In Adversity Vanguard, you may earn 15 points of Encrypted Data via each Challenge Task and up to 195 points in total.

[Matrix]
Endstate Matrix consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion.

[Stability Accords]
You may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge.

[Singularity Expansion]
There is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will open the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.

[Power Circuits]
In Endstate Matrix, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge.

[Demo Resonators]
Demo Resonators are available only if you own the corresponding Resonators. Each Demo Resonator is set to Lv. 90, equipped with a Lv. 90 weapon and a fitting Echo set with Lv. 25 Echoes. They inherit the Resonance Chain from your own Resonators.

[Resonator Enhancements]
In Endstate Matrix, certain Resonators will receive special skill enhancements.

[Viral Infection]
In Singularity Expansion, enemy HP increases by each round, and stronger enemy effects will be unlocked as rounds progress.

[Vigor]
Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.

[Weapon & Echo Occupation]
Different Resonators cannot use the same weapon and Echo in this event. If a Resonator in the team has equipped a weapon or Echo used by another Resonator with a challenge record, you cannot start the challenge with this team.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and obtain access to the expedition motorbike during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands."

[Event Rules]
1. During the exam, explore, defeat powerful foes, and repair Mechascouts across Lahai-Roi to earn plenty rewards including Astrites.

[GPA Level]
Defeating enemies around the Grand and Common Knights for the first time grants GPA Level EXP.

[Interim GPA Level]

HelpText_532_Content:
Echo Smart Discard provides two discard methods: Suggested Plan and Custom Management Plan. They can be selected at the same time.

Based on the selected methods, Echo Smart Discard can quickly filter and discard owned Echoes that are unupgraded, unequipped, and not locked.
HelpText_538_Content:
[About]
Enter the world of the Stellar Orbit Beats and pilot your spacecraft through the boundless universe.
Press buttons to the beat in a music face-off with other Resonators.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock (for the best experience, please complete this event's preceding quest "Gold Suspended in Shadows").

[Rules]
1. You can access the event via the Stellar Orbit Beats machine in the Mind Dive Arcade or through the Event Page. Pilot your spacecraft alongside other Resonators and hit the notes in time with the music to complete the track. A stage is completed once the spacecraft completes its journey.
2. Fly through space and press the buttons to the beat! Hit the Notes at the right timing to earn Stage Points. Reach the goals for each stage to unlock rewards.
3. Based on your final score, you will receive a Stage Rating of SSS, SS, S, A, or B. A stage will not be finalized if you quit mid-way.
4. Each music track has 3 difficulties: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Easy and Normal are unlocked by default. Hard is unlocked after completing the goals on Normal difficulty.
5. You can team up with unlocked Companion Resonators to challenge a stage together. Each Companion Resonator has their own skills that provide unique buffs.
6. Each track's Hard difficulty features a Friend Ranking leaderboard. Think you've mastered the beats? Compete with your friends for the top spot!
7. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your in-game mailbox automatically if you log in within 30 days after the event ends.

HelpText_558_Content:
To every Rover who's walked this long road with us, thank you for being here.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
Log in during the event period to claim the rewards.
Rewards for this event will NOT be reissued via in-game mail once the event ends. Please pay close attention to the event time and claim the rewards beforehand.
HelpText_559_Content:
[About]
To encourage the Pioneers to further share their explorations of the Roya Frostlands, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs to get various rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during the Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
- During the event, complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs.
- Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package. Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards.
- There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
HelpText_561_Content:
[About]
Beneath Lahai-Roi, the Solvein Heartwood towers overhead, as though holding up those long, shadowed ages. Innumerable motes drift here like traces of a past not yet extinguished, ancient and silent, waiting for an answer. Follow the light downward, and amid layers of dust, listen as those bygone days begin to wake.

[Eligibility]
Reach the Grand Architect's illusion during Main Quest "Wishes in the Bell" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
- The event is divided into four phases, each unlocking as you progress through the Main Quest. Complete event tasks to earn generous rewards.
- If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
- Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode, and Quest Tracking is not available while in certain areas of the quest.
HelpText_259_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 5.

[Event Rules]
Complete Spindrift Tasks to earn Spindrifts, which can be exchanged for various items in the Bountiful Waves.
Spindrift Tasks include Activity Tasks and Convene Tasks:
- Featured Resonator Convene tasks can be completed through Featured Resonator Convene. Weapon Convene tasks can be completed through Featured Weapon Convene. Some tasks can be completed multiple times. Please note that the Convene tasks above cannot be fulfilled through other ways, such as New Voyage Resonator Convene or New Voyage Weapon Convene.
- The Lustrous Tide consumption tasks can be completed through Standard Resonator Convene, Standard Weapon Convene, Novice Convene, or Beginner's Choice Convene.
(All Convenes made after the Version 3.3 update will count toward task progress.)

[Important Notes]
Spindrift Task and Bountiful Waves are both limited-time events, and their event duration may differ. Please pay close attention to their schedules.
- If the Spindrift Task ends but the Bountiful Waves is still available, any unclaimed Spindrifts will be automatically claimed upon login.
- If you log in within 30 days after the Bountiful Waves has ended, unused Spindrifts will be automatically converted into Shell Credits at a rate of 1:1000.
- If you log in after that 30-day period, any unclaimed Spindrifts will no longer be claimable, and any remaining Spindrifts will be cleared. Please pay attention to the event period and participate in the event accordingly.
GuideTutorialPage_36084_Content:
The Knight will hurl you directly to the Boss challenge!
Repairing the Knights will significantly weaken the Boss and boost your combat strength. We recommend repairing all the Knights first.

HelpText_572_Content:
[About]
To help Solaris prepare for future crises, the Black Shores and Spacetrek Collective have launched a new hologram simulation project. At Yhoran’s invitation, you and your companions step up to take part, ready to fight for humanity's survival in a simulated doomsday.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14, and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Choose a participating Resonator and dive into simulated combat drills! Under a special tactical view, use your weapons wisely to fend off waves of enemies. As you battle, power up your Resonator with new weapons, weapon upgrades, and boost items. To clear a drill, you must survive every wave of attack.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
HelpText_573_Content:
1. Skill Tests come in three types: Training, Op Record, and Challenge.
2. In Training and Op Record stages, the participating Resonators are fixed. In Challenge stages, you can choose any Resonator you like.
3. Clear specific stages to unlock new Resonators, Weapons, and Items.
4. The available charges and CD of Dash vary with stage difficulties.
HelpText_574_Content:
1. Each participating Resonator has a unique passive skill, offering different boosts and distinct combat styles.
2. Each Resonator comes with their own fixed default Weapon.
3. In Infinite Mode: Last Stand, every Resonator will bring a set of default Weapons and Items that match their personal style.
HelpText_575_Content:
1. Clearing a stage or completing specific stage objectives will unlock new Resonators, Weapons, and Items.
2. You can check the details of unlocked content in the Codex.
3. The Codex also shows how to obtain any locked content.
HelpText_418_Content:
The "Back to Solaris" web event is now live! Participate to earn up to 530 Astrites.
Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts!

[Eligibility]
Union Level ≥ 8.

[Rules]
1. Share your invitation code with up to 3 Returning Players in your server, complete in-game tasks to obtain Startorch Sigils, and exchange them for up to Astrite x480 and Shell Credit x300,000.
2. Returning Players can link their accounts with the Player of their choice by using their corresponding invitation code. This can be done once and cannot be changed later. After linking, Returning Players are eligible to claim a reward of Astrite x50, Advanced Enclosure TankⅡx5, and Shell Credit x50,000.

※ In-game reward Mail can be claimed within 30 days after the issuance of the reward. 
※ Upon completing an event task, there may be a slight delay before you can claim the rewards. If this occurs, please wait at least 2 minutes before refreshing the page or restarting the game.
※ A Returning Player cannot be both the inviter and invitee of another Returning Player.

[Returning Player Eligibility]
1. Union Level ≥ 8.
2. Has not logged into the game for at least 14 consecutive days immediately before the start of this event or before April 16, 2026, 03:59 (UTC+8).
3. Eligible Returning Players will retain their status for the duration of this event.
HelpText_577_Content:
[Event Rules]
Use Lucy's Resonance Ability to bring up the Breach Protocol Interface. Select codes from the code matrix to place them in the buffer. In order to complete the hack, match your code sequence in the buffer with the sequence required to upload.

Start from the first row of the code matrix. After selecting a code, the next must be from the same column. Then select from the same row. Keep alternating between column and row with each pick.

Selected codes fill the buffer to match the target sequence. If your code does not match a target sequence in exact order, you must restart that sequence from the beginning.

The breach fails if the remaining empty slots in the buffer are fewer than the unmatched codes in the target sequence.

The breach succeeds only when every target sequence is fully matched.
HelpText_576_Content:
[About]
As frequencies spill forth from the Somnoire, Lucy seeks your assistance in breaching the dreamscape to contain the problem.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 to unlock.

[Rules]
Within the 7 days after the "Matrix Reform” event begins, a new "Breach Protocol" stage will unlock each day at 04:00 server time.
Each stage includes Normal and Hard modes. Completing a challenge on a given difficulty for the first time will grant the corresponding challenge rewards.
HelpText_578_Content:
[About]
The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, and deep within the Dream Abode, a crisis brews...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and unlock the Resonance Nexus of the Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands."

[Event Rules]
1. After the event begins, speak with Namipon at Lahai-Roi to accept the quest and start the challenge.
2. The challenge features two "Surface of Illusions" stages and one "Depth of Illusions" stage. Before entering, you can adjust the reward rate via Memetic Tuning. Higher rates yield greater rewards. Clearing stages earns you Illusive Specimen and Memory Points.
3. Illusive Specimens can be used to exchange for Astrites and other rewards. 
4. Spend Memory Points in Thought Evolution to upgrade your abilities, making future challenges easier.
5. In "Depth of Illusions," you can obtain Dream Trackers to unlock Dream Abode in Fissure. Use enhancements gained in "Depth of Illusions" and decide your challenge order wisely to defeat the Wardens.

※ You may explore the Illusive Realm with the following Resonators:
※ Resonators available: Denia, Hiyuki, Sigrika, Luuk Herssen, Aemeath, Mornye, Lynae, Chisa, Qiuyuan, Galbrena, Iuno, Augusta, Phrolova, Lupa, Cartethyia, Ciaccona, Zani, Cantarella, Brant, Phoebe, Roccia, Carlotta, Camellya, Shorekeeper, Xiangli Yao, Zhezhi, Changli, Jinhsi, Yinlin, Jiyan, Calcharo, Lingyang, Jianxin, Verina, Encore, Rover: Aero, Rover: Havoc, Rover: Spectro, Buling, Lumi, Youhu, Yuanwu, Danjin, Sanhua, Mortefi, Taoqi, Aalto, Baizhi, Yangyang, and Chixia.
※ The selected Resonator's level, Resonance Chain, and weapon will be carried over in the Illusive Realm, but their Echo stats and Echo skill will not.
※ You may view your Resonators' Attributes via the Dream Tracker. The Stats shown are before the dreamscape enhancements.
※ If Rover's gender or Attribute does not match the record in the Dream Tracker, a trial Rover will be used instead.
HelpText_581_Content:
- Voidmatter Blocks spawn from the ready zone above, which follow your movement, and fall when the timer ends. Evade the falling blocks to avoid being struck.
- Additionally, guide the blocks by moving your character to make them fall at desired positions and prevent blocks from piling up beyond the ready zone.
- Use the rotation buttons to adjust their orientation when the timer's active. Once the block is at the right position and orientation, you can press the drop button to end the timer and have the block fall directly.
- The challenge includes two modes: Normal Mode and Infinite Mode.
- Normal Mode: Achieve victory by reaching the end of the countdown.
- Infinite Mode: Accumulate enough points to achieve victory. Points can be earned by clearing stacked rows of blocks and by manually dropping blocks.

Tutorial_33072_Title: Clearing the Anomalies Around Voidbane Eldertrees
Tutorial_33073_Title: Restoring the Growth of Voidbane Eldertrees
GuideTutorialPage_33072_Content:
<color=#ffd12f>Four rare ancient plant specimens known as Voidbane Eldertrees</color> are waiting to be restored. But Void Storms sweep through the Dimmr Plains year-round, and the trees remain stunted by Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies.
You must first work with the Survey Team members and the Soliskin to clear the <color=#ffd12f>Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies</color> around the Voidbane Eldertrees.
GuideTutorialPage_33073_Content:
The factors hindering the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees have been removed, but after prolonged exposure to Voidmatter, the plants have entered an adaptive dormant state...
<color=#ffd12f>Deliver the corresponding area's "Restoratives"</color> to restore the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees.
GuideTutorialPage_3307302_Content:
Restoratives can be obtained in large quantities from the <color=#ffd12f>recommended tasks and challenges within the corresponding sectors</color>.
In addition to recommended tasks, it can also be obtained from <color=#ffd12f>quests, challenges, and Supply Chests</color>.
You can also check which activities drop this item in the <color=#ffd12f>Exploration Progress</color> page.
GuideTutorialPage_3307303_Content:
Once the Restoration is completed, the Voidbane Eldertrees will resume growth, using their own energy to <color=#ffd12f>form bridges linking nearby survey sectors</color>.
It will also create <color=#ffd12f>support mechanisms</color> within the corresponding survey sectors.
GuideTutorialPage_33074_Content:
Each completed Restoration grants the rare research specimen: Prism Fruit.
Deliver it to <color=#ffd12f>I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp</color> for analysis to advance the survey and <color=#ffd12f>expand the Base Camp</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3307402_Content: Once all Restorations are complete, all Prism Fruits have been delivered, and the <color=#ffd12f>Base Camp has been upgraded to Level 5</color>, the Solvein Heartwood's energy overflow will become even more pronounced, and the Dimmr Plains ecosystem will revive once more.

GuideTutorialPage_36086_Content: Destructible objects will appear in the challenge. They shatter when struck by a Pinball. Some destructibles drop special items that grant temporary buffs when picked up.
GuideTutorialPage_36087_Content: Pinballs gain Burst Points over time. When the Burst Gauge is full, they will enter the Burst state, granting all Pinballs multiple buffs and generating 4 Direction Bounce mechanisms in the field.
GuideTutorialPage_36088_Content: Prism Formation has a special skill. Once activated, it continuously fires lasers and gains a Shield. Break the Shield to interrupt the skill.
GuideTutorialPage_36089_Content: This is a bonus challenge. Every attempt counts as a successful challenge and adds that run's points to your total. Reach certain milestones to claim the corresponding rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_36090_Content: One-way gates that can only be entered from one side begin to spawn in the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_3609002_Content: Obstacles that block Pinballs begin to spawn in the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_36091_Content: Dreamless has a powerful skill. Once activated, it begins charging and gains a Shield. While charging up this skill, Dreamless unleashes hurricane strikes. Break the Shield to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_36092_Content: Omni-Bounce mechanisms begin to spawn in the challenge. When a Pinball collides with one, it bounces straight back along its original path.
GuideTutorialPage_36093_Content: Hecate has a powerful skill. Once activated, she begins charging and gains a Shield. When the charge completes, she flashes and summons Crescent Servant to launch an AoE attack. Break the Shield to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_36094_Content: Directional Bounce mechanisms begin to spawn in the challenge. When a Pinball collides with one, it is launched in a fixed direction.
GuideTutorialPage_36095_Content: Lioness of Glory has a powerful skill. Once activated, she begins charging and gains a Shield. When the charging completes, she summons a ballista to fire. Break the Shield to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_36096_Content: Black Hole mechanisms begin to spawn in the challenge. When a Pinball enters a Black Hole, it is teleported out through the other corresponding Black Hole, retaining its original speed and direction.
GuideTutorialPage_36097_Content: Elegy of the Fallen has a powerful skill. Once activated, it begins charging and gains a Shield. While charging up this skill, Elegy of the Fallen unleashes a multi-stage attack. Break the Shield to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_36098_Content: Hyvatia has a powerful skill. Once activated, it fires lasers continuously and Hyvatia takes more DMG in the duration.
GuideTutorialPage_36099_Content: Reactor Husk has a powerful skill. Once activated, it begins charging and gains a shield. When the charging completes, smoke spreads across the field, and fireballs will shower down. Break the shield to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_36100_Content: Nameless Explorer has a powerful skill. Once activated, it begins charging and gains a Shield. When the charging completes, Nameless Explorer summons a massive meteor to attack. Break the shield to interrupt the charging.
GuideTutorialPage_36101_Content: S-Class Tactical ROMs are Pinball-exclusive special ROMs that can only be equipped by the corresponding Persona Pinballs. Equipping one grants powerful bonuses to that Pinball.

GuideTutorialPage_33075_Content: The upgraded Module unlocks the motorbike's aerial capability. At a certain height, hold Glide to enter the gliding state. Gliding consumes Aerial Energy and ends when Aerial Energy is depleted.
GuideTutorialPage_3307502_Content: While gliding, you can consume Boost Energy to dash. The motorbike will not descend during the dash.
GuideTutorialPage_3307503_Content:
Unlocking the Expansion Module grants Charged Leap.
After unlocking it, hold the Bounce Jump button to use the motorbike's Charged Leap to gain height. Using Charged Leap from the ground will also automatically enter the gliding state.
Charged Leap has a maximum of 3 charges, which replenish over time while the motorbike is on the ground. Charges cannot be replenished in mid-air.
GuideTutorialPage_34252_Content: There are many mysterious caves throughout the Dimmr Plains. Interact with the Light Builder at a cave entrance, then rotate the Exostrider components inside until the projection matches the pattern on the wall to open the cave.
GuideTutorialPage_34253_Content: Voidcreeps release Voidmatter to erode the surrounding environment. Entering the affected area will continuously drain HP and restrict movement.
GuideTutorialPage_34254_Content:
Lumescribe Components can suppress Voidmatter and cleanse Voidcreeps. A Voidcreep's tendrils exposed to light will close up, and its main body will shrink and explode after prolonged exposure.
Standing within a Lumescribe Component's range protects you from the Voidcreeps. The Voidcreep tendrils in the area will only disappear after all Voidcreeps in the area have been removed.
GuideTutorialPage_3425402_Content:
Attack or use the Hoverdroid to shoot the Solvein Heartwood Branch to activate a Lumescribe Component. It can also be activated by the light from another Lumescribe Component.
Interact with a Lumescribe Component to move it between rails.
GuideTutorialPage_3425403_Content: Sometimes obstacles will block the light from a Lumescribe Component. Attack the obstacle to destroy it.
GuideTutorialPage_34255_Content: While standing within a Lumescribe Component's range, your Hoverdroid is empowered. Use it to deal a deadly blow to enemies.
GuideTutorialPage_34256_Content:
The Reactor Drive energy within the Stalaglow Cavern is being eroded by Voidmatter. Purification cannot be completed until the Threnodian creations have been driven off.
Use Lumescribe Components to drive away the Threnodian creations. If the illuminated target is a clone, the clone will be destroyed. If it is the real body, the real body will be shot down.
GuideTutorialPage_34257_Content: When you approach a Royan rune fragment, the rune carved by Sigrika will react. Casting the selected rune power allows you to see the rune fragments scattered throughout the area.
GuideTutorialPage_3425702_Content: Align the scattered rune fragments with the runes on the stone to reveal the complete rune.
GuideTutorialPage_34258_Content:
A special monster left behind in the Voidthirst Cradle. It seems to have no physical form and cannot be attacked or destroyed.
It will relentlessly pursue intruders and drag them into the void, but remains completely still while being observed.
When you see Voidmatter contamination effect at the edge of the screen, she is getting close. Press the button to turn around quickly at such moments.
GuideTutorialPage_34259_Content: Aligning the main body and its reflection triggers resonance, releasing a directional beam that activates nearby mechanisms.
GuideTutorialPage_34260_Content:
Soliskin Platform is created when Soliskin energy is released through a scientific instrument once contaminated by Voidmatter.
The platform itself is made of unstable Soliskin energy. As you move across it, the unstable platform tilts toward your position.
GuideTutorialPage_3426002_Content: Soliskin Platform still obeys the laws of light and cannot pass through opaque objects.
GuideTutorialPage_34261_Content:
When the platform is tilted at the proper angle, you can ask Hiyuki to freeze the Soliskin Platform beneath your feet. A frozen platform temporarily stops tilting.
Use the frozen platform to reach higher ground and continue forward.
GuideTutorialPage_34262_Content:
A branch of the Solvein Heartwood. It seems to still bear traces of Exostrider creations and can store a small amount of Soliskin energy.
Try striking it to awaken the Soliskin energy within, which can be guided to and reactivate the nearest abandoned mechanics.
The Dimmr Plains are abound with such abandoned mechanics: Lumescribe Emitter, Lumescribe Component, and Soliskin Platform.
GuideTutorialPage_34263_Content: Dodge the falling blocks and climb upward using the path they form. First things first, catch up to Denia.
GuideTutorialPage_34264_Content: In Voidmatter Blocks, you must dodge the falling blocks until the countdown ends to win the game.
GuideTutorialPage_3426402_Content:
Before a block falls, it will track horizontally above you for a limited time. You can rotate the block by 90 degrees with the Rotate button.
Once you are in the right position, you can manually drop the block.
GuideTutorialPage_3426403_Content:
While dodging the blocks, be careful not to let the stack rise beyond the ready zone. If it does, the game will also fail.
When Voidmatter Blocks fill an entire row, that row is cleared, reducing the stack height.
GuideTutorialPage_34265_Content: In Voidmatter Blocks: Infinite, you must dodge falling blocks while also adjusting positions and orientations to earn points. Reach certain milestones to claim rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_3426502_Content:
Before a block falls, it will track horizontally above you for a limited time. You can rotate the block by 90 degrees with the Rotate button.
Once you are in the right position, you can manually drop the block. Manually dropping a block grants bonus points.
GuideTutorialPage_3426503_Content:
While dodging the blocks, be careful not to let the stack rise beyond the ready zone. If it does, the game will also fail.
When Voidmatter Blocks fill an entire row, that row is cleared for a large score bonus. The more rows cleared at once, the greater the bonus.
GuideTutorialPage_34266_Content: Once activated, it condenses Exostrider energy into a beam that can clear Voidmatter contamination and certain obstacles.
GuideTutorialPage_3426602_Content: One side of it is a smooth, mirror-like surface. When struck by the Origami Construct's energy, it forms crystals that reflect beams. Can be rotated after interaction.
GuideTutorialPage_3426603_Content: A construct issued by the Spacetrek Collective to members of the Dimmr Plains Survey Team for protection against Voidmatter threats. While aiming, it can alter the state of Rock Mirror.
GuideTutorialPage_34269_Content: Once activated, the Speed Pipe propels the gliding expedition motorbike forward without consuming energy.
GuideTutorialPage_34270_Content: Touch Score Rings to gain points and restore energy.
GuideTutorialPage_34271_Content:
Advance on a designated track, get past any obstacles in your way, and earn enough points to complete the challenge.
Use Drift to slide under barriers or Bounce Jump to leap over obstacles. You may also use Drift to swing out the motorbike through certain spots to grab more points.
GuideTutorialPage_34272_Content: After interaction, a large number of motorbike mechanisms and score items will appear in the field. Earn enough points within the time limit to complete the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_34273_Content: Hiyuki has left traces of her frequency throughout the Dimmr Plains. You can activate the power sealed within them in the face of threats.
GuideTutorialPage_34274_Content: A special plant found in the Dimmr Plains. Use the Projector to blow it away for a possible surprise reward.
GuideTutorialPage_34275_Content: After the Stridergate incident, faint traces of Voidmatter still remain in Lahai-Roi. Use the Voidwing Moth Echo to dispel the Voidmatter residue.
GuideTutorialPage_34276_Content:
In the Dimmr Plains Void Storm Zones, when a Resonator takes enemy damage, they gain 1 stack of Warp, increasing all DMG taken by 10%.
Casting Tune Break Skill on the second wave of enemies restores HP to the Resonator and removes Warp. When the Resonator attacks enemies or inflicts Negative Statuses, enemies lose HP over time for a certain duration. This effect can stack.

GuideTutorialPage_36102_Content:
Rovers can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> a <color=#ffd12f>Cube</color> by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the match <color=#ffd12f>Winner</color>.
Each match begins at 21:00. Support is open from the end of the previous match until 30 minutes before the next one begins (20:30).
GuideTutorialPage_3610202_Content: Each match begins at 21:00. Support is open from the end of the previous match until 30 minutes before the next one begins (20:30).
GuideTutorialPage_3610203_Content:
During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.
Cubes that arrive later at the target pad will stack on top of those that arrived earlier.
GuideTutorialPage_3610204_Content: On each turn, <color=#ffd12f>there is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Skill</color>. Skills have unique effects on how Cubes move. The track also contains mechanisms that can hinder or help their progress.
GuideTutorialPage_3610205_Content:
In each match, the Cube of <color=#ffd12f>the first place</color> wins. Rovers who <color=#ffd12f>supported</color> the winning Cube will <color=#ffd12f>receive</color> Popularity Rewards.
The Popularity Rewards are determined by the Popularity consumed in Support, and the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color>. These odds <color=#ffd12f>refresh at set times</color> based on how much Support the Cube receives.
Race flow differs by Race stages, and match rankings determine whether a Cube <color=#ffd12f>advances</color> to the next match.
GuideTutorialPage_3610206_Content: Race flow differs by Race stages, and match rankings determine whether a Cube <color=#ffd12f>advances</color> to the next match.
GuideTutorialPage_36103_Content:
During a match, Dice rolls decide which Cubes move first and how far.
<color=#ffd12f>There is a chance</color> for a Cube to trigger its own special <color=#ffd12f>Skill</color>. Skills have unique effects on how Cubes move.
Cubes that arrive later at the target pad will stack on top of those that arrived earlier.
GuideTutorialPage_3610302_Content: When Cubes are stacked, if the bottom Cube moves first, it will carry along all the Cubes stacked above it. Among stacked Cubes, the higher up a Cube is, the higher its rank.
GuideTutorialPage_3610303_Content:
During the Support Phase, players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> their favorite Cube by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the <color=#ffd12f>Match Winner</color>.
<color=#ffd12f>Supporting</color> a Cube consumes a player's Popularity. <color=#ffd12f>Popularity</color> can be obtained by completing the event's <color=#ffd12f>Daily Tasks</color>.
If the Cube you Supported wins, you will <color=#ffd12f>receive Popularity Rewards</color> based on [Popularity Given] x [Underdog Odds].
If your prediction turns out wrong, 80% of the Popularity spent on Support will be refunded.
GuideTutorialPage_3610304_Content:
Support is open from the end of the previous match until 30 minutes before the next match begins (20:30).
Based on the Support a Cube receives and its starting position, the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color> are <color=#ffd12f>refreshed</color> daily at 4:00, 12:00, and 18:00. 
Your Popularity Rewards for correctly predicting the winner will depend on the Cube's Underdog Odds. Be sure to keep an eye on any changes to those odds!
GuideTutorialPage_36104_Content:
The Race Page shows all stages of the Race and who's advancing.
The Race consists of 3 stages: Preliminary, Eliminator, and the Final. Each stage has a different schedule structure, which can be viewed in detail on the Race Page.
During the Support Phase, the current Contenders and match will be highlighted. After each match ends, the page will update to show which Contenders advance to the next match.
GuideTutorialPage_3610402_Content:
Some matches have the 1st and 2nd rounds. A Cube's ranking in the 1st round will determine its starting position in the 2nd round.
The number of advancement slots varies by match. Cubes that fail to advance will end their run after competing in a Showmatch.
GuideTutorialPage_3610403_Content: After each match, you can view its replay in the Race Recap page or go directly to Support for the next match.

HelpText_598_Content:
[About]
A strange gate to the Somnoire appears, beyond which a forsaken Dreamland lies. A host of peculiar Echoes have gathered here in diligent labor, striving to restore a lost wonderland to its former glory. You unexpectedly fall into this dreamscape and decide to stay for a while with the Echoes to enjoy the rhapsody this illusory dreamland offers...

[Eligibility] 
Reach Union Level 30 (Complete the Permanent Event "Phantasma Dreamland" first for a better experience).

[Event Rules]
- During this event, you will take charge of a long-abandoned amusement park in the Somnoire and direct the park's Echoes to keep it running. Strategically assign Echoes to maintain the park's stability and prolong its existence.
- <color=#c19f51>The Stage Environment refreshes every Monday</color>. Echoes can only be directed on certain days based on the Stage Environment of the week. Use them to collect Dreamland Coupons to reach the stage goals so that the park may continue to operate.
- Phantasma Dreamland: Rhapsody offers the new features of Strange Encounters and Relics. Different Strange Encounters and Relics provide various effects that give you a new taste of the event.
- <color=#c19f51>Completing Dreamland Stage Goals grants Weekly Activity Points</color>. Weekly Activity Points will no longer be granted once the weekly limit is reached. Accumulate Weekly Activity Points to unlock and claim Weekly Rewards. Weekly Rewards reset at 04:00 a.m. each Monday.
- Weekly Activity Points and Weekly Rewards of a Phase both reset at 04:00 a.m each Monday. If you still have unclaimed Weekly Rewards when they are reset, they will be sent to your Mail.
HelpText_609_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Event Rules]
This event's login rewards are split into regular login rewards and cumulative login rewards.
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim daily sign-in rewards, for total of 10 days. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time.
Once your cumulative login days meet the requirement, the corresponding cumulative login reward will be ready to claim.
After the event ends, any unclaimed login rewards you earned will be reissued via in-game mail within 30 days upon your next login.
HelpText_610_Content:
[About] 
This is a place where dreams overlap with reality, where violence and conflict keep fortunes flowing. Here, everything is up for grabs, provided you can pay the price. Welcome to Night City.

[Eligibility] 
Available after the Event page unlocks.

[Rules]  
1. The following content is available in the Night City Roaming event: 

(1) Episodic Quest
Episodic Quest "At Dream's Edge" is now available. Early access to the quest is available via "Next Stop: 'Night City'" Event after reaching the transport dock during the Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands." The quest is automatically accepted after the completion of the Main Quest "Beneath a Melting Night Sky."

(2) Trial Resonators
You may test the new Resonators indefinitely with preset teams.
Rewards are granted after your first clear.

(3) Nightmare Challenge 
While this version is live, you'll have the chance to challenge Nightmare: Adam Smasher across 5 basic stages and 1 high-difficulty stage. 
You can use your own Resonators or the Trial Resonators in the challenge.
Special environmental buffs will activate if your team includes Lucy or Rebecca.
Stage rewards are granted after completing a stage. Each stage reward can only be claimed once during the event. 

(4) Milestone Challenge
Advance through quests, level up Resonators, and complete challenges to earn CredChips among other rewards. Spend CredChips to redeem the event-exclusive Sigil "Where Did Your Love Go?".

2. The Night City Roaming event is available for a limited time during Version 3.4 "The Dream Not Dreamed." But the Episodic Quest "At Dream's Edge" remains available after this event ends. Unclaimed rewards will be sent via in-game Mail after this event ends.

HelpText_616_Content:
[About]
Tethys's crisis simulation program is getting an upgrade. With newly gathered data from Lahai-Roi, harsher scenarios await those who dare to face the challenge…

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Crisis Trials]
As a member of the Black Shores, take on trials with different combinations of Stress Modules.
Each Crisis Trial has a default set of Stress Modules. Support Modules are available to lower the trial's difficulty.
After completing a Crisis Trial, the corresponding Disaster Trial along with its Stress Modules will be unlocked.

[Disaster Trials]
To gather additional combat data and improve the Black Shores's crisis response plans, this training program also includes a Hard Mode.
As a member of the Black Shores, you will face <color=#c89a45>hard challenges</color> with various Stress Module combinations.
Disaster Trials have no required Stress Level. Data samples are gathered from participants pushing their limits.
Participating in a Disaster Trial will consume Support Modules, so select them carefully in advance.
Certain risky Stress Modules can only be unlocked after clearing a Disaster Trial with the required Stress Level.
<color=#c89a45>Warning: Equipping too many Stress Modules may make the trial excessively challenging.</color>

[Revival Mechanism]
If a participant is downed in a trial, they can consume Stress Levels to revive. This also gives a corresponding buff.
Please note that consuming Stress Levels will affect the completion and final result of Challenge Goals.

[Challenge Goals]
Complete Challenge Goals in the Crisis and Disaster Trials to claim rewards.
Completing certain Stress Level challenges in Disaster Trials will grant an <color=#c89a45>event-exclusive Title reward</color>.
<color=#c89a45>Challenge Goals are no longer available after the event ends. Please claim your rewards in time.</color>
HelpText_618_Content:
[About]
Since the founding of Xuanfang Hold, the Constables have kept the peace with the aid of the Mingshen System. Lately, however, a string of suspicious incidents across the Hold has begun to trouble them...

[Eligibility]
Reach Shaftpost Yard and interact with the Four Chime Shaftpost during the Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm"

[Event Rules]
The Mingshen System can detect and log every Potential Case and General Commission occurring across the Land of Xuanfang.
Rovers can pinpoint these incidents through the Mingshen System and resolve them. Resolving an incident grants rewards, including Constable Tokens. Constable Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards at the Yard Exchange.
In certain Potential Cases, Rovers must use clues found during the investigation to deduce the truth of the incident. Different clue choices may lead to different outcomes.
This is a Permanent event. From Version 3.5 onward, Rovers can enter it at any time via the Region Guide on the map of Xuanfang.
HelpText_620_Content:
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim daily sign-in rewards. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time.
This event is a permanent event. After you claim all rewards, this event will automatically conclude.
HelpText_621_Content:
After the event starts, you can claim rich rewards by reaching specified Union Levels.
This event is a permanent event. After you claim all rewards, this event will automatically conclude.
HelpText_622_Content:
This event consists of 10 Phases, with each Phase composed of multiple tasks.
The tasks are divided into two categories: Regular Tasks and Advanced Tasks. Complete each task to claim the corresponding rewards. Advanced Tasks are more difficult and offer more rewards.
You are eligible to claim the rewards for each Phase after completing a specific number of tasks in the Phase.
Complete Phase 8 to claim one Resonator of your choice from a pool of 5-Star Resonators.
This event is permanent. After you claim all rewards, this event will automatically conclude.
HelpText_623_Content:
Completing one Act of any Main Quest or any Companion Story grants 1 point of progress. When the progress reaches specific milestones, the corresponding rewards will become available.
Completing Prologues and Segues of Main Quests counts toward the progress.
If an Act or a Companion Story contains two parts, both parts need to be completed to advance the progress.
This event is a permanent event. After you claim all rewards, this event will automatically conclude.
HelpText_624_Content:
In this event, many features have been put in place to fast-track leveling for new players.
[Union EXP Bonus]
During the event, new players will be awarded 100% more Union EXP every day when claiming Activity Rewards.

[Leveling Aid]
During the event, you will enjoy access to locations that contain the upgrade materials of the current Featured Resonators, New Voyage Resonators, and Resonators you own.

This event lasts for 30 days.

GuideTutorialPage_34280_Content: Access Quickhack through the Utility wheel. Aim the camera at targets to show hack options available
GuideTutorialPage_3428002_Content: System will begin hacking once an option is selected, and upload the hacking command automatically. Hacking will be complete upon successful upload.
GuideTutorialPage_3428003_Content: Time will be slowed during the hacking process. Exit the Quickhack interface for quick upload.
GuideTutorialPage_34281_Content: Control cameras to gain a different perspective to survey the surroundings.
GuideTutorialPage_3428102_Content: You can also use Quickhack through Camera.
GuideTutorialPage_34283_Content:
In the Breach Protocol Interface, select the code sequence required to upload from the code matrix and shelve the sequence in the buffer.

To complete the hack, match the code sequence in the buffer with the sequence required to upload.
GuideTutorialPage_3428302_Content: In the Breach Protocol Interface, start from the first row of the code matrix. After selecting the first code, the next one must be chosen from the column of the previously selected code. After that, you must select from the row of the new selection. This row-column alternation continues throughout. Selected codes will be shelved in the buffer for matching with the target sequence.
GuideTutorialPage_3428303_Content:
If the selected sequence does not match the target sequence in the exact order, you'll need to start from the beginning.

The hack will fail if the number of unfilled slots in the buffer is less than the number of unmatched segments in the Target Sequence.

The hack will succeed only when all Target Sequences are fully completed.
GuideTutorialPage_34284_Content:
Quickhacks can also be used to attack targets.
Performing Quickhacks consumes RAM, which recovers over time.
GuideTutorialPage_34285_Content: Quickhacks have a limited input window. Complete the hacking within the time limit to overcome your obstacles.
GuideTutorialPage_3428502_Content: When there are multiple targets within your view, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} on the targets to commence hacking in order.

GuideTutorialPage_3610703_Content:
After completing Depth of Illusions, Dream Tracker will become available.
The Dream Tracker allows you to use powers obtained in the dreamland to challenge Dream Abode in Fissure.
GuideTutorialPage_36108_Content: After completing Depth of Illusions, Dream Tracker will become available. It saves the obtained Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, Tokens, and Resonator Enhancements.
GuideTutorialPage_3610802_Content:
The Dream Tracker allows you to use powers obtained in the dreamland to challenge Dream Abode in Fissure.

※You may view your Resonators' Attributes via the Dream Tracker. The Stats shown are before the dreamscape enhancements.
※If Rover's gender or Attribute does not match the record in the Dream Tracker, a trial Rover will be used instead.
GuideTutorialPage_36109_Content:
To challenge Dream Abode in Fissure, Dream Trackers obtained by completing Depth of Illusions are required.
Dream Trackers can be used repeatedly and will not be consumed.

*If Rover's gender or Attribute does not match the record in Dream Tracker, a trial Rover will be used instead.
GuideTutorialPage_3610902_Content: Obtain the desired Dream Tracker from Depth of Illusions to challenge powerful enemies!
GuideTutorialPage_36110_Content:
There are a total of five Fissure Wardens in Dream Abode in Fissure awaiting your challenge. Each Fissure Warden is unique and is a force to be reckoned with.
The first four Wardens can be challenged in any order.
You will face the final Fissure Warden after defeating the first four Wardens.

※ After 3 minutes of combat, the Fissure Warden's ATK will be increased.
※ After 6 minutes of combat, the challenge will automatically fail.
GuideTutorialPage_3611002_Content:
Fissure Wardens gain additional enhancements during challenges.
These enhancements are cumulative. The more Fissure Wardens you challenge, the stronger the enhancement effects will be.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} Details to view all enhancement effects. Balance the enhancements and the strength of the Fissure Wardens, and sequence your challenge carefully.

HelpText_629_Content:
[Phases & Days]
- In each phase, you must reach the required revenue target within the given days to advance to the next phase.
- Entering a new phase will raise the difficulty of the Phase Goal.
- <color=#c79f49>Completing all Phase Goals</color> to clear the stage.
- Each new phase grants some Frequency Crystals and will <color=#c79f49>automatically deduct the required Dreamland Coupons for the previous phase</color>.

[Weekly Activity Points]
You can obtain corresponding Weekly Activity Points after achieving a certain number of goals and completing stage settlements. Completing the goals of phases 1 to 7 will grant 400/800/1,200/1,600/2,000/2,400/3,000 Weekly Activity Points respectively, and completing goals of phases 8 to 12 in Infinite Mode will grant 3,600/4,200/4,800/5,400/6,000 Weekly Activity Points respectively.
 
[Dreamland Echo]
- The number of Dreamland Coupons earned each day is affected by the Echoes, props, and Dream Block types.
- A maximum of 20 Echoes can be placed on the field at one time. Up to <color=#c79f49>100</color> Echoes can be accommodated on and off the field. 
- At the start of each new day, Echoes on the field will randomly change positions.
- If the field is full when a new Echo arrives, the newcomer will be concealed and may appear on the field the next day.
 - As phases progress, the rarity of Echoes available for recruitment will gradually increase, up to Gold rarity.
- Echoes with Dream of Connection attribute will be added to the recruitment pool once unlocked.

[Dreamland Props] 
- Dreamland Props offer a variety of special effects. You can possess up to 10 Props at a time.
- Dreamland Props are divided into multiple rarity levels. The higher the rarity, the more difficult it is to obtain. Relic is the highest rarity.
- Dreamland Props can be sold for Frequency Crystals, except for Relics.
- Dreamland Props can be obtained from the Dreamland Shop or Strange Encounters.

[Dreamland Shop] 
- Dreamland Shop automatically pops up upon entering a new phase.
- Frequency Crystals can be spent to purchase Echoes and Props in Dreamland Shop.

[Phantasma Blessing]
- Phantasma Blessings provide different effects that can aid in Dreamland management.
- Each use consumes one Blessing attempt. Once all attempts are used, Blessings can no longer be activated.
 
[Dreamland Details]
- In the Dreamland Detail page, you can view all Echoes currently on and off the field, as well as your daily yield.
- In the Dreamland Detail page, you can also <color=#c79f49>Dismiss</color> any Echoes on the field.

[Strange Encounters]
- There is a chance to trigger Strange Encounters during your operation.
- Choose your encounters based on your Dreamland's situation.
 
[Infinite Mode]
- Stages offer Infinite Mode after being cleared.
- In Infinite Mode, Phase Goals are significantly harder to reach, and the Phase durations will be <color=#c79f49>infinite</color>. Your challenge is considered successful once you reach the system limit for revenue.
- You can choose to end the run at any time, and it will still count as a cleared challenge.
HelpText_635_Content:
[About]
This is a place where dreams overlap with reality, where violence and conflict keep fortunes flowing. Here, everything is up for grabs, provided you can pay the price. Welcome to Night City.

[Eligibility]
Reach the transport dock in Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands"

[Event Rules]
The Episodic Quest "At Dream's Edge" is now available. Early access to the quest is available.
Players may experience the Episodic Quest and the Main Quest in parallel. All progress and unlock status of the current quests will not be affected.

[About]
Players may experience different Main Quest Chapters early via Pioneer Experience.
After accepting a Main Quest this way, all Main Quests can be experienced non-exclusively.
Early access to Chapter II also unlocks Time Adjustment, Resonance Conversion functions, as well as some Utilities.

[Eligibility]
Go to the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou and unlock the Terminal during Main Quest "First Resonance."
HelpText_638_Content:
[About]
O Seeker of the road ahead, you have climbed the peaks of Jinzhou and listened to the waves crash against the Black Shores. You've braved tempests, heard the dual nature of Ragunna's faith, and tasted the glory in the arenas of Septimont. Adventuring through the City Set in Amber, you faced deep space in mysterious Lahai-Roi, meeting the Void with courage. Now the road ahead has again revealed itself. Let us return to Huanglong, and journey on to Mengzhou.

[Eligibility]
Go to the Resonance Nexus in Jinzhou and unlock the Terminal during Main Quest "First Resonance."

[Event Rules]
Main Quest Chapter IV is now available. Eligible players can now experience this Chapter early.
After accepting this Quest, all Main Quests can be experienced non-exclusively.
Early access to Chapter IV also unlocks Time Adjustment, Resonance Conversion functions, as well as some Utilities.
HelpText_388_Content:
[About]
Behold! Wutherium Film Studio Special Feature: Resonators in Combat Edition is back for a limited time!
Capture Resonators' exhilarating moments during combat, then submit the photos to Fulmine and C-MOSS to earn plenty of rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Freeze Frame]
During the event, you will be given different daily Freeze Frame challenges, each with Normal and Hard modes. Complete Normal Mode to unlock Hard Mode for that challenge and the Normal Mode for the next Freeze Frame challenge.
Each Freeze Frame challenge will center on a specific Resonator. Your goal is to capture highlights of these Resonators in combat by meeting specific objectives. Completing these tasks earns you rewards.
Complete Normal Mode to unlock Free Mode, where there are no designated Resonators and you can select your own model. Complete Hard Mode to unlock the Slow Motion gadget during photography.

[Slow Motion]
During Freeze Frame challenges, when the designated Resonator performs the action needed for the objective, Slow Motion will be triggered. Time will slow down significantly, allowing you to observe and capture precise moments of the Resonator's movements.
In Free Mode, Slow Motion will no longer trigger automatically. Instead, you can activate it manually using the Slow Motion gadget whenever you want.

Note: Stage "Freeze Frame: Gentle Stream" will be available simultaneously with Featured Convene "Blessings From Dewy Winds."
This event is unavailable in Co-op Mode.
If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your mailbox when you log in again within 30 days.
HelpText_615_Content:
[Resonator Voice Customization]
You may now customize voice packs for individual Resonators.
To ensure the best story experience, these changes apply only to non-story voicelines.

[Settings]
You may customize the voiceover language for each Resonator in the Resonator's profile screen or the Resonator Voice Customization screen.

[Notes]
Download the corresponding voice pack before the customization.
Voice customization applies only to non-story voicelines. Story voicelines will follow the global settings.
Voice customization settings are automatically saved on the cloud and support cross-platform sync.
You have the option to overwrite individual voice customizations when you change the global voice settings.
