Skybarges navigate through mid-air tunnels and serve as the primary means of transport across the Land of Xuanfang.
When driving a vehicle, you can move along the surface of a Skybarge or enter the Skybarge Tunnel, where you can freely adjust your altitude.
GuideTutorialPage_34288_Content: Pathways will automatically materialize when you near a Ridge Bridge and disappear once you are out of range.
GuideTutorialPage_34289_Content: Pass through Point Rings or gather Collectibles to earn points and recover the Energy Tank to reach the destination before time runs out.
GuideTutorialPage_34290_Content:
If you fall into the Yuan Fortress ruins beneath Xuanfang Hold, you can catch an updraft to lift yourself back up, provided you are gliding or piloting a vehicle.
Plummeting into the ruins without gliding or driving will trigger a reset, teleporting you back to a safe zone.
GuideTutorialPage_34292_Content: In this challenge mode, you must dodge obstacles, accumulate points, and cross the finish line. While on the track, you can deploy Support Modules or perform aerial drifts to battle rival Cloud Riders, and shatter scattered objects along the way to maximize your score.
GuideTutorialPage_34293_Content: Drag the glowing objects in the designated direction to alter the environment, such as creating new paths or bridges.
GuideTutorialPage_34294_Content: Certain Censure Cages will open when approached or when nearby mechanisms are triggered. The contained Tacet Discords will break free and attack any nearby Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_34295_Content: Interact with the key clues in the scene to start the gameplay.
GuideTutorialPage_34296_Content: Use the power of Hsin the Moon Fox to enter Apex State.
GuideTutorialPage_33076_Content: Upon reaching this node in Main Quest, you can {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} the specific Resonator Avatar to choose the preferred narrative line to continue the quest.
GuideTutorialPage_36111_Content:
During the simulation, Resonators will automatically attack enemies using their equipped Weapons.
Regular skills are disabled during the simulation. Only basic movement and Dash can be used.
A wider, top-down tactical camera will be used to oversee the battlefield.
GuideTutorialPage_36112_Content: In Stats Upgrade, you can select and upgrade a specific Stat for your Resonators.
GuideTutorialPage_36113_Content: Destroying a Supply Chest grants a chance to earn extra Items.
GuideTutorialPage_36114_Content:
The following additional rules apply in the Infinite Mode: Last Stand simulation:
1. Receive extra starting Weapons and Items at the start of the simulation.
2. Enemies are significantly stronger than in other simulations.
3. Dodge Cooldown is significantly increased.
GuideTutorialPage_36115_Content: Denia cannot equip Weapons. Instead, crashing into enemies or taking damage triggers an explosion, dealing Explosion DMG to nearby targets.
GuideTutorialPage_36116_Content:
A High-Risk Target is a formidable foe with various powerful skills.
It shifts toward more threatening behavior patterns and skills as its HP drops.
GuideTutorialPage_33077_Content: The Mingshen System utilizes Skywatch Rings displayed across the Land of Xuanfang to detect and log suspicious activities, directly aiding Constables in maintaining peace and security throughout Xuanfang Hold.
GuideTutorialPage_33078_Content: Once the high-level clearance is granted, the Mingshen System will scan and register all General Commissions across the Land of Xuanfang. Completing these commissions earns you Constable Tokens, which can be traded for various items at the Yard Exchange.
GuideTutorialPage_36117_Content: Each Freeze Frame Challenge assigns three photo objectives. Complete them by capturing Resonators performing the required combat actions.
GuideTutorialPage_36118_Content:
In Hard Mode, Freeze Frame objectives are less obvious. You must try to find the correct combat actions.
In Hard Mode, Slow Motion no longer triggers automatically. You need to <color=#ffd12f>manually activate the Slow Motion gadget</color> to slow time.
GuideTutorial_36119_GroupName: Freeze Frame Challenges - Group Photo Mode
Tutorial_36119_Title: Freeze Frame Challenges - Group Photo Mode
GuideTutorialPage_36119_Content:
In Group Photo Mode, you must capture a photo featuring two Resonators.
When the first Resonator performs the required action, use the Slow Motion gadget to trigger a Slow Motion window. Then, quickly switch to the second Resonator to complete the photo objective.

Group Photo Mode can be challenging, so capturing the shot in Slow Motion is recommended.
GuideTutorialPage_31014_Content: Rover has awakened a new power and will remain in the Apex Resonance state throughout this battle. Cast Resonance Skill to unleash the combined abilities of Rover: Spectro, Rover: Havoc, and Rover: Aero. Muster every power obtained so far to strike down the enemy.
GuideTutorial_31015_GroupName: Many Days Apart, An Eternity Passed
GuideTutorialPage_31015_Content:
During your time apart, Yangyang has pushed her training to new heights.
Casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Domain now grants an additional Melody, while enhancing its damage, area of effect, and pulling force.
Casting Heavy Attack - Zephyr Song now grants an extra Melody and features a strengthened pulling effect.
GuideTutorialPage_32060_Content:
The Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's Wall Shield, Left Arm, and Head can be destroyed.
Wall Shield Destroyed: Increases the Vibration Strength depletion inflicted on the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion.
Left Arm Destroyed: Temporarily reduces the damage dealt by the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion.
Head Destroyed: Greatly increases the Off-Tune Level on the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion.
GuideTutorialPage_32061_Content:
When the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion prepares its ultimate skill, several unique mechanisms will manifest across the battlefield. Strike these mechanisms with Heavy Attack or Plunging Attack to deploy a protective barrier.
Stand within the effective barrier zone to nullify the ultimate skill damage. Please note that this is the only way to avoid the ultimate skill.
GuideTutorialPage_3307602_Content: Line selection only allows you to experience the stories in different orders and does not affect the narrative content.
GuideTutorialPage_33079_Content: The Expedition Motorbike now features a Boosted Drift Mode. While being boosted, you can perform drifts with enhanced handling and control.
GuideTutorialPage_3307902_Content: Go to Settings - Controls to enable/disable Expedition Motorbike Boosted Drift Mode.
GuideTutorialPage_3307702_Content: Access the Mingshen System to track Potential Cases across the Land of Xuanfang. Resolve these cases to earn Constable Tokens for reward redemption.
GuideTutorialPage_3307703_Content: Interact with the Resonance Nexus in Xuanfang Hold to obtain the Mingshen System's high-level clearance, unlocking access to General Commissions.
GuideTutorialPage_3428902_Content: While on the track, you can use Grapple or ride on special track surfaces to alter your vehicle's gravity direction.
GuideTutorialPage_34297_Content: Drag the fire-spitting Lionarch along the trail to stop Tacet Discords from approaching and defeat them.
GuideTutorialPage_34298_Content:
Move or rotate the glowing objects in the indicated direction to alter the shapes of the shadows cast upon the wall.
Position the objects correctly so that the resulting shadow patterns match the puzzle's requirements.
GuideTutorialPage_34299_Content: Move the glowing objects in the indicated direction to shift the Model Box's internal mechanisms, thereby altering the layout of the entire Chamber.
GuideTutorialPage_34300_Content: Move the glowing objects in the indicated direction to open pathways, deactivate hazardous traps, and rescue Q-L1NG.
Tutorial_34301_Title: Healing Injured Xuanfang Wardens with Suisui
GuideTutorialPage_34301_Content: Use Suisui to heal the nearby injured Xuanfang Wardens. Once their HP is restored to a required level, they will rejoin the battlefield.
GuideTutorialPage_34302_Content: Spend Shell Credits to start the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_34303_Content: Drop the items into the prize box to gain points. The higher the item rarity, the more points earned.
GuideTutorialPage_34304_Content:
Eight Automaton sets are scattered throughout the Land of Xuanfang, each consisting of a main body and two component parts. Deliver the assembled sets to King Auto to claim rewards.
You may view all the finished and delivered Automotons in the Automaton Collection Cabinet.
GuideTutorialPage_34305_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} the tile close to an Autopuppet to move it on the ground or on walls.
GuideTutorialPage_34306_Content: Use the Control Lever or Pedal Platform to navigate back and forth between the two locations along the route.
GuideTutorialPage_34307_Content: Smolder: Sparring is stationary. Instead of moving, it attacks targets directly in front of it. Flank it or strike from behind to take it down.
GuideTutorialPage_34308_Content: Smiter: Sparring monitors the second tile directly in front of it. Stepping into that tile triggers its tracking mechanism.
GuideTutorialPage_34309_Content: The Circular Saw moves back and forth along its track. Adjusting the track changes its route.
GuideTutorialPage_34310_Content: If Rover or a Smiter: Sparring passes over a Spike Trap a second time, it will collapse and instantly kill the target.
GuideTutorialPage_34311_Content: Step on the Pedal Platform to fire an arrow, which will instantly kill the first target caught in its flight path.
GuideTutorialPage_34312_Content: Skywatch Rings positioned across the Land of Xuanfang record and store local visual data from recent timeframes. Interacting with the residual frequencies at a place allows you to reconstruct and review past events.
GuideTutorialPage_34313_Content:
Powerful enemies are contained within the Censure Locks.
When approached, the locks become temporarily ineffective, releasing the enemies they contain.
GuideTutorialPage_3611102_Content:
During the simulation, defeating enemies awards Op Credits, which can be spent at the Shop between waves to upgrade Resonator Stats, enhance Weapons, or purchase new Weapons and Items.
Survive a set number of waves to clear the challenge.
GuideTutorialPage_3611103_Content: Each Resonator has unique passive skills. When purchasing Weapons and Items, or upgrading, prioritizing Stats that synergize with passive skills will maximize combat effectiveness.
GuideTutorialPage_3611104_Content: Defensive Stats boost Resonator survivability and give more room for error during combat. These Stats include Speed, DEF, and Dodge, etc.
GuideTutorialPage_3611202_Content: The Shop appears at the end of every wave, offering a random selection of four Weapons or Items. You can reroll the selection using Op Credits, though each consecutive reroll increases the cost. The Shop inventory automatically resets at the end of each wave.
GuideTutorialPage_3611302_Content: Destroying a Supply Chest grants corresponding Items at the end of the wave. You may sell any unwanted Items.
GuideTutorialPage_3611702_Content: In Normal Mode, performing the designated action with the required Resonator automatically triggers <color=#ffd12f>Slow Motion</color>, allowing you to observe and capture the Resonator's action precisely.
GuideTutorialPage_36120_Content:
In the Endstate Matrix: Adversity Vanguard Challenge Cycle, the Score Multiplier increases with each Round. The specific multipliers are as follows:
Round 1: Score Multiplier x1.00
Round 2: Score Multiplier x1.15
Round 3: Score Multiplier x1.25
GuideTutorialPage_3612002_Content: Teams receive bonus Points upon defeating Matrix Mimic in the Adversity Vanguard Challenge Cycle of Endstate Matrix.
GuideTutorialPage_3612003_Content: In the Adversity Vanguard Challenge Cycle of Endstate Matrix, one Resonator will be selected as the Emergency Agent per Phase, gaining an additional point of Vigor.
GuideTutorialPage_3612004_Content:
The following Resonators are enhanced in the Adversity Vanguard Challenge Cycle of Endstate Matrix:
Jiyan, Yinlin, Jinhsi, Changli, Zhezhi, Xiangli Yao, Camellya, Carlotta, Roccia, Phoebe, Brant, Cantarella.
GuideTutorialPage_3429502_Content: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} the special button to fully recharge the Refluent Hourglass and activate it.
Tutorial_3429503_Title: Showing the Past with Refluent Hourglass
GuideTutorialPage_3429503_Content: Once activated, the Refluent Hourglass reverses time for the environment within its scanning radius, restoring it to a previous state.
GuideTutorialPage_3429602_Content: Use the new skill to quickly eliminate Tacet Discords.
GuideTutorialPage_3430202_Content: Control Deft Grabber to move and grab items. Drop the grabbed items into the prize box to gain rewards.
GuideTutorialPage_3430203_Content:
Gilded Cache: Comes in large and small sizes. Deliver it to the prize box to obtain Astrites.
Sachet: Comes in large and small sizes. Deliver it to the prize box to obtain various materials.
Pouch: Comes in large and small sizes. Deliver it into the prize box to obtain a set number of Shell Credits.
Automatons & Components: Captured Automatons or components can be delivered to King Auto, who will grant rewards based on what you turn in.
GuideTutorialPage_3430204_Content:
The Auto Casket Challenge features a countdown timer. The challenge ends when time expires.
Capturing a Time Dial extends the remaining time, but it cannot exceed the timer bar's maximum limit.
GuideTutorialPage_3430502_Content: Guide the Autopuppet to the finish line to clear the challenge. The Autopuppet will be destroyed if hit by enemies or traps, and then automatically rewind to its previous step.
GuideTutorialPage_3430503_Content: Passing a checkpoint activates it instantly. You can also {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} the Reverse button to rewind to the previous step, up to the last activated checkpoint, with a limit of 40 steps. If you use Reverse for over 40 steps, the Autopuppet will be sent directly back to the last activated checkpoint.
GuideTutorialPage_3431202_Content: The Skywatch Ring automatically identifies critical information in the visual data, pausing playback and highlighting it at such moments. Hold the interact button while paused to extract the recorded clue.
GuideTutorialPage_3431302_Content: Censure Locks will aid you in battle. Accumulate Snare Doom stacks by performing Dodge Counters, Counterattacks, or applying Negative Statuses. Reaching the max stacks will consume all stacks to trigger a powerful Snare Doom Strike that summons the Censure Lock to attack targets.

GuideTutorialPage_34315_Content: Thunder Barrel explosions damage Resonators, enemies, and breakable objects alike. Use their explosive nature strategically to gain an edge in combat.

[Guqin Performance]
Use the Timbre buttons on either side of the screen to select the right timbre. Then {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} the Note buttons at the bottom to play the specific notes.
Enjoy playing the guqin!

Please note that other players can hear your playing in Co-op mode.

When experiencing the Guqin Performance feature, please ensure that your performances and the recording, sharing, or distribution of your performance do not infringe upon the copyrights or other lawful rights and interests of any third party. The content of your performance must not contain illegal or inappropriate materials, violate public order or accepted codes of conduct, disrupt the gameplay experience of others, or otherwise breach the User Agreement. We reserve the right to take necessary action in accordance with the User Agreement and related rules. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
HelpText_670_Title: New Event "If Dreams Still Reverberate" is now available!
HelpText_670_Content:
[About]
The Ivory Gatekeeper has sent you an SOS over WavesLine! The gate in the depths of the Somnoire—the one that should never be opened, the one you once shut—has somehow come open again. Now, terrifying Nightmares are once again running rampant in the Somnoire...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 22. Activate the Four Chime Shaftpost during Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm."

[Event Rules]
1. In this challenge, you can choose "Support Echoes" to assist you in battle, greatly enhancing the combat abilities of Resonators.
2. Downed Resonators will automatically revive after a while.
3. This event can be played in Co-Op Mode.
4. Only designated Echoes can be used in this event (Sonatas remain effective; only the main Echo Skill is replaced).
5. Surface Layer Stage Points: Clearance Points + (Remaining Time x Time Coefficient).
6. Clear all Surface Layer stages to unlock the Abyss of the Final Dreams for a boss-rush challenge.
7. Total Points are the sum of the highest points from the Surface Layer stages and the Abyss of the Final Dreams (Deep Layer stages other than the Abyss of the Final Dreams do not have points).
HelpText_421_Content:
[About]
Hsin has arranged a task for Suoming, asking you to join her in recording the sights of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. A trip "down memory lane" that draws out the long-sealed memories of the Ten Seals Covenant...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter IV Act IV "Simulacrum of the Heart: Epilogue" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
Collect all Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

GuideTutorialPage_34318_Content:
"Will and sword as one, that the edge follows your heart."
<color=#ffd12f>Hold</color> the interact button at the start of the Sword Flight Windpath to fly on your sword.
GuideTutorialPage_3431802_Content: While flying on your sword, use the <color=#ffd12f>directional controls</color> to steer left or right and make minor adjustments on the Windpath.
GuideTutorialPage_3431803_Content: While flying on your sword, <color=#ffd12f>use Attack</color> to destroy obstacles along the Windpath.
GuideTutorialPage_34319_Content:
Sword Flight Windpaths can be found throughout the Land of Xuanfang.
<color=#ffd12f>Hold</color> the interact button at the start of the Sword Flight Windpath to fly on your sword.
Most Windpaths are near Meditation Spots, so make good use of them while exploring. Take to the skies on your sword and soar across the horizon.
GuideTutorialPage_34320_Content:
Most Cloud Shuttle mechanisms use control devices called Mechanism Controls.
When near one, <color=#ffd12f>strike its core with Flying Swords</color> to overload it, much like striking the eye of a formation.
GuideTutorialPage_34321_Content:
Reeling Fog corrupts nearby Mechanism Controls, turning mechanism barriers into fog walls...
Destroy all linked controls using Flying Swords to overload them at once and clear the fog.
GuideTutorialPage_34322_Content:
Xuan Bombards serve as the Cloud Shuttle's premier defense system, automatically targeting and engaging enemies.
To activate one, approach its Mechanism Control and strike it with your Flying Swords.
GuideTutorialPage_34323_Content:
Resonance Energy from the Qingfu Pendant creates a domain that reveals unseen frequencies...
While inside the Di Realm, <color=#ffd12f>interact with certain Autopuppets</color> to reveal their original living forms, enabling normal conversation.
GuideTutorialPage_34324_Content:
Modular parts fallen from the Skyend Barriers have multiplied and gathered into wandering, corrupted mechanism clusters.
While in Sword Flight, <color=#ffd12f>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press}</color> the interact button to have Qingxiao unleash ranged Sword Energy and strike down incoming corrupted mechanism clusters.
Tutorial_34325_Title: Enter Sword Flight by Dodging in Mid-air
GuideTutorialPage_34325_Content:
Accustomed to riding the wind, Qingxiao travels swift and free on her flying sword.
Perform <color=#ffd12f>Dodge</color> in mid-air to immediately enter Sword Flight.
GuideTutorialPage_34326_Content: Select the seven-string guqin in your Backpack, or assign it to a Utility slot and interact with it to start Guqin Performance.
GuideTutorialPage_3432602_Content: Interact with the <color=#ffd12f>guqin keys</color> to play their corresponding notes. Feel free to perform any tune you like.
GuideTutorialPage_36121_Content: You can enter the Resonance Sim Realm only as Rover. Rover has five skills: Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Resonance Skill, Dodge, and Morph Skill.
GuideTutorialPage_3612102_Content:
Collect Resonance Factors to boost your combat power or change skill forms.
Each skill can have only one form-changing Resonance Factor at a time. Factors that do not change skill forms provide passive boosts and can be stacked.
GuideTutorialPage_3612103_Content: Dodge no longer has a default Stagnation effect. Instead, its effect changes based on your acquired Dodge Resonance Factors.
GuideTutorialPage_3612104_Content:
In every simulation, Rover has a limited number of Revive attempts.
If Rover's HP drops to zero while unused Revive attempts remain, HP will be restored by a set percentage. If all attempts have been exhausted, the simulation fails.
GuideTutorialPage_36122_Content:
Rehearsing before a performance helps you get into the rhythm.
Interact with the <color=#ffd12f>highlighted keys</color> in sequence to practice a short melody.
GuideTutorialPage_36123_Content: Drag and line up three or more Pieces of the same color to clear them. Each Piece cleared earns you 10 points.
GuideTutorialPage_3612302_Content:
Matching more than three Pieces creates Special Pieces:
1. Matching four Pieces in a straight line creates an Explosive Piece.
2. Matching five or more Pieces in a broken line creates a Crisscross Piece.
3. Matching five or more Pieces in a straight line creates an Ultimate Piece.
GuideTutorialPage_3612303_Content:
An Explosive Piece clears Pieces within a 3x3 area. A Crisscross Piece clears all Pieces in its row and column.
Swapping an Ultimate Piece with a normal Piece clears all Pieces of the same color on the board. Swapping two Ultimate Pieces clears the entire board.
GuideTutorialPage_3612304_Content: Each Resonator has two Skills, which will be automatically cast upon reaching the required amount of Energy. Once both Skills are used, the Energy gauge is reset. You gain 50 points of Energy per action, and 2 extra points of Energy for each Piece cleared.
GuideTutorial_36124_GroupName: Energy Bottle Piece and Stage Events
GuideTutorialPage_36124_Content: Complete three matches surrounding the Energy Bottle to clear it, granting you 80 points of Energy when cleared.
GuideTutorialPage_3612402_Content: Some stages have Stage Events that affect the board and generate Special Pieces. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} the left side of the board to view the event's specific effects.
GuideTutorialPage_36125_Content: Ice Pieces can't drop down, and block normal Pieces from dropping down. Complete one match around the Ice Piece to clear it.
GuideTutorialPage_36126_Content: The Movement Hourglass clears automatically when you move it to the very bottom. Clearing it adds two more Moves for the current Stage.
HelpText_679_Title: Second Coming of Solaris: Coded Deception
HelpText_679_Content:
[About]
A brand-new version of Second Coming of Solaris like you've never seen is coming soon! What are you waiting for? Come give it a try!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
Certain anomalies can be found in the game scenes. After locating these anomalies, use the Utility: Zoom Camera to capture them, then work with Bertolt to modify them.
You may choose to mark these anomalies or intentionally distort them further. The choices you make will determine how players of The Second Coming of Solaris test server rate this scene after all anomalies have been handled.
HelpText_678_Content:
Cubie Wars Progress Saving
1. During a Stage, you can save your current progress and exit from the pause screen.
2. After exiting, you can continue the challenge from the saved progress at the Stage page.
HelpText_680_Content:
[About]
Looming over the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, the Nexus Fox Shadow watches the realm with cold detachment.
However, a conversation with a Celestial from the Court of Savantae has revealed something new: the Fox Shadow reacts to a specific token within the Simulacrum Nexus...

[Eligibility]
Meet the Nexus Fox Shadow in Mengxuan Vale during Main Quest "Simulacrum of the Heart" to unlock.

[Rules]
1. Explore Mengzhou's Simulacrum Nexus to gather Thousandfold Petals of varying rarities across the three Heart Realms of the Nexus Fox Shadow.
2. Offer Thousandfold Petals at the Heart Calmer Altars in their corresponding Heart Realms to level them up and earn rewards. Doing so increases Heart Realm Stability and raises the Fox Shadow's trust, unlocking stronger bonuses throughout the Simulacrum Nexus.
3. This is a permanent event. Starting in Version 3.7, you can access it anytime through the Region Guide on the Land of Xuanfang map.
GuideTutorialPage_3432002_Content: When all <color=#ffd12f>related Mechanism Controls</color> are overloaded at once, the mechanism barrier on the Cloud Shuttle can be removed.
HelpText_681_Content:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Event Rules]
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim the sign-in rewards. The sign-in record refreshes daily at 04:00 server time.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
HelpText_691_Content:
[About]
Following the resolution of anomalies of the Simulacrum Nexus, a mysterious girl sends you a WavesLine message, claiming she "has a favor to ask." As the matter unfolds, a story about Hsin the Moon Fox, the past Sentinel, comes to light.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete the Main Quest "Simulacrum of the Heart: Epilogue."

[Event Rules]
Complete the Tales Quest "Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing" to claim the quest rewards. The event will close after Version 3.7 ends. In versions after 3.7, if you meet the quest unlock conditions, you can still accept and complete this quest from the quest page to claim its rewards.

GuideTutorialPage_37030_Content: Each round is split into a Store Phase and a Combat Phase. Purchase, place, and synthesize Items to strengthen your Storybook, and win as many duels as you can before your Retries run out.
GuideTutorialPage_3703002_Content: During the Store Phase, spend Coins to buy, refresh, lock, or sell Items. Coins are issued during the Store Phase, and any unspent Coins carry over to the next round.
GuideTutorialPage_3703003_Content:
Drag Items into the Storybook and adjust their positions. Items must be placed entirely on a Sheet.
Items placed in the Storybook automatically trigger their effects during combat.
GuideTutorialPage_37031_Content: Items that don't fit in the Storybook can be kept in the Storage Box.
GuideTutorialPage_3703102_Content: Drag Items in your Storybook to rearrange them. You can also rotate Items to change their orientation for better placement.
GuideTutorialPage_3703103_Content:
Items must be placed on a Sheet.
The Sheet can also be rotated. Adjust the Sheet and Items together for better placement.
GuideTutorialPage_3703104_Content: When an Item is placed on top of another Item, you can {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=click Gamepad=press} Replace to switch the Items.
GuideTutorialPage_37032_Content: When multiple Items can synthesize into a new Item, a connecting-line appears between them.
GuideTutorialPage_3703202_Content: When Items available for synthesis are placed in adjacent positions on a Sheet, a "Synthesis" button appears. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} it to synthesize them directly.
GuideTutorialPage_3703203_Content: The Quick Synthesis list shows all Items available for synthesis, saving you the hassle of dragging Items next to each other.
GuideTutorialPage_37033_Content:
Random Events appear in Rounds 3 and 7, each with a different effect.
If you're not satisfied with an Event, you can refresh it once.
GuideTutorialPage_37034_Content:
A Signature Weapon is the core weapon of each build with powerful effects.
Each Cube can only synthesize one Signature Weapon, while Rover has no limit.
GuideTutorialPage_3703402_Content: Signature Weapons come with a Star. Placing specified types of Items onto the Star positions activates the Star effect.
GuideTutorialPage_37035_Content: Sell unwanted Items by dragging them to the Shop area, or by selecting an Item and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=clicking Gamepad=pressing} the Sell button.
GuideTutorial_38004_GroupName: Moon-Chasing Festival: By Moon's Grace Event Page
Tutorial_38004_Title: Moon-Chasing Festival: By Moon's Grace Event Page
GuideTutorialPage_38004_Content: The "By Moon's Grace" Moon-Chasing Festival event is now open. Access the event from the Terminal menu or the Utility Wheel.
GuideTutorialPage_33083_Content: Collect and deliver Thousandfold Petals in the <color=#ffd12f>Heart of Bloom, Heart of Flames, and Heart of Frost</color> to upgrade the corresponding Heart Calmers. Doing so increases the Heart Realm Stability and shifts the Nexus Fox Shadow's attitude.
GuideTutorialPage_3308302_Content: <color=#ffd12f>Thousandfold Petals</color> are scattered throughout the Simulacrum Nexus, obtainable through various events.
GuideTutorialPage_3308303_Content: Deliver Thousandfold Petals at the corresponding <color=#ffd12f>Heart Calmer</color> to increase <color=#ffd12f>Heart Realm Stability</color>.
GuideTutorial_33084_GroupName: Blooms for the Shadow: Activating Node
GuideTutorialPage_33084_Content: As the Heart Realm Stability increases, the Nexus Fox Shadow's mood toward Rover will shift from indifference to trust.
GuideTutorialPage_3308402_Content: Activate the <color=#ffd12f>Shadow Binder</color> to make the Nexus Fox Shadow respond and activate new Nodes.
GuideTutorialPage_3308403_Content: As your Heart Realm Stability rises and the Nexus Fox Shadow's mood changes, Rover gains increasingly powerful buffs within the Simulacrum Nexus.
GuideTutorialPage_33085_Content: Identical non-upgraded Echoes (same type, Sonata Effect, and Main Stat) automatically stack together to save Backpack space. Each stack uses only one Backpack slot.
GuideTutorialPage_34327_Content: Realm Keys are found throughout the Simulacrum Nexus. As you progress through the Main Quest, they grant access to different Inner Thresholds and unlock the anomaly-restoration ability of their corresponding Heart Realm, each influencing its surroundings in different ways.
GuideTutorialPage_34328_Content:
Take the Heart of Flames Key from the Dream Fox Statue to gain the <color=#ffd12f>Reconstruction</color> ability.
Use the Heart of Flames Key to restore nearby anomalies, then return it to its place. The Dream Fox Statue will then be reconstructed back to its original form.
GuideTutorialPage_34329_Content:
Take the Heart of Bloom Key from the Dream Jade Rootstone to gain the <color=#ffd12f>Proliferation</color> ability.
Use the Heart of Bloom Key to restore nearby anomalies, then return it to its place. The Dream Jade Rootstone will then proliferate into a Dream Jade Tree.
GuideTutorialPage_34330_Content:
Take the Heart of Frost Key from the Dream Kernel Puppet to gain the <color=#ffd12f>Stasis</color> ability.
Use the Heart of Frost Key to restore nearby anomalies, then return it to its place. The Dream Kernel Puppet will then resume activity.
GuideTutorialPage_34331_Content:
The Inner Thresholds serve as the Civilization Capsule's "Root Reconstruction Portals," housing the anomalous zones within.
Carry the corresponding Realm Key to pass through an Inner Threshold and use its restorative power. Enter to clear the anomalies.
GuideTutorialPage_3433102_Content: Leave the Inner Threshold through this exit and return to the center of the Civilization Capsule, the Simulacrum Nexus.
GuideTutorialPage_34332_Content:
Entering an Inner Threshold grants the corresponding anomaly-restoration ability.
Complete the puzzle within the Inner Threshold, then return with the Realm Key to repair its Dream Construct.
While inside an Inner Threshold, interference restricts your access to the map on your Terminal.
GuideTutorialPage_34333_Content: You can pass through the Endless Barrier to reach the other side of the Simulacrum Nexus.
GuideTutorialPage_34334_Content: Activate Reconstruction to reconstruct nearby transparent objects and creatures.
GuideTutorialPage_3433403_Content: Disable Reconstruction to return reconstructed objects and creatures to their previous state.
GuideTutorialPage_34335_Content: Activate Stasis to freeze nearby objects and creatures in place.
GuideTutorialPage_34336_Content:
Activate Proliferation to make nearby objects and creatures grow. Such objects and creatures can then be destroyed.
Objects that can be proliferated or destroyed stand out more in the environment.
GuideTutorial_34337_GroupName: Rogue Autopuppet Wreck and Endless Barrier
Tutorial_34337_Title: Rogue Autopuppet Wreck and Endless Barrier
GuideTutorialPage_34337_Content:
Certain wrecked Autopuppets trapped in Stasis will continue to spawn anomalies and project an Endless Barrier.
Destroy the wreckage to bring the barrier down.
GuideTutorialPage_3433702_Content: You can pass through an Endless Barrier to reach the other side of a nearby area.
GuideTutorial_34338_GroupName: Heart of Bloom: Jade Planter Pot
Tutorial_34338_Title: Heart of Bloom: Jade Planter Pot
GuideTutorialPage_34338_Content: After activating a Jade Planter Pot with Proliferation, it re-activates nearby proliferated objects and grows a flower trail linking to the next Jade Planter Pot.
GuideTutorialPage_34339_Content: Objects around a Proliferation Core grow endlessly, so it must be destroyed as quickly as possible!
GuideTutorialPage_34340_Content:
Jade Bamboos brimming with Proliferation energy can be destroyed.
Once destroyed, they can be regrown through Proliferation or other objects radiating Proliferation energy.
GuideTutorialPage_3434002_Content:
Jade Blocks brimming with Proliferation energy can be destroyed.
Once destroyed, they can be regrown through Proliferation or other objects radiating Proliferation energy.
GuideTutorial_34341_GroupName: Heart of Bloom: Horizontal Jade Platform
Tutorial_34341_Title: Heart of Bloom: Horizontal Jade Platform
GuideTutorialPage_34341_Content: Under Proliferation, the Jade Platform proliferates horizontally, and the proliferated part can be destroyed.
Tutorial_3434102_Title: Heart of Bloom: Vertical Jade Platform
GuideTutorialPage_3434102_Content: Under Proliferation, the Jade Platform will proliferate vertically, and the proliferated part can be destroyed.
GuideTutorialPage_34342_Content:
The creature causing the Lantern Carriage's anomaly cannot be touched directly.
Under the effect of Reconstruction, it becomes immobilized and can be attacked.
GuideTutorialPage_34343_Content:
The Lantern Carriages prepared for the Waking Moon Festival have fallen into an anomaly and can no longer move.
Defeat the Flamejaw Chi to restore the Lantern Carriages to normal.
GuideTutorialPage_34345_Content:
These cannons, hidden in the ground or walls, are scaled-down versions of the ones aboard the Cloud Shuttle.
They activate and appear from the wall when you approach them.
GuideTutorialPage_34346_Content: Repair the processing core in the Heart of Frost to complete the current phase of construction in Xuanfang Hold.
GuideTutorialPage_34347_Content: Use the grapple points inside the Heart of Frost to overcome various terrain.
GuideTutorialPage_34348_Content: Hsin separates part of Her own processing core to keep Xuanfang Hold operational, losing a portion of Her power with each one She completes (She loses one combat Skill).
GuideTutorialPage_34349_Content:
Passing through the door transforms you into the Moon Fox. In this form, your abilities change as follows:
Jump: Perform precision jumps to spots marked by icons that appear when you approach. Areas where the environment moves too fast require using Stasis first.
Roar: Release objects trapped in Stasis while shattering destructible objects.
Anomaly restoration: Identical to Rover's ability.

Pass through the Shadow Fox Shroud again to return to Rover's form.
GuideTutorialPage_34350_Content: Defeat the scattered Flamejaw Chi to repair the Lantern Carriages, ultimately repairing the Dream Fox Statue.
GuideTutorialPage_34351_Content: Repair the damaged Autopuppet Kernel to repair the Dream Kernel Puppet.
GuideTutorialPage_34352_Content:
Some Inner Thresholds within the Heart of Flames contain a second Inner Threshold inside them, making them the perfect hideout for the Flamejaw Chi.
Changes to an Inner Threshold's exterior pocket also affect the interior pocket. (e.g., mechanisms such as the Moment Captor will be activated, and the anomalies deconstructed will be reconstructed.)
GuideTutorialPage_34353_Content: Use Small Endless Barriers to traverse between different areas, reaching places you otherwise couldn't.
GuideTutorialPage_34354_Content: The Feeling Capsule stores Hsin the Moon Fox's memories. When used, it grants an ability similar to the Heart of Flames Key's <color=#ffd12f>Reconstruction</color>.
GuideTutorialPage_3435402_Content: The Feeling Capsule can be carried at all times within the <color=#ffd12f>Heart of Ruin</color>.
GuideTutorial_34355_GroupName: Anomalies in the Heart of Ruin
Tutorial_34355_Title: Anomalies in the Heart of Ruin
GuideTutorialPage_34355_Content: The Heart of Ruin holds many anomalies that have altered the environment.
GuideTutorialPage_3435502_Content: Anomalies can be dispelled by <color=#ffd12f>completing the Heart of Ruin's trials</color>. Offer the Feeling Capsule Shards before the Fox Statue to access the memories recorded in the Heart of Ruin.
GuideTutorialPage_34356_Content: In some parts of the Heart of Frost, Censure Cages move in endless loops along assembly lines. Use the Heart of Frost Key to freeze one in Stasis, then hop aboard and ride it once it breaks free.
GuideTutorialPage_34357_Content: On some assembly lines, a static Censure Cage blocks the movement of other Censure Cages. Attack to break it free of Stasis and have the assembly line moving again.
GuideTutorialPage_34358_Content:
Push the Memory Post along its fixed track to shift or change the scene.
You can freeze the moving scene with the Heart of Frost Key.
GuideTutorialPage_3435802_Content: Some memory scenarios stored in the Memory Post have become disordered. Push the Memory Post to restore the scene, then use the Heart of Frost Key to lock it in Stasis at the right moment to extract the memory you need.
GuideTutorialPage_34360_Content: When Rover's fox form overlaps with the Fox Phantom within a memory, the memory is completed and can be viewed.
GuideTutorialPage_34361_Content: When approaching a Homeward Fin, it will provide healing for Rover.
GuideTutorialPage_3436102_Content: Affected by Wuluo's frequency, some Homeward Fins have gone out of control, chasing Rover and attacking relentlessly.
GuideTutorialPage_3436103_Content: While in the fox form, you can use the Heart of Frost Key to freeze the Homeward Fins in Stasis, or roar to repel them.
GuideTutorialPage_34362_Content: In the Heart of Frost, some enemies are frozen in Stasis. They will break free of Stasis and attack Rover when approached within a certain distance.
GuideTutorialPage_34363_Content:
Some Inner Thresholds within the Heart of Bloom contain a second Inner Threshold inside them.
Changes to an Inner Threshold's interior pocket also affect the exterior pocket. (e.g., once a Dream Jade Tree grows within the interior pocket, some objects in the exterior pocket also become proliferable.)
Tutorial_34364_Title: Dream Jade Tree: Proliferation Stage One
GuideTutorialPage_34364_Content:
When the Dream Jade Tree is at Proliferation Stage One, it proliferates special objects, including Realm Keys.
Connecting flower trails supplies the Dream Jade Rootstone with Proliferation energy, allowing the Dream Jade Tree to keep growing.
Tutorial_3436402_Title: Dream Jade Tree: Proliferation Stage Two
GuideTutorialPage_3436402_Content: At Proliferation Stage Two, the Dream Jade Tree affects the Inner Threshold's exterior pocket, turning some of its objects proliferable.
GuideTutorialPage_32062_Content: Bloomburst Puppets disguise themselves as flowerbeds and potted plants. When a threat draws near, they unfold into Autopuppets and strike without warning.
GuideTutorial_34367_GroupName: Blooms for the Shadow: Shadow Binder
GuideTutorialPage_34367_Content: Activate the Shadow Binder to make the Nexus Fox Shadow respond.
GuideTutorial_34368_GroupName: Blooms for the Shadow: Nexus Fox Shadow
GuideTutorialPage_34368_Content: The Nexus Fox Shadow sometimes intervenes in what happens inside an Inner Threshold.
GuideTutorial_34369_GroupName: Blooms for the Shadow: Thousandfold Petals
GuideTutorialPage_34369_Content: Thousandfold Petals are scattered throughout the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. They come in three qualities, and once collected can be delivered to the Nexus Fox Shadow at the Heart Calmer.
GuideTutorialPage_34370_Content: Lit under the influence of the Heart of Flames Key, it continuously affects all related mechanisms and objects within its illuminated area.
GuideTutorialPage_34371_Content:
Activated under the influence of the Heart of Flames Key, it controls the movement of objects.
Once free of the Realm Key's influence, everything returns to normal, and objects return to their original positions.
GuideTutorialPage_34372_Content: Lit under the influence of the Heart of Flames Key, it continuously affects all related mechanisms and objects within its illuminated area.

<size=10></size>

Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> sends Lynae into <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. <size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color></size>

Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> cast recovers 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
Within a certain time after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1</color> {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2</color> also pulls in nearby targets.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color></size>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> is on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color></size>

- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.

With 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> become available.
Exiting <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.

<size=10></size>

Attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and generating a <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> at the target area. The array deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and inflicts {1} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on all targets within it every {0}s, lasting for {2}s. When <color=Highlight>Five Thunders Spell Array</color> is active, all Resonators in the team enter the <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> state.
- While in the <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> state, when any Resonator in the team casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>,  <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Primordial Qi</color> becomes <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Yin and Yang</color>.

- <color=Highlight>Thunder Spell - Heaven, Earth, Mind</color> grants {4} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> DMG Bonus to all active Resonators in the team.
<size=10></size>

Can be performed in mid-air.

As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> instantly trigger 1 instance of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG and reduce the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> attacks restore <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> reaches 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.

When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to transform back into <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>. When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4</color> will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> resistance to interruption increases. 
<color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>: 
<color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> or after <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> deals damage, raise the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
<color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> will transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> during <color=Highlight>quest dialogues</color>, <color=Highlight>environmental interaction animations</color>, or using <color=Highlight>Utilities</color>.
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.

Bamboo, hollow yet full; People, whole yet seldom true.

Every rushing hue converges upon her aim, and at last, she reaches a sky where nothing lies beyond her sight.

Every pattern can be observed. Every phenomenon can be understood.
The ideal may lie light-years away, yet the path toward it rests within her own hands.

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Iai Stance</color></size>
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after casting any <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a certain period after casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>.
Hiyuki may enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> while airborne. Upon entering the <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> ends if Hiyuki is switched out.
<size=10></size>

If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> is cast, if Hiyuki has <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> to inflict 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit, and gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.

Skill_1005501_SkillDescribe:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to {0} consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Parry Stance</color></size>

While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes {1}% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to exit <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color>, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {3}</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Havoc</color>
In <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>, use Dodge to consume STA to perform <color=Highlight>Dodge: Flicker</color>, which can trigger successful <color=Highlight>Dodges</color> during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {6}</color>.
<size=10></size>

<size=40><color=Title>Overshock</color></size>
At max <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Stage {0}</color>.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, clear all <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color> to grant Resonators in the team {1}% ATK Bonus for {2}s.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by holding down the button, consume <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color> to enter <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Apex Resonance</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> is unlocked, which consumes {4}% <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> per second:
While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to launch up to {5} consecutive attacks:
- The first <SapTag=5>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=5}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- The next <SapTag=6>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=6}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- The last <SapTag=7>{8}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=7}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
While on the ground, hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and leaping into the air.
While airborne, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to perform up to {9} stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first <SapTag=9>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=9}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- The next <SapTag=A>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=A}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last <SapTag=B>{12}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=B}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after landing to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>.
Each time <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> hits the target, <color=Highlight>Thunder Bane</color> is triggered, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target within range, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Electric Surge</color></size>
Rover can hold up to {13} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color> is restored when <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Deterrence</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Thunderclap</color>, or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Repel</color> deals damage.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Rage</color></size>
Rover can hold up to {14} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color>.
Entering <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color> restores <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> to the max limit.
<color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> is restored when <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> deals damage.

WheelBattle_1_Boss5_Desc:
<color=Highlight>Hyvatia</color>
- For 15s after defeating Hyvatia, all Resonators in the team are immune to damage.
- Vibration Strength Reduction taken by Hyvatia is reduced by 25%. When Hyvatia is in mid-air, the Vibration Strength Reduction it takes is increased by 50%.
- When a Resonator successfully triggers a Counterattack, Hyvatia builds up 30% of its Max <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color>. This effect has a 20s cooldown.
- When Hyvatia takes Tune Rupture DMG, its Vibration Strength is reduced by 8%. This effect has a 5s cooldown.
[Unlocked in Round 2] Hyvatia's Immobilization duration is reduced by 20%.
WheelBattle_1_Boss6_Desc:
<color=Highlight>Sentry Construct</color>
- For 15s after defeating Sentry Construct, all Resonators in the team are immune to damage.
- Vibration Strength Reduction taken by Sentry Construct is reduced by 25%. When Sentry Construct is in mid-air, it deals 30% more DMG. If it's affected by <color=Highlight>Negative Statuses</color> or <color=Highlight>Tunability - Shifting</color>, Resonators' Vibration Strength Reduction Rate is increased by 50%.
[Unlocked in Round 2] Sentry Construct's ATK is increased by 3% every 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses the stacking.

- Sentry Construct's ATK is increased by 3% every 5s, stacking up to 10 times. Immobilizing it clears all stacks and pauses the stacking.

<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color> inflict <SapTag=E>{18}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target hit. <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector</color> inflict <SapTag=F>{19}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=F} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target hit.

Morale_flagdesc_1:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3> A humanoid Tacet Discord with a body assembled from shattered stained glass. Glittering lights beam from its body with each move. It exudes a resilient beauty born of rebirth through destruction.
The stained glasses that form the Vitreum Dancers are varied and unique, making each Vitreum Dancer a unique existence.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_10:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade and extraordinary might existing only in legends.
Said to be the lost souls of fallen heroes, it was once witnessed slaying other Tacet Discords to protect villagers. Yet such acts were driven purely by an instinctual hunger for battle.
Though it has lost its heart, it stubbornly clings to the vestiges of past honor, wandering the world in solitary defiance.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_11:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Gehinom deals Fusion DMG equal to 4% of the targets' Max HP per second to the surrounding targets.
When Gehinom hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#9a9da3>A dragon-like Tacet Discord that haunts the peak of Penitent's End for an unknown reason, devouring all frequencies indiscriminately. Twisted by the frequencies of decay and death it consumes, it now appears as a dreadful, skeletal beast.
Once a sacred place, this island is now a grave of sorrow, and anyone who comes for redemption must face its fire of judgment.
Such is Gehinom, the Dragon of Dirge, whose flames burn to the bone, whose pain echoes, yearning for a final release.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_12:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Galecrest Gladiators follow the will of freedom. Bound by neither rule nor glory, they become the blade that severs all chains.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_13:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>A stone statue TD that embodies deconstruction and reconstruction. Though sluggish and clumsy, its punches are devastating.
It hurls rocks and other rock-mimic Tacet Discords as a means of attack.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_14:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the pale glow of the moon.
Said to be the lingering shadows of heroes in the old days, their kind retains a chivalrous demeanor even as they decay into TDs.
Glorious knights who have long forgotten their titles. Protectors with nothing to defend, bound by their relentless obsession with honor.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_15:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>Lumiscale Constructs are composed of Jué's defensive modules, commonly known as "Loong's Scales."
They are found throughout the Court of Savantae ruins in Mt. Firmament, tasked with eliminating intruders and potential threats to Jué.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_16:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
When inflicted with Spectro Frazzle, Lorelei takes 100% more damage.
When Lorelei hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#9a9da3>Once a remnant creature in Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.
Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the "Queen of the Night," seeking to cloak the Sanctum in endless darkness to clear all sins.
With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within the atrium, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_17:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Flamecrest Gladiators embody a warrior's undying passion. Wounds become fire, hardship their forge. Battle after battle, they chase a blood-lit path to their truest form.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_18:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>A humanoid Tacet Discord clad in fine attire, wielding a sharp blade. Seen only in the radiance of the sun.
Said to be the lost souls of fallen heroes, it retains an air of commanding dignity, even as a Tacet Discord.
Once a knight who has long forgotten the title they once bore, it has lost all it was sworn to protect. Now, only an unyielding obsession with honor remains.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_19:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>An enormous feline-mimic TD, only sighted in Mt. Firmament in Huanglong.
According to the Hongzhen Chronicle, it is a solitary TD with four claws and a scaly back. It is called "Lightcrusher" because of the glowing tracks left in its wake.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_2:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>Kerasaurs are amphibious Tacet Discords mimicking Saurosuchus. Fierce in battles, they are named for the rows of horns covering their bodies.
Not native to Septimont, Kerasaurs were introduced as gladiatorial opponents in matches, prized for their distinct appearance and aggressive behavior.
Their pronounced territorial instincts also make them suitable for training as functional Echoes, where they serve in roles such as city defense and patrol.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_20:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
When Arsinosa hits a target, the target's STA is reduced by 100%, triggered once every 10s.
Upon entering the battle, Arsinosa gains a Shield equal to 20% of her Max HP. If she hasn't taken damage for over 10s, she gains a Shield equal to 20% of her Max HP.
When Arsinosa hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#9a9da3>She guards the City of Glory, a valiant lioness of the arena.
Built with the pristine white stones that Gryphons are carved out of and tempered in the echoes of battle cries and the laughter of heroes.
This is Arsinosa, ever steadfast, watching over Septimont’s glory for all time.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_3:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
 When Lampylumen Myriad deals damage, it inflicts 3 stacks of Glacio Chafe on the target, triggered once every 6s.
 
 <color=#9a9da3>An ensnarer that slumbers in a freezing mine pit, obsessed with collecting and imitating sounds. It can imitate human speech through a vibrating hum.
 Lampylumen Myriad uses sound as bait to lure its prey, which will be frozen in the deep cold. The loss of warmth and the illusion before dying will cause human beings to pour out their last words, which contain great emotional fluctuations.
 For Lampylumen Myriad, this is the frequency of the supreme taste.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_4:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Lightcrest Gladiators uphold the ideal of justice. They bow to no tyrant, yield to no shadow. If justice has rotted, they shall forge it anew in light.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_5:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Frostcrest Gladiators bear unyielding resolve. Their fortitude is impervious to frost and bitter cold. Though blades may shatter, their creed endures.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_6:
The enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Hitting Kelpie with Counterattack further reduces its Vibration Strength by 50%.
When Kelpie is not Immobilized, its all Attribute RES is increased by 200%.
When Kelpie hits a target, the target's Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation's cooldown is extended by 5s, triggered once every 5s.

<color=#9a9da3>A humanoid TD born from the deep sea. Commonly found in all types of waters, it's known for its aggression and ferocity.
It attacks with sharp claws laced with paralytic toxins, then rips its prey apart and swallows them whole.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_7:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> against <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>A ferocious bear-mimic TD with Tacetite spikes on its head, neck, and shoulders. Its swings strike like a hurricane.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_8:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>Gladiators of Septimont who fight unrestrictedly, side by side with Echoes, ever in pursuit of the strong.
Thundercrest Gladiators wield stormborne might. Unmoved by favor and unbowed by power. Beneath the thunder’s judgment, right and wrong divide.</color>
Morale_flagdesc_9:
The enemies have a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=#9a9da3>It holds the authority to command other Echoes of the Order, carrying out the Order's will to eliminate any transgressors.
Just as the Order's authority is inviolable, so too is the power of the Echo.</color>
Morale_title_20: <color=#ffcd23>This is a high-difficulty challenge. Please be fully prepared.</color>
Morale_title_21:
Banner Trophy Chest: Defeat enemies in Banner of Conquest: Medium and Banner of Conquest: Major within the zone to earn valuable rewards.

Exploration Trophy Chest: These Trophy Chests are scattered throughout the zone. After activating banners during the challenge, you can harness their power to locate the chests. They will remain in the zone after the event ends.
Morale_title_23:
[Blessing of the Lioness of Glory]:
Warriors that pass the trial will be blessed by the Lioness of Glory: All Resonators in the team have their ATK, Max HP, and <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> increased by <color=Highlight>25%</color>.
Morale_title_29:
The environment in the zone is perilous. It's recommended to raise your Glory Level by taking on the banners that match your current level first.
Their blessings will help you reclaim your former glory faster.
Morale_title_33: The event ends when all Banners are activated

RogueRes_Event_Desc_2: A bit of a nuisance, but still manageable.

RogueRes_Event_Name_110051: Main Story: In the Name of Heroes
RogueRes_Event_Desc_110011: Great friendships start with a chance encounter.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_110021: A shadow in the shape of a bird cuts across your vision.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_110031: "From now on, refrain from using your powers. Is that understood?" the doctor warned.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_110041: "Then I'll fight fate... And I'll win!"
RogueRes_Event_Desc_110051: The weather after the rain was always pleasant. Just another ordinary day on a long road ahead.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120011: Mom says Starflowers bring good luck, and I'd like to share some of that luck with you.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120021: Medicine is the art of compassion.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120031: They say that before the chaos of the unidentified lifeforms, this place gave the entire city its greatest sense of security.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120041: "As long as I don't have it on me, my editor will never find me..."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120061: Come on, friends! Today's the day to give your childhood another go!
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120071: "As long as someone is profiting from these attacks, we can't rule out the possibility."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120081: "I really like this city. Everyone here is chasing their dreams."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120091: Sometimes, it's nice to sit back, relax, and have a good chat with your friends.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120101: A little girl clutches a stuffed animal, oblivious to the approaching danger.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120111: A hysterical man gives a speech about the unidentified lifeforms.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120121: A swaying figure holding a glass bottle stumbles out from the shadows.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120131: Great bands don't fail... they just break up.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_210011: The day marks the beginning of another sixteen-year cycle. People from different factions gather at the inn located at the base of the mountain.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_210021: "This is a place of prayer. Violence is strictly prohibited on these grounds."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_210031: Snowflakes pass through the echoes and illusions left by past seekers, falling onto the bodies of both the living and the dead.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_210041: The lamp in her hand casts a glow on the scales along her cheeks and neck.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_210051: How long did it take for it to return?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220011: As the scent of incense lingers, an echo from the past draws your attention.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220021: "The flame never goes out. It endures because people feed themselves to it."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220031: You can feel the joy when she says the word "together."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220041: "I can tell by your remarkable physique, you must be a once-in-a-millenium martial arts prodigy..."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220051: A blue-haired girl who looks familiar barters with an antique shop owner, several porcelain bowls clasped tightly in her hands.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220061: "That Divine Loong must be a workaholic."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220071: "Being human is hard enough, but being a happy human? Even harder..."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220081: It is the frequency of someone caught between life and death, not yet fully consumed.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220091: Beneath the stellar halo above, soft whispers ride the wind.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220101: Something catches your eye. What looks to be dark stone lies buried in the shadow of withered trees.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220111: Through the swirling snow, you spot a man, his arms raised high, his voice cutting through the storm with a manic roar.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220121: Hello, welcome to the Room of Wishes.
RogueRes_Event_Name_310021: Main Story: Aroma in the Cave
RogueRes_Event_Name_310051: Main Story: Shores Shrouded in Mystery
RogueRes_Event_Name_310071: Main Story: The Souls Beyond the Black Hole
RogueRes_Event_Desc_310011: A call brings your long-awaited vacation to an end.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_310021: Meeting a girl as vibrant as a camellia in full bloom makes you question the rules of this world.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_310031: Your lost memories are seemingly unraveled by a stranger's hands.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_310051: "But are you truly in control of your own fate?"
RogueRes_Event_Desc_310061: You march forward on the endless path of thought and progress, striving to reach the ultimate truth of morality that human wisdom can touch...
RogueRes_Event_Desc_310071: Beyond the dying black hole, there is Solaris, a vast land of bitter or sweet stories and endless bonds waiting to be formed.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320011: His ability to analyze escape routes was second to none. No fugitive ever slipped past his calculations.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320021: You spot a young delivery girl dodging a pack of monsters while a cargo box bobs on her back.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320031: The moment you see her, her name pops into your mind. She is one of the three Prescients overseeing Psyche Pass—the Fleece Prescient.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320041: Through the rain, you catch sight of a man's silhouette.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320051: Against the moonlight, his face is veiled in its shadow, but you can see the curve of his eyes, the faintest hint of a smile there.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320061: You realize it's a hidden outpost built as a place for Sentries to rest and recover.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320071: But you're not the first to arrive. You barely have time to take it all in before you come face-to-face with a squad of resting Sentries.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320081: A hunt is closing in, swift and inevitable, like a storm on the horizon.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320091: You glance back at the frantic attacker, still waving his knife, and the businessman shaking in fear. Then, you decide to—

RogueRes_Event_Name_620121: Encounter: Trip on an Abandoned Train II

RogueRes_Event_Name_620251: Encounter: Lone Tree in a Forsaken Corner II

RogueRes_Event_Name_620311: Encounter: Light up the Moon II
