RogueRes_Event_Name_620351: Encounter: Voice at the Seabed I
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620011: You trace the humming to its source, where you find a familiar gate.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620021: You trace the humming to its source, where you find a familiar gate.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620031: You trace the humming to its source, where you find a familiar gate.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620041: Hello. How can I help you?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620051: I am sorry, my friend. We are closed for today.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620061: No one is there to greet you today at Solaris Retail. Finally, the blessing of silence.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620071: On the screen, you see the long-missed Solaris, the gateway to Somnoire, and two cats.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620081: On the screen, you see the long-missed Solaris, the gateway to Somnoire, and two cats.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620091: Who would call you at a time like this?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620101: Who would call you at a time like this?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620111: Its headlight pierces through the mist and darkness. It arrives before you, right on time.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620121: Its headlight pierces through the mist and darkness. It arrives before you, right on time.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620131: A rat invites you to its show tomorrow.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620141: A rat delivers an impassioned performance on stage.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620151: You can't tell if this confession is just an act or a true expression of feeling.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620161: Time within the painting freezes once more, oblivious to the drips and splatters of overflowing colors.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620171: This time, it is a tranquil island under a shower of shooting stars.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620181: Silence. Only dead silence remains as far as the eye can see.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620221: They study you closely like old acquaintances. Your clothes, your posture. They want to reach your essence and the civilization you carry with you.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620231: They cleave to the stones, stretching eagerly upwards as if begging your merciful hand to take them away.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620241: One branch stands out. Long. Reaching beyond the cliffside. It's an invitation. Following it, you might find your way upward.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620251: When you finally make it to the top, a bloated package catches your eye.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620261: "Coins please. Give me some coins." One of them seems to whisper.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620271:
You lean closer, your head above its mouth. Inside, you find half a pot of water.
The reflection, vague yet familiar, slowly emerges on the water's surface.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620291: It emits faint glimmers, abyssal light.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620301: You find yourself in pitch dark. Leaves rustle as wind slithers through. You realize you're in a forest.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620311: You heard a story. A long time ago. A story of a forest where moonlight never reaches, where night falls like an abyss...
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620321: You see a massive, black rock hurtling straight at you.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620331: You fall into a bottomless pit...
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620341: "To my surprise, the visitor's still lingering in the 'story'..."
RogueRes_Event_Desc_620351: Who are you waiting for? Have you fallen into the same dilemma as her?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320101: For a moment, it all feels familiar. You must have walked this shore with someone.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_120141: In this city, no two days are the same.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_220131: Through the swirling snow, you see something, but only faintly.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_320111: The shore is wrapped in a thin fog, blurring your vision.
RogueRes_Event_Name_410011: Main Story: Return From the Night
RogueRes_Event_Name_410041: Main Story: Debts Paid in Full
RogueRes_Event_Desc_410011: The Gondola glides steadily through the water, the ripples reflecting the stars in Ragunna's night sky.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_410021:
When you see the members of the circus, it was as if you'd stepped back into that vibrant, raucous era that once belonged to them.
They welcome you with open arms, and offer a piece of information.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_410031: You pondered their words as you stepped into a restaurant.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_410041:
You tell yourself that perhaps this is the best outcome.
Debts have been settled. Not all, but you've done what you could.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_410051: Tonight, the Age of Sea Winds draws to a close.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420011: She was a girl born aboard a ship, a child of the waves who had never once set foot on solid ground.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420021: You turn to look at the waterway. The idyllic waterways of Ragunna City suddenly darken, and the Gondolas are replaced by massive, shadowy sea creatures.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420031:
After crossing Thessaleo Fells, you travel east and arrive at Porto-Veno Castle.
Such a journey could never be a mere whim. You are here by appointment.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420041: You decide to explore the market. Which merchant's Gondola will you approach?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420051: It looks like a full-blown market brawl is about to erupt.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420061: A band of fallen knights block your path.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420071: You find a shiny new Monnaie coin lying on the ground.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420081: But at the top of the island, beneath the towering lighthouse, an auction is in full swing.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420091: Are there any items you would like to bid on?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420101: Years have passed, and as you return to Ragunna, everything feels unfamiliar.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_420111: Today is the auction house's day off. Since there's nothing better to do around here, why not take a brief rest youself?
RogueRes_Event_Name_520011: Encounter: A Gift From the Sky
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510011: The fifth film didn't premiere as scheduled. Something went wrong in the cinema.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510021: Now, two bodies lie cold in the cinema... As the first ones on the scene, you choose to investigate carefully.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510031: Behind you, the rest of the crew make their choices.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510041: If anything happens... you will be the one to piece together the truth.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510051: Things have really taken a sharp turn for the worse.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510061: It's time to lift the curtain.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510071: When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510081: What's there to be scared of when it's already been wrecked once?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510091: Existence. Existence is the only thing that really matters.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510101: Even if your home is lost, even if your people vanish, even if your words and history fade away... at the very end of time, dreams will still remain.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510111: Cheer up. You're the first person to ever see this. That's got to count for something.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520011: It will light up the night and grant future generations the time they need.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520021: If we ever got into an argument with someone who speaks a Level-30 language, how the hell would we win?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520031: I am now the last remaining human member of the ship's crew, reporting everything I have witnessed during this mission.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520041: And once we got a job, will everything get better?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520051: You are like a coffin, sealed up with all that pride and fear of yours inside.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520061: Everyone wants to change their fate.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520071: Who must be sacrificed? Or, are you ready to stop that train regardless of the cost?
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520091: We don't need someone who aspires to heroism.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520101: To take on the task of saving, and the risk of hoping.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520131: Posters filled the theater's hallway, each more bizarre than the last.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_520111: You trace down the humming to its source, where you find a familiar gate.
RogueRes_Event_Desc_510121: You've made your judgment. Now, it's time to draw your blade.
RogueRes_Event_Name_410061: Main Story: Prelude to the Carnevale
RogueRes_Event_Desc_410061:
As the sun dipped below the horizon, the clock tower's bells signaled the start of evening.
Streets were draped in ribbons and lanterns, while balloons and colorful streamers floated lazily above.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_1: Through the darkness, your vision slowly begins to clear.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_2: "Good morning, everyone. Thank you for watching Megalopolis Today. We begin today's morning news with a report on an attack by unidentified lifeforms that occurred at Memorial Park around 9:30 p.m. yesterday. Local authorities have confirmed that all victims have been safely transported to Central Hospital for treatment, and surprisingly zero deaths resulted from the incident. Witnesses claim seeing a second unidentified lifeform using flames to eliminate the creatures involved in the attack. Now, let's turn our attention to the live report from our correspondent on the scene." On the glowing screen, a woman sits in a spacious office, speaking directly to the camera.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_3: "Thank you. Behind me is the scene where the attack took place last night. Even at this distance, the destruction caused by these unidentified lifeforms is extensive. As you can see, the damaged concrete structures and…" The scene cuts to an outdoor area filled with foliage, as the man referred to as the news correspondent continues his report. You quickly realize this is a live broadcast using a communication device similar to a Terminal.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_4: "Mom! I'm on TV!" An excited citizen suddenly bursts into the frame.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_5: "As you can see, the damaged concrete structures and exposed steel reinforcements are riddled with holes. It appears that one of the unidentified lifeforms may have used a firearm, and scorch marks are visible on the wreckage..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_6: "What a load of crap!" A citizen with a thick accent suddenly pops up from below the screen.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_7: "Yeah! What do you mean, 'unidentified lifeform using flames'?! It was Flame Ranger, for Sentinel's sake. The Guardian of the City!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_9: The screen flickers, accompanied by a burst of static, before cutting back to the news studio.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_10: "It seems we've run into some issues with the feed from our correspondent. Next up on Megalopolis Today, a meet-and-greet signing event scheduled this morning for the comic book artist, Danqing, was canceled after the organizers failed to contact the artist. The venue is now packed with fans who have been waiting in line since the night before..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_11: "I can't believe it! You saw what happened last night, right, Abby? You were there. Up close. You saw how I was kicking butt and taking names. In what world did I come remotely close to being like one of those monsters?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_12: "(Yawns)... How long was I asleep...? You say something, Chixia?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_13: "Chixia? Who's Chixia? My full name is Flame Ranger—Tch, ow! I'm still sore there..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_14: You remember the hint from that *piece of paper*. It appears that you're already inside a "movie."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_15: "Either way! No one got hurt in the end, which is great. Thanks for having my back yesterday, partner."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110011_17: A fight scene flashes through your head...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_1: You recall yesterday's attack. One which you successfully stopped from turning into a terrible disaster.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_2: "That's the third attack this month... What are those things, anyway? Any ideas, {PlayerName}?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_4: "Tacet... Discords? Never heard of 'em. Well, whatever those things are, if they dare show their ugly faces again, I'll send 'em right back to wherever they came from..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_5: "WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—" Your conversation is interrupted by the wail of an ambulance screeching past you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_6: "Hey, hey, quit looking at me like that! I get it, alright? But I'm fine. I became Flame Ranger to protect the smiles, not let anyone shed tears on my watch. You think I'm gonna let that happen?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_7: "Still, you should probably get that wound from yesterday checked at the hospital."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_8: "Oh, that? It's almost as good as new! Just a little scratch, patched it up myself."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_9: "Wait, you're not scared of going to the doctor, are you?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_11: "WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—" In the brief silence, the ambulance's shrill wails gradually fade into the distance.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110012_12: "Alright... If you're so worried, let's head to the hospital right now! Might as well check on those poor folks from yesterday while we're at it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_1: "This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, and community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_2: You arrive at what appears to be a train station. Inside the steel behemoth, the air is thick with the clamor of people coming and going and the constant murmur of the PA system blaring the same message on a loop. Truth be told, you've never seen this many bodies packed together, not even during the Carnevale in Ragunna...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_3: Suddenly, a girl with a familiar blue hat stops you in your tracks.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_4: "Hello. I am the Public Security officer on duty. May I see your identifications, please? ...Hmm? You're the girl from the accident scene earlier..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_5: "Huh? Isn't this Yangyang? What's up with this Public Security officer thing?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_6: "It's probably something similar to a Patroller..." You whisper, keeping your voice low. Abby responds with a puzzled nod.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_7: "Oh, hey! If it isn't my favorite officer! Here's my ID."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_8: "Mm... In light of recent incidents, we're conducting security checks at all points of entry... for the safety of the public." After verifying your IDs, the officer gestures for you to proceed. "Your IDs are in order. Thank you for your cooperation."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_9: "Incidents. You mean those freaky monsters causing all the chaos, right?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_10: "Yes. We still haven't figured out the pattern or logic behind their movements. All we know is that they attack anything on sight." The officer frowns as if recalling the incidents from the past days.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_11: "We have to treat this with the utmost caution. Places like the train station, the business districts, and Central Hospital are packed with people. If something happens, we Public Security officers are the first line of defense."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_12: "Being an officer sure is tough... Wouldn't it be great if Flame Ranger could swoop in every time and save the day?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_14: "This Flame Ranger... the one from yesterday's incident?" It's clear that the name has caught the officer's attention.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_15: "What do you make of this Flame Ranger, Officer?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_16: "Flame Ranger... She's shown up during multiple crises... From her actions, it seems she's either a masked hero or a vigilante."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_17: "You mean the legendary Ally of Justice?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_18: "Justice...? Her abilities are disturbingly similar to those of the unidentified lifeforms. For the sake of public safety, I'm afraid I can't condone someone like that living in the city."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_19: "If we just accept what she's doing, what happens if one day she loses control and turns into one of those mindless creatures?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_20: "Phew. She's got her hands full, huh? See? I told you being an officer is tough."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_21: A sudden burst of noise erupts from a nearby crowd. You turn to glimpse a massive creature emerging from the shadows between buildings.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_22: A shadow in the shape of a bird cuts across your vision—the officer with the blue hat. Weapon drawn, she leaps forward, rushing straight toward the fleeing crowd.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_24: "Everyone, get back! Now! Move this way and remain calm!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_25: "I'm with Public Security. Follow my lead and evacuate the building to my left!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_26: "See, what did I just tell ya... Wait, where are you going?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110021_27: "To help her, duh! I'm not letting her fight that thing by herself!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_01: Together, you successfully repel the monster's attack and ensure all citizens are evacuated. But just as quickly, new monsters emerge from the shadows.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_02: A nagging sense of déjà vu claws at you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_03: "This is no place for a civilian. How could you be so foolish and reckless!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_04: "I admire people like you, Officer. That's why I can't let you face this alone!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_06: "I don't want to see anyone crying because of these monsters. This city deserves to see smiles every damn day."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_07: "What are you doing? Get back here!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_09: Flames burst from the girl's Tacet Mark and engulf her in blazing light. As the flames subside, a familiar figure stands before you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_10: "I trust you, Officer... And I hope you'll trust me, too. Keep this between the two of us, will ya?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_12: "The glowing star mark is my weak spot. So, if one day..." She hesitates, as if a memory flashes before her. She cuts herself off. "No. I can't. I promised someone I wouldn't turn into that."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110022_13: "Oh, whatever. Overthinking isn't my style. Flame Ranger, roll out!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_01: You and Abby arrive at the clinical research department of Central Hospital, where the air is thick with the smell of medicine and disinfectants. The bustling atmosphere here rivals that of Huaxu Academy.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_02: "From now on, refrain from using your powers. Is that understood?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_04: "Have I not made myself clear? Given your current physiological state, continued exposure to homologous influences could accelerate cellular degeneration or necrosis. Your body's organic components are diminishing, resulting in a metamorphosis towards a state resembling that of the unidentified lifeforms. Now, listen carefully. I do not concern myself with your aspirations to be the Flame Ranger or the Ally of Justice. However, you promised me that you'd avoid such a transformation. Do you not remember this?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_05: "Of course I do. You just gotta trust me."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_06: "I do wish to place my trust in you, but your decisions directly contradict your stated objectives. If the current situation is allowed to persist, your excessive energy input and the influence of the homologous entities will push you toward a state that can no longer be classified as human. We are still in the preliminary stages of our research into these unknown phenomena, which means it is highly probable that this process is irreversible. Consequently, the very desire you expressed to eliminate the cause of people's tears caused by the unidentified lifeforms will become a lie. And your recklessness will force Officer Skylark to become the one who must terminate a friend. Or is this the outcome you foresee?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_07: "Yup. Can't understand a word she's saying, no matter which version of Baizhi it is.."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_08: "All right, all right, Doc... You don't have to make it sound so dramatic. Besides, a real hero doesn't go out that easily."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_09: [Bond Boost] You should listen to your friend.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_10: [Status Boost] You should take better care of yourself.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_11: "Well, my partner here makes some good points... l got it. Relax! Nothing a good night's sleep won't fix."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_12: "Make sure to contact me if she tries anything again, {PlayerName}." The researcher sighs heavily, passing the responsibility onto you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_14: "Come on, is that really necessary? Did you see how much damage those freaks can do? What happens if you get hurt... Uh..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110031_15: "Okay, okay. You're giving me that look again. I get it. I'm not as hot-headed as you think... I'll get some rest."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_01: "We interrupt with an emergency report. Just ten minutes ago, multiple reports came in regarding a large-scale attack by unidentified lifeforms in the Central Business District. Public Security has established an exclusion zone and deployed multiple search and rescue teams. Citizens are advised to stay inside, avoid the exclusion area, and take necessary precautions. Those still within the exclusion zone should find shelter or head to designated evacuation points for assistance. We now join our correspondent at one of the evacuation points for more details on the attack."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_02: "Good evening. We're currently standing in front of Midnight Square, with the second evacuation point just behind us, closest to the scene of today's devasting attack. Here we can see Public Security has set up a large convoy of transport vehicles, forming what's essentially a conveyor belt for evacuating citizens..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_04: The camera whirls in a chaotic spin, accompanied by screams and the sound of clashing metal. The broadcast cuts to black, with the last frame showing the officer rushing forward and pushing the reporter aside.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_05: Abby points to the window and you notice that rain has begun to fall over the city.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_06: "...Our correspondent seems to have encountered some technical difficulties. We repeat the advisory from Public Security: Citizens still within the exclusion zone should seek shelter and await rescue, or head to designated evacuation points for assistance..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_07: "That's our cue, {PlayerName}. We gotta get over there!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_09: "I need to go help those people. You saw the news!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_10: "I must remind you that your mutations have not fully recovered or been mitigated since your last interval. If you insist on going, all the promises you made to me will be in vain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_11: "I can't just stand here and do nothing. We know that officer on TV... I have to protect everyone. A hero can't just turn tail and run."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_12: "...Seeing as I can't convince you." The disappointment in the researcher's voice is palpable.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_13: "Seeing as I can't convince you, I ask that you don't let your powers consume you. And don't you dare die in battle. If that happens, I will consider it a betrayal."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_14: "Hehe." She flashes her signature smile, as if to reassure her companion.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110041_16: "Let's go, everyone! Here I come to save the day!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_01: You force your way through the encroaching monsters, carving a path for the civilians and Public Security officers to escape, but the situation remains grim. The rain continues to pour, and monsters keep emerging from the fissure in the ground.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_02: You quickly understand why all this feels familiar. The fissure beneath the city. The root of all these attacks.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_03: "What are you doing here? Get out of here, now! Can't you see this situation has spiraled out of control?!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_07: "This isn't a game. This is not the time for theatrics."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_08: "You don't have to become the Flame Ranger. You're just an ordinary citizen who happens to have powers. You have no obligation to fight!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_09: The rain drowns out her voice, no matter how loud she yells. You can only make out her words by reading her lips, straining to understand through the chaos.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_10: "That's a bit too much for my brain, Officer. Gimme some time to process all that."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_13: "To be honest, I've been scared. Ever since that big lecture Doc gave me. Scared that I might actually turn into one of these things."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_14: "Right now, I feel... like I'm just glad I got to know all of you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_15: "Wait. What are you planning to do?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_16: "You said those things are called Tacet Discords, right, {PlayerName}? That they bring disaster and destroy civilizations."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_17: "That makes it sound like humanity's fate has already been decided or something."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_18: "But being a hero is my job. If that's all true, then I'll fight fate... And I'll win!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_20: A blinding flash of light and fire erupts from her Tacet Mark.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110051_21: Engage in the final battle to defend the city.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_01: "This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else, and the most popular hero story ever. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_02: The city's train station is as busy and crowded as usual, but unlike before, no officers are waiting to check your IDs today. On the sidewalk in the distance, a girl with a backpack hurries toward you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_03: "I'm here! Phew, made it. Sorry, I'm late... Hit a bit of traffic on the way."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_04: "No need to worry. I've already accounted for your delay in the deviation margins. Current expectations remain within acceptable parameters. We will now board the express train to Midnight Square Station. From there, we'll take the airport highway and maintain a speed that will ensure we arrive on time for the afternoon flight at the mere cost of a speeding ticket. The sole variable that remains is the uncertainty associated with the traversal time from the airport parking terminal to the acquisition of our boarding passes, followed by the security screening checkpoint..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_05: "Hold on. I don't think that's a valid reason for us to purposely risk a speeding ticket."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_06: "What's a speeding ticket? Short for 'speed-eating ticket'? I bet I could bring that trophy home!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_08: "As good as it'll ever be! I'm in tip-top shape with one helluva appetite. I can still gobble down two servings of spicy beef hotpot if I wanted!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_09: Upon hearing spicy hotpot mentioned, you notice an annoyed expression on the researcher's face. "The health risks from your previous encounter still remain. Although there isn't a necessity for transformation at this time, I encourage you to avoid highly spicy foods until a cure is found for your condition. Such foods contain over—
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_10: "Um, Professor. I don't think that's what she meant..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_12: "Hehe. Hey, it stopped raining. Don't you guys think we should head out now?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_13: "The next train's gonna be leaving at twelve-thirty. We'd better get moving, or else we'll— " The girl swings her arms around in the shape of a clock, emphasizing the urgency of time ticking away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_16: And so, a hero's tale, full of familiar tropes and strange twists, quietly came to a close. Together, they set out on their journey to distant horizons. The weather after the rain was always pleasant. Just another ordinary day on a long road ahead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_17: As the laughter and chatter fade, the world before you blurs and dims... The strange third-person perspective slips away, and you find yourself once again seated in the theater.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_18: Completed Theater 1 "Transforming Hero: Flame Ranger" - Ending Unlocked: "In the Name of Heroes"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_1: You are at Central Hospital. At first glance, it's difficult to believe that such a spectacular building serves as a medical facility. They say that before the chaos of the unidentified lifeforms, this place gave the entire city its greatest sense of security.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_2: In the busy hallways, you spot a familiar figure clutching a wrapped box, her eyes shifting restlessly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_3: "Um... Hello. Do you know how to get to the inpatient center?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_4: "The inpatient center is at Building 2. This is Building 1."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_5: "Ah, so that's why. Thank you so much."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_7: "Oh, really? That would be great. Thank you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_8: "What are you doing here by yourself?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_9: "I'm here to bring my mom some lunch... She's been receiving treatment and needs all the rest she can get. I thought I'd run the errand for her. "
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_10: "Say, I've been wanting to ask. What's that you got there in your hands? Smells really good!" Abby sniffs the air, eyeing the box in the girl's hands.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_12: "Hey. Hold your horses. I haven't said anything yet."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_13: "I'm sorry. I'd love to, but this is the only thing I can't share with you. It's the lunch I made for my mom. The food around here is usually too rich, so I thought something lighter would be better for her."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_14: "I'm still working on my cooking. I hope all the healthy ingredients I used will help Mom feel better soon... If you'd really like to try, I can make extra next time."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_15: "That's ok, you don't have to. I just thought it smelled really good, that's all. I prefer my chili, anyway."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_16: "We wish your mother a speedy recovery."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120011_18: The mention of her mother's health seems to deepen the girl's worry.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_1: You are at Central Hospital. At first glance, it's difficult to believe that such a spectacular building serves as a medical facility. They say that before the chaos of the unidentified lifeforms, this place gave the entire city its greatest sense of security.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_2: As you move through the bustling hallways of the inpatient center, a familiar figure catches your eye. Outside one of the patient rooms, he stands, absorbed in the files in his hands.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_3: "...It's not just human tissue that's being affected by those unidentified lifeforms. Conservative treatments won't address the root of the problem."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_4: "...No, that's out of the question. The new medication hasn't even had its first clinical trial."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_5: "You seem really torn up. The general I know would never!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_7: "The general you know? Ahem... Forgive me, I got caught up in my thoughts. I'm the attending physician in this department. Do you know the patient in this room?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_8: "No, we don't. You mentioned the unidentified lifeforms. Does this mean...?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_9: "Yes... This patient was injured during the attacks. A mother of a grade-schooler. Have you already met her daughter?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_12: "I see... All the victims from those recent incidents have all been transferred to this department."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_13: "I'm ashamed to admit that while I can treat their physical injuries, I've yet to find a cure to the mutations caused by these unique energies."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_14: "If this situation persists, the number of people affected by those lifeforms will only keep growing."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_15: "Medicine is the art of compassion... But to truly resolve this crisis, we have to eliminate the source of this disaster."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_18: We're looking for allies to fight those monsters together.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_19: "So that's why you're here. Now that I think about it, the unique energy I sensed earlier must've come from you two."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120021_20: "If this gives me a chance to change the fate of these patients, I'll gladly help."

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120031_11: "Whoa, whoa, whoa! That's definitely not why we're here!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120031_12: "I was expecting a more composed reaction from you. After all, we must all master the art of a proper farewell, don't you think?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120031_13: "Working here long enough, and you get used to these kinds of situations."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120031_14: "Which is why, sometimes, it's the patients who end up saving the doctors, not the other way around."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120031_15: The girl in the beret falls silent after her words. You quietly exit the office, not sparing a glance back.

The mysterious artist's true identity is actually a cute young lady? Purchase a comic at the event and receive a special bookmark, or purchase the complete collector's edition for a photo op with the artist in person..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120041_11: "Umm, well. Yes. Yes, it is me. I wasn't wearing glasses back then..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120041_14: "I, uh... Here, take this. Please... just don't tell anyone I'm here, okay?

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_1: You find yourself in the heart of the Business District plaza. Despite the unease caused by the recent attacks, the streets are still bustling with shoppers.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_3: "Ah, welcome to Lightning Outfitters! If anything catches your eye, don't hesitate to let me know."

Over here, we have tents and mounting kits. Think of them as the perfect partners for your sleeping bag. Peanut butter and jelly, if you will."

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_12: "Heh... Don't worry, interest in outdoor sports and exercise is always a good thing. After all, your body's your temple, yes? The younger crowd's always chasing this and that, but I always say, before you hustle, make sure you're taking care of yourself first."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_13: "When those monsters attacked, I helped with the rescue efforts. Saw a lot of people struggling because they weren't in good shape. They couldn't keep up with the evacuations."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_14: "A little attention to your health can make all the difference when life starts throwing curveballs."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_15: You were part of the rescues?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_16: "Indeed. Twice. I'm just a regular civilian, but I can hold my own. If I can help keep people safe when it matters most, I'll be there."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120051_17: "There's no knowing when the next attack will happen. So if there's anything I can help with, you know where to find me. I've got your back."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_1: You find yourself in the heart of the Business District plaza. Despite the unease caused by the recent attacks, the streets are still bustling with shoppers.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_3: "Ten credits per draw. Prize guaranteed at draw No. 70! Remember your childhood dreams that seemed just beyond the glass window? Come on, friends! Today's the day to give your childhood another go!"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_6: [Fleeting Fancy] I'll give it a shot!
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_8: You pull out a few coins from your pocket and decide to give it a try... In just minutes, you master the controls. It's not as tricky as you thought. "This could be an easy catch," you think.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_9: As the claw hoists the stuffed cat, you feel like you've traveled back to the city's industrial age. You can almost see the workers laying underground sewer lines and building factories, watching architecture evolve through the ages.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_10: But just as quickly, the toy slips from the claw and falls back inside with the others. You've failed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_12: [Save the Drama] It's a scam. I'm cutting my losses.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_13: You fish out a few more coins from your pocket. Giving up was never your style... even if the prize is just a plush kitty.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_14: The second the toy is lifted again, your vision stretches beyond the machine's limits. You see the people of Solaris reaching toward the sky for the first time and the inventor of the Glider leaping from a mountaintop.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_15: Then, in the distance, you see an obelisk-shaped behemoth slowly rising into the sky, shooting flames as it ascends before disappearing into the clouds... but once again, the toy slips from the claw.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_16: [Fleeting Fancy] I will not admit defeat!
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_17: [Save the Drama] Mistakes can always be corrected.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_18: At this point, winning the stuffed cat isn't the real goal. The game has become a test of will, a battle against fate itself. Like the legend of the man condemned to push a boulder up a mountain forever, you are no longer afraid of the toy's inevitable fall.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_19: ...And this time, victory is yours. The stuffed cat is finally within your grasp. It's just a simple toy, and you can't imagine anyone but Abby celebrating with you. But hey, you won. And that's what counts.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_20: It's obvious that this claw machine wasn't designed for reliability. It's just a stuffed cat, after all. "That wasn't as disappointing as I thought," you tell yourself.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_21: You lost some spare change, but stepping away when you did keeps things from getting worse. The wise are proficient in risk management.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120061_22: You didn't have a childhood dream to fulfill, at least not inside of a claw machine.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_1: You now stand at the outdoor plaza in the center of Memorial Park, where wooden embankments surround a stage in the lake. They say this spot is usually used for performances, but it's been abandoned ever since the last attack.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_2: You notice a familiar figure pacing back and forth nearby, her eyes scanning the area as she jots something down in her notebook.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_3: "From the timing and patterns, these weren't premeditated attacks... The lifeforms were already lurking in the city, waiting to act once provoked... We can't eliminate the possibility that they're being controlled."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_4: "The scorch marks and bullet holes suggest that Flame Ranger took a heavy hit from the north. That means the lifeforms came from behind the stage... Were they targeting someone specific?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_5: "No... Wait, the timing doesn't add up. Instead of targeting a specific person, it's more likely they were drawn to certain signatures in the crowd and were acting on instinct when the attack started."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_7: "Hm? Yes, I'm collecting evidence. And you must be...? Ah, I see. I'm a temporary investigator with Public Security. You seem to know a thing or two about these lifeforms. Mind sharing what you got?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_8: You share with the investigator your findings.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_9: "So you're saying these things can mimic human traits, but without full awareness? If that's the case, then they don't sound like planned experiments... That also matches the combat traces we found."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_10: "So, do you think those Fractsidus goons are involved in this, Yinlin?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_11: "Yinlin? Fractsidus? I'm unfamiliar with these names... But I did suspect some kind of criminal activity. Recently, there have been multiple reports of illegal trafficking in untraceable pharmaceuticals. These drugs claim to be capable of creating those monsters, curing diseases, or even granting superpowers like Flame Ranger's... Heh, no matter how ridiculous the rumors may sound, as long as someone is profiting from these attacks, we can't rule out the possibility."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_12: "Criminally motivated? Man, why does all the crazy stuff always happen in big cities?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_14: "Still, after some on-site investigation and profiling, I have to admit that these lifeforms are beyond my current understanding. It's most likely that these criminals are just petty thieves cashing in on the situation."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_15: "I appreciate your help. Once we can narrow down the list of possible suspects, we'll be closer to solving this case. If everything goes as planned, we should have answers for the public within a few days."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_16: "We appreciate the hard work, Officer!" Abby raises a paw in a playful salute, mimicking a Public Security officer.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_17: "Heh... By the way, if you ever need help with those monsters, don't hesitate to ask."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_18: "Though it's not exactly an investigator's job, ensuring public safety is still one of our responsibilities."

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120081_15: You accept a CD case with a handwritten signature and date from the tourist.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120081_16: "It's a demo song I prepared for my new performance. I'm still taking feedback from friends. Have a listen to it, if you don't mind. I hope it brings you good luck!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120081_17: "Well then, I look forward to seeing you on stage next time, friend!"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_1: The first thing you feel is the cold creeping into your fingertips and spreading up your hands. Then, bit by bit, light filters into your vision. You awaken in the realm of film once more.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_2: Flurrying snow blankets this old town, the cold cutting through your clothing, seeping into your very bones.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_4: "Brrr! It's freezing out here! Where are we? Is this even Solaris?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_5: You brush the snow from Abby's head and scan the area. An inn stands before you, and you reach out to open the door. This must be where the story of Theater 2 begins.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_6: The door swings open, a blast of snow rushing in. Two groups, facing off across tables, look your way.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_8: A girl hidden under a hood sits quietly in the corner, clearly startled by your arrival, her eyes scanning you as if unsure of what she's seeing.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_9: The door creaks shut, blocking out the howling wind, leaving only the hiss of boiling tea. The terrified innkeeper wipes the counter with his head down, doing his best to stay unnoticed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_10: A voice shatters the silence. "Well, well. You must be here for the Divine Loong's legacy too."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_11: "If you know anything about the treasure up in that mountain, it's best you speak up. We're with the Frontier guard and we can offer you protection. What do you say? It's for the good of the people."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_12: "Divine Loong?" You sense the threat, but the name catches your attention.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_14: "Tch. You call yourselves guards? You're just mercenaries who take money and do nothing. 'For the good of the people.' Hah!" A man on the right sneers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_15: "Damn right! The Divine Loong's only been gone for, what, how long now? And you've already deserted your posts! The Celestial Summit's sixteen-year cycle has ended, and here you are, chasing a quick Credit. You're all a disgrace to the Frontier!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_16: "If you know something, friend, why not work with us? We Frontier folks aren't like those sellouts. A fair 30/70 split. What do you say?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_18: "Bold words! You lot think you're something now? Without us, would you Frontier dogs even be standing here today? What do curs like you know about honor? You think we've let you off easy cause we're afraid?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_19: "We owe our survival to the Divine Loong, not spineless worms like you. And honor? Deserters like you couldn't handle the monsters of the Frontier, so you turn on your own? Come on then, try us!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_20: "I'll rip your tongue out! Take 'em down, boys!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_21: "Take your shot! A scrap was coming sooner or later. Think I'm scared of the likes of you?!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_22: The two groups begin to brawl. Tables are upturned, bowls and jars shatter. The innkeeper sighs and hides behind the counter, unsurprised.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_23: "{PlayerName}, what's going on? We didn't start it, right?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_25: "Cool! So it's not my problem!" Abby watches the fight with growing interest.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_26: "Hey, you in the black mask! Punch straight, will ya?! Whoa, careful with that plate! I can finish that wing for ya! Nooo, now it's on the floor—hey, don't step on it!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_27: You're about to stop Abby when you catch sight of a chair flying toward the hooded girl, who seems oblivious.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_29: You block the chair instinctively, only to realize it wouldn't have hit her. But that wasn't why you acted without thinking. Her silver hair… it reminded you of someone from your past.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_31: "We should leave, it's not safe here."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_32: "Watch out, {PlayerName}! Abby coming to the rescue!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_33: You dodge the blade, and Abby seizes the opportunity to knock your attacker down. In seconds, the fight has spiraled into chaos, with no clear sides.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_34: "They've lost control. We need to find a way out... Follow me."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210011_36: After a brief hesitation, the hooded girl grips your hand tightly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_1: After running for some time, you and the hooded girl finally find a place to rest inside the town.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_2: She's clearly familiar with the area. Following her, you avoid the chaos with ease.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_4: "I'm fine. Thank you for your aid." After a brief pause, the hooded girl continues, "I don't think I've seen you before. Even in the past. You're not from the mountain. What brings you here?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_5: [Bond Boost] I'm here to help a friend.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_6: [Status Boost] I'm here for the treasure.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_7: "So you've come for a friend... The town is small, and most visitors have already ventured up the mountain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_8: "I see... You've come for the rumors about the legacy in the mountain, too. The town is small, and most visitors have already ventured up the mountain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_9: "The mountain paths have been neglected for sixteen years. Should you force passage, you'll only lose your way. Even the most skilled have fallen victim to the traps that lie ahead..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_10: The hooded girl pauses, her expression concealed, yet you can still feel her hesitation.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_11: "If you insist on venturing up the mountain, I can guide you. But I would ask something of you in return."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_12: She is a young woman of decision. Just as always.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_13: "Anything. I'll help in any way that I can."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_14: "Yeah! After that fight back there, we're basically friends now. Come on, don't be shy.”
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_15: "Friends?" The word seems to surprise her.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_16: "I wouldn't hesitate if it were something simple... But I need you to help me... take down a monster."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_17: "...You are free to refuse. It's just that, after seeing your skills, I believe your aid would greatly ensure the success of this noble task."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_18: Taking down a monster, a noble deed... The stakes couldn't be higher. But her tone is detached, as if she's talking about dinner plans or future travels. Remote. In the abstract.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_19: "I'll do it. But you'll need to tell me more about this place."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_20: "Thank you," she nods slightly. "I'll share with you everything I know about the mountain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_21: "Huh, I don't get it... Whatever. You know this place, right? What's with that smoke? A barbecue?" Abby leans on your head, lazily pointing at a wisp of smoke rising from the mountain.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_22: "That's the mountain temple, where people pray for blessings before climbing to the summit. When the mountain opens, incense is burned in honor of the Divine Loong."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_23: Abby grimaces, clearly not interested in temples or prayers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_24: "The Divine Loong... Those men at the inn mentioned the Divine Loong's legacy earlier. What's the story behind it?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_25: "You're not from the Frontier, are you, {PlayerName}? It's a harsh, cold land. The legend of the Divine Loong began as a folk tale. People believed that praying to such a being would save them from hardship, bringing an early spring and good harvests."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_26: "But then the monsters came, and war ravaged the Frontier for years. The people lost their farmlands, left with nothing but prayers to the Loong. They prayed for the safety of their loved ones, but the Loong never came. Eventually, they began calling the one who truly protected them the 'Divine Loong,' an incarnation of the great Loong, or so they believed... Heh. Tell me, {PlayerName}, if such a divinity truly existed, how could it stand by and watch its people suffer? The legend is nothing more than a lie meant to unite the masses."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_27: "..." Her hood hides her face, but you can feel the bitterness in the air.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_28: "Forgive me, I've spoken about the Frontier with too heavy a tone."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_29: "It's getting late. We should make haste to the temple if we wish to reach the peak in time."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210012_30: "Exactly! No point overthinking it. All this talkin' is making me sleepy! Let's go treasure hunting!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_01: You arrive at the temple, where incense burns steadily. As you take in the beauty of the snow-covered trees lining the walls, familiar yelling and cursing reach your ears from ahead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_02: You draw closer and recognize the two groups from the inn. Their ranks have thinned, but they're still blocking the gate.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_03: "Yapping about honor and the people, acting like you've got the inside scoop... Hell, you can't even find the damn mountain path!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_04: "Oh, and you lot are fit to make the climb, huh? Pfft, don't waste my time, you carrion-eating jackals."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_05: "Hah! Even bandits have more honor than deserters like you! The Divine Loong is here, and we know it! Every sixteen years, she returns from the mountain. But this year, she's been gone for months with no word. And you still dare call yourselves Frontier folk?!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_06: "Yeah! You took the pay and ran. That's why I'm a bandit now! And my ma, she's still stuck in town! She can't run like you, not with those bad legs!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_07: "A pack of misfits, desperate to find the Loong first. You just want to use her name for your own profit... Pathetic. You've all been played. There's no Divine Loong!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_08: "Never seen her, have ya? But I have, after years of fighting. Your precious Divine Loong is just another puppet. Same as the monsters. She saved you, but only for her own reasons. The real truth's buried in that mountain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_09: "Ridiculous! A puppet? I'm looking at one right now! After all these years in the Frontier, the truth's clearer than you think! C'mon, boys. It's time to shut these damn liars up for good!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_10: The shouting escalates, and it doesn't take long for one of the combatants to snap and charge forward, weapon drawn.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_11: You notice the hooded girl beside you has been silent since the argument broke out. You glance at her and her hood trembles, betraying her emotions.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_13: A flash of steel slices through the air and splits the pristine snow, revealing the stone pavement beneath.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_14: "Those who overstep will face consequences." A cold female voice cuts through the air, sending shivers down the spines of all present. Both sides freeze, eyes locking on her.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_15: "This is a place of prayer. Violence is strictly prohibited on these grounds." She pulls her hand away from her sword, her fingers gently brushing the prayer beads around her neck. "If you've come to worship the Divine Loong, show respect. The snowstorm has made mountain rescues impossible, and monsters roam the trails. Stay off the paths."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_16: The two groups lower their weapons in reluctant unison and exchange glances. They huddle in circles, whispering in hushed counsel.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_17: "Look, {PlayerName}! Isn't that Sanhua? Finally, a familiar face!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_18: "...Anyone who wants to leave, can go. But those who want justice for our fallen comrades, follow me up the mountain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_19: "So it's true. A silver-haired Asura living in the temple. The Divine Loong must be up there... You boy—take the crew back to the inn and wait for my word. The rest of you, come with me."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_20: After some back and forth, most of the men head down the mountain, while the rest take separate paths upward.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_21: The crowd thins out, their tracks swallowed by fresh snow. Only you, the hooded girl, and the woman with prayer beads remain in the empty, wintry landscape.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_22: "Hmm, weird. They talk so much about the Divine Loong, but there's hardly anyone actually visiting the temple."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_23: "A celestial being worshiped and revered... yet it is those she's meant to protect who carry the heaviest burden. Are these people not...?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_24: "The way I see it, those who cannot break free from their desires invite their own suffering. What waters flow today, the moon shall rise on the morrow."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_25: "Blessed or not, all will eventually meet their destined end. Even if it comes in the freezing grip of karma's will."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_26: "H-Hold up... My brain hurts. Can you repeat all that in layman's terms?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_27: "Consider it ramblings meant for comfort. But tell me, what brings you here? Are you here to seek the Divine Loong's blessings, or do you intend to head up the mountain?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_28: "Up the mountain." The hooded girl replies firmly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_29: "All these years, and you still don't hesitate, not even once..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_30: The swordswoman with the prayer beads sighs deeply, her breath forming a cloud of mist that vanishes in the storm. When the hooded girl stays silent, she turns to you instead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_31: "And you? You've come from afar and traveled with her... What do you make of those consumed by their obsessions?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_32: [Status Boost] They're responsible for their own actions.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_33: [Bond Boost] There's no right or wrong, only different paths.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_34: The swordswoman nods slightly, then turns and heads up the mountain gate steps toward the temple.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_35: "No right or wrong... Though I wonder how many can face the inevitable without fear, and how many deceive themselves with illusions?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_36: With a sigh you can't tell is filled with doubt or lament, she turns and heads up the mountain gate steps toward the temple.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_37: "Please, follow me inside and rest. I still have matters to attend to, then I will guide you up the mountain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_01: The way beyond the temple was more treacherous than expected, but the hooded girl always seemed to find a way through the blanketing white, as if she'd walked it countless times.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_02: By now, the entire mountain was covered in a endless blizzard. The snow fell on every stone step leading to the summit, on the broken wooden path, and further east, into the steaming, boiling creek that flowed down to the village at the foot of the mountain. They passed through the echoes and illusions left by past seekers, falling onto the bodies of both the living and the dead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_03: As you approach a hot spring waterfall, a faint flame shines through the storm. You soon realize it's a woman holding a paper umbrella. The snowflakes vanish before they can land on her, as if some unseen force is at work.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_04: "On this mountain, snow obscures the moon's journey... I've been waiting, though I can't say for how long. But this year... it feels like you've come later than expected."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_05: The woman holding the umbrella greets you with an unhurried wave through the swirling snow. The hooded girl beside you hesitates, then nods slightly, as if recognizing her.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_08: "We just gotta stay close to her and we don't have to feel the cold anymore...!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_09: "Hmm. And you are... I see. Even the best laid plans have flaws. There are more guests this year than I had expected." She smiles, seemingly unsurprised by your arrival.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_10: "Well, then, travelers from afar, I take it you've met quite a few Frontier folk on your journey up. Each strong with... opinions, shall we say?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_12: "Hmm. Then you must have heard their claims about the Divine Loong... What do you make of the situation in the Frontier?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_13: "Or rather... after everything you've seen, can you distinguish the truth from the false?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_14: You reflect on her words, sensing there's more beneath the surface.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_15: "Each side only sees the truth they want to see... Or rather, the truth itself doesn't really matter to them."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_16: "It seems you've learned to piece together the truth from fragments." She glances at the hooded girl. "However... she too has never revealed her identity nor her intentions, and yet you still choose to join her on this journey?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_18: Though you haven't asked, you're long been certain of the hooded girl's identity. You nod with confidence.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_19: "Why does it feel like everyone speaks in riddles around here?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_20: "Anyway, {PlayerName} said it's actions that count, not intentions. She's fought beside us and led us up the mountain for treasure. I'd say she's a friend we can trust!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_21: "Judge actions not intentions... I never expected to hear those exact words again on this mountain after sixteen years."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_22: "Very well, then... As promised, it's time to test your strengths."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_23: She throws her paper umbrella into the air, and with a loud bang, it explodes into a fiery bird that scatters the snow around it.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210031_24: "...Sixteen years. A mere blink of an eye."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_01: As the fiery energy of the bird fades, it transforms back into the paper umbrella and returns to the woman's hand. The blizzard swiftly covers the scorch marks and puddles left behind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_02: You barely notice the transformation. The whole time, your eyes are fixed on the girl's exposed face as her hood slips away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_03: Silver hair, a mole beneath her right eye, scales marking her skin... And Loong horns sprouting from her forehead. It's no wonder she wears a hood.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_04: This isn't the first time you've seen her like this.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_06: "I-It's Jinhsi! No wonder her voice sounded so familiar. It all makes sense now!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_07: "Wait, {PlayerName}. Did you know it was her all along? Am I the only one who didn't realize?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_09: The girl reaches for her hood and catches your gaze. With a bitter smile, she lowers her hand.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_10: "Forgive me, I wasn't intentionally hiding my identity. The situation demands discretion. Though I am worshipped as the Divine Loong, revealing the truth to the people proves difficult."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_12: "You mean... you're the Divine Loong? But doesn't that... Wait, isn't it... Umm... no, wait, or is it...?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_14: "Illusions arise when causes and conditions meet, then vanish when they part."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_15: "You knew what they sought from the start. So why do you persist?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_16: "Whether I explain or not, people will interpret as they wish. Everyone chooses the truths they want to believe... even I am no exception..." She says, pausing for a brief moment.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_17: "I only sought to make choices I wouldn't regret. If perfection wasn't possible, I believed protecting the majority was the right path. But those choices become betrayals to those sacrificed. Who is sacrificed, who deserves it, and who has the right to decide... For the one making such a choice, weakness is unforgivable."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_18: "Only through absolute strength can one refuse to choose at all. To fulfill this conviction, my methods may seem extreme, but they're necessary."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_20: "...I am no longer the person I was when I first left this mountain. There's so much in the world... how can anyone really know what's right or wrong in everything?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_21: Her philosophical tone creates an odd disconnect, making you feel as though you've missed something important.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_22: "Good golly, {PlayerName}. I understand every word, but when you put 'em together it makes zero sense to me!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_23: "Feels like everyone's just saying things without saying anything, huh?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_24: "I understand. Since your resolve remains unwavering, I will speak no more on this matter."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_25: "As for you, traveler from afar... Your confusion is understandable. As her companion, it is customary to grant you access to the Loong Chamber. Soon, all will become clear."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_26: The woman with the umbrella steps closer, placing a finger to her lips and shaking her head with a knowing smile.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_27: "Throughout this journey, I've observed each of you. Now, the responsibility of bearing witness falls to you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_28: "And as for everything we've discussed thus far... You may use the information you've gathered at your discretion when this is all over."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_29: A brief silence settles over the group, save for Abby, who continues glance around in curiosity.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210032_30: The silver-haired girl with horns gives you a bow before continuing her ascent toward the mountain peak.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_02: As she completes the puzzle, the disc on the stone wall rotates clockwise, revealing a dark cave entrance.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_03: "The final path to the Loong Chamber can be revealed by aligning the mechanism according to the spring star map of the Frontier's night sky."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_04: "…If you ever travel there in the future, you'll be able to witness this night sky with your own eyes."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_05: "Whoo-hoo! We made it! I can smell the treasure waiting for me!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_06: Rather than the decaying, crumbling ruin you anticipated, the Loong Chamber is surprisingly well-preserved, free of deadly traps or monstrous inhabitants. There are even traces of recent cleaning in some corners.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_07: "The wicks on these lamps look like the ones in the temple..." Moving along a path surrounded by stone walls, the swordswoman examines the decorative elements.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_08: "Was someone living here? What exactly is this place...?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_09: "Venturing deeper without caution wouldn't be wise. I suggest we rest here for a moment. A difficult battle likely awaits us."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_10: "As for what's ahead... If I may, I prefer to go alone. I'll return once I've activated all the mechanisms within the Chamber, then we'll move forward together."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_12: "It's better this way. I'm sure you've noticed it by now, haven't you, {PlayerName}?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_13: Turning back at the passage's turn, the lamp in her hand casts a glow on the scales along her cheeks and neck.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_15: "Though our time together in the tempest has been brief, it's given me a feeling like none other. I've never met anyone so similar to myself until now."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_16: "How reassuring it is to know there's someone like me. Now, no matter what awaits at the end of this journey, it won't feel as daunting."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_17: "Thank you, {PlayerName}. I'll leave the rest in your capable hands."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_18: Raising the lamp, she walks away without looking back.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210041_19: With little light in the Loong Chamber, the darkness obscures the expressions of your companions.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_01: Perhaps not long had passed, only the burn of a matchstick. Or rather a lonely candlestick, devoting its entire lifespan—
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_02: You notice someone holding a lamp approaching you from the direction you came. Her steps are steady, a warrior poised to pour all her passion into the coming battle.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_04: "It took longer than I expected. What happened?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_05: "I was just about to charge in there and look for you!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_06: "I am fine. I appreciate your concern."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_07: "Preparations for this battle took longer than I anticipated, that's all. The survival of the Frontier is at stake... there's no room for mistakes."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_08: Her tone differs from her parting words. Though she attempts to remain candid, you sense a subtle distance in her words.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_10: "We will eliminate the Loong dwelling within and gain the power needed to protect the Frontier."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_12: "I will protect you until the very end."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_14: Following her lead, you navigate the vast, winding passages until suddenly the path opens up into a wide area.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_15: Snowflakes drift down onto your shoulders once more. The final stretch of the Loong Chamber leads to the mountain's summit, where a Loong with blue and black scales, a white mane, and golden horns awaits.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_16: You notice its labored breathing. The powerful yet unstable frequencies it emanates leak out like water from a cracked vessel. Only the creature's eyes remain calm, locking with yours.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_17: How long did it take for it to return?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210051_18: After all those years, any trace of joy or sorrow has long since faded, swallowed by the endless snow.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_01: The tea on the table hisses at it boils. In the inn's lobby, the troublemakers from earlier are still sitting across from each other, silently locked in a standoff. At the counter, the innkeeper flips through his account book, nodding in approval at the compensation totals.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_02: Sunbeams slice through the air to catch dust particles that float like whispers. The corner where the hooded girl once sat is now empty.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_03: "When do you suppose Jinhsi's coming back, {PlayerName}?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_04: "She made us a promise. All we need to do is wait."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_05: "You know, I didn't expect that the Loong would just turn into frequencies and get absorbed by her like that... She already had horns when we met, right? So why did she grow new ones right after? Everything in this film is so weird, I feel like we're barely scratching the surface."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_06: Abby slumps against your shoulder, showing no interest in the plate of wings on the table, muttering about the recent adventures.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_07: After the battle at the mountain peak, you parted ways on the descent. The swordswoman returned to the temple, and the woman with the umbrella remarked, "We shall meet again in sixteen years," before disappearing without a trace.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_08: Only the silver-haired girl agreed to meet you at the dock the following day to leave the mountain together.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_09: You spent a day resting at the inn, but strangely, the image of the Loong's dying gaze continues to haunt you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_10: In an instant, her words while she held that lamp suddenly makes sense to you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_11: "The mountain will be sealed off in a few days... The place will be a ghost town by then. We'd better head out soon if we want to make it back."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_12: "But what about the guys still up there? What are we gonna do... Are we supposed to go home empty-handed?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_13: A gloomy atmosphere settles over the inn. But it's soon shattered by the hurried footsteps of a Tong Sui vendor from the dock as he bursts though the door.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_14: "The girl with the Loong horns showed up! I saw her! With my own eyes! She's left the mountain and is heading to the Frontier! She's at the dock right now!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_15: "You found the Divine Loong?! Move it, people! If we miss her, we might not get another chance!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_16: The inn erupts into commotion as everyone rushes out. You and Abby exchange a glance before quickly following.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_17: Despite the large crowd, you immediately recognize her standing by the dock , giving a speech to everyone gathered around her.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_18: You can't catch every word, but from her lips and the crowd's reactions, you know what she's doing. She isn't speaking for herself—she's uniting them.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_19: You finally grasp the significance of her existence. In a world without saviors, people still need something to believe in to keep going.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_20: Perhaps her refusal to compromise defines her journey. She drifts on currents of untraceable desires, choosing a path she sees as ideal, no matter the cost.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_21: And so, every sixteen years, the same scene plays out on this mountain.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_25: She smiles and guides you onto the small boat headed for the Frontier.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_26: "You're not from the Frontier are you, {PlayerName}? Have you been there before?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_28: "I see... Growing up, I often heard stories from travelers. They said, in times of peace, the fields flourish with crops, and the lights from homes dance on the rivers."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_29: "And on cloudless nights, if you look up, you'll see a river of stars stretching endlessly across the sky."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_30: "Truth be told, I've never been there myself."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_31: Following her gaze, the snow-capped mountains above the sea gradually fade into the falling snow. Her words take you back to the moment you first stood on the Central Plains, gazing back at Jinzhou.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_33: "I've lived my entire life on this mountain, as far as I can remember. This... is the first time I've ever left."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_34: "The world has never been so quiet."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_35: "What do suppose it's like in the Frontier {PlayerName}? Will my powers... bring happiness to the people?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_37: "Perhaps. But if we ever manage to unite everyone... if we bring back that starlit sky..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_38: "We shall name that force, the Midnight Rangers."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_39: The small boat sways gently, sailing into the vast whiteness. Everything before you becomes blurred and distant... The detached narrative fades, and you find yourself back in your theater seat once again.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210052_40: Completed Theater 2 "Mt. Firmament Inn" - Ending One Unlocked: "Serenity"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_01: "Long, long ago... Legends say a girl was raised by a Divine Loong, the ruler of wind, rain, and seasons. She grew up happily in the Loong Chamber."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_02: "Her snow-covered home was bountiful, drawing many from the Frontier to travel and trade. She cherished the townsfolk's company, yearning to see the world beyond."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_03: "But gradually, fewer came seeking blessings, and those who did wore troubled expressions. When she asked, they told her a devastating truth: monsters were ravaging their lands."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_04: "Troubled, she approached her guardian: 'Those who once worshiped us now face hunger and ruin. Is there a way for me to save them?'"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_05: "The Loong sighed, 'It is futile, child. You cannot change their fate, and neither can This One. It is the natural course.'"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_06: "'I refuse to accept that,' she insisted. 'If by natural law, I should have perished in the wilderness long ago. Yet you changed my fate.'"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_07: "Seeing her resolve, the Loong granted her powers of wind, rain, and seasons. With its final breath, it spoke, 'Do not mourn This One's passing. Our paths diverge. Remember, every gift bears a cost. The people offered tribute for good seasons, and This One fulfilled its duty. But now, This One denies them passage, for new promises lie beyond my power. In these troubled times, power becomes a curse. Should you falter, those who depend on you will suffer. They will not thank you, but will question and resent you... You remind This One of what I once was. This One accepts its end, yet cannot bear to watch you experience the same... and lose your faith.'"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_08: "'I have no regrets,' the girl said, sorrow in her voice. 'Now, with you leaving my side, they are all I have. I cannot watch them perish. I will grow stronger, unmoved by hardship, betrayal, or anything that dares to break me.'"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_09: "But the Loong only smiled softly. 'There is nothing wrong with fading away.' It vanished into the blizzard, leaving only a whisper in the wind."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_10: "The Loong's words echoed in her mind. She began contemplating ways to overcome the inevitable. In time, wielding that power, she locked the mountain's flow of time to the sixteen years of her youth, severing the mountain from the rest of the world."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_11: "After that, she journeyed to the Frontier, using her powers to protect the people and unite survivors against adversity. Sixteen long, brutal years passed, until she finally returned to the mountain. There, she would pass her power to her younger self, untouched by time."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_12: "Thus, time within the mountain became like a pre-determined game of Weiqi. No matter how the world changed, the Divine Loong of the Frontier would never fall. When the old faded, the new would rise. There would always be a youthful, passionate version of her to uphold the ideal, fulfilling her promise to protect for eternity."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_13: The tea on the table hisses at it boils. In the inn's lobby, the troublemakers from earlier are still sitting across from each other, silently locked in a standoff. At the counter, the innkeeper flips through his account book, nodding in approval at the compensation totals.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_14: You set the empty dishes aside and nudge Abby, signaling that it's time to stop eating.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_15: "Well then, what do you think of this story, pieced together as it is?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_16: It's very much what I imagined.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_18: "An interesting story, yes. But it has its inconsistencies."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_19: "Heh... True. The truth is unclear, and the story is riddled with questionable elements... But if there is no Divine Loong, then which came first, the girl with the power or the dragon that gave it to her?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_20: "...These are simply baseless rumors, nothing more. We need to leave soon. You should finish your meals."
