RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_21: "Once we return to the Frontier, who knows when we'll taste such delicacies again."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_22: "That's right! You guys better eat up or I'm gonna finish the whole thing! {PlayerName} promised us a proper feast before we leave!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_23: "Indeed. 'Without attachments, there is no fear, no illusion, only the path to enlightenment.' For now, nothing matters more than the meal before us."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_24: "Once we're back in the Frontier, we'll be caught up in duties. Though {PlayerName} might still manage to visit here from time to time."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_25: "With the Temporal Disruption now stable, the mountain's connection to the rest of the world is restored, and local cuisine will be easier to access. However..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_27: "With time flowing in sync, prices here no longer match those of the outside world. The local currency is now a rare antique."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_28: "Wait. Why is everyone looking at me like that? Are these dishes pricey? {PlayerName}, we found the Loong's treasure, right? Come on, think of something!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_32: "A-Ahem! I am immensely grateful for your aid these past few days. Consider this meal a gesture of my gratitude."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_33: She rises and walks to the counter. After a brief exchange with the innkeeper, she retrieves a small pouch of coins taken from the Loong Chamber and settles the bill.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_34: Now that the horns and scales are gone, no one would associate her with the legendary Divine Loong. She's simply a girl, smiling and blushing like any other.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_35: She turns back with a smile. It's time for the ferry.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_37: In truth, you didn't keep your promise to help her slay the Loong that day.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_38: Right before the final blow, you hesitated, facing the silver-haired girl as confusion flickered across her face.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_39: Slaying the Loong was not a difficult task. Her plan was flawless for those involved. After walking such a long, solitary path, she could not let the chance to realize her ideals slip away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_40: Killing the Loong could save everyone. Would they ever understand the immense resolve it took her to walk this desperate path?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_41: Yet even so, the three of you were enough to stop her from ending the Loong's life. It was so close.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_44: You respond to her question with one of your own.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_45: To hold compassion for all means letting go of attachments and rising above emotion. But if one has truly abandoned emotion, can they truly say to another, "You are so similar to me"?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_46: That's why the three of you came to an understanding before the Loong Chamber: no one is destined to be sacrificed, and no one has the right to decide who is sacrified. The sixteen-year cycle had to end.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_47: The world exists in a turbulent stream. Can violence truly bring about goodness? Of all the ways to find salvation, only saving oneself is true.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_48: —Your thoughts are interrupted by Abby's voice, pulling you back into the film. At the dock, the silver-haired girl waves from a boat.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_50: It's about a girl who has no companions.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_51: It's about the journey of a lonely savior.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_52: "Is it... Well, I don't really get her thinking..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_53: "But I get what you're saying. If she'd had companions like us from the start, her journey would've been much easier, right?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_54: You gently ruffle Abby's hair with a smile and follow your companions onto the small boat heading for the Frontier.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_55: What comes next will be a brand-new story.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210062_56: Completed Theater 2 "Mt. Firmament Inn" - Ending Two Unlocked: "Turmoil"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_01: Snow-laden trees sway gently in clusters, while temple smoke drifts on the mountain breeze. Wings beat somewhere above, yet only the endless sky meets your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_02: Once more, you stand before the temple gate. Incense lingers in the air as distant cries and arguments drift toward you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_04: "How can you be sure the Divine Loong and the temple folk can save her? She can't even say 'Mama' or 'Papa' yet—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_05: "We have no choice! Remember the immortal's warning? Miss this chance, and we wait another sixteen years. By then, it'll be too late."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_06: "She's your own flesh and blood! How can you do this? My sweet girl... we've failed you. We couldn't cure your eyes, and now we can't even raise you ourselves...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_07: "O, great Divine Loong. I beg you, please save our child... We ask for nothing but her safety. Even if it means she must serve you in this temple for the rest of her life..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_08: "And if, by some miracle, we're able to reunite with her in sixteen years..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_09: "Enough! We've wasted too much time already. If the mountain closes, we'll be trapped here. Who will take care of the family back home?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_10: "...Have faith in the Divine Loong. Even if she only has sixteen years here, isn't that better than the uncertainty of life in the Frontier?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_11: "The immortal said everyone has their fate. Even if we never meet again, as long as she's safe, that will be enough..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_12: The temple gates swing open. Holding on to their child, the couple pleads desperately. After a moment of struggle, the woman reluctantly surrenders their child.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_13: "Hua! Forgive me! I won't be there to watch you grow... From now on, you'll have to take care of yourself."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_14: As they descend the stone steps, the couple turns back again and again, until they finally disappear into the endless white, leaving no trace behind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_16: A sudden cry shatters the silence.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220011_18: She moves toward the fading mirage, almost against her will, unaware of the ominous presence lurking within the blizzard.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_02: "I'm alright, thank you. Forgive my lapse." She composes herself with a deep breath.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_03: "This mountain has its monsters and mirages... born of inner demons and obsessions, nothing more."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_04: "All things are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows... as fleeting as dew or lightning. When one becomes too attached to the idea of who they are, vulnerability easily takes hold."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_05: She speaks with her usual cold, detached expression, but you know there's more to it.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_06: In the uneven flow of time, some things were left behind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_08: "I was simply caught off guard. Don't worry. I promised to escort you up the mountain, and I will see it through."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_09: "I must warn you, there have been sightings of mirages formed by the  Divine Loong's unstable powers. Should you encounter them, hold true to your beliefs, and you will not lose your way..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_10: Have you ever thought about looking for them?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_11: Did you ever visit that couple?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_12: She hesitates for a moment, then shakes her head with a soft sigh.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_13: "These are just my attachments. The fate of the Frontier hangs in the balance. There's no place for personal obsessions. After sixteen years, no one is more suited than I am to guard this sacred place."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_14: "Perhaps that couple and the little girl... were destined to be apart."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_15: "Attachments... But how can someone let go without confronting them?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_16: "If something's troubling you, why not share it with us?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_17: "Yeah! Your fancy talk is flying right over my head. But even from the start, everyone in this film's been acting weirder than usual. Geez!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_19: "Oops! I didn't mean to blurt that out... I mean, if something's buggin' ya, just talk to me and {PlayerName} about it!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_20: "Film? Acting weird? Perhaps. But explaining it wouldn't change anything. It's just a drop in an sea of suffering. Hope endures to this day only because of human will."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_21: "Have you ever seen someone build their own prison, {PlayerName}? Most birds would fly free if they could, but she traded her wings for a cage to guard the temple. How could someone like that ever let go?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220012_22: "Maybe someday... if she can protect this land without such a heavy cost, then maybe she can finally let go."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_01: The final stretch leading to the Loong Chamber is covered in pristine white. Your breath freezes instantly, blending with the snow. You can hardly make out the figures of those traveling beside you, even though they are just feet apart.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_02: You find yourself once more at the waterfall veiled in warm vapor. Through the steam, you glimpse a fiery glow and two distant figures.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_03: "Divine Loong, I have come to honor a promise."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_05: "Since my mentor's passing, I must take on his duty. I am the new Wayfinder."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_07: "Please, Divine Loong, do not mourn. As he often said, birth, aging, illness, and death are natural parts of life. As your Wayfinder, fulfilling this sacred task made his life more than worthwhile."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_09: "Still, I didn't expect one so young to be chosen... Do you understand what this promise demands?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_10: "Yes. Though this is my first time on the mountain, his instructions were clear. Rest assured, Divine Loong."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_11: "Very well. After the ritual, the task of guiding 'her' to oversee the Frontier falls to you... I trust the immortal's wisdom in choosing his successor."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_13: Amidst the falling snow, the young girl raises her umbrella high.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_15: "I heard of the mountain's fierce storms, so I brought an umbrella with me. I'm glad it's come in handy."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_16: "It's just wind and snow. I can manage without it. You may keep it for yourself."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_17: "I don't mind the cold at all. Please, let me hold the umbrella for you for the rest of the way."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_18: "You always put other before yourself. Master spoke of 'To ordain conscience for heaven and land. To secure life and fortune for the people.' But I've often wondered, why shouldn't the Divine Loong herself be counted among those 'people'?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_19: "...I simply wish to ensure the flame never dies."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_20: "But in this world, no fire can burn eternally in solitude, Divine Loong."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_21: The silence lingers, and then a gentle sigh is swept away by the blizzard.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_24: "Have you wondered why visitors must leave before the mountain seals itself, {PlayerName}? Why has no one chosen to stay for sixteen years?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_25: "That is because this has always been death's domain. When the time comes, everything here returns to how it was. Those who do not belong to the past vanish in the current of time."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_26: "The flame never goes out. It endures because people feed themselves to it. The mirages are echoes of those consumed by time."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_27: "Everything returns to how it was? Does that mean...?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_28: "Perhaps you've already sensed the truth. If so... what choice will you make?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220021_29: "I eagerly await the change you will bring."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_01: Perched among the mountains, the inn was built around hot springs that appear once every sixteen years. Steam rises in a warm amber glow, contrasting with the snowy landscape. A comforting sight to behold.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_02: In front of the wooden porch, a girl with red hair and a jade pendant looks around.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_03: "{PlayerName}, look! Is that Danjin over there?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_04: "Oh, where can I find those Loong-whisker-shaped pastries I had last time? After relaxing in these hot springs for so long, it'd be nice to bring some milk back for Mama and the others..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_05: "Excuse me, do you know if there's a place that sells pastries and milk nearby?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_06: "The inn at the town entrance might have something similar, but..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_07: "You probably don't wanna go there now."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_09: "Two groups of thugs were just fighting there. It's dangerous, even tables and chairs were wrecked."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_10: "I see. I've heard about the unrest in the Frontier. Never imagined this sacred mountain would be caught up in it too."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_11: "Are you also here on a visit?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_12: "Yes, I'm actually here on vacation with my family... We don't get to be together too much, so I wanted to show them around this mountain. We'll have to wait another sixteen years if we miss this chance."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_13: You can feel the joy when she says the word "together."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_14: "If you're looking for something tasty, I remember passing some food stalls while we were running earlier."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_15: "Oh, really!? Do they have those Loong whisker-shaped pastries? I've been wanting to get some for my siblings."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_16: "The stall you want should be that way. Just follow the path for about 130 steps, turn left, then circle around an old tree. You can't miss it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_17: "For someone with no sense of direction, you sure know exactly where the food stalls are..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_18: "Y-You got a problem with that? Food is everything! And I'm starving! We've been runnin' around everywhere..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_19: Well, then. Lead the way, Abby!
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220031_21: "Wonderful, thank you for your help... If you need anything in the coming days, please feel free to find me at this inn!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_01: You find yourself in one of the rare bustling marketplaces inside the ancient town, filled with treasures, paintings, and artifacts. A favorite among travelers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_02: Passing an old stand selling books, a hoarse yet oddly familiar voice suddenly calls out to you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_03: "Wait, please wait, my friend. I can tell by your remarkable physique, you must be a once-in-a-millenium martial arts prodigy..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_04: "No, I am certain that, in time, you will be the hero who brings peace and order to all of Solaris."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_05: "I have a few martial arts scrolls for sale. They're worth fifteen Credits each, with a tenfold money-back guarantee! But I'm starving, so if you're interested, I'll take three Stuffed Flatbreads instead."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_06: Stuffed Flatbreads as payment? That's quite a discount.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_07: Is it my lucky day? I'll take one, please.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_08: "Oh, the Tao shouldn't be sold cheaply, and techniques shouldn't be shared lightly... If not for my current misfortune, I'd never do this."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_09: "Very well, these are all rare copies I brought from the mountain. Make sure to keep them safe."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_10: "Quick, lemme see what these scrolls say... Huh? It says to unite everyone's will and strength for one blow to the enemy. Seriously?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_11: "Hold on. It's you! I didn't recognize you earlier..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_12: "Holy! Jianxin? Geez, you look awful... What happened to you?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_13: "Do you two know me? Jianxin? Could it be one of the names I used during my training years? I see, meeting you here must be fate."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_14: "As for why I'm in such a dire state... Well, long story short, after I left the mountain to train, I witnessed the suffering happening across the Frontier. I wanted to help those in need. That's why I followed the Divine Loong's trail to this mountain."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_15: "At the dock, I met a righteous person rescuing antiques. I traded all my possessions for these scrolls to support her cause. When I finally reached this town, I didn't expect living here to be so costly..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_16: This righteous person you're talking about, could it be...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_17: That's the Jianxin I know all right...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_18: "I never thought I'd run out of money and supplies before I could start my journey up the mountain... Now I have no choice but to sell these ancient scrolls until the day I can finally aid the Divine Loong."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_19: "My master always told me, 'The Tao shouldn't be sold cheaply, and techniques shouldn't be shared lightly.' These scrolls are indeed precious, but if I hadn't done this, I wouldn't have met you today."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_20: "I know how it feels to be on an empty stomach. Been there."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_21: "We're also heading up the mountain. You can join us if you like."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_22: "That's right! Stick with {PlayerName}, and food will never be a problem!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_23: "You're so kind... I'm deeply grateful. To repay your generosity, let me help with the dangers ahead. I may not look it now, but I'm quite capable with martial arts. The monsters here won't—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_24: Suddenly, an unmistakable growl rumbles from her stomach: Grr... Grr... Grr...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_25: "...Won't even stand a chance against me. Of course... if you could spare a couple of Flatbreads, I'd be forever grateful..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_01: You find yourself in one of the rare bustling marketplaces inside the ancient town, filled with treasures, paintings, and artifacts. A favorite among travelers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_02: A blue-haired girl who looks familiar barters with an antique shop owner, several porcelain bowls clasped tightly in her hands.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_03: "Hang the silver moon, break the gilded lock. Timber falls uphill, embers glow by the shore. Swift falcons land on barren ground, divining bones guide where treasure's found."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_04: "Crack the scaled ridge, torch the twilight's hue. Snow drifts outside the mirror, treasure shimmers within. Winding waters reach the crown, and green stone cradles the golden gown. Aha! It's a match! Well now, seems we're kindred, little one! By the master's grace, I never expected to meet a fellow sister today!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_05: "As if! So that's the second half, huh? You got it right, but I'm betting you're no mountain local. Come on, spit it out. Did you steal these treasures from the mountain?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_06: "What?! How could you know the secret code if you're not from my faction?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_07: "Wouldn't have a clue if it weren't for you bozos causing a ruckus everywhere! Guess the Frontier was just too small for you, huh? Somebody! Help! I've caught a no-good grave robber trying to sell the Divine Loong's treasures!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_08: "Quiet! D-Do you have any idea how business is done around here? Keep that mouth of yours shut! I didn't steal anything! I can't even get into the Loong Chamber!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_09: "Oh, I see. Your group still hasn't found the path up the mountain yet. Hehe. No wonder you're peddling this ordinary mountain junk."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_10: "Ordinary mountain junk?! We busted our backs to get these! You little brat! That's it, time for a lesson! Take this!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_11: The furious antique shop owner draws a weapon and leaps at the girl.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_12: "Oh, no! Help! You, hero over there—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_14: "Um, I'm pretty sure that's Youhu... What should we do, {PlayerName}? Should we go help her out?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_16: Let's wait a bit longer to see what happens.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_17: "Alrighty! Hey, you! Get your hands off of her!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_18: "Whoa... really? You're just gonna stand there while a little girl gets beat up? These guys are real thugs, by the way, I'm not lying..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_19: "So you've got friends, huh? Looks like we've been made. To arms, boys! Neither of you is leaving here alive today!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_01: Your teamwork quickly sends the thieves into disarray, leaving them groveling and pleading for mercy as they confess a lifetime of crimes...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_02: "Spill it! What else are you hiding? You scum, you scummy scumbags!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_03: "That's everything! I swear! We just picked up a few tricks to get by... You know how hard times are these days!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_04: "Tricks? You're looting ancient relics! I've seen your kind before. Money-hungry cheats who'd kill a man for a Credit... Now, hurry up! What else are you hiding?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_05: "Stop, please! All right! I'll talk! When I was fifteen, I stole from the old doctor next door. I-I did it to buy medicine for my brother..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_06: "Brother! Why bring that up?! Look, we've told you everything! We're just a couple of fools chasing rumors about this sacred mountain, hoping for some luck..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_07: "Hmph. Thought you'd make a quick fortune, did you? Fine. Get lost before you wet your pants! I'm feeling generous today. But don't ever let me catch you at this again!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_08: "If we ever catch you thieves at it again... Hehe."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_09: The merchants scramble off in a panic.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_10: "Another day, another justice mission! Some of their relics weren't half bad, though. Not bad for a bunch of petty thieves. Ooh, hello there, my precious. Time for you to shine..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_13: "Oh... Hehe, thanks for stepping in when you did! I'm a traveling antique master, and if you're eyeing these treasures... Tch, don't look at me like that! Fine, fine, I promise I'll return them. A master like me would never stoop so low!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_14: "Well, since you're into rare finds, how about I offer you some ancient texts from the mountain? A steal at the right price. They're one-of-a-kind, after all. Martial arts scrolls, sacred scriptures... all sorts of things."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_15: Let's take a look at one of those.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_17: The ancient text she hands you is filled with near indeciperal words... Luckily, there are illustrations. The pictures seem to tell the story of the Divine Loong gifting seven jades capable of granting wishes to humanity...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_18: "What language is this, anyway? I can barely understand a word... Lame. Ugh."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_19: "No matter where she is, it's the same old Youhu..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_20: "If you're not interested in treasures, why'd you come all the way up here? Listen, I don't take favors for granted. If there's something I can do for you, I'll do it!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_22: "Oooh! Aiming for the legendary Loong Chamber, huh? With skills like yours..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_23: "Then it seems this Master Appraiser has no choice but to join you! You wouldn't refuse an expert on treasures of all eras, would you? And just to be clear... I'm doing this to repay you for helping me earlier, got it? Has nothing to do with all the fancy stuff in the Loong Chamber. Nothing at all!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_01: Perched among the mountains, the inn was built around hot springs that appear once every sixteen years. Steam rises in a warm amber glow, contrasting with the snowy landscape. A comforting sight to behold.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_02: "(Yawns) Ahh... So this legendary mountain hot spring is really something... I was just soaking, and... oops! Guess I dozed off for a little bit."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_03: A familiar figure slowly stretches as she steps out of the inn. She catches a snowflake before looking up at the sky.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_04: "Seems there's still time before the mountain seals itself... I guess... well, everything's set. That person already left to greet the Divine Loong..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_05: "Guess I'll just take it easy a little longer. Maybe stay a few more days at the inn... Oh! Right, they'll want souvenirs... um... where did I put that travel guide?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_06: "Excuse me... you look like you're here visiting too. Do you happen to have any travel guides or scenery books for this mountain on you?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_07: I don't have anything like that...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_08: Just this ancient book that I can't read...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_09: "Ah, that's alright. A guide written by someone else might not be the best, anyway. I'd rather find something that fits me better."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_10: "Hmm... I can't understand this either. It might be perfect for... a nap. A few pages and you'd be asleep in no time."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_11: "Anyway, I'm not really in a rush to get souvenirs. I'll run into some eventually... By the way, are you all here for sightseeing as well?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_12: "If you're looking for places to just... chill, I know a few good spots."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_14: "Yup, we're looking for the Divine Loong's legendary treasure!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_15: "Really...? So you're actually planning on going up the mountain? I heard it's full of dangerous paths and awful blizzards... sounds like a full day of work to me."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_16: "Who in their right mind would volunteer for that? No vacations, no comps, not even extra pay... That Divine Loong must be a workaholic."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_17: "Someone really needs to explain to her that a break wouldn't kill her..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220061_19: "Join you? That sounds like an invitation to work off the books... but, well, if it's for that child, sure, I'll come along."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_01: Perched among the mountains, this inn is built around hot springs that appear once every sixteen years. Steam rises in a warm amber glow, contrasting with the snowy landscape. A comforting sight to behold.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_02: You wander through the inn, finding nothing particularly remarkable, save for the sign hanging at the entrance: Dream Spring, a one-of-a-kind experience.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_03: A soft glow radiates from the windows, filling you with warmth. There's no cold here, only a soothing, enveloping embrace, like when you first came into being.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_04: "I wonder if those hot springs are really as special as everyone says, {PlayerName}? Why don't we go find out?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_05: [Fleeting Fancy] Let's go check it out.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_06: [Save the Drama] Not interested. We better keep moving.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_07: Days of being on the road has worn you down. After a moment's pause, you give in to Abby's enthusiasm and push open the door.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_08: "Woah, the water looks amazing! Here I come!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_09: Abby jumps into the hot spring, and a chain of bubbles rises to the surface. Seconds later, Abby floats back to the surface.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_10: "That was awesome, {PlayerName}! Felt like I just ate a mountain of food underwater! Everything I could dream of, bigger than Cetus the Tidebreaker! I-I actually feel full."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_12: "Having all the food you could eat, a cozy place to rest, and great friends close by... Isn't that about as perfect as it gets?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_13: "But getting everyone enough to eat... is no easy task."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_14: "Yeah, I never really understood that before, not in Jinzhou or Ragunna. But now? I get it. Things would be easier if the Frontier was as prosperous as Jinzhou, wouldn't it?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_15: "But come to think of it, maybe not. There's always something else. People are complicated. Being human is hard enough, but being a happy human? Even harder... If only everyone could be an Echo and just be happy like me."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_18: "Hey, loosen up, {PlayerName}! Come join me in the hot spring. We might not find another place like this, you know."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220071_19: You choose not to enter. For you, dreams and unique experiences are mere trifles.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220081_01: The path to the mountain peak stretches ahead in pristine white. The closer you get, the harder it is to navigate through the snow. But at least you're not alone. You have a guide, someone who knows these treacherous paths all too well.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220081_02: The weight of the snow bends brittle branches, and as the wind howls, it sends flurries of snow swirling around you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220081_04: You sense a threat amid the vastness of white. Instinctively, you leap aside, narrowly dodging the attack.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220081_05: A howl cuts through the air, and from the fallen snowdrift, wolf-like creatures slowly emerge.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220081_06: The leader of the pack bears a deep, jagged gash running from its forehead to its snout. From the pulsing wound, a faint, labored voice struggles to break free.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220081_07: "At last... We have found you... Please... You must save..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220081_09: It is the frequency of someone caught between life and death, not yet fully consumed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_01: The path to the mountain peak stretches ahead in pristine white. Through the swirling snow, faint outlines of colossal figures appear on the glacier.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_02: Flames dance across the horizon, cutting through ice, rock, oceans, and the very air itself. Beneath the stellar halo above, soft whispers ride the wind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_03: "War is coming. And this time, it'll be a spectacle unlike anything before!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_05: [Save the Drama] Not interested. We better keep moving.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_06: "I know! We'll get to witness the incredible weapons in action and get footage of the new monsters!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_08: [Save the Drama] Not interested. We better keep moving.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_09: "What's there to be glad about? You youngsters don't know anything... War... War never changes."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_11: [Save the Drama] Not interested. We better keep moving.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_12: "Where did these monsters come from anyway?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_13: "They exist only to destroy. Nothing more."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_14: The distant flames die out. The massive figures sink beneath the snowdrifts, leaving only silence in their wake.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_15: After a long pause, a voice murmurs from the void:
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_16: "...We'll wait for the next era. We'll wait, and hold onto hope."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220091_17: The voices and phantoms fade away. Without warning, monsters hidden in the blizzard close in around you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_01: On the snow-covered path, something catches your eye. What looks to be dark stone lies buried in the shadow of withered branches.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_02: As you approach, faint breathing reaches your ears, a life on the verge of death. You clear the snow and quickly start a fire, but when you move to tend his wounds, he pushes your hand away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_03: "You're the one from the inn, right? I remember your skills... If you'd fought alongside us... we would've won..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_04: "Don't bother. My insides and spine are done for, and I can't feel my legs. The only thing keeping me alive is... my lungs... still working. Listen... friend... you're strong enough. You can make it to the peak."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_05: The cold and blood loss have clearly muddied his thoughts, but his determination still bleeds through.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_06: "You have to... climb the mountain. Help me... I don't buy the captain's stories. I only followed him so I could see the Divine Loong. My father's from the Frontier. He told me... about the legends..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_07: "I became a merc after my parents died. I did whatever it took... things I'm not proud of. But one of my parents is from here. So... being buried here isn't so bad..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_08: "I joined them last fall, they promised money... never thought we'd lose so many. But where the Divine Loong goes, we win our battles... that's why we followed her... she's our hero... I saw her... last year."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_10: "I don't buy that she's some villain. The captain's wrong. She's not with those monsters... the captain's the idiot. I need to help her."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_12: "There's only one Divine Loong in the Frontier.. I need to help her..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_13: "That beast is coming, go... Help her... Do it for me..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_14: In his final moments, he presses his pouch and weapon into your hands before collapsing into the snow.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220101_17: Snow sweeps across in a sudden gust. Drawn by the flames, monsters begin to close in on you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_01: Through the swirling snow, you spot a man, his arms raised high, his voice cutting through the storm with a manic roar.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_02: "Iron doors, windows, chains... no longer! Be gone, my prison! Hahaha!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_03: "A shepherd without his flock is but a pathetic fool. None of you will ever understand!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_04: As you approach, his eyes gleam with wild excitement. He quickly drops into a combat stance.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_05: "Ha! You're a rare one! Join me, and together, we'll make the living tremble and the dead bow!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_06: "Refuse, then kneel before me! Witness my power and meet your tragic end!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_08: What if I don't choose either?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_09: "Hahaha! Then let's settle this! For ten thousand years, I've been imprisoned within this glacier, denied my rightful stage!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_10: "Now, you dare to challenge my wrath..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220111_12: A huge battle is about to start.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_01: You find yourself in one of the rare bustling marketplaces inside the ancient town, filled with treasures, paintings, and artifacts. A favorite among travelers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_02: "Hello, welcome to the Room of Wishes. As an all-powerful wish granter, is there anything I can assist you with?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_06: "Certainly... I've carefully selected these items specifically for you. I trust they will meet your expectations."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_07: "How touching... You still yearn to reunite with your companions, even at a time like this."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_08: "Certainly. This is what being a merchant is all about, isn't it?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_09: "Sell goods to those who seek, at prices beyond their value... and when demand wanes, create new desires."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_10: "As the saying goes: A mediocre merchant sells products. A great merchant sells dreams."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_13: "Naturally. At the end of the day, humans are driven by their desires. It's through these desires that they define themselves. In other words, desires are essential."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_14: "Merchants trade for profit, but dealing in raw desires seems crude. Civilization hides these longings, wrapping them in a delicate veil called... dreams."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_15: "As the finest of merchants, I cater to all appetites: men, women, the elderly, newborns, the living, and even the dead."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_16: "As long as they can afford the price."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_17: "Is that so? A being that survives without dreams. Or rather, without desires."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_18: "Once you've tasted food that's cooked, even the thought of rotten or raw food becomes repulsive. Once you've bonded with others, isolation turns unbearable. Once you've witnessed life's wonders, their absence is pure devastation."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_19: "Or perhaps... you believe that life requires neither cognitive dissonance nor a sense of self?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220121_20: "A world where everyone is reduced to mindless, pure existence... where consciousness dissolves and many merge into one... perhaps this is a more blissful world."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_1: As the screen cuts through the darkness, a familiar shore materializes before you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_3: The blaring ringtone shatters your peaceful dream, just as it has every morning for years.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_4: But today is different. Instead of lounging in the leather armchair of your office, you're tucked away in a coastal hotel enjoying a rare vacation.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_5: The responsibilities of the Black Shores' Chief Steward are overwhelming—issuing warrants, arresting criminals, investigating cases… the list never ends. You haven't had a proper rest in months.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_6: Alas, your precious time off is coming to an end tomorrow. You groggily reach for the Terminal on the nightstand, dragging yourself away from the soft pillow.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_7: As expected, that annoyingly familiar face fills the screen…
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_10: "Haha, crossing the one who controls my paycheck? I'd never... well, except today."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_13: A brief silence follows on the other end of the line.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_15: His words hit you like ice. For a moment, you're swallowed by the cold, a chill creeping down your neck and spine, sinking deep like raindrops pooling on the ground.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_16: "I didn't want this either, Chief… Actually, I guess I should call you {PlayerName} now."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_17: "Just turn yourself in when you return to the Black Shores. I'll give you six hours. Let's not make this harder than it needs to be, okay? After all, we were colleagues."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_18: "I'm wanted?" The words barely register. After years of issuing warrants and leading ops, now you were the one on the other side. It felt surreal.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_19: "Anyway, enjoy the rest of your vacation. Don't forget to check in at prison when you're back..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_20: That's it. You've had enough of his nonsense.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_21: "This has to be a joke, right?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_23: "Do you think I'm the type to joke around casually? Trust me, I'd rather this was a joke, but it's not."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_24: "I know, right? We were supposed to sit back, sip coffee, and chat in your office tomorrow. But, well... here we are."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_25: "Honestly, this is not what I expected…" He sighs, the weight of it heavy. Then, shifting to a formal tone, he continues, "You should get moving, {PlayerName}."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_27: The grave finality of his words leaves you baffled. Who issued the warrant? What could they possibly want you for?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_28: The only way to clear your name is to figure out why you're wanted. As the Chief Steward of the Black Shores, the Sentry Organization safeguarding all of Solaris, you know this better than anyone—only the Black Shores holds the answers, including that warrant, issued for who-knows-what reason.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_29: But if you're caught and sent to the Black Shores prison, it's over... Your only shot at evading capture is to run now.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_30: Mr. Sunglasses gave you six hours, but the others might already be on their way to hunt you down. There's no guarantee you'd be able to return safely to the Black Shores and get the warrant as planned.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_31: You quickly get dressed and wash your face in the bathroom.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_32: A long road lies ahead... but the first step is to leave this hotel. Your vacation whereabouts aren't a secret, and the Black Shores' Sentries will be here soon.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310011_33: You push open the hotel room door and step into the morning drizzle.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_1: "What a surprise to find you here."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_2: A familiar voice echoes, yet no one is in sight.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_3: You're inside a cavern now, its path leading away from the coast. The Lampylumens around make the air frigid, so biting that you wonder if the voice was just a hallucination born from the chill.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_4: You're about to press forward when the ground starts to tremble, shaking loose icicles from the ceiling.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_5: A haunting cry rises from the mineral-laced depths... a warning of something dangerous approaching.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_6: "Aha, looks like the big fella's here. Don't say I didn't warn you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_7: That voice again. But there's no time to search for its source. The cause of the tremors leaps from the shadows.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_9: Stay alert and watch its moves.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_10: You draw your weapon to confront this twisted monster (Your ATK in this battle increases by 20%).
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_11: You steady yourself, keeping your focus on this twisted monster (Your Crit. Rate in this battle increases by 10%).
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310021_12: The Black Shores' Sentries are hot on your trail, so you must finish this quickly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_1: Time passes, but the monster still stands. It's far more resilient than you expected.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_2: Your breath quickens, the cold air tearing at your throat and nostrils. Sweat and mist cling to your palms, the sword hilt growing slick and harder to hold with each passing second.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_4: Without warning, a crimson flash streaks past your vision, surging from behind like the outstretched arm of a blood-wrought devil.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_5: The strike of that unseen speaker? Or the monster's fatal blow? Either way, it's too late to dodge. Your heartbeat pounds in your ears, a futile drum against the inevitable.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_6: But the crimson flash never reaches you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_7: Instead, it thrusts at the monster's throat with lethal precision. Only now do you realize what it truly is—not some demonic arm, but a camellia, blooming from the vines. The monster turns lifeless upon being hit.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_8: "Well? How does it feel, hearing your heart pound like that?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_9: The voice comes from the figure now standing beside the fallen monster.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_13: Vividly, in fact. Because you were the one who issued her warrant.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_14: "You don't look surprised. And here I thought breaking out of that cursed prison was quite the feat."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_15: "You escaped from the Black Shores' prison?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_16: "How did you manage to do that?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_17: "Funny that you asked. Shouldn't a Sentry like you know that place better than I do?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_18: She's right, which is precisely why you can't believe she actually made it out.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_19: Still reeling, she poses another question you can't answer.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_20: "Speaking of which, do you still remember the crime you charged me with?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_22: The words catch in your throat. Your mind goes blank.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_24: You stutter, racking your brain for the right answer.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_25: Then it dawns on you: not because you forgot her crime, but because it never existed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_26: You suddenly remember everything. Her past, her trial, and how she was locked away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_27: But she never committed a crime.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_29: Her smirk widens as your frown deepens. "Can't seem to recall anything about Psyche Pass?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_32: It's the Black Shores' precognitive system, designed to identify potential criminals before they commit a crime.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_33: And this woman standing before you was one of them.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_34: One question answered, yet more arise. Why did you need reminding of what Psyche Pass is? And why can't you recall her crime? She may not have committed one yet, but you should at least remember what the system accused her of.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_35: As Chief Steward, the one who enforces the system's orders, these things should be ingrained in your mind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_36: "Still lost? I'll spell it out for you. The system flagged me for the attempted murder of the Black Shores' Chief Steward. Ring any bells now?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_38: You have absolutely no idea. Besides, if she really attempted to kill you, she had the perfect chance just moments ago. But instead, she saved you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_39: Something about Psyche Pass feels distant, slipping just beyond your grasp.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_40: But why? You can't think straight, lost as a wanderer in the wilderness. The young woman's voice cuts through your reverie.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_41: "Tell me, do you believe what the system predicts? That I'd try to murder you?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_44: "Haha, how naive. Never once stopped to question it, did you? But let's put this aside for now."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_45: "Haha, how naive. What if it's right, though? You might want to stay on your toes. Anyway, let's put this aside for now."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_46: "I saw how you worked your cases years ago. It was precision. Blade sharp, mind sharp. Enough to keep me entertained."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_47: "I've spent my life chasing people who intrigue me, or... hunting them, if we're being honest. Ever heard of the suspension bridge effect? That thrill is what I'm after. And if no bridge exists, I don't mind creating one myself."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_48: "So, how do you like this one? When my camellia nearly pierced you, did it make your heart skip a beat?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_49: You hesitate. That moment did send a jolt through you, but now that you understand her nature, she no longer feels like an immediate threat.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_50: Still, Psyche Pass marked her as dangerous. You can't help but wonder if the system was too rigid.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_51: As you turn the thought over in your mind, the young woman with camellias is already gone, vanished without a trace before you even noticed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_310022_52:
Perhaps that's how she escaped the Black Shores…

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_1: You slip into the Black Shores' archives to search for any trace of your own warrant.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_2: "Hold it right there! This isn't a place for just anyone to waltz into."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_3: A deep voice cuts through the silence, and you know, without looking, that he's right behind you. Slowly, you turn around.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_4: "…You?" The man's surprise quickly shifts to something more urgent. He lowers his voice. "Quite the nerve, Chief Steward. Every Sentry out there is looking for you." A reprimand, softer than most.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_5: "Which is exactly why I can slip in unnoticed while they're all busy chasing their own tails."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_6: "Aren't you here to turn me in?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_7: The man before you was once your most trusted subordinate. His ability to analyze escape routes was second to none. No fugitive ever slipped past his calculations.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_8: But at the same time, he is fiercely loyal to Psyche Pass. Coming here was a gamble. Between the system and you, there's no telling where his allegiance lies.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_9: "…I used to believe Psyche Pass was perfect. With it, no criminal could ever escape justice."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_10: "But when your warrant came in, I started to doubt. You're the most righteous pers—" He clears his throat. "Person I know."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_12: A quiet relief washes over you. Your gamble paid off.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_13: He doesn't say outright that he won't turn you in, but you know him well enough to read between the lines. And coming from him, even a rare, clumsy compliment like that speaks volumes.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_14: "WARNING! WARNING! ALL AVAILABLE SENTRIES, REPORT FOR DUTY IMMEDIATELY! ALL AVAILABLE SENTRIES, REPORT FOR DUTY IMMEDIATELY!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_15: The system broadcast cuts in, shattering the awkward yet wholesome moment. You don't have time to waste.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_16: "There's nothing here on you. The system's already extracted and locked everything away. Take this. I'll let you know if I find anything."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_17: He presses a small piece of red metal into your hand and gestures for you to leave with a flick of his wrist.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320011_18: "Go quickly." He flicks open his lighter, letting the flame swirl lazily in the air." Once they start making me track your escape route, you're as good as caught. So run fast, Chief Steward."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320021_2: A panicked voice rings out in the distance, thick with desperation, like someone about to go bankrupt.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320021_5: Having worked your way up from an ordinary Sentry, you know what it's like to struggle on the job. You can't help but sympathize.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320022_4: "Could you smuggle me out of here?"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320022_7: "H-huh?! B-but Lollo Logistics only ships cargo, not people…"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320022_8: Seeing how seriously she takes your joke, you almost feel bad.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320022_10: "Phew… Anyway, thanks a lot for the help! Oh, by the way, don't take that road over there! It's crawlin' with scary animals and monsters. I barely made it through!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320022_12: "If you ever need a delivery, hit me up! I'll even give you a discount!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320022_13: With one last grateful bow, the girl hoists her cargo and hurries off, back to her deliveries.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_1: "Prince Cosmos, meet Princess Cloudy, your new best friend!"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_3: You remember this girl. The moment you see her, her name pops into your mind. She is one of the three Prescients overseeing Psyche Pass—the Fleece Prescient.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_10: Your brain stutters for a second. Why has the Fleece Prescient forgotten everything? Same reason you did at first? You need to find out.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_12: "Today, I met Princess Cloudy at the mall! I gave all my Shell Credits to the nice shop lady, and now Princess Cloudy is finally home!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_13: "And now, I'm introducing her to Prince Cosmos, because best friends should always meet! And yesterday... it's all fuzzy."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_14: "That's okay. You don't have to think too hard about it." You don't want to push her, so instead, you smile and say, "Can I be your friend too, Wooly Warrior? I can join Prince Cosmos and Princess Cloudy's team."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_16: She excitedly pulls out a tiny Wooly-shaped badge and pins it onto you with a serious face.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_17: "There! Now you're the fourth member of Wooly Warrior's team!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320031_18: Looking at her genuine smile, you decide not to ask any more questions. Not yet. But one day, you will find out the truth about her lost memories and yours.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_1: Through the rain, you catch sight of a man's silhouette.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_2: A massive blade is strapped to his back, nearly as tall as he is. Behind the towering weapon, his skin bears countless scars, each one a silent testament to a violent past.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_3: "…Hm?" He tilts his head, glancing at you with sharp, wolf-like eyes. "Still alive, are you?"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_16: "Where are these other three coming from?!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_17: "Heh... seems like you still don't know enough," he dodges your question, walking into the heavy rain. "Or maybe, you've just forgotten too much."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_18: "If trouble finds you during your escape, use this to contact the Hounds..." He walks away, leaving only the lingering echo of his voice.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_20: You step forward, but he's already vanished in the downpour.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320041_21: Something glints in the spot where he last stood. A rusted metal tag, marked with the name "The Hounds," carved with rough, almost primal strokes. Below it, is a barely legible contact code.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_1: When you open your eyes again, you find his gaze turned toward you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_2: Against the moonlight, his face is veiled in its shadow, but you can see the curve of his eyes, the faintest hint of a smile there.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_3: "I didn't expect to meet you here." He says.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_4: You recognize him right away—the prodigy and youngest full-fledged scholar.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_6: "Well…" He stretches out his hand, and the moonlight glints off the surface of his mecha arm. "I have some new theories to test. Care to hear them?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_7: You follow him to a nearby tree. He taps a few commands on his two small robots, which project a holographic panel before you. The screen is filled with streams of numbers and text, flowing like a relentless tide.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_8: "You must already know about Psyche Pass, right? How it calculates and judges."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_10: "And what is your opinion?" He looks at you, his gaze soft and steady, like a calm lake with few ripples. It's hard to gauge what he's thinking.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_11: "I don't know what crime it thinks I'll commit in the future, and I don't want to believe it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_12: "But," you pause, locking eyes with him. "Are you with the system?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_13: It would make sense. A once-in-a-century genius scholar paired with a system capable of surveilling people's psyches. But he simply shakes his head.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_14: "I'm not affiliated with it. In fact, I'm trying to find its flaws… and crush it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_15: You're taken aback. "Can that even be done? I thought everyone in this field… was under its control."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_16: "Everything has a solution, and I won't be trapped by it forever." He says, a grin playing on his lips. "I'm just... waiting for the right moment."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_18: "Right now." His assured voice rings. "You are the very chance."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_19: You turn, and the fog that had been obscuring your path begins to clear. Moonlight slices through the branches of the tree, revealing a new road ahead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_20: "My theory is that for you, it's not about the verdict. It's about fear."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_21: "Therefore, you don't need to doubt anything."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320051_22: He mouths the words, barely moving his lips: Tear it down.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_1:
On the shallow blue sands, an Aetherfin floats toward you.
It circles you briefly, then turns to face the distant horizon. You wonder if it's trying to lead you somewhere.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_4:
Can it understand your words? You don't expect it to.
But as you look into its eyes, a sense of its sentience stirs within you. Before you lose your nerve, you speak anyway.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_5: "Do you want me to follow you?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_7: "Did you just... speak?" You wonder if your mind is playing tricks on you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_9: The Aetherfin doesn't answer. Instead, it begins to float ahead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_10: As soon as it senses you've followed, the Aetherfin drifts ahead without a glance back, leading you further into the unknown.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_11:
You walk for what feels like a long time, but weariness never comes.
Your steps part the water, the soft sand squelching beneath your feet. 
A vague familiarity stirs in the back of your mind. You've walked this shore before. With someone.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_12:
The Aetherfin turns, looking at you to see if you're still following.
Its pale blue wings flutter delicately in the air, like a... butterfly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_13: At some point, you arrive at a bay. Towering rocks stand like silent sentinels. Around them, more Aetherfins spiral through the air.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_15:
A towering wave snaps your attention back to the present.
It rises from the sea, its monstrous height crashing toward the stone pillar before you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_16: The Aetherfins struggle to evade it, but they are prey in the web, unable to escape.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_18: This time, you are certain. The Aetherfin that led you here is calling out for help.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_19: Try to lead the Aetherfins away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_20: Try to stop the giant wave.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_21: You surmise that the stone pillar may be what binds the Aetherfins here, forcing them into their endless spirals.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_22: You grip your blade and resolve to shatter the pillar.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_23: You grip your blade and resolve to cleave through the wave.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_24: In that instant, the air fills with the deafening wail of an alarm that shakes the earth beneath you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_26: As the alarm blares, the pillars and waves waver, like a mirage flickering in the heat. They dissolve slowly, fading until nothing remains but pixelated blocks of color.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_28: A sudden horde of data monsters emerges from the pixels amid the alarm's wail.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320101_29: They close in, surrounding you and the Aetherfins. Their intent is clear.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_2: As the last of the monsters fall, the alarm cuts off abruptly, leaving silence in its wake.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_3: From a crack in the rocks not far off, a faint blue glow catches your eyes. An Aetherfin emerges from the gap.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_4: As you wonder where the others have gone, the blue light from the crack intensifies. One by one, the Aetherfins begin to pour forth from the fissure.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_6: There must be over a hundred of them, but when they speak their gratitude in unison it's like they share a single soul.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_7: They begin to dance around you, their delicate bodies brushing past you. It feels like you're being caressed by countless morning dew drops.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_8: After a while, the Aetherfins pull away to form a new formation in the air.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_9: They are free now. Of that you are certain.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_10: They begin to fly toward the horizon. You know that is where the system's core lies.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_12: Before they vanish from view, the Aetherfin's final message drifts across the sky to you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_320102_13:
Perhaps the Aetherfin was not simply waiting for your help along the shore, but wished to offer her own.
Her journey's end is also yours.
The path she follows, too, is your road to salvation.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_1:
The theater lights dim, but the screen remains unexpectedly dark.
A soft, distant rush of waves creeps into your ears, gradually enclosing you.
In the dark, you realize you're not as alone as you thought. As your eyes adjust, you realize you're afloat on a Gondola, drifting beneath the starlit sky of Ragunna. This is where the story begins.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_2:
The Gondola glides silently through water that glistens in the light of the stars.
Beside you is a professional woman in a mask. This is her time, the quiet hours of the night when she's most alive.
Even with the mask, you recognize her instantly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_3: "Chief, I had planned to meet with you earlier today..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_4: "But with Carnevale preparations, it was difficult to find time... My apologies."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_5: At the mention of the Carnevale, you instinctively reach for your own mask, now resting on your face.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_6: "How long has it been since I was last here?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_8:
As her words fall away, a series of memories flash before your eyes, like a parade of stained windows.
You were once a name spoken across Ragunna and beyond—Chief of Averardo Bank.
One of your finest investments was backing the Circus of Savants. Their tours were legendary, filling every seat in every venue across Rinascita.
Your expression darkens in the wake of those memories.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_9: "Don't call me 'Chief' anymore. Let's not make things harder for the current one."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_10: "No, you are the Chief." The office hand stands firm. Her tone sharpens, a flicker of anger creeping in. "You didn't leave the bank by choice."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_12: "Let's hope the current Chief doesn't mind too much..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_13: "There's only one Chief, and it's me."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_14: "Mmhmm…" The office hand pauses briefly, her eyes scanning you before speaking again. "The debt you want to collect won't be an easy one."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_15:
At those words, the colors on the stained windows of your mind start to fade, your thoughts now firmly back in the present. 
You know exactly why you're here.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_16: "The circus's final tour was a grand spectacle, but Fenrico still hasn't settled the performance fees."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_17: You pause for a moment to settle on your judgment, the words coming to you heatedly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_18: "As Ragunna's High Adjudicator, he can't afford to make a habit of dodging debts. He will pay."
