RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_2:
In the past, your sponsorship made sure every island across Rinascita was stationed with a branch of the circus. Back at Ragunna, the circus's birthplace, dozens of stages, both grand and modest, flourished.
In the heart of Ragunna City alone, there were more than three performances daily, each one packed with spectators.
Behind the scenes, the circus performers were constantly crafting props, recruiting new talent, and rehearsing new acts. The show never stopped.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_3: Now only the echo of your own footsteps fills the empty cavern.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_5:
A bright voice calls from above, breaking the desolate silence.
You look up to see a striking figure standing on the huge chandelier suspended from the cavern's ceiling.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_6:
The man grips the chandelier's arm and spins effortlessly in mid-air before stepping onto a suspended ribbon.
He runs along it, then leaps once more, landing effortlessly on another ribbon.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_7:
He weaves between twelve satin ribbons, his movements almost otherworldly. The ribbons seem to respond to his will, shifting in a carefully choreographed pattern. They transform the cavern into a vibrant, spiraling staircase of color.
He is the leader of the Circus of Savants, the one known as the Circus King. At the sight of him, you're instantly transported back to the glorious, bustling days of the circus.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_8:
The man spirals downward, quickly descending to the lowest point of the staircase, still far above the ground. You watch him intently, unsure of what will come next.
Then, from his sleeve, several streaks of white light shoot out.
They streak through the air like shooting stars—five short daggers slicing through the darkness.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_9:
Your gaze returns to the ribbons, but the man has already vanished. He has become the sixth star in the meteor shower.
In the next instant, a perfect pentagon appears on the cavern's rocky wall. Gripping the hilt of his dagger, he spins from point to point, each one only inches from the dagger's tip.
With a powerful flip, he completes five full rotations before landing atop the circus tent.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_10:
In that instant, a purple box bursts through the circus tent curtains, landing squarely in the center of the stage. You can't help but wonder what's hidden inside.
The silence that follows feels heavy. Then, with a deafening bang, a burst of violet flames erupts from the box. The flames lick at the curtains, quickly spreading, and soon, the whole stage is ablaze with violet fire.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_11:
From the swirling purple flames, a girl steps out, dancing gracefully amidst the fire.
Her skirt threatens to catch flame with each twirl, but her expression and movements remain serene, undisturbed by the danger around her.
She is the magician of the stage, the brightest spark in the Circus of Savants.
The girl edges closer to you and curtsies.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_13: The man slides down the tent's peak and lands in front of you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_14: "No use moping around all day. We can't bring the circus back like that, right, Boss?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_15: Fireworks explode in the air, perfectly timed, as Lario carrying the circus float lets out a jubilant cry.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_16:
"Ahem..." You clear your throat awkwardly. It's been years since anyone called you that.
Long ago, it was you who funded the circus.
As the memories flood back, your expression softens. "Were you all waiting for me?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_17: "We made those fireworks last night. Pero's been looking forward to this," the girl says, glancing at the purple box on the stage, "We haven't done magic in years."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_19: "Most have left. Besides us two, there are less than ten of us now..." He lowers his head to adjust his hat, gathering his thoughts. "Let's not dwell on the past. We've waited far too long for this! You're here to collect the debt, aren't you?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_20: You nod. To collect the debt, you'll first need to find the debtor. But arranging a meeting with High Adjudicator Fenrico wouldn't be easy for you now.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_21: "Getting into the Court of Mercury isn't a walk in the park. The last time we tried to apply to perform there, our little Magician over here almost ended up in a brawl with those officials."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_22: "When I went to apply, the security guard insisted I fill out fourteen forms," she says, counting on her fingers. "An entry application, identity forms, organization details, financial reports, performer list, prop declarations, and..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_23: She continues listing the forms with a blank expression, and you start to feel a headache creeping in.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_24: "If you let her keep going, you'll be out cold. Heh," the man chuckles, noticing your growing confusion, and quickly interrupts her. "But it wasn't all bad. We did run into an old friend."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_25: He leans in closer and whispers something in your ear.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_26: "Go there to meet her. Time's ticking, Boss."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410021_27: "Make sure you take this," the girl says, handing you a rucksack. "It's a magical prop you'll need later."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_1: The streets of Ragunna hum with excitement for the upcoming Carnevale. A young noblewoman directs her handmaiden to adorn the family porch with colorful decorations, a father lifts a balloon from the lamppost and hands it to his daughter, while groups of children laugh and chase each other through the streets. Every corner of Ragunna is alive with preparations for the grand celebration to come.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_2: Amidst the festive chaos, you find yourself on a lively street where a restaurant, centered around a massive pizza oven, beckons you. The inviting scent of freshly baked pizzas wafts through the air, irresistible to most passersby.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_3: You recall the Circus Leader's words as you enter the restaurant. You scan the packed tables, but the person you're looking for is nowhere in sight.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_5:
A deliberate cough slices through the noise.
You follow the sound, but your gaze initially lands on the giant oven. Realizing the source is on the other side of the restaurant, you make your way to the other side of the oven.
Through the heat-distorted air, a figure in white slowly comes into focus.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_6:
A blond girl.
She was once a star in the Circus of Savants, captivating audiences with her magical staff. Offstage, she also lent her melodious voice to the performances, adding an extra layer of enchantment to the show.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_7:
You came here seeking her help.
But the girl you once knew is no longer the same. The Circus Leader told you that she now serves as a Ceremonial Emissary under Fenrico's rule, and that she might be the key to helping you gain entry into the Court of Mercury.
You touch your mask and turn your gaze to meet hers. She too wears a mask.
Would she be willing to help you?
What had driven her to leave the circus three years ago? And what led her into the Court of Mercury's arms?
As one of its Emissaries, did she still remember those carefree, wild days spent together in the circus?
Is she still the person you once knew?
As you stand there, you realize that the masks aren't just on your faces. They hang like a heavy fog between you, a barrier that feels thick, a reminder of how much has changed.
The girl notices your peculiar demeanor.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_9:
Her gentle voice is exactly the same voice that once asked you, years ago, if she was ready for the stage.
You blink, snapping out of your thoughts. Something in her tone eases something inside you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_11: "Sorry, I just dozed off for a second."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_13: "Well, would you like to rest a moment beside me?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_14: "No, I'm fine. I'm wide awake now..." You hadn't expected her to be so earnest. You straighten your shoulders, aiming to reassure her.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_16: A steaming pizza is suddenly placed in front of you. Glad for the interruption, you reach for a slice to fill the lull in the conversation.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_17: "How are things at the Court of Mercury?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_18: "It's complicated. Fenrico's influence has grown these last few years... Now, there are two factions within the ranks."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_19:
You listen as you take a bite of the pizza.
It was a Carnevale special, a limited-edition flavor. Packed with spices, each bite brought an extraordinary burst of flavor... and heat.
You feel as if the Carnevale itself is unfolding in your mouth, the intense seasonings awakening each taste bud, making them dance like performers in the circus.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_20: "He hasn't kept a single promise he made before taking power. Aside from the nobles who've thrown their weight behind him, he's hardly seen anyone else in the Court."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_21: As she speaks, she slides an envelope across the table. The wax seal, bearing the crest of the Court of Mercury, glints in the light.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_23: "A permit to enter the Court of Mercury."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_24: "But didn't you say he's only meeting with nobles?" You wipe the bead of sweat from eating the spicy pizza off your forehead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_25: "On the day of the Carnevale, there'll be a noble visiting the Court. Along with five of his attendants."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_26: "Five attendants... So, six permits in total?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_27:
"Exactly. Nobles tend to change their minds a lot, so I prepared a seventh permit, just in case."
She slides the envelope closer to you. "What do you think, Boss?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_30: "I hoped I could be of help to you." The girl smiles gently, lowering her head as she murmurs.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_32: "Er... No, I meant to say phenomenal. You're more dependable than ever!
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_33: "You've always been the reliable one," she replies softly, her voice barely a whisper. "I just hope I can be of help."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_34: With that, she straightens, slipping back into the dignified posture of a Ceremonial Emissary. Her tone is solemn as she lifts her staff.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_35: "May Ragunna City prosper under the Court of Mercury's guidance."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410041_1:
The whole city awaited, breathless, as the moment everyone had been anticipating finally drew near.
After weeks of frenzied preparation, the Carnevale was on the brink of its grandest peak.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410041_2:
As the sun dipped below the horizon, the clock tower's bells signaled the start of evening.
Streets were draped in ribbons and lanterns, while balloons and colorful streamers floated lazily above.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410041_3:
As night fell, people began to leave their homes.
The Carnevale workers arrived at the central square, adding the final touches to the preparations.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410041_4:
The city's elite gathered in private garretts, on balconies, and in gardens, or claimed the best tavern spots near the grand stage in anticipation for the revelry to unfold.
Families came together at Trattoria Margherita, ready to enjoy dinner while watching the distant celebration from afar.
In the streets, crowds began to gather as they moved toward the heart of the city, hoping to secure the best vantage points around the square.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410041_5:
But you are not among them.
Beneath your feet, the Gondola glides steadily through the water, the ripples reflecting the stars in Ragunna's night sky.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410041_6:
As you hum a tune whose name escapes you, its soft notes seem to carry the weight of a forgotten story. The Gondola murmurs gently in response.
You drift from the northern seas toward the city on the verge of losing itself in celebration.
And with the Gondola, you draw closer to the one you seek.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_1:
The sound of the tide envelopes you, accompanied by the sensation of rising.
You find yourself in a well beneath the Court of Mercury, the water level steadily rising upward.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_2:
Like a small stranding raft lifted by an incoming wave, you and the Gondola surge from the depths of the well toward its opening.
As you reach the top, your view opens up, revealing the solemn grandeur of the Court of Mercury.
No sooner have you emerged than a guard stationed at the gates approaches the well.
He yawns in your direction
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_4: "Here it is." You hand over the sealed envelope, its navy blue wax seal still warm.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_5: "Are you one of Sir Valentino's attendants?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_7: "Please proceed." The guard attempts to rouse himself. He helps you out of your Gondola and opens the gate. "Viscount Valentino and his other attendants have already gone to the central square for the festivities. Aren't you joining them?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_8: "Thank you for your concern, but I have other matters to attend to."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_9: You walk straight through the gate. The guard, sensing your resolve, refrains from asking further questions and offers a brief nod.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_10:
The Court of Mercury is unnervingly silent.
You pass through several hallways before eventually reaching the door in the innermost part of the building—the High Adjudicator's office. Along the way, no guards cross your path.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_11:
The stillness of it all unsettles you.
But as you approach the door, a part of you clings to the faint hope that maybe, just maybe, things aren't as they seem.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_12:
The heavy groan of the door opening reverberates throughout the Court.
No one steps forward to stop you, no one to disrupt your disruption of the quietness.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_13:
Inside the office, a navy blue chandelier hangs from the ceiling. A soft halo of blue light fills the room, as though the space itself were submerged beneath the sea's ebb and flow.
Golden light dances across the waves of blue like the first rays of dawn catching the rising tides.
In truth, this unusual golden hue is streaming in from outside.
The festivities have begun. Every lamppost in the city is aglow, their warm yellow light spilling through the windows.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_14:
The High Adjudicator's office provides an unrivaled view of the Carnevale, with an unobstructed sightline to the central square. A telescope even stands beside the desk.
Every past High Adjudicator has enjoyed the celebrations in comfort from this very spot, year after year.
Yet, at this moment, only a lone clerk occupies the office.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_15: "Hello, is there something I can do for you?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_16: You sense the inevitable but push it aside, focusing on the task at hand.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_17: "...I've come to see High Adjudicator Fenrico."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_18: "I'm afraid he's not here tonight. Is there something else I can do for you?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_19: "I need to settle the payment for Circus of Savants' last performance."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_20: "Please hold on a moment." The clerk flips through a stack of papers, finding the document he needs. He reads it over, nods, and hands it to you. "Everything checks out. High Adjudicator Fenrico has already set the funds aside. Please review and sign this document. Afterwards, you can use it to withdraw the money from the treasury on the second floor. If you have any further questions, feel free to ask."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_22:
You don't remember how you left the Court of Mercury, nor what was going through your mind when you signed the paper.
But you do recall the sounds and sights outside, the crescendo of the Carnevale in full swing, and the burst of fireworks lighting up the night sky.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_23:
You recall the chandelier's deep blue glow, how it wrapped the room in a soft light.
And now, you're once again immersed in that familiar light.
Drifting on the water, as if nothing has changed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_24: "Chief..." The office hand looks over the document you handed her a moment ago.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_25: "That's all for now. You can head back. When you do, withdraw the funds and divide them among the circus performers."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_28:
The Carnevale has ended.
Ragunna City slumbers on the shore, as though the revelry was a fleeting dream.
You tell yourself that perhaps this is the best outcome.
Debts have been settled. Not all, but you've done what you could.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_29:
Beneath the stars, memories of the city resurface.
You remember the Circus of Savants, passionately rehearsing their performances as you lay atop the tent and watched.
You remember the staff at Averardo Bank, quietly preparing a birthday surprise for you in the still of the night.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_30:
You remember Margherita's Restaurant where lunches with friends felt like a pause in the madness of the world.
You remember the Court of Mercury, tonight more silence than promise, yet you recall past talks with the former High Adjudicator and how you'd glimpsed the future of Ragunna through the court's navy blue windows. A future shaped by justice, openness, and hope.
But that too is gone.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_31:
On this still, cloudless night, you watch the low crescent moon slip further from the city you love, further from the people.
The Gondola moves through the water, its sound sharp and clear, carrying something that transcends words.
It almost feels as if it's humming an old, forgotten tune, one you can't quite place.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_33:
"Celebration belongs to the night past—"
"Drink and dance with the crowd—"
"For nights to come, you shall only gaze at me—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_34:
"Guest from afar—"
"With origins unknown to me—"
"I long to rest on your shoulder—"
"But that crescent moon has already set—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_35:
"Go, go now—"
"This is for the best—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_36:
"Take this song with you—"
"And leave your smile with me—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_38: "What?" The projector light cuts out as Abby's voice snaps you back into your seat. "Is that how it ends?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_40: "Walking off all sad and getting defeated like that?! That's not like you at all!" Abby shakes its head in clear disappointment. "We didn't even get to see Fenrico. He must've been the rotten egg in the story."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_41: A thought strikes you as you listen to Abby. "If he wasn't in his office that night, where could he have gone...?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_42: "Let's try this again. But this time, we actually find him."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_44: "Maybe we should take a break first."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_46: "Find him first, then break. Come on, can't stop now!"

Ragunna is still, its streets empty. The inhabitants of the city have all gathered in the square. 
From the railings along the canals to the elegant terraces above, to the tables laden with delicacies, every eye is focused on the stage where the celebration is about to begin.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_2: A man in white ascends the steps slowly, making his way to the center of the stage.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_3: "Every citizen of Ragunna has been waiting for this moment... and so have I." Fenrico lowers his gaze, his hand resting on his chest. "Tonight, unlike any before, I step out from the Court of Mercury to share this moment with you and offer my blessing for the Carnevale."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_4:
Fenrico's voice reverberates through the city, yet it is met with unexpected calm. The crowd is not as enthusiastic as he had hoped.
Confused, he scans the crowd, noticing that their eyes are not on him, but on the waters surrounding the square.
Then, from the north, the sound of crashing waves grows louder. A weathered circus float slowly drifts into view, making its way toward the stage.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_5:
"That's... that's the Circus of Savants!"
"Good heavens, are they here for the Carnevale?!"
"Is the leader of the circus here? I want to see him fly through the air!"
"You must be joking. The magician's act is the real highlight!"
"Has the musician returned? Oh, if only she could play for us forever."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_6:
The quiet is shattered in an instant. The crowd erupts, their excitement palpable as they recognize the float. To them, it's the Carnevale's grand surprise, an unexpected spectacle.
Amid the cheers, the float docks slowly, and the Circus Leader and Magician step down from the deck.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_8: "After all this time, the illustrious Circus Leader returns... But I do recall that the Court of Mercury never approved your performance application. And I certainly don't recall any mention of this... unconventional entrance."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_9: "If there's no surprise, there's no performance. My good High Adjudicator, I trust you will enjoy the special opening we've prepared for the Carnevale."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_10: "Arrangements for the festival aside..." The Magician steps forward, pulling her purple prop box behind her. She opens it with a quiet flourish.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_11: "There's someone else we haven't mentioned in our lineup."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_12:
A burst of purple smoke erupts from the Magician's box and quickly spreads across the stage.
Amidst the haze, you step down from the circus float.
You feel the weight of every eye in the city now fixed on you. But they don't know who you are.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_13: Fenrico instinctively takes a step back at the sight of you. His eyes search yours, but tonight, you are hidden behind a mask, your high-necked formal attire concealing all but the faintest hint of your form.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_14:
"Guest of the Circus of Savants, I see discontent and bitterness in your eyes... If you seek something from me, perhaps it's best to wait until the festivities end. We can speak in the Court of Mercury."
His gaze is probing as he discreetly gestures to the guards below the stage.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_15:
You notice the guards surrounding the stage, but you disregard them, walking straight toward Fenrico.
You meet his eyes calmly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_16: "There's no need for that, Fenrico. It's better we speak where the entire city can hear."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_17:
Several performers stand in preparation atop the circus float's tent.
With a sharp snap of their leader's fingers, they throw colorful floral pom-poms into the air.
They soar across the square, unfurling midair into vibrant ribbons. In the next moment, they are draped over the lampposts surrounding the square, filling the air with color and transforming the central square into a magnificent circus stage.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_18:
"Ladies and gentlemen, the show is about to unfold! This performance, 'The Age of Sea Winds,' will whisk you away to the golden days of four years ago!"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_19:
The leader removes his regular mask and replaces it with a golden half-mask identical to Fenrico's.
With calculated steps, he begins his slow, deliberate walk along the red silk ribbon. Despite the dizzying height above the ground, he moves with perfect grace, as if the fragile ribbon were solid earth. This is the troupe's signature high-wire act, known as "The Stroll Through Rainbows."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_20: "I am Fenrico, a candidate for this year's High Adjudicator. Citizens of Ragunna, elect me, and I will bring to this city peace and prosperity such as it has never known before."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_21: You leap onto a lamp post, joining the Circus Leader in the air as you step onto another golden ribbon.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_22: "Citizens of Ragunna, I am {PlayerName}, another candidate for the High Adjudicator."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_23: "Ah, {PlayerName}... the Chief of Averardo Bank, the merchant who claws at the wealth of the people. Citizens, if you allow this one to rise to power, Ragunna will become a city doomed to fill the pockets of the rich at the expense of the common folk!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_24: "Yes, I possess wealth. But I do not seek to use the office of High Adjudicator for my own gain. RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_25: You advance across the golden ribbon, each step as sure as the words you speak.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_26: "As High Adjudicator, I vow to stop the powerful's monopoly over art. Every citizen will have the right to create, buy, and sell the art they wish. The pursuit of art and its creation should be the right of every soul in Ragunna."

The Circus Leader leaps from one lamppost to another with practiced ease. He grips the pole as he spirals down, landing softly on the ground.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_31: "A raucous performance may bring a moment of joy, but it can also stir up indulgent and evil thoughts..."

"Citizens of Ragunna, before you stands an executioner! {Male=He;Female=She} has slain a Gondola and defiled the purity of our city!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_40: The Circus Leader strides closer to where you fell and calls out to the audience.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_41: "This noble of Averardo Bank is soulless! Today, the Gondola {Male=he;Female=she} killed sinks to the depths, in the future, {Male=he;Female=she} may lead our people to the same fate!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_42: "This very morning, the Fisalia family pledged their support to me. Voters, now it is in your hands. Cast your ballots freely, I will hold no grudge. But should you choose to believe, know that I will use the Fisalia family's support to build a more prosperous and beautiful Ragunna."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_43:
As Fenrico delivers his campaign speech, you remain floating in the cold, merciless water.
From your pocket, you pull out a small rucksack. It was the "magical prop" the Magician had given you before.
You open it, ensuring no water seeps in, and retrieve the item inside.
You raise your right arm high and pull the trigger.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_44:
A sharp sound fills the air, marking the finale of "The Age of Sea Winds."
Above, the silk ribbons hanging in the sky all fall at once, weaving together to form a magnificent carpet. As the fireworks you launched explode overhead, brilliant bursts of light shape themselves into a Gondola. It's Loadie, forever immortalized by the circus.
The crowd erupts into applause as the circus performers take the stage to bow in gratitude.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_45:
At this moment, the Gondola you had been riding slowly rights itself. Her name is Shippy, the late Loadie's sister. Like her brother, she had been a loyal companion to the circus for many years. The two of you had rehearsed this act countless times.
In this moment, a wave of déjà vu washes over you. You know that Shippy will never forget the day Loadie was lost, either.
As she steadies herself, she sways her tail and gently nuzzles your cheek.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_47: The crowd watches in silence, then erupts into thunderous applause.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_48: "You do not seem to understand the gravity of this false accusation," Fenrico, unmoved, turns deliberately to address the crowd, his voice cutting through the air. "Citizens of Ragunna, {PlayerName} was banished for heinous crimes and has unlawfully returned to our city. The Circus of Savants performed without approval and, under the pretense of entertainment, spread malicious lies. Guards, dispose of them as the law commands."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_49: "I'm afraid I cannot comply, my lord."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_51:
"Liar!"
"You banished {PlayerName} on your own authority and now you dare stand here acting as if you are the law! You should be thrown out of the city!"
"You were behind Loadie's death... The Fisalia family was deceived by you, imposter!"
"{PlayerName} should be the one to lead Ragunna!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_52:
Fenrico stands frozen, attempting to maintain his composure, while the guards advance toward him.
Meanwhile, the other performers return to the circus float, hats off to you in respect.
The Circus Leader and the Magician approach your side. With a wry grin, the Circus Leader unsheathes his sword and points it at Fenrico. The Magician sets off small firecrackers, scattering colorful confetti across the stage before bowing to you, signaling you to step forward.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_53:
In a tall building beside the square, the head of Fisalia sips from her drink. She raises her glass to you through the full-length windows. 
A street away, in the offices of Averardo Bank, the acting bank chief signs a transition agreement with your name as the recipient.
Outside the gates of the Court of Mercury to the east, a Ceremonial Emissary stands, awaiting the arrival of both a criminal and a new High Adjudicator.
In faraway waters, a violinist listens to the distant roar of the crowd, strumming a tune for you and for Loadie, an old song from days long past.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_54:
As the cheers crescent, you gently stroke Shippy's forehead one last time, then remove your mask and step to the center of the stage.
This night, the farce of "The Age of Sea Winds" will come to an end.
This night, Ragunna's course, diverted for four long years, will finally begin to right itself.
This night, the guilty will be held accountable and the Court of Mercury will pass to new hands.
This night, the Fool who was banished will return at last.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_56: "You... become the ruler of Ragunna!" The projector light cuts out as Abby's voice snaps you back into your seat. "Wait, and also the bank's chief?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_59: "The people here are so different from the ones in reality."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_60: "Do you think that's a bad thing, Abby?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_61: "No," Abby shakes its head firmly. "It's different, but it's still nice."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_63: "These stories are so interesting! Are there more? Any more stories?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_64:
You glance at the little one beside you and can't help but think of Shippy from earlier. You reach out and gently pat Abby's head.
Abby squints, seeming to struggle to tell whether the head pat or the stories were what felt good.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_65: "So... Should we keep looking? Maybe there's more, right?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_67: "Hold on, I'm not finishing patting your head."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_68: "Then what are we waiting for? Let's start the next one already!"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_1: You wander through the outskirts of Ragunna and, before you realize it, find yourself standing beside a small lake. Suddenly, a soft, melodic tune reaches your ears, carried by the breeze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_3: You follow the voice to see a girl with flaming red hair sitting on a Gondola along the water's edge. She strums her violin as the boat sways gently with the ripples.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_8: "Oh... I suppose I can't blame you. It has been four years, after all."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_9:
The girl smiles warmly as she talks about the past.
You remember that she was born aboard a ship, raised among the crew, and never once set foot on land. On that ship, she heard sailors sing their songs in the waves, the soft melodies over dinner, and the thunderous sound of storms shaking the deck. Through these sounds, she came to know music, and in time, teach herself to play the violin and sing.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_10: You met her during a trade voyage. The sight of her singing atop the mast left a lasting impression and later, you invited her to join the Circus of Savants.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_11:
You remember telling the other performers about her. Born in a ship's cabin, she had an unshakeable connection to the sea. The circus float had given her a sense of peace.
The other performers respected her deeply, and while most of her time was spent on the float or in her own Gondola, the circus made sure she saw land as well.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_12: "Those were happy days," she says, a smile playing on her lips. "I'll always be grateful for bringing me into the circus."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_13: As you talk, the Gondola beneath her begins to move, gently swaying towards the east where a small stream flows into a lake.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_15: The red-haired girl gives a small shake of her head. "It's not me," her eyes drift down to the Gondola. "It's this girl right here."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_16: "I never really tell her where to go. She takes me wherever she fancies. It's thanks to her that I'm here, meeting you today!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_17: She waves at you warmly, her hands moving toward the strings of her violin.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_18: "Till next time, Boss! If you ever want to find me, just listen to the music in the wind. Wherever you hear a song, you'll know I'm close by."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420011_19:
As her fingers move over the strings, a tune fills the air, a melody that you know all too well.
You watch as she becomes a distant silhouette.
Even though it was a farewell, something about it felt like a quiet reassurance, an unspoken promise that lingered in the air.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_1:
A peculiar, disorienting scent drifts through the air.
The idyllic waterways of Ragunna City suddenly darken. The Gondolas are replaced by massive, shadowy sea creatures. The boatmen and citizens transform into strange sea folk, their limbs and torsos becoming tails and fins, their necks marked with gill slits...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_2: "Lost, are we? Or perhaps you were looking for me?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_3: A voice breaks the spell and pulls you back to reality. You blink, and find yourself sitting in a pavilion by the water's edge, a cup of tea in hand, across from a woman whose presence feels both familiar and elusive.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_4: "It's easy to get lost in daydreams talking with you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_5: The woman smiles, her eyes twinkling with something unspoken.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_6: "It's been a while. How have you been enjoying your... retirement?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_12: "Mmhmm. However, a lost fish will eventually find its way back to familiar waters... and here you are."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_13: "A few words were enough to persuade me to help you manage things at the bank for some time... It's time you do it yourself."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_14:
In a sudden gust of wind or perhaps the fleeting shadow of a seabird, your tea cup topples, spilling its contents into the waterway.
She watches, quietly, as the color of the tea thins. After a while, she breaks the silence with a question.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_16:
Her words stir memories long buried.
Once, in the days of the Circus of Savants, there was a Gondola named Loadie. Your most beloved one.
Back then, the woman across from you was your subordinate. When there were no rehearsals or shows, Loadie would accompany you everywhere, ferrying you across Ragunna's canals.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_17:
Loadie was loved by all. During the circus' final performance, he was even one of the stars of the stage.
But then, during the show, something went wrong. Loadie broke free from his reins and harness, and blood began to pour from his neck, staining the waterway crimson.
And with that, he left you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_18: You find yourself staring into the waterway for what feels like an eternity as the past unfolds in your mind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_19:
The woman silently rights your cup and brews another, her gaze steady and unspoken. 
Much like when you once entrusted her with the bank, you now feel her trust in you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_20: "I will find the one who killed Loadie."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_21: Time flows on. The water of the canal gradually washes the tea's color away, until it's gone entirely. But your memories... those remain.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_1:
After crossing Thessaleo Fells, you travel east and arrive at Porto-Veno Castle.
Such a journey could never be a mere whim. You are here by appointment.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_2: "On behalf of the Fisalia family, I thank you for honoring our appointment."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_3:
A few hours ago, you received a permit to enter the Court of Mercury.
But upon closer inspection, you notice something unusual on the seal. There are two different wax seals—evidence that the envelope had been opened and then resealed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_4: "Must the Fisalia ways always be so elusive?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_5: "I trusted that you, of all people, would be able to see the code in the letter."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_6: "I'll spare you the pleasantries, Chief. I sought you out regarding the High Adjudicator Fenrico."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_7: "Fenrico owes his current position to the support of the Fisalia family. Indeed, he had been of great service to us in the past." The young woman sits erect in a grand wingback chair, her fingers delicately turning a gemstone between them.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_8: "But now, our interests no longer align. To Fenrico, the Fisalia family is but a tool to line his pockets, a crutch to further oppress the people. He no longer deserves our support." At these words, she places the gemstone on the table and, as if dismissing an insignificant object, flicks it across the surface, sending it rolling away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_9: "That has nothing to do with me."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_10: "I'm just here to collect a debt."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_11: The young woman stares at your eyes, and leans forward slightly.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_12: "You're here to collect a debt. To do that, you must first learn where the debtor is."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_13: "I presumed that you'd be at the Court of Mercury during the Carnevale. Traditionally, he would be there to enjoy the festivities."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_14: "But this year, Fenrico doesn't intend to stay in his office. He plans to take the stage and deliver a speech."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_16:
Years ago, when you were still Chief of Averardo Bank, the head of the Fisalias was someone else.
The young woman before you is the second daughter of the Fisalia family. From what you gathered, her position within the family was... controversial. Some said she was the adopted daughter of the previous head, while others claimed that her bloodline could be traced back to another rising noble house...
In short, she was an enigma to you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_17:
The young woman rises, gliding toward you along the edge of the table.
A cold sensation seeps into your palm. You glance down to find a small gemstone pressed into your hand.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_18: "Cat's Eye, a small gift. It's my favorite gemstone, and somehow, you remind me of it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_19: "Had I been the head of the family back then, I would never have supported Fenrico. I would have chosen to support you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_1: At a bustling dock, vendors stand aboard their Gondolas hawking wares. It is at once a spectacular marketplace on the water.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_2: "Step right up, step right up! Pay a little extra, and we'll cover the difference. If it breaks, we'll replace it!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_3: "Only what truly suits you is worth your time. Let me help you find what you need, tailored perfectly for you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_4: "You won't find these anywhere else. No one else offers what I do... Come on, take a look."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_5: You decide to explore the market. Which merchant's Gondola will you approach?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_9: "You have an eye for quality! I guarantee you won't be disappointed!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_10: "You won't regret this. You've made a wise choice."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420041_11: "You'll never forget today... These are things you've never seen before."

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_2: But today, the cries of the vendors seem particularly grating.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_3: "You won't regret this, friend. You've made the right choice, mark my words."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_4: "You're not from here, are you? If you go to them, they'll rob you blind. Come to me, and I'll give it to you at half the price!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_5: "Don't listen to them! They all get their stock from the same place. Only I have the true, rare treasures of this land!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_8: A loud slam of a table echoes through the air.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_9: "Are you looking to leave the business?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_10: "Now you are scaring off the customer! What foolishness..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_11: It looks like a full-blown market brawl is about to erupt. You decide to...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_12: [Save the Drama] Get out of there.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_13: [Fleeting Fancy] Roll up your sleeves to bring peace.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_17: You hear the commotion behind you fade into the distance. Just as you're about to leave the market, a product flies past you. It seems some unlucky vendor had their goods thrown out in the heat of the argument.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_18: You pick up the item and inspect it. It's been shattered to pieces, clearly no longer sellable in the store.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_19: But perhaps it could still be of use to you? You decide to tuck it away in your pack.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_20: You move forward, intent on restoring some order and helping the vendors calm down. But sadly, after years of doing business, they've lost all patience with each other.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_21: They continue to clash, even pulling you into their brawl as you try to intervene.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_23: You offer them a deal they can't refuse. All of them are in the same line of work, after all, and no one turns down money.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_24: The vendors nod, counting the cash in their hands. Their expressions shift from snarls to wry smiles. It seems their issue has been resolved.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420051_25: Now, it's your turn to wonder what you'll do with all these items you just bought.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420061_2: You pause, gazing at the strange, violet-hued landscape unfolding before you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420061_4: You snap your head in the direction of a group of armored figures emerging from behind the trees.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420061_5: "I am stranded in these wilds because of those miserable aristocrats! How much blood did my sword spill for the Fisalias... How can they cast me out like this?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420061_6: "A knight's loyalty is a great honor! You are unworthy of the protection we offer!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420061_9: "You may not know us, but we know you. You're from the bank! Even if you're not a Fisalia, you're still one of the high and mighty! You're all cut from the same cloth!

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420071_13: "What did I tell you? There's always a fool who'll fall for it!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420071_14: "You're telling me a hook this straight can still catch fish?!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420071_15: "What are we waiting for? Let's go!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420071_16: You saw this coming, but now it's happening. Like a pack of ravenous wolves, they descend on you.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420081_22: "Fifty thousand Monnaie, going once. Fifty thousand Monnaie, going twice... And sold! Congratulations."

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_3: "If you're hoping to take a boat ride today, best wait till tomorrow... It's a rest day."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_4:
The gondolier stretched lazily, then curled up in his boat.
Cradled by the seawater, he smiled like a child rocked to sleep.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_5: "What about the auction? I heard there's one today."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_6: "The organizers are busy shipping the exotic items... probably won't start till tomorrow."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_7: The gondolier gave a final, half-hearted answer before turning away and dozing off completely.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_8: With little else happening on the island, perhaps you, too, should have a rest.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_9: [Save the Drama] Rest on the shore.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_11:
In the shade of a tree, you sit down. Whether it's the sea breeze or the dappled sunlight through the leaves, everything feels warm and gentle.
You miss weather like this.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_12: You drift into a peaceful nap.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_13:
Something nudges you—it's unclear what. You tiptoe aboard the Gondola.
You move with care, making sure the boat barely shifts.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_15: The gondolier turns slightly but doesn't wake.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420111_16: You slip into a far corner of the Gondola, away from him, and allow yourself a long, deep rest...

You rise gently and leave the Gondola without a sound...

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_510011_1: The lights flicker on. You're back in the theater. Again. Theater 5 didn't deliver the dreamlike world you imagined... looks like you just nodded off in your seat.

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520021_18: Words are meaningless. Information is meaningless. Even the mind is meaningless. Reject the connection. Reject the system. Reject the rules.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_2: The scene unfolds inside the belly of a colossal steel warship. You see control panels and intricate instruments lining the wall and the crew members moving around. But beyond the thick glass of the viewport, there's no ocean. No horizon. Just the visage of a planet suspended in the void, its surface awash with eerie, undulating hues.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_3: "This is Investigator of the Lem. I repeat, this is Investigator of the Lem. I am now the last remaining human member of the ship's crew, reporting everything I have witnessed during this mission."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_4: "The Lem has remained in orbit around the target planet for a full local year. This recorded transmission will serve as the final report to be delivered to ground control via neutrino communication. To prevent any possible contamination of the Nexus on our planet, the Lem will not be returning. I repeat, to prevent any possible contamination of the Nexus on our planet, the Lem will not be returning."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_5: [Fleeting Fancy] Why do you reject returning?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_7: "Following six months of hypotheses and measurements, the crew conducted successive landings on the surface of the target planet."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_8: "As the only crew member confined to the ship due to illness, I never participated in any of the ground expeditions... Ironically, that is precisely why I am the only one who was never *replaced* by the planet."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_9: "Have you ever heard of the Swampman Paradox? A bolt of lightning strikes a person, vaporizing them entirely. But by sheer coincidence, that same lightning simultaneously triggers a strange reaction in a nearby swamp, creating a being identical to the original in every way—"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_10: "Down to their mass, structure, memories, and skills. And even, to some extent, their emotions or cognitive echoes. Yet, no matter how perfect the imitation, it is not *human*. Everything it does is merely an act of observation, mimicry... or perhaps an instinctual drive to replace us."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_11: "Now, you should understand... This is why the Lem can never return. During the course of our mission, every single crew member who set foot on the target planet and returned to the ship became a 'Swamp Person.' Even now, their numbers continue to grow."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_12: "Message received. Likewise... good luck, my fellow kin."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_13: "Any final words you wish to leave behind, Investigator?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_14: "...I believe this mission may not be entirely in vain for our home world. For too long, we have set our eyes and minds on distant horizons, yearning to conquer worlds beyond our own."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_15: "But has anyone ever stopped to consider: do we truly need another world? Where do we draw the line between outward exploration and inward reflection? Is there really an inherent link between self-awareness and intelligence?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520031_16: "This planet is a mirror for us."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_2: The scene is a desolate, run-down street. Discarded household items lie tangled with forgotten toys. A small group of young people gathers around a mound of broken junk, casually chatting as they stare at the pile.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_3: "Why do we even go to school?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_5: "And once we got a job, will everything get better?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_6: "Not really. Life at every stage is more or less the same. There are small differences, sure, but nothing worth getting hung up on. Trust me, the longer you live in this world, the clearer it becomes. This kind of frustration never ends. People are always worried about something, always have been, ever since they were born. You think moving on to the next stage of life or changing your surroundings will make things better? It won't."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_8: "Kinda, yeah. But it's not completely dull. At the very least, you're still free. If you don't feel like going to school tomorrow, you don't have to. If I don't feel like going to work, I won't either. Simple as that. Sure, it'll cause trouble, but that doesn't mean you can't do it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_10: "Why do you always take my words out of context?... But yeah, I really don't feel like going. I want to go out. Maybe visit the circus at the zoo."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_12: "To see the tumbleyak. I heard they got a new one in the troupe. It just sits there all day. Maybe it's because the audience keeps poking it with sticks, or maybe it just likes sitting there. People come from all over to see it, throwing food at it, but it never reacts. It just sits there, and doesn't even roll when the wind blows. It does nothing, every single day."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_13: [Fleeting Fancy] I'll go see that tumbleyak.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_14: [The Final Word] I'll go observe those who go for the tumbleyak.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_15: You trail the girl's words and wind up at the circus in pursuit of the fabled tumbleyak... The reality, though, is drab, unremarkable. The creature sits silently in a shadowed corner of the tent, its fur hanging limp over its eyes, looking like a lifeless rug. You linger, watching it. Nothing. As you're about to walk away, it suddenly speaks.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_16: "Did you know? This world has no roads. People rise from the warmth of one grave, only to march toward the chill of the next. Everything in between is called the present. And everything you do in between... is called struggle."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_17: You trail the girl's words and wind up at the circus in pursuit of the fabled tumbleyak... When you get there, you witness the trainers whipping it.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520041_18: A man stumbles into the tent, his eyes landing on the scene before him. Without a moment's hesitation, he lunges forward, throwing his arms around the tumbleyak's neck, his face buried deep in its fur. With every ounce of strength he has left, he sobs, "Oh, my poor, suffering brother… my tumbleyak!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_2: The sun blazes overhead in the scene, casting a warm glow on everything below. Scattered around an artificial swimming pool are signs and a jumble of toys. Sitting side by side, a young man and an elegantly dressed elder stare off into the distance.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_3: "You're just a kid. You don't have the faintest idea of what you're researching... You've never been out of this city."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_4: "I don't see how that has anything to do with my project."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_5: "You know a lot, I'll give you that. But you haven't lived enough to really get it. Look at you, always holding onto your work. You guard it like it's some precious relic, keeping it neat, perfect, locked up tight where no one can touch it... You are like a coffin, sealed up with all that pride and fear of yours inside."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_6: "But the more you bury yourself this way, the more you lose touch with the real world. In the end, all our research on Resonance is about the people it's supposed to help."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_8: "If I ask you about capturing those measurable quantities using physics, you will probably throw some cutting-edge lab theories at me, talking about how syntony principles and expansion formulas are all intricate, elegant, and precise. And yeah, they are. But you've never watched a groundbreaking invention ripple across the world, bit by bit, until nothing's the same. You don't know how it feels to see a big leap in technology destroy what came before it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_9: "You don't get it, kid, that feeling when you see the world just toss its past aside like it's nothing. Most people only live through that once. They just stand there, frozen, as everything they've ever known gets wiped clean right before their eyes. Those who can't keep up grow old in a heartbeat, ground down powerlessly by the gears of history that keep turning without them."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_10: "But that day will come, whether I'm here or not."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_11: "Yeah, it'll happen. With or without you. But you're not ready to be the one who turns the key. Not yet. And you know what? People can't learn anything from you with some tech or gadget. No one understands the depths of you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520051_12: "So you will regret it. And they will fear you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_2: A young man stands in the scene before a lottery counter, a blank look on his face, his gaze fixed on the machine as it spits out a stream of white tickets. Behind him, the wall's a mess of scribbled charts and faded records of past winners.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_3: "Two lottery tickets, miss. I picked the numbers meself. 'Ere, keep the change, love, an' throw me a scratch-off while yer at it... Eh? 'Thank you for your purchase' again? Bloody 'ell. Anybody strike it rich today?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_4: "Yeah, someone hit the *large currency unit* jackpot right here."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_5: "Naah, yer jokin'! An' yer only tellin' me now? Ain't there a rule or summink? First time's a fluke, second time's a coincidence, but third time? Nah, no chance I'm winnin' now... 'Ang on, did they pick their own numbers or let the machine do it?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_6: "Oh, definitely by the machine. These machines are proper clever these days... all that data modelling, fancy AI tech or whatnot. Dunno how it works, but somehow, it got it right."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_7: "Ain't it all just a load o' luck?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_8: "Hi, I'll take as many tickets as this cash can get me. And make sure they're all machine-picked."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_9: "Alright, hang on a moment. There you go, love. Keep them safe."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_10: "Wot's the point o' machine-picked numbers, eh? Them machines are built by the lottery lot! Yer really fink they'd let yer win?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_11: "And you really think picking your own numbers makes a blind bit of difference? Come on, you've got to keep up with the times, mate. I'll tell you straight, every property I own, every penny in the bank, it's all down to those machine-picked tickets."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_12: "Here's a bit of advice: if you can't outsmart the odds, at least treat the lottery with a bit of peace and respect, eh?" With that, the man tucks his tickets away and strolls out of the store.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_13: "Wot a right ungrateful sod. I was only tryin' ter 'elp... I'll 'ave a machine-picked one an' all."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_15: [Fleeting Fancy] Buy a machine-picked lottery ticket.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_16: [The Final Word] Buy a lottery ticket with hand-picked numbers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_17: [Save the Drama] I don't want to buy a lottery ticket. Forget it.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_18: Unfortunately, you didn't win. Maybe that town boy had a point... But more likely, this kind of luck only ever happens to an exceptionally rare few. And you, however, are not one of them.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_19: Unfortunately, you didn't win. Maybe that middle-aged man had a point... But more likely, this kind of luck only ever happens to an exceptionally rare few. And you, however, are not one of them.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520061_20: Yes, winning is always a low-probability event. Whether the numbers are hand-picked or machine-picked, it's pure chance. Attaching meaning to random results and clinging to an illusion of patterns? That's nothing short of absurd.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_2: In the scene, a girl draped in a trench coat and sporting a beret saunters leisurely along the railway tracks, leaving behind the train where a murder has just unfolded.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_3: "There's no real culprit on that train. Not one that a detective like me should even be digging into... The real killer is long gone."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_4: "How's that even a failure for a detective?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_5: "With cases like this, there's not much I can do. If we have to pin it on someone, then maybe the culprit is the deceased themselves, weighed down by their own sins. Guess you could say they were a messed-up soul who dodged justice in life and finally got what was coming to them."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_6: "Every single person on that train had the chance to pull it off. Any one of them could've been the killer. And I'd bet they all probably thought about it at some point... Most importantly, every last one of them had a motive."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_7: "So tell me, my friend, what would you do in a case like this?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_8: [Save the Drama] People on that train are innocent.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_9: [Fleeting Fancy] We should bring them all to justice.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_10: [The Final Word] I hate moral dilemmas like this.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_11: "Indeed... Procedural justice, consequential justice... It's all just a part of some boring debates. When the law can't even deliver real justice, who gets to decide what's right or wrong about taking matters into your own hands?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_12: "You're really something else... Even with all this infamy, you still stick to your principles, no matter what."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_13: "But beyond this moral dilemma, aren't you just facing something more serious all the time? Maybe that's why you didn't even blink before stepping up as some kind of guardian of order."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_14: "Ugh, I can't stand them either. And I especially loathe the people who love tossing these questions at everyone else…"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520071_15: "But like it or not, you're gonna run into a situation like that sooner or later. And when that day comes… what will you do?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_2: In the scene, a hunched humanoid figure sits on the ground, basking in the distant glow of the sunrise. Behind him, an inorganic abomination looms, its intricate assembly of gears and cogs interlocking with precision, ticking out a rhythmic, mechanical heartbeat. From afar, humans spy on the figure, their silent observation a testament to his supreme power.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_3: "I have no desire to be caught in the tangle of your lives and the conflicts among your nations. Yet, even after I retreated here, humanity persists in perceiving me as a danger. Ever so vigilant, ever tracing the paths I take."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_4: "In the vast expanse of the infinite cosmos, human notions of morality are fleeting and inconsequential. Time will ultimately consume all civilizations, reducing them to dust. I will merely observe as a silent witness, preserving their tales. Nothing more."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_6: [Save the Drama] Points out the fear of those spying on him.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_7: "I was merely bored, exploring the boundaries of my existence. After all, I am no longer human, merely a being who, by chance, still wears the shape of one."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_8: "I have grown weary of humanity. There was a time when I played the role of a hero, striving to save the world. But now I see it for what it truly was: a hollow pursuit of purpose and acknowledgment."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_9: "That distant world holds no place for me now. I will depart from here and drift onward. Perhaps, in some distant corner of the galaxy, our paths will cross once more."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_10: In the razor-thin gap between one heartbeat and the next, the figure vanishes. Humanity erupts in cheers at his departure, but no one pauses to consider the cracks already spreading through the very fabric of their civilization.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_11: "It is intrinsic to human nature. Every civilization throughout history has been shaped by fear and awe of what lies beyond understanding."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_12: "And that is precisely what I desire. To stand as an adversary to all of humanity is far more compelling than assuming the mantle of a god."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520081_13: His eyes lock onto yours, challenging and utterly alien. You know you can firmly draw your blade against him for humanity's survival. Of course... he knows it too.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_2: A man in a dark suit is hoisted high into the air by a brute, his battered body displayed like a trophy to the surrounding criminals. Pain and fear surge through his shattered spine, stripping away the last remnants of his disguise. Both his physical and mental fragility are laid bare.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_3: "You are no hero. This is no story of heroism."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_4: "This city doesn't need saving. Corruption and chaos are carved into its very bones. It's a thriving haven for the wicked to flourish."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_5: "Face the truth. No matter how many times you save them, these people will never thank you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_6: [Fleeting Fancy] Help the hero beat up the bad guys.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_7: [Save the Drama] Observe the ending of the hero.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_8: Yet before you move, someone has stepped up to protect the man.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_10: "And who are you, a mere spectator, to dare stand against me? Witness now, as I bring you your doom!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_11: "Even if I fall, others will rise to take my place. In the face of evil and injustice, anyone who resists can be a hero."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_12: "Well spoken. But until that day comes, I'll keep you safe. I'll stand by you until you're strong enough to live up to your own ideals."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_13: The broken hero struggles to his feet, his battered body barely holding together, yet his fists clench once more.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_14: "You're not wrong. But I don't fight for thanks or praise... I fight to ensure that what happened in that alley never happens to anyone else."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_15: "...Thank you. For staying out of my fight."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_16: The battered hero nods at you before struggling to his feet, his fists clenched once more.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520091_18: "Hah... A hero can never run from battle!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_1: In the shadowy corridor of the cinema, a movie poster snags your gaze.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_2: A man kneels before a grave. The air around him thrums with the chaotic debate of the villagers. They're stitching together lies about the life now buried. Alien, they call it. A threat, they claim. The streets burn. The beasts roar. The setting sun is weeping.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_3: "To protect themselves, humans spin lies without a second thought and sacrifice innocent lives. I see only their own ignorance and folly."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_4: "...What should I do? Does a world like this truly deserve my protection?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_5: [Fleeting Fancy] Offer flowers to the departed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_6: [Save the Drama] Fight in his place.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_7: "Thank you, stranger. Your actions have reminded me that beauty still exists in this world, that there are still things worth protecting."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_8: "If I stop moving forward because of the ugliness I see... then the little beauty that remains will be destroyed along with it."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_9: With unwavering resolve, he rushes toward the burning streets. In a flash of light, the lone warrior stands tall against the bleeding sun.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_10: The crowd erupts into cheers for your bold action, quickly forgetting that they have just ruthlessly snuffed out a life.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520101_11: From a distance, the agent from another planet watches it all unfold, his heart stormed by confusion...

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_2: Indistinct hums of a nursery rhyme drift into your ears. The distorted sounds seem to have come from a far-off place... You try to focus and listen, as you always did, but the melody cuts off, all at once.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_3: "Ah... It's nice to meet you again. Please come this way."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_4: Following the voice, you once again pass through the familiar gate. Dorothy waits for you in a field of flowers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_5: "So this is it. Your adventure here is almost over."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_6: "You've come so far. Before you leave, please, rest a little longer."

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_8: [Fleeting Fancy] No more singing this time?

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_10: "If it's you, I know... I know you can find a new ending to the story…"

RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_12: "It's time to stop singing. Even Dorothy knows: children must one day grow up."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_14: "Someone once told me, each decision we make is a bullet we choose. And life is the act of firing those bullets, one after another, at the world."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_520111_15: "And one day, you find that candy no longer works as your bullets... that's when you've grown up."
