RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600211_11: No twists, no foreshadowing, No hope, no despair. And... no ending, either.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_01: You step into a narrow, aromatic alleyway. A place time forgets to pass through.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_02: Nameless flowers grow wild within the confines of the tiny space. Unbothered by the harsh environment.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_03: "...Ah, the Immortal? Never did I think these clouded eyes would gaze upon thee once more in the span of mine existence."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_04: Leaves brush against each other in their whispered exchange. They study you closely like old acquaintances. Your clothes, your posture. They want to reach your essence and the civilization you carry with you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_05: "Take hence this withered bough of mine. This time, it shall bear the warmth of the sun."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_07: [Save the Drama] Turn around and leave.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_08: The old tree shudders, straining its brittle spine, and snaps off a bough. You take it, turn around, and plant it right in the sunshine a few steps away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_09: But the wind and light do not grant rebirth. Spring cradles the bough for a fleeting moment, only to discard it, leaving it to wither in desperation.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_10: "...The tale doth end as ever it hath. It seems it hath not yet the will to depart this place."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_11: "I shall abide yet longer, sowing and tending. To see our dream fulfilled, I need more time... Aye, as much time as thou dost possess."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_12: You disregard the frenzy in its eyes and turn to leave. Let it rust in the dark alone.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_13: Realizing its insolence and brazenness, the old tree quietly tucks its bough behind its back.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600221_14: "...I shall abide yet longer. Maybe, when next our paths entwine, thy heart shall waver."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_01: You step into a narrow, aromatic alleyway. A place time forgets to pass through.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_02: Nameless flowers grow wild within the confines of the tiny space. Unbothered by the harsh environment.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_03: "Welcome, human. Grandpa told me about you."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_04: "It gave up its dream and returned to the land's embrace in the end."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_05: "...Oh, by the way, have you noticed these flowers? Because of your visit, these soulless creatures started to crave the sun."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_06: Blossoming flowers. They cleave to the stones, stretching eagerly upwards as if begging your merciful hand to take them away.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_09: But the tree moves first. Its boughs, yet to be crafted into coffins, spear through the prison. Countless stones rain down, isolating you from the flowers.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_10: "No, no, you shan't bestow your blessing on just a single being, leaving the rest engulfed by flames of envy."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_11: The young tree bark starts peeling off, so do the guises that have concealed the obsession and madness of a thousand years old.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_12: "Stay with me, the Immortal. This time, thou shalt not slip from me!"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_13: The flowers shift their attention. Under the tree's command, they reach for you, eager to make you one of them. A nutrient, to be more exact, for their endless pursuit of the sky.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_14: These flowers, feeding on unfulfilled wishes, can only bear fruit that is sweet yet poisonous.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600231_15: The tree knows this. And so do you. Hence you leave, without hesitation. Behind, it lingers in the thinning mist, alone, waiting for another dusk, another dawn.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_02: It grows in a quiet, distant corner, cleaving to a giant rock.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_03: One branch stands out. Long. Reaching beyond the cliffside. It's an invitation. Following it, you might find your way upward.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_04: At its base, the grass is thick and dense. A perfect place to rest.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_05: [Save the Drama] Sit down and get your strength back.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_06: [Fleeting Fancy] Climb up and see what awaits ahead.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_07: The quiet environment offers you a good rest. Nothing disturbs you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_08: You feel a surge of energy rising within you once more.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_09: Hand over hand, step over step, you climb upward.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600241_10: At last, you reach the farthest edge of the outstretched branch. Beyond the cliff, the world unfolds before you.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_02: Sunlight barely visits this place, but to your surprise, you find a tree standing, cleaving to a giant rock, its branches stretching out of the entrance.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_03: No soil in this cave, and yet, it persists. How deep must its roots have burrowed to find sustenance? How many years has it fought to grow into a tree like this? A sudden urge takes hold. You *must* climb on top of it.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_04: Carefully, you clutch the tree trunk, pulling yourself upward. The sturdy trunk remains unwavering, not shaken or bended by an inch under your weight.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_05: When you finally make it to the top, a bloated package catches your eye.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_06: You recognize it instantly. An ordinary package, the kind favored by thieves and robbers. After all, no one would ever notice if it were gone, would they?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_07: This one is old, worn from time. You assume whoever hoarded this wealth, whoever stole it from them, are long gone.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_08: [Fleeting Fancy] Why not take it with me...?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_10: You weigh it in your hands, and a bold decision forms.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_11: The possibility of finding its rightful owner is slim. And you know it. All too well. So why leave it here, lonely, covered in dust?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_13: But you're not a thief. No, you tell yourself. You're a person of principle.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_14: Descending the tree, your feet feel the solid ground again. Embraced by quietness, you lean back against the tree and take a rest, undisturbed.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600251_15: You feel a surge of energy rising within you once more.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_01: Suddenly, you find yourself standing next to a crumbled wall.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_02: Unfamiliar vines drape in the ruins of the rock wall. Beneath lies a stone platform, dotted with patches of moss.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_03: At its center sits a cluster of old clay pots coated in dusts. Their mouths are chipped, edges uneven.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_04: "Coins please. Give me some coins." One of them seems to whisper.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_05: You lean closer, your head above its mouth. Inside, you find half a pot of water.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_06: The refection a vague yet familiar slowly emerge on the water's surface.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_07: [Try Your Luck] Can you help me find someone?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_08: [The Final Word] Take the money in the pot.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_09: Small as it is, it can still pass as a wishing well.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_10: It's time to try your luck. Will these coins lead you to the one you want to meet?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_11: You reach in and take all the coins.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_12: When you step away, the pot crumbles a bit more. Is it your imagination?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_13: The water still reflects the image of a vague yet familiar figure, watching, waiting.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_14: [Try Your Luck] Can you help me find another one?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_15: [The Final Word] Take the money in the pot.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_16: You decide to push your luck. This time, will these coins lead you to the one you want to meet?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_17: You reach in and take all the coins.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_18: When you step away, the pot crumbles a bit more. Is it your imagination?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_19: The water still reflects the image of that vague yet familiar figure, watching, waiting.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_20: [Try Your Luck] Can you help me find someone for the last time?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_21: [The Final Word] Take the money in the pot.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_22: You try one more time. Will Lady Luck strike you one last time?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_23: This time, the pot doesn't hold. As the coins fall, a deep, splintering crack runs through the wall. The water spills, all over the ground. It answers your wish. The very last time.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_24: You reach in and take all the coins.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600261_25: When you step away, the pot crumbles a bit more. Is it your imagination?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_01: Suddenly, you find yourself standing next to a crumbled wall.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_02: Unfamiliar vines drape in the ruins of the rock wall. Beneath lies a stone platform, dotted with patches of moss.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_03: At its center sits a cluster of old clay pots coated in dusts. Their mouths are chipped, edges uneven.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_04: Something about this place feels familiar.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_05: You lean closer, your head above its mouth. Inside, you find half a pot of water.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_06: The refection a vague yet familiar slowly emerge on the water's surface.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_07: [Try Your Luck] Can you help me find someone?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_08: [The Final Word] Take the money in the pot.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_09: "You took away something that doesn't belong to you earlier." One of them seems to whisper.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_10: Before you can drop some coins, the reflection ripples and stirs into a full form and climbs out. It's clearly not a friend, but a formidable foe.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_11: Oh, you must fight. You realize. And that you must be the winner to find your companion.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_12: You reach in but find nothing.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600271_13: Seems like you had taken all the coins last time.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600281_01: You're drawn to a flash of light.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600281_02: You step closer. It's a cave, faintly glowing.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600281_03: Common sense kicks in. Minerals like these? They sell.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600281_04: [Save the Drama] Dig out a batch of minerals.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600281_05: [Fleeting Fancy] Dig out stones you don't recognize.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600281_06: You take the minerals and find a trader. The owner offers you a fair price.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600281_07: You take the minerals and find a trader. The owner's gaze lingers on them. You cannot tell what that look means.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_02: You step closer. It emits faint glimmers, abyssal light.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_03: Common sense whispers. This goes deeper than you can fathom.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_04: [Save the Drama] Dig out a batch of minerals.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_05: [Fleeting Fancy] What lies deep in the cave?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_06: You take the minerals and find a trader. The owner offers you a fair price.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_07: The cave is murky. What's worse, jagged rocks wait in silence.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_08: You move forward with great caution but still the sharp edges of the stone bites.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_09: After walking for a while, you hear an echo coming from the depths.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_10: You stop and listen attentively. Someone's calling for help.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600291_11: Following the call, you proceed further and rescue the one who's been trapped.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_01: You find yourself in pitch dark. Leaves rustle as wind slithers through. You realize you're in a forest.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_02: You heard a story. A long time ago. A story of a forest where moonlight never reaches, where night falls like an abyss...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_03:
You feel your way through in the darkness. With no light, your eyes fail you. Your world is now sound and touch.
The crunch of grass underfoot. The brittle snap of fallen leaves. The rustle of your shoes against pebbles.
Your fingers graze rough tree bark, the jagged edge of a rock, the curve of something. Withered vines, perhaps? Or the ossified remains of a wild beast?
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_04:
You don't know how long it has passed, but suddenly you feel the ambient sounds become distant. You feel you are now in a clearing.
You inch your way towards the edge, until your fingers brush against something different.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_05: Your finger is stung by metallic cold. It's a button.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_07: [Save the Drama] Safety first. Leave this place.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_08: You hear some static from above. The noise of turning lights on. The next moment, you're circled by several warm, gentle light beams.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_09: In this forest where moonlight cannot pierce through, someone has left you *moons*.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_10: The tender light from the "moons" allows you to take a good rest. Eventually, you leave the forest behind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_11: But even long after you've gone, a thought lingers. Who could have prepared all this for you? You may never know, but you're thankful for their care and effort.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_12: Your instincts warn you not to touch what you don't understand.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_13: You proceed towards another direction, fumbling through the darkness. Eventually, you leave the forest behind. Safely.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_14: But even long after you've gone, a thought lingers. Maybe you can do something for the unfortunate travelers who wander these woods.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_16: The next day, you return to the forest with new "moons" you purchased. Now, you stand on the clearing again. The metal button is here too. This place seems to have been a facility long ago, now abandoned and forgotten.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_17: But that no longer matters. You hang these "moons" up on a giant tree, connecting their switches to the button.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600301_18: Once everything is in place, you take a good rest in this clearing. From now on, these "moons" will serve as the true moonlight, bathing the forest in their glow. You quietly make a wish to yourself.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600311_01: You find yourself in pitch dark. Leaves rustle as wind slithers through. You realize you're in a forest.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600311_02: You heard a story. A long time ago. A story of a forest where moonlight never reaches, where night falls like an abyss...
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600311_03: But you know, the story no longer holds true. You changed this forest. Forever.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600311_04: Guided by your memory, you reach a clearing in the forest and find a metal button at the edge of it. You press it hard. Without hesitation.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600311_05: The "moons" you hung shine warmly on the forest.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600311_06: You are well-rested in the clearing.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_01: You feel your steps become feather light. Too light. Each stride carries you much farther than it should. The sands kicked up by your movement slowly float upward and halt in the air. Something is wrong with the gravity here.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_02: You see a block of ashen ruins. A catastrophe frozen at the moment when the titan's heavy stomp struck. The ground has split into thousands of fractures. The rocks crumbled by great form crystallize into jagged rings. Splintered debris hangs suspended mid-air.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_03: You carefully examine the surrounding, but suddenly, a thunderous swoosh cuts through the air above.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_04: You look up. A massive, black rock is hurtling straight at you—
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_05: [Save the Drama] Dodge to the left.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_06: [The Final Word] Smash it with your sword.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_07: You swiftly sidestepped to the left, avoiding the giant rock.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_08: It slams to the ground with a deep, shuddering boom. Then cracks follow. Fissures across its surface, and fragments burst out.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_09: But that's not the only sound. All around you, stones are falling apart.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_10: You look around. Several dark figures emerge from the corners. Their twisted faces bear one thing in common. A pair of thirsty, hungry eyes. Apparently, the loud noise catches their attention.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_12: You lower your stance, grip tightening, and... *strike*!
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_13: The moment your blade meets the rock, it shatters into dozens of serrated shards. *Boom*. A detonation of debris.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_14: The resounding bellows of bombardment engulf your ears. The monsters trying to ambush you are now blown to pieces. Falling, one after one.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_15: The ambush turned on its head.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_16: You slowly lift your gaze, fixating it on the culprit. The one who standing high above, the one who hurled that massive rock.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600321_17: One thing is certain: this fight is ending soon.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_01: You feel your steps become feather light. Too light. Each stride carries you much farther than it should. The sands kicked up by your movement slowly float upward and halt in the air. Something is wrong with the gravity here.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_02: You see a block of ashen ruins. A catastrophe frozen at the moment when the titan's heavy stomp struck. The ground has split into thousands of fractures. The rocks crumbled by great form crystallize into jagged rings. Splintered debris hangs suspended mid-air.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_03: You carefully examine the surrounding, but suddenly, you slip.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_04: The ground suddenly crumbles in. A bottomless pit gapped open. And you, are about to fall straight into it.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_05: [Fleeting Fancy] Let's see where it leads.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_06: [The Final Word] Leap for the edge.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_07: You plunge into the pit. Weightless. Consumed by the dark. The only sound is the rush of air bawling past your ears.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_08: Ten seconds. One minute. Five minutes. An hour... You can see nothing. You can hear nothing but the howling wind.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_10: An endless fall. You're a snowflake, lone, floating forever in the vast universe. And then... you simply fall asleep.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_12: You open your eyes, and it feels... different. The whole world is different. No deep pit. No weightlessness. No ruins. Now you see and hear, but you don't know where you are.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_13: At the final moment, just before the ground collapses completely, you push off. A desperate leap.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_14: You hit the edge, barely. Behind you, some stones, kicked by your heel, tumble into the pit. You hear them falling, but the sound of them hitting the ground never comes.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600331_15: You exhale. A long, slow breath. You're safe now.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_01: "To my surprise, the visitor's still lingering in the 'story'..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_02: "You didn't let the story reach its end. Refused to follow classic, tight arc of a commercial production. Instead, you stay here, shooting some meaningless footage with the remaining film. Oh, how unbelievable."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_03: "Look at you. Weapon in hand, eyes sharp as lightning... Have you fallen into the same dilemma as her?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_04: [The Final Word] I want fiercer battles.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_05: [Fleeting Fancy] I'm used to this feeling.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_06: [Save the Drama] I'm just looking around.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_07: "No matter how small the screen becomes, some people are destined to be the protagonists."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_08: "Indeed. Immersing yourself in the world of filmography allows you to momentarily escape reality. It's a refuge. While the film plays, you are yours alone."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600341_09: "Indeed. Filming feels like breaking free from the prison of your soul. But in the end, you only end up creating a larger one."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600351_01: "To my surprise, the visitor's still lingering in the 'story'..."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600351_02: "You didn't let the story reach its end. Refused to follow classic, tight arc of a commercial production. Instead, you stay here, recording people and moments around you with the remaining film. Oh, how unbelievable."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600351_03: "Who are you waiting for? Have you fallen into the same dilemma as her?"
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600351_06: [The Final Word] I'm waiting for someone special.
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600351_07: "A reliable old acquaintance. You make a good team. You're connected."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600351_08: "A reliable old acquaintance. You make a good team. You're connected."
RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_600351_09: "A delightful encounter? A long-anticipated reunion? But will they be the one you want to meet the most?"

HelpText_260_Content:
[Resonator Stats]
In Dreaming Deep, stats for the Resonators' Resonance Chain, Weapon, and Skill will be the same as in the Overworld.

[Resonator Level]
Every level gained by the team increases Resonator level by 1.

[Weapon Level]
Every level gained by the team increases Weapon level by 1.

[Skill Level]
Team Level 1 = Skill Level 1
Team Level 40 = Skill Level 3
Team Level 60 = Skill Level 6
Team Level 80 = Skill Level 9
Team Level 90 = Skill Level 10
HelpText_262_Content:
1) Completing a Battle Event, Random Event, or Story Event inside a Film consumes Film Rolls.
2) If you're defeated in battle, consume Film Rolls to return to a pre-battle state.
3) The number of Film Rolls you have determines the effects you gain:
More than 70 Film Rolls: Crit. Rate is increased by 20%. Casting Resonance Skill recovers 20% of Max HP, effective once every 30s.
30 to 70 Film Rolls: Casting Resonance Skill recovers 20% of Max HP, effective once every 30s.
-70 to -30 Film Rolls: Enemy ATK is increased by 20%
Less than -70 Film Rolls: Enemy ATK is increased by 40% and HP is increased by 30%.

RogueRes_MapRule:
About Map Exploration
 
[Events]
There are various types of events on the map, each with the following effects:
Story Event: A mandatory event required to progress, including the main story and final challenge.
Battle Event: Engage in battle and earn Dream Fragments based on the battle's difficulty.
Random Event: Trigger different outcomes.
Recruitment Event: Spend Dream Fragments to recruit Resonators.
Respite Event: Restore Film Rolls.
 
[Film Roll]
Film Rolls are consumed by Battle Events, Random Events, and Story Events.
If you are defeated in a battle, use Film Rolls to restore your Resonators to their pre-battle state.
 
[Bond]
Bonds can be formed between certain Resonators, and a Resonator can hold multiple Bonds.
Bonds provide combat buffs that apply to all Resonators unless specified otherwise.
Bond Level is based on the Star Ratings of all Resonators sharing the same Bond.
Increase the Bond Level to unlock its unique Synergy Burst.

[Synergy Burst]
When three Resonators with the same Bond are in the team, their Synergy Burst is triggered, providing the following effects:
1. Targets are immediately immobilized.
2. Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation Cooldown are reset. Resonance Energy is recovered and 100 Concerto Energy is restored.

<color=Highlight>[Burst Bubble]</color>: Burst Bubbles track Resonators and detonate after a short delay, dealing damage to herself (<color=Highlight>2% of her Max HP</color>) or Resonators and other enemies (<color=Highlight>10% of their Max HP</color>).

<color=Highlight>[Healing Bubble]</color>: Healing Bubbles track Queen of the Night and restore herself (<color=Highlight>2% of her Max HP</color>) or Resonators and other enemies (<color=Highlight>10% of their Max HP</color>).

The creeping malevolence gnaws at the Queen of the Night, driving her to flood the Sea of Clouds with chaotic tides. Yet, as a being enlightened by the Sentinel and entrusted with purging corrupt frequencies, a sliver of sanity may remain in her to help you end this calamity.
BabelTowerLevel_2_LeveLDes:
Reconstructed arena for Fleurdelys!

<color=Highlight>[Shielded Crown]</color>: When Fleurdelys's HP drops below <color=Highlight>20%</color> for the first time, she gains a <color=Highlight>Shield equal to 50% of her Max HP</color>.

<color=Highlight>[Realm]</color>: Fleurdelys's arena is always shifting. Resonators gain corresponding buffs when staying in different zones. While in <color=Highlight>Realm of Spear</color> in the center of the arena, Resonators <color=Highlight>deal 30% more DMG to shielded enemies</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Realm of Shield</color> that covers the entire arena, Resonators <color=Highlight>gain a Shield equal to 10% of their Max HP every 5s</color>, which is unstackable. While in moving <color=Highlight>Realm of Resonance</color>, all Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>restore 10 points of their Resonance Energy each second</color>.

The two opposing forces, the Sentinel and Threnodian, had etched their unique frequencies deep into Avinoleum's very essence. Here, unpredictable anomalies occur and fade without warning. Stay sharp in the constantly changing environment and brace yourself for the relentless storms of echoing blades.
BabelTowerLevel_3_LeveLDes:
Aid from the packs for Feilian Beringal!

<color=Highlight>Wolf Blood</color>: Feilian Beringal summons a <color=Highlight>Havoc Dreadmane</color> to help the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>95%</color>, allowing Feilian Beringal to restore <color=Highlight>1% of its Max HP</color> each time it deals damage.

<color=Highlight>Bear Will</color>: Feilian Beringal summons a <color=Highlight>Spearback</color> to help the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>75%</color>. Spearback sacrifices its own Vibration Strength to restore <color=Highlight>5% of Feilian Beringal's Max Vibration Strength</color> each second.

<color=Highlight>Ape Spirit</color>: Feilian Beringal summons a <color=Highlight>Hoochief Menace</color> to help the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>55%</color>. Hoochief Menace sacrifices its HP to restore <color=Highlight>0.2% of Feilian Beringal's Max HP</color> each second.

<color=Highlight>Group Aid</color>: Feilian Beringal summons <color=Highlight>Havoc Dreadmane and Spearback</color> again to help the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>30%</color>. They provide corresponding buffs to Feilian Beringal.

With the other Tacet Discords fueling its rage, Feilian Beringal has unleashed a violent storm of frequencies, pushing its horde toward Ragunna in a relentless expansion. To end this onslaught, you must cut the beast's ties to its allies!
BabelTowerLevel_4_LeveLDes:
Fallacy of No Return now uses data to summon Tacet Discords!
 
<color=Highlight>Lampylumen Myriad</color>: Fallacy of No Return summons a Lampylumen Myriad the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>95%</color> and gains a 
<color=Highlight>Shield equal to 80% of its own Max HP</color>. Defeating Lampylumen Myriad <color=Highlight>removes the Shield</color> on Fallacy of No Return and <color=Highlight>restores all Resonance Energy</color> for Resonators. Lampylumen Myriad's Glacio RES is reduced.

<color=Highlight>Inferno Rider</color>: Fallacy of No Return summons an Inferno Rider the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>65%</color> and gains a 
<color=Highlight>Shield equal to 80% of its own Max HP</color>. Defeating Inferno Rider <color=Highlight>removes the Shield</color> on Fallacy of No Return and <color=Highlight>restores all Resonance Energy</color> for Resonators. Inferno Rider's Fusion RES is reduced.

<color=Highlight>Impermanence Heron</color>: Fallacy of No Return summons an Impermanence Heron the first time its HP drops below <color=Highlight>35%</color> and gains a <color=Highlight>Shield equal to 80% of its own Max HP</color>. Defeating Impermanence Heron <color=Highlight>removes the Shield</color> on Fallacy of No Return and <color=Highlight>restores all Resonance Energy</color> for Resonators. Impermanence Heron's Havoc RES is reduced.

The error codes in the Stellar Matrices have compromised the Tethys System's defenses during the data breach. Using Fallacy of No Return as the framework, they've spawned Overlord-Class Tacet Discords for self-protection. To end this crisis, these data-forged Tacet Discords must be destroyed.
EpithetDesc_Babel_2: The Tethys System's Virtual Crises defy all reason, but you vanquished your limits in response. Now, you stand as a living beacon against the possible calamities, lighting the way forward.

Findbug_Desc_1: A certain business tycoon, whose name must not be mentioned, controls this street from the shadows. His sales campaign was aimed at winning hearts with some delicious deals. But for whatever reason, clearly things didn't go as planned.
Findbug_Desc_2: A famed hot spring resort in the Second Coming of Solaris, known for its eternal snow and familiar mountain peaks… Still, visitors always manage to discover something novel.
Findbug_Desc_3: The Second Coming of Solaris lore mentions a highly secretive research group, which the designers attempted to recreate their base in-game. Unfortunately, it's so well-hidden that no one really knows what it should look like.
Findbug_Desc_4: This restaurant draws diners from all across the Second Coming of Solaris, thanks in part to its oven Echo, which is said to hold temperatures capable of melting steel in its belly. Some say keeping it here is a waste, that it should be forging weapons, not crisping up pizzas.
Findbug_Desc_5: Every angler dreams of landing the biggest catch. No one wants to slink home with an empty bucket while everyone's watching. The abundant fish here has brought steady profits to the nearby seafood market and earned the dock its famous name: Big Haul Dock.
Findbug_Desc_6: Nothing can shake the cheerful spirit of the Fountain Square folks. They sing, dance, and celebrate all day, completely unbothered by the strange happenings around them.
Findbug_Desc_7: As its name suggest, all's well at A-okay Harbor. Everything's normal. Really.

FindBug_2_Title_7: Duel Atop the City of Mechanisms
FindBug_2_Desc_1: Some say the celebration in this villa ended long ago. Yet most insist that as long as one final guest remains, the party will go on forever. And fortunately, it seems an endless stream of new guests is about to pour in.
FindBug_2_Desc_2: A few years into their careers, every graduate eventually develops wild fantasies and rose-tinted memories of their school days. Here, every beautiful daydream they've ever had comes true... Well, almost. In truth, it's probably a little more realistic than anyone would have expected.
FindBug_2_Desc_3: On the bright side, the Academy has never been short of brilliant minds bursting with wild imagination. On the downside, they seem to have found a way to make those fantasies real.
FindBug_2_Desc_4: Every student dreams of stepping onto the stage and showing the world who they are. Such passion has even drawn the attention of the animals wandering nearby—wait, how did these adorable little creatures get inside in the first place?
FindBug_2_Desc_5: They say a creature of foul temper lurks deep within the forest, devouring anything that strays into its territory—animal, Soliskin, Exoswarm, or human alike. Even though no one has ever actually seen it, everyone swears they know someone who was eaten by it.
FindBug_2_Desc_6: No one knows why a scene modeled after the Land of Xuanfang appeared deep within The Second Coming of Solaris's data. Perhaps it was mere coincidence, a temporary collection of placeholder assets? One thing, at least, is certain: this scene will never make it into the game.
FindBug_2_Desc_7: Legend tells of two martial masters who agreed to duel on a stormy night. As torrential rain poured from the heavens, one master stood atop the city, waiting for an opponent who never came. Believing his rival had fled without a fight, he raised his sword and declared himself the greatest under heaven. After centuries of embellishment and hearsay, this unfortunate accident became the legend it is today: a celestial being calling down divine thunder to strike a great demon.

HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_FeatureDes: Though all Namipons have a passion for food, this one's appetite is… on a whole other level. Maybe that's its special trait... maybe.
A white-collar worker in a tailored suit and sunglasses, looking like a real elite.
Wild and unpredictable, this Namipon's hooked on rap, though it's terrible at it, and tends to vanish without warning.
A total office slacker, always laid-back, as if every day were a holiday.
A hardcore kaidan fan. Wherever a kaidan pops up in the city, it'll definitely be there.
A traveler with a sunhat, always off exploring, once even tried to submit travel journals to the Pioneer Association.
A timid high schooler, but precisely because it's a student, it feels like it could do anything.
A former yakuza leader with countless legends to its name—righteous, dignified, and intimidating.
A Namipon drawn to the water's edge... Wait, it's a mermaid? Seriously?
A Namipon who lives for trips. If it's not at a tourist spot, it's must be on the road to the next one.
Always in formal wear, this Namipon is currently between jobs, not exactly by choice.
A Namipon who's deep in ninja training, said to be able to hide its presence with just a leaf on its head.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_1: Each missing Namipon reflects a different side of the original. This one, for example, dreamed of being a bank clerk. A kind citizen told me it once showed up at a fork in the road in the <color=#d08c0f>Sakura Quarter</color>. You might want to check there.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_2: I never really got this Namipon's way of speaking. Last I saw, it was wandering <color=#d08c0f>in a residential park near Sakura Quarter</color>. Oh, and those ad banners by the store... Wait, why aren't they in the same style?
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_3: If I remember right, this Namipon loves a good view with pastries. And around here, the best view has to be where <color=#d08c0f>sakura petals drift across the water</color>. You'll probably find it there.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_4: Honestly, this Namipon might be the bravest of the lot… though of course I'm still better. Last sighting was in the <color=#d08c0f>Meishin Passageway</color>, where most of Honami's urban legends are set.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_5: This one works in Honami's <color=#d08c0f>Commercial District</color>, serrated with office buildings and malls. But in that concrete jungle, there's a <color=#d08c0f>giant cherry blossom tree</color> so tall its branches cover the sky... I wonder how it got that big.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_6: As a pro detective, I can say with certainty this Namipon is hiding in the <color=#d08c0f>Meishin Passageway</color>—the stage of countless urban legends. It also loves to leave riddles that only it finds challenging. If you spot any <color=#d08c0f>odd objects around</color>, that's probably its work.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_7: One of my fellow capybaras swears they saw it in <color=#d08c0f>the underground street</color>, being chased by a Tacet Discord. But they call it the Student with Ultimate Luck, so it'll probably be fine... I guess.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_8: This one's drawn to water, so keep an eye on <color=#d08c0f>pools around here</color>. A capybara disguised as a mermaid should be... *relatively* easy to spot, right?
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_9: The Nami Clan once ruled the underground street. They say if you light a lamp in the dark, someone will come to your aid. If you're looking for the yakuza Namipon, try your luck at <color=#d08c0f>Seisen Garden</color>. It's deep in the underground street.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryMascot_ClueDesc_1: Not long ago, it left a note saying it went to the park for ninja training. After that, no word. But come to think of it, have you noticed the new Namipon statues under <color=#d08c0f>the wisteria tree in Central Park</color>? Could that be its doing?
This Namipon is the type to hit every single spot in the guidebook when visiting somewhere new. By now, it's probably already wandered to <color=#d08c0f>Central Park</color>.

Parks are often refuges for the downhearted. The Left Behind here say it's often seen alone in <color=#d08c0f>a pavilion</color>, staring blankly into the air. Ah, such is the melancholic world of an adult capybara.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryArea_Desc_1:
Once hailed as "Honami City's most beautiful living quarter," Sakura Quarter was a place where cherry blossoms framed the rows of residences in a picturesque harmony. Cross the blossom-shaped footbridge and walk a few blocks, and you would see the famous "Sakura Upon Water" spot, a favorite for young lovers. The housing prices here, however, were anything but beautiful.

In the past, the neighborhood was safe, uneventful, and almost free of ghost stories. But after the Lament, tales began to spread. Many speak of the "Mysterious Scissorswoman," a black-haired, red-eyed schoolgirl. At times, she leaps from rooftops, drifting down like a crow's feather. At others, she flashes across the streets, cutting through TDs with her giant scissors. Some say she came from Hell, others call her a hero of justice, while a few whisper that her figure in battle resembles the legendary miko herself.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryArea_Desc_2:
Even before the Lament, Meishin Passageway was already a fixture among Honami's urban legends. In the strictest sense, it refers to a passage connecting two parallel tunnels in the Commercial District, open only during certain times of the year. Many residents swore they heard strange noises, saw traffic cones gathering on their own, or felt a tap on the shoulder, only to turn and find no one.

Though the city hall insisted that it was just an old service passage from construction, this hardly deterred the thrill-seekers. Over the years, tales multiplied. Some claimed that ten minutes inside meant a full day outside. The best-known story came from a local radio interview. A man said the passageway had granted his wish by letting him see his long-departed family... His proof was a limited-edition Namipon plushie with a unique serial number, which was thought to be destroyed in a fire, but somehow appeared in the passageway.
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryArea_Desc_3:
Hanakage Underground Street was originally part of Honami's subway system, and was later repurposed into a cultural passage themed around contemporary art. Before the Lament, quarterly film festivals and exhibitions filled the streets with artworks from across Ashinohara. The gift shops sold unique souvenirs that could only be found in Honami.

Of all its events, the annual "Honami Urban Legend Exhibition" always drew the largest crowds. Submissions ranged from amateur films by students to pieces by renowned photographers of the Pioneer Association. One anonymous short film went almost unnoticed at the time of its debut, but years later, it resurfaced in public debate. Countless interpretations sprang up, as tales in the film began to manifest in reality, one by one: "The Migrating Fish Windsocks," "The Wish-Granting Passageway," and "The Midnight Ghost Bus."
HonamiStory_HonamiStoryArea_Desc_4:
Contrary to popular memory, the park around Neon Tower predates the tower itself. In fact, Neon Tower was sited here precisely because the park's open grounds would minimize radio interference. After the tower's completion, the original Honami City Park was expanded into Honami Central Park, a proud symbol of the city center. At the time, it also stood as the largest park in all of Ashinohara.

Its first urban legend came shortly after staff began hanging fish windsocks. One morning, they discovered that every windsock, once scattered across the park, had gathered above the innermost garden. Not long after, the Pioneer Association published a grainy, shocking video captured by a citizen staying late there one night: under the moonlight, many windsocks glided through the sky toward a single spot, as if they were alive...

AdvertisingEnemy_2810501_Desc:
Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

The Research Institute implanted the Exostrider's space-time error correction module runtime into Hyvatia's core, allowing Hyvatia to adjust the Exostrider's orbit and detect hidden spaceborne threats with high precision. Therefore, Hyvatia possesses sufficient computational power to predict the Reactor Drive's rotation.

Hyvatia's core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.
AdvertisingEnemy_2810502_Desc:
After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activities of Aleph-1. 

When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.
AdvertisingEnemy_2810503_SkillText: Summon Hyvatia to attack enemies, dealing Spectro DMG and granting All-Attribute DMG Bonus to the Intro Skill of the incoming Resonator.
AdvertisingEnemy_2810504_SkillText:
Transform into Reactor Husk to attack enemies, dealing Fusion DMG.

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in their main slot gains Energy Regen.
AdvertisingEnemy_2810505_FetterDesc_5: Casting Outro Skill increases the incoming Resonator's ATK and grants additional ATK increase based on their Tune Break Boost.
AdvertisingEnemy_2810506_FetterDesc_5: Healing an ally increases ATK for Resonators in the team based on the current Off-Tune Buildup Rate.
AdvertisingEnemy_2810507_FetterDesc_5: Dealing Basic Attack DMG increases Spectro DMG, stackable. With max stacks, casting Resonance Liberation increases Basic Attack DMG.
AdvertisingStory_2810201_SubTitle: Chapter III Act I "What Burns Beneath Frostlands"
AdvertisingStory_2810201_ContentText:
To reach Lahai-Roi in the midst of a Void Storm, you dive into the spatial tunnel, which pulls you into a strange dimension...

Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Void Storm...
AdvertisingStory_2810202_SubTitle: Chapter III Act II "Ode to the Second Sunrise"
AdvertisingStory_2810202_ContentText: With the Voidworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods....
AdvertisingRegion_2810301_ContentText: A warm, humid haven beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift, this region became the new Solaris pole, prompting the Roya to migrate below ground. Here, the Spacetrek Collective established Startorch Academy. Today, this borderless academic city has become a cradle for countless rising scholars.
AdvertisingRegion_2810302_ContentText: Officially Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, it stands as a borderless scientific community dedicated to the pure pursuit of knowledge. Its name reflects its ethos, "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Within this vast academic city, knowledge flows freely and cultures meet in harmony.
AdvertisingRegion_2810303_ContentText: A grand observational array established by Startorch Academy. Unlike the Cassettes, which record humanity, this system was built to record Lahai-Roi. It continuously tracks terrain shifts, ecological cycles, and celestial disturbances wrought by Void Storms and the Threnodian, like a giant eye observing the turning of the ages.
AdvertisingRegion_2810304_ContentText: A colossal lift linking Lahai-Roi to the Roya Frostlands, its structure resembling a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it plummets and ascends through the deep cavern, serving as one of Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.
AdvertisingRegion_2810305_ContentText: A sacred homeland of the Roya and the habitat of the Soliskin. Bathed in the radiance of the Reactor Drive, its towering trees reach hungrily toward the light, their deep, interwoven roots returning that energy to the earth.
AdvertisingRegion_2810306_ContentText: A vast waterfall often visited by Jetrays. When they leap in unison, their silver wings form a shimmering curtain, hence the name. They travel in flocks for mutual protection, and Roya herders are often seen being carried by their wings, crossing the skies together in serene harmony.
AdvertisingActivity_2810603_ThumbnailTex: Let's Head to Startorch Academy & Gifts of Freshers Week
AdvertisingActivity_2810603_SubTitle: Let's Head to Startorch Academy & Gifts of Freshers Week
AdvertisingActivity_2810601_ContentText: A strange land with new Ecoacoustics. Together, we step into the unknown.
AdvertisingActivity_2810602_ContentText:
The two moderators of "Everything Startorch" can't agree on their next feature. 

They want to produce a freshman guide to Lahai-Roi's iconic landscapes. But with the "Voidworm Rider" dominating the charts, could this trending topic be the key to making their feature explode?
AdvertisingActivity_2810603_ContentText:
Let's Head to Startorch Academy
After Version 3.0 goes live, log in to the game to claim Radiant Tide x10 and Crystal Solvent x10 from your in-game Mail.

Gifts of Freshers Week
After the event begins, log in to the game daily to claim your daily sign-in rewards.
AdvertisingActivity_2810604_ContentText: The new Rev It Up! Startorch Race Season is officially underway! Give it up for on-track thrills, roaring crowds, and enticing prizes! Hop on your beloved motorbike and sign up for the race now!
AdvertisingActivity_2810605_ContentText:
The Peaks of Prestige fan club at Startorch Academy is facing its greatest crisis since its inception. However, the threat does not come from beyond these walls, but from... the very teachers who claim to hold their students' best interests at heart.
Now, the fate of the fan club lies entirely in your hands. Seize victory, and shatter the shadow that looms ahead!
AdvertisingActivity_2810606_ContentText: In the Spacetrek Collective's database, invisible offenses and defenses occur every day. Locate the malice deep inside the matrix, and delete it.
AdvertisingActivity_2810607_ContentText:
KU-Raji of the Black Shores sends you a message: the Spacetrek Observatory has been demolished by a Void Storm. Despite its vital role in charting Lahai-Roi's terrain, ecology, and climate, its reconstruction has stalled…
Now it's the time to restore this frontier. Rebuild Lahai-Roi's route network and support the reconstruction of the Spacetrek Observatory!
AdvertisingSystem_2810701_ContentText:
As you explore Lahai-Roi, a new Expedition Motorbike Utility will be available

The expedition motorbike helps you move faster. Its functionalities improve through upgrades.

When on the expedition motorbike, use features such as acceleration, Boost, Drift, and Bounce Jump etc. While moving, a force field is deployed around the expedition motorbike, and the Resonator will be forced to dismount once the force field is down.

The motorbike is equipped with the Adaptive Hook module, which can be used to grab resources, Sonance Caskets, and other items over long distances.  

The motorbike is able to receive the Heart Radio Channel, allowing you to tune in and enjoy your favorite music while on the road.

Numerous Challenge Tracks can be found in Lahai-Roi for you to take on with the motorbike.
AdvertisingSystem_2810702_ContentText:
A new battle mechanic has been added when Resonators battle enemies: Off-Tune Mechanic.

Off-Tune and Mistune

Your Resonators' attacks build up enemies' Off-Tune Level. Once the enemy's Off-Tune Level reaches the limit, they enter the Mistune state.

During the enemy's Mistune state, your Resonators can unleash a powerful Tune Break, dealing additional damage. Landing a Tune Break resets the enemies' Off-Tune Level.
Within a period after being struck by Tune Break, the enemy's Off-Tune level cannot be built up again.

Tune Break

For powerful enemies, once their Off-Tune Level is full, Resonators must cast a Tune Break skill to deal Tune Break damage to enemies in the Mistune State.

Tune Break skills deal damage to enemies, reduce their Vibration Strength, interrupt their attack patterns, and reset their Off-Tune Level.
AdvertisingSystem_2810703_ContentText: WavesLine is a Terminal messaging app developed by the Pioneer Association. It is available for use by all inhabitants of Solaris.
AdvertisingSystem_2810704_ContentText:
The Databank's Max Level is increased to 30.

Optimized the Databank leveling system. After the Databank Levels up, in addition to existing Enhanced Absorptions for COST 4 (Overlord Class/ Calamity Class) Echoes, Enhanced Absorption attempts will also apply to COST 1 (Common Class) and COST 3 (Elite Class) Echoes.
Advertising_VersionText: For reference only. The final content will be released with Version {0}.
Advertising_EnemyTips: Only Calamity and Overlord Class enemies and Echoes are shown.
Amswarmup_A_1_1: I've got the whole story figured out, every detail.
Amswarmup_A_1_2: Too bad you kept quiet the whole time, I couldn't get your opinion. But next time we meet... hehe...
Amswarmup_A_1_3: No, forget it. No hard feelings, okay? Now c'mon, say cheese!
Amswarmup_A_2_3: I guess this is the burden I must carry. Chasing your goal... it always comes at a cost.
Amswarmup_A_2_4: The constant pressure and exhaustion of those days... I understand them now.
Amswarmup_A_2_5: But pursuing this path, I feel no pain, only joy.
Amswarmup_P_2_6: Sorry, I think you've got the wrong person.
Amswarmup_A_3_1: Whaaat? The last demo I dropped racked up over 999+ comments?!
Amswarmup_A_3_2: Can't believe people are still visiting that dusty old site...
Amswarmup_A_3_3: Does that mean I'm actually a musical genius? Hehe...
Amswarmup_A_3_5: I wonder if I'll ever get to finish that song.
Amswarmup_A_4_2: Second row, far left, sneaking snacks like no one's watching.
Amswarmup_A_4_3: Fourth row, dead center, nose deep in a comic book.
Amswarmup_A_4_4: Last row, by the window, zoned out for half the class already.
Amswarmup_A_4_5: ...Wait. What did the teacher just say?
Amswarmup_A_5_1: Today, I went deep into the Void Storm again... that dead-silent void.
Amswarmup_A_5_3: But now, every time I come here… those things I saw start flashing before my eyes again.
Amswarmup_A_5_4: I hope you never have to know what it's like.
Amswarmup_A_5_5: Even thinking about it... makes me sick.
Amswarmup_A_6_2: My power isn't there yet. But time's running out.
Amswarmup_A_6_3: Doesn’t matter anymore whether people see or hear me! I must become a true Resonator…
Amswarmup_A_6_4: Maybe I still need more Soliskin...
Amswarmup_P_6_6: Void Storm... Existence... Are you the one devoured by the Void Storm? Who are you, really?
Amswarmup_A_7_2: You wished that I live a happy life. Now I'm wishing the same for you!

RestoreFrequency_Desc_1:
In ancient times, the shift in magnetic poles centered Solaris's planetary axis on Lahai-Roi. Gradually, over the ages, the cavern beneath layers of ice became home to human settlement.

In this warm, humid underground haven, the "sun" the people speak of is something else entirely. Look upward. The ██ brings here constant, unyielding daylight. Yet one question lingers in the author's heart:
If one day the ██ were to fall dark, what would become of us?
RestoreFrequency_Desc_2:
It may not be the largest cafeteria in Solaris, but it is definitely the most advanced. Every meal follows rigorous safety standards, with scientifically tailored nutritional values, ready made for long-term storage in even the harshest environments.

Popular Comment [Deleted]: Safe, refined, storable… but it just doesn't taste good.
RestoreFrequency_Desc_3:
(Fragmentary Audio Log of a short conversation)

Male Voice: (excited, breathless)
Male Voice: This lift... It's colossal! A miracle in the architectural history of Solaris. 
Male Voice: It supports the cavern's dome, linking the Academy and the Research Institute, ferrying supplies nonstop from the frostlands…
Female Voice: Typical freshman. Ride it a few more times, and you'll get used to it.
RestoreFrequency_Desc_4:
...To adapt to the vast and complex terrain of the underground haven, a new type of all-terrain vehicle was developed.

Though officially designed for research expeditions, the user manual contains no explicit rule against taking it for a joyride beyond the grounds of Startorch Academy.
RestoreFrequency_Desc_5:
Long before the Spacetrek Collective was founded, the self-sufficient nomadic Roya people had already made their home in these vast caverns. The construction of both Startorch Academy and the Research Institute would not have been possible without their help.

Drawing upon mechanical remnants of the ██, the Roya forged a settlement unlike any other. Skilled in astronomy and chronology, they are said to guard an ancient mission—awaiting the day they might repair and awaken the slumbering ██.
RestoreFrequency_Desc_6: Do Clockatoos Dream of Electric Schedules? (Excerpt) ...The crown feathers of a Clockatoo form the hour and minute hands on a living "clock face." At fixed hours each day, it lets out a clear, piercing call. A light tap on its head will silence it. For this reason, most Roya use the Clockatoo as an "alarm-capable" timepiece and timer. Note: Bringing Clockatoos into the dormitory is strictly forbidden by the Academy.
RestoreFrequency_Desc_7:
In ancient times, It held up heaven and earth with a colossal sword; Its body nourished all life, and its blazing, deathless ██ drove back darkness from this world.

Now, upon the frozen land, it lies in silent slumber...

HelpText_422_Content:
[About]
After a rift appeared at the entrance of Honami Crossing, many "castaway" objects from Lahai-Roi have begun surfacing across Honami. They have been transformed by the Sonoro into things familiar to the Left Behind. Namipon seems to have a way to restore the original messages hidden within these objects… Soon, the distant scenery of Lahai-Roi will unfold before you.

[Event Rules]

BuildRoad_1_Des:
<color=#ddc992>This old-model Route Constructor can only be activated using the special materials obtained from "Fire It Up! Route Constructor!".</color>
The main road linking Startorch Academy and the Spacetrek Observatory. The now desolate, muddy path still bears the marks of the convoys that once struggled through here.
BuildRoad_2_Des: A cliffside road carved into the mountain. The Void Storm that ravaged the Observatory erased this route as well, leaving only the wind's scream where traffic once passed.
BuildRoad_3_Des: A cliffside road carved into the mountain. After the Void Storm destroyed the northern section, this stretch too fell into decay, its cracked surface now buried beneath sand and dirt.
BuildRoad_4_Des: Loose soil covers this broken roadway. Once a key link between the primary network and the cliffside roads, it is now all but impassable.
BuildRoad_5_Des: A level road tracing the lakeshore. Even its sweeping views cannot restore the vitality the pavement itself has lost.
BuildRoad_6_Des: A long highway stretching across southern Lahai-Roi, initially a natural path leading to Bjartr Woods. The Roya refer to it as Godhfavn, meaning "embrace of the divine."
BuildRoad_7_Des: A road connecting the Howling Tunnel to Startorch Academy. Damage has rendered its steep incline nearly impossible to traverse.
BuildRoad_8_Des: The winds roar through this massive natural tunnel, like the rumbling of the Exostrider's throat. The Roya call it Jotunhals, meaning "throat of the Exostrider."
BuildRoad_9_Des: A grand bay bridge linking Bjartr Woods and the Etching Plains. Several years ago, a tremor from Sundermere fractured its structure, and it eventually collapsed after seasons of erosion.
BuildRoad_10_Des: An underwater tunnel connecting Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. Deep under the seabed, the Exostrider's greatsword causes unusual tectonic shifts, frequently compromising the integrity of the tunnel's rushed and flawed design.
BuildObser_1_Des:
Advance… extend… the foundations of the Observatory…
("After the Void Storm, the foundations of the Spacetrek Observatory were heavily damaged. Fortunately, most of the energy conversion array built on top remained functional. So the team decided to retract the foundations to prevent further wear. Once resources were sufficient, we would extend them again and begin structural repairs," says Dhalifa!)
BuildObser_2_Des:
The Suspension Platform is the Observatory's primary support and control core. Restoring it calls for no small amount of resources and effort. Let's get through it together.
("The Suspension Platform we're rebuilding won't just support the main body of the Spacetrek Observatory, it will also become the primary workspace for the researchers. Its upper level will even feature an open plaza where people can relax and enjoy the view of the Etching Plains. I can't wait to see the platform after it's fully restored," says Dhalifa!)
BuildObser_3_Des: When the Spacetrek Observatory first began recording Lahai-Roi's ecology, climate, and landscapes, many researchers who had worked tirelessly for it broke into tears. It was our way of resisting the Void Storms that could erase even existence. And now, with your help, we stand only one step from rebuilding it. I hope you, too, will feel what we felt on that day! (So says Dhalifa!)
BuildObser_4_Des: Now that the Spacetrek Observatory is operating again, Lahai-Roi's long-shut eyes have reopened. BuildRoad_1_CompleteDes: The main road linking Startorch Academy and the Spacetrek Observatory. Students often pull over here to capture the colossal silhouette of the Observatory against the distant sky.
BuildRoad_2_CompleteDes: A cliffside road carved into the mountain. Researchers studying Lahai-Roi's terrain often marvel at the vast, arcing walls. When convoys pass through, echoes rise from the valley's depths as if answering their awe.
BuildRoad_3_CompleteDes: A cliffside road carved into the mountain, linking the Spacetrek Observatory with the broader southern Lahai-Roi. A waterfall shrouded in mist marks the road's end.
BuildRoad_4_CompleteDes: A key link between the primary network and the cliffside roads. When headlights cut through the sandy wind, travelers can't help but glance toward the distant sandstorm, catching glimpses of a giant shadow moving within.
BuildRoad_5_CompleteDes: A level waterside road offering a sweeping view. Under the Reactor's glow, the lake shimmers with flecks of light. As you pass, the reflected shoreline shifts and dances across the ripples.
BuildRoad_6_CompleteDes: A long highway stretching across southern Lahai-Roi. With the Solisylum's approval, the Spacetrek Collective expanded Godhfavn, turning it into a fully developed highway. Out of respect to the Roya, the original name was preserved and translated as Sol's Embrace.
BuildRoad_7_CompleteDes: A road connecting the Howling Tunnel to Startorch Academy. Compared to other roads near the Academy, the Starleap Ascent is of moderate length and has varying road conditions, making it one of the main sites for students' expedition motorbike tests.
BuildRoad_8_CompleteDes: After reinforcing the rock walls and paving the highway, the tunnel can now accommodate heavy transport, shortening the journey from Startorch Academy to southern Lahai-Roi. The winds that once echoed here are now said to carry a different meaning: they are the Exostrider's blessing for Roya students heading to the Academy.
BuildRoad_9_CompleteDes: A grand bay bridge linking Bjartr Woods to the Etching Plains and Startorch Academy. For Roya students bound for the Academy, the bridge is a gateway to a new life. With anticipation, anxiety, and excitement, they step onto it and begin their academic journey.
BuildRoad_10_CompleteDes: An underwater tunnel connecting Bjartr Woods to Sundermere. Rebuilt with a new blueprint, the tunnel now withstands the tectonic shifts caused by the Exostrider's greatsword. Beyond improved durability, its transparent structure offers travelers a stunning panoramic experience.

DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_101: Tea leaves fully fermented to develop a deep, robust aroma. Since its introduction to Rinascita, it has become a timeless classic.
DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_102: Tea infused with fresh mint. Chilly and wonderfully refreshing.
DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_103: A blended juice made from Sunflare Everlasting and several fruits. Balancing sweet and sour flavors, it is a traditional base for Nectarwine in Egla Town.
DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_104: A juice made from olives, offering a distinctive bittersweet flavor.
DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_105: Concentrated form of freshly ground coffee. Used as the base for many coffee drinks.
DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_106: A juice made from naturally bitter fruits. Known for its bitter flavor and long believed to offer health benefits when consumed regularly.
DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_107: A drink crafted entirely from plant ingredients. A specialty of Lahai-Roi, prized for both its rich flavor and nutritional value.
DRINKS_DrinkBase_Desc_108: A juice made from fresh lemons, delivering a sour and astringent taste.
DRINKS_DrinkBatching_Desc_101: Sliced Viscum Berries pickled in sugar, preserving their maximum crispiness. A favored add-in ingredient of a certain Wandering Knight.
DRINKS_DrinkBatching_Desc_102: A mix of various nuts, rich in nutrients. With bitter almonds and oaknuts included, they carry a subtle bitter note.
DRINKS_DrinkBatching_Desc_103: Small red berries, offering a balanced sweet-and-sour flavor.
DRINKS_DrinkBatching_Desc_104: Dried lemon peel with a hint of bitterness. Added in moderation, it enhances a drink's depth and smooth, bitter undertone.
DRINKS_DrinkBatching_Desc_105: Carefully dried berries that provide a naturally sweet-and-sour taste.
DRINKS_DrinkBatching_Desc_106: Traditional Huanglong solid drink in convenient cube form, with a sweet-and-sour flavor. Can be enjoyed in water after mixing, or used as an add-in for other drinks.
DRINKS_DrinkOrDescnt_Desc_101: Thinly sliced oranges, mostly used as a decorative fruit garnish in Rinascita.
DRINKS_DrinkOrDescnt_Desc_102: A fragrant grass originating from the New Federation, with a strong lemon aroma. Widely cultivated across Solaris.
DRINKS_DrinkOrDescnt_Desc_103: Common throughout Rinascita, Laurus leaves emit a distinctive scent and are essential in many local specialties.
DRINKS_DrinkOrDescnt_Desc_104: Choco-vanilla flavored marshmallows with a sweet taste, especially popular among children.
DRINKS_DrinkOrDescnt_Desc_105: Crunchy crushed vanilla cookies that can add texture and a richer flavor to drinks.
DRINKS_DrinkOrDescnt_Desc_106: A star-shaped fruit primarily used for decoration or candied treats. Despite its name, its flavor is mild and not suited for eating raw.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1001: A creative blend of black tea and iced tea. Two distinct tea leaves meet in a balanced harmony of aroma and mouthfeel.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1002: Black tea enriched with Sunflare Nectar, where gentle bitterness meets honeyed sweetness, much like a knight's path through trial and triumph.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1003: Black tea enriched with the savory depth of olives.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1004: A fusion of black tea and coffee, said to be a regional specialty in parts of Huanglong.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1005: Black tea blended with a generous amount of bitter melon juice. Intensely bitter, yet said to help maintain one's physique.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1006: A drink made by adding pure plant milk to black tea, offering a silky texture and a memorable, lasting impression.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1007: Black tea brightened with a splash of lemon juice, delivering a refreshing sweet-and-tart balance.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1008: Iced tea blended with Sunflare Nectar. Lighter than pure black tea, but still pleasantly sweet and sour.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1009: Iced tea blended with olive juice, refreshing and thirst-quenching. For a Gladiator, a glass of Olive Iced Tea is undoubtedly the perfect refresher after intense training.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1010: Coffee blended with specially processed iced tea, adding a cool freshness to its original richness.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1011: Iced tea blended with a generous amount of bitter melon juice. Intensely bitter, yet said to help maintain one's physique.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1012: A drink made by adding pure plant milk to iced tea, offering a silky texture and a memorable, lasting impression.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1013: Iced tea blended with lemon juice. The freshness of the tea and the tartness of the lemon complement each other perfectly.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1014: A fusion of Sunflare Nectar and olive juice, bringing together two of Rinascita's most beloved fruits.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1015: Espresso sweetened with Sunflare Nectar. Once controversial among Ragunnesi—like Pizza Tropicale—it is now a popular specialty favored by travelers.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1016: Sunflare Nectar blended with bitter melon juice. The nectar's sweetness neutralizes some of the melon's sharp bitterness.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1017: Plant milk lightly sweetened with Sunflare Nectar. Unlike dairy milk, it blends smoothly with fruit juices, making it ideal for fruit-based milk drinks.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1018: A mix of Sunflare Nectar and lemon juice, offering a lively sweet-and-sour flavor.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1019: Coffee blended with olive juice, adding a cool freshness to its original richness.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1020: Bitter melon juice blended with olive juice. It sounds very healthy, but not everyone can handle the taste of the mixture.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1021: Plant milk lightly blended with olive juice. Unlike dairy milk, it blends smoothly with fruit juices, making it ideal for fruit-based milk drinks.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1022: Olive juice blended with lemon juice, balancing rich olive aroma with lemon freshness.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1023: A creative blend of coffee and bitter melon juice. Overwhelmingly bitter, almost no other flavor can be tasted.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1024: Espresso blended with pure plant milk. The coniferous aroma of the plant milk and the rich fragrance of the coffee bring out the best in each other, as if dancing on the tip of the tongue.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1025: Espresso blended with lemon juice, offering a more refreshing taste than lemon juice or coffee alone.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1026: Plant milk blended with bitter melon juice. It has a scent that smells very healthy.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1027: Lemon juice blended with bitter melon juice. The sourness and bitterness offset each other, creating a surprisingly good taste.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1028: Plant milk blended with lemon juice. Tart notes brighten the milk's richness, partially making up for plant milk's inability to be used to make yogurt.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1029: Black tea brewed with double the leaves, delivering an intensified flavor.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1030: Iced tea brewed with double the leaves, crisp with a pronounced bitter edge.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1031: Concentrated Sunflare Nectar with a significantly heightened flavor.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1032: Concentrated olive juice with a significantly heightened flavor.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1033: Espresso pulled with double the grounds. Exceptionally strong and bitter.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1034: Concentrated bitter melon juice with significantly heightened bitterness.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1035: Concentrated plant milk with significantly heightened richness.
DRINKS_DrinkMix_Desc_1036: Concentrated lemon juice with significantly heightened sourness.
DRINKS_DrinkInvite_ActorPerferlike_Befor: As a Gladiator, Lupa likely prefers drinks that are refreshing and truly thirst-quenching.
For Cartethyia, a classic Ragunna drink would likely be more to her taste.
Mornye would likely appreciate a drink with a rich flavor that carries the unique character of Lahai-Roi.
DRINKS_DrinkInvite_ActorPerferlike_After: A chilled iced tea with a hint of olive juice is the perfect refresher for gladiators after a grueling training session. It's said the famous Heartpour of Septimont was inspired by this very blend.

Black tea infused with Sunflare Nectar always carries Cartethyia back to the afternoons of her childhood—the sunlit streets of Egla Town, and a gentle breeze that felt as though it might last forever.

Enriched with a generous pour of plant milk, the coffee's velvety richness lingers long after each sip, allowing Mornye's frayed nerves to finally relax. Reinvigorated, she returns to her research with reignited energy.

DIY_RegionDesc_Content_1: A spacious lobby filled with soothing greenery. It's the perfect place to unwind, whether you're taking a moment of rest on the plush sofas or enjoying a friendly card game with companions.
DIY_RegionDesc_Content_2: A wide selection of drinks and snacks is served here. Thanks to the tireless efforts of Lollo Logistics, ingredients from across Solaris all find their way here.
DIY_RegionDesc_Content_3: The items once displayed here have long since vanished into the passage of time. Perhaps your own collection could be used to fill these empty display cases once more.
DIY_RegionDesc_Content_4: A relaxing swimming pool awaits here. To immerse yourself here is to bathe in the frozen starlight of Sonoro, gathered here in one place.
DIY_RegionDesc_Content_5: From here, you can gaze out at the distant view of the Sonoro. Between the carefully trimmed hedges and lawns, the occasional chirping of birds and insects drifts through the air.
DIY_RegionDesc_Content_6: This place once housed a diverse film collection as well as Mr. Geisel's ride. Though those symbols of dreams and memories are no longer here, your own ride and the Startorch Academy's promotional video now stand in their place, giving form to new dreams and hopes.
DIY_RegionDesc_Content_7: This is Mr. Geisel's private study. Meticulously maintained by Cobb Copo, the room feels suspended in time—as if its owner has merely closed an unfinished book and stepped out for a moment.

DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_2: A lawn with an azure color that evokes the depths of the ocean.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_3: A lawn with an azure color that evokes the depths of the ocean.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_4: A lawn with an orchre color that evokes autumn days and the blazing sun of Septimont.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_5: A lawn with an orchre color that evokes autumn days and the blazing sun of Septimont.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_6: A lawn with an orchre color that evokes autumn days and the blazing sun of Septimont.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_7: A lawn with a verdant color that evokes vibrant spring and long summer days.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_8: A lawn with a verdant color that evokes vibrant spring and long summer days.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_9: A lawn with a verdant color that evokes vibrant spring and long summer days.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_10: A sleek screen of modern design. The Montelli Family has a deep affinity for this artistic movement and maintains an extensive collection of similar works within their Vault.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_11: A lavish, fully handcrafted screen composed of blue stained glass and draped in rich crimson fabric. Adorned with brass fittings, it reflects the Ragunnesi's belief that delicate handiwork is one of the ways to pay tribute to the Sentinel.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_12: An ancient piece from Cobb Copo's collection. This orrery simulates the movement of celestial bodies. Strangely, the planetary orbits it depicts do not align with the ones observed from Solaris.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_13: A plush pillow modeled after a Chirpuff, widely loved by the citizens of Jinzhou. These are released as a limited-edition commemorative item during the Riverside Games in Taoyuan Vale, Jinzhou.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_14: A plush pillow modeled after a Gulpuff, widely loved by the citizens of Jinzhou. These are released as a limited-edition commemorative item during the Riverside Games in Taoyuan Vale, Jinzhou.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_15: A plush pillow modeled after a Diggy Duggy. While the concept of "a pillow based on a plushie" may seem odd, it still offers you a warm and comforting embrace.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_16: Balloons commonly used during the Carnevale in Ragunna. Their iconic color scheme has earned them global popularity, making the "Carnevale Balloon" a worldwide name.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_17: Balloons named after Laureate Bardolino's anecdote—though in truth, they are merely Carnevale Balloons in a different color.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_18: ...Why is it here? From the Somnoire to Chronorift Metropolis... how many times have you encountered it already?
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_19: A floor clock used in Averardo Vault. According to an anonymous staff member, its real purpose is to justify docking the pay of late employees. They also swear that the closer it gets to closing time, the slower its hands seem to turn.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_20: A floor clock inspired by the grand vessels of Ragunna. The ammonoid ornament crowning its top is said to have been popular among ancient people on this land long before the founding of Rinascita.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_21: A floor clock inspired by the Luminous Calendula, a motif widely favored throughout Septimont.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_22: A common water purifier, designed as a standard device to ensure the safety of drinking water.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_23: A lamp in the signature Averardo Vault style, offering soft, glare-free illumination. Elegant yet understated, its design reflects the Vault's "customer-first" philosophy in every detail.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_24: A common lamp found in Ragunna. The tentacle-like arms supporting the candles are actually simple-form Echoes. Occasionally, they can be seen gently writhing.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_25: A common plucked string instrument from Rinascita. Boasting ancient origins, it remains a signature tool for wandering bards.
DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_26: A light-toned lute perfectly suited for cheerful melodies. It is widely used in impromptu street performances.
