InstanceDungeon_8724_DungeonDesc: Some researchers believe biomechs are capable of appreciating "art." Most, however, insist that it is nothing more than algorithmic hallucination.
InstanceDungeon_8725_DungeonDesc: Now, with the hard-won freedom on the line, the biomechs stand ready for a desperate battle.
InstanceDungeon_8726_DungeonDesc: No one knows why the biomechs targeted the research funds. Perhaps an early trading system has formed among them. Or perhaps it was simply an attempt to disrupt the project.
InstanceDungeon_8721_Tips:
Riot Blades
Lv. 0: <color=Highlight>Energy Regen</color> is increased by 50%. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: When dealing <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color> or dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, fire Riot Blades toward nearby enemies, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. CD: 4s.
Lv. 2: <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> Cooldown is reduced by 50%. Riot Blades last longer and can orbit for a short distance, its Cooldown is reduced by 2s.
Lv. 3: <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> DMG is Amplified by 200%. For every enemy hit by Riot Blades, restore 5 Resonance Energy.
InstanceDungeon_8722_Tips:
Mind Shock
Lv. 0: When <color=Highlight>in Mid-air</color>, Crit. DMG is increased by 100%. The effect is removed 2s after landing. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: When <color=Highlight>in Mid-air</color>, every 4 hits generate a Data Core, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
Lv. 2: Data Core generation is reduced to 2 hits. Each generation splits into 3 cores, increasing damage radius and causing enemies to take 60% Amplified damage.
Lv. 3: Data Core triggers Mind Shock, dealing additional damage.
InstanceDungeon_8723_Tips:
Impulse Tide
Lv. 0: Dealing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> or dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> grants 60% All-Attribute DMG Bonus. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: Dealing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> or dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, creates an Impulse Tide that pulls in nearby targets and deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. CD: 5s.
Lv. 2: Cooldown of Impulse Tide is reduced by 2s. Affected targets take 60% Amplified damage.
Lv. 3: Impulse Tide releases a shockwave, dealing additional damage.
InstanceDungeon_8724_Tips:
Hypnotic Chant
Lv. 0: All <color=Highlight>Negative Status</color> DMG is Amplified by 100%. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: Defeating a target affected by <color=Highlight>Negative Statuses</color> leaves behind a Ceaseless Chant, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> per second to nearby targets.
Lv. 2: Damage dealt to enemies affected by <color=Highlight>Negative Statuses</color> is Amplified by 100%. Defeating such enemies applies 1 stack of the same <color=Highlight>Negative Status</color> to nearby targets. Ceaseless Chant DMG is increased by 100%.
Lv. 3: Ceaseless Chant DMG is further increased. It explodes every 4s, dealing additional damage and increasing affected targets' <color=Highlight>Negative Status</color> stacks by 1.
InstanceDungeon_8725_Tips:
Piercing Claw
Lv. 0: Casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color> increases ATK by 35%, stacking up to 2 times. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: Casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color> launches 6 Piercing Claws that deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. This effect has a 3s Cooldown.
Lv. 2: <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color> Cooldown is reduced by 85%. Casting an Echo Skill Amplifies the DMG dealt by all Resonators in the team by 60% for 5s.
Lv. 3: Piercing Claws return after being launched, dealing additional damage.
InstanceDungeon_8726_Tips:
Budget Dilemma
Lv. 0: <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color> is increased by 300%. Cannot be downed during the challenge.
Lv. 1: When casting <color=Highlight>Tune Break</color>, fire Deadly Design toward nearby enemies, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Lv. 2: Casting <color=Highlight>Tune Break</color> increases <color=Highlight>Tune Break Boost</color> of all Resonators in the team by 200. Deadly Design can now stagnate enemies and leave behind 3 Budget Cages, dealing additional damage.
Lv. 3: Budget Cages deal additional damage when they expire.

HelpText_518_Content:
[About]
Around a Sonoro Sphere, you run across a troubled researcher, who seems to have an important job to do...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and unlock the Resonance Nexus of the Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands"

[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you will enter a special Sonoro Sphere to battle waves of enemies within a set time limit, with the aid of unique buffs.
2. You collect Coins by dealing damage to enemies, and lose Coins when taking damage.
3. Advance through enemy waves unlocks more special buffs to give you the support you need.
4. Clearing a wave grants bonus time. The Coins you have collected by the end of the countdown will be your Coins record of this stage.

Morale_32_LeveDesc_1: A proving ground prepared just for you—and the graveyard for the countless knights who came before. Legends say this very soil witnessed the fall of the Third Grand Commander. Now, once in a while, when the rain falls on its mechanical remains, an elegy for the valiant is sound.
Morale_32_LeveDesc_2: It was here that the Fifth Grand Commander led the knights in a final stand. Not against a tyrannical lord, but... a Void Storm capable of obliterating all life. They failed to overcome it... or did they?
Morale_32_LeveDesc_3: This is where it began, long before they were called the Knights of the Wild. Here, a group of Mechascouts with no way home drained their last sparks of energy to save a single child.
Morale_32_LeveDesc_4: This land may never have heard the noble knight tales that flutter through the windmills of Egla Town. Yet the stories born are no less worthy. Let them be remembered in the rustle of the grass and the sighing winds of the emerald plains.
Morale_32_LeveDesc_5: Machines are not born with names. Yet... if one walks through the world with the bearing of a knight, does it not deserve a name of its own? So a young man once took up his pen and inscribed their names. Astra, Caldheim, Petrahane, Airelas...
Morale_32_LeveDesc_6: Charge, my friend! Charge! Even if your hands hold no blade, you carry one within your heart. And who is to say that a machine cannot have a heart?
Morale_32_LeveDesc_7: The Eighteenth Grand Commander... takes the humble form of a trash can. Yet, no one ever dares toss a wrapper or a pit into its belly. Within that metallic shell lay praises written for the Knights of the Wild.
Morale_32_LeveDesc_8: They say the Seventeenth Grand Commander was a mere human who possessed no martial prowess to speak of. Yet before the Void Storm descended, it was he who guided the knights in a desperate, wandering flight, leading them from lands doomed to be cursed. But as for his fate...

The onboard storage compartments are designed to support long-term scientific expeditions.

HelpText_531_Content:
[About]

At this year's Club Show & Tell, Van Tassie of the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society proudly unveils his latest project: the "F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator." He claims this game will revolutionize the Academy's culinary experience by gathering the essential data.  As is par for the course, your name is on the playtest roster. Yet, something about the project's core design seems... slightly off from the outset.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during the Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.
(Notice: Complete "Gold Suspended in Shadows" to have a better gaming experience.)

[Rules]

1. How to Play

Access the event from the Mind Dive Arcade machine or the Event Page. Control your Resonator to move left and right to catch falling food and earn Gourmet Points.

2. Energy & Skills

Catch food to build Energy. Once your Energy bar is full, you can activate a powerful Resonator Skill.
Be careful—catching certain negative foods will drain your Energy and slow you down.

3. Clearing a Stage

Reach the target Gourmet Points to earn 1 Star to clear the stage. Quitting the game midway will finalize this stage based on the Gourmet Points earned.

4. Stage Unlocks

Stage 1 is available when the event begins. A new stage unlocks each following day, each featuring a new Resonator with unique skills.

5. Rewards

If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.

AdvertisingStory_3010201_SubTitle: Chapter III Act III "The Star That Voyages Far"
AdvertisingStory_3010201_ContentText: After a sudden assault by a mysterious mech, your frequency loss worsens. Aemeath appears once more to aid you. To find a solution to your frequency loss and help this digital ghost reclaim her "existence," you journey together to the Roya Frostlands, toward the frozen, bleak land where the Exostrider lies in slumber...
AdvertisingStory_3010202_ContentText: After returning from the Frostlands, you consult Luuk Herssen at the Academy infirmary regarding the Exostrider plan. The ever-smiling doctor reveals a sliver of the truth behind the Fractsidus. At the same time, a Fractsidus member abducts the Roya student who once traveled with you and retreats to a fallen space station on the Frostlands...
AdvertisingRegion_3010301_ContentText: Once a fjord roamed by the Roya nomads, this land has now become an expanse of ice that isolates Lahai-Roi from the outside world.
AdvertisingRegion_3010302_ContentText: Across ice and mist, the Shepherds lead the Exoswarm on their migration to the edge of the permafrost. There, ancient forests forced the ice upward into frozen waves. Beneath them, the Exostrider lies in slumber…
AdvertisingRegion_3010303_ContentText: When the Lament occurred, the great eye, through which humanity once observed both the universe and the earth, crashed here from the sky. Using the wreckage as a foothold, the ancient Roya resumed their survey of the Frostlands. Even today, researchers continue to study the remains that fell from the heavens.
AdvertisingRegion_3010304_ContentText: Towering over the Frostlands Surface, this is the region's highest peak. Royan myth claims that once its Reactor Drive is restored, the Exostrider will ascend this summit step by step, and from its pinnacle, launch back into the depths of space.
AdvertisingRegion_3010305_ContentText: A fjord forest of ancient times, sealed beneath permafrost. To study the prehistoric flora preserved within the ice, the Research Institute established the Upphaf Life Chamber nearby.
AdvertisingRegion_3010306_ContentText: A high-traffic coastal zone where the port and its transport arteries move personnel and supplies around the clock.
AdvertisingActivity_3010601_ContentText: Invited by Lumi, you attend a party hosted by Lollo Logistics, only to find yourself drawn into a never-ending festival. Join the revelry beneath a river of stars, and uncover the secrets hidden within their glow.
AdvertisingActivity_3010602_ContentText: The frostlands of Lahai-Roi beckon the curious. Many find their eyes fixed upon the endless white expanses. Truth seekers walk this polar region, one step at a time, chasing but echoes of truth in this land of snow where silence reigns. Now, join them in their exploration of the frostlands and go where no one has ever been before.
AdvertisingActivity_3010603_ContentText:
On the endless expanse of the frostlands, countless relics lie quietly dormant beneath the frozen ice. Here, truth seekers and those who revere nature come in search of the destination of their pilgrimage.
A maintenance worker from the Frostlands Polar Research Outpost prepares to embark on her first vacation in a decade. She hopes you will guide her across the Roya Frostlands, documenting the views of the pole along the way...
AdvertisingActivity_3010604_ContentText:
Kinova, a Biomatic Club inventor, loaded too much student data when training one of her inventions—the Heuristic Expedition Robotic Motorbike - Embedded Sentience, Mark II, or H.E.R.M.E.S. Due to the overwhelming influx of data, H.E.R.M.E.S went wild and refused to be ridden.
The project has since been shelved. In desperation, Kinova seeks the help of the legendary rider in the Academy, Rover the Voidworm Rider.
AdvertisingActivity_3010605_ContentText: A team of Royan herders has run into trouble while guiding their Exoswarm across the frostlands. Now, they need your help to track down the strays.
AdvertisingActivity_3010606_ContentText: Around a Sonoro Sphere, you run across a troubled researcher, who seems to have an important job to do...
AdvertisingActivity_3010607_ContentText:
In the world of academia, time is everything! Researchers are waiting on pins and needles for data that never seems to arrive. Who will step up and lend a hand? It's time for you and Maji to shine once again!
Help Maji devise a stable pipeline for the efficient transport of research materials.
AdvertisingActivity_3010608_ContentText: After the event begins, log in to the game daily to claim your daily sign-in rewards.
AdvertisingActivity_3010609_ContentText:
A sudden catastrophe trapped the lush vegetation beneath a thick layer of ice, but the people here, through their collective wisdom, constructed a range of research facilities to bring life back to this icy land...
However, low temperatures have caused damage and breakage to the lines that power the facilities.
You decide to do what you can to help repair these power lines, so that the research here can carry on uninterrupted.
AdvertisingIntelligence_3010501_ContentT:
Lahai-Roi feels both foreign and familiar.
Through the Academy, you walk in uniform, among the grand dreams of gifted minds. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.
AdvertisingIntelligence_3010502_ContentT: From 2026-02-17 to 2026-03-19, you can claim a total of 1600 Astrites, along with rewards such as an exclusive Avatar "Come On, Smile" via in-game mail.
AdvertisingIntelligence_3010503_ContentT: Complete Starpath Tasks to earn Journey Points. Reach Journey Point milestones to claim Starpath Gifts, including Lustrous Tide, Sigil "Concealed Starlight," Title "Law of Stars," Radiant Tide, and Premium Glider Aspect "Cosmic Spindle."
AdvertisingIntelligence_3010504_ContentT:
Voyaging Star Chassis Set
Includes the Voyaging Star Chassis, Motorbike Livery "Girl with Exostrider" (Left Fender, Right Fender, Front/Rear), and Astrites.

Lunar Causality
Includes Motorbike Livery "Lunar Causality" (Left Fender, Right Fender, Front/Rear), and Astrites.

Horizon Lookout
Includes Motorbike Livery "Horizon Lookout" (Left Fender, Right Fender, Front/Rear), and Astrites.
AdvertisingIntelligence_3010505_ContentT: The Weekly Subscription can only be purchased once. After purchase and activation within the specified period, it remains valid for 15 days. Log in on or after designated days during the validity period to obtain Lunites, Astrites, and Transducers.
AdvertisingIntelligence_3010506_ContentT: During the event, you can directly claim Lustrous Tide x1. Reach Moonlit Ring milestones to unlock the corresponding rewards.
AdvertisingEnemy_3010601_Desc: A wordless black mech, lost and longing to return home.
AdvertisingEnemy_3010602_Desc:
The station fell like a dying star, burying the dream of its era beneath ice and soil.
The Explorer was one of those who dreamed, who once walked among the stars.
But now he hides in the dark, corrupted by the Void.
Before reason and strength slipped entirely from his grasp, he sealed himself away in the cabin.
AdvertisingEnemy_3010603_SkillText:
Summon Sigillum to attack enemies, dealing Fusion DMG.
When equipped in the main slot by Aemeath, it grants Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus.
AdvertisingEnemy_3010604_SkillText:
Summon Nameless Explorer to attack enemies, dealing Aero DMG.
The Resonator with this Echo equipped in their main slot deals more Aero DMG and Echo Skill DMG.
AdvertisingEnemy_3010605_FetterDesc_5: Inflicting Fusion Burst or Tune Rupture - Shifting on enemies increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate and Fusion DMG.
AdvertisingEnemy_3010606_FetterDesc_5: Inflicting Fusion Burst grants Fusion DMG Bonus. During this time, using an Outro Skill grants Fusion DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator.
AdvertisingEnemy_3010607_FetterDesc_5: Dealing Echo Skill DMG increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate and grants Aero DMG Bonus.
AdvertisingSystem_3010701_ContentText: Venture deeper into the Roya Frostlands with the new Expedition Motorbike feature, "Glacier Track." Once unlocked, this upgrade allows you to ride directly over open water.
AdvertisingSystem_3010702_ContentText: The Expedition Motorbike now features an All-Terrain Tactics module. Switch your setup at will to match the terrain or the heat of battle.
AdvertisingSystem_3010703_ContentText:
Data Merge
Added support for merging into selected Sonata Sets.

Data Modify
Added batch modification for Echo Mainstats.

HelpText_539_Content:
[Event Duration]

2026-05-09 04:00 to 2026-05-25 03:59 (server time)

*From 2026-05-09 08:00 to 2026-05-23 19:30 (server time), you can support your favorite Cube every day. From 2026-05-23 20:30 to 2026-05-25 03:59 (server time), support will be closed. During this period, you can view race results, check the Patron Board, watch replays, and claim event rewards.

[About]

A new season of Cubie Derby is back for the 2nd Anniversary of the Second Coming of Solaris! Come watch the match and support your Cube!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 8.

[Rules]

1. During the event, 18 Cubes will take part in matches in 3 Groups. Not counting the Final, 1 match takes place per day with 14 matches in total to decide the Ultimate Race Winner.
2. The entire competition is comprised of 3 Stages: Preliminary, Eliminator, and the Final. Please refer to the event schedule for specific times and dates.
3. Between the end of the previous match till half an hour before the next match starts (20:30 server time), you can support your favorite Cube by predicting the Match Winner of the day.
4. The match of the day starts at 21:00 server time. From the event page, you can view the race live broadcast and cheer for your favorite Cube in the live chat.
5. After the match, you will obtain Popularity rewards based on the Cubes' final placements and the prediction outcomes.
6. The Patron Board will open at 04:00 server time on the day after the Preliminary B - 2nd, and thereafter be updated at 04:00 on the next day after each match. You can view your ranking on the Patron Board.
7. After the Final, a commemorative item will be sent out to all Rovers who unlocked this event. Please claim it in time before the event ends.
8. Any unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game Mail upon your next login within 30 days after the event ends.

After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activities of Aleph-1.

When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.

In the face of the vast unknown lands in Lahai-Roi, the Spacetrek Collective developed the multi-purpose Spacetrek Explorer to serve in transport, storage, and defense roles. Its wheeled legs and heavy-duty tires allow it to race along vertical surfaces, making it suitable for both urban and off-road terrain. The onboard storage compartments are designed to support long-term scientific expeditions.

Using New Federation technologies, they have fused a picture hat with the essence of a Tacet Discord, forging a chainsaw horror capable of rending steel and grinding prey to dust.
Yet, all transcendence comes at a price. Those who embraced this creation have become thralls to their own design, leaving behind nothing but hollow shells.

A powerful raptor-like Exoswarm, mimicking an ancient predator known as Kronaclaw.
In the distant past, these raptors once circled the skies of Lahai-Roi, their dominion unchallenged since the First Epoch.
Legend holds that the Kronaclaw was a creation of Sol, sharing the divine sight of the Eye of Sol and beholding all that lay above and below Lahai-Roi.
But as magnetic poles shifted and the landscape was reshaped, the Kronaclaw species had faded into near extinction. Their place was eventually taken by Kronablight, an Exoswarm born of the Exostrider.
Morale_32_FlagDescLv8_3_8:
This enemy periodically generates a sword array that can pull in and deal damage to nearby Resonators.

Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

The Research Institute implanted the Exostrider's space-time error correction module runtime into Hyvatia's core, allowing Hyvatia to adjust the Exostrider's orbit and detect hidden spaceborne threats with high precision. Therefore, Hyvatia possesses sufficient computational power to predict the Reactor Drive's rotation.

Hyvatia's core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.

Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_16: The dice is set to roll 3, 2, and 1 in succession.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_17: For each turn, there is a 60% chance to advance by a doubled number, but also a 20% chance to stay still.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_18: When this Cube reaches the course's midpoint, it teleports on top of the closest Cube (if that Cube is not Abbowser). This can be triggered only once per match.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_19: Triggering the Thruster pushes this Cube forward by 2 extra pads. Triggering the Blocker knocks this Cube back by 1 extra pad.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_20: Up to 2 Cubes right ahead of this Cube at the start of the turn advance 1 fewer pad this turn (the first roll at the start of the match only determines turn order). This effect does not freeze Cubes in place or make them go backwards.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_21: Encountering Abbowser Cube causes this Cube to advance by 1 extra pad each turn afterward.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_22: If the number rolled matches the previous roll, this Cube advances 2 extra pads.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_23: If this turn's roll is the lowest among all Cubes, this Cube advances 2 extra pads.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_24: When stacked at the bottom at the start of the turn, this Cube advances 3 extra pads.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_25: When at the top of a stack at the start of the turn, this Cube stays still this turn and becomes the last to move the next turn.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_26: When this Cube passes through the midpoint, teleport all non-Abbowser Cubes ahead and behind to its pad. The Cubes are stacked based on their previous positions. This effect can only be triggered once per match.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_29: A Cube that ends its move on this pad is propelled forward to the next pad.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_30: A Cube that ends its move on this pad will be sucked into a spatial rift, then fall down to this pad again, randomizing the stack order.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_31: A Cube that ends its move on this pad is knocked back to the previous pad.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_32: In the 3rd turn, Abbowser Cube starts moving from the finish line to the starting line. Abbowser Cube does not stack with other Cubes before it starts moving. Once it's moving, it is also affected by all mechanisms along the course. Abbowser Cube rolls from 1-6, always ends up at the bottom of the stack. If Abbowser is separated from all other Cubes at the end of each turn, it teleports back to the finish line.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillDes_33: In the 3rd turn, Abbowser Cube starts moving from the finish line to the starting line. Abbowser Cube does not stack with other Cubes before it starts moving. Once it's moving, it is also affected by all mechanisms along the course. Abbowser Cube rolls from 1-6, always ends up at the bottom of the stack. If Abbowser is separated from all other Cubes at the end of each turn, it teleports back to the finish line.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_16: The dice is set to roll in <color=Highlight>cycle of number</color>.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_17: For each turn, there is a chance to <color=Highlight>double</color> the number rolled or <color=Highlight>stay still</color>.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_18: Teleport on top of the closest Cube ahead.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_19: <color=Highlight>Advance or go backward further</color> when a mechanism is triggered.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_20: The two Cubes ahead advance <color=Highlight>1 fewer pad</color> this turn.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_21: When encountering Abbowser, <color=Highlight> advance an extra pad</color>.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_22: <color=Highlight>Advance 2 extra pads</color> when rolling the same number again.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_23: <color=Highlight>Advance 2 extra pads</color> when rolling the lowest number among others.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_24: <color=Highlight>Advance 3 extra pads</color> when stacked at the bottom.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_25: <color=Highlight>Skip the turn</color> and <color=Highlight>act last next round</color> when at the top of a stack.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_26: Teleport all other Cubes onto this Cube's pad.
Dango_SkillPage_SkillShortDes_31: Cubes are knocked back by 1 pad.

Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Linnai: Lynae appears completely unfazed. She's here to kick ass and chew bubblegum!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Linnai: "Easy peasy!" Lynae's flashing a victory sign at the camera. We're all looking forward to her next showing!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Linnai: Lynae claims that given her past training, these contestants don't stand a chance. When pressed for details, she suddenly developed selective hearing and changed the subject. How suspicious!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Linnai: Lynae is thrilled with her own performance and plans to go all out in the next match. She even mentioned something about a special surprise for the audience.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Linnai: Lynae has declared that if she wins the Final, she'll spray paint a giant portrait of herself on the course. So far, the event organizers have declined to comment on the matter.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Linnai: Congratulations to Lynae, our new Champion! In other news, event organizers quickly confiscated her spray paint right after she pulled out a can. A real pity, if you ask me.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Linnai: Lynae states that the results do not matter, and she's here to have a good time.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Linnai: Lynae is calling this a perfect finish! She's off to train now, aiming for back-to-back victories in the next Derby.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Moning: Mornye's initial concerns about her prosthetic legs proved unnecessary given her cube form. She's ready to compete as best as possible.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Moning: Mornye says she's quite used to hovering in the air. Her fondness for flight may well be the secret to her outstanding performance.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Moning: According to a few keen-eyed spectators, Mornye spent the entire night before the match de-stressing by calculating her odds of winning.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Moning: Mornye stated after the match that she really needed a triple-strength Instant Wakeup Energy Gel Sachet.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Moning: Mornye told us in an interview that despite not being particularly athletic, she's more than willing to demonstrate the might of the Spacetrek Collective techs.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Moning: Congratulations to Mornye for placing first in the competition! Mornye remarked that while this outcome didn't exactly match her calculations, life is always full of surprises.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Moning: Mornye stated that she will give it her absolute all in the final stretch of this competition.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Moning: Mornye expressed her joy at participating in this competition, noting that occasional outdoor exercise has increased her research efficiency.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Aimisi: Before the match begins, Aemeath sends her best to all Fleet Snowfluff fans, stating that she definitely won't let them down.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Aimisi: Aemeath thoroughly enjoyed the competition and has decided to put on a live show for the contestants and audience alike after the Final.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Aimisi: Aemeath credits her superhuman pace to her younger days spent chasing Snowfluff Seals.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Aimisi: Aemeath states that she is fully prepared for the next match. We can't wait to see her in action.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Aimisi: Aemeath hopes that her victory will make someone out there proud.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Aimisi: Inspired by her win, Aemeath is set to write a song about this competition. We can't wait to hear it!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Aimisi: Aemeath believes that a temporary setback is a minor inconvenience. She remains determined to prove her true strength in the Final.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Aimisi: What a brilliant performance! Let's give a big round of applause to Aemeath!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Luhesi: Luuk Herssen is in a remarkably calm and positive mindset before the match. He's stated that he simply intends to do his best.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Luhesi: Luuk Herssen demonstrated precise control during the match, which he attributes to the muscle memory developed from years of performing surgery.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Luhesi: Luuk Herssen has kindly offered medical aid and mental health support to those eliminated from the match. The event organizers extend their thanks for his generosity.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Luhesi: Luuk Herssen was not at all surprised by his win. But he does feel that he could have done even better.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Luhesi: Luuk Herssen says eating candy before a match is his secret to excellent performance.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Luhesi: Congratulations to Luuk Herssen on winning the Final! During his interview, he says he'll donate the prize money to children in need.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Luhesi: Luuk Herssen isn't disappointed with his result. He believes it was enough that he gave it his all.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Luhesi: Luuk Herssen is satisfied with his performance in the competition. He added that he'll likely be back for the next Derby.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Xigelika: Sigrika's parents sent her a good luck package before the match. To honor their expectations, she is determined to compete at her absolute best.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Xigelika: Sigrika is deeply grateful for everyone's support, and she has stated that she will achieve great results in the next match as well.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Xigelika: Sigrika states that she will redouble her efforts in the Eliminator. With the help of Soliskin, she's certain she'd win.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Xigelika: Sigrika says she finds this competition easy because she spends all day chasing Exoswarm.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Xigelika: Sigrika believes everyone who made it to the Final is incredibly strong, and that she's starting to feel the pressure...
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Xigelika: Congratulations to Sigrika on becoming the Champion! In her interview, Sigrika thanked her family and friends in the Roya tribe, her classmates and teachers at Startorch Academy, as well as the Soliskin and Exoswarm... Let's give a round of applause for her victory!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Xigelika: Sigrika states that while she thoroughly enjoyed the competition, it's now time to conclude her journey with a spectacular victory.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Xigelika: Sigrika competed brilliantly in the Final! She's promised to keep pushing forward and is aiming for another championship next time.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Feixue: Hiyuki declined our interview, stating that she would like to meditate in peace before the match.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Feixue: When asked about her plans after her win in the Preliminary, Hiyuki stated that she would like to rest and eat something, preferably with a cup of fine tea.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Feixue: In her interview, Hiyuki shared her daily sword practice routine. The event organizers kindly remind you: for safety reasons, please do not attempt these yourself.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Feixue: Hiyuki won the Eliminator with ease. It looks like she's still holding back. You don't want to miss what she'll bring to the next match.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Feixue: In her pre-Final interview, Hiyuki stated that she did not attempt to draw upon a future where she is victorious. She values the experience itself more than the outcome.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Feixue: Huge congratulations to Hiyuki for coming out on top! She's dedicated to perfecting her skills and aims to create more miracles in the years to come.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Feixue: Undeterred by her defeat, Hiyuki has decided to put everything on the line in the next match. Let's see what she can do!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Feixue: An excellent result for Hiyuki in the Showmatch. We look forward to her performance in future Championship matches.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Daniya: Denia doesn't think she has a chance of winning... She just wanted to do her best to make it to the finish line.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Daniya: Denia is somewhat surprised that she wasn't eliminated in the Preliminary, though she chalks it up to a bit of luck.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Daniya: We've heard from a reliable source that Denia is currently preparing for the match and is not in the locker room. Let's turn our cameras to the other contestants.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Daniya: Denia has delivered another outstanding performance! She rather modestly remarked that luck was on her side again. Perhaps she really is the "chosen one" of the course!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Daniya: Denia looks incredibly nervous at the starting line of the Final! Let's wait to see how the results unfold!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Daniya: Denia has claimed victory in the Final! In her acceptance speech, she thanked her friends at Startorch Academy, whose support made it possible for her to reach this far.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Daniya: Someone reported hearing things being smashed in Denia's locker room, but when we arrived, everything inside seemed to be fine. Maybe Denia got caught up in a video game.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Daniya: Denia was outstanding in the Showmatch! She remarked that next time, she'll show us her true abilities. Can't wait to see what she's really capable of!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Qianxiao: Chisa was reading a mystery novel an hour before the match, so the interview team decided not to bother her.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Qianxiao: When asked about her post-match plans, Chisa said she'd be going to the Spacetrek Archive to look up some research papers.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Qianxiao: Chisa cooked up a Lemon-Scented Sukiyaki in the locker room and shared her delicious meal with the other contestants.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Qianxiao: Chisa notes that she knows how to find her way through a labyrinth, citing her experience in Honami City. In her view, that was the key to her success today.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Qianxiao: Speaking after her victory, Chisa said she'd like to return to a certain cafe and hang a photo of her victory on the wall.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Qianxiao: Congratulations to Chisa on her victory! After thanking her fellow competitors, a mysterious capybara showed up with victory snacks for her.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Qianxiao: After reflecting on why things didn't go her way, Chisa reaffirmed her commitment to the competition. Win or lose, she won't let up on her prep work.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Qianxiao: After winning the Showmatch, Chisa said she had a wonderful time competing alongside everyone.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Fuluoluo: When interviewed, Phrolova would not reveal her reasons for participating in the Derby and declared that her actions in cube form are not representative of her real self.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Fuluoluo: Phrolova has emerged victorious! Unfortunately, she left immediately after the match, so we were unable to complete our post-match interview.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Fuluoluo: Phrolova may not be on the best of terms with the other contestants, so the event organizers provided her with a private locker room. Melodious strains of violin can always be heard emanating from within.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Fuluoluo: Phrolova remarked that defeating her "rivals" has brought her a fleeting sense of satisfaction. She hopes to lead a climactic movement for everyone during the next match.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Fuluoluo: Phrolova says the time is ripe to bring her grand performance to its dramatic conclusion!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Fuluoluo: Phrolova has been crowned Champion! There was a flash of delight on her face before she reverted to her expressionless demeanor as if nothing had ever happened.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Fuluoluo: Phrolova vows that she will not fail a second time. She is prepared to do anything to bring this final movement to its conclusion.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Fuluoluo: Phrolova expressed her satisfaction with her final performance and offered her deepest regards to the opponents she defeated.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Aogusita: Augusta is fully prepared for the match and will storm the field with the force of a thunderbolt!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Aogusita: Augusta secured an effortless victory. It seems the competition was merely a small hunt for someone of her stature.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Aogusita: Augusta believes there are no shortcuts to victory. The only way to win is through relentless training and endless fighting.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Aogusita: Augusta is the first across the finish line! Let's give a huge cheer for yet another victory!
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Aogusita: Augusta believes that future Agons should include elements of the Derby. It would keep certain gladiators from relying too much on Fortes and combat techniques while neglecting basic strength and endurance training.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Aogusita: Victory belongs to Augusta! She has nothing but high praise for the iron resolve and formidable strength shown by all participants. She looks forward to competing with them once more.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Aogusita: Augusta says that winning and losing are simply parts of the game. She is determined to turn the tide and secure a victory in the Showmatch.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Aogusita: Augusta feels she still has work to do and says she'll be back in the competition as soon as she's fully prepared.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1_Younuo: Iuno declared that she will charge at the finish line, moonlight in arms.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage1Win_Younuo: Iuno claims that winning is a breeze, and the result is obvious even without a prophecy.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2_Younuo: Iuno declined to be interviewed, saying she wanted to get a good night's sleep before the match.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage2Win_Younuo: Iuno is pleased with her showing. She noted that the Moonring's flight speed is still a bit on the slow side, else she would've finished even sooner.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3_Younuo: Sticking to hunting tradition, Iuono performed a small divination ritual before the match. She's not one to blindly follow fate, but it seems to have strengthened her belief in victory.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage3Win_Younuo: Congratulations to Juno on her championship victory! May her glory endure forever, as timeless as the moonlight.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Younuo: Iuno isn't quite pleased with her performance, but she's determined to see the competition through to the end.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Younuo: Iuno has won the Showmatch. She expressed her gratitude for the audience's support and promised to do better next time.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Jinxi: Jinhsi states that she would not try for a better result by using her Temporal Mandate to return to the start of a match. She believes that every outcome is both precious and significant.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Jinxi: Jinhsi excelled in the Showmatch. She remarked that she was simply glad to have given it her all.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Changli: Changli admits that things haven't gone exactly to plan, but she believes a touch of the unexpected is more interesting than a predictable outcome.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Changli: Changli emerged victorious in the Showmatch. She hopes that by the next Derby, she will have formulated a more formidable winning strategy.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Kakaluo: Calcharo believes that it wasn't a lack of effort on his part. There were just too many heavy hitters.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Kakaluo: Following his victory in the Showmatch, Calcharo expressed his desire to celebrate with his Ghost Hounds.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Shouanren: Shorekeeper has suggested that if teleportation were allowed, her finish time would have been vastly improved.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Shouanren: After winning the Showmatch, Shorekeeper mentioned that she'll be reworking the office calendar so Black Shores staff have time to exercise on top of their regular duties.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Kelaita: Carlotta notes that victory or defeat hinges on numerous variables, including wind direction, temperature, barometric pressure, and even air humidity.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Kelaita: Carlotta came out on top in the Showmatch. She stated that she was well pleased with how she competed.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Katixiya: After careful reflection, Cartethyia eventually concluded that a wandering knight really does need a horse to go fast.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Katixiya: Cartethyia took the top spot in the Showmatch. She has decided to have a proper celebration after she gets back.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4_Feibi: Phoebe believes everything is a trial of Imperator, and she accepts them all with gratitude.
Dango_Broadcast_Stage4Win_Feibi: Victory goes to Phoebe in the Showmatch! Phoebe chubby!

BossPilingActivity_HelpText:
[About]
Standard tests make your eyes glaze over, but a test of combat skills sends your adrenaline into overdrive. So bring your A-game and step into the clash for Instructor B.1.N.G.O.'s Combat Mastery Test!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14, and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands"

[Rules]
The event features 7 sets of tests. Each set consists of a Preliminary Test with Associate Assessors and a Final Test with a Chief Assessor.
Meet the various requirements to buff up the team in the Preliminary Test.
All buffs obtained in the Preliminary Test are carried over in the Final Test, where only one objective remains—burn through as much of the Chief Assessor's health bar as possible to rack up your score!

Pinball_Weapon_personal_01_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Xiangli Yao.
Crafted with the lost art from the Court of Savantae, these gauntlets are solid and unbreakable, despite their lightweight materials. They are no tools of violence or aggression, but instruments for unraveling puzzles and pursuing the truth.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_02_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Zhezhi.
An artist's seal adorned with rimed sprouts. It is stamped on numerous paintings that capture mountains and ravines in expressive, mesmerizing strokes. The tender sprouts symbolize the perpetual blossoming of artistic marvels.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_03_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Qiuyuan.
Bamboo, hollow yet full; People, whole yet seldom true.
Bamboo speaks without deceit, acts without conceit, seeks no vanity. Few ever measure up thus.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_04_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Jiyan.
The ancient mountain stands tall, its peak reaching towards the sky. A river flows for thousands of years, forming the blade of a powerful weapon. As it is unsheathed, a powerful dragon's roar echoes through the heavens and earth, causing the sea to churn. This awe-inspiring weapon strikes fear in all who witness its might.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_05_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Changli.
Forged from the very essence and feathers of a legendary bird, this weapon blazes with an intensity that bathes the world in its luminous glow. With each fiery surge, it consumes all in its path, leaving nothing but ashes in its wake.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_06_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Jinhsi.
Each swing of the blade reveals the flow of time and the change of the stars. The sword embodies all things, uniting them into one. Its gentle aura seems capable of dissolving the indestructible, whether it's millennia-old ice or the stagnation of time.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_07_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Galbrena.
From darkness she seizes power, layering sins upon herself. To hunt. To kill. To deliver a relentless and fatal blow to all evil.
From the light she falls, with her vows etched in her mind. For the deceased. For the living. For her pistols' true targets.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_08_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Lupa.
The young wolf races through the wilds, shedding every shadow that once held her back.
The lone wolf strides into the arena, cutting down each obstacle in her path.
She seizes victory. She claims glory. She raises everything she has high above. She belongs to the arena, but even more, she belongs to herself.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_09_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Iuno.
By what means do all things endure? By light and heat, by matter and word, by the mechanics of converging chances, by the soft dissolution into silence, by a moment that mimics the eternal... All things rise and fall in endless rhythm, each bearing its meaning. As for hers, it lies here within her grasp.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_10_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Ciaccona.
All things exist within the lines of poetry. Every sound has its meters and rhymes.
The forest's melodies ascend in spirals toward the moon's silvered grace, harmonized by the nightingales' chorus. When the final note falls and vanishes into the silent earth, a flawless chord echoes endlessly in the depths of this boundless realm.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_11_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Augusta.
Thunder shall purge her pain and weakness. From the crucible of blood and sand, the Sun rises. Not dimmed by dust, but ablaze in her full radiance.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_12_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Chisa.
A crimson thread emerges in the void, as if binding the structures of all things onto a single thread.
At her fingertips, the endless season is drawn taut, snipped, and rewoven, until the scattered path at last converges once more upon this timeline.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_13_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Mornye.
Every pattern can be observed. Every phenomenon can be understood.
The ideal may lie light-years away, yet the path toward it rests within her own hands.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_14_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Lynae.
Prismatic light dances at her fingertips, arcs of color carving radiant trails.
Every rushing hue converges upon her aim, and at last, she reaches a sky where nothing lies beyond her sight.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_15_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Denia.
Dream dissolves like foam, leaving only a silent white dwarf.
Yet the light that once swept the cosmos remains.
She waits in quiescence until her borrowed light finds its way back to the main sequence star.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_16_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Luuk Herssen.
Those are not ridges of the mountains, but the spine of the earth, carrying the night. They protrude from the abdomen of darkness. From the incision spills the light of new life.
Your shadow was nailed to the dying night. With the breaking dawn, your flesh shall rise.
Let it knock open every door of denial.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_17_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Aemeath.
As you drift across the hushed sea of stars, stardust scatters beside you as time crumbles in your wake. All that remains is the unyielding loneliness, warped, diluted, and remade into the plumes of your wings.
The universe sends you on a tribulation of silence, yet you travel on, repaying in radiance.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_18_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Sigrika.
Sunlight gathers. The answer is made plain.
What must be done awaits. The Rein is in your hand.
Step forward, toward the sunlit end.
Pinball_Weapon_personal_19_desc_01:
The Exclusive ROM for Hiyuki.
How keen a blade it takes to impale this unrelenting night?
She presses ever forward for the answer, those unbound wishes roaring in her veins.

HelpText_582_Content:
[About]
Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe have joined forces to establish a foothold on the Dimmr Plains, launching a joint scientific expedition into this long-isolated realm. Objectives include collecting environmental data, recovering ancient plant samples and Exostrider components, and remediating environmental damage caused by Void Storms. The fruits of this operation will effectively advance ecological research and habitat restoration in Lahai-Roi.
You receive a message from I.R.I.S., inviting you to join the inaugural expedition...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest "Starlights from Yesterdays" to unlock.

[Rules]
What appears to be an entirely new species of ancient trees has been discovered across four sectors of the Dimmr Plains. The Department of Light Energy Sciences has officially named them Voidbane Eldertrees. Due to the combined effects of the Solvein Heartwood and Void Storm contamination, these specimens have become stunted and irregular in their growth. The expedition team has developed a plan to restore them to full health.

Work with the Survey Team members to clear Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies within the sectors to complete the necessary preparations.

The required material, "Restoratives," can be obtained through each sector's exploration tasks and challenges. Deliver the required quantity of Restoratives for a sector to restore its Voidbane Eldertree.

Complete Restoration of a tree grants you rare Prism Fruits, which can be delivered to I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp to advance exploration progress and expand your base.

Once you have completed all Restoration activities across the Dimmr Plains and upgraded the Base Camp to Level 5, the energy flow from the Solvein Heartwood will be intensified, making the Dimmr Plains shine once more.

AdvertisingStory_3110201_SubTitle: Chapter III Act IV: "Gold Suspended in Shadows"
AdvertisingStory_3110201_ContentText: Amidst the festive atmosphere of Startorch Academy's New Solar Celebration, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...
AdvertisingStory_3110202_ContentText: After the New Solar Celebration comes to an end, Lucilla sends you a WavesLine message, saying that the root of the Dark Side anomaly remains unresolved, and the Academy is still uncertain of Fractsidus's reasoning for tampering with the Dark Side. Lucilla now looks to you to protect the Academy and uncover the mysteries. Meanwhile, a strange rabbit awaits you inside the Dark Side...
AdvertisingActivity_3110601_ContentText: Lately, "Stellar Orbit Beats" has been taking the Mind Dive Arcade by storm! It's officially the go-to game for everyone to unwind and have fun here at the Academy. Got a free minute between classes? Grab your friends and let the rhythm carry you on a trip through the stars!
AdvertisingActivity_3110602_ContentText: At this year's Club Show & Tell, Van Tassie of the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society proudly unveils his latest project: the "F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator." He claims this game will revolutionize the Academy's culinary experience by gathering the essential data. As is par for the course, your name is on the playtest roster. Yet, something about the project's core design seems... slightly off from the outset.
AdvertisingActivity_3110603_ContentText: Outside the Mind Dive Arcade, a student named Tetoris beckons you to try the latest "Game of the Year," Lahai-Roi Blocks. The game has many wondrous properties, or so she claims…
AdvertisingActivity_3110604_ContentText: Scattered across Lahai-Roi, the Mechscouts provide shelter to people in danger and are hailed as the Knights of the Wild. Yet now, even these guardians need your help.
AdvertisingActivity_3110605_ContentText:
"Green and hazy as they may feel, school days always shine like gems in the river of memory. Those stories drift among the stars, your constant companions through every quiet night.
As the New Solar Celebration unfolds, fresh little tales begin to blossom between you and your friends..."
AdvertisingActivity_3110606_ContentText: In Solaris's data space, invisible offenses and defenses occur every day. Before the malice inside the matrix annihilates everything, find it... and put an end to it.
AdvertisingActivity_3110607_ContentText: After the event begins, log in to the game daily to claim your daily sign-in rewards.
AdvertisingActivity_3110608_ContentText: Platya, a Black Shores Bloom Bearer, has come to Startorch Academy chasing rumors of a Ghost Miko—whispers that seem to echo the legend of the "Lady Miko" of her distant homeland. Intrigued, you join her search.

AdvertisingSystem_3110701_ContentText:
[Echo Management]
You can create multiple management plans for Echoes based on COST, Sonata Effects, and Mainstats.
When a new Echo is obtained, it will automatically be locked or marked for discard according to the enabled plans.
Echo Management Plans do not affect already upgraded Echoes.

[Presets, Sharing & Importing]
You can import recommended management plans via the Suggested Plans feature, or import other Rovers' configurations via the Sharing & Importing feature.
After importing, all local plans will be overwritten and enabled.
AdvertisingSystem_3110702_ContentText:
Echo Smart Discard provides two discard methods: Suggested Plan and Custom Management Plan. They can be selected at the same time.

Based on the selected methods, Echo Smart Discard can quickly filter and discard owned Echoes that are unupgraded, unequipped, and not locked.

Advertising_VersionTitle_33: Reverbs From the End of Galaxies
AdvertisingStory_3210201_SubTitle: Chapter III - Segue "Wishes in the Bell"
AdvertisingStory_3210201_ContentText: With her origami familiar, Hiyuki probes the depths of Voidspace and detects Aemeath's lingering frequency. As the Voidmatter grows increasingly restless, Lucilla intends to put Hiyuki in charge of watching over the Dimmr Plains. But before that, Hiyuki still has some unfinished matters to attend to...
AdvertisingStory_3210202_SubTitle: Chapter III Act V "Starlights from Yesterdays"
AdvertisingStory_3210202_ContentText: The Threnodian Aleph-1's shadow over Lahai-Roi looms larger by the day as the Voidmatter concentration surges across the region. Through negotiation, the Spacetrek Collective accepts your proposal and initiates the Exostrider plan. Shouldering everyone's hope, you activate the Exostrider and venture into the depths of the Voidspace—for Lahai-Roi, and for the paper airplane that never returned to your hand. The future of Lahai-Roi is being written...
AdvertisingStory_3210203_SubTitle: Chapter III - Segue "Beneath a Melting Night Sky"
AdvertisingStory_3210203_ContentText:
After the decisive battle, the Spacetrek Collective and Startorch Academy gradually returned to their normal operations.
Days after the event, you hear news concerning Denia from the Spacetrek Collective...
AdvertisingRegion_3210301_ContentText:
Located in the deepest reaches of Lahai-Roi, the subterranean space where the Keystone resides. The clash of powers between the Threnodian Aleph-1 and the Exostrider sent the land masses afloat in the air, creating a unique landscape.
In the Royan mythology, the calamity-bringing "Hvedrungr" was sealed here by "Baldur."
AdvertisingRegion_3210302_ContentText: The final destination before Soliskin return to the trees. From this point onward, they will transform into warm lights, descend along the roots, and converge into scattered sparks that keep the spreading Voidmatter at bay.
AdvertisingRegion_3210303_ContentText: A floating island with an extreme climate, perpetually covered in snow. Hiyuki once left a portion of her power here to suppress the rift from which Voidmatter encroached on the land.
AdvertisingRegion_3210304_ContentText: A precipice in the depths of Lahai-Roi touched by Voidmatter. Here, sound itself is consumed.
AdvertisingRegion_3210305_ContentText:
Here, Voidmatter's power swells to its peak. Beyond this point lies the Stridergate, a passage to a universe now beyond your reach.
Beyond the Stridergate lies the sea of stars you long for, and the darkness that fills you with dread.
AdvertisingActivity_3210601_ContentText:
Guided by the orbit, led by luck, and fueled by romanticism. This is the great adventure—a vibrant trek across the galaxy. 
Time to let the sea of stars bounce in rhythm with your heart!
AdvertisingActivity_3210602_ContentText: A new season of Cubie Derby is back for the 2nd Anniversary of Second Coming of Solaris! Come watch the match and support your Cube!
AdvertisingActivity_3210603_ContentText: For the couriers of Lollo Logistics, no hardship is too great, no obstacle too steep. Their resolve to deliver never wavers. As the collab season between Second Coming of Solaris and Lollo Logistics takes flight, their most demanding rush has begun...
AdvertisingActivity_3210604_ContentText: To every Rover who's walked this long road with us, thank you for being here. During the event, unlock and claim rewards from the Gifts of Grand Celebration event.
AdvertisingActivity_3210605_ContentText: Beneath Lahai-Roi, the Solvein Heartwood towers overhead, as though holding up those long, shadowed ages. Innumerable motes drift here like traces of a past not yet extinguished, ancient and silent, waiting for an answer. Follow the light downward, and amid layers of dust, listen as those bygone days begin to wake.
AdvertisingActivity_3210606_ContentText:
The night sky over Lahai-Roi is a faithful scribe, bearing record of every star that has ever burned against the dark.
Now, under its watchful gaze, a graduating student is about to embark on his journey across the Dimmr Plains...
AdvertisingActivity_3210607_SubTitle: Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy
AdvertisingActivity_3210607_ContentText: The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, along with a bizarre, tangled dreamscape. Somehow, you even see Namipon in the midst of this chaos...
AdvertisingActivity_3210608_ContentText: Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe have joined forces to establish a foothold on the Dimmr Plains, launching a joint scientific expedition into this long-isolated realm. Objectives include collecting environmental data, recovering ancient plant samples and Exostrider components, and remediating environmental damage caused by Void Storms. The fruits of this operation will effectively advance ecological research and habitat restoration in Lahai-Roi.
AdvertisingActivity_3210609_ContentText: Standard tests make your eyes glaze over, but a test of combat skills sends your adrenaline into overdrive. So bring your A-game and step into the clash for Instructor B.1.N.G.O.'s Combat Mastery Test!
AdvertisingActivity_3210610_ContentText:
Whispers tell of a program that can read the user's memories and project them in miscellaneous ways across the digital world. 
Step into this enigmatic realm. Walk through your past again. Who knows what you might find along the way?
AdvertisingActivity_3210611_ContentText: Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign: Beyond the Waves! Upload Adventure Logs obtained by completing daily tasks, and receive an "Adventure Package" for the corresponding location filled with surprises!
AdvertisingActivity_3210612_ContentText: After the event begins, log in to the game daily to claim your daily sign-in rewards.
AdvertisingActivity_3210613_ContentText: Invite your former companions back and complete tasks together to receive Astrites, Shell Credits, and more! Returning Rovers who link their accounts will also receive bonus gifts!

HelpText_613_Content:
[About]
Every fragment of Xuanfang Hold stands as a witness, recording the city's every smallest collapse, bearing testament to how solemnly it marches toward ruin.
Gather these fragments and piece together the image of Xuanfang Hold, its past, its present, and its future.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and arrive in the Land of Xuanfang through the Dreaming Cavern during Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm."

[Event Rules]
Complete the tasks under each tab to obtain the item "Sliver of Xuanfang." Accumulate Sliver of Xuanfang to raise the "A Glimpse of Xuanfang" event level and earn rewards.
Please note that some event tasks cannot be completed in Co-op Mode, and quest tracking is unavailable in certain in-game areas.
BabelTowerLevel_1117_Subtitle: When the Stridergate opened, the leaked anomalous flows contaminated the tactical cores of the Twin Novas, reconstructing their synergy logic in Voidmatter. Contain them before the spiral turns them into total chaos.
BabelTowerLevel_1118_Subtitle: Overloaded energy erupts in waves of flame. The strain on Reactor Husk's structure and core has reached the breaking point. The immune response is more violent than anything the Spacetrek Collective predicted. Now, every movement it makes sends boundless energy surging through its frame and bursting outward. Everything around it burns.
BabelTowerLevel_1119_Subtitle: Voidmatter has tainted his mind. Torn between sanity and insanity, the aberration creeps through his spacesuit, fusing him with mechanical arms and the drilling probe. The Voidmatter‑infused heavy armor is impenetrable from the front. Your only hope to put an end to it all lies in the exposed panel on his back.
BabelTowerLevel_1120_Subtitle: The Void Storm surged through the Stridergate and swallowed the detection array. Hyvatia, built to peer into the farthest reaches of deep space, now stands face to face with the void itself. The aberration has taken root in its every chip, and there is no undoing it. Now, it hovers above Sundermere, still watching, still reporting, but perhaps for some unknown entity.

DirectTrainActivity_NewMainTaskTitle03: To the Stars Yet to Shine
Activity_103000003_Desc01:
A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 
The Rinascitan people, with their unique "Common Echoes," have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."
Activity_103000004_Desc01: A warm, humid haven beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift, this region became the new Solaris pole, prompting the Roya to migrate below ground. Here, the Spacetrek Collective established Startorch Academy. Today, this borderless academic city has become a cradle for countless rising scholars.
Activity_103000035_Desc01: A unique region nestled between Jinzhou and Mengzhou. Though under Mengzhou's jurisdiction, time has shaped it into a land with its own regional character. Its people once lived alongside Xuanling Birds, rare Remnant Creatures revered as the land's spiritual totem for generations.
Activity_103000003_MotorDesc: A lightweight, all-terrain vehicle co-developed by the Department of Exostrider Engineering and the Department of Voidmatters at Startorch Academy. Indispensable for field expeditions, the Academy has created specialized driving courses and multiple training tracks around the campus to cater to the adventurous spirit of its students and faculty.

HelpText_626_Content:
[About]
Startorch Racing is back! This time, it's not just a race against the clock. You're going head-to-head against other players. Hop on your expedition motorbike and throttle toward the finish line!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and unlock the "Expedition Motorbike" Utility.

[Rules]
1. In "Startorch Racing, Rerun!", players need to compete against other players in Co-op Mode on select racetracks. Players are ranked by the order they reach the finish line.
2. Once the first player crosses the finish line, the race enters a 20-second countdown. The race will automatically end after the countdown.
3. During the race, all combat skills will be locked. Follow the trackers to pass the checkpoints and cross the finish line to complete the race.
4. During the race, players holding the 1st place for a certain period activate the "Front Runner" state, granting a special leaderboard display. Players staying in the 3rd place for a certain period activate "Power Boost," granting them a performance buff and a special leaderboard display.
5. The Co-op race starts when all players join the instance. The max wait time is 120s.
6. When a Co-op race starts, the host cannot quit the Co-op instance, nor disband the party.
7. The race will be automatically ended after 300s.
8. The map resources for the corresponding levels must be downloaded first.
9. Once the race ends, select "Quit Co-op" to return to your own world.
10. Once the race ends, you may select "Restart" to invite other players to another race. The race restarts when all others agree.
11. All players have an Energy Tank cap of 2,400 in this race, regardless of Resonator skills.
12. Special rule for this race: Hop Dash cannot be used after Bounce Jump.

HelpText_628_Content:
[About]
The Skyworks has designed a new combat test for the Autopuppets, but the Artisans have been arguing endlessly over whether its difficulty matches the intended design.
To ensure the validity of the test's intensity, an Artisan from the Ministry of Development has invited you to take part in the combat test and bring this debate to a close.
Complete test objectives to obtain Sparring Coins issued by the Skyworks and exchange them for various supplies and rewards.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 27 and activate the Four Chime Shaftpost during Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm."

[Sparring Store] 
Complete Tactical Hologram: Sparring to obtain Astrites and Sparring Coins, which can be exchanged for rewards at the Sparring Store.
Tactical Hologram: Sparring is a permanent event that can be experienced at any time and will continue to be updated in future versions. Please stay tuned.

[How to Unclock]
Unlocking any difficulty level in Tactical Hologram: Sparring will automatically unlock all other challenges up to that same level. Successfully clearing a difficulty level will also grant all first-time completion rewards for the lower difficulty tiers beneath it.

HelpText_634_Content:
[About]
Although a work reassignment has kept him from traveling to Xuanfang for now, Maji of Lollo Logistics has still prepared a new campaign for his old friends.
During the event, complete the daily tasks to claim Lollo Stamps in return for your favor. Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate Four Chime Shaftpost during Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm."

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.
Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.
There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.
If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.

AdvertisingStory_3310201_SubTitle: Chapter III Side Story "At Dream's Edge"
AdvertisingStory_3310201_ContentText: Following a sudden shift in the Somnoire, a Gateway emerges within the Academy. From it, ominous frequencies spill forth. You venture into the depths and chance upon Lucy and Rebecca, visitors from another world. On the edge of reality and dream, you fight back Nightmare Tacet Discords and search for a solution to the crisis. At the end of your quest, a familiar figure awaits.
AdvertisingStory_3310202_SubTitle: Chapter III Segue "We Choose the Sky"
AdvertisingStory_3310202_ContentText: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.
AdvertisingRegion_3310301_ContentText:
A phantom city manifested from Lucy's mind and the dreamscape of Lahai-Roi. A place born from her memory, where those with great ambitions sought freedom within a cage of neon light. There, passion burned as readily as hatred, and starlight could scarcely pierce its gloom. For those dark streets below, only the moon shone through.

* Somnoire: Night City is a special area. Re-entry is available after completing the Episodic Quest "At Dream's Edge."
AdvertisingActivity_3310601_ContentText: This is a place where dreams overlap with reality, where violence and conflict keep fortunes flowing. Here, everything is up for grabs, provided you can pay the price. Welcome to Night City.
AdvertisingActivity_3310604_ContentText: As frequencies spill forth from the Somnoire, Lucy seeks your assistance in breaching the dreamscape to contain the problem.
AdvertisingActivity_3310605_ContentText: After the event begins, log in to the game daily to claim your daily sign-in rewards.
AdvertisingActivity_3310602_ContentText: The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, and deep within the Dream Abode, a crisis brews...
AdvertisingActivity_3310603_ContentText: Startorch Racing is back! This time, it's not just a race against the clock. You're going head-to-head against other players. Hop on your expedition motorbike and throttle toward the finish line!

HelpText_655_Content:
[About]
With peace restored to the Land of Xuanfang, you once again return to the peak where Qingxiao lives. She gave you a seven-string qin some time ago. This time, she intends to formally teach you how to play it...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Four Chime Shaftpost during Main Quest "The Wind Before the Storm" to access this event early (Complete the pre-requisite Quest "The Nethermancer's Requiem" for the best experience.).

[Event Rules]
During the event, one event quest opens each day at 04:00 server time, for a total of 7 quests. You can receive Qingxiao's personal instruction at various locations, play pieces to refine your skill on the guqin, and earn the corresponding event rewards.
GuQinActivity_PreOpenTips:
You can skip the prerequisite quests and jump straight into the event.
<color=RedD>Please note that skipping ahead may affect your story experience.</color>

RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_01_01: Go. This blade is also at your service.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_01_02: Leave it to me. I will clear the path ahead.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_02_01: Running into troubles? Please, let me lend a hand. May the light descend and pierce the stormy night...
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_02_02: Keep moving forward, Rover. I will scatter the shadows along your path.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_03_01: This blade will answer to your will.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_03_02: The frequency of the wind resonates between us.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_04_01: Since they dare raise their blades, they shall pay the price. Press on, Rover, the eternal sun is by your side.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_04_02: Your eyes blaze with fierce devotion, the very bedrock of our companionship. Now I place my strength in your hands. Let them behold a victory that cannot be shaken.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_05_01: Wanna try it? Come on, give it a go! The power of the Exostrider Armament! Whatever blocks the way ahead, it will sweep everything squeaky clean!
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_05_02: Hehe! If we wanna beat the baddies in the cosmos, we gotta outgun 'em! So pick your moment and light up the beam array!
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_06_01: Heh... The way this flower blooms in your hands is more amusing than I expected. Well, do you like it?
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_06_02: Just as I expected... Only you never fail to thrill me. Ha, how fun! Dancing with you is always such a sweet, sweet delight!
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_07_01: Well, I'm headed that way anyway. Be nice to have someone to chat with, honestly. Run into anything tricky, just let this bobtail cat handle it.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_07_02: Yin and Yang bared to my sight, spirits and ghosts bowed to my might. Lantern high, I light up the night. All of it... burns in my lamp.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_08_01: Seems like we're facing a common foe again. Come, Rover. Whatever stands in our way, we'll cut through it together.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_08_02: Birds always fly somewhere far away. Over the mountains, through the storms, chasing wherever the wind leads... I hope I can be like that too. A bird in the wind, flying wherever I'm needed.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_09_01: Good timing. Today's rounds are done, so this is my private time now.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_09_02: Need me out in the field? Mmm, sure, no problem. Whatever comes up, we can handle it side by side.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_10_01: This wisp of Sword Intent born of my mind shall answer to yours. Should you meet with obstacles, let my blade break them.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_10_02: Dodge the edge, find the gap, exploit the flaw. Disciple, though this stance is not meant for besting a foe, to act with deliberation is itself cultivation.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_11_01: Not that I doubt you can handle it, darling. I just can't miss out on a lively occasion like this. A mindless cloud might still bring timely rain.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_11_02: Springs chime over stones like tinkling jade, a bright moon over the stream, the water singing cool and clear... All flowing water is mine to command, and yours to wield.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_12_01: An improvised flourish? How moving a melody.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_12_02: A discordant note need not disturb the ensemble.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_13_01: To keep the fire from consuming you, live inside it. Pain keeps you sharp. Until the hunt is truly over.
RoverRogueBless_TriggerRoleInfo_13_02: I wield the power of the Dark Tide, this blood and bone turned to unquenchable flame long ago. Now I place that ember in your hands. Together, we ride to the next hunting ground.
DangoBrawlRoleDes_80700016: A Cubie Warrior capable of carrying an unlimited number of Signature Weapons. A perfect choice to try out the Item builds of different Roles. Be an adventurer and explore your path freely!
DangoBrawlRoleDes_80700017: A Cubie Warrior capable of carrying an unlimited number of Signature Weapons. A perfect choice to try out the Item builds of different Roles. Be an adventurer and explore your path freely!
DangoBrawlRoleDes_80700018: A Cubie Warrior who excels in Rectifier and Cursed Keystones, skilled in inflicting <te href=853712>Negative Effects</te> to deal massive <te href=853714>Effect DMG</te>.
DangoBrawlRoleDes_80700019: A Cubie Warrior who excels in Broadblade and Gauntlets, skilled in applying <te href=853707>Positive Effects</te> to herself with Blessing Keystones and Accessories to deal massive <te href=853715>Weapon DMG</te>.
DangoBrawlRoleDes_80700020: A Cubie Warrior that launches continuous attacks with Sword to pile up the <te href=853709>Tune Rupture</te> and <te href=853708>Fusion Burst</te> stacks on the enemies and increase Weapon DMG.
DangoBrawlRoleDes_80700021: A Cubie Warrior who suppresses the enemies with the firepower of her Pistols, gaining <te href=853706>Luck</te> and inflicting a great number of <te href=853710>Spectro Frazzle</te> stacks on her enemies to deal various types of damage.
DangoBrawlOccupationDes_1: This Role activates the Exostrider with various types of Weapons to frequently deal <te href=853715>Weapon DMG</te>.
DangoBrawlOccupationDes_2: This Role uses Rectifier and Accessories to deal <te href=853714>Effect DMG</te> and inflict <te href=853712>Negative Effects</te> on enemies. Especially effective against opponents with few weapons.
DangoBrawlOccupationDes_3: This Role applies <te href=853707>Positive Effects</te> to themselves when attacked. A good smasher against enemies that use Weapons with low Attack Intervals.
DangoBrawlOccupationDes_4: This Role launches continuous attacks with Sword to pile up the <te href=853709>Tune Rupture</te> and <te href=853708>Fusion Burst</te> stacks on the enemies and increase Weapon DMG.
DangoBrawlOccupationDes_5: This Role uses Pistols to gain <te href=853706>Luck</te> stacks, earning wealth while inflicting a huge number of <te href=853710>Spectro Frazzle</te> stacks on enemies.

HelpText_660_Content:
[About]
The Pioneer Association has picked Fogveil Pagoda as the featured location for an upcoming edition of Wutherium Geographic. To that end, the association has organized a special survey of the area.
Complete Survey Tasks and accumulate Survey Points to secure valuable rewards offered by the Pioneer Association.

[Task Reset]
Survey Tasks reset daily at 04:00. Upon reset, any unclaimed Survey Points will be automatically claimed, and uncompleted tasks will expire.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
