Once in the past, the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> were always struggling to defend against surprise attacks from the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. With such extensive frontlines, it was nearly impossible to detect every breach and they were constantly vulnerable. So, they turned to Taoqi for help.

Feeling stressed and overwhelmed, Taoqi took a break on a swing nearby. As she watched children playing in a sandpit, an idea came to her - just like how they filled the gaps in their sandcastles, they could also fill the gaps in the frontlines. She proposed building a sand wall at the frontline during Tacet Discord assaults. This would shorten the frontlines and limit the attack paths for the enemy. With fewer spots to defend, the Midnight Rangers would have more time to assess each attack and respond accordingly based on the varying frequencies caused by sand deformation. Thanks to Taoqi's clever thinking, they were able to better protect themselves against attacks and gain some much-needed breathing room on the frontlines.

According to Taoqi, staring at a desk all day leads to monotony and disconnect from reality. So she seeks alternative methods for efficiency. It's in her free time that she stumbles upon unexpected guidance and inspiration through serendipitous encounters.
FavorStory_160201_Content:
There are many dangerous areas near <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> — the Dim Forest cloaked in towering trees; the Whining Aix's Mire shrouded in unending fog; and the Wasted Metropolis, where shadows hide unknown dangers.

Generally speaking, people would always steer clear of such dangerous places. Even on those rare occasions when they have to pass through these places, they do so carefully and try their best to hide themselves.

However, there was one girl who didn't follow this unspoken rule. The girl, clothed in vivid red, strolled through dangerous streets with an air of ease. The bright jade pendant she wore danced to the tune of her light footsteps.

Naturally, this alluring appearance made her a prime target for predators.

A bandit approached her under the guise of offering help, and asked why she was wandering alone in this desolate and treacherous place.

"I'm looking for someone," the girl answered.

"Wow, small world! I hardly see anyone around here. Funny enough, I actually saved someone recently and they're at my place. Maybe it's the person you're looking for? Want me to take you there?" The bandit eagerly offered.

The girl studied him thoughtfully, pondering for a moment before finally giving a timid nod. 

Pleased with this response, the bandit immediately led the girl to his camp.

They veered off the main roads and soon found themselves in a desolate place, shrouded in dense fog and overgrown with vegetation. Eerie cries echoed from the depths of the forest — was it a child's wail or a cat's scream? No one knew the answer. 

The bandit, stealing a glance at the girl, worried that his prey may be scared off by the bloodcurdling ambiance.

However, she still wore a calm expression with no trace of fear on her beautiful face.

"Stupid chick," the bandit snickered to himself.

As they approached an old iron door at the end of the path, intermittent whimpers could be heard from behind it. The girl pushed the door open and inside, they found a trembling and battered little girl.

"Is this the one you're looking for?" asked several bandits with wicked grins, surrounding the girl.

"Exactly!" replied the girl with a bright smile.

Amidst deafening screams and agonized moans, crimson blood splattered everywhere... And so began a brutal slaughter that hushed even the evening glow.
FavorStory_160202_Content: Uncle Wei the blacksmith had a strange customer one day. It was a young girl, who looked puny and quiet. Her request, however, was rather unusual: she asked him to repair a broken sword. "What happened to it?" Uncle Wei furrowed his brow and inquired. He was no stranger to repairing all kinds of damaged weapons; still, he couldn't help but wonder what could have caused such significant wear on this blade. In his mind's eye, Uncle Wei conjured up an image of a formidable big man wielding the sword with immense power, slashing through whatever stood in his way without mercy. By no means could he relate this image to a slender girl like her. "Sorry, I may have hit them a bit too hard... I didn't mean it..." the girl answered, her embarrassment evident. "Is it difficult to repair?" Uncle Wei stared at her in disbelief. He examined the rolled edge with his callused finger and replied, "...No worries. I'll give it a go." With precision and skill, Uncle Wei heated the blade until it glowed and struck it forcefully with his hammer. Sparks flew, but the blade remained unyielding. Years of expertise guided him as he inspected and stroked the damaged metal, contemplating each blow. In a moment of clarity, he discovered the problem. "The blade is exceptionally hard but lacks toughness. Its center of mass is off now, and it has a special frequency. It's difficult to repair and sharpen with traditional tools." "If you wanna get it repaired," Uncle Wei continued, "you'll need some really hard gray chalks with a good amount of Tacetite. But they're not easy to get, only found in a dangerous place, with a lot of rock cliffs! Don't get your hopes up, kid." "You mean the Desorock Highland, right? Please give me some time. I'll be back soon." With those words, the girl dashed out like the wind, leaving Uncle Wei confused and the rolled blade forgotten. She returned shortly after, carrying a big piece of gray chalk with ease. "Is this enough?" she asked, surprising Uncle Wei with her quick return from the dangerous Desorock Highland. "Absolutely!" he stammered, amazed at her speed. How did she make it back so quickly? The girl smiled, and cute dimples appeared on her face — a faint red spot could be vaguely seen on one of her dimples. Was it a mole? Or was it... something else?
FavorStory_160203_Content:
Every food vendor in Jinzhou knows Danjin. After the rain, when the sun peeks through and the air is thick with humidity, they all set up their stalls. It's a symphony of clanging pots and sweet smelling syrup. That's when Danjin shows up, handing over a neat stack of <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> for her favorite snack: two pieces of <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisp</te>. She always puts one in her pocket first, and then eagerly breaks apart the other, savoring each piece like it's a precious gem.

A food vendor lady noticed Danjin always came alone and couldn't help but feel sorry for her: Even the cheapest snacks in Jinzhou, like Loong Whiskers Crisps, seemed so precious to this girl. Wanting to spread some kindness, the lady started giving Danjin extra snacks popular with girls her age — from pretty Rock Sugar to fluffy Dreamy Floss, and more. At first, Danjin would always refuse, because she felt uncomfortable accepting someone's generosity without a good reason, and because her wallet was running on empty from constantly repairing her weapons.

However, the lady insisted it wouldn't be trouble to let Danjin have some more sweets for free, as she always prepared extra snacks for her sweets-loving younger sister back home, who was approximately Danjin's age. Touched by this genuine kindness, Danjin eventually nodded and accepted the extra snacks.

From that day on, every time the vendor lady gave Danjin extra snacks, a mysterious gift appeared on her stall. Rock sugar brought a Pearl Leaf, while Dreamy Floss resulted in a Caltrop. These herbs were crucial in easing her younger sister's panic disorder, which she hadn't even told Danjin about.

Maybe sooner or later, her younger sister would be able to leave the house by herself, and enjoy the freshly made Loong Whiskers Crisps with Danjin.
FavorStory_160204_Content:
Danjin is indeed traveling in the wild to look for someone.

She is looking for revenge.

One vicious group of bandits was kidnapping children for sinister purposes. Years ago, they slaughtered Danjin's entire family. Her younger sister, a girl with a kind soul, opened the door for them out of sympathy, only to welcome the bloodthirsty blades that claimed her family's lives.

The culprits already met the wrath of Danjin's sword, but even after many years, similar tragedies continued to occur. The evil persisted. It seemed like an impenetrable barrier, preventing anyone from escaping their grasp. Day after day, month after month, new tragedies emerged as other evildoers continued their reign of terror. Danjin knew she had to find the root and eradicate it once and for all to stop the cycle of pain and suffering inflicted upon the innocent. She would not rest until justice was served and peace was restored.

Danjin decided to make herself the bait. She travelled through treacherous terrain looking all innocent and defenseless, wiping out one hideout after another while hunting for more clues.

Hidden throughout the wilderness were these camps, blending into the natural surroundings. With precision and thoroughness, she scoured every inch of each campsite, uncovering vital details amidst the blood-stained haystacks and dilapidated structures. 

Her efforts paid off when she discovered that all the camp vehicles had passed through a specific location: where the bandits had been ambushing innocent victims.

Hiding in the tall weeds, Danjin nibbled on a <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisp</te>, her eyes glued to the foggy crossroad. 

For seven days she had been waiting at this crossroad, stopping any suspicious vehicles that passed by. She refused to give up hope of catching those bandits, no matter what.

Finally, eerie headlights and crunching wheels broke through the dense fog. The wheels' creaking almost drowned out a faint whimper, but it didn't escape Danjin's ears.

Emerging from her hiding place, Danjin approached the vehicle. 

She recited the lines she prepared with a perfectly practiced timid voice: "Excuse me... I'm lost. Could you please give me a ride?"
FavorStory_160205_Content:
Eliminating all evil is a daunting task. That foggy crossroad had turned out to be merely a transit point, but Danjin wasn't discouraged. Small progress is still progress, and besides, she had rescued some kidnapped children along the way. After escorting the children to the Patrol Station, Danjin sighed in relief and decided to return to the city for some much-needed rest.

She strolled down the decorated street illuminated by vibrant festival lanterns and warm lights. The moon shone brightly above, adding to the enchanting atmosphere of the night.

Many years ago, on a similar moonlit night, her family shared precious moments together. Her mother had prepared a table full of mouth-watering dishes, whereas Danjin's younger sister happily presented two pieces of <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisp</te>, one for herself, and one for Danjin.

"B-Big sister, this is for you..."

Such thoughts were foreign—she had never cared about her own life, or that of others. She had little faith in the organization built on this shore, and even less in the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System. Aside from {PlayerName}, she had little trust in anyone else.

She had followed {PlayerName} travels from <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> till now. 

A singular force, always moving forward, gathering a diverse array of companions along the way.

Though Solaris was vast, she believed that if they were threads in the same story, their paths would surely cross again.

At a time when {PlayerName} was none the wiser, that's when she would surprise {Male=him;Female=her}!

FavorStory_160302_Content:
She awoke from her dream.

The walls of the medical pod sank into darkness. Enveloped in heavy silence due to sound dampening, Camellya blinked and turned her dry gaze to the right. The indicators on the Terminal screen had returned to normal. The shackles around her wrists and ankles had loosened, yet she still felt weak, forcing her to remain lying in the narrow confines of the pod.

She tried to recall what had happened. She forced a precarious composure trying to remember, but the lost memories felt like a bottomless black hole—gazing into it revealed only darkness. Her memories had fractured once again.

Having been with <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> for only a year, Camellya had recently passed the test to become an official Bloom Bearer. She now enjoyed greater access to the <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System's archives of information.

Before her arrival there, she had wandered across <te href=850079>Solaris</te> for a long time.

The cave where she first awoke showed no signs of other people, only twisted plants climbing the walls. Barefoot, Camellya waded through the water until she emerged into the open air, discovering a desolate village. Her foot struck something—a stone slab bearing the faded inscription, "Petalfall Village."

It took her a long time to escape that abandoned place. When hunger struck, she hunted wild beasts for sustenance. When thirst overtook her, she drank from mountain springs. It took her several months to traverse the dense forests and finally arrive at a place bustling with people. Only later did she realize that the village had likely been forgotten for hundreds of years.

Even after returning to civilization, Camellya's memories remained blank, unstimulated by her new surroundings. She felt like an untamed animal, living on pure instinct. The rules and regulations of the human world were foreign to her, but she wasn't frustrated—using her Forte was enough. To her, power was an instinctive weapon, and she wielded it freely, carving her own path through the <te href=850075>Lament</te>-scarred land.

Initially, everything in Solaris fascinated her. However, as she gradually learned more, boredom set in quickly. Arriving at the Black Shores had been an accident, yet Camellya felt a strange familiarity with it. A year later, she found her name in the Tethys System and learned that she had once lived and worked there, known then as Lady Flora. It was odd how she had forgotten everything yet still remembered the name "Camellya." 

Driven by curiosity, she began her investigation of the Black Shores, eager to uncover her past and the stories of Lady Flora. What had truly happened to her?

As those thoughts surfaced, a sharp pain pierced her head again, and the flower in her chest suddenly swelled, darkening to a deep purple. The sharp thorns of its veins threatened to tear through the medical pod. Fragments of memories flickered in her mind—Ah, Lady Flora had forbidden her from recalling the past. Camellya let out a muffled scream of pain as the restraints tightened once again around her limbs, and a loud alarm blared. Medical personnel would arrive soon.

Yet, she knew there was little they could do. They had already examined her carefully, concluding that her <te href=850073>Overclocking</te> symptoms were unique and untreatable, manageable only through restraint. Death could offer relief, but in her current condition, she couldn't even simply die.

All she could do was wait, wait for the grace of death. This passivity chafed at her spirit. If she couldn't decide the outcome, she at least wanted to control the process. 

"I'll follow my instincts until death finds me."

"It hurts!" she thought.

Despite her agony, Camellya laughed loudly.
FavorStory_160303_Content:
She awoke from her dream.

Lady Flora opened her eyes, feeling the cold air brushing against her fingertips, making her hands and feet slightly numb. She dawdled in her seat for a moment, slowly sitting up to take in her surroundings.

The vehicle had come to a halt in a cave, a refuge from the snowstorm outside, where an endless silver expanse of snow stretched before her. Frost flowers drifted gently from the sky, landing delicately on the tip of her nose. Shivering, she huddled deeper into her thick clothing. 

She was not the kind of plant that could withstand the cold.

"Where did the leader go?" she asked after taking a few sips of water, turning to the Bloom Bearer in the front seat. "I didn't see {Male=him;Female=her}."

"The leader? {Male=He;Female=She} went west. {Male=He;Female=She} said something interesting had turned up and wanted to take a look." 

"Why didn't {Male=he;Female=she} take me? I am {Male=his;Female=her} guard, after all!" she complained under her breath.

Her fellow Bloom Bearer chuckled as he drove, barely glancing away from the steaming soup. "You were asleep! You haven't been sleeping well on the journey, always shivering in the cold. {Male=He;Female=She} didn't want to wake you while you finally caught some rest."

Grumbling quietly under her breath, Lady Flora pouted and swung the door open. "Anyway, I'm off to find {Male=him;Female=her} now!"

The Bloom Bearer waved her off, clearly used to the dynamic between Lady Flora and their leader.

Leaving the warmth of the vehicle, Lady Flora dragged her feet across the snowy expanse, memories of their first encounter in Petalfall Village flooding back. She had known they would come to this snowy plain for the mission, and despite her dislike of the cold, she knew the time spent with the leader of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te> would be worth it. Most of the time, she opted to accompany {PlayerName} on various errands, leaving her footprints across the tapestry of <te href=850079>Solaris</te>, from bustling towns to unknown alcoves, safe havens to treacherous lands. Lady Flora relished this existence, brimming with the thrill of the unknown, and {PlayerName} had an uncanny talent for transforming the ordinary into something extraordinary.

She didn't mind the threat of danger. In fact, she rather enjoyed it. To her, danger signified change, and change led to excitement. She did find, however, that with her leader by her side, she stifled her impulse to seek out trouble for fun.

Danger...

Camellya raised her hand, the delicate chain on her wrist catching the light. The bracelet monitoring her Rabelle indicators read as normal. She squeezed her wrist and exhaled softly. "Good, everything is as it should be," she thought. "If I start spiraling out of control, {Male=he;Female=she} would have to look after me. It would derail the entire mission."

She hated losing control.

In recent years, Lady Flora had been haunted by bizarre and fragmented dreams. They felt like memories of a life she had never lived. In these dreams, she was always searching for {PlayerName}, but the two never found each other. Each time she jolted awake, a disquiet settled over her, the mental turmoil seeping into her very being. She was often forced to report to the Black Shores medical facility. 

The thought soured her mood. 

She needed to find {Male=him;Female=her} as quickly as possible.

Shoving those tangled thoughts aside, she focused on pinpointing {PlayerName}'s frequencies. After crossing two hills and a frozen lake, she finally spotted a blurry figure in the distance.

"Camellya, how did you sleep?" 

{Male=His;Female=Her} golden eyes sparkled with warmth, and she couldn't help but smile back.

"Hehe… With my leader by my side, of course I had the sweetest dreams." she heard herself reply.
FavorStory_160705_Content:
In the misty purple room, voices blended together—the majestic and enchanting, the cold and resolute, and the genuine and innocent. They intertwined, forming a dreamlike symphony. The sapphire light shimmered with quiet authority, the pages of a book rustled softly, and the scent of freshly baked pastries mingled with the warmth of the room, creating a sweet, ethereal atmosphere.

Cantarella lifted the delicate teapot and poured the tea, a change from the usual. No longer the alluring purple hues, but a cup of tea with a refreshing clarity.

"Thank you for your invaluable opinions," she said, setting the teapot down. The fresh aroma filled the room. "Now, I've made up my mind."

"I will continue to wear the crown of thorns, for the poison has already sunk deep into my bones, and the dream is a part of me I cannot remove."

"I will keep brewing potions, for they are needed not just by the <te href=850094>Fisalias</te>, but by all in struggle."

"I will step outside and follow the flight of birds, into the mountains and the streets. The whispers that once trapped us are gone, and now we are free."

"I am still within the dream, but I will strive to feel the ground beneath my feet… In that fleeting moment between dream and reality, I will hold on to what is real."

Cantarella took a deep breath, slowly opening her eyes. She had just woken from a brief afternoon nap, stepping out from a hazy yet lucid dream. The sunlight at three in the afternoon filtered through the glass window, casting a quiet glow over her lonely figure in the room. The only sounds left were the gentle bubbling of the tea and her steady breathing.

She picked up her cup and took a sip. The fresh aroma soothed the restless <te href=850072>Tacet Mark</te> in her mouth. It no longer draws power from illusion or pain. This was the tea she had bought earlier this morning in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, just ordinary tea. The faint sweetness and subtle fragrance reminded her of a breeze in the countryside, of dew drops hanging on fresh leaves…

So, this was the taste of peace and happiness after everything had settled.

The door creaked open. She poured another cup and offered it to the guest who had just arrived. The guest had black hair and golden eyes, a presence of calm and unwavering strength that grounded the room. This quiet, tranquil afternoon was a miracle granted by no other but {PlayerName}.

The soft sunlight brushed through the room, and the refreshing fragrance lingered between them, filling the space around the two teacups. She lifted her violet-blue eyes, the mist long faded, her gaze now like a calm sea, with just the ripple of gentle feelings.

FavorWord_110403_Content: Words hold incredible power. In <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, we believe spoken words may manifest into reality. Then if even jokes have a chance to come true, why not good wishes and blessings? That's why we should always express our positive thoughts out loud. Who knows, maybe there is a higher power listening and ready to grant our desires. So, I make sure to say my Lucky Greetings to everyone, as often as possible!
FavorWord_110404_Content: I wish I could show you my hometown, but it's not the same anymore. It's been turned into a <te href=850078>Tacet Field</te>, without any life or joy. I prefer living in vibrant places, where there's energy and excitement. But one day, when we overcome the <te href=850075>Lament</te> and bring back the beauty of this land, I'll take you there. You'll see the tallest trees, twinkling fireflies, and a river glittering with stars... Yes, we'll see that day...
FavorWord_110405_Content: I'm no longer afraid of letting people see my real appearance, but... I guess I still look rather different, and not everyone is so accepting of that. Sometimes I just want to lend a helping hand, and they'd assume I'm trying to claw at them or something... Erm, what do you think, Rover? Do I look scary to you?
FavorWord_110406_Content: I love people-watching. It's fascinating to see so many different faces and backgrounds come to watch the <te href=850131>liondance</te>. Each person brings their own story and personality... I guess they're just, just like... leaves? I've never come across two identical leaves. Every one of them is unique. And you, Rover, I want to know more about you so bad... Tell me more, please?
FavorWord_110407_Content: "Feel the drum and dance along," they say. In <te href=850131>liondance</te>, there isn't really a set melody we dance to. It's all about finding the perfect balance between movement and music. Everyone in our troupe must attend both Mr. Wufang's liondance classes and Mr. Qixing's drumming classes. And let me tell you, I struggle with the drums. Catching the beat is always tricky. I do better in the liondance class, but I often get lost in the dance and forget to keep up with the beat... Luckily, I can still manage to pull off the performance smoothly, thanks to my fellow troupe members. They often tweak the drumbeat tempo to match my rhythm. As my Master likes to point out, I'm a classic case of being "good at some things but not so much at others."
FavorWord_110408_Content: Medium-rare is the way to go for grilled meat. That tender texture with a hint of secret spices... mmm, delicious! Trust me, I know all about it. Have you tried those "Medium Rare" skewers in Jinzhou? I'm the genius behind them, and now they're all the rage!
FavorWord_110409_Content: Hmm... you've got a point there. Would grilled veggies taste any better?
FavorWord_110410_Content: The liondance tradition is all about banishing evil, guarding fortune, and beckoning blessings. I want to be the best dancer out there to keep this tradition thriving. My Master always reminds me not to aim too high and bite off more than I can chew. I know there's still a long road ahead in perfecting my skills, but as long as I keep moving steadily from one pole to another, like we do in the tournaments, I'll surely reach my goal, no matter how high or far away it may seem.
FavorWord_110411_Content: Why do I keep this liondance head with me? Well, when I first got to Jinzhou, I was afraid to take it off. I didn't want people to see that I looked different from everyone else. Wearing the head made me feel safe, like I could hide my appearance and just focus on dancing. Maybe back then, I thought that only by wearing the liondance head could I truly be myself without judgement.
FavorWord_110412_Content: For some reason, people seem obsessed with my tail. Sometimes my seniors like to play their little drums to the beat of my swishing tail. But honestly, I have no idea how to control it. It's more like some kind of... reflex? When I feel happy—like right now, it just starts wagging on its own.
FavorWord_110413_Content: In <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, the <te href=850131>liondance</te> tradition started as a way to celebrate victories in battle. And nowadays, we always perform before our soldiers go into battle—it's like a good luck charm and morale booster. Our <te href=850130>Liondance Troupe</te> has been traveling between military camps in various regions to deliver performances. I'll never forget my first time leading a pre-battle show. I was nervous and messed up here and there, but General Jiyan didn't get mad at me. He actually encouraged me a lot. He isn't as strict as he seems in public, is he? No wonder the soldiers admire him so much... He's really a strong and kind person.
FavorWord_110414_Content: <te href=850131>Liondance</te> is a fusion of martial arts and dance. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures. Miss Jianxin practices Fengyiquan, a contrasting style to liondance, but just as impressive. I once saw her effortlessly take down seven men with a single punch! The Fengyiquan truly lives up to its reputation: conquering the unyielding with the yielding.
FavorWord_110415_Content: The Qixing Drum's sound echoes far and wide, and people say it scares evil spirits and beasts away. I never thought anyone could sleep through that loud banging, but then I met this pink-haired lady called Taoqi... Turns out she's the Chief Officer of border defense at the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te>. With all the defenses in Jinzhou, I'd be tired too... Maybe she is just too exhausted from work? I hope she can catch some good rest.
FavorWord_110416_Content: Uncle Yuanwu keeps lots of street cats at his boxing gym. I often bring them fish I've caught as thank-yous for, let's say, helping me practice. I wonder if those cats are picking up on his moves? Maybe I can draw some inspiration from that. By the way, Uncle Yuanwu's dried fish is super delicious!
FavorWord_110417_Content: Don't let Mr. Mortefi's permanent 'Do-Not-Disturb' face fool you, he's actually a big kid at heart. He's the genius behind all those fun toys for Jinzhou's children, and he even created some sick merch for our <te href=850130>Liondance Troupe</te>! So when you need his help, don't hesitate to tell him—just do it politely and he'll surely lend you a hand!
FavorWord_110418_Content: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!
FavorWord_110419_Content: I love Yangyang's singing! I've been trying to convince her to sing at our theater, but she keeps turning me down.... Says she's embarrassed to sing in front of a crowd. I don't get it! It's just like liondancing—once you take that first step, the rest falls into place!
FavorWord_110420_Content: The <te href=850076>Remnant</te> Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called <te href=850140>You'tan</te>, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was…
FavorWord_110421_Content: Happy birthday! May your life be filled with joy and delight, as you chase your dreams and reach new heights. May happiness follow wherever you go, may your journey be a wonderful show! Hehe, I've come up with a special liondance just for you! Can you spend some more time here with me today? Because, well, this dance might run a little long.
FavorWord_110423_Content: Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament!
FavorWord_110425_Content: Hmm? Did I just hear something? It feels off to not hear the drums...
FavorWord_110426_Content: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!
FavorWord_110427_Content: Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound!
FavorWord_110428_Content: Hmm? Where are you going? Count me in!
FavorWord_110429_Content: Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay?
FavorWord_110430_Content: Here's to a safe journey ahead.
FavorWord_110431_Content: Great! That's a new move for me!
FavorWord_110432_Content: No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder.
FavorWord_110433_Content: So this is what they mean by "Beyond the mountain lies a broader world"... Thank you, Rover! I couldn't have made it this far without you. Now I'm ready to challenge higher Plum Blossom Poles.
FavorWord_110434_Content: My Master once told me this: Never lose reverence for the "highest pole", no matter how much you've achieved. There's always someone better, and always more to learn, so we should always stay humble. I'll keep cultivating myself with this reverence in mind. Besides, there's someone right in front of me that I want to catch up to.
FavorWord_110435_Content: Legend has it that the <te href=850131>liondance</te> was created by ancient sages, inspired by the movement of constellations in the sky. True mastery of it allows one to draw power from the world, to form a miniature cosmos within. ...Now I think I've finally caught a glimpse into that realm. I've still got a long way ahead, but at least I can better protect you now.
FavorWord_110441_Content: Beat the drum. Ready to prance!
FavorWord_110481_Content: There's no stopping good luck once it's on your side!
FavorWord_110513_Content: Before I came to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I once met her training in the mountains. She had journeyed far and wide, sharing tales of the incredible places she'd been. Her views on nature completely changed how I paint. That deep focus she had while training... I aim for that same focus in my own art.
FavorWord_110514_Content: I often run into her when I'm out painting. I'm curious about the habits of plants, and she's really into what they mean in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> culture. So we end up spending a lot of time just squatting by some plant, chatting.
FavorWord_110517_Content: His lion dancing... it's really something. So precise and yet so full of life. I once walked by a lion dance performance and tried to sketch it quickly, but the movements kept changing... My pencil couldn't keep up. So, I ended up going to the theater a few more times just to watch. Before I knew it, I actually started enjoying the <te href=850131>liondances</te> quite a bit.
FavorWord_110603_Content: Hey, here's a secret–but don't go blabbing to anyone else. If you recite "Master Youhu's Poem Collection" by the City Hall, the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> will totally bless you. Well, maybe it won't... but hey, at least *I'll* totally help you…
FavorWord_110607_Content: Treasures are plenty if you look, but stealing is a total bore. Catching baddies dusk till dawn, that's what I do all along.*Yawn* Still got a bunch of losers who haven't returned what they took. Let's see who's so unlucky to cross paths with yours truly, Master Youhu!
FavorWord_110608_Content: Loong Buns are cool, they're like our tribute to the great Loongs. Food Ration Bars are cool too, they remind me of our soldier's dedication. Obviously, only the best meaningful food could ever impress Master Youhu!
FavorWord_110613_Content: That <te href=850131>liondancer</te>... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!
FavorWord_110615_Content: A <te href=850112>Jinzhou Patroller</te>... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?
FavorWord_110618_Content: So, I accidentally heard it's your birthday today. And because we're like, friends or something, I made you this wooden statue of the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. It's said to protect you on your trips. Yeah, I just whipped it up on a whim! W-What do you mean it takes other people months to finish? Well I'm just amazingly talented, so of course it only took me half a day!
FavorWord_110701_Content: Before our paths crossed, I'd only heard stories about you from Grandfather. But <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> is rather secluded, and not all the tales that reach us remain true. I found myself wondering who you really were, and you surpassed every expectation. Your arrival didn't just disrupt the delicate balance in Ragunna, it also shed light on doubts and hesitations that had kept me trapped for so long.
FavorWord_110710_Content: The <te href=850101>Montellis'</te> legacy is built and sustained by every member of the our family. We know the world is far greater than <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> or <te href=850096>Rinascita</te> alone. Just as our ancestors once ventured into the unknown, we too must continue to chart new courses. Now, a golden opportunity lies before us... I need only to seize it and take that step forward. Perhaps more than just one.
FavorWord_110712_Content: My past is no secret within my family or among old acquaintances… I've been called many things: the abandoned orphan, descendant of the lesser branch, prominent young lady, and efficient executor. Each title represents a part of me, though none capture the whole. To dance on the edge of danger, one must learn to wear many masks. For the future of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family, I will play any role that's required of me.
FavorWord_110714_Content: I've always been curious about something. Just how much can her box, <te href=850122>Pero</te>, actually hold? New designs, costumes, the fine wines the troupe keeps hidden, shimmering sea gems and shells... And Roccia's thoughts and feelings, too. Though Roccia herself rarely speaks her mind, Pero seems to reveal them all.
FavorWord_110717_Content: Some people see family as a matter of blood and heritage, while others, unbound by such conventions, consider those who share their ideals as family. I am deeply grateful for the protection, opportunities, and insight Grandfather has given me, along with the pride of being a <te href=850101>Montelli</te>. He embodies the spirit of the Montelli family, and I am determined to honor his legacy. Like him, I will lead our family forward with action, as a true Montelli would.
FavorWord_110718_Content: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. I must confess, ever since I found out about your birthday, I've been thinking about the perfect gift for you. You likely already possess many treasures, so I wanted mine to be something unique, practical, and delightful—something that would bring you joy and remind you of me. So, here it is: a pistol reshaped by my Forte. It symbolizes that you have the freedom to do as you wish. Whether or not you're a Montelli, this promise holds true, always, in the name of Carlotta <te href=850101>Montelli</te>.
FavorWord_110722_Content: I am Carlotta Montelli, the second lady of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family. In certain situations, I might also be known as Opal. I have a talent for uncovering value and solving problems. Whether it's for business or building friendships, you can rely on me. If you're interested in closer collaboration... well, that's certainly possible. However, are you prepared to offer your faith, life, and future in exchange?
FavorWord_110748_Content: In the name of the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>.
FavorWord_120201_Content: It sucks that you can't remember your past, there must've been a lot of unforgettable memories. But no worries, we can create new ones. You and I, together!
FavorWord_120202_Content: You should check out Uncle Mahe's for freshest groceries and Auntie Panhua's for the best cuisines. Oh, I'm not saying this because we're related. The food's just that good! Say, I'll bring you over so you can give 'em a try yourself when we have the time.
FavorWord_120203_Content: Auntie Panhua always told me how tastebuds can store memories. Maybe the taste of a familiar dish could jog your memory? Even if that fails, a yummy meal will certainly lift your spirits! I want to make everyone happy, especially you.
FavorWord_120204_Content: <te href=850113>Overdash</te> racing, hero plays, plus the secret bases out in the suburbs... There are so many more places that I want to take you to. I've never been hyped for days off like this before you came. It's amazing how time flies when we're together!
FavorWord_120205_Content: Even I can tell you're different from us... One day you'll leave for somewhere far away, right? Well, when the day comes, do take this Fiamma sticker, this wristlet I made, plus this jar of homemade Victor Savor... What? That's too much to carry? I-I just want you to think of me when we're not together!
FavorWord_120206_Content: The hero plays at Jinzhou Theater are the bee's knees! Especially during New Years, everyone would gather around to enjoy the plays, havin' a whale of a time.
FavorWord_120207_Content: You see, heroes can defeat bad guys with just a few whams 'n' bams in plays. But that isn't so easy in real life. They're like those pesky Excarats, you whack one here and another pops up somewhere else, like those <te href=850081>TDs</te> in the wilds, those no-good bandits, and those weirdos in red... Ahem. Anyway, just keep 'em comin' alright. I'll take 'em all on!
FavorWord_120208_Content: Victor Savor! That sauce is so good, you'll munch an old shoe with it.
FavorWord_120209_Content: What's there to be picky about? I'm good with any food, as long as it fills my tummy.
FavorWord_120210_Content: I've always wanted to become a hero! A hero matching Speedster and Fiamma, bringing hope and courage to all!
FavorWord_120211_Content: I used to fight with nothing more than my flames, but now I have these pistols. I'll hold on tight to whatever weapon I can have, so I can protect everyone!
FavorWord_120212_Content: I was really scared of the dark when I was little, but "Fiamma" would always arrive in time to drive it away. Now that I'm all grown up, I'm not scared anymore. I can be my own torch!
FavorWord_120213_Content: Happy Birthday! Try this, I made this bow of Maocai all by myself, with extra Victor Savor added just for you. Eat up while it's still steamin'! Don't worry about the spiciness, it's a good omen!
FavorWord_120215_Content: Everyone's safe and sound? Looks like I didn't practice for nothing, then!
FavorWord_120217_Content: <te href=850112>Jinzhou Patroller</te>, Chixia. You can always call on me if you ever find yourself in a pickle!
FavorWord_120222_Content: Huggghhh... I can feel the power! And the flames rising!
FavorWord_120223_Content: At this rate, the entire <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> City... No wait. The entirety of Huanglong shall be known to the heroic Chixia's name!
FavorWord_120224_Content: I've become a Human Torch! I am flame! With this power, I can now protect everyone, including someone as strong as you!
FavorWord_120236_Content: I can do this all day!
FavorWord_120248_Content: Now, what do we have here? Ya can't hide from me!
FavorWord_120249_Content: Chixia, Ally of Justice, at your service! Are you the one in need of a hero?
FavorWord_120250_Content: Whoa! You've made me so much stronger than I could have ever imagined! Now I'm finally the superhero I've always wanted to be! You've been here for me every step of the way, and you'll forever be the one I want to protect the most!
FavorWord_120267_Content: Ohhh... please have something good this time!
FavorWord_120268_Content: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!
FavorWord_120269_Content: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.
FavorWord_120270_Content: She was once the thunder that lit up my path ahead. I've always wanted to be like her, until I realized not everyone had that power. Now, I am happy with being a small flicker of flame, doing what I can to help people around me.
FavorWord_120271_Content: Sometimes they'd perform <te href=850131>liondance</te> between hero plays. That leading dancer, Lingyang, can put on quite a show for a small guy like him! The way he moves and swings around really makes for an awesome lion!
FavorWord_120272_Content: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old <te href=850093>Huanglong</te> saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?
FavorWord_120301_Content: Isn't weird that there's only one right answer to every question? I mean, even the Woolies in my box aren't all the same. They're not all cute and cuddly. Some may even have pointy teeth! "Baa!" ...You see?
FavorWord_120302_Content: Do you know what's under <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>' base? Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near. Are they keeping cool stuff and scary things down there?
FavorWord_120303_Content: Cosmos said you smell full of stories, and Cloudly told me you've been to many, many places. So, here's Encore's question of the day... What does it feel like to walk at night, when there's no stars in the sky? And... how's it like to be out there in the wild, all by yourself?
FavorWord_120304_Content: At the end of a show, everybody yells "Encore!" really loud, then the curtains open, and they play another song. That's super cool, right? So... If you're friends with Encore, your story will never come to an end!
FavorWord_120305_Content: I've got lots of friends now, but sometimes in my dreams, I'm still all alone. Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends… Erm. C-can you hug me a little?
FavorWord_120306_Content: What have you been up to today? Did you have fun? Saw anything cool? C'mon, spill the beans! Encore loves stories! And the feelings people share... they're like one story after another!
FavorWord_120307_Content: Mommy... will you be there in my dreams?
FavorWord_120308_Content: Here! You can have this chocolate, and I'll take your Star Flakes! And presto! Now you have yummy chocolate, and I have chocolate-flavored Star Flakes! How's that for a deal? Psst, It's a little trade secret I got from Aalto!
FavorWord_120309_Content: Ooh… Watch out! The ghosts of food you didn't finish will crawl out of your tummy and give you bad dreams... Boo! Gotcha!
FavorWord_120310_Content: Maybe one day, Encore will go everywhere in the world and be a hero too. Hehe, but first, what's for breakfast tomorrow?
FavorWord_120311_Content: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy. They're my best buddies! Don't worry, they're nice Woolies, they tell me lots and lots of stories!
FavorWord_120312_Content: Being happy is the bestest feeling, but it can't just be some pretend thing in a dream! Once upon a time, Encore was living in the happiest dream ever... but it had to stop, like all dreams do. Then when a dream is over, it's another brand new day ahead. Let's do our best!
FavorWord_120313_Content: ♪Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you...♪ Mommy used to sing this birthday song on Encore's birthdays! Now, Encore is singing it just for you. Here's to a new, happy life!
FavorWord_120315_Content: One sheep, two sheep... Three... Um? Where was I?
FavorWord_120316_Content: Encore spent a long, long time on this! Wanna have a bite? Hehe!
FavorWord_120317_Content: Hee-hee. Hi, there! I'm Encore from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>! Wanna go on an adventure with me and my Woolies?
FavorWord_120318_Content: Knew it! You can't do without Encore! Off we go!
FavorWord_120320_Content: What kinda story will Encore hear today?
FavorWord_120321_Content: This is wicked cool! It's just like in the stories... So Encore can beat up a bad dragon now?! Yay!
FavorWord_120322_Content: Woah! Is this "Rover Magic"!? Oh no you don't, you're not going anywhere unless you tell me your secrets!
FavorWord_120323_Content: The fire's getting warmer and prettier! Can we share it with other people? Encore wanna be a helper!
FavorWord_120324_Content: Woah, so that's how you did it! Encore's making it part of the story... You'll hear it when you've got the time.
FavorWord_120330_Content: No one picks on Encore's friends!
FavorWord_120351_Content: Ooh, shiny! It's gotta be a dragon's treasure!
FavorWord_120352_Content: Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out!
FavorWord_120353_Content: Verina's flowers are grown with love! Nothing like the ones they sell in the New Federation! But some of them looked a bit wacky, like the one that gobbled down on Aalto's head and gave him a new haircut… Gotta ask her what it's called next time!
FavorWord_120354_Content: Friends in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…
FavorWord_120355_Content: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!
FavorWord_120356_Content: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!
FavorWord_120357_Content: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.
FavorWord_120358_Content: Woah! Hey! Woolies, make some room! I wanna look, see? ...<te href=850109>Black Shores</te> member, Encore, reporting in!
FavorWord_120359_Content: Your adventure sounds so much fun! Encore really wanna go! Promise you'll take me next time? Pinky swear!
FavorWord_120366_Content: There has to be more. Right?
FavorWord_120401_Content: The Academy is working as fast as a Hoartoise. So many mysteries about you remain unanswered, yet my research proposals are still pending approval.
FavorWord_120402_Content: As a lone traveler, there must've been times when you were taken advantage of, but couldn't retaliate on the spot. If you ever find yourself in such a situation again... do not hesitate to bring me along.
FavorWord_120403_Content: Many believe having "talent" is a blessing, but ignore the curse that comes along: someday fate might take it away, quietly. Don't take your talent for granted—make the most of it, before it's too late.
FavorWord_120404_Content: Creating and sustaining connections requires reading between the lines, and speaking words that please... Even the same words can be interpreted differently, depending on the tone and context. It's too complicated for my liking. This is why I prefer straightforward individuals... and I'm glad you are one.
FavorWord_120405_Content: A powerful weapon can bring either justice, or devastation. The character and conviction of its wielder dictate how it's used, and that has a bearing on the judgement of those who crafted it. Now, if I entrust my works to you... to where will this decision lead me?
FavorWord_120406_Content: Music composition follows intricate regulations, much like balancing mathematical equations. This attention to rationalism is profound in classical music. I remember reading a score that sounded beautiful even when played in reverse. The composer was able to create something so mathematically precise, yet still kept all its beauty... I couldn't help wondering how.
FavorWord_120407_Content: Scientific research is but a tool. It's not magic. People tend to have unrealistic expectations about how research works, and you wouldn't want to be one of them.
FavorWord_120408_Content: I need an energy source to keep my brain going while I work, and sugar is the most effective choice. Candies always instantly improve my mood without leaving sticky residues on my fingers. Here, allow me to present you the Lemon Bomb, a proud work of mine. Care to have a taste?
FavorWord_120409_Content: It's important to take time savoring meals prepared with devotion and care, but never those shoddily manufactured instant foods; consuming them is only a disservice to my chewing muscles.
FavorWord_120410_Content: There is an abyssal gap between "knowing" and "understanding". I once assumed I knew the suffering of people stricken by <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, trapped in dread and hunger... After my departure from the New Federation, I realized how I wasn't even close to "understanding" any of them. Maybe there is still a gap between true understanding and what I know now; still, I must do what I can to remedy the situation, now that I am aware of it. I will create Tacetite weapons that are stronger than ever... and with that, grant humans the power to confront Tacet Discords.
FavorWord_120411_Content: Curious about this lighter? I use it to quell my temper when things get annoying. It's not about the flame that goes up in the instant; it's about the "click" it makes. Sounds nice, doesn't it? Try it yourself.
FavorWord_120412_Content: I knew a couple of researchers from the New Federation. Their worship of technology was fanatical, and it was exactly this fanaticism that clouded their judgment. They believed technological progress was an end in itself, rather than a means for achieving something else. As creators, we must recognize exactly what we are building, and for what purpose.
FavorWord_120413_Content: Happy birthday! I spend most of my time working in the lab, but days like this are not ones I'd easily forget. Here, I have made a multi-purpose tactical belt for you. This is the fifty-plus iteration of it, with an illuminator, a thruster, an air inflation module, and more. This should suffice for most situations you may encounter in the wild. If you want other features, come find me and I'll install them for you.
FavorWord_120414_Content: I still have much experiment data to process...
FavorWord_120415_Content: Precision, elegance, and harmony... These are the beautiful parallels between classical music and science.
FavorWord_120416_Content: With temperance and discipline, my flames will be kept in check.
FavorWord_120417_Content: Mortefi, researcher at Department of Safety, <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te>. For inquiries about Tacetite weapons, you may visit my lab. Make sure you know what you're talking about, though, before knocking at my door.
FavorWord_120418_Content: As always, I'm the one you need... I really can't win with you, can I? Let's just get this done.
FavorWord_120419_Content: Make this quick. I have experiments underway.
FavorWord_120420_Content: Dragging me out of my lab for this...*Yawn* You better have a good reason.
FavorWord_120421_Content: Hmm... Thank you, I appreciate it. From now on, you'll have priority access to me for any deliverables you need.
FavorWord_120422_Content: My thoughts feel sharper now... Wait, that could be an interesting concept. I should jot it down.
FavorWord_120423_Content: Such mystical power... If applied to Tacetite research, our progress will be remarkable.
FavorWord_120424_Content: Fine, since you've done this much for me... Go ahead, tell me the wildest inventions you can think of, and watch me make them happen for you.
FavorWord_120449_Content: It was Jiyan who rescued me from the wilderness and referred me to the Academy, and I've been thankful for that... I have solved a lot of problems for him in return, of course. For example, all the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> currently use a one-piece medical kit of my design.
FavorWord_120450_Content: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.
FavorWord_120451_Content: Baizhi and I are almost colleagues, though we don't work in the same department. I've only interacted with her briefly on a few occasions, but I had the chance to read some of her writings. Her paper was well-thought-out and carefully expressed, featuring an intriguing perspective. If I may comment, she is an excellent scholar of <te href=850076>Remnant</te> Creatures.
FavorWord_120452_Content: Speaking of Chixia, she's a regular visitor at my lab, often bringing children along. She's a straightforward person, which I like. Besides, those who get along with kids are never bad people. Kids are incredibly perceptive of a person's true character.
FavorWord_120453_Content: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!
FavorWord_120454_Content: Quit the chit-chat. Tell me what you need and I'll make it for you, provided your descriptions are reasonable.
FavorWord_120455_Content: Come find me when you need something made. Come find me... when you don't, too. Just idling by together, listening to music and indulging in some sweets... I'll be looking forward to that, if you're here with me.
FavorWord_120461_Content: Hmph... Quite good at hiding, aren't you?
FavorWord_120509_Content:
What food do I dislike? It's not something that crosses my mind often. 
Having traveled through barren lands where people suffer from starvation, I have learned to appreciate every bit of nourishment. 
Plus, there are endless culinary delights beyond the borders of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. 
Even if I spent years exploring, I doubt I could taste them all.
FavorWord_120510_Content: I have always dreamed of a world filled with peace and prosperity. Though I may not live to see it myself, I will do everything in my power to support those who continue to work towards that future. And when that day finally arrives, if you ever find yourself back in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, please take a moment to leave a cup of tea for me at my resting place.
FavorWord_120512_Content: Why did I quit my job in the capital and request a transfer to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>? It's quite simple, really. After the Battle Beneath the Crescent, there was no <te href=850084>Magistrate</te> in Jinzhou and the central government couldn't just sit by and let chaos reign. Also, my master had a strong connection to Mt. Firmament. He told me it would be the very place where I would find the one I needed to look for. I didn't quite understand his intentions then, but now... well, as they say, fate works in mysterious ways.
FavorWord_120513_Content: Jinhsi is a bright and diligent soul. With time, she will undoubtedly blossom into a capable <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>. She has always been dedicated to her work, perhaps too much so. She simply needs some time to find balance and fully embrace who she truly is. I am entrusting her care to you, Rover.
FavorWord_120514_Content: Upon my initial arrival in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I was tasked with handling paperwork at the City Hall for a temporary period. Despite sifting through countless documents and files, never once did I come across any issues regarding our border defenses. During the time when Jinzhou was lacking a <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, General Jiyan's unwavering efforts were essential in protecting the welfare of our people.
FavorWord_120517_Content: Chixia is a vibrant girl, radiating warmth and enthusiasm like a shining flame. She graciously showed me around <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, introducing me to all the local gems and delectable delicacies. Ah, yes, now I remember... The Spicy Pulled Chicken may seem intimidating to many, but it's just the right amount of spice for me.
FavorWord_120522_Content: I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know.
FavorWord_120605_Content: See that? Over there, just around the corner—that's Trattoria Margherita. Nearly everyone in our troupe has walked this alley; it's where we grew up. Out at sea, I'd wonder how <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> could turn its back on us, or what I'd do when I finally returned. I pictured a hundred things… but now, standing here, all I want is a slice of pizza... The sights and sounds of this city have always been a part of me.
FavorWord_120614_Content: She's got her course set and sticks to it, no matter what. Living as a <te href=850101>Montelli</te> is no easy path, but she's determined to make her own way. And mark my words, when her performances draw to a close, she'll be known not just as a Montelli, but Carlotta.
FavorWord_120621_Content: Brant's the name, captain of the <te href=850108>Fool's Troupe</te>! A pleasure to meet you, and please, call me whatever you'd like, for I'm but a humble Fool in pursuit of freedom. Enough with introductions now. Let's hand the stage over to everlasting joy and boundless liberty!
FavorWord_130101_Content: Misconceptions about us abound. Violence is just one tool in our arsenal, not our sole means to an end. Cooperation is our usual aim, but in a world of betrayal and deception, we must make sure backstabbing us is never worth the risk. To maintain efficient cooperation, we demand an ironclad contract with consequences... and that's where necessary violence comes in play.
FavorWord_130102_Content: You're quite good with your sword, but in a world like this, fighting alone will not suffice. Picture this: a single hound may not scare you, but what about a pack? Fear creeps in as you're trapped alone, with no one to guard your back, surrounded by enemies on all fronts. They aren't leaving without blood. Strength comes in numbers... Keep that in mind.
FavorWord_130103_Content: As a leader, one must excel in the art of deception, projecting an image of unwavering composure and offering false reassurance... Every decision you make could change lives. If a day comes when you are in charge of other people, or even the entire world, what choices will you make? Will you bear the weight of their fate, or prioritize your own desires above all else?
FavorWord_130104_Content: You've done your homework on us, it seems. As mercenaries, we take on any job and always deliver... The pay is our only concern. Wherever war and chaos go, the Ghost Hounds will follow. We exist, because there is always demand for our service. How do you perceive us? Though I couldn't care less about others' opinions... I'm open to your thoughts.
FavorWord_130105_Content: Someday, I may need your aid. If my actions steer the Ghost Hounds off course, I'll count on you to right my wrongs... or put an end to my existence. For now, I am happy to enjoy our current alliance.
FavorWord_130106_Content: Search, rescue, transportation, recon, group combat... Dogs are loyal and skilled in many ways. Me? I don't keep dogs. It's too dangerous... for the dogs, that is.
FavorWord_130107_Content: Hopefully, my guys aren't stirring up too much trouble back at the base...
FavorWord_130108_Content: <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>'s emergency rations. They taste slightly better than those made elsewhere.
FavorWord_130109_Content: ...Out in the wild, food preferences don't matter. I only care about what's edible.
FavorWord_130110_Content: Humans or <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, I'll eradicate any danger to the Ghost Hounds. It is my sole focus to protect my people, and secure any form of momentary respite when I can.
FavorWord_130111_Content: The deaths of our kind are likely to go unnoticed. It's our destiny—fleeting, like dust in the wind. Each of us bears a dog tag with our name and story etched upon it, as a form of legacy... A symbol of our existence, no less than a declaration of it.
FavorWord_130112_Content: In the Underworld, it's all about survival of the fittest. Either you dominate as the apex predator, or you're doomed to be devoured by those above you. It's the brutal law of the land. In a world where might makes right, we must rise to the very top to remain free from others' schemes, and preserve our autonomy.
FavorWord_130113_Content: He's a capable leader. He once recommended me an ancient tome on the art of war from <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, one that I regret not acquiring sooner—it could have saved me some effort. As for the deal between us... *scoff* It was merely an exchange of interests. Nothing more.
FavorWord_130114_Content: Pretentious, arrogant, and self-absorbed... That man epitomizes every trait associated with those snooty New Federation nobles. That said, I cannot deny his talent in crafting Tacetite Weapons. I can arrange a meeting with our trusted arms dealer, if he's interested.
FavorWord_130115_Content: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.
FavorWord_130116_Content: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.
FavorWord_130117_Content: I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.
FavorWord_130118_Content: Happy birthday. Is there anyone or anything bothering you? On this special day, I can offer my services at a discounted price to help rid you of your problems.
FavorWord_130122_Content: Calcharo, leader of the Ghost Hounds Mercenary Group. I suppose you've heard about what we do. Don't worry, your safety as my client will be guaranteed until the job is done.
FavorWord_130124_Content: You should have the payment ready by now.
FavorWord_130125_Content: Curious you'd want me to join you in person...
FavorWord_130126_Content: Let's see if the gains will be worth the effort.
FavorWord_130127_Content: This power you just gave me... Do you always trust others so easily?
FavorWord_130128_Content: ...Your kindness, I have certainly received. Naturally, I'll work for you in return.
FavorWord_130129_Content: Follow our rules and never betray us. As long as I'm alive, the name "Ghost Hounds" should command enough respect to grant you free reign over the continent.
FavorWord_130130_Content: *amused huff* Impressive, you've got a much bigger ambition than I thought. The offer you made is too enticing to ignore... Very well. I will repay you with my unwavering loyalty.
FavorWord_130131_Content: I owe you a debt that cannot be easily repaid. The Ghost Hounds have their stance to maintain, and I cannot make decisions for my people lightly. However, I am willing to accept this "contract"... on my own terms. Speak, and your wish will be granted, no questions asked.
FavorWord_130138_Content: Let slip the dogs of war!
FavorWord_130167_Content: The loot we find is not part of my pay. It's all yours.
FavorWord_130168_Content: I trust you can use it to the full.
FavorWord_130201_Content: Perhaps you haven't noticed, but you seem to always draw in some... rather interesting people. Not sure if it's a blessing or a curse for you, but it certainly makes my job easier... *chuckle* After all, my targets are usually the more peculiar types.
FavorWord_130202_Content: Contrary to what you may believe, many crimes are motivated by love and responsibility. Ironic, isn't it? The two fundamental values of human society can also lead to its downfall. When love becomes all-consuming and responsibility turns into obsession, crimes find fertile ground to thrive.
FavorWord_130203_Content: I've seen what you're capable of, so I'm not worried about you in a fair fight. That being said, not everyone plays fair. Just watch your back out there... wouldn't want you to get caught off your game.
FavorWord_130204_Content: The Fractsidus... You've dealt with them before, correct? Though we still don't know their origins or motives, I do know one thing from experience—criminals are most dangerous when we don't understand their intentions. You may run into them again anytime, so stay vigilant.
FavorWord_130205_Content: Being a secret agent means constantly adapting to new identities. When the situation calls for it, I'm ready to shed any of my current personas and slip into a new one. But with you, perhaps I can just be myself, Yinlin... and no one else. It doesn't feel awful... to have someone who knows and remembers me for who I truly am.
FavorWord_130206_Content: Speaking of the puppet show... It's an old tradition in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, though not as popular here as in other places. Dollmaker taught me the tricks to help me manipulate my own puppet better. More importantly, it's a useful way to hide in plain sight while performing. I can teach you a move or two, if you're interested.
FavorWord_130207_Content: Lately, it seems I've been "running into" you a lot lately... Just a heads up, I like to stay under the radar, and being seen with someone as high profile as you tends to attract unwanted attention... *pause, sigh* Not that I don't want to see you, but you'll need to be more subtle than that.
FavorWord_130208_Content: I've tried many so-called delicacies through my job, but none has left a lasting impression like the plate of Aureate Fried Rice I once had. I believe it's not the fancy ingredients that make a dish truly special, but the skill and care put into its preparation.
FavorWord_130209_Content: Dining with a target requires always catering to their taste. When the food is subpar, I know how to choke it down with a grin. That's why there isn't any dishes I truly dislike... It's not the food that ruins a meal, but the company. With you by my side, I suppose I'd be pleased to eat anything.
FavorWord_130210_Content: A utopia free of all vices and crimes may sound tempting, but once you think about it, it is nothing more than a naïve dream. That's why we exist—to uncover the hidden and unapproachable darkness that the majority refuse to acknowledge, and do the dirty work in their place.
FavorWord_130211_Content: This puppet? I call it Zapstring. It used to be a basic puppet made by some novice, but I've revamped it for battle. It hasn't let me down yet, despite its wear and tear.
FavorWord_130212_Content: Members of the Séance Society were lured in by Dollmaker's false promises, but they too must bear responsibility for what had transpired. I can only hope that upon their release, they will break from the illusions of the past... Despite the loss of loved ones, life must continue.
FavorWord_130213_Content: Happy birthday... What's with that look? Come on, I promise it's really your special day. And no, I'm not playing any games this time. Oh well. I can already tell you have nothing planned, so... Will you let me have you all to myself, for the entire day?
FavorWord_130215_Content: No rush. The impatient ones will fall right into our lap.
FavorWord_130217_Content: Name's Yinlin. As for what I do... Shhh, we don't talk about that in public.
FavorWord_130218_Content: Anything you need me to deal with?
FavorWord_130219_Content: So we're teaming up? Fine, though I'm more used to fighting alone.
FavorWord_130221_Content: Good. That did make me stronger... Should I start thinking about how to repay you?
FavorWord_130222_Content: For us undercover agents, fighting skills are just the bare minimum. The key to success is having an unbreakable will.
FavorWord_130223_Content: I have finer control over Zapstring now. It's all credit to you.
FavorWord_130224_Content: I will make good use of this power and fight by your side... We'll confront evil, wherever it lies.
FavorWord_130246_Content: Good. There's no time to waste.
FavorWord_130250_Content: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the <te href=850087>Patroller</te> position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.
FavorWord_130251_Content: Being skilled as a <te href=850087>Patroller</te> doesn't necessarily make one suited for undercover work, but curiously enough I see potential in you. Have you considered applying to the Bureau? Just kidding, unless you're interested.
FavorWord_130252_Content: What's that look on your face? Surprised to see me?
FavorWord_130253_Content: This special power you have entrusted me... Should I take it as a sign of trust in my abilities? Or...perhaps a token of affection for me? Either way, I appreciate the gesture. Your straightforwardness is quite endearing.
FavorWord_130301_Content: Hello there. What will it be for today? Are you here to put in some extra work, or maybe just to loosen up a bit? Of couse, you're welcome for a chat, too. One moment, I'll go make some tea for you.
FavorWord_130302_Content: Exercising is essential for us martial artists. Other people may not find the same importance in exercise, since everyone has their own unique strengths. After all, we no longer live in a time where brute force is the only solution. Or rather, brute force never really solved anything.
FavorWord_130303_Content: Rumors have been circulating about me, and I don't intend to stop them. My story isn't particularly exciting, but people find amusement in talking about it, that doesn't bother me. And with words about me getting out there, I might end up reeling in a few dunderheads. Whatever impression others may have of me, I trust your judgment will not be swayed. Or, if I may say so, I am happy to accept whatever you think of me.
FavorWord_130304_Content: I did hurt people in the past, sometimes with my hands, and sometimes through other means. Back then, I had to take the initiative... to make sure no more innocent people would fall prey to them. I had experience handling such things, and that was why I felt obligated to help. But I'm not telling you this in response to the rumors. I believe friendship is built on mutual understanding, and now is a good time for you to get to know me better.
FavorWord_130305_Content: When it comes to the business world, one is often told that it's impossible to find true friendship. I have to concede, nobody I've ever known has understood me as well as you do. Though my gym has many customers, you are the only one to have become a true friend of mine. You are, and will always be welcome at my gym, my friend.
FavorWord_130306_Content: A steaming cup of tea makes an excellent remedy for sore muscles after an intense workout. It's quite effective, you should give it a try.
FavorWord_130307_Content: Nestled between the borders, <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is subject to ever-changing weather. Sustaining the dried fish I've been making for Mimi has been a difficult task... Hmm, I suppose a solution will come to me in due time.
FavorWord_130308_Content: The solid ingredients of Jinzhou Stew blend effortlessly to form a simple dish. Back in the days when I had to live far away from home, it was the only dish that I could recreate to make me feel close to my roots. I can never have enough of it.
FavorWord_130309_Content: I'm not a big fan of foods that are hard to chew… Oh, it's got nothing to do with my teeth. I'm just not fond of the prickling sensation of stickiness in my mouth.
FavorWord_130310_Content: Well... I just want to maintain the stability I currently enjoy, and maybe keep my hometown safe, if I get the luxury to, haha.
FavorWord_130311_Content: Have I been keeping some kind of secret healthy drink in this flask, you ask? *chuckle* It's really just regular hot tea.
FavorWord_130312_Content: The stiffest tree is often broken by the harshest of winds, whereas the bamboo and willow survive by bending along. Finding harmony between strength and adaptability is integral to lasting success, be it in martial arts, commerce, or all aspects of life.
FavorWord_130313_Content: You're always tied up with affairs, how about relaxing a bit for a change on your birthday? Here, I got you an ordermade massager, some Angelica Tea leaves, and a personalized health management planner for the upcoming year. You really should prioritize your health. Self-care comes before anything else, including helping other people, my friend.
FavorWord_130314_Content: Oh? *chuckles*... Did you smell the dried fish I have?
FavorWord_130316_Content: Please don't worry. I've got it in check.
FavorWord_130317_Content: Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.
FavorWord_130319_Content: Anything I can help you with?
FavorWord_130320_Content: It's nice to take a break once in a while.
FavorWord_130321_Content: I haven't felt this tingling sensation swimming across my veins in a while... So this is all your doing? *chuckle* Looks like this is going to take some time getting used to.
FavorWord_130322_Content: Now that I've gotten used to it, this power feels robust and flexible. It does have something in common with my <te href=850114>Leihuangquan</te>.
FavorWord_130323_Content: Thanks to your help, my skills have improved and even my thunderbolts are stronger. Owing to your aid, I might be able to get a couple more scoundrels dealt with.
FavorWord_130324_Content: I can't thank you enough. With such power, I feel young and back to my prime days again. They say that time is invaluable. Doesn't that make the gift of power you've bestowed on me priceless? *chuckle*... Now, if you'd allow me some time, I should come up with a way to repay the favor.
FavorWord_130351_Content: Whether you need help with working out or maintaining your health, feel free to come by my gym. We welcome all visitors.
FavorWord_130352_Content: Since you've gifted me such a precious treasure, I should give you a matching gift in return. Please, take this Tea Pet—it grants you free access to all the boxing gyms and teahouses in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>. And... if you ever need me, just hand it to any one of the shopkeepers. I will come to your aid as soon as possible, no matter what.
FavorWord_130356_Content: Nice. Let's go check it out.
FavorWord_130357_Content: Found what you're looking for? Good.
FavorWord_130359_Content: Lingyang often visits my gym to play with Mimi just outside the front doors, always carrying a couple of fresh tetras as treats. I guess it might be his thank-you to Mimi for all the agility training they had done together. He sure is a thoughtful young man.
FavorWord_130360_Content: I am more than happy to get an outstanding training partner like Jianxin by merely offering her a simple meal... Of course, I'm always pleased to spend time with her over a meal, whether she's here to train with me or not.
FavorWord_130361_Content: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.
FavorWord_130362_Content: Every morning, when I opened the gym, Chixia was already patrolling the street with exuberant energy. *chuckle*... I must keep up with my exercises too. Can't be outdone by the younger generations.
FavorWord_130363_Content: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.
FavorWord_130401_Content: Welcome to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, esteemed guest from afar. My apologies for any shortcomings in my hospitality; my schedule is quite full. If there is a matter requiring my attention, please do not hesitate to find me at City Hall.
FavorWord_130402_Content: The bustling city of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is a product of every blooming flower, sturdy brickwork, and occupied home. With every new visitor, the city gains new life. Among them, you are truly one of a kind... No, I am not simply repeating what our <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> has said. These words come from my heart as well.
FavorWord_130403_Content: An old proverb states, "When a great mind emerges, even the sea will part and the mountains will tremble." It speaks to the transformative power of extraordinary individuals... With your presence in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I believe great changes will come in due time.
FavorWord_130404_Content: I used to be quite curious about your background. However, I've come to realize that one's actions hold more weight than their past. Your past may shape you, but it is your present deeds that truly define you. Having witnessed everything you have done for <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I cannot help but notice the mysterious connections between them... Perhaps there is something deeper behind your arrival in Jinzhou.
FavorWord_130408_Content: If you haven't yet, I highly recommend visiting <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>'s morning market. The breakfast stall vendor sells the most delicious Loong Buns topped with plump red dates. As they steam, their sweet aroma envelops the air. They are truly a delight.
FavorWord_130409_Content: <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> once suffered from severe food shortages because of the <te href=850075>Lament</te> crisis. As someone who lived through that difficult time, I've learned to understand that food is not something to be taken lightly. Every morsel is a gift from Mother Nature as are those who work tirelessly to cultivate it... Personally, I have no dislikes when it comes to food, except for wasteful extravagance or exorbitant prices.
FavorWord_130410_Content: People prayed to the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> not out of weakness, but because they had no other recourse. As leader, I will guide my people towards a future where humanity takes control of our own destiny.
FavorWord_130412_Content: The snows of Mt. Firmament... I still vaguely remember how the snowflakes there danced in their own whimsical ways. One moment they were hovering in the air, and the next moment they flew upwards into the sky, twirling around the tree branches... Before long, everything was coated in a shimmering blanket of white. In <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, the snow brings a sense of peaceful togetherness. Strangers become friends as they brush off each other's shoulders and build snowmen together...
