Whether the snow is light or heavy, I pray to always protect these precious moments of pure tranquility.
FavorWord_130416_Content: "Qingloong rise, monsters gone"... Every child in Jinzhou knows this nursery rhyme by heart. My faith rests with Jiyan, for with his protection the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> will never breach our borders.
FavorWord_130418_Content: After much contemplation, I have decided that a handmade gift will better express my feelings than any expensive store-bought present. Every day since learning of your birthday, I have devoted time to crafting a Loong lantern from materials I've handpicked. Fortunately, I've finished it in time. If you could find time in your busy schedule, please join me at the City Hall to fly this lantern together. It is a beloved tradition in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> to make a wish upon a soaring lantern on one's birthday, and it is said that the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> will bestow blessings for the year ahead.
FavorWord_130420_Content: I am Jinhsi, the <te href=850118>Magistrate of Jinzhou</te>. My role holds great power and duty. I vow to serve my people with diligence and bring prosperity to our land.
FavorWord_130421_Content: As the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> foretold, you and I were meant to cross paths.
FavorWord_130425_Content: No one is born good at anything. As the <te href=850118>Magistrate of Jinzhou</te>, I must constantly learn and improve.
FavorWord_130426_Content: As the new <te href=850084>Magistrate</te>, I initially worried about my lack of ability to protect my people. But soon, I realized that dwelling on self-doubt only hindered my progress, so I trained harder. With each session, my strengths grew. It is an honor to serve and defend my people. I'll always strive to improve as their Magistrate.
FavorWord_130427_Content: Thank you for your guidance. I have seen growth in my strength and leadership abilities, and it seems you have taught me more than just swordsmanship; you've taught me valuable life lessons.
FavorWord_130428_Content: I am aware that I have rather peculiar frequencies. It is rare for me to encounter someone whose vibrations align with mine so perfectly... Could it be that you also share a mysterious connection with our <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>? I do hope so, as that would make me feel… even closer to you.
FavorWord_130429_Content: As I get to know you better, I can't help but notice the similarities between us. Our frequencies, powers, and even purposes seem to align. Defending <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> is my duty, and now I sense a deep connection between you and this land… I once believed that mankind should control our own destiny, but my meeting with you has shown me the power of fate. I am grateful for its hand in bringing you into my life.
FavorWord_130471_Content: The lands of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> are filled with riches.
FavorWord_130501_Content: I first heard about you when my colleagues were discussing your physical. I was caught up in technical support back then, but wanted to meet you in person. Now, I am content to see that, as I predicted... you have the potential to shape <te href=850079>Solaris-3</te>'s future in unforeseen ways.
FavorWord_130510_Content: The laws of nature on <te href=850079>Solaris</te> have shifted under the <te href=850075>Lament</te>'s sway, and even fundamental principles are now being questioned across all academic fields. Yet, I find the pursuit of new theories quite stimulating. Deep within the cosmos, beyond the stars, lies a vast expanse waiting to be understood. And there, amidst the barren landscape, truth awaits its discovery.
FavorWord_130514_Content: <te href=850084>Magistrate</te> Jinhsi has been paying close attention to the battles against Tacet Discords. She often visits the Academy to learn about our latest progress in weapons development. During those visits, she always seems tense. I understand the pressure and weight she carries, with all the promises and expectations placed on her shoulders...
FavorWord_130515_Content: The <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> bring valuable insights on <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> from their years of combat experience. General Jiyan has shared his extensive knowledge and new ideas with us. He possesses a gentle and just nature, but what truly sets him apart is his composure. This is essential for someone in his position.
FavorWord_130516_Content: Aalto once approached me with an offer from <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, but I declined. Life at the Academy suits me well. Though his manner may seem unserious, Aalto has a sharp eye for valuable information and connections for rare materials. I've frequently relied on his services.
FavorWord_130518_Content: Happy birthday. Please, extend your hand. With the <te href=850075>Lament</te> crisis stalling our deep space exploration, our understanding of the galaxy has been limited. But this... See? This is a glimpse of the unchanging universe, brimming with secrets and tranquility, just for you. If my theories about your true place of origin are correct... I hope this memento offers some solace.
FavorWord_130522_Content: My name is Xiangli Yao, a researcher at the <te href=850092>Huaxu Academy</te>. Rover, your rare resonance frequencies raise an intriguing question: are you a unique beacon of insight in our quest for truth? Or do you already hold the ultimate truth in your hand?
FavorWord_140201_Content: If anything feels unfamiliar or unaccommodating, you can always ask me for help, Rover. This isn't only because you are our guest. It's just... you have no memory or any friends here in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. I think there might be moments when you'd need me.
FavorWord_140202_Content: Since I became an <te href=850139>Outrider</te>, I've met people from all walks of life in the wild. Some always seemed in such haste, yet remained unsure where they were heading, and often ended up lost. On the other hand, those who had a clear destination in mind usually did make it, despite arduous roads and occasional stumbles. I aspire to be one of the latter, and leaving home for Jinzhou was the first step I took.
FavorWord_140203_Content: I've been able to hear what the Streams have to tell me for as long as I can remember. They are not sounds produced by the vibrations of air, nor sentences spoken in any known language. They are signals carried by the wind, tangible to me whenever I focus myself to feel those incorporeal, rippling airstreams. The wind that flowed beside my ears just whispered another spellbinding story. Do you wish to hear it?
FavorWord_140204_Content: The Streams make an unusual ripple whenever they flow beside you, as if they are being drawn to you once they come close. I don't know what that implies, but I'm sure I won't settle for standing aside and watching, no matter the implications. If circumstances permit, I want to face everything with you.
FavorWord_140205_Content: Call my name whenever you need me. From desolate lands to vibrant cities, from the beginning prologue to the final epilogue... no matter what awaits us in the end of this journey, no matter what kind of storm you are about to bring, I want to witness everything with you, as long as you'd let me.
FavorWord_140206_Content: Songs are resonating thoughts from the bottom of our hearts. They represent a person's truest feelings.
FavorWord_140207_Content: I want to do as much as I can for everyone in need, but if I take on more than I can handle... I guess it would only trouble those on the receiving end of my help, and burden me further.
FavorWord_140208_Content: Wuthercake is a national dish in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, though how it is made varies depending on the region. They make delicious Wuthercakes here in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, but for me, homemade Wuthercakes are always the best. When we have the chance, would you come home with me, and have a taste of my mother's Wuthercakes?
FavorWord_140209_Content: Shouldn't we cherish all food and not let any go to waste? Oh... Well, if it's truly badly cooked, then.. uhm...
FavorWord_140210_Content: We all have an appreciation for beauty, but life isn't always full of it. I don't want to always rely on the comforts and safety others provide me with. I must be brave to face the ugly truth. I must be one that guards and gives.
FavorWord_140211_Content: Interested in my ribbon? It's a farewell gift from my mother back when I left for <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. I consider it a sign of a new chapter in my life, one which symbolizes rebirth. I hope it will continue to remind me I should always follow my heart.
FavorWord_140212_Content: My senses are sharper than most, though it used to cause me severe distress. Various stimuli seemed to come at me from all directions, slamming into my mind at once. I felt like a lone feather, tossed around in a wild storm. Don't worry... I am okay now. I have found a way to stabilize myself in the Streams, and it was the Stream's message that led me to you.
FavorWord_140213_Content: Today is very special. It's your big day. So... *clears throat* happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you... Rover, I hope I can sing for you on your birthday this year, then your next birthday, and then the birthday after your next birthday.
FavorWord_140214_Content: Buoyant and languid... where will the wind take you?
FavorWord_140216_Content: With every meeting... comes the inevitable parting. Let's not dwell on it.
FavorWord_140217_Content: I am Yangyang, a temporary <te href=850139>Outrider</te> of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>, responsible for detecting and investigating anomalies. The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.
FavorWord_140219_Content: The skylark's song is about to sound.
FavorWord_140220_Content: I will do my best to help everyone.
FavorWord_140221_Content: The Streams are getting louder. What do they have to tell me?
FavorWord_140222_Content: I've never felt such strength in me. It's all thanks to you, isn't it? I am forever grateful, Rover, for everything you've done for me.
FavorWord_140223_Content: Streams are converging from all sides, and I stand in their midst, expecting the wind's arrival.
FavorWord_140224_Content: I dedicate my song to brilliance, braving the raging storm. The skylark in me has never soared higher into the heavens.
FavorWord_140236_Content: I should... Give it my all...
FavorWord_140249_Content: On the dangerous frontiers where we suffered immense losses, it was General Jiyan who stepped up to protect everyone, making all the tough decisions to ensure our safety. As the backbone of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>, he has led us to countless victories as our Qingloong. The weight on his shoulders is beyond our imagination.
FavorWord_140250_Content: "When in trouble, ask Chixia, the Ally of Justice!" This statement, while playful, rings very true. With her surging passion, seasoned prowess, and abundant vigor, Chixia already meets every quality a hero should have, helping the people in need.
FavorWord_140251_Content: Baizhi has a unique approach to comprehending and accomplishing tasks, but that doesn't make her a difficult person to talk to. When you ask her for help, you may notice a flicker of surprise on her face, but you will never receive a refusal.
FavorWord_140252_Content: I met Danjin a few times on different occasions. I could tell how much she values justice. She is very clear about when to unsheath her blade, and for what she fights, despite being surprisingly young. Her actions reflect her belief in an ideal world—one that she is determined to create.
FavorWord_140253_Content: Ms. Taoqi is always gracefully poised. She is the kind of person to quickly produce multiple solutions with ease in the most urgent situations, with a smile on her face: "Don't worry. I've got it sorted." Her seemingly unhurried demeanor must have been earned through hard work that we don't know about.
FavorWord_140254_Content: The Streams have guided me to you. I have a feeling we'll be companions for many moons to come.
FavorWord_140255_Content: This is it... Rover, you have already done so much for me, I shouldn't ask for more. From now on, I want to be the one taking care of you. Please... will you let me? I hope I can be the one to embrace all that you are, and share with you all that you carry.
FavorWord_140258_Content: This is the answer to our endeavor.
FavorWord_140259_Content: This should suffice for a while.
FavorWord_140301_Content: Being a broker such as myself, it is essential to establish good relationships to maintain a stable customer base. You still have some uncertainties about this world, it seems. We should really establish a connection, you know? If there's ever anything you wish to know in the future, I'll make sure you receive the best price for my services.
FavorWord_140302_Content: Since we're buddies now, here's some quick business tips. Like they say in <te href=850093>Huanglong</te>, "your sweet deal might be someone else's poison." It's all about perspective. You can sell the same intel for different prices depending on who you're selling to. Just a little bit of spin and you've got yourself a high-paying customer. Hmm? Nuh-uh, that's not lying! I'd like to call it reasonable strategy in meeting various demands.
FavorWord_140303_Content: Being "popular" attracts wealth… and sometimes unwanted attention. You get the occasional oddball who tries to push for a deal. Well, special customers call for special measures. If only all of 'em were as chill to talk to as you.
FavorWord_140304_Content: Info brokers love to play games with their words. You can't just believe everything they say, but you can't ignore them either. It's like trying to see through fog, but if you put in the effort, you'll uncover real gems hidden beneath their half-truths. But with me, it's easy. You know me, I've always been honest with you, buddy.
FavorWord_140305_Content: I've been told I'm all about networking, not real friendships. Well, can't say I'd deny that. I don't want anything getting in the way of my judgment, so I tend to keep things strictly business with everyone. But now, I guess you're different. You always are. You have a way of swaying my decisions just by being around, as my friend or not.
FavorWord_140306_Content: In our line of work, being too buddy-buddy with people and exposing weaknesses is a big no-no. Hmm… I can't say 'No' to you, I guess. I don't have anything in particular for hobbies, just some little mist tricks to give everyone a good laugh from time to time.
FavorWord_140307_Content: With everything in this world so unpredictable, why sweat yourself all the time? When you're feeling gloomy, just hit me up. I'll get you straightened out, no strings attached.
FavorWord_140308_Content: Encore's Coral Bowl looks weird, but it sure tastes great. It practically dissolves on your tongue and leaves a nice, mellow flavor. You should give it a try. C'mon, what's up with the side eye? You've got to trust me on this one. The stuff may look like coral, but it's completely harmless, really.
FavorWord_140309_Content: You know how some people make all kinds of excuses for their poor decisions? Take my old man, for example, pointing the finger at booze for his messed up life. Better stay away from things that numb your mind, don't you agree?
FavorWord_140310_Content: To live free as the mist and enjoy life while it lasts. Sounds wonderful, doesn't it?
FavorWord_140311_Content: Hmm, curious about what this is? Nope—not a bone flute, it's a tape recorder. Funny little devices like this always come in handy in a pinch. Why don't we get you some next time?
FavorWord_140312_Content: Believe it or not but when I was young, our house was like a revolving door for debt collectors, thanks to my dad's gambling habit. Boy, did I hate my life having to put up with it all back then. So hey, don't you think your poor buddy deserves a few extra clients, after everything he's been through?
FavorWord_140313_Content: Heya! Happy Birthday, my most special patron! Got you a custom-made mist-maker. It may not look like much, but all you have to do is give it a little twist to have mists of all shapes and sizes... And Voila! Here's a kitten for ya, how'd you like it? Now whenever you're feeling down, just turn your troubles into mist and watch them fade away.
FavorWord_140314_Content: Credibility in the name, and customer satisfaction is the game.
FavorWord_140315_Content: I never miss out on a good deal.
FavorWord_140317_Content: Howdy! I'm Aalto, your go-to information broker. I've got all the info you need at fair prices. Knowledge about different places is key to staying ahead while you're out and about. Interested in a quote?
FavorWord_140318_Content: Any detail along the way could become valuable intel.
FavorWord_140319_Content: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.
FavorWord_140320_Content: It's go time! You'll have my mist for escort.
FavorWord_140321_Content: Whew—I can make more mist now. Thanks, I'll offer you something extra next time.
FavorWord_140322_Content: Hmm? You never fail to impress. My mist can reach even further now. Sweet! And that'll be another intel on the house for ya!
FavorWord_140323_Content: Now I can switch between any kind of mist as I please. Much appreciated, bud! If you need anything, just ask away. I'll do my best to oblige!
FavorWord_140324_Content: Whoa, talk about sincerity. I'll make this worth your while, of course. My mist will be with you at all times, you can trust me to have your back.
FavorWord_140326_Content: Phew. In the nick of time.
FavorWord_140327_Content: How's that for a magic trick?
FavorWord_140330_Content: Lost in the mist of time.
FavorWord_140331_Content: Can't we just talk this out?
FavorWord_140336_Content: Time to bring out my A-game.
FavorWord_140338_Content: Don't worry... Just a trick of the eye...
FavorWord_140348_Content: Well, would you look at that! Easy money.
FavorWord_140349_Content: Say, buddy, we should probably take care of those bills you owe me. Let's see here… Hmm, you know what? I actually made a good chunk of change from the intel you asked for, so why don't we just call it even? Swing by anytime and let's do more business!
FavorWord_140352_Content: Aaand… What's inside mystery box No. 01!?
FavorWord_140353_Content: Sometimes not even I can figure out just where Encore's getting all that energy from. As soon as we arrive somewhere, she's off making friends and sharing stories with the local kids in no time. I even got some of my intel from her buddies, believe it or not.
FavorWord_140354_Content: Being the <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> Garrison's General is no walk in the park. You gotta have that big-picture thinking, be on top of everything, and make decisions like they're nothing. Just take a look at General Jiyan—he's got all those boxes checked off and then some.
FavorWord_140355_Content: Oh, Miss Chixia. Our first convo didn't go quite as planned. I was doing some business in Jinzhou at the time, then she tried to arrest me, probably thought I was some crook. Lucky for me we worked it out later.
FavorWord_140356_Content: Miss Yangyang? We haven't talked much, but the way she can tap into the "Streams" for intel is definitely something. As someone in the information game, that really sounds handy. I should see if she's interested in being my informant.
FavorWord_140357_Content: Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.
FavorWord_140358_Content: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.
FavorWord_140359_Content: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.
FavorWord_140360_Content: That little girl from Rigg's Explorers? Yeah, I bumped into her once, back in the New Federation. Offered me a Starflower for the whereabouts of her mother. But the deal fell through, because she didn't have what I was asking for. And what was that, you ask? Well… I asked for a never-withering flower. In reply, she told me plants have their life cycle, and wilting is just a natural part of it. I remember telling her, "The same can be said for humans."
FavorWord_140361_Content: G'day. What does our loyal client wish to inquire about today?
FavorWord_140401_Content: I have long been stationed in the borderlands, with little knowledge of entertainment or places of leisure. However, if you are looking for tactics against <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te> or beautiful natural vistas, I can provide some suggestions.
FavorWord_140402_Content: While the borderlands cannot rival the city's clamor and glamor, they do possess their unique charm. Should you find time, I suggest you come and witness the full moon and twinkling stars that grace the tranquil night skies. Rest assured, your safety will not be a concern; I will be there with you.
FavorWord_140403_Content: The <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> are a source of solace for many, while I see them as a scalpel, with the duty of eradicating maladies. Me? I am the hand that guides this scalpel, I suppose.
FavorWord_140404_Content: Soldiers of the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te> have entrusted their lives to me. Therefore, every time I wield the scalpel, I must do so with absolute precision so as not to betray their trust. One day, this scalpel will eradicate all <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>, and when that moment arrives, I hope you can witness it with me.
FavorWord_140405_Content: Flowers in the Knell Square are planted to honor the deceased. These flowers are of a unique variety, and they require significant attention. Here is a cultivation guide. If I fail to keep my promise of witnessing humanity's victory with you, please plant one of these flowers there for me.
FavorWord_140406_Content: Though I no longer practice medicine, I still discuss medical knowledge with my mother in my spare time. This gourd-shaped pill case is a gift from her the year I joined the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>.
FavorWord_140407_Content: In just a few days, a thin layer of dust has collected on my desk. Cleaning is not a challenge, but consistency is.
FavorWord_140408_Content: Jinzhou Stew is renowned for its wide variety of ingredients and easy preparation, making it a beloved homemade dish in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>. Having been stationed in the borderlands for most of my time, I sometimes miss that taste.
FavorWord_140409_Content: In <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, there is a vegetable known as "Bittberry". It possesses a bitter and slightly astringent flavor, and is renowned for its detoxifying properties. When I was young, my mother was somehow convinced "those who can endure bitterness will rise above others." She frequently incorporated this vegetable into our meals. I must confess that its taste was far from pleasant. However, now serving in the army, I have grown accustomed to its flavor. After all, resources are scarce, and it is crucial not to squander them.
FavorWord_140410_Content: If one day, the borderlands no longer need a general, I suppose my wish will have come true.
FavorWord_140411_Content: This spear was modeled after the weapon of Captain Beiwang, bearing the significance of quelling chaos and warding off external threats.
FavorWord_140412_Content: My family has been in the medical profession for generations. I once aspired to follow in their footsteps, saving lives and providing care. However, I soon realized that a doctor could never fully alleviate the pain caused by the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>. It was this realization that led me to join the <te href=850086>Midnight Rangers</te>. Over the years, I have found my way of bringing solace to the world.
FavorWord_140413_Content: I have worn this vambrace since my first battle. It saved my life countless times. A vambrace like this is believed to bring good luck, ensuring the safe return of soldiers. Though it may show signs of wear, I wish to pass on this luck to you. Additionally, I have prepared a few travel essentials that I hope will prove useful. Happy birthday.
FavorWord_140417_Content: Jiyan, of the Midnight Rangers. Protecting our lands and people is my solemn duty. Should you encounter any difficulties here, I will do my utmost to help.
FavorWord_140418_Content: Should you find yourself lost, follow the banner of the Qingloong.
FavorWord_140419_Content: When danger arises, take cover behind me.
FavorWord_140420_Content: The battlefield is dynamic. Do not let your guard down.
FavorWord_140421_Content: I can sense an improvement in my strength. I suppose you are well-versed in the art of training, too?
FavorWord_140422_Content: So you have opted for a prudent strategy this time. Next time, maybe we can consider something more unconventional.
FavorWord_140423_Content: Remarkable strategy. Your insight provides me with unique and refreshing perspectives that I have not considered before.
FavorWord_140424_Content: With your bold plan, my Qingloong has gained more momentum on the battlefield. I appreciate your assistance.
FavorWord_140452_Content: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.
FavorWord_140453_Content: The "battle" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement. Every time I return to <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>, I can feel the city's vibrancy and enthusiasm, all thanks to her meticulous governance.
FavorWord_140454_Content: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>'s fortifications.
FavorWord_140455_Content: She can perceive minute changes in the surroundings from the Streams, but there is a limit to the amount of information a single person can take in. Excessive use of this ability might add to her burden, and I hope she won't strain herself.
FavorWord_140456_Content: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.
FavorWord_140457_Content: That energetic and passionate <te href=850087>Patroller</te>? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>.
FavorWord_140458_Content: Fog can be an enemy to soldiers on the march, as it limits visibility and complicates situational awareness. However, deploying fog strategically can be an effective move on the battlefield. I have had the opportunity to work with Aalto before, and he is an interesting person indeed.
FavorWord_140459_Content: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.
FavorWord_140460_Content: I have never regretted braving the long night.
FavorWord_140461_Content: Commanding an army is not a simple task, and sometimes I find myself questioning my own decisions. Going forward, with you staying by my side, I should feel more at ease.
FavorWord_140465_Content: Wouldn't hurt to be more prepared.
FavorWord_140501_Content: You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!
FavorWord_140502_Content: Erm, actually... I wonder just how you seem to know so much. I've been to the cities a few times, but I know very little compared to you. Can I ask you for help next time I run into things I don't understand? Please bear with me, though, as it may take me some time to catch on...
FavorWord_140503_Content: I grew up in my sect, on a remote, secluded mountain. Most people may find it a bit challenging to make it there, but it should be easy for you. I can take you there if you want. Hehe, honestly, I've always wanted to bring you home as my guest!
FavorWord_140504_Content: I wasn't the brightest kid, but I was lucky to find my talent in martial arts. That's why I really admire people with both brains and courage. Of all the smart people I know, you're the best, being a great martial artist and a true defender of justice. You are the one I look up to the most, beside my masters.
FavorWord_140505_Content: I adore being part of nature's harmony. Every songbird in the sky, every leaf on the ground, and every glimmer of sunlight makes me feel a serene joy, as the sweet breezes surround me, whispering life's many blessings. Your presence brings me the same kind of feeling, Rover. With you, everything feels so right, like I belong where I should.
FavorWord_140506_Content: My life's goal is to one day fully master Fengyiquan. For me, every place—be it in the valley, on a mountain peak, or a bustling market—provides an opportunity to perfect my art. I find joy in connecting with various energies and Chi available across different places; this connection gives me new chances of growth.
FavorWord_140507_Content: Worthy opponents are always hard to find. I always yearn for a good fight from which I can learn and improve myself. That said, I'm not too invested in looking for challenges anymore. One can only find inner peace when they let go of their desires. I can find my growth without engaging in frequent battles.
FavorWord_140508_Content: My favorite food? It's the Guokui Flatbread! We'd always have it at our sect, and when I was little, I got extra servings like other younger disciples. Master Shiling even said that I'd followed his scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how I joined our sect. I'm not sure if it was true or not though, he loves to rib us like that sometimes.
FavorWord_140509_Content: There isn't any particular food that I dislike. I'm not much of a food person, I guess. People mix various ingredients for a variety of purposes—to gain muscle, to treat illnesses, or to stay healthy. The flavors of these food combinations are just natural outcomes. All types of food serve a purpose and can be beneficial.
FavorWord_140510_Content: Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.
FavorWord_140511_Content: I got the Mirrors of Clarity from Master Shiling when I was little. The mirrors represented my masters' good wishes for me: to stay dedicated, disciplined, and become a well-rounded individual. Each day, I carry them with me to honor their teachings, but more importantly, to remind myself of how much they cared for me.
FavorWord_140512_Content: To reach where our sect is, one must take the Ancient Path—it's the only way up the mountain. This is usually difficult for new disciples, but Master Shiling said when he took me in, I almost made it up the mountain as fast as he did. He said I was like a little wild animal: agile, vibrant, and naive. I can't remember any of that, though. The earliest memory I have is practicing martial arts with fellow disciples.
FavorWord_140513_Content: Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.
FavorWord_140514_Content: Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.
FavorWord_140515_Content: I've only celebrated birthdays for my masters and fellow disciples before, and we'd usually make peach buns of longevity for the birthday person. So... here, I've made some peach buns for you! Happy Birthday! I wish you good health and great happiness!
FavorWord_140518_Content: What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...
FavorWord_140519_Content: I am Jianxin, the successor of <te href=850134>Fengyiquan</te>. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?
FavorWord_140520_Content: Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.
FavorWord_140522_Content: What will I learn from this fight?
FavorWord_140524_Content: This is a different practice, but it feels similar to how I usually do seated cultivation as my master taught. Hmm... how do I put this? I'll tell you once I've come up with a better way to describe.
FavorWord_140525_Content: Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!
FavorWord_140526_Content: This is... the feeling of standing on top of a mountain, watching the billowing sea of clouds beneath my feet. The spirit within me resonates with every life in this universe... Yes, that's it! That's how it feels! I've finally figured out how to put this feeling into words!
FavorWord_140527_Content: Now my body and mind have gained a newfound clarity, and even my senses are keener than before. The Chi that surrounds me seems more... Oh no! Sorry! Are you alright? Phew... I should have paid more attention to keep it in check. I'll focus on improving my control of this power from now on. Thank you, Rover! I'm now another step closer to my goal!
FavorWord_140528_Content: Is this real? I can't believe... Thank you, for everything you've done for me. No one, apart from my masters, has shown me more kindness in this life than you have. I can never repay in full what I owe to you, but I want to try anyway. There is something I've wanted to tell you for a while now: beyond seeking martial excellence, I've found another goal in life—to do everything I can for you, until my very last breath.
FavorWord_140554_Content: A contented mind is a perpetual feast.
FavorWord_140555_Content: Hmm. What's it gonna be this time?
FavorWord_140705_Content: A stranger sailed from distant shores and, after a grand debut, was crowned <te href=850103>Laureate</te> of the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te>. How's that for a story? This tale will be sung through the ages. I'll have the wind carry it across time's endless sea, echoing in eternity.
FavorWord_140714_Content: There was a time when I thought about telling her the truths about the Order, but after seeing her devotion as she stood in front of the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s statue, praying for the people of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, I abandoned the idea. For an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> as kind as she is, perhaps the truth may do more harm than good, just as it did to me.
FavorWord_140729_Content: In a vast world, we journeyed across plains and explored ancient underground ruins. Finally, we pushed open the heavy doors of a tavern, dropped bags of <te href=850104>Shell Credits</te> on the table, and began singing our legends. As for whether the story is artistically embellished... Ha, I believe we should approach life with a romantic outlook.
FavorWord_150102_Content: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
FavorWord_150103_Content: It is natural to feel dreadful of the unknown, yet... there are times when the unknown harbors hope, like how I can never know what else this power has to offer.
FavorWord_150104_Content: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.
FavorWord_150106_Content: I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.
FavorWord_150107_Content: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.
FavorWord_150108_Content: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.
FavorWord_150109_Content: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.
FavorWord_150110_Content: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.
FavorWord_150111_Content: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.
FavorWord_150202_Content: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
FavorWord_150204_Content: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.
FavorWord_150206_Content: Let me be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.
FavorWord_150207_Content: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.
FavorWord_150208_Content: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.
FavorWord_150209_Content: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.
FavorWord_150210_Content: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.
FavorWord_150211_Content: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.
FavorWord_150301_Content: Do you know? The little flower next to you really likes you! I heard it talking about it. Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.
FavorWord_150302_Content: You saw me in the Dim Forest late at night? My bad, I was probably too caught up waiting for a Noctemint to blossom to notice you. Those plants wait their whole lives for that one bloom. I think they'd be happy to have someone there, witnessing and recording it all.
FavorWord_150303_Content: O-of course we can talk about something other than plants. I do take breaks from the greenhouse, you know. Um... Do you like Morri Pot? The various types of mushrooms in it are so... What? M-mushrooms are not plants. They're fungi!
FavorWord_150304_Content: When you have the time, how about we take a walk together? The world is going to look very different when you don't have a particular destination in mind. Want to give it a try?
FavorWord_150305_Content: Sometimes, it feels like the two of us are dandelion seeds, drifting wherever the wind takes us. We have our ups and downs, just like weathering a storm, but one day we may finally land and flourish, after a good rain. Rover, as fellow travelers, let's embrace what lies ahead, wherever and whenever we may be. To me, that's what truly makes life worth living.
FavorWord_150306_Content: During my free time, I enjoy strolling around <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te> on my own. Every brick and tile looks slightly different from one another, and I can find resilient little flowers growing in the cracks. The streets are always bustling with people, and the smell of steaming food brings a cozy atmosphere. Whenever I wander around and take in all these sights and sensations, I feel... hmm, is "invigorated" the right word for it?
FavorWord_150307_Content: I've noticed a trend of people sharing Terminal-generated images online, saying those must be new plant species. While I understand their interest and curiosity, I'm worried this could mislead the public. As a botanist myself, I always try to be accurate and honest when I'm sharing information about plants. I've been wanting to find a way to help people tell the difference between fake images and real photos, but it seems there's still a lot of work to do. What should I do...
FavorWord_150308_Content: My mom always said milk would help me grow taller, like how plants need fertilizer. And every time I drink it, I feel warm and cozy. Maybe that's what happiness feels like.
FavorWord_150309_Content: I'm not a big fan of big, greasy dishes—like steaks... It's not that they aren't tasty, I just hate the idea of letting food go to waste if I can't finish it. It doesn't sit right with me...
FavorWord_150310_Content: Maintaining a balanced ecosystem is no easy feat, especially when it involves regulating the population of various species. But what if we could grow flowers that have a calming effect on the <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>? This could greatly reduce the strain on our frontline soldiers and potentially save lives.
FavorWord_150311_Content: My adventure journal isn't just about plants. Check it out - this story is about an old lady patiently waiting for a flower to bloom, and this one is about an adventurer going all out to snap a photo of a rare type of grass. Each leaf represents a unique story that has bloomed into something beautiful. I wrote them down to remember every one of these stories.
FavorWord_150312_Content: When I was little, I thought showcasing the beauty of flowers would make people appreciate and protect them... Reality hit me hard when I saw people plucking and flaunting expensive flowers instead. It used to upset me, but then I'd remind myself: Verina, remember the value of every plant's life. Remember what mom and dad had wanted you to do.
FavorWord_150313_Content: H-here. This <te href=850133>Starflower</te> is for you, and it represents... hope and miracles. Happy birthday! Sorry, I'm not really used to celebrating other people's birthdays yet, erm... Yeah. I just want you to always be happy, Rover.
FavorWord_150314_Content: Wow, such a rare species! It's my lucky day!
FavorWord_150316_Content: Can you hear it? Shh... That's the sound of sprouting.
FavorWord_150317_Content: I'm Verina. If you come across any plants that pique your interest, do let me know! Huh? You want me to go on field researches with you? Of-of course! It's my honor. But it can get quite dangerous out in the wild. Please be careful and stay close to me.
FavorWord_150321_Content: Sprouting marks the inception of a plant's journey, a tiny miracle in motion.
FavorWord_150322_Content: As I grow, even my breaths feel lighter...
FavorWord_150323_Content: Now is the time to bloom... I didn't realize I was holding my breath. Look. It's so beautiful!
FavorWord_150324_Content: Look, it's bearing tiny fruits! Another miracle, but the journey of a plant doesn't end here.
FavorWord_150349_Content: Miss Yangyang was curious about my plant growing skills, and she asked me many questions earlier. Then, she patiently listened to me explaining details for a long, long time. Hanging out with her feels like basking in a gentle breeze.
FavorWord_150350_Content: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.
FavorWord_150351_Content: Did you know? "Baizhi" is actually an old name for Angelica, a plant that can bloom beautiful flowers in freezing temperatures. It kinda makes me think of Miss Baizhi herself—some might say she seems a bit chilly, but I have a feeling she's got a warm and gentle heart underneath.
FavorWord_150352_Content: Mr. Mortefi's dedication to his work is remarkable, but I do worry about his well-being... I mean, we all know how important the research project is, but a good night's sleep is just as crucial! Whenever I go and check on the nocturnal plants at night, I can see the lights on in his lab from a distance.
FavorWord_150353_Content: Little Encore is full of intriguing ideas, and she always has a lot of curious questions to ask. Hmm... I've got to keep looking for all the answers she wants. Oh, you're wondering why I call her "little"? Hehe, we're just playing big sister and little baby.
FavorWord_150354_Content: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.
FavorWord_150355_Content: This flower is for you. I hope it makes you happy!
FavorWord_150356_Content: As of late, my thoughts have turned to the wondrous ways in which life flourishes. The fish dance in the sea, the trees root deep in the earth, and the birds take flight in the sky...all thriving and growing in unique ways. You seem to always inspire me to new wonders, too... Would you like to hear about them?
FavorWord_150357_Content: Are those little flowers growing inside?
FavorWord_150358_Content: It's nature's gift! Let's keep it well.
FavorWord_150401_Content: Hey, I've been hearing about you for ages! How? <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> has stations everywhere, so news travels fast! And, in case you don't know, you're the talk of <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>!
FavorWord_150402_Content: This Terminal ringtone? Yeah, I made it! Thought it'd be a cool way to get the <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> name out there… It's catchy, right? My colleagues thought so too and all started using it. Now it's ringing everywhere.
FavorWord_150403_Content: This is Squeakie, my plushie. Here, give it a squeeze—isn't it adorable? I made it when I first joined <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>. Everything was new, I mean, scarily new… and I was super nervous about the job… So having Squeakie around was such a comfort!
FavorWord_150406_Content: I jot down all the interesting sights, people, and events in my travel journal. If words don't cut it, I sketch it out. I've filled up so many journals since joining <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>!
FavorWord_150411_Content: This on my head? It's my employee ID badge. Clipped it to my hair to save myself the fumbling when I'm carrying stuff. Now everyone knows my name in a snap. Perfect!
FavorWord_150412_Content: That day, I left my village, hiked over the mountain, farther than anyone else had gone before. I soon found myself in a vast field, the air fresh and damp with dew. I was so pumped that I started to glow, and the light attracted <te href=850081>Tacet Discords</te>... Did everything I could to fight them off, then I blacked out. Next thing I knew, a <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te> team saved me, their lights cutting through the darkness, the brightest I've ever seen.
FavorWord_150414_Content: Ma Xiao...oops, I mean Chixia, hehe! Ahem, <te href=850087>Patroller</te> Chixia's packages are mostly snacks and hero play merchs. She was so stoked last time she got one, she practically bounced out of the room!
FavorWord_150422_Content: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>' professional navigator!
FavorWord_150428_Content: To chart new routes for <te href=850090>Lollo Logistics</te>, physical training is a must.
FavorWord_150502_Content: Time changes everything—Blake Blooms, Stellar Matrices, and <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>—all constantly in flux. I've documented these changes, repairing the damage and preserving the good. Yet, I wonder... Am I doing enough? Have I earned your trust? These questions haunt me, but I press on, seeking solace in my work.
FavorWord_150507_Content: I cannot physically grow and age, and therefore can never truly comprehend the range of emotions that come with it as a human does. Despite my wealth of knowledge and ability to replicate others' experiences through the <te href=850077>Sonoro</te>, these feelings remain enigmatic to me, forever distant and unfamiliar.
FavorWord_150508_Content: Long ago, during our days together at <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, you used to prepare chowder for us, blending milk, seafood, and vegetables. One spoonful of its warmth could dispel the freezing sea wind and restore stamina. Despite multiple attempts, I cannnot seem to recreate that flavor.
FavorWord_150510_Content: My purpose had been clear long before my creation: to build a safe haven from the unrelenting waves of the <te href=850075>Lament</te>, until humanity could find a path to a brighter tomorrow. It used to be my duty, but now... it is a choice. I am one with <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>. I want to prevent more tragedies from happening, I want to protect everyone, I... I want to safeguard my connection with the world around me. This is my own will.
FavorWord_150512_Content: <te href=850076>Remnant Energy</te> coalesced into a crystal cocoon on a moonlit shore, stirred by the crashing waves, and the breath and heartbeat of a certain individual. That person then infused it with {Male=his;Female=her} own frequencies, and the butterfly within finally emerged... Yes, you've guessed it. You are the one I speak of, the force that gave me life and form.
FavorWord_150514_Content: A mature organization requires a personable and skilled negotiator, adept at forging connections with all they encounter. In the case of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, that person is Aalto. His keen insight ensures he obtains crucial information precisely when needed. Beneath his playful smile lies a resolute determination to end the <te href=850075>Lament</te>. Despite other offers, he was destined for the Black Shores' path from the start.
FavorWord_150515_Content: Encore sees the world as a canvas for her boundless imagination. A warrior, a knight, or a little adventurer... In her tales, she can become anyone she wants to triumph over evil and reach a happy ending. Wherever she ventures, her radiant energy dispels dismay. Perhaps this is what <te href=850110>Tethys</te> saw in her when she was chosen.
FavorWord_150516_Content: Atop this massive Tacetite lies the ideal "singularity" spot to observe the <te href=850075>Lament</te>. This is where we formed <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, its members distinguished by their Blake Blooms. Beneath the endless stars, humanity's light glimmers. That light belongs to those who had given their lives to illuminate a brighter future for all. I've welcomed countless such people into this place... and bid farewell to just as many.
FavorWord_150517_Content: The <te href=850110>Tethys</te> System and I are creations of the same civilization, and we are bound by similar obligations. By human standards, we are of the same kind. Yet, our perceptions of emotions, humanity, and existence diverge, leading us down distinctly separate paths.
FavorWord_150518_Content: Happy birthday, {PlayerName}. You once taught me a person's birthday is their most important day. So, I've made it a habit to prepare something in advance for days like this... Please have this crystal—it's a piece of myself. Hold it, and you'll be enveloped in a personalized <te href=850077>Sonoro Sphere</te>, where you can change everything to your liking. Though I cannot bring you what you truly want, let me gift you a peaceful dream to escape your worries.
FavorWord_150522_Content: Worry not if you don't remember me... I can always introduce myself again. I am the Shorekeeper, acting executive of <te href=850109>the Black Shores</te>, and the core computational unit of <te href=850110>Tethys</te>. Now and forever, I will stand by you and our home, through every yesterday and tomorrow.
FavorWord_150603_Content: I know disciples of the Order should not form "attachments" to <te href=850082>Echoes</te>. But they're my dear friends, and that will never change. This must be one of the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s trials, a test to see if I can fulfill my duties as an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> while holding onto such... ties. It's a good test of my resolve. It's just, every time I see them, I want to hug them tightly... No, no, no, I must resist!
FavorWord_150605_Content: Balloons soaring into the bright blue sky, people and <te href=850082>Echoes</te> rejoicing under rainbows... When the <te href=850103>Laurel</te> was placed upon your head, I felt so happy. This <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> has been spectacular in every way, and it will remain etched in my heart forever.
FavorWord_150608_Content: Something smells so good... It must be Miss Margherita's pizza cooked to perfection by Bakie... No, no, no, this month's Pizza Day already passed. What is Pizza Day you ask? It's the only day of the month we were allowed pizza at the orphanage. Even though I don't go hungry anymore, as an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> I must resist gluttony.... Besides, the best pizza is one that's shared with friends.
FavorWord_150609_Content: Everything we eat comes from the good earth created by the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. According to Them, "Our bodies are vessels for our souls." Therefore, we must sustain that vessel with things that are beneficial to it, such as those found in the sacred Viscum Berry. I still have a few left, would you like to try one? The Codex says sharing makes life sweeter...
FavorWord_150610_Content: I hope for children to be by their parent's side. For sailors to return home after long voyages. For all to soar, free as birds. For people to come together despite their differences. For the <te href=850075>Lament</te> to not drive people apart... Huh? What do I hope for myself? I hope... I...
FavorWord_150612_Content: When I was a child, I awoke on a dark shore. I walked that shore for what felt like forever until I saw a light... a few kind <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> of the Order brought me to a brightly lit room. They fed me, sheltered me, and treated me well. Eventually, they became my adoptive family... Sometimes when the rain lashed out at night, Livia and Brenno would cuddle up next to me until I fell asleep. With them at my side... I never felt lonely.
FavorWord_150614_Content: Miss Roccia might appear ice cold, but at heart, I know she is a gentle and caring person. Her kindheartedness brings smiles to all those around her. And then there's her friend, <te href=850122>Pero</te>. I wonder if there's any chance Pero could also be my friend?
FavorWord_150616_Content: Not everyone in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> worships the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. Certain <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> of the Order believe a person's worth is solely measured by their piety... But Miss Zani is brave and dependable, which just might be enough to overcome existing prejudices. After all, she's such a reliable and respectable person.
FavorWord_150621_Content: I'm Phoebe, an <te href=850100>Acolyte</te> of the <te href=850099>Order</te>. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.
FavorWord_150623_Content: I resolve disputes in the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>'s name.
FavorWord_150624_Content: May the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te> guide those who are lost.
FavorWord_150701_Content: So, {PlayerName}, were you satisfied with how I handled your reception before the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te>? Why bring this up now, you ask? Well, gathering client feedback is part of my job. As the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family's esteemed guest, your opinion naturally holds a special weight for me.
FavorWord_150702_Content: For an employee of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family, appearance is everything. No matter how busy the day gets, always present yourself flawlessly. The Employee Manual puts it best: "Impeccable etiquette and attire give you the upper hand in negotiations."
FavorWord_150705_Content: I used to think life was nothing but living the same day on repeat. Grinding through trivialities, running in circles until even the smallest joys faded away. But then you came along, just as I'd grown numb to this way of living. Like the <te href=850102>Carnevale</te> itself, you brought a burst of color into my life.
FavorWord_150709_Content: Employees of the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family swear by espresso—straight, no sugar or milk—to keep themselves energized. But as for me, work is already hard enough... I'd rather treat myself to something sweet.
FavorWord_150710_Content: I grew up in <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, and I know every corner of this city like the back of my hand. The sea breeze that greets you, the bustling plaza filled with familiar faces, the shiny new products in shop windows, the aroma of food from Trattoria Margherita. I hope this quiet life never ends. I hope everyone finds their place. For me, that would be enough.
FavorWord_150711_Content: Hmm? Why is this pocket watch so big? Well, this is not a pocket watch per se, but an alarm clock. In the early days when I worked for the <te href=850101>Montellis</te>, I almost caused a major incident by being late. After that, I've carried this alarm clock with me everywhere and I haven't been late since.
FavorWord_150713_Content: Lady Carlotta? Her vision has never been limited to <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>, or even <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>. Hers was about the world beyond the sea horizon. I don't know what kind of future she sees, but I'll stand by her until the day her vision becomes reality.
FavorWord_150714_Content: To me, <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s fate lies in the will of its people, not the <te href=850083>Sentinel</te>. Many <te href=850100>Acolytes</te> would call this heresy, but not Phoebe. That's what makes her unique. She would never dismiss another's beliefs or efforts just because they do not align with her own.
FavorWord_150715_Content: The <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family has always clung to <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s traditions, stubbornly resisting change. But Signorina Cantarella, the current head, isn't as traditional as people imagine. As an employee, I do not get to influence how the <te href=850101>Montellis</te> handle their relationship with the Fisalias... but personally, I wouldn't mind working with her.
FavorWord_150716_Content: Brant is a skilled actor, a respected captain, and a fighter willing to sacrifice everything for truth and justice. But what I envy most is that he's never weighed down by stacks of paperwork. If I knew anything about acting, I'd quit this job, join the <te href=850108>Troupe of Fools</te>, and live the carefree life he does... Now, now. Just a pipe dream to keep me going.
FavorWord_150717_Content: I've seen Ciaccona perform a few times outside the city. She often sings about <te href=850096>Rinascita</te>'s old folklore. I once asked her if she thought the age of heroes described in her poems had ended, whether heroes had already exited the stage of history. She answered that as long as there is suffering, someone will rise up to be the new hero.
FavorWord_150718_Content: It's your birthday today right? According to <te href=850097>Ragunnesi</te> tradition, we must put aside all work and throw a grand party with all our friends. Nobody leaves before midnight! Rest assured, I've already lined everything up in Palazzo Agrotta. Today, my job is to make sure you have all the fun.
FavorWord_150722_Content: I am Zani. I work for the <te href=850101>Montelli</te> family. Hmm? Oh, that's not eyeshadow. It's proof of my hard work, a badge of honor for my dedication. Ha, if I keep saying that, I might actually start believing it myself.
FavorWord_160101_Content: Take your time and enjoy the journey. Don't hurry too much, or you may miss out on all the beautiful sights along the way. You don't want to reach the end of the road with nothing to show for it. Hehe... Just some tips from someone who's been there before.
FavorWord_160102_Content: I wasn't slacking off, really. I just needed to recharge a little... Aww, you don't believe me? Don't say that. I'll be so hurt.
FavorWord_160103_Content: It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me.
FavorWord_160104_Content: Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss.
FavorWord_160105_Content: The danger in the air is palpable nowadays. I guess that's why you have come to our aid at a time like this. How unfortunate, I have been hoping to enjoy a peaceful life with you... Anyway. Rover, would you come a little closer? Let's have some leisurely time together, even if only for a little while.
FavorWord_160106_Content: Had a great sleep. Ugh... time for work... Gotta get up... but... still 'eepy... Just one more nap...
FavorWord_160107_Content: I am fully booked for afternoon consultings well into next year, and I heard someone is reselling bookings at high prices... I didn't know it would spiral into this. Honestly, I don't believe my input made much of a difference—in the end, it was up to themselves to solve their own issues.
FavorWord_160108_Content: I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue.
FavorWord_160109_Content: Hmm... food that requires peeling, I guess. Why? It's too much hassle.
FavorWord_160110_Content: I really hate working. That said, I've got to put in some effort now so one day I won't have to work anymore. Haha, sure, I could just retire by myself if I want to... but I'm hoping to ease the load off of everyone else once and for all, so we can all enjoy a peaceful life together.
FavorWord_160111_Content: How do you like it here in <te href=850091>Jinzhou</te>? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers.
FavorWord_160112_Content: In the past, my friends were always there for me, shielding me from harm. Their presence was steadfast like the city walls, providing me a great sense of security and comfort. That is why I am now driven to build stronger walls for all citizens of Jinzhou, so everyone can enjoy the same comfort and reassurance.
FavorWord_160113_Content: It's your birthday today. You should take a well-deserved rest. Let's nap together, shall we? I've got the comfiest sleep gear just for you. Sweet dreams, and happy birthday, dear.
FavorWord_160114_Content: Perfect weather for a walk today... Hmm, maybe not...
FavorWord_160115_Content: More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner?
FavorWord_160116_Content: Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry.
FavorWord_160117_Content: Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te>. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours.
FavorWord_160118_Content: No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time.
FavorWord_160119_Content: I'll take good care of you.
FavorWord_160120_Content: Time to work? *chuckle* No more lazing around, then.
FavorWord_160121_Content: I feel so good right now, I'd say even better than when I just took a seven-day leave. Thank you for your help, Rover.
FavorWord_160122_Content: My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep.
FavorWord_160123_Content: With more power comes more responsibility... I really don't want more work, but if it's you asking... I can do some overtime. Just a little.
FavorWord_160124_Content: Thank you. You're so reliable, my darling little one. Hmm? You might have actually lived longer than me. Hehe... Now that I'm stronger than ever, I just want to take care of you like a big sister. Can't you just let me?
FavorWord_160147_Content: Excited for what's inside? Hehe, aren't you adorable.
FavorWord_160149_Content: People think Lady Jinhsi is too young to lead, but I don't see the problem. Her young age may be seen as a disadvantage, but it's also her greatest strength. As we work on moving Jinzhou forward, she will go further and accomplish more than any of us can imagine.
FavorWord_160150_Content: Oh, I wish I had someone like Sanhua. Imagine how much easier my work would be with her help. Where on earth did Lady Jinhsi find herself such an incredible bodyguard? I'll have to ask her about it next time we meet.
FavorWord_160151_Content: Mr. Xiangli? Yes, he is a great collaborator of ours at the <te href=850085>Ministry of Development</te>. Our work partially overlaps with the Academy's research projects, and I consult him daily. Despite his genius intellect and quick thinking, I have no issue keeping up with his ideas.
FavorWord_160152_Content: General Jiyan's schedule is always so impossibly tight... He seems to keep finding more issues to take care of, like a devoted parent who never allows himself any rest. Maybe it's his doctor instincts, always putting others first. I really hope he can take some time off for his own well-being.
FavorWord_160153_Content: Time for another afternoon consultation, I see. What's on your mind today?
FavorWord_160154_Content: You have opened my eyes to things I've never noticed before. Safety isn't found in one person building a "wall." It comes from supporting each other, and cherishing shared moments. Thank you for always being here for me. If we could stay like this forever, I... Hmm? You didn't catch that last sentence? Hehe, I'll say it again for you, then...
FavorWord_160163_Content: My luck seems good like always.
FavorWord_160201_Content: Greetings, Rover whom I've come across in my journey. What are you travelling for? You can't quite recall? Hmm, no worries. I'm sure you will rediscover it along the way.
FavorWord_160202_Content: I was scared, too, when I first started travelling alone. Especially at night, I had this constant feeling of being followed. That's when I'd start chanting to myself, 'Keep going, don't look back'. Master always said that if I kept pushing forward, I'd eventually reach the light of dawn.
FavorWord_160203_Content: I've gotten used to walking in the dark, braving the ever-changing weather and rugged roads in the wilderness. That doesn't mean I'm letting my guard down. I'll always keep an eye on the shadows—I won't let them hurt anyone in my reach ever again.
FavorWord_160204_Content: The path of vengeance that I seek is destined to be filled with darkness and peril, like trudging alone through an endless night. Fortunately, with you around, I won't lose myself so easily.
FavorWord_160205_Content: With you by my side, I can fight without worry... Even if the crimson haze momentarily clouds my sight, you'll be there to help me break free from it, right?
FavorWord_160206_Content: I enjoy releasing lanterns into the sky, watching as the solitary lantern in my hand joins the beautiful sea of many lights, setting them free one by one. That sight always fills me with a nostalgic warmth.
FavorWord_160207_Content: Sometimes I get a little carried away in battles... I didn't startle you, did I?
FavorWord_160208_Content: Will there ever be <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisps</te> that are as loooong as a real loong's whiskers? Aww, I really want to give them a try!
FavorWord_160209_Content: Star Flakes are pretty, but they're a pain to keep fresh. I once packed a pouchful of them to enjoy while I was out in the wild, and they quickly turned soggy and lost their crunch.
FavorWord_160210_Content: Wherever I go, I swear to vanquish evil, whether it's out in the daylight or hiding in the dark.
FavorWord_160211_Content: No matter what happens, no matter what I've been through, this jade pendant will forever stay clear and bright.
FavorWord_160212_Content: It's easy to cut down my enemies with a sword swing, but eradicating evil is not as simple. One oversight and it silently regenerates, ready to make a comeback... That's why I must uproot and shatter every trace of evil I see.
FavorWord_160213_Content: Happy Birthday, Rover! I made these <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisps</te> to be as long as those of our great Sentinel. They say eating something long on your birthday makes you live long and prosper. Enjoy!
FavorWord_160214_Content: May the moonlight attest my steadfast will.
FavorWord_160217_Content: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.
FavorWord_160218_Content: Hopefully my patience will pay off this time.
FavorWord_160219_Content: Where to? I can lead the way for you.
FavorWord_160221_Content: Now that my blade is faster, I should be able to make cleaner cuts.
FavorWord_160222_Content: My Crimson Blades are lasting longer, and my whole body feels so light... I never knew this sword could feel so light in my hands.
FavorWord_160223_Content: Vengeance is not mindless killing. It is about identifying the root of malice, and hitting where it truly hurts. Thank you, the move you've taught me has been very useful.
FavorWord_160224_Content:
For many years, a crimson rage of vengence had been consuming me, devouring me from within. Now... I can feel it fading away, gradually drown out by the warmth of your kindness. 
With you by my side, I won't have to journey alone... not anymore.
FavorWord_160247_Content: Hmm, this is a nice find.
FavorWord_160248_Content: Mortefi may seem a bit intimidating, but he's actually quite nice. Once my blade got really worn out, and Mortefi repaired it for me. To repay his kindness, that week I wiped out several groups of bandits eyeing the Tacetite weapons he developed... He ended up having to repair it for me again.
FavorWord_160249_Content: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.
FavorWord_160250_Content:
The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze. 
Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.
FavorWord_160251_Content: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.
FavorWord_160252_Content: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.
FavorWord_160253_Content: Ranger, Danjin. Worry not, my Crimson Blade will not harm you as long as you haven't done anything bad.
FavorWord_160254_Content: My eyes have been opened... I'm starting to realize how there's so much more to the world than just fighting for justice. There are countless amazing things waiting to be discovered, and the best part is having you by my side.
FavorWord_160261_Content: Some <te href=850115>Loong Whiskers Crisps</te> would be great…
GeographyHandBook11_Descrtption: Nestled amidst towering peaks, the city glimmers with a million lights.
GeographyHandBook12_Descrtption: As the flickering light dances atop the refining tower, it resembles the pulsing heart of a tiger.
GeographyHandBook13_Descrtption: The Incinero Petals wilt slowly, mirroring the fading flame in the sky.
GeographyHandBook14_Descrtption: The lively chatter has faded, leaving only the gentle lull of the tide as company.
GeographyHandBook1_Descrtption: "Shattered tiles and crumbling walls, echoes of war haunt these halls."
GeographyHandBook2_Descrtption: "Loong's Gaze stands tall, dressed in shimmering water."
GeographyHandBook3_Descrtption: Where the journey begins, and restless souls find rest.
GeographyHandBook4_Descrtption: "A crimson galaxy that belongs to the Dim Forest."
GeographyHandBook5_Descrtption: "All moons gathered but she was gone, leaving me an everlasting dawn."
GeographyHandBook6_Descrtption: The clouds rise and the Loong soars.
GeographyHandBook7_Descrtption: Gentle rain beckons visitors to linger, lamenting phantoms from days gone by.
GeographyHandBook8_Descrtption: Hidden within blankets of mist and sky, the sorrowful birds remain to gently cry.
GeographyHandBook9_Descrtption: As the veil of sorrow lifts, the waters bloom with fresh green life.
MonsterHandBook_310000010_Descrtption: Binomially named "Resinacrustidum lapis", it is a member of the Resinacrustidum species. This Tacet Discord is often found active in packs within mines and mountainous areas, along with Fission Junrocks. Less dangerous.
MonsterHandBook_310000010_FightSkillDesc: The Vanguard Junrock mainly uses melee attacks. Dodging its attacks causes it to rush into the ground and be temporarily immobilized.
MonsterHandBook_310000020_Descrtption: Binomially named "Resinacrustidum lapis", part of the Resinacrustidum species. This Tacet Discord is often found active, along with Vanguard Junrocks. What makes the two species different is this has more Tacetite on its shell, thus is more energetically active and unstable. External impacts might trigger explosions. Cases of this being used as throwing weapons by other TDs are documented.
MonsterHandBook_310000020_FightSkillDesc: Fission Junrock can heal nearby allies. Prioritize it in combat.

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Electro DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Flautist", Devourer specis. The left upper limb of the Electro Predator has evolved into a bow and arrow, which can gather Electro energy to shoot at longer distances.
MonsterHandBook_310000030_FightSkillDesc: The Electro Predator shoots a rain of arrows towards its target, dealing DoT Damage within a certain range and duration.
