<color=#1891e7>[Glacio]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Glacio DMG</color>.  



Binomial name "Devorsonidum glacies", Devourer specis. Glacio Predator has evolved a body structure similar to a human "cape", which is presumed to gather Glacio energy more quickly to form a "javelin" for long-range attack.
MonsterHandBook_310000040_FightSkillDesc: After the "javelin" from the Glacio Predator lands, it will explode after a certain period of time, causing unexpected damage to the enemies.
MonsterHandBook_310000050_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Aero]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Aero DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Devorsonidum spiritalis", a member of the genus Devorsonidum. Different from other "Predator" TDs, which condense energy for attacks, the Aero Predator's throwing weapon is part of its body structure, and can be recovered using its own Aero energy after being thrown.
MonsterHandBook_310000050_FightSkillDesc: The throwing weapon of the Aero Predator is capable of tracking its enemies. Be careful of its trajectory, otherwise you may suffer serious damage.
MonsterHandBook_310000060_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Fusion]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Fusion DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Devorsonidum fusio", a member of the genus Devorsonidum. Its two upper limbs resemble long and short spears respectively, and can attack by stabbing and chopping. Moderately dangerous. While it attacks, this TD is observed to perform actions that looks like saluting, presumed to be a clumsy imitation of human swordsman.
MonsterHandBook_310000060_FightSkillDesc: Fusion Warriors can defend and bounce off close range attacks received from the direction they're facing, and will immediately thrust at the enemy if the bounce is successful. However, the thrust attack can be parried with Counterattacks.
MonsterHandBook_310000070_Descrtption:
<color=#7e1f57>[Havoc]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#7e1f57>Havoc DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Tambourinist", a member of the genus Disorder. Its appearance resembles that of a human, with a strong desire to attack. Dangerous to a degree. This TD has body parts that look that "cloth", presumed to be structures evolved to mimic human dress, though its functions remain unclear.
MonsterHandBook_310000070_FightSkillDesc: When facing the Havoc Warrior, you need to pay attention to dodging its fast, mid-range dash attack.
MonsterHandBook_310000080_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Fusion]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Fusion DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Strepoplasmidum fusio", a member of the genus Strepoplasmidum. Does not possess any intelligence. Due of its plier-shape body, Snip Snap is occasionally called the "plier beast". Fusion energy is observed to be in a low level in the species.
MonsterHandBook_310000080_FightSkillDesc: When Snip Snap is defeated, the residual Thermo energy within its body can trigger an explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind a Fusion Energy Circle that deals DoT Damage to players within the circle.
MonsterHandBook_310000090_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Spectro]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Spectro DMG</color>.  

Scientifically named the "Strepoplasmidum spectrum", a member of the genus Strepoplasmidum. Gained its name due to the lack of intelligence and simple behavioral logic. Spectro Energy is found to be in low level.
MonsterHandBook_310000090_FightSkillDesc: When Zig Zag is defeated, the residual Spectro energy within its body can trigger an explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind a Diffusion Energy Circle that slows the Resonators within the circle.
MonsterHandBook_310000100_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Aero]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Aero DMG</color>.  


Binomial name "Strepoplasmidum spiritalis", a member of the genus Strepoplasmidum. Possesses no intelligence. Since the Aero energy mass gathered in its "head" emits sound similar to that of a gust of wind, it gained the name "Whiff Whaff".
MonsterHandBook_310000100_FightSkillDesc: When Whiff Whaff is defeated, the residual Aero energy within its body can trigger a explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind a Storm Eye that continues to drag players inward and deals DoT Damage to players within the range.
MonsterHandBook_310000110_Descrtption:
<color=#7e1f57>[Havoc]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#7e1f57>Havoc DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Strepoplasmidum ruptura", a member of the genus Strepoplasmidum. Can use Havoc energy in simple ways to attacks, possesses no intelligence.
MonsterHandBook_310000110_FightSkillDesc: When Tick Tack is defeated, the residual Fusion energy within its body can trigger an explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind an Havoc Energy Circle, reducing the Resonance Energy of the Resonator within the circle and dealing DoT damage.
MonsterHandBook_310000120_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Glacio]</color>
This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Glacio DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Tetraodon lateo", a Mutant Organism of the genus Tetraodon. Widely present in all fresh waters. A duckweed-shaped leaf on the top of its head serves as its cover to help its surprise strike on preys.
MonsterHandBook_310000120_FightSkillDesc: Gulpuff can compress the air stored in its airbag and spit out to knock its enemy up, which can deal a great amount of fall damage.
MonsterHandBook_310000130_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Aero]</color>
This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Aero DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Tetraodon spiritalis", a Mutant Organism of the genus Tetraodon. Presumed to be a relative to Gulpuff, though their ecological niche are slightly different. Chirpuff lives mainly in the air, preying on insects.
MonsterHandBook_310000130_FightSkillDesc: Chirpuff can compress the air stored in its airbag and spit out to knock its enemy up, which can deal a great amount of fall damage.

<color=#1891e7>[Glacio]</color>

 This enemy is <color=#b49f50>immune</color> to <color=#1891e7>Glacio DMG</color>.  



Glacio Prism is a member of Resinacrustidum, with a unique shell structure that can stimulate a chemical reaction with water in the air to absorb massive heat in a short course of time and channel Glacio Energy for attacks.
MonsterHandBook_310000140_FightSkillDesc: Herons are capable of consuming Cluster Prisms of any attribute.

<color=#1891e7>[Fusion]</color>

 This enemy is<color=#b49f50>immune</color> to <color=#1891e7>Fusion DMG</color>.  

A member of the genus Resinacrustidum, Fusion Prism has the ability to heat up rapidly and preserve it, presumably because of the high temperature at its habitat. Its outer shell has a structure similar to volcanic rocks, helping it to contain much Fusion Energy.
MonsterHandBook_310000150_FightSkillDesc: Herons are capable of consuming Cluster Prisms of any attribute.
MonsterHandBook_310000160_Descrtption: [Spectro Prism] This enemy is immune to Spectro DMG. A member of the genus Resinacrustidum, Spectro Prism has a unique construction of mineral shell that can effectively trap photons, thus allowing it to hold massive Spectro Energy and radiate it in light beams. Years ago a population of Spectro Prism boomed in one nation amid rumors that its Relic is a material for ever-bright lamps. The story's end was marked by a tragedy that claimed thousands of life. "Prohibited for illumination purposes" - Manuals for Relic Using (New Federation Edition)
MonsterHandBook_310000160_FightSkillDesc: Herons are capable of consuming Cluster Prisms of any attribute.

The notion of "Havoc Prism is a member of the genus Resinacrustidum" is being questioned recently in New Federation and Liangdao, as a latest paper by Liangdao scholars claimed that the shell of "Havoc Prism is merely a mimicry of other Prism TDs formed by condensed energy.
MonsterHandBook_310000170_FightSkillDesc: Herons are capable of consuming Cluster Prisms of any attribute.

Binomial name "Acanthacorydalis squapenna". Diurnal animal. Commonly found on waterfronts in warm and humid areas throughout Huanglong. Although slightly aggressive, it is easily preyed upon by Geohide Saurians and other predators, and are thus not very dangerous. Judging from its scientific name, it is a member of the Corydalidae family rather than a butterfly.
MonsterHandBook_310000180_FightSkillDesc: Cruisewing can restore HP to its nearby allies at an extremely fast rate. Therefore, it needs to be dealt with first in combat.
MonsterHandBook_310000190_Descrtption: Binomial name "Babyrousa fractden". An omnivore Mutant Organism commonly seen. Although its diet is mainly of vegetative origin, its temperament is not that of an ordinary herbivores. Sensitive and irritable, the whole population will charge twoards intruders of its colony on the instant the intrusion is found. Hunters often take advantage of this habit to trap them. A Huanglong idiom also compares "Sabyr Boar's charge" to reckless people.
MonsterHandBook_310000190_FightSkillDesc: The Sabyr Boar's main method of attack is to charge and ram their targets. It will fall to its side and get stunned once hitting an object on the way. If it is not obstructed on its trajectory, it will flexibly turn around and continue to charge again until it is taken down.
MonsterHandBook_310000200_Descrtption:
<color=#7e1f57>[Havoc]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50>higher RES</color> against <color=#7e1f57>Havoc DMG</color>.  

Binomial name "Myospalax actinoaftia", a commonly seen rodent Mutant Organism mostly found in grasslands or temperate forests and mountains. It has a habit of storing food in accomadation. Human who encounter accidents in the wild can find emergency nutrition in an Excarat's cave.
MonsterHandBook_310000200_FightSkillDesc: When an Excarat burrows into the ground, use Plunging Attacks to knock it out of the ground.
MonsterHandBook_310000210_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Fusion]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Fusion DMG</color>.  

A young Geohide Saurian. The species does not have the habit of caring for their younglings, thus young lizards can only survive by imitating the hunting behavior of the adults, scavenging the remains of their food and, if necessary, preying on fellow young Geohide Saurians.
MonsterHandBook_310000210_FightSkillDesc: Immature Geohide Saurians will imitate mature ones. It fights in the same way adults do.
MonsterHandBook_310000220_Descrtption:
<color=#7e1f57>[Havoc]</color>

This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#7e1f57>Havoc DMG</color>.  

A younger individual of Roseshroom. It shares the shade-tolerant, hydrophilous habit with adults. Research shows that in its immatured stage, Roseshroom does not yet possess the ability to absorb nutrients from Tacetites, thus needing to gather nutrients from nearby matured Roseshrooms in order to survive.
MonsterHandBook_310000220_FightSkillDesc: Just like the mature counterpart, Baby Roseshroom's real weakness is hidden inside its top. When it is charging, attacking its weakness with pistols can disupt its action and disable it.
MonsterHandBook_310000230_Descrtption: The name "Exile" means an unforgivable felony. Exiles are not allowed to enter towns, thus left wandering in the wilderness. Although most of them are merely paying for their past misdeeds, considering that trials are not always "fair" in all nations, there are quite a number of Exiles who are wrongfully expelled and bearing grievances.
MonsterHandBook_310000230_FightSkillDesc: Exile Commoners will pick up any weapon at their disposal to engage enemies, but upon taking damage, their weapons will be knocked out of their hands. These weapons can be taken and used against them, though they might be destroyed in the middle of the combat as they are mostly old and worn.
MonsterHandBook_310000240_Descrtption: The name "Exile" means an unforgivable felony. Exiles are not allowed to enter towns, thus left wandering in the wilderness. Although most of them are merely paying for their past misdeeds, considering that trials are not always "fair" in all nations, there are quite a number of Exiles who are wrongfully expelled and bearing grievances.
MonsterHandBook_310000240_FightSkillDesc: Exile Commoners will pick up any weapon at their disposal to engage enemies, but upon taking damage, their weapons will be knocked out of their hands. These weapons can be taken and used against them, though they might be destroyed in the middle of the combat as they are mostly old and worn.
MonsterHandBook_310000250_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Aero]</color>

 This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Aero DMG</color>.  

A young Hoochief. Sightings of it are only located from the Dim Forest, same as the adults. Though physically incomparable to adults, it has a intellectual development that is no different to the latter. Adult Hoochiefs teach them to hunt and ambush passers-by in the Dim Forest.
MonsterHandBook_310000250_FightSkillDesc: The immature Hoochief learns fighting skills from adults. It fights in the same way.
MonsterHandBook_310000260_Descrtption: TheDiamondclaw is one of the few Mutant Organisms whose common name is identical to its scientific name. It is rumored that the Huanglong biologist who discovered it was dilatory and could not establish its scientific name until he passed away. However, by then the creature's common name was already widely cited in various periodicals, which makes the revision of the name too costly for later researchers.
MonsterHandBook_310000260_FightSkillDesc: Diamondclaw will use its pincers to shield itself when facing attacks to its front, which is an opportunity to use pistols to strike the Tacetrite core on its back. This will defeat it quickly.
MonsterHandBook_310000270_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Glacio]</color>

 This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Glacio DMG</color>.  



Its scientific name is 'Hoartoise', a Mutant Organism of terrestrial reptiles. It exhibits a violent temperament, often provoking and rushing towards creatures larger than itself. Whether this behavior is linked to its mutation is unclear. In Huanglong, tortoises are typically associated with calmness and sophistication, except for the Hoartoise.
MonsterHandBook_310000270_FightSkillDesc: Hoartoise will be turned upside down if attacked by plunge attack, immobilized temporarily.
MonsterHandBook_310000280_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Fusion]</color>

 This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Fusion DMG</color>.  

A young individual of Fusion Dreadmane. With a smaller body, it is absolutely obedient to adult Dreadmanes. At this stage, the young wolves' mane is almost the same as that of adult wolves', which help them stay safe against Fusion attacks. However, they still lack the experience and skills for hunting in packs. Adult wolves would teach them to hunt, as well as protecting them. Sometimes such protection involve taking lethal damage.
MonsterHandBook_310000280_FightSkillDesc: Young Fusion Dreadmanes can cleverly dodge enemy attacks even before attacks are made, though this doesn't work every time.
MonsterHandBook_320000010_Descrtption: Binomially named "Resinacrustidum lapis", Stonewall Bracer is a member of the genus Resinacrustidum commonly seen in the mountains. It is presumed that the material that makes its rocky shell is sufficient in such areas. This TD has a enormous size, and fights by crashing or throwing rocks. Its impressive fighting capability comes at the price of slow movement.
MonsterHandBook_320000010_FightSkillDesc: Stonewall Bracer will use its left hand to defend when being attacked. At this stage its left hand can be broken by repeated attacks, forcing it to change tactics. But once it begins to rage, the broken left hand will be recovered.
MonsterHandBook_320000020_Descrtption:
<color=#1891e7>[Electro]</color>

 This enemy has a <color=#b49f50> higher RES</color> against <color=#1891e7>Electro DMG</color>.  



A subspecies of Ardea purpurea uniquely found in Huanglong.
MonsterHandBook_320000020_FightSkillDesc: Herons regain all of its health after devouring Cluster Prisms, befor e entering an empowered state of the element of the Prism devoured. Under this state the Herons will launch more powerful attacks.

<color=#1891e7>[Aero]</color>

QuestTree_Summary_110000:
You wake to the voice of two girls, Yangyang and Chixia. You remember nothing of your past and know little of the present, but the abilities you display show that you are no ordinary person.

Guided by them, you begin to learn the ways of this world. When you encounter the statue of Sentinel Jué, a fragment of memory stirs, leading you toward Jinzhou City to search for the truth about yourself.
QuestTree_Summary_110001:
On the road, you absorb an Echo directly with your body. This unusual ability draws your new friends' attention. Chixia suggests you collect more Echoes along the way to Jinzhou City, but your second attempt fails.

With no idea how it works, you continue your journey to Jinzhou City to look for answers, unaware that a mysterious girl is watching your every step...
QuestTree_Summary_110010:
Your journey takes you to the City Hall, where the Magistrate of Jinzhou, Jinhsi, has summoned you. But Jinhsi is not there. Her bodyguard, Sanhua, hands you three tokens and promises a meeting in three days.
 
Yangyang urges you to seek out Huaxu Academy, where Baizhi works, for clues about the tokens. There, the first token reveals a past connection between you and Jinzhou.
 
 Your actions seem to draw many eyes. Who plays the predator, and who the prey?
QuestTree_Summary_110020:
The second token leads you and Yangyang to somewhere outside the city.

As you make your way out, you run into Jianxin, a young Taoist searching for a missing person. With your clearance, you bring her along past the city walls. The three of you arrive at the Midnight Rangers' Rearguard Camp, where the shadow of war looms over the horizon. Clues from the quartermaster reveal that the second token is somehow connected to the coming war.

After the matter is settled, you find yourself caught in an illusion. When you snap out of it, Yangyang's words help you realize where the final token leads: Qichi Village in the Central Plains.
QuestTree_Summary_110030:
When you and Yangyang reach Qichi Village, you are shocked to find it has become a Tacet Field. Your investigation is then cut short by Scar, an Overseer of the Fractsidus. He reveals the tragic events that befell Qichi Village and invites you to join him. You refuse, and the confrontation escalates into a battle.

In the chaos, a mysterious girl intervenes to cover Scar's retreat. Having gathered the information on all three tokens, you return to Jinzhou City.
QuestTree_Summary_110040:
With all the clues gathered, you unlock the sundial device. Hidden inside is a slip of paper pointing you to your next destination, the heavily guarded Grand Library.

As you enter the Library, Scar follows you in. But by this time, you have already met Jinhsi, and with your help, she captures Scar. From him, Jinhsi learns a shocking truth and advises you to seek an organization called the Black Shores, saying your ties to them run deep.
QuestTree_Summary_110050:
You find Aalto and Encore, Consultants of the Black Shores. Aalto agrees to tell you about your origins but only if you join them in investigating the Court of Savantae Ruins.

There, you discover that the Court of Savantae once tried to use an artificial Retroact Rain to trace something back in time, but the experiment failed, creating a monster. After defeating the monster, Aalto tells you that your journey once took you to the Black Shores before.

Just then, a real Retroact Rain begins to fall, and a wave of Tacet Discords strikes Jinzhou City.
QuestTree_Summary_110060:
Fighting alongside the people of Jinzhou, you help hold back the TD outbreak. Jinhsi confirms this was foretold by the Sentinel. With Yangyang at your side, you head to the Desorock Highland to meet Jiyan.

On the road, you are attacked by the Thundering Mephis, but Jiyan arrives just in time to help, and together you defeat the enemy. Back at the Midnight Rangers camp, you and Jiyan plan to use the Disruptor to break the Threnodian's defenses.
QuestTree_Summary_110061:
The Disruptor shatters the barrier protecting the Threnodian. Under the cover of your allies, you and Jiyan fight your way to the heart of the Threnodian, and together, you engage in a grueling battle against the powerful Dreamless. In the heat of battle, you unexpectedly absorb its Havoc power. As it tries to kill you, a little creature pops out of your hand and absorbs the attack, ending the crisis.

The Threnodian flees, and the dust settles. With the help of Jiyan, Yangyang, and all your allies, you manage to save Jinzhou.
QuestTree_Summary_110070:
Jinhsi disappears while checking on the Sentinel's safety alone. You and Changli set out for Mt. Firmament to find her.

In the mountains, time has spiraled out of control. Jinhsi refuses Jué's offer to sacrifice itself, choosing instead to fight the Sentinel as fate decrees. You witness her battle, and with your approval, Jué transfers its Temporal Mandate to Jinhsi, returning Jinzhou's future to its people.

When all is done, Jué suggests you visit the Black Shores to explore the past of you and Abby.
QuestTree_Summary_110080:
Data brought back from the Port City of Guixu contaminates the Tethys System and fills the Black Shores with corrupted frequencies.

The administrator of the Black Shores, Shorekeeper, reveals that you were once the Chief Steward of this place, but remains silent about the buried past... Eventually, the corruption is cleansed. With the clearance Shorekeeper returns to you, you manually reset the algorithm of the Tethys System. The lost souls trapped in the system at last find peace, and Shorekeeper regains her freedom.
QuestTree_Summary_111000:
Outside Panhua's Restaurant, you meet Yangyang and Chixia again. You have fully assimilated the Threnodian's power that the "little one" who now lives inside of you had absorbed.

The "little one", oblivious of its origin, turns down Chixia's suggestions for its new name, but loves the one you randomly come up: Abby. Hoping to find clues in Abby's special abilities, you discover that it cannot use them for now. You decide to consult the Sentinel and the Magistrate when you meet again.
QuestTree_Summary_112000:
Yangyang, Chixia, and Baizhi invite you to join them for the Moon-Chasing Festival. At the Wishing Tree, you meet Xiangli Yao and learn that he is the mysterious wish granter. You agree to help him investigate four wishes containing abnormal data.

Together, you explore the abnormal Sonoro Sphere, uncovering Xiangli Yao's past and addressing the wishers' problems. At the end of the festival, you and your friends take a commemorative photo under the moonlight.
QuestTree_Summary_210000:
Following the guidance from your past self and the Tethys system, you set sail for Rinascita to find Imperator and seek solutions to Abby's weakening frequencies.

Cetus the Tidebreaker attacks at sea, but Brant, captain of the Fool's Troupe, helps you through the mist. You two promise to meet again at the opening of the Carnevale.

Upon arriving in Ragunna, you see strange "pilgrimages," and a playwright steps forward to explain their origins.
QuestTree_Summary_210010: Led by Acolyte Phoebe, you enter this city of Echoes and come to understand the significance of Echoes to Rinascita. While dealing with the Montelli family, who sent the invitation to the Black Shores, you resonate with an out-of-control Vitreum Dancer and receive a plea for help from the Sentinel. As you investigate the cause of this incident, you catch a glimpse of undercurrents beneath Ragunna: the secretive dealings between the Order, the nobles, and the Fractsidus. Phrolova, a Fractsidus Overseer you once met briefly, also watches from the shadows.
QuestTree_Summary_210020:
Gilberto has gone mad, and Lorelei of Nimbus Sanctum has fallen under the influence of the mysterious Lycoris. After helping Lorelei regain her senses, you learn that the only way to reach the Sentinel is to claim the Laurel at the Carnevale.

You work with Carlotta from the Montelli family to return the damaged Vitreum Dancer back to Averardo Vault. Clues along the journey lead to a shocking truth: Rinascita has two divinities.

Carlotta stays behind to hold off the Order's pursuers, while you make for a northern island where another secret of the Order lies hidden.
QuestTree_Summary_210030:
On the bridge to the island, you are attacked by the Dragon of Dirge, and Roccia of the Fool's Troupe comes to your aid. In the Penitent's End, you learn the truth behind the "pilgrimages" and regroup with Carlotta. You decide to join forces with the Fool's Troupe to win the Laurel at the Carnevale. However, Phrolova moves to disrupt the festivity.
 
After defeating her, you finally speak to the Sentinel, who tells you that "The Lost"—They wish you to help—is among the people at the Carnevale.
QuestTree_Summary_210040:
"The Lost" turns out to be Cartethyia, the Blessed Maiden who should have martyred herself. Together with Cantarella, head of the Fisalia family, you travel to the Avinoleum Theological Seminary to meet her.

As you explore the Seminary, Cartethyia's true origin comes to light. She is a creation of the Threnodian. She asks you to end her life once and for all, but you refuse her request.

With the help of many, the crisis is finally resolved, and Cartethyia gains a new life. In the Sentinel's final moments, They tell you the truth of history.
QuestTree_Summary_210050: Cartethyia suddenly disappears, and following the clues she left behind, you arrive in Septimont, where you meet the prodigy gladiator, Lupa. To learn Cartethyia's whereabouts, you choose to team up with Lupa and win the Great Agon of Septimont. In between the events, Phrolova hands you a script and warns that Lupa will draw the Dark Tide. Meanwhile, the story of Mya seems to hint at something more… Eventually, you and Lupa win the championship, while Cartethyia fights alongside you in a way no one else can perceive.
QuestTree_Summary_210060: You and Lupa head for the Central Hub. Lupa becomes frenzied and destroys its control panel. You manage to separate her from Mya, who has become a vessel of the Threnodian, and send Lupa to the beginning of the "story." There, she retrieves her lost memories and learns about Mya's fate. She then duels the Lady of the Sea and reclaims peace for Septimont. Although Cristoforo escapes Cartethyia's attack, the crisis in Septimont comes to a close, and you, Lupa, and Cartethyia finally reunite.
QuestTree_Summary_210070:
While searching for the residual energy of the Threnodian, you are struck into the sea by Fenrico and saved by Phrolova. To reach your goal, you decide to work with her temporarily. Inside the Sonoro she created, "the Beyond," you learn about her past, and that you once broke a promise to her.

In Fenrico's final moment, the Lantern wakes him from the Threnodian's control. He sacrifices himself to seal the gateway to the Journeying Paradise and stops the Dark Tide. But the Gem holding the Threnodian's power is taken by the Fractsidus.
QuestTree_Summary_210080:
Augusta invites you to join her on the hunt. But when you fight the Dark Tide entity, "the False Sovereign," an unseen force intervenes, causing the attempt to fail.

To stop the Dark Tide from spreading, you track the False Sovereign to Murmurstown. There, you and Augusta fight side by side to bring it down. The Dark Tide then subsides, and you recover the Relic of Imperator. But as you savor your victory, Cristoforo is already plotting his next move…
QuestTree_Summary_210090: After the successful hunt of the False Sovereign, you discover everyone except you has forgotten about the existence of Iuno. The people attribute every one of her past deeds to you. To bring Iuno, who vanished into the moon, back to existence and rewrite her ending, you follow the guide of her bracelet and head off to the Chaos as suggested by Avidius and Lillibet. Finally, you "anchor" her amidst the Chaos and bring the unwritten future back to Septimont, and to her.
QuestTree_Summary_210100:
Ragunna comes under attack by the Dark Tide, its creations appearing across the city. Avidius joins you in the hunt, but during the pursuit, he gradually uncovers the truth of himself. At the end of his life, he absorbs the Dark Tide and ends the crisis in Ragunna.

It is then that you realize you have long been secretly corrupted by the Dark Tide and have now become Leviathan's Harbinger. To end the crisis once and for all, you set out for Septimont once more with the mysterious Discord Slayer Galbrena.
QuestTree_Summary_210110:
An abnormal High Tide strikes Septimont. To stem the Dark Tide, the people of Ragunna come to aid the city, and the Black Shores send every Bloom Bearer still able to fight. Galbrena goes headfirst into the Dark Tide. You and your companions soon follow suit and take the plunge carrying the lantern brought by Qiuyuan.
 
After all the hardship, you finally see the light of hope. You and the people of Rinascita together defeat the Threnodian revived by the Gem. Rinascita gets the peace it deserves at last.
QuestTree_Summary_211000: At a tavern, you meet the traveling poet Nestor, who shares with you Ephor Augusta's stories. Before rising to power, she was an ordinary girl with no outstanding gift, yet she grew through countless trials to seize the championship and claim victory and glory. At the same time, Augusta and Iuno have readied themselves for the hunt in the Sanguis Plateaus.
QuestTree_Summary_212000:
As the Dark Tide closed in, at a personal request from someone in Mingting, Qiuyuan journeyed to Ragunna to your aid. After rescuing an Acolyte in Ragunna, he traveled to the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where he convinced Fenrico to yield the First Relic, a key instrument in stopping the Dark Tide. Then he arrived just in time for the final battle to deliver the Relic to you.

After the war, Ciaccona recounts Qiuyuan's deeds in Rinascita. You later find Qiuyuan at the dock as he prepares to depart, and express your gratitude.
QuestTree_Summary_210120: With the chain of events at Rinascita finally concluded, you return once more to the Black Shores. Unexpectedly, the Tethys System detects a strange frequency and isolates from it a set of coordinates. As you trace the coordinates, a spatial rift leading to an unknown Sonoro Sphere tears open at sea close to the Black Shores. During the investigation, you are pulled into the rift and soon awaken in a ruined, restless city. And as the situation grows dire, a mysterious black-haired girl appears before you…
QuestTree_Summary_213000: You travel to the Black Shores to visit Chisa, only to learn that during her recovery, she had secretly gone alone to Honami City. Burdened by the truth that over two decades have passed in the outside world, she feels uncertain about the future. Together, you stroll through Sakura Quarter to ease her mind. Under the falling petals, she bares her feelings to you and gives you your old student ID card along with a carefully prepared gift. To your surprise, you discover you were once a member of Startorch Academy. Chisa then suggests inviting your friends from the Black Shores to Shashou Cafe to give it a proper "opening"…
QuestTree_Summary_310000:
The passage to Lahai-Roi finally opens. After parting ways with Namipon and Shorekeeper, Chisa and you enter the tunnel in turn. Along the way, you are dragged into a mysterious realm inhabited by a Threnodian. Just as your frequency is about to be consumed, a pink-haired girl appears, rescues you, and sends you back to reality.
Upon reaching Lahai-Roi, you unexpectedly cross paths with a student named Lynae. She arrives on her motorbike, helps you escape an attack from a Voidworm, and brings you safely to your destination—Startorch Academy.
QuestTree_Summary_310010: Once you complete the enrollment procedures, you officially become a student of Startorch Academy. At the Research Institute, you meet Professor Mornye and learn that the Spacetrek Collective is preparing for the crucial project, New Solar Ceremony. But before long, you are caught up in an incident triggered by Hyvatia's sudden malfunction. Lynae—present at the scene—becomes an immediate suspect, and together you begin to dig into the truth behind the chaos. Your investigation uncovers Lynae's hidden identity and a conspiracy orchestrated by the Fractsidus. In the end, you and Lynae lure away and defeat the Voidworm threatening the Academy, resolving the immediate danger. Yet the masterminds behind the plot remain at large, and their plans are far from over.
QuestTree_Summary_310020: As the New Solar Ceremony approaches, you receive a plea for help, with its sender addressing you as Arbiter. Suspecting a link to the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye travels with you to Bjartr Woods to uncover the truth. There, you discover that the Fractsidus has deceived the Roya Tribe into triggering the Reactor Drive's fall. To ensure the successful launch of the artificial sun "Helios," Mornye enters the Drive herself. When the dust settles, a new dawn finally rises over Lahai-Roi.
QuestTree_Summary_310030: After an ambush by the mysterious mech Sigillum, your frequency-loss symptoms worsen until Aemeath once again comes to your rescue. This digital ghost, visible only to you, has already died in the past, Overclocking to resonate with the Exostrider and protect Lahai-Roi. Now, to cure your symptoms and help Aemeath recover her "existence", the two of you journey to the Roya Frostlands. Along the way, you encounter Luuk Herssen. At the site where the Exostrider lies dormant, you confront and defeat Sigillum, uncovering the truth Aemeath has been hiding and witnessing her to become the savior.
QuestTree_Summary_311000: After your journey to the Roya Frostlands concludes, you head to the infirmary to discuss the Exostrider plan with Luuk Herssen. In his secret workspace, he explains the current status of the Fractsidus and why he has come to Lahai-Roi. A Fractsidus member has kidnapped the Royan student who once traveled with you, taking her to the abandoned space station. Together, you work to resolve the crisis. During the mission, however, you discover that another Fractsidus agent is still hiding within the Academy, waiting for the New Solar Ceremony to begin. Comforted by Luuk Herssen's words, you accept the candy he offers, and with renewed resolve, you regain your inner peace and determination.
QuestTree_Summary_310040:
With the New Solar Celebration just around the corner, a game mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus looms over the Academy like a lurking shadow. Together with Sigrika, you set out to investigate the mysterious frequency in the Dark Side and unravel the riddles surrounding it.
Working together, you manage to defeat the vortex left behind in the Dark Side, restoring a temporary calm. Yet you can't shake the feeling that more shadows are hidden, waiting beneath the peaceful facade of the evening for you to handle them.
QuestTree_Summary_312000:
After the New Solar Celebration concludes, Lucilla reveals that the root of the Dark Side anomaly remains unresolved. During your investigation, she discovers that the trap set by the Fractsidus specifically targets memory-type Resonators. Determined to draw the rabbit out, Lucilla volunteers to act as bait, but doing so means confronting her own vulnerabilities.
However, Lucilla has learned to face her past with honesty long ago. She breaks the illusion, and, with your help, captures the rabbit. In doing so, the root of the Dark Side anomaly is finally eliminated.
QuestTree_Summary_313000: Before setting out on the mission to defend the Dimmr Plains, Hiyuki travels alone to Honami. While helping the Black Shores deal with unresolved matters about the Left Behind, she also searches for traces of the previous Miko of Flaming Sakura. There, she unexpectedly runs into the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Even when faced with the Grand Architect's incendiary speech, Hiyuki keeps her blade sheathed...
QuestTree_Summary_310050: After the Dark Side incident, the Fractsidus's real intentions remain unclear, and the Voidmatter beneath Lahai-Roi seems to be stirring again. With the help of Lucilla, Luuk Herssen, and others, you secure a chance to speak directly with the head of the Spacetrek Collective. In the end, he gives you the green light to activate and pilot the Exostrider. The road there is anything but easy, but with the help of "everyone", you drive back Aleph-1 from deep within Voidspace and bring Aemeath home. This time, the story written across Lahai-Roi, and across the past itself, becomes one that leads toward the future: a story in which the world saves its hero.
QuestTree_Summary_314000: Hiyuki raises her blade to bid farewell to the Left Behind of Honami, and to Lady Gyokuro, the former Miko of Flaming Sakura. Seeing Hiyuki's resolve, Gyokuro leaves her with one final blessing: that she no longer remain bound by fate, but step into a spring of her own as an ordinary person.
QuestTree_Summary_315000: Denia, who was taken into custody after the final battle, has now woken up. The Spacetrek Collective hopes to cooperate with her and entrusts you with the negotiations. After speaking with her, you strike a bargain: she agrees to help the Collective and tell you what she knows about the Grand Architect, and in return, you spend her birthday with her at the Academy. That night, Denia finally tells you the truth about who she really is. There is no easy answer to her situation, but you speak from the heart, and that gives her the courage she needs.
QuestTree_Summary_316000: The disappearance of the Exostrider led investors to question the very purpose of Rabelle College. Meanwhile, factions from the New Federation have begun harboring ulterior motives regarding the Synchronists. Inspired by the unwavering faith of her students, Lucilla, as both the Academy President and students' professor, has chosen the path that best serves their future: a daring breakthrough toward the Etheric Sea.
QuestTree_Summary_410010: With affairs in Lahai-Roi coming to a close, you decide to revisit Huanglong, only to unexpectedly learn of Yangyang's disappearance. To find her, you and Yangyang's older sister, Suisui, set out for the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou to investigate. Unbeknownst to you, an Autopuppet crisis is already brewing there...
QuestTree_Summary_410020:
After overcoming numerous obstacles, you and Suisui successfully find Yangyang and obtain the token left behind by Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox. Following the clues, you delve deeper into Xuanfang, and the mastermind of the chaos finally surfaces—Muyu, an Artisan from Mengzhou's Zhuojun Atelier. His goal is to get his hands on Sentinel technology and incite Autopuppets to lay siege to Xuanfang Hold.
During the attempt to stop Muyu, Yangyang hears the Voice of the Streams for the first time, and in direct confrontation with the colossal Thousand-Puppet Pavilion Autopuppet Muyu created, she awakens new powers.
However, after defeating the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion, you and Yangyang discover that the Muyu before you is only a shell. His true body remains hidden somewhere in Xuanfang.
QuestTree_Summary_411000: Days after the Autopuppet crisis, Yangyang chooses to remain in the Land of Xuanfang to help its soldiers and people. While waiting for her Resonance Evaluation Report, the Streams bring Yangyang back to the Gorges of Spirits, recreating the moment when she first met you. The Streams address Yangyang as the "Votary of the Voice," and tell her that her true journey is only just beginning.
QuestTree_Summary_410030: You and Qingxiao met at Fogveil Pagoda, both of you searching for Hsin the Moon Fox, and all the while, a shutdown of the mechanisms was spreading quietly across the whole Land of Xuanfang. To find the source of the anomaly, the two of you traveled to the Sanctum together, only to arrive, unexpectedly, in the Land of Xuanfang of two hundred years ago. History had run a different course there: Yuan Fortress had come through the Fortress and Gorges War unscathed, and Cloud Shuttles raced across the sky overhead...
QuestTree_Summary_412000: Not long after the crisis was over, you found Jingran standing before his parents' empty graves. There you learned what his past had been, and kept him company as he "freed" the last of the Reverberations. The old dust was settled at last, and somewhere in the dark, something new had begun to stir...
QuestTree_Summary_410040: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread through the city. To uncover the cause—and to find Hsin, who has not shown Herself for a long time—you enter the Simulacrum Nexus deep within the Sanctum, together with Suoming, an Intendant who claims to have been sent by the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs in search of Hsin the Moon Fox. Guided by the Celestials, you venture into the Heart Realm, where a long-buried past unfolds before you: the truth behind Hsin the Moon Fox and Xuanfang Hold, a promise of sacrifice and continuance, and Hsin's plan to give up Her own life to bring back the real Hsin the Moon Fox, who has long since died. In the end, with your help and Suoming's, Hsin—a Fractal Form of the Sentinel—comes to accept who She truly is, and confronts Suhsin the Inevitable, an entity born from the base code of the Civilization Capsule that has held Her in check for ages. She reclaims authority over Xuanfang Hold and spares it from its fated collapse. Once the crisis settles, Hsin joins you at the Waking Moon Festival She has not attended for so long. And when that brief revelry ends, She will shoulder Her duty as a Sentinel once more and depart for Mengzhou, where danger still stirs beneath the surface...

PhotographHandBook_52_Descrtption: Don't worry, she has a gentle touch. The "fireworks" won't hurt you.
PhotographHandBook_53_Descrtption: Accompanied by a grand performance and its roaring crowd, the troupe arrives as promised.
PhotographHandBook_54_Descrtption: The stage is set, and the curtain rises. Actors, the moment to dazzle has arrived.
PhotographHandBook_55_Descrtption: "Now, I shall reveal the truth behind that idyllic ending..."
PhotographHandBook_56_Descrtption: You should take center stage for the final bow.
PhotographHandBook_57_Descrtption: A performance doesn't have many dos and don'ts, just relax and express yourselves freely on stage!
PhotographHandBook_58_Descrtption: We are born free, and our souls will soar even in death.
PhotographHandBook_59_Descrtption: Listen to your hearts and let the song guide your path.
PhotographHandBook_60_Descrtption: The Montelli family holds in high regard each of its many friendships.
PhotographHandBook_61_Descrtption: Take my power, my blessings, my past. Seek out a future... Where I am your blade. We'll find it together.
PhotographHandBook_62_Descrtption: "Well done." Her final words were not laced with the bitterness of a defeat, but with a deep, comforting gratitude.
PhotographHandBook_63_Descrtption: Light. Come hither… Make way for your destroyer.
PhotographHandBook_64_Descrtption: Arbiter. One question remains... Did I fulfill the charge set upon me?
PhotographHandBook_65_Descrtption: Your life stretches ahead, shaped by moments you'll never forget.
PhotographHandBook_66_Descrtption: A girl surrounded by birds, her world filled with poetry and song.
PhotographHandBook_67_Descrtption: Though we have never met, your poetry and music bridge time and bind us together.
PhotographHandBook_68_Descrtption: The lone wolf locks eyes with you. In her gaze, you see excitement, respect... and a reflection of yourelf staring back.
PhotographHandBook_69_Descrtption: Though she remains out of reach, she stands at your side in battle.
PhotographHandBook_70_Descrtption: Only those who press on without faltering shall claim the final victory.
PhotographHandBook_71_Descrtption: At the end of this story awaits a warm embrace.
PhotographHandBook_1001_Descrtption: Embrace The Past With Steadfast Pace
PhotographHandBook_1002_Descrtption: A Clear Chime Cleanses The Evil
PhotographHandBook_1004_Descrtption: Don't worry... This game is almost over.
PhotographHandBook_1007_Descrtption: The essence of art lies in the true colors.
PhotographHandBook_1008_Descrtption: This is a very happy ending.
PhotographHandBook_1009_Descrtption: Her lost memories pour in, relentless as raindrops splashing into the ground.
PhotographHandBook_1010_Descrtption: The gun was always there. You earned the right to use it the moment you chose to act on your own accord.
PhotographHandBook_1011_Descrtption: "Then let's fall together... You and I."
PhotographHandBook_1012_Descrtption: Starlight splashes across the entire troupe, illuminating the corners of her eyes.
PhotographHandBook_1013_Descrtption: "With any luck, it'll be a catchy one for my next performance on stage."
PhotographHandBook_1014_Descrtption: It feels like nothing happened, as though everything was just a fleeting night's dream. But you know it was real, for Cantarella stands right beside you.
PhotographHandBook_1015_Descrtption: The darkest hour fades and hope quietly takes root in her heart.
PhotographHandBook_1016_Descrtption: A story born from violence often ends in violence.

Moonfiesta_Entrust_1_Content:
"We wish for a Moonlit Fair free of all threat."
Preparations for the Moonlit Fair are in full swing. Historically, the full moon has been linked to Threnodian activity, even though the Threnodian hatch has been halted. Ensuring security around Taoyuan Vale remains a top priority.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_2_Content:
"Please secure the routes for us."
The materials and goods ordered for the festival are being dispatched to Taoyuan Vale. However, advance investigation of road conditions and handling of potential threats are required to ensure all goods are delivered safely.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_3_Content:
"I want to protect people just like the Midnight Rangers."
One of the most made wishes is for the strength to protect those closest. While gaining immense strength instantly isn't feasible, it may prove useful to give these wishmakers training in self-defense. It may prove invaluable during critical moments.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_4_Content:
"I can't remember its name, but I can still taste it like it were yesterday."
Many long for the delicious meals they once enjoyed. By describing the flavors and ingredients, perhaps these dishes can be recreated to rival even their fondest memories.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_5_Content: Uncle Li at Yumyum Haven is a keen experimenter of various recipes to cater to his guests' preferences. To that end, he is always in search of rare ingredients. Guided by his belief in knowledge from practice, he compiled an Ingredient Handbook and made a wish for someone to inherit his work.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_6_Content:
"How I wish to make my family a great Moonlit Fair feast from scratch."
Many find the sharing of food bonding, and the Lodge has received many such wishes. Maybe a Chef's Masterclass at Taoyuan Vale's kitchen could fulfill these wishes.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_7_Content: A legend persists that throwing items into the tree's hollow will repair them, hence the piles of old objects there. Each crack and chip on them silently tells a story of their past.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_8_Content:
"Can someone help me draft a letter?"
Some may find it difficult to adequately convey their feelings in words. Talk with these wishmakers to learn their intentions and help them craft their letters with beautiful and accurate wording.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_9_Content:
Xieyang is currently preparing themes for his riddles. 
To ensure the riddles are appreciated by all, Xieyang is looking for an assistant to help him gather inspiration from the crowd.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_10_Content: Join the Jinzhou Theater as they recruit part-time actors for a special Hero Play written for the festival. Be part of creating unforgettable moments for your audience!
Moonfiesta_Entrust_11_Content: A troupe of unique performers has arrived in Taoyuan Vale. The Academy hopes to showcase some of the cute and charming Echoes in the Moonlit Fair's performances, highlighting the potential of Echoes to the audience. To ensure the Echoes perform reliably, they need someone to help capture specific Echoes and collect related data.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_12_Content:
"What fireworks will people want to see?"
The fireworks stall is troubled by the show it must present for the Fair. The owner is waiting for someone to assist him in creating beautiful fireworks of various shapes and colors.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_13_Content: Soldiers stationed at the border have submitted their wishes to the Moontree Lodge—photos, dishes from their hometown, and essential supplies. If there were ever a time to make these wishes come true, it would be during the Moonlit Fair.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_14_Content: Researchers stationed in the wild sent the Moonstree Lodge a photo of the moon. Engrossed in studying lunar phases and their influence on the lifecycle of certain plants, they seek additional photos of the moon's phases from different locales to complete their records.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_15_Content: The piles at the Moontree Lodge consist not only of wish tags but packages of all sizes. People separated for various reasons wish to send tokens of their affection. The Lodge seeks "express couriers" to assist.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_16_Content: The Moonlit Fair at Taoyuan Vale offers a glimpse into local customs and traditions in Jinzhou. To assist first-time visitors in fully experiencing the Moon-Chasing Festival, Taoyuan Vale is seeking tourist guides to enrich their visit.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_17_Content: The Fan Drawing Stall is designing a series of fans themed "Memories of Moon-Chasing," aiming to capture the festival's beauty for travelling visitors. They are now calling for photos to serve as their inspiration.
Moonfiesta_Entrust_18_Content:
"Can you help me find them?"
Among the foreign guests are special groups revisiting Jinzhou not for the first time, but for a past promise or item. Finding these memories has proven elusive due to changes in Jinzhou. Is there truly no wish that cannot be made a reality?

Moonfiesta_FailDialog1: There remain many problems worthy of our consideration...
Moonfiesta_FailDialog2: An error...? Let's tweak the method and go again, shall we?

Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog4: Hah hah, we will be getting what we want.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog4: We see accidents like this in our Liondance shows from time to time. It's normal, don't lose heart.

Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog6: Ta da! It's my spark magic!
Moonfiesta_FailDialog6: Sob sob... I don't like bad endings. The Wooly Warrior mustn't be defeated!
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog7: Wishes symbolize hope, something I hold dear.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog7: You can't win them all. We learned something, didn't we? We'll get it next time.

Moonfiesta_FailDialog8: Hmm, bad timing. Let's wait for a better one.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog9: Start steady, end strong. Was my last move a stroke of genius or what?
Moonfiesta_FailDialog9: Maybe we missed something in our planning... Hm. Let's find a way to solve it.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog10: Did, did I contribute to this...? Phew, great.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog10: I-I messed up. I p-p-promise I'll working hard t-to improve...

Moonfiesta_FailDialog11: Haste makes waste... We need to understand these wishes better.
Moonfiesta_SuccessDialog12: Woah! Best condition ever. The festival has been fire so far!
Moonfiesta_FailDialog12: No... This is way worse than I expected. Hm... Gotta cheer up.
Moonfiesta_FailDialog13: It's okay. Relax. We'll make it next time.

Moonfiesta_InvestDialog4: Things always work out in the end. See? An opportunity.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog5: Twists... Hm, I've gotten used to them.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog6: Heh, I know! This is what they call a "turning point" in a story.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog7: Opportunities come and go. Stay focused.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog8: Looks like we've stumbled onto a fresh lead.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog9: Plans change. We need to find a way to turn it to our advantage.
Moonfiesta_InvestDialog10: Wasn't daydreaming... O-okay, maybe a little. I just saw something weird. D-do I have to say?

Moonfiesta_InvestDialog12: Hey hey. A challenge to the unknown!

Moonfiesta_NewPartner9: I like to help. Mind if I tag along?

Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta5: Do you enjoy the Plumpcake's new flavor?

Moonfiesta_PartnerGift6: Oh, is this what the grown-ups call a festival gift? I love it!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta6: Colors, shapes... There are endless possibilities for fireworks!
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel6: Off to the secret haven. Promise you won't tell anyone!
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat7: The border's not as busy as Taoyuan Vale, but we share the same hopes. Let's ask the moon to hear them.
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift7: Were you worried I wouldn't like this? Silly... I love it. Thank you.
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta7: Have to be prepared just in case.
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel7: Should we go on another walk? The more patrols the better!

Moonfiesta_PartnerGift8: Looks like you've mastered the art of surprises. Is this your big reveal?
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta8: Hearing voices? Ah, you mean this puppet. Quite a magical craft, isn't it?
Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel8: I'm feeling sleepy... While I nap, you make sure I sleep soundly, okay?
Moonfiesta_PartnerChat9: Let's not bother with other matters. A Weiqi game with you right here right now is time well spent.
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift9: You're full of surprises. Guess I owe you one!

Moonfiesta_PartnerChat11: Your journey ahead might take you far away, but this city and everyone here will always welcome you back. Happy Moon-Chasing Festival, Rover!
Moonfiesta_PartnerGift11: I'm touched. It's not about the cost, it's the thought that counts. I felt it when I opened it.

Moonfiesta_PartnerTravel11: Close your eyes and feel the streams. Hmm... I hear your heart racing.

Moonfiesta_PartnerGift12: Whoa, is this for me? Who knew the day could get even better!
Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta12: Challenge accepted! No holding back. Allow me to test its difficulty!

Moonfiesta_PartnerFiesta13: Let me add some strokes to this scene of Taoyuan Vale.

Jinhsi recalled Jué telling her in her youth that Jinzhou had once been a wasteland due to its remote location at the border.
Turning Jinzhou into a flourishing haven—like a seed sprouting in barren soil—was what Jinhsi dreamed of when she first tapped into her Forte.
RogueBuffPool_910312000672_BuffDesc: Upgrade the Resonator after obtaining a certain number of Attribute Orbs.

RogueBuffPool_910312000672_BuffDesc_0:
At first, Jiyan wasn't great with a spear.
Like all Midnight Rangers, he was only trained to use swords. But in that fateful battle, when he rose to lead his comrades out of a dire situation, the wind itself became the long spear he now wields.

RogueBuffPool_910312000673_BuffDesc_0:
Lucky Greetings Collection, edited by Lingyang, has become a must-read for the Liondance Troupe.
"Moms won't have to worry about their kids being tongue-tied ever again!"
"'The moon shines above, pure and bright, tonight we gather in its light.' What a beautiful greeting! Memorize Chapter 13, and you'll have nothing to fear when visiting elders during the Moon-Chasing Festival!"
At the end of the book, more and more heartfelt recommendations from members of the troupe are being added.
RogueBuffPool_910312000674_BuffDesc: Restore HP upon defeating an enemy.
RogueBuffPool_910312000674_BuffDesc_1: Recover <color=#3cea36>5%</color> of the Resonator's Max HP upon defeating an enemy.
RogueBuffPool_910312000674_BuffDesc_0:
Once during her training, Jianxin controlled several leaves with her palms, making them rise and fall three thousand times.
Though never touched them, she felt connected to their essence. Three thousand raindrops danced upon their foliage, three thousand beams of light penetrated through them, and three thousand breezes made them flutter like butterflies. Finally, as three thousand specks of dust settled upon them, the leaves became nourishment for three thousand more lives.
RogueBuffPool_910312000675_BuffDesc: Obtain Dream Fragments based on the current Dream Fragments owned.
RogueBuffPool_910312000675_BuffDesc_1: Obtain Dream Fragments equal to <color=#3cea36>100%</color> of the current Dream Fragments owned.
RogueBuffPool_910312000675_BuffDesc_0:
When Changli arrived in Jinzhou, Jinhsi was still in her youth, and the region was in dire straits.
No one knew how she managed to juggle the interests of various factions and push forward progress across all sectors with a limited budget.
It was said that Changli avoided electronic media during this time, instead recording notes in a booklet. To this day, people continue to search for this elusive booklet, hoping to uncover the secrets of Jinzhou's past. However, no one has ever succeeded, and there's no evidence to even confirm its existence.
RogueBuffPool_910312000676_BuffDesc: Obtain Dream Fragments equal to the multiplier of the current Attribute Orbs owned.
RogueBuffPool_910312000676_BuffDesc_0:
During times of desperation, many sought assistance from Calcharo. Despite their willingness to give up everything for his help, Calcharo asked for just one Shell Credit and one condition: becoming his informant.
Anyone could be Calcharo's informant—it might even be the lady selling groceries in the alley... Much like the mounting pile of Shell Credits, Calcharo's web of spies grows steadily, unwittingly turning him into the "Protector" of the oppressed.
RogueBuffPool_910312000677_BuffDesc: Summon a lightning strike every once in a while during battle.
RogueBuffPool_910312000677_BuffDesc_1: Summon a lightning strike every <color=#3cea36>5</color>s that deals DMG equal to <color=#3cea36>650%</color> of the Resonator's ATK to the enemy on hit.
RogueBuffPool_910312000677_BuffDesc_0: Yinlin is accustomed to walking in shadows, much like the threads of lightning in her hand. These threads silently ensnare her prey, delivering an unexpected fatal blow. With the charge gathered at her fingertips, she metes out punishment to those who deserve it. Once the myriad threads are lifted, everything in her grasp becomes nothing more than lifeless puppets.
RogueBuffPool_910312000678_BuffDesc: Reduce DEF and obtain more Dream Fragments.
RogueBuffPool_910312000678_BuffDesc_0:
He loathes the frail bodies and contemptible souls of humanity, convinced of their incorrigible malevolence.
In his eyes, humans are beyond redemption. His sole desire is to annihilate all in his path.
RogueBuffPool_910312000679_BuffDesc: Lose all Dream Fragments and obtain random Metaphors.
RogueBuffPool_910312000679_BuffDesc_1: Lose all Dream Fragments and obtain <color=#3cea36>5</color> random Metaphors.
RogueBuffPool_910312000679_BuffDesc_0:
Rules are nothing but cages and shackles. Only by breaking them down can we get closer to the truth.
To him, the world is a dull cube with six identical sides. Only the hues of chaos can inject vibrancy to its monotony. And if that proves futile, then twisting and tearing it apart are the only options left.
RogueBuffPool_910312000680_BuffDesc: Increase Resonance Skill DMG. Casting Resonance Skill consumes STA.
RogueBuffPool_910312000680_BuffDesc_1: Increase Resonance Skills DMG Bonus by <color=#3cea36>200%</color>. Casting Resonance Skill consumes <color=#ff5454>80</color> additional STA.
RogueBuffPool_910312000680_BuffDesc_0:
His mother used to tell him countless fairy tales when he was little, the only tender moments in their family. Yet, he couldn't bring himself to believe in those stories.
In every tale he recounted to others, there was always a sacrificial figure. Innocent and virtuous, these were good people who did nothing wrong.
Yet, he interpreted their kindness as sins. The kindness of the meek is not a virtue, but rather a flaw, a trait destined for sacrifice.
RogueBuffPool_910312000681_BuffDesc: Deal more damage upon entering a new Memory Zone. This effect is removed upon taking damage.
RogueBuffPool_910312000681_BuffDesc_1: Increase DMG dealt by <color=#3cea36>70%</color> upon entering a new Memory Zone, which will be removed upon taking DMG.
RogueBuffPool_910312000681_BuffDesc_0: Humanity's evil is like a flickering spark—transient yet enduring, dancing amid the delicate balancing act of human lives. He takes pleasure in orchestrating the perfect moment to ignite those sparks, watching as people succumb to the ensuing pain and bloodshed.
RogueBuffPool_910312000682_BuffDesc: Reduce the Max HP and increase the progression efficiency of Symphony Rank.
RogueBuffPool_910312000682_BuffDesc_1: Reduces Max HP by <color=#ff5454>35%</color>; increases Symphony Rank's progression efficiency by <color=#ff5454>100%</color>.
RogueBuffPool_910312000682_BuffDesc_0: He has shattered the invisible shackles of concepts and rules. Fresh thoughts and ideals now proliferate in the shadows, driven by his conviction that they'll one day emerge into the light as universal truths. When that moment comes, he'll once again cast off all restraints and step into true freedom.

FavorWord_130405_Content:
Walking alone may lead to a faster pace, but a group can cover greater distances. 
Moving forward, I will stand by my companions… and I will stand by you as we face whatever the future holds, together.
FavorWord_130406_Content: Have you been to the Jinzhou Theater? It's a place of endless joy and laughter, especially when a show concludes on a happy note. I've always cherished that sight, which is why I want to ensure everyone finds their own happy ending.
FavorWord_130407_Content: Hmm... When faced with challenges, I am driven by a sense of purpose to find solutions instead of succumbing to worry. The feeling of worry or frustration rarely crosses my mind nowadays.
FavorWord_130411_Content: As a child, I had vivid dreams, some of them turning into nightmares. I would find myself lost at sea, fighting against the crashing waves and tangled seaweed. But each time, I managed to hold onto a piece of driftwood and make it back to shore. And when I woke up, I would find something in my hand… Yes, it was this shiny piece of scale.
FavorWord_130413_Content: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.
FavorWord_130414_Content: Amidst my busy days, meals can easily slip my mind. Before I knew it, it would be well past the time for another meal. But like a blessing, Sanhua would always appear with a plate of delicious Loong Buns, filled with exactly what I was craving. I am in awe… How does she know every time?
FavorWord_130415_Content: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.
FavorWord_130417_Content: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.
FavorWord_130419_Content: May I pray for anything specific for you? It would be my honor… I'm sure your wishes will come true.
FavorWord_130455_Content: There is... much to be done...
FavorWord_130462_Content: As far as the eye can see.
FavorWord_130472_Content: Would these be enough for your needs? Tell me if there is anything else you want.
FavorWord_120501_Content: Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave?
FavorWord_120502_Content: I seem to know a lot about your past, you say? *a small chuckle* Not really. I'd say you may have left those clues for your present self long ago, and I just happened to come across them while going through historical records. I am honored to guide you through the connections between your past and present.
FavorWord_120503_Content: A strategist's mind is a vast and complex entity, much like the ocean. Its placid exterior may mask the turbulent currents of thought swirling within. Master once warned me to be wary of those who stay quiet in times of uncertainty. Yet with you, I find solace in the quiet moments, in our unspoken connection.
FavorWord_120504_Content: Master Xuanmiao taught me the ways of the sword, but he left this world before I could fully absorb his teachings. I have since tried my best to understand his notes and continue my training on my own. When I first saw you wield your sword, it struck a chord with me, and now I understand why. It's not that you resemble my late master in your skills, but rather that he learned from you.
FavorWord_120505_Content: I found you and brought you out of that Sonoro Sphere. This is proof I am qualified to stand by your side and assist in achieving our shared goal. It takes great courage and wisdom to willingly enter into a situation full of unknowns, and I trust that you will achieve your desired outcome. My knowledge and power are at your disposal, always ready to help you in any way needed.
FavorWord_120506_Content: The dynamics of a Weiqi game mirror the complexities of our world, always in a state of constant flux and transformation... Fascinating, isn't it?
FavorWord_120507_Content: My body temperature is higher than usual because of my Flame-controlling Forte. It doesn't hinder daily tasks, but it does have its quirky consequences. Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands... Sigh.
FavorWord_120508_Content: Each delicacy is unique in its own right. It's difficult to choose just one, but if I must, there was a meal I received as a hungry child, a kind gesture that left an indelible memory. That taste remains with me to this day.
FavorWord_120511_Content:
The feather I gave you before? Well, it was forged from the fires of my heart. There are only two of them. 
As long as you hold onto that feather, my fire will never harm you. In fact, I can use it to track your whereabouts if you wish. However, if it ever falls into our enemies' hands... hehe.
FavorWord_120515_Content: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.
FavorWord_120516_Content: Although we followed different sects of Taoist teachings, I found commonalities with her. Her pure and open mind is quite rare nowadays. I believe her perception of the world must be as clear as her eyes. I first met her at the tea house; back then, she seemed to have sensed something about my condition, and served me a bowl of Lotus Seed Soup. That was a delightful surprise.
FavorWord_120518_Content: Happy birthday, my dear. When I was younger, I traveled to many places and saw diverse customs for celebrating birthdays, each one unique and fascinating. Here are some gift boxes for you, a small token of my affection. May you find peace and happiness in the years ahead, like the constant moon and rising sun. Oh, these may be too much? Hehe… Consider them extra gifts for your future birthdays. And if I'm still around to see them, I'll find you something different.
FavorWord_120521_Content: The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives.
FavorWord_120523_Content:
Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game... 
I am fortunate to have you as my opponent.
FavorWord_120524_Content: Time to start a new game.
FavorWord_120525_Content: Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity.
FavorWord_120526_Content: Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time?
FavorWord_120527_Content: The sword has no set form, it adapts along with its foes... Likewise, strategies must shift against different opponents.
FavorWord_120528_Content: Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round.
FavorWord_120529_Content: After my master's passing, I spent years studying martial arts and other subjects through… various unconventional methods. This resulted in some rather comical situations, where angry bookshop owners chased me around. But now, I have the luxury of having you teach me everything without any expectations in return. It's something my younger self could only dream of.
FavorWord_120530_Content: I never thought I could further refine my abilities. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I ought to help you in some way in return. So… Anything I can do for you?
FavorWord_120531_Content: You've taught me more than words can express... I believed I had come to terms with my death; never thought I could one day catch a glimpse into the perspective of an eternal being. For this, I am grateful. As long as my flames still burn, I will stay by your side, dear Rover.
FavorWord_120541_Content: Who is the caged bird now?
FavorWord_120550_Content: No need to dwell on it.

"Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away; the painted world fades, forgotten today."
Upon arriving in Jinzhou, Zhezhi resided in Xiehua Village for a while. Inspired by the scenery outside her window, she captured it in a painting.
RogueBuffPool_11012004_BuffDesc: ATK increases after clearing a certain number of Memory Zones with [Phantasm Partita] enemies.
RogueBuffPool_11012004_BuffDesc_1: Gain <color=#3cea36>40%</color> ATK increase after clearing <color=#ff5454>2</color> Memory Zones with <color=#ff5454>[Phantasm Partita]</color> enemies.
RogueBuffPool_11012004_BuffDesc_0:
Once in a moment of despair, Sanhua witnessed a golden snowfall, dazzling like petals cascading from the heavens.
Drawn to the sight, she forgot her pain and predicament.
Only later did she realize they were actually fallen Bodhi blossoms.
To this day, that ethereal scene enchants her dreams, where swirling snow transforms into a golden deluge of petals. These dreams bring her solace, giving her the strength to face her anomalous visions with calm determination.
RogueBuffPool_11012005_BuffDesc_0:
In Jinzhou, Mortefi is the creative force behind 80% of popular children's toys and entertainment facilities. From the Spinning Bloop to the Swinging Loongboat and the Sabyrboar Scooter, his designs always captivate young minds. Surprisingly, he doesn't charge any patent fees for these designs. 

For Mortefi, it's not about money; it's about seeing the joy, wonder, and admiration in children's eyes. 

Or perhaps, it's a way for him to recapture his own lost childhood.
RogueBuffPool_11012006_BuffDesc_0:
Ali, a classmate of Chixia's, once described to her how poignant their migration was: a time marked by relentless disruptions from the Tacet Discords, when hunger forced them to eat grass or tree bark. Yet, Chixia also remembers savoring this green grass cake, always roasted crusty and seasoned with spicy sauce. It remains a delightful treat etched in her memory.
When she asked her mother about their journey to Jinzhou after school, her mother playfully responded that it was a story open to Chixia's imagination.
RogueBuffPool_11012007_BuffDesc: Reduce DEF for the next few Memory Zones, then increase ATK.

RogueBuffPool_11012009_BuffDesc_0: It serves as the shadowy pawn of unseen adversaries and heralds the onset of ceaseless woes of war.
