FavorGoods_120601_Content:
A meticulously preserved Ammonoid fossil. Little Brant once stood atop a table, proudly declaring to his father that he had found a treasure hidden among the books. His father took off his glasses for a closer look, recognizing it as the Ammonoid fossil tucked away at the bottom of the bookshelf. Seizing the moment, his father recounted an adventure about unearthing the past and seeking the truth.

That Ammonoid became Brant's first treasure and marked the beginning of his journey into a world of endless adventure.
FavorGoods_120602_Content:
A sculpture of stacked masks, each crafted for a different play and occasion.

On stage, he is the star, the center of all eyes. With each mask, he breathes life into the tale, captivating the audience with joy and wonder. But offstage, there is no need to conceal his true self.

In that moment, he is, at last, simply Brant.
FavorGoods_150601_Content:
A locket Phoebe carries with her, repurposed from an old pocket watch. Inside is a family portrait. 

It was lost to the depths of the sea during a shipwreck, but thanks to the tireless search of her kind friends, it was eventually returned to her.

"In the fleeting waves of time... in the beautiful spray of the sea, and in the light, there are words I want to tell you, over and over again."
FavorGoods_150602_Content:
A handcrafted souvenir from a land across the sea was the only item Phoebe kept when her family's possessions were sold off.

In the bedtime stories she once believed would never end, there was a bird with blue wings, the envoy of the Divinity. It had the power to cross through storms and bring happiness to the little girl who endured loneliness each night as she drifted to sleep.
FavorStory_120601_Title: An Improvised Afternoon at the Tavern
FavorStory_150601_Title: A Day in the Life of an Acolyte
FavorWord_120601_Content: I've got some time today. What would you say to a nice stroll on the beach? Maybe the sea breeze and ocean sunset will inspire you!
FavorWord_120602_Content: When sailing the seas, always remember to set your course first, and then... adapt to whatever comes your way!
FavorWord_120603_Content: Hey, here to see our performance? Take this ticket. No need to bring anything, just a smile and a heart full of excitement. But if you insist… Well, when I step on stage, be sure to give me all the applause and cheers you've got!
FavorWord_120604_Content: All I think about on stage is losing myself in the role—the stage becomes "my" entire world, with every light, note, and movement telling "my" story. Up there, the world is my oyster. But once I step off, I'm just a minor character in the tale of <ano=the world>Solaris</ano>.
FavorWord_120606_Content: The boundless sea is the grandest stage, its towering waves our most thunderous applause! We sail with the currents and winds, hunting for cheers and laughter on every distant shore. Therefore, my friend, lift your voice and dance with abandon—for you, for me, and for every day we have lived in full!
FavorWord_120608_Content: Here, try this wine… A bit too sweet? Haha, that's just my "Strength!" Everyone's brew tastes different, you know. Battier's has a spicy edge, Tina's is rather refreshing. This is the Troupe's Strength… a blend of everyone's life.
FavorWord_120609_Content: For me, any food's fair game. C'mon, don't overthink it! When you're hungry enough, everything tastes amazing!
FavorWord_120610_Content: One day, our troupe will sail to every corner of the world, and every wave will echo a shared story—the tale of <ano=Freedom>the Fools</ano>!
FavorWord_120611_Content: Take this telescope and see for yourself… Even the highest clouds feel close enough to touch, don't they? With this gadget, you'll catch every thrill onstage and every "new world" waiting out at sea.
FavorWord_120612_Content: Unforgettable adventures? Where to start? How about an ancient trial that spanned over a century?
FavorWord_120613_Content: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!
FavorWord_120615_Content: Some call her a saint; others, a sinner. But who is she really? No one cares how she treats her friends or faces her foes. The Order's tales never speak of her dreams, and the legends conceal her heart's desire. Everyone has heard of Cartethyia—but does anyone know the person behind that name?
FavorWord_120616_Content: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.
FavorWord_120617_Content: Happy birthday, my dear friend! Got any plans today? How about slipping away with me for a little adventure? I'll even let you take the helm. Here, hold on tight—together, we'll sail into the far horizon!
FavorWord_120620_Content: Hey, little one... There you go!
FavorWord_120622_Content: The curtains pull back and I'm here to hunt for every laugh! Brant, at your service. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
FavorWord_120623_Content: The course is determined. Time to set sail!
FavorWord_120626_Content: With this, the stage is set for a grand opening. Come on, trim the sails!
FavorWord_120627_Content: More power... Now we're storm-proof and unstoppable! Let's go, full speed ahead!
FavorWord_120628_Content: We're smooth sailing now. Onto the next stop... Hard to portside!
FavorWord_120629_Content: With your strength, this massive wave is just a splash in our show! Bring it on!
FavorWord_120630_Content: Haha! Now this is the strength worthy of a true swordsman of the seas! Join me on this voyage to the world's end, my friend! Together, we'll face that fleeting moment when the world turns upside down!
FavorWord_120662_Content: You earned it, you keep it.
FavorWord_150601_Content: Shhh.... how come you're all here? Ah, sorry {PlayerName}, didn't mean to disturb you. I just wanted to pay you a visit. Didn't expect these guys to tag along...
FavorWord_150602_Content: {PlayerName}, how did you meet Abby? Sorry, I don't mean to pry, it's just the two of you are inseparable, always looking out for each other, always trusting one another. It's wonderful, Abby must be... like family.
FavorWord_150604_Content: You always seem so busy, but I hardly ever see you resting... Are you, perhaps, having trouble sleeping? If that's the case, I can help. Just a little tap with my staff and your mind will be at ease... Hmm? Where are you going? It won't hurt at all...
FavorWord_150606_Content: When I was little, I loved going to Whisperwind Haven with friends. We'd lie on slopes surrounded by flowers and watch the clouds drift by. Tilly would play their accordion, and Livia and Brenno would weave all sorts of garlands that left a wonderful scent in their wake. I still go back sometimes... in secret.
FavorWord_150607_Content: I saw shadows where light could not reach. What if the path I once believed in so fervently was never the right one? Then... No, never mind. Please don't mind me...
FavorWord_150611_Content: This locket was a gift from my father. I always thought it had sunk with that merchant ship, but here it is again in my hands. This itself is already a miracle... I cannot ask for more.
FavorWord_150613_Content: Mother once told me a story about an adventurer braving storms in search of freedom. When I saw Brant on stage, he reminded me of that adventurer, caring for naught while the ocean thrashes around him... Sometimes, I think Mr. Brant chooses to act out a life of equal parts comedy and tragedy.
FavorWord_150615_Content: ...I once dreamt of a black sea, with swells growing larger and more violent. Amidst the spray, the Blessed Maiden appeared—or at least I think it was her. Something in that swaying silhouette resembled her, yet it also felt so unlike her...
FavorWord_150617_Content: Happy Birthday! Ooh... confetti! Just like how Mama and Papa used to celebrate. Here, take this, a bluebird set with aquamarine gemstones. A little something to be by your side through winds and storms. Like this statue, may your eyes always be bright, and may luck always be with you. Your path is not one ordained by the Sentinel, but one of your own making. And no matter where you go, I will always pray for you.
FavorWord_150618_Content: May Thy love endure forever, never ceasing.
FavorWord_150619_Content: Hm... Eh? Oh, there you are! Who's a good boy...
FavorWord_150625_Content: The sparkling sea knows no bounds.
FavorWord_150626_Content: Do I have what it takes to fight the forces of darkness?
FavorWord_150627_Content: Your light has shown me a world I had never seen.
FavorWord_150628_Content: Thanks to you, my light will shine upon those in need.
FavorWord_150629_Content: Held aloft by the rapids, I saw a golden glow... Your wisdom and grace have become gospel which I shall forever hold dear.
FavorWord_150654_Content: Dark forces approach, be on guard.
FavorWord_150657_Content: Cherish the gift not given lightly.

AreaReportContent_Text47:
A worn student handbook, its pages frayed and torn, revealing only snippets of information.

Welcome to Avinoleum. This handbook serves as a guide for new students.

 1. The academy consists of three towers. In addition to the classrooms used for daily lessons, one tower is specifically dedicated to student gatherings and social events. This tower also houses portraits of past Primuses. Both new and old students are welcome to visit and pay their respects. Afterward, visitors must leave in an orderly manner.
 2. The watchtower and garden are only accessible before curfew. Entry is prohibited outside of these hours. Students are strictly forbidden from feeding the dragons that inhabit the surrounding area. Violators will face confinement for a period of three to five days.
AreaReportContent_Text48:
3. Students who have completed the knighthood curriculum may apply to participate in the trials. Applications must be submitted with the required materials at least seven days in advance. A review process will follow, during which instructors will ensure applicants are not carrying any prohibited weapons or Echoes before proceeding to the trials.
4. The Path of Bestowal is only open to faculty and students during divine services and the Carnevale. Outside of the Carnevale, students invited to attend divine services must wear the prescribed attire and be accompanied by a member of the Order to the Path of Bestowal for their studies.
 
By the Sentinel above, may every student find enlightenment in Avinoleum.
AreaReportContent_Text49:
A journal carried by a Fisalia member, detailing the principles and taboos that all must respect.

About the Family: Trust nothing blindly, not even your own kin. As a Fisalia, blessings and protection are earned by your own efforts. If you prove your worth, the family permits you to use any means necessary to rise. Even the position of family head is a treasure to be claimed at the right price. Betrayal is a tool, and greed is a virtue. But remember, always wield them with grace.

About Visiting: Every visit to the estate must be justified. For those who dare intrude without invitation, the Fisalias will show them the Fisalia way of hospitality. "Invite" them to leave, or "invite" them to stay permanently as a warning to others. When an invitation is extended, visitors must mind their manners and maintain discretion. Never allow curiosity or fear to lead to your undoing.
AreaReportContent_Text50:
About the Castle: Visitors with matters to discuss must wait quietly in the reception room on the first floor until granted an audience with the family head. No wandering or departure is allowed during this time. Invited guests must present their invitations and proceed to the banquet hall on the right, where hospitality will be provided in accordance with their station. All other rooms in the mansion are off-limits for visitation, including but not limited to the study on the second floor and the surrounding garden.

About the Montellis: Fleeting brilliance. Remember, true glory belongs to the Fisalia family.

FavorRoleInfo_1607_Info:
The current head of <te href=850094>Fisalia</te>, Cantarella, the Bane.
A mysterious noblewoman, her beauty as captivating as it is perilous. She resides in a crown-like castle perched atop the mountain, where illusory dreams flow like streams, meticulously spun by her own hands.
FavorGoods_160701_Content:
The parasol carried by Cantarella.

Its round canopy resembles a soft, plump jellyfish with long, graceful tentacles that seem to float effortlessly in the air. The ribs of the parasol are crafted from deep-sea coral, meticulously shaped into perfect curves that gleam with a subtle glow, both beautifully delicate and unyieldingly strong. At the handle, a sapphire is embedded, a symbol of the unshakable authority of the family head.

Violence has never been Cantarella's first choice, but when forced to defend herself, she merely spins her parasol, and in an instant, the canopy radiates brilliant light. From it, a mesmerizing swarm of jellyfish unfurls, drifting into a phantasmal sea of illusion.

Drawing her enemies into this enchanting yet perilous sea of dreams is the signature art of Cantarella. Like its owner, the parasol may appear soft and fluid, yet when the need arises, it is always indestructible.
FavorGoods_160702_Content:
The cauldron used by Cantarella, the Sea Witch, for potion brewing. The sapphire adorned on it marks Cantarella's authority as the head of the Fisalias.

She often allows her whims to guide her, carelessly tossing in unexpected ingredients, such as jellyfish tentacles, fish scales, tears from the heartbroken, and even the murmurs that linger in the air.

Whatever she adds, the result is always a pot of sweet dreams that dissolves the bitterness of reality, gently soothing those lost in the abyss.
FavorStory_160701_Content:
The light filtered through the stained glass, casting a speckled pattern across the crimson sofa. 

Dim lamps flickered softly in the misty purple room. Around the round table sat several indistinct figures. Some lounging in the light, others half-immersed in the shadows. The lady who arranged this gathering, or at least, by her position, that's what it seemed, spoke first. She had long, silky purple hair, and her indigo eyes, veiled in a soft mist, gave her an ethereal, dreamlike vibe. Lounging lazily on the sofa, she absentmindedly toyed with the sapphire pendant on her chest, a habit she indulged whenever lost in thought.

"I've gathered everyone today to discuss one thing: where should we stay? In the '<te href=850119>Illusory Dream</te>,' or in reality?"

"Since we've been wandering the edge of dreams, should we remain here, in this illusion, where everything is familiar, light and delicate as bubbles? Or should we step forward, into reality, where we might face the unknown… but also see sights we've never known?"

A lazy but resolute voice cut through her words. "How weak of you, Cantarella. You may be head of the family now, but from what I see, you're far from being capable."

A figure emerged from the shadows, a woman with long hair cascading like a waterfall. She wore the same sapphire pendant and carried an air of grace similar to Cantarella's, but with the undeniable weight of experience and authority. Her deep purple eyes glinted with an unquestionable edge.

"This meeting is pointless. Just pour the '<te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>' into the waterfall behind the castle, and let all of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> fall into a dream under your control. That way, we will be queen wherever we go."

"Invalid answer. Or, if you insist, it will be counted as a vote for 'Illusory Dream.' Though it sounds a little wild and impractical, I'll still write it down for fairness. This is our discussion, after all." A young girl sitting beside them answered, opening a notebook full of strange doodles. She found a small space nearly buried under potion recipes and seriously drew a neat line.

"I abstain," she said casually. "This discussion probably won't change anything. You already have your answer, don't you? For me, it doesn't matter where we stay." She closed the notebook with a soft snap and shook out her white shawl. The light caught her blue, hazy eyes.

"Why can't we just keep it simple and follow our hearts? Cantarella, you like watching the birds outside the window and long for a life of freedom, right? Then just do what feels right," said the youngest one, sprawled on the sofa, her hands lazily chasing the dust motes dancing in the light.

"This is an important decision and should be discussed seriously," Cantarella replied, her voice tinged with a hint of helplessness. "Let's start with you then. Please explain your choice and the reasoning behind it."
FavorStory_160702_Content:
The deep purple, venomous crown, when first placed upon the brow, brings a sharp sting. Yet, the blood that seeps from the forehead nourishes it, making it shine ever brighter. Soaked in the blood and tears of countless souls, this crown of toxic thorns rises from the depths of the sea,  symbolizing those who work silently against the chaos to support the weight of the Celestial Steed's tail feathers.

Such is the glory of the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family, and its inescapable fate.

But what of each member of the family? In the dark, deep sea, they suffer the gnawing whispers, until the faintest glimmer of true faith in their hearts fades, lost to the abyss. The next in line to wear the crown will take up the duty, and so the cycle endures, unbroken, with no beginning or end.

Fragrant yet toxic blooms,
Colorless, flavorless tears of poisons,
Twisted organs and venomous breaths,
Neurotoxins,
Biotoxins,
Metallic toxins…

The poisons and toxins the Fisalias so pride themselves on and the abilities birthed from them will inevitably be undone by the whispers… In the end, they only come in handy when used to seek the end of life, either for the Fisalias themselves or their kin.

This had long been the norm until I developed the "<te href=850119>Illusory Dream</te>." When the thorned crown burrowed into my flesh, the blood flew in strange, shimmering hues. Black tea steeped in mercury tasted like rich, honeyed nectar, while scones soaked in Jellyrose juice had a delicate sweetness. The heat in my throat was searing, as if hastily swallowing an entire cherry, and the suffocating sensation was like drifting in an endless sea… Slowly, the pain faded, and both body and mind became light as air. The bottles of poisons shattered on the floor, and our expressions turned relieved. The whispers were powerless in the world woven by the sea of dreams, for it gently dissolved all discord. Amidst the colorful waves, the once harsh thorned crown was softened… So soft that it formed delicate folds, resting lightly on my head. It became light and pure, like the tail feathers of the Celestial Steed.

That's why I cast my vote for "Illusory Dream." After all, what harm is there in this illusion? Have we not all wandered here for so long? Pour the "<te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>" into the waterfall behind the castle, and let the whole of <te href=850097>Ragunna</te> fall into a dream shaped by my hand… Rest assured, this is but a joke. I do not seek to control but only wish for all to live more peacefully.

You see, the "Illusory Dream" flows within our veins, and whether we like it or not, it's a permanent and inseparable part of us.
FavorStory_160703_Content:
In the dimly lit room, heavy with a peculiar scent, a faint yellow light illuminated an old notebook and a strange cauldron. The young woman, wrapped in a white shawl, scribbled notes in the book while casually tossing ingredients into the cauldron. The smoke rising from it darkened her clothes, leaving patches of black and purple. Her once-clean apron was now speckled, but she wiped her face carelessly, unfazed by the mess.

Distilled water, peppermint, castor bean, barnacle fish leaves, rosemary… The scent was fresh, the toxicity mild, with soothing and analgesic effects. It could treat the common Infantile Gray Matter syndrome seen recently… I'll write this recipe on a small note and leave it for Chloe later.

Hilo grass, sea okra, barnacle fish leaves, sea apple juice… The scent was unpleasant, and the toxicity potent, though it could counteract some nerve paralysis reactions. Hmm, but the side effects… Never mind, I'll keep it.

Sea okra mucilage, barnacle fish leaves dried and crushed, a splash of sea apple juice, a touch of Jellyrose juice… The toxicity of Jellyrose is too strong. Effective, but too risky.

Crush the barnacle fish leaves, drizzle with Violacas juice, mix with sea okra mucilage, add a bit of sea apple juice, and let it ferment in a glass vial… Done. Once consumed, it soothes the spirit and neutralizes most poison reactions. I should distribute some to everyone to get through the trials in the coming days. And the name… okay, I'll call it <te href=850120>Velvet Dream</te>.

The ingredients, processing method, sequence of preparation, and environmental temperature… Handle each step at the right moment, and I can brew the perfect elixir. I believe the same applies to life. At the right moment, with the right steps, most problems can be solved. No matter how illogical the rules or how brutal the situation is, there is always a way to find the right approach.

Therefore, I stepped into the darkness with the lamp, facing my fears. The abyss mocked me—reclusive, weak, incapable of adapting. Its taunting howls echoed through the corridors, the twisted frequencies of past family heads surging forward, engulfing me. Serious, rigid, pale, gloomy, silent… They knew me too well, able to predict my every move and trap me effortlessly.

But still, I played my very first and last trick as I drank a large dose of Velvet Dream in advance. The moment the jellyfish's poisonous thorns pierced my skin, I pressed the Jellyrose Medusa to my head. The violent toxins clashed within my veins, nearly tearing me apart. My soul rolled between life and death, on the verge of spilling out through my burning throat. I couldn't tell if it was blood, tears, or sweat mixed with the remnants of the potion… It dripped onto the almost extinguished lamp.

A small jellyfish wobbled out from the faint light. When I raised my eyes, the darkness lifted, and my blurred vision filled with colorful, vivid illusions.

It worked.

So, like I said, any situation can be solved with the right steps at the right time, even if you're just one part of the process. Since then, I've remained in a perpetual state between life and death, between dreams and reality. I often catch glimpses of lingering illusions, like the girl in the red hat. Who is she? Is it me? Or someone else? I can't figure it out.

Anyway, I'll abstain from voting. It doesn't matter whether it's in a dream or reality. I've been used to it, and I can survive anywhere.
FavorStory_160704_Content: Since I could remember, I had always been in that big, empty house. I would walk from one end to the other, knowing every tile on the floor and every potion bottle on the shelves. The house was gray, dark, and quiet. The only time it ever felt alive was when a bird flew past the window. I would watch its white wings flutter up and down until it became nothing more than a tiny dot in the sky. Beyond that, the sky turned a clear blue, and the trees shone a bright green. It was such a beautiful sight. That was when I would wonder… what was happening in that thick forest? Maybe a princess was having an adventure. I imagined a clever princess who knew how to spot a poisoned apple. When a snake chased her, a little bird would swoop in to save her, carrying her high into the sky. There, she would find a girl in red shoes who couldn't stop dancing and save her. Then, they would dive into the sea to rescue a siren who was on the verge of turning into foam. In the end, the bird would carry them all, flying as far as it could until it could fly no more, finally landing in a castle… But what was the castle like? I only hoped it wasn't like the manor I lived in—big and boring. Sorry, that probably sounds all over the place, doesn't it? Well… Mother and Father always said that girls from the Fisalia family didn't need to read silly fairytales or have strange ideas like that. We were supposed to read books—books like The Complete Guide to Poison Recipes, The Fisalia Family's Secret Elixirs, and 108 Poisons You Never Knew About. They were interesting, but after reading them too many times, they became dull. Still, Mother and Father insisted that I memorize everything so that one day, I could save myself, or perhaps even become a Maiden or the family's leader. It sounded like a huge responsibility. I didn't really understand it yet, but I did what they told me. They were always busy, always rushing around. Whenever they left, they locked the door extra tight and checked it over and over again. I never understood why they grew busier and thinner. And why did they drink so much "water" and mumble strange words? I had learned to say those words too: "It's the glory and fate of the Fisalias." Eventually, I grew older and had to move to a different house. When I left, Mother and Father looked proud, but their eyes were full of tears. "Indeed, milord, our child has great talent, especially in brewing poisons." "Yes, becoming a candidate for the trials is the glory and fate of the Fisalias." That was the first time I ever left home. As I stepped outside, my footsteps startled the crows perched on the dead tree near the gate. They flapped their black wings and took off, flying toward a strange castle in the distance. Oh, sorry, I went off track again. What I meant to say was... after spending so long flying through dreams, you start to miss the feeling of your feet on the ground. Sure, you might step into mud or get pricked by sharp stones, but there was something comforting about taking each step on solid earth. So, when it came time to vote, I chose reality—The Other Side of the Dream, as the adults liked to call it. They always used fancy terms like that. But deep down, you already knew what your heart truly wanted, didn't you? Not just in dreams, but in reality, too. You could open the door, step outside, and go with everyone. Just fly alongside the white birds and chase after the happily-ever-after ending for everyone.
FavorWord_160711_Content: Tell me, what do you suppose goes into the <te href=850094>Fisalia</te> family's famed elixir? A rare herb, grown in secret? Tormented souls simmering in unseen cauldrons? Hehe... Or perhaps the delicate flesh of young girls?
FavorWord_160713_Content: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true <te href=850101>Montelli</te>, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.
FavorWord_160716_Content: She accomplished the impossible, reclaiming her humanity from the cage of a Divinity's vessel. When the Carnevale petals fall upon <te href=850097>Ragunna</te>'s streets again, the Holy Maiden will at last be herself.
FavorWord_160722_Content: The current head of <te href=850094>Fisalia</te>, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know.
FavorWord_160701_Content: Can I mix you a jug of Violaca juice? It soothes nerves and eases fatigue. You must learn to relax. You can't help others if you don't take care of yourself, you know.
FavorWord_160702_Content: Aren't these jellyfish beautiful? Come, try touching one... a light caress. There, there, you needn't be afraid. I would never put you in harm's way. See, they only wish to wrap their soft tendrils around your finger and pull you into a sweet, sweet dream.
FavorWord_160703_Content: Some see in dreams the scars of a troubled past, others see bleak futures. For those confined in reality, dreams offer a sweet reprieve. Tell me, what do you see in yours, if not nothing at all? Look at you, hehe... so peacefully asleep.
FavorWord_160704_Content: Dreams born of fevered escape lay bare our darkest desires and fears. The weak drown in their own fantasies until they fade into oblivion. But I know that's not you. You sip the poison like it's sweet nectar.
FavorWord_160705_Content: I like the way you look at me. In your eyes, even the darkest depths of the sea are made transparent. With you, I am no longer "The Bane." I am simply myself.
FavorWord_160706_Content: You see those delicate blooms in the garden? I shall pluck them and distill their essence into sweet concoctions. The toxins in their petals, once crushed, will be tempered, the poison dissolving like a fading nightmare leaving only a soft fragrance that beckons sweet dreams.
FavorWord_160707_Content: I've spent too much time in the depths of the sea. At times, I wish for a breath of fresh air above the surface.
FavorWord_160708_Content: Food, stripped of extravagant "seasonings." I can scarcely recall the natural taste of most foods.
FavorWord_160709_Content: Apples soaked in poison for too long. They become sickeningly sweet. Even the glossy sugar shell cannot mask the scent of decay beneath.
FavorWord_160710_Content: I've longed to craft a potion like no other. One born of my soul, to free the dreams buried deep below, and let them soar, singing through the waking world.
FavorWord_160712_Content: Perhaps you've heard of this method for crafting poison? Seal venomous creatures in a jar, and let them battle until only one remains... Nourished by the venom of the dead, it will produce the deadliest poison, the vilest of all banes.
FavorWord_160714_Content: A lively Starfish and a gentle Sea Bunny... But I must admit, I can't tell them apart.
FavorWord_160715_Content: The little girl with a giant box who plays with fireworks? A fascinating child. I wonder if bringing her into this castle would liven it up a little. Oh relax, I'm only teasing.
FavorWord_160717_Content: Hmm, what would be a fitting analogy... perhaps an immortal jellyfish? Like these delicate, shimmering creatures roving alone in the darkness, {Male=he;Female=she} dispels shadows with {Male=his;Female=her} gentle light, inch by inch, until the end of time.
FavorWord_160718_Content: Fine black pearl powder, the essence of Albizia flowers, and the petals of starfish blooms, all sealed in a glass vial bearing your name. For all the time we've shared, it has slowly fermented, ripening to perfection. Today, the moment has finally come. Unseal this birthday elixir, and look... Do you see? A fleeting moment in your long life, a private stretch of sea that belongs to only the two of us.
FavorWord_160726_Content: I can feel that warmth, just like the caress of sunlight tracing the sea.
FavorWord_160727_Content: Mmm, how exquisite... Like a storm crashing into a still sea, stirring it to life with waves that reach for the sky.
FavorWord_160728_Content: Ah... Like a fierce undertow sweeping through the abyss, causing the sea itself to tremble.
FavorWord_160729_Content: Who can plumb the sea's depths, or uncover its secrets? Yet for those who brave its dark currents, the sea offers her truest, most tender gifts—her treasures, her deepest secret.
FavorWord_160730_Content: You rose from the ocean in the sky, wove through loops of time, and now you've reached the sea's depths. Remember, no matter how venomous the seabed, there will always be a place for you here. Here, the currents move slowly, and I long to... drift with you.
FavorWord_160746_Content: Sleep, in the whispers of sirens.
FavorWord_160747_Content: Take a breath, I'm right here.
FavorWord_160753_Content: I'm no stranger to this sensation...
FavorWord_160755_Content: Like sea foam on the shore...
FavorWord_160758_Content: Who will sink into the depths with me?
FavorWord_160762_Content: We desire, and so we find.
FavorWord_160763_Content: What we want has a way of appearing when least expected.
FavorWord_160764_Content: Luck does seem to favor you.
FavorWord_160765_Content: The sea is a mirror. It reflects the shape of your soul in its tides.
FavorWord_140602_Content: This is a testament to my connection with the world around me, and it's very much my companion now, bearing witness to everything I've experienced on this journey.
FavorWord_140604_Content: We still have a long journey ahead of us. Let's press on.
FavorWord_140606_Content: I will be there for everyone... As we head toward our shared future, leaving the past behind.
FavorWord_140607_Content: The world around me... I can hear it clearer now.
FavorWord_140608_Content: This power... it's mysterious, yet reassuring nonetheless.
FavorWord_140609_Content: I still need more time to acquaint myself with this unfamiliar world.
FavorWord_140610_Content: A new journey awaits? Brimming with novel sounds, stories, and... fragmented memories.
FavorWord_140611_Content: The place where the land ends is where the ocean begins. Our journey is far from ending.

HD_XK_43_1: This is a realm created from melodies. Music can transcend space and time to bring memories and stories to life.
HD_XK_43_2: That music sheet is no ordinary piece of music, is it?
HD_XK_43_3: No. Normally, you can't perceive the frequencies in a melody, but that manuscript lets you see the world as I do. That part with the Daemons... should be right here.
HD_XK_43_4:
???: They burned in despair, resentful of the Order's verdict till their last breath. Their last work is nothing but a curse upon us all!
{PlayerName}: It's the same as what we heard before, but now I see something. A balance scale, with a crowd of people standing on one of the pans. What are they weighing?
Ciaccona: The two sides of the scale represent differing perspectives. Once a work is made public, its meaning no longer belongs to its creator alone, but is shaped by the interpretations of its readers.
HD_XK_43_7:
Perhaps it was a simple poem at first, nothing more. But then that article claimed it was a curse upon Ragunna.
Given that members of the Golden Anthem were banished on the Pilgrim's Sail and died in a fire, the notion quickly took hold.
HD_XK_43_20:
No one knew exactly what happened, so they filled in the gaps with their imaginations. With motive and a complete story, perhaps that's all it took for a lie to become the truth.
"Each time someone plays their last work, it summons Daemons. This is the Golden Anthem's revenge and curse upon Ragunna."
But still, words and imagination alone cannot bring something into existence...
HD_XK_43_13:
Yes, someone must've used them to create the Daemons. What if the mastermind pulling the strings from the shadows... is the author of that article?
Daemons are bound to their creator, so it might not be a coicidence you felt them target you at the resturant. 
There could be a connection between you and this mastermind, or perhaps they have their own reasons for wanting to see you silenced.
HD_XK_43_16: How do we catch this mastermind?
HD_XK_43_19:
If the Daemons are born from the public's imagination, then things will shift once we catch whoever is responsible for starting this in the first place. 
This mastermind has gone to great lengths to twist the facts, stirring fear and turning it into resentment. It may be an attempt to cover up certain stories about the Poets Society.
He must be tied to them somehow. If we can learn more about the Golden Anthem, we might be one step closer to catching him.
HD_XK_44_1: {PlayerName}: This is... a cathedral. That's the choir on stage, with the Poets Society leading them. Looks like it's a ceremony of some kind. It sounds like...
HD_XK_44_3: A triumphant victory song for the knights.
HD_XK_44_5: A song to glorify the Order's reign.
HD_XK_44_6: It sounds like a song celebrating the knights who defeated the Tacet Discords at Whisperwind Haven. Wait... someone's approaching the stage.
HD_XK_44_7:
Angry Listener: Degenerates! Arrogant hypocrites, every last one of you! You have no idea what happened... none at all!
Angry Listener: Has the Order reduced our sacrifices to mere tales to be told over tea? The Sentinel's blessing. Bah!
Angry Listener: Where were you when we fought the Tacet Discords at Whisperwind Haven? Where were any of you? Where was the Sentinel?!
Angry Listener: We didn't fight for the Sentinel or for the damned Order. We fought for ourselves! You're nothing but hypocrites!
HD_XK_44_11:
Master of Ceremony: This is madness! Who is this madman? Someone remove him from here, immediately!
Master of Ceremony: Do not be deceived! All knights who rode into that battle wielded swords sanctified by the Order. They fought in the name of Divinity!
HD_XK_44_13: What he said about the common folk... Is it true? Tell me, were they also sent to fight at Whisperwind Haven? I must see it for myself.
HD_XK_44_14: What a mess... I suppose this incident is what changed the Poets Society.
HD_XK_44_25: The cathedral's gate is open. We should leave now.
HD_XK_44_15: {PlayerName}: Strange... why is this passageway so long? This is the same study I stumbled into in the Realm of Melodies.
HD_XK_44_17:
"Girl in the Study": Afternoon tea! Yes, please!
Maid: Your tea and biscuits, miss. I'll reapply the medicine once you're finished. Next time, no more climbing walls, understood?
"Girl in the Study": It wasn't just for fun, I was trying to—
HD_XK_44_20:
Maid: There, there. I understand you've always been a curious child. You saw something terribly interesting and snuck out to take a closer look. 
"Girl in the Study": Mmmff... Wait, wait! Is it raspberry? My favorite. Huh? Ah... Oww, oww, oww!
HD_XK_44_22: "Girl in the Study": Look at this! This book says the flower doesn't live long, but that's silly. I know it can survive the coldest of winters! "Girl in the Study": Maybe one day, I'll become a great bard. A proper one, who never makes mistakes like this!
HD_XK_44_24:
Maid: Miss, this study is a secret... You must never tell a soul.
"Girl in the Study": I understand, but I've always wondered... why do people say they're guilty? There are so many interesting poems and songs here. Why won't Father let me see them?
Maid: Oh, you'll understand when you're older, Miss...
HD_XK_45_1:
The poets did board the Pilgrim's Sail, becoming the stars of their own final act.
We all know how that tale ended—a great fire consumed the ship, dragging it to icy depths, and the poets of the Golden Anthem with it.
But hear this, banishment did not breed hatred in their hearts for our city, and the flames did not scorch a curse into their music or poems.
HD_XK_45_4:
If you wish to hear their true voices once more, seek them at the Cathedral of Mercury.
The children there still sing hymns written by the poets of the Golden Anthem, and yet... not a single Daemon has appeared.
Even as those poets faced their end—
HD_XK_45_7: They did not surrender to hatred.
HD_XK_45_8: The great fire burned everything to ashes.
HD_XK_45_9: They weren't the ones that boarded the Pilgrim's Sail.
HD_XK_45_10:
As the fire filled the ship's cabins, they penned their last poems with death drawing near.
Perhaps they were greeted by the Sentinel in their final moments, or perhaps they fell silently toward death...
HD_XK_45_12:
If the poets truly meant to curse Ragunna, why would they write such obscure poems?
Why not simply leave their works behind in Ragunna? No, their last words were hastily written as the flames closed in.
HD_XK_45_13:
This charade... it was carefully crafted, twisting their work to conceal the truth.
We already have... no...
HD_XK_45_17: Tomorrow, at the Odyssey Opera House, I will reveal the truth. Until then, I thank you all for your patience.
HD_XK_46_1:
This is how it all started. A mysterious person showed the poets the truth about the Sentinel. Then they decided to become Knights of Ragunna. 
Back then, besides the conductor, there were others who helped organize things. That was us, the Toccata family.
HD_XK_46_3:
It didn't take long for the Order to notice us. To keep everyone safe, they gave my father a key to a study. 
Inside, there were papers that could've destroyed the Order... if anyone would even believe them in the first place.  
It was blasphemy... but my father didn't hesitate. He took the key right away.
HD_XK_46_6: Was the fire on the Pilgrim's Sail really an accident?
HD_XK_46_7: As you've already seen, I was also banished. You've probably heard a lot about the Pilgrim's Sail from Brant.
HD_XK_46_8: Usually, the food and water on those ships aren't enough to get the people where they need to go. Even if they made it, the cold would get them. But on that ship, the Order made sure there was nothing. No food, no water, nothing. And there were only three "Fools" onboard.
HD_XK_46_10: As for the fire... the poets started it themselves...
HD_XK_46_11:
In the past, everyone thought they were brilliant cantors. But inside, only they understood how fake and arrogant all their poems and music really were. 
In their last moments before death, the poets just wanted to leave something real behind. But it was so cold out at sea, and wood for fire was already running low...
So they set the cabin on fire and met their ends in the flames.
HD_XK_46_15:
In the world they dreamed of, poets would no longer be shackled and everyone could sing freely. That was their wish for the future when the curtain fell.
"With our bodies to fuel the fire, the ensuing inferno shall forge Ragunna's true gold."
HD_XK_46_18: But the Order was afraid. They didn't want any loose ends, so they went to salvage the ship's wreckage...
HD_XK_46_19: The poets gave their legacy to the Toccata family...
HD_XK_46_21: The Toccata family were also banished...
HD_XK_46_22:
The Golden Anthem gave my father the key. At first, he wouldn't let me near it because I was too little.
It wasn't until my mother, my uncle, and the rest of my family were one by one escorted onto Pilgrim's Sails... Then, it was his turn.
HD_XK_46_24: I still remember the day he handed me the key... The smile on his face.
HD_XK_46_25: Don't see it as a burden, my child. Remember, true courage isn't hiding it away in your heart. Raise it like a torch, just like the sun, so it can light the way for others.
HD_XK_46_26: Only this kind of courage can rid your father of the cowardice he showed toward you and your mother... Never forget, you are a Toccata.
HD_XK_46_27:
Father wanted to tell everyone, so the Order put him on a Pilgrim's Sail with the same charges. And... that was the last time I saw him.
Later, after I became a wandering bard and poet, I started to feel what was in the melodies of the poets and my ancestors... A sincerity like none other.
HD_XK_46_29:
I wrote songs, weaving the stories my father and the poets discovered into musical scores...
But what awaited me... was the Order's banishment.
HD_XK_46_31:
The Poets Society and our family could never prove whether the Sentinel's form is really that of a Celestial Steed.
All we could do was hold onto our suspicions and the possible truth... waiting for someone to prove it.
Now... that someone has come. {Male=He;Female=She} has reached the inverted tower.
HD_XK_46_34:
Now, I have that choice again—Do I reveal the truth?
Always worrying about my next meal, wandering from place to place, being chased by Acolytes... I'm used to it.
HD_XK_46_36:
But this time, I have you and my friends with me... I can't let you all repeat my fate. 
If we step onto that stage tomorrow, the Order will not stand idly by. They might even come after you and Carlotta...
HD_XK_46_38: {PlayerName}: Like I said, the truth exists to be uncovered. I've made my choice. And once everyone hears the truth, I believe no one will question the choices you all made in the past.
HD_XK_46_40: {PlayerName}: (There are hints of the sea inside Ciaccona's melodies.) You should take greater pride in being a poet.
HD_XK_46_42:
Thank you... Thank you for understanding everything.
Let's open the doors. I hope this time the story ends differently.
HD_XKTW_1_4:
Imagination knows no bounds. If left unchecked, such incidents will only increase. For Resonators, dealing with them isn't much of a challenge, but for ordinary folk, it's enough to spark panic across the city. 
Finding the one pulling the strings should be our priority...
HD_XKTW_1_5:
Maybe because you went to Avinoleum and uncovered some of the truths the Order is desperate to hide... 
It will take a lot more than that to even leave a scratch on you. Perhaps they're having someone else do their dirty work. 
That just makes finding the one pulling the strings a top priority...
HD_XKTW_2_4:
Banished and forever stripped of the right to sing for the Sentinel and the Order... that much is true. 
The Order's records say as much. But there's still... something missing. 
If such an important melody is lost, we won't be able to find the link between the poets and the Order...
HD_XKTW_2_5:
On the surface, yes, the Order certainly upheld Ragunna's prosperity and stability…
The poets, praised for their songs to honor the Sentinel, earned the Order's favor. Despite their banishment, their works still serve the Order's cause today.
But this, my friend, doesn't strike the right chord we need to follow...
HD_XKTW_2_6: Simply knowing the Order once stood with the poets doesn't reveal the true reason behind their banishment.
HD_XKTW_3_5:
A fire seemingly forged from the depths of hell destroyed everything, leaving nothing but ash behind. 
And so... their work, too, was swallowed in the flames?
HD_XKTW_3_6:
That doesn't quite add up. 
If hellfire was all that remained from the Pilgrim's Sail, then... could they really have been trying to curse Ragunna?
If that were the case... well, shouldn't the curse have come true?
HD_XKTW_3_7:
That's an awfully big assumption! What if they never boarded the Pilgrim's Sail at all? What if none of them perished in that fire? 
That begs the question, who was on that ship? Who started the fire and spread the rumors about the Golden Anthem?
HD_XKTW_3_9:
Another poet intimately familiar with the poets of the Golden Anthem, you say? 
If such a person exists, then why haven't the Golden Anthem stepped forward to prove their innocence?
No... That's not it. This will take the story in the wrong direction...
HD_XKTW_4_5:
Is that what you think? Well, that's one way to look at it.
But it wasn't ever the poets' intent to curse Rinascita.
HD_XKTW_4_6:
No, it was the Order and others who "cursed" their works, then deliberately spread them as "forbidden works" to the public... 
But why? If their aim was to silence you for knowing the truth about the Blessed Maiden and Imperator, it was a clumsy attempt.
HD_XKTW_4_8:
Monsters breed fear, and perhaps fear is exactly what the Order of the Deep and this puppet master want to see.
It seems we've become pawns in Fenrico and this puppet master's game...
The more I think about it... we, too, have become the very ones to curse Rinascita...
HD_XKTW_4_9:
Our crime was the same as the poets. "Blasphemy." 
Our family wasn't like the Fisalias, deeply rooted in tradition, nor were we like the Montellis, wielding power. We simply did what we thought was right, preserving everything for those who would come after us.
HD_XKTW_4_10:
Compared to the Order, we were just a tiny speck of dust. Even if we'd kept the secret, they would've discovered it eventually. 
They would seize what the poets left behind and lock it away.
HD_XKTW_4_11:
Maybe, if Father hadn't taken in the poets' legacy, the Toccata family would've escaped this fate.
Perhaps none of this would've happened... 
If so, wouldn't it have been wiser to surrender it all to the Order back then?
HD_XKTW_4_12: No, you know that's not true...
HD_XKTW_4_13:
The fate of the Toccata family might've taken a different turn. 
But when you face the Order of the Deep and their false Divinity... our fate is no longer ours to control.

FavorRoleInfo_1507_Info:
A member of Averardo Vault's security team and holder of "Best Employee" for longer than she cares to count.
 
She has made plenty of plans for her free time, but for now, her biggest mission is simple: clocking out on time.
FavorGoods_140701_Content:
An exquisitely crafted quill that speaks through its feather. In the hands of a poet, it gives rise to endless inspiration, recounting lively tavern tales of thousand-year glaciers, the grand ruins of underground cities, and enchanted forests. 
 
Where will the hero's legend unfold this time?
FavorGoods_140702_Content:
A trinket Ciaccona bought from a marketplace. She was told it was a miniature instrument capable of producing sound.

She often says that a performer's state of mind is intimately tied to the music, and that an instrument is not defined by its price. Not even if it is a tiny one... 

With eyes wide open, the crowd waits for this young girl to bring forth sounds that create miracles.
FavorGoods_140703_Content: A music box of fine craftsmanship, gifted to Ciaccona by a merchant after hearing her performance. Ciaccona's melodies can be recreated at a gentle turn of the handle. This made her realize that music can exist forever in another form.
FavorGoods_150701_Content:
A notebook, Zani's constant companion. It's not just for jotting down daily schedules and important tasks. It also keeps life hacks she's gathered along the way.
 
From recipes she stumbled upon in a forum to success tips pulled from a bestseller, and even a quick tutorial on fixing a washing machine in five minutes, Zani collects all sorts of seemingly useless tricks. Correction. Completely pointless tricks.
 
But for Zani, each note is a valuable piece of her daily life. She holds onto the hope that one day, these tricks will come in handy. Maybe today when she's off from work, or on her next, distant vacation, or maybe...
FavorStory_140704_Title: For the Stories, She Shall Sing
FavorStory_140701_Content:
The little girl always loved to look up. Whether at the clear blue of day or the glittering blue of night. She once wondered to herself why, but the words she knew couldn't express how she felt. All she knew was a sense of awe at the great unknown and the mysteries that lay beyond... Eventually, she stopped wondering, for she had discovered that gazing at the skies was an inexplicable beauty in itself.
 
With this discovery, she began to look up while reading, while sleeping, even while walking...
 
"Hey, hey. Eyes up front, Ms. Ciaccona. Why do you keep staring at the ceiling? Watch where you're going!" After taking a hard bump to the head, young Ciaccona decided it would be best not to stare at the sky so much... at least not while walking. The next time she looked up, she saw something that would become her lifelong passion.
 
It was an ordinary afternoon when Ciaccona pushed open the door of her father's study. The object tucked away on top of the cabinet was the first thing she noticed after looking up. She took it down nice and slowly—it was a violin and her first encounter with an instrument. Picturing how her father had played it before, she decided to give it a try.
 
"Screech..."
 
It was undoubtedly a harsh sound. Yet she felt a peculiar sensation, like she was sinking toward the bottom of the sea. All sounds but the violin began to fade away. The light and shadows of the setting sun blurred. The world before her eyes seemed to draw its curtains, and by the time they opened again, a new world appeared before her. The air was filled with dancing music notes, and in the distance, a group of people played music.
 
"H-Hello?"
 
No one responded to the young girl. She walked closer, and though their faces were blurry, the melody seemed familiar.
 
"It's a piece Father often plays. Composed by our family." Young Ciaccona recalled the music's origins.
 
The group seemed unaware of her presence as they played, surrounding the girl with melodies that sounded of cries of newborn babies, and life's joys and tragedies...
 
"Thud." The music came to an abrupt stop at the sound of a door opening. Noticing the violin in Ciaccona's hands, her father gently patted her head with a slight look of resignation before putting it away.
 
"I'll teach you how to play when you're a bit older," he said, taking Ciaccona's hand and leading her out of the room. Just before the door closed behind them, Ciaccona turned around and waved goodbye to the violin.
 
From that day on, Ciaccona began searching for information about the music. The more she learned, the clearer her visions became whenever she touched an instrument.
 
She never told anyone what she saw that day. It wasn't until much later that Ciaccona learned it was due to her Forte: the power to recreate the past through melodies.
 
People of different times, brought together through music and poetry. It was the greatest miracle the girl could have ever imagined.
FavorWord_140701_Content: You must be exhausted from your long journey. Well, time to sit down, take a break, and enjoy some poetry and music. What do you have in mind today? A heroic epic, or a simple jolly tale of rural life?
FavorWord_140702_Content: While reality may not have those magical swords and spells flying around in stories, that doesn't mean they have no meaning. The enduring goodness and beauty we find in those tales help us love the world even more.
FavorWord_140703_Content: Want to find me quickly? Let's see... You might catch me at restaurants late at night, on a random street corner, or up on the rooftops... Oh, that doesn't sound very helpful... Anyway, just follow the poetry and music, and we shall meet again.
FavorWord_140704_Content: So, you've noticed I never mention any goodbyes or farewells in my poems. That's because, to me, goodbyes are just preludes to reunions. If I made the endings all sad and teary, it would be awkward when we meet again, don't you think?
FavorWord_140706_Content: I really love a polyphonic form of music called the "chaconne." It captures the fleeting journey of life. From the cries of birth, to the drama and joy of living, and finally the melancholy of aging and loss. I believe my poems should follow a similar style. Triumphs deserve celebration, but suffering must also be recognized. Only by embracing both the light and the dark can we truly learn to love the world.
FavorWord_140707_Content: I've slept in all sorts of "beds" while wandering from one place to another. Tents, treehouses, mountain rocks, you name it. I'm not really picky about the environment. What bothers me the most is that whenever I try to switch sleeping positions, my horns always get in the way. Ugh, a perfect-size nightcap or horn covers would be nice.
FavorWord_140708_Content: Any food can taste more delicious when paired with poems or music. How about we grab some wine and pizza, my friend? Add a side of "Poetry & Music Sauce," and when you hear the first few notes, you'll know it's time to dig in and enjoy.
FavorWord_140709_Content: Food names can be misleading sometimes. I once met a merchant who taught me how to make a "gourmet treat" called "Deer Crackers." It was a type of biscuit made with breadcrumbs and flours. The name sounded cute, and I thought it would have a fresh, natural taste. But when I gave it a bite all I got was just dry and bland. Right as the merchant noticed and snatched the crackers from my hand, a deer popped out of the bushes and started enjoying them. So, as the name suggests, "Deer Crackers" are really just crackers for deers.
FavorWord_140710_Content: I wish I could travel forever. A child's journey, a crazy journey, a colorful journey, a wanderer's journey... Any journey. Being on the road, I get to meet all sorts of people and hear their stories. Their tales of love for life, random chatter, and wild dreams and ideas are like fireworks bursting with colors and excitement.
FavorWord_140711_Content: This is the first musical instrument I ever had. It can no longer make the sounds it used to, but thanks to my Forte, I can still feel the joys it once brought me from time to time... A young girl basking in the setting sun on stage, performing all by herself for an imaginary audience.
FavorWord_140712_Content: When I was little, my father wanted me to stay far away from poetry and music. I didn't understand why, especially when he was a choir master himself. But as they became a bigger part of my life, I began to see the other side—the often overlooked tragedies. Tragedies that can even harm the performers themselves.
FavorWord_140713_Content: She's a discerning buyer and a skilled seller. Whether modern or vintage, Carlotta always appraises art with a fair and thoughtful eye. She taught me that the beauty of art transcends time, and that every artist will eventually find an audience that appreciates their vision.
FavorWord_140715_Content: He's a captivating performer on stage. Sometimes I wonder about Brant's fate. Will he be written into the pages of history after countless adventures? Or will he spend his retirement years recounting his legendary tales on a ship somewhere, holding a bottle of Troupe Strength?
FavorWord_140716_Content: The Blessed Maiden? Or a villain? There are still many unanswered questions in Cartethyia's story. I would never sing an incomplete story. A tale must have a proper ending for a bard to make it truly resonate through history.
FavorWord_140717_Content: On this night of twinkling stars, I give my best wishes to the lucky star born on this day. Have you thought of a birthday wish yet? Wait, don't say it out loud. Once you have it, come sit down. The performance is about to begin.
FavorWord_140721_Content: Bards are the couriers of heroes' tales. No need for applause or flowers. I'm just a storyteller like any other. Nice to meet you, great hero. You can call me Ciaccona.
FavorWord_140722_Content: Hear that? A twinkling star just tinkled to the ground!
FavorWord_140723_Content: Off we go! May my poems light the way on your path ahead!
FavorWord_140724_Content: Some say, the storyteller will end up being part of the story as well.
FavorWord_140726_Content: Isn't it amazing what miracles words and music can bring?
FavorWord_140727_Content: It's a type of vocal exercise. Want to join me?
FavorWord_140728_Content: Look, a mandolin made from a cookie jar! And a maraca made with a water bottle filled with beans. Amazing, right? We define what a musical instrument is. Performers never worry about being out of tune when expressing genuine emotions.
FavorWord_140730_Content: Time to end this story, the tale of all our adventures together. And there it is, the title of the final chapter: "To be Continued."
FavorWord_140736_Content: Now presenting, a poem of finale.
FavorWord_140744_Content: The poems will be sung again…
FavorWord_140752_Content: Phew. Not a mimic from the stories this time.
FavorWord_140753_Content: Well, look who's also got an eye for inspiration.
FavorWord_150703_Content: I don't hate work or overtime, so long as it serves a purpose. If I'm forced to sit idly at a desk doing nothing or sacrifice my personal time on trivial tasks... Then what I'm earning isn't a salary, it's compensation for the piece of my soul that's been taken.
FavorWord_150704_Content: You look tired, {PlayerName}. I understand you're shouldering some heavy burdens. But I suggest you catch a break whenever you can. You don't want to end up like me. Once I pulled my first overtime, I soon found myself working around the clock. Trust me, saving the world can wait.
FavorWord_150706_Content: I love my job! Really. No joke. Was I smiling? No? Then you get the idea.
FavorWord_150707_Content: Listen, efficiency is everything at work. It's all about hitting the nail on the head. Some people just don't get it. Instead, they waste so much time on unimportant details, prioritizing form over substance. A shame, really. That won't solve anything. All it does is complicate things even more.
FavorWord_150708_Content: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita. Nothing fills my stomach and soothes my soul quite like a slice of pizza freshly baked by Signorina Margherita after a long day at work.
FavorWord_150712_Content: My past? Nothing worth mentioning, really. I clock in, do my work, clock out—then do it all over again. Now and then, I straighten out a few troublemakers. Were you expecting some "white-collar hero saves the day" kind of story? Then you've read too many comic books.
FavorWord_150719_Content: Alright, where are we off to next?
FavorWord_150721_Content: Time to get back to work.
FavorWord_150723_Content: Alright, what's the first thing on today's to-do list?
FavorWord_150726_Content: Is that the alarm... Alright, time to work.
FavorWord_150727_Content: As the Montelli saying goes, "A blade only stays sharp if it's regularly honed." Even if it's just for work, exercise is necessary.
FavorWord_150728_Content: Hmm? Have I become more... productive? How am I supposed to act busy now...
FavorWord_150729_Content: Such radiant lights... I hope it shines on every shadow and leaves no darkness to hide in.
FavorWord_150730_Content: Ah, such power... Perfect. Now I can be the shield that protects more people.
FavorWord_150731_Content: Words alone can't repay all you've done for me. Now, it's my turn to fight for you. Happen to need an unbreakable sword or a shield that can withstand anything?
FavorWord_150734_Content: And that was me holding back.
FavorWord_150749_Content: I can spare a minute to knock some heads around.
FavorWord_150750_Content: All of you at once. I don't do overtime.
FavorWord_150751_Content: Ugh, now I have a report to write.
FavorWord_150758_Content: My shield can withstand more than that.
FavorWord_150761_Content: No… I've still got work to do...
FavorWord_150765_Content: I'm off duty, it's your turn.
FavorWord_150766_Content: Fine. Comes with the job, I guess.
FavorWord_150770_Content: Some pocket money? Won't say no to that.
FavorWord_150772_Content: I'll take it as my overtime fee.
XKAVG_ChapterDsec_01: As Ciaccona adjusts the tune, melodies from the <ano=remaining frequencies>Daemons</ano> reshape into a realm. From within, you will learn the truth of their origins.
XKAVG_ChapterDsec_02: Songs from the past are sung once more. However, the choir's performance seems to have encountered some trouble, as their pure voices are drowned by the chattering crowd.
XKAVG_ChapterDsec_03: You're back at the Margherita's, ready to uncover the truth behind the Daemons. But instead of announcing the truth, Ciaccona asks the crowd a few questions, claiming the answer will be revealed at the Odyssey Opera House in the following day... Your guess is she's trying to gather a bigger audience, and today is but a raise of the curtains.
XKAVG_ChapterDsec_04: These tales belong not only to the members of the Golden Anthem, but also to Ciaccona Toccata. You meet the little girl once more. She is neither of the past nor the present—she doesn't truly exist at all. She carries all of Ciaccona's stories, revealing the truth in this very place.
XKAVG_ChapterResultTitle_02_03: The Order and the Poets Society
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_01_01: You realize people's interpretation and imagination of music and poems are what brought these Daemons into being.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_01_02: Imagination knows no bounds. If left unchecked, things could only get worse.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_01_03: You feel what happened at the restaurant wasn't a random attack. But what matters now is finding whoever is responsible for it.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_02_01: The common folk once criticized the Poets Society's works. The poets themselves wondered if their creations were telling the truth.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_02_02: It's all over. But the more you stare at the empty stage, the more you feel a crucial melody is missing.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_02_03: If the Poets Society was once connected to the Order, why were they banished?
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_03_01: Ciaccona throws questions at the crowd, claiming the truth will be revealed on a larger stage tomorrow.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_03_02: The ship's fire burned everything to ashes. And the last work was brought back by the Daemons from the "hell."
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_03_03: The poets did not board the Pilgrim's Sail. Then why would they put on a show like this?
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_04_01: Ciaccona tells you everything that happened in the past.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_04_02: The Order and the mastermind behind it all were the ones who put the curse on those poems.
XKAVG_ChapterResultDsec_04_03: The Toccata family was also banished for hiding what the poets left behind.

XKAVG_EndingDsec_01: The Golden Anthem entrusted the key to the Toccata family, along with the duty of protecting the truth. Life is finite, but the poems and songs shall stand to tell the stories.
XKAVG_EndingDsec_02: The poems are indeed cursed, but by the Order and the mastermind. You might be just another pawn in their game. Every move that fails to end the rumors will only fuel more panic.
XKAVG_EndingDsec_03: The Toccatas have suffered the same fate as the Poets Society. Should they have chosen differently and confessed to the Order, their fate might have taken a turn. But is that really how the story should've been written?

BirthdayConfirmText: Fate casts a stone into the river of time, and every ripple marks the path of your journey around destiny. {0}-{1}-{2}—on this ordinary yet special day, your past, present, and future selves cross paths for a fleeting moment. And now, <color=#fa601a>who might be the one standing before you?</color>
EpithetDesc_Role_1: As the sounds in your memory fall into place, their magnificent echo crosses eons to reach your ears. Throughout your journey, your identity and purposes slowly piece themselves back together, and once again, you, the Astral Modulator, return to the center stage.
EpithetDesc_Role_2: Wind, though invisible in form, can be seen through the flowers it blows, the flames it caresses, and the larks it makes soar. Wind carries the birdsong high, echoing, echoing... until it is heard once more.
EpithetDesc_Role_3:
"The Flame Ranger still chooses to challenge an opponent who is simply unbeatable..."
The girl behind the curtain waves a hero figurine in her hand. Whether it was the light or something else, the figurine shone brightly in her grasp.
EpithetDesc_Role_4: A bloom in snow is cold yet irresistibly tempting to touch. But in the end, it cannot escape the natural order of things, and melts away in your hand.
EpithetDesc_Role_5: A girl who walks among the righteous and the wicked must constantly refine her sense of justice and morality. It is precisely because of this, that the jade pendant hanging from her chest remains so clear and pure.
EpithetDesc_Role_6: "Sit, breathe, and find inner peace." She opens her eyes to perceive the gradual stabilization of frequencies, using pupils corroded by Tacet Discords. She had walked away, free from the blizzard.
EpithetDesc_Role_7: Being half a step slower also meant that Taoqi had more time to observe the world. She gradually began to notice subtle changes in the marketplace. A brick was missing here. A flower had wilted there. The next season would arrive when she was aware.
EpithetDesc_Role_8:
Many people light fires they cannot hope to contain.
But he is the creator of fire, the master of fire, and the smotherer of fire.
EpithetDesc_Role_9:
They say Yuanwu can best any challenger in three minutes. It takes him one minute to step into the ring, then another minute to perform a ceremonial bow, and one final minute before the kettle comes to a boil.
"Come now, all martial artists are friends. Do stay for a cup of tea."
EpithetDesc_Role_10:
In the market, Aalto floats on the boundary between buying and selling, playing different roles: investor, opportunist, and market mover. He lays chips in every corner.
Every investment made is an avenue of future wealth.
EpithetDesc_Role_11: Planting seeds, watering and nurturing them till they sprout and bloom... That's how Verina initially imagined what the process of "Healing" meant.
EpithetDesc_Role_12: Encore's paradise is in the land of imagination. Brave Wooly Warriors and their wooly companions leap from the pages of books to a "Happily Ever After."
EpithetDesc_Role_13: The "hound" in the shadow stalks his prey. First, he is calm, waiting for his target to move through the crowd. Then, unease sets in as the surroundings grow eerily quiet. Finally, the fangs are bared, and the target can no longer see its own shadow.
EpithetDesc_Role_14: With every step a dance, he will surely leap to the highest perch.
EpithetDesc_Role_15: With a limpid mind and sustained inner peace, she, who has undergone the trials of the world, completes the final piece of the mirror. The heart is a mirror. The mirror reflects her heart.
EpithetDesc_Role_16: "The enemies surging in were suddenly met by a streak of blue light. Qingloong swept in with the wind, and after the storm subsided, the Midnight Rangers' flag stood tall on the high ground…"
EpithetDesc_Role_17: Like a puppet with a thousand faces, she walks through the shadows in different facades. But at the end of the day, she's still the one holding the strings.
EpithetDesc_Role_18:
It was an age when the flow of time was chaotic, with dawn blurring into dusk and the cold proving relentless.
Doubt, weariness, and the weight of duty... such was the life of a Magistrate. Though quite young, she shouldered it all as she ascended the mountain, striving to illuminate the sky with a sliver of candlelight. It was the moment when winter relented. The thaw came, and the slopes awoke, bathed in the first tender hues of spring...
EpithetDesc_Role_19:
Changli wishes for an era of peace and prosperity.
This is the longest game of Weiqi she's ever played, and with each move, she becomes a part of the game, an eternal fire that lights the way.
EpithetDesc_Role_20:
Xiangli Yao often describes himself as a greedy person, who is hungry for truth, yet equally starves for the warmth of human bonds.
Though he often gazes at the stars, he occasionally casts glances at the distant mountains and the vast land they anchor. And with each step forward, he measures the distance he has traveled, the life he has lived.
EpithetDesc_Role_21:
She prefers colors on ink and wash, which, while not the most dazzling, still depict a stunning array of hues.
This is Zhezhi's true colors, that which she hopes will one day burst forth with the power to leave others in awe.
Or at least, during self-introductions...
EpithetDesc_Role_22: Starlight falls into the deep sea, filling all of her longing and emptiness. In vastness and loneliness, she stood watch over the shores that exist only because of {Male=him;Female=her}... This is her innate duty, both past and future.
EpithetDesc_Role_23: Though young, Youhu can already distinguish real antiques from fakes. Valuables weighed down by time can only be cherished and cared for when entrusted to those who understand their value.
EpithetDesc_Role_24: Blossom, wither, and bloom again with memories of the past. When red and white converge... What form will Camellya take when she flowers once more in your eyes?
EpithetDesc_Role_25:
We Promise, We Deliver!
Bright and cheerful Lumi travels across the vast land of Solaris, delivering messages from distant places to those on her route.
EpithetDesc_Role_26:
Before this radiant moment arrived, the "gem" had endured endless nights of rain.
Once, she loathed the downpower, but now she embraces the rhythm... With patient hands, she polished the rough stone that was "herself" until it shimmered with a thousand captured hues, in the name of Montelli, and more so in the name of Carlotta.
EpithetDesc_Role_27: How should the stage be set for a drama? Spotlights check, curtains check, magnificent costumes? Check. "Pero Pero!" A strange box jumps up and hands her a confetti gun. "Ta-da!" —It's showtime!
EpithetDesc_Role_28: Set sail! The curtain rises! This maritime stage belongs to Brant. From the bow comes the scent of "Troupe Strength" and wild laughter mocking the outdated doctrines of The Order. On deck, they're rehearsing plays banned by The Order. From the stern, the sea chases after them in pursuit.
EpithetDesc_Role_29: "As the sand of time flickers through your finger, please remember: in the gentle starlight, among beautiful waves, beneath the lantern... and where the kindness of your heart shines, my unspoken words are waiting for you... Listen! The door is open. It's time to move on."
EpithetDesc_Role_30: Where does the dream end and reality begin? The moment your fingers meet the jellyfish, you're falling into a deep sea, descending ever deeper... Only to surface at last into the calm harbor of her gaze.
EpithetDesc_Role_31: Listen! The chimes of a starry, starry night, a prelude to the young maid's song. Bright as midsummer sun even in the depth of the night, yet gentle as the breeze on a summer's day. The wind carries her music across the dark, a melodic story that greets the dawn.
EpithetDesc_Role_32:
A fixed routine isn't that bad. Stability has got to count for something. These are words Zani lives by.
Her routine consists of work, meals, sleep, and the occasional bouts of saving the world. Life, after all, is simply a matter of style.

PhantomBattleEntryDes_1:
- Modulation is the act of Deploying an Echo from your hand by placing it on top of an Echo already on the field. The newly Deployed Echo inherits and activates all Special Skills from the Echo it was placed on.
- Cost 1 Echoes can only be Modulated onto another Cost 1 Echo that has not been previously Modulated.
- Cost 3 Echoes can only be Modulated onto another Cost 1 Echo that has already been Modulated.
PhantomBattleEntryDes_2: Echoes with Transform take effect when dragged into the Transform area. Normally, Transformed cards are not returned to your deck, but are destroyed in this duel instead.
PhantomBattleEntryDes_3:
- Modulation allows Echoes to Activate powerful abilities.
- Special Skills are Unactivated when Echoes are first Deployed and need to be Activated.
- Modulation Activates the Special Skills of the Modulated Echo.
PhantomBattleEntryDes_4:
- In this stage, you can Deploy, Modulate, or Transform an Echo. You may also drag the Echo to the Reconstruction Area to recover Energy.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} "Fight!" to finish this stage.

PhantomBattleFactorDes_1: <color=#e4c69b>Invisibility</color> - For {0}s after the Battle Stage begins and until it deals damage, this Echo cannot be attacked. For {1}s after Invisibility ends, damage dealt by this Echo is increased by {2}.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_2: <color=#e4c69b>Flash</color> - At the start of the Battle Stage, teleport this Echo to the opponent's Backline area.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_3: <color=#e4c69b>Resilience</color> - The first time this Echo takes a fatal blow during a Battle Stage, it will remain standing for an additional {0}s before being downed.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_4: <color=#e4c69b>Toughness</color> - When this Echo is attacked during the Battle Stage, DMG taken is reduced by {0} for {1}s. Reset the cooldown instead of stacking if triggered again.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_5: <color=#e4c69b>Mimic</color> - When this Echo Activates the next Special Skill through Modulation, Mimic becomes that skill.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_6: <color=#e4c69b>Explosion</color> - When this Echo is downed in a Battle Stage, it explodes and deals damage to nearby enemy Echoes.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_7: <color=#e4c69b>Restraint</color> - When the Deployment Stage ends, the enemy Echo in the same position as this Echo (either Frontline or Backline) loses {0} Strength this round.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_8: <color=#e4c69b>Last Stand</color> - If your HP is at or below {0} at the end of the Deployment Stage, this Echo deals {1} more DMG to enemy Echoes in the following Battle Stage.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_9: <color=#e4c69b>Berserk</color> - If this Echo's HP is at or below {0} during a Battle Stage, it deals {1} more DMG to enemy Echoes in this Battle Stage.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_10: <color=#e4c69b>Forestall</color> - When the Battle Stage starts, this Echo deals {0} more DMG to enemy Echoes for {1}s.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_11: <color=#e4c69b>Taunt</color> - When in the Frontline, enemy Echoes will attack this Echo first during the Battle Stage.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_12: <color=#e4c69b>Boost</color> - When the Deployment Stage ends, this Echo's STR is increased by {0} for {1} rounds, stacking up to {2} times. This buff carries over to Modulated Echoes.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_14: <color=#e4c69b>Recharge</color> - You gain <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Energy each time using Transform.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_15: <color=#e4c69b>Conversion</color> - Each time you use Transform, you draw a card and then put a hand card back to the deck.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_16: <color=#e4c69b>Cycle</color> - Reconstructing the this Echo grants <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> more {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Energy.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_17: <color=#e4c69b>Flank Force</color> - When this Echo is in Deployment Zone (either Frontline or Backline) with another two Echoes, all of them gain {0} DMG when the Deployment Stage ends, until the end of the round.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_18: <color=#e4c69b>Superpower</color> - For each Special Skill this Echo has, it deals {0} more DMG to enemy Echoes during the Battle Stage, stacking up to {1} times.
PhantomBattleFactorDes_19: <color=#e4c69b>Versatility</color> - When Versatility is Activated, this Echo can be Modulated by any Normal Echo with no restrictions.

ItemInfo_72010038_BgDescription: While Duelists don't fight like Gladiators, they share the same goal: to claim victory and glory in the heat of battle.
