ConsumptiveTaskTitle28: Obtain a total of 6,000 Illusive Specimen in "Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy"
QuestTree_Summary_130001: Before your eyes, the Mourning Aix is reunited with its mate in their final moments. The researcher Jiuyue chooses to carry the memory of a loved one and move forward, and at last, the fog over Whining Aix's Mire is dispersed. This may not be an ending, but rather the beginning of a new story.
QuestTree_Summary_130701: You help Shicheng complete the Rite of Offering that has been passed down for generations, and she resolves to carry the tradition forward.
QuestTree_Summary_130702: A girl from Hongzhen named Shicheng wishes to perform the Rite of Offering, but she is attacked by TDs. You manage to save her just in time.
QuestTree_Summary_130703: You and Shicheng climb to the peak of the arch-shaped rock and complete the rite.
QuestTree_Summary_130704: You and Shicheng travel to where the waterfalls converge and complete the rite.
QuestTree_Summary_130705: You and Shicheng reach the shoals and islands and complete the rite.
QuestTree_Summary_130706: You and Shicheng come to the boundary of yellow and white and complete the rite.
QuestTree_Summary_130707: You and Shicheng enter the Offering Site and complete the final rite.
QuestTree_Summary_130708: Using the Prototype Chronosorter, you repair the damaged Woodveil Hall, and the once-withered Tianqu Tree springs back to life. Afterward, you tell the relic merchant Chenpi everything that happened here, and the story set in motion by a single ancient artifact finally comes to a close.
QuestTree_Summary_230001: To find Liel, the missing companion of the Exile Insula, you enter the Twilight Rise with him. There, you become trapped for a time and are attacked by an unknown monster. You eventually find a way out, but Liel is nowhere to be found.
QuestTree_Summary_230002: You then enter the Resounding Rise with Liel's sister, Itzel. There, you encounter the same unknown monster again and discover that the Fanatic Shark gang, responsible for Liel's disappearance, has itself been wiped out by the creature. Within the tower, you uncover the reason the Fisalia family built the Thorncrown Rises. Sadly, Liel still remains missing.
QuestTree_Summary_230003: Following the monster's frequency, you, Insula, and Itzel enter the Command Rise and uncover a secret weapon created by the Fisalia family. At last, you catch up with the monster and defeat it, but by then, Liel is already dead. After thanking you for your help, the Exiles decide to leave Rinascita behind.
QuestTree_Summary_230004: You complete the trial on the Shores of Last Breath amid raging winds. Though you cannot help but question why the Sentinel and the Order would have set such a test, the truth has long since been buried by history.
QuestTree_Summary_230005: The Acolyte Lenore asks you to recover the long-lost Nimbus Chorales. You gather its scattered parts in Nimbus Sanctum, but Lenore believes one final passage is still missing. At that moment, the lost Major Forbidden Archive reappears, and she asks you to enter it in search of the last part.
QuestTree_Summary_230006: Deep within the Archive, you recover the missing part, only to find that it does not praise the Sentinel as Lenore expected, but the ancient people of Rinascita. She believes this runs counter to the Order's teachings, yet she is still moved by the emotions carried in the music. Until she can resolve the doubts it has stirred within her, she decides not to report it to the Order.
QuestTree_Summary_230301:
You, Phoebe, and Zani escort a "relic" entrusted to you by the Order into an unknown area deep within the Averardo Vault. There, you uncover the secret that the Montelli family once sheltered a group of artists and scientists from the Order. Though they are long dead, their Reverberations remain trapped within the vault. At the same time, you realize that the "relic" you brought inside is in fact a bomb the Order intended to use to erase its own crimes. 
Phoebe uses her power to defuse the crisis before anything happens, and with the imprisoned Reverberations finally set free, the vault's great doors swing open once more.
QuestTree_Summary_230401: Guided by the Nimbus Wraiths, you free the memory fragments left behind by past candidates of the Divine Trials, and at "Lake of Spirits" you witness a breathtaking meteor shower. Traveling beside you, Cantarella makes a wish that one day the Fisalia family will be freed from the curse of the Threnodian, and that everyone will be able to enjoy life in peace and freedom.
QuestTree_Summary_230601: In the ruins near the Ashen Dragon's Crypt, you find the Scourgewing, Iaen, trapped by hunters. From the nearby Reverberations, you learn that a Gladiator named Levis tried to rescue Iaen from them in defense of his honor, only to be trapped himself. In his final moments, Iaen creates an illusion so that Levis may finally lay his regrets to rest in one last duel.
QuestTree_Summary_230602: Together with Tulia, you rescue the trapped Scourgewing, Isth, from a tower, and you also witness the undying friendship between fallen members of the Black Shores and Gladiators.
QuestTree_Summary_230603: The Scourgewings you saved, Isth and Iaen, soar back into the sky as the wilds once ravaged by the Dark Tide slowly begin to recover. They will fly toward distant lands, while Tulia returns home to continue her research. Though you part for now, as long as you live beneath the same sky, you are certain to meet again.
QuestTree_Summary_230604: Pursuing Phrolova's phantom, you descend deep into Mournfell Canyon, where you encounter Lenore and a man calling himself a Reverberation, Medulius. Your investigation reveals that Medulius came here to revel in the "blood duel" he himself set in motion, a father and daughter driven to kill one another, only to be cursed by Phrolova and denied the release of true death. After you defeat the Gladiator father and daughter, as well as Medulius, silence finally falls. You decide to continue the hunt for Phrolova, but are unsuccessful in locating her.
QuestTree_Summary_330301: A Kronaclaw corrupted by the Void Storm leads you and its Shepherd, Skavitz, to the ruins of Upphaf Forest. Though already consumed by corruption, it still manages to return there and pour the last of its strength into the Life Chamber core. Under that core's power, the long-since withered forest slowly begins to recover. Spent and powerless, the bird flies off alone and disappears into Upphaf's frozen caverns.
QuestTree_Summary_330302: Later, you and Skavitz find the Void Storm corrupted Kronaclaw once more. Unable to return to its flock and unwilling to endanger the others, it follows a Kronaclaw's instinct back to Upphaf Forest, the ancient homeland of its kind. There, you help free it from the torment of corruption. Returned at last to its home, it no longer has to fly alone.
QuestTree_Summary_330501: Lenie, one of Warren's students, ventures into a contaminated Voidmatter zone in an attempt to prove herself and falls into danger. When you come to help, the two of you discover the first-generation Helios, a prototype Warren had abandoned years ago. With the help of several professors, you restore it, and Lenie finally finds her own path. She vows never to repeat Warren's mistakes. In the days ahead, she'll live up to her mentors' hopes and strive, like any true researcher, to bring hope and progress to humanity.
QuestTree_Summary_330502: Sigrika discovers an ancient ruin still brimming with life. There, you find a very special feather. It leads you to Aurora Bridge, where you free an Auroraclaw trapped in ice. Once freed, the bird carries you and Sigrika into the sky. Beneath its wings, the world opens up below you. Wide, peaceful, and breathtaking.
QuestTree_Summary_430101: With your aid, the Constable uncovers the truth behind numerous incidents within Xuanfang Hold, all orchestrated by Fractsidus agents lurking in the city. You thwart their plot to destroy the Four Chime Shaftpost to escape the Hold, narrowly averting disaster. For a brief moment, peace returns to Xuanfang.
QuestTree_Summary_430102: You encounter Suyu, an injured Midnight Ranger, in Xuanfang. She tells you that she is here on a mission as an Oversight Officer, accompanying a unique Resonator. Seizing the chance, you join this Resonator in investigating a crisis unfolding in the Skyworks, and along the way, uncover the burdens she carries in her heart...
QuestTree_Summary_430103: A malfunctioning Autopuppet slips into the Fogveil Pagoda, where you also discover a master and his apprentice, T-G0NG and Q-L1NG, who have been sealed inside, faithfully maintaining their duties for over a century. They had been collecting data to study Xuanfang Hold's structure when the Autopuppet arrived with a message: "Xuanfang Hold has already been completed. You may rest now." In the end, you help them reestablish contact with the outside world, and the Autopuppet often returns to the Pagoda to visit them.
QuestTree_Summary_430401:
At the invitation of a mysterious girl named Xuanqing, you agree to help her gather the scattered shards of the Feeling Capsule.
Along the way, you learn that Xuanqing was, in fact, Hsin the Moon Fox's Resonator a century ago, and that she has come here for one reason: to deliver the "final feeling" held within the Feeling Capsule to Hsin.
Through the memories preserved in the Heart of Ruin, you witness the story Hsin the Moon Fox and Xuanqing shared a hundred years ago, and come to understand the final feeling passed down from one Sentinel to the next: a humanity that is chosen.
QuestTree_Summary_430402: At Chenghuai's request, you travel to the Heart of Flames to investigate an anomalous disturbance. Along the way, you become acquainted with a dancer named Mashan and, together with him, step into a strange, uncanny "Waking Moon Festival." There, the two of you rescue several of Mashan's junior sisters, yet the anomaly is far from resolved. At last, within the Lantern Carriage, you grasp the key to the anomaly and break through the delusion buried deep in the human heart...
QuestTree_Summary_430403: Guided by Youfang, you come upon a long-abandoned Autopuppet and use it to open a passage into a hidden space. There, you encounter the Reverberation of a fox, who leads you to bear witness to the life of Wuluo, one of the Xuan Triad. In the end, you free Wuluo's Reverberation from the inner demon that had long tormented her, and she is granted the peaceful rest she had always longed for.
QuestTree_Summary_140201: To find the gift her sister Shiyu left behind, you accompany Shixia through waterfalls and across open wilds on a journey through memories that belong only to her. When Shixia realizes that her sister's "gift" was simply the vast landscape beneath her feet, and a wish for Shixia to move forward bravely, she decides to climb the even steeper West Mountain with you, just as Shiyu once did.
QuestTree_Summary_140202: After crossing a harsh mountain path, the two of you reach the top of West Mountain at sunrise. At the summit, Shixia realizes that her sister has always been watching over her and encouraging her. She resolves to face the future with courage.
QuestTree_Summary_140203: Back at the theater, Shixia, just like Shiyu before her, encourages a little girl named Mumin to move forward bravely as well.
QuestTree_Summary_240401: You set out on an adventure with the plushies of Plushie Village who long to explore the world. Along the way, you take plenty of photos for them. At one point, you even step alone into a strange world inside a painting and capture a one-of-a-kind night sky, unlike anything you've ever seen. Maybe that's what adventure is really about: finding unique sights in faraway places. Your journey inspires the other plushies too scared to leave before. In the end, the plushies who explored with you take a photo of you standing beneath the stars, then quietly add themselves into the picture.
QuestTree_Summary_240601: When everything is over, you reunite with Cartethyia at a Septimontian plaza. Though a few regrets remain, she is content with a life in which she can cook the food she loves, travel freely, and meet the people she wishes to see.
QuestTree_Summary_240602: After the dust settles, you share drinks with Lupa on the hotel terrace. In the warm evening light, she swears to you, and to the undying sun, that if you ever call for her, she will come to whatever battlefield awaits you.
QuestTree_Summary_240603: Near the cable car, you meet Buling just before her holiday ends. Before leaving, she gives you a bronze mirror and says that perhaps the two of you will meet again someday.
QuestTree_Summary_240701: You report the situation beneath the sea to Zani, the Black Shores, and Cartethyia, then decide to return to Septimont and investigate the truth behind the "Journeying Paradise."
QuestTree_Summary_240801: A Hurriclaw named "Chunkie," corrupted by the Dark Tide while trying to save the old Gladiator Arctos and a little Wootter named "Teeny," keeps circling outside the camp. Together with Arctos, you free Chunkie from the Dark Tide. It scatters into the wind, leaving behind only a feather from Arctos's helmet. Arctos fastens the feather to the tail of the Hornett, hoping that Chunkie's will to protect others will live on in its cry and reach every Gladiator who hears it.
QuestTree_Summary_240802: The old Gladiator Aeolus, whom you rescued during a scouting mission in the Wastelands, cannot stop dwelling on the past. He regrets being a coward and leaving Cato to face the Dark Tide alone. He wants to become the man who fought bravely instead. He joins you in killing a Kerasaur near camp, then after losing a sparring match with you, he leaves.
QuestTree_Summary_240803: After leaving, Aeolus resolves to hunt a Corrosaurus alone. When you find him and the beast, the two of you defeat it together despite his injuries, but he does not survive. You return to camp bearing news of his death. Standing by his new sword grave, Rolla, who had always stayed by his side, tells him that in her heart, he was always a hero. Not because he chose to fight, but because he chose to save her from the Dark Tide.
QuestTree_Summary_240804: A letter Ephor Augusta writes to the Gladiator Aeolus. She still remembers him as a worthy rival and rejects his request to leave the ranks.
QuestTree_Summary_241101: You save a dying Aria Mummer and promise to fulfill its final wish by delivering Melody Boxes to the people they were meant for. As you carry them across the city, you witness one small life after another in Septimont. Through the melodies, people come to glimpse sides of their loved ones they never knew. After the last Melody Box is delivered, the Aria Mummer returns to the Resonance Nexus, leaving only a faint strain of music echoing in people's hearts.
QuestTree_Summary_240002: The recovery efforts in Rinascita after the Dark Tide leave Phoebe overwhelmed. You decide to help her by taking on some of the work in Septimont.
QuestTree_Summary_240003: In the Mournfell Canyon, you meet Acolyte Lenore, the one Medulius once protected. Having returned from the Dark Tide, Lenore is burdened by guilt for having abetted evil and is unsure of what she should do now. With your encouragement, she decides to join the recovery efforts in Septimont and do whatever she can for others.
QuestTree_Summary_240004: The rebuilding of Septimont's Old District moves forward smoothly thanks to everyone's hard work. You help Lenore face her fears and meet the Troupe of Fools, once oppressed by the Order, which loosens some of the knots still tied in her heart. In the end, she gives the Nimbus Chorales to the troupe and resolves to stop drowning in self-pity and find a way to keep living.
QuestTree_Summary_240005: The celebration marking the completion of the small square begins. Amid joyful music, Lenore steps onto the stage and confesses what she truly wants: to keep helping people. As the Nimbus Chorales rise into the air, the final knot in her heart is released.
QuestTree_Summary_240006: At sunrise, the celebration comes to a perfect close. Lenore tells you that when she let go of everything weighing her down and sang freely, she became a Resonator, awakening the power to "heal." She intends to use that gift to help Rinascita heal and do what she believes is right.
QuestTree_Summary_240007: Septimont's Old District is showing signs of recovery. There, you see Julia Silva, once exiled and now returned, surrounded by jeering crowds. Ignoring their scorn, she takes her nephew Adric's spear and heads alone into the Mournfell Canyon, swearing to reclaim the Silvas' honor.
QuestTree_Summary_240008: You and Lenore witness an argument between Luther and Alessio. Though innocent, Luther chooses not to abandon his colleague Alessio but to stand beside him and be judged by the people together. After they leave, you and Lenore talk about whether Julia and Luther truly deserve punishment. Lenore decides that she, too, must find the courage to change and make amends.
QuestTree_Summary_340001: A frail little girl named Misha asks you to help find the Soliskin stickers left by her mother, Vantier. While gathering them, you inadvertently learn that Vantier has already passed away. Having sensed the truth herself, Misha quietly slips away and passes on as well. Like the Soliskin, they will both become light, and in that warmth, they will meet again.
QuestTree_Summary_340002: At Zahira's recommendation, you become a test volunteer helping rebuild the route network across the Etching Plains. With Elowyn's assistance, you restore the transport routes, and the lifelines of the plain begin to spread out beneath your feet once more.
QuestTree_Summary_340003: Songdis, hopelessly absorbed in games, decides to create 8-bit chiptune music for the Roya. You go with her to Bjartr Woods, where you turn the melodies played by the Soliskin into a new song. With her wish fulfilled, she decides to put games aside for a while and throw herself into her studies, though she will never forget the memories those games and songs gave her.
QuestTree_Summary_340101: A student named Ang, who loves stargazing, wants to watch the stars again with his old classmates. You help him invite them, along with Miss Dhalifa, to the Observatory. Beneath a sky glittering with stars, you take a group photo and make a promise: no matter how far apart you may be, one day you will all watch the stars together again.
QuestTree_Summary_340102: You take part in the "Light Chaser Collection," a photography event organized by the Photography Fan Club, and use your camera to capture snapshots of student life. When you deliver the photos, the club leader, Lianna, gives you a record in return, hoping that the songs on it will accompany you through this bright and precious chapter of campus life.
QuestTree_Summary_340103: A student named Daigo discovers that someone has been impersonating him at the Academy and asks you to track the impostor down. To everyone's surprise, the "Fake Daigo" turns out to be a formal B.1.N.G.O. unit disguised by I.R.I.S. It accomplishes what Daigo never had the courage to do, nudging him to confess to the girl he loves, Nanami, and to join the scientific expedition team. Now Daigo is chasing his dreams together with Nanami.
QuestTree_Summary_340104: At the Academy, the renowned Professor Edgar is about to retire. His student, Frantz, wants to send him off with his own research: a grand fireworks display. But your choices, in ways unseen, will decide whether Frantz can make it to Edgar's farewell ceremony in time. When the sky finally erupts with fireworks, Professor Edgar tells him the truth: the man who always considered himself ordinary has, in fact, always been his proudest student.
QuestTree_Summary_340105: Robbie, a Mechascout corrupted by the Void Storm and nearing the end of its service life, sets out with you to fulfill its final wishes. One by one, you help it do the small things it never had the chance to try. At the very end, it makes one last gesture. Showing both its love for the world and its longing to fly, it falls from the sky like a meteor, opening its mechanical arms toward the land that meant so much to it.
QuestTree_Summary_340106: Together, Dari of the Roya people and you from Startorch Academy, restore the Spacetrek Collective's power supply and relight Roya petroglyphs so they can shine once more beneath Lahai-Roi's sky. Now, illuminated by the Collective's light, the petroglyphs are more than a work of Royan artistry. They have become a symbol of both peoples standing together to protect Lahai-Roi.
QuestTree_Summary_340107: You bring Mr. Trevor, now old and unable to travel himself, the photographs you took from within the Void Storm. Though age has kept him from venturing out in person, he still wants to turn those magnificent images into postcards and send them to his friend, Mr. Fulmine, in Ragunna.
QuestTree_Summary_340201: To explore whether a different holographic projection is possible, you and Mornye enter the "ocean" projected within the Submerged Tunnel. There, Mornye, who has never seen the ocean with her own eyes, makes you a promise: one day, she will see the real thing in person, with you beside her.
QuestTree_Summary_340301: While helping Ero sort through a pile of odds and ends, you accidentally uncover a number of precious pre-Lament satellite data recorders. After some investigation, you learn they were gathered by a Flufftail Fox Ero once saved called "Fluffball," who tried to repay his kindness in its own way. To keep Ero's tent from becoming a junk heap again, and for the sake of future research, you contact the Spacetrek Collective and turn the recorders over to them.
QuestTree_Summary_340302: A glitching order in the cafeteria's food machine leads you to a strange patch of blue snow in the frostlands. A research team, determined to study the frostlands' Cobalt Sediment structure, pushed into a hazardous zone and never returned. Following the clues left in the order records, you find the vehicle they once used, along with a non-standard component and their logs. The logs describe how their obsession with tracing the strange structure slowly drove them mad. I.R.I.S. recovers the component, and you decide it's best to let that cobalt dream remain buried beneath the snow.
QuestTree_Summary_340501: Back to Lahai-Roi, Aemeath waits for you on a bench in the Academy. Now "reborn," she is ready to continue her studies there. One day, she hopes to travel farther and save even more people. As the two of you stroll through Lahai-Roi's spring breeze, you promise that no matter what path she chooses, you will always be proud of her.
QuestTree_Summary_340502: Hiyuki speaks on behalf of Lucilla to let you know how things will be handled after the Aleph-1 incident. She also fills you in on what's happening in Ashinohara and what the Fractsidus have been up to lately. Their plan against her has failed, and after going through life-and-death situations by your side, she has finally let go of her wish to save Ashinohara all by herself.
QuestTree_Summary_340503: At the request of Ham, the director of the Spacetrek Incubation Program, you help four research teams funded by the program push past their setbacks and finish their reports. Ham tells you that while their work may not seem groundbreaking, it's a crucial step forward on the path of scientific discovery. He believes that with the Academy's support, these students will one day rise like new stars and light up the skies above Lahai-Roi.
QuestTree_Summary_340504: Zenus, a student whose proposal was rejected by the Spacetrek Incubation Program, still refuses to abandon his project. Determined to deepen humanity's understanding of Solaris, he plans to deploy high-sensitivity seismometers across the Dimmr Plains to map the region. You help him place the instruments at three of the most dangerous sites, while Ham, the very teacher who once turned him down, helps with the deployment of the remaining survey equipment. Once the data is successfully recovered, Zenus gets his drive back with your support and resolves to continue his relentless commitment to research.
QuestTree_Summary_340505: Reynard, hoping to take a shortcut on his field assignment, gets tricked by a mysterious group known as the "Retrievers." Not only does he fail to finish the assignment, but he also gets swindled out of a large sum of money. He comes to you for help in finding out who the Retrievers really are. Together, you track down the people they once served. You discover that even when what they recovered was nothing more than a forgery, grieving people still clung to it for comfort. After you shut down the Retrievers' operation, a business built on profiting from people's sorrow, Reynard is deeply moved. He decides to become a true Retriever instead: someone who can recover what's been lost and help ease the pain of those who are grieving.
QuestTree_Summary_349901: The Spacetrek Collective finishes sorting through the Fractsidus records recovered in the Dimmr Plains. Arman invites you to meet with him in person and shares what they found. From those materials, you finally learn the truth behind Denia's plan. Later, Sigrika tracks you down and tells you that before she left, Denia wrote her a letter confessing everything. Now that she knows the truth, Sigrika is finally able to accept her friend's decision to leave and face the future with renewed hope.
QuestTree_Summary_440101: Inside the Shadowcast Chamber of Fogveil Pagoda, you manipulate mechanisms to reshape shadows on the wall and solve a puzzle. The shifting silhouettes tell a story of the past, one where Hsin the Moon Fox sent Autopuppets to battle and sealed Tacet Discords within Censure Cages.
QuestTree_Summary_440102: Inside the Hunting Chamber of Fogveil Pagoda, you discover traces left by the malfunctioning Autopuppet that had slipped inside. Pursuing the illusions it left behind, you confirm that it eventually departed from here and returned to the Pagoda's Upper Foyer.
QuestTree_Summary_440103: Inside the Puppet Chamber of Fogveil Pagoda, you reassemble a dismantled Autopuppet, the Archival Autopuppet, which once served as the administrator of the Fuming Archive Chamber. Once restored, it leaves the Pagoda to search for a girl named Tianyue.
QuestTree_Summary_440104: Inside the Fuming Archive Chamber of Fogveil Pagoda, you encounter the mirage of a girl named Tianyue. She had first sneaked into Fogveil Pagoda to find her father, but unexpectedly formed a bond with the Archival Autopuppet. Through the Gallery of Mechanisms, you witness her life unfold from childhood visits, to adulthood, to her final days. After she passed, the Archival Autopuppet visited her grave to mourn.
QuestTree_Summary_440105: Inside the Replica Chamber of Fogveil Pagoda, you manipulate mechanisms to alter the Model Boxes, shifting the structure of the entire room to solve the puzzle. Along the way, you discover that these Model Boxes were crafted long ago by the master and apprentice, T‑G0NG and Q‑L1NG.
QuestTree_Summary_440001: Ruoyun asked for your help looking into a fragment of data hidden in the Xuanyuan Domain. In the course of the investigation, the two of you learned it was a Reverberation that had escaped the Domain long ago. Perhaps it was a miracle worked by that Reverberation's wish to see its family again.
QuestTree_Summary_440002: Ruoyun asked for your help looking into a fragment of data hidden in the Xuanyuan Domain. In the course of the investigation, the two of you learned it was a Reverberation that had escaped the Domain long ago. Thinking back to what had happened to Lyu Yi, you understood that it was all a miracle wrought by the wish to see family again.
QuestTree_Summary_440003: You investigated alongside Buling and uncovered the truth behind the "ghosts." Lyu Yi's longing for his grandfather and the Reverberation's longing for its own family had wound together, and out of them came a brief miracle.

AreaReportContent_Text85:
[00:00:11]
That's it! We're out of the Dimmr Plains! Hey, look—what... what is that?

[00:00:27]
That might be the Solvein Heartwood. I've heard the Roya speculate about where Soliskin really go when they return to the Solistrees. They say they slowly lose their physical form, turning into warm sunlight that flows down along the "root system"...

[00:00:55]
Lose their form? So... does it hurt? When they return to the Solistrees?

[00:01:00]
I don't know. But I reckon it shouldn't.

[00:01:05]
How can you be sure?

[00:01:07]
It's just a guess. If a Soliskin's natural instinct is to return to the Solistrees, then from the logic of the Exostrider's existence and the perspective of natural evolution, it wouldn't make sense for them to feel pain. It's an inevitable part of their life cycle. Once the process starts, they should get some kind of positive feedback, something that drives them to complete it.

[00:02:13]
Makes sense, but... I still feel like there's more to it than that.

[00:02:25]
That's okay. Tell me what you're thinking, Annika.
AreaReportContent_Text86:
[00:02:32]
I think... based on my research on Soliskin, I'm more inclined to believe that this was their choice from the very beginning. Not "a Soliskin chose to do this," but rather "the Soliskin collectively decided to do it." Do you remember that paper, the one that proposed that the individual intelligence of the Exoswarm is just nodes, but the network formed by those nodes contains feedback loops and servers? The author used biological material as an analogy to explain their hypothesis about how the Exoswarm evolved.

[00:04:13]
I remember. The hypothesis was remarkably bold, yet the data fitting was actually reproducible. It still stands out in my mind.

[00:04:29]
Exactly. So here's what I've been thinking. Soliskin are different from ordinary animals and different from the Exoswarm, but they still have intelligence and the ability to perceive emotion. An individual Soliskin carries only a faint trace of the Exostrider's energy. Even if it burns itself up, it can only release a limited amount of light and heat. But that's enough to briefly disperse Voidmatter, or to power an Exostrider component. And in doing so, it can help its companions, or the Exoswarm, get through a crisis, giving them more chances to fulfill the mission their creator gave them.

So when countless nodes across the network all kindle the same flame, that behavior gets recorded on the server. That's how the feedback logic of the Soliskin network is formed.

Maybe the Soliskin returning to the Solistrees was never a single node choosing its own end. Maybe it doesn't come from a life instruction set by the creator either. Instead, it's the result of something more complex, an operational logic we still don't fully understand, working in unison.

[00:06:04]
I see what you mean. You're saying that the Soliskin have also developed "altruism" through evolutionary change?

[00:06:19]
Yes, and this "altruism" ultimately manifests itself as the Solvein Heartwood at the heart of the Dimmr Plains.

[00:06:29]
Which means, this sunset we see before us... is the Soliskin's...

[00:06:37]
A thousand flames burning as one.
AreaReportContent_Text87:
Presenter: Lucilla
Recipient: Strategic Risk Assessment Committee, Spacetrek Collective

I. Investigation Background and Objective
Since the third week of this fiscal year, the following anomalies have been observed across Lahai-Roi:

1. The active cycle of Void Storms has abruptly shortened to 72 standard hours, with frequency increasing by approximately 40%.
2. Regional Voidmatter concentrations have increased by 31.7% compared to the same period last year, with the curve growth showing no signs of flattening.
3. Low-frequency Threnodian interference phenomena are occurring frequently, with several monitoring stations recording harmonic fluctuations of unknown origin.

In accordance with the "Lahai-Roi Voidmatter Protection and Safety Regulations," and given that the above anomalous indicators closely match the precursor characteristics of a Threnodian overflow event, a special consultant has been commissioned to conduct an emergency reinspection of the Sealed Fissure site in the Dimmr Plains.

Operator: Hiyuki (Counter-Threnodian Response Force Specialist)
Investigation Site: Dimmr Plains Sealed Fissure - Ceased Court

II. Operator Investigation Record
The following content is compiled from Hiyuki's oral account and Terminal records:

The blade at the Ceased Court is still in place, but the ground where its edge makes contact shows traces of Voidmatter contamination.
Correct. The entity on the other side of the Stridergate is intensifying its power accumulation, but I cannot determine when it will act.
...I have reinfused my frequency into the blade. At the very least, Aleph-1's power cannot cross this point for the time being.

End of record.

III. Investigation Conclusions
Based on Hiyuki's on-site survey and subsequent spectrum data analysis, the following conclusion has been reached regarding the state of the Dimmr Plains' Sealed Fissure:

The primary structure of the seal remains intact, with no signs of substantial rupture or overflow. However, Voidmatter activity beneath the fissure shows a sustained upward trend, positively correlating with the recent increase in Void Storm frequency and concentration. Based on the above, the window of time before the seal on the Threnodian Aleph-1 fails is narrowing.

IV. Recommendations and Matters for Review
Given the current situation, I respectfully submit the following matters for review by the Spacetrek Collective Department of Voidmatters:

• Immediately lift the preparatory phase of Duskveil and raise the Voidmatter disaster early warning level across Lahai-Roi to Level Two.
• Accelerate the calibration process for combat and counter-Voidmatter Mechascouts, prioritizing the completion of repairs to the Exostrider's basic framework and dynamic load testing.
• Authorize the formation of a Voidmatter Rapid Response Team, with Hiyuki serving as Tactical Director, responsible for dynamic monitoring and emergency response in the Dimmr Plains area.

The above investigation conclusions and recommendations are submitted for joint review.
Applicant: Lucilla

AreaReportContent_Text89:
During the subsequent survey of the Dimmr Plains, the investigation team discovered a large-scale material accumulation zone beneath the Silent Crag.

Preliminary identification shows the deposits in this area fall into two main categories:

1. Structural remains bearing the architectural characteristics of the early Spacetrek Collective — including but not limited to prefabricated alloy bulkheads, energy transmission conduits, and partial functional module frameworks.
2. Fragments of Exoswarm components in various forms, their biological activity completely halted and confirmed to be in a dormant state.

These findings raise an urgent question: how did this batch of materials end up in the barren Dimmr Plains, far from any planned infrastructure zones?

While tracing the component models of these abandoned assets, the investigation team noticed a previously overlooked archive entry. In the early stages of Startorch Academy's establishment, a shipment of materials from the New Federation arrived in Lahai-Roi. According to the transport dispatch report at the time, the convoy encountered a sudden Void Storm near Sundermere. Subsequent inventory records show that the Void Storm caused significant loss of assets and construction materials, which were then registered as "permanent loss."

However, as the investigation progressed, several discrepancies emerged in the records of that Void Storm:

1. Among the incident records kept by different departments, the categories, quantities, and specific models of lost materials show multiple inconsistencies. Some data contradict each other, making it impossible to form a unified write-off basis.
2. Data from Voidmatter monitoring stations from the same period indicates that the intensity and duration of the Void Storm fell short of the threshold needed to completely dissolve industrial-grade materials. Furthermore, notes in that day's transport manifest show that certain assets in this shipment had already been treated with a Voidmatter-resistant coating.
3. If the materials in this accumulation zone had once dissolved in Voidmatter and been abandoned in the Dimmr Plains, the residual Voidmatter frequency should be evenly dispersed, not concentrated on the surface protective layer.

These contradictions point to one possibility: the material loss recorded as an "accident" that year may not have been the result of a Void Storm at all. It is more likely that after arriving in Lahai-Roi, this batch of materials was diverted through some other means, and the Void Storm happened to provide natural cover for the transfer.

The investigation team has now marked the coordinates of this zone and collected samples. Given that the sealed early Exoswarm component fragments still hold some reference value for studying the differentiation limits and degradation mechanisms of Exoswarms, it is recommended that they be included in the subsequent recovery inventory. As for how this batch of materials reached the Dimmr Plains, and what those mismatched numbers in the Void Storm records ultimately mean, those questions may have to be left for future verification.

Research Group Annotation:
Regarding the formation time of this accumulation zone, its stratigraphic sequence, and its correlation with Void Storm activity during the same period, further cross-departmental data comparison is still needed. It is recommended to coordinate the retrieval of all original records from those who participated in the transport and inventory work that year, in order to restore the full picture of the event as much as possible.

AreaReportContent_Text91:
"In Memory of Those Who Never Returned"

Fellow citizens. Colleagues of the Spacetrek Collective. Faculty and students of Startorch Academy. And all of you still holding your posts in Lahai-Roi.

Today, we stand once more beneath the light of Helios.

The last time we gathered here, we celebrated the New Solar Ceremony. We had just ignited an artificial sun in Lahai-Roi's sky. We cheered for the future.

We didn't know that months later, we would endure the largest Void Storm on record. We would activate "Duskveil," our final contingency. And we would face the Threnodian, Aleph-One, head-on.

But we have driven the Threnodian back. We have sealed the Stridergate. We have crossed the Twilight Epoch, the very period of time Royan mythology said would end everything.

Yes. We have triumphed.

This victory is unprecedented. The known over the unknown. Humanity over the Threnodian.

But as the head of the Spacetrek Collective, it is my duty to tell you what this victory cost.

In the past months, Lahai-Roi has recorded nearly one hundred Void Storms. Five exceeded the highest alert level. Over thirty of our monitoring stations, research facilities, and defense nodes have been destroyed. In our search for the runes, we lost countless Mechascouts. Seventeen of our best operators suffered Voidmatter contamination. Most of them will never return to Lahai-Roi.

And most critically, we lost the cornerstone of the Spacetrek Collective itself. The Exostrider—the one who carved out Lahai-Roi's future.

And yet, this is the greatest victory we have ever achieved in our long war against the Voidborne Threnodian.

This frontier was built by the people of Solaris. Countless pioneers have been lost to the Void Storms. Their Cassettes still sit in the deepest vaults of our archives.

Roald, Koki, Mingxia, Beverly, Bajcetic—many of you have heard these names. They were the first explorers. The first researchers to come from every corner of Solaris to these frozen lands. And they were the first to try to conquer the void through their recordings, helping us learn the truth about Void Storms.

And before them, there were so many more whose Cassettes could not be recovered. They remain forever lost to the Void Storms.
AreaReportContent_Text92:
Today, I stand here to recount these "costs." Not to dwell on suffering, but to remind you, and myself, that this very moment we are living through, and every tomorrow to come, is a chain of miracles built on the accumulation of all that came before.

I still remember my first speech after taking office here. It was at the memorial for the Roald expedition team.

Since then, I have witnessed the disappearance of many fine explorers.

But they were never just cold, lifeless names on a list. The traces they left behind still guide us forward.

Together with the Roya, lost in darkness since ages past, they endured. They resisted dissolution in eternal darkness.

The Roya. The people of Rinascita. The people of Huanglong... People from every corner of Solaris, even in the deepest darkness of the void, they resisted dissolution. They kept moving forward. They kept exploring.
...
...
...

As for what came after, I believe everyone here already knows. We are still standing here. Even when nothingness tried to consume all of Lahai-Roi, we are still standing here.

Yes. We have lost so much.

But right now, we are still standing. And we will keep moving forward.

Aleph-One tried to make us believe that everything eventually returns to nothing. But it was wrong. That signal, sent by a probe Solaris explorers launched years ago, was not white noise. Not cosmic background radiation. 

It was the voice of the beginning. The afterglow of the universe's birth. And we can still hear it, across billions of years.

So remember this: everything that has ever existed always leaves a trace.

The Spacetrek Collective will not stop. One day, we will break through the Etheric Sea. We will venture into a wider world.

And as the Exostrider once said:

May we meet again in the boundless sea of stars!

Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_1_1:
Frightens passersby wherever it appears, and at times loses control and harms them.
Rumor has it that it snatches up round objects of all kinds to use as a head...
Sheriff_Criminal_Name_1_2: The Thief Who Stole the Lionarch's Head
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_1_2: A thief seen stealing the Lionarch's head in a time-rewind record
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_1_3: A father who, taken in by a folk remedy, hoped to cure his gravely ill daughter by learning the liondance. Whatever possessed him to use a Lionarch's head for it is anyone's guess. There was no malice in it, though; a stern word should set him straight.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_1: Passersby nearby say the Fog Lionarch that patrols this area has gone missing of late...
Sheriff_ClueDesc_2: Passersby nearby say a "Headless Lionarch" has been appearing around here lately...
Sheriff_Clue_3: The Thief Who Stole the Lionarch's Head
Sheriff_ClueDesc_3:
A recording captured by the Skywatch Ring.
In it, while a Fog Lionarch rests in standby, someone lifts off its beastly head, sets it atop their own, and strides away without a care.
Sheriff_Clue_4: The Man Teaching Himself the Liondance
Sheriff_ClueDesc_4:
A man named Shouyuan has lately been teaching himself the liondance.
By his own account, he hopes to use the Taiping Musical to chase away the nightmares that plague his daughter.
Sheriff_End_1_1:
Earlier, residents reported a "Headless Lionarch" haunting the Skyworks.

The truth was far humbler: Shouyuan's daughter had been suffering frequent nightmares, and having heard that Jinzhou's Taiping Musical could drive off illness and evil, he hoped to chase those nightmares away with a liondance. But he could neither hire a master from Jinzhou's Liondance Troupe nor buy a liondance head, so Shouyuan took a crooked turn, stealing the head from a Fog Lionarch while it sat idle to teach himself the dance. And thus the rumor of the "Headless Lionarch" was born.
Sheriff_EventProgress_1_Content_1: Residents have reported a "Headless Lionarch" appearing around the Skyworks...
Sheriff_EventProgress_1_Content_2: Investigation reveals that someone made off with the Fog Lionarch's head.
Sheriff_EventProgress_1_Content_3: The thief appears to be a middle-aged man named Shouyuan.
Sheriff_EventProgress_1_Content_4: Through deduction, it turns out Shouyuan was taken in by a folk remedy: he meant to don the Lionarch's head and teach himself the liondance to chase off his daughter's nightmares, but the head has since slipped away into a cave.
Sheriff_EventProgress_1_Content_5: The head has been found. Now set it back on the Lionarch.
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_2: A Twistscale that ran rampant near the victim's home, suspected of willful assault and willful destruction of property.
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_2_2: A Tacet Discord disguised as a Twistscale, suspected of assault and damage of property.
Sheriff_End_2:
Earlier, Wu Shisan, a resident of Xuanfang, was attacked by a Tacet Discord at midnight.

By the accounts of Wu Shisan and his neighbor Old Jin, a Twistscale had been wreaking havoc near their homes, and Wu Shisan was attacked while tracking it, but saved, fortunately, by the Xuanfang Wardens.

The investigation found that the Twistscale was in fact a Tacet Discord in disguise. It is surmised that the Tacet Discord caused the destruction deliberately, luring people out to the outskirts to attack them. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is advised to watch for other abnormal acts of destruction attributed to animals.
Sheriff_EventProgress_2_Content_1: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs received a report: a resident was attacked late at night by an unidentified creature.
Sheriff_EventProgress_2_Content_2: According to the victim and the Xuanfang Wardens who witnessed it, the unidentified creature was likely a Twistscale.
Sheriff_EventProgress_2_Content_3: The attacker behind the event was a Tacet Discord mimicking a Twistscale.
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_3: Posing as a plant enthusiast, exploited the Leafweaver's leaf-cutting nature to steal the Ministry of Development's construction logs.
Sheriff_EventProgress_3_Content_1:
Head to the Ministry of Development and ask the archivist Suoyin about the theft from the archive.
The stolen items were a batch of <color=#e3e5ae>construction logs from twenty years ago</color>. The lock was intact at the time of the theft, but the <color=#e3e5ae>ventilation window showed traces of entry and exit</color>.
Sheriff_EventProgress_3_Content_3: Search the locations mentioned in the suspects' testimonies for relevant evidence.
Sheriff_EventProgress_3_Content_4: Only Le'an had the means to move and destroy the records with the Leafweavers, and his strange familiarity with the logs, along with conduct that flatly contradicted his testimony, marks him as the true culprit.
Sheriff_EventProgress_3_Content_5: Presented with the shredded paper from the nest and the construction logs, Le'an finally admits to the crime, but won't reveal his motive, and is handed over to the Constables.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_5:
Though he hid his real movements at first, Tuzao eventually admits his actions stemmed only from job-hunting anxiety and had nothing to do with the theft of the logs.
He'd claimed to be night-fishing by the river at the time, but in truth, ashamed to let anyone know he was looking for work, he had slipped out late at night to check the notice board, which is why he repeatedly passed near the archive.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_6:
Though she had tried to sneak into the archive, she ultimately admits her actions were driven only by commercial interest and had nothing to do with the theft of the logs.
She'd claimed to be minding her stall by the bamboo grove at the time, but in truth, having heard of a lost recipe for the "Yuan's Flavors," she'd been asking around for old books and papers, hoping to buy it up cheap before anyone else.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_7:
A crumpled workbook with half its inner pages torn out. The edges of what's left are charred, and up close they still carry a faint smell of smoke. The handwriting crawls every which way, like earthworms across mud, and right at the score line sits a great big "23."
This was what Xiaobei was so desperate to hide, the thing she'd slip out to burn in the dead of night rather than let anyone see.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_8: A Leafweaver nest built up in layers from countless shredded scraps of paper. Pull the scraps loose, fit them together piece by piece, and words like "Development" and "Artisanry" surface, along with the names of many Artisans. These are the remains of the stolen construction logs.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_9:
A shredded and reassembled paper scroll, its yellowed pages laced with tears.
These twenty-year-old Ministry of Development construction logs seem unremarkable at first glance. However, scattered throughout are records of projects Muyu oversaw while infiltrating the Ministry under the alias "Shenyuan."
Sheriff_Event_Name_4: Disappearance Case: The Visitor from Jinzhou
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_4: Tacet Discords left behind by the kidnappers to guard "Rover." They appear to be controlled by some unknown technology, obeying the kidnappers' commands.
Sheriff_End_4:
A resident reported to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs that "Rover" had gone missing in the Land of Xuanfang.

The investigation revealed that this so-called "Rover" was just a miner from Jinzhou. A similar appearance and some overlapping travel records had seen him mistaken for the real Rover, after which an unknown faction abducted him.

The kidnappers' true identity remains untraceable for now; they are presumed to be a group with a grudge against Rover. Since their methods have surfaced in other cases too, pursuing those cases together may be worth considering.
Sheriff_EventProgress_4_Content_1: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs received a report that Rover, meaning you, may well have gone missing.
Sheriff_EventProgress_4_Content_2: According to a tip from the resident Sen, this "Rover" appears to have been kidnapped.
Sheriff_EventProgress_4_Content_3: At the scene you find signs of a struggle, along with a recording left behind by the kidnappers.
Sheriff_EventProgress_4_Content_4: Following the clues, you find the kidnapped "Rover" and defeat the Tacet Discords standing guard over them.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_10: The ground shows signs of being reshaped and then set right again. This is a stone-shaping Resonance Ability, not one suited to combat. You've seen Artisans with similar Resonance Abilities back in Jinzhou.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_11: A slip torn from a notebook, bearing the words "Rinascita," "reconstruction," "dispatch," and "bridge," written in Huanglong script.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_12: The figure behind it all never appears in the recording captured by the Skywatch Ring... Perhaps they found some way to disrupt the Four Chime Shaftpost's records.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_13:
A recording captured by the Skywatch Ring.
The kidnappers seem to know of your existence, and clearly nursed a deep grudge against you back in Jinzhou.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_14:
A recording captured by the Skywatch Ring.
The kidnappers' aim seems to be to lure you into investigating, with a secondary goal of drawing the Constables away to weaken the protection around the Four Chime Shaftpost.
Sheriff_Event_Name_5: Potential Risk: A Road to Riches
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_5: Suspected of fraud carried out in the name of the "Xuanfang Aegis" foundation. A warning from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs: sky-high returns are bait for a scam, so report anything like this to a Constable at once.
Sheriff_End_5:
The citizen Jianji had set up a foundation under the pretext of supporting Xuanfang Hold's reconstruction, gathering funds from the public. He then vanished without a trace, the money gone with him.

Investigation revealed that Jianji had in fact been used by a group of former Exiles. Calling themselves "traveling merchants," these former Exiles had come from Jinzhou. They used Jianji to swindle the funds, planning to flee Xuanfang Hold.

The former Exiles involved have all been arrested, and the funds recovered. They are expected to be returned to the victims shortly.
Sheriff_EventProgress_5_Content_1: Jianji, a citizen who raised funds in the city under the banner of "rebuilding Xuanfang Hold," has gone missing, likely having absconded with the money.
Sheriff_EventProgress_5_Content_2: According to a tip from Fuling, Jianji seems to have <color=#e3e5ae>quarreled with someone</color> before he disappeared.
Sheriff_EventProgress_5_Content_3: After investigating the scene, you find that Jianji seems to have been <color=#e3e5ae>taken away by the "traveling merchants" he'd partnered with</color>.
Sheriff_EventProgress_5_Content_4: After investigating the scene, you find that, doubts aside, it was most likely Jianji's own doing.
Sheriff_EventProgress_5_Content_5: Following the clues, you find Jianji along with the "traveling merchants," and recover the funds after defeating them.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_15: In conversation, two citizens mention that the foundation was never registered with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_16: In conversation, two citizens mention that the foundation claimed to settle accounts through futures and to pay out dividends in advance.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_17: In conversation, two citizens mention that Jianji is usually diligent and honest, hardly the sort to run a con. Perhaps he was being used as well.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_18: In conversation, two citizens mention that Xuanfang Hold is not, in fact, facing any shortage of supplies, contrary to what the foundation claimed.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_19:
A recording captured by the Skywatch Ring.
In it, the "traveling merchants" mention "those higher-ups," seemingly people who have yet to surface.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_20: The saboteur seems to have studied the Four Chime Shaftpost's structure closely, the kind of effort that would take years.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_21: The terminal overloaded and burned out under an enormous frequency load. A crude move, plainly meant to squeeze every bit of damage it could out of the Four Chime Shaftpost's systems.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_22: Enormous claw marks scar the wall, seemingly left by a humanoid creature or Autopuppet of extraordinary strength.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_24:
A recording captured by the Skywatch Ring.
The saboteur is plainly in league with Muyu. Muyu directed them to draw away the attention of the Xuanfang Wardens and Constables, the better to aid the scheme he was working within the city.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_25:
A recording captured by the Skywatch Ring.
The saboteur and those behind him do not trust Muyu. From their talk, it seems they were abandoned in Xuanfang Hold for some reason, and harbor hatred toward whoever left them behind.
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_6: A visitor from Rinascita, brought into the city by patrolling Xuanfang Wardens after a Tacet Discord attack. Suspected of taking part in an Autopuppet trade.
Sheriff_End_6:
A man from Rinascita named Barrado fell under suspicion of taking part in an Autopuppet trade.

When found, Barrado claimed he had no idea the item he'd bought was an Autopuppet, taking it for an ordinary souvenir made by a Xuanfang Hold folk artist.

Tracking down the folk artist behind the Autopuppet replicas, the team learned he had crafted these lifelike Picket models as a tribute to Xuanfang Hold, and that a real Autopuppet had slipped in among them while his back was turned.

In the end, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs decided to dispose of the Autopuppet replicas, and on Barrado's suggestion the artist made a fresh batch of smaller, miniature Picket figurines.
Sheriff_EventProgress_6_Content_1: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs received intel: an outside merchant is trading Autopuppets within Xuanfang Hold.
Sheriff_EventProgress_6_Content_2: After finding the buyer, you discover he had no idea he'd purchased an Autopuppet.
Sheriff_EventProgress_6_Content_3: To get to the truth, you decide to seek out the "artist" selling the handicrafts.
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_10: A faulty Autopuppet due for servicing wandered off by accident and slipped in among the Autopuppets on patrol.
Sheriff_End_10:
An Autopuppet sent to the Skyworks for servicing developed a misaligned-part fault during calibration, leaving it able to move only in reverse. It then wandered off mid-test, its whereabouts impossible to pin down.

Tracing its trail, the team first picked up signs of the stray around the Snare Platform on the Western Fang Peaks. Following the footprints from one clue to the next, Rover finally reached the Autopuppet's hiding place.

Three Autopuppets stood waiting there, with no way to tell the faulty one apart at a glance. Drawing them into conversation revealed that all three were speaking in deliberately odd ways, seemingly covering for one another to hide which was the faulty one. After some questioning, it slipped up and gave itself away. In the end it was returned to the Skyworks, where the institution arranged fresh professional servicing to settle the misalignment for good.
Sheriff_EventProgress_10_Content_1: An Autopuppet recently sent in for repair developed a part misalignment during calibration and can now only move in reverse. This faulty Autopuppet has wandered off by accident...
Sheriff_EventProgress_10_Content_2: Above the Snare Platform on the Western Fang Peaks, you find traces left by the Autopuppet.
Sheriff_EventProgress_10_Content_3: You decide to follow the clues onward until you track down the stray, faulty Autopuppet.
Sheriff_EventProgress_10_Content_4: Following the footprints, you finally find where the Autopuppet is hiding. But three of them stand before you... You'll need to pick out the right one.
Sheriff_Criminal_Charge_11: Deserting its post and venturing, unbidden, into areas outside its assigned duties.
Sheriff_End_11:
A Kernel Puppet began malfunctioning, repeatedly leaving its assigned patrol zone. Its unanticipated, unsupervised behaviors prompted a dedicated investigation.

Your investigation has determined that the Kernel Puppet's destination is the Fogveil Pagoda. However, based solely on the clues gathered there, it is not possible to establish why the Kernel Puppet has been abandoning its post to travel to this location. Further investigation into the Sunken Warren may yield the answer.
Sheriff_EventProgress_11_Content_1: A Kernel Puppet keeps leaving the area it's meant to patrol, moving toward the Fogveil Pagoda...
Sheriff_EventProgress_11_Content_2: In one of the Fogveil Pagoda's enclosures, you find traces left by this Kernel Puppet.
Sheriff_EventProgress_11_Content_3: Unable to uncover why the Kernel Puppet keeps slipping away at the Fogveil Pagoda, you decide to continue the investigation at the Sunken Warren.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_1: Yuan's Flavors welcomes the pickiest diner in its history, and the Fillet Fairmaiden resolves to bring back Xuanfang's finest, freshest taste. But reviving the old recipe and tracking down the ingredients leads to one surprise after another…
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_2: Muyu has escaped for now, but the crisis of the rogue Autopuppets is far from over...
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_3: The battle for the city has come to a pause. How are the Xuanfang Wardens faring now?
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_4: The Huizhen Plaza is holding its annual sale, and you and Abby set out to take a look.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_5: The Sunken Warren is a vast facility for detaining and disposing of Tacet Discords, no place for ordinary folk to wander near. Yet while exploring it, you catch the sound of someone crying out for help...
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_6: Lately, many have noticed an Autopuppet pinned beneath the mountain near the Fogveil Pagoda... Wenchang, over in the Peach Garden, may know what's really going on.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_7: To revive the Auto Empire, King Auto has a favor to ask of you.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_8: In the Squarefield, idle now for many years, you receive a recording from the past.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_9: A film crew from the Pioneer Association is shooting footage for a documentary, and they might just need your help.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_10: An eerie tale called the "Street Lighter's Night Walk" is said to circulate across the Land of Xuanfang. On every foggy night, the Street Lighters that tend the lamps around the Skyworks keep vanishing without a trace…
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_11: In the Land of Xuanfang, a squad of feeble Autopuppets keeps losing fight after fight in their combat qualification. They could use some guidance.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_12: A resident named Jianji is gathering funds in the city under a foundation's name, promising investors a remarkably handsome return. It sounds like a fine chance to get rich...
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_13: Jianji seems to be rallying the foundation's investors. Go and see what it's all about.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_14: Qiuhong has asked for your help investigating a "ghost" sighting.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_Start_15: Qingyan is weighing up his own future, and he hopes you can point the way.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_1:
Hard was the hunt for rare fare, steeped in the old ways,
yet the jade-green dish upon the plate withheld its flavor's grace.
Only when she grasped the truths of years long past,
did the old and new unite, and fragrance bloom at last.

An ancient taste, reborn—the Immortal's Medley Tribute takes the stage to thunderous acclaim. Her heart unchanged, the Fillet Fairmaiden's long road of taste still stretches on.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_2: A sudden crisis of rogue Autopuppets erupts in Xuanfang Hold. You are tasked with investigating Shenyuan, who had lurked within the Ministry of Development for over twenty years. Following the clues, you find Jiuwu, who uses the Hazardous Autopuppet Registry as leverage to demand that you delete his maintenance records. You feign agreement, then work in secret with the Development Codex keeper. Under Sonija's persuasion, Jiuwu finally comes around, handing over the registry of his own accord and clearing the way for the screening effort.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_2_2: A sudden crisis of rogue Autopuppets erupts in Xuanfang Hold. You are tasked with investigating Shenyuan, who had lurked within the Ministry of Development for over twenty years. Following the clues, you find Jiuwu, who uses the Hazardous Autopuppet Registry as leverage to demand that you delete his maintenance records. Faced with Jiuwu's hesitation and fear, you refrain from using force. Instead, you tell him of the efforts other Artisans have made to resolve the crisis. Jiuwu wavers. He agrees to turn himself in the next day, but leaves behind an unfinished confession, a letter born of inner conflict. It is only under Sonija's questioning that he finally finds remorse, decides to face his wrongdoings, and cooperates fully with the investigation.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_2_3: A sudden crisis of rogue Autopuppets erupts in Xuanfang Hold. You are tasked with investigating Shenyuan, who had lurked within the Ministry of Development for over twenty years. Following the clues, you find Jiuwu, who uses the Hazardous Autopuppet Registry as leverage to demand that you delete his maintenance records. After careful thought, you refuse. As the standoff intensifies, an anomaly strikes without warning. Jiuwu witnesses firsthand the determination and sacrifice of the other Artisans. In that moment, he realizes that hiding is not the answer, and it will only waste precious time. He resolves to cooperate fully and face the consequences of his actions.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_3: While helping Huaxu Academy distribute medical supplies, Qingyan moves among the wounded, listening as people speak of fear, duty, and what they fight for. Bit by bit, he begins to understand that protecting others takes more than courage and a willing heart. It means carrying a heavy burden, and bearing the cost that comes with it. And for the first time, he starts to ask himself: Who do I want to become?
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_4: At Huizhen Plaza, you meet Suisui. Together, you settle a commercial dispute and work out a better partnership for Yubai and Shangming. There were a few twists along the way, but the two of you share an easy, unhurried day.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_5:
You rescue the Exiles who had stumbled into the Sunken Warren and witness the final moments of their leader, a man who was once a Fractsidus Artificer. 
At the end, he is finally freed from the mad voice that had whispered ceaselessly in his ear, and finds a peace he had never known.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_6: It turns out this was all just a staged interactive attraction. At Wenchang's invitation, you try out her "Kernel Puppet Pinned Beneath Five-Fox Mountain," "rescuing" the Autopuppet from under the hill. She plans to write up a promotional piece for the Pioneer Association and return the rented Autopuppet to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Perhaps... you'll run into her again near Shaftpost Yard someday.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_7: Together with Leitao, you repair the faulty Auto Casket and learn what had caused it to break down.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_8:
These recordings from the past chronicle the days when the Autopuppets were trapped in their mission.
The mission is over now, and they wish never to wake again.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_9: With your help, the documentary footage is filmed without a hitch.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_10: That strange, eerie tale of the "Street Lighter's Night Walk" turns out to be a story from one of Zhuangyu's books.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_11: Under your guidance, the Autopuppet squad passes its combat qualification, though the captain still thinks there's room to improve.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_12: You've invested in the foundation Jianji spoke of, but will you really see the returns he promised?
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_13: You rescue Jianji and discover the whole affair was the work of Exiles who had slipped into Xuanfang Hold. You recover the funds and, with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' help, return them to the victims.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_14: You investigated alongside Buling and uncovered the truth behind the "ghosts." Lyu Yi's longing for his grandfather and the Reverberation's longing for its own family had wound together, and out of them came a brief miracle.
Sheriff_QuestDesc_End_15: You put Qingyan's doubts to rest. With Liangyu smoothing the way, Qingyan and Duzhou worked together to repair the building where preserved fruit is made. Qingyan has begun to find a sense of direction for his future, while you and Liangyu fell to reminiscing about days gone by. Qingzhi then, Qingyan now—the people of Xuanfang Hold pass down what they believe in, and so the road to the future is paved...
Sheriff_ClueDesc_26: The detailed record of food expenses kept by Lyu Yi.  Judging by the list, the skewers are made with generous ingredients. He's particularly upset about the price of bird eggs.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_27:
Lyu Yi's memo. From the notes, he's been secretly performing a ritual. However...
"He's definitely been scammed," Buling remarked.
Sheriff_ClueDesc_28:
Lyu Yi's records of Buling's tabs. Judging by the records, Buling really does love this shop's skewers...
"That's not the point!"
Sheriff_ClueDesc_29:
Some oddities discovered during the on-site investigation. For one, the "ghosts" mentioned over and over in the report don't actually exist.
For another, the shopkeeper Lyu Yi's words and actions don't quite add up...
Sheriff_ClueDesc_30:
Lyu Yi inherited his grandfather's trade and is a master of skewers. It seems that he's destined for this line of work.
Lately, though, he always seems to stay up very late...
Sheriff_ClueDesc_31: Boss? Why you keep staring at me? I'm definitely NOT hanging around here just because I blew all my travel money!

QuestBranch_Node10_Desc: Yangyang and Muyu arrive at the Western Fang Peaks. Elsewhere, Rover and Suisui arrive in Xuanfang.
QuestBranch_Node11_Desc: Rover and Suisui arrive at Shaftpost Yard in the Southern Yuan Hills.
QuestBranch_Node12_Desc: Rover and Suisui become separated by the Disorienting Fog.
QuestBranch_Node13_Desc: Rover and Liangyu intercept Muyu at the Skyworks as he prepares to escape. Elsewhere, Suisui enters Fogveil Pagoda in the Eastern Xuan Peaks.
QuestBranch_Node14_Desc: Rover and the others pursue Muyu into the depths of the Skyworks. At the same time, Suisui enters Hsin's secret chamber, ready to negotiate a deal with Her.
QuestBranch_Node15_Desc: Rover regroups with the others in Xuanfang Hold. After trading intel, they begin preparing for the upcoming battle.
QuestBranch_Node16_Desc: Xuanfang Hold is surrounded. Tacet Discords and rogue Autopuppets swarm as a great battle looms.
QuestBranch_Node17_Desc: A wrongness stirs in the Censure Courts. Yangyang and Rover head towards the source to face the one who started it all.
QuestBranch_Node18_Desc: Yangyang and Rover defeat the Thousand-Puppet Pavilion created by Muyu, and the Land of Xuanfang welcomes a moment of peace.
QuestBranch_Node19_Desc: Yangyang and Rover reunite at last. Together, they face the enormous Autopuppet, the Myriad Snare, in the innermost part of the Skyworks. At the critical moment, Suisui delivers something crucial to Rover.
