Skill_1004207_SkillDescribe:
<size=40><color=Title>Unseen Snare</color></size>
Chisa inflicts <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> on the target for {0}s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting <color=Highlight>Serrated Loop</color>.
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Locking</color> on to a target.
When targets marked by <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every {2}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thread of Bane</color></size>
When dealing damage to targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>, ignore {4} of their DEF.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa unlocks <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> consume <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> on hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Blitz</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.  
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start the combo from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, successful Dodges can be triggered.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>.
Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to sustain the attack. When <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> ends, cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> automatically.
Release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> automatically.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> deals <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Eradication</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa casts <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> in the following 2 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after consuming all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> or <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
Attacking targets with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for {5}s.
The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Every {6} point of <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> consumed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>. Up to {7} points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> and ends <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Fever</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color>.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color> and exits <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa resets <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>.
When in <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Glide</color></size>
When Chisa is not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and has more than {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>, she can consume {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> in the following 5 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> in mid-air before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
- While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> or <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> forward shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing when launched into mid-air.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>.
During the skill, hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ring of Chainsaw</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {9} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Normal Attack </color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> grants <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> grants {11} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Jetstream</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>. 
Chisa continuously obtains <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> over time.
Chisa obtains {13} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> upon defeating a target. 
Exiting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> resets <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> passively for a short period of time after casting  <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.
Skill_1004607_SkillDescribe:

<size=10></size>

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>

<size=10></size>

Text_AgeTip_Text:
1.本游戏是一款开放世界动作类游戏，适用于年满16周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。

2.本游戏基于架空的故事背景和世界观，与真实历史和现实世界均无任何关联。

3.根据国家相关要求，本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未通过实名认证的用户不可进入游戏；
游戏中部分玩法和道具需要付费。认证为未成年的用户将接受以下管理：未满8周岁的用户不得进行充值；8周岁以上但未满16周岁的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币。
游戏仅会在周五、周六、周日及法定节假日的20时至21时，向未成年人提供1小时游戏服务。

4.游戏中设置了主线及丰富的支线剧情，并且提供了开放世界探索玩法。游戏内有丰富多彩的剧情，精美的游戏画面，优质的游戏配音以及新颖的系统玩法。

Text_WorldLevelIntro_Text:
<color=HighlightB>Every 10 Union Levels raises your SOL3 Phase by 1.</color>
  
Higher SOL3 Phases yield better rewards but also present more challenging enemies.
 
At Union Level <color=HighlightB>20, 40, and 60</color>, you must complete <color=HighlightB>SOL3 Phase Ascension Quests</color> in order to keep increasing your Union Level and/or SOL3 Phase.
 
You can lower your SOL3 Phase or raise it back up again <color=HighlightB>every 12 hours.</color>

ConfirmBox_175_Content:
SOL3 Phase is raised through Union Level. <color=HighlightB>Every 10 Union Levels raises SOL3 Phase by 1.</color>

Once you've reached Union Levels <color=HighlightB>20, 40, and 60</color>, complete the corresponding <color=HighlightB>Phase Ascension</color> quests to further increase your Union Level.

If you haven't completed the corresponding Phase Ascension quest, SOL3 Phase cannot be raised when your Union Level reaches the cap.

Proceed to the Quests menu to complete the Phase Ascension quest, raising the Union Level cap.

HelpText_464_Content:
[About]
To help Startorch freshmen learn to drive safely, the Biological Mechanical Exoswarm Materials Manufacturing and Research Club developed H.E.R.M.E.S., a motorbike simulator running on heuristic algorithms. But due to some issues with the model's training data, the system accidentally became sentient and refused to be driven. In their last-ditch effort, the developer reached out to you for help with the testing.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and obtain access to the expedition motorbike.

[Event Rules]
Select a Resonator to challenge the tracks with H.E.R.M.E.S. with an arsenal of new weapons. Use enhancement modules to boost the stats of H.E.R.M.E.S. and upgrade their weapons. Complete all tracks to finalize the testing.
Any unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game Mail the next time you log in to the game within 30 days after the event ends.

ItemInfo_41100061_BgDescription: Fragile flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a dying blossom. Commonly found in areas affected by Void Storms.
ItemInfo_41100062_BgDescription: Standard flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a wilting blossom. Often recovered from Exoswarm corrupted by Void Storms.
ItemInfo_41100063_BgDescription: Stable flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a budding blossom. Occasionally found in areas with frequent Void Storm occurrences.
ItemInfo_41100064_BgDescription: Unique flower-shaped Tacet Core, resembling a fully bloomed blossom. Found only in the most dangerous areas ravaged by Void Storms. Legend has it that when a Void Storm sweeps across Lahai-Roi, this kind of Tacet Core may be seen entwined around the body of the strongest Exoswarm.
ItemInfo_41100071_BgDescription: Fragile triangle Tacet Cord, looking broken and unstable. Commonly found in areas affected by Void Storms.

ItemInfo_41100073_BgDescription: Stable triangle Tacet Cord, with a strong, enduring structure. Occasionally found in areas with frequent Void Storm occurrences.
ItemInfo_41100074_BgDescription: Special triangle Tacet Cord, exhibiting the most resilient structure, retaining complete frequency even under intense energy shock. Legend has it that when a Void Storm sweeps across Lahai-Roi, this kind of Tacet Cord can control even the most powerful mech humanity has ever built.

ItemInfo_41400204_AttributesDescription: Fleurdelys' drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400204_BgDescription:
An item bestowed on her during the Order's Initiation.

Fleurdelys used to be a meticulously crafted "idol" for the public. Only when the divine shell is shed can her true life begin.

Fleurdelys, or Cartethyia... Which name does she truly wish to live by?
ItemInfo_41400204_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Fleurdelys' drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400214_AttributesDescription: Lioness of Glory's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400214_BgDescription: When the hero's banner rises, even the mountains of Septimont honor this crown with respect. It's not made to dazzle like gold or gems. It's forged from sheer strength and unshakable will.
ItemInfo_41400214_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Lioness of Glory's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400224_AttributesDescription: Fenrico's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400224_BgDescription: He fumbled forward through formless chaos, barely recalling when the shift in his perception took hold—the day he rose as the Primus, an icy conviction settled in his chest, so cold that it burned in his clenching grip.
ItemInfo_41400224_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Fenrico's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400254_AttributesDescription: Threnodian Leviathan's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400254_BgDescription: Once the manifestation of Leviathan's power, its calcified tail stands as a testament to the fall of an ancient divinity—yesterday's shackles long since broken. As the endless night recedes, the curse turns into strength, carried forth until the final waves.
ItemInfo_41400254_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Threnodian Leviathan's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400264_AttributesDescription: Starward Handmaiden: Hyvatia's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400264_BgDescription:
Fragment of the Hyvatia Observation Array's Primary Lens
Once used to survey the Reactor Drive, Hyvatia was among the Spacetrek Collective's proudest creations. Now, the polished beryllium plate no longer reflects the sun of tomorrow, but a distorted illusion of Voidmatter. What stretches toward the future is no longer noble ideals, but grasping, covetous hands.
ItemInfo_41400264_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Starward Handmaiden: Hyvatia's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400274_AttributesDescription: Reactor Husk's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400274_BgDescription:
When the Reactor Drive's defense is triggered, it can only mean that the Threnodian has breached containment. The mech will eliminate the intruder at all costs. 
Even if the body itself is destroyed, it will fulfill its duty to the very last moment.
ItemInfo_41400284_AttributesDescription: Nameless Explorer's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400284_BgDescription:
The broken helmet offers no clue to the explorer's identity, only a faint string of numbers: 1957104192825. 

It points back to lost times, leaving the present shrouded in mystery. The starlight once danced across its surface, but also scarred it with abyssal marks. Yet, even so, the choice would be repeated. Again and again.
ItemInfo_41400294_AttributesDescription: Sigillum's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400294_BgDescription: Memories of that person—their strength and frailty, their suffering and joy, everything that was them—remain only in this battered yet radiant golden fragment.
ItemInfo_41400294_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Sigillum's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.

ItemInfo_42600021_BgDescription: The eyes of this mysterious giant fish gleam with an eerie glow, and if you listen closely, you might even catch a faint melody within the flickers. Undoubtedly, it is one of the ocean's gifts.
ItemInfo_42600021_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Ocean's Gift.
ItemInfo_42600022_AttributesDescription: A strange Tacetite Bloom arranged in a spiral pattern. Can be used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Bloodpact's Pledge.
ItemInfo_42600022_BgDescription: This uniquely shaped Tacetitie Bloom encages an ancient yet powerful core from which you sense a familiar power.
ItemInfo_42600022_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A strange Tacetite Bloom arranged in a spiral pattern. Can be used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Bloodpact's Pledge.
ItemInfo_42601200_BgDescription:
A nut from the tall evergreen trees of Septimont. They drop when ripe, waiting to be gathered by animals preparing for the coming year.
Where there's a Leaftail Fox, you'll usually find these nuts. The foxes wrap their tails in oak leaves and use the nuts as lures for unsuspecting prey.
ItemInfo_42601210_BgDescription: These clear, cube-shaped halites, marked by unique swirling patterns, are found along Septimont's coastlines and coastal ravines. Septimontians often grind them into smelling salts or craft them into elegant jewelry.
ItemInfo_42601220_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601220_BgDescription: A common purple flower from the Septimont plains. Locals use it for spice blends or as home décor.
ItemInfo_42601220_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601230_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601230_BgDescription: Viburnums that grow in Border Mountains. Its deep red leaves stand out sharply, like blood seeping through the pale mountains.
ItemInfo_42601230_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601240_BgDescription:
A strange glowing marine life found in the ocean depths.
The Rinascita legend has it that the Sentinel left the Abyss Luminaries beneath the waves to guide the souls of the drowned.
ItemInfo_42601250_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601250_BgDescription:
A pure-white lycoris.
Its petals seem untinted by the vivid scarlet typical of its kind. Or perhaps the colors that were there have long faded. These delicate flowers bloom quietly in darkness. Just like the name they've been given, their unique appearance suggests maybe a whole new world exists beyond the Beyond.
"Things unfinished in this life shall wait for the next."
ItemInfo_42601250_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601260_BgDescription: Meat obtained from shrimps, tender and springy. In skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
ItemInfo_42601320_BgDescription: These pinecones grow slowly under low clusters of needles. Their thick shells can't hide the warm, nutty scent inside. The kernels have a gentle pine-resin sweetness, and once roasted, they release a mellow, toasty aroma, perfect for travelers crossing the frostlands who need quick energy.
ItemInfo_42601330_BgDescription: The needles of the Creeping Torchpine stand in dense, upright clusters and can survive extreme cold and poor soil. They carry a sharp herbal fragrance and small amounts of frost-resistant oils. Slightly bitter with a clean aftertaste, they're used in medicinal drinks or as a seasoning to add a bright, wintry note to food.
ItemInfo_42601340_BgDescription:
A large berry nourished by the Reactor Drive's light, gleaming with the warm amber glow of dusk. Sweet-tart, juicy, and rich in natural sugars, it is often gathered by Shepherds tending the Exoswarm, who drink its nectar to recover their strength.

Yet once a Dusk Honeypot overripens, it can leave both humans and Exoswarm intoxicated. When a Shepherd fails to return from a foraging trip, chances are they've simply indulged in one too many overripe berries without realizing it.
ItemInfo_42601350_BgDescription:
An ancient fern that thrives in cool, shady spots. Its newly sprouted fronds will curl tightly at the tips, forming tender, fresh fern balls. Naturally dehydrated after being picked, these balls are easy to preserve as compact, long-lasting dried food.

Before eating, simply soak them in snowmelt to rehydrate, and they instantly regain a vibrant, fresh green, as if just harvested. The Roya often thread Fern Spores for grilling or scatter them in shaded areas to grow new ferns. Most Roya have their first taste of Fern Spores in early childhood, though it's rarely a fond memory.
ItemInfo_42601360_BgDescription:
This species of lichen clings to waterside rocks, its existence as ancient as the underground cavern itself, even predating the arrival of the Exostrider. Long before the underground was called Lahai-Roi, this type of lichen had already taken root. Over countless years, it slowly eroded the hard rock, breaking it down into soil capable of nurturing new life.

In Royan mythology, Cradle Lichen symbolizes return and transformation. When burying precious objects, the Roya will weave the lichen into mats, wrapping the treasures before laying them in the earth.
ItemInfo_42601370_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon and Tool crafting.
ItemInfo_42601370_BgDescription:
After the geological shifts in the Royan Frostlands, some trees were frozen instantly, while others were dragged underground with the moving crust and slowly turned into minerals under long pressure. Their growth rings remain perfectly preserved, providing key clues about how Solaris's climate changed after the Lament.

In Royan stories, Jade Wood stands for time, experience, and wisdom—the embodiment of nature's memories.
ItemInfo_42601370_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon and Tool crafting.
ItemInfo_42601380_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601380_BgDescription:
A meteorite crashes into the ground, and upon it sprout spores. The fungal network grows, forming a microscopic cosmos of its own.

The Gemini Spores are extraordinarily delicate. One gentle puff and they dissolve into fine spore dust, drifting like a miniature galaxy. Yet they are also incredibly resilient, perhaps harboring faint frequencies of the "old universe." They are the only Lahai-Roi creature capable of surviving in the Voidmatter Zone.

The frequencies of the star clusters have painted them with celestial colors. The Roya use these spores as pigments to record observed galaxies or create predictive petroglyphs of their structures.
ItemInfo_42601380_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601390_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601390_BgDescription: No taller than the knee, fragile against the icy wind, yet it grows year after year in the cracks of frozen rocks. Only at the very instant the polar night ends does it bloom, unfurling clusters of white flowers like delicate snowflakes. The Roya call it Linnaea, meaning "the last trace of tenderness in the blizzard."
ItemInfo_42601390_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601400_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601400_BgDescription: For most Roya, their first encounter with "calculation" in childhood wasn't a numeration table from Startorch Academy, but the cross-section of an ancient seashell. These fossilized shells, known as Arithmetic Shells, have natural interiors etched into concentric grooves, like a mathematical grid carved by the hands of the divine. Elders would teach children to drop small stones of varying colors and shapes—or tiny sticks—into the grooves, mimicking the processes of addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, distribution, and pairing…
ItemInfo_42601400_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601410_BgDescription:
Due to the Exostrider's fragmented frequencies incorporated into these minerals, they have become ideal materials for both Exoswarm restoration and construction. Over the course of history, the Exoswarm has been instinctively collecting Luxite. Some friendly Exoswarm also assist the Spacetrek Collective in harvesting the mineral, providing material for Lahai-Roi's infrastructure.

Beyond its practical uses, certain Luxite deposits possess exceptional optical properties. At specific angles, they refract the Reactor's light in a fixed pattern, allowing observers to determine their position relative to the Reactor Drive. The Roya call these special stones the Eye of Sol.
ItemInfo_42601420_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601420_BgDescription: A "time capsule" preserving Lahai-Roi's warmer days. Tree resin encased the moss below, holding a fleeting moment in time. When this frozen memory shatters, even paused life may find a chance to begin anew.
ItemInfo_42601420_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601430_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601430_BgDescription:
In the harsh frostlands, the carnivorous Edelschnee has developed a unique survival strategy.

At rest, it curls into a fluffy snowball. When it senses a wounded creature nearby, it gently unfurls, wrapping the being in its delicate tendrils to feed. While doing so, it cleans wounds and secretes a mild anesthetic, while its long fibers cover and protect the injury.

Creatures of the frostlands often seek Edelschnee for healing. Once the seed balls mature, they disperse through the environment. Its fluffy fibers are used for textiles and medicine, making Edelschnee an essential resource for the Roya.
ItemInfo_42601430_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601440_BgDescription:
Legend has it that the Waxweavers were once Solsworns, cursed for failing their sacred charge.

Day in and day out, they observe the light. Day in and day out, they weave the light. Their spinning begins with the first rays of dawn and concludes at the hour of twilight when the finished web is retrieved. This endless vigil continues, as if they are still desperately striving to fulfill the duty they abandoned, weaving a web of their own atonement.

For this reason, the Roya maintain a solemn, religious reverence and deep pity for the Waxweavers.

When melted, their silk can be applied to wounds to aid healing, or used as a water-resistant coating.
ItemInfo_43021011_BgDescription: A metallic shard, resembling a solitary butterfly wing, its surface dull and covered with a dense passivation layer. Under suitable temperature conditions, the residual frequency energy within can still be harnessed.
ItemInfo_43021012_BgDescription: A metallic shard, resembling a pair of butterfly wings, its surface glimmers like Tacetites. Due to its reactive nature, careful storage is required after collection to prevent loss of its frequency energy.
ItemInfo_43021013_BgDescription: A triple-winged metallic shard, exhibiting an unusual radiance. This material forms under extremely rare conditions, and its transformation patterns remain largely unexplored by current scientific research.
ItemInfo_43021014_BgDescription: A solidified metallic shard, resembling a fused cluster of butterfly wings. Microscopic analysis of a few samples reveals their highly intricate internal structure, which appears more like that of a living organism than an inorganic material.
ItemInfo_43021021_BgDescription: A bullet-shaped metal, named Combustor for its peculiar shape. Specialized purification processes are required as it typically contains a high level of impurities.
ItemInfo_43021022_BgDescription: Resembling a solidified bullet, this metal has undergone quenching, greatly reducing impurities. Even non-specialists can discern the differences between various grades.
ItemInfo_43021023_BgDescription: Resembling a bullet, this metal has its impurities almost removed after repeated purification. Beyond its practical applications, its exquisite and unusual form makes it a highly sought-after collectible.
ItemInfo_43021024_BgDescription: Rsembling a bullet, this metal is virtually flawless in purity. Some Resonators hesitate to use it as Ascension Material, preferring to have it crafted into unique ornaments by skilled artisans.
ItemInfo_43021031_BgDescription: Pieced together from fragments, this Resonance Cord reveals to humans the concept of stationary vibration for the first time.
ItemInfo_43021032_BgDescription: Intermittent and incomplete, this Resonance Cord contains stored tonal energy that can be extracted by researchers, yet its content remains indecipherable.
ItemInfo_43021033_BgDescription: Complete and solidified, this Resonance Cord captures the paradox of motion and stillness that fascinates researchers. Its secrets, however, remain unsolved.
ItemInfo_43021034_BgDescription: Interwoven yet balanced, this Resonance Cord is as harmonious as a song that no one has ever written. Perhaps it is more a subject for aesthetics than science.
ItemInfo_43021041_BgDescription: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. Originally a blocky structure, its equilibrium is broken, and its Remnant Energy has mostly dissipated.
ItemInfo_43021042_BgDescription: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.
ItemInfo_43021043_BgDescription: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a delicate equilibrium and, after centrifugation, its concentrated product becomes widely useful.
ItemInfo_43021044_BgDescription: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a breathtakingly stable equilibrium. As a critical material for advanced technologies, it is subject to the strictest trade restrictions worldwide.
ItemInfo_43021051_BgDescription: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. Its equilibrium has been disrupted, and the remaining Remnant Energy has decayed to mere Reverberations.
ItemInfo_43021052_BgDescription: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.
ItemInfo_43021053_BgDescription: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. It maintains a delicate equilibrium and, after centrifugation, its concentrated product becomes widely useful.
ItemInfo_43021054_BgDescription: A radial-cracked Waveworn residue. It maintains a breathtakingly stable equilibrium. As a critical material for advanced technologies, it is subject to the strictest trade restrictions worldwide.

ItemInfo_2_BgDescription:
In the ancient past, the ancestors of Huanglong utilized seashells as currency. Though the manufacturing techniques have evolved over time, the shell-like appearance of this currency has endured. 
"As a witness, it preserves the history of our people."
ItemInfo_31000011_AttributesDescription: A damaged anklet, with a string of text engraved on the inside. After a long time, only the word "Institute" can be distinguished.
ItemInfo_31000011_BgDescription: "I shall offer my one and only life for these broken shackles. A beast as I am, should also be given the highest acclaim."
ItemInfo_31000015_AttributesDescription: TEXT: At 7:00 a.m., where the shadow of the spire of the lighthouse in Central Plains lies, there is a treasure that only the brave and the strong can open.

ItemInfo_31000034_BgDescription: Appears to be the maintenance log for Court of Savantae's No. III suppressor. However, instead of research findings, it contains what seems to be an unsent message.
ItemInfo_36000001_AttributesDescription: Basic Echo EXP item. Provides 500 EXP.
ItemInfo_36000001_BgDescription: A cylindrical storage that contains simplified frequency cluster. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. Resonators can then extract its data using their Terminal, employing it to optimize the performance of the absorbed Echoes.
ItemInfo_36000002_AttributesDescription: Medium Echo EXP item. Provides 1,000 EXP.
ItemInfo_36000002_BgDescription: A cylindrical storage that contains standard frequencies. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. This medium-sized storage holds a greater volume of information compared to the basic version. Consequently, the database available for training is more complete, better optimizing the performance of the absorbed Echoes.
ItemInfo_36000003_AttributesDescription: Advanced Echo EXP item. Provides 2,000 EXP.
ItemInfo_36000003_BgDescription: A cylindrical storage that contains advanced frequencies. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. This storage not only contains the database needed for routine training, but also incorporates simulation materials tailored to diverse scenarios. Therefore, it can fully exploit the potential of the absorbed Echoes.
ItemInfo_36000004_AttributesDescription: Premium Echo EXP item. Provides 5,000 EXP.
ItemInfo_36000004_BgDescription: A cylindrical storage that contains special frequencies. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. It contains precious data collected from various extreme environments, facilitating the revolutionary transformation of the absorbed Echoes.

ItemInfo_3_AttributesDescription: The precious remnants of the civilization reverberate within... Perhaps they hold infinite possibilities.
ItemInfo_3_BgDescription: Echoes from distant planets have found their way here from the vast expanse of the universe. In the starry night, the symphony of civilizations from untold light-years away resonates.
ItemInfo_40040001_AttributesDescription: Exchangeable for resources when delivered to the relic merchant.
ItemInfo_40040001_BgDescription: The Sonance Casket is a product of the natural decay and collapse of the Sonoro Sphere, containing the unlost past. Since the Sonoro Sphere is an important source of information for humans to understand the history of the Lament and the evolution of the civilization, the Sonance Casket, as a "fragment" and "condensation" of the Sonoro Sphere, is considered to have a high archaeological value and is regarded as an "antique" by people.
ItemInfo_40040001_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Exchangeable for resources when delivered to the relic merchant.
ItemInfo_40040004_AttributesDescription: Sonance Caskets in Ragunna are often found in precarious locations. Use Grapple for easier access. Deliver them to the Plushies in the Garden of the Lost in exchange for resources.
ItemInfo_40040004_BgDescription: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. The Plushies are collecting them—perhaps they'll have something in exchange.

ItemInfo_41100011_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100011_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a feeble Whisperin. It takes the form of a broken star. Faint and deep frequencies are still lingering within the core, yet the messages they try to convey remain elusive to all.
ItemInfo_41100011_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100012_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100012_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a common Whisperin. It takes the form of a clear and complete star. Its Frequency Energy aligns with the hearing range of normal people. Yet, the question remains: what's the intention behind this imitation?
ItemInfo_41100012_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100013_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100013_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a powerful Whisperin. It takes the form of a star with sharp ridges along its outline—like an embodiment of its shrill Frequency Energy. Perhaps, its personification has already led to the Uncanny Valley effect.
ItemInfo_41100013_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100014_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100014_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a special Whisperin. It takes the form of an intricate star, bearing both recognizable and unfamiliar Frequency Energy. It seems that humans only know the tip of the iceberg of themselves.
ItemInfo_41100014_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100021_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100021_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a feeble Howler. It is the remaining part of a Tacetite Bloom after it withers. Despite its astonishing accuracy in mimicry, it only ends one way—reducing to a mass of twisted Frequency Energy.
ItemInfo_41100021_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100022_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100022_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a common Howler. After the Tacetite Bloom withers, a certain amount of Frequency Energy remains. Similar to the natural cycle of life, this frequency can probably serve as the sustenance for newcomers.
ItemInfo_41100022_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100023_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100023_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a powerful Howler. The fierce and untamed Frequency Energy continues to reverberate within it. Evolution is all about adapting to the environment. Who will emerge victorious from the ordeal of the devastating Waveworm Phenomenon?
ItemInfo_41100023_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100024_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100024_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of a special Howler. It takes the form of a seed emerging from a withered Tacetite Bloom. Life is brimming with endless possibilities. This core, akin to the seed of life, also contains infinite possibilities.
ItemInfo_41100024_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100031_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100031_BgDescription: A crude ring that serves more as an identification than for practical use. It is used to display one's commitment to sever ties with civilized society.
ItemInfo_41100031_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100032_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100032_BgDescription: A ring with bearable quality. Apart from helping the Exiles to recognize each other's identification, it also provides various functions such as basic communication, location services, and scanning. These features assist the Exiles to better survive in the wilderness.
ItemInfo_41100032_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100033_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100033_BgDescription: An improved Ring, exclusive to a selected few. This ring stores a large amount of wilderness survival information. Certain entries detailing rare plants and special minerals hold academic significance compared to papers written by the Academy.
ItemInfo_41100033_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100034_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41100034_BgDescription: A ring made of special material using unique techniques. Its owner must boast a legendary experience. Much of the information stored within it is encrypted and challenging to decipher for details.
ItemInfo_41100034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200031_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200031_BgDescription: A mask worn by Fractsidus recruits. It seems to be used to suppress the rejection reaction induced by the integration of Tacet Discords. The side effect that comes with it is the suppression of the wearer's normal human emotions. Perhaps, that's one of the designer's purposes?
ItemInfo_41200031_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200032_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200032_BgDescription: A mask worn by Fractsidus active members. Due to long-term use, its ability to stabilize frequency has been greatly mitigated. One can clearly feel the torment of being drowning in negative emotions from the mask.
ItemInfo_41200032_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200033_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200033_BgDescription: A mask worn by Fractsidus veterans. The original owner has now had no turning back on the road of Overclocking. Would they have chosen to wear this mask if they had foreseen all the torment and suffering that lay ahead?
ItemInfo_41200033_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200034_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200034_BgDescription: A very peculiar Fractsidus mask. It would be nearly impossible for a normal person to imagine the mental state of its owner. Judging from the residual frequency on the mask, one can perceive that the owner's emotions have become severely distorted, generating frequencies that resemble Tacet Discords.
ItemInfo_41200034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400234_AttributesDescription: The False Sovereign's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400234_BgDescription:
The shattered crown of the False Sovereign.
Forged from the collective yearning of the masses, the puppet took the form of their deepest desire. Yet its role as the Sovereign and even its very existence are nothing but a fabrication. When the tide recedes, the crown of power and authority is revealed to be nothing but a mask, tainted by the Dark Tide.
ItemInfo_41400234_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The False Sovereign's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400244_AttributesDescription: Lady of the Sea - Embers of Glory's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400244_BgDescription:
The cheers, the applause, the cry for glory from within...
She sinks, as if into the depths of the sea, drifting ever farther from those sounds of her past, unable to respond.
In the stillness below, only the shadows of a sea creature circle her in silence.
ItemInfo_41200041_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200041_BgDescription: A fractured polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. Cracks can be found on its frail spiral structure. Seems to be a simple power unit of a Tacet Discord.
ItemInfo_41200041_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200042_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200042_BgDescription: A common polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The spiral structure is fairly complete. Seems to be an analog circuit recording the behavioral patterns of a Tacet Discord.
ItemInfo_41200042_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200043_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200043_BgDescription: A robust polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The concentric layers spiral inward in dense steps. It's deduced the density of its pattern correlates with the complexity of the Tacet Discord's behavioral patterns.
ItemInfo_41200043_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200044_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200044_BgDescription: A robust polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The polygonal structure shows a tendency to expand outwards, likely because of the lack of capacity for storing the growingly complex logic in the behaviors of a Tacet Discord.
ItemInfo_41200044_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200051_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200051_BgDescription: A friable formation resembling a stranded boat, often found on Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legends say these once covered every shore as the Dark Tide receded.
ItemInfo_41200051_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200052_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200052_BgDescription: A common formation resembling a storm-weathered boat, often found on Tacet Discords in Rinascita, which are said to be born of the Dark Tide and carry this Residuum since their formation.
ItemInfo_41200052_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200053_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200053_BgDescription: A robust formation resembling a sailing ship, occasionally found on certain Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legend say Tacet Discords with this Residuum can hear the distant echoes of the Dark Tide.
ItemInfo_41200053_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200054_AttributesDescription: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41200054_BgDescription: A unique formation resembling a tide-breaking vessel, found only on a few powerful Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legend say Tacet Discords bearing this Residuum can chart the course to the Journeying Paradise.
ItemInfo_41200054_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41300005_BgDescription: The metal scrolls with mysterious symbols seem to be able to create some kind of connection with Rover.
ItemInfo_41400014_AttributesDescription: The Crownless's drop, a Resonator's Ascension item.
ItemInfo_41400014_BgDescription: The core of Crownless's clone. Only more strife and sacrifice can mend the cracks and voids within this Tacet Core.
ItemInfo_41400014_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The Crownless's drop, a Resonator's Ascension item.
ItemInfo_41400024_AttributesDescription: Thundering Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400024_BgDescription: The core of Thundering Mephis. Like a miniature thunderstorm, the core radiates a dazzling light between the flashes.
ItemInfo_41400024_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Thundering Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400034_AttributesDescription: Mourning Aix's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400034_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of Mourning Aix, singing a never-ending elegy. Those who touch the Tacet Core will be overwhelmed by a great sense of loneliness and loss and will unconsciously shed tears. But this is not empathy, perhaps just a kind of emotional hypersensitivity.
ItemInfo_41400034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Mourning Aix's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400044_AttributesDescription: Inferno Rider's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400044_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of Inferno Rider, surrounded by the never-ending fire of rage. The raging flames, fueled by the supreme clamor, vow to burn everything to ashes.
ItemInfo_41400044_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Inferno Rider's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400054_AttributesDescription: Feilian Beringal's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400054_BgDescription: The rock shell covering the arm of Feilian Beringal, named for the thunderous roar of Feilian's heavy punch.
ItemInfo_41400054_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Feilian Beringal's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400064_AttributesDescription: Impermanence Heron's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400064_BgDescription: The golden feathers of Impermanence Heron, from which a dirty and rotten smell constantly flows. A researcher once tried to seal the feathers in various metal containers, but the containers would corrode in a moment.
ItemInfo_41400064_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Impermanence Heron's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400074_AttributesDescription: Lampylumen Myriad's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400074_BgDescription: The Tacet Core of Lampylumen Myriad, freezing the humming whispers. The surrounding sounds will be captured by the Tacet Core and turned into a cold absolute echo.
ItemInfo_41400074_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Lampylumen Myriad's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400084_AttributesDescription: Mech Abomination's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400084_BgDescription: The huge Clamorling hidden in the underground ruins of Court of Savantae, is a huge collection of countless program logics. The heterogeneous Tacet Core is stacked in disorder, just like the complex code of the mechanical puppet.
ItemInfo_41400084_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Mech Abomination's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400094_AttributesDescription: Bell-Borne Geochelone's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400094_BgDescription: The ancient bell carried on the back of the Bell-Borne Geochelone. When the bell rings, the awakened past will leave a new mark in this era.
ItemInfo_41400094_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Bell-Borne Geochelone's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400104_AttributesDescription: Cetus the Tidebreaker's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400104_BgDescription: The blue spiral-shaped heteromorphic sharp tooth of Cetus the Tidebreaker, capable of cutting through waves. Legend has it that the water surface cut through by the Cetus's tooth will leave long-lasting ripples.
ItemInfo_41400104_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Cetus the Tidebreaker's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400114_AttributesDescription: Scar's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400114_BgDescription: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.
ItemInfo_41400114_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Scar's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400124_AttributesDescription: Dreamless's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400124_BgDescription: Emerging from the abyss with aspirations of ruling the land and the beings in Jinzhou, it now lies extinguished in the shadows, leaving behind only this feather.
ItemInfo_41400124_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Dreamless's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400134_AttributesDescription: Tempest Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400134_BgDescription: The core of Tempest Mephis. Like a miniature thundercloud, the rumbling thunder spreads from the Tacet Core, causing the surroundings to quiver in its wake.
ItemInfo_41400134_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Tempest Mephis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400154_AttributesDescription: Fallacy of No Return's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400154_BgDescription: A dataset with an ever-changing topology that serves to create an infinite, eternal representation of reality. The Tethys System created this prison of causality, where unknown variations, including love and hope, are forever trapped.
ItemInfo_41400154_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Fallacy of No Return's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400164_AttributesDescription: Queen of the Night's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400164_BgDescription: A mystical, star-speckled conch. Hold it to your ear, and you may hear Lorelei's faint whispers. It was once used by the lost faithful to clear their minds and strengthen their belief. Some say a tiny Sonoro hides within, and the whispers are nothing more than echoes of one's true self.
ItemInfo_41400164_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Queen of the Night's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400174_AttributesDescription: Sentry Construct's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400174_BgDescription: A finely crafted armor grants the Echo unstoppable strength, while a restless core hums quietly beneath its protective shell. Is it a mechanical component that powers the Echo, or a spirit trapped within its metal confines?
ItemInfo_41400174_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Sentry Construct's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400184_AttributesDescription: Dragon of Dirge's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400184_BgDescription:
The bone of the giant dragon, burning with a haunting flame.
The fire blazes from its marrow, bringing both a soul-shaking trial and destruction to those who dare intrude. This is its eternal duty, a rage that never fades, ignited by those who forced it into service.
ItemInfo_41400184_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Dragon of Dirge's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400194_AttributesDescription: Hecate's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400194_BgDescription: The joyful rhythm of her rondo taps on the gates of the netherworld, and with a single exchange of glances, death takes its first step. A gaze from the other side transforms into a full moon, filling her hollow right eye—thus, the still moon shifts, awakened by her stare.
ItemInfo_41400194_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Hecate's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_42100020_AttributesDescription: Used to heal 20% of the current Resonator's Max HP, plus an extra 160 HP.
ItemInfo_42100020_BgDescription: An energy drink rich in vitamins that helps invigorate the mind.
ItemInfo_42100020_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Used to heal 20% of the current Resonator's Max HP, plus an extra 160 HP.
ItemInfo_42100030_AttributesDescription: Instantly revives a selected Resonator. Can only be used once every 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
ItemInfo_42100030_BgDescription:
Single Revival Potion
[Effect] Stabilizes the Resonator's condition to a certain extent and aids in their recovery.
[Precautions] Long intervals between doses are recommended. Excessive use within a short period is not advisable.
[Warning] Prohibited to use in combination with the same type of potion or any frequency stabilizing potions.
ItemInfo_42100030_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Instantly revives a selected Resonator. Can only be used once every 60s. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
ItemInfo_42300010_BgDescription: An aquatic plant prized for its ornamental and practical value. Its seeds are renowned for their fragrance in Jinzhou.
ItemInfo_42300020_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300020_BgDescription:
The fruit of climbing vines that thrive on the exterior walls of buildings, which is often used in desserts.
When Jinzhou people move to a new residence, it's a tradition to take a cutting from the vine growing at their old house and plant it near the new home.
ItemInfo_42300020_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300030_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300030_BgDescription:
A plant native to Whining Aix's Mire. It symbolizes broken or concealed affection.
Affected by the continuous thundercloud weather of this place, this variant has a significantly shortened flowering period compared to its original species. A true pity, indeed.
ItemInfo_42300030_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300040_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300040_BgDescription: A fungus that spreads across dark soil, resembling a black lotus. Once the cap matures and darkens, it begins to liquefy and makes the ground fertile for more mushrooms to grow, hence its name.
ItemInfo_42300040_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300050_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300050_BgDescription:
A fluorescent berry growing in caves.
Before miners get down the mine in the Tiger's Maw, their family will tuck a lanternberry into their pocket, hoping its glow will lead them safely home in the midst of darkness.
ItemInfo_42300050_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300060_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300060_BgDescription:
A vibrant flower, with its sap often processed into dye.
Known for its fragrance and water-resistant properties, the flower is commonly used to produce seal ink paste for official or personalized stamps.
ItemInfo_42300060_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300070_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300070_BgDescription:
Once the symbol of the Port City of Guixu, it nearly went extinct when Incinero Petals were rampant.
However, at the outskirts of the city ruins, Belle Poppy was found to bloom still at its home, having endured the disaster.
ItemInfo_42300070_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300080_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300080_BgDescription:
A special fungus associated with ancient trees. Its medicinal and curative properties have been recorded in numerous medical classics of Jinzhou.
An ancient specimen is preserved in the Academy, a living relic tracing back to the era when the towering Central Banyan in the Dim Forest was not so majestic.
ItemInfo_42300080_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300090_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300090_BgDescription:
A flower blooming on the high shores.
Legend has it that the Wintry Bell does not really wither. When the ancient bells born by the giant Turtoise in Gorges of Spirits resonate, they will rise again from the ice and snow.
ItemInfo_42300090_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300100_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300100_BgDescription: Violet Coral, commonly found trapped in the shallow beaches, is always revitalized with the flow and withered with the ebb.
ItemInfo_42300100_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300110_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300110_BgDescription:
A fruit of bitter taste and a childhood nightmare of many Jinzhou people.
Bittberry is often associated with phrases like "recall past bitterness, savor present sweetness" or "bitter food detoxifies the body".
ItemInfo_42300110_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42300120_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42300120_BgDescription:
Berries resembling feathers, the people of Hongzhen call them Linglong Hearts.
It is said to be exceedingly nutritious for the brain. But it's never seen as edible because of its extreme bitterness.
ItemInfo_42300120_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42310010_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310010_BgDescription:
Common countryside plants.
Mushed Pearl Leaves can quickly stop bleeding when applied to wounds.
Jinzhou pharmacopeia records an instance in which a Green Rabbit gnawed Pearl Leaves to accelerate the healing of wounds.
ItemInfo_42310010_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310020_BgDescription:
A scarlet Dewvetch. Natural moisture often builds on its buds, thus it is called Dewvetch.
It is a major nectariferous plant within Huanglong. Its honey has a natural, fresh fragrance, and it is refreshing and sweet to taste.
ItemInfo_42310030_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310030_BgDescription: If applied externally, Noctemint soothes inflammation and relieves itching; if brewed with tea, Noctemint refreshes the user's mind. It is a daily essential, especially for warriors from the Midnight Rangers stationed in the wild. Chewing a few leaves offers a refreshing sensation from tongue to brain, assisting warriors through the enduring night.
ItemInfo_42310030_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310040_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310040_BgDescription:
Honeysuckle is named after its characteristic of two flowers blooming from one stem.
Besides its use in tea drinks and medicines, it is also a favorite ornamental pot plant in Jinzhou.
ItemInfo_42310040_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310050_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310050_BgDescription:
Perilla is not impressive to the eye, but is known for its unique, rich aroma.
The adding of Perilla to a dish not only removes unpleasant odor, but also enhances the ingredient's freshness.
ItemInfo_42310050_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310060_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310060_BgDescription:
A lone and tall herb. It seems that it can confront grave difficulties with a composed demeanor. In Jinzhou, it's affectionately known as the "'Cold Beauty".
This association sometimes sparks an intriguing comparison to a certain researcher from the Academy—yet, neither of them will comment on this.
ItemInfo_42310060_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310070_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310070_BgDescription:
An aromatic plant native to the New Federation. It exudes a unique citrus fragrance.
The stems and leaves of Lemongrass can be used to extract essential oil, which is an ingredient for perfume, soap, or seasoning to add a flavor twist to foods.
ItemInfo_42310070_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310080_BgDescription:
A plant that grows on the edges of Tacet Fields. It blooms even in the harsh environment.
As a saprophyte, it cannot support photosynthesis with its pale leaves, and only absorbs nutrition from decayed organisms. As it is often found blooming in areas lacking vitality, it is named "Erodorchid" by Resonators who often travel around dangerous zones.
ItemInfo_42310090_BgDescription:
A fluorescent plant that grows by the riverbanks. They look like the lamps at the side of the ships anchoring for the night, hence the name Waterlamp.
The white pith inside Waterlamp's stem is used as wick, while the fibre of the stem skin is used for knit weaving and paper making.
ItemInfo_42310100_BgDescription: Common bladderwort in river crevices. An insectivorous plant that is not harmful to human. Its stamens secrete a unique fragrant substance that attracts insects.
ItemInfo_42310110_BgDescription: The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.
ItemInfo_42310120_BgDescription:
Chromeshell is a pearl shell. Under illumination, its nacre will glow with a strange polychrome gloss.
When it ebbs, many Chromeshells will be left on beaches.
ItemInfo_42310130_BgDescription:
A snail with strange wave-like patterns on its shells. Usually spotted after Retroact Rains.
Dripsnail's shell can store the sound waves of specific frequencies, and once the shell is crushed, nearby creatures will hear a sound similar to the rain sound, hence the name.
ItemInfo_42310140_BgDescription:
The Exiles prefer Viola, a plant of great vitality. They cook the young shoots of Viola as a source of vegetable.
Experienced observers can determine the whereabouts of the Exiles by the distribution of Viola.
ItemInfo_42310150_BgDescription:
A blossom on cliffs, swaying to the blowing of breezes.
When the flowers swing in the currents, their light gestures always leave a strong impression.
ItemInfo_42310160_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310160_BgDescription: Legend has it that a traveler, who delighted in exploring mountains and rivers, stumbled upon this mushroom. Its shape, resembling a person sheltering from rain under an umbrella, inspired the traveler to name it "Umbragricus".
ItemInfo_42310160_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310170_BgDescription: A gem-like plant with scarlet, sweet, and juicy fruit, perfect for immediate consumption or sauce making.
ItemInfo_42310180_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310180_BgDescription: Edodes offers a richer and more tender flavor compared to common mushrooms. Simply boiling Edodes in fresh water with a pinch of salt yields a taste akin to Jinzhou Stew.
ItemInfo_42310180_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310190_BgDescription:
Gloom Slough is commonly found among the ruins of villages or cities, and is named for the glowing light that resembles a candle flame without the heat.
Gloom Cicada's diet is mainly fluorescent plants, and the sloughs they produce are left with the sedimented fluorescent matters from the insects' skin.
ItemInfo_42601290_BgDescription:
A rare flower found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to glow like moonlight in the dark.
"O warriors, should shadow steal the moon, look down, and the Sliverglow Bloom still shines beneath your feet."
ItemInfo_42400010_BgDescription: Meat obtained from fowls. Freshly cut. Extra tender. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
ItemInfo_42400020_BgDescription: Lightweight and soft feathers that are often used in crafting of accessories or toys.
ItemInfo_42400030_BgDescription: Meat obtained from animals, featuring a clean cut with distinct fat marbling. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
ItemInfo_42400070_BgDescription:
A large butterfly. They are often active in dense vegetation areas in woodlands or other environments. They often fly in pairs at high altitudes and feed on nectar. Hard to capture.
It is the most commonly seen butterflies because of its high reproductive ability and adaptability to the living environment.
ItemInfo_42400080_BgDescription: Red Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly family. Its overly bright coloration renders it less adaptable to various environments compared to the common Phoenix Butterfly, making it more susceptible to predators. It ranks second in terms of both quantity and rarity among the three butterfly species.
ItemInfo_42400090_BgDescription: Blue Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly. Its genetic mutation gives it a dreamy scale color but also reduces its reproduction ability. As a result, the Blue Feather Butterfly is the rarest and most elusive of the three species.
ItemInfo_42400100_BgDescription:
Chrysopa possesses two pairs of wings made of transparent membranes with delicate reticulate veins resembling leaves.
It primarily preys on small insects and serves as a natural predator for many pests, making it a valuable resource for biological pest control.
ItemInfo_42400110_BgDescription: Golden-ringed Dragonfly is a wetland and water predator. Its diet includes flying insects and small fish and shrimp. It is known for rapid flying and predating speed.
ItemInfo_42400120_BgDescription: Meat obtained from fish, featuring a tender cut with a refreshing taste. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
ItemInfo_42400130_BgDescription: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living in stone crevices or caves and other dark places. Their skin is covered with leathery scales, and their body has black and white ring-shaped patterns alternately arranged. They most feed on earthworms, snails, and insects.
ItemInfo_42400140_BgDescription: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living by waters or in wetlands. Their skin is covered with leathery scales. While their whole body is blue, musclar spines are found on their back. They favor wet, warm environments and small shrimp, crabs for diet.
ItemInfo_42400150_BgDescription: Carnivorous reptiles, common lizards in grasslands, though occasional sightings in towns exist. They would hide themselves in parterres or plant trellis. However, as they are not poisonous, has a wide diet and a gentle temper, they are sometimes taken as pets by citizens.
ItemInfo_42400160_BgDescription: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. Their habitat is often established on lush bushes. When it rains, they often come out to feed on snails and earthworms. Therefore, after rain, Black-Striped Frogs can often be seen crossing the roads in an attempt to return to the waterside.
ItemInfo_42400170_BgDescription: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. A heterochrome species of Black-Striped Frog. Since it is relatively scarce and more vulnerable to enemies due to the color, some amphibian fans will catch Goldenback Frogs after rain and take them home as pets.
ItemInfo_42500010_BgDescription: A specialty mineral with a shape of needle clusters. Sharp and tough. Mostly used in cutting metals or other crystals or making weapons.
ItemInfo_42500020_BgDescription: A translucent specialty mineral found in the Tiger's Maw Mine. Both the crystal produce and raw status of this mineral has a translucent azure shine. As a material, it has excellent toughness and stability.
ItemInfo_42500030_BgDescription: A widely distributed mineral. Its unique, profound purple distinguishes itself from other minerals. Due to its fragility, it requires careful processing with specialized equipment.
ItemInfo_42500040_BgDescription: Minerals formed over time from the remains of dead plants within Tacet Fields that had sunken into its terrains. Due to the retained woody plant-like structural appearances, these minerals were given the name "Floramber", though they are unrelated to ambers in terms of shape or form.
ItemInfo_42500050_BgDescription: A boost part disassembled from various weapons, featuring impressive versatility. By collecting enough quantity of these parts, you can apply them to enhance the performance of Tacetite Weapons.
ItemInfo_42500060_BgDescription: A chip with missing content. Therefore, it cannot be directly used to optimize the performance of Echoes. However, by collecting enough quantity of these chips, you can still pick out complete frequencies with similar effects.
ItemInfo_42600010_BgDescription: A gift from birds, and a regular on dinner tables.
ItemInfo_47_AttributesDescription: Can be used to increase your Trial Level.
ItemInfo_47_BgDescription: The essence of tribulations endured by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.
ItemInfo_47_ObtainedShowDescription: Can be used to increase your Trial Level.
ItemInfo_48_AttributesDescription: Can be used to increase your Glory Level.
ItemInfo_48_BgDescription: The essence of bravery shown by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.
ItemInfo_48_ObtainedShowDescription: Can be used to increase your Glory Level.

ItemInfo_66_BgDescription:
The Spacetrek Collective has deployed Supply Chests across Lahai-Roi, serving not only as supply containers but also as terminals recording environmental data. 
These Supply Chests continuously record surrounding data, including temperature, humidity, frequency fluctuations, and the Voidmatter Index, storing it onto a disk known as the Module.
The information contained within the Modules can be revisited and analyzed, and they also serve as training data for I.R.I.S., nourishing her deep learning capabilities and enhancing her processing power.

Crisp, aromatic, with a cooling sweetness that sweeps away every trace of fatigue.

The rich fat of the Kronapuff mingles with the firm, chewy Lemming meat, offering alternating waves of flavor. On a night when the cold wind cuts to the bone, one mouthful of this dish is enough to make you forget the coldness and the exhaustion.

Before eating it, make sure to keep these things in mind:
1. Always open the jar outdoors, in a wide and downwind spot.
2. Never open it indoors, in a warm place, upwind, or near a crowd.
3. Check the jar before eating. If you see a crack, put it down immediately and bolt.

ItemInfo_80001018_BgDescription: Refreshing lemons meld their zesty notes into this rich stew. Tender and flavorful, it is one of Chisa's signature dishes. Every winter, she'd curl up under a heated futon to watch music shows while scents wafting from the pot filled the room. Those were the coziest days in her memories.

ItemInfo_80001019_BgDescription: Stir fry the shredded fish with seasoning, place it on top of the simmered thick broth, and then pour hot oil over the dish, creating a sizzling sound that brings out sweet and savory flavors. This rich soup is by far Buling's favorite hometown dish.
ItemInfo_80001028_AttributesDescription: Defeating overworld enemies yields 55% more Shell Credits, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.
ItemInfo_80001028_BgDescription:
When Qiuyuan and his comrades were still in service, their missions often required them to travel fast and eat light, with little chance to enjoy a good meal. Even when they lodged at village inns, they still had to cook their own food out of an abundance of caution. Originally from Chongzhou, Qiuyuan had learned a few basic recipes at a young age. One of his dishes was fragrant, spicy, and mouthwatering, perfect for an empty stomach when paired with rice. Simple, yet satisfying. 
"Eat well, live well."
ItemInfo_80001028_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Defeating overworld enemies yields 55% more Shell Credits, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.

ItemInfo_80001060_BgDescription:
Galbrena's unique dessert recipe features large scoops of ice cream over a bowl of shaved ice, topped with colorful jams for that extra kick in flavor, along with a portion generous enough to eat to your heart's content. She even took extra care to adjust the Tacet Discord-shaped candies and cookies to be more appealing and cute.
Perhaps there's a deeper reason behind it all: When dealing with Tacet Discords, one needs a sharp, decisive "crunch." But when it comes to life, one should savor its flavors to the fullest. According to Galbrena, eating them separately or together comes down to personal preference. Her only advice is: Enjoy it before it melts. Many life's precious moments "melt in an instant," just like the sprinkles of ice. But don't worry, delightful flavors cling to the taste buds and never fade, always there to enjoy.
ItemInfo_80001060_Name: Super Doubleshot Shaved Ice Milkshake Deluxe

ItemInfo_80001065_BgDescription: Did someone pick these olives? Hardly. The branches, heavy with ripened fruit, simply yielded their bounty, dropping them gently into her waiting hands. No elaborate preparation could improve their natural, fresh flavor. A simple roll in honey is all it takes to satisfy her discerning palate: as the verdant aroma still clings to her fingertips, a wave of sweet freshness washes over her mouth.

ItemInfo_80001066_BgDescription:
An ordinary, traditional bread found throughout Septimont, even in the far-off town of Fabianum. Perhaps to set it apart, local bakers in Fabianum would sprinkle crushed herbs over the crisp crust and, with a sense of ceremony, carve the word "Delicious" into the surface, as if this modest declaration could lend it a hint of dignity.
Is it delicious? The young Augusta never thought so. To her, it was just the dry, hard bread waiting at home after a day of running wild, something to fill her belly, the quiet "footnote" to every dinner her mother made. It was plain, unremarkable. Like water. Like sunlight. So ordinary it was easy to overlook. But years later, standing before her own stove in Septimont, Augusta tried to recapture that long-forgotten taste. And as the familiar scent and gentle sweetness returned to her tongue, she finally understood what "Delicious" meant.
Perhaps, she had never truly bid farewell to her hometown.

ItemInfo_58_BgDescription: A calcified fragment left behind by the Dark Tide creatures, shaped like a beast's fang. Though affected by Tidal Blight, it poses no threat and holds no practical purpose. To most, it's just another forsaken shard scattered across the Plateaus. But to Gladiators, Blighted Fangs carry meaning. Hunters who clash with the Dark Tide often claim these fangs from fallen Dark Tide creatures before they dissolve. Each fang is a blood-earned token of valor and a silent yet gleaming badge of honor.
