ItemInfo_42600020_AttributesDescription: Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Somnoire Anchor.
ItemInfo_42600020_BgDescription:
Ever since he turned into a white cat, Ivory Gatekeeper has been dreaming of a grand meal...
It's a shame that he refuses to share any details with anyone.
ItemInfo_42600020_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Somnoire Anchor.
ItemInfo_42601010_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601010_BgDescription:
An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."
ItemInfo_42601010_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601020_BgDescription:
Golden Thiefbat's talon.
Golden Thiefbats have dexterous claws and like to steal anything that shines. The Thief's Talon is considered a lucky charm in Rinascita.
It is not unusual for a Ragunnesi businessman to put a Thief's Talon in their pocket in the hope of cutting lucrative deals.
ItemInfo_42601030_BgDescription:
Refined animal fat, rich with savory aroma.
In expert hands, it creates a perfectly golden crisp crust, delivering indulgent flavor without a hint of greasiness. 
One bite and your taste buds will be in pure bliss.
ItemInfo_42601040_BgDescription:
Sea Bunny Meat, rich in protein with a tender, succulent texture.
This delicacy requires careful preparation. The Heliobane Fungia, along with other poisonous glands and fluids, must be removed, and the meat cooked to just the right temperature to neutralize any toxins. Whether it becomes a delicious delicacy to die for, or one that costs you your life, depends entirely on the chef's skill.
ItemInfo_42601050_BgDescription:
Thick, soft fur, gentle to the touch, and warming to the very core.
Why strip their coats bare, you ask? Well, haven't you heard of the law of conservation of energy? The warmth hasn't disappeared, it's simply been transferred from them to you.
ItemInfo_42601060_BgDescription:
A species of scarab that resembles a coin in appearance, with a reflective golden exoskeleton.
For Golden Thiefbats, Goldcrest Scarabs are both a pleasant sight and a delicious snack.
ItemInfo_42601070_BgDescription:
A type of poisonous algae that forms a symbiotic relationship with Sea Bunnies. Heliobane Fungia is rich in gelatine, an important ingredient in many desserts.
Gelatin extracted from Heliobane Fungia has a subtle sweetness and gives desserts a silky, springy texture.
ItemInfo_42601080_BgDescription:
A species of crab that makes its home in miniature bells. 
Bell Crabs feed on fish, shrimp, clams, and other small sea creatures. They can scuttle about quickly, emitting a jingling sound as they go. At night, they avoid predators by hiding beneath the decaying hulls of beached boats.
ItemInfo_42601090_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601090_BgDescription:
A creamy resin produced by Nuvola trees, shaped like a cloud and carrying a unique fragrance.
The Nuvola tree is a symbol of healing and renewal. If such a tree is cut, it produces resin to seal the wound until it fully heals. The Ragunnesi call Mastic Nuvola "Healer's Tears."
ItemInfo_42601090_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601100_BgDescription: A type of strawflower that grows in clusters. Sunflare Everlasting has pinnate leaves and disk-shaped flowers. Once picked and air-dried, the flowers retain their golden hue, described as "sunlight that never fades."
ItemInfo_42601110_BgDescription:
Legend says the first divine oracle given to Ragunna was carved into a tree trunk, and from the mark, a green branch grew.
The Viscum Berries that sprout from this branch are known as the "Fruit of Wisdom." It is believed that eating them grants spiritual enlightenment.
ItemInfo_42601120_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601120_BgDescription:
An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."
ItemInfo_42601120_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601130_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601130_BgDescription:
The delectable fruit of a wild olive shrub that grows in fertile soil. Felicitous Olives are a favored food for certain animals.
Herders often raise herbivores with a keen sense of smell to help track down these prized olives.
ItemInfo_42601130_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42601140_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601140_BgDescription:
A cluster of golden sulfur crystals, often found in caves rich in geothermal activity. They resemble their mythical namesake—the Golden Fleece guarded by a venomous dragon.
When ground into a fine powder and combined with a hint of molten copper, Golden Fleece transforms into stage-worthy fireworks.
ItemInfo_42601140_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601150_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601150_BgDescription:
A tall flower with a firm stem, crowned by delicate flowers.
Sword Acoruses are often used by instructors to teach swordsmanship to young nobles, replacing real swords with these harmless blooms. The children, entranced by the beauty and fragrance, find their attention captured far more easily than by cold, menacing blades.
ItemInfo_42601150_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601160_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601160_BgDescription:
A vividly colored flower shaped like an unfurling firework.
Give a Firecracker Jewelweed a gentle shake, and its swollen capsules will burst open...
The seeds scatter in all directions, resembling the colorful burst of a firecracker.
ItemInfo_42601160_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601170_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601170_BgDescription:
A fluorescent flower often found in the crevices of ruins. In the past, Seaside Cendrelis wreaths were used in the rite of initiation for infants and the inaugurations of new Fisalia family heads. As a result, it became a symbol of the power once held by the old nobility.
Ever since the tower's fateful ascent to the sky, the Seaside Cendrelis has been considered extinct, for it has never been seen again.
ItemInfo_42601170_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42601180_BgDescription:
A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.
The origins of Resonant Calcite are still debated. Some believe its unique properties come from prolonged exposure to the flow of frequencies in Nimbus Sanctum, while others argue that these frequencies seeped into geological fissures, where they influenced the mineral's formation.
ItemInfo_42601190_BgDescription:
A versatile, bronzed iron ore often mistaken for gold, though it's not hard to tell the difference upon closer inspection.
In the past, con artists would craft Fool's Gold into jewelry and sell it as real gold.
Though such tricks are long obsolete, the name "Fool's Gold" endures to this day.
ItemInfo_43010001_BgDescription: A potion that can slightly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. It is especially beneficial for Resonators struggling with mastering their Fortes, as it greatly enhances adaptability. However, when consumed by Resonators who already exhibit excellent control over their Fortes, its effectiveness is somewhat diminished due to its fully diluted nature.
ItemInfo_43010002_BgDescription: A potion that can further enhance the user's frequency perception ability. By adjusting the mixture ratio, this potion is more suitable for Resonators with relatively good control over their Fortes. With a near-perfect cost-effectiveness, it is regarded as flawless except for its "notoriously" bland taste.
ItemInfo_43010003_BgDescription: A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys high popularity among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.
ItemInfo_43010004_BgDescription: A potion that can significantly enhance the user's Frequency perception. Its formula is locked within a vault with the highest security. Rumor has it the inventor of this potion is a powerful Resonator in their own right, and their hope is to groom a successor capable of surpassing their achievements.
ItemInfo_43020001_BgDescription: Purified liquid energy extracted from Tacetite, its purity increasing with higher ratings. When injected into a weapon, it offers a corresponding bonus.
ItemInfo_43020002_BgDescription: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used to recharge the core modules of Tacetite Weapons. Routine preventative maintenance of weapons is advised for all Resonators, or they may find themselves caught off guard in the case of an emergency.
ItemInfo_43020003_BgDescription: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used in the core modules of Tacetite Weapons to increase power output. Weapons are the allies of Resonators and Tacetites serve as their food. Only by nourishing weapons well can they be handier and more powerful in battles.
ItemInfo_43020004_BgDescription: A supplement storing high-density Tacetite Energy, fully capable of powering most Tacetite Weapons. Experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat this supplement to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.
ItemInfo_43020011_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020011_BgDescription: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been greatly diminished. Its surface appears lackluster, covered with a dense layer of passivation film. However, under suitable temperatures, the residual Frequency Energy within it can still be utilized.
ItemInfo_43020011_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020012_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020012_BgDescription: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been partially retained. Its surface presents a luster similar to that of Tacetites. As it is quite reactive, it needs to be stored properly upon collection to prevent any loss of Frequency Energy.
ItemInfo_43020012_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020013_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020013_BgDescription: A fluid metallic drip with high activity. Its surface presents an amazing luster. This polarized matter only forms under extremely strict conditions, and the scientific world has yet to fully figure out its transformation patter.
ItemInfo_43020013_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020014_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020014_BgDescription: A special fluid metallic drip which can barely form naturally. It maintains a perpetual flow on its surface. Microscopic examinations of a few samples have revealed its intricate inner structure, resembling more of a living organism than an inorganic substance.
ItemInfo_43020014_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020021_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020021_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a solidified flame. Its unconventional appearance challenges Old Science. Typically, it contains a rather high level of impurities and thus requires specialized purification treatment for practical use.
ItemInfo_43020021_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020022_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020022_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a solidified candle flame. Its impurities are significantly reduced through a rough extraction and recrystallization process. This makes it simple even for those without expertise to distinguish between crystals of varying quality.
ItemInfo_43020022_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020023_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020023_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a solidified firework. After repeated purification, it is almost free of impurities. Its eye-catching and magnificent appearance not only holds practical utility but also elevates its collectible value.
ItemInfo_43020023_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020024_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020024_BgDescription: A crystal shaped like a raging flame, known for its impeccable purity. As a result, some Resonators don't want to use these crystals solely for enhancement, instead opting to entrust professional craftsmen to process them into unique accessories.
ItemInfo_43020024_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020031_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020031_BgDescription: A helix with soothing waveforms. Facing this remarkable substance, human beings finally realize what static vibration is about.
ItemInfo_43020031_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020032_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020032_BgDescription: A helix with gentle waveforms. Researchers can extract and utilize the sealed Cadence Energy within it. However, it is worth mentioning that researchers cannot effectively analyze the content contained within this helix.
ItemInfo_43020032_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020033_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020033_BgDescription: A helix with graceful waveforms, like a melodious song composed by nature. Instead of being studied by scientists, it might in essence be a subject best explored by researchers of aesthetics.
ItemInfo_43020033_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020034_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020034_BgDescription: A helix with intense waveforms. Researchers are greatly captivated by the perfect harmony of movement and stillness it displays. However, to this day, no one knows how this harmony is formed.
ItemInfo_43020034_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020041_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020041_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. However, the inner balance has been disturbed, causing the Remnant within the inner core to reduce to the Reverberation.
ItemInfo_43020041_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020042_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020042_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is not in a state of decline. By selecting an appropriate absorber, users may still have the chance to extract Remnant Energy.
ItemInfo_43020042_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020043_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020043_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It maintains a delicate balance. When it is highly concentrated in a centrifuge, it produces products that have various applications.
ItemInfo_43020043_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020044_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020044_BgDescription: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is known for its astonishing balance. Due to its indispensable role in many high-tech fields, it is subject to the most stringent trade restrictions.
ItemInfo_43020044_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020051_AttributesDescription: A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020051_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant seed. If you listen carefully, you can feel a pulse-like rhythm. However, in fact, this substance is not alive, and its structure is pretty similar to that of the Tacet Core of a Howler.
ItemInfo_43020051_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020052_AttributesDescription: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020052_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant bud. If you listen carefully, you can sense the pleasure of sprouting from the ground. However, it can never grow into a complete plant.
ItemInfo_43020052_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020053_AttributesDescription: An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020053_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a new leaf. If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint rustle of it bathing in sunlight and sucking dew. In fact, it is able to absorb the wandering Frequency Energy from the environment.
ItemInfo_43020053_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
ItemInfo_43020054_AttributesDescription: A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
ItemInfo_43020054_BgDescription: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a blossom. If you listen carefully, you can hear the petals unfolding. At the end of the silent time, a blossom of Cadence finally bursts into bloom.
ItemInfo_43020054_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Weapon Ascension.

One day, as the campfire crackled to life, she had an idea and took the bread she always carried.
As the rich aroma of meat sauce filled the air, seeping into the bread's warm crust, she spread on the final layer of seasoning.
However, there's an unspoken rule. Ragunna's pasta is not to be tampered with. No shortcuts, no twists. Taking a bite of her creation, Ciaccona was lost in her thoughts. "If I ever get banished, this bread might just be one of the reasons."

ItemInfo_80004005_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A customized 2026 birthday accessory for Rover. This circlet braided from starlight and Resonance Cord now rests in your Backpack, as if it had always been there.
ItemInfo_80004006_AttributesDescription: The 2026 birthday song, specially readapted by your dear friends.
ItemInfo_80004006_BgDescription:
A piece of music as gentle and bright as the afternoon breeze that once brushed your cheek. It carries shared memories of adventures, unspoken gratitude, and quiet longing. With every note, the happy days you lived through return once more. This isn't merely a song written for you. It's a moment in time, carefully kept for you.
Happy birthday, Rover.

"I don't want to be your enemy, nor do I actually plan to destroy anything.
Let me make it clear for you: destruction is not my end goal. It's not even a matter of anyone's desires, but an inevitable conclusion.
Embrace IT. You will come to realize that resistance is futile."

Dreams that collide and fuse before dissipating like foams. At the point of impact, a hazy shadow appears—a projection of the anticipation and premonitions intertwined within...

A young woman dreams of the vibrant garden back in her hometown.
An elderly man envisions pouring tea for his late wife, just as he did in their early days together.
Yet IT claims these dreams are worthless, devoid of meaning.
Do you also agree that they should be erased?

ItemInfo_80100000_AttributesDescription: Item obtained during the exploration in Depths of Illusive Realm, an indispensable currency for your exploration. It will be reset when you challenge Depths of Illusive Realm again.
ItemInfo_80100000_BgDescription: Memories of reality and illusion intertwine into fragments of dreams.
ItemInfo_80100001_AttributesDescription: Item obtained from Depths of Illusive Realm. Can be exchanged for rewards in the Illusive Store.
ItemInfo_80100001_BgDescription: The reality tells you that the creature this specimen is made from does not exist. But in your dreams, you have clearly seen it and received its words of wisdom. It has given you such power to let you realize dreams are also a form of reality.
ItemInfo_80100003_AttributesDescription: Item obtained from Depths of Illusive Realm. Can be used to unlock skills in Thought Evolution.
ItemInfo_80100003_BgDescription: When the continuous or discrete memories intertwined, a network of consciousness is formed. “When you understand your consciousness, you become the master of your dreams.”
ItemInfo_80100004_AttributesDescription: A material used in repairing the Somnoire. Collect to redeem rewards in the Somnium Labyrinth event.
ItemInfo_80100004_BgDescription: Under the dome of a dark night, a single ray of white light illuminates the path ahead, guiding you back to past realities through a trail of shattered dreams.
ItemInfo_80100101_AttributesDescription: An item from the depths of the Somnoire. Collect enough of them to trade for rewards.
ItemInfo_80100101_BgDescription:
"Are dreams something you can trade?"
"Not anywhere else, but in the Somnoire, absolutely. Just place your dreams on the table, like this."
"And?"
"And showdown. All or nothing."
"What? That's not fair at all!"
"Well, that's how dreams work."
ItemInfo_80100102_AttributesDescription: An item from the depths of the Somnoire. Used to unlock special exploration abilities.
ItemInfo_80100102_BgDescription:
"The Observer doesn't play dice." This is a fundamental truth among the administrators in the depths of the Somnoire.
Within the light cone they observe, everything follows its destined path, without exception. In that case, how about introducing some new variables?
The dice are in your hands now. It's time to decide.

ItemInfo_BS_BgDescription: Fear is just your brain's way of saying, "Not enough firepower." But with a heavy weapon and unlimited ammo? Well, now it's your enemies' turn to sweat.
ItemInfo_QSXSS_BgDescription: Friendship and companionship are the protagonists' most dependable weapons against evil—or so the stories say.
ItemInfo_PGSS_BgDescription: 500 classic games on 1 console! Come and relive your childhood!
ItemInfo_ZJSS_BgDescription: Forged in fire, honed to prevail.
ItemInfo_ZLXHJC_BgDescription: Cheap, ubiquitous, and effective. Such convenient items only exist in games.
ItemInfo_FY_BgDescription: Sometimes, a rock can be tougher than metal, especially when it's wrapped in chains.
ItemInfo_JNFW_BgDescription: Transform into a destructive whirlwind and tear through everything in your path! "I AM THE CATACLYSM!"
ItemInfo_ZDSL_BgDescription: This isn't a special effect to slow time, but literally, the moment bullets are happily fired. Time to let this barrage wipe out your enemies!
ItemInfo_CXSS_BgDescription: Time is undoubtedly on our side, though the catch is getting up early on those chilly mornings.
ItemInfo_EWDS_BgDescription: Making this solvent is a breeze. Just toss in whatever ingredients you can find, stick them under the lightning rod, and wait for that strike.
ItemInfo_JNCD_BgDescription: Boosts your perception so much that time basically hits the pause button. Classic video game logic.

MusicName_19000011_Text: The King of Wayward Souls (Remix Ver.)
MusicDes_19000001_Text: Together face it. We will be the saving light.
MusicDes_19000002_Text: I'm crashing through the silence. I'm coming with the rising tide.
MusicDes_19000008_Text:
At the Carnival!
Come one, come all, hearken to the call, the celebratory echoes of our grand carnival!
MusicDes_19000010_Text: Weave the daisies by Whisperwind Haven into a daisy crown. It tells you: no matter how far apart we are, we can still find warmth in each other.
MusicDes_19000011_Text: Fierce waves and tumultuous storms are merely splashes of water, unable to drive us off course. Sing loudly! Cheer joyously!
MusicDes_19000013_Text: I feel invincible just knowing that you're here.
MusicDes_19000015_Text:
The morning dew of Norfall Barrens. The melting snow of Mt. Firmament. The ripples over the Shores. The angry waves of the Thousand Isles...
Tiny water drops gather because of you, forming an endless flowing tide.
The tide continues endlessly because of you!
MusicDes_19000016_Text: If freedom must pierce the waves, then melt the crown into a bird. At the end of the storm, watch the irises bloom.
MusicDes_19000017_Text: Let the arena hear my victorious roar. I desire nothing else.

ItemInfo_80110101_BgDescription: A cherished item among the Rinascita people, it is said to hold music within, crafted by skilled artisans. However, due to internal damage, it no longer fulfills its original purpose.
ItemInfo_80110501_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Music found within Dreaming Deep, bearing unique tunes of the Somnoire.

ItemInfo_80110425_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A piece of music performed by Ciaccona the bard.
ItemInfo_70139319_AttributesDescription: Sketch Obtained in the camp of the Séance Society.
ItemInfo_70139319_BgDescription: A sketch drawn with a naive stroke, pressed between faded leaves of a damaged diary. It portrays a family of four and separate image on each one.
ItemInfo_70139320_BgDescription: Identity mark used by members of the Black Shores. You can feel the surge of Remnant Energy when carrying it with your hands.
ItemInfo_70139320_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Blake Bloom worn by members of the Black Shores.
ItemInfo_70010069_AttributesDescription: A recipe detailing the ingredients and method for Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_70010069_BgDescription: A recipe found in an old book by Panhua, it is said that following this recipe can recreate the long-lost wartime dish, the Jade Treasure Soup that people describe as “a condensed bowl of Jinzhou". However, through time, the terms written in the recipe have become obscure and difficult to understand. Before cooking, it is necessary to further confirm the specific ingredients.
ItemInfo_70010069_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A recipe detailing the ingredients and method for Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_70010070_AttributesDescription: Special ingredient pack for cooking Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_70010070_BgDescription: The grocer Mahe, who has traveled far and wide, has identified and prepared an ingredient pack according to the recipe. This pack contains all the ingredients needed to make the Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_70010070_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Special ingredient pack for cooking Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_70010071_AttributesDescription: Special potion used for cooking Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_70010071_BgDescription: Luohan Clearwater, an unrecognizable term for Mahe, is used among pharmacies years ago, referring to the potion made by boiling Coriolus, Perilla, and Lemongrass. To make the Jade Treasure Soup, Koko gave you a portion.
ItemInfo_70010071_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Special potion used for cooking Jade Treasure Soup.
ItemInfo_40040002_AttributesDescription: Exchangeable for resources when delivered to Xian'ge.
ItemInfo_40040002_BgDescription: An ingenious gadget that captures sounds and transforms them into energy. It can be used in tuning. It is said to be of great interests to some collectors, who'd provide resources in exchange for them.
ItemInfo_40040002_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Exchangeable for resources when delivered to Xian'ge.
ItemInfo_42310200_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42310200_BgDescription:
Berries resembling feathers, the people of Hongzhen call them Linglong Hearts.
They have an incredibly spicy taste and are said to be able to refresh the mind and enhance intelligence when consumed.
ItemInfo_42310200_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42310210_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42310210_BgDescription: A tranquil flower, casting its gentle radiance amidst the shadows.
ItemInfo_42310210_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42310220_AttributesDescription: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310220_BgDescription: A resilient lotus blossoming amidst the freezing snow. When cooked with other ingredients, it can offer solace and warmth to those in need of comfort from the cold.
ItemInfo_42310220_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
ItemInfo_42310230_AttributesDescription: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42310230_BgDescription: An unstable crystal precipitated out of highly concentrated Remnant Energy. It is so unsteady that it starts to sublimate as soon as it is formed, disappearing into thin air as energy. Its existence reminds one of the transience of the life of a Nova.
ItemInfo_42310240_BgDescription: A translucent shellfish, known as the "sea flytrap." It has a body composed of a dense gelatinous substance. It uses the luminescent pearl-like objects on its body to lure in and prey on marine organisms.
ItemInfo_42310230_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_42500090_BgDescription: An ore bearing a likeness to the Sentinel's scale. Can be used to repair weapons.
ItemInfo_70139323_AttributesDescription: A key used to open the Woodveil Hall laboratory.
ItemInfo_70139323_BgDescription: The Court of Savantae Committee left many mysteries in Mt. Firmament: its unfinished research buried deep in the mountains and the ending that befell the researchers. Perhaps you'll be able to uncover these dust-sealed secrets with this key.
ItemInfo_70139323_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A key used to open the Woodveil Hall laboratory.
ItemInfo_70139325_AttributesDescription: An energy device crafted by the Court of Savantae. Can be used to disable the sealing device of Mianloong Chamber.
ItemInfo_70139325_BgDescription: Those blessed by the deity aspired to raise a gate, however modest it may seem to the divine eyes. Even in its decay, the solitary gate stood sentinel: upholding reverence, for the divine is near.
ItemInfo_70139325_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An energy device crafted by the Court of Savantae. Can be used to disable the sealing device of Mianloong Chamber.
ItemInfo_70139326_AttributesDescription: A letter penned by Changli, containing a message for you.
ItemInfo_70139326_BgDescription:
With a subtle delightful scent, it reads: "Behold Hongzhen in its entirety, next to a ring and hanging eaves. When eternal snow thaws into flowing streams, let us reconvene."
It appears to be an invitation.
ItemInfo_70139326_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A letter penned by Changli, containing a message for you.
ItemInfo_70139327_AttributesDescription: A feather pendant left behind by Changli.
ItemInfo_70139327_BgDescription:
Warm and weightless, it gently lands in your palm.
Its purpose remains a mystery.
ItemInfo_70139327_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A feather pendant left behind by Changli.
ItemInfo_70139328_AttributesDescription: A flame feather warm to the touch, bestowed by Changli. It symbolizes a cherished sentiment.
ItemInfo_70139328_BgDescription: Through relentless practice, the most brilliant flames born of Forte are condensed into a flame feather nestled in your palm. Radiating a warmth akin to the touch of its creator, it shields the carrier from the harm of Flame Manipulation. This gift is reserved solely for the most significant individual.
ItemInfo_70139328_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A flame feather warm to the touch, bestowed by Changli. It symbolizes a cherished sentiment.
ItemInfo_70139329_AttributesDescription: A key item in the Rite of Offering. Can be used to activate the Altar of Initiation.
ItemInfo_70139329_BgDescription: An ancient lamp crafted from special minerals. Its luminous blue radiance flickers ceaselessly, as if infused with boundless energy that endures through the ages.
ItemInfo_70139329_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A key item in the Rite of Offering. Can be used to activate the Altar of Initiation.
ItemInfo_14_AttributesDescription: A written order for materials with an inventory schedule attached. Used for Wishes. Automatically restored to 100 at 04:00.
ItemInfo_14_ObtainedShowDescription: A written order for materials with an inventory schedule attached. Used for Wishes. Automatically restored to 100 at 04:00.
ItemInfo_14_BgDescription: The supplies prepared for the Moonlit Fair must be meticulously planned and allocated to ensure they fulfill as many wishes as possible.
ItemInfo_15_AttributesDescription: Funds prepared for the Moonlit Fair that are used for construction or Wishes.
ItemInfo_15_ObtainedShowDescription: Funds prepared for the Moonlit Fair that are used for construction or Wishes.
ItemInfo_15_BgDescription: You can never have too many funds if you want to hold a grand festival.
ItemInfo_16_AttributesDescription: The Wish Tag of a fulfilled wish. Used to improve characters' stats.
ItemInfo_16_ObtainedShowDescription: The Wish Tag of a fulfilled wish. Used to improve characters' stats.
ItemInfo_16_BgDescription: Completed Wish Tags are stored carefully as invaluable mementos to everyone who has worked hard to make the Moonlit Fair possible.
ItemInfo_17_AttributesDescription: Popularity Points are gained by completing Wishes. They indicate how successful the Moonlit Fair is.
ItemInfo_17_ObtainedShowDescription: Popularity Points are gained by completing Wishes. They indicate how successful the Moonlit Fair is.
ItemInfo_17_BgDescription: An objective overview of the number of visitors at the Moonlit Fair and their feedback, gathered through big data analysis, anonymous questionnaires, community reviews, and random street interviews.
ItemInfo_18_AttributesDescription: A common souvenir of the Moon-Chasing Festival that can be exchanged for exclusive rewards.
ItemInfo_18_ObtainedShowDescription: A common souvenir of the Moon-Chasing Festival that can be exchanged for exclusive rewards.
ItemInfo_18_BgDescription: Perfect for holding in one's hand, this small and exquisite lantern is usually given out as souvenirs during the festival.
ItemInfo_19_AttributesDescription: The voucher used to redeem the Lollo Helper special delivery.
ItemInfo_19_BgDescription:
Thank you for being a Lollo Helper!
To express our gratitude, we'd love to present you with a Lollo Stamp. You can use it to exchange for your Lollo Helper special delivery during all Lollo Campaign events.
ItemInfo_19_ObtainedShowDescription:
Thank you for being a Lollo Helper!
To express our gratitude, we'd love to present you with a Lollo Stamp. You can use it to exchange for your Lollo Helper special delivery during all Lollo Campaign events.
ItemInfo_70139324_AttributesDescription: A book obtained at Mt. Firmament.
ItemInfo_70139324_BgDescription:
"In this vast expanse, every goodbye could be a farewell for life.
Be well. Farewell."
ItemInfo_70139324_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A book obtained at Mt. Firmament.
ItemInfo_41400144_AttributesDescription: Sentinel Jué's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400144_BgDescription:
A ritual vessel gifted by Sentinel Jué.
Legend holds that upon the Lament's arrival in Jinzhou, time became entangled, with no more clear line between mornings and nights.
The Magistrate used the Sentinel's dagger as the gnomon of the sundial to determine the date and time.
ItemInfo_41400144_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Sentinel Jué's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_70139330_AttributesDescription: A Pavo Plum sample collected near the hot spring. It should come in handy for Bing'ge.
ItemInfo_70139330_BgDescription: Like Pavo Plums found elsewhere, this fruit looks incredibly delicious. However, knowing its taste, you wouldn't be quick to eat it.
ItemInfo_70139330_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A Pavo Plum sample collected near the hot spring.
ItemInfo_70010072_AttributesDescription: An in-game item redemption code that can be used to redeem Second Coming of Solaris x Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack.
ItemInfo_70010072_BgDescription:
The collaboration between Jewel Boba and the Pioneer Association's Second Coming of Solaris has begun, bringing exclusive "jewels" to Second Coming of Solaris!
This secret key includes an in-game item redemption code, which can be used to claim the exclusive Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack in the game client.
ItemInfo_70010072_Name: The Second Coming of Solaris in-game redemption code.
ItemInfo_70010072_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An in-game item redemption code that can be used to redeem Second Coming of Solaris x Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack.
ItemInfo_70139331_AttributesDescription: While equipped, this allows you to use the Chronopins left by CSC to temporarily slow down time in the surrounding area.
ItemInfo_70139331_BgDescription: Confirming identity, code name: Rover. Top-level access to the Woodveil Hall laboratory granted. May this item guide you to the answers and enlightenment we seek.
ItemInfo_70139331_ObtainedShowDescriptio: While equipped, this allows you to use the Chronopins left by CSC to temporarily slow down time in the surrounding area.
ItemInfo_6_AttributesDescription:
Refined Waveplate with a higher purity.
Waveplate Crystals start to regenerate once Waveplates are full, at the rate of 1 per 12 minutes. Consume to replenish an equal amount of Waveplates.
ItemInfo_6_BgDescription:
Created using the special technology from the Black Shores. An effective form to store and manage Waveplate resources.
"Always be prepared to avoid wastage."
ItemInfo_20_AttributesDescription:
A note containing music scores of Solaris's unique music.
Collect a certain number of these notes to claim rewards on the event page.
ItemInfo_20_BgDescription:
In a world constructed out of energy and syntony, all words and stories can be sung in music.
"I came into this world, bringing naught but paper, rope, and a shadow."
ItemInfo_70140021_AttributesDescription: Specially made firecrackers sold at the fireworks stall. Once equipped to Utility, it allows you to throw firecrackers that deal damage to enemies.
ItemInfo_70140021_BgDescription: A special firecracker made by following a secret blueprint found in Xisha. Refrain from using this in crowded areas as it is both powerful and loud.
ItemInfo_70140021_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Specially made firecrackers sold at the fireworks stall. Once equipped to Utility, it allows you to throw firecrackers that deal damage to enemies.
ItemInfo_70140022_AttributesDescription: A folding fan that Zhezhi painted for you.
ItemInfo_70140022_BgDescription: Zhezhi's painting on this fan captures everything that is beautiful about this moment forever. It is her wish that you will recall this beautiful moment when you see this fan no matter where you are.
ItemInfo_70140022_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A folding fan that Zhezhi painted for you.
ItemInfo_70140023_AttributesDescription: A cake made by every household during the Moon-Chasing Festival.
ItemInfo_70140023_BgDescription: After receiving this cake from adults, children run to the osmanthus trees to gaze at the moon and give their blessings to elders in exchange for tales of the Moon-Chasing Festival. As everyone takes a bite of the cake, the sweet taste brings the joy of reunion to all.
ItemInfo_70140023_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A cake made by every household during the Moon-Chasing Festival.
ItemInfo_70140024_AttributesDescription: Used to learn how to cook Plumpcake.
ItemInfo_70140024_BgDescription: A recipe that details how to make Plumpcake.
ItemInfo_70140024_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Used to learn how to cook Plumpcake.
ItemInfo_70140026_AttributesDescription: A scroll painting that Zhezhi gave you. This is the first scroll painting she has painted with her Forte in many years. The beautiful scenery depicted in the painting seems to give off a different feeling than before.
ItemInfo_70140026_BgDescription: It is an opportunity for encounters, a testimony of shared experiences, a key that opens hearts, and an unforgettable collaboration.
ItemInfo_70140026_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A scroll painting that Zhezhi gave you. The beautiful scenery depicted in the painting seems to give off a different feeling than before.
ItemInfo_70140050_AttributesDescription: A whistle Cartethyia taught you how to use. When equipped in Utility, it allows you to summon the Gondola Phaom near water. (Usable only in Avinoleum)
ItemInfo_70140050_BgDescription: A whistle Cartethyia taught you how to use.
ItemInfo_70140050_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A whistle Cartethyia taught you how to use. When equipped in Utility, it allows you to summon the Gondola Phaom near water. (Usable only in Avinoleum)
ItemInfo_70010073_AttributesDescription: An in-game item redemption code that can be used to redeem Second Coming of Solaris x Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack.
ItemInfo_70010073_BgDescription:
The collaboration between Jewel Boba and the Pioneer Association's Second Coming of Solaris has begun, bringing exclusive "jewels" to Second Coming of Solaris!
This secret key includes an in-game item redemption code, which can be used to claim the exclusive Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack in the game client.
ItemInfo_70010073_Name: The Second Coming of Solaris in-game redemption code.
ItemInfo_70010073_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An in-game item redemption code that can be used to redeem Second Coming of Solaris x Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack.
ItemInfo_70010074_AttributesDescription: A large fish acquired by chance from fishing. It can be used to replace another fish.
ItemInfo_70010074_BgDescription: This fish leaped into the boat as the net was hauled in, almost as if eager to be caught. It looked strangely familiar...
ItemInfo_70010074_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A large fish acquired from fishing. It can be used to replace another fish.
ItemInfo_70010075_AttributesDescription: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Helm Village.
ItemInfo_70010075_BgDescription: "Oh, you mean this? Ahab asked me to keep it for him. I don't know where he got it, but... this thing, it must have something to do with that whale, right?"
ItemInfo_70010075_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Helm Village.
ItemInfo_70010076_AttributesDescription: A mysterious mechanical device. It activates the Serene Bay lighthouse.
ItemInfo_70010076_BgDescription: This mysterious fish doesn't seem to be from this world. Perhaps that's why it has the power to activate the lighthouse Imperator built.
ItemInfo_70010076_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Serene Bay.
ItemInfo_70010077_AttributesDescription: A fragment of a treasure map. Collect all pieces to assemble the complete map.
ItemInfo_70010077_BgDescription: Why are treasure maps often fragmented? They should probably conceal the treasure in multiple locations. Easier for the later generations to find.
ItemInfo_70010077_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A fragment of a treasure map. Collect all pieces to assemble the complete map.
ItemInfo_70010078_BgDescription: The island's fishermen never actually saw the real "Pequod." Captain Ahab only described it as a ship that sank at sea. This design is based on Ahab's sketches and the Ragunna boat model.
ItemInfo_70010079_BgDescription: "The world is a vast ship sailing onward, with no single, definitive voyage."
ItemInfo_70010080_AttributesDescription: A sea-weathered journal of Ahab's past sailing experiences.
ItemInfo_70010080_BgDescription: He was invincible at sea until he encountered it. The Captain Ahab who once traversed Solaris's vast oceans, is now but an old man, filled with hatred and hope, defiantly awaiting death by the sea.
ItemInfo_70010080_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A sea-weathered journal of Ahab's past sailing experiences.
ItemInfo_70010081_AttributesDescription: Nannerl's drift bottle that holds her dreams.
ItemInfo_70010081_BgDescription: "Brother, wherever you may be... if you can see this, play a song for me. I will hear it. One day, you will hear my music too."
ItemInfo_70010081_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Nannerl's drift bottle that holds her dreams.
ItemInfo_70010082_BgDescription: Intended as fireworks for Starbuck's wedding with a certain fish, this Bampuff is incredibly powerful and can also be used to destroy reefs.
ItemInfo_70010082_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Bampuff used for detonating certain reefs.
ItemInfo_70010085_AttributesDescription: Special Every Flavor Bell-less Crab, though it looks like the taste might be a bit weird.
ItemInfo_70010085_BgDescription: Perhaps "delicious" is always subjective, just as Imperator understands that not everyone knows how to ride a horse.
ItemInfo_70010085_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Special Every Flavor Bell-less Crab, though it looks like the taste might be a bit weird.
ItemInfo_70010086_AttributesDescription: A fully pieced-together treasure map marking hidden treasure.
ItemInfo_70010086_BgDescription: A life at sea entails battling the the ocean and fighting pirates to the death. To the victor goes the spoils. Thus this Treasure Map is a testament to our victory.
ItemInfo_70010086_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A fully pieced-together treasure map marking hidden treasure.
ItemInfo_70050027_Name: Investigation Report on the Quick-Access Portals on the Black Shores
ItemInfo_70050027_BgDescription: A report with an appendix over 10 pages long of meticulous data analysis. Whoever submitted it was conscientious; that much is clear.
ItemInfo_70050027_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Investigation Report on the Quick-Access Portals on the Black Shores
ItemInfo_70050028_Name: Data Log of Black Shores Staff Forum
ItemInfo_70050028_BgDescription: An incomplete record of a discussion thread on the Black Shores' Staff Forum about the access doors.
ItemInfo_70050028_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A data log of a Black Shores' staff forum discussion record
ItemInfo_70120007_AttributesDescription: An abandoned Blake Bloom in a cave.
ItemInfo_70120007_BgDescription: This Blake Bloom once symbolized Lady Flora's role as a Bloom Bearer. However, its owner left it behind on the Black Shores.
ItemInfo_70120007_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An abandoned Blake Bloom in a cave.
ItemInfo_70120008_AttributesDescription: A stack of old, candid photos, most worn beyond recognition.

InfoDisplay_70130014_Text: As the year draws to a close, friends from near and far have gathered here at your invitation to spend quality time together. The wish you once made shall be granted upon the arrival of spring. May your journey be filled with hope and joy, and may all rovers of the land always find a place to call home.

InfoDisplay_201001103_Text: On the forty-second full moon of my knighthood, a young man stabbed the right of my abdomen. In retaliation, I took his life. The Order rewarded my killings and celebrated my bloodlust. Yet Sentinel, if my words reach you, I beg for clarity: is mercy the path to saving grace or a swift descent into an early grave?
InfoDisplay_201001104_Text: On the first full moon of my knighthood, I was defeated by a band of Plushies. The big Plushie was more terrifying than I imagined—a slight hesitation almost cost me my life. I was lucky to survive. But Sentinel, I ask you to witness how I conquer my fear and become unyielding. Under your divine gaze, I will forge myself into the very embodiment of the Five Knightly Virtues!
InfoDisplay_201001105_Text: On the hundred and forty-fourth full moon of my knighthood, I was ordered to write a book on an island—despite my illiteracy. I wanted to share my techniques for fighting Tacet Discords, but the Acolytes suggested I center my words around the Five Knightly Virtues. O Sentinel, perhaps you can't hear this, but in all my supposed wisdom, I might be the most foolish of all.
InfoDisplay_201001106_Text: On the ninetieth full moon of my knighthood, I was assigned to duel on the great bridge. Day after day, knights came to challenge me, only to fall again and again—all to hasten my so-called glory of a hundred victories. O Sentinel, do you hear me? The weight of honor grows heavier, yet my sword feels ever more brittle.
InfoDisplay_201001107_Text: On the ninety-fifth full moon of my knighthood, I managed to gather fifteen crates of donations. After giving dues to the Order and the family I serve, only five remained. Even with the three crates I donated... No, it's not enough. It's nowhere near enough! O Sentinel, please enlighten me: why do the greediest souls always hide behind the banner of generosity?

ItemInfo_71500011_BgDescription: A strange pact and its accompanying Echo, offered by an unnamed lady. It recreates fragments of the Sentinel's divine miracles in a mysterious way.
ItemInfo_71500012_BgDescription: An amazing device paired with its detailed instruction manual brought from distant shores. It vanished without a trace after being auctioned off to a mysterious magnate.
ItemInfo_71500013_BgDescription: The seal of a captain whose settler ship foundered within sight of its new homeland. The captain ordered those onboard to save themselves, while he himself gripped the helm and vanished into the deep with his cherished ship.
ItemInfo_71500014_BgDescription: A pirate ship wandering in the mist, known for instilling everlasting fear with the simplest tricks.
ItemInfo_71500015_BgDescription: A ship, wrecked in the struggle for its seal. Treachery set its sail ablaze, toppled its masts, and left nothing but this seal.
ItemInfo_71500016_BgDescription: A ship of the Order Tribunal, often found cruising the sea. It always arrives in time to "mediate" conflicts. They may have "absolved" the guilty, but others never "absolve" them.
ItemInfo_71500017_BgDescription: Everyone celebrates its departure; no one anticipates its return.
ItemInfo_71500018_BgDescription: Evil sank their ship, trying to stifle their joy. Instead, they turned their last moments into a fiery celebration, singing and dancing atop the blazing sea.
ItemInfo_71500019_BgDescription: "Amidst the panicked Fools, he stood out, kneeling devoutly before the terrifying anomaly. Raising his brooch high, he chanted hymns, surrendering himself to the tide until he became one with it..."
ItemInfo_71500020_BgDescription: Time was too short—he only managed to save a single possession before plunging into the sea. Even as his lungs emptied of air, his grin widened. "Surely, I'm the greatest merchant in the world! Trading my life for my family's future—a bargain like no other!"
ItemInfo_71500021_BgDescription: In the opening act, an obscure youth boarded the ship with nothing but a dagger. In the final act, a notorious pirate captain met his end, betrayed by his own confidant, sinking with a dagger into the deep.
ItemInfo_71500022_BgDescription: "His body grew heavier, the darkness wrapped around him, dragging him steadily toward the abyss. In the silence, only the whisper of the ring echoed, 'You cannot escape; no one can...'"
ItemInfo_71500023_BgDescription: Sing and dance, my friends! Rejoice in our triumph over a thousand reefs and a thousand storms! Sing and dance, my friends! With gratitude to the Sentinel and memories of our fallen comrades, we shall live proudly on this scorching land!

ItemInfo_71550005_AttributesDescription:
A potion vial that Cantarella carries with her all the time. Its body is adorned with a sapphire that represents the family head's authority.

To a Fisalia like her, what's stored inside is more than just potion but her very essence: her trust, her emotions, and her soul...
ItemInfo_71550005_BgDescription:
A token from Cantarella. This vial holds a potion she specially crafted for you. Its delicate, calming fragrance works to soothe your mind. She has noticed your specialty, the burdens you carry, and the efforts you put forth. In her kindness, she hopes this potion brings you a peaceful slumber wherever you are.

This vial also contains her deepest sincerity and affection for you. It grants its owner unrestricted access to Porto-Veno Castle. All of Fisalias' elixirs, secrets, and resources... are yours to claim.
ItemInfo_70050060_AttributesDescription:
A seemingly ordinary feather, soft and warm to the touch.

A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "If You Gaze Into the Abyss of Dreams."
ItemInfo_70050060_BgDescription:
This feather doesn't belong to any real bird, yet it looks somewhat familiar to you.

For a brief moment, holding it evokes the sensation of overlooking the entire Somnoire from great heights.

Though its purpose remains unclear for now, it might come in handy one day.

"If you gaze into the abyss of dreams, the abyss of dreams gazes also into you."

ItemInfo_71500029_Name: The Call that Comes from a Lost Land
ItemInfo_71500032_Name: The Finale that Fails to Reach
ItemInfo_71500033_Name: The Resolve that Burns for All or Nothing
ItemInfo_71500028_BgDescription: "He bent down and picked up the box, salvaged from the wreckage. Its surface, stained with blood, radiated a strange, captivating glow. This eerie luster seemed to beckon him, drawing him away from the tragic aftermath of the crew's violent fights. Without a glance back, he vanished into the depths of the island."
ItemInfo_71500029_BgDescription: The traveler clung to the belief that the blood flowing through his veins was tied to a lineage from a land long forgotten by Rinascita. The visions of cold and fjords relentlessly plagued his mind. Finally, he poured all his savings into a ship, set sail, and never returned.
ItemInfo_71500032_BgDescription: "Mary, by the time you read this letter, everything will have already settled. Do not mourn for me. I have given my life willingly, alongside my comrades, to defend the glory of the Sentinel. We will ascend to the heavens and stand beside Them."
ItemInfo_71500033_BgDescription: He continued to roll the dice, silently praying that he wouldn't be forced to face the fate head-on. Yet, deep down, he understood that by continuing to roll, he had already made his choice. He was prepared to bring it all to an end.
ItemInfo_71500028_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Each time dealing Coordinated Attack DMG increases Basic Attack DMG of all Resonators in the team by 12%, stacking up to 10 times for 30s.
ItemInfo_71500029_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Each time the Resonators in the team cast Resonance Liberation, Resonance Skill DMG of all Resonators in the team is increased by 62.5%, stacking up to 2 times for 30s.

ItemInfo_80130000_BgDescription: This marks the borderline of simulation, not the end of your potential. The crisis may persist, but the flame of hope burns ever brighter.

ItemInfo_71600002_AttributesDescription: A lithograph etched with Sentinal Imperator's true form.
ItemInfo_71600002_BgDescription: A lithograph carved with Sentinal Imperator's true form. Members of the Poets Society concealed it in Egla Town, assuming it was a relic left by the ancient Rinascitans.
ItemInfo_71600003_AttributesDescription: A sheet music book gifted by Ciaccona, preserving every melody she recorded on her travels.
ItemInfo_71600003_BgDescription: A sheet music book gifted by Ciaccona, preserving every melody she recorded on her travels. With her Forte, she can bring the stories behind the music back to life.

ItemInfo_80004001_BgDescription: An anonymously gifted birthday cake, brimming with warm wishes and blessings. With rich chocolate, colorful fruit jam, and a lifelike marshmallow Abby on top, it's almost too wonderful to eat!
ItemInfo_80004001_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An anonymously gifted birthday cake, brimming with warm wishes and blessings.

ItemInfo_80004002_AttributesDescription: A customized 2025 birthday accessory for Rover. Before you even notice, this crown gently finds its way into your Backpack.
ItemInfo_80004002_BgDescription: Before you even notice, this crown gently finds its way into your Backpack. Our bonds shine like starlight, weaving stories as brilliant as the boundless galaxies.

ItemInfo_80004003_BgDescription: A sweet Rinascitan-style birthday song performed by the Plushies of the Plushie Village, infused with their warmest wishes just for you!
ItemInfo_80004003_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The 2025 birthday song, magnificently performed by the Plushie Squad.

ItemInfo_80200003_AttributesDescription: A key appeared from nowhere. Used to unlock the lower levels of Abbowser Castle.
ItemInfo_80200001_BgDescription: Theoretically, pastries loaded with sugar and fat aren't great for fitness, but... it's just a game, so go ahead and indulge!

The tail was intended to feature the Pioneer Association's logo, but somehow, it bears Abbowser's portrait instead. It seems Abbowser has taken a particular interest in this coin.

ItemInfo_50020_BgDescription: Across human civilizations, many take an interest in collecting vouchers. With unique fonts and designs from each era, these vouchers are like the outfits of history, carrying the memories of the past.
ItemInfo_50020_ObtainedShowDescription: An outfit voucher valued at <color=Highlight>300</color> Lunites.
ItemInfo_50020_AttributesDescription: A special voucher issued across Solaris, valued at <color=Highlight>300</color> Lunites per voucher for outfit purchases.
ItemInfo_71500031_Name: The Wave that Cleanses the World
ItemInfo_71500031_AttributesDescription:
Casting Resonance Liberation grants 36% Spectro DMG Bonus per second for 15s to the active Resonator, stacking up to 4 times.

This Token can be used up to <color=#fee388>2</color> times in Whimpering Wastes.
ItemInfo_71500031_BgDescription: Some Acolytes believed the Dark Tide was not a disaster but a trial to weed out nonbelievers so that only the Righteous remained. This heretical notion quickly faded into obscurity, but not before the heretics created weapons that harnessed the power of the Dark Tide itself, weapons now lost to the depth of the sea.
ItemInfo_71500031_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Casting Resonance Liberation grants 36% Spectro DMG Bonus per second for 15s to the active Resonator, stacking up to 4 times.
ItemInfo_71500037_AttributesDescription:
When a Resonator inflicts Aero Erosion upon enemies, the active Resonator in the team gains 40% Aero DMG Bonus for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. 

This Token can be used up to <color=#fee388>2</color> times in Whimpering Wastes.
ItemInfo_71500037_BgDescription: He heard from his grandmother that birds could carry wishes from the mortal world to the heavens. From that moment on, he began carving birds day and night, hoping that the Sentinel would allow him to see his departed mother once more. When the chisel in his hand suddenly fell to the ground, he realized that it was the moment the Sentinel answered his wish.
ItemInfo_71500037_ObtainedShowDescriptio: When a Resonator inflicts Aero Erosion upon enemies, the active Resonator in the team gains 40% Aero DMG Bonus for 15s, stacking up to 3 times.
ItemInfo_72010033_BgDescription: Torn pages found in Avinoleum. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
ItemInfo_72010034_BgDescription: "The Sentinel teaches us to illuminate the world for others, and never let it dim for those beside us."
ItemInfo_83100111_Name: Fish Head, Fish Tail, Fish Bones I
ItemInfo_83100011_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Jinhsi Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: As Sentinel Jué's Resonator, Jinhsi is blessed with fortune and shares it with those around her. Stay close to her and you might just find luck on your side.
ItemInfo_83100021_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Changli Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Even as a kid, Changli couldn't resist those colorful marbles everyone loved, all because of their cool touch against her palm. Though she could create them effortlessly with her Flame Manipulation now, she still finds herself browsing the marble vendor's stall.
ItemInfo_83100031_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Calcharo Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Calcharo always carries a few puppy-shaped cookies with him.
ItemInfo_83100041_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Shorekeeper Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Shorekeeper actually enjoyed Encore's Coral Bowl at first, because the salty flavor reminded her of the sea. Encouraged by her reaction, Encore keeps making it even saltier... and, well, let's say she can't quite keep up with Encore's enthusiasm now.
ItemInfo_83100051_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Camellya Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Camellya quite adores the weightless thrill of battling while hanging upside down. She swears it's a blast! Then, a field mission with Encore proved rollercoasters deliver the same fun. And now she's hooked on that as well.
ItemInfo_83100061_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Carlotta Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: The key ingredient in Carlotta's signature coffee blend is orange. Not just any orange. Only the finest varieties at their peak ripeness sourced from the best origins will do. It is said she has a particular fondness for sour and bitter orange slices lately.
ItemInfo_83100071_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Roccia Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Though dependable, Roccia is still a child who craves candy and hates the dark. That's why she always has lots of candies when in shadowy places.
ItemInfo_83100081_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Brant Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Brant loves sweet food because they are sweet.
ItemInfo_83100091_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Cantarella Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Few can keep secrets from Cantarella. One glance, and her toxins reveal all she needs to know.
ItemInfo_83100101_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Zani Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Zani's wardrobe is filled with nearly identical suits, but she knows exactly which one suits each occasion.
ItemInfo_83100111_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Cartethyia Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Cartethyia doesn't eat fish. Not because she's a fussy eater. She just doesn't like it.
ItemInfo_83100121_AttributesDescription:
Equip to use Phoebe Cube's ability.
Fun Fact: Phoebe has diligently trained to perfect her staff treatment techniques without causing harm, though how she practices and the risks involved are for her to know and for you to wonder.
ItemInfo_70050065_AttributesDescription: An intact portrait of the Blessed Maiden discovered in the ruins of Avinoleum. You can zoom in to admire it.
ItemInfo_70050065_BgDescription: The painting captures the Blessed Maiden's contemplation in the Seminary. Though it has weathered the passage of time, her sacred aura remains undimmed.
ItemInfo_70050065_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A portrait of the Blessed Maiden, untouched by time.
InfoDisplay_70050065_Text:
Completed a month before the Blessed Maiden's coronation, this portrait has invited much discussion within the halls of Avinoleum. What, exactly, is the Blessed Maiden contemplating? Some believe she is lost in fond memories of the past; others argue she reflects on weightier matters like faith. A few suggest her thoughts go to the future of Ragunna, or all of Rinascita itself.

Whatever the truth, perhaps only the Maiden herself holds the answer.
ItemInfo_70050070_AttributesDescription: A heavy chest, stashed away here by Samousas.
ItemInfo_70050070_BgDescription: It gives off a dull metallic clatter when shaken. It seems like it's packed with coins... and some dreams long since forgotten.
ItemInfo_70050070_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A heavy chest, stashed away here by Samousas.
ItemInfo_70050071_AttributesDescription: A letter found in the underwater ruins near Ashen Dragon's Crypt of Septimont. It holds the final words of its master.
ItemInfo_70050071_BgDescription: A letter found in the underwater ruins near Ashen Dragon's Crypt of Septimont. It holds the final words of its master.
ItemInfo_70050071_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A letter found in the underwater ruins near Ashen Dragon's Crypt of Septimont. It holds the final words of its master.
ItemInfo_70130016_Name: Picture of the First Cubie Derby
ItemInfo_70130016_AttributesDescription: A commemorative photo from the Pioneer Association. Can be enlarged to view the details.
ItemInfo_70130016_BgDescription: It was such a heated competition thanks to everyone's endless enthusiasm! As the saying goes, competition comes first… Ahem, I mean, friendship comes first!
ItemInfo_70130016_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A commemorative photo from the Pioneer Association. Can be enlarged to view the details.
InfoDisplay_70130016_Title: Picture of the First Cubie Derby
InfoDisplay_70130016_Text: "Oh! Contender Cartethyia has not only caught up with the pack but surged into the lead! If she keeps this pace to the finish line, she'll—wait, what's that?! Contender Brant is soaring! Contender Brant, what are you doing?!"
ItemInfo_70130017_AttributesDescription: A commemorative photo from the Pioneer Association. Can be enlarged to view the details.
ItemInfo_70130017_BgDescription: It was such a heated competition thanks to everyone's endless enthusiasm! As the saying goes, competition comes first… Ahem, I mean, friendship comes first!
ItemInfo_70130017_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A commemorative photo from the Pioneer Association. Can be enlarged to view the details.
InfoDisplay_70130017_Text:
"Denia leads the charge. Sigrika refuses to give an inch and is closing the gap, but blocking their path is... Wait, it's Abbowser!"
"Listen up, challengers!" shouts Abbowser. "Let's see what you're really made of!"
ItemInfo_71500036_AttributesDescription:
When Resonators are in mid-air, their DMG dealt is Amplified by 80%.

This Token can be used up to <color=#fee388>2</color> times in Whimpering Wastes.
ItemInfo_71500036_BgDescription: "Return, people, to ways of old, and cast aside the arrogant boasts of progress. For yesterday's light shall ever outshine today's pale imitation, as today dimly outglows tomorrow's coming darkness. Cling to the known, the tried, the true. Only then may we find shelter from the terrors and confusion of the unknown."
ItemInfo_71500036_ObtainedShowDescriptio: When Resonators are in mid-air, their DMG dealt is Amplified by 80%.
ItemInfo_46_AttributesDescription: A black-gold metallic token that the Gilded Nightmarket accepts in exchange for all sorts of items.
ItemInfo_46_BgDescription: A chip found in Black Alley. Some say it is cast from the daggers of the defeated, while others say it is made from violently pried-off bottle caps... In any case, it's worth something to Black Alley merchants.
ItemInfo_46_ObtainedShowDescription: A black-gold metallic token that the Gilded Nightmarket accepts in exchange for all sorts of items.
ItemInfo_70050064_AttributesDescription: The brass knuckles Zani used to wear, as famous as the Blazing Nightwalker's tale itself.
ItemInfo_70050064_BgDescription: For endless nights, these brass knuckles were her only light in the darkness. Now dawn finally breaks. The Blazing Nightwalker may fade into legend and even be lost in history, but the adventures you shared will stay with you forever.
ItemInfo_70050064_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A pair of brass knuckles Zani used to wear.
FlySkinSet_84000002_BgDescription:
Once bound by thorns, these wings now break free, soaring into the boundless sea of clouds.
The old laws no longer hold sway, for they will carry you to the farthest skies of freedom.

Every actor has their assigned role, and all stories unfold exactly as written, unless...
ItemInfo_71250002_AttributesDescription: A medal awarded to the winner of Septimont's Agon of Champions.
ItemInfo_71250002_BgDescription:
A medal split in two. Lupa wears the other half. 
It's a testament to the applause you've earned in the City of Glory and the symbol of the triumph you've achieved side by side.
ItemInfo_71250003_AttributesDescription: A fleeting trace in memory, one that belongs to Lupa for your journey in the City of Septimont.
ItemInfo_71250003_BgDescription: The journey has come to an end. Her oath remains steadfast and sincere.
ItemInfo_71250004_AttributesDescription: A fleeting trace in memory, one that belongs to Cartethyia for your journey in the City of Septimont.
ItemInfo_71250004_BgDescription: The journey has come to an end. Her three wishes have now all come true.
ItemInfo_71250005_AttributesDescription: A copper mirror given by Buling.
ItemInfo_71250005_BgDescription:
An old copper mirror, simply crafted, with a fox-shaped tassel at its tail.
In the tales of Huanglong, mirrors are said to reveal hidden truths, and in certain hands, even legends may reflect reality.
ItemInfo_53_AttributesDescription: A memento from the Dreamland, used to redeem rewards.
ItemInfo_53_BgDescription: An exquisite badge once given to guests of Dreamland as a souvenir. The Hocus Pocus on it seems to be ever beckoning guests into a wonderland of boundless surprises.

ItemInfo_71500039_BgDescription:
"That unspeakable voice came from beyond the hull. Not even thick timber or thousands of feet of seawater could stop it from drilling into our minds. We tried to resist."
"But to no avail."

ItemInfo_55_BgDescription: The Agon Medals are a mark of honor for the people of Septimont. Over time, they have become one of the symbols of the city itself. Inspired by that, this souvenir badge lets travelers carry home a piece of Septimont's fiery spirit. Even far away from Septimont, they can still hear the echo of battle in their hearts.
ItemInfo_55_ObtainedShowDescription: A souvenir badge for travelers in Septimont. Can be used to advance reward progress in Gifts of Glory.
ItemInfo_51_BgDescription: A true celebration should be full of life! Bring your friends, dive into the fun, and crank up the excitement!

ItemInfo_71500044_BgDescription: …In the end, only this strange melody echoed across the empty seabed. The first note of a promised world that never came.

Casting Echo Skill increases Havoc DMG by 20%, stacking up to 2 times. The same Resonator cannot trigger this effect again with the same Echo Skill.
