ItemInfo_71260005_BgDescription: According to Acolyte Confere, this book offers the most comprehensive documentation of rites performed by the most devout of the Order. It may be worth studying.
ItemInfo_71260005_AttributesDescription: A book given to you by the Acolyte of the Sanctuary of Faith.
ItemInfo_71270001_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Petals symbolizing honor and triumph, meant to be distributed by Rosebearers like you during the celebration.
ItemInfo_71270001_BgDescription:
At the height of the celebration, petals will shower down as everyone rejoices.
Beneath this rain of petals, people who fought side by side will share honey and wine. Such is a true moment of joy for the Septimontians.
To receive petals from the Rosebearer is an honor. And to bestow them? Just as great a privilege.
ItemInfo_71270013_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A photo of you and Iuno taken by the Ceremonial Officer Bruno.
ItemInfo_71270013_AttributesDescription: Bruno happened to capture this moment at the height of the celebration.
ItemInfo_71270013_BgDescription: She has preserved many such memories in this way to guard against the fading blur brought on by her Anchoring ability. Those photos have blurred in the eyes of those who no longer recall her. But… this one marks a beginning. Moonlight pours down, filling the quiet void. For the first time, the present belongs to both of you.
ItemInfo_71270014_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A photo of you and Iuno taken by the Ceremonial Officer Bruno.
ItemInfo_71270014_AttributesDescription: Bruno happened to capture this moment at the height of the celebration.
ItemInfo_71270014_BgDescription: She has preserved many such memories in this way to guard against the fading blur brought on by her Anchoring ability. Those photos have blurred in the eyes of those who no longer recall her. But… this one marks a beginning. Moonlight pours down, filling the quiet void. For the first time, the present belongs to both of you.
ItemInfo_71270015_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A bracelet given to you by Iuno, once again. It's like a crescent moon resting on the wrist.
ItemInfo_71270015_AttributesDescription: A bracelet given to you by Iuno, once again.
ItemInfo_71270015_BgDescription: You tried to return it to her. Yet, in time, it found its way back to you. To wear it or keep it safe, the choice is yours, and in that choice lies her trust. But this time, it means something more. No longer merely a relic of her long and lonely journey, it has become proof that you reached out and drew the moon to your side. She Anchored the world, and you, with this, have Anchored her.
ItemInfo_71270002_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A pure reverberation from the Dark Tide of the past. Sending it back to the Back Shores could help the Tethys System pinpoint the False Sovereign's hideout.
ItemInfo_71270002_AttributesDescription: A pure reverberation from the Dark Tide of the past.
ItemInfo_71270002_BgDescription:
Pure and silent, this frequency has slumbered long enough to leave no ripples. As the firstborn of the Dark Tide, it carries the ancient will of its mother. Undeniably powerful yet defiant, it betrayed its creator in the abyss and now sleeps alone in the dark realm.
Only the sweet Resonance can stir its dreamless sleep… and awaken its long-forgotten hunger.
ItemInfo_71270008_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone. The False Sovereign must be made to take this in by all means.
ItemInfo_71270008_AttributesDescription: A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone.
ItemInfo_71270008_BgDescription:
A shattered piece of an Anchor Stone, still emitting the force field as ever.
"Let this small thing pry open the cracks in fate's door."
ItemInfo_71270009_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A discoid-shaped relic that Sentinel Imperator left you. There is still no way to open it yet.
ItemInfo_71270009_AttributesDescription: A relic that Sentinel Imperator left you.
ItemInfo_71270009_BgDescription: This relic from Sentinel Imperator has been sealed in the Earthrend Wedge, waiting silently for the destined hand. As your fingers lightly tap on its surface, a gentle wind whispers past your ear, carrying with it an unspoken tenderness from realms beyond the farthest horizon.
ItemInfo_71280001_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old. Present it at a shattered Waystone, and the unyielding spirit shall answer the call, guiding the lost traveler forward.
ItemInfo_71280001_AttributesDescription: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old.
ItemInfo_71280001_BgDescription:
A scrap of fabric imbued with the unyielding will of its former owner, a warrior who stood fearless against the Dark Tide.
Bathed in the Dark Tide, the Gladiator faced death without hesitation. Crimson blood long stained the cloth that bound his wounds. He fought. He bled. He rose. He fought again. Until death came, but never conquered.
ItemInfo_71270010_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A handwritten invitation from Augusta herself. The script flows gracefully, yet bears subtle hesitations, as if each word was carefully weighed before touching the paper.
ItemInfo_71270010_AttributesDescription: A handwritten invitation from Augusta herself.
ItemInfo_71270010_BgDescription:
You feel lingering warmth on the envelope as you unfold the letter:

To Our Distinguished Guest from Afar,

I hope your stay in Septimont has been pleasant. Though we never met again after the Great Agon's Final, your deeds have already stirred fresh winds through our halls. Even from mere fragments of conversation, I know your arrival has breathed new life into our city.

While formalities were never Septimont's tradition, I must apologize for missing our appointed meeting. No excuse justifies such neglect toward a Champion of Septimont. Now, with preparations complete and sunrise approaching, I too await the dawn.

Should this invitation still find favor with you, I would be honored by your presence at Ephor's Palace. I await your coming with humble anticipation.

Augusta
ItemInfo_71270011_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A bracelet given to you by Iuno, like a crescent moon resting on the wrist.
ItemInfo_71270011_AttributesDescription: A bracelet given to you by Iuno.
ItemInfo_71270011_BgDescription: This bracelet has been with Iuno ever since she became a Priestess. Forged from lunarum and adorned with sprout motifs, it is not only a keepsake, but a quiet witness to her journey. Now, she entrusts it to you as a medium of Anchoring so you may draw upon her strength to reveal the Dark Tide creations.
ItemInfo_71270012_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An Anchor Stone that looks a bit worn. Inserting it into an Anchor Obelisk can repel the Dark Tide and its creations within a specific range.
ItemInfo_71270012_AttributesDescription: An Anchor Stone that looks a bit worn.
ItemInfo_71270012_BgDescription:
A type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge. It provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.
During the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.
ItemInfo_70140080_AttributesDescription: Phrolova's baton, imbued with part of her Forte.
ItemInfo_70140080_BgDescription:
A precarious alliance demands deep trust. She handed you her last hope, just to earn a moment of your faith.
Keep it close. Even from afar, a temporarily allied enemy must remain in your grasp.
ItemInfo_70140080_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Phrolova's baton, imbued with part of her Forte.
ItemInfo_70140081_AttributesDescription: A residual fragment of Phrolova's Forte. Though not nearly as strong as her baton, it remains just sufficient for Orchestrating.
ItemInfo_70140081_BgDescription: As the blade drove through her chest, everything around her fell silent. Her body was flung away, light as a fallen petal. Tears and the blood bloomed into flowers unnoticed. In their midst, a melody whispered, softly and wistfully, of loss and regrets sunken beneath the sea.
ItemInfo_70140081_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A residual fragment of Phrolova's Forte. Though not nearly as strong as the baton, it remains just sufficient for Orchestrating.
ItemInfo_71260001_BgDescription: Incomplete sheet music, part of the core melody regulating the Fabricatorium of the Deep.
ItemInfo_71260001_AttributesDescription: Phrolova composed this melody upon the founding of the Fabricatorium. She blended the music of her past into it, wishing that those dear and near to her might one day play it in the real world.

ItemInfo_71260004_BgDescription: To the Acolytes, Sacred Salt has the ability to cleanse anything untouched by the Sentinel's grace. With its purifying power, sliced bread turns into the Divinity's nurturing meal, ordinary wine becomes holy blood that grants enlightenment...
InfoDisplay_186700023_Text:
How many steps does it take to offer one's most extensive and reverent prayers?

1. Kneel.
2. Pray.
3. Stand.

ItemInfo_71500048_BgDescription: The captain lowered his telescope, certain he had found the fabled land where treasures litter the ground like dust. He barked orders to charge through the last veil of fog that stood between them and their dream. But the fate waiting ahead was something he never anticipated.
ItemInfo_71500049_BgDescription: Only when the stargazer saw destruction fall with their own eyes did they realize that nothing lasts forever. Not even stars that seem to shine with endless life.
ItemInfo_71500051_BgDescription: Its whisper repeated over and over, offering a tempting promise: Give up yourself. Give up your freedom. Give up your thoughts. Surrender everything, and live on like a bird in a cage. In return, it promises true happiness.

A token of your successful completion of all the challenges in "Dreams of Cindertide: Septimont." A tribute to the long-awaited Hero of the Heroes from their loyal warriors.

"The cherished homeland of mine... I wonder if flowers begin to bloom there once more?"

ItemInfo_80500002_AttributesDescription: A cherry blossom bonsai made by Chisa. She handpicked the branches from Sakura Quarter, where you two roamed together.

ItemInfo_80500002_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A cherry blossom bonsai made by Chisa.
ItemInfo_80500003_AttributesDescription: The standee Namipon made to celebrate the opening day according to your suggestions. It shows a mysterious, stylish, and adorable girl.
ItemInfo_80500003_BgDescription: Legend has it that she is the Mysterious Scissorswoman hunting down Tacet Discords in Honami. How long can you meet her gaze?
ItemInfo_80500003_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The mysterious special ornament prepared by Namipon.
ItemInfo_80500004_AttributesDescription: A stand-up card that conveys Chisa's special feelings, which she crafted herself while convalescing at the Black Shores. Zoom in for a closer look.
ItemInfo_80500004_BgDescription:
Under the open city sky stands the Chisa in her high school days.
The joys and sorrows she once knew in her hometown have become indelible traces upon her heart, shaping the "Kuchiba Chisa" of today.
Now, she offers you those treasured memories of her past, her love, and all that she once called her own.
ItemInfo_80500004_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A stand-up card made by Chisa that conveys Chisa's special feelings.
ItemInfo_80500005_AttributesDescription: An old student ID from Startorch Academy, said to have been yours once.
ItemInfo_80500005_BgDescription:
The student ID Chisa unintentionally took amid the Void Storm.
The ID is eroded, but you can still make out your face in the picture.
Twenty-odd years ago, you once roamed the halls of Startorch Academy.
ItemInfo_80500005_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An old student ID from Startorch Academy, said to have been yours once. Its surface marked by years of erosion.

InfoDisplay_28010002_Text:
To Ms. Eri, or the unknown sender:

We hope this letter finds you well.

The details on the application you submitted are for Eri, from our Association. Sadly, she was lost to us decades ago while conducting her membership review fieldwork in Honami. Whether you are Eri herself or a guardian who has completed her work, we extend our profound gratitude. What you have returned to us is beyond value. It has restored a thread of connection we feared was severed forever.

Regarding the submitted "Honami City Photo Feature" and application:

The photographs speak of a profound love for your subject. They faithfully capture the spirit of the people, the civilization they built, and the unique beauty of their home. Through your lens, we have witnessed not only Honami's vibrant life but also the poignant, brilliant flash it left upon the world at its end.

After careful deliberation, the editorial board has unanimously approved this late confirmation. Her work will be featured in a special commemorative edition of Wutherium Geographic. It is our honor to formally welcome Eri as a full member of the Pioneer Association. 

The Pioneer Association Headquarters
Editorial Board, Wutherium Geographic
InfoDisplay_28020001_Text:
When... did the rain stop?
...Even if no rain falls, I will stay here with you.
InfoDisplay_28020002_Text:
To lighten her master's troubles is the basic duty of a maid.
If you are reading this note, it means—
I have already set out to retrieve the castaway for you!

This time, the castaway should be near the Meishin Passageway.
There shouldn't be any danger… I hope.
InfoDisplay_28010010_Text:
Happy eleventh birthday, our sweet, sweet Shion!
Mom and Dad are doing well, just as we promised you. No more quarrels between us.
Shion… we just hope you can live a happy life in the world beyond.

InfoDisplay_28010011_Text:
Come and spread excitement all over the world with ██████ Brigade.

We don't bother with ordinary people. But if you're a Resonator, a time traveler, or even an alien beyond Solaris, then come seek us out!
InfoDisplay_28010012_Text:
I'm Strom, an explorer of the Pioneer Association.
I have spent fourteen days and nights in this sinking city...
If anyone is reading this, there's something I need you to do...
If you ever meet Aria of the New Federation, please tell her...
Aria, the time I spent with you... was the most precious treasure of my life.
Thank you...
InfoDisplay_28030002_Text:
Under the open city sky stands the Chisa in her high school days.
The joys and sorrows she once knew in her hometown have become indelible traces upon her heart, shaping the "Kuchiba Chisa" of today.
Now, she offers you those treasured memories of her past, her love, and all that she once called her own.

InfoDisplay_72010100_Text:
Forte Evaluation Report – Bridge and Static
Evaluation Basis: Dhalifa's Medical Report

The patient's Tacet Mark is located on the upper right arm. The precise time of Awakening cannot be determined. Upon admission, the patient was conscious but non-communicative. When asked about her Forte, she applied it to a clock in the ward, increasing its accuracy to within femtoseconds.

The patient later clarified, via a caregiver robot, that her Forte can randomly impact machine performance. For instance, a different clock affected by her Forte began running slowly, and became unresponsive to recalibration.

As inquiries were made solely to ensure treatment safety, no further investigation is planned.

"A femtosecond is one quadrillionth of a second. The precision is astonishing. Send this clock to Startorch Academy. They'll know what to do with it."

Conclusion: Resonant Criticality is moderate. Patient stability is also moderate, with minimal risk of Overclocking.
A prior history of Overclocking is documented. 
Maximum severity rating: Moderate.

The patient previously Overclocked during a Void Storm, drawing Exoswarm material to her body to replace contaminated tissue, which enabled her survival. The embedded material now shows no Exoswarm frequency and functions solely as prosthetic tissue.

The patient currently demonstrates unusually stable emotional states considering her trauma and injuries. Regular evaluation and psychological support are recommended.

"Dhalifa survived only by Overclocking. This is not an ability that can counter Void Storms! Make sure the Department of Voidmatters leaves her alone!"
InfoDisplay_72010101_Text:
A rust-stained electronic sheep toy, loose and wobbly, as if it could fall apart at any moment.

Dhalifa grew bored with this simple gadget almost immediately. But the instant she discovered that turning a single screw, nudging a bearing, or rerouting a thin line of circuitry could make the toy spin, tumble, or even bleat, something inside her ignited.

From that moment on, she seized every chance to pester the visiting Spacetrek Collective researchers with endless questions. It was also the point when the more conservative members of her tribe began to alienate her for her newfound obsession.
InfoDisplay_72010102_Text: A length of plain, monotone silk, embroidered with the names of the Roya lost to the Void Storm that ravaged the Spacetrek Observatory. Dhalifa's name is there as well, yet a single strand of violet thread crosses it out.
InfoDisplay_72010103_Text:
"…In short, developing high-performance combat mechs had become a pressing need.

The project was assigned to a pair of twin researchers: an older sister who was bold and daring, and a younger sister who was quiet and steady. Their personalities shaped the Twin Nova series they created.

The melee model, Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade, engages with fast and aggressive actions, while its ranged counterpart, Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon, prefers to stay back and provide support. Their very names embody the Spacetrek Collective's mission: to descend into the unknown as they continue to reach for the stars.

The idea of building the mechs in pairs began as something almost poetic. The Threnodian of Void, Aleph-1, erases individuals from memory, and the twins couldn't imagine a world where they might forget each other. They hoped their creations, at least, would always have a companion and never face that silence alone. While Aleph-1's influence may not extend to inorganic matter, this sentiment became the emotional core of the Twin Nova project.

This philosophy also influenced their form. The Collective opted for humanoid frames to symbolize humanity's presence on the frontier. Rumor has it the design also helps them seem less intimidating when serving as security at Startorch Academy, and perhaps caters to a few researchers' personal tastes.

An autonomous tactical intelligence model was built for the units. However, with little combat data available in the Collective, the sisters had to pilot the prototypes themselves to generate the initial data. Their influence made the Twin Nova units move with a graceful, almost showy flair, a style that is sometimes more artistic than practical.

Now, with the accumulating real combat data, the models continue to evolve. The melee unit leads the charge and breaks through enemy lines, while the ranged unit coordinates with human teams, offering support fire and protecting the formation."
InfoDisplay_72010104_Text:
"The sprawling, secret-filled lands of Lahai-Roi made it necessary for the Spacetrek Collective to establish mid-to-long-term field research programs. However, sustaining these operations in such dangerous terrain required dependable mobile bases.

After weighing its options, the Collective developed a versatile transport platform capable of handling logistics, storage, and emergency defense. They named it Spacetrek Explorer.

The Explorer's design is based on a wheel robot. Its massive tires provide exceptional grip, allowing it to climb smooth vertical surfaces and easily navigate the dense architecture of Startorch Academy, delivering cargo to otherwise inaccessible locations. The large storage container mounted on its top further supports fieldwork, enabling researchers to access supplies or auxiliary equipment directly on-site.

To defend against the Exoswarm affected by the Waveworn Phenomenon and attacks from Outcasts, the Explorer is equipped with a heavy electromagnetic cannon and a protective shield projector. However, due to its weight, frequent cargo load, and energy-saving design, it carries only small thrusters. These are useful for brief bursts of acceleration, but not for sustained flight.

In addition to field expeditions, the Spacetrek Explorer now serves as one of Lahai-Roi's primary heavy logistics vehicles. In its logistics configuration, its weapons are removed and replaced with expanded storage modules to maximize cargo capacity."
InfoDisplay_72010105_Text:
"Operators must follow the steps below with strict attention to operate Route Constructors.

Step 1: Put in the required amount of Compressed Bedrock.
Note: Compressed Bedrock is processed material made of natural minerals. After refining native Lahai-Roi stone, the Spacetrek Collective produces a high-density construction medium. Once parsed and separated by the Route Constructor, it can be combined with other resources to form structural baseplates for various building types.

Step 2: Put in the required amount of Mechanite.
Note: Mechanite is a native Lahai-Roi mineral. After the arrival of the Exostrider, mechanical patterns and structures started to grow on it under the influence. The Collective has found that electronic devices made with this mineral exhibit increased computational performance, as if the Mechanite itself has processing capability.

Step 3: Put in the required amount of Constructor Cores.
Note: Constructor Cores are artificial power units designed for the equipment's operation. Since the Route Constructor's immense energy demands, remote deployment, and single-use nature make stable energy lines impractical, the Collective developed these cores to serve as portable, reusable "batteries." They are charged by focusing the Reactor's light through a Solis Lens Array.

Step 4: Verify the construction blueprint.
Note: Blueprints are usually pre-loaded during setup. Only a simple confirmation is required.

Step 5: Ensure the construction area is fully cleared of any personnel, animals, or Exoswarm units.

Step 6: Activate the Route Constructor."
InfoDisplay_72010106_Text:
"The Relay Station combines garage, warehouse, rest areas, and basic laboratory facilities in a single complex, providing support for arduous field research and logistics operations. One of its key services is vehicle rental.

The station primarily offers three types of vehicles:
- Hauler: A large vehicle designed for transporting heavy cargo.
- Pathfinder: A medium-sized vehicle for personnel transfer, with limited cargo capacity.
- Sprinter: A small vehicle optimized for rapid, solo transport.
 
Due to limited vehicle availability, all applicants must submit a formal request. The staff will review each application and assign vehicles based on demonstrated need.

'Lately, it seems like all the Haulers in Lahai-Roi are heading to the Spacetrek Observatory. Just how massive is that project?'"
InfoDisplay_72010107_Text:
"The Spacetrek Observatory stands as a monumental achievement co-built by the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya. Its mission is to map Lahai-Roi's various data points. Unlike the Cassettes that store personal data, the Observatory primarily captures and tracks the changes in Lahai-Roi's terrain, ecology, climate, and sky under the influence of Void Storms and Threnodian activity.

As our partnership with the Roya deepened, the Observatory grew to also document their architecture and cultural landmarks. But then, disaster struck. A devastating Void Storm swept through, leaving the structure in ruins. Although the Academy has started the reconstruction, progress has been painstakingly slow. The sheer number of ongoing projects across Lahai-Roi, coupled with the damaged roads leading to the site, has left this massive facility languishing.

That concludes the introduction to the Spacetrek Observatory. I trust you can now appreciate its importance. Despite the current challenges, its restoration is a necessity! That is why I am calling on each and every one of you to join me in this vital endeavor. We need your help, in whatever form you can offer. Every contribution matters.

My name is Rakosan. I will be here, at the Spacetrek Observatory, waiting for you!"
InfoDisplay_72010108_Text:
Alienated by their tribes, openly rejecting tradition, or lured by an insatiable curiosity for a world they had never seen, a group of Roya set out on a path separate from their people. They began trading in Exostrider cell remnants and Exoswarm materials to fulfill their own desires.

Their actions were intolerable to the rest of the Roya. As a result, they were exiled and branded Outcasts. But they did not see this as a punishment, but a liberation, a chance to embrace their true natures. They spread across Lahai-Roi, becoming a force of unrestrained chaos. Their defiance was more than a simple rejection of tradition. They actively inverted it, mocking the old ways in every gesture, every object, and every action.

They cast aside ornaments drawn from nature, instead tearing skulls from the Exoswarm to wear as grisly masks. They reforged their Shepherd's Staffs into weapons.

But what exactly is their purpose? Some say they see themselves as the new, true branch of the Roya, striving to carve out a place in a changing world. These, however, are only rumors. In truth, the Outcasts demonstrate no unified ideology and voice no common demands. They appear consumed instead by the thrill of discovery and the hunt for the Exoswarm.

ItemInfo_71600004_BgDescription: The red wasteland lay silent, like a seabed after the tide had withdrawn. The wind lingered, echoing endlessly across the surface. If Fa recalls correctly, this was where they first met Matthew. He was holding that strange object in his hands, which, with a single gentle pluck, let sound bloom into the night, bright and tender. It was here that the Soliskin learned how to enjoy music for the first time, and the photo quietly preserved that moment of first encounter.
ItemInfo_71600005_BgDescription: Water cascaded down the rock face, scattering into a fine mist that shimmered softly in the air. If Fa recalls correctly, they practiced playing the music here again and again with Matthew. When they finally succeeded, the melody carried them forward like flowing water. The color of "Mi" softened into green, and the photograph retained the memory of wind and water entwined, a light that still trembles gently, like dew on a blade of grass.
ItemInfo_71600006_BgDescription: A massive metal ring caught the light, its curves reflecting a warm, muted glow. Beyond it, the plains stood in silence. If Fa recalls correctly, it was here that Matthew taught them to recover the beat with their own steps. The bass drifted like the wind across open ground, rhythm lighting up within the Soliskin themselves. The photo preserves that moment when rhythm was rejoined, a faint tremor lingering in the sunlight.
ItemInfo_71600007_BgDescription: Beginning, climax, finale... red, yellow, and green marks rest quietly in order, forming a complete score. These colors once drifted separately, carried by wind, water, and light. until they return to a single melody. It is a song they completed together. And it remains, even now, a gentle echo that the Soliskin still remember.

Teacher's Column, Issue No. 5:
"Fashion is a way of self-expression, a reflection of who we are and what we are. The variations in size, the play between symmetry and asymmetry, and the differences in contours… They all quietly shape how we see ourselves and how the world sees us. Styling, at its heart, is a delicate and graceful experiment, a designer's way of interpreting the world and the ever-shifting scenery through their own lens."
"Warm sunlight spills across the campus. A gray, off-shoulder knit top meets a timeless plaid skirt, paired with a dark-toned handbag in just the right size. A golden butterfly brooch gleams gently at the chest, infusing a touch of grace into the muted gray. A hint of retro charm blends effortlessly with the modern academic mood, as though time itself has slowed..."
InfoDisplay_32010002_Text:
Title: Breaking News! Startorch's Eighth Great Mystery—The Vanishing Miko?
Multiple students have reported seeing a girl in a white miko robes wandering around campus. Yet, when school authorities reviewed the surveillance footage, not a single trace of this mysterious figure was found.
Some say that spirits cannot be captured by cameras. Others dismiss it as an elaborate prank. And some even suspect that the witnesses themselves may have staged the entire event, perhaps in an attempt to add a new chapter to the Academy's Seven Great Mysteries.

ItemInfo_42601470_BgDescription:
Frostwort has a structure remarkably similar to neural tissue. Over millennia of independent evolution, it has gained the ability to transmit simple signals through its symbiotic network, helping it grow efficiently and repair itself.

The Roya dry Frostwort and use it to brew drinks, though it is reserved only for adults.
ItemInfo_42601450_BgDescription:
Foxtail Kelp is entirely edible. Its long, fragile stems often break off and drift to the shore, looking like lost walking sticks or pipes.

The Roya call it the "Traveler’s Staff." For lost travelers trapped in caves, it can serve as a reliable source of food until they reach safety. Children also play with the stems, sparring with one another to see whose kelp lasts the longest.
ItemInfo_42601460_BgDescription:
Meteoric Iron is naturally magnetic and often paired with Sunstone to guide herders through snowstorms. Its excellent heat conductivity also makes cookware crafted from it highly prized, reducing cooking time while adding unique flavors.

Within the iron are dense gems formed under immense pressure when it fell, known as Star Marks among the Roya. They are extremely hard and valuable outside Lahai-Roi. Some have been caught defying Royan rules to extract and trade them.

ItemInfo_70050073_AttributesDescription: Candy wrapped in gleaming paper, carrying a gentle sweetness.
ItemInfo_70050073_BgDescription:
Wrapped in translucent, colorful candy paper, the sweets are firm to the touch. Once in the mouth, they release a gentle, lingering sweetness.

A little sweetness keeps numbness at bay. You understand and accept his kindness, even though a faint trace of bitterness still lingers beneath the sugar.
ItemInfo_70050074_AttributesDescription: A poster alive with bright colors, radiating the passion of its fans.
ItemInfo_70050074_BgDescription:
After the once-beloved voice faded from campus, fans of Fleeting Snowfluff found a haven on her clean, vibrant website. They left behind a trail of messages, wishes, and memories. Year after year, those words gathered like fallen leaves, slowly forming a genuine community.

The singer may be long absent, yet the youthful warmth of her voice still echoes through this academy.
ItemInfo_70050074_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Event material of the Fleeting Snowfluff Fan Meeting.
ItemInfo_70050075_AttributesDescription: A keepsake photo from the fan meeting, capturing a moment of music and joy.
ItemInfo_70050075_BgDescription:
Aemeath sings onstage, her voice light and warm, floating effortlessly through the air. You applaud from below. When the song ends, she slips in beside you and flashes a bright smile toward the camera.

Click.

In this moment, a song left unfinished more than a decade ago finally feels complete. Seeing Aemeath smile like this always lifts your spirits, and before you realize it, you're smiling too.
ItemInfo_70050076_AttributesDescription: A softly contoured talisman with a lustrous finish, engraved with Royan patterns.
ItemInfo_70050076_BgDescription:
A Royan talisman once cherished by a young owner, only to be lost to the whims of fate.
Now that it has found its way back to you, it feels like a silent proof that your efforts were never in vain. The world lies calm and beautiful before you at this moment, just as you always hoped it would on your journey.

The brief yet indelible time you two shared began with this talisman, and now, with its return, it has come full circle.

Thankfully, the result was pretty good.
Sometimes a little inspiration goes a long way.

ItemInfo_70340007_BgDescription: Dessert-making is a hobby Luuk Herssen took up amid his busy schedule. Creating treats is similar to conducting experiments. Both involve following a prescribed order, which helps him regain a sense of familiarity he once had. Meanwhile, the comfort of cooking connects him to the vibrant realities of life. Of course, not every attempt is a success. But he chose to present his most successful creation to you, for whom he'll share the very life he has experienced.

ItemInfo_70350000_BgDescription:
The Exostrider poured forth light and heat from its Reactor Drive, sheltering life from the killing frost. Grateful for this gift, the Roya revered the Reactor Drive as their sun. They took it upon themselves to gather the Exostrider's "cells," making this quiet labor the duty of their tribe.
Now, their ancient vow is complete. As the new sun rises, they hold the New Solar Celebration, both to mark the renewal and to remind their kin of the purpose that set them on this path.

InfoDisplay_35000002_Text:
Dear Rover,

How are you finding your time at Startorch Academy? I find myself wondering how long the sunlight I basked in today will take to reach you.

Lately... I have been having the same dream. In it, I am alone in the Gorges of Spirits, running and running... And just when it seems I am about to find something, something always pulls me back to reality.

Does that sound like I am complaining? Forgive me. Once in a while, I hope you will not mind if I write like this.

Oh, yes. Some time ago, my older sister said she wanted to come visit me in Jinzhou. It's been years since we last saw each other. I wonder what she is like now, but knowing her, I think she must still be the same sister I remember. I would like to introduce you two someday. I'm sure you would become very good friends.  

I assume by the time you receive this letter, Chixia and I will be on an assignment together. Things have been a little unsettled in Jinzhou lately, but do not worry. Just as you have sharpened your blade through so many stories and trials, I would like to think I have grown too, since the day we first met.

So next time, let me be the one to share my "adventures" with you, Rover.

Sincerely,
Yangyang

P.S. I've also included some seasonal snacks for Abby. Do share them with your friends at Lahai-Roi. I hope they are to everyone's liking.

ItemInfo_80001077_BgDescription:
Red bean pudding that can be easily made at home, a simple homemade dessert. After Hiyuki tweaked the recipe, it now comes in a more convenient package.
Hiyuki doesn't have much of a sweet tooth, but once she became the miko, she quietly visited a dessert shop to learn how to make red bean puddings. 
The children of Ashinohara came to call it the "good luck pudding." However the story grew, the sweetness itself stayed simple. Almost plain.
Just as she hoped.
ItemInfo_80001071_BgDescription:
Denia's dessert from a cooking class. She spent most of the session taste-testing, so in the end she went with jam, something easy to prep.
The result was extremely sweet, under-marinated, and overcooked. The texture and sweetness never quite came together. But it looked creative and photographed well, so her classmates still gave it decent scores—by a slim margin.
"It tastes sweet. It looks nice. That's good enough, right? Hm? Texture and flavor? Sorry, not really following you."

She had left many traces throughout Lahai-Roi. This serves as proof that she existed.
Back in Voidspace, she pushed it toward you... What was it she was trying to say?

It can help you perceive the Royan rune fragments scattered throughout Lahai-Roi and restore them to their original form.
But who was it, and by what means, that used the Royan runes to etch those scattered messages across the plains?

OrnamentAttrDes_80870007: Upon her second admission to Startorch Academy, she chose her very first accessory. The shadows of the past had finally receded. Now, all that matters is the vivid colors before her eyes and the dazzling future that lies ahead.
OrnamentAttrDes_80870008: To monitor the effects of Overclocking on her vitals, Mornye temporarily modified her Starstack. An unstable Forte disrupting the instruments? That's the kind of predictable accident you'll never see in Mornye's lab.
OrnamentBgDes_80870007: The light of dawn, the brilliance of color, and a brand-new journey... in this very moment, she can finally embrace her life, unburdened.
OrnamentBgDes_80870008: Whether found in a simulated sky or an artificial Reactor Drive, the future she envisions holds infinite possibilities. She will answer with action, questioning and probing relentlessly until she finally touches the distant stars.

ItemInfo_70050080_BgDescription:
On the stone are three animals: a Fluffguin, a Kronapuff, and a Toskr Lemming. They are gathered happily around a Roya girl who is carving statues with a small knife.

"To my best friends: Fenrir, who loves to dance. Dallas, who loves to eat fish. And Bori, who loves flowers.
I carve you on this stone, so we can always be together. Forever."

ItemInfo_71200015_AttributesDescription: A mysterious pendant retrieved from the Fogveil Pagoda. Seems to be a clue left behind by Cat of the Nether Lamp.

ItemInfo_71200016_AttributesDescription: A keepsake gifted to you by Qingxiao. This jade sword glimmers with a chilling, emerald glow.
ItemInfo_71200016_BgDescription:
A few strands of pure, tranquil Sword Intent reside within this jade pendant. Held in the palm, its gentle frequency brushes over the body and mind like a soft breeze.

Many years ago, Jingwei the Perfected entrusted Qingxiao with a jade pendant bearing the legacy of her teachings. Now, Qingxiao has placed a pendant she carved herself into your hands. It stands as both a token of your bond as master and disciple, and a keepsake of the journey you have shared.
ItemInfo_71200016_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A keepsake gifted to you by Qingxiao.
ItemInfo_71200017_AttributesDescription: An old swordcraft manual. Many of the sword moves pictured within seem familiar to you.
ItemInfo_71200017_BgDescription: A swordcraft manual with gentle Sword Energy soaked into it. Despite the passage of many years, only slight wear is evident along its edges. Its keeper must have treasured it greatly.
ItemInfo_71200017_ObtainedShowDescriptio: An old swordcraft manual with familiar sword moves pictured within.
ItemInfo_71200018_AttributesDescription: A confection Yanshu asked you to give to Jingran. Seems to be fresh out of the oven.
ItemInfo_71200018_BgDescription: A full moon-shaped steamed rice cake made from rice batter. Snow-white, soft, and pleasantly springy, it is garnished with slivers of candied red and green peel resembling twin rainbows upon fresh snow, hence the name "Moonlit Splendor."
ItemInfo_71200018_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A confection Yanshu asked you to give to Jingran.
ItemInfo_71200019_AttributesDescription: An advance copy of a novel found on a Cloud Shuttle, recounting the strange encounters of a Nethermancer across Mirage Realms. It seems someone has jotted down a few comments on some pages.
ItemInfo_71200019_BgDescription: Since its debut, Mirage Seeker's Tales has seen multiple collected volumes published and garnered a loyal following across Mengzhou. The author halted serialization several months ago, claiming to be "away gathering inspiration"—a decision that has left countless readers clamoring for the next chapter.
ItemInfo_71200019_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A novel recounting the anecdotes of a Nethermancer.
ItemInfo_71200020_Name: Feeling Capsule Shard: Yueji Rice Cake
ItemInfo_71200020_AttributesDescription: An entity condensed from a frequency within the Feeling Capsule, taking the form of a rice cake.
ItemInfo_71200020_BgDescription: Fragrant, soft, and delightfully chewy, this mouthwatering rice cake tastes strikingly like the Moon Fox Rice Cake. Could it be only partially prepared...?
ItemInfo_71200020_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A frequency that is similar to that of Hsin the Moon Fox. One of the Feeling Capsule's shards.
ItemInfo_71200021_Name: Feeling Capsule Shard: Gilded Fragrance Pouch
ItemInfo_71200021_AttributesDescription: An entity condensed from a frequency within the Feeling Capsule, taking the form of a fragrance pouch.
ItemInfo_71200021_BgDescription: A fragrance pouch woven from gold thread, embroidered with the emblem of Hsin the Moon Fox. The weave is fine and intricate, its sheen shifting with the light, and its scent quiet and restrained, likely an item borne by someone of high standing in Mengzhou.
ItemInfo_71200021_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A frequency that is similar to that of Hsin the Moon Fox. One of the Feeling Capsule's shards.

ItemInfo_71200022_AttributesDescription: An entity condensed from a frequency within the Feeling Capsule, taking the form of a flute.
ItemInfo_71200022_BgDescription: A flute as green as fine jade, warm and smooth to the touch, with a clear, mellow tone. The rims of its finger holes have been worn round and smooth, bearing witness to the affection its owner held for it.
ItemInfo_71200022_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A frequency that is similar to that of Hsin the Moon Fox. One of the Feeling Capsule's shards.
ItemInfo_71200023_AttributesDescription: A Feeling Capsule put together from various fragments. Accessible once placed within the Inner Threshold.
ItemInfo_71200023_BgDescription: An item which Xuanqing refers to as the "Feeling Capsule," seemingly affiliated with Hsin the Moon Fox. Its frequency is linked with a certain location within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. When placed in the Inner Threshold, one can view the memories stored within.

ItemInfo_71200011_BgDescription: Don't get yourself lost in a memory, Rover.
ItemInfo_71200011_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Lucilla's chat screenshot. Perhaps it can be the key to finding the meeting point.
ItemInfo_72630001_BgDescription: Inside is a well-worn Nine Linked Rings puzzle, and a half-opened letter. Left behind by a daughter for her father, these tokens are as quiet as she was—a silent proof of her unspoken care.
ItemInfo_72630002_BgDescription: An inventory listing the belongings of the fallen Xuanfang Wardens, accompanied by a parcel containing the Nine Linked Rings puzzle and the letter you just retrieved.
ItemInfo_72630003_BgDescription: A delicate jade-green pendant emitting a soft, restrained glow. Alongside it lies a crumpled, expired ticket to a popular water performance in Mengzhou.
ItemInfo_41400334_AttributesDescription: Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400334_BgDescription:
The forge fires have melted multiple modular parts into a singular mass. After a century of bitter warfare, only a lonely, unbending soul remains to drive this vessel, turning it into an unquenchable flame.

This obsession burns to this very day, fueled by the desire to repay that unwavering companionship that leaves no soul behind, and to fulfill a century-old vow to defend Xuanfang to the death. Within the flickering firelight, a fine line faintly comes into view: "Son of Unyielding Virtue."
ItemInfo_41400334_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis's drop, used for Resonator Ascension.
ItemInfo_41400324_AttributesDescription: Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.
ItemInfo_41400324_BgDescription:
He believes he has exploited everything of this emotion, yet he never truly understands its essence.

A burning hatred against the foes. A pining for home. A longing for the beloved. A wandering lost on the road ahead. The terror of death. The sheer tenacity for life.

It was never some incomprehensible impurity, nor the dawn of chaos.

What the girl witnessed as she cast a glance back was voices fading softly into the drifting winds—hearts as clear as glass, carried away on feathers toward the far reaches of the sky.
ItemInfo_41400324_ObtainedShowDescriptio: Thousand-Puppet Pavilion's drop, used for Skill Upgrade.

ItemInfo_42601530_BgDescription: The Land of Xuanfang is rich in jade. Locals see the Jadeplume Eagle as a spiritual creature bound to the jade, and guard it closely. If a fallen Jade Egg is found, they will try to return it to its nest. Only those confirmed abandoned are treated as a gift from the wild and used with care. Once the chicks hatch, the remaining jade‑calcified shells become even more precious. They are carved into ornaments for children, carrying the blessing: "May you spread your wings and soar."
ItemInfo_42601540_BgDescription: Once Climber Shoots emerge from the ground, they gradually take on the straight appearance of ordinary bamboo shoots, their color shifting from black to green. Locals associate them with a wondrous artifact in Huanglong legends capable of connecting people's hearts, viewing the shoots as an auspicious ingredient that blesses children with sharp senses and deep empathy.
ItemInfo_42601550_BgDescription: Hard and dense, the Jade Hexahedron is a superb energy-conducting medium, frequently mined for use in mechanics and residential construction. When selecting a site for a Autopuppet factory, the builders will specifically choose an area rich in Jade Hexahedron veins to meet the immense power demands of its automated operations.
ItemInfo_42601560_BgDescription:
The White Jade Beauty is difficult to preserve. Once touched or bruised, the damaged area rapidly oozes a striking cyan-blue hue, resembling a clouded jewel or a cracked jade plate. 
Though delicious, it is mildly toxic. Eating it raw causes dizziness and vomiting, so it must be fully cooked before consumption. To ensure safety, eateries often take diners' utensils away while the mushrooms are cooking to prevent them from sneaking a premature bite.
ItemInfo_42601570_BgDescription:
Every Opus Stone is made thanks to the rigorous selection process of Opus Otters. Uncut stones with dull acoustics or messy textures are discarded along the water's edge, becoming "Otter Castaways" occasionally found by travelers.
The people of Mengzhou carefully polish Opus Stones of varying pitches, crafting them into lithophones and wind chimes hung beneath eaves or by the water. Whenever the chimes ring, nearby Opus Otters often pause their work to listen closely. If the mood strikes them, they will even knock on their own stones in harmony, as if jamming a song with a kindred spirit.
ItemInfo_42601580_BgDescription: The Leafweaver has a delicate frame and a pale golden hue. As a "professional weaver," it cuts leaves or petals to construct intricately designed, spiral tower-like nests. On sunny afternoons in the Land of Xuanfang, one can often spot busy Leafweavers fluttering through the air, carrying leaves several times larger than their own bodies.
ItemInfo_42601590_BgDescription:
The Floral Crest Jade is encased in a shell of dense, incredibly hard black jade. Twistscales grind away at this outer layer using their own scales, polishing it over and over until the surface gleams like a mirror. Eventually the shell flakes off in one smooth piece, revealing the "jade chrysanthemum" beneath—fully intact and vivid with color.
Cherishing the stone's delicate veining, the people of Mengzhou have long taken to displaying these Twistscale-polished jades in their homes, where they sit upon desks as quiet, elegant treasures.
ItemInfo_42601600_BgDescription: In the Land of Xuanfang, the Cloudperch Seed is seen as the embodiment of lightness and ambition. Whenever the late autumn winds begin to blow, the tree's "perching feathers" rustle in unison, breaking free from the branches to dance through the valleys. Borne on mountain breezes and air currents, these seeds can travel immense distances. Only when the wind finally subsides do the winged seeds touch down gently, scattering life across distant lands.
ItemInfo_42601610_BgDescription:
"Drawing the twilight's glow, gathering radiance upon scales."
The Flowborne Dream is exceptionally sensitive to environmental shifts. The shimmering changes in its scales and its swimming patterns allow it to detect ecological imbalances in a given area faster than any crafted device. It is also why the people of Mengzhou often keep them in wall-mounted glass tanks draped with thin silk scroll paintings. Beyond mere decoration, they serve as a natural early-warning instrument.
ItemInfo_42601620_BgDescription: With its sword-like leaves and refreshing scent, the Blade Blossom has historically been imbued with the folkloric meaning of "warding off evil with blade leaves" by the people of Mengzhou. Every midsummer, locals gather their long, straight leaves and hang them alongside mugwort on doorframes and windows, believing they can ward off impurities and misfortune. Its tendency to bloom under the moonlight and scatter its blade-like petals in the wind is viewed as a fleeting purification ritual. Wherever the petals drift, all gloom seems washed away.
ItemInfo_42601530_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The egg of the Jadeplume Eagle, an apex predator in the Land of Xuanfang. It is massive, cyan-green in color, and lustrous like pure jade.
ItemInfo_42601540_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A specialty bamboo shoot from the Land of Xuanfang. Shaped like the coiled horns of a mythical beast, it is exceptionally delicious.
ItemInfo_42601550_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A green jade encrusted with stones and crystals, formed into a hexahedron shape. It is commonly found clinging to steep cliffs.
ItemInfo_42601560_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A mushroom that grows in damp woodlands. It earned the name "White Jade Beauty" because its body resembles pure jade and its veil drapes gracefully like a flowing dress of snowy gauze.
ItemInfo_42601570_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A natural instrument carried by Opus Otters. Every stone produces a distinct musical note.
ItemInfo_42601580_ObtainedShowDescriptio: The nest of Leafweaver, a kind of chirping insect. Meticulously structured, it is primarily built from leaves and petals.
ItemInfo_42601590_ObtainedShowDescriptio: A chrysanthemum-shaped crystal found within jade. Elegant and unfurling, it is hailed as the "ethereal one among the stones."

ItemInfo_41100092_BgDescription: A standard kernel structure produced in massive quantities. This is the most ubiquitous model, serving as the default powerhouse for standard Autopuppets. Commonly found across a wide variety of models.

ItemInfo_80000087_BgDescription:
A soup made by pouring Uncracked Jade liquid and White Jade Beauty into a broth, then letting it simmer over a low flame. Remarkably versatile, it bends willingly to the cook's hand—a rich stock brings out a deep, savory character, while spring water yields a lighter, fresher note. A brief simmer is all it takes for the flavors to naturally bloom.

To keep impatient children from sneaking a taste before the mushrooms are fully cooked, parents have long made a habit of hiding away their bowls and chopsticks until the White Jade Beauty is properly done. Across the Land of Xuanfang, this is a comfort dish everyone grows up with.
ItemInfo_80000088_BgDescription:
Made by slow-stewing newly sprouted bamboo shoots with salted meat in a single pot. The natural sweetness of the bamboo melds with the savory depth of the meat, yielding a classic dish that is both hearty and deeply satisfying.

In Yuan Fortress, Cloudward Stew is regarded as a dish of good fortune, said to grant children sharp senses and a compassionate heart. During school enrollments or festive occasions, families often prepare this meal, wishing for their little ones to grow as strong and upright as spring bamboo, reaching ever skyward toward the clouds.
ItemInfo_80000089_BgDescription:
Thinly sliced cured meat is layered atop sliced mushrooms and steamed for hours. The saltiness of the meat seeps into the mushrooms' natural sweetness, lifting the whole dish to something far greater than its parts.

Mengzhou has a long-standing tradition of curing meat to bring out deeper flavor. Among the cuts, locals prize the rose-colored core as the "Sizzling Cube." This dish lays that cube over White Jade Beauty mushrooms, hence the name "Sizzling Jade Stir-fry." When honored guests arrive, a plate of this fine delicacy is more than enough to delight them.
ItemInfo_80000090_BgDescription:
Fresh fish fillets are bathed in a sweet-and-sour glaze, then simmered over a low flame to bring out their delicate flavor. Though no crab ever touches the pot, the taste is remarkably true to the real thing.

This famous Yuan Fortress dish boasts a long history, though its reputation has waxed and waned with the passing generations. The recipe that now circulates across the Land of Xuanfang preserves the most widely embraced method, yet the truly authentic taste is known only to a few.
ItemInfo_80000091_BgDescription:
Steamed from a base of rice milk, these snow-white sponge cakes are shaped like a full moon, earning them the name "Little Snowy Moons." Soft and sweet, the pastry also goes by alternative names such as "Jade Plate" or "Water Moon Bun."

During Mengzhou's annual Waking Moon Festival, it has long been a tradition for every household to prepare these cakes in welcome of the rising moon. Soldiers stationed far from home in Xuanfang carried this custom with them, hoping that even if the same moon doesn't shine over both lands, their hearts might still meet in this shared moment of reunion.
ItemInfo_80000092_BgDescription:
Two varieties of fresh meat and seasonal bamboo shoots are finely scored in a chrysanthemum pattern, then flash-fried over a roaring flame. When the heat hits just right, all three ingredients curl up and bloom into a bright, glistening cascade of crimson.

This dish boasts an incredibly short cooking time, delivering a rich aroma and fiery kick that instantly stirs the appetite. In the Land of Xuanfang, locals often gauge a patient's recovery by their craving for the Stir-Fried Trio. If they can catch its scent and handle the heat, they're bound to be well on the mend.
ItemInfo_80000093_BgDescription:
A whole fowl is submerged in an aged stock and braised thoroughly over a low flame, basted again and again with the savory broth until the meat turns tender.

This dish is intensely spicy, yet the heat builds up rather than striking at first bite. First-timers are often fooled by its seemingly mild appearance, but by the time the waves of spice roll in, they are drenched in sweat, tongues burning as if they'd swallowed a wheel of fire. Rumor has it that an epicure who feared no spice once polished off three whole plates. Finishing his meal, he let out a satisfied cry: "Three birds, one hand—enough to seize every flavor under heaven." The room fell silent in awe, and the dish has borne the name ever since.
ItemInfo_80000094_BgDescription:
Minced meat is mixed with diced bamboo shoots and chili flakes, shaped into perfect spheres, and placed into a bamboo steamer to cook through. The finished meatballs gleam with a pleasing, glossy crimson hue. With each bite, a fragrant burst of meat and spice unfurls, revealing a texture that is soft yet chewy. Their luminous, pearl-like appearance has earned them the local name "Brocade Pearl Meatballs."

Round as they are, they speak of reunion. Red as they gleam, they carry wishes for prosperity. And that perfect hint of spice keeps this well-rounded flavor ever tasting plain.
ItemInfo_80000095_BgDescription:
Delicate fish balls, crafted from minced fish, are simmered together with tea leaves to form a refined soup. The tea buds offer a gentle bitterness while the fish balls lend a subtle sweetness. At first glance, the soup appears modest and unassuming, but a careful sip reveals a faint, lingering note of autumn that stays on the palate.

This soup traces its origins to Mengzhou, where it was initially made with an entirely different aquatic ingredient, one far fresher than tea leaves. When the recipe made its way here, however, that original ingredient was nowhere to be found, and the locals had no choice but to substitute it with tea. And so, as the soup meets the tongue—poised somewhere between the familiar and the foreign—it stirs a flood of memories all the way back home.
ItemInfo_80000096_BgDescription:
Fine noodles, thin as silver silk, are dropped into boiling water, blanched in an instant, then nestled neatly into a bowl. Large chunks of meat, slow-braised to a melt-in-your-mouth tenderness, rest atop the noodles. The broth, clarified to crystal clarity with White Jade Beauty mushrooms and rich stock, carries a faint, lingering whisper of cooking wine.

It is the most common meal you'll find across the Land of Xuanfang. Utterly ordinary in appearance, yet it delivers a depth of flavor that surprises with the very first bite. As some have put it: "The mildest flavors hold the truest essence. The ultimate delicacy is pure simplicity."
ItemInfo_80000097_BgDescription:
White Jade Beauty mushrooms and Climber Shoots are julienned and flash-fried in hot oil until their edges curl slightly. An Uncracked Jade egg mixture is then poured in and tossed gently until soft, delicate curds form, then finished with a scattering of Pavo Plums. With each sudden burst of berry juice, an intense, spicy aroma unfurls, instantly coaxing out the freshness of every ingredient.

Unbound by the traditional culinary methods, the Fillet Fairmaiden captures the true spirit of cooking. The essence of these premium ingredients seeps fully into the mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and egg curds, sending out a fragrance so mouthwatering that anyone who catches a whiff can't help but crave a taste.

ItemInfo_80001087_BgDescription:
Wax gourd and fresh crab meat are simmered together with an Uncracked Jade egg mixture in a tureen, creating rich, alternating layers of gold and jade. Stewed slowly in a rich broth, the wax gourd soaks up the full sweetness of the crab, while a delicate topping of finely minced ham adds a savory depth to the unfolding finish. Every spoonful feels like a conversation between the mountains and the sea.

The first time Suisui laid eyes on this soup in a small eatery, she was instantly captivated by its layers of jade-and-gold hue. One spoonful, and the fragrance unfurled across her tongue. From then on, she sent someone to buy takeout from the shop every single day. However, it was tucked away in a remote corner and saw few customers, teetering on the edge of closure and soon to be turned into a tea house. Without a second thought, Suisui marched in with a chest of Credit Shells and an acquisition contract, and set them down squarely in front of the shopkeeper.
ItemInfo_80001096_BgDescription:
The egg noodles Yangyang makes, tasting exactly as she remembers her mother's did.

Back in her hometown, Yangyang's schedule was always packed to the brim. Still unsure of where her path would lead, she was constantly trying to squeeze out every last second, desperate to add any edge that might carry her forward.  But no matter how late she came home from vocal lessons, walking back under a starlit sky, a steaming bowl of egg noodles was always waiting for her on the table. Sometimes there would be two bowls, which meant her father had also worked late into the night. And sometimes, there would be three, because her older sister, who was supposed to be fast asleep, would inevitably catch the scent of the noodles and coax her mother into making her a midnight meal.

To Yangyang, that bowl of egg noodles means home, love, and all the quiet warmth folded into everyday life.

It's the flavor that carried her all the way to where she is now, and the exact taste she wishes to pass on to someone special, someday.

ItemInfo_80001090_BgDescription:
Made with fresh live fish from the Luo River, this dish is gently poached over a low flame and dressed in a traditional sweet-and-sour sauce. It gleams a glossy red, its flesh silver-white at every cut—delicate on the tongue, with a bright tangy-sweetness. The recipe is an old one, and though no shortage of variations have appeared over the years, only the original may be called "Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar."
At the Waking Moon Festival in Yuan Fortress long ago, Qingxiao once tasted this dish at the famed restaurant Yuan's Flavors. Lanterns filled the city that night; dragons and fishes of light danced above the crowds, and every face wore a smile. A century later, fewer and fewer can cook it the way it tasted back then. Qingxiao has tried her own hand at it, but never managed to bring back the taste she remembers.
ItemInfo_80001091_BgDescription:
This snow-white steamed rice cake is round as a full moon, soft and springy, and scattered with candied green and red threads like twin rainbows fallen across snow. Hence the name "Moonlit Splendor." Lightly sweet and dense on the tongue, the fragrance of rice and sugar from it melts slowly between the teeth.
This confection is created by the wife of Jingran's Shifu, Granny Yanshu, and is his favorite. His little sister always says the cake is sickly sweet. Jingran disagrees, and every time he cups one in his hands and bites down, the satisfaction shows in his whole face.

ItemInfo_44010025_BgDescription:
Across Jinzhou, ancient buildings were traditionally built using wood, but it proved to be insufficient in meeting modern strength requirements. Hence, Jinzhou began to explore alternative building materials that could replicate the traditional wooden texture while providing sturdiness.
These Wood-textured Shards can be found throughout Jinzhou, with varying shapes and origins – from houses and shops to military camps and academies. Although uncovering the stories behind them is a challenging task, the Pioneer Association relentlessly pursues this endeavor. Each shard holds a piece of history waiting to be discovered.

ItemInfo_42601630_BgDescription: Legend has it that the Divine Fox once spent all Her divine power and became bound to the mortal world, all to keep Mengzhou's endless night alight. In commemoration, people inscribe the year's blessings upon Moon Lanterns and set them adrift as invitations, bidding the mirth-loving Divine Fox to share in mortal joys. The Bloom of Hearkening is said to have taken shape from the divine power She left behind, and thus resonates with the emotions of all living things: it wilts in sorrow, blushes in joy, and bursts open in wrath. Seeing it as an incarnation of the Divine Fox Herself, people often confide their hearts to it.
ItemInfo_42601640_BgDescription: Originally a common tree of Mengzhou, it was corrupted by the Evil Miasma's Miasmic Thunder and reduced to a charred, blackened stump, upon which red lightning can still be seen pulsing along its surface. Though the Huaxu Academy and the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs have confirmed it poses no immediate danger, its contamination by the Evil Miasma has made it a scar upon the land, and few dare approach. Whether it is the remains of the Evil Miasma or the breeding ground of a new calamity has yet to be determined.

ItemInfo_80001088_BgDescription:
Cloudward Stew prepared by Hsin. Fresh and rich broth, white as silk, with bamboo shoots meticulously cut into the delicate patterns of modular parts, and fresh vegetables carved into floral garnishes, presented in a jade bowl inscribed with a gold fox. The seasoning and heat are matched to perfection, exquisite beyond reproach.
According to legend, the original recipe of this dish derived from the guidance of Hsin the Moon Fox. Hsin naturally remembered it by heart, yet after tasting the many variations throughout the streets of Xuanfang, She discovered that the flavor would vary from household to household. This home cooking, brought forth from ordinary stoves, is sometimes rich, sometimes light, each unique in its own way, yet it is a taste that people, although separated, still hold dear in their hearts.
ItemInfo_80001095_BgDescription:
When Suoming first arrived at Xuanfang Hold, she came across a dish flavored with tea broth called "Memories of Autumn," which awakened memories of the white tea from home. It was Tangning who later told her that this dish originally used no tea at all, but due to the lack of its true ingredients locally, it was a traveling soul yearning for the taste who used tea as a substitute, thus giving it its present form.
Suoming then procured Huating white tea and personally remade the dish. The tea's fresh aroma gave it a delicate flavor, and from then on it frequently graced her table. Those under her command secretly lamented that her homesickness was difficult to dispel, which accounted for her singular fondness for the flavor. Yet to her, it was merely a preference for that fresh and clear taste, and perhaps, without intention, this dish had also retained within it the flavor of her homeland.

The world was full of small wonders that never failed to catch Her eye. One stroll down a lantern-lit street, and before She knew it, Her hands would be full of snacks and trinkets.

She once found this troubling. Such behavior wasn't part of a Sentinel's prescribed logic. Why did it keep happening? She had more important duties to attend to, and perhaps She ought to curb such impulses.

But during that long-awaited Waking Moon Festival, She found herself turning over a small jingling ornament, caught in indecision. The golden-eyed person beside her only smiled, gave a small nod, and bought it for Her before She could make up Her mind.

InfoDisplay_37000004_Title: Research Outline on the Homeward Fin: Several Conjectures on Its Form and Functions
InfoDisplay_37000004_Text:
Classification: Repair-type Autopuppet
I. Overview
...
 
II. Form
...
 
III. Behavioral Logic
One of the Homeward Fin's defining traits is frequency dispersal.
Under normal conditions, this dispersal is controllable, and the unit emits its own frequency outward on a stable, periodic basis. Such emission can heal human wounds and repair Autopuppet components.
In a disordered state, however, the same emission inflicts a measurable degree of negative effect on the recipient. Tests indicate that a single Homeward Fin poses little danger.
...
 
IV. Cluster Mechanism
When its own frequency is thrown into disarray by excessive dispersal, a Homeward Fin will form a cluster with others of its kind, resonating with them to return to a stable state.
 
V. Outstanding Questions
The source that triggers the disordered state remains unclear. It is conjectured to relate to shifts within the Heart of Frost.
The correlation between cluster scale and energy resupply efficiency remains unverified.
...
InfoDisplay_37000005_Text:
A letter home, stained with blood. The corners are uncreased. Someone handled this with great care.

Father and Mother,

I hope these words find you the way I would, if I could. The fighting has been fierce, and I haven't had a quiet hour to myself in days. Don't be cross with me for the silence.

Father, look after yourself. Wrap up warm now the cold's setting in. Mother's old ailment hasn't let up, and since I can't be there to sit with her, ask my sister-in-law to carry more of the load. And if Bao still wants to learn to fight, let him. Growing into a soldier is no bad thing.

Staying behind to cover the retreat was the camp's call. We all agreed to it. I've made my peace. I just don't know how to tell the two of you.

I'm well. Serving under Watcher Wuluo has taught me more than I can put into words. Half the camp said she was too stubborn for her own good, and at first I agreed. But you don't follow someone this long without seeing what's underneath. She keeps track of every sick and wounded comrade. When rations were handed down last night, she gave her share to the wounded and didn't say a word. I'd follow her anywhere.

Father, Mother, if it goes badly for me out there, don't wear yourselves out grieving. I'm a Xuanfang Warden. Xuanfang is the line I hold, and behind it stand Jinzhou and Mengzhou.

I have no regrets.

The sparrows outside have started up again. I'll leave off here. Please don't worry about me.
InfoDisplay_37000006_Title: Field Record on the Stasis Phenomenon of the Fortress and Gorges War
InfoDisplay_37000006_Text:
...The ley fault here is unlike ordinary battlefield remains. Vegetation, dust, even fallen arrows, all hold perfectly still, untouched by so much as a trace of decay through all the years since.
Extraordinary. Inexplicable.
(This appears to be a very old record.)
...
 
Since the stasis is shaped by the Civilization Capsule, the oddities shown are still beyond our reckoning. Our own learning is limited, but we have the benefit of many years of study. In ten years, or a hundred, these uncertainties may yet be resolved.
(We have since determined that the anomalies are bound up with the emotions Lady Hsin projected, and we are already able to dispel them using a Realm Key. If only you could see it...)

InfoDisplay_37000007_Text:
Only you could have found this.
You were in the Land of Xuanfang, I knew. But the road called us each elsewhere, and old friends must sometimes pass each other by.
From here, I press deeper into Mengzhou to settle a duty I left unfulfilled. What becomes of that land is not for you to carry. Should the winds rise again, you and I are sure to meet.
As for Muyu, put him out of your mind. I have his kernel. A man with no grave to lie in will make no more waves.
That is all. Jianghu roads stretch wide. Till we meet again.

AdvertisingStory_3610201_SubTitle: Chapter IV Act IV - <word>Simulacrum of the Heart</word>
AdvertisingStory_3610201_ContentText: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread through the city. To uncover the cause—and to find Hsin, who has not shown Herself for a long time—you enter the Simulacrum Nexus deep within the Sanctum, together with Suoming, an Intendant who claims to have been sent by the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs in search of Hsin the Moon Fox...
AdvertisingStory_3610202_ContentText: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule shards.
AdvertisingRegion_3610301_ContentText: Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe, otherwise known as the Manifold Sanctum, governing the foundational order that keeps the city running.
AdvertisingRegion_3610302_ContentText: The entrance to the Simulacrum Nexus. Forest paths twist and intertwine, shifting with each heartscape. Without guidance, those who enter may find themselves returning to where they began, without even realizing it…
AdvertisingRegion_3610303_ContentText: A stable inner realm within the Simulacrum Nexus. Mengxuan Vale is home to the Celestials, while the mountains, rivers, and living things of Mengzhou follow the Sanctum's order here, forming a world of their own between dream and reality…
AdvertisingRegion_3610304_ContentText: A realm within the Simulacrum Nexus shaped by memories of the Waking Moon Festival. Passing light turns across jade. Flickering shadows become stars. The Waking Moon's old glory endures in memory, scattered still throughout the streets and lanes…
AdvertisingRegion_3610305_ContentText: A realm within the Simulacrum Nexus shaped by memories of the old Land of Xuanfang. Snow settles on buried blades. Old cities stir beneath the frost. Obsessions never untangled, doubts never laid to rest—all held in frozen stillness.
AdvertisingRegion_3610306_ContentText: A realm within the Simulacrum Nexus shaped by memories of unresolved regrets. A broken shuttle, long silent. But the warmth of old ties remains. Unfinished wishes and paths never taken all rest here, beside the Cloud Shuttle.
AdvertisingRegion_3610307_ContentText: A realm within the Simulacrum Nexus shaped by memories of Xuanfang's flourishing flora. Green fills courtyards. Blooms follow footsteps. All is tranquil and at ease, yet echoes of the past seem to linger here as well…
AdvertisingActivity_3610601_ContentText: With Encore's help, the Second Coming of Solaris has built a Wooly Stage for the Cubie Wars. On this stage, the Cubie Warriors will make use of magical items to wage a fierce battle!
AdvertisingActivity_3610602_ContentText: The latest flagship offering from Second Coming of Solaris! Come experience the fun of tapping Echo Pieces away!
AdvertisingActivity_3610603_ContentText: Lisha, apprentice Artisan, reporting for duty!
AdvertisingActivity_3610604_ContentText:
Here Mengzhou's mountains and rivers, its woods and wilds, meet its pavilions and towers, the very place the people of Mengzhou, bound to one another across time, make their homes and live out their lives. Peace and quiet, ardor and flame, despondency and sorrow, every feeling there is settles into a Heart Realm of its own, continuing without end. In this small world, the Court of Savantae and Hsin are shaping the face of Mengzhou anew.
This is the Simulacrum Nexus.
AdvertisingActivity_3610605_ContentText: Hsin has arranged a task for Suoming, asking you to join her in recording the sights of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. A trip "down memory lane" that draws out the long-sealed memories of the Ten Seals Covenant...

AdvertisingActivity_3610606_ContentText: Lollo Logistics has once again partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present you the bountiful campaign, Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang!
AdvertisingActivity_3610607_ContentText: The Waking Moon Festival begins right on schedule, its lanterns bright as day. Before you stands a mysterious stall... AdvertisingSystem_3610701_ContentText:
In Version 3.7, all unequipped, non-upgraded Echoes in your Echo Backpack that share the same Echo type, Sonata Effect, and Mainstat will automatically stack into a single backpack item. Each backpack item can hold up to 999 Echoes.

*During auto-stacking, your Echoes will be marked according to the following priority: Locked > Discarded > Unmarked.
AdvertisingSystem_3610702_ContentText: Handheld and Selfie Modes are now available, with several adjustable poses and expressions added to Selfie Mode. Tripod Mode now features a more freely controllable drone perspective. In addition, the Camera System now offers expanded camera tools, including Reference Lines, Quick Focus, and Lens Templates, making it easier to compose shots and fine-tune the image. You can also adjust environmental settings such as Time, Weather, and Foliage Wind Direction in the Environment tab.
AdvertisingSystem_3610703_ContentText: In Version 3.7, you can replay main quests from Version 1.1 - Thaw of Eons, the Moon-Chasing Festival event from Version 1.2 - In the Turquoise Moonglow, and main quests from Version 1.3 - To the Shore's End in Journey Log.
AdvertisingSystem_3610704_ContentText:
A new 3D Team Setup Mode is now available, allowing you to switch between 2D and 3D display modes based on your needs.
The number of team setups has been increased to 20. Team Management is also now available, allowing you to quickly reorder and name your team setups for easier organization.
AdvertisingSystem_3610705_ContentText:
Tiered Client Resource Downloads will be available for the PC, iOS, and Android versions of the game. The PC version supports downloads in three resource tiers: UHD, HD, and SD, while the mobile versions support two: HD and SD. The resource package size and graphics quality vary by tier. You can choose the tier that best suits your device specifications and needs.

*As this optimization involves significant changes to the game client, Tiered Client Resource Downloads will initially be launched as a limited test. As we gradually roll out the test, the dev team will closely monitor your feedback and continue to optimize the feature. Stay tuned for more information on this feature.
