ZYHSGST_1_1: Fuling... are you feeling all right now?
ZYHSGST_1_2: Mhm, don't worry about me. The new medicine is actually working really well. I feel surprisingly energetic now!
ZYHSGST_1_3: That's a relief... Kuiren mentioned that anyone who watches the Carriage Procession will be blessed with good fortune.
ZYHSGST_1_4: Just let me know if you get tired, okay? I can carry you back.
ZYHSGST_1_5: I-I'm fine, really... The doctor said I need to walk and stretch my legs anyway—Ah... look over there, Wuli! Isn't that beautiful?
ZYHSGST_10_1: Mmh... this is incredible! Seriously, you have to try it—Blegh!
ZYHSGST_10_2: Are you serious? You're literally throwing up! And tears are streaming down your face!
ZYHSGST_10_3: I just choked! Come on, I'd never lie to you! This is good stuff, I swear!
ZYHSGST_10_4: Really? Well, just one bite then... Blegh!
ZYHSGST_11_1: Oh, no... I spent all my pocket money. I'm so gonna get it this time...
ZYHSGST_11_3: A Moon Fox lantern, two <ano=candied fruit>Tanghulu</ano> skewers, and a pack of Moonlight Sparklers...
ZYHSGST_11_4: I gave the lantern to Yishu, and the Tanghulu... I bought them for Mom and Dad, but they were so tasty I ate them...
ZYHSGST_11_5: I promised Mom I'd save my money... What if I say a big gust of wind blew the money away? Do you think she'd believe me?
ZYHSGST_11_7: Maybe you should just tell her the truth.
ZYHSGST_11_9: I can't... Mom's got a short fuse...
ZYHSGST_12_1: Zhumei! Th-there's something I've wanted to tell you for a long time! I, uh... well...
ZYHSGST_12_3: I mean... you... you look... really pretty today.
ZYHSGST_12_4: ...Oh, thank you. You look quite sharp yourself, Maqing.
ZYHSGST_12_5: So... was there anything else you wanted to tell me?
ZYHSGST_12_6: Oh! Yes! I, uh... I've always...
ZYHSGST_12_8: Always... wanted to take you out to dinner at Yuan's Flavors!
ZYHSGST_13_1: Sir, the storyteller's legends are so different from what's written in our history books...
ZYHSGST_14_1: Say, if Paragon Qingxiao and Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox actually went all out, who do you think would win?
ZYHSGST_14_2: Is that even a question? Lady Hsin is a Sentinel. Who in this world is more powerful than a Sentinel?
ZYHSGST_14_3: But I heard Paragon Qingxiao can summon countless swords hundreds of meters tall! I'd say she's got a fighting chance.
ZYHSGST_14_4: Oh yeah? Lady Hsin can conjure an entire city out of thin air and drop it right on her head. Boom.
ZYHSGST_14_5: But then the Paragon could summon a vast formation of giant swords and channel her Sword Intent into an impenetrable shield!
ZYHSGST_14_6: ...Then Lady Hsin could just turn all of Xuanfang Hold into one giant Autopuppet that swallows the Paragon whole, swords and all!
ZYHSGST_14_7: ...Sure, but then the Paragon would make her swords go wild inside its belly and cut her way out from the inside!
ZYHSGST_14_8: Then... then Lady Hsin would just conjure another city!
ZYHSGST_14_9: Would there even be a Land of Xuanfang left after all that...
ZYHSGST_15_1: Mhm... This year's Waking Moon Brew... is so good...
ZYHSGST_16_1: It's a quiet Autopuppet, but somehow, you feel like it's observing you.
ZYHSGST_16_3: I see what you're doing here.
ZYHSGST_16_15: It's good to see you again. Yes, it's me—Leyue.
ZYHSGST_16_16: You vanished right in front of me last time. I thought you were...
ZYHSGST_2_1: "I am Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox. A sudden crisis has struck the Sanctum, leaving me trapped in its deepest depths..."
ZYHSGST_2_2: "You have been chosen to assist me in reclaiming Xuanfang Hold. As my next Resonator, you must..."
ZYHSGST_2_3: ...Send 80,000 Shell Credits to rebuild the Celestial Ring Formation? Wait, this is obviously a scam! Tell me you didn't actually send them money!
ZYHSGST_2_5: By the way... do you mind buying me lunch today? I'm... a little strapped for cash lately.
ZYHSGST_3_1: Legend has it that the Ministry of Development once had a prodigy on their hands. One with the rare talent to command the mountains and oceans. She even built the entire Bird-Return Garden in a single night!
ZYHSGST_3_3: She just vanished into thin air one day...
ZYHSGST_3_4: Left nothing behind but a tuft of tail fur on the blueprints. That's when it hit them... she was Hsin the Moon Fox in disguise, come to help the Artisans crack what they couldn't!
ZYHSGST_3_5: Yeah, yeah, keep making things up. She's a Sentinel! Hsin the Moon Fox doesn't shed.
ZYHSGST_4_1: The Waking Moon Festival is finally here... When will Lady Sentinel arrive?
ZYHSGST_4_2: Grandma... Hsin the Moon Fox isn't coming. Just try not to think about it.
ZYHSGST_4_3: You always said She'd come, but She never shows. Those old legends are just made-up stories.
ZYHSGST_4_4: It's different this time. She will be here.
ZYHSGST_4_5: Someone saw Her walking down from the Sanctum alongside that great hero who saved Jinzhou!
ZYHSGST_4_6: Everything is going to get better... for all of Xuanfang.
ZYHSGST_4_7: ...Xuanfang's been doing just fine on its own, even with Hsin the Moon Fox gone!
ZYHSGST_4_8: I'm gonna see what this long-lost Sentinel looks like for myself...
ZYHSGST_5_1: I heard the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs has sent someone to the Land of Xuanfang... Think you might know a thing or two about it?
ZYHSGST_5_2: Of course I do! They say that Intendant is no small figure, plus she's got history with Lady Hsin...
ZYHSGST_5_3: She dresses all in black, is always seen with an umbrella, and comes and goes without a trace. A mystery through and through, and worth ten of any other. Wherever she passes, folks can't help but stare...
ZYHSGST_5_5: That's just the word on the street.
ZYHSGST_6_1: First time at the Waking Moon Festival? Well, well, you've found the perfect guide!
ZYHSGST_6_2: For daytime, I'd say the Carriage Procession and a taste of Waking Moon Brew are a must. And by night? Go watch the fish lantern dances and make a wish with the Water Moon Lanterns. Trust me, it's a sight you won't want to miss!
ZYHSGST_6_3: So, how about it? Need a local guide? Honest prices, satisfaction guaranteed. I can even wait in line for you at Yuan's Flavors!
ZYHSGST_6_4: ...No need? That's quite alright! Then how about these Xuanfang mechanism models? The craftsmanship is exquisite. They make perfect souvenirs!
ZYHSGST_6_5: Care for a look? Only 500 Shell Credits!
ZYHSGST_7_1: Alright, everyone! Today I'm gonna show you the must-try dishes at the Waking Moon Festival!
ZYHSGST_7_2: First up: Cloudward Stew. Savory, packed with flavor... Mmm, this is sooo good!
ZYHSGST_7_3: Next on the list: Stir-Fried Trio. Spicy, savory, perfect with rice. Yum yum!
ZYHSGST_7_4: Now for Mengzhou's No. 1 pastry: Moon Fox Rice Cake. Say less, people. This one's a solid ten out of ten!
ZYHSGST_7_5: Alright, now I'm taking you to try the signature dish at Yuan's Flavors. Stay tuned!
ZYHSGST_8_1: N-no way... The fourth and fifth volumes of "Meteorite Tiger Blade"?!
ZYHSGST_8_2: Hehe. A friend from Jinzhou came in for the Waking Moon Festival and brought them along by chance. I knew you were dying to read them, so I kept them right here just for you.
ZYHSGST_8_3: I can't believe my wish on the Moon Lantern came true so fast... Thank you SOOO much!
ZYHSGST_9_1: Don't gobble the Water Moon Cakes straight from the steamer. While they're still hot, add a scoop of ice cream and a drizzle of plum sauce...
ZYHSGST_9_2: You'll get a cool, creamy richness on the first bite, followed by the warm, pillowy cake. You'll enjoy that lovely contrast while the plum's tart bite cuts through the sweetness...
ZYHSGST_9_3: Just try it. One bite, and you'll be too busy enjoying it to talk.
ZYHSGST_9_4: You must be a true gourmet... Now I've gotta try one too!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1_1:
[Xianling Village Farmhouse] Grand Opening Special: half-price on everything! Be the first to taste our Waking Moon Feast. Even the Golden-Eyed One swears by it!
Reply "Unsub" to unsubscribe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1_2: But I haven't tried it yet.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1_4: But I haven't tried it yet.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1_5: Shoot, did this actually go to {PlayerName}'s Terminal...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1_7: Don't go, valued patron! This text reaching you must be fate. Come give us a try! You won't regret it!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1_10: [Auto-reply] We'd love to have you here!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_10_1: (First the Autopuppets going rogue, then the grim omen from the Providence Lock, and now the Intendant coming in person.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_10_2: (No matter what happens to Xuanfang Hold... I will keep them safe, whatever it takes.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_11_1: You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_1: You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_2: I am Jiqing. Thank you for your service. Ten years in the Hold is no small thing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_3: It's nothing. But may I ask, do you have any insight into what she might be thinking?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_5: I don't doubt the Intendant's competence. I'm sure she can handle whatever comes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_6: But... she doesn't feel for Xuanfang Hold the way I do. And those rumors about her, two hundred years back...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_7: I'm afraid she'll sacrifice the Hold's best interests for the Ministry's ends.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_8: Seems you're not very familiar with those rumors, or else I doubt you'd think that.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_9: I know that everyone who fought beside her back then were all—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_12_10: Easy now. Speak with Intendant Suoming yourself. If you have concerns, voice them directly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_13_1: (If the Intendant truly means to leave the Hold to its fate, then I'll have to...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_3: Not long ago, my Providence Lock opened on its own. Following its guidance, I went in secret to the Manifold Sanctum and measured the Sentinel's frequency.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_4: There's no mistaking it. Her frequency is fading fast. I fear the Sanctum could fall at any moment.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_5: I see. Your years of reporting to the Ministry on all that has occurred here are duly noted.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_6: All of it, exactly as you foresaw a century ago.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_7: I understand your final charge. I will deliver it into "Hsin's" hands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_8: Forgive me. In the end, the promise went unkept.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_9: No matter. From the day we met, I have known you gave everything you had.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_10: And the promise is only deferred. A hundred years is nothing. Without you in Mengzhou, the Ministry will have much to do.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_11: Then it all falls to you, Suoming.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_12: You needn't say that. This was all part of your design, wasn't it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_13: Not design. Only faith. Faith in you... and in Her.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_15: The Manifold Sanctum and Hsin the Moon Fox are one and the same. I must see the truth for myself before it falls.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_16: Only the three of us will go, lest we rouse the "snake." We should not draw attention.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_2_1: Say, on this trip to the village, we're not having that same stuff again, are we?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_2_3: Eugh, yeah. Besides that, Xuanfang's full of good eats. Brocade Pearl Meatballs, Stir-Fried Trio, Jade Mushroom Soup... Slurrrp! Aww, now my tummy's rumbling again...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_2_4: Abby, your appetite is always right on cue.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_2_5: Heheh. C'mon, let's go grab a meal!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_1: Come one, come all! You won't regret—Oh! {PlayerName}, is that you?! Welcome, welcome!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_2: Our farmhouse restaurant is finally open for business! Here to sample the new menu?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_3: Your spam ad blew up my Terminal...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_4: I'm here for that Waking Moon Feast even the Golden-Eyed One swears by.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_5: Wha—? Ah, well... haha, sorry about that! Today's meal is on us, so try anything you like!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_6: Ha, you're a funny one! Ahaha...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_7: My honest apologies! We just thought it sounded catchier that way. Your meal today's on us, so try anything you like!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_3_9: That'd be our new Moon Fox Rice Cakes, no question. They're Lady Hsin's favorite treat!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_1: So you're really set on moving to Mengzhou?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_2: Of course! Once the Censure Courts clear out the last of the Tacet Discords, Xuanfang Hold will have served its purpose and collapse. We've known that since day one, haven't we?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_3: It can't just crumble overnight, though. The Ministry of War would give notice first, wouldn't they?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_4: Oh, please... Think about all the strange things that've been happening. Sit around waiting for an official notice, and you'll be caught with your trousers down.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_5: And with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs sending people now... something big's brewing. You can count on it...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_6: Anyway, better to be ahead of the curve than buried under it. When things go sideways, who knows what else might happen...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_7: That's... kind of jumping at shadows, isn't it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_8: Ugh, you never see past your own nose. Forget it. Eat up, eat up.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_9: (Xuanfang Hold collapsing... at a time like this? And the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_10: (I remember their reach extends all across Huanglong... If they're showing up now, it must involve Hsin in some way.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_11: (Oh... ran straight into {Male=him;Female=her} the second I stepped out.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_12: (Given my position, I really ought to speak with {Male=him;Female=her}, but—)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_13: (Better see Intendant Suoming first. Safer to let her decide how to approach the Arbiter.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4_14:
At a tea stall, you overhear patrons trading hushed rumors that Xuanfang Hold is on the verge of collapse. They note that the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs has sent people into the Land of Xuanfang, surely a sign that something big is brewing. You suspect they must be here for Hsin the Moon Fox.
 
Unnoticed behind you, Tangning of the Ministry passes by, heading to report to Intendant Suoming.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_5_1: (Last time I saw Intendant Suoming, I was still a fresh recruit.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_6_1: Tangning? Well, look at you. All dressed up.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_1: Tangning? Well, look at you. All dressed up.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_2: Dressed up? Feels like a plain old work uniform to me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_3: You? Work? I only ever see you loafing about the Hold, teasing birds, sipping tea, gabbing with anyone who listen.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_4: Ouch. You make me sound useless... even if you're not wrong. Anyway, I'm off. Gotta go see the boss.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_5: To be honest, I'm a little nervous. Heard she once ousted the local officials back home and took over herself...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_6: Is this job of yours above board? Sounds like you work for a tyrant.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_7: I just worry we won't see eye to eye. That what matters to me... might mean nothing to her.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_8: What's with the doom and gloom? You'll be fine, I know it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_9: Remember that rogue Autopuppet that smashed into my house? You took it down with a yawn while fixing your hair.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_10: I had no idea I was that good. And are you telling me to pick a fight with her...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_7_11: Haha. Tell you what, I just made some Moon Fox Rice Cakes. Bring them along as a gift for your scary boss.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_8_1: (I heard Intendant Suoming dislikes anything bitter-tasting. These rice cakes might just be...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_9_4: Aw! You've been working hard, haven't you? For that, half these rice cakes are yours!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_9_5: Go easy on them, though. You just got better.

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_172_29:
Suoming and the Ninth Seal reach the end of the road. "Hsin the Moon Fox" steps forward, coaxing Suoming with honeyed words to surrender the Vermillion Locks and let go of her obsession with the Ten Seals. Suoming answers with the guilt she has carried for two hundred years—it was her decision, in the campaign to destroy the "Evil Miasma" back home, that cost the Ninth Seal her life. The Ninth Seal herself urges Suoming to let the past go and hand over the Locks.

At those words, Suoming reveals she has long known this is not the true Ninth Seal, and that this "Hsin the Moon Fox" is Suhsin in disguise. She stops holding back and strikes without hesitation. As Suhsin's form dissolves, the Ninth Seal who walked beside her all this way drops to the ground, a doll with nothing behind its eyes.

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>I still remember the first time I saw a Xuanling Bird. It recognized my true identity almost instantly.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>It told me that in all of Xuanfang, there was no one left who could understand its <ano=Streams>words</ano>. Only I could commune with its frequency.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_3: <color=XinyuehuSub>Back then, I had not yet mastered the proper cadence of a Sentinel. I hid from the public eye as much as I could.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_4: <color=XinyuehuSub>And the Xuanling brought me, day after day, the beauty of all four seasons.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_5: That was Hsin's voice... Is She here?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_6: You call out, but receive no answer. Instead, the Xuanling Bird nearby hops around with nimble steps, looking curious.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_7: This is only an echo of a memory, just like before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_8: If this is the memory of her first encounter with a Xuanling Bird, then Hsin must have just arrived in Xuanfang...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_9: This is Her at the very start of Xuanfang Hold's construction.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_176_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>"Repair the Civilization Capsule. Build Xuanfang Hold." That was the first mandate that surfaced in my mind when I gained consciousness.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_176_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>But I had been severed from my true self too hastily... I lacked the strength to conjure a city from nothing.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_176_3: <color=XinyuehuSub>I had no choice but to build the first prototype of the Lexicon Axis and reclaim my power as Sentinel little by little.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_176_4: <color=XinyuehuSub>I made myself the "origin" of this city. True to my pact with the Court of Savantae, I provided them with the knowledge and technology needed to raise these walls.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_176_5: <color=XinyuehuSub>I dispersed my power throughout the city to manage the workings of every modular part.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_176_6: <color=XinyuehuSub>The world sings praises of how Hsin the Moon Fox descended upon Xuanfang with a celestial city in tow... yet no one knew how nervous I was back then.</color>

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_179_3: Really? You think I have it in me?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_179_4: <color=XinyuehuSub>He was a brave soul. Even when cornered by Tacet Discords, he did not flinch in front of the children.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_179_5: <color=XinyuehuSub>After I saved him, I felt compelled to say something... something that sounded like a true Sentinel's words.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_179_6: <color=XinyuehuSub>He believed me. They believed me. Even their descendants believed me...</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_179_7: <color=XinyuehuSub>He did indeed become a legendary Xuanfang Warden. So did his children after him.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_179_8: <color=XinyuehuSub>But I... I could never truly calculate their futures, nor guarantee their hopes would come to pass.</color>

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_180_3: <color=XinyuehuSub>Thus, during the early days of the city's construction, I spent my time fighting to purge the festering filth.</color>

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_181_2: Did the Civilization Capsule's blueprint and Xuanfang's data get merged together?

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_182_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>For this, I had to separate my processing core to serve as the cornerstone of Xuanfang Hold's operations.</color>

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_183_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>...To think those clumsy first attempts of mine would one day be called "miracles" in the eyes of humanity.</color>

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_185_1: Her movements... are much heavier now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_186_1: The engineering in this blueprint... Haha... Without the Sentinel, I could have spent a lifetime studying and never grasped a fraction of its brilliance!

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_187_4: <color=XinyuehuSub>They... had the brilliant gift of distilling wild, abstract hypotheses into logic and formula, the very language of human reason.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_187_5: <color=XinyuehuSub>I could see their longings. I could see how desperately they fought to leave behind a legacy.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_187_6: <color=XinyuehuSub>Watching them, I began to realize... Though this city was born from knowledge not of this age, it was still their hands that were building it.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_187_7: <color=XinyuehuSub>And so, the "systems" they built gradually took the place of my own "perception."</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_187_8: <color=XinyuehuSub>My power was once rootless. But now, it had found soil. And it was beginning to grow.</color>

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_187_10: Our construction efficiency will surge by another thirty percent!

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_4: <color=XinyuehuSub>The joy on their faces was real. And the happier they were, the less I understood...</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_5: You do realize that the faster Xuanfang Hold is completed... the sooner you—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_6: ...The sooner we become Celestials, bound to this city forever?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_8: Lady Sentinel, to gaze upon absolute truth, what regret could we possibly have, even in death?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_9: <color=XinyuehuSub>I heard them say that a thousand times. I thought this time, surely, I'd be convinced. Just as the true Sentinel had been once.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_10: Since we are ahead of schedule, you are dismissed from the workshop for today. Take a walk in the city.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_12: It is decided. Go see the land that your own ingenuity is bringing to life.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_14: <color=XinyuehuSub>That was the first time I ever gave them an order. I wanted their lives to be more than just an obsession with the unknown.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_15: <color=XinyuehuSub>The city shouldn't just exist only as a legacy they leave behind.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_16: <color=XinyuehuSub>It should hold their footsteps. It should remember their joy... I wanted them to love the city they built.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_17: <color=XinyuehuSub>Wishing for such things... does it make me more like the Sentinel? Or less?</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_18: Hsin... you are simply being yourself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_194_1: That Artisan helped open the way forward.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_195_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>By the time the Xuanling brought me the message, Qingxiao had already purged those Tacet Discords.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_195_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>That was the first time I met her. I could see the doubts clouding her heart, but the Way she sought was never meant to be detached from the mortal world.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_196_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>When I learned she was staying in a ruined temple up on the mountain, I asked my Xuanling to visit her often on my behalf.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_196_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>...I wanted her to see the vibrant world that I saw.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_198_2: Did Hsin lose some of Her memories?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_198_3: <color=XinyuehuSub>...There's so much to do... I can't stop here.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_199_1: This is... the last processing core.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_200_2: Xuanfang Hold's defense formations... Are they being hacked?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_201_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>This area has suffered the worst of the Fractsidus's corruption.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_203_2: Lady Hsin... if I truly have the courage to fight for Xuanfang...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_203_3: Then I will not betray your trust. My family stands behind me. I will not retreat!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_203_4: Thank you, Lady Sentinel... for bending the rules for us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_203_5: The Waking Moon Festival in Xuanfang Hold is even more beautiful than I ever imagined.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_203_6: Very well. If this is your wish, I will guard Xuanfang at all costs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_203_7: But... this land without you will forever be incomplete.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_203_8: There are so many people waiting for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_204_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>So many people... are waiting for me...</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>Since then, my remaining power could only sustain a brief manifestation once a year.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>I became the fabled Sentinel who appeared only during the grand festivals.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_3: <color=XinyuehuSub>When the morning bell rang, I was there.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_4: <color=XinyuehuSub>When the evening drum fell, I had to leave.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_5: <color=XinyuehuSub>But I wanted to be with them every day.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_6: <color=XinyuehuSub>To watch the dawn creep over their rooftops.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_7: <color=XinyuehuSub>To watch the chimney smoke melt into the twilight.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_8: <color=XinyuehuSub>I wanted to breathe alongside this city, witnessing the flow of time with its people—</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_9: <color=XinyuehuSub>I thought our days would only grow brighter as Xuanfang neared completion... I had never imagined that those busy, precious days...</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_10: <color=XinyuehuSub>Would become the weight on the other side of the scales...</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_205_11:
Over the course of Xuanfang Hold's construction, Hsin overdraws Her computational power and grows weaker and weaker, until She can only manifest briefly at the Waking Moon Festival to share in the people's joy.

Slowly, she comes to love Xuanfang Hold and the people within it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_1: ...Since the shift change two nights ago, Ovathrax launched a surprise raid at Desorock Highland, pushing straight toward the Clouded Cliffs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_2: It's broken our front lines and is nearing Yuan Fortress. Based on the Outriders' reports, it will reach the gates in thirty minutes.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_3: The Threnodian clearly knew about Xuanfang Hold's construction... and planned this raid strategically. The Tacet Discords' assault is fierce. They've reached the mountain gates. We've already...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_7: Lady Hsin? Are you with me?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_8: ...Is there anyone left who can retreat?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_9: A message came from the Central Plains. Only two words—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_11: We are holding here to establish a second line of defense. Ensure the civilians and critical mechanisms can evacuate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_12: Lady Hsin, as long as you're here, we still stand a chance. There will be a future for Xuanfang. Please—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_13: You want me to leave and fight another day, don't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_14: I understand your intent, but... my answer is the same as yours. The same two words.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_16: Every moment I stay is one more life I can save.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_18: Enough. That is final. What is the status of the civilians?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_19: Most have been evacuated, but some remain trapped near Yuan Fortress.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_20: The perimeter is swarming with monsters summoned by Ovathrax. With our current forces... a full breakout is impossible.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_21: But there are weak points. We can still carve a path through.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_22: Prioritize the civilians. Notify all units...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_23: In the name of Hsin the Moon Fox... In the name of the Sentinel of this land, follow my command. I will ensure everyone lives to see tomorrow.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_25: Wait. Before you go, tell me your name.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_26: I am <ano=Feather-Brought>Yuxian</ano>. My mother told me a Xuanling Bird flew by when I was born, so she gave me this name. An interesting coincidence.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_27: Yuxian... Good. I will remember it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_28: In this outbreak, the odds are slim. The least I can do is carry your names with me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_29: Remember: no matter what, I stand with you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_30: ...Understood. Lady Hsin, it is time for me to return to the battlefield.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_31: When you first arrived, that boy was barely seven. Now, he looks like a true "pillar" of the force.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_32: And you, Little Fox? The enemy is at the gates, Jinzhou's affairs remain unresolved, and the true Sentinel is nowhere to be found.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_33: The Threnodian knew our moves from the start. Waiting is death. Fighting is death. Even you, in your innocence, must see this is a stalemate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_34: Even if death awaits us either way, I cannot sit by.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_35: Even if Ovathrax did not come today, it would eventually. We built Xuanfang to fight it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_36: All I can do is respond to the turn of battle and deploy Autopuppets as needed. At the very least, the civilians must be evacuated.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_37: The battlefield shifts in a breath. Even with your Prism of Fate to see it all, relaying orders to every flank at once is impossible.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_38: That's exactly why you are here, isn't it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_39: ...Little Fox, have you thought this through?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_41: Then I will watch the battlefield for you and help you relay your commands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_42: Some of the civilians are still trapped... We must prioritize their safety.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_44: These monsters have no mind of their own. They blindly pursue "people"...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_48: Well done, Little Fox. The monsters are withdrawing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_49: Xuanling, tell everyone to stay hidden and move away from the Tacet Discords.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_50: Good. Now the trapped citizens can escape.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_51: How is our communication with Mingting? Any news?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_52: The distress signal went out. But even at top speed, they are still five days away.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_54: The situation at the Gorges of Spirits is no better. We have to rely on these Autopuppets...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_56: Xuanling, tell everyone the civilians should be safe now. As for the rest... If it comes to it, save yourself first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_58: I know. Xuanfang is the bridge between Mengzhou and the Jinzhou of the future. It cannot fall.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_59: Yuan Fortress is the choke point. Once it falls, all of Xuanfang becomes as fragile as paper against the swarms.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_60: I will find a way. If necessary... you know, I am also "Hsin the Moon Fox."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_61: Still not enough... I have to find another way...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_63: What... There are still people who haven't left?!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_65: The Warden Commander asked me to deliver this message.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_67: He said Yuxian passed on your orders. They each found stones and carved their names into them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_68: He has also organized the Artisans and Wardens to move to other sectors.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_69: He said... as long as you are here, and as long as the Lexicon Axis you established stands, even on scorched earth, Xuanfang still has a future.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_71: No. Xuanling, tell him not to do anything stupid!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_74: You said you would stand with the people of Xuanfang, didn't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_75: They, in turn, stand with the Sentinel who guards this land.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_77: Little Fox, they all believe in you... We have no time for despair.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_78: Most of the civilians were evacuated. Now we should help the Artisans still out there on the battlefield.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_79: Before the explosion, Ruoyun relocated them all. I've marked their locations for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_81: Pull yourself together, Little Fox. Who are you pulling that long face for?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_83: There were seven thousand souls here. You saved most of them amidst a relentless attack. What more do you want?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_84: Wake up! You keep insisting you're also "Hsin the Moon Fox," remember?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_85: What about the rest of the people? Let them die? They're all waiting for the Sentinel's commands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_87: Tell me, what do you want, Little Fox?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_88: I want them all to escape and live.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_89: Xuanling, how much can you see?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_90: Not much. The Threnodian's influence is too strong. Most of my companions can barely fly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_91: It's alright. Evacuate the front lines. Try to find survivors along the way and guide them to me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_92: We only need to hold until the last of them gather. Then I will create a new path for everyone to leave together.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_93: Rest assured. The Artisans who failed to evacuate in time have already been guided to the vicinity of the Lexicon Axis.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_94: Good. You and your companions can also follow them back now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_96: Little Fox, this may be the last you hear from me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_97: The Autopuppets cannot draw enough attention. Slow as Ovathrax is, it has already turned its eye toward Xuanfang.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_98: There are soldiers still in the field. I will buy them time to reach the Axis.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_100: Hush now, Little Fox. Even with the Sentinel here, the Xuanling are still the guardian spirits of this land.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_101: Fate willing, we will meet again, Little Fox.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_102: What remains is yours to carry, Sentinel—"Hsin."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_106: Lady Hsin, can you hear me now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_108: The Wardens gave their lives for the Hold. The Xuanling Birds used their flesh to destroy the Fortress. We are at the brink, but this, right now, is also our opening.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_109: The Tacet Discords are all gathered here. Now is the moment to finish them in one sweep.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_110: Do you remember what you told us? If we merge with the Axis and surrender our own will, we can accelerate the Hold's completion.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_111: You are... offering to become Celestials?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_112: It is as we promised—those who build the Hold do not return.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_113: Lady Hsin, this is the "price" we are willing to pay.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_114: We know your concerns. One shouldn't be greedy, that is true. But... hehe, people like us are the greediest of all.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_115: "Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_116: But if I offer this body to my homeland at dawn, only to know the Way once more at dusk—what could be better?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_117: This battle determines Xuanfang's fate. Lady Hsin, from now on, we are one with this Hold—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_120: At this point, if I still hesitate, I might as well cast aside this human form.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_121: In the end, I was never truly a Sentinel.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_122: Perhaps it is this "heart" that kept me from ever becoming "Hsin the Moon Fox."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_123:
A vision simulated by the Heart Realm unfolds before you, and you watch the Fortress and Gorges War through Hsin's eyes.
 
Xuanfang Hold is nearly complete when Ovathrax's Tacet Discord hordes descend on Yuan Fortress. Warden Yuxian brings word that the front is in crisis. The Hsin of that day chose to save Xuanfang Hold and hold the line alongside soldiers and civilians alike.
 
Inside the memory, you walk in Hsin's shoes, making decisions and directing the Autopuppets to evacuate the people. In the Sanctum, She pushes Her power to its limit to accelerate the Hold's construction. Outside, the Wardens refuse to yield, and the Xuanling Birds dive into the city, giving their lives to slow the Tacet Discord advance. At the crisis point, the Court of Savantae's Artisans offer themselves to the Lexicon Axis early, becoming Celestials to bolster Hsin's strength. Grieving but resolute, Hsin gambles everything to force the Civilization Capsule to bring Xuanfang Hold to completion.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_2061_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>Using the Civilization Capsule to hasten Xuanfang Hold's completion...</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_2: What I just saw... That was everything you went through, wasn't it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_4: You've been in Xuanfang for a while now, Arbiter. Have you visited the Ministry of War?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_5: There is a stone tablet there. Every single one of their names is engraved upon it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_6: I merely waved my hand. I merely offered a few words of judgment. They all acted on their own accord.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_7: They walked away from the path I instructed and shielded a Hold that was never meant to exist. They gave their lives without a second thought.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_8: In the end, all that remains of them is a name carved into cold stone. Faint. Hollow. One after another.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_9: If no one speaks of them, they will be forgotten as if they never were.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_10: They didn't throw themselves into the fire just to be remembered forever.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_11: Hsin, you already did everything you could. They surely knew that. The circumstances...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_12: The circumstances left no other choice, I know.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_13: Speaking of which, I have been swept along by such circumstances many times.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_14: Take past lantern festivals, for instance. In the form of a little fox, I could see their pain, but all I could offer were small gestures of comfort.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_15: Sometimes I wondered... was my presence alone enough?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_16: As long as I appeared before them, they felt safe. Happy. They believed they could endure the hard days.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_17: But my reach was so limited, just as it is now. How is this any different from facing the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs back then?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_18: I took a Capsule and ran. I ran and ran, searching for somewhere safe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_19: And they... they were all waiting for me to appear. Waiting for me to stand before them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_20: Round and round, and in the end, I am still that little fox.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_21: But now, it should be different. After all, I have you with me now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_22: Thanks to you, I have seized more and more authority from Suhsin—from the "Sentinel's true will." The more I take, the more power I command.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_24: Yes, the Sentinel's underlying logic. Its true will.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_25: The Sentinel believed that my remolding of the Civilization Capsule, my choice to preserve Xuanfang Hold, was a violation of the rules. A "loss of control." So it has been trying to reclaim the Hold to force it back onto its ordained path of ruin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_26: But thanks to you, I have gained the upper hand. The "anomalies" you fixed along the way have been strengthening my new authority.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_27: —To break free from the Sentinel's will and forge new rules with my own hands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_28: With authority like that, I can finally do what the true "Hsin the Moon Fox" once could.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_29: That girl carries my scent. It will make finding her easier.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_30: Come, Arbiter. I know you still harbor many questions.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_31: But right now, finding her and restoring Xuanfang Hold is what matters more, isn't it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_32: When all this is over, tell me what you're still holding back, okay?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_33: Yes... I will when "all this" is over.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_207_34:
You open your eyes to find Hsin before you, Her spirits low. You raise what you just witnessed, but She deflects, brushing it off with a self-deprecating joke, calling herself a little fox swept along by events, changing the subject.
 
She tells you Suhsin embodies the "Sentinel's true will." In Suhsin's view, remolding the Civilization Capsule and preserving Xuanfang Hold broke the established order. Its goal has been to reclaim control and steer Xuanfang Hold back to its destined collapse. Every "anomaly" you repaired has strengthened Hsin's rewritten rules over Suhsin, allowing her now to wield the Moon Fox's power directly.

She opens the way into the Heartscape Labyrinth and asks you to join her to find Suoming and restore Xuanfang Hold. You can tell She's still hiding something. You make Her promise to tell you the rest once this is over.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_100_1: The Waking Moon Festival... It's finally here...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_100_2: I haven't been this happy in so long. When those Formrenders were around, I felt hollow, like my heart had been plucked out.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_100_3: Those monsters are gone now! Things are going to get better from now on!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_100_5: She loves a bustling festival too much to stay away.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_100_6: See that "Moon Lantern" at the very top? Only She has the power to light it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_101_1: Come on! I found us the perfect spot to see the lanterns!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_101_3: A fox? Where did you see it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_101_4: Don't rush, sweetheart, you'll bump into someone!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_101_6: What wish are you going to write on yours?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_101_7: Just health, safety, and smooth days ahead for my family.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_102_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>Run, Hsin... Run faster. Everyone... is waiting for this!</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_102_2: May all beings rejoice... the Moon and lanterns ever bright...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_102_3: Does this sight bring you any comfort, old friend?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_102_4: Forgive me. Your frequency was fading too quickly, and all I could gather from the people's longings was this single thread. If It were here... It would have done better.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_102_5: Look, the Waking Moon lanterns are lit once more. Let us linger in this view a little longer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_102_6: From now on, everything will be well.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_102_7:
In the fox's body, you leap for the moon in the sky and restore its light. The lanterns blaze bright as day, and the Waking Moon Festival becomes at last what it was always meant to be.

Off in a quiet corner, Hsin's phantom stands gazing down at the lights, a Rafter Kite perched on her fingertip. Her face is soft, as if catching up with an old friend.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_103_1: Look! That door over there! Isn't that where we came from?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_4: Thanks to you, the Heart of Flames has recovered. I've reclaimed enough authority to meet you like this.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_5: Before this, I had no way to speak with you directly. I could only guide you here. It must be a long journey for you, Arbiter. Would you... like to rest? Have some pastries?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_9: Hsin, I have so much to ask you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_10: You've been missing for some time. Where were you? What happened to you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_11: What you saw before was merely a fractured strand of myself. My true form still sleeps deep within the Simulacrum Nexus.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_12: I thought I could spare the strength to find you. But anomalies kept appearing. I've had to pour everything into repairs. I'm spread... terribly thin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_13: Even now, I can only speak to you in this unstable form.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_14: From what I gathered, Muyu's corrupted Reverberations have all been purged. Xuanfang Hold should be safe now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_15: What is truly binding you, Hsin?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_18: It has your face. Your frequency. But every Celestial I met spoke of it with dread. I think they were under some kind of restriction.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_19: The Heart Realm anomalies, the canceled Waking Moon Festival... Is the Fox Shadow behind it all?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_20: It took Suoming too. Do you know where she is now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_21: Mm... that is a lot of questions at once...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_22: That "Nexus Fox Shadow," let's call it "Suhsin." It began to break free of my control after I decided to remold the Civilization Capsule. Since then, it has been spreading through the Nexus.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_23: Suhsin seeks to devour all "Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox" data to stabilize its own existence. It's been fighting me for control over Xuanfang Hold. In our struggle, I took my eyes off the Hold. A part of the Sanctum collapsed because of it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_24: As for that girl with the umbrella, she deliberately released the Moon Fox frequency in her token to lure Suhsin into taking her. Reaching Suhsin was her goal all along.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_25: But the Heart Realm she's in now... is currently beyond my reach.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_26: Hm... but there is one simple way to make Suhsin obey your every command.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_28: Use the power within the Prism of Fate to overwrite my personality data and reset all clearances. Since Suhsin shares my source code, it will revert to its initial state.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_29: And what would happen to you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_30: Well, I'd lose my sense of self and exist solely as the core to keep Xuanfang Hold running, wouldn't I?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_32: I won't allow that to happen.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_33: Aw, not that frown, Arbiter. I was only joking.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_34: Why was Suhsin able to drive you into such a corner? What could override a Sentinel's authority?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_35: Suhsin's clearance... comes from the Civilization Capsule's base code. Its core logic dictates that once Xuanfang Hold fulfills its mission, it must be destroyed. To keep the Hold, I had no choice but to overwrite it with new logic.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_36: So that's the reason you remolded the Capsule?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_38: Shh. Tread lightly. We wouldn't want a giant hand to appear and snatch us both away!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_39: Then let me ask you this: are the things shown in the Heart Realms your memories?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_41: You made Xuanfang's very first Rafter Kite, didn't you? Then who is the "It" you mentioned to that Rafter Kite?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_43: Ah... my time in human form is up.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_44: Tell me, what do you need me to do now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_45: Arbiter, please continue through the Heart Realms. Venture deep into the Simulacrum Nexus to fix the anomalies. I will be waiting at the end of the next Realm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_46: What I am forbidden to say aloud is hidden within those fragments of the past. Once you have witnessed everything, you will understand why I brought you here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_48: The Providence Lock didn't react. Guess Hsin was telling the truth.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_50:
You step back through the door into your own body, and Hsin the Moon Fox is waiting for you in the flesh. She tells you to call Her "Hsin" and thanks you for clearing the anomaly in the Heart of Flames—the only reason this meeting is possible at all.
 
You press Her with your many questions. She admits that Her true self has been trapped deep inside the Simulacrum Nexus all along, bound by the entity behind the Nexus Fox Shadow, the one She calls "Suhsin." Suhsin emerged from the Civilization Capsule's base code, and its core logic dictates that Xuanfang Hold be destroyed once its mission is complete. Hsin overwrote that logic with Her own in order to keep Xuanfang Hold standing. Suhsin has been fighting back ever since, tearing loose and seeding anomalies across the Nexus while Hsin struggles to maintain control of the Hold.

As for Suoming, she let Suhsin take her on purpose, for reasons of her own. The Heart Realm she now occupies lies under Suhsin's control, beyond Hsin's reach.

Hsin asks you to press deeper into the Simulacrum Nexus and repair the remaining Heart Realms. Everything the restrictions keep Her from saying is buried in the memories those Heart Realms hold.

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_270_1:
To my wife, Mingxi,

I hope this letter finds you well. Your note and the dried fruit reached me safely, and I am in good health. There is no need to worry about me. Not a single piece was crushed on the way, and I confess I could not bring myself to share any with my colleagues; I ate them all myself. Each one was wonderfully sweet, and I was quite content. I only hope that next time you might spare a few more words for me.

Matters at the Ministry have kept me busy of late, so this reply comes later than it should. Forgive me. I have picked out a hairpin for you, one of the styles now fashionable in the city, in a pattern I know you like. As for the reassignment, it is still under discussion, and my posting has not been decided. I mention it only so that it will not sit on your mind later.

By the time this reaches you, autumn will likely have set in. Remember to dress warmly in the mornings and evenings. Do not give all your attention to the children. Perhaps you might treat yourself to a few new garments? Counting the days, I may be able to take leave around the time of the Waking Moon Festival. If the leave is granted, I will be home before dusk, and we will go to see the lanterns together.

There is more in my heart than this page can hold. Take good care of yourself.

Yours,
Guilan

...It has been ██ days since the Formrenders first appeared, and at last we have found a way to relight the Moon Lanterns.

Those faint glimmers scattered through the alleys—Luobin calls them <color=Highlight>Nightlight Tokens</color>—carry some very peculiar frequency. <color=Highlight>Burn them in the Moon Lanterns, and the darkness gives way.</color> They suppress the Formrenders too: the brighter the flame, the heavier their limbs, the slower their approach. But each lantern lit also draws their attention, so we must move with care.

Where the glimmers come from, none of us knows. Faint as they are, one always rekindles somewhere just as the oil runs dry and the wick burns out. Whatever the truth of it, so long as we have the Nightlight Tokens, there is still hope. Jianwei believes it is a blessing bestowed by the Sentinel... But if it truly is a blessing, why has She never shown Herself?

...Last night I heard the wind sweep down the corridor, and in my terror I snatched up a weapon and rushed outside, only to frighten my neighbors half to death. Then I remembered the Fortress and Gorges War ended long ago. My memory really has been failing me of late. Best to write it all down.

Its voice grates like a rusted blade scraping bone, and a red light sits in its eyes. It keeps to dark places, and loathes above all the joys of mortal men. At the sight of them it wakes to wrath, and in its wrath it devours that light.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_6902_1: A note scrawled in a hurry.

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_74_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>They say that when the Moon Lanterns are lit at the festival, the Sentinel, who so cherishes the mortal world, will slip quietly into the crowd from some corner to walk among the people.</color>

Main_Mengzhou_3_7_106_6: (She speaks as if addressing someone standing right before her.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_106_7: (Am I experiencing this memory through Hsin's own eyes?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_108_1: Amidst the deadlock, hidden desires stir in every heart.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_2: We are heavily outnumbered. Facing endless hordes of Tacet Discords, even the fiercest resolve dulls eventually.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_3: It only dulls when fear takes root. If someone dares to lead, the deadlock has already begun to break.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_4: Fine words. But who has the spine? And who could actually lead us?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_5: The crux of the matter rests neither on you or me. It hinges on the Sentinel's will.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_6: We can pray for guidance, but to wait in idleness?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_7: Sentinel Jué has long shielded Mt. Firmament, just as Mengzhou relies on Lady Hsin the Moon Fox. If Jinzhou is to be our first step toward reclaiming our lands, we cannot simply leave the entire burden to the Sentinels.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_8: If no one is willing to be the torch, darkness will never lift. Please, sir. Stand with me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_9: A woman like you knows how to build a legacy...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_109_10: You just won't live to see it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_10901_1: This deadlock is not unbreakable. What we need is the resolve to act.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_110_1: The loyal and righteous have gathered here out of reverence for you, my Lady. There is no need to worry about our plans being disrupted.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_110_2: Unity is forged from within. It was not I who brought them here, but their own hearts.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_2: Brother, the border is in dire straits. How could I have stayed in the village, idling and warming my hands? I had to come.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_3: You have a wife and child. Our mother to care for. A school to teach... those are your duties!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_4: I took care of everything before I left. I told Gui to make sure Mother takes her medicine.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_5: And Liang, he's so bright. He's already learned how to massage his grandmother's joints so they won't stiffen so much.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_6: I do feel bad about leaving the children at the school. But there are plenty of good teachers there. They won't miss me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_7: They won't miss you here either!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_8: See that chimney smoke, Brother? That's our village, right behind us. You were the one who taught me to fight for it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_9: I taught you to fight so you could live, not so you could throw your life away! Staying out of danger is how you survive!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_10: I'll protect myself. And I'll protect everyone around me too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_112_11: We'll bring victory home, Brother. When that day comes, Mother will be waiting with the porch light on.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_11201_1: You stubborn mule! You're just jumping straight into the fire!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_113_1: So this is what they mean... When brothers stand together, their bond can cleave through steel.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_113_2: They fought to safeguard the homeland behind them. Do not let their blood be spilled in vain.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_115_2: I'm only taking the crumbs here. Bet you pocketed a fortune for yourself, eh?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_115_3: Watch your mouth. You get paid for the work you do. That's how it goes. Trying to back out on me now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_115_4: Heh, of course not. Just thought you might want to spread the wealth a little.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_115_5: After all, between the two of us, you're the one who can't afford to get caught.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_115_6: Tsk... Fine. Meet me in the kitchen at midnight. After that, I wash my hands of you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_115_8: (That's right. Play the fool, take the loot. Then I'm leaving here for good.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_11501_1: Alright, save your breath. I don't give a damn what you're hiding, just hand over my cut.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_116_1: The two moles were caught red-handed. They've already been imprisoned.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_116_2: These trifles should not delay your schedule. Please move along, my Lady.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_118_1: <color=XinyuehuSub>All souls reach out to seize hope, yet tremble at the thought of grasping nothing.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_118_2: <color=XinyuehuSub>They seek a response, a spark of courage to move forward. I believe their prayers must not fall on deaf ears.</color>
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_119_1: The meeting hall is right ahead, my Lady.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_120_1: Channel the Nexus, foresee fate. Face the abyss, steady every heart.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_1: I have summoned you today to address the Tacet Discord threat plaguing our borders.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_3: I will build a city, a mechanism of ever-changing forms, designed to counter Tacet Discord outbreaks.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_4: To bring it into being, I need the backing of our finest Artisans. But before you commit, you must know the price—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_5: Those who build this city shall never return.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_6: This... this technology outlined in the blueprint is unprecedented. Could it be...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_8: The Court of Savantae pledges its full support!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_10: Delegates, present your qualifications in turn. The Sentinel will render Her judgment based on the facts.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_11: We have long studied Sentinel technology. Our knowledge guarantees we can decipher this blueprint in the shortest time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_12: As for the price, we stopped counting the cost of life and death ever since we built the Chronosorter. What does it matter if there's no way back?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_13: Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_14: Xuanfang's terrain is volatile. It will require real-time adjustments to mechanism formations. Our knowledge of the local environment gives us the upper hand.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_15: As Lady Hsin noted, this city requires highly sophisticated mechanisms. Yuan Fortress, the very ground beneath the chosen site, was built by our hands. Navigating those intricacies is where we excel.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_16: We will master this technology, of that we are certain. And we are ready to give our lives for Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_17: If it's mechanisms you need, we have reserves in spades.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_18: We are local. We know the people. We are the best suited to move them safely.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_19: This construction cannot afford to fail. I need those who are unwavering in their acceptance of this technology.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_20: Zhuojun Atelier is making this unnecessarily complicated.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_21: The decision is made. Xuanfang Hold will be built by the Court of Savantae. Effective immediately.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_22: Please, one final word! The Court of Savantae lacks practical experience in large-scale mechanism engineering—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_23: The Ministry will coordinate with City Hall. I want logistics sorted and materials dispatched within three days. As for you...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_24: Submit your personnel roster to the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs by tomorrow. Any delay will be treated as a forfeit.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_28: I do, my Lady. You made your choice long ago, so why call this meeting at all?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_29: First, to let the military and civilians of Mengzhou see that their City Hall has a plan, thereby assuring them. Second, to confirm, one last time, which of the two is fit for the task, and which is a threat wearing the mask of an ally.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_30: ...Zhuojun Atelier operates with hidden agendas. Their intentions are unclear, their loyalties uncertain. A liability, without question.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_31: No. The Court of Savantae is the more dangerous.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_32: They are willing to destroy themselves for true knowledge. Naturally, they will preserve such technology at any cost. To them, death is merely an acceptable compromise.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_33: But a fragile civilization cannot bear knowledge that is too far ahead of its time. If this continues, sooner or later, it will yet again be...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_34: Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk... Very well. If that is their "final wish," I will grant it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_35: ...But they are not the only ones sacrificing for the Hold. You are, too, My Lady.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_36: I chose to be of this world, so how can I stand apart from it? Come. It is time to retrieve the Civilization Capsule.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_123_5: Peace to Yuan Fortress and Jinmen Pass
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_124_1: Your decision will surely lift the spirits of our troops at the border.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1241_1: Now that we have taken this step, there is no turning back.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1241_2: I can't catch up... What's happening?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_126_1: Pay no mind to the occasional objections, my Lady.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_126_2: Turbulent times demand a resolute heart.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_128_1: There is truly no need for you to personally attend to these petty affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_128_2: Think of it as a habit of mine.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_128_3: Besides, however restless people's hearts may grow, in the end, they are all searching for peace of mind.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_128_4: My presence grants them that peace.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_130_1: And what about you? You haven't slept in three days.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_130_3: When all of this is over, take some time for yourself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_132_1: The Civilization Capsule... I was never meant to use it this way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_132_2: It never recovered from the damage it sustained from the Sentinel Resonator's death, not even now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_132_3: But the border can wait no longer...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_132_4: Years of waiting, all for this moment.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_1: Forgive me for forcing those memories upon you. I couldn't bring myself to tell you the truth before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_3: Safe, for now. As long as I am still here and the Capsule holds, they won't dare make a move.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_4: If you are a fractal form of Hsin the Moon Fox, then what of the real Sentinel...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_5: It will return once the Civilization Capsule is fully repaired.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_6: Why didn't you ask the other cities for help?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_7: If I laid the truth bare and let these conflicts come to light, would they back down when they saw the cost? Or would they rather break everything than yield?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_8: I... dared not take that gamble.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_9: Perhaps I lack the resolve of a true Sentinel, and that is what led to this crisis.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_10: Every time those memories are rewritten into my mind, I always...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_11: ...I want to call out to It. To pull It back. To tell It not to go.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_12: Yet I can never do it. After all, I was nothing more than a stray emotion It had yet to manifest.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_13: Perhaps that is why the Heart Realm is in chaos. I was desperate to change the past, even when it was unchangeable.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_14: I am not the Sentinel. I only walk this world in Its form.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_15: It trusted me to repair the Capsule, yet I failed my duty.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_16: Arbiter, is this considered a deception?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_17: From the outside, maybe it looks that way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_18: But you're the one who's been protecting Xuanfang Hold...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_19: You're the one who helped Qingxiao and me when we were trapped in the Sanctum's illusion.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_20: Hsin the Moon Fox gave you Its heart, and you gave yours to Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_21: As long as it stands, no one can deny what's in your heart. The world's judgment doesn't matter. What matters is what you think, Hsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_22: What I think... but Arbiter, so often in this life, we are not the ones who decide who we are, or what we do.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_23: It seems my time is almost gone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_24: I will... be waiting for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_276_1: The Tacet Discord Outbreak at the Gorges of Spirits grows fiercer every day, and the Threnodian is showing signs of waking... At this rate, even Mengzhou won't come out unscathed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_276_2: Word is, Lady Hsin answered Sentinel Jué's call for aid. You can expect a new city any day now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_276_3: Are you serious? That's no small matter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_121_38:
You witness the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs in council. To spare Mengzhou, and Jinzhou, still yet to be founded, from the worst of the Tacet Discord hordes, Hsin the Moon Fox decides to raise Xuanfang Hold using Sentinel technology far beyond the current era. Delegates from the Court of Savantae and Zhuojun Atelier are summoned to select the architects. Both parties are stunned by the blueprint they are shown—technology generations ahead of anything they have ever seen. Even after being told that those who build the Hold will never return to the regular world, both sides still pledge themselves to the cause.
 
The Court of Savantae argues that their familiarity with Sentinel technology and willingness to sacrifice makes them the better choice. Zhuojun Atelier counters with their knowledge of the local terrain and practical experience with mechanisms. In the end, Hsin chooses the Court of Savantae. For them, the pursuit of knowledge has outpaced even the fear of death.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_132_8: Through "Hsin's" eyes, you glimpse the truth of what happened at the Ministry's council. The Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, is assassinated. The killer is Balanophora, a Ministry Intendant who spent years undercover waiting for this moment. In the crisis, Hsin splits off a <ano=Hsin>Fractal Form</ano>. As the shadows close in, a newborn fox flees with the Civilization Capsule.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_25:
You emerge from the Heart Realm and return to Hsin's chambers. She confesses the truth She has kept from you. She is not the true Sentinel, but a Fractal Form created by Hsin the Moon Fox—an inheritor of Its memories and will, charged with repairing the Civilization Capsule damaged in the Ministry coup. She kept this a secret and continued to act as the original Hsin the Moon Fox. Hearing Hsin's doubts about Herself, you tell Her that the world's judgment is not what matters here. What matters is what She believes Herself.
 
Before you finish speaking, Hsin, unable to maintain Her form, fades in front of you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_284_1: Ugh, it's completely caved in... What do we do now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_284_2: We leave it to the Ministry of Development...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_1: Huh?! It's fixed already? How is that humanly possible?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_2: Uh... actually, I only just got here...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_3: You'd never guess. Lady Hsin came and repaired it Herself!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_4: A flick of Her hand, and the modular mechanisms went spinning like a kaleidoscope, and everything was back the way it was.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_5: Agh, just a bit earlier and I'd have caught it... I really wanted to see how Lady Hsin did it in person!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_26_1: That little fox that showed us the way...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_26_4: Its frequency resembles Hsin the Moon Fox's own, but it's still different from the Sentinel I've known.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_26_5: ...Arbiter. You lent me a hand in that fall. Thank you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_26_6: You still haven't explained what this "deal," this "covenant" with Hsin even is. I'm not letting you off the hook just yet.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_26_8: But if Hsin really is in danger and the Sanctum could fall because of it, then finding Her comes first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_26_9: Let's go. We need to get out of this mist.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_27_1: You needn't worry about the consequences of the Sanctum's collapse, Arbiter. The Ministry has prepared for it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_27_2: (I'll take her at her word for now...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_28_1: Here all the heart's faces show. Countless forms arise, shifting without end. Lose yourself among the false paths, and the way out shall be lost to you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_28_3: Yeah. It was just a hum, but somehow I caught what it was trying to say.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_28_4: Keep an eye out as we move forward.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_29_2: Is this what it meant by countless forms arising, shifting without end?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_30_1: Is it trying to keep us from leaving?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_30_2: If so, then who's controlling this place...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_32_1: We're back where we first started?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_32_2: We won't find the way out like this. We—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_33_1: It's not just guiding us... is it controlling this place?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_34_1: The way it shifts very much resembles Mengzhou's Automata Mechanics.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_34_2: If this fox can work these mechanisms, then it might be...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_35_1: Hm? These look like things from the Waking Moon Festival.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_35_2: How did they end up here?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_36_1: Glorious! A whole sky of Waking Moon lanterns!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_37_2: And it looks like the Fortress and Gorges battlefield.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_38_1: Behind us stands Xuanfang Hold! No retreat! We fight!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_40_1: That flute... it was Her favorite.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_41_1: Hm? I'm picking up an unusual frequency up ahead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_42_1: It's stopped. So this is the source of the unusual frequency?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_42_2: That's right. And the Prism of Fate seems to be reacting, too...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_208_1: A Heartscape Labyrinth? You once led me and Suoming out of this bamboo forest when you were in your fox form.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_208_2: Yes. Thanks to you, Arbiter, I can finally walk by your side in this form.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_209_1: Did Suhsin set up these mechanisms to stop us?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_209_2: Yes. My current authority still falls slightly short of its own. We'll have to take a detour.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_210_1: Hsin, where did this thick fog come from?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_210_2: This is a real bamboo forest in Mengzhou. Stay close to me, Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_211_1: Hmm? The Heartscape Labyrinth looks different than before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_211_2: Hehe... more beautiful than it was, isn't it? Arbiter, at the end of this bridge lies the Threshold that leads to Suoming.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_1: You should be relieved to hear I have reclaimed most of my authority from Suhsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_2: This Labyrinth is now entirely mine to command.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_3: Everything you wish to know, I will lay before you, piece by piece, through this Labyrinth. Honestly and fully.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_4: (Tch... Seems like that thingamabob that red-haired girl gave you is acting up.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_5: (Didn't she say it would react if Hsin the Moon Fox wanted to do something against you?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_8: I'm fine. Just a bit dizzy from the emotional whiplash. Let's keep moving.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_9: Mm... this Labyrinth reaches into one's very soul. You have lingered in my Heartscapes for too long; some discomfort is natural.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_10: Once we are out, I will make it up to you. How does that sound?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_212_12: You and Hsin press deeper into the Heartscape Labyrinth. Hsin promises to answer anything you wish to know. In that moment, the Providence Lock reacts. Suoming's words ring in your head: the Lock will only warn you if Hsin the Moon Fox tries to do anything against you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_1: The mountains and waters in the Land of Xuanfang have always looked so peaceful...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_2: What you see before you is the future the Sentinel's will desires—this land, eternal and unchanged.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_3: Arbiter, sometimes I wonder... Is what I'm doing truly what the people of Mengzhou want?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_4: Restoring the Civilization Capsule, establishing Xuanfang Hold... Right or wrong, I can't judge for the people here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_5: But I've heard what they have to say about "Lady Hsin." Their faith in you is genuine.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_6: Is that so... So they have been waiting for the Sentinel to appear again...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_7: Hsin, the reflection in the water...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_213_9: Then, Arbiter, through this Heartscape, I will lay everything bare—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_2: is for Xuanfang to know peace and to endure
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_3: Not only these mountains and rivers
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_4: but the warmth of ordinary life
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_5: And I... I would live beside them
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_7: And then... I would see the Waking Moon Festival's lanterns light the sky
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_9: Celebrate with everyone one last time
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_10: Then take the Civilization Capsule to the Sentinel in Mengzhou
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_11: Xuanfang Hold... would have peace forevermore.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_214_13: You don't have to lie anymore
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_1: What's that... Suoming gave it to you, didn't she?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_3: Had I known you were carrying it, I wouldn't have had to put on such a show. All those stories I spun for you...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_5: Everything you said is true. You really wanted to be with the people of Xuanfang. To see the sea of lights at the festival again. To see Hsin the Moon Fox once more.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_7: Hsin, tell me, was the cost of remolding the Civilization Capsule your own life?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_9: Whatever you're planning, don't sacrifice yourself. I'm here. There's no need for you to bear this alone.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_11: You did well, Hsin. You held everything together while I was away. That wasn't easy.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_13: Don't say comforting things like that... I... I...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_16: You saw it yourself... The founding of Xuanfang... came at the cost of further damaging the Civilization Capsule...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_17: I was born from the hope of restoring it! I knew my duty. I knew how much the Moon Fox had entrusted me with.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_18: But I... but I... I betrayed that hope. I betrayed the very duty I was born to carry.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_19: After that, I could feel Its frequency waning with each passing day. I tried so many things. I tried everything...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_20: But just as I couldn't stop It from walking into that trap, I couldn't catch up to the fading of Its frequency.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_21: Until... I could no longer sense It. And the Civilization Capsule stopped draining my power, and instead began to feed me...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_22: I knew... It was gone. And I had caused Its death.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_24: I believe... what people need is Hsin the Moon Fox, not a diminished Fractal Form...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_25: What were you planning to do behind my back?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_26: If I reclaimed Suhsin's power, I could awaken the Sentinel's will from the <ano=base code>deepest part</ano> of the Civilization Capsule... Its true will.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_27: If I gave myself up, the true Sentinel could return! Its memories might be incomplete, but... even so, It would be the true Sentinel.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_28: You're already a piece of the Moon Fox. If you disappear, how can you be certain that what returns is truly the Sentinel?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_30: Hsin, I've had this on me since I first entered the Labyrinth. It only reacts if you intend to do something against me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_31: You lied to me many times along the way, but this Lock only warned me just now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_32: Because even you believed... that if I learned the truth later, it would affect me as Arbiter more than anything else. Am I right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_34: I thought if I couldn't bring the Sentinel back...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_35: You aren't afraid of death, yet you fear this?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_36: Hsin, all you wanted was to use "Arbiter" as an excuse to justify your escape, didn't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_37: You had the courage to stay in a Xuanfang ravaged by Tacet Discords, but no courage to face yourself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_38: If the true Sentinel had made the decision, it would've been better. Wiser. More foolproof for Xuanfang, Mengzhou, even Solaris.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_39: If It were here, even in circumstances like this, It would never have let Muyu's chaos take root.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_40: You're trapped in self-doubt. You never give your own effort its due.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_42: The death of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox is my responsibility as Arbiter. I will uncover the truth.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_43: And the wrongdoings of the Sentinel's Fractal Form will be judged once the dust settles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_44: But for these past hundred years, it's been you leading the people of Mengzhou forward.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_45: Hsin, will you betray the hopes they place in you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_46:
You call Hsin out on what She has been trying to hide from you all along: She intends to sacrifice Herself to finish remolding the Civilization Capsule. You comfort Hsin, who can no longer keep up Her pretense of ease, and tell Her that since you have come this far, you will not let Her bear this burden alone. That is when Hsin's walls finally break and She tells you the truth: Her decision to use the Civilization Capsule to save Xuanfang Hold directly caused the original Hsin the Moon Fox's death. Her true purpose in reclaiming Suhsin's power is to overwrite Her own existence with the Sentinel's consciousness buried in the Capsule's code, and bring the original Moon Fox Sentinel back.

You refuse to let Her do that.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_216_1: (Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox is dead...?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_217_2: Hsin, we'll discuss this more after we find Suoming and handle Suhsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_1: Arbiter, now that you've arrived, it seems "Hsin's" power has been largely reclaimed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_2: Hm? Seems you already know the secrets She and It keep.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_4: From my position, I speak from the perspective of Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_5: Everyone here understands... how to handle Her is ultimately your authority as Arbiter. I have no right to intervene, nor the ability to stop you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_6: But still, let's hear what It has to say first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_7: A Vermillion Lock... So what I sensed was not just the lingering frequency on the token...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_8: The Sentinel bound it with a seal only you can undo. Open it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_11: You find Suoming in the Heartscape Labyrinth, locked in combat with a Suhsin Fractal Form. She takes one look at Hsin's face and knows you've learned the truth. She pulls out the Vermillion Lock and hands it to Hsin. Inside, she says, is a message left for Her by the true Hsin the Moon Fox. With your encouragement, Hsin decides to open it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_220_2: Yes, let's handle this clone first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_221_1: "Hsin's" frequency is here, too. You can't reject it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_221_2: Let's go, Arbiter. It will lead us to Suhsin the Inevitable.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_221_3: Lady Hsin, look at my Moon Lantern!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_221_4: Lady Hsin, look at my Moon Lantern!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_221_5: I can never become the Sentinel I was supposed to be... My only choice... is to bring It back...
