Main_Mengzhou_3_7_222_1: Arbiter, Hsin has strayed at every turn. By my calculations, I surpass Her in every measurable metric.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_223_1: To capture the Waking Moon's chaos and seal it in the Capsule. How can such inversion befit a Sentinel?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_224_1: To gather the world's grief and seal it in the Capsule. How can such contradiction befit a Sentinel?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_225_1: Suhsin the Inevitable... We've found it, but what of Hsin the Moon Fox?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_225_2: You've already given Hsin what She needed most. Right now, we need to focus on weakening Suhsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_226_1: You need only press forward, Arbiter. I'll use the frequency of the Hsin the Moon Fox within the lock to open up a path.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_227_1: It's forcing us into the deeper regions. Stay on it!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_228_1: (These chains... I can use the Heart of Flames key to break them!)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_231_1: (Too many! I'll use this Realm's key to freeze them!)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_3: Sentinel? If you are here, will Suhsin—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_4: The Arbiter and Suoming will not give it the chance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_7: I knew you were born of feeling. Your capacity for joy and sorrow far exceeds my own.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_8: Remolding the Civilization Capsule would trap you between cruelties, and the grief would eat you alive.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_10: The fault is my own! If only I had not—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_11: No. That very choice proves you are the Sentinel who can find a new path forward.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_12: If it had been you, <ano=Xuanqing>she</ano> might still be here today...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_13: But—if I hadn't... If you were still here...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_14: Hsin. The day you were born, I envisioned your future.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_15: I envisioned how you would laugh, cry, and find your place in this world...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_16: But I've stumbled every step of the way. I do not deserve your... faith.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_17: You saved thousands in the Fortress and the Gorges War. You guarded the Civilization Capsule for centuries to make its restoration possible. You brought hope where there was none.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_18: You have long been revered as the divinity you are—the very heart of Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_19: Go. Walk forward, one step at a time. Walk farther and better than I ever could.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_22: Sorry to keep you waiting, Arbiter. Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox has come, and She's finally made up Her mind.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_235_1: Rule violation. Contradictory logic. Inefficient. Redundant. Return your authority.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_235_2: My, my, is that the best you can do? I thought you took pleasure in mimicking me?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_235_4: You are unworthy of being Sentinel!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_236_1: Manifold forms, take shape. The Heart of Flames burns eternal.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_236_2: Arbiter! Stay within the field, I'll—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_236_3: Hsin, don't waste your strength reshaping the ground. Focus on Suhsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_237_1: Manifold forms, solidify. The Heart of Frost fades without a trace.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_1: Suhsin, look. The Simulacrum Nexus. Our Civilization Capsule is so vast, so varied.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_2: The Heart of Stillness is wide and welcoming. The Heart of Flames is fierce and thriving. The Heart of Frost is still and steady. The Heart of Bloom is peaceful and pleasant.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_3: In other words: compromise, impulse, indifference, and mediocrity.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_4: True. It is greed, pleasure, and the endless hustle. And yet, it is also life, endless and enduring.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_5: This is humanity. This is emotion. This is the heart. This is—civilization.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_6: How could you strip them of that? And leave only reason, logic, and cold principles?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_7: You defy your own origin. You overturn what is ordained. Even with your divine cunning, the path ahead remains a chaos no stratagem can pierce... much like the error of my own existence.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_8: A chaos no stratagem can pierce? How frightening. Then let us walk that path together.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_9: The remolding of the Civilization Capsule is nearly complete. The remains the Fractsidus stole will no longer be enough to shake Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_10: I will stop Xuanfang Hold's collapse and gather those Celestials whose wills are spent, those on the verge of fading, into my Prism of Fate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_11: There they will remain, until the day I find them a place to belong.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_12: This exposes forbidden secrets. It is unbefitting a Sentinel.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_13: But... anyone who possesses a heart would do the same.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_240_14: Hsin, you truly are capable of becoming a Sentinel like no other.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_1: Hurry! The Lantern Carriage is about to leave!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_3: The Waking Moon Festival... It feels like another lifetime.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_4: Hsin, why are you still here? The whole city is waiting for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_5: They have waited so long to see me. If I simply strolled through the streets, wouldn't I disappoint them?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_6: As always, I must wait until the festival reaches its peak, until every heart is full of aching anticipation—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_7: Arbiter, do you think all the Sentinels feel this restless and giddy? I can barely stand to wait a moment longer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_8: You all show it differently, but you all feel in similar ways.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_9: Quite so. And what I feel only deepens with every passing moment.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_10: So, Arbiter... that plan of yours, to tell everyone the truth about Hsin? Let's wait. Just a little longer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_12: It told me to find my place in this world... And I think, what I want most right now, is this.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_13: To give them a sense of safety. A sense of peace. Not because I am expected to... but because I want to.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_14: The dark currents of Mengzhou have yet to be purged at the root. Whether "Hsin" appears is secondary. What matters is whether the Sentinel still endures.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_15: If that is what you've decided, then do as you wish.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_16: Then I gratefully accept your approval, Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_17: And truly, in this moment I feel no regret. No loneliness. Because I know... as long as Hsin is here...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_18: This Waking Moon Festival, and all the lanterns yet to come... they will shine on, countless and bright.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_1: Oh? Is there something else on your mind, Arbiter?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_2: What will become of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_3: Has the Civilization Capsule been fully remolded?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_4: I'll see you at the Waking Moon Festival.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_5: The turmoil within the Simulacrum Nexus hasn't fully quieted yet. Until then, I cannot reclaim it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_6: I have left a portion of my frequency and power with the Nexus Fox Shadow. It will join the remaining Celestials in finishing the work.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_7: Once the dust has settled, I will take over from there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_8: I want to ask something else.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_9: Mm, you could say the grand design is finally taking shape. A portion of its power is still stabilizing the Nexus's framework, much like the Xuanyuan Domain once separated to sustain Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_10: At the very least, the Fractsidus can no longer use the remains they stole away to interfere with the Capsule.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_12: I want to ask something else.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_13: Mm. Do look forward to it, Arbiter. The Waking Moon brings its own delights.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_243_1: During the Manifold Sanctum restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_244_1: During the Manifold Sanctum's restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_244_3: Suoming, do you ever take a break?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_244_6: W-wow, Qiting, could I ask the Arbiter for an... autograph?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_244_9: These two still have much to learn, but they show promise. I assigned them to oversee the Sanctum's repairs. The entrance to the Simulacrum Nexus is still inside, after all.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_244_10: Besides, Hsin the Moon Fox will appear before the people tonight. First time in years. I cannot afford to relax.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_244_11: Looks like it'd take Hsin hiding your umbrella and locking you away in some quiet garden to get you to rest.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_244_12: Arbiter... That sounds exactly like what She would do.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_245_1: Arbiter, you head to the festival first. I still have matters to settle with the Ministry.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_245_2: Sure, if you get some rest. At least tonight.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_245_3: I already have. Sampling Tangning's Moon Fox Rice Cakes was a start.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_245_4: I imagine the ones at the festival... will taste even better.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_246_1: For a hundred years, I rebuilt countless landscapes and cultures within the Capsule.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_246_2: None of it compares to the warmth of this. Real light, living and breathing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_246_3: Yes, the cold projections of the past have transformed into the warm scene before us now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_246_4: The road ahead is long. For the next thousand dawns and dusks, I will be the one to watch over Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_246_5: Here, it is customary to write the year's joys on the lantern.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_246_7: Hehe, the one who gathers all the wishes doesn't release her own.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_246_10: Arbiter, the night has come. Let us walk into the Waking Moon together.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_3: No. My conversation with them has concluded.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_5: Yes... Every now and then, I commune with... their frequencies.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_6: Though, to be precise, it's merely speaking to myself. I refrain from doing it in the presence of others.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_7: But Suhsin recreated one of the subordinates I was most fond of... It reminded me of how much I miss them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_8: I see. Would you allow me to say a few words to them?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_9: What did they usually call you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_10: Seal Master, Boss, Sister Suoming... They had many names for me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_14: Your Seal Master is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_15: Your Boss is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_16: Your Sister Suoming is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_17: And she did it flawlessly. Now, with her counsel, Hsin will become a Sentinel like no other.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_18: Not just in the past, but in the future too, she'll keep giving you every reason to never regret following her.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_19: The last time I cried was when they were taken from me. Now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_20: To have someone else speak to them... It feels good, like they're still here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_1: Suoming, I still know very little about the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... There's something I've been wondering.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_3: The condition a Sentinel is in can profoundly affect a civilization. I've... seen that firsthand before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_4: After Hsin the Moon Fox was attacked, and Hsin was in Xuanfang Hold for a century remolding the Civilization Capsule, what became of the people of Mengzhou?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_7: Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon we called the "Evil Miasma" began spreading across Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_8: It descended with black rain and rolling clouds. It eroded faces and devoured souls.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_9: My homeland, Huating, was ravaged by it. Countless lives were lost.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_10: So it was during that fight your companions were...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_11: Yes... They were willing to die for Huating. Still, I hated the Sentinel for never reaching out to help us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_12: Back then, Hsin the Moon Fox was heavily weakened and in no state to watch over all of Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_13: Exactly. So when I finally met Her, how could I hold onto that hatred?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_14: I simply inherited the title of Intendant and purged the remnants of "Balanophora" from our ranks.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_15: Together with other Ministry members, we bore Providence Locks created from Fractal Proliferation. They're fragments of the Sentinel's power that allowed us to quell crises across Mengzhou.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_16: This Providence Lock really came through for me this time as well. Speaking of which, Mengzhou should be stabilizing by now, right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_18: Although there is one matter that remains unresolved. You should be made aware.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_20: Mingting has long coordinated the Ministries of Sentinel Affairs across every city, seeking greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_22: Whatever happens, we cannot let our enemies seize the initiative again.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_23: Still, as I said, nothing is settled yet. Should there be progress down the line, your involvement will be indispensable.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_24: I understand. If it concerns the Sentinels, I'll do everything I can.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_25: I would share more, but I haven't had the luxury of involving myself in that particular affair.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_26: That's alright. It's always a comfort to know a little more about the Sentinels... or rather, my partners in all of this.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_1: Arbiter, look. The celebrations are at their liveliest now. Let's go.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_3: (I guess Hsin the Moon Fox hasn't witnessed this festival with Its own eyes... not since It was betrayed.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_4: (If I'd gotten here sooner, maybe It would still be here—)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_7: Arbiter, if the Sentinel saw someone with a sad face at the festival, It would take their hand and walk with them through the celebration until their smile returned.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_10: I wish the Sentinel could see this. Ever since that day, It never came to the Waking Moon Festival again.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_11: Hehe, you are more sentimental than I thought. I don't even need my powers of emotional sensing to read you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_14: You... all of you Sentinels always carry these heavy burdens alone. By the time I arrive, you've already backed yourselves into a corner.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_15: Once again, I came too late.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_16: Arbiter, inside the Vermillion Lock Suoming gave me resides the Sentinel's last strand of frequency.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_17: Its last frequency? What did It say?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_18: The Sentinel... It apologized to me. It said It had put me through so much hardship, and given me no other choice.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_19: And then, It told me It approved of my choices. It watched me walk my own path, step by step, and said I walked it better than It could...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_20: Arbiter, it was you who opened my eyes. I could not betray the hopes Mengzhou placed in "Hsin."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_21: And then, with the Sentinel's... with the approval from the one I admired most, I was able to transform.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_22: And Xuanfang Hold and Mengzhou were able to rise again, bathed in such warm, splendorous light.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_23: Long ago, It chose to build Xuanfang Hold to protect every living soul in this land. Then It created you, to remold the Civilization Capsule in a way never done before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_24: Even knowing you might have to choose between the people and the Sentinel... It never wavered.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_25: Mm, that is why... It told me It was sorry.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_26: Yes. It loved Mengzhou that deeply. Every thought, every intention was bound to this land.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_27: Like you said, Hsin the Moon Fox always cherished the joys of the mortal world. It could never bear to see sorrow.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_28: If all we do is grieve, we'd be betraying Its very heart.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_29: Exactly. So cheer up. The Sentinel never taught me how to console a sorrowful Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_30: Thank you, Hsin. Knowing what the Sentinel said in the end... It really mattered to me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_31: No need to thank me. Let us simply take in the lantern lights together.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_32: Heavy is the weight you have carried, Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_249_33: You walked the Waking Moon Festival with Hsin, and amid the brilliant lantern light you were moved to grief by the loss of Hsin the Moon Fox. Sensing your sorrow, Hsin drew you into the crowd to share in the festival's revelry. Afterward, you spoke to Hsin the Moon Fox of your regret, and Hsin passed on the Moon Fox's last words: It had always cherished the joys of the mortal world, and could never bear to see sorrow.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_1: Hsin the Moon Fox? It's not time to depart yet, is it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_2: Not yet. Why don't you call me Hsin? Such formality.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_3: As I addressed the Sentinel before, so I will do so today.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_4: Hehe, a strange display of care, but I'll accept it. Thank you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_5: I came to thank you for your recent efforts, but... more than that, I came to apologize.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_6: You unlocked two Vermillion Locks, didn't you? One to hold the Sentinel's frequency, the other when Suhsin dragged me away.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_8: The Sixth and Eighth Seals. One sharp-tongued, one taciturn.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_9: They are Reverberations that should have faded a century ago, sustained only by my obsession. You owe no apology.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_10: At both turns, I knew the task at hand outweighed my own attachments.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_11: But Suoming, you are not one with a strong Resonance Ability, yet you've lived through centuries.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_12: It was your obsession with the Ten Seals that carried you this far? If one day, you release them all—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_13: I would welcome that day, Hsin the Moon Fox.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_15: Enough about me. Have you chosen who will accompany us to Mengzhou?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_16: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_17: A fugitive framed by the Fractsidus, formerly known as the "Blind Watcher."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_18: A Jinzhou Patroller who has deep ties to Zhuojun Atelier.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_19: And the third... an informant who, having finally seen his vengeance satisfied, offered his blade to our cause.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_21: That Chairwoman has her own methods for bringing together those who share a common purpose.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_22: Hmph, it seems my grand plans for a "welcome party" for little Suoming were quite unnecessary. Seems I needn't worry about you getting along.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_23: We all have scores to settle in Mengzhou. Naturally, the conversation hardly runs dry.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_24: Indeed... We all have scores to settle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_251_1: Arbiter, leave this to me. The manifold power of Fractal Proliferation exists for moments like this.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_252_1: Careful! Suhsin commands more power than just that.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_253_1: Hsin! There's no time. Get out of the way!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_254_1: Hsin... If you insist on defying the ordained path, I shall reveal... the full weight of my power.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_1: I need to say it once more. Thank you, Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_2: If you had not come, I cannot imagine how things would have ended.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_3: You were about to say, "No need. This is what an Arbiter should do," weren't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_6: Xuanfang Hold's affairs are settled for now. But Mengzhou... how is it faring?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_7: Mm... Remember that "lock" that young lady from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs gave you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_8: The Sentinel's assassination could not be hidden forever. But those above insisted on keeping it secret. If not for good, then for as long as they could.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_9: Those below could only feign ignorance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_11: Worry not. That girl is one of ours. She has kept this secret well. If not, "those people" would never have allowed her to represent the Ministry here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_13: The Moon Fox's power has always been geared toward defense. Mengzhou retains many of Its protections. The Threnodian's invasion is not an immediate threat.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_14: Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_15: As for the Ministry, that young lady manages it. I'll speak with her soon about other tasks.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_16: The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... Yes, I'll keep an eye on their movements too.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_17: Oh, and... I asked the Celestials about those satellites and Court of Savantae lettering. But it was so long ago, even they could not say for certain.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_18: ...Perhaps the past Moon Fox knew. But my memory has gaps from the time I arrived in Xuanfang... I will keep searching for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_19: What I do remember is blurred, but I can send what I have to the Black Shores for analysis. Perhaps they will discover something I overlooked...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_20: Good, someone from the Black Shores will contact you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_21: Rest now. Let your thoughts settle. Tonight, at least, let yourself share this "Waking Moon Festival" with all of Xuanfang.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_280_1: Qingxiao lingers at the edge of the crowd, keeping to herself, quietly listening to the storyteller.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_280_2: "Who would win, Lady Hsin or Paragon Qingxiao?" She appears to be giving it serious thought...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_281_1: Yangyang and Suisui linger at the fireworks stall, choosing carefully, their gazes warm and gentle. Suisui came all this way just to be with her little sister at the Festival.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_281_2: Years ago, two much smaller girls laughed their way down a street lit just like this one. The years turn, and some things never change.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_282_1: Jingran is surrounded on all sides by children clamoring for a story.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_282_2: One tale after another, and still not a single one of them runs away screaming the way he expected. You notice he's moved on to an unpublished chapter of "Mirage Seeker's Tales"...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_283_1: Suoming stays where she is, watching the crowd stream past, her gaze wistful and gentle.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_283_2: For a moment, it's as if a young girl stands at her shoulder, watching the same peaceful scene.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_241_19: Night falls, and the Waking Moon Festival begins as planned. Taking in the bustling liveliness She has not seen in years, Hsin tells you She means to continue guiding Mengzhou as its Sentinel, and that She is in no hurry to reveal Her identity as "Hsin" just yet. She smiles and says that in this moment, She feels neither regret nor loneliness. As long as "Hsin" is here, this festival and all the lanterns to come will be countless and bright.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_22:
You find Suoming speaking with the frequencies held inside her Locks. She does not hide it, admitting that Suhsin's conjuring of her most beloved subordinate had left her missing them dearly. You ask to speak to her departed friends, telling them how she led Mengzhou in the Sentinel's absence for centuries. Suoming is deeply moved.

"To have someone else speak to them... It feels good, like they're still here."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_28:
You ask Suoming what became of the people of Mengzhou during the century after Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox was struck down, while "Hsin" was away remolding the Civilization Capsule. Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon called the "Evil Miasma" spread across Mengzhou. Suoming's homeland, Huating, was ravaged as well, and countless lives were lost. The Sentinel, bound by Its own injuries, could offer no help. Suoming took up the title of Intendant and led the Ministry's members against the disaster, each of them carrying a "Providence Lock" the Sentinel had made imbued with Its power. Over the years, the situation in Mengzhou began to stabilize.
 
Suoming tells you that Mingting is working with the Ministries of every city to seek greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels, and that when the time is ripe, you will be needed to act as Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_25:
Hsin and Suoming make secret preparations to leave for Mengzhou. Hsin has already chosen their companions: a fugitive framed by the Fractsidus, once known as the "Blind Watcher"; a Jinzhou Patroller with deep ties to Zhuojun Atelier; and an informant who, with his vengeance served, offered his services to their cause.
 
The tangled web of fate has finally drawn tight. Now, the time has come to unveil it all.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_26: Joyful laughter echoes through the lantern-lit streets, while clear moonlight shines upon the bustling Hold as ever.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_27: A few days later, somewhere in the Land of Xuanfang...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_136_1: I missed my chance to ask where Suoming is... And there's more to that Intendant's assassination of the Sentinel than what I saw. I'll have to dig into that later.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_136_2: The Providence Lock hasn't reacted, but She's still clearly hiding something from me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_137_1: Messages from Yangyang and Qingxiao? Have the comms been restored?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_5: The Sanctum must be blocking all attempted word from the outside. That was impatient of me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_6: There has been no further collapse. The Ministry of War has reached an understanding with our envoys, and all is well inside Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_7: ...If this reaches you, do send word that you are safe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_12: With your skill, I have no doubt you will manage. Still, if you need help, call. I will come.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_14: Have you found any trace of Hsin?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_16: I've seen Hsin. She's in real trouble. I'm doing what I can.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_17: It's a long story. I'll tell you everything once I'm out.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_18: The connection is unstable. It could cut off any second. Don't worry about me, Master.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1371_20: And you need not worry about Xuanfang Hold. The Wardens are at their posts, and so am I. Focus all your attention on helping Hsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_2: Liangyu told me you went into the Sanctum with that Ministry of Sentinel Affairs Intendant... Are you all right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_4: I know you'll be fine. It's you, after all. But no one knows what's inside, and... I can't help worrying.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_5: If my messages get through, send something back. A line or two is enough.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_9: Things inside the Sanctum are complicated. There's a lot going on below the surface. But don't worry, I'm doing fine.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_10: Once I've handled things in here, I'll be back.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_13: I'm with Warden Commander Qiuhong, helping with the evacuation. People are frightened. I'm trying to keep them calm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_15: I'll do my part as a Xuan Watcher. I'll be waiting for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_1: We noticed the changes in the distant mountains. It seems you repaired the Heart of Flames, Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_2: It has been so, so long since anything changed here...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_3: I know why She and all of you came here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_4: We made peace with it the moment we accepted the contract for the city's construction.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_5: Thank you... for your years of tireless work.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_6: Well, with Lady Hsin's authority reclaimed, I think I can finally ask what I've held onto all these years.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_7: The Court of Savantae... Did we leave anything behind?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_8: There are ruins. Many scholars are still studying them to this day.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_10: So She did help us. Now it's our turn to help Her.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_12: The key to the Heart of Frost... It's... it's right...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_138_13: You meet Leyue again. With more of Hsin's authority reclaimed, the Celestials can speak far more freely than before. She thanks you for repairing the Heart of Flames and asks about the Court of Savantae's fate in the outside world. Your answer draws a contented smile. Then, risking Suhsin's notice, she tells you where to find the key to the next Heart Realm—the Heart of Frost.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_18: Tangning. I know this place holds your heart. Your concern is only natural.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_19: Hsin the Moon Fox accounted for this from the start. The Sanctum was built to break clean from the Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_20: Should the worst happen and it falls, the surrounding districts will remain standing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_21: And should the Hold itself be imperiled, don't look for me. Put the people first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_22: I, Tangning, will see that it is done.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_23: One more thing. Ten years you've held this post. With Hsin here, I should've been the one overseeing Xuanfang myself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_24: But Mengzhou's crises didn't let me go. You and your predecessors have held firm in your duty.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_25: For Hsin, for Mengzhou, you've done more than your share. You have my gratitude.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_26: Yes! Intendant Suoming, may all be well in <ano=heart>Hsin's</ano> keeping.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_27: May all be well in Hsin's keeping.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_28: Ah, that reminds me. Xuanfang's Waking Moon Festival is almost here. The last few were a delight. Will you join us this time, Intendant?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_29: The Waking Moon Festival... If things go well, we'll see.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_30: Tangning, the Ministry's quiet observer inside Xuanfang Hold, delivers his findings to Suoming. Following the Providence Lock the Sentinel once gave him, he went to the Sanctum and measured Hsin the Moon Fox's frequency, only to find it fading fast. The Manifold Sanctum at the Hold's heart could collapse at any moment. Hearing this, Suoming remembers a promise she made someone long ago. She decides to go to the Sanctum and see the truth for herself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_149_1: Hsin... Is She in the Heart of Frost right now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_1: {PlayerName}. My greetings have been remiss lately.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_3: My new dwelling in the Xuanyuan Grotto-Heaven is newly raised. Sparrows sing from the eaves and the clouds drift in, a setting made for brewing tea and playing the qin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_4: Should a free day find you, I would welcome you most gladly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_6: Why so formal over comms again...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_7: An invitation calls for proper manners. That said, I've grown more adept with these messages.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_9: ...In plainer words: if you're free, I'd like you to come sit a while at the Xuanyuan School's new training hall.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_12: Yes, only just raised, with room enough for the disciples to practice the sword.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_13: That's my Master. Heading there now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_14: A whole new training hall already? That's my Master.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_15: Count me in for a visit, then. I'm available right now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_19: I'll be waiting here for you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_16_1: How'd she put up a whole new training hall so fast?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_16_2: It's Qingxiao, after all. She's probably got some secret art for it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_16_3: We'll know once we get there. If it's her hall...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_16_4: Oh! I can kind of picture it. Bet it's one of those misty, immortal-looking places, huh?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_1: You raise a fair point, Fourth Seal. If She wanted to see me, why not just bring me to Her side from the start?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_2: A whim I could tolerate, but I suspect this is not Her doing at all.... Regardless, you may rest now. Thank you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_3: Walk with me through this, Ninth—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_6: Haha, long time no see! Did you miss me?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_7: It's been, what, two hundred years? Since we took down that Evil Miasma that came from the Sentinel's assassination.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_8: The sacrifice was heavy, but at least everyone's frequencies are safe in those locks of yours, right? We'll be together forever!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_10: Wow, is that the Sentinel? Sister Suoming, can you take me to see Her?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_11: Only if you stop being so rowdy.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_161_13:
Suoming walks alone, murmuring to the frequencies sealed within her Locks. She takes out the one belonging to the Ninth Seal, and a rare smile crosses her face.

A moment later, the Ninth Seal stands beside her in the flesh, cheerfully catching up on old times. The sight dims Suoming's expression, but she says nothing of it, only lets the Ninth Seal's wish to "see the Sentinel" pass unchallenged.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_162_1: Sister Suoming, did Huating become a better place after we killed off the "Evil Miasma"?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_162_2: I never got to see it at peace. Is it beautiful?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_163_1: Look, Sister Suoming! Doesn't that look like the mechanism teapot the Lord Second Seal made?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_163_2: I remember when you stuffed Water Moon Buns into it and he chased you all over the courtyard!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_163_3: But he'd always let it slide as long as you lent him the Vermillion Locks to play around with.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_163_4: That wasn't for play. Because of him, the Locks were refined into what they are today.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_163_5: So that... after you all died, I could seal your frequencies inside them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_164_1: Sister Suoming, these Autopuppets... Did the Sentinel abandon them here?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_164_3: Maybe the Lord Second Seal could fix them?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_164_4: This is the Sentinel's technology. Even he would find it hard to repair.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_165_2: That's right. Get to cover, Ninth...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_1: Hmph. This place is not to be trifled with.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_3: Hehe, it's written all over your face!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_4: The way these fiends are constructed is alarmingly similar to the Moon Fox's own handiwork.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_5: Oh! Lord Second Seal! Long time no see! Back still aching? I can help, you know!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_6: Enough of that. Focus on the work at hand.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_8: Your timely aid is much appreciated, Intendant Suoming. I have heard much of you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_9: Mm. Were you ambushed by those fiends?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_10: Indeed. They call themselves Formrenders and Soulfrayers. They are Autopuppets, but far more brutal than the rest of us.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_11: Even the Kernel Puppets guarding us stood no chance. I suppose the technology used to forge them originates from...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_12: I'm fully aware. It's too dangerous here. Let me escort you back to Mengxuan Vale first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_13: There is no need to trouble yourself, Intendant. The path we came from is safe enough.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_15: You have more pressing matters to attend to, don't you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_167_1: In the light of understanding, life and death lose their weight...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_168_1: In the light of understanding, life and death lose their weight...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_168_3: Classic Formrender work. They can never be fixed.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_168_4: Do you resent them? Your enemies... or the Sentinel who didn't aid in time?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_168_6: We mourn for the deceased, but we still have a higher mission to achieve.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_168_7: And you are just like us, Intendant Suoming. That we do know.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_169_1: I heard those Celestial Autopuppets call you Intendant.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_169_2: Hmph. Beating around the bush doesn't suit you. Well? Do you dislike the title?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_169_3: It's not about liking it or not. It's just that no one will ever call you Seal Master again. That makes me a little sad.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_1: Take this! Xuanyuan First Form, Hidden Heart!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_2: Master Qingxiao never taught us that move... Cheater!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_3: The immortal lady told us, "We train in the heart, not in the form." I came up with this myself!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_6: Taking in disciples already, Master Sword Transcendent?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_7: Just watching over the little ones for Jiuniang. Letting them run about.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_8: I showed them a handful of forms, lest their wild horseplay leave them bruised. If they come to master my swordcraft in time, then the art lives on.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_9: So this really is the Xuanyuan School's new training hall?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_10: It's... the Xuanyuan School, Xianling Village Branch!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_11: Look! I carved that plaque myself. "World's Greatest Cultivation School." Amazing, right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_12: It truly is a training hall, and we truly do train in the sword.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_13: ...Did my little joke fall rather flat?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_15: A martial school is not built in haste. There are many days to consider what comes next. This place suits well—no worldly dust, only kitchen smoke. No hindrance to cultivation.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_16: And with the festival near, there are countless tasks needing hands. Staying here, I can at least be of some use.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_17: Master Qingxiao can cut out a whole pile of Moon Lantern frames in one swing! Beats my whole day's work!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_18: Getting ready for the Waking Moon Festival?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_19: Yes. When the <te href=852014>festival</te> draws near, Xuanfang livens up. If you are free, do take a stroll through it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_21: Is it true Hsin shows up at the festival?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_22: ...Mm. In the old days, if I did not attend, Hsin would send a Rafter Kite to fetch me, hounding me till I went.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_23: It was true over a decade ago. But in recent years... Hsin appears more rarely.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_24: I wish we could meet Lady Hsin! Grandma and Grandpa always say the Sentinel will come to play with us at the festival, but we've never seen Her, not once.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_25: Don't you know? That's just grown-up talk to make us behave. Like the one about Autopuppets stealing kids who won't go to bed...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_26: Hsin is... simply a little busy. You will have the chance to see Her some other day.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_27: Your mother's here. Off you go.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_29: It's just... I'm still not quite used to minding such lively little ones.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_30: Does it remind you of when you first met Ruoyun?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_33: But let's return to the matter at hand.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_34: I asked you here, in part, to talk about Hsin. These past few days... the presence I have sensed from Her has grown weaker than before.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_35: Hsin keeps no set path, so a flickering presence is nothing new... She vanishes for a time, then reappears as if nothing happened, chattering of trifles.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_36: In the past, Hsin never spoke of what She was doing, so I asked no further.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_37: Yet with Xuanfang's portents growing more frequent, even the Rafter Kites no longer bring word of Her. Until moments ago, I sensed a wisp of Her presence near the Sanctum, but it was gone in a breath, too fleeting to catch.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_38: ...Hence my wish for you to accompany me to Xuanfang Hold to search for Her trail. And when the moment calls, I may need to rely on your power as Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_40: Then let's head to the Hold first. There's something I've been wanting to look into as well.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_42: Thank you. After all this is settled...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_44: You'll take me to the Waking Moon Festival?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_17_46:
Qingxiao's "new training hall" turns out to be nothing more than an ordinary village courtyard, where she stands smiling as children tear around the yard. She catches your surprised look and admits it was only a joke, and she's simply watching the little ones while their parents prepare for the Waking Moon Festival.
 
Talk of the festival leads Qingxiao to her real reason for inviting you. Hsin's presence is growing fainter by the day, and she wants you with her when she investigates the area where she last sensed it, near the Sanctum. Recalling the rumors from the tea stall, you agree to go with her to Xuanfang Hold.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_19_1: The two of them are going at it again... Someone find a Warden, quickly...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_1: I'm not leaving. After everything we've been through, you want me to listen to some stranger?!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_2: This is about keeping us safe... Won't you stop being so stubborn...!?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_3: Ah, Paragon Qingxiao, {PlayerName}! Thank goodness you're here. Help me talk some sense into my father, please...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_5: Well, a while back, someone from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs said the Hold had "served its purpose" and would collapse any day now. Told us to move out while we could.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_6: Ridiculous. Our family has lived in this land for generations. You don't just pack up and leave...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_7: To be fair, I'm not convinced either. It came out of nowhere...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_8: But that person carried an Intendant's command token. Clearly no small figure... And I'd rather not wait to find out. We can't survive another disaster like the Autopuppet rebellion...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_9: Nothing's settled yet. No need to panic.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_11: If you say so, {PlayerName}, I want to believe it. But the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_12: See? Even {PlayerName} thinks the same thing!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_13: Paragon Qingxiao, my apologies for disturbing your cultivation. But there's been an emergency... It requires your attention.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_15: Someone tried to break into the Sanctum. We've detained her, but she claims to hold the Sentinel's token. Except... it's not in any of our records. No way to verify it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_17: Did she say where she came from?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_18: She said... she's an Intendant in Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_19: ...I see. {PlayerName} and I are bound for the Sanctum as we speak. We won't be long.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_20:
You come upon a family in the middle of an argument. Wanhong, an old man, refuses to leave the Land of Xuanfang, the only home he has ever known. His daughter Qingchen, however, is convinced the Hold is heading for another disaster and insists on moving the family out.
 
As father and daughter stand at an impasse, Qingxiao receives word from Liangyu: a woman claiming to be an Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs tried to force her way into the Sanctum and was stopped by the Wardens.

You decide to head to the Sanctum and find out what's happening.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_21_1: Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_21_2: Not anymore. But one thing still bothers me...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_1: Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_2: Not anymore. But... one thing still bothers me.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_3: What happened before she joined the Ministry. The way she took the frequencies of her fallen comrades...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_4: Hm. The omens of the Sanctum's fall aren't settled yet. Let's get through this first. I'll explain later.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_5: What worries me more right now is the people. Our presence here has already—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_7: The Sanctum's fall? What are you two talking about?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_8: Are you the ones spreading rumors and causing all this panic?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_9: That uniform... they're from Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_10: You must be... the Xuan Paragon of Xuanfang Hold, and this {Male=gentleman;Female=lady}... Never mind.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_12: Forgive us. To us in the Ministry, {Male=he;Female=she} holds a special standing. Not something to speak of before outsiders.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_13: Your Ministry governs Sentinel matters, so this is about...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_14: Ah, I get it. Qingxiao already knows I'm the Arbiter. No need to dance around it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_15: We meant no disrespect, Arbiter. The situation demanded immediate action. We couldn't report in time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_16: Besides, the Intendant ordered us to stay silent. She said... you would surely arrive at the Sanctum at this time, and that all your questions would be answered there.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_17: As for the panic this has caused, we'll help the Wardens contain it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_18: ...I see. I understand your position. I won't make things more difficult.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_19: But when this is all over, I want the full story.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_20: You have my word, Arbiter. The Intendant... she came to safeguard Xuanfang.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_23_1: You know this is the Sentinel's Sanctum. How dare you trespass?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_23_2: Watcher Liangyu... The way you carry yourself reminds me of an old friend.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_2: Arbiter, we meet at last. I am Suoming.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_3: And this... would be the Xuan Paragon. Qingxiao, I take it. A pleasure.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_5: She claims she came by decree to meet the Sentinel. And yes, we've confirmed that she really is an Intendant from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_6: But by custom, the Sentinel has to approve visitors first before an escort guides them in. And with Her absence of late, there's no way to know Her will.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_7: Besides... if the Intendant truly came by decree, why sneak in through a side gate?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_8: The people on the way over here spoke of "Xuanfang Hold's collapse." Did that rumor come from you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_10: The Ministry detected that Hsin's frequency has become critically unstable, reaching its breaking point. As Her state and the Hold's are one, I acted to keep the people safe.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_11: You're only just noticing this now?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_12: Spare the probing questions. The Ministry's decisions and orders are not mine to disclose, Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_13: Hsin's <te href=750059>Prism of Fate</te>... I never imagined She would give this to you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_15: It means... She had a change of heart. She chose to trust you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_16: Paragon Qingxiao. You know Hsin the Moon Fox well. You understand what this token signifies.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_18: It is a covenant. A deal between Hsin the Moon Fox and me. The time has come for Her to honor it. But as things stand, She may not even be able to save Herself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_20: Paragon, what does all this mean...?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_21: It is Hsin's frequency within that lock. She speaks the truth.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_22: So that presence you sensed earlier...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_24: Is that proof enough for you?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_25: Hsin promised that when the time was right, she would give us and Xuanfang the answers we deserve.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_26: It seems... that "time" is now. Watcher Liangyu, kindly let her through.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_28: Intendant, my apologies for the earlier offense... The Ministry of War's rules say you still need an escort to enter the Sanctum...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_31: The Prism of Fate grants its bearer the authority to enter the Sanctum. Your presence there may be the variable that shifts everything.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_33: ...I'll stay in the Hold. See to my duties as Xuan Paragon.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_34: Hsin charged me to act in Her stead should the tide ever become irreversible. Now I see She meant more than just the chaos Muyu caused.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_35: A Sentinel's waning frequency may spark trouble in the Hold. Someone must remain here to handle it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_36: The Sanctum's matters... and Hsin, I leave to you. I have faith in you.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_38: I'll handle whatever's waiting for us in the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_41: You find Intendant Suoming at the Sanctum entrance with the Wardens barring her way. She addresses you as Arbiter and knows you carry Hsin's Prism of Fate. When questioned, she states her purpose plainly: the Ministry has measured Hsin the Moon Fox's frequency and found it critically unstable. She may no longer be able to save even Herself. Suoming holds a covenant with Hsin, and the time has come for Her to honor it. The rumor of the Hold's collapse was Suoming's doing as well, a warning to give civilians time to evacuate should the worst occur. Qingxiao senses Hsin's frequency within Suoming's token, the Vermillion Lock, and confirms she is telling the truth. After some discussion, you agree to enter the Sanctum with Suoming to search for Hsin, while Qingxiao remains in the Hold to manage any fallout.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_256_1: Come one, come all, don't miss out...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_256_2: Moon Fox Rice Cakes, fresh out of the steamer!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_257_1: That one over there... Don't they look like—
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_257_2: Shh. Big name out of Mengzhou City, has to be. Best keep our distance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_258_1: Think Lady Hsin will show up this year?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_258_2: Nobody's heard a word about the Sentinel in years. I wouldn't count on it...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_259_1: How come nobody came out to play today?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_259_2: They're moving away, I heard... So it's only the two of us now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_261_1: There's been no warning. We aren't ready for any of this...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_261_2: I'm sorry. It was sudden for us too. This is for your own safety...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_262_1:
Crates line the roadside, filled with Waking Moon Festival decorations and provisions. Somebody was counting them not long ago.
 
The people of Xuanfang have been waiting for this Festival for a long time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_263_1: Have evacuation routes ready, and make sure not to cause alarm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_263_2: Understood. And the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_263_3: I'll handle them. The people's safety comes first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_264_1: Why's the path to the Sanctum blocked? I thought they said the Celestial Ring Formation needed maintenance somewhere?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_264_2: Somebody important showed up, is what I hear... No idea beyond that.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_265_1: The Inner Threshold is inside Mengxuan Vale. This way, please.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_278_1: ...Someone repaired the anomaly in the Heart of Flames?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_279_1: With the Heart of Flames back, I've finally got hold of this corrupted data. Time to take it apart properly...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_279_2: ...Wait. This power came from the same source as Lady Hsin?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_291_1: (Hm? Yao? What's she doing out here?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_1: So this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou today. I wouldn't have guessed...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_4: As with the Xuanyuan Domain you visited before, it's one of the Manifold Dimensions Hsin commands.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_5: You seem to know my comings and goings very well.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_6: The Ministry keeps a record of anything concerning the Sentinel's Sanctum, Arbiter.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_7: I merely read of it in our Grand Library.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_8: Supposedly, this place governs the base order of every mechanism in the Hold. It calculates the Manifold Forms, and you'd expect efficiency to come first, not extravagance.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_9: But such intricate, lifelike scenery... is not what I anticipated. Still, for Hsin the Moon Fox, such style is no surprise.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_10: It's like the Xuanyuan Domain... Hsin once told me that was only a small part of the <te href=800053>Civilization Capsule</te>...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_11: What if... this place is connected to the Capsule as well?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_13: I'm guessing by your reaction I'm right?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_14: ...The evidence is thin. I won't commit to an answer yet.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_15: You emerge from the mist into a serene landscape of Xuanfang mountains and waterways. It is not what Suoming expected, and her face betrays her surprise. She tells you this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou—the framework that underpins Xuanfang Hold's fundamental order. You wonder if it might be connected to the Civilization Capsule. In the distance, among the peaks, a massive silhouette catches your eye.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_4301_2: (The mist is obscuring it, but it looks like... Hsin the Moon Fox?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_1: ...Sector <ano=Yang Fire and Yang Wood>Bing-Yin</ano> has three corrupted registers. Tracing from the old framework... There. All sorted.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_2: And that disturbance earlier... resolved too. Phew, that was close...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_3: (A phantom? No... the way she's dressed...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_4: (Could she be one of the <te href=852016>Celestials</te>, like Ruoyun?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_5: Wha-! Wh-who are you? How did you get in here?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_8: ...So you're Lady Hsin's guest. Pardon my manners.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_10: I'm Mingxiao, a Court of Savantae Artisan here in the Simulacrum Nexus. I handle maintenance and repairs in this area. Ah... outside, I suppose you'd call us Celestials?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_12: Well... lately, structures have been collapsing for unknown reasons. It's started to disrupt the Hold's operations. We're fixing them as fast as we can.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_14: Yes. Ever since Lady Hsin decided to...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_15: My apologies... the restrictions forbid me from answering. But please, rest assured, it's safe here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_44_17: Lady Hsin... isn't able to see guests now. You may wait at Mengxuan Vale for the time being.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_45_3: Our Grand Library records that Sentinel Hsin and the Court of Savantae agreed that once the Hold was complete, the Artisans would surrender their lives and become conscious frequencies woven into the mechanisms. Part of the Sanctum's computational power.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_45_4: That meant losing their bodies, sense of self—everything that makes a person human.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_45_5: And yet they... seem no different from anyone else. Not exactly what I expected.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_2: This used to be a place for the Celestials to rest. But with the Simulacrum Nexus's data anomalies increasing, Lady Hsin set up repair workshops all over. This is one of them.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_3: We so rarely have guests... do excuse us if we fall short. Whatever you'd like to know, Arbiter, I'll do my best to answer.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_5: Lady Hsin's Prism of Fate isn't something just anyone can carry. Once, she told us that if a black-haired, golden-eyed person ever came bearing it, we should answer {Male=his;Female=her} questions as fully as possible.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_8: I need to know where Hsin is now, as well as Her condition.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_9: At this point... I'm not here to assign blame, but I'm done waiting for the moment to be "right." If Hsin the Moon Fox is caught in something, I'll find Her myself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_10: She's the Sentinel. Her every move could affect Xuanfang Hold's safety.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_11: That's... I understand your worry. It's just, Lady Hsin's power of Fractal Proliferation lets her exist across the entire Sanctum to guide the Hold's operations. And lately, with all the repairs, She's busier than ever...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_12: Even we... have not seen Lady Hsin's true form in a long time.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_13: Over there on the horizon. What is it?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_14: ...That is the <te href=852015>Nexus Fox Shadow</te>, one of the Sentinel's manifestations. It resides outside the Simulacrum Nexus, occasionally acting on the Sentinel's behalf to... oversee matters.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_15: Do you know why we're here?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_17: Of all the Sentinels in Huanglong, none are more "willful" than Hsin the Moon Fox. But She is not one to treat a covenant lightly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_18: Xuanfang Hold is complete. The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs should have reclaimed the Civilization Capsule long ago. Hsin delayed. Again and again. Now the final term is past.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_19: As an Intendant in the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, I have come to take it back. Will She yet hide from me?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_22: So this is what you've all been refusing to name.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_24: That response is answer enough. What you cannot say, I will learn for myself.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_25: Forgive me... nothing in the Sanctum escapes Lady Hsin. She must already know you've come.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_26: But we can't say for certain when you'll be able to see Her. While you wait for Her response, do explore as you like.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_27: I still have repairs to attend to. I'll take my leave.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_32: (Got jolted awake by some huge frequency wave! It was kinda like... that Prism of Fate, but with all these extra nasty, funky smells. Ugh...)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_33: (Is it coming from that Fox Shadow on the horizon?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_34: (Uh-huh! Whatever's there has been giving me the willies since we got here. Like something's spying on me... Creepy. So I'm staying inside. If things get hairy, just holler!)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_36: (It seems like the Celestials here are bound by restrictions, just like Ruoyun was.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_37: (Now that I'm inside the Sanctum, I should take a look around.)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_38: Inside Mengxuan Vale, Mingxiao explains that this area once served as a resting place for the Celestials, but it's now home to repair workshops for Celestials to fix anomalies. Hsin left instructions here long ago, and they have been waiting for the Arbiter ever since. Hsin, however, has been so consumed with keeping Xuanfang Hold running that she has not appeared before them in a long time. You learn that the great shadow on the horizon is called the Nexus Fox Shadow, a manifestation Hsin uses to oversee matters in her stead. But the Celestials refuse to say more about it. Suoming cuts to the point: she has come to reclaim the Civilization Capsule Hsin used to raise the Hold. No sooner are the words out than the shadow stirs, lifting a single finger to its lips. It is not an answer. It is a warning. Sensing that Mingxiao is bound by Celestial restrictions and cannot speak freely, you decide to investigate on your own first.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_2: Oh! You must be that Arbiter Lady Hsin told us about! I never imagined someone from the outside world could make it in here...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_3: How are things in the Hold these days? Is the Land of Xuanfang still safe?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_6: None of you knew what was going on out there?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_7: No. Beyond the information needed to keep the Hold running, we Celestials barely interact across sectors, let alone with the world beyond the Sanctum.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_8: Lady Hsin calls it "modular management," I think. She doesn't seem to like it much... but it is a restriction set from the Hold's founding. We've all come to accept it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_10: It's alright. We're used to it. I thought becoming a Celestial would turn me into a heartless program, but Lady Hsin told us this place runs on "emotion" as its support, so She's been splitting off computational power just to keep our sense of self intact.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_11: To ease the strain on our minds, we have no sense of time passing. I don't know how long it's been. The horror of the Fortress and Gorges War still feels like yesterday...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_12: Thank you for telling me how Xuanfang is doing.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_13: Well, I've rested enough. Time to get back to my modular parts and my duties.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_14: ...Oh, and, Arbiter, the Lady Hsin of today is already... Ngh.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_16: Never mind... Sorry. It is a rare chance to be here. Please, take your time exploring.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_17: (That reaction... is he afraid of the Fox Shadow?)
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_47_18: The Celestials in the Sanctum do not perceive the passage of time, a mercy that spares their minds the burden of the years. But becoming a Celestial did not strip them of their humanity. They still carry the full range of human emotion and seem no different from the living. One of them tells you this was Hsin's doing. She once told them that the Sanctum runs on "emotion" as its support. All this time, she has been diverting her own computational power to preserve their sense of self, and it seems she has been bearing other pressures alongside it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_48_1: Back when the Sentinel's computational power was still strong, She would often conjure Fractal Forms to come and amuse us in our workshops. "To keep us from getting bored," She said.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_48_2: And She would tell all sorts of stories and gossip from Xuanfang. She never could resist a good joke. Some had us laughing for days... Others, ahem, had us spinning for days.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_48_3: Not what you would expect from a Sentinel, is it? But that's exactly why, through all this, we haven't lost ourselves.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_48_4: A Celestial's frequency... does wear down over time. And yet, not one of us has ever been lost. Not one.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_49_1: Oh, what am I supposed to do now...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_49_3: It's these anomalies, what else... Oh, sorry, I thought you were... Wait. You're the Arbiter, aren't you?! I'm Leyue, I'm in charge of Autopuppet repairs here.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_49_4: ...Does everyone here know who I am?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_49_5: Of course! The Sentinel told us to keep nothing from you. Let me guess, you want to know about the anomalies?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_49_7: Let me just take you to see it. It's... a bit complicated.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_50_2: The anomalies have affected their consciousness. They're riddled with errors now... There's nothing we can do.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_2: Anomalies like this were rare in the early days, but the few that cropped up, Lady Hsin would fix quickly.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_4: Lady Hsin said it's redundant data from repairing modular parts. But the root source... we've never been able to trace it.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_5: It seems to originate from the highest level of clearance. We cannot intervene. We can only wait for Lady Hsin to fix it Herself. And there are even more anomalies like this in the <te href=852012>Heart Realms</te>.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_7: They make up the innermost region of the Simulacrum Nexus, storing not only Xuanfang's history and culture, but also the Sentinel's own memories. Projections of Xuanfang's fate, its web of possibilities... Everything is held in Lady Hsin's keeping.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_8: We Celestials don't have the authority to enter the Heart Realms, so we can't fix the anomalies there. Right now, three Heart Realms are still in chaos.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_9: There's no way for us to share Her burden. All we can do is... Hold on. That frequency, it's...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_10: Th-this is Lady Hsin's power! Then maybe... Arbiter, come with me. Quickly!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_51_11: Leyue leads you to one of the anomalies and explains that it appears to originate from the highest clearance level. There is nothing the Celestials can do but wait for Hsin to repair it Herself. And anomalies like this are far more numerous within the Heart Realms, where Xuanfang's history, culture, projected futures, and the Sentinel's own memories are all stored, all of it answerable only to Hsin the Moon Fox. It is then that you discover the Prism of Fate can restore any Celestial affected by the anomalies.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_1: Incredible! You actually resolved the anomaly here!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_2: Who knew the Prism of Fate was good for this...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_3: I've seen Lady Hsin use a Prism of Fate when She fixed the Sanctum. She said it was Her "backup plan." Now that it's in your hands, that means...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_4: I see it now, Arbiter! Maybe... maybe you're the only one who can save Hsin now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_5: The Heart Realms shift with the Sentinel's heart. Countless changes, yet each follows a set rule. If you can find the anomaly, the Realms will return to balance...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_6: Save? What exactly is Hsin the Moon Fox caught up in?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_7: ...I'm sorry. This is as much as I can share.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_8: But if you want to "see" Lady Hsin, this is the quickest way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_9: ...Got it. Finding Hsin the Moon Fox is why I came here in the first place. Tell me what to do.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_10: This is a Realm Key. With it, you can pass through an Inner Threshold into a Heart Realm. We can't activate the keys ourselves... but you can, with the Prism of Fate.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_54_12: Seeing that the Prism of Fate can also calm rampaging Autopuppets, Leyue grows hopeful and pleads with you to "save Lady Hsin." You ask what Hsin is currently entangled in, but Leyue still cannot say. Instead, she hands you a Realm Key and tells you it will grant passage through an Inner Threshold into a Heart Realm, the most direct way to see Hsin.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_55_2: As long as you hold the right key, it will take you deep into a Heart Realm.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_2: I'd say... after what I've gathered, the situation has become clear.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_3: Splitting Her computational power to maintain the Celestial's minds. Remolding the Simulacrum Nexus into lush landscapes...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_4: All of it fits what I know of Hsin the Moon Fox... She is soft on matters of the "human heart."
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_5: And that's precisely why the Fox Shadow's behavior is so strange.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_6: ...You suspect it's not acting on Hsin's will?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_7: Indeed. If that great shadow is the anomaly itself, then what has become of Hsin, who ought to be in control of this place?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_9: A Providence Lock. Should Hsin the Moon Fox seek to do anything against you, it will react.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_10: Why are you giving me this?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_11: Trust it or don't, the choice is yours. I only mean to guard you against the worst.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_12: Tracking the anomalies in the Heart Realms is the obvious first step. But now I have a theory...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_56_14:
Before you go, Suoming tells you what she thinks. The Nexus Fox Shadow may not be acting on Hsin's own will at all. She gives you a Providence Lock, saying it will react if Hsin the Moon Fox seeks to do anything against you. Then she adds that she has a theory of her own to test.
 
The moment she takes out her Vermillion Lock, Mengxuan Vale begins to shake.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_139_1: It's trying to stop me from getting closer. The key must be up ahead.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_139_2: Looks like I can only go this way.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_140_1: The Prism of Fate is resonating with the key...
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_140_2: Has it granted me a new clearance level?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_141_1: This place... looks dead. Like everything's just stopped.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_142_1: Whoa, why did that huge annoying shadow suddenly stop moving?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_142_2: Has Hsin reclaimed more of Her authority? Or... did Suoming do something?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_144_1: This is the only Autopuppet with a kernel.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_145_2: I'll clear out these anomalies first!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_146_1: Hmm. How 'bout using the key's power for this?
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_147_1: This should be the last one.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_147_2: The key is complete. We can leave now.
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_52_2: Arbiter, you bear the Prism of Fate. You should be able to make them stop!
Main_Mengzhou_3_7_53_1: The anomaly still hasn't been dealt with yet... I can't just walk away.
MXXSST_19_8: If that's the case, you should have a little more faith. Do you think Hsin would let the people who stood by Her for a century to remold the Civilization Capsule just fade away?
MXXSST_19_10: Hsin will gather every Celestial's frequency into a Prism of Fate and sustain your existence with Her own computational power. And once the people of Solaris grow strong enough to reach a level of power comparable to a Sentinel's, She'll grant you new bodies.
MXXSST_19_11: You mean... I might still have the chance to witness such a future with my own eyes...?
MXXSST_19_12: If that is so, then there could be nothing more wonderful in all the world. Thank you for telling me this, {PlayerName}.
MXXSST_21_1: I was right there when the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs held that meeting.

MXXSST_21_3: Which means... She's likely taken on just as heavy a burden as She did back then.
MXXSST_21_4: Yes. All we can do is watch Her moods closely, and stay alert for any unexpected shifts in each Heart Realm.
MXXSST_21_5: We need to keep a close eye on the Heart of Bloom. It only regained its stability not long ago...
MXXSST_21_6: Agreed. Let's do all we can to share Her burden.
